title_en: The shaping methods of more stem plant types after a kind of cotton in Xinjiang disaster caused by hail
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of shaping methods of more stem plant types after cotton in Xinjiang disaster caused by hail, include the following steps：Disaster caused by hail Harm is investigated, the cotton management scenario after disaster caused by hail is carried out, excludes field ponding in time, clear up and repair cotton field ridge, irrigation canals and ditches；It 7~1O days after calamity, intertills in time after the basic restoration ecosystem of cotton plant, being loosened the soil by intertillage increases soil and air contact area, divulges information and dissipates moisture in the soil, improves ground temperature；After disaster caused by hail 10 days, when cotton grows young leaves in succession, 10~20ppm gibberellin and foliar fertilizer are sprayed, is spaced 5~7 days, even spray 2~3 times, promotes the growth of cotton leaf branch after disaster caused by hail；Trickle irrigation presses alkali and timely flushing and spreading fertilizer, and every plant of cotton is retained 34 leaf branches from top to bottom, removes remaining leaf branch, is laid a solid foundation to mould more stem plant types；Rationalize control, beat group's point in due course and spray foliar fertilizer in the later stage.The present invention improves the output of cotton after the disaster caused by hail of Xinjiang, and the income for cotton grower escorts.
assignees: INST OF ECONOMY CROP HENAN ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title_en: River ecological flow regulation and control method based on pollution condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river ecological flow regulation and control method based on pollution conditions, which comprises the following steps: acquiring satellite remote sensing image data and ground monitoring value data of a river, and processing the data to obtain water flow characteristic data, historical large-section data and flow data of the regional river; analyzing the water flow characteristic data, the historical large-section data and the flow data, and eliminating useless data; the online river flow is comprehensively analyzed and calculated by acquiring water level height, flow velocity data and section information in real time according to water flow characteristic data, historical large section data and flow data and combining the positions of the upper and lower reaches and the left and right bank test stations. The method can effectively identify the river flow velocity, can conveniently and accurately adjust the river flow velocity, can effectively ensure the normal water supply of the river, maintains the health of a river ecosystem, provides technical support for the restoration and protection of the ecological health of the river, and has good economic and social benefits.
assignees: LANTOGIS ECOLOGICAL TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Can effectively prevent soil erosion and water loss's gardens side slope protective structure for ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a protection structure for ecological restoration of a garden side slope, which can effectively prevent water and soil loss, and comprises a side slope, a water-proof structure and a water-proof layer, wherein planting soil is arranged in the side slope, and a steel wire mesh covers the outer surface of the planting soil; the protective frame is positioned on the outer surface of the side slope, a support frame is arranged at the bottom end of the protective frame, a movable shaft is connected inside the support frame, and windmill blades are arranged on the outer surface of the movable shaft; the concrete skeleton is located the surface of planting soil, the surface of concrete skeleton is provided with keeps off the backplate. This can effectively prevent soil erosion and water loss's gardens side slope protective structure for ecological restoration, the skeleton bottom anchors the wire net to enclose in the skeleton outside after forming and keep off protective frame, can avoid the rainwash side slope to lead to not hard up and the landslide that leads to of earth, also can reduce the destruction that soil erosion and water loss caused to the vegetation simultaneously, thereby increase the coverage of side slope vegetation.
assignees: ZHONG AO ECOLOGICAL ENV CO LTD

title_en: Service recovery priority evaluation method and equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The invention provides a service restoration priority evaluation method and equipment, a storage medium and a product, wherein the service restoration priority evaluation method comprises the following steps: respectively acquiring an RTO (remote terminal operation) evaluation value, an RPO evaluation value, a tolerable minimum QoS (quality of service) evaluation value and a tolerable minimum QoE evaluation value of a target service; and determining the target recovery priority of the target service according to the RTO evaluation value, the RPO evaluation value, the tolerable lowest QoS evaluation value and the tolerable lowest QoE evaluation value. That is, the invention realizes the purpose of establishing disaster recovery priority by introducing the service recovery QoS target and the service recovery QoE target and combining the service recovery QoS target and the service recovery QoE target with the RTO target and the RPO target, thereby ensuring reasonable allocation of disaster recovery resources, establishing a more objective and comprehensive disaster recovery strategy and ensuring the service quality and the experience quality after service recovery to the maximum extent.
assignees: CHINESE TELECOM GROUP SYSTEM INTEGRATED LLC

title_en: Method for determining efficiency evaluation grade of underground water restoration technology in petrochemical polluted site
abstract_en: The application provides a petrochemical pollution site groundwater remediation technology efficiency evaluation grade determining method, device, computer equipment and storage medium, and relates to the technical field of water environment. The method mainly comprises the following steps: acquiring weights and values respectively corresponding to a first parameter, a second parameter and a third parameter of the groundwater remediation technology of the target area; calculating the corresponding association degrees of the first parameter, the second parameter and the third parameter in different repair technology efficiency evaluation grades according to the values; determining membership matrixes respectively corresponding to the first parameter, the second parameter and the third parameter through the association degree; and determining the performance evaluation grade of the groundwater remediation technology according to the membership matrix.

title_en: Evaluation method for influence of dam removal of power station on habitat quality based on fish protection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating influence of a power station dam removal based on fish protection on the quality of a habitat in the technical field of river ecological restoration of hydropower development, which comprises the steps of constructing an evaluation system for restoring river fish protection objects, and obtaining scores and weights of all evaluation indexes; quantitatively evaluating the repaired river fish through the scores and the weights of the evaluation indexes to determine target fish to be protected; acquiring hydraulic preference of each life stage of the target fish; the method comprises the steps of obtaining habitat hydraulic parameters corresponding to hydraulic preferences before and after dam disassembly by constructing a water-sand transportation model and performing hydrodynamic simulation, and constructing a fish habitat quality assessment model before and after dam disassembly by utilizing the habitat hydraulic parameters and the fish habitat model; and quantitatively evaluating the habitat quality of the target fish in each life stage before and after dam disassembly. The method realizes quantitative evaluation of the influence of the dam removal on the habitat quality of the fish in the key life stage, and provides scientific basis for dam removal and river ecological restoration.
assignees: SHANGHAI INVESTIGATION DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Disaster backup migration method and system for computing power network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster recovery migration method for a computing power network, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a master node obtains a mode of a current application process and a state of a container in a Kubernetes cluster, the obtained mode of the application process is switched to a check point mode, in the check point mode, check point/restoration CRIU software in a user space is used for converting the state of the container in the obtained Kubernetes cluster into a container group Pod state image file, the master node uses Ceph reliable autonomous distributed object storage block device Ceph RBD to convert the Pod state image file into a Pod backup file which simultaneously comprises Pod state information and persistent data volume backup, the current backup node obtains the Pod backup file from the master node and cold-loads the Pod backup file, the Pod backup file is migrated to a target cluster, and the target cluster uses the obtained Pod backup file to realize Pod restoration in the Kubernetes cluster. The method can solve the technical problem that the existing cross-regional deployment method occupies excessive computing power resources due to repeated deployment of the application and the service at different geographic positions.

title_en: Power supply recovery analysis method for active power distribution network source network load storage synergy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power restoration analysis method of active power distribution network load storage synergy, which comprises the following steps of S1, respectively constructing a distributed power supply model, an energy storage device model and a load characteristic model, S2, constructing a source storage combined output model based on the distributed power supply model and the energy storage device model, S3, determining a priority power supply load based on the load characteristic model, S4, forming an island network by using a distributed power supply after failure, restoring important load power supply, S5, constructing a power distribution network fault restoration model, optimizing by using a genetic algorithm, restoring and reconstructing other power loss loads, and carrying out power restoration in two stages.
assignees: XUCHANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Sliding door with earthquake-proof strike
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a sliding door with an earthquake-proof strike that does not bring about damage to a thumb turn and other components, allows unlocking readily, enables prompt and safe evacuation, and avoids unexpected situations such as a user being locked in, even when an interlayer deformation occurred due to an earthquake, etc.SOLUTION: A sliding door 15 with an earthquake-proof strike includes a frame member 2, a sliding door member 3, a strike 11, a hook lock 12, a base 16, a guide member 17, a stroke adjustment member 18, and a compression spring (energizing member) 19. When the sliding door member 3 moves toward a door tail at a time of an interlayer deformation of the frame member 2 in the door tail direction, the strike 11 may be separated from the base 16 and moved toward the door tail, while resisting energizing force derived from restoration power generated when the compression spring 19 is compressed. Thus, increase in lateral pressure from a tip part 13a of a sickle-shape member 13 of the hook lock 12 on an inner surface 11e of the strike 11 is mitigated, thereby allowing the lock to be unlocked.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Offshore housing unit
abstract_en: To solve the problem that it is difficult for residents who cannot live in a house due to an earthquake, a tsunami, a fire, or the like to secure a lodging place for a restoration worker because the residents cannot go to a house with electricity and water while being safe against an aftershock and a tsunami and protecting privacy.SOLUTION: A wooden artificial island is floated on the sea adjacent to the land, a plurality of dwellings are installed on the wooden artificial island, and the wooden artificial island is fixed by setting a concrete guide on the sea adjacent to the land, passing a log connected to the wooden artificial island through the concrete guide, and stopping the wooden artificial island with two wooden stoppers so that the wooden artificial island does not move in the horizontal direction (left, right, front, and back) but can move in the vertical direction to cope with the ebb and flow of the tide.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Facility management system
abstract_en: The present invention determines evacuation sites for maintenance workers in the occurrence of a disaster for the purpose of early restoration of equipment installed in customer facilities. This facility management system has: a current location information collection unit (21) for collecting current location information of maintenance workers using a GPS function of portable terminals (4) in the occurrence of a disaster; a damage condition information acquisition unit (23) for collecting damage condition information indicating damage conditions of equipment installed in each building (1) in the disaster; an evacuation information generation unit (25) for generating, from the current locations of the maintenance workers and the damage conditions of the equipment, evacuation information indicating evacuation sites for each maintenance worker for the purpose of early restoration of the equipment; and an evacuation site instruction unit (26) for transmitting the evacuation information to the respective portable terminals (4) so as to indicate the branch office (3) to be used as an evacuation site for each maintenance worker.
assignees: MITSUBISHI ELEC BUILDING TECHN;MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC CORP

title_en: Power connection control system and method
abstract_en: For each of consumers, a connection control apparatus is provided that includes an opening/closing device capable of connecting or disconnecting an electric power system and a consumer, that, when a power outage occurs in the electric power system, disconnects the electric power system and the consumer from each other by the opening/closing device at a command from an outage management apparatus or the like, and that connects the electric power system and the consumer to each other by the opening/closing device upon receiving a command from the outage management apparatus or the like at the time of restoration from the power outage. A power supply control apparatus supplies electric power from energy provision equipment to electrical appliances during a power outage in the electric power system.

title_en: Power distribution network multiple target fault recovery method based on hybrid algorithm
abstract_en: A kind of novel mixed fault recovery game, includes the following steps：1) initial parameter is inputted；2) initial matrix is established；3) initial disaggregation is searched for；4) power verifies；5) networking amendment；6) type load partitioning algorithm convergence is examined；7) a type load division result is exported；8) algorithm transition；9) quanta particle swarm optimization parameter setting；10) initialization of quanta particle；11) object function calculates；12) parameter updates；13) positional value and optimal vector update；14) non-domination solution screens；15) elite collects screening；16) operation is eliminated；17) quanta particle swarm optimization test for convergence；18) result exports.The characteristics of present invention combination heuritic approach and intelligent optimization algorithm, proposes mixed fault restoration methods, solves the problems, such as that the distribution network failure containing DG restores.

title_en: Log model-based power grid operation and maintenance compound method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid operation and maintenance restoration method based on a log model, which belongs to the technical field of power grid operation and maintenance and comprises the specific steps of (1) receiving log data and classifying the log data, (2) establishing a fault knowledge base and extracting information from the fault log, (3) self-matching the log data and recommending corresponding operation and maintenance schemes, (4) updating data of a scheme list according to staff, (5) receiving user feedback information and updating related operation and maintenance schemes, and the method can extract keywords in the log and match the keywords, improve the log matching rate, improve the computer data processing efficiency, update the fault knowledge base in real time, improve the use experience of staff, improve the fault processing rate of the staff, save the maintenance time of the staff, and simultaneously optimize and update according to the user requirements, and improve the fault tolerance of the scheme.

title_en: Power consumption data restoration method and system based on Bayesian Gaussian tensor decomposition model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of data restoration, and discloses a power consumption data restoration method and a power consumption data restoration system based on a Bayesian tensor decomposition model, which are used for collecting weather, holidays, week types and power consumption data, constructing weather factors, holiday factors and week factors, and constructing a similarity objective function according to the weather factors, the holiday factors and the week factors; optimizing the similarity objective function by using a Trojan optimization algorithm, and searching M similarity days with the highest similarity with the repair day in the history days; and constructing a third-order tensor by using the electricity consumption data of M similar days with the highest similarity, and inputting the third-order tensor into a Bayesian Gaussian tensor decomposition model to carry out data restoration. According to the invention, the improved Trojan optimization algorithm is adopted to select similar days, and incomplete data is restored by inputting the similar days into the Bayesian Gaussian tensor decomposition model, so that the restoration accuracy is improved, the data quality is improved, and the accuracy of behaviors such as prediction and the like is improved.

title_en: Risk multilink conduction method for water resource system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource system risk multi-link conduction method, which mainly comprises the following steps. The method comprises the steps of collecting risk element data in a researched area and carrying out standardized processing on the risk element data, constructing a water resource system risk link by utilizing relevance among the risk elements, defining a risk conduction mechanism, namely a ① risk opening stage, describing simple mechanism of risk conduction and opening conditions of risks, ② resistance threshold action, describing resistance capability of the system in risk conduction, revealing the risk conduction mechanism and the resistance threshold action of the risk links with different structures according to the conduction characteristics of the risk links, ③ restoration threshold action, namely natural restoration force and social restoration force, enabling the risks not to exist all the time, defining a risk restoration action, ④ threshold updating calculation, namely the resistance capability and restoration capability to be improved, and updating a threshold value, and a ⑤ risk suspension stage, namely deducing conditions of risk suspension according to the risk conduction, wherein ⑥ risk strength and conduction speed relation, namely the greater risk disturbance strength and the higher risk conduction speed are. By exploring a risk link conduction mechanism, the water resource risk assessment system under complex conditions is perfected.

title_en: Automatic operation and maintenance method and system suitable for closed system
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic operation and maintenance method and system suitable for a closed system. The method aims to solve the technical problem that the traditional operation and maintenance scheme is difficult to apply due to network isolation and sample scarcity in closed environments such as finance, energy sources and the like. The method comprises the steps of generating unique and traceable migration identifications for all operation and maintenance data, models and reasoning results through a data and migration treatment module, quantitatively calculating migration scores between a source domain and a target domain through a migration evaluation module, dynamically selecting an optimal model migration strategy according to the migration scores to achieve efficient self-adaptation of the models, executing closed-loop operation and maintenance through a multi-agent cooperation system comprising detection, diagnosis and restoration agents, and achieving self-learning and self-optimization of the system through small sample active learning and knowledge base evolution mechanisms. The invention realizes the rapid construction, continuous evolution and whole process traceability of the artificial intelligence operation and maintenance capability in the closed system, and has remarkable innovation and industrial application value.

title_en: Fire extinguishing water spray nozzle clamping device for fire extinguishing in buildings
title_ko: 건축물 화재진화용 소화용수 분사노즐 클램핑장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire extinguishing water spray nozzle clamping device for extinguishing a fire in a building, which can absorb shock and vibration, and prevent an accident, comprising: a pair of ceiling supports; a pair of internal fixtures separately disposed inside the ceiling supports; a pair of lower fixtures disposed at a lower part of the ceiling supports; an internal partition; a pair of external cushioning restoration members; a pair of internal cushioning restoration members; and a horizontal connector.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물 화재진화용 소화용수 분사노즐 클램핑장치에 관한 것으로서, 천장에 배치되는 소화용수 공급관의 하부에 간격을 두고 분사노즐이 배치되고, 상기 분사노즐이 위치하는 천장에는 건축물 화재시 상기 소화용수 공급관에서 공급되는 소화용수를 분사하는 분사노즐을 고정 및 지지할 수 있도록 분사노즐 클램핑장치가 각각 장착되되, 상기 분사노즐 클램핑장치는 상기 분사노즐을 기준으로 양측에 간격을 두고 배치되고, 상부 끝단에는 수평방향으로 지지구 결합홈과 수직방향으로 간격을 두고 체결공이 형성된 상부 천장 연결부가 형성되며, 하부에는 내측 수평방향으로 내측 수평 지지구가 형성되는 한 쌍의 천장 지지구; 상기 천장 지지구의 내부에 각각 배치되고, 상부에는 지지구 결합홈에 끼움 결합되면서 상기 천장 지지구의 체결공에 결합되는 체결구와 결합될 수 있도록 체결공이 형성되는 상부 수평 고정부가 형성되며, 하부에는 수평방향으로 하부 고정구와 결합을 위한 하부 끼움 결합홈과 수직방향으로 간격을 두고 체결공이 형성되는 하부 수평 고정부가 형성되는 한 쌍의 내부 고정구; 상기 천장 지지구의 하부에 배치되고, 상부에는 상기 천장 지지구의 내측 수평 지지구 상부와 상기 내부 고정구의 하부 내측 수평부의 사이에 형성된 공간에 삽입되는 하부 고정 수평부가 형성되며, 하부에는 수평방향으로 수평 연결구를 결합을 위한 하부 끼움 결합홈과 수직방향으로 간격을 두고 체결공이 형성되는 하부 내측 수평부가 형성되는 한 쌍의 하부 고정구; 상기 하부 고정구의 내측에 각각 배치되고, 수직바를 기준으로 상부 외측과 내측에 상기 하부 내측 수평부의 하부 끼움 결합홈에 결합되는 수평 구획돌기와 수평 지지돌기가 형성되며, 상기 수직바를 기준으로 외측과 내측에는 외측 공간과 내측 공간이 형성되는 내부 구획구; 상기 내부 구획구의 외측 공간에 배치되고, 상부에는 수평 구획돌기와 하부 끼움 결합홈에 삽입되는 외부 수평돌기가 형성되며, 상기 외부 수평돌기의 끝단에는 수직 지지부가 형성되는 한 쌍의 외부 완충복원부재; 상기 내부 구획구의 내측 공간에 배치되고, 내부에는 상기 분사노즐이 관통하는 노즐 관통홈이 형성되는 한 쌍의 내부 완충복원부재; 상기 하부 고정구의 하부 끼움 결합홈에 끝단이 결합되고 중앙에는 상기 분사노즐이 관통할 수 있도록 분사노즐 관통공이 형성되는 수평 연결구;를 포함한다.

title_en: pressure drop recovery system
abstract_en: Present invention is disclosed a kind of pressure drop recovery system.The pressure drop recovery system includes：Equipment restoration schedule module, there is provided equipment recovers priority；Risk analysis module, the risk class of impacted product is assessed, there is provided real-time risk class；Product treatment module, according to it is described in real time risk class impacted product is handled, and with the risk analysis module real-time, interactive, to update the real-time risk class；And whether health degree monitoring module, the equipment after monitoring recovers are normal.The pressure drop recovery system of the present invention can efficiently realize that the plant produced after power failure is recovered.
assignees: SEMICONDUCTOR MFG INTERNATIONAL CORPORATION SHANGHAI CO LTD;SEMICONDUCTOR MFG INT BEIJING CORP

title_en: Simultaneous line loss abnormal data restoration method based on singular value decomposition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for repairing synchronous line loss abnormal data based on singular value decomposition in the field of power system line loss data management. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a same-period line loss electric quantity matrix in a mode of taking a row by day and taking a column by month according to historical operating data, and carrying out standardized processing; identifying the data type of the line loss abnormality in the same period based on a threshold analysis method; replacing and repairing the constant abnormal data based on a spline regression model, and updating the line loss electric quantity matrix at the same period; splitting the updated same-period line loss electric quantity matrix into a normal matrix A and an abnormal matrix E, and performing singular value decomposition on A; and establishing a synchronization line loss abnormal data restoration model based on a robust component analysis method, and performing iterative optimization on the matrix A to restore abnormal data. The method for repairing the synchronous line loss abnormal data based on the singular value decomposition can realize the repair of different types of abnormal data, is high in repair accuracy and high in speed, and can be used for online repair of the synchronous line loss abnormal data.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Data statistical method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a data statistical method, a device, equipment and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring data to be counted uploaded by each data acquisition department; wherein the data to be counted comprises at least one of the following items: the method comprises the following steps of (1) overload line rectification condition, heavy load line rectification condition, highest load growth rate, highest load after daily restoration of the highest load, daily average load, load peak-valley difference, maintenance of distribution network and no forced peak load shifting; counting the data to be counted according to a preset counting method to obtain a counting result; wherein the statistical method comprises at least one of screening, ranking and summarizing; and responding to the query operation of the user, and displaying the statistical result to the user. The embodiment of the invention realizes automatic statistics of the data to be counted, reduces manual intervention, improves the working efficiency and the accuracy of the data, supports the user to inquire the statistical result, and is favorable for finding out the weak link of distribution network operation in time.
assignees: DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Optimal recovery path based on distributed power supply and black start strategy
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of operation control of an electric power system, and particularly relates to an optimal recovery path and a black start strategy based on a distributed power supply. The invention comprises the following steps: based on the distributed power supply, the performance and the distribution of important loads of the distributed power supply are considered, and the power distribution network is subjected to island division; providing an improved mathematical model of the island division; realizing an island division strategy by using a power supply recovery sequence optimal method; performing recovery path optimization calculation on the distributed power supply to make the recovery path of the distributed power supply shortest; and optimizing the load recovery path by utilizing the load recovery sequence of the improved hybrid particle swarm algorithm to obtain a global black start strategy. The method can obviously improve the success rate and the recovery efficiency of the black start, recover as many important loads as possible, increase the recovery amount of the total load, and ensure that the island after power supply recovery can stably operate.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power supply master-slave networking pre-decision method for power grid power supply restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply master-slave networking pre-decision method facing power supply restoration of a power grid in the technical field of power supply restoration of a power system, which comprises the steps of dividing a power supply into a v/f control power supply and a non-v/f control power supply according to power supply control capability, and searching power supplies in a power supply range by taking each v/f control power supply as a starting point to form a networking sub-scheme set to be verified; acquiring power supply data parameters; checking networking sub-schemes in the networking sub-scheme set to be checked according to the power supply data parameters to obtain a networking sub-scheme set meeting constraint conditions, wherein the constraint conditions are short-circuit capacity ratio and inertial constraint; evaluating expected recovery net benefit and load recovery capacity of networking sub-schemes in the networking sub-scheme set meeting constraint conditions; and arranging the networking sub-schemes in descending order according to the expected net return of the networking sub-schemes to obtain a plurality of groups of power system networking schemes. The invention can combine the control capability, parameters, power grid topological structure and other information of the power supply, adapt to power failure faults in different scenes and decide an optimal networking scheme.

title_en: Intelligent collaborative decision-making method for power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution systems, in particular to an intelligent collaborative decision-making method of a power distribution system, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting sampling frequency, uploading delay and data integrity identification of sensing nodes of each subarea, analyzing consistency of an operation data structure, identifying time alignment defects or logic coupling faults and generating a heterogeneous drift characteristic map, S2, reconstructing control input by combining historical data, a topology mechanism and boundary rules to generate a data consistency control input set, and S3, constructing and distributing a collaborative strategy based on the input set, a scheduling target and system constraint to realize intelligent collaborative regulation. According to the invention, by constructing the isomerism drift characteristic map, reconstructing the space-time consistency operation data and generating the collaborative strategy set with self-adaptive execution capacity, the accurate identification, effective restoration and intelligent collaborative regulation and control of the power distribution system under the condition of inconsistent data are realized.
assignees: BEIJING NORTH STAR TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Watershed ecological restoration measure configuration optimization method based on multi-objective cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a watershed ecological restoration measure configuration optimization method based on multi-objective coordination, which is used for respectively calculating water storage benefits, ecological restoration measure corrosion reduction benefits and watershed different ecological restoration measures pollution reduction benefits of watershed different ecological restoration measures according to basic data; and solving and optimizing the multi-objective constraint condition by using an NSGA-II optimization algorithm to obtain a Pareto front of an optimized solution. The optimization method not only reserves the calculation stability of a mature optimization algorithm, but also remarkably improves the simulation efficiency and the result precision, and can effectively avoid the problems of large simulation deviation and low convergence speed in the traditional method through the verification of actual river basin data.

title_en: Ammeter historical data restoration method based on multidimensional association relation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ammeter historical data restoration method based on multidimensional association relation, which relates to the technical field of power data management and intelligent restoration, the invention realizes the accuracy and traceability of data restoration by establishing a multisource abnormality type library and an element time-varying degradation model, predefines a plurality of abnormality mode combinations and corresponding restoration strategies aiming at multisource data conflict, locates a fault source through the mode matching of a real-time index and the abnormality type library, the method comprises the steps of selecting reference data by combining historical average deviation rates of a target ammeter and an associated ammeter, avoiding deviation caused by single judgment, determining fault elements of a shunt and an ADC chip aiming at nonlinear degradation, constructing a resistance degradation model and a conversion error model, calculating a theoretical correction value, optimizing a result by a machine learning model trained by historical normal data, and simultaneously storing original readings, model parameters and calculation basis in an associated mode to form a traceable log, so that repair accuracy is guaranteed.
assignees: NANJING TIANSU AUTOMATION CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent protection device for forest breeding in ecological restoration of geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent protection device for wood breeding in ecological restoration of geological disasters, which relates to the technical field of ecological environment management and comprises a multidirectional impact-resistant base, a rotary connecting device, a plurality of anchoring mechanisms, a control adjusting device, a dynamic protection device, an auxiliary adjusting device and a control adjusting device, wherein the multidirectional impact-resistant base is horizontally arranged and fixed in a soil layer, wood seedlings are planted in the middle of the soil layer, the rotary connecting device is fixed at the top of the multidirectional impact-resistant base, the anchoring mechanisms are annularly distributed and provided with a plurality of anchoring mechanisms, the anchoring mechanisms are fixed at the outer side of the rotary connecting device and correspond to the vertexes of the multidirectional impact-resistant base, the control adjusting device is fixed at the top of the rotary connecting device, the dynamic protection device is fixed on the control adjusting device, and the auxiliary adjusting device is movably arranged at the top of the dynamic protection device and is fixedly connected with the control adjusting device through a telescopic arc plate. The intelligent impact-resistant protection device disclosed by the invention realizes intelligent impact-resistant protection under the complex terrain and dynamic geological conditions of the geological disaster area, simultaneously has an ecological restoration function, and remarkably improves the protection effect and ecological benefit of forest breeding in a geological disaster scene.
assignees: HENAN PROVINCE NATURAL RESOURCES MONITORING AND STATE SOIL REGULATION INST

title_en: Disaster preventive self-supporting type support system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the problems of being essential in aiming at strengthening a non-support restoration system in wide area disaster time, in being not necessarily safe and assured in the evacuation movement (evacuation passage risk) due to being hardly rescued in a wide area disaster, in being unavoidable in delaying recovery to normalization of a life when evacuated, and in maintaining a life standard (such as a toilet, face-washing and bathing) together with eating and drinking when staying in one's own home.SOLUTION: Water taken from underground is temporarily stored in a water storage case, and is pressurized by a manual water supply pump fixed to a case bottom part, and is branched off via a water supply hose, and can be used by supplying the water to a faucet fixed by a faucet fixing assembly of respective stories. The inexhaustible light and water received from the natural world are take out and stored, so that even if an infrastructure maintained in a present society is stopped, a minimum daily life is maintained, and a restoration period can be shortened.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Maintenance management system
abstract_en: To provide a service appropriate to restore a house to its original state.SOLUTION: The present invention relates to a maintenance management system used to calculate the cost for restoring a building damaged by generation of disasters to its original state, and the maintenance management system includes a server 1. The server 1 includes a maintenance management unit 43, a damage information acquisition unit 46, a damage determination unit 47, and an original restoration cost calculation unit 48. The maintenance management unit 43 manages, as maintenance management information, the history of works done to a house to maintain and manage the house which include at least a part of inspection, maintenance, repair, and renovation at regular intervals. The damage information acquisition unit 46 acquires information of damages on the house associated with the disasters. The damage determination unit 47 determines the locations and the degree of damages on the house by the disasters on the basis of the maintenance management information and the information of damages. The original restoration cost calculation unit 48 calculates the cost for restoring the house to its original state on the basis of the maintenance management information and the locations and the degree of damages on the house.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Power consumption emergency management system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a power consumption emergency management system, comprising: an emergency information acquisition module, used for acquiring emergency information from a marketing and distribution information integration platform; a statistics module, used for collecting statistics about affected customers according to a power failure; an emergency kit maintenance module, used for maintaining and updating emergency kit information of customers; an emergency service module, used for starting a corresponding customer emergency service according to the emergency information, comprising: starting a power failure notification module to send power failure notification information to the customers, starting a customer service module to receive emergency information reported by the affected customers, and starting an emergency resource allocation module according to the emergency information and the emergency kit information of the customers to allocate resources for the affected customers and arrange for restoration of power supply; an emergency service monitoring module, used for acquiring, in real time, an emergency condition reported by an emergency personnel and dynamically updating the condition; and a power restoration notification module, used for sending power restoration notification information to the customers. According to the present invention, emergency processing is performed on customers according to information of the customers, thereby improving the level of customer emergency management.

title_en: Green value coordinated electric power market operation simulation deduction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power market operation simulation deduction system with a cooperative green value, which relates to the technical field of green energy, and comprises a characteristic record extraction module, a deviation range calculation module, a data correction module and an early warning prompt module, wherein the characteristic record extraction module is used for obtaining a historical carbon emission record of an electric power enterprise, extracting the characteristic record from the carbon emission record according to the carbon content and the generated energy in the carbon emission record, the deviation range calculation module is used for analyzing the carbon content and the generated energy change in the characteristic record to obtain a deviation range, the data correction module is used for obtaining the current carbon emission record and obtaining data with abnormal carbon content and correcting the data, and the early warning prompt module is used for judging whether to early warn a data correction technology according to the corrected virtual carbon content. According to the invention, by summarizing the historical carbon emission rules, the current carbon content correction data is analyzed, and whether the current data correction technology needs to be prompted is judged, so that the accuracy and the rationality of current data restoration are improved.

title_en: Vessel seaway and maneuverability supporting system for safety evacuation seaway in event of vessel accident based on evacuation level determination using real-time restoration index, and method thereof
title_ko: 실시간 복원성 지수를 이용한 대피 레벨 결정 기반 선박 사고시 안전한 대피를 지원하기 위한 선박 항로 및 선박 조종 지원 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 실시간 복원성 지수를 이용한 대피 레벨 결정 기반 선박 사고시 안전한 대피를 지원하기 위한 선박 항로 및 선박 조종 지원 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명은 선박의 이상 상황 발생 및 사고 상황에서 피해를 최소화하기 위한 지원 정보를 선박 내 결정권자에게 전달, 판단력이 떨어질 수 있는 긴급한 상황에서보다 안전하고 정확한 정보를 제공하여, 비상상황을 대처할 수 있는 효과를 제공한다. 또한, 여객선을 포함한 선박 비상 사태 발생시, 신속하고 정확한 선장의 선박 운항 의사결정을 위한 선박 대피 안내 지원 및 음성과 시각적 안내를 통한 인명 대피 안내를 제공할 수 있는 효과를 제공한다. 
또한, 저전력 무선통신기술 기반으로 선내 이상 상태 조기 감지 및 선박과 승객 대피레벨 신속히 결정할 수 있도록 하기 위한 선박 사고시 안전한 대피를 지원할 수 있는 효과를 제공한다. 뿐만 아니라, 사고 지점 중심 해황(sea state)·항행(sailing) 환경 정보를 포함한 긴급대피안내 통합 운용할 수 있도록 하기 위한 선박 사고시 안전한 대피를 지원할 수 있는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Phased network formation for power restoration
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a device receives a router advertisement message after a power outage event in a network. The device joins the network, in response to receiving the router advertisement message. The device sends a power restoration notification message via the network. The device selectively delays a disconnected node from joining the network.

title_en: Storage aggregate restoration
abstract_en: One or more techniques and/or systems are provided for controlling restoration of a storage aggregate. For example, a local storage device, located at a first storage site, and a remote storage device, located at a second storage site, may be assigned to a first storage aggregate. Responsive to a disaster of the first storage site, a gate may be created for the local storage device. The gate may block automated reconstruction and/or automated synchronization that may otherwise occur with respect to the local storage device. Until the local storage device is restored, the remote storage device may be used to service I/O requests that were otherwise directed to the local storage device. Responsive to receiving a user restoration command, the gate may be removed from the local storage device. Synchronization between the local storage device and the remote storage device may then be facilitated.

title_en: Road restoration block
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a road restoration block for covering eliminated pavements during various road constructions conducted by eliminating some of or the entire existing road pavements, and more specifically, to a road restoration block, which can quickly and safely cover the eliminated pavements by providing blocks that are simply carried, disposed, and disassembled with strong coupling power to the upper part of the eliminated pavements so that people and cars may pass even when the constructions are in progress, thereby providing a safe and pleasant construction environment by preventing the traffic congestion caused by the constructions.; Further, the invention may maximize cost reduction for construction companies by preventing the increase of construction costs and waste of resources caused by temporary pavement works (provisional pavement works) that are currently in operation, and improve the construction quality and prevent poor construction. Consequently, the invention promotes reduction in the national budget, and is usable for emergent road restoration in case of national disaster and thus the safety and wealth of people can be protected.

title_en: Low-voltage power grid first-aid repair, operation and maintenance management method and system combining real-time power failure and power restoration information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage power grid emergency maintenance operation and maintenance management method combining real-time power failure and power restoration information, which is characterized in that the occurrence of a power failure and power restoration event is sensed in real time by combining a real-time power failure and power restoration research and judgment result, the actual personnel in the corresponding area are positioned by utilizing an operator GPS or a network equipment base station to accurately sense the personnel affected by the power failure event, the progress feedback of emergency maintenance personnel and the verification of the power restoration event are combined, the emergency maintenance condition is pushed to the actual affected user in real time, the accurate and humanized pushing of information is realized, the service quality is improved, and the occurrence of complaint events is reduced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;WUHU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Highway maintenance passageway fire control water generator circulating oil cooling device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circulating oil cooling device of a fire-fighting water generator for an expressway access passage, which comprises a shell and a generator body, wherein the left side and the right side of the front surface of the shell are fixedly connected with mounting blocks, the left side and the right side of the back surface of the generator body are fixedly connected with a matching plate, the matching plate and the mounting blocks are in plug connection, the inner side of the matching plate is provided with a fixing mechanism, and the inner side of the matching plate is movably connected with the mounting blocks through the fixing mechanism. Through setting up the installation piece on the casing for the board that joins in marriage on installation piece and the generator body is pegged graft, and join in marriage and set up fixed establishment on the board, the pulling pull rod, make the spring that the arm-tie compression was played the intracavity, and the kelly on the arm-tie breaks away from the installation piece, has still set up the pivoted peg on the pull rod, the peg can hang on the peg on joining in marriage the board after through the upset, during the installation, only need insert the back, take off the peg, the installation can be accomplished in the spring restoration, loading and unloading are convenient.
assignees: SICHUAN YAKANG EXPRESSWAY LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY;LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY FOR EXPRESSWAY IN TIBETAN AREA OF SICHUAN

title_en: Method and device for automatically studying and judging power failure event progress
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for automatically studying and judging the progress of a power failure event, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the work order information of the current power failure event of the power failure information pool; acquiring real-time data information matched with the current power failure event from an automatic system associated with a power failure information pool according to the work order information; determining the progress of the current power failure event according to the real-time data information; wherein the automation system comprises one or more of a dispatch automation system, a distribution automation system, and a metering automation system. Therefore, the method and the device can study and judge the progress of the power failure event in real time, and improve the real-time performance and the accuracy of power failure and power restoration monitoring.

title_en: Disaster area loss analysis method, device and medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to disaster detection technology and discloses a disaster area loss analysis method and device based on an unmanned plane and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of cruising shooting a disaster area to be detected by using the unmanned plane to obtain real-time laser data, real-time radar data and real-time aerial shooting data, and carrying out point cloud difference analysis, point cloud restoration and three-dimensional modeling on the real-time laser data and historical laser data to obtain a change model group; and carrying out differential interference analysis on the real-time radar data and the historical radar data to obtain an interference phase diagram group, carrying out parallax analysis on the real-time aerial data and the historical aerial data, and carrying out comprehensive loss analysis on the disaster area to be detected according to the variation block diagram group, the interference phase diagram group and the variation block group to obtain a disaster area damage result. The method can be applied to the disaster detection field, can realize triple contrast disaster detection according to the three-dimensional model, the radar data and the two-dimensional image, and improves the disaster detection efficiency.
assignees: MINTAIAN INSURANCE LOSS ADJUSTERS CO LTD

title_en: Automatic power restoration method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic power restoration method, an automatic power restoration device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of power application. The automatic power restoration method comprises the following steps: searching a power grid at the upper stage by taking the current bus where the equipment to be powered back is located as a starting point, and searching to obtain a target bus with voltage; constructing a corresponding candidate power supply path based on a node between the current bus and the target bus; the optimal power supply path of the equipment to be powered back is determined according to the power supply path length of each candidate power supply path, so that automatic power back is carried out on the equipment to be powered back according to the optimal power supply path, the problem that the optimal power back path is difficult to comb when large-area equipment is powered off is solved, rapid combing and rapid power back of the optimal power back path of the equipment are realized, switching operation of a main network regulator is reduced, and economic loss and social influence are reduced.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact type power-off and power-on detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact type power outage and restoration detection system, which relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid detection and comprises an application layer, a module processing layer, a protocol layer, a driving layer and a hardware layer, wherein the application layer comprises an uplink communication module, a data acquisition module, a data storage module and a parameter storage module, the data storage module and the parameter storage module form a storage module, the storage module is also in interactive connection with a user layer interface, the module processing layer is used for processing a carrier module, and the protocol layer comprises a data processing module, an RS-485 communication protocol, a data acquisition module, a phase identification module, a power failure identification module, a data storage module, a protocol uploading management module and a dog feeding module. According to the non-contact type power outage and restoration detection system, the non-contact type power outage and restoration detection device and the power outage and restoration position accurate identification method are researched, power outage data acquisition, arrangement and analysis work of the tail end power grid are achieved, data support is provided for application of the intelligent power distribution network big data technology, the actual effect of a power grid feedback link can be further enhanced, and a user can obtain more accurate and high-quality power service.

title_en: Method, device, equipment, medium and product for determining post-disaster power system restoration scheme
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product for determining a post-disaster power system restoration scheme, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a virtual power plant node model, post-disaster traffic topology and communication constraint of a post-disaster power system; the method comprises the steps of establishing an energy accessibility model between a virtual power plant node and a load node to be repaired according to a virtual power plant node model and a post-disaster traffic topology, determining a task matrix of an emergency repair task according to the energy accessibility model, communication constraint and the loss load condition of the load node to be repaired, establishing a double-layer optimization model according to the dynamic energy state of the node and the emergency repair index of the emergency repair task, solving the double-layer optimization model based on an improved multi-objective evolutionary algorithm and the task matrix, and determining an optimal emergency repair path of an electric power system and a virtual power plant coordination scheme. The intelligent matching and coordinated scheduling of the output of the virtual power plant and the rush-repair task are realized, and the dynamic coordination of the multi-source energy after the disaster and the optimal allocation of the rush-repair task are realized.
assignees: SUQIAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Disaster assessment device, disaster assessment method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a disaster assessment device or the like capable of comprehensively assessing a damage state caused by occurrence of a disaster and a restoration state.SOLUTION: A disaster assessment device 100 includes: a plurality of simulation units 140 to 14-N which executes simulation for damage states of a plurality of events due to occurrence of a disaster; a data conversion unit 150 which converts data representing the damage states being results of each of the simulation results of the plurality of simulation units 140 to 14-N to data representing common social value; and a social value assessment unit 160 which assesses a change of the social value caused by the disaster on the basis of the plurality of pieces of data obtained by the conversion by the data conversion unit 150. Further, the disaster assessment device 100 includes a transmitting and receiving unit 120 which, after occurrence of the disaster, receives disaster occurrence information indicating a scale and occurrence position of the disaster, and damage actual state data representing an actual state value of the damage caused by the disaster and actual circumstances of which have become clear.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3
assignees: NEC CORP;UNIV TOHOKU;NEC SOLUTION INNOVATORS LTD

title_en: System for multi-phase management of a natural disaster incident
abstract_en: A computerized system for multi-phase management of a natural disaster incident is disclosed. In one embodiment of the invention, the computerized system incorporates a pre-incident risk reduction management module, a crisis response management module, and a restoration and rehabilitation management module to correspond to these three distinct phases of managing a natural disaster incident. This multi-phase natural disaster management system can be utilized by private entities, community groups, state, national, and/or international agencies to assist prevention or reduction of damage to human and natural resources in a particular disaster incident. Furthermore, the multi-phase natural disaster management system can assist or enable protection of lives, health, and safety of community members and disaster incident response personnel. A prioritization model in the pre-incident risk management module can take an empirical or subjective weighting factor in evaluating a particular geographic section to optimize disaster prevention and management.

title_en: Method for improving proliferation and releasing survival rate of artificially bred tridacna juvenile mollusks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the proliferation and releasing survival rate of tridacna juvenile mollusk artificially bred. The method comprises the following steps: selecting and treating artificially bred tridacna juvenile mollusks, and transporting to a proliferation and release sea area; the giant clam juvenile mollusk is transferred out of the living water cabin and is half-embedded in a releasing flow 'base' made of calcium carbonate, then the releasing flow 'base' and the embedded giant clam juvenile mollusk are placed into a net cage frame with a cover, the net cage frame is fixed to the sea bottom, the distance between the net cage frame and the flat tide level is 3-15 meters, and the height between the net cage frame and the bottom surface of the sea bed is more than or equal to 30 cm; when giant clams shell grow to be larger than or equal to 6cm, giant clams together with a releasing base are moved out from a net cage frame and placed in a coral reef area with gentle water flow, light intensity of 6000-doped 12,000LX and relatively flat local part to grow, covers are timely cleaned in typhoon seasons, the laterally turned giant clams substrate is restored and fixed, and enemy organisms are removed. The method disclosed by the invention can effectively improve the survival rate of giant clams and provide technical support for giant clam resource proliferation and coral reef ecological restoration in China.

title_en: Geological disaster post-vegetation restoration monitoring method based on high-resolution remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster post-vegetation recovery monitoring method based on high-resolution remote sensing images, which comprises the steps of constructing a fusion type spectrum-vegetation index-texture feature set, uniformly selecting n typical vegetation sample areas in a target area under a clear weather condition, constructing a similar-bagging type integrated learning model, analyzing obvious differences of three types of vegetation of arbor, shrubs and herbaceous plants on vegetation height, single plant vegetation horizontal projection coverage area, root depth and root extension range, and quantitatively analyzing vegetation recovery conditions of the target area by analyzing on-time phase change information of vegetation change rate indexes and vegetation type change rate indexes of remote sensing images of a plurality of continuous time phases, so that accuracy of the method according to pixel classification is effectively improved, accuracy of vegetation quantitative analysis of the target area is greatly improved, and cost of long-term accurate monitoring can be greatly reduced.

title_en: Power grid node recovery priority evaluation method and system in extreme environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid node recovery priority evaluation method and a system under extreme environment, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating and determining disaster influence factors of all nodes according to fault probability of lines in all nodes; the method comprises the steps of determining the output of a unit in each node and the load of the node after being affected by disasters according to disaster influence factors and disaster information of each node, determining the expected recovery benefits after correction of the unit in each node according to the output of the unit in each node and the unit recovery benefits of the unit in each node after being affected by disasters, determining the expected recovery benefits after correction of the load in each node according to the unit recovery benefits of the unit load in each node after being affected by disasters, adding the expected recovery benefits after correction of the unit in each node and the expected recovery benefits after correction of the load to obtain the expected recovery benefits of each node, and determining the recovery priority of each node in a power grid according to the expected recovery benefits of each node. Accurate determination of recovery priority of each node in the power grid is achieved.

title_en: NDVI prediction method and system based on ecological response space diversity of water diversion engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses an NDVI prediction method based on ecological response space diversity of water diversion engineering. The method comprises the steps of firstly, definitely analyzing objects of a water diversion project, secondly, collecting hydrologic element data under a dam after the project is operated and normalized vegetation index NDVI data month by month, thirdly, constructing buffer areas with different radiuses by taking a reservoir dam address as a center, calculating correlation coefficients of hydrologic element data and NDVI indexes of each buffer area, fourthly, constructing a function model F (r) of the variation of the correlation coefficients under different buffer area radiuses, fifthly, calculating a water diversion ecological response range of the reservoir, sixthly, introducing derivative functions of F (r) as geographic weights, and predicting the variation of the NDVI based on an improved space-time geographic weighted regression method. The invention comprehensively considers the change of the hydrological runoff condition and vegetation growth condition after water intake in the water diversion project, can more accurately evaluate the influence range and degree of reservoir water diversion on peripheral vegetation, and provides scientific basis for water diversion ecological response analysis and ecological restoration.

title_en: Degraded high and cold marsh wetland recovery structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a restoration structure of degraded alpine marsh wetland, belonging to the technical field of alpine vegetation restoration, comprising a substrate, wherein a greening mechanism comprises a non-woven fabric bag and a turf layer, a interception groove is embedded and installed at the top of the outer side wall of the substrate, the bottom end of the interception groove is communicated with a water storage tank through a connecting pipe, a spraying assembly comprises a water pump and a rotary spray head, the wetland is greened and restored through the arranged turf layer, the earth surface is solidified, the water and soil loss is reduced, the situations of soil loss, landslide and the like can be prevented, the interception groove is used for collecting rainwater to form a water collection depression, the water and soil loss is reduced, the water conservation capacity of the degraded marsh wetland is improved, the radial source tracing erosion undercutting of a natural water system is reduced, the ecological system function of the degraded alpine marsh wetland is restored, and the rotary spray head is matched with the water pump to carry out auxiliary spraying operation on the turf layer, therefore, the turf layer is irrigated in an auxiliary mode, turf growth is facilitated, and the construction recovery rate is increased.

title_en: Landslide mass side slope ecological restoration structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of ecological restoration structures, and particularly discloses a landslide body side slope ecological restoration structure which comprises a restoration mechanism for carrying out ecological restoration on a side slope surface, an upper fixing mechanism for fixing the upper part of the restoration mechanism and a lower fixing mechanism for fixing the lower part of the restoration mechanism, wherein the restoration mechanism comprises a plurality of water guide strips with triangular longitudinal sections, a protective net and a plurality of planting parts, one ends of the corners of the water guide strips are pressed into the side slope surface, the plane of the opening of the water-diversion strips and the slope surface are the same plane, the planting part is fixed on the two water-diversion strips, the protective net is fixed on the water-diversion strips, one end of the upper fixing mechanism is fixed on the top surface of the side slope, the other end is fixedly connected with the top surface of the water-diversion strips, the lower fixing mechanism is fixed on the ground at the bottom of the side slope, and the lower part of the water diversion strip is fixedly connected, the utility model solves the problem that the side slope is easily influenced by water to cause landslide in the prior art.
assignees: CHONGQING BAJUN XIANGJI IND CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration system for erosion coastal zone
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an erosion coastal zone ecological remediation system, include: constructing a bank-connecting biological reef structure at the bank-connecting position of the coastal zone; a low beach biological reef structure which is built in a low beach area of the coastal zone and is positioned behind the bank-connecting biological reef structure; a first remedial local vegetation planted in a beach area of the coastal zone and located behind the beach biological reef structure; a second remedial earth vegetation planted in a first half portion of a mid-beach area of the coastal zone; a plurality of tidal ditches are constructed in the front half section part of the middle and high beach area of the coastal zone at intervals along the direction vertical to the coastline; constructing a tidal pool in the latter half section of the mid-beach area of the coastal zone; and the ecological reconstruction slope protection is constructed on the sea wall slope protection. The utility model has the advantages of obvious treatment effect, obvious ecological support effect, outstanding disaster reduction effect and the like.

title_en: A kind of load scheduling method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present application discloses a kind of load scheduling method, comprising: obtains daily load prediction curve；According to the prediction load at moment each in daily load prediction curve, total prediction load is calculated；It is equal to total prediction load with the summation of the generated output power at each moment for the first constraint condition；It is equal to the summation of the load restoration amount at each moment with the summation of the load reduction at each moment for the second constraint condition；The corresponding single moment, according to the prediction load at single moment, using power flow equation as third constraint condition；The 4th constraint condition is limited to generated output power；The 5th constraint condition is limited to busbar voltage；It is optimized using the totle drilling cost function for combining load to cut down cost and cost of electricity-generating as objective function, obtains optimum results；According to optimum results, while dispatching generator and load translation；Solves the existing electricity market method of operation, there are no a kind of dispatching methods of consideration load translation, do not provide the user with the chance for carrying out load translation.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;SHENZHEN INSTITUTE OF RESEARCH AND INNOVATION THE UNIV OF HONG KONG

title_en: Lake wetland ecological hydrologic regulation and control method considering dynamic requirements of waiting bird habitat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lake wetland ecological hydrologic regulation method considering the dynamic demand of a waiting bird habitat, which comprises the following steps: (1) Through investigation and analysis of the habitat types of the waiting birds, typical emergent aquatic plants and submerged plants are selected as important habitat factors of the waiting birds; (2) Determining a habitat suitability curve of the typical emergent aquatic plant and the submerged plant; (3) And simulating and evaluating the suitability of the birthday, and calculating an annual average suitability index. According to the method, a bird waiting habitat suitability evaluation model based on hydrodynamic force simulation is constructed, the potential bird waiting habitat area and spatial distribution characteristics are analyzed, the influence degree of the hydrologic process on the bird waiting habitat suitability is quantized, and finally a lake wetland bird waiting habitat simulation and regulation method considering dynamic matching of habitat factors is provided. The invention enriches the system of the method for regulating and controlling the ecological hydrology of the shallow lake wetland, and is helpful for providing references for the operation management and ecological protection restoration of the regulation type lake in the heavy water diversion project.

title_en: Method for evaluating functional toughness of urban multi-mode traffic network under flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaluation method for the functional toughness of an urban multi-mode traffic network under flood disasters. The method comprises the following steps: and acquiring and researching urban road network data, ground public transportation network data and rail public transportation network data, and constructing a multi-mode traffic network structure model. Acquiring POI data to estimate traffic occurrence and attraction of the city, and simulating individual daily trip chains; and fusing the multi-mode traffic network structure model and the individual daily travel chains to construct the multi-mode traffic network function model of the city. According to the space destruction characteristics of the flood disasters, constructing a failure model of the multi-mode traffic network function model based on the structural failure model of the multi-mode traffic network, and evaluating the function toughness of the multi-mode traffic network function model under the flood disasters from the two aspects of passable demands and travel delays. The method can be applied to aspects of disaster prevention and reduction strategy evaluation, post-disaster infrastructure restoration strategy evaluation and the like of pre-disaster engineering and management, and can enhance urban toughness, thereby realizing sustainable development.

title_en: Commercial power restore indicator for sites, such as cellular telecommunications sites
abstract_en: Systems and methods are described herein for determining the restoration of power at a site, such as the restoration of commercial power to a cell site within a telecommunications network. The systems and methods may be utilized to determine whether power is restored at a cell site when a generator is currently or temporarily providing power to the cell site (e.g., during a power outage on a utility grid that provided the power to the cell site), such as by determining the presence of a generator is running alarm message and the absence of a commercial power failure message, among other messages.

title_en: Method and system for protecting privacy in microgrids based on homomorphic encryption algorithm
abstract_en: A method for protecting privacy in microgrids based on a homomorphic encryption algorithm and relates to the technical field of microgrid control includes: designing a distributed cooperative control method for a microgrid based on distributed control theory, to achieve frequency restoration of a microgrid; defining a technical essence of privacy protection and a scope of privacy protection; designing a method for protecting privacy in microgrids based on a homomorphic encryption algorithm according to defined technical essence of privacy protection and scope of privacy protection, and protecting initial and real-time values of each distributed power source in the microgrid from disclosure to neighbor nodes, to achieve a distributed cooperative control objective in the microgrid; and verifying the method for protecting privacy in microgrids based on the homomorphic encryption algorithm through simulation experiments. The method enhances trustworthy monitoring capabilities and privacy security during distributed cooperative operation of microgrids.
assignees: HAINAN RESEARCH INST OF ZHEJIANG UNIVERSITY;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Method for repairing frozen tobacco plants
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for repairing a frozen tobacco plant, which comprises the following steps: 1) removing the disability; 2) selecting and reserving buds; 3) water fertilizer and intertillage management: topdressing for the first time; topdressing for the second time; topdressing for the third time; earthing up and promoting growth; 4) and (4) disease control. The method can well restore and grow the field frozen tobacco plants, the yield of the tobacco leaves can reach more than 90% of the normal yield of the tobacco leaves, and the yield value can reach more than 80% of the normal yield value of the tobacco leaves, thereby effectively ensuring the yield and quality of the tobacco leaves, ensuring the economic benefit and greatly reducing the loss of the tobacco caused by freezing damage. The cured tobacco subjected to freezing disaster restoration has orange appearance quality and color, bright luster, oil content, loose leaf structure and moderate leaf thickness, and is basically not different from normal tobacco leaves.

title_en: A quick hardening method of the soil
title_ko: 토양 속성고결공법
abstract_en: A quick hardening method of soil is provided to stabilize and solidify the ground in a short time at urgent restoration works for the ground or the ground carried away by the floods or ground subsidence or various foundation works. The invention relates to a quick hardening method of soil for quick-hardening soil in a short time for stabilizing and solidifying soil at urgent restoration works for the road or the ground carried away by the floods or ground subsidence or various foundation works, which comprises the steps of: manufacturing a soil mixture(2) by mixing 80~120 weight percent wet sandy soil, 5~50 weight percent water-soluble silicate against the weight of the wet sandy soil, and 20~80 weight percent bond reinforcing agent against the weight of the water-soluble silicate; paving the manufactured soil mixture on the road or the ground(1) required to be restored in the optimum quantity and tamping; perforating many holes at regular intervals according to a diameter of a gas injection pipe(3) to make the gas injection pipe located to the inner bottom of the part where the soil mixture is paved and inserting a gas injection pipe to each hole; and hardening the soil mixture in a short time by supplying carbon dioxide to the gas injection pipe.
abstract_ko:

title_en: A kind of remote sensing image landslide monomer division methods
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of remote sensing image landslide monomer division methods.This method includes：Based on the multispectral image data and dem data of survey region, carry out landslide extraction and obtain the object that comes down；NDVI standard deviation threshold methods are set, resulting landslide object are merged using blending algorithm；Making fused landslide object using the common boundary length threshold between landslide, further fusion obtains the trunk that comes down；And using common boundary account for landslide girth percentage threshold cause landslide trunk merged with the landslide object around it, obtain landslide monomer.The landslide object that can be then obtained extraction according to the landslide monomer division methods of the present invention is divided into landslide monomer one by one, it is to avoid irrational huge landslide areas occur.Especially, rapid evaluation can be carried out to a wide range of landslide disaster caused by earthquake or heavy showers, obtains the area and quantity of landslide disaster, be that emergency management and rescue after calamity and restoration and reconstruction work provide reference.

title_en: Power distribution network collaborative power restoration method and system based on disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster-based collaborative power restoration method and system for a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time supply and demand condition data and network topology constraint information, analyzing and extracting key load node sets and power flow distribution boundary conditions to construct a resource distribution model, and obtaining an optimal distribution strategy by combining power flow analysis and a multi-objective optimization method; and determining temporary power supply network configuration and a capacity allocation scheme by combining temporary equipment access parameters, and further planning a deployment path of the temporary power supply configuration so as to deploy the temporary power supply network to perform cooperative power restoration on the power distribution network.
