The method can rapidly evaluate the supply and demand conditions in the post-disaster environment, optimize resource allocation, ensure key load power supply, improve the recovery efficiency and stability of the power distribution network, and provide an effective solution for rapid recovery of a post-disaster power system.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Method for identifying water-level-fluctuating zone treatment area based on water body inundation frequency and terrain limitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a hydro-fluctuation belt treatment area based on water flooding frequency and topography limitation, which comprises the steps of obtaining a remote sensing image and preprocessing, calculating a normalized water index based on green light and near infrared wave bands in the remote sensing image after preprocessing, setting a threshold value for the water index, extracting water distribution of each period to obtain a binary image of water and non-water of an annual image, calculating the maximum continuous flooding time frequency of the water, dividing an area into frequent flooding areas, alternate flooding areas and low-frequency flooding areas based on the continuous flooding time frequency of the water, obtaining gradient distribution grid images according to a DEM (digital elevation model) calculation gradient, carrying out superposition analysis in an ArcGIS (geographic information system) according to gradient grids, obtaining the alternate flooding areas and the low-frequency flooding areas, and solving the technical problems that the traditional method lacks a treatment area identification flow based on time dynamic flooding information, the selection deviation of the repair areas, the ecological restoration efficiency and the like.

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: The system includes a means for monitoring a power supply state of a base station, a means for counting the number of base stations in power failure, a means for determining a wide area power failure from the number of base stations in power failure, a means for transmitting a standby and fuel supply instruction to an operator when a disaster occurs, a means for tracking a position of an active user in a disaster area, a means for determining an optimum base station restoration order based on a user density, a means for updating a restoration situation in real time, a means for preparing an optimum material supply plan, and a means for notifying an operator of an action plan.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Remote power outage notification
abstract_en: Power outages and restorations at telecommunications subscribers' premises can be automatically detected and reported in a manner that is sensitive to subscriber privacy concerns. A server device receives, from a network terminal device installed at a subscriber premise, an alert that the network terminal device has lost primary power from a power grid. The server device determines a physical address of a location for the network terminal and associates the physical address of the network terminal location with particular power grid equipment. The server device determines whether a power outage of the power grid has occurred and outputs a notification of the power outage associated with the particular power grid equipment when the power outage is determined to occur.
assignees: VERIZON PATENT & LICENSING INC;VERIZON PATENT & LICENSING INC

title_en: Medium-and-long-term load prediction method considering industry relevance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medium-long term load prediction method considering industry relevance. The method of the invention comprises the following steps: firstly, preprocessing industry load data aiming at the problem of large industry load data loss and large data magnitude difference, providing an industry month load data restoration method based on iterative interpolation, restoring month load loss data of a typical industry, and normalizing the load data by adopting a min-max normalization method. On the basis, the industry relevance is analyzed and quantified based on a Shapiro-Wilk test and a pearson correlation coefficient, and the strong correlation industry is screened according to the relevance index. Finally, based on industry load data, air temperature data and industry relevance, long-term memory (Long Short Term Memory, LSTM) neural networks are utilized to predict long-term loads in the industry. The method can realize high-precision medium-long term load prediction by introducing industry relevance analysis.

title_en: Transformer substation anti-seismic toughness rapid evaluation method based on Bayesian neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly evaluating the anti-seismic toughness of a transformer substation based on a Bayesian neural network, which is characterized in that a network model of the transformer substation system is built through a directed acyclic graph, the failure probability of the system is rapidly evaluated based on the passing probability of each path under the condition of determining the reliability of various devices, the restoration sequence of the post-earthquake devices is analyzed through setting function indexes, a function recovery function is determined, and the anti-seismic toughness index is obtained, so that the rapid evaluation of the anti-seismic toughness of the transformer substation system is realized. The method has the advantages that the complex network model is disassembled into the probability and the logic connection relation of each sub-node, the data input quantity and the processing quantity of the network model are greatly reduced, the target probability and the earthquake-resistant level of each sub-node are rapidly output, the probability level of the tested node is accurately and efficiently obtained through analysis and calculation of the probability set of each sub-node in the network model, and the problem of poor convergence of the sampling result is avoided.

title_en: Intelligent maintenance system and method for ecological restoration of side slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent maintenance system and method for ecological restoration of a side slope, and relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, wherein the intelligent maintenance system comprises a data acquisition module, a sensor array deployed from a road network, and an environment monitoring signal, wherein the environment monitoring signal comprises side slope surface displacement, soil humidity, vegetation coverage and rainfall intensity, an emergency preliminary position and severity description are obtained by fusing multi-source input signals, an event judgment module judges whether an event exceeds a single area processing capability or not by adopting a preset threshold value according to the obtained emergency preliminary position and severity description, and if the event exceeds the single area processing capability, state records and position coordinates of ecological restoration equipment in adjacent areas are extracted from a central database; the intelligent maintenance system and the intelligent maintenance method for the ecological restoration of the side slope have the beneficial effects of intelligent monitoring, rapid response and accurate restoration.

title_en: Landslide monitoring device for ecological restoration of mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a landslide monitoring device for mine ecological restoration, which relates to the technical field of mine ecological restoration and comprises a mounting hole and a storage box, wherein the mounting hole is formed in a hillside, a waveguide tube is arranged in the mounting hole, the top of the waveguide tube extends to the upper part of the mounting hole and is fixedly connected with a rain gauge, one side of the waveguide tube is fixedly connected with a detection device, the top of the detection device is fixedly connected with a mounting frame, the inside of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with a photovoltaic panel, the landslide monitoring device for mine ecological restoration is provided with the storage box, a collection hopper and a fixing frame, water and air are sequentially input into a spray tube through a hose, and are sprayed on the surface of the photovoltaic panel through the spray tube, so that the surface of the mounting frame is cleaned and dried, and the cleanliness of the surface of the mounting frame can be guaranteed, and the device can be used for monitoring the mine landslide stably.
assignees: SHAANXI YAOYUAN LYUCHUANG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hybrid power distribution network power restoration control
abstract_en: A power outage restoration system manages a power grid including a plurality of switching devices. The power outage restoration system includes an outage management system having a network model of the power grid. A plurality of local restoration controllers are in communication with the outage management system, and each of the local restoration controllers includes a trim network model associated with a respective area of responsibility.

title_en: Power distribution network fault treatment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network fault treatment method and belongs to the technical field of power network management. A platform comprises a fault information acquisition system, a fault information study and judgment system and a fault clearing and power failure/supply information push system. The method is characterized by acquiring information of faults requested to be cleared, line faults and consumption acquisition faults in an existing 95598 system, a distribution automation management system and a power consumption information acquisition system, after receiving and verifying the information, carrying out equipment locating, fault information screening, line topology analysis, equipment operation information analysis and line switch analysis to determine and display the fault types, places and areas of influence in an existing GIS (geographic information system), guiding fault clearing according to the determined fault results and simultaneously pushing the power failure information and power restoration information to users. The platform and the method can be used for achieving centralized acquisition and advanced automatic study and judgment of existing various fault information, can be used for actively pushing the power failure and power restoration information to the users and can interact with the users.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY CO JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;JIANGSU SUYUAN HIGH TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: The restorative procedure of coal mine small-sized hillock
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of restorative procedures of coal mine small-sized hillock, cut slope shaping including being carried out to hillock, adjust Slope angle value, the finishing of top of the slope platform is then carried out at the top of hillock and carries out multi level slope to hillock side slope；Ramped surfaces embedment Reinforced hook more than the second level step of hillock side slope and second level step；Retaining wall is set in the ramped surfaces of the first order step of hillock side slope, friction pile is set at the platform more than the second level step of hillock side slope and second level step；Pinner on hillock plain stage of slope upper berth.The present invention makes artificial pool form good ecological circulation with hillock restoration of the ecosystem, natural Mud Sediment realizes hillock restoration of the ecosystem as restoration of the ecosystem nutriment by the use of in pool by excavating artificial pool on hillock leading edge level land.Meanwhile artificial pool build after both can provide water source for hillock restoration of the ecosystem, can also be used as hillock or mine fire-fighting water head site.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;INNER MONGOLIA INST OF GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENTAL SURVEY

title_en: A kind of anti-power grid wave propagation system based on frequency converter
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of anti-power grid wave propagation system based on frequency converter, and the major loop of frequency converter is controlled by DCS opened point；Power-off delay relay is accessed in the fault-signal circuit of frequency converter, using the power cut off delay break KT of power-off delay relay as in the logic of frequency conversion fault-signal access DCS opened point control frequency converter start-stop；The process conditions (pressure, temperature etc.) of start-stop frequency converter and frequency conversion fault-signal are and door relationship.Situations such as present invention can be according to state and temperature, the pressure of frequency converter, the working condition of intelligent control frequency converter, as long as soon as have a process conditions problematic, halt command, stop jumping equipment can be issued to frequency converter at once.Process conditions are met the requirements during power network fluctuation; and in the safety time of time relay setting, equipment can be restarted when power system restoration is normal immediately, i.e., protects load and frequency converter to the greatest extent; it can resume production as early as possible again, reduce loss and prevent the generation of secondary disaster.

title_en: Online evaluation method for line availability in power grid restoration process based on protection information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a line availability online evaluation method in a power grid recovery process based on protection information. The method can acquire the availability probability of the power transmission line in real time, is not limited by the complexity of natural disasters causing power grid blackout, can meet the requirement of decision support in the recovery process of the power system, and ensures the rapid and efficient recovery of the power grid and the load.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: A green prosthetic devices that plants for mine side slope
abstract_en: Compared with the existing soil-shifting thin green plant restoration technology, the green plant restoration device provided by the invention has the advantages that no matter whether the restored area is a waste slag field, a mining side slope, a platform pit opening and a stone wall, the restored area can be paved like a spider web, the green plant can be safely planted in the restored area, the restored area can be protected as a protection net to avoid the occurrence of water and soil loss, falling rocks and landslide, the poor water retention capability and low vegetation survival rate in the existing green plant restoration technology are solved; the bonding property of the soil with the foundation is poor, especially in the uneven places; the growing vegetation is easy to be eaten by wild animals, and the vegetation survival rate is poor.
assignees: HENAN SHANSHUI GEOLOGICAL TOURISM RESOURCES DEV CO LTD

title_en: Fan abnormal value repairing method based on space-time clustering and decision tree
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fan abnormal value restoration method based on space-time clustering and decision trees, which comprises the steps of clustering the space geographic positions of fans to determine target fans and reference fans in fan position classes; acquiring a solar wind speed curve and a solar wind speed first-order differential curve in a threshold value of a first time period; obtaining the Euclidean distance between the daily wind speed curves of the reference fan and the target fan and the cosine similarity between the daily wind speed first-order difference curves, analyzing the similarity between the target fan and the reference fan in the clustered fan position class to obtain the similar reference fan of the target fan, and predicting and repairing the abnormal value of the target fan at the current moment based on the decision tree model after obtaining the power values of the first T moments of the moment when the abnormal value of the target fan is to be repaired. The wind power prediction accuracy can be improved, the economic benefit of a wind field is improved, and a solid foundation is laid for high-precision wind power prediction.
assignees: MITA CARBON HANGZHOU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fault positioning and restoration decision method and system for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault positioning and restoration decision method and system for a power distribution network, and relates to the field of electric data processing. The method comprises the following steps: identifying a target power distribution system and determining a target power distribution topology network; performing fault characteristic analysis, and constructing a multisource sensing monitoring array; extracting abnormal characteristic data sets of a plurality of abnormal monitoring nodes which do not meet the characteristic monitoring threshold; performing power distribution simulation to obtain a simulation characteristic data set; performing fuzzy analysis and fault prediction, and outputting a plurality of fault prediction results; and generating a fault recovery scheme and sending the fault recovery scheme to operation and maintenance personnel. The power distribution network fault prediction method based on the fuzzy analysis solves the technical problems that in the prior art, due to the influence of various power distribution factors, complexity and uncertainty of power distribution fault recognition are large, power distribution network fault prediction accuracy and efficiency are low, through fuzzy analysis on abnormal simulation features, prediction nodes are accurately set, power distribution fault prediction of the prediction nodes is performed by constructing fault prediction sub-channels, and the prediction accuracy and efficiency are improved.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating landslide surge disaster influence of reservoir area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide surge disaster influence assessment method and system in a reservoir area, and relates to the technical field of landslide surge disaster assessment. The method comprises the steps of performing direct loss evaluation, quantifying damage condition and economic operation loss of the disaster to the tangible asset, performing indirect economic loss evaluation, summarizing the integral influence of the disaster to society and economy, including the influence of economic growth, involved economy and financial balance of a warehouse area, performing post-disaster reconstruction cost evaluation, evaluating intervention measures required for starting recovery work in a short period and realizing comprehensive post-disaster recovery reconstruction fund requirements, performing macroscopic economic influence analysis, evaluating the influence of the surge disaster to long-term development of the warehouse area, performing personal and family influence evaluation, and analyzing the influence of the disaster to personal and family income and living standard. The invention provides a comprehensive methodology guidance for the economic evaluation of the reservoir area, and is helpful for making an effective landslide surge disaster coping strategy and a restoration plan.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;UNIV HOHAI;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission engineering area ecological restoration monitoring management system based on multisource perception and artificial intelligence decision
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power transmission engineering area ecological restoration monitoring management system based on multi-source perception and artificial intelligence decision. Aims at solving the technical problems of difficult ecological restoration and monitoring, rough management and wide application of vegetation in power transmission engineering in loess hilly areas in northwest of jin. The technical scheme is that the intelligent sensing layer comprises a five-layer cooperative structure, an intelligent sensing layer comprises a self-organizing wireless sensor network formed by an ecological restoration special sensor group, a data processing layer performs space-time normalization processing on multi-source heterogeneous data, extracts vegetation restoration activity indexes, soil moisture content evolution coefficients and water and soil conservation efficiency characteristics, an AI decision layer comprises a state evaluation and prediction module and an optimization decision module, an application layer is related to automatic scheduling resources of a material inventory system, and a feedback layer dynamically adjusts AI decision module thresholds and parameters. The invention constructs a set of intelligent ecological restoration monitoring and management system aiming at the power transmission engineering areas of the loess hills in northwest of jin and provides effective technical support for solving the difficult problem of ecological restoration monitoring and extensive management of the areas.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Dynamic damage perception collaborative recovery method for coping with flood disasters of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power distribution network restoration, and particularly relates to a dynamic damage perception collaborative restoration method for a power distribution network to cope with flood disasters, which comprises the steps of S1, obtaining local data of a target area, S2, building a disaster scene deduction model, a searching and fault perception model, a random maintenance time model, an unmanned plane-maintenance team collaborative scheduling model, a communication restoration and switching control model, a waterlogging development model and an operation constraint model based on the local data collected by S1, S3, taking the weighted load energy recovered maximally, the waterlogging cost reduced, the fault information FI perception efficiency improved as a target function, building a dynamic damage perception collaborative restoration model for the power distribution network to cope with the flood disasters under the fault information deficiency, and S4, building an event-driven rolling optimization frame and solving to obtain a power supply restoration strategy. The method can sense the damage state in real time, dynamically adjust the recovery strategy and cooperatively schedule the unmanned aerial vehicle and the maintenance resources in a complex environment with dynamic waterlogging development.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method of processing electricity consumption data and server implementing thereof
title_ko: 전력 사용량 데이터를 처리하는 방법 및 이를 구현하는 서버
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for processing power consumption data and a server implementing the same, wherein the server for processing power consumption data according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a database storing collected data regarding power consumption; a data restoration processor that generates restored data by adding rows to correspond to missing data based on the collected data and stores the restored data in the database; an outlier detection processor that detects outliers among data rows having actual measurement values from the restored data, renders the data determined to be outliers as missing or adds information to identify the data determined to be outliers, and stores the data in the database; and a missing data interpolation processor that loads the data stored by the outlier detection processor in the database, applies two or more missing data generation models to the data having actual measurement values regarding power consumption, selects one missing data generation model, and applies the selected missing data generation model to the missing data or data rows rendered as missing or determined to be outliers to perform interpolation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전력 사용량 데이터를 처리하는 방법 및 이를 구현하는 서버에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 의한 전력 사용량 데이터를 처리하는 서버는 전력 사용량에 관한 수집 데이터를 저장하는 데이터베이스와 수집 데이터를 기준으로 누락된 데이터에 대응하도록 행을 추가한 복원 데이터를 생성하여 데이터베이스에 저장하는 데이터 복원 프로세서와 복원 데이터에서 실측값을 가지는 데이터 행 중에서 이상치를 탐지하여 이상치로 판단된 데이터를 결측화시키거나 또는 이상치로 판단된 데이터를 식별할 수 있도록 정보를 추가하여 데이터베이스에 저장하는 이상치 탐지 프로세서와 이상치 탐지 프로세서가 데이터베이스에 저장한 데이터들을 로딩하여 전력 사용량에 대한 실측값을 가지는 데이터에 둘 이상의 결측치 생성 모델을 적용한 후 하나의 결측치 생성 모델을 선택하며, 선택된 결측치 생성 모델을 누락된 데이터 또는 결측화되거나 이상치로 판단된 데이터 행들에 적용하여 보간하는 결측치 보간 프로세서를 포함한다.

title_en: Power distribution system reconfigurations for multiple contingencies
abstract_en: System and method simulate power distribution system reconfigurations for multiple contingencies. Decision tree model is instantiated as a graph with nodes and edges corresponding to simulated outage states of one or more buses in the power distribution system and simulated states of reconfigurable switches in the power distribution system, Edges related to each outage are disconnected. A reconfiguration path is determined with a plurality of switches reconfigured to a closed state by an iteration of tree search algorithms. A simulation estimates feeder cable and transformer loading and bus voltages on the reconfigured path for comparing against constraints including system capacity ratings and minimum voltage. Further iterations identify additional candidate reconfiguration paths which can be ranked by total load restoration

title_en: It is a kind of to suppress the generation schedule optimization method that unit is reversely adjusted in power plant
abstract_en: Disclosed by the invention is the generation schedule optimization method that unit is reversely adjusted in a kind of suppression power plant, including system loading, new energy is predicted, repair schedule, cross-section limitation, compressor emergency shutdown information, unit reference plan and unit are to monitoring element sensitivity information, consider all kinds of constraints, including system balancing constraint, unit operation is constrained, Network Security Constraints and machine group constraint etc., on the basis of optimization routine model, safeguard the mapping relations between unit and power plant, introduce unit in power plant and reversely adjust constraint, form the mathematical modeling that unit in power plant reversely adjusts constraint.The higher unit output plan of the relatively reliable effective degree of being practical of the present invention, lift unit plan and perform level, improve the closed loop level planned a few days ago and in real time with AGC, the intelligent level and decision-making capability dispatched a few days ago with real-time generation schedule are favorably improved, the bulk power grid safe operation demand of increasingly lean is met.

title_en: Fire-fighting facility operator real-operation online examination system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of remote examination and discloses a fire-fighting equipment operator real-operation online examination system and a method, wherein the fire-fighting equipment operator real-operation online examination system comprises an encryption and contract management module, a multi-factor identity authentication module, a behavior monitoring and risk assessment module, a skill and decision analysis module, an examination question self-adaptive updating module, a fault diagnosis and system feedback module and a security maintenance and vulnerability restoration module; the invention uses SHA-256 encryption algorithm, ethereum intelligent contracts and IPFS to store in a decentralization way, improves the data security, uses the behavior feature analysis, logistic regression model, openCV library and Isolation Forest algorithm to carry out identity verification and behavior monitoring, uses the support vector machine, BERT model and convolutional neural network to analyze the skills of examinees, carries out multi-dimensional ability assessment, uses TF-IDF and potential Dirichlet allocation algorithm, combines natural language generation technology, updates the questions, adopts logistic regression and clustering algorithm to predict system faults, and improves the system stability.

title_en: Smart circuit breaker, system including the same, and method of managing power
abstract_en: A smart circuit breaker includes a communication interface, separable contacts, a processing unit having a memory with a routine stored therein which, when executed by the processing unit causes the processing unit to: sense a power outage in an electrical grid, control a meter to open contacts to disconnect from the electrical grid, sense power restoration to the electrical grid, control contacts corresponding to a secondary power source to open, control the meter to close contacts to reconnect to the electrical grid, sense that a frequency of power from the electrical grid matches a frequency of power from the secondary power source, and control the contacts corresponding to the secondary power source to close.

title_en: Failure feedback method, device and access control equipment
abstract_en: It includes: to determine in access control equipment whether have module to break down according to prefixed time interval startup separator self-test strategy that the application, which provides a kind of failure feedback method, device and access control equipment, the failure feedback method,；When determining has module to break down, error code corresponding with the module to break down is generated；Judge in the module to break down whether to include network communication module；When not including network communication module at least one module to break down, error code is reported into server using network communication module；When at least one module to break down including network communication module, judge at least one module to break down whether to include bluetooth module；When not including bluetooth module at least one module to break down, error code is transmitted to the user terminal using Bluetooth matching to access control equipment using bluetooth module, error code is reported to by server by user terminal.Failure feedback method of the invention, can be improved the efficiency of access control equipment fault restoration.
assignees: BEIJING QDING INTERCONNECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of space resources of lake waters utilizes aid decision-making system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of space resources of lake waters to utilize aid decision-making system, is analyzed by the variation tendency to city inland lake ecological environment eutrophication and correlative environmental factors and obtains its distribution character；Then comparative analysis has been carried out to the eco-environmental quality in city inland lake different function area, has obtained city inland lake eco-environmental quality situation, identifies pollution key factor；Finally by inference pattern; the dynamic change of the Phytoplankton biomass of city inland lake is simulated; it determines the causality characteristic between environmental factor and Phytoplankton biomass dynamic change, provides decision-making foundation for city inland lake environmental protection and restoration of the ecosystem；City inland lake ecological environment is analyzed through the invention, it can not only differentiate the quality condition of city inland lake ecological environment, and ecological environment superiority and inferiority order can be being distinguished, more structurally sound improvement and recovery scenario early warning are carried out to city inland lake ecological environment.
assignees: RONGZHI COLLEGE OF CHONGQING TECHNOLOGY AND BUSINESS UNIV

title_en: Combined ecological revetment applied to river management and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined ecological revetment applied to river treatment and a construction method thereof, wherein the ecological revetment comprises an ecological revetment foundation, a river water purification area and a surface source pollution interception area which are sequentially arranged from a river shallow water area upwards along a river slope, the ecological revetment foundation comprises a pile foundation and a lower lattice peduncles which are arranged along a river trend, the pile foundation is fixed in a river shallow water riverbed, the lower lattice peduncles are fixed on the pile foundation and are arranged along the river trend, the river water purification area extends from the lower lattice peduncles to the river flood level height along the river slope, emergent aquatic plants are planted in the river water purification area, an upper lattice peduncles is arranged at the upper end of the river water purification area, the upper lattice peduncles are arranged along the river trend, the surface source pollution interception area extends from the upper lattice peduncles to the river slope, and herbaceous plants are planted in the surface source pollution interception area. The invention combines the advantages and disadvantages of the traditional hard revetments and natural revetments, realizes the balance of three aspects of ecological restoration, water conservancy anti-scour and landscape lifting, has simple structure, reasonable design and easy construction, and has great reference significance for river management engineering.
assignees: NANJING INST OF ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES MEE;CHINA NAT ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING CENTRE

title_en: Disaster damage situation sensing method and system for power distribution network based on emergency communication under rain and flood
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network disaster situation awareness method and system based on emergency communication under a rainflood, which are used for establishing a power distribution network disaster situation awareness model under urban rainstorm waterlogging, establishing a communication working point location model, determining possible stop points of a mobile unmanned aerial vehicle station and an emergency communication vehicle, determining a scheduling scheme and a transfer path of the mobile unmanned aerial vehicle station and the emergency communication vehicle based on the possible stop points of the mobile unmanned aerial vehicle station and the emergency communication vehicle, taking into consideration path constraint and time constraint, establishing a vehicle-computer cooperative communication restoration model, establishing a power distribution network disaster situation awareness lifting model under urban rainstorm waterlogging based on the constructed power distribution network disaster situation awareness model under urban rainstorm waterlogging and the constructed vehicle-computer cooperative communication restoration model, and solving the power distribution network disaster situation awareness lifting model under urban rainstorm waterlogging to obtain a situation awareness lifting strategy. The invention improves the disaster situation awareness capability of the distribution network and realizes the rapid recovery of the distribution network after disaster.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Event-based water damage seawall facing block repairing weight calculation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the restoration weight of a water damaged seawall protecting block based on an event, which comprises the steps of determining a typical typhoon according to tropical cyclone optimal path data, seawall completion time, protecting block arrangement and a pre-seawall tide level process, collecting multi-element collaborative observation data during the typical typhoon, constructing an astronomical tide-storm tide mathematical model and a typhoon wave mathematical model according to the typical typhoon, correcting the two mathematical models by utilizing the multi-element collaborative observation data, calculating the pre-seawall tide level and the washout corrected typhoon wave after correction, designing a protecting block stable weight parameterization scheme, obtaining stable calculated weight based on the pre-seawall tide level and the typhoon wave, combining the actual weight of the protecting block to determine an optimal scheme, calculating a design wind speed according to weather station wind speed data, calculating the design tide level and washout corrected design wave based on the tide level data and the washout tide relation, and obtaining the protecting block restoration weight by adopting the optimal scheme. The method has higher guiding function on coast protection engineering design.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Communication terminal device, communication control method, and program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a terminal capable of not imposing big load on a network apparatus such as a router and a switch, even if a number of the terminals carry out simultaneous activation from blackout restoration and the like.  <P>SOLUTION: The terminal comprises a notice information sending means and a delay control means. The notice information sending means sends out notice information such as a router solicitation message and an MLD (Multicast Listener Discovery) notification to a network apparatus at least in the case of activation of the terminal. The delay control means delays a notice information sending timing at least in the case of activation by the notice information sending means, based on a terminal peculiar information.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Apparatus and method for constructing partitioned private room in refuge gymnasium and the like in short time by small number of men
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for installing a framework, a support, a partitioned room for an emergency refuge.  <P>SOLUTION: By supplying private rooms, sound sleep of family etc., safety of victim mates, restoration of a co-operative mutual aid organization as a neighborhood association, and curing of various mental anxieties and stresses and economy-class syndrome can be expected. The supplies of emergency foods, emergency medicines, bedclothes, and heating apparatus are accommodated in a special carriage under a stage. Pool water can be supplied as drinking water by a water purifying device which can be worked even in a region isolated by an inland earthquake. Installation of a private power generator enables accommodation of a large number of refugees in a regional gymnasium, and preparation of residential environmental functions for a family unit.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: The coast where applies the environmental engineering works fiber which hits, the seabed sand being washed away prevention infrastructure and the spatial-temporal method
title_ko: 친환경 토목섬유를 활용한 해안, 해저 모래 유실 방지용 구조물 및 그 시공방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A seaside and seabed sand loss prevention structure utilizing an environmentally-friendly geotextile and construction method thereof are provided to recycle the dredging sand generated by the dredge on the seaside, thereby minimizing the construction cost of the sand loss prevention structure and providing an environmentally-friendly seaside restoration construction method for the vegetation of a artificial reef. CONSTITUTION: A seaside and seabed sand loss prevention structure utilizing an environmentally-friendly geotextile includes a vegetation soil pouch and a non woven bag. A water soluble adhesion layer is formed by coating a water soluble adhesive onto the covering material of a vegetation soil pouch and the water plant seeds are sown to be attached the adhesion layer. The vegetation soil pouches filled with the dredge soil and the non woven bags are provided to be transported to a construction site. The vegetation pouches are layered in several layers on the unfolded non woven bags in the construction site. An artificial reef is formed by coupling members inserted into coupling rings formed on the edge of the non woven bags whose edges are gathered in the center. The artificial reef is dropped and sunken closely to the spot of the sand loss and dropped and sunken through a dual wall structure. [Reference numerals] (AA) Start; (BB) End; (S100) Coating a water soluble adhesive onto the covering material of a vegetation soil pouch to form a water soluble adhesion layer and spreading and attaching water plant seeds onto the water soluble adhesion layer; (S200) Filling the inside of the vegetation soil pouch with dredge soil produced from a coastal construction or construction site and preparing a plurality of vegetation pouches according to the area of an installation place; (S300) Manufacturing and preparing non woven bags by determining the size and number of the non woven bags according to the conditions of the installation place; (S400) Transporting the prepared vegetation pouches and non woven bags to the site; (S500) Laminating the vegetation pouches in several layers on the top of the unfolded non woven bags in the site; (S600) Gathering the edges of the non woven bags to the center and inserting coupling members into coupling holes formed in the edges, thereby forming an artificial reef; (S700) Dropping and sinking the formed artificial reef in the installation place; (S800) Repeating the steps above to form an artificial reef structure
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 안복원공사 또는 건설현장에서 발생하는 준설토를 작은 면적을 차지하는 식생토낭에 충진하여 설치장소로 수송한 후 식생토낭을 부직포 백에 다수 수용한 후 부직포 백을 설치장소(해저 모래가 유실되는 곳)에 투하(또는 수중잠재)하여 설치함으로써 해저모래의 유실을 방지함과 아울러 인공어초가 식생할 수 있도록 한 친환경 토목섬유를 활용한 해안, 해저 모래 유실 방지용 구조물 및 그 시공방법에 관한 것으로,  
상기에 따른 본 발명은 식생토낭(100)의 피복재(140)에 수용접착제를 도포하여 수용성접착층(150)을 형성하고, 그 위에 수초 씨앗(130)을 뿌려서 부착시키는 단계(S100); 상기 식생토낭(100)의 내부에 해안복원공사는 또는 건설현장에서 발생하는 준설토 등을 충진한 후 설치장소의 면적에 따라 다수의 식생토낭(100)을 준비하는 단계(S200); 부직포 백(300)을 설치장소의 요건에 맞게 크기 및 수량을 정한 후 제작하여 준비하는 단계(S300); 준비된 식생토낭(100)과 부직포 백(300)을 현장으로 수송하는 단계(S400); 현장에서 부직포 백(300)을 펼쳐놓은 상태에서 부직포 백(300) 상부에 식생토낭(100)을 다수 층으로 적층하는 단계(S500); 부직포 백(300)의 모서리를 중앙으로 모은 후 모서리에 형성된 체결고리(320)에 체결부재(330)를 삽입하여 하나의 인공어초를 형성하는 단계(S600); 상기와 같이 형성된 인공어초를 모래가 유실되는 장소에 밀착되게 투하, 침수시키거나 이중벽구조로 투하, 침수시키는 단계(S700); 상기 과정을 반복수행하여 해저모래 유실방지용 친환경 인공어초를 설치하여 모래의 유실을 방지함과 아울러 물고기와 조개, 해조류가 서식할 수 있도록 하는 단계(S800)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Management device, power supply system, electronic device, management method, shutdown method, and program
abstract_en: Provided is a management device (30) that has: an electronic device control means for controlling operations of multiple electronic devices (20) which are configured so as to receive electricity from a common uninterruptible power supply device (10) in the event of a power outage of a commercial power supply; and a monitoring means for detecting power outage and restoration of the commercial power supply. The electronic device control means transmits a shutdown command to some of the electronic devices (20) if the monitoring means does not detect restoration of the commercial power supply before a predetermined amount of time passes after the monitoring means detected power outage of the commercial power supply.

title_en: Video-Focused Compression with Hierarchical and Lorentzian Autoencoders
abstract_en: A system and method for compressing and restoring data using hierarchical autoencoders and Lorentzian autoencoders for video processing. For general data, the system employs hierarchical autoencoders operating at multiple scales. For video data, Lorentzian autoencoders preserve three-dimensional tensor structure where spatial and temporal relationships remain intact throughout compression and decompression. A correlation network, trained on cross-correlated data sets, enhances restoration by leveraging relationships between compressed representations, recovering information lost during compression. The Lorentzian approach enables advanced video features including temporal prediction and infinite zoom, where users can examine regions beyond original resolution with synthesized yet plausible details. This architecture achieves higher compression ratios while maintaining or improving data quality, particularly for video content where spatiotemporal coherence is critical, applicable to surveillance, medical imaging, entertainment, and remote sensing.

title_en: A kind of future-state alternating-current flow of power grid generates method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of future-state alternating-current flow of power grid and generate method.The method comprises the following steps: 1) select an electrical network real time execution section as initial section；2) grid generation planning data is obtained；3) maintenance scheduling for power systems data are obtained；4) bus load prediction data is obtained；5) interconnection planning data is obtained；6) electric network swim is driven to calculate；7) dominant eigenvalues deviation value is calculated ；8) modified load injects；9) electric network swim is driven to calculate；10) set each electromotor and participate in adjustment state of exerting oneself as initial set value, obtain from the nominal parameter of electromotor；11) preserve the electrical network section after having adjusted, be successfully generated future-state trend.The present invention, based on true operation of power networks section, takes into full account future anticipation and the planning datas such as generation schedule, repair schedule, interconnection trading program, bus load prediction data, automatically adjusts and generate future-state AC power flow；The power flow solutions of future-state forecast accurately is provided, provides complete basic flow data for plan security check.

title_en: Power supply and outage information detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power supply and outage information detection method and a system, wherein the power supply and outage information detection method comprises the following steps: reading the power supply and outage state of a distribution transformer area client from electric energy terminal equipment corresponding to a distribution transformer at intervals of set time; wherein the power supply and power off state comprises a power supply state and a power off state; if the currently read power supply and power off state is different from the last read power supply and power off state, recording a first reading moment of currently reading the power supply and power off state and a second reading moment of last reading the power supply and power off state; if the current power supply and outage state is the power outage state, determining the intermediate value between the first reading moment and the second reading moment as the power outage moment; and if the current power supply and outage state is the power supply state, determining the intermediate value of the first reading moment and the second reading moment as the power supply restoration moment. The power supply information of the distribution transformer area customer can be efficiently and accurately detected.

title_en: Deep learning-based river network dense watershed water situation trend prediction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river network dense watershed water situation trend prediction method based on deep learning and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting rainfall, water level time sequence point data and longitude and latitude information of all rainfall stations and river channel water level stations in the full watershed range, and performing whole editing; converting the integrated rainfall and water level time sequence point data into space-time data by an inverse distance weight method and an isosurface map rendering method; constructing and training a watershed high-resolution water level forecasting model, and respectively inputting rainfall and water level time-space data tensors; the watershed high-resolution water level forecasting model comprises a preliminary spatial feature extraction module, a space-time feature extraction module, a stacking module, a splicing module and a feature restoration module; and the model outputs a water level isosurface map of the whole basin in a forecast period to obtain the basin water regime change trend. The method can fully excavate the production convergence mechanism of the basin from historical hydrological data, and can accurately forecast the space-time water regime change of the whole basin.

title_en: Mountain highway disaster identification method and system based on multi-source remote sensing image restoration and super-resolution reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plateau mountain road disaster identification method and system based on multi-source remote sensing image restoration and super-resolution reconstruction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source remote sensing images of mountain areas of a plateau, preprocessing, extracting geomorphic metering parameters based on a digital elevation model, constructing a super-resolution reconstruction network integrating deformable convolution and a Transformer, reconstructing low-resolution images by utilizing composite loss function constraint training comprising the geomorphic metering parameters, carrying out feature extraction and self-adaptive weighted fusion on the preprocessed images and the high-resolution images obtained by reconstruction, identifying landslide, debris flow and subgrade subsidence disasters along the road by utilizing a multi-task deep learning model based on the fused images, carrying out morphological optimization and boundary refinement under GIS constraint on identification results, and outputting disaster thematic map. The invention effectively improves the accuracy and reliability of highway disaster identification under complex terrain environments.

title_en: Unit combination optimization method driven by large language model
abstract_en: A large language model driven unit combination optimization method relates to the technical field of electric power systems and comprises the steps of obtaining economic operation basic data of an electric power system, constructing an integer relaxation safety constraint unit combination model according to the economic operation basic data, solving the unit combination model, further obtaining the unit combination model, solving the unit combination model, constructing a variable dimension reduction algorithm, a constraint dimension reduction algorithm and an infeasible solution restoration algorithm, sequentially carrying out single algorithm evolution on the variable dimension reduction algorithm and the constraint dimension reduction algorithm by adopting the large language model, carrying out single algorithm evolution on the infeasible solution restoration algorithm by adopting the large language model, solving and calculating the unit combination model after the integer relaxation safety constraint, calculating the variable constraint dimension reduction safety constraint unit combination model to obtain an optimal solution, and restoring the optimal solution of the variable constraint dimension reduction safety constraint unit combination model based on the optimal infeasible solution restoration algorithm to obtain a result, wherein the method is used for solving the problem that the conventional model dimension reduction method is insufficient in terms of generality, stability and interpretability.

title_en: Analysis management device for low-voltage power supply reliability
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an analysis management device for low-voltage power supply reliability, which is characterized in that an electric parameter acquisition module acquires electric parameters of a power distribution network line, a charging state monitoring module judges whether a current power distribution network node is charged, a recognition module establishes a topology change detection index when the power distribution network node is charged, judges whether the topology of a user is changed, automatically records power failure time and power restoration time after the topology of the user is changed and when the topology of the user is changed, and a statistics module counts average power supply reliability, average power failure time of the user and average power failure frequency of the user.
assignees: STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of load restoration scheme generation method based on decision tree pruning algorithms
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of load restoration scheme generation method based on decision tree pruning algorithms, belong to power system dispatching automation technique field.This method includes：First, failure being obtained respectively the electric network model after previous minute and failure generation occurring, Load flow calculation is carried out to two models by the power flow equation after simplification respectively, trend before and after failure is contrasted, determines power supply interrupted district；Then, topology search is carried out according to electric network composition after failure, decision tree is generated by root node of power supply interrupted district；Factor of influence is determined, establishes Estimate equation；Finally, beta pruning is carried out by depth-first search on decision tree, obtains the optimal path scheme of load restoration.The inventive method provides scientific and effective supplementary means for the fast quick-recovery of grid power blackout failure, improves the rapidity and reliability of electric load recovery.
assignees: SKILLS TRAINING CENTER STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;BEIJING KING STAR HI TECH SYSTEM CONTROL CO LTD

title_en: Oil field power load management and control system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses the technical field of oilfield power load prediction, which is used for solving the problems that in the existing mode aiming at oilfield power load prediction, correction analysis on abnormal values in load data is omitted, so that the accuracy and precision of oilfield power load prediction results are difficult to ensure, and the management and control work of load prediction on an oilfield power distribution network is greatly influenced, and particularly discloses an oilfield power load management and control system based on data analysis, which comprises a data acquisition unit, an abnormality recognition unit, a repair modeling unit, a data rating unit, an early warning feedback unit and a display terminal; according to the method, the box-line graph method is selected to complete detection and analysis of the abnormal values of the load sequence data, symbolic calibration, formulaic processing and graph comparison are utilized to complete restoration of the abnormal values, and then fusion analysis is conducted on various data signals, so that the accuracy and precision of prediction of the electric load of the oil field are improved, and management and control of the power distribution network of the oil field are promoted.
assignees: SHENGLI COLLEGE OF CHINA PETROLEUM UNIV

title_en: Distribution network line rapid power restoration capability analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network line quick-speed re-energizing capacity analysis method and system, which are used for providing distribution network line quick-speed re-energizing capacity indexes through a distribution network line net rack quantification analysis principle, carrying out block division on the distribution network line according to distribution network line equipment account data, distribution network line automatic switching account data and distribution network line topological structure data, analyzing the number of users of quick-speed re-energizing blocks when the blocks are failed, and analyzing the total quantity of equivalent equipment in each block, so that the block quick-speed re-energizing capacity and the distribution network line quick-speed re-energizing capacity are calculated, the fault quick-speed recovering capacity of the distribution network line is dynamically and quantitatively analyzed, and support is provided for improving the distribution network automatic construction effect and carrying out safe and reliable operation on the distribution network.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Emergency prediction and early warning method for oil spill and dangerous chemical leakage accidents on water
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency prediction and early warning method for oil spill and dangerous chemical leakage accidents on water, which comprises the following steps of establishing a basic database of a inland river, constructing an environmental ecological effect model of an oil spill event, identifying biological population changes under the influence of the oil spill event, evaluating the influence of the oil spill event on an ecological system by utilizing an eDNA macro-stripe code technology, analyzing the relation between a microbial community and environmental elements based on a biometrical method, monitoring and early warning the multidimensional degree of the oil spill event in real time, and providing a targeted pollution cleaning scheme and ecological restoration measures. According to the method, the multi-dimensional real-time monitoring and early warning of the oil spill event are realized by combining the aerial remote sensing, the ship and shore radar, the video monitoring and the buoy data and through a multi-source data fusion technology, and the traditional method usually only depends on a single data source.

title_en: Historical similar runoff classification recommendation method based on characteristic index identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a characteristic index identification-based historical similar runoff classification recommendation method which comprises the steps of historical runoff process restoration, historical scene water rising process extraction, historical runoff characteristic depiction, archive construction, scene runoff process cluster analysis and Siamese network architecture-based historical similar runoff process recommendation. According to the invention, the matching efficiency of the historical similar runoffs is shortened from the small hour level to the minute level, the real-time decision of flood control dispatching is supported, meanwhile, the short-term forecast is replaced by recommending the complete historical runoff process, the uncertainty conduction risk is effectively reduced, high-confidence data support is provided for reservoir group joint dispatching and disaster emergency response, and the initiative and the scientificity of flood control disaster defense are comprehensively improved.
assignees: BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for formulating restoration strategy of post-earthquake urban road network emergency rescue stage based on fastest restoration path
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-earthquake urban road network emergency rescue stage restoration strategy formulation method based on a fastest restoration path. According to the method, road repair time of the post-earthquake road network and road repair time of building rubble removal are calculated at two angles, so that medical rescue priority, material transportation priority and the fastest repair path and 'supplementary repair path' comprehensively considering medical rescue and material transportation requirements are determined, and a strategy is formulated for repairing the post-earthquake road network in an emergency rescue stage.
assignees: INST ENG MECH CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Fire mitigation and downed conductor detection systems and methods
abstract_en: A transformer monitoring device has one or more voltage sensors and/or one or more current sensors integral with a housing for detecting voltage and/or current of a power cable of a transformer. The transformer monitoring device can be configured to monitor voltage data, current data, voltage imbalance, phase angle, outage detection and restoration detection, and/or transformer temperature changes, etc., and cause alerts to be Issued directly and/or by a remote central computing device if voltage levels drop, and/or if voltage imbalance occurs, along with additional alert messaging capabilities to be provided by the transformer monitoring device where utility operator personnel would find value. The transformer monitoring device further has one or more onboard, and/or external wired and/or wireless environmental and/or transformer conditions sensor(s) and/or sensor packs, including a smoke sensor, ambient temperature sensor, external transformer temperature sensor, a fire/wildfire sensor (e.g., infrared camera, etc.).

title_en: Methods and systems for forecasting estimated time of restoration during service interruption
abstract_en: Machine learning may be used to forecast an estimated time of restoration (ETR) during a service interruption. To forecast an ETR, the collection of information from the multiple sources may be provided as inputs to a machine learning model, such as a deep long-short term memory recurrent neural network, a predictive model, and/or the like. The machine learning model may be trained to optimize the temporal cost function of sustained service interruptions and forecast ETRs for service interruptions (in minutes). The machine learning model may process data/information in real-time and provide an ETR when inputs are not yet available in the repair/resolution process, and update (reforecast) the ETR in real-time as the inputs late become available.

title_en: Secure data replication to, and recovery of data from, air-gapped data storage pools
abstract_en: An illustrative air-gapped data storage site for storing secure copies at the air-gapped storage site. Using specialized air-gapped media agents installed within the air-gapped storage pool site, the illustrative system, at an unpredictable time, establishes a one-way tunnel from secondary storage site to air-gapped site to receive backup copies of the data stored at primary site. In another embodiment, during disaster recovery, backup copies stored within the air-gapped site are replicated to a non-air gapped site (e.g., secondary storage pools) as “tertiary copies.” Those copies are then restored to the primary site in original application data formats for quick recovery. As restoration of data is complete, the tertiary copies are promoted to “secondary copies” to receive incremental backups.

title_en: Optimization restoration method for urban ponding road and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimization restoration method for urban ponding roads and a computer readable medium. The method comprises the steps of constructing a road undirected network topology model, carrying out traffic simulation through a SUMO open source model to obtain a traffic flow set of nodes in the road undirected network topology model and a traffic flow set of edges in the road undirected network topology model, generating a shortest time point path set among all nodes of the road undirected network topology model and a shortest time edge path set among all nodes of the road undirected network topology model based on dijkstra algorithm, calculating the medium number centrality of the edges and the medium number centrality of the nodes in the road undirected network topology model, carrying out sorting by utilizing a merging sorting algorithm to respectively obtain a set of the edges after descending sorting and a node set after descending sorting in the road undirected network topology model, and further carrying out repairing of water accumulation road sections and water accumulation intersections. The invention has the advantages of considering the traffic time and the traffic flow optimization betweenness centrality and dynamically and accurately reflecting the road network state.

title_en: Low-power-consumption hardware encryption system based on geological disaster monitoring scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hardware encryption and discloses a low-power-consumption hardware encryption system based on a geological disaster monitoring scene, which comprises a layering architecture module, an encryption and decryption module, a key management module and a security protection module, wherein the layering architecture module is used for constructing a terminal perception layer and a cloud platform layer, generating a three-dimensional risk thermodynamic diagram, carrying out short-term early warning model and emergency deduction, carrying out multi-dimensional identity verification based on protocol layering and national encryption algorithm fusion, carrying out dynamic management and eavesdropping monitoring on a key, optimizing a data processing flow, establishing whether encryption or decryption is needed for dynamic negotiation of a security channel, carrying out processing and risk assessment on monitored data, adopting a dynamic key period according to a generated risk level, carrying out key backup and recovery, and the security protection module is used for carrying out intelligent management on system power consumption, adopting a dynamic compression algorithm, selecting a compression strategy according to data types, carrying out security monitoring on hardware and firmware, carrying out intrusion monitoring on the system and carrying out automatic restoration.

title_en: Method and apparatus for communicating power distribution event and location
abstract_en: A system, device, and method of providing information for a power distribution system is provided. In one embodiment, a method of using a device that receives power from the low voltage power of the power distribution system and experiences a power loss during a local power outage may perform the processes of monitoring a voltage of the low voltage power line, detecting a voltage reduction below a threshold voltage for a predetermined time period, storing information of the voltage reduction in a non-volatile memory prior to the power outage, and transmitting a notification to a remote computer system prior to the outage. The monitoring may comprise making a plurality of measurements of the voltage during a time interval and averaging the plurality of voltage measurements. In addition, the method may include transmitting an alert message upon power up after the outage to indicate a power restoration local to the device.
assignees: YANEY DAVID S;KEHN ROBERT D;CURRENT TECH LLC

title_en: Hybrid distribution network power restoration control
abstract_en: A power outage restoration system manages a power network including a plurality of switching devices. The power outage restoration system includes an outage management system having a network model of said power network. A plurality of local restoration controllers are in communication with the outage management system and each said local restoration controller includes a trimmed network model correlating to a respective area of responsibility.
assignees: WANG ZHENYUAN;STOUPIS JAMES;DONDE VAIBHAV;LI WENPING;PETERSON WILLIAM;ABB RESEARCH LTD

title_en: Two bag malleation liquid packaging bags
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a two bag malleation liquid packaging bags belongs to medical liquid medicine bag, its characterized in that: two -layer structure inside and outside inner packing high elasticity bag and outer packing bag, inner packing high elasticity bag are the elasticity films that has 8000% -20000%'s elongation and 99% -100%'s restoration ratio, the last exhaust hole that is equipped with of outer packing bag, and inner packing high elasticity bag connects the transfusion system interface and annotates the liquid mouth, and the advantage is: self having elastic pressure, need not to hang or apply the external pressure in the eminence, both can realize the infusion, broken away from the reliance to gravity and external force, saved the auxiliary facilities such as support, pressure device of string transfusion bottle, convenient and fast practices thrift time of rescue, the utility model is suitable for a rescue under the various places that need the infusion, special environment such as first aid before the open -air war of specially adapted, natural disasters, the institute, patient's transportation.

title_en: Geological disaster ecological restoration structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ecological restoration structures, in particular to a geological disaster ecological restoration structure, which comprises a grounding nail, wherein the surface of the grounding nail is provided with a connecting plate, the surface of the connecting plate is provided with a winding column, the end part of the winding column is provided with a struck block, the outer side of the winding column is sleeved with a lantern ring, the surface of the lantern ring is provided with a first bolting ring, the surface of the first bolting ring is bolted with a traction rope, the other end of the traction rope is bolted with a second bolting ring, the second bolting ring is fixed on the surface of a planting frame, the surface of the planting frame is provided with a notch, the inside of the notch is provided with a grid plate, and the upper part of the grid plate is provided with a straw mat; the beneficial effects are that: the utility model provides a geological disasters ecological remediation structure plants the vegetation inside planting the frame, then will plant the frame with the help of the tractive rope and be connected with the lantern ring, and the lantern ring cover is established on fixed rod spare, and two sets of fixed rod bodies are strikeed and are inserted and fix planting the frame through the tractive rope on the slope, avoid planting the frame and drop.

title_en: A kind of power distribution network toughness appraisal procedure based on system information entropy
abstract_en: A kind of power distribution network toughness appraisal procedure based on system information entropy, including：According to network structure relevant parameter and typhoon meteorological data, each element failure rate of power distribution network is calculated；The typical fault scene of full system entropy constraint is chosen based on system information entropy；Power distribution network toughness, which is assessed, to be calculated, including calculates typical fault scene probability of happening, determines the scarce delivery of typical fault scene correspondence system, and power distribution network toughness index calculating.The failure scale that the present invention is likely to occur using power distribution network under the method analysis extreme weather of system information entropy, the power distribution network toughness index that areal calculation is obtained is lacked using distribution network load curve, the size of dead electricity loss of the power distribution network in extreme disaster failure process can either be reflected, the time used in distribution network restoration to normal power supply state can be reflected again.The model can be used for the disaster response ability for evaluating power distribution network, and improving measure for further research toughness provides basis, and then instructs distribution network construction.

title_en: Remodeling procedure after a kind of natural rubber woods calamity
abstract_en: The invention belongs to natural rubber woods post-disaster reconstruction technical field, remodeling procedure after a kind of natural rubber woods calamity, the integrated treatment measure for taking " support, prevent, controlling " three to combine are disclosed；Water and fertilizer management after " foster " calamity using reinforcement and reduction rubber tapping intensity；It is " anti-" to be rotted using the xylem for preventing bark beetle from causing harm, anti-wound exposes；" controlling " promotes healing using wound is administered；The rubber tree growth not handled after calamity is slower, is remolded after calamity notable to the increment impact effect of rubber tree；Disaster-stricken processing rubber tree restoration ecosystem speed is fast, resists bark beetle infringement, and the wind-fall tree death rate grows rubber tree level close to no calamity naturally.The present invention opens rubber tapping tree fire 3.5 kilograms of 1 annual yield of cave of post-processing；2.7 kilograms not handled after disaster-stricken；It is not disaster-stricken to grow 3.6 kilograms of gum naturally；It can be seen that influence of the calamity post-processing to the resistance of rubber tree, yield effect significant effect.

title_en: Wireless power transmission
abstract_en: A power transmitter (101) transmits power to a power receiver (105) and includes a power input (209) that receives a supply of power. A power detector (211) detects a restoration of the supply power after a power outage, and a presence detector (213) detects a presence of the power receiver when the supply power is restored. The first communicator (207) may communicate with the second communicator (509) of the power receiver (105) using a short range communication channel. When the supply power is being restored, a message circuit (215) sends a power restoration message to the second communicator (509). A user action detector (217) detects a power receiver user action, and the controller (205) is arranged to: a power transmission to the power receiver is initiated after a power restoration in response to detecting the user action, and if the user action is not detected, the initiation of the power transmission is suppressed after a power restoration. The power receiver (105) may generate a user alert upon receipt of the power restoration message.

title_en: Ecological restoration protection method for rock-soil body slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock-soil body slope ecological restoration protection method, which comprises the following steps of; step one: cleaning a slope: the slope is trimmed to a proper slope according to the site condition, and then objects such as broken stones and dangerous stones on the slope are cleaned and removed, so that the objects such as broken stones and dangerous stones roll off in the later period to avoid corresponding disasters; step two: slope reinforcement: soil piles or metal nets are arranged in the slope rock soil to consolidate the slope soil and prevent the slope soil from loosening, cracking and collapsing; step three: arranging a drainage facility: arranging drainage facilities on the surface of the slope or the bottom of the rock stratum of the slope, and ensuring that the excessive rainwater accumulated on the slope can be rapidly discharged so as to prevent the internal structure of the slope from being softened or corroded; the rock-soil body side slope ecological restoration protection method can comprehensively strengthen side slope soil, avoid disasters such as water and soil loss, slope collapse and the like as much as possible, and can also build a complete ecological chain on the surface of the side slope so as to promote the gradual restoration of the ecological environment of the side slope.
assignees: SHENZHEN RUIYAOLIN ECOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation method for ecological drought and waterlogging in alpine plateau region by considering vegetation restoration force
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating ecological drought and waterlogging in a alpine plateau region by considering vegetation restoration force, which belongs to the technical field of disaster evaluation and comprises the following steps: constructing an improved distributed hydrological model WEP; extracting a water source which is effective for vegetation growth in precipitation of a source area, evaluating water supply branches of slope vegetation, and calculating ecological water supply of the source area; introducing a vegetation ecological system restoring force theory, calculating a slope vegetation month scale ecological water demand elastic interval, and evaluating ecological water demand considering vegetation restoring force; according to the ecological water supply quantity of the source area and the ecological water demand taking the vegetation restoration force into consideration, obtaining the quantitative evaluation and grading result of ecological drought and waterlogging of the slope vegetation in the river basin based on the slope vegetation supply and demand water balance relation; and (3) obtaining synchronous evolution characteristics of slope vegetation drought and waterlogging in time and space by using a clustering algorithm of three-dimensional drought and waterlogging identification, and finishing evaluation of ecological drought and waterlogging in the alpine plateau region. The invention solves the problem that the current ecological drought and waterlogging index can not reflect the vegetation supply and demand balance.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Power distribution network two-stage fault restoration optimization method and terminal based on variable time step
