abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage fault repair optimization method and a terminal for a power distribution network based on a variable time step, damage evaluation information of the power distribution network is determined after an extreme weather disaster occurs, a maintenance team scheduling decision model is established according to the damage evaluation information, the power distribution network operation strategy optimization model is established based on the variable time step by taking the total active weighted loss of each scene under the minimum known fault repair sequence as an objective function, the maintenance team scheduling decision model and the power distribution network operation strategy optimization model are solved to obtain an optimal fault repair strategy, the established maintenance team scheduling decision model is a first-stage problem, the established power distribution network operation strategy optimization model is a second-stage problem, an effective and reliable fault repair strategy can be given after the extreme weather disaster occurs through the two-stage optimization problem, and the second-stage problem adopts the variable time step idea modeling, so that the efficiency and accuracy of solving the fault repair strategy are improved, and the toughness level of the power distribution network is effectively enhanced.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Park network reconstruction method considering conditional risk value
abstract_en: The invention discloses a park network reconstruction method considering conditional risk values, which comprises the steps of 1) constructing a park network reconstruction model considering distributed power supply and load uncertainty, 2) constructing a park conditional risk value model based on a risk measurement theory and adding the conditional risk value model into the park network reconstruction model, 3) constructing a park network reconstruction model restoration strategy constraint considering the conditional risk values, and 4) solving a park network fault reconstruction optimization model to obtain an optimal park network reconstruction scheme. According to the method, the optimization model of the park network reconstruction taking the condition risk value into consideration is built, the optimal reconstruction scheme of the park network is obtained, and the safety and reliability of the operation of the park system are improved.
assignees: SUQIAN WANDA ELECTRIC POWER IND CO LTD;SUQIAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Hydropower station fusion power server and elastic resource management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower station fusion power server and an elastic resource management system, which relate to the technical field of automation and intelligent operation and maintenance of electric power systems and comprise a resource state sensing and acquisition module, a key index extraction and quantitative analysis module, an intelligent discrimination and risk identification module, a resource regulation and abnormal driving cleaning module and a resource recovery and node reconstruction module, wherein the resource state sensing and acquisition module is used for acquiring operation data of each computing node and scheduling execution log data information generated by a scheduling platform in real time through a resource state acquisition component deployed in a virtualization management platform. According to the method, the early identification and accurate cleaning of the ghost virtual machine resources are realized through multidimensional sensing and intelligent evaluation, the abnormal exposure is induced by the dynamic regulation and control calculation force threshold value, the node resource state is restored in a self-adaptive mode, an identification-regulation-restoration closed-loop flow is constructed, the calculation force utilization rate and the stability of a dispatching system are improved, and the continuous operation of key business of the hydropower station is ensured.

title_en: Virtual power plant scheduling method and device for power system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a virtual power plant scheduling method, a device and electronic equipment for a power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining forecast data, equipment parameters and market information of a virtual power plant in a preset scheduling period; the method comprises the steps of establishing an economic dispatching optimization model of a virtual power plant, solving the economic dispatching optimization model to generate a candidate dispatching scheme in a dispatching period, carrying out iterative optimization on the candidate dispatching scheme, wherein the iterative optimization comprises the steps of uniformly encoding time sequence values of various dispatching variables in the dispatching period into a dispatching variable set of the virtual power plant dispatching scheme, integrating a feasible solution restoration mechanism based on physical constraints of the virtual power plant in an updating process, taking the current optimal virtual power plant dispatching scheme as an optimal dispatching scheme when the iterative process meets a preset termination condition, generating a control instruction corresponding to the dispatching instruction, and executing the control instruction in the preset dispatching period. By adopting the technical scheme, the overall efficiency, reliability and economy of virtual power plant dispatching can be improved.

title_en: Restoration status grasping and supporting device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To accurately, surely and quickly grasp a place to be repaired and a restoration status thereof after an accident occurs on a distribution line while contributing to sure and quick restoration of a power failure.SOLUTION: A restoration status grasping and supporting device 2 forms display information based on information such as patrolled sphere information, failure place information, repair requesting place information, and repair place information and distribution line system diagram information, causes a display to display the display information, extracts a place being a sphere, in which an accidental power failure occurs, having been patrolled and having been repaired, further extracts a place adjacent to a section, to which power is transmitted, therefrom, determines that power can be transmitted to the place in a case where a transmission section adjacent to the place is in a forward transmission direction and determines that the power can be transmitted to the place when a current value is within an acceptable range in a case where the transmission section adjacent to the place is in a backward transmission direction.

title_en: System and Method for managing performance data when communication errors occur in power plant
title_ko: 발전소 통신장애시 성능 데이터 관리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for managing performance data that can enhance usability of a remote monitoring system by restoring or estimating key data for a communication error section, the system for managing the performance data comprising: an overseas plant which generates generation information; a communication relay block which relays the generation information; and a monitoring block which calculates an average generation load during a communication error period from a time of an occurrence of a communication error between the communication relay block and the plant to a time of communication restoration by using the generation information and restores performance data with a preset scenario based on the average generation load. In addition, the time of the occurrence is a case where there is no difference between a current time cumulative output value and an accumulated output value for a preset time.
abstract_ko:
통신오류 구간에 대한 주요 데이터들을 복원 또는 추정하여 원격 감시 체계의 활용성을 강화할 수 있는 성능 데이터 관리 시스템이 개시된다. 상기 성능 데이터 관리 시스템은, 발전 정보를 생성하는 해외 발전소, 상기 발전 정보를 중계하는 통신 중계 블럭, 및 상기 발전 정보를 이용하여 상기 통신 중계 블럭과 발전소간 통신장애의 발생시점으로부터 통신의 복원시점까지 통신장애기간에서의 평균 발전 부하를 산출하고, 상기 평균 발전 부하를 기반으로 미리 설정되는 시나리오로 성능 데이터를 복원하는 모니터링 블럭을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
또한, 상기 발생시점은 미리 설정되는 시간 동안 누적 출력값대비 현시간 누적 출력값의 차이가 없는 경우인 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: One-stop disaster recovery platform system
title_ko: 원스톱 재해복구 플랫폼 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an one-stop disaster recovery platform system, which provides recovery estimates and recovery simulations through on-site confirmation when damage occurs in a building due to various disasters such as fire, to help decision-making, and supports smooth damage recovery by selecting a recovery company, proceeding with restoration work, and processing insurance work in one stop. The one-stop disaster recovery platform system includes a database, a request module, a judgment module, an estimate module, a recovery support module, and a cost processing module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물에 화재 등 다양한 재해로 인한 피해 발생시 현장확인을 통한 복구견적 및 복구 시뮬레이션을 제공하여 의사결정을 돕고, 복구업체의 선정 및 복구작업의 진행과 보험업무처리를 원스톱으로 진행하여 원활한 피해회복을 지원하는 원스톱 재해복구 플랫폼 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Systems and methods for managing power at an optical network terminal
abstract_en: Systems and methods presented herein provide for operating an optical network terminal (ONT) during a power outage. In one embodiment, an ONT includes an opto-electrical converter operable to receive an optical signal and to convert the optical signal to a data signal, and a data processing module operable to process data from the data signal. The ONT also includes a power management unit operable to detect a power outage of a power supply, to initiate a low power mode, to terminate a portion of data processing by the data processing module based on the low power mode, to convert the optical signal to electrical power, and to maintain operation of the low power mode utilizing the electrical power. The power management unit is further operable to monitor the power supply for restoration of power, and to reinitialize the data processing module upon restoration of power.

title_en: Self-healing control method for urban power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-healing method for urban distribution networks. The method comprises the following steps: (1) defining a system state function with respect to voltage, current, active power and reactive power, and setting ranges of a function value in an emergency state, a function value in a restoring state, a function value in an error state, a function value in an alert state and a function value in a safe state; (2) acquiring an electric capacity parameter;(3) calculating the function value of the state function, comparing the function value with the system set function values and carrying out related control processing steps according to the results of the comparison; (4) emergency control processing; (5) restoring control processing; (6) calibrating control processing; and (7) prevention control processing. The method carries out hierarchical control on the operation state of the urban distribution network and makes the urban distribution network be capable of self-prevention, self-restoration and handling extreme disasters and big power grid emergencies and improves the reliability of the urban distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;NANJING NARI CORP

title_en: Deterioration simulation system for falling zone of reservoir area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster research, in particular to a reservoir area hydro-fluctuation belt degradation simulation system. The technical scheme simulates the rock mechanical property change of the falling zone rock mass under different water levels, different pressures and different temperature environments, the damage effect of pore water to the rock mass and the deterioration effect of dry-wet circulation to the rock mass, the method is used for improving the ecological restoration capacity and the landscape reconstruction capacity of the bank slope of the reservoir area, reducing the risk of secondary geological disasters in the reservoir area, improving the early warning and forecasting capacity of the geological disasters and guaranteeing the life and property safety of people.

title_en: Scene self-adaptive fault first-aid repair scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a scene self-adaptive fault repair scheduling method and system, which relate to the technical field of fault detection and comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of monitoring the running state of a target power grid in real time, identifying a plurality of running fault scene parameters, performing fault detection, traversing a fault detection data set, determining a plurality of fault points, evaluating the plurality of fault points, generating a fault rush-repair scheduling scheme, performing dynamic feedback and self-adaptive adjustment, and generating a fault rush-repair scheduling optimization scheme. The application can solve the technical problem of low fault first-aid repair efficiency caused by complex and changeable power grid fault conditions and lack of a dynamic feedback mechanism in the prior art, and the generated fault first-aid repair scheduling scheme is dynamically fed back and adaptively adjusted by integrating multiple data sources for real-time monitoring, so that the technical effect of improving the power grid fault first-aid repair efficiency is achieved.

title_en: Data disaster recovery method supporting multi-backup path switching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data disaster recovery method supporting multi-backup path switching, which comprises the steps of generating dynamic granularity data fragments based on sensitivity of input data and storage medium characteristics, generating metadata labels comprising data fragment identification, storage preference and recovery priority, constructing a heterogeneous transmission path performance model through the metadata labels, generating a path quality map, distributing an optimal transmission path for each data fragment, monitoring path performance, detecting abnormality and migrating fragments through standard deviation of accumulated transmission delay, adopting Merkle proof of incremental integrity verification and blockchain storage to carry out parallel verification, and retransmitting the verification failure fragments preferentially.

title_en: Power outage and restoration detection for multi-meter nodes in a mesh network
abstract_en: A system for detecting power status changes, such as power outages or power restorations, at a multi-meter node associated with a power distribution network is provided. For example, a multi-meter node associated with a power distribution network can be configured to detect the power status change event occurred at the node, such as a power outage event or a power restoration event. Based on the type of the event, the communication module of the multi-meter node identifies meters contained in the multi-meter node that are impacted by the event, such as meters that become unpowered due to a power outage event or meters that become powered due to a power restoration event. The communication module generates a consolidated power status change message for the impacted meters and transmits the message to a headend system over a mesh network.
assignees: LANDIS & GYR INNOVATIONS INC;LANDIS & GYR TECHNOLOGY INC

title_en: Remote power outage and restoration notification
abstract_en: Power outages and restorations at customer premises can be automatically detected and reported. A method includes receiving, from a network terminal, a first notification associated with a power outage; retrieving location information associated with the network terminal; sending a second notification indicating that the outage has occurred and that includes the location information associated with the network terminal; retrieving prior outage information that corresponds to a set of network terminals associated with a group of set top boxes; determining that an outage event is triggered, when a quantity of outages is greater than a threshold, where the quantity of outages is based on the outage and other outages obtained from the prior outage information; and sending a third notification based on the determination that the outage event is triggered, where the third notification includes information associated with the quantity of outages that enables a server to remedy the outage event.
assignees: MEYNARDI ALESSANDRO M;DUBOIS JEAN F;DOEHRING MARTIN;CHENG C P;VERIZON PATENT & LICENSING INC

title_en: Flying soil hanging groove structure for ecological restoration treatment of high and steep slope
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fly and hang native groove structure that steep side slope ecological restoration was administered belongs to the environmental protection technology field. The technical scheme is as follows: one end of the main rib (2) is fixed on one side of the rock platform (8) far away from the mountain rock (1), and the other end of the main rib extends upwards; one end of the tie bar (6) is fixed on one side of the rock platform close to the mountain rock, and the other end of the tie bar extends to the oblique upper side of one side far away from the mountain rock (1) and is welded with the part of the main bar (2) extending upwards; the reinforcing mesh (7) is arranged on the main rib (2), and the sprayed concrete wall (5) is arranged around the main rib and the reinforcing mesh; the corrugated template (3) is arranged on the inner side of the sprayed concrete wall; and nutrient planting soil (4) is arranged among the waveform template, the mountain rock and the rock platform. The utility model has the advantages that: greatly reduces the cost of ecological restoration, is simple and rapid in construction, takes effect quickly, controls the further damage of the ecological environment, and effectively treats geological disasters.
assignees: THE SECOND GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE OF HEBEI BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL RESOURCES EXPLOR;TANGSHAN ZHONGDI GEOLOGICAL ENG COMPANY

title_en: Dual-layer optimization fault recovery method based on electric-gas coupling integrated energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of dual-layer optimization fault recovery method based on electric-gas coupling integrated energy system, the present invention constructs comprehensive energy power distribution network using natural gas as spare energy, keeps non-faulting power loss area power loss amount of recovery maximum and based model for load duration is powered.It establishes bi-level optimal model and comprehensive energy distribution network restoration range is mutually coordinated with economy with the feature of environmental protection, upper layer model is optimal for target with the whole network fault recovery index, switch state and grey target contribution degree are obtained to index objective assignment using ant group algorithm is improved, and utilize grey target target center degree comprehensive assessment recovery scheme；Underlying model establishes the multilevel recovery model based on multi-agent system and obtains specific isolated island recovery scheme using scheduling broker rational management renewable energy and energy storage and pass to layer model using integrated energy system economy and the feature of environmental protection as target.Node emulation, which shows to reduce using electric-gas coupling comprehensive energy recovery power distribution network, gives up load condition, extends to obtain the electric load duration.

title_en: Main and distribution network accident recovery processing method based on index set weight
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a main network and distribution network accident recovery processing method based on index set weight, which comprises the steps of analyzing a main network power loss area according to a network topology model after receiving fault equipment, analyzing all main network power return paths according to a fault recovery method of layered partitions, and carrying out priority ordering on pre-arranged plans by an intelligently generated pre-arranged plan set according to the index set weight. After analyzing the main network restoration scheme, if the 10kV bus which is not subjected to power restoration still exists or the 10kV bus which is out of limit exists after the power flow calculation is carried out, the distribution network carries out power restoration or power supply on the capacity gap meeting the 10kV bus according to the power supply transfer capacity gap and the radial network topological structure, each weight coefficient value of each group of power restoration schemes is configured, the distribution network side schemes are subjected to priority sequencing, and a unified and complete main distribution network complex circuit path strategy is formed. The method is beneficial to timely knowing the safe and stable state of the power grid, can be supported by the decision of accident handling in advance, and has important significance for improving the handling capacity of dispatching operation personnel for major faults of the power grid.
assignees: JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Self-service big data multistage closed loop restoration method and device for power enterprise
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-service big data multistage closed loop repairing method for a power enterprise, which comprises the following steps: the data acquisition is carried out in a data acquisition mode according to time intervals, abnormal data identification is carried out by adopting a threshold value method, the captured abnormal data is subjected to partition repair, so that the repair work of the abnormal data is converted into a multi-stage closed loop mode, and the system performance of repairing various data is realized. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the abnormal data identification module is optimized, a data calculation threshold value is set, abnormal data identification is achieved according to a smooth estimation threshold value algorithm, the repair grade is set according to the data type in data repair according to the data partition calculation process, the multi-stage closed-loop data repair process is completed by combining the traditional data repair technology, and the data repair integrity and the data bearing capacity are improved.
assignees: DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Visual management system for drainage pipe network detection data
abstract_en: The utility model provides a visual management system of drainage pipe network detection data, includes data import module, data storage module, map module, data query module, data display module and cost estimation module, the data import module imports drainage pipe network detection data, data storage module has a plurality of pipe network attribute field bars of establishing, the map module calls the pipe network coordinate parameter of storage in data storage module, with the position of pipe network facility like the show, data query module looks over the various basic information and the detection information of pipeline section through condition inquiry or fuzzy inquiry according to different field information, data display module is used for showing the attribute information and the defect information of pipe network, cost estimation module is used for assessing the restoration and the maintenance cost of pipe network defect. The system can automatically import detection videos and defect results, generate a drainage network detection data dynamic database, ensure the accuracy of the data and have good visual display capacity.
assignees: NORTH CHINA MUNICIPAL ENG DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Completion method for missing daily freezing data of electric energy meter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for complementing missing day freezing data of an electric energy meter, belongs to the technical field of electric power marketing electric quantity monitoring and analysis, relates to a method for complementing missing data of the electric energy meter, and particularly relates to a method for complementing missing data of the electric energy meter, which is used for complementing the missing data of the electric energy meter with missing day freezing data and certain days freezing data. The method comprises the steps of obtaining basic information of a user and relevant characteristic factors of electricity utilization; forming an electric energy data time series characteristic diagram; dividing the training set, the verification set and the test set; transmitting the electric energy data time series characteristic diagram to an input layer of the LSTM network; training and modeling the LSTM network by using the training set data to obtain an LSTM model; inputting the verification set into an LSTM model to determine the optimal parameters of the model; testing the LSTM model; restoring data of the date missing date of the daily freezing data; and outputting a daily freezing data restoration result of the missing date. The method fills data loss, improves the data quality of power supply enterprises, improves the recovery accuracy of the lost data, and has high missing completion accuracy.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ZHENJIANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Engineering cost approximate calculation method and device special for soil remediation engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to a project cost approximate calculation method and a device special for soil restoration engineering, which automatically judge whether the current engineering adopts a quota pricing mode or a market pricing mode by using a binary decision tree, and select project characteristics of the split tree based on the principle of maximum amplitude of prediction precision improvement when splitting the decision tree so as to enable the decision tree to split most quickly; meanwhile, for numerical data, data processing is carried out in advance, and a grouping threshold value is determined according to the principle of the maximum prediction precision, so that the algorithm is simple and clear, and the computer computing power is saved; for the soil restoration project without the instructive pricing specification, corresponding model training is carried out, so that the current project can be matched with a proper historical project record, and the accuracy of the approximate calculation of the project cost is improved; meanwhile, an option for independently determining which pricing mode is selected is provided for the user, and the pricing mode can be adjusted in three aspects of manual operation, material operation and mechanical operation, so that the user can use the pricing mode conveniently.
assignees: THE BROTHERS ENG CONSULTING CO LTD;UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Soil pollution prevention and control integrated platform and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a soil pollution prevention and control integrated platform and a method thereof, wherein the soil pollution prevention and control integrated platform comprises a soil environment investigation management module, and the soil environment investigation management module can obtain on-site survey, soil sampling, underground water sampling and sample detection results; the soil environment restoration management module is used for making a soil restoration scheme according to on-site survey, soil sampling, underground water sampling and sample detection results, monitoring the soil restoration process, obtaining a final soil restoration result, judging the final soil restoration result by utilizing evaluation data, and taking corresponding risk control measures for the land parcel which cannot reach an ideal restoration target; and the soil environment comprehensive analysis module is used for counting and analyzing the final soil remediation result and visually displaying the soil environment data. The soil environment can be effectively investigated and managed, the repairing process of the polluted soil needing to be repaired is effectively supervised, the soil pollution prevention and treatment efficiency is improved, and the personnel investment is reduced.
assignees: SUZHOU IND PARK SURVEYING MAPPING AND GEOINFORMATION CO LTD

title_en: Efficiency optimization method for in-situ restoration integrated equipment of underground water
abstract_en: The invention discloses an efficiency optimization method of underground water in-situ restoration integrated equipment, which comprises the following steps: s1: modeling a process of repairing a polluted stratum by a GCW+ system through COMSOL; s2: taking a scene, an environment or a stratum condition as input, and inputting the scene, the environment or the stratum condition into a COMSOL model for simulation; s3: obtaining initial pollutant concentration prediction data of different pollution sites according to input conditions; s4: and evaluating and optimizing the output prediction data. Based on a physical model, the prediction accuracy and reliability of underground water flow and pollutant transmission processes are improved through multi-parameter modeling of scenes, environments and stratum conditions, and the method can be widely applied to actual underground water pollution restoration.
assignees: SICHUAN RUIMEIDI ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT TECH CO LTD;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power distribution network fault line restoration method and system considering extreme weather oscillation stage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for repairing a fault line of a power distribution network by considering an extreme weather oscillation stage, and belongs to the field of power system optimization operation; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power distribution network line information, and acquiring time nodes of an extreme weather final oscillation stage and power distribution network line fault information; constructing constraint conditions of operation of the power distribution network; according to the power distribution network line information, a virtual network with the same topological structure as the original network of the power distribution network is established by combining a single commodity flow method, and a power distribution network reconstruction constraint condition based on the virtual network is obtained; constructing an objective function of a fault line repair model considering generalized resource time scheduling in an extreme weather oscillation stage; establishing constraint conditions of a fault line repair model considering generalized resource time scheduling in an extreme weather oscillation stage; and solving a fault line repair model considering the generalized resource time scheduling in the extreme weather oscillation stage to obtain a generalized maintenance resource time scheduling scheme of the fault line in the extreme weather oscillation stage.

title_en: Transformer substation anti-seismic toughness determination method and system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a substation anti-seismic toughness determination method and system based on data analysis, and relates to the field of power system evaluation. By defining a function state F and a toughness evaluation index R of a transformer substation system, establishing a function relation between a network directed graph model function state F and a device state s of the transformer substation system, determining related variables of a transformer substation system function loss and a recovery simulation process, acquiring a current state vector of the device and the current function state of the transformer substation system, determining a decision deployment time threshold, determining a device recovery priority according to a device recovery time distribution model and device importance, generating a fault device recovery sequence, obtaining the recovery time of each fault device, decomposing the function recovery process according to a time step delta t, distributing available recovery resources according to a fault device recovery sequence pi, updating the device state s and the transformer substation system function state F, obtaining a transformer substation system function anti-seismic toughness curve, and calculating a corresponding toughness evaluation index.

title_en: Method for relieving waterlogging injury of tea trees and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for relieving waterlogging injury of tea trees and application thereof, wherein a drainage ditch is dredged in time to loosen soil around the tea trees; removing broken branches and injured branches, shearing off the upper section of the tea tree branches, and keeping the distance between the main branches and the ground by 40 cm-50 cm; covering the tea tree with a shading net for 1-2 months. After the method is implemented for 1-2 months, the bud growth vigor of the waterlogged tea tree can be obviously improved, and the damage of waterlogged tea to tea trees is relieved. And the method is low in implementation economic cost, simple, effective and high in reliability, and can be applied to post-disaster restoration after waterlogging of various tea gardens.
assignees: TEA RES INST GUANGDONG ACADEMY AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES;SOUTH CHINA BOTANICAL GARDEN CAS

title_en: Video restoration tampering detection method based on noise residual error and average optical flow
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of multimedia content security, and in particular relates to a video restoration tampering detection method based on noise residual errors and average optical flows, which comprises the following steps of S1, extracting noise of a video, a forward optical flow mode and a backward optical flow mode, acquiring the noise residual errors based on the noise, and averaging the forward optical flow mode and the backward optical flow mode to obtain the average optical flow mode; the method comprises the steps of S2, inputting a noise residual error and an average optical flow mode into an encoder taking SegFormer as a main network to generate multi-scale features, S3, carrying out intra-feature interaction on the generated noise residual error multi-scale features and the average optical flow mode multi-scale features by using a decoder, S4, carrying out inter-feature interaction on the interacted features through a multi-scale feature fusion module, and S5, merging all the features to obtain a tampered positioning area of a final depth restoration video. The method aims to solve the threat of malicious tampering on videos, which is brought to public safety, in the existing depth video restoration technology. Experimental results show that the method has better performance compared with the existing method.

title_en: Geological disaster abnormal data cleaning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for cleaning geological disaster abnormal data, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring data processing. According to the method, the data flow is divided locally by setting the sliding window, the relevance and time sequence characteristics among the data are comprehensively utilized, and the abnormal data are effectively identified. According to the method, firstly, data distribution is dynamically monitored, abnormal points are accurately detected based on abnormal probability calculation and combined abnormal judgment, and abnormal data are further subjected to classification analysis so as to identify potential types and reasons of abnormality generation. By improving the dynamic threshold selection strategy and the dependency relationship representation method, the detection accuracy and applicability of the algorithm are remarkably improved. Finally, the high-efficiency cleaning of the abnormal data is realized, and the quality and reliability of the geological disaster data are improved. The invention not only enhances the accuracy and the scientificity of the geological disaster early warning system, but also provides important technical support for subsequent data restoration and risk assessment, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Source network load storage collaborative transaction decision support system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation and control of power systems, in particular to a source network load storage collaborative transaction decision support system; the technical scheme is that the collaborative transaction decision support system comprises a panoramic monitoring and data fusion module, a multi-time space scale prediction module, a collaborative optimization and game decision module, a transaction strategy management and execution module, a real-time coordination and control module and a simulation deduction and risk assessment module; according to the invention, through constructing the panoramic monitoring and data fusion module, the whole-flow closed-loop management from a data source to high-quality information output is realized, the module breaks barriers among systems through the multi-source data acquisition unit, the indifferent access to source, network, lotus and storage all-link heterogeneous data is realized, the data cleaning and reduction unit extracts massive original data, and the data impurity is removed through systematic abnormal recognition, restoration and standardization treatment, so that the data quality is remarkably improved.
assignees: HUANENG JILIN ENERGY SALES CO LTD

title_en: Dynamically selecting optimal instance type for disaster recovery in the cloud
abstract_en: One example includes performing a VM restore instance type discovery process, creating a test VM with a VM restore instance type matching a VM restore instance type identified during discovery, using the test VM to create a test restore VM at a cloud storage site, restoring the test VM at the cloud storage site using the test restore VM, generating a 4-D baseline vector based on the restoration of the test VM, the 4-D baseline vector identifying a particular VM restore instance type, generating a 5-D vector based on the 4-D baseline vector, ranking the 5-D vector relative to other 5-D vectors, the 5-D vectors identifying the same production site VM, and restoring, at the cloud storage site, the production site VM identified in the 5-D vectors, the production site VM restored at the cloud storage site has a VM restore instance type identified in the highest ranked 5-D vector.

title_en: The electric power apparatus examination optimization method to be retracted based on the fuzzy enlistment age
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of electric power apparatus examination optimization methods to be retracted based on the fuzzy enlistment age, the uncertainty of effect is promoted to equipment failure rate according to maintenance activity, fuzzy fitting is carried out to failure rate in device history data, it proposes to obscure enlistment age rollback failure rate prediction model, and consider reliability and economy, establish elastic stage maintenance decision Optimized model.The failure rate distribution function of equipment after maintenance is calculated by using fuzzy enlistment age rollback model, and the solving-optimizing of electric power apparatus examination time is carried out with elastic stage maintenance decision Optimized model.Wherein, constraints failure rate limit value being most worth as equipment failure rate distribution function after maintenance so that the overall life cycle cost of equipment is more economic.This method has fully considered ambiguity and randomness of the maintenance to single transformer equipment failure probability and service life, contributes to power grid enterprises' reasonable arrangement repair schedule, reliably extends service life of equipment.

title_en: Power system attacked measurement data two-layer repairing method based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data-driven-based two-layer repairing method for attacked measured data of an electric power system, which relates to the field of operation safety maintenance of the electric power system, and is characterized in that a measured regression model under each topological structure is established according to network parameter information of regional power grids, and attacked measured vectors under FDIA working conditions are simulated; the attacked data is separated by combining multidimensional scaling with federal forest algorithm in the upper layer; inputting the separated normal data into a generator G of an underlying modified CBEGAN to generate data G (z); injecting the G (z) and the history measurement regression model into a discriminator D, and distinguishing authenticity by calculating the Hellinger distance between the reconstruction error distribution of the real sample and the generated sample; and judging convergence through the target M, and finally realizing data restoration. The invention can effectively repair the measured data on the basis of the residual normal data, realizes the self-healing capability of recovery after the power grid is attacked, and has better measurement convergence, control distribution diversity and practicability.

title_en: Ecological restoration method for rock slope of mine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration of mine rock slopes, and discloses a method for ecological restoration of mine rock slopes. The method for judging the rock slope instability of the mine can carry out scientific cause analysis on landslide disasters and obtain accurate judgment results of the rock slope instability of the mine, so that theoretical basis is provided for reinforcement of the rock slope of the mine, meanwhile, the point cloud data of the slope is divided into a block part and a non-block part by a monitoring method for deformation of the rock slope of the mine, the block deformation method is used for detecting deformation such as rotation and offset of a block, the point cloud subtraction method is used for detecting change of the non-block part, and the two parts are overlapped together to comprehensively analyze and judge the overall deformation condition of the slope. Compared with the traditional point cloud subtraction method, the deformation condition of the rock mass can be accurately and comprehensively detected.

title_en: Use of chitosan oligosaccharide and its composition in crop growth restoration after frost damage
abstract_en: The invention relates to use of chitosan oligosaccharide and its composition in crop growth restoration after frost damage, and specificallyprovides the use of a pesticide composition comprisingchitosan oligosaccharide for crops to resist frost. The use provided by the invention is characterized in that the pesticide composition comprises 0.0035% to 0.23% by weight of chitosan oligosaccharide. The use anda method of chitosan oligosaccharide to restore crop growth after frost or freeze damage provided by the invention solve the problem that at present there is no effective measure for restoring crop growth after frost or freeze damage, playing an important role in reducing the effect of natural disasters on crops.
assignees: HAINAN ZHENGYE ZHONGNONG HIGH TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Direct current convertor station containing power supply recovery route optimization method based on artificial bee colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a direct current convertor station containing power supply recovery route optimization method based on an artificial bee colony algorithm. The maximum ratio between electric energy production and recovery time in a recovery process of a to-be-recovered power supply is taken as the optimization target; a partial optimized power transmission path of a to-be-started power supply is solved based on a Dijkstra shortest route algorithm; and a global optimal recovery route is solved based on the artificial bee colony algorithm. The power supply recovery route optimization method comprises the steps of 1, initializing power supply recovery sequence codes; 2, searching a shortest route from an electrified system to the to-be-recovered power supply by adopting the Dijkstra algorithm; 3, performing technological verification on the to-be-recovered power supply and the recovered path of the to-be-recovered power supply; and 4, optimizing the power supply recovery sequences based on the artificial bee colony algorithm. According to the method, a universal mode for optimizing the power transmission route of a power grid containing the direct current convertor station is proposed; the optimization is realized based on the advantages of high rate of convergence and strong global searching capability of the artificial bee colony algorithm; and the optimization method is of great significance for a black-start scheme after blackouts.
assignees: UNIV NANJING SCIENCE & TECH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Green mine construction planning method based on live-action three-dimensional modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green mine construction planning method based on live-action three-dimensional modeling, which comprises the steps of obtaining geographic data of a target area, constructing a point cloud model and a TIN model, constructing an original landform live-action three-dimensional model, constructing a mining area mining planning live-action three-dimensional model and constructing an ecological restoration planning live-action three-dimensional model. Preferably, under the condition that the mine has geological disaster hidden trouble, before the step of constructing the ecological restoration planning live-action three-dimensional model, the method further comprises the step of constructing a mining area disaster management planning live-action three-dimensional model. The invention has the advantages that the unmanned aerial vehicle oblique photography technology and the three-dimensional geographic information software platform are comprehensively utilized, the two-dimensional plane design conversion three-dimensional model, the design model and the current situation real scene three-dimensional model are fused, the mine exploitation, the staged exploitation and greening, the geological disaster treatment and the post-exploitation ecological restoration design scheme are truly presented in the real scene three-dimensional model, and objective and intuitive scientific evaluation support is provided for the construction of green mines.
assignees: CHINA GEZHOUBA GROUP YIPULI CO LTD

title_en: Risk management and control system for treating arsenic pollution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk management and control system for treating arsenic pollution, which is a 'risk-based treatment method' with strong adaptability, and can protect human health and environmental sanitation while managing and controlling soil risk. At present, the concept of soil risk management and control is not defined in detail at home and abroad, but according to risk elements related to soil environment, the soil environment risk management and control refers to that a leaching risk assessment method is established for risk sources, exposure ways and risk receptors, the leaching risk of soil is quantified through surface water body hazard quotient, the formulation of a restoration target value is guided together by combining human health risk assessment results, risk management and control measures are scientifically and reasonably formulated, key prevention and control are carried out on high-risk polluted media, and excessive restoration of low-risk pollutants is avoided.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE;ENERGY SAVING IN CHINA CHINA SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Ecological restoration treatment method based on historical abandoned mine
abstract_en: The application discloses an ecological restoration treatment method based on a historical abandoned mine. The ecological restoration treatment method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of topographic mapping, danger elimination, side slope trimming, site leveling, mine greening reclamation, drainage interception engineering and monitoring maintenance engineering. The application acquires the topography and three-dimensional image data of the current mine by mapping the mine, carries out danger elimination and clearing on dangerous rock bodies, collapse, unstable slopes and other ground disaster points existing in the mine, trims the side slopes, fully utilizes waste stones to level the mine topography, carries out regrinding on the mine, carries out intercepting and drainage engineering arrangement on the mining area, prevents water and soil loss, carries out regular monitoring and maintenance on the mining area after regrinding, and ensures that the survival rate of vegetation increases the coverage rate of the vegetation. The application can be used for treating abandoned mines and has the advantages of good treatment effect, improvement of the stability of mine slopes, reduction of geological disasters, beautification of mine geological environment, high vegetation coverage rate and increase of effective cultivated land.
assignees: MCC WUKAN ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Electric quantity data restoration method and system based on power grid operation mechanism
abstract_en: The application provides an electric quantity data restoration method and system based on an electric network operation mechanism, which comprise the steps of obtaining operation data of an electric network, carrying out data check on the operation data of the electric network by utilizing a consistency check method based on the electric network operation mechanism to obtain abnormal electric quantity data of the electric network, carrying out abnormal classification on the abnormal electric quantity data by utilizing a rule-based classification method to obtain an abnormal type to which the abnormal electric quantity data belongs, carrying out data restoration on the abnormal electric quantity data by utilizing a pre-constructed electric quantity balance model according to the abnormal type, and carrying out data check on the operation data of the electric network by utilizing the electric network operation mechanism, so that judgment errors caused by data errors are reduced, and carrying out data restoration on the abnormal electric quantity data subjected to data check by utilizing the pre-constructed electric quantity balance model so as to quickly, automatically and accurately correct the abnormal electric quantity data.
assignees: BEIJING GUODIANTONG NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic scheduling method, system and readable storage medium for power disaster relief and repair
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power disaster relief and repair scheduling, in particular to a power disaster relief and repair dynamic scheduling method, a power disaster relief and repair dynamic scheduling system and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps of S1, S2, S3, S4, calculating an optimal repair strategy, wherein the dynamic network topology model G of a disaster relief scene is built, the dynamic power recovery model GP is built, the first-aid repair dynamic decision model is built through an objective function, the optimal repair strategy is calculated according to the latest dynamic network topology model G, the power recovery model GP and the current position of an electric facility node of a rescue team, and the optimal repair strategy is obtained by solving the current position of the electric facility node based on a Monte Carlo tree search algorithm. The method considers that the situation of the disaster relief site can change dynamically, and the emergency repair strategy is adjusted dynamically according to the changing situation of the site.
assignees: HUBEI CENTRAL CHINA TECH DEVELOPMENT OF ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster power communication network collaborative recovery system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid dispatching and communication network recovery, and provides a post-disaster power communication network collaborative recovery system and a post-disaster power communication network collaborative recovery method, wherein the system comprises a power network model, a power distribution system and a communication network collaborative recovery system, wherein the power network model is used for distributing power supply resources to each node by taking power supply of power network nodes of a shortest time recovery target area as a target; the system comprises a line restoration model, an electric vehicle path planning model, an unmanned aerial vehicle deployment communication network restoration model, an optimal scheme solving unit and a power communication network node, wherein the line restoration model is used for taking an electric vehicle as a load supply and mobile restoration unit, and realizing joint optimization of power network topology reconstruction and power restoration of a target area by coordinating path planning and resource allocation of the electric vehicle, the electric vehicle path planning model is used for taking maximum restoration of power supply of the target area as a target, enabling the electric vehicle to quickly restore the power network within a limited time by optimizing a moving path of the electric vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle deployment communication network restoration model is used for taking minimum restoration of the communication network as a target, and combining cooperative work of the electric vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle is deployed as a temporary air base station while power is supplied by a base station node, and the optimal scheme solving unit is provided with a layered multi-target optimization problem for maximizing total power communication coverage time as a target function under the condition of minimizing the restoration time of the power communication network.

title_en: Method and device for recovering power supply of comprehensive energy system and comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for recovering power supply of a comprehensive energy system and the comprehensive energy system. The method comprises the steps of modeling a comprehensive energy system to obtain a device coupling model and an energy consumption model corresponding to the comprehensive energy system, determining an electric power demand interval of the electric power system connected to the comprehensive energy system in a power failure period, determining an objective function corresponding to power restoration in the power failure period based on load reduction cost of the electric power system, wherein a function value of the objective function is a power failure loss minimum value in the power failure period, solving the switching state of each switch in the comprehensive energy system based on the objective function by taking the device coupling model, the energy consumption model and the electric power demand interval as constraints, and controlling each switch according to the control parameters to restore the power supply of the comprehensive energy system. The power supply system can adapt to the power demand of a power system, and aims at minimum power failure loss and recovering the power supply of the comprehensive energy system.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SOLAX POWER NETWORK ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Planning method and system for disaster recovery path of satellite network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of satellite network communication, and particularly discloses a planning method and a planning system for a satellite network disaster recovery path, wherein the planning method comprises the steps of monitoring and acquiring a network state in real time, and constructing a satellite network directed graph model based on the network state; calculating normalized information betweenness of all satellite links in a satellite network directed graph model to generate a mixed weight model, constructing a path cost function based on the mixed weight model and path hops, planning a disaster recovery path based on the path cost function and an improved Ford-Fulkerson algorithm to obtain a disaster recovery path planning result, and planning a path based on the disaster recovery path planning result. The method realizes the joint optimization of load balancing and disaster recovery capability, further realizes the synchronous optimization of communication fault restoration and low-centrality alternative paths, and ensures the high efficiency and reliability of network communication.

title_en: Information cooperation system and information cooperation method
abstract_en: To provide an information cooperation system and an information cooperation method enabling a restoration work of a power substation where power failure occurs to be efficiently executed.SOLUTION: An information cooperation system of an embodiment has an operation management server, an operator terminal, and a manager terminal. The operation management server plans a restoration procedure of a power substation according to detection of a power failure of the power substation. The operator terminal notifies an operator executing the restoration procedure planned by the operation management server of the procedure. The manager terminal notifies a manager of a restoration work of a state of the work of the power substation based on a result of the restoration procedure executed according to the notification.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP;TOSHIBA INFRASTRUCTURE SYSTEMS & SOLUTIONS CORP

title_en: Network management device, method, and program
abstract_en: A network management device according to one embodiment of the present invention includes: an extraction unit that, on the basis of prediction information for an area in which a disaster occurs, extracts a building in an area in which a failure is predicted to occur in communication by the disaster reaching a communication facility, from among buildings which constitute a network configuration of a plurality of areas and which have communication facilities accommodated therein; a resource calculation unit that, under the condition of assuming that the failure indicated by the prediction information has occurred, calculates a resource to be used for a restoration work, of the failure, on the building extracted by the extraction unit; and a plan processing unit that, when a communication failure has actually occurred in the building extracted by the extraction unit, plans the restoration work, of the occurred failure, on the building extracted by the extraction unit, by using the resource calculated by the resource calculation unit.

title_en: Non-Volatile Flip-Flop with Enhanced-Scan Capability to Sustain Sudden Power Failure
abstract_en: Non-volatile flip-flops (NVFFs) based circuitries and schemes that incorporate magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs) are provided to ensure fast data storage and restoration from an intentional or unintentional power outage. The NVFFs based circuitries and schemes also include enhanced scan mode testing capability by exploiting the nonvolatile latch to function as hold latch for delay testing. The NVFFs based circuitries and schemes eliminate additional write drivers, and may operate at an operation frequency of, for example, up to 2 GHz at a supply voltage of 1.1 V and with 0.55 pJ of energy consumption. A near uniform write latency can be achieved through transistor sizing, given write asymmetry of MTJs. NVFFs based circuitries and schemes incorporating data-dependent power gating circuitries can be used to mitigate high static currents generated during retention and back-to-back writing of identical input data.
assignees: GHOSH SWAROOP;IYENGAR ANIRUDH SRIKANT;JANG JAE-WON;UNIV SOUTH FLORIDA

title_en: A kind of more gate dam plain tract wintering ecology flow calculation methods
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of more gate dam plain tract wintering ecology flow calculation methods, for more gate dam plain tract biology Habitat Characteristics, based on fish overwinter phase Habitat requirement, the method specifically includes: investigating first survey region Status of Fisher Resources, it determines the alternative fish that ecological flow calculates, Fish of interest is further then screened using Hierarchy Analysis Method；Pass through indoor water temperature response experiment for the Fish of interest filtered out and historical summary is collected, establishes Fish of interest Wintering Period to the quantitative response curve of water temperature；According to river temperature Characteristics of Vertical Distribution, combining target species wintering ground Habitat requirement determines the eco-grounderwater level for guaranteeing Fish of interest safe overwintering, and flow needed for maintaining eco-grounderwater level is calculated using water balance formula.The invention can instruct more gate dam plain tract restorations of the ecosystem and protection, and watershed water resources and configuration have important theory and practice meaning.

title_en: Photovoltaic power station monitoring data restoration method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data restoration processing, and particularly discloses a photovoltaic power station monitoring data restoration method, which comprises the following steps: searching whether temperature and humidity information, illumination intensity and historical photovoltaic power station output power data in the monitoring data of the photovoltaic power station at the same moment are missing; if the data item is missing, marking the missing data item and excluding the missing data item; training the monitored photovoltaic power station monitoring data after the missing data items are eliminated to obtain a state conversion function; fitting according to an interpolation theory to obtain missing data items, and completing the missing data items in the monitoring data of the photovoltaic power station; inputting the temperature and humidity information, the illumination intensity and historical photovoltaic power station output power data in the completed photovoltaic power station monitoring data into a state conversion function for prediction to obtain a predicted value; and filtering the predicted value to obtain a photovoltaic power station monitoring data restoration result. The photovoltaic power station monitoring data restoration method provided by the invention can realize data restoration.

title_en: Distribution network fault information sending method and system for power supply service command platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network fault information sending method and a distribution network fault information sending system for a power supply service command platform, belongs to the technical field of power dispatching, and particularly relates to a system module for the power supply service command platform, wherein after a fault repair information processing unit receives fault repair information, first information is sent to a distribution transformer area manager, an equipment responsible person and a power user related to the fault repair information; after the fault judgment unit determines the fault point, sending second information to a station manager, an equipment responsible person and a power user of the power equipment within the influence range of the fault point; and after the fault repair information relates to address restoration power supply, sending third information to the personnel receiving the first information and the second information. The method and the system can judge the power-on area and the non-power area according to the circuit topological structure under the condition of accurately providing the distribution network fault information, and timely release the rush-repair information to the related personnel of the non-power area, so that the power supply service command platform meets the technical index of timely and reliably releasing the information.

title_en: Oil field power load management and control system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses the technical field of oilfield power load prediction, which is used for solving the problems that in the existing mode aiming at oilfield power load prediction, correction analysis on abnormal values in load data is omitted, so that the accuracy and precision of oilfield power load prediction results are difficult to ensure, and the management and control work of load prediction on an oilfield power distribution network is greatly influenced, and particularly discloses an oilfield power load management and control system based on data analysis, which comprises a data acquisition unit, an abnormality recognition unit, a repair modeling unit, a data rating unit, an early warning feedback unit and a display terminal; according to the method, the box-line graph method is selected to complete detection and analysis of the abnormal values of the load sequence data, symbolic calibration, formulaic processing and graph comparison are utilized to complete restoration of the abnormal values, and then fusion analysis is conducted on various data signals, so that the accuracy and precision of prediction of the electric load of the oil field are improved, and management and control of the power distribution network of the oil field are promoted.

title_en: Ecological restoration method for partial collapse of high-fill road
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological restoration method for partial collapse of a high-fill road, which comprises the following steps: s01, adopting first vertical pipe grouting and first transverse pipe grouting to carry out temporary support on a collapsed surface of an original road, adopting second vertical pipe grouting and second transverse pipe grouting to carry out temporary support on a far end of an uncollapsed high-fill roadbed, and fastening a stepped light retaining wall with an original foundation through a vertical prestress anchor rod at a boundary line position of the original road; s02, trimming the collapsed surface of the original road into a ladder shape; s03, sequentially filling wall back layered filling soil, EPS light backfill layer and permeable concrete layer from bottom to top between the stepped light retaining wall and the collapse surface of the original road. The method solves the problems that the engineering quantity is large, secondary disasters are easy to occur when the foundation 7 is disturbed greatly and the manufacturing cost is high when the high-fill collapsed road is repaired in the prior art.

title_en: Systems and methods for prioritizing power restoration to sites after a power outage
abstract_en: A device may determine a number of user equipments (UEs) connected to an inactive site during a first period of time and determine that the inactive site experienced a power outage during a second period of time. The device may determine that the UEs connected to a set of active sites during the second period of time. The device may determine one or more key performance indicator (KPI) changes to one or more KPIs, during the second period of time, for each of the set of active sites. The device may determine a plurality of weights associated with the inactive site experiencing the power outage; determine a set of impacts, of the inactive site, on the one or more KPI changes for the set of active sites based on the plurality of weights; and cause power to be restored to the inactive site based on the set of impacts.

title_en: Self-resetting honeycomb beam node
abstract_en: The utility model provides a from honeycomb roof beam node that restores to throne, belongs to building steel technical field, including the intermediate beam section, intermediate beam section both ends are connected with the short beam section one end that corresponds respectively, and install the friction damper at the junction of short beam section and intermediate beam section, and the short beam section other end is connected with the frame post, and is provided with the steel strand wires between frame post and the short beam section simultaneously. The utility model discloses well roof beam-ends has added the self-reset node that has friction damper and power consumption bolt, and it is an integral node, and the friction damper that this structure was added makes its damage that can the effective control major structure in the earthquake and shake the characteristic that the back has the retrieval function with the power consumption bolt, and it is with low costs to shake the back restoration, and the shock resistance is big. The utility model discloses reducing under self weight condition, can also forming the continuous sheet at the web department welding negative reinforcement of adjacent centre sill section, the overall structure firmness that makes roof beam and building combine back formation is high, and the shock resistance improves by a wide margin.

title_en: Long-term weathered sandstone layer deep foundation pit slope restoration and reinforcement system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a long-term weathering sandstone layer deep foundation pit slope repairing and reinforcing system, which belongs to the technical field of building construction and comprises a water intercepting ditch arranged at the top of a deep foundation pit slope and a drainage ditch arranged at the bottom of the slope, wherein a net sheet structure and a plurality of rows of fully-bonded anchor rods are fixed on the slope of the deep foundation pit slope, the net sheet structure covers the water intercepting ditch and the drainage ditch, and a concrete surface layer is integrally sprayed on the net sheet structure. The system ensures that the support of the side slope of the deep foundation pit is firmer and more reliable, avoids the landslide of soil, improves the structural safety of the deep foundation pit, ensures the construction quality, provides a safer and more convenient environment for the construction operation surface of the deep foundation pit, and ensures the long-term stability and safety of projects. Meanwhile, the system of the utility model is provided with the intercepting ditches at the slope top of the side slope and the drainage ditches and the collecting wells at the slope bottom of the side slope, so that the side slope can form a stable system in rainy season or drainage season, the durability of the side slope is increased, and the service life of the side slope is prolonged.

title_en: Automated test method and device for simulating server cluster startup
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automated test method and device for simulating server cluster startup. The method includes DC testing and AC testing. The DC testing includes the following steps that: the Linux is set to character interface startup, passwordless login and tested server login; if the test cycle number of tested servers has achieved a preset test cycle number, the testing is terminated, otherwise, the tested servers are tested, and one cycle is added to the test cycle number; next startup time is set; and the tested servers are restarted, and whether the test cycle number of the tested servers achieves the preset test cycle number is judged. The AC testing includes the following steps that: a central control machine is connected with a switch and a PDU, and the PDU is connected with a preset number of tested servers, the tested servers are connected with the switch; and the central control machine is utilized to perform power outage and power supply restoration operation on the PDU for a preset number of times through a control network, and after power supply is restored, the central control machine is adopted to test the tested servers. With the automated test method and device for simulating server cluster startup of the invention adopted, material costs and labor costs are greatly saved, and the safety of a testing process is improved.

title_en: A kind of power supply reliability monitoring method based on big data
abstract_en: The present invention relates to grid monitoring approach more particularly to a kind of power supply reliability monitoring methods based on big data.A kind of power supply reliability monitoring method based on big data provided by the invention, it is intended to which electric network reliability monitoring method is unreasonable in the prior art for solution, causes the technical problem of subsequent data analysis difficulty.A kind of power supply reliability monitoring method based on big data provided by the invention, acquire the action record of each distribution components when grid power blackout number and grid power blackout, and classified to the reason of grid power blackout, to the type of grid power blackout carry out classify and the power off time of power grid is acquired, acquire power system restoration power when whether livewire work, the monitoring method carries out classification to data and is conducive to technical staff's subsequent analysis data, and, the data of monitoring method acquisition are more comprehensive, are conducive to the subsequent analysis of technical staff.
assignees: WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;WENZHOU TUSHENG SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD;PINGYANG ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: User missing electric quantity data restoration method based on clustering compressed sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for restoring user missing electric quantity data based on clustering compressed sensing. The method comprises the steps of firstly, acquiring the current month electricity utilization information of a user from a metering system, and setting a data missing day and a missing time period; dividing the electricity utilization modes of the users by adopting k-means clustering, and constructing a similar daily electricity utilization matrix according to classification results; calculating a similar daily average power consumption sequence through a similar daily power consumption matrix; pre-filling the electricity quantity of the missing period in the similar day matrix according to the average electricity consumption quantity; judging the distortion degree of the user electric quantity curve, and adopting a pre-filling value to repair serious distortion; dividing the missing time period into blocks according to whether the missing time period is continuously divided before and after, and calculating the electric energy increase rate of each block time period; and if the electric energy fluctuation in the missing period is not in the normal range, the electric energy fluctuation is repaired in a linear interpolation mode, and if the electric energy fluctuation is not in the normal range, the electric energy fluctuation is repaired by adopting compressed sensing. The method can simultaneously consider the horizontal and vertical similarities of the data, and has higher accuracy rate for repairing the continuous missing electric quantity of the user.
assignees: KUNMING ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network load missing data recovery method based on approximate low-rank matrix completion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network load missing data recovery method based on approximate low-rank matrix completion, which comprises the following steps of: s1, dividing the load historical data into a data loss vector and a data complete vector; s2, forming an original matrix; s3, interpolating the missing elements to form a primary recovery matrix; s4, solving a Pearson correlation coefficient matrix for the initial recovery matrix, and screening out vectors with high correlation with data missing vectors; s5, screening the original vector containing data loss through a Pearson correlation coefficient matrix; s6, restoring and complementing the missing elements in the restoration matrix by using a singular value threshold contraction algorithm; and S7, taking out the next vector with data loss, and repeating the steps. Compared with the traditional low-rank matrix completion algorithm, the improved algorithm has better overall recovery effect and stability, and is more excellent in completing the load missing data of the power distribution network.

title_en: Quick power restoration management platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid power restoration management platform, which integrates data of a distribution and dispatching intensive application system, a safety production management system and a marketing management system, and comprises: the fault monitoring module generates a fault alarm event when the main network equipment fails; the dispatching fault reporting module generates a fault reporting work order according to the fault warning event and transmits the fault reporting work order to the power failure pool; the fault repair module generates a fault repair work order according to the fault reported by the client and transmits the fault repair work order to the power failure pool; stopping the battery to convert the fault reporting work order into a fault power failure event, synchronizing the fault power failure event to a safety production management system for fault first-aid repair processing and synchronizing the fault power failure event to a marketing management system for power failure notification; the power failure monitoring module counts all fault power failure events in the day; the fault processing progress monitoring module counts the number of faults according to the processing progress of all fault power failure events in the day; and the emergency repair resource management module allocates corresponding emergency repair materials for the fault power failure event. The invention enhances the customer power failure management, reduces the customer power failure time and improves the customer satisfaction.

title_en: Method for evaluating toughness of power distribution network in typhoon weather, storage medium and equipment
