abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-stage evaluation method, a storage medium and equipment for the toughness of a power distribution network in typhoon weather, wherein when no typhoon disaster occurs, the influence of the typhoon disaster on the power distribution network and the response process of the power distribution network to the typhoon disaster are simulated and analyzed, and the pre-disaster toughness index of the power distribution network is counted and calculated; in the typhoon disaster occurrence process, calculating toughness indexes in the power distribution network disaster according to real-time data returned by the power distribution network data acquisition and monitoring control system; acquiring actual data of emergency response and emergency repair of the power distribution network after the typhoon leaves the environment, and calculating a post-disaster toughness index of the power distribution network; the three-stage toughness level of the power distribution network is quantized, and the pre-disaster firmness degree, the in-disaster resisting capability, the post-disaster recovery efficiency and the comprehensive toughness of the power distribution network for coping with typhoon disasters are quantized. The method can be used for guiding reinforcement of the elements of the power distribution network when no typhoon occurs, emergency control in the process of typhoon disaster and emergency repair and power restoration after typhoon disaster, and provides quantitative basis for system planning, operation scheduling and restoration decision.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Heavy metal contaminated soil treatment and remediation decision-making method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heavy metal contaminated soil treatment and restoration decision-making method, which comprises the steps of firstly, acquiring basic data of heavy metal contaminated soil, wherein the basic data comprises human health risk data, pollution risk data and ecological risk data; then, comprehensively evaluating the human health risk data, the pollution risk data and the ecological risk data to determine different risk levels, substituting the risk data into a pre-trained feedforward neural network model, carrying out auxiliary decision-making on the heavy metal contaminated soil treatment and restoration, and outputting a recommended technical scheme; and finally, carrying out cost accurate measurement and calculation according to the recommended technical scheme and the remediation formula quantities of different risk levels to obtain a treatment and remediation decision-making scheme, establishing a soil remediation range and formula quantity estimation and soil remediation decision-making system based on a neural network model, realizing intelligent and accurate decision-making recommendation of the soil remediation scheme, and providing technical support for efficiently developing heavy metal contaminated soil treatment and remediation.
assignees: YONKER ENV PROT CO LTD;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Landslide body side slope ecological restoration structure and restoration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide body side slope ecological restoration structure, which comprises: the ecological restoration layer comprises a plurality of first fixed barrels and a plurality of second fixed barrels, wherein the first fixed barrels and the second fixed barrels are communicated with the water pipe network, herbaceous plants are planted in the first fixed barrels, shrubs are planted in the second fixed barrels, and two adjacent first fixed barrels are connected through anchor rod assemblies. When the invention is applied, the landslide slope is firstly leveled, then the metal net, the water pipe net and the ecological restoration layer are sequentially paved on the slope, when heavy rain is encountered, the rainwater flows out through the water pipe net, the erosion of the rainwater to the landslide slope is reduced, and meanwhile, the first fixing cylinder and the second fixing cylinder are communicated with the water pipe net, so that part of the rainwater is absorbed by shrubs and herbaceous plants, the plant growth is promoted, and the soil fixing and slope protection effects are better.
assignees: INST OF GEOLOGY AND NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION GANSU ACADEMY OF SCIENCE

title_en: Corn disaster monitoring and ecological restoration assessment method based on multi-source remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing monitoring, in particular to a corn disaster monitoring and ecological restoration assessment method based on multi-source remote sensing data. Comprising the following steps: continuously measuring and sampling corn plots, extracting Sentinel data, and analyzing characteristic time variation; acquiring and processing high-resolution binary data to obtain a multispectral image and performing visual interpretation; establishing a sample data set of corn disaster degree; masking the Sentinel data as an input dataset; performing mask processing on the preprocessed Sentinel data, performing characteristic calculation, and creating a characteristic parameter set; constructing a random forest model; training and optimizing the random forest model to obtain a corn disaster degree monitoring model, obtaining a corn disaster degree spatial distribution result according to the model, and analyzing the corn ecological change condition to realize corn disaster monitoring. The advantages are that: and the dynamic change monitoring of the post-disaster growth of the corn is realized, and the post-disaster loss is estimated.

title_en: Abnormal data evaluation and repair method based on power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing of power systems, and discloses an abnormal data evaluation and repair method based on a power system, which comprises the following steps of S1, data preprocessing; S2, an abnormal data evaluation model, S2.1, incomplete data identification by using a K-nearest neighbor algorithm, S2.2, inaccurate data identification by using a time sequence abnormal detection method based on a sliding window, S2.3, abnormal data restoration, S3.1, incomplete and inaccurate marked data restoration by using a weighted mean correction model, S3.2, incomplete data restoration by using an ARIMA prediction model, S4, correction result fusion, and comprehensive correction of different types of abnormal data is formed by combining weighted mean correction and ARIMA prediction results by using a weighted ARIMA fusion correction model. The strategy of multi-algorithm fusion avoids the possible limitation caused by a single algorithm, thereby improving the accuracy and pertinence of abnormal data identification.
assignees: INFORMATION & COMM CO STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Micro-grid contact path optimization method considering power restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microgrid connection path optimization method considering power restoration, which comprises the steps of adopting an NSGA-II algorithm to solve a constructed microgrid connection path multi-objective optimization model to obtain a pareto dominant solution of the microgrid connection path multi-objective optimization model, selecting an optimal solution in a power restoration scene from the pareto dominant solution to obtain a feeder line needing to be connected, and optimizing the installation position of the feeder line needing to be connected to obtain the optimal installation position of the connection. According to the invention, the high-efficiency transfer of the load is realized by optimizing the contact path, so that the power supply reliability and the operation flexibility of the micro-grid under the condition of island operation or main grid power interruption are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Water data processing method, processing device, user water meter and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a water consumption data processing method, a water consumption data processing device, a user water meter and a computer program product. According to the method, when the sampling frequency of the water consumption data is increased, the water consumption rule of a user is combined, lossless compression is respectively carried out on the zero-flow water consumption data and the non-zero-flow water consumption data meeting the compression condition, a data packet is formed by packing a compression result, the data packet is uploaded to an upper computer, and water consumption characteristic analysis is carried out after analysis and restoration by the upper computer. In this way, the acquisition capability of the user water meter is not limited by the traditional hardware conditions, is not limited by the low-frequency sampling of tens of minutes, and can realize the high-frequency sampling of seconds or even milliseconds. In the process, the calculation or storage burden of the user water meter is not increased remarkably, the lossless compression is light and efficient, the high-frequency acquisition, the rapid processing and the low-load uploading can be realized under the condition of limited resources, and powerful support is provided for the characteristic analysis of the refined water.

title_en: Restoration planning apparatus, restoration planning method, and restoration planning program
abstract_en: To provide a technique for formulating a restoration plan in consideration of a gap between a real-time estimated value of a damage level assumed in the event of a disaster and a damage level assumed in advance.SOLUTION: A restoration planning apparatus 11 includes: a probability density distribution calculation unit (calculation unit) 113 which calculates a probability density distribution indicating an occurrence probability density of a damage level of a damage which occurs due to a predetermined disaster, for each restoration object, in the restoration objects which are facilities to be restored or areas to be restored; a priority calculation unit (setting unit) 114 which receives a real-time estimated value of a damage level of the damage in each restoration object assumed based on the disaster in the event of the disaster, integrates probability densities of a differential section between the real-time estimated value of the damage level and a true value of the damage level of the probability density distribution, and sets priority of changing restoration plans of the restoration objects in descending order of an integrated values, respectively; and a priority display unit (display unit) 115 which displays the priority changing the restoration plans in association with each of the restoration objects, on a screen.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Data management device and DR cost calculation support method
abstract_en: To provide a data management device for supporting operation by calculating cost at the time of a disaster of the volume of a DR site of a virtual environment, and a DR cost calculation support method.SOLUTION: A data management device being a restoration support device includes a DR operation phase determination part for executing DR operation phase determination processing on the basis of a copy situation table for managing copy configuration information for managing a pair configuration of an object task use volume and a copy volume, and copy situations in the object task use volume and the copy volume in acquiring object task specification information for specifying an object task, and a disaster correspondence cost calculation part for calculating a usage fee of a DR site of a cloud environment until calculating a disaster pattern corresponding to a disaster situation of the volume of an affected disaster object in accordance with the calculated operation phase and completing a system recovery of a use site with a use volume created from a fault occurrence in each disaster pattern.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Cold load pickup support through local condition detection
abstract_en: A cold load pickup device includes a load controller comprising a microprocessor or microcontroller. The device is programmed to detect restoration of power after a power outage on a circuit powering an electric load. A power outage time for the power outage is determined, and a startup delay for the electric load is determined based on the power outage time. A startup delay mechanism, such as a power relay operated by the load controller or switching of the load on/off by the load controller, is configured to apply the startup delay after the detected restoration of power before restarting the electric load. In some embodiments, the startup delay for the electric load is determined based on the power outage time and a startup delay versus power outage time curve stored in a non-volatile memory of the load controller.

title_en: Phased network formation for power restoration
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a device receives a router advertisement message after a power outage event in a network. The device joins the network, in response to receiving the router advertisement message. The device sends a power restoration notification message via the network. The device selectively delays a disconnected node from joining the network.

title_en: Parallel accelerated solution method for post-disaster restoration of power system based on quantum computing
abstract_en: The present application relates to the technical field of power system operation control, and specifically to a parallel accelerated solution method for post-disaster restoration of a power system based on quantum computing, including: step 1: establishing a model for post-disaster restoration; step 2: according to the quantum proxy Lagrangian relaxation algorithm, decomposing an original optimization problem into node subproblems; and step 3: solving the model for post-disaster restoration, updating Lagrange multipliers and penalty factors in iteration, achieving an optimal solution under the interaction of quantum computing and classical computing, and accelerating the acquisition of a restoration plan to guide a safe operation of the power system. The present application decomposes a problem into subproblems and divides the subproblems into discrete and continuous parts for solution, reducing the difficulty. The effects of parallel computing and quantum-embedding accelerated computing are realized without complete optimization for a relaxed problem, ensuring better convergence.

title_en: The alarm device of transfer of data and voice restoration in Zigbee network
abstract_en: The present invention, to implement the alarm device of transfer of data and voice restoration in Zigbee network, realizes: to gas anomaly automatically monitor with the accuracy reported in time, communicative to the very first time of natural calamity, to the reliability of the General Promotion of public safety, the uniformity broadcasted area information.User sets gas anomaly alarm module, abnormal vibrations alarm module, automaticmanual security alarm module, emergency alarm debug system module, data wireless transmission and data receiver is carried out by Zigbee, directly transmit with MCU pulse data and voice sound data, the voice restoration completing Zigbee synchronizing information carries out corresponding audio alert.Utilize Zigbee MANET to complete the real-time automatic monitoring of complex environment and region.Add the controllability of individual event warning system, multinomial warning system, improve initiative and the accuracy of real-time monitoring data.

title_en: Pollution site restoration intelligent decision method based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pollution site repair intelligent decision method based on multi-source data, which is characterized in that pollution site sample data are collected, a to-be-repaired area higher than a risk threshold is determined, comprehensive repair demand assessment is formed by comprehensively analyzing pollutant characteristics, site characteristics and environmental factors of the to-be-repaired area, historical repair data are collected, a neural network decision model is constructed to predict optimal repair targets and repair methods under different conditions, corresponding data are input for specific to-be-repaired areas by utilizing the trained model, and decision results of the repair targets and the repair methods are intelligently output; the invention realizes the scientificalness and the accuracy of the polluted site restoration decision by integrating the multi-source data, improves the restoration efficiency and the restoration effect, and provides powerful support for the polluted site management.

title_en: Constrained service restoration with heuristics
abstract_en: A method of determining service routes for a plurality of crews is provided. Outage data identifying a plurality of service outage source locations, a number of affected customers associated with each location of the plurality of locations, and a type of repair to perform at each location of the plurality of locations is received. A repair time is estimated for each location. Crew data identifying a plurality of crews and a start location for the plurality of crews is received. A service route for each crew is determined based on a crew skill indicator associated with each crew satisfying the type of repair to perform at each location and based on the estimated repair time for each location. The service route for a crew of the plurality of crews includes the start location as a first location and at least one location of the plurality of locations.

title_en: Buckling-restrained supporting pin shaft connecting node
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-buckling supporting pin shaft connecting node, open the round pin shaft hole including the connecting plate the upper limb quadrature welding upper limb listrium of connecting plate, lower limb quadrature welding lower limb listrium, the department of linking of connecting plate, upper limb listrium, lower limb listrium and steel column and post bracket adopts the full penetration butt weld of groove to connect the upper limb listrium with steel column weld butt joint sets up a pair of trilateral enclosure welding of post stiffener and is in on the steel column the lower limb listrium with post bracket weld butt joint sets up a pair of trilateral enclosure welding of bracket stiffener and is in on the post bracket, the utility model is suitable for a connection of articulated support between the post, the atress route is clear and definite, under the earthquake power effect, has good anti low all fatigue's performance, and the node simple structure adopts assembled round pin hub connection technique, and the restoration or the change after the anti-buckling support damages after being convenient for the earthquake only need pull out the round pin axle can.
assignees: HANGXIAO STEEL STRUCTURE JIANGXI CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for service restoration after PCRF (Policy and Charging Rules Function) fault
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for service restoration after a PCRF (Policy and Charging Rules Function) fault, and relates to the technical field of information. According to the method and the device for service restoration after the PCRF fault, performance consumption of a PCRF network element can be reduced. The method comprises the steps of when a P-CSCF network element receives a VoLTE service request sent from a user terminal, firstly inquiring a currently registered PCRF network element of the user terminal and judging whether the PCRF network element is in fault by the P-CSCF network element; if the PCRF network element is in fault, sending a notification message to an HSS through an S-CSCF network element, wherein the notification message carries a disaster recovery identifier, and the notification message is used for notifying the S-CSCF network element and the HSS that the PCRF network element is in fault; then sending an IDR message to an MME by the HSS, wherein the IDR message is used for indicating the MME to send an indication message for load release to the user terminal; and finally, when the user terminal receives the indication message for load release sent from the MME, registering a new PCRF network element again by the user terminal. The method and the device are applicable for service restoration after the PCRF fault.

title_en: Ecological restoration method for mine side slope
abstract_en: The ecological restoration method for the mine side slope comprises the following steps: s1: cleaning dangerous rocks on the mine slope and leveling the slope surface; s2, fixedly arranging a reinforcing layer for stabilizing the slope surface on the mine side slope; s3, fixedly arranging a vegetation groove for cultivating green plants on the reinforcing layer; s4, filling biomass nutrient soil in the vegetation groove; s5, planting green plants in the plant growing tank and distributing a drip irrigation system. According to the invention, the prefabricated reinforcing mesh is anchored on the mountain of the leveled mine side slope through the anchor rod, and the concrete is sprayed to the reinforcing mesh to form a stable integrated reinforcing layer, so that the slope structure of the mine side slope is enhanced, and natural disasters such as rockfall, mountain landslide and debris flow are effectively avoided; the invention fixedly installs a plurality of planting grooves which are arranged in a longitudinal step shape on the reinforcing layer of the mine side slope, plants green plants in the planting grooves, and recovers the ecological landscape of the mine side slope to be consistent with the surrounding environment.

title_en: Power distribution network fault emergency repair dispatching-fault recovery coordination method and device
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of fault self-healing, and provides a distribution network fault emergency repair dispatching-fault recovery cooperative method and a distribution network fault emergency repair dispatching-fault recovery cooperative device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: coordinating a fault emergency repair scheduling scheme and a fault recovery scheme, taking the master-slave relation of decision variables of the fault emergency repair scheduling scheme and the fault recovery scheme into consideration, modeling by adopting a two-layer planning theory, taking control variables of an upper-layer planning model as a fault emergency repair scheme, constructing a target function by taking the minimized power loss load loss and the repair time into consideration, considering geographical constraints of the repair scheme, and meeting necessary constraint conditions such as constraints on repair resources and time; the lower-layer planning model takes a fault recovery scheme as a decision maker, takes the minimized power loss load loss as a target function, and takes necessary constraint conditions such as network radial constraint, node voltage constraint, fault recovery and emergency repair progress coordination constraint and the like into consideration. And solving the optimal scheme by adopting a particle swarm algorithm design model, thereby improving the efficiency of fault emergency repair and reducing the loss of power load under the fault state of the distribution network system.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intelligent payment method for power grid integrated platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent payment method for a power grid integrated platform, which belongs to the field of intelligent payment and comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing an electric power payment big data analysis system, wherein the electric power payment big data analysis system comprises 4 steps of sample extraction, feature construction, data cleaning and model training by selecting an algorithm; and 2, intelligently analyzing, judging and executing the power failure and power restoration data based on the electric power payment big data analysis system established in the step 1, and realizing automation of the whole business process. By the application of the mobile terminal, a distribution room manager can quickly respond to the abnormal power failure and restoration information and perform targeted processing. Through strategy configuration in the system, reason prompt of abnormal information is realized, and the processing efficiency of the distribution room manager for power failure and recovery work is greatly improved.
assignees: YANBIAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID JILINSHENG ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Farmland drainage diversion regulation and utilization purification system and operation method thereof
abstract_en: A farmland drainage diversion, regulation and utilization purification system and an operation method thereof are provided, the system comprises a ditch and an isolation wall which are arranged around a farmland, the isolation wall longitudinally separates the ditch into a irrigation ditch and an ecological ditch which are parallel to each other, the irrigation ditch is arranged close to the farmland, one end of the irrigation ditch is communicated with a branch ditch through a first sluice, the other end of the irrigation ditch is communicated with one end of the ecological ditch through a water outlet sluice, the middle part of the ecological ditch is communicated with the middle part of the irrigation ditch through a second sluice, and the other end of the ecological ditch is communicated with the branch ditch through a third sluice. The invention communicates ditches with different functions, can effectively utilize the capabilities of ditches for regulating, storing, draining and purifying water, and simultaneously has multiple functions of ecological restoration, water quality purification, flood storage, flood diversion and the like; in addition, the operation method of the system respectively establishes corresponding irrigation and drainage strategies aiming at the farmland irrigation period, the drainage period and the heavy rainfall period, and can effectively solve the irrigation and drainage problems of different emergency situations such as heavy rain, drought and the like while ensuring the purification efficiency.
assignees: INNOVATION ACADEMY FOR PRECISION MEASUREMENT SCIENCE AND TECH CAS

title_en: Phonetic communication method based on pinyin and voiceprint coding and low-power consumption voice terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides a phonetic communication method based on spelling and voiceprint coding and a low-power consumption voice terminal, which firstly converts voice into spelling and voiceprint packet codes for transmission, the method is restored to a personalized voice mode at the receiving end, and breakthroughs of low data volume, low power consumption and high semantic restoration rate of voice communication are realized. The embodiment reduces the traditional voice communication data volume by more than 90%, reduces the power consumption by more than 30-50 times, and improves the terminal access quantity by more than 10 times. The method and the device are suitable for various scenes such as interphones, smart phones, emergency and military communication, and have revolutionary potential for reconstructing a voice communication mode in the smart phones. The embodiment transmits standardized text information, so that the data volume is greatly reduced, the system becomes simple, secret and easy to deploy, and a low-cost and low-power consumption emergency disaster relief communication system capable of being connected with a satellite network can be quickly established in remote areas or under the condition of resource shortage caused by war and disasters.
assignees: CHENDU WESTVALLEY DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Storage device, controller and control method of storage device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a storage device, a controller and a control method of the storage device, capable of backing up with high disaster resistance and guaranteed ordering.SOLUTION: A storage device includes: data storage means for storing first data stored in first storage means in second storage means; saving means for reading a data group from the second storage means and saving it in third storage means corresponding to the status of use of the second storage means; data group output means for outputting the data group stored in the second storage means to a copy destination device connected communicable with the self device; restoration means for storing the data group saved in the third storage means in two or more pieces of the second storage means that are not in use; and suspension means for outputting all the data group already stored in the second storage means to the copy destination device, suspending the output of the data group to the copy destination device and shifting to a suspension state when an instruction of suspension is received.

title_en: Method for treating waste
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for treating wastes, capable of rapidly carrying out the treatment of wastes in disaster area by natural disasters such as earthquakes and tsunamis, and reducing the period and cost until the restoration.SOLUTION: Wastes are collected at a primary temporary placement site installed in each district; then when the wastes collected at the plurality of primary temporary placement sites are collected at a secondary temporary placement site and subjected to an intermediate treatment, the treatment includes at least one of a utilizable extraction step or a recycle processing step; in the occurrence site of the wastes and the primary temporary placement sites and the secondary temporary placement site, at least one of cleaning, disintegration or crushing, and sieving is carried out to make sizes of resultant individual pieces into ≤50 cm; secondary wastes are subjected to at least one of a utilizable extraction step or a recycle processing step; and in the secondary temporary placement site, re-selection and re-treatment are carried out to reduce the volume and reduce the time, cost and labor necessary for transportation and the like.

title_en: Gas supply pipe network management system and gas supply pipe network management program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a computer system capable of promptly and properly determining a gas supply stop area in a restoration work.SOLUTION: The gas supply pipe network management system includes: a work support screen generation part for generating a supply stop support screen Sa in which a gas supply network layer S1, an altitude layer S2, a user gas plug state layer S3, a supply stop area work layer S4, and a residence map layer S0 are superposed; a supply stop area setting part for setting an area regulated by an input contour line drawn in the supply stop area work layer S4 on the basis of the area to which the supply is actually stopped as a gas supply stop area, while visually recognizing the condition of the gas supply pipe network of the area to be a construction object through the supply stop support screen Sa; and a sealing information generation part for generating supply stop sealing information including a location of a shut off valve for stopping the supply of the gas to the set up gas supply stop area.

title_en: Dispatch planning system, control method, and program
abstract_en: To make a dispatch plan with high accuracy considering an operating state of a facility not to be remotely monitored at occurrence of a disaster.SOLUTION: A dispatch planning system (10) comprises: a first operating state acquisition unit (11) that acquires an operating state of a facility to be monitored; an estimating unit (52) that estimates a probability of the operating state of a facility not to be monitored; a second operating state acquisition unit (17) that acquires an operating state provided from a monitor terminal for the operating state of the facility not to be monitored in which the probability is equal to or more than a first threshold and less than a second threshold; a restoration target specification unit (14) that specifies a restoration target from elevator facilities; and a search unit (12) that searches for an optimal dispatch plan defining the combination of the restoration targets to which groups are scheduled to be dispatched and the order of dispatch for each of the groups. The restoration target specification unit specifies, as the restoration targets, a facility the operating state of which is acquired by the first operating state acquisition unit, a facility in which the probability of the operating state is estimated to be equal to or more than the second threshold by the estimating unit, and a facility the operating state of which is acquired by the second operating state acquisition unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Data restoration method, device and equipment based on photovoltaic envelope
abstract_en: The application provides a data restoration method, a device and equipment based on a photovoltaic envelope, which relate to the technical field of data processing and comprise the following steps: acquiring photovoltaic power generation data of each of a plurality of photovoltaic meters, wherein the photovoltaic power generation data comprises original accumulated power generation amounts of each of a plurality of moments; based on the photovoltaic power generation data of each of the plurality of photovoltaic tables, carrying out region clustering on the plurality of photovoltaic tables to obtain a plurality of photovoltaic table clusters; determining a light Fu Baolao curve corresponding to each photovoltaic meter cluster based on photovoltaic power generation data of each photovoltaic meter in the photovoltaic meter cluster aiming at each photovoltaic meter cluster; and on the basis of a light Fu Baolao curve, repairing photovoltaic power generation data of each photovoltaic meter in the photovoltaic meter cluster to obtain target photovoltaic power generation data corresponding to each photovoltaic meter in the photovoltaic meter cluster, wherein the target photovoltaic power generation data comprises target accumulated power generation amounts at a plurality of moments. According to the scheme, the repair of the photovoltaic power generation data can be realized, and the precision of the photovoltaic power generation data is improved.

title_en: Aluminum electrolysis cell emergency short circuit power outage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aluminum electrolysis cell emergency short circuit power outage device. The device comprises a group of anode guide rods (1) which are connected with a cuboid bus bar (3) through a group of bus bar soft belts (2), and the cuboid bus bar (3) is connected with a short circuit block (5) through short circuit bus bar soft belts (4). During a cell leakage accident of an aluminum electrolysis cell, the device can serve as an emergency tool for the short circuit accident cell for a rapid power restoration of an aluminum electrolysis cell series within a short time, so as to minimize the influence of the cell leakage accident on production, and avoid the phenomenon that the breakdown of other aluminum electrolysis cells due to long-time power outage leads to larger loss.
assignees: GUIYANG AL & MG DES INST CO

title_en: Disaster information providing system and disaster information providing method
abstract_en: A correlation unit (15) correlates earthquake disaster information issued by an administrative agency, an autonomous entity, or the like with base station data including position information of a base station. A base station priority order calculation unit (16) gives a priority order for a restoration countermeasure to the base station in the event of an earthquake disaster, based on the result of the correlation by the correlation unit (15) and the estimated number of users existing under the base station. The calculated priority order of the base station is displayed on a display unit (30). In this way, the base station can be easily given a priority order based on the earthquake disaster information issued by the administrative agency and the autonomous body.

title_en: A kind of elastic power distribution network multistage service restoration method containing microgrid
abstract_en: The elastic power distribution network multistage service restoration method containing microgrid that the invention discloses a kind of, recovery policy include that microgrid restores the three-level service restoration scheme that critical load, microgrid cooperate withs recovery critical load and microgrid to restore non-key load with power supply vehicle of meet an emergency.The three-level recovery scheme established can make full use of the electric energy supporting role of microgrid, energy-storage system to power distribution network under disaster, and then improve the elasticity of power distribution network.After guaranteeing critical load full recovery using preceding two-stage service restoration scheme, to restore non-key load to greatest extent as target start three-level service restoration scheme.Established mixed integer linear programming model is finally solved, the optimal power range of day part microgrid is obtained, and calculates power distribution network elastic index, promotion degree of the assessment this method to distribution elasticity of net.This method can maximize the elasticity of power distribution network while guaranteeing critical load full recovery.

title_en: Frame slant power consumption strutting arrangement
abstract_en: The application discloses frame slant power consumption strutting arrangement includes: the energy-consuming device comprises a frame body, a plurality of supporting bodies arranged on the frame body and an energy-consuming assembly used for connecting the supporting bodies; the support bodies are obliquely arranged on the frame body, and the two support bodies are oppositely arranged and connected through the energy dissipation assembly; the energy consumption subassembly just includes: the connecting pieces are respectively arranged at one ends of the two supporting bodies, and the energy dissipation pieces are arranged on the connecting pieces; the two connecting pieces are oppositely arranged, the free ends of the two connecting pieces are hinged with each other, and the energy dissipation piece is used for connecting the end parts of the two supporting bodies, or the energy dissipation piece is used for connecting the end parts of the two connecting pieces. The concrete frame structure adopts a node form, is simple to assemble and is convenient for connection of supports in the concrete frame structure; the earthquake energy can be effectively absorbed during the earthquake, the horizontal connecting rod and the energy dissipation component are convenient to replace after the earthquake, the restoration after the earthquake is easy, and the reinforcement of the building after the earthquake is convenient.

title_en: Element identification method, device, equipment and storage medium of power network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an element identification method, device, equipment and storage medium of a power network, relating to the technical field of power grids, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating a simulation power network model corresponding to the power network of the area to be identified, wherein the simulation power network model comprises a transformer substation; acquiring the maximum load value and the initial working efficiency of each transformer substation, and attacking at least one first transformer substation in the simulation power network model according to a preset attack strategy; restoring all second substations in the attacked first substations in the simulation power network model according to a preset restoration strategy; and calculating the real-time score of each second substation according to a preset scoring strategy, and taking the second substation corresponding to the real-time score which is greater than or equal to the preset score as a target element in the simulation power network model. The method and the device take the operation and maintenance elasticity among the power networks into consideration, can accurately identify the target elements, and have important practical significance.
assignees: CHENGDU DATA UNITED CLOUD COMPUTING SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Urban waterlogging traffic network rapid restoration method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for rapidly repairing urban waterlogging traffic road network based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a graph structure of a road traffic network; generating a corresponding road dislocation degree matrix based on the adjacency matrix of the graph structure and the randomly generated feature matrix, and establishing a data set; constructing a deep learning neural network model with an attention mechanism based on the graph convolution neural network and the capsule neural network; training a deep learning neural network model through a data set; and predicting the road dislocation degree through the trained deep learning neural network model, and repairing the road network based on the road dislocation degree prediction result. According to the road network repairing method, the dislocation degree of the roads is represented by the difference of the edge medium number centrality, the dislocation degree of the roads under the rainstorm waterlogging situation is predicted by the deep learning neural network model, and the roads with high dislocation degree of the roads are preferentially selected from the dislocation degree to repair the road network, so that the timeliness of the road network repairing strategy is improved.

title_en: Comprehensive investigation and evaluation method for mine geological environment influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive investigation and evaluation method for mine geological environment influence, which is beneficial to comprehensively evaluating the target mine in multiple aspects based on 6 factors of mine geological disasters, land resource occupation damage, water resource damage, water environment damage, earth and stone environment damage and landform landscape damage by analyzing the comprehensive sampling data. The comprehensive investigation and evaluation method for the mine geological environment influence disclosed by the invention can obtain the comprehensive evaluation result about the mine geological environment according to the environmental data in multiple aspects, is favorable for the accuracy of the mine geological environment evaluation, and is favorable for providing basis for the later development of mine ecological protection and restoration engineering.

title_en: Urban power distribution network toughness recovery management system under extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network recovery, in particular to a management system for urban power distribution network toughness recovery under extreme weather, which comprises the steps of collecting voltage, current, temperature, humidity and wind speed in real time, cleaning, formatting and standardizing data, identifying abnormal conditions affecting the stability of a power grid, evaluating the performance of the power grid under the extreme weather, providing optimization suggestions, simulating various extreme weather scenes, generating feedback data, carrying out comprehensive risk evaluation, generating coping strategies, identifying fault points needing emergency treatment, scheduling restoration resources and dynamically optimizing the operation strategies of the power grid according to real-time analysis results. Feedback data generated by the system in the simulation is used to further optimize the strategy in the toughness assessment and decision support module, ensuring the adaptability and effectiveness of the strategy in actual extreme weather events.

title_en: Water supply network safety evaluation system and method based on multidimensional data fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pipe network management. A water supply network safety assessment system and method based on multi-dimensional data fusion are provided. The method comprises the steps of collecting static data and dynamic data of a water supply network by a data collecting module, further processing and processing the static data and the dynamic data collected by the data collecting module by a data processing module, inputting the static data and the dynamic data processed by the data processing module into a model prediction module, predicting to obtain the safety grade of the water supply network, generating a safety risk assessment report of the water supply network by a risk assessment module based on the safety grade of the water supply network and combining urgency of user demands, road traffic flow intensity and geographic particularities of pipeline layout, and making a priority restoration and transformation strategy by a decision support module according to the safety risk assessment report. The invention can formulate a more reasonable priority repair and transformation strategy, reduce the complexity of the transformation of the water supply network and improve the transformation effect.
assignees: HANGZHOU WATER SHUZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of river pollution in-situ remediation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river pollution in-situ remediation system construction method which comprises the steps of S1, constructing a hydrodynamic force and pollutant migration coupling model, simulating pollutant distribution, 2, constructing a biological collaborative purification quantification model, screening efficient aquatic plants and benthonic animals, constructing a purification kinetic equation, 3, combining biological collaborative purification quantification model output and biological parameters, optimizing plant planting positions, 4, configuring a dynamic three-dimensional ecological position, and constructing a biological remediation system. The invention obviously improves the pollution restoration efficiency through the synergistic effect, builds an ecological friendly in-situ restoration system, does not need interception or dredging, directly builds a biological community in the water body, reduces the damage to the river channel structure, and avoids secondary pollution caused by physical and chemical methods. By simulating a natural river ecosystem, a proper habitat is provided for organisms, so that the recovery of an ecological chain is accelerated, and the self-cleaning capability of a water body is maintained for a long time.

title_en: Intelligent digital power marketing information management method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital electric power marketing information intelligent management method based on the Internet of things, which comprises the steps of reading an RFID electronic tag of a paper marketing information document through RFID equipment, creating a unique document identification code, scanning the paper marketing information document to obtain a scanning image, enhancing the scanning image by using an image restoration algorithm based on a convolutional neural network, generating an electronic marketing information file and an index through OCR (optical character recognition), associating the paper marketing information document, the electronic marketing information file and business data based on the file identification code, constructing a client-marketing information-business data association library, responding to a marketing information inquiry request through an intelligent search engine, recording marketing information operation by using a alliance blockchain network, and generating a tamper-proof log. The invention solves the problems of information island, incomplete paper document information and the like in marketing information management, and realizes the full-flow, high-quality, associated and credible management of marketing information.
assignees: NANYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: New-power-system power grid restoration method and apparatus based on second-order cone transformation
abstract_en: A new-power-system power grid restoration method and apparatus based on second-order cone transformation. The method comprises: acquiring power data of a new power system (101); on the basis of the power data and taking the output uncertainty of a new energy unit into consideration, constructing a mixed-integer nonlinear two-stage robust optimization model based on a multi-state uncertainty set (102), wherein the model comprises an alternating-current power flow constraint; using a second-order cone relaxation technique to simplify the alternating-current power flow constraint, and converting the mixed-integer nonlinear two-stage robust optimization model into a mixed-integer second-order cone two-stage robust optimization model (103); decomposing the mixed-integer second-order cone two-stage robust optimization model into a main question and a sub-question, and solving the main question and the sub-question, so as to obtain an optimization result (104); and on the basis of the optimization result, generating a power grid restoration scheme for the new power system (105).
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Storage aggregate restoration
abstract_en: One or more techniques and/or systems are provided for controlling restoration of a storage aggregate. For example, a local storage device, located at a first storage site, and a remote storage device, located at a second storage site, may be assigned to a first storage aggregate. Responsive to a disaster of the first storage site, a gate may be created for the local storage device. The gate may block automated reconstruction and/or automated synchronization that may otherwise occur with respect to the local storage device. Until the local storage device is restored, the remote storage device may be used to service I/O requests that were otherwise directed to the local storage device. Responsive to receiving a user restoration command, the gate may be removed from the local storage device. Synchronization between the local storage device and the remote storage device may then be facilitated.

title_en: Uncertainty-based dynamic evaluation method for recovery value of power distribution network object to be recovered
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic evaluation method for the recovery value of an object to be recovered of a power distribution network, which comprises the following steps: evaluating the recovery value of the ith load unit to be recovered, and evaluating the recovery value V of the iota load bus per se  ι‑self  Calculating adequacy in the partition at the current moment, evaluating uncertainty of units on the g-th unit bus, and traversing J from the outward width of the g-th unit bus preferentially  g  Layer, evaluator, perimeter J  g  G-th unit bus recovery value V of layer bus recovery value  g  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Breadth-first traversal J from iota load bus  ι  Layer, evaluator, perimeter J  ι  Iota load bus recovery value V of layer bus recovery value  ι  . The potential recovery value brought by the recovery of the object to be recovered for the peripheral object is considered, so that the recovery priority of the object to be recovered in the recovery process is effectively determined, the emergency degree reflecting the power supply recovery requirement of the object to be recovered is fully reflected, and the help is provided for the optimization decision of the recovery scheme.

title_en: Connecting structure of curtain wall for earthquake resistant
title_ko: 커튼월의 내진 연결구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an earthquake-resistant connection structure of a curtain wall installed at a connection portion between a vertical portion and a horizontal portion of the curtain wall, comprising: a pad portion coupled to the vertical portion to buffer between the vertical portion and the horizontal portion; a connecting portion for connecting the horizontal portion to the pad portion; a fixing portion engaged with the pad portion and fixing and supporting the pad portion in the vertical portion; and a fitting portion for fixing by fitting the connecting portion. Therefore, the present invention provides a buffer in an event of an earthquake by installing the pad portion and the connecting portion at the connection portion between the vertical portion and the horizontal portion, thereby simplifying an earthquake-resistant connection work of the curtain wall, and at the same time improving the earthquake-resistant performance and restoration performance, and providing the effect of improving watertightness and airtightness.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 커튼월의 수직부와 수평부 사이의 연결부위에 설치되는 커튼월의 내진 연결구조에 관한 것으로서, 수직부에 결합되어, 수직부와 수평부 사이를 완충하는 패드부와,이  패드부에 수평부를 연결시키는 연결부와, 패드부에 걸어맞춤되어 패드부를 수직부에 고정지지하는 고정부와, 연결부를 끼워맞춤 결합하여 고정시키는 끼움부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 따라서 본 발명은 수직부와 수평부 사이의 연결부위에 패드부와 연결부를 설치하여 지진시 완충함으로써, 커튼월의 내진 연결작업을 단순화하는 동시에 내진성능 및 복원성능을 향상시키고 수밀성 및 기밀성을 향상시킬 수 있는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Accelerated recovery after a data disaster
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present invention, a metadata file is transferred from the first system to the second system and a database on the second system is initialized based on the metadata file. An image, including information of the first system to be restored, is transferred from the first system to the second system, and restoration of the information to the second system based on the image is initiated. Prior to completion of the restoration, one or more log files indicating actions performed on the first system relating to the information to be restored is transferred from the first system to the initialized database on the second system. In response to completion of the restoration, the actions of the log files are performed to synchronize the restored data on the second system with the first system.

title_en: A kind of ecological restoration of mine system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of ecological restoration of mine systems, belong to ecological restoration technical field, the rebuilt component connected with several by joinery and its construction including water supply system, the rebuilt component includes bearing substrate and the vegetable fiber blanket that is laid on the bearing substrate surface, the bearing substrate is equipped with fixation hole, and fixed drill steel is equipped in the fixation hole；The material of the bearing substrate is degradation material；Gutter and several through-holes are additionally provided on the bearing substrate surface；The water supply system includes reservoir, pump, the feed pipe connecting with the water outlet of the pump and the spray head being mounted on the feed pipe；The spray head has several, several described spray heads are evenly distributed on the laying work area of the rebuilt component.The utility model is not only able to play the role of stable mine soil, prevents landslide, landslide, and also there is low cost, low investment, low-maintenance to afforest mine.
assignees: ANHUI XINYU ECOLOGICAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Side slope recovery structure embedded with climbing plants
abstract_en: The utility model provides a side slope recovery structure of embedding climbing plant. The side slope restoration structure embedded with the climbing plants comprises: planting hole and climbing plant embedded in the planting hole and wrapped by degradable nutrition pot. The side slope restoration structure embedded with the climbing plants has the characteristics of preventing landslide and water and soil loss and ensuring that the slope body is evergreen in winter.
assignees: QINGDAO ZHONGYUANYE ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Consider that the spare gas-of energy storage is electrically coupled integrated energy system flexible scheduling method
abstract_en: It is a kind of to consider that the spare gas-of energy storage is electrically coupled integrated energy system flexible scheduling method, comprising: integrated energy system to be electrically coupled according to selected gas-, input gas-is electrically coupled the structure and parameter of integrated energy system；It establishes gas-and is electrically coupled integrated energy system equipment operation constraint and cold/electric equilibrium of supply and demand constraint；Carry out the calculating in energy storage spare capacity rolling calculation stage；Carry out the Optimized Operation of economic dispatch stage a few days ago；Carry out the Optimized Operation in real time execution stage.The present invention is electrically coupled the Optimal Scheduling of integrated energy system based on solution gas-, fully consider the complementary coordinative role of power driven equipment, gas driven equipment, and play the responding ability of in emergency circumstances energy storage equipment, it establishes and considers that energy storage cushion gas-is electrically coupled integrated energy system multistage flexible scheduling model, load restoration scheme when obtaining system operation plan and failure occurring a few days ago.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power distribution network fault assessment and scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating and scheduling power distribution network faults, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing and obtaining a city digital distribution network topological map based on a geographic information system and distribution network construction information; positioning fault point distribution information based on distribution network terminal monitoring data and marketing data; planning a routing inspection path; the unmanned aerial vehicle group shoots images of the routing inspection path and fault points; inputting the shot image into a pre-trained convolutional neural network, and evaluating the disaster situation and the traffic situation to obtain an evaluation result; constructing and obtaining an optimal scheduling model according to a preset strategy; solving the optimal scheduling model by using a simulated annealing algorithm to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme; and implementing scheduling according to the optimal scheduling scheme. The method and the system can quickly locate the fault point and evaluate the disaster situation after the extreme meteorological event occurs, and provide an optimal emergency repair scheduling scheme and an emergency repair progress monitoring function.

title_en: Data recovery method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a data recovery method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: in the state that the target service operated in the first service server is abnormal, the target service is restored in the second service server, and in the process that the second service server restores the target service and under the condition that the second service server operates the target service, whether the first service server is abnormal or not is detected, so that the situation that the two service servers currently operate the target service and are mistakenly restored is caused, the situation that service data are inconsistent due to mistaken restoration can be avoided, the service disaster tolerance performance when the target service is executed is improved, the target service can be continuously operated only by short-time blocking under the abnormal condition, and therefore the stability of the target service operation is improved.

title_en: Power distribution network rush-repair and restoration method considering traffic road interruption and rush-repair
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network rush-repair and restoration method considering traffic road interruption and rush-repair, which comprises the following steps: 1. establishing a fault line clustering model by taking the sum of the distances from the minimized fault line to all warehouses as a target; 2. considering the influence of traffic network road interruption and road rush-repair on the power distribution network rush-repair and recovery, and establishing a traffic network-power distribution network cooperative rush-repair model considering the power distribution network operation by taking the sum of the maximum weighted load recovery amount, the minimum time required by repairing all fault lines and the time required by repairing all interruption roads as an optimization target; 3. modeling on AMPL optimizing software, and calling a solver CPLEX to solve to obtain a cooperative first-aid repair scheme of a power distribution network fault first-aid repair team and a traffic network road first-aid repair team and load recovery conditions of each period. The invention considers the actual traffic situation of the post-disaster road when the power distribution network rush-repair strategy is prepared, and can also improve the power distribution network rush-repair and recovery speed by timely rush-repair and road interruption.
assignees: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD HEFEI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: NSGA-II-based power grid emergency dispatching method and system under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for power grid emergency dispatching under extreme disasters based on NSGA-II, which relate to the technical field of power grid emergency management and optimization and comprise the steps of collecting power grid data to establish power grid side and user side optimization targets and constructing a multi-target dispatching model; and calculating satisfaction of the multi-objective scheme by using a fuzzy membership function, comprehensively evaluating and selecting the optimal scheme. According to the invention, by constructing a multi-objective optimization model, improving a chromosome coding mode and introducing a fuzzy membership function, comprehensive scheduling is performed on the number of rush repair teams, task allocation and path optimization, the problems of complex power grid rush repair scheduling tasks, low response efficiency and insufficient rush repair resource utilization under flood disaster conditions are solved, and the effects of improving the response speed of the rush repair tasks, optimizing the resource utilization rate and realizing optimal balance in time, resources and task completion degree are achieved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Marine ecological environment influence tracking and monitoring method based on offshore wind power engineering
abstract_en: The application provides a marine ecological environment influence tracking and monitoring method based on offshore wind power engineering, which relates to the technical field of marine ecological environment and comprises the steps of calculating an ecological risk index based on an obtained multi-mode feature vector to obtain ecological risk data, configuring a space-time sequence based on a preprocessed comprehensive data source and the ecological risk data, and predicting a pollution diffusion path and migration blocking prediction based on the preprocessed comprehensive data source. By introducing a dynamic assessment model of an ecological risk index and combining time sequence modeling and space distribution modeling, dynamic analysis and future trend prediction of ecological risks are realized, a high-risk area is identified and pollutant diffusion paths and biological migration blocking conditions are simulated by generating a risk thermodynamic diagram in real time, and the method can dynamically adjust a monitoring strategy according to real-time monitoring data, provide scientific basis for construction optimization and ecological restoration, and improve the accuracy and timeliness of monitoring and assessment.
assignees: NORTH CHINA SEA FORECAST DISASTER REDUCTION CENTER OF MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES QINGDAO OCEAN CENTER

title_en: Method, system, equipment, medium and product for collaborative scheduling of disaster resources of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of distribution networks and discloses a method, a system, equipment, a medium and a product for cooperatively dispatching disaster resources of a distribution network, wherein the method uses load loss minimization before disaster as a first optimization target, determines a first constraint condition of the first optimization target according to the site selection of a transfer warehouse and the limitation of total material transportation quantity, constructs a pre-disaster resource pre-allocation model, thereby obtaining the pre-allocation resource quantity transported to each fault point by the transfer warehouse, and after the disaster, minimizing power failure loss, material scheduling cost and mobile power supply operation cost to form a second optimization target, determining a second constraint condition of the second optimization target in a scheduling balance state, constructing a post-disaster resource scheduling model, optimizing through the post-disaster resource scheduling model, and obtaining a post-disaster resource scheduling optimization scheme, thereby ensuring the coordination of pre-disaster pre-allocation and post-disaster scheduling through the coordination of pre-disaster resources and post-disaster resources, dynamically coordinating a maintenance team and the mobile power supply, and improving the scheduling efficiency and the post-disaster restoration efficiency.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Retaining wall structure with stepped partition ecological restoration function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a retaining wall structure with a stepped partition ecological restoration function, which relates to the technical field of ecological disaster prevention, and comprises a retaining wall body, a green planting box and a nutrition planting base, the inside of barricade body is filled with the nutrition planting foundation, the green planting box of planting is installed to the last Fang Bushe of nutrition planting foundation, the lower bottom surface of planting the box is the design of macroporous latticed, can form laminating close contact and intercommunication with the nutrition planting foundation. The retaining wall structure with the stepped partition ecological restoration function utilizes the retaining wall body, the nutrition planting base filled in the retaining wall body and the inserted fixed rod at the lower bottom surface, can form a gravity retaining wall structure with the functions of self weight, anti-overturning and anti-sliding under the cooperation of the inserted rod at the lower bottom, stably supports the deformation instability of artificial filling soil, hillside rock-soil body and the like, and can realize greening and planting by utilizing the nutrition planting base and the green planting box arranged above, thereby realizing the composite requirements of disaster prevention and ecological greening.
assignees: INST OF GEOLOGY AND NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION GANSU ACADEMY OF SCIENCE

title_en: Collaborative data processing method and system based on source network load storage integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative data processing method and a collaborative data processing system based on source network load storage integration, which are used for data acquisition, processing and optimal scheduling of multi-source heterogeneous equipment. The method comprises the steps of registering power generation side equipment, energy storage side equipment, power distribution network equipment and load side equipment, obtaining self-description information, automatically identifying a communication protocol, loading corresponding drivers, generating a standardized data stream through protocol conversion and semantic mapping, executing real-time feature extraction and preliminary calculation by an edge node, performing global state estimation, predictive analysis and optimal scheduling by a cloud platform, establishing a time delay monitoring and task priority mechanism, realizing edge and cloud dynamic collaboration, performing quality assessment and anomaly restoration on transmission data, generating a high-quality data set, establishing a probability distribution model based on the data, calculating uncertainty weight, performing feature fusion and weighted dimension reduction by a collaborative data processing engine, forming weighted confidence matrix input optimal scheduling, realizing system robustness enhancement, and being suitable for a power system with high new energy proportion and large load fluctuation.
