title_en: Game machine
abstract_en: To simplify display control processing in a game machine.SOLUTION: A power outage restoration screen 1201 is the screen display that is constituted by at least a display layer L1 for displaying an error notification screen, a display layer L2 for displaying a power outage restoration screen and a display layer L5 including a small pattern group 502, a special pattern 1 reservation number display 503 and a special pattern 2 reservation number display 504 as display contents, the display layer L2 is arranged in front of the display layer L5, and the display layer L1 is arranged in front of the display layer L2. A performance control device generates the image display of the small pattern group 502, the special pattern 1 reservation number display 503 and the special pattern 2 reservation number display 504 even in a state where observation cannot be performed on the power outage restoration screen 1201. The error notification screen on the display layer L1 may be displayed even after switching to a customer-waiting demonstration screen, a variable display screen, and a win screen since it is displayed independently of the power outage restoration screen.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 185

title_en: Artificial living structure for the fresh water fishes
title_ko: 생태하천 복원용 수중생물의 수중생태환경구조체
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An underwater ecological environmental structure of aquatic organisms for ecological river restoration is provided to live in natural environment since aquatic organisms safely live and multiplication is also vigorously occurred. CONSTITUTION: An underwater ecological environmental structure of aquatic organisms for ecological river restoration includes a first shelter space unit(1) formed in a box shape while having a water supply pipe connected to a front face, a cutting slit groove and an entry hole respectively formed and a shelter space formed inside, a living space unit(2) having a living space formed inside, a spawning space unit formed in a box shape, a water supply pipe connected in a front face, an entry hole in a rear face of a downstream side and a spawning space in which a rock layer formed inside, and a second shelter space unit(5) having a divided shelter space by a compartment wall inside.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 생태하천 복원용 수중생물의 수중생태환경구조체는, 생태하천의 수중에 수중생물의 생활시 갑작스러운 주변환경의 변화나 위기상황에서의 보존을 위한 대피공간부와, 일상적인 유영(遊泳)과 먹이활동을 위한 생활공간부와, 산란과 부화 또는 치어들의 안정적인 생장을 위한 산란공간부와, 은닉본능과 스트레스 해소를 위한 휴식공간부를 제공하고, 또한, 각 대피공간부, 생활공간부, 산란공간부, 휴식공간부에 상류에서 신선한 생수공급이 가능하게 되므로서, 생태하천에 서식하는 수중생물의 서식활성화와 수중생태계의 보존을 위한 천연과 유사한 수중생태환경을 제공하는 것이 가능하게 되어 어류, 양서류와 같은 물과 친밀한 생물들의 개채의 증식이 가능하게 되면서 주위의 수변 생태계와의 균형을 이루게 되면서 인간생활에 해로운 각종 곤충의 유충들도 자연 조절됨으로써 인간과 자연의 공존을 모색할 수 있으며, 인근 시민들의 자연친화적 생활, 친환경적 정서함양과 자연관찰, 생태체험장의 역할을 담당하게 되므로 수중생물의 자연생태계의 회복을 이룩하고 건강한 생태하천으로 재탄생하게 된다.

title_en: Storage system and data processing method
abstract_en: The present invention comprises a management computer which exchanges information with storage apparatuses and host computers of primary sites and a secondary site via a management network and which manages a data processing performance and a data processing status of each of the sites, wherein, when any of the primary sites is subject to disaster, the management computer selects a normal primary site for which a data transfer time of a restoration target application is within a recovery time objective as a restoration site which possesses processing performance for restoring the application, and remote-copies restoration copy data, which exists at the secondary site, to the storage apparatus of the primary site selected as the restoration site, via a data network.

title_en: High-performance foam mortar filling method for mine stope
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-performance foam mortar filling method for a mine stope. The method comprises the following steps of: adding a foaming agent into dilution water in a foaming and mixing device to prepare foaming solution; feeding compressed air into the foaming solution to form bubble flow; and then constructing an upper stope and a deep stope respectively according to conditions of the mine stope. In the method, under lubrication action of dense foams which are not interconnected with one another, the using amount of cement in unit cubic meter can be averagely reduced by over 20 percent, the using amount of water can be reduced by over 35 percent, the filling efficiency can be improved by over 20 percent, the firmness rate is enhanced from below 70 percent at present to over 95 percent, and the comprehensive filling cost is reduced by over 10 percent; furthermore, the segregation phenomenon of materials is eliminated essentially; overflowing water is avoided in an underground filling body; as the foam light soil is applied to a foam mortar filling body which is filled in the stope, multiple effects of improving the whole quality of the filling body, reducing the filling cost, improving an underground working environment and the like can be achieved; therefore, the method has great significance for sustainable development of mineral resources, environment restoration and disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHONGJIN LINGNAN NONFERROUS METAL CO LTD FANKOU LEAD ZINC DEPOSIT;UNIV GUANGZHOU;GUANGDONG SHENG RUI CIVIL TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Power grid line fault first-aid repair scheduling simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid line fault emergency repair dispatching simulation method and system, which are characterized in that a power grid structure topological graph is obtained according to power grid line data, the types of switches in the power grid lines and the connection relations between various switches and lines are set according to the power grid structure topological graph, a power grid simulation line is constructed, when a line fault at a certain position in a power grid is simulated, the state of the switches in the power grid simulation line is read, a dispatching instruction is generated, emergency repair personnel are dispatched to the position of a section switch to check and send the front section line in a trial mode according to the dispatching instruction, the operation is repeated until the line in the power grid simulation line trips again, and a line section where the fault is located is determined. In the whole process, the power grid simulation circuit is constructed and the fault simulation processing is carried out, so that the training of power grid workers can be realized, the power grid workers can coordinate and cooperate to quickly isolate faults as soon as possible, and the power supply can be quickly recovered.

title_en: Telephone traffic prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a telephone traffic prediction method, which comprises the following steps: the model is divided into: fault power failure, planned power failure, arrearage power failure and power restoration, electric quantity and electricity charge, customer basic information and electricity service; performing broad-table processing according to the models to obtain input and output variables of each model; data processing: after wide-table data processing is carried out on original data and before data modeling is carried out, data cleaning is carried out on the data, and the data are converted into stable dimensionless input-output variable data; and (3) modeling data, wherein the selected model is an LSTM long-short term memory network model for training, verifying and testing. The invention classifies the models of the telephone traffic, determines the input variable and the output variable of each model, and trains the selected model as an LSTM long-term and short-term memory network model, thereby ensuring the model accuracy rate which can reach more than 80%.

title_en: Distributed fault recovery method and system for ring distribution network adapting to 5G communication network
abstract_en: According to the distributed fault recovery method and system for the ring distribution network adapting to the 5G communication network, after a fault occurs, circuit fault information is exchanged between adjacent STUs through the 5G network, and fault points are located; secondly, searching a non-fault power-off area through an adjacent STU; thirdly, returning the searched power supply points to the root node of the lower stage of the fault point step by step; then, sending a power supply recovery area searching instruction to a power supply point; the power supply point STU determines the power supply range of the power supply point STU by searching the power supply recovery area and realizes power supply recovery. Based on a 5G communication network, information such as faults, power access points, power supply requirements, power supply capacity and the like is exchanged between an upstream STU and a downstream STU, and finally functions such as fault positioning, identification of a non-fault power failure area, power supply restoration path identification, power supply restoration and the like are realized. The method adopts the 5G-based sparse communication network to realize the distributed fault location and the power supply recovery of the power distribution network, and has the advantages of simple realization, quick response and high reliability.

title_en: Code semantic analysis-based electric power information system safety protection method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a power information system safety protection method and device based on code semantic analysis, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting operation codes and related operation state information of a power grid information system, and extracting information of key information; performing lexical analysis and grammar analysis on the collected key information to obtain an abstract grammar tree; judging and detecting the code logic of the preprocessed abstract syntax tree according to a preset security model, and identifying code holes; and according to the vulnerability attack behavior judgment condition, carrying out semantic restoration on the source code. The method takes the function as an entry point for attack monitoring, detects the load of SQL attack through analysis processes such as lexical analysis, grammar analysis and the like, and complements the missing grammar. The method has the advantages that the possible loopholes are estimated in advance, the alarm is sent out, the common loopholes are repaired, the safety protection of the electric power information system can be effectively enhanced, the safety loopholes in the application process can be effectively found, and the information safety of the power grid is ensured.

title_en: Power failure radio station area display method, device and system based on power grid map
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grids, and discloses a power failure multi-station area display method, device and system based on a power grid map. The invention periodically acquires and stores the power outage and power restoration data from the metering automation system, obtains longitude and latitude information of the power outage and power restoration areas according to the power outage and power restoration data association inquiry, packages and sends the related data to the front-end plug-in, thereby the front-end plug-in displays the power outage and power restoration areas on the power grid map in real time by calling the power grid map application API.

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network power supply recovery method based on expert demonstration guidance reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster power distribution network power restoration method based on expert demonstration guidance reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of firstly, constructing an expert demonstration data set, establishing a multiple priority experience playback pool, including expert demonstration, normal operation and constraint violation experience playback pool, extracting experiences in batches from the expert demonstration experience playback pool, pre-training a reinforcement learning model, constructing and integrating an invalid action shielding module after the pre-training is completed, shielding invalid operation, then simulating operation in a large number of fault scenes, respectively storing the normal operation and constraint violation experience into the corresponding playback pool, extracting experiences in proportion for priority playback, training the model, and finally, recursively solving in a real-time fault scene by utilizing the trained model, and outputting an approximate optimal decision of post-disaster power restoration. The invention obviously improves the accuracy and efficiency of power supply recovery of the post-disaster power distribution network, and solves the problems of high calculation complexity and poor real-time performance in the prior art.

title_en: Scenic region whole process planning management method and system based on GIS platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landscape area whole process planning management method and system based on a GIS platform, the method comprises the steps of raw data acquisition, data preliminary processing, ecological risk area discrimination, planning management optimization and scenic region planning management. The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent planning management of scenic areas, in particular to a scenic area whole-process planning management method and system based on a GIS platform, which acquire original data through original data acquisition; the method comprises the steps of carrying out data preliminary processing of data space alignment, missing value restoration, semantic feature extraction, data standardization and data set segmentation, carrying out ecological risk area discrimination by adopting a depth contrast map convolution network model, improving the accuracy of ecological risk identification under complex landforms, providing risk support for subsequent planning, carrying out scenic region planning management optimization by adopting a multiparty reinforcement learning model, responding to environmental state change in real time, and feeding back iterative optimization strategies based on historical data in real time.

title_en: Method for identifying mao-bamboo forest snow disaster damage of airborne laser radar based on differential point cloud encryption strategy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forestry disaster monitoring, in particular to an identification method of an airborne laser radar phyllostachys pubescens disaster damage based on a differential point cloud encryption strategy; according to the method, the three-dimensional structure of the bamboo forest is reconstructed through fitting the axis of the bamboo trunk and image post-processing, different types of disaster damage are identified, virtual point clouds are generated to fill the scanning missing area, the accuracy of the axis of the bamboo trunk is effectively improved, the image expression of the bamboo trunk and the tree crowns is enhanced through layered reconstruction and principal component analysis technology, a finer disaster damage characteristic diagram is provided, and accurate disaster assessment is facilitated. In addition, the accuracy and reliability of disaster damage analysis are further improved through targeted image processing based on disaster damage types. In the whole, the invention provides high-efficiency and accurate technical support for post-disaster evaluation and ecological restoration of the bamboo forests.

title_en: A closed transition transfer switch
title_ko: 무정전 절환 절체 스위치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an uninterruptible transition transfer switch and, more specifically, to an uninterruptible transition transfer switch which minimizes redundant transition consumption time between a commercial power source and an emergency power source to prevent occurrence of a power failure during a transition procedure, and restricts a transition manipulating lever connection work during a transition work by a manual lever to prevent occurrence of mortality accidents. To this end, provided is the uninterruptible transition transfer switch, comprising: a cabinet providing an appearance and forming insertion holes at an upper part and a lower part, respectively; a pair of manipulation holders installed at the upper part and the lower part within the cabinet and coupled to main shafts respectively; a pair of interlocking members coupled to one sides of the manipulation holders on the main shafts respectively, and having lower ends at which sliders are installed; a pair of guide members axially coupled to lower sides of the interlocking members respectively, and forming an inclined surface, on which a slider of the interlocking member moves through rotation of the manipulation holder, and a stopper groove which has a concave groove shape on the inclined surface and into which the slider is inserted to be arranged; a pair of springs installed between the cabinet and each guide member and providing restoration force according to rotation of the guide member; and an interlocking linker connected between shafts of the pair of guide members, interlocking with rotation of the pair of guide members by rotation of one between the pair of manipulation holders, and making the slider of the interlocking member positioned at the stopper groove of the other manipulation holder side guide member get out to the inclined surface to restore the other manipulation holder to an original position thereof.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무정전 절환 절체 스위치에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 상용전원과 비상전원간 중첩절환 소요시간이 최소화되도록 하여 절환 과정에서 정전이 발생하지 않도록 하고, 수동레버에 의한 절환 작업시 절환조작레버 연결 작업의 제한을 통해 인명사고가 발생하지 않도록 한 무정전 절환 절체 스위치에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해, 외관을 제공하며, 상부와 하부에는 각각 삽입공이 형성된 캐비닛;상기 캐비닛 내부의 상부 및 하부에 각각 설치되며, 각 메인축에 결합된 한 쌍의 조작홀더;상기 각 메인축 상에서 각 조작홀더의 일측에 결합되며, 하단부에는 슬라이더가 설치된 한 쌍의 연동부재;상기 각 연동부재의 하방에 축 결합되며, 상기 조작홀더의 회전을 통해 연동부재의 슬라이더가 이동되는 경사면과, 경사면 상에 요홈 형태로 이루어지며 슬라이더가 삽입 배치되는 스토퍼홈을 형성하는 한 쌍의 가이드부재;캐비닛과 각 가이드부재 사이에 설치되며, 가이드부재의 회전에 복원력을 제공하는 한 쌍의 스프링;상기 한 쌍의 가이드부재 축 사이에 연결되며, 한 쌍의 조작홀더 중 어느 하나의 조작홀더 회전에 의해 한 쌍의 가이드부재 회전을 연동시키면서, 다른 하나의 조작홀더측 가이드부재의 스토퍼홈에 위치된 연동부재의 슬라이더를 경사면으로 빠져나오게 하여 다른 하나의 조작홀더를 원위치시키는 연동링커:를 포함하여 구성된 무정전 절환절체 스위치를 제공한다.

title_en: Method and system for sharepoint backup for disaster restore
abstract_en: A method is provided for backing up and restoring a web applications platform. The method includes backing up web applications platform databases to a backup system. A search index of the web application platform is backed up. An application programming interface (API) is queried to discover internet information services (IIS) virtual directories associated with the web applications platform. Discovered IIS virtual directories associated with the web applications platform are backed up to the backup system. IIS configuration data, IIS metabase data and registry data for the web applications platform are then backed up to the backup system. A similar process enables the restoration of this data to allow for disaster recovery for the web applications platform.
assignees: EMC CORP;EMC IP HOLDING CO LLC

title_en: Cyber-physical integrated restoration method and system for distribution systems based on emergency mobile communications
abstract_en: A cyber-physical integrated restoration method and system for distribution systems based on emergency mobile communications are provided. After extreme natural disasters which cause serious damage to distribution systems, damages of distribution systems are evaluated through system feedback data. When ground communication base stations are unavailable due to the damages, the method can make full use of existing wireless emergency communication resources to provide emergency communication services, and quickly restore the power supply through distribution automation functions with supports of the backup battery of automatic terminal devices, so as to effectively improve the resilience of distribution systems.

title_en: Method and system for protecting privacy in microgrids based on homomorphic encryption algorithm
abstract_en: A method for protecting privacy in microgrids based on a homomorphic encryption algorithm and relates to the technical field of microgrid control includes: designing a distributed cooperative control method for a microgrid based on distributed control theory, to achieve frequency restoration of a microgrid; defining a technical essence of privacy protection and a scope of privacy protection; designing a method for protecting privacy in microgrids based on a homomorphic encryption algorithm according to defined technical essence of privacy protection and scope of privacy protection, and protecting initial and real-time values of each distributed power source in the microgrid from disclosure to neighbor nodes, to achieve a distributed cooperative control objective in the microgrid; and verifying the method for protecting privacy in microgrids based on the homomorphic encryption algorithm through simulation experiments. The method enhances trustworthy monitoring capabilities and privacy security during distributed cooperative operation of microgrids.
assignees: HAINAN RESEARCH INST OF ZHEJIANG UNIVERSITY;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Efficient method to predict integrated circuit temperature and power maps
abstract_en: The temperature distribution associated with a design of an integrated circuit is calculated by convoluting a surface power usage represented by a power matrix with a heat spreading function. The heat spreading function may be calculated from a simulation of a point source on the integrated circuit using a finite element analysis model of the integrated circuit or other techniques. To account for spatial variations on the chip, the heat spreading function may be made dependent on position using a position scaling function. Steady-state or transient temperature distributions may be computed by using a steady-state or transient heat spreading function. A single heat spreading function may be convolved with various alternative power maps to efficiently calculate temperature distributions for different designs. In an inverse problem, one can calculate the power map from an empirically measured temperature distribution and a heat spreading function using various de-convolution techniques. While the forward problem is analogous to image blurring, the inverse problem is analogous to image restoration.

title_en: A kind of circular platform type beach builds reef
abstract_en: The utility model is related to a kind of circular platform type beach to build reef, belongs to fish shelter technical field.A kind of circular platform type beach builds reef, including hollow concrete cylinder and cross concrete-pile；The cross concrete-pile is vertically intersected on the rod piece of any in space by three and forms；The vertical position of rod piece of the cross concrete-pile, which is inserted into, to be fixed among mud bank, and rod piece horizontal position is located at mud bank upper surface location；The hollow concrete cylinder is erected on the cross concrete-pile；The hollow concrete cylinder surrounding offers the pane of water flowing.The utility model fish shelter can be easily installed in sandy beach surface, and can keep for a long time；Fish shelter has the characteristics of centainly combating typhoon, wind resistance, moisture resistance nighttide, seawater corrosion resistance；Restoration of the ecosystem effect is apparent, is especially suitable for the basis of the sandy beach in entrance of Changjiang River；Reef battle array reservoir storage is big, bores husky space greatly, energy sunshade, meets the needs that aquatile inhabites, multiplies, evading solarization and natural enemy.

title_en: Ecological restoration plant planting structure of high steep slope
abstract_en: The utility model provides an ecological restoration plant planting structure of a high and steep slope, which comprises a slope body and a leveling layer, wherein the surface of the slope body is provided with the leveling layer, positioning piles are inserted on the leveling layer, and a plurality of steel wires are fixedly connected between the positioning piles. The utility model has the advantages that: the core of this structure is that soil conservation, waterproof soil loss performance are good, it can be matched by steel wire spud pile, the fixed muscle is fixed a position, but the pocket tightly plants the bag, landslide, displacement when preventing its direct laying, the setting of layer is sowed in the spraying, can add a layer of spraying at the surface of planting the bag, by alien soil and grass seed constitution, can further consolidate planting the bag and affiliated structure thereof, steel wire, the spud pile, stock and fixed muscle can be as the interior muscle of layer is sowed in the spraying, firm spud pile and the stock on layer can be firmly ground to the leveling layer to guarantee to spray, prevent that the leveling layer is smooth, spud pile and stock have dual action, can fix a position planting the bag, also can fix soil to the leveling layer.

title_en: Slope protection system is restoreed to green slope that plants of geological disaster restoration
abstract_en: The application relates to a slope restoration slope protection system for restoring geological disasters, which relates to the technical field of rain-collecting irrigation facilities and comprises a water collecting assembly, an irrigation assembly and a filtering assembly. The water collecting assembly is arranged on the slope, the water collecting assembly is used for collecting rainwater in rainy seasons, the irrigation assembly is connected with the water collecting assembly and used for irrigating the repaired slope, the filtering assembly is arranged on the water collecting assembly and used for filtering the collected rainwater. The application has the effects of reducing the workload and cost of slope irrigation to be repaired and reasonably utilizing rainwater resources.
assignees: SHANXI GEOLOGICAL EXPLOR BUREAU 214 GEOLOGICAL TEAM CO LTD;SHANXI NO 8 GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIG INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Water and soil conservation measure combination method and system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a water and soil conservation measure combination method, a device and electronic equipment, the method can carry out multiple combination on water and soil conservation measures according to user input measure parameters, the water and soil conservation measures and risk parameters, and adopts a mathematical average method to calculate the sand reduction flood reduction rate and the vegetation coverage restoration rate under different gradients, different soil types, different land utilization conditions and different water and soil conservation measure combination modes, and finally, the optimal configuration parameters of the water and soil conservation measures which reach the target are displayed, so that the efficiency of outputting the optimal configuration parameters of the water and soil conservation measures is improved, and the accuracy of the optimal configuration parameters of the water and soil conservation measures is also improved.

title_en: Method, system, medium and processor for calculating splitting and load of feeder line power supply section
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a medium and a processor for splitting and load calculation of a feeder line power supply section. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a single feeder XML model file of a selected feeder provided by a GIS system; carrying out topology analysis on the single feeder xml model file, and generating a basic feeder topology tree corresponding to the selected feeder by taking a transformer substation outgoing switch as a root node and taking a distribution transformer and tie switch as leaf nodes; splitting a power supply section of the net rack of the selected feeder line according to different switch types to obtain a corresponding recovery power supply section; copying the basic feeder topology tree according to the restoration capability power supply section to generate a corresponding sub feeder topology tree; performing load calculation according to the sub feeder topology tree; the time complexity of the processing mode is low, and the high efficiency of load calculation is ensured.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target intelligent scheduling method for river basin flood control engineering system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target intelligent scheduling method of a river basin flood control engineering system, and belongs to the field of water resource regulation and control. Specifically, a river basin flood control engineering system multi-target cooperative scheduling index system is established; generating a drainage basin flood control scheduling data set based on the index system, and constructing a drainage basin flood control engineering system scheduling numerical simulation model; constructing an intelligent acquisition model of priori scheduling knowledge by combining a numerical simulation model to generate a drainage basin flood control scheduling plan library; constructing a river basin flood control engineering system multi-target cooperative scheduling decision model according to the plan library; combining a numerical simulation model to construct an automatic intervention model of a drainage basin flood control engineering system scheduling scheme; constructing a drainage basin flood control engineering system scheduling scheme evaluation model, and completing construction of a drainage basin flood control engineering system multi-target intelligent scheduling model; and inputting decision conditions of the intelligent scheduling model, and outputting a drainage basin flood control engineering system scheduling scheme. The invention is helpful to solve the problems of flood control and disaster reduction in watershed, water environment restoration, water resource supply and the like which restrict the local social and economic development.

title_en: Electric power emergency material allocation method, device, equipment and storage medium under geological disaster
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for allocating electric power emergency materials under geological disasters, and belongs to the field of allocation of electric power emergency materials. Determining a transportation path set according to a traffic line between an area to be restored of a power grid and an emergency material reserve point; calculating the material transportation time of each transportation path in the transportation path set by using the triangular fuzzy number, and constructing a triangular fuzzy traffic network diagram according to the transportation path set and the material transportation time; calculating the path guarantee rate corresponding to each transportation path according to the power restoration time; calculating an optimal transportation path in the triangular fuzzy traffic network diagram by using a preset path optimization algorithm based on the triangular fuzzy traffic network diagram and the path guarantee rate; and transporting the emergency materials from the emergency material reserve point to the area to be restored of the power grid according to the optimal transportation path. The application can determine the optimal transportation path under the condition that the road condition information and the transportation time of the disaster area are uncertain, and can provide electric emergency materials for the disaster-stricken site in time.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Sand land landscape pattern optimization method based on internal and external ecology water demand of river and lake
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sand landscape pattern optimization method based on ecological water requirements inside and outside a river and a lake, and relates to the technical field of ecological restoration and water resource management, comprising the following steps of 1, collecting remote sensing images, field ecological data and hydrological meteorological data, and preprocessing to obtain ecological hydrological element data; the method comprises the steps of (1) calculating ecological water demand of the semiarid sandy landscape according to ecological hydrologic element data, (3) constructing a nonlinear-multi-target sandy landscape pattern optimization model according to the ecological water demand and the ecological hydrologic element data, (4) solving the nonlinear-multi-target sandy landscape pattern optimization model by adopting a multi-target optimization algorithm according to condition constraint to obtain a parameter optimal solution, and (5) constructing a sandy landscape pattern strategy according to the parameter optimal solution. The invention realizes sustainable utilization of the sand landscape water resource and improvement of the ecological hydrologic function by comprehensively optimizing the water-sand resource allocation, the ecological water demand inside and outside the river and the lake and cooperatively allocating each landscape element.

title_en: Mine safety training method and system based on digital twin and virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine safety training method and system based on digital twin and virtual reality, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring laser scanning point cloud and geological exploration data of an underground roadway of a mine, and constructing a high-precision virtual underground environment model based on the data; based on the virtual underground environment model, combining explosion condition judgment, triggering disaster simulation, generating a virtual training environment by using a real-time rendering and dynamic labeling technology, acquiring operation behavior data of training personnel in the virtual training environment, evaluating the operation behavior data to obtain a behavior evaluation result, constructing and training an evaluation model by using machine learning based on the behavior evaluation result and environment parameter change data, and generating customized training contents by combining geological conditions and mining process characteristics of different mining areas. The method can construct a high-restoration-degree virtual scene, solves the problem of single traditional training scene, realizes quantitative evaluation of training effect, and improves training pertinence and effectiveness.
assignees: HSIKWANG SHAN TWINKLING STAR CO LTD;HUNAN INST TRAFFIC ENG

title_en: Ecological restoration monitoring system for forests and grasses
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest and grass ecological restoration monitoring system which comprises an intelligent sensing layer, a multi-mode fusion layer, a knowledge mining layer, a decision support layer and an ecological ontology library update layer, wherein the intelligent sensing layer is used for carrying out full-coverage access on multi-source data by constructing a self-adaptive sensor network, an unmanned aerial vehicle inspection module and a manual inspection terminal, the multi-mode fusion layer is used for carrying out unified data alignment by adopting a data standardization protocol, adopting a space-time fusion algorithm and a deep learning framework, adjusting fusion weights according to data quality to generate a data set and transmitting the data set to the knowledge mining layer, the knowledge mining layer is used for constructing unified data semantic standards of an ecological ontology library, utilizing a space-time dependency relationship in the data mined by a space-time graph neural network and utilizing a causal reasoning engine to convert an implicit ecological rule into interpretable decision knowledge, the decision support layer is used for displaying core indexes by utilizing an LSTM network and utilizing an optimized recommendation engine to generate an individualized restoration scheme, and dynamically adjusting and optimizing sensor deployment strategies and weight distribution algorithms according to effects, and the updating of the ecological ontology library.
assignees: Weiyuan County Forestry and Grassland Service Center

title_en: Industrial network intelligent decision system and method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial network intelligent decision system and method based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source sensor data on an industrial site, forming standard data vectors through wavelet threshold denoising and short-period memory network missing value restoration, constructing production line geometric, physical and flow models in a digital twin server, achieving time and state synchronization through an IEEE 1588 PTP protocol, inputting the standard data vectors into a Informer-based time sequence prediction model, combining equipment dimension coding to achieve fault type and probability calculation and fault position identification, establishing a multi-target optimization decision model through a genetic algorithm according to detection results, integrating outage loss, maintenance cost and production assurance, generating an optimal maintenance and scheduling scheme, and transmitting the scheme to a local controller for execution. The system realizes closed-loop decision flow from data acquisition, modeling, detection optimization and feedback.
assignees: HEFEI RUIJING AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid multi-fault-point rush repair task allocation method and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid multi-fault-point rush-repair task allocation method and computer equipment, which comprise the steps of S1, calculating three coefficients of equipment operation time, load rate and historical faults, building an equipment fault probability model according to the three coefficients, generating a fault point quantization set through a Bernoulli test, calculating traffic passing difficulty through a logic Stir function, building a traffic network quantization matrix, building a manpower resource quantization vector of a rush-repair team, calculating real-time capacity according to exponential decay, summarizing quantization results of the fault point quantization set, the traffic network quantization matrix and the manpower resource quantization vector to obtain a multi-fault-point scene quantization result, S2, building an objective function according to the multi-fault-point scene quantization result, and solving a global optimal task allocation scheme through a self-adaptive peak group algorithm to improve rush-repair scheduling quality and efficiency under a power distribution network multi-fault scene.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Phased network formation for power restoration
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a device receives a router advertisement message after a power outage event in a network. The device joins the network, in response to receiving the router advertisement message. The device sends a power restoration notification message via the network. The device selectively delays a disconnected node from joining the network.

title_en: Directed unmanned aircraft for enhanced power outage recovery
abstract_en: Methods, systems and computer program products for enhancing power outage recovery using a drone are provided. Aspects include identifying a predicted damage area based on one or more forecast models of a weather event and staging a drone in the predicted damage area prior to the weather event. Aspects also include dispatching the drone to survey one or more portions of the predicted damage area after the weather event and assessing damage to infrastructure equipment in the one or more portions of the predicted damage area. Aspects further include dispatching a repair crew based on the assessed damage.

title_en: Efficient data restoration
abstract_en: A data center communicates with a cloud-based backup system. Client-server roles are established such that a client role is assigned to the data center and a server role is assigned to the cloud-based backup system. On an ongoing basis, backup operations are performed. In the event of disaster or other cause of an outage of the data center, a failover protocol might be invoked such that the cloud-based backup system takes on additional processing operations beyond the aforementioned backup operations. After remediation, the data center issues a data restoration message to the cloud-based backup system. The remediated data center initiates a failback protocol that reverses the client-server roles of the data center and the cloud-based backup system such that the server role is assigned to the data center and the client role is assigned to the cloud-based backup system. After performing system restoration operations, the roles may be reversed again.

title_en: Temporal distribution pattern-based medium-term streamflow forecasting method and system
abstract_en: A temporal distribution pattern-based medium-term streamflow forecasting method includes: acquiring and organizing long-series hydrological streamflow data from a control cross-section of a study basin, including flow data at daily, ten-day, monthly, seasonal, and yearly scales from a hydrological station and inflow data from a reservoir station; performing streamflow restoration calculation based on a water balance principle, and obtaining a natural streamflow series for any basin node; performing an inflow frequency analysis, and determining seasonal and monthly inflow frequencies of any node in different inflow years; calculating distribution ratios of each month's streamflow at any node across first, middle and last ten-day periods, and defining a temporal streamflow distribution coefficient for the corresponding month; and identifying a historical year with a similar characteristic based on a monthly natural flow at a specific cross-section, matching the temporal distribution coefficient of a historical streamflow series, and deriving a forecasted medium-term natural flow value.
assignees: BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Plain area urban river network water circulation regulation and control method based on ecological restoration target
abstract_en: The invention relates to a plain area urban river network water circulation regulation and control method based on an ecological restoration target, which comprises the steps of surveying the basic situation of the urban river network, and constructing a water quantity-water power-water quality-water ecological index system by taking aquatic organism diversity as the basic target of the urban inland river network water ecological restoration; constructing a fine simulation model of river network hydraulics-water quality-water ecology, optimizing a running water engineering regulation and control scheme by using a hydrodynamic force-water quality simulation result of each scenario scheme, constructing an urban river network large circulation system, and adjusting a section structure of a local tip river reach to realize local small circulation; comprehensively evaluating the flood control safety, the environmental improvement benefit and the influence on a water replenishing source of the regulation and control scheme. The invention realizes that under the existing engineering system, the running water source and the kinetic energy thereof are fully utilized, and the water conservancy project scheduling such as a gate, a pump and the like is taken as a main path to promote the ordered movement of inland river water flow and recover and improve the inland river self-purification capacity.

title_en: Fault prediction method and management system of intelligent energy storage power station
abstract_en: The application provides a fault prediction method and a management system of an intelligent energy storage power station, wherein enhanced information is added to a monitoring log, operation state semantic detection is carried out to obtain an operation state semantic detection result, so that monitoring log recovery operation is carried out according to the operation state semantic detection result to obtain a second monitoring log of energy storage power station equipment, and finally fault information corresponding to the monitoring log of the first energy storage power station equipment is determined based on a characteristic information commonality metric value between the two monitoring logs. In other words, based on the mode of performing operation state semantic detection on the first energy storage power station equipment monitoring log to obtain an operation state semantic detection result, the operation state semantic detection result guides the log to perform information restoration, the sequence of data items in the restored log is ensured to be consistent, fault information of the sequence of data items in the first energy storage power station equipment monitoring log is determined by comparing the characteristic information commonality metric value, and the precision and the speed of fault detection of the sequence of data items can be increased.

title_en: Novel pipe huff type shockproof expansion joint
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel telescopic joint that takes precautions against earthquakes of pipeline huff formula belongs to pipeline restoration technical field. The telescopic joint comprises a telescopic joint body, wherein the telescopic joint body comprises an outer layer, an elastic buffer layer and a flexible inner layer, the elastic buffer layer is positioned between the outer layer and the flexible inner layer, and one side of the outer layer is fixed with the elastic buffer layer. The utility model discloses mainly utilize flexible inlayer and elastic buffer layer and skin to replace traditional cast iron formula shell, when the pipeline when the damaged condition that just causes pressure too high, utilize the first keep out of flexible inlayer, keep out back flexible inlayer shape and can change, and keep the shape after the change unchangeable, utilize the inside flexure strip of elastic buffer layer to carry out the weakening of doing all can when receiving flexible inlayer pressure immediately, make and avoid water pressure too high to cause ruptured condition to appear to the outer layer, thereby fine assurance the life of this telescopic joint body.
assignees: SHANGHAI NANHUI JINGYI HEATING EQUIPMENT FACTORY

title_en: Low-altitude remote sensing image rapid and automatic splicing method without POS assisting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-altitude remote sensing image rapid and automatic splicing method without POS assisting. The method comprises the first step of full-automatic restoration of a low-altitude remote sensing image test area, the second step of conducting fine matching on a preprocessed image according to fine matching seed points to obtain a fine matching result, the third step of conducting free network adjustment iteration on the fine matching result to obtain an adjustment result, and the fourth step of conducting interpolation to generate a digital ground model of the image according to the adjustment result, obtaining a relative outer orientation element of the image under the free network coordinate system according to the adjustment result, conducting orthographic rectification on the image based on the digital ground model and the relative outer orientation element, and meanwhile generating an orthographic image splicing image of the test area. The method is free of POS data assisting, the orthographic image splicing image can be rapidly produced in a full-automatic mode, the remote sensing image quasi real-time processing requirement can be met, and the method is suitable for the fields of disaster emergency response, military security and the like.

title_en: High restoration robustness secret key management method based on self-organized wireless network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high restoration robustness secret key management method based on a self-organized wireless network. Whether the number of service nodes passing through verification is larger than or equal to a preset number is judged; if conditions are not met, common nodes send requests to auxiliary nodes, and identity identification is carried out through the auxiliary nodes and the service nodes together; when the conditions are met, the requests are accepted, an effective certificate is generated and issued. The method has the advantages that redundancy of secret keys in a system is strategically improved, safety is guaranteed, and system robustness is improved; the problem that the number of the secret keys is lower than a threshold due to network segmentation, and accordingly service based on a threshold scheme is valid is solved; the method is more suitable for typical application of an MANET such as military and emergency rescue; the problem of self restoration of the secret keys in the communication process is solved, work of a server is simplified, and network communication traffic is reduced.

title_en: A kind of power distribution network power supply reliability computational methods
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of power distribution network power supply reliability computational methods.Distribution net work structure figure is divided into 4 class sections, respectively described minimum failure sectional, minimum trouble shoot section, minimum Fault Isolation section and perfects section；Troubleshooting process is divided into 5 stages, the method for operation stage before respectively described preliminary fault isolation stage, preliminary trouble shoot stage, the accurate isolation stage of failure, fault restoration stage and recovery failure.The method of the present invention obtains the relationship between 5 stage power failure amounts in the troubleshooting process, reduces reliability amount of calculation.
assignees: FUJIAN YONGFU POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Chemical industry garden site pollution early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chemical industry park site pollution early warning system, which comprises: the multi-scene monitoring system is used for acquiring monitoring values of the pollution conditions of the atmosphere, the soil and the water body; the decision-making system is used for receiving the monitoring values of the multi-scenario monitoring system and carrying out data processing to judge the pollution risk; a precision investigation system for sample analysis; determining a pollution range and carrying out a repairing emergency control and repair system according to a feedback result of the accurate survey system; the multi-scenario monitoring system is connected with the decision-making system and sends the acquired monitoring values of the atmospheric, soil and water pollution conditions to the decision-making system for processing; the accurate investigation system is connected with the decision-making system, when the decision-making system judges that the pollution risk exists, the accurate investigation system carries out sample analysis on the atmosphere, the soil and the water body with the pollution risk, and corresponding restoration treatment is carried out through the emergency control and restoration system after the pollution range is determined.

title_en: Method and device for predicting pollutant solute distribution under karst landform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for predicting pollutant solute distribution under karst landform, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting pollutant solute concentration and karst landform characteristics in a preset time period, and determining the time and model parameters of the pollutants arriving through a plurality of migration paths based on the pollutant solute concentration and the karst landform characteristics in the preset time period; constructing a three-stage truncated fractional order solute transport model based on the contaminant solute concentration within the preset time period, the time the contaminant arrives through the plurality of transport paths, and the model parameters; and collecting the current pollutant solute concentration, and inputting the current pollutant solute concentration into the three-stage truncated fractional order solute transport model to generate pollutant solute distribution. According to the method, a three-stage truncation fractional order solute migration model is used for simulating a solute migration process in an aquifer under a karst landform, the pollutant and solute distribution of a target area is identified, and data support is provided for underground karst water pollution assessment and restoration.

title_en: Function-restorable wall and modeling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a function-restorable wall and a modeling method thereof, wherein the function-restorable wall comprises a hinged wall, self-resetting friction energy dissipation devices, gravity columns and bottom beams, the bottom of the hinged wall is hinged with the bottom beams, the gravity columns are arranged on two sides of the hinged wall and are connected with the hinged wall through a plurality of groups of self-resetting friction energy dissipation devices, the bottom of the gravity columns is hinged with the bottom beams, and the self-resetting friction energy dissipation devices adopt a hierarchical friction structure to realize smooth conversion of static friction and dynamic friction and provide friction energy dissipation and self-resetting capability after earthquake. The self-resetting and energy consumption of the wall body are realized by utilizing the recovery capability of the self-resetting energy consumption friction device, the technical problems of complex self-resetting structure and high construction difficulty of the existing restorable function concrete shear wall are overcome, other parts of the reinforced concrete shear wall structure are not damaged or are low in damage, the post-earthquake restoration difficulty of the reinforced concrete shear wall structure is reduced, the post-earthquake function restorability of the reinforced concrete structure is improved, and the influence of earthquake disasters on normal life and production is reduced.

title_en: Small watershed comprehensive treatment method based on vegetation recovery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small watershed comprehensive treatment method based on vegetation restoration, which relates to the technical field of vegetation restoration and comprises the following implementation steps of configuring IP address information of a remote control area server for comprehensive treatment, entering a treatment planning end, setting a planning scheme for the small watershed comprehensive treatment according to the vegetation area range to realize time sequence hierarchical small watershed comprehensive treatment, entering an ecological tracking end, judging whether ecological restoration and water quality abnormality occur in a river channel in a corresponding vegetation area range in real time, entering an environment acquisition end, and predicting whether the small watershed treatment is abnormal in real time through environmental change and human utilization projects to early warn vegetation reduction or species loss in time. The comprehensive treatment method for the small river basin based on vegetation restoration effectively guides the treatment and protection of the recent river, can combine ecological restoration and water quality conditions of the river course, and can early warn whether ecological problems such as vegetation reduction or species loss occur in treatment projects within the range of the corresponding small river basin.

title_en: Multi-target toughness maintenance method for water supply network fused with graph convolution reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water supply networks and provides a multi-target toughness maintenance method for a water supply network integrating graph rolling reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a data set, S2, constructing a degradation damage module, S3, constructing a performance evaluation module, S4, calculating transportation time, S5, calculating recovery degree, S6, calculating toughness evaluation indexes, S7, calculating weights, S8, constructing an M2DRL model, S9, training the model, and S10, generating a pipeline recovery sequence through the trained model, and evaluating based on the toughness evaluation indexes. The invention can cooperatively promote the recovery degree of the water supply network and shorten the recovery time by optimizing the pipeline recovery sequence, and finally enhance the toughness of the system.

title_en: Data-driven path selection and dynamic feedback expressway traffic volume prediction method
abstract_en: S1, multi-source data fusion and management, S2, multi-model fusion path selection probability calculation, S3, dynamic flow distribution based on path resistance iteration, S4, data-driven path resistance calculation and dynamic feedback, and the invention can comprehensively acquire traffic flow information, weather information and the like running on a highway network based on highway toll stations, toll gate running water data and weather data fusion analysis, thereby realizing characteristic construction of all factors affected by path selection; and finally, combining the flow iterative dynamic distribution model to realize the high-precision dynamic restoration of the charging OD data into the road traffic flow state with road section level and high time resolution, and providing reliable basic data for traffic planning, engineering item current period decision, emergency management, real-time induction and the like.
assignees: GUANGZHOU TRANSPORTATION RESEARCH INST CO LTD;GUANGZHOU COMMUNICATION INVEST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Communicating Power Distribution Event and Location
abstract_en: A system, device, and method of providing information for a power distribution system is provided. In one embodiment, a method of using a device that receives power from the low voltage power of the power distribution system and experiences a power loss during a local power outage may perform the processes of monitoring a voltage of the low voltage power line, detecting a voltage reduction below a threshold voltage for a predetermined time period, storing information of the voltage reduction in a non-volatile memory prior to the power outage, and transmitting a notification to a remote computer system prior to the outage. The monitoring may comprise making a plurality of measurements of the voltage during a time interval and averaging the plurality of voltage measurements. In addition, the method may include transmitting an alert message upon power up after the outage to indicate a power restoration local to the device.

title_en: Cold load pickup support through local condition detection
abstract_en: A cold load pickup device includes a load controller comprising a microprocessor or microcontroller. The device is programmed to detect restoration of power after a power outage on a circuit powering an electric load. A power outage time for the power outage is determined, and a startup delay for the electric load is determined based on the power outage time. A startup delay mechanism, such as a power relay operated by the load controller or switching of the load on/off by the load controller, is configured to apply the startup delay after the detected restoration of power before restarting the electric load. In some embodiments, the startup delay for the electric load is determined based on the power outage time and a startup delay versus power outage time curve stored in a non-volatile memory of the load controller.

title_en: Harm controllable shake and decrease steel column that to repair
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a harm controllable shake and decrease steel column that to repair, including steel column, attenuator and first connecting plate, the steel column passes through the end plate and is connected with the cushion cap, first connecting plate is fixed on the cushion cap, is connected through the attenuator between steel column and the first connecting plate, the attenuator includes a plurality of detachable mild steel boards, the mild steel board is vertical to be placed. The utility model discloses a set up the attenuator, when the small earthquake takes place when, steel column and attenuator combined action, steel column and attenuator are all at elastic state, when strong earthquake takes place when, it is better relatively owing to plasticity as the mild steel board of attenuator power consumption board, can produce and cut the surrender, absorb most seismic energy, protect the steel column not take place destruction well, anti -seismic performance is better, simultaneously, because the mild steel board detachable, behind strong earthquake, can take off the replacement with impaired mild steel board and be undamaged mild steel board, realize shaking the quick restoration in back.
assignees: UNIV HUAQIAO;XM SPECIAL REAL ESTATE CONSTRUCT ENGINEERING GROUP COMPANY LTD

title_en: Ecological reinforcement and vegetation restoration system for soil slope in cold and arid desertification area
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an ecological reinforcement and vegetation restoration system for soil slopes in cold and dry desertification areas. It comprises a protection main body and a tree cultivating device; the protection main part includes from bottom to top in proper order: the three-dimensional degradable three-dimensional net layer, the reinforced soil layer and the spray-seeding grass seed layer are connected with the slope surface; an ecologically degradable container; a plurality of holes are arranged in the protective main body, and an ecological degradable container is arranged in each hole; the ecological degradable container is filled with seedling growing planting soil and vegetation which has completed seedling growing. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the ecological reinforcement and vegetation restoration technology is beneficial to improving the stability of soil body and preventing the geological disasters such as side slope peeling, erosion, slumping, slope collapse, landslide and the like caused by precipitation, strong wind and sand and other factors; the influence of the adverse climate environment on the growth and development of the vegetation is reduced; the frequency and the difficulty of vegetation maintenance management in the later stage of engineering are reduced; is favorable for quickly forming richer arbor, shrub and grass vegetation community levels and improving the greening effect and landscape appearance.
assignees: SHANXI PROVINCE TRAFFIC ENVIRONMENT PROT CENTRAL STATION LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Novel environmental ecology restores device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel environmental ecology restores device, ecological restoration device set up on improving the soil horizon, and it is the slope to improve the soil horizon top, is provided with a plurality of anchor mechanisms on the slope, is connected through expanding spring between the adjacent anchor mechanism, and slope one side is provided with fender mud pile, and fender mud pile side is provided with the screen cloth, and the screen cloth communicates to drainage channel, and drainage channel sets up on unable adjustment base, and the unable adjustment base top is provided with annular connection pad. This ecological prosthetic devices of environment consolidates on the slope to domatic, has the shock attenuation effect of taking precautions against earthquakes, improves the stress of slope when earthquake or landslide come to the time to reduce natural disasters 'such as landslide, mud-rock flow's emergence, multilayer protective action promotes ecological prosthetic devices holistic shock resistance and life simultaneously, is provided with drainage channel and is convenient for massif drainage, avoids the water to soak.
assignees: SHAANXI HEIHE ZHIXING IND CO LTD

title_en: Slope greening restoration method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for restoring slope greening, which is characterized in that a slope protection technology is combined with an ecological protection technology and an engineering protection technology. Firstly, according to the geological condition and the stability of the side slope, the stability of the side slope is ensured or increased by adopting an engineering protection technology according to actual needs; then combining natural factors such as local climate, geological landform, vegetation, land condition and the like, and adopting an ecological protection technology. The active protection system of the protection net takes a steel wire rope net as a main component and covers (actively protects) the steel wire rope net to prevent and control various slope surface geological disasters, avalanche, bank slope scouring and other hazards. The slope protection technology organically combines engineering protection technology and ecological protection technology. The method has the advantages of simple process, no need of excavation, quick construction, convenient operation, less environmental disturbance, controllable quality, low cost, long service life of a protection system, quickest elimination of the threat of geological disasters and the like.
assignees: HANGZHOU LANDSCAPE GARDEN ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: A kind of trouble hunting method and system of secondary equipment in power system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to field of power, a kind of trouble hunting method and system of secondary equipment in power system are disclosed, by the topology monitoring information, operational monitoring information and network communicated information that obtain secondary device；According to automation equipment health assessment model, status monitoring is carried out to the topology monitoring information, operational monitoring information and network communicated information；By artificial neural network, the result to status monitoring is analyzed, to analyze the relation between relation and operation hours and equipment degree of unavailability between the running status of automation equipment, running status；According to the relation between operation hours and equipment degree of unavailability, the optimal repair time is calculated；Existing repair schedule is optimized according to the relation between the running status of automation equipment and optimal repair time and fault fast positioning is carried out.The present invention is based on health assessment model, and automation equipment repair based on condition of component strategy more can accurately be judged, improve overhaul efficiency and fault location speed.
assignees: ZHUHAI HONGRUI SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for protecting dam body and dam foundation of sand blocking dam
abstract_en: A protection method for a dam body and a dam foundation of a sand blocking dam comprises the following steps: processing the front and back of the main dam and the front and back of the auxiliary dam into a plane and paving soil; planting herbs at the upstream of the main dam and the upstream of the auxiliary dam so as to accumulate silt, slow down flow speed and disperse water flow through the herbs; planting shrubs under the main dam and the auxiliary dam to reduce the flow velocity of flowing water and splash erosion by using the shrubs; moss is planted on the dam body to reduce the erosion of wall-facing flow. The invention utilizes the ecological vegetation to carry out cascade energy dissipation, and can effectively reduce the damage of the upstream long flowing water to the sand blocking dam for a long time. Compared with the existing engineering measures such as a reinforcement gabion and the like, the protection effect of the invention is increased along with the increase of time, the cost is low, the environment is protected, the ecological restoration in a debris flow channel can be accelerated by silting the soil around the grass, and the ecological sustainable development of the channel is facilitated.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Simulation and prediction method for ecological influence of inland waterway improvement project
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological impact simulation and prediction method for inland waterway regulation engineering, which comprises the steps of determining indicated aquatic organisms of a regulation river reach, habitat factors forming the aquatic organisms and space-time distribution of the habitat factors, and establishing a fitness model of a habitat of the aquatic organisms; establishing a three-dimensional water-sand mathematical model of the renovation river reach, and predicting three-dimensional space-time distribution data of water depth, flow velocity, flow state and sand content of the renovation river reach under different channel renovation measure parameters; in the design stage of the inland waterway regulation engineering, the predicted habitat factor three-dimensional space-time distribution data is input into the fitness model by adjusting different regulation measure parameters in the three-dimensional water-sand mathematical model, and the influence on the habitat under different waterway regulation parameters is predicted, so that the organic integration of the waterway regulation target and the aquatic environment protection is achieved. The inland waterway regulation engineering influences the three-dimensional space of the indicative biological habitat conditions, develops the river navigation function and simultaneously considers the protection and restoration of the river ecological function.
assignees: TIANJIN RESEARCH INST WATER TRANSP ENGINEERING MOT

title_en: Power distribution network power-communication fault cooperative repair method oriented to elastic improvement
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elasticity-promotion-oriented power distribution network power-communication fault collaborative restoration method, which comprises the following steps: 1) after an extreme event, judging the urgency of the optical fiber fault in the power distribution network communication system, determining the optical fiber fault affecting the remote control interconnection switch as an urgent optical fiber fault, generating a repair scheme and repairing, wherein the non-urgent optical fiber fault is not repaired for the time; 2) dividing power nodes and a mobile base station of a power distribution network into 1 and 2-level grids, determining a grid repair sequence, and generating a scheme for repairing power faults and mobile base station faults in the 2-level grids, wherein the faults of a non-emergency mobile base station are not repaired for the time being; 3) and generating a repair scheme for the non-emergency optical fiber fault and the non-emergency mobile base station fault in the communication system and repairing the non-emergency optical fiber fault and the non-emergency mobile base station fault. According to the method, the influence of the power distribution network communication system fault on the load recovery of the power distribution network is considered, the communication fault and the power fault of the power distribution network are repaired in a coordinated mode, the more effective and rapid fault recovery can be achieved, and the elasticity of the power distribution network is improved.

title_en: Model training method, data repairing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model training method, a data repairing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of constructing an original sample tensor based on electric power measurement sample data, determining an original sample tensor based on the original sample tensor, wherein the original sample tensor comprises complete electric power measurement sample data, decomposing the original sample tensor by utilizing a data restoration model to obtain a preset number of hidden characteristic sample tensors, synthesizing the preset number of hidden characteristic sample tensors to obtain a reconstructed sample tensor, restoring the value of the original sample tensor comprising the missing value in the original sample tensor in the reconstructed sample tensor, and training the data restoration model by utilizing a preset objective function and a preset gradient descent algorithm based on the original sample tensor and the reconstructed sample tensor. The data repairing capability is effectively improved, the resource consumption of data repairing is greatly reduced, and the repairing efficiency and low precision of the data are improved.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method, system and storage medium for identifying and alarming total stop risk of power grid in small region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for identifying and alarming total stop risk of a power grid in a small region, which are based on a real-time data platform full-network model, analyze a power grid topological relation, accurately identify a series county-region power grid model, monitor power supply channel outage, regional load drop and power restoration progress in real time, build a grading evaluation model by combining loss load quantity and power failure duration to evaluate accident grades, roll and update equipment states, dynamically correct a power failure range and a grading result by polling power restoration progress in real time, store the analysis result in a time sequence database in an event structure, and push an alarm picture by a dispatching alarm assistant to realize panoramic visualization of fault information. Compared with the prior art, the method can improve the accuracy of the research and judgment of the total stop risk of the power supply channel in the small region, shorten the sensing time of the accident influence range and the risk information, assist the dispatcher to quickly re-electrify, reduce the economic loss, and is suitable for quick fault response and re-electrifying decision of the county/district-level power grid.

title_en: Deep mining and structured intelligent auditing method and system for high-low voltage power user address data and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power informatization, in particular to a deep mining and structured intelligent auditing method and system for high-low voltage power user address data and a computer readable storage medium, which are used for constructing a three-level closed loop of 'standardized matching-business association-intelligent monitoring', and realizing address standardization by cleaning and weighing multi-source data, formulating power exclusive unified coding and using 'regular fuzzy matching-alias mapping conversion-level membership complement' three-level restoration; setting up an address characteristic-voltage class rule base, establishing address and voltage class association through forward and reverse check, and combining scene hierarchy check and service system coupling to realize intelligent monitoring and closed loop optimization. The invention improves the qualification rate of the address data, reduces the labor cost and realizes the collaborative optimization of data management and business application.
