title_en: Big data-based wheat irrigation optimization system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of resource scheduling, in particular to a wheat irrigation optimization system based on big data, the system comprises a leaf index identification module, a water consumption characteristic reconstruction module, a period supply and demand prejudgment module, a decision water distribution generation module and a dynamic duration execution module. According to the invention, a continuous change structure is constructed through leaf area amplification characteristics in a wheat growth stage, dynamic restoration of water demand characteristics in a crop growth process can be realized, a trend curve is established through matching of the evaporation rate and leaf area change to identify water consumption change nodes, accurate time period water demand depiction can be realized in the growth stage, evaporation supply trend is established by combining weather prediction data, prejudgement identification of water supply and demand states in a future time period is realized, time period deviation analysis and supply and demand difference judgment are introduced in an actual water distribution process, scheduling flexibility and resource matching precision are improved, and adaptability and high efficiency of field water regulation in different growth stages are ensured.

title_en: Wall body provided with liquefaction countermeasure and steel sheet pile with liquefaction prevention function
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a wall body and a steel sheet pile capable of providing the ground, having a sand layer posing a risk of liquefaction on an occurrence of an earthquake but performing high water permeability in normal time, with a drainage function for liquefaction restoration without inhibiting the water permeability in the normal time.SOLUTION: A planar resin material 13a configuring a drainage member is installed at an inside of a main body of a steel sheet pile 11 surrounded by a web 11a and flanges 11b thereof. The web 11a of the main body of the steel sheet pile 11 has many permeable holes 12 therein. Thus, an environmental-friendly steel sheet pile wall with a liquefaction countermeasure can be constructed in the ground by driving the steel sheet piles 11 with the drainage members into the ground while fitting left and right side joints 11c and 11d thereof. The permeable holes 12 in the web 11a of the main body of the steel sheet pile 11 enable underground water to smoothly flow without being interfered in normal time and thereby solving a problem with drawdown of a well or lowering of an underground water level behind the steel sheet pile wall. Also, the planar resin material 13a configuring the drainage member enables excess pore water pressure to be dispersed therethrough and thereby restraining liquefaction of the ground on an occurrence of an earthquake.

title_en: Methods and systems for restoring power based on forecasted loads
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a system for restoring power that identifies back-feeding pathways that reduce the risk of cascading power failure and the need for additional network reconfigurations as a result of restoring power in a power distribution network.SOLUTION: A method for restoring power on the basis of forecasted loads is described. The method includes identifying at least one zone within a power distribution network, and predicting a first energy demand of the at least one zone. The method also includes identifying at least one alternate source of power for the at least one zone, identifying at least one switch within the power distribution network capable of supplying power from the at least one alternate source to the at least one zone, and generating a restoration plan for restoring power to the at least one zone.

title_en: Disaster recovery supporting system and disaster recovery supporting program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To restore power at proper priority corresponding to the states of uses.SOLUTION: A disaster recovery supporting system comprises: a communication unit 4 for acquiring disaster information including the occurrence date and time, contents, and scale of a disaster; and a priority planning task 5 that figures out priority users including a user expected to have high public interest, a user expected to be accommodating disaster victims, and a user expected to have a risk of life, on the basis of the present time, a power supply system stored in a system database 2, user information stored in a section database 3, and the disaster information obtained by the communication unit 4, and makes a plan to give the priority users higher recovery priority.

title_en: Data collection system during disaster, and method of collecting data during disaster
abstract_en: To support that a restoration plan for restoring a mechanism concerning power supplied to a power distribution system, facilities and so forth after disaster occurrence is quickly prepared without imposing any load thereon.SOLUTION: A data collection system during disaster comprises a first processing unit for collecting data comprising power distribution information including a position of a power distribution system and/or equipment, and a power application state of the power distribution system and/or the equipment; a second processing unit for calculating an area restored from a power failure state, based on the position and the power application state of the power distribution system and/or the equipment included in the data; and a third processing unit for determining execution timing of application of preparing a restoration plan with respect to the area, based on a typhoon-elapsing situation of the area obtained using meteorological information about the area, an occurrence state at a fault point indicating a power failure state place in the area, and a collection situation of the data including the power distribution information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Safety receptacle
title_ko: 안전 콘센트
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A safety socket is provided to block current corresponding to generation of heat by using restoration force of a memory alloy spring and prevent safety accidents. CONSTITUTION: One end and the other end of a plate spring(200) are composed of conductive metal in order to supply power to a coupler(110). One end of a memory alloy spring(300) is fixed to one end of a body. The other end of the memory alloy spring includes a plurality of memory alloys connected to the one end or the other end of the plate spring. When high temperature or overheat is generated, the memory alloy spring separates the plate spring from the coupler at a constant distance.

title_en: High impedance fault (hif) location to assist faster repair and outage restorations
abstract_en: A high impedance fault (HIF) may cause a section of a power line to burn open. When the fault current is in the same order of magnitude as the normal load current, the protection device that is upstream from the faulted power line will not trip, which may make it difficult to quickly identify the location of the faulted power line. Accordingly, disclosed embodiments leverage advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) data in a weighted least squares (WLS) distribution state estimation to estimate a state of the power network. The estimated states from successive WLS distribution state estimations may be used to calculate power-flow drops, which are used to define the search space for the faulted power line. From this search space, a single power line may be identified as the faulted power line, such that remedial action(s) may be performed to resolve any resulting power outages.

title_en: Fire-fighting telephone host voice communication circuit and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting telephone host voice communication circuit and a realization method, the method comprises that a voltage signal reaches a point C through a PMOS tube and a diode V9, and then a high voltage 24V is output; the voice signal of the host computer is modulated on a bus signal of 24V in a digital signal mode and is transmitted to the extension; 12V reaches a point C after passing through resistors R34, R39, R41 and a diode V8; d9 will output low voltage and maintain at 10V; when the MCU of the extension detects that the falling edge of the bus signal comes, the extension modulates the voice signal converted into the current signal onto the bus and transmits the current signal back to the host along with the bus; the MCU of the host reads the voltage difference at two ends of the resistor R34, and the signal is converted and amplified by 20 times through the current-voltage converter D7 and then reaches the MCU of the host through the resistors R37 and R35; after the low level of the uploaded signal lasts for 20 mus, the host MCU samples the stable signal of the uploaded signal to perform voice restoration processing. Through the scheme, the anti-interference power supply system achieves the purpose of strong anti-interference capability, and has high practical value and popularization value.

title_en: Multi-point fault emergency repair method and system for elastic power distribution network considering emergency resource scheduling
abstract_en: The disclosure belongs to the technical field of power distribution network optimization, and provides a multipoint fault rush-repair method and system for an elastic power distribution network, which consider emergency resource scheduling, and comprise the following steps: step S01: acquiring fault node position information and load node index weight, judging whether the power distribution network completely recovers power supply, if so, turning to step S03, otherwise, turning to step S02; step S02: performing network reconstruction of the power distribution network with the aim of maximizing the power restoration load until the power is completely restored, and turning to step S03; step S03: judging whether the fault node in the power distribution network is completely recovered, if so, ending the rush-repair, otherwise, turning to step S04; step S04: and repairing the fault node by taking the highest recovery force of the power distribution network as a target until the fault node is completely repaired, and ending the rush repair.

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster rush repair scheduling method and device based on greedy algorithm combination
abstract_en: The invention relates to a post-disaster rush-repair scheduling method for a power distribution network based on a greedy algorithm combination, which comprises the following steps of constructing three greedy algorithms for preventing rush-repair strategies, respectively searching optimal solutions according to the current load state of the power distribution network, selecting the optimal solution with the minimum loss of the power distribution network as the rush-repair strategy of the power distribution network, wherein each greedy algorithm comprises the steps of starting from a rush-repair center, respectively selecting the fault point which best meets the corresponding rush-repair strategy for rush-repair by each rush-repair team, and after each rush-repair team finishes the rush-repair, selecting the fault point which is not rush-repaired and best meets the corresponding rush-repair strategy for rush-repair until all faults finish the rush-repair, wherein the corresponding rush-repair strategies of the three greedy algorithms are closest, the best rush-repair effect and the highest rush-repair efficiency. Compared with the prior art, the invention can quickly obtain a satisfactory solution, save a great deal of time spent on exploration in the whole space, and improve the post-disaster solving efficiency while ensuring the optimality as much as possible.

title_en: Ship track prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship track prediction method and device, wherein a track distribution range is discretized into a plurality of grid cells based on space-time distribution density of ship tracks in a ship navigation area, grid cells corresponding to current ship track nodes and adjacent grid cells are obtained, a cost function of ship position transfer between the current grid cells and the adjacent grid cells is calculated respectively, and the adjacent grid cell with the minimum cost function is used as a predicted ship track of ship position transfer. According to the scheme, before prediction, reliability evaluation and restoration are carried out on the original data of the training track, the real track is restored, time sequence factor constraint is added in the ship navigation network diagram, and time sequence correlation of the track data is considered while spatial correlation of adjacent tracks is described. The size of the grid unit in the ship navigation network is flexibly set based on the space-time distribution density of the ship track.

title_en: Method and system for quickly recovering power supply of shelter suitable for emergency rescue task
abstract_en: The application provides a shelter rapid power restoration method and system suitable for an emergency rescue task. The method comprises the steps of collecting power interruption signals, analyzing the power interruption signals to generate emergency response instructions, automatically identifying and accurately positioning fault points, evaluating importance levels of electric equipment in a shelter to generate a dynamic priority list and an equipment demand report, intelligently selecting a standby power supply combination scheme, starting a standby power supply switching process to generate a standby power supply activation instruction, dynamically adjusting power supply sequence and power distribution of each equipment to ensure normal operation of key facilities to generate an equipment power supply plan after the standby power supply activation instruction is received, continuously monitoring working states of the standby power supply and influences of the working states on the whole power system of the shelter, dynamically optimizing a power supply strategy, and generating an optimized power supply scheme. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the response speed and the power supply reliability of shelter hospitals or temporary emergency facilities when the power is interrupted.

title_en: Mine ecological risk prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine ecological risk prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence, which are characterized in that multisource ecological monitoring data are collected through a distributed sensor network deployed in a mine area, a space-time alignment treatment is carried out to generate a space-time correlation feature set, a pre-trained ecological risk prediction model is called to predict features to generate a risk conduction mode set comprising a risk propagation path, a starting node, a propagation direction and strength, an ecological risk evolution network is constructed based on the risk conduction mode set, the topological structure and time sequence dependency relationship of risk nodes are displayed, a risk early warning instruction set comprising a risk classification result and an ecological restoration strategy is generated according to the ecological risk evolution network and is sent to an ecological management platform, so that mine ecological risks can be comprehensively and accurately predicted, effective risk early warning and ecological restoration strategies are provided, and mine ecological safety is guaranteed.

title_en: Burst combination formula pier protector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a burst combination formula pier protector, it encloses the protective unit of establishing on the pier outer wall including the fastening, and the protective unit includes the protective member that a plurality of structures are the same, and each protective member all includes inner layer structure and outer layer structure, and airtight cavity is separated into by a plurality of strengthening ribs to outer layer structure, and it has the filler all to fill in inner layer structure and the cavity. The utility model has the advantages of protecting effect is good, the durability is strong, transportation and simple to operate, product quality and construction quality all easily are protected, the suitability is strong and be convenient for later maintenance, restoration or change, can extensively be used for high mountain barranca district, the protection when the highly seismic region pier receives the geological disasters impact fracture.

title_en: Landslide repairing structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a landslide restoration structure, mainly include bank slope, sand cobble, gabion above the normal water level, anti-filter geotechnological cloth, planting soil, precast concrete frame lattice girder, grass planting bank protection, precast slab, normal water line, spud pile bottom plate, outer coating bag slip casting gabion lock foot, dredged groove, stake, L shaped steel plate, steel nail, U shaped steel plate, gabion pre-buried dead lever, precast concrete frame lattice girder preformed hole, gabion below the normal water level, steel sheet, frame lattice groove; after the excavation of the bank slope is finished, sand and pebbles are backfilled and rolled; constructing a gabion below a normal water level and constructing a gabion above the normal water level; the outer side of the wooden pile is provided with a locking pin of a grouting gabion which is externally coated with a film bag; laying reverse-filtering geotextile in a gabion above a normal water level; laying concrete prefabricated frame beams on the reversed filter geotextile; and planting soil and grass are laid in the lattice grooves to protect the slope. The utility model discloses can effectively reduce engineering cost for construction speed, the repairing effect is showing, is applied to and can obtain better technological economic benefits in the actual engineering.
assignees: SICHUAN GANGHANG CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Low voltage intelligent switch closing system for power distribution station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-voltage intelligent switch closing system for a power distribution station. The system includes a low voltage outgoing cabinet, a low voltage incoming cabinet, a switch control device and remote/field operation selection knobs. The switch control device includes a master control unit, a power module, a battery, a signal receiving module and a signal transmitting module. The signal transmitting module is connected to switches of different circuits and receives switching position signals, fault trip signals and selection switch signals of the circuit switches. Each circuit on a panel of the low voltage outgoing cabinet is correspondingly provided with one remote/field operation selection knob. According to the invention, quick power supply restoration and reduction of work amount of maintenance workers are realized through a pilot closing process. Besides, fault information and state amount of a low voltage total bus switch and a low voltage outgoing switch are taken into fully account during the closing process and pre-closing heat capacity check is performed for low voltage cable outgoing, so that power failure expansion caused by switch closing after power outage is avoided.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN BAODI POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Surface soil reconstruction material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of ecological restoration, and discloses a surface soil reconstruction material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the surface soil reconstruction material comprises 30-70% of clay and 30-70% of sandy soil according to weight percentage; wherein, the clay contains clay particles of 85-90 wt% and the sand contains clay particles of 15 wt% or less. By adding sand into the surface soil reconstruction material, the pores and the permeability of the surface soil reconstruction material can be increased; and then when the surface soil reconstruction material is used for repairing the surface coverage, rainwater can infiltrate down at the time to form surface runoff, so that surface soil erosion and flood disasters can be avoided.
assignees: GUONENG LANGXINMING ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power distribution network rush-repair scheduling system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power grid maintenance, and particularly relates to an intelligent power distribution network emergency repair scheduling system which comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a data analysis module, a data updating module and a display module, wherein the data acquisition module monitors multi-parameter data of all nodes of a power distribution network in real time through a multi-parameter sensor, the data acquired by the data acquisition module are transmitted to the data preprocessing module in real time in a wireless or wired mode, the data preprocessing module cleans and standardizes the multi-parameter data, the preprocessed multi-parameter data is subjected to model training through the data analysis module, the model comprises LSTM and RNN, meanwhile, the data updating module updates parameters of the data analysis model RNN through an Adam optimization algorithm, the data analysis module outputs specific positions of faults, and the specific positions are displayed through the display module, so that the emergency repair process is completed.
assignees: STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY GONGYI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;ZHENGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power grid recovery system and method for reducing power influence based on electric energy coupling equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid recovery, in particular to a power grid recovery system and a power grid recovery method for reducing power influence based on electric energy coupling equipment, the method comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a multi-energy coupling power distribution network, namely coupling the power distribution network, an air network, a heat supply network and a traffic network through the electric energy coupling equipment; the method comprises the steps of S2, obtaining an initial disconnection scheme of a power distribution network, S3, obtaining a recovery sequence, establishing a power distribution network recovery optimization model based on the power distribution network state, the load state, the traffic network state and the predicted values of power distribution network power supply and power distribution network load after an extreme event occurs, obtaining an EV transfer path, a rush-repair sequence, a power distribution network line recovery sequence and a load recovery sequence based on the power distribution network recovery optimization model, S4, updating the recovery state, S5, recovering the power grid, and applying the method to the fault scene of the urban multi-energy power system caused by the extreme disaster.

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network power supply restoration optimization method, system, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a method, a system, equipment, a medium and a product for optimizing power restoration of a post-disaster power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of power supply equipment used for power restoration in the power distribution network, taking the sum of maximum load restoration power as an optimization target and taking the running balance state of each power supply equipment as a first constraint condition in the power restoration process of the power distribution network, and constructing a power supply restoration optimization model of the power distribution network by taking the system operation balance state of the power distribution network as a second constraint condition, so that the power supply restoration optimization model of the power distribution network can solve a power supply restoration scheme of the power distribution network, the maximum restoration load power supply is considered, the operation balance state of each power supply device and the system operation balance state of the power distribution network can be maintained, and the reliability of power supply restoration after disaster is improved.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic power missing data restoration method based on similar matching and cross-domain associated modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed photovoltaic power missing data restoration method based on similar matching and cross-domain associated modeling, and belongs to the technical field of new energy and power systems. According to the method, a deep-layer similarity matching strategy is utilized, deep features of a historical irradiance sequence are extracted through a self-encoder, feature reconstruction is carried out, multidimensional similarity between a period to be repaired and a historical period is calculated, a similar power candidate set is constructed, an optimal matching sample is screened out, and a similar feature matrix is formed. On the basis, a depth crossover network model is introduced to perform association modeling on cross-time domain similar features, high-order nonlinear features are extracted through feature crossover, and accuracy and robustness of power data restoration are improved. The method can effectively relieve the problem of power data missing caused by abnormal acquisition, channel congestion or equipment failure, remarkably improve the input data quality of the power prediction model and support the safe and efficient operation of the distributed photovoltaic system.

title_en: Power source supply device for electromechanical fixture and embedded outlet
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a power source supply device for an electromechanical fixture which does not supply a power source at the time when a power switch of an electric tool remains switched on in the case of not only power restoration after a blackout at a power source side of a device but also recovery of connection after power source connection between the device and the power tool is once out of place at the load side of the device.  <P>SOLUTION: In the device for supplying the power source by connecting a power source line of the electromechanical fixture, the power source supply device includes a contact means for opening and closing a conductor of a main circuit and the main circuit, a means for supplying the power source to the load side in parallel with a contact for opening and closing the main circuit via impedance, a detection means for current circulating through the impedance, a detection means for detecting whether or not a power source line of the load is connected, and a sequence which puts the contact of the main circuit when the detection means for current does not detect current and the detection means for detecting whether or not the power source line of load is connected detects its connection.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&amp;INPIT

title_en: Support system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reliably support restoration of facilities by providing terminals carried by working personnel with information related to work procedures for operating disaster prevention facilities and state information representing states of equipment related to the operation object facilities.SOLUTION: A support system includes a support device connected to disaster prevention facilities installed in a building, and a plurality of terminals carried by working personnel. The support system transmits information related to work procedures for operating the disaster prevention facilities, to the terminals so as to be displayed thereon, and causes state information terminals to display the information, the state information terminals representing states of the equipment related to the operation object facilities.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Disaster prevention system
abstract_en: To provide a disaster prevention system which surely prevents a monitoring function by a disaster prevention receiving board from being lost, in such a manner that temporary restoration can be rapidly performed to failure of a power supply part without increasing the circuit structure of a power supply part or requiring management as a reserve system.SOLUTION: In the disaster prevention receiving board of a tunnel disaster prevention system, a power source rack includes: AC/DC conversion parts 102-1 to 102-3 which output the results of conversion of a power source into DC voltage; and DC/DC conversion parts 104-1 to 104-5 to which outputs from the AC/DC conversion parts are inputted to output the results of conversion thereof into DC voltage to be required in each system. In failure of an AC/DC conversion part 102-1, backup is performed by changeover by a manual changeover switch 106-1 in such a manner that the output of a regulated power supply device 110-1 is inputted into a DC/DC conversion part 104-1. In failure of the DC/DC conversion part 104-1, backup is performed by changeover by a manual changeover switch 108-1 in such a manner that the output of a regulated power supply device 110-2 is inputted into a power source line 122-1.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Method and system for coordinated source-grid-load-storage dispatch optimization during post-disaster restoration of power distribution system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of power systems and operations research. Disclosed are a method and system for coordinated source-grid-load-storage dispatch optimization during post-disaster restoration of a power distribution system. The method comprises: acquiring network topology constraint data for a power distribution system, wherein network topology constraints for the power distribution system comprise a virtual network topology constraint for the power distribution system, a geometric network topology constraint for the power distribution system, and an electrical network topology constraint for the power distribution system; on the basis of fault situations of a power source device, a load device and an energy storage device that are caused by a disaster, generating operational characteristic constraint data for devices in the power distribution system, wherein the operational characteristic constraint data for the devices in the power distribution system comprises operational characteristic constraints for the power source device, the load device and the energy storage device; and inputting the network topology constraint data for the power distribution system and the operational characteristic constraint data for the devices in the power distribution system into a pre-established coordinated source-grid-load-storage dispatch optimization model for power distribution systems in a post-disaster restoration scenario, such that a coordinated dispatch optimization result is output.

title_en: Autonomous restoration of power systems after natural disasters
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and computer-readable media are disclosed for autonomous restoration of power systems after natural disasters. An operating mode of a circuit breaker that is in a power system grid and that is coupled to other circuit breakers in the power system grid via communication channels is determined. Based on determining that the operating mode is a normal operating mode, data to parameterize a plurality of power grid restoration scenarios is collected at the circuit breaker. Based on determining that the operating mode is an exception mode, measurement data that includes current and voltage data is received at the circuit breaker, and one of the power system grid restoration scenarios is initiated at the circuit breaker. The power system grid error restoration scenario is selected based at least in part on a status of the plurality of communication channels coupled to the circuit breaker and on the measurement data.

title_en: A business method, apparatus and system for monitoring quantitative and qualitative environmental analytics and managing associated financial transactions
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system, apparatus, and business method for using financial instruments to provide investment incentive to fund disaster mitigation projects and/or ecosystem restoration projects triggered by real world events detected at set points by sensors and analyzed by computing devices. The detection of events results in the computational analysis and determination of a characteristics of a resilience bond or ecosystem-service bond to be issued or returned to investors. Examples involve sensors used to detect events, including flood damage mitigation, earthquake damage mitigation, or air quality improvement. In one preferred embodiment of the disclosure an investor may make an initial payment into a financial instrument being a resilience bond used to fund a mitigation project, said financial instrument pays phases to the mitigation project developer at the completion of phases of the project that occur prior to the occurrence of a disaster.

title_en: System and method for power outage and restoration notification in an advanced metering infrastructure network
abstract_en: A method and system are provided to transmit a meter power status. The method includes recognizing a power status change at a meter. The method includes, if the meter is scheduled to transmit first, transmitting a notification message to at least one neighboring meter towards a mesh gate, wherein the notification message includes a power status indicator and a meter identifier. The method includes, if the meter is not scheduled to transmit first, waiting a predetermined time period to receive a notification message from at least one neighboring meter. The method includes, responsive to receiving a notification message, adding a meter identifier to the received notification message before retransmitting the modified notification message to at least one neighboring meter. The method includes retransmitting the notification message.

title_en: Remediation method for flue-cured tobacco after hail disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for remedying flue-cured tobacco after a hail disaster, which comprises the following steps: (a) cleaning the tobacco field, cleaning the ditch to drain water, performing branch leaving treatment on the tobacco field, and applying pesticide; the flue-cured tobacco in the root extending period is subjected to branch-leaving-free treatment under light disaster, medium disaster and heavy disaster; the flue-cured tobacco in the colony period is treated without branches under light disasters; in a middle disaster, performing top branch treatment; under serious disasters, performing bottom-left branch treatment; the method comprises the following steps of (1) carrying out top branch treatment on flue-cured tobaccos in a busy period under light disasters and medium disasters, and carrying out bottom branch treatment under heavy disasters; (b) spraying a leaf fertilizer on the leaf surfaces of the flue-cured tobaccos; (c) applying a cured tobacco restoration fertilizer and applying rooting powder; (d) selecting and remaining flue-cured tobacco branches, and erasing other axillary buds; (e) cultivating and ridging, and applying flue-cured tobacco growth fertilizer. In the remedial method, the remedial treatment such as targeted branch leaving, fertilization and the like is carried out on the flue-cured tobacco which is in different growth periods and is subjected to hail damage of different degrees, so that the yield and the quality of the flue-cured tobacco are improved.

title_en: Silt reducing system for drainage beach of artificial ditch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drainage beach silt reducing system of an artificial ditch, which belongs to the technical field of coastal wetland ecological restoration, is arranged at the side of a silt beach of an open sea and comprises a water injection ditch, a drainage passage, an outer wall and a water injection system, wherein the water injection ditch is arranged on the land behind the silt beach, the water injection system is matched with the water injection ditch to always inject water into the water injection ditch, the outer wall is arranged at two sides of the water injection ditch, water in the water injection ditch is drained to the beaches at two sides through the drainage passage, fine-particle mud in the drainage passage is started and moved under the action of water flow and is output along with the leaving shoal flow during the ebb period, and the beach is prevented from being argillized. The invention effectively adjusts the action of waves and tides through the ditches which are excavated manually so as to reduce natural disasters; the coastal wetland can effectively degrade pollution and restore the original ecological system and natural balance mechanism; through ecological restoration, the diversity of species is increased. Provides a good foundation for further building leisure tourism and inhabitation facilities and provides a foundation for developing the tourism industry.

title_en: Elastic lifting-oriented power distribution network power-communication fault collaborative restoration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elastic lifting-oriented power distribution network power-communication fault collaborative restoration method, which comprises the following steps: 1) After an extreme event, judging the urgency of an optical fiber fault in a power distribution network communication system, determining the optical fiber fault affecting a remote control interconnection switch as an urgent optical fiber fault, generating a repairing scheme and repairing the urgent optical fiber fault, wherein the non-urgent optical fiber fault is not repaired once; 2) Dividing power nodes and mobile base stations of a power distribution network into 1-level and 2-level grids, determining grid repair sequences, and generating a power failure and mobile base station failure repair scheme in the 2-level grids, wherein non-emergency mobile base station failures are not repaired temporarily; 3) And generating a restoration scheme for the non-emergency optical fiber faults and the non-emergency mobile base station faults in the communication system and restoring. According to the method, the influence of the power distribution network communication system faults on the power distribution network load recovery is considered, the communication faults and the power faults of the power distribution network are cooperatively recovered, more effective and rapid fault recovery can be achieved, and the elasticity of the power distribution network is further improved.

title_en: Method For Restoring From Damages By Fire On Building
title_ko: 건물화재시 피해 복구방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for restoring from damages by a fire on a building, comprising: a wall foreign matter removal step for manually removing wallpaper damaged by a fire and trash attached to walls; a wall soot removal step for primarily removing soot formed on the walls using a water jet and then secondarily removing the soot manually; a wall diagnosis step for diagnosing the walls, from which foreign matter and soot have been removed, using various inspection devices; a wall restoring and repair step for restoring and repairing walls that need repair or restoration as a result of the wall diagnosis step; and a wall finishing step for inspecting the walls repaired and restored through the wall restoring and repair step, and then aligning the verticality of the walls and leveling the outer surfaces of the walls. According to the present invention, when walls of a building are damaged by a fire, a part or the whole of the walls can be easily restored.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물화재시 피해 복구방법에 관한 것으로서, 화재로 인해 손상된 벽지와 벽면에 부착된 쓰레기를 수작업으로 제거하는 벽면 이물질 제거단계; 벽면에 형성된 그을음을 일차적으로 워터젯을 통해 제거한 후 수작업을 통해 이차적으로 제거하는 벽면 그을음 제거단계; 이물질과 그을음이 제거된 벽면을 각종 검사기기를 통해 진단하는 벽면 진단단계; 상기 벽면 진단단계를 통해 수리 또는 복구가 필요한 벽면을 복구 및 수리하는 벽면 복구 및 수리단계; 및 상기 벽면 복구 및 수리단계를 거쳐 수리 및 복구가 이루어진 벽면을 검사한 후 수직을 맞추고 외면을 고르게 하는 벽면 마감단계;를 포함한다.

title_en: Power restoration management method and system
abstract_en: A power restoration method and system. The method includes receiving by a computer processor of a computing apparatus, a signal indicating that a power outage has ended and that an input voltage signal used for powering power consumption devices at a first specified location power will be enabled. The computer processor disables input voltage signal connections to the power consumption devices and detects that the input voltage signal is enabled. The computer processor enables a first input voltage signal connection associated with a first power consumption device and monitors a frequency signal associated with the input voltage signal. The computer processor generates frequency level data comprising a frequency level of the frequency signal and compares the frequency level to a predetermined frequency level value. The computer processor generates results data comprising results of comparing the frequency level to a predetermined frequency level value.
assignees: BOSS GREGORY JENSEN;HAMILTON II RICK ALLEN;HAUGH JULIANNE FRANCES;SAND ANNE R;IBM

title_en: A kind of slope surface restoration of the ecosystem structure
abstract_en: A kind of slope surface restoration of the ecosystem structure is successively horizontally arranged with No.1 intercepting ditch, No. two intercepting ditch, No. three intercepting ditch the utility model relates to ecological environment recovery technique field, in slope surface from top to bottom；No.1 intercepting ditch, No. two intercepting ditch and No. three intercepting ditch are equidistantly vertically installed with several rhones between any two；Several grids are laid between two adjacent rhones；No.1 suction pump is provided on No. three intercepting ditch；The water outlet of No.1 suction pump is connected with No.1 drinking-water pipe；The inside of water storage box is inserted with No. two drinking-water pipes, and the interior bottom for being located at water storage box is stretched in the bottom end of No. two drinking-water pipes；The outer end of No. two drinking-water pipes is connect with the water inlet end of No. two suction pumps；The water outlet of No. two suction pumps is vertically installed with spray head, it is not easy to lead to vegetation deterioration by rain drop erosion when experience rainwater more season, the grass-seed high survival rate of slope surface, the native face on slope are not easily formed landslide or tomography, can repair again to the ecological environment of slope surface in dry season.
assignees: SICHUAN HENGXIN CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Prefabricated assembled type partially-wrapped concrete combined connecting beam with replaceable seismic damage
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a removable prefabricated assembled part parcel concrete combination even roof beam of shock damage, including combination beam section and removable power consumption roof beam section, the combination beam section includes left beam section and right beam section, left beam section and right beam section set up respectively in the left and right sides of removable power consumption roof beam section carries out bolted connection, removable power consumption roof beam section middle part is provided with the power consumption piece. The utility model discloses a combination is roof beam even has better deformation and power consumption ability, realizes linking the roof beam easily and yields the power consumption's mechanism, and works as the combination even roof beam and yields the back, and removable its power consumption piece of surrendering position realizes shaking the back and to the quick restoration of impaired structure. Meanwhile, the form of partially wrapping the concrete is adopted, so that the post-earthquake reinforcement of the combined coupling beam is more convenient. In addition, all parts of the prefabricated assembled type part-wrapped concrete combined connecting beam with replaceable seismic damage can be prefabricated in a factory, are connected through bolts during site construction, can be installed in a short time, and greatly improves the construction efficiency.

title_en: High-resolution remote sensing image-based multi-index fusion landslide detection method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a high-resolution remote sensing image-based multi-index fusion landslide detection method, which comprises the steps of (1) acquiring a high-resolution remote sensing image and a stereoscopic image pair; (2) generating a digital elevation model and calculating terrain feature indexes; (3) preprocessing the remote sensing image; (4) conducting the multi-scale image segmentation for the remote sensing image; (5) selecting appropriate terrain feature indexes for different scale layers and obtaining the values of the terrain feature indexes; (6) conducting the fusion processing for terrain feature indexes and ground object feature indexes, and comparing each feature index with a preset rule set to realize the landslide detection. Compared with the prior art, the noise influence caused by the scattered distribution of landslide regions can be avoided, so that the landslide recognition and extraction problem caused by earthquakes or other natural damages can be solved. Therefore, the method provides support for the post-disaster reconstruction and restoration. The above feature indexes can reflect the features of a ground object within a selected region, and a threshold corresponding to the feature indexes is unique. Based on the combination of features and the determination of the threshold, the landslide region can be successfully extracted and studied.

title_en: Power grid timing sequence recovery optimization method of considering potential damage probability of elements
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid timing sequence recovery optimization method of considering potential damage probability of elements. According to the method, power grid recovery is carried out by a timing sequence recovery strategy aiming at the problem that a natural disaster can cause a widespread power failure and bring a potential damage to a power element. Within each recovery time frame, unit startup sequence optimization and path recovery sequence optimization are carried out step by step. In the first step, the unit startup sequence is optimized employing the maximum system generating capacity within the power grid recovery time as the target; and in the second step, the path recovery sequence is optimized, and transmission component damage probability model and recovery time model are built. The unit startup sequence optimization in the first step and the path recovery sequence optimization in the second step are associated with each other through path operation time, so that consistency optimization of two targets is effectively achieved. The power grid timing sequence recovery optimization method considers the potential damage probability conditions, with different degrees, of transmission components such as a circuit and a transformer, and simultaneously forms a power grid recovery scheme of a timing sequence to guide practice, so that the method has higher practical significance.

title_en: Electrically-based automated system and the power project formulating method of synthetic data server
abstract_en: The invention provides the ways to draw up the plan of a kind of electrically-based automated system and synthetic data server, first, next year preliminary project is formulated according to equipment Inspection cycle and defect situation in power plant, and secondly, next year preliminary project is sent to control centre by power plant, control centre judges that plan is the most reasonable, if rationally, agreed to, the information that otherwise feeds back to is to power plant, again, power plant is according to feedback information amendment plan, until meeting the requirement of control centre.The ways to draw up the plan that the present invention provides when making a plan in power plant by considering that abundant exopathogenic factor and endogenous cause of ill make the formulation more science of power plant repair schedule, make maximized to have ensured supply of electric power level by considering load alteration when control centre's examination & approval plan, take full advantage of the data in existing power automatic system, and synthetic data server is set to store data influential on plan, and then make plan the most accurate, closer to reality.
assignees: ZHAOYUAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: A kind of power distribution network intelligent diagnosis system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power distribution network intelligent diagnosis system, including following functions module: status information of equipment acquisition module, status information of equipment ETL module, smart machine state estimation module, equipment state management module, Maintenance Schedule Optimization module, result output module, smart machine state estimation module is according to the various status informations of Distribution Network Equipment, analytical data feature, equipment state is defined the level, and passage combines new status information of equipment and deduces equipment state over time.System uses intelligent evaluation, machine learning, the Internet, database technology, equipment various to distribution are monitored in real time and assess, remind staff to carry out and make an inspection tour service work targetedly, improve the initiative making an inspection tour service work, and tour repair schedule can be generated, and the maintenance material list of correspondence and service kit inventory, instruct constituent parts to carry out service work, help people to improve tour overhaul efficiency and quality.
assignees: JINAN LICHENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for identifying weak points of power distribution network structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for identifying weak points of a power distribution network structure, which is used for calculating bus security loads, calculating feeder line restoration total loads of a single transfer supply path, calculating multi-transfer supply path restoration total loads, finally calculating the primary load restoration rate of a transformer substation, identifying the weak points of the power distribution network structure by using the primary load restoration rate, quantitatively calculating the weak points of power distribution network transfer power, providing a basis and a method for planning, regulating and controlling the power distribution network and modifying the power distribution network, improving the fault restoration efficiency, reducing the power failure range and shortening the power failure time.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD KAIHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Landslide monitoring devices for ecological restoration of mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide monitoring device for mine ecological restoration, belonging to the technical field of monitoring equipment; the device comprises a mounting rack, a first detection mechanism, a second detection mechanism and a signal emission mechanism; the first detection mechanism comprises a collecting cylinder, and a first contact block and two water outlet pipes which are symmetrically arranged are arranged on the collecting cylinder; the second detection mechanism comprises a detection rod, a contact is fixedly arranged on the detection rod, the detection rod is arranged on a pneumatic assembly, and the pneumatic assembly comprises a contact plate; the signal emission mechanism comprises two signal bullet emission barrels, the signal bullets are filled in the signal bullet emission barrels, and when the first detection mechanism or the second detection mechanism detects the danger of landslide, the signal bullet emission barrels emit the signal bullets. According to the invention, the vicinity of the mine is automatically monitored through the first detection mechanism, the second detection mechanism and the signal emission mechanism, so that the risk of landslide can be predicted in advance, and the device has a simple structure and is convenient to operate.
assignees: ZHONGDI SHANSHUI BEIJING ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Early fault characteristic data integration method for power equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early fault characteristic data integration method of power equipment, which belongs to the technical field of power grid fault restoration and comprises an autonomous navigation module, a fault identification module, a fault processing module and a control module, wherein the autonomous navigation module is used for planning an optimal path moving to a pre-repair position and performing autonomous navigation, the fault identification module is used for acquiring an RGB image of the pre-repair position and extracting the early fault characteristic data of the power equipment, the fault processing module is used for inputting the early fault characteristic data of the power equipment into a large language model for integration and outputting integrated fault characteristics, and the integrated fault characteristics are used for controlling a mechanical arm to repair the fault position. The invention solves the problems of low maintenance efficiency, poor safety and inaccurate repair existing in the prior art of integrating the early fault characteristic data of the power equipment.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID XIAN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Hybrid distribution network power restoration control
abstract_en: A power outage restoration system manages a power network including a plurality of switching devices. The power outage restoration system includes an outage management system having a network model of said power network. A plurality of local restoration controllers are in communication with the outage management system and each said local restoration controller includes a trimmed network model correlating to a respective area of responsibility.

title_en: Evaluation and identification method for plateau lakeside ecological landscape restoration planning
abstract_en: An assessment and identification method based on plateau lakeside ecological landscape restoration planning comprises the following aspects: (1) Evaluating the components of the plateau lakeside ecological landscape based on the vision field; (2) evaluating the restoration value of the ecological landscape of the lakeside of the plateau lake; (3) human activity disturbance intensity assessment; (4) identifying potential habitats of typical wetland waterfowls in plateau lakesides; (5) line selection evaluation of the ecological green roads in the plateau lake shores; and establishing a lakeshore ecological landscape micro-landform recognition algorithm based on the terrain index and the terrain humidity index, and combining with sight analysis to effectively recognize and analyze the composition of the plateau lakeshore ecological landscape system.

title_en: Ecological integrity-based water ecological health evaluation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological health evaluation method based on ecological integrity and application thereof, wherein an evaluation index system is divided into a target layer, a criterion layer, an element layer and an index layer, different types of indexes are subjected to differential standard determination method based on ecological integrity, a core index is subjected to quantitative and qualitative analysis by adopting a method combining an entropy weight method and a analytic hierarchy process, and finally the health condition of an water ecological system is displayed in a pattern marking and color partition mode which is easy to understand. In conclusion, the method can comprehensively, scientifically and accurately evaluate the health state of the water ecological system, is beneficial to promoting the water ecological assessment, and provides scientific basis for water ecological management and restoration.

title_en: A kind of earthquake disaster scene evolutionary model
abstract_en: The invention discloses the restoration and reconstruction stages after a kind of earthquake disaster scene evolutionary model, including earthquake monitoring and forecasting stage, earthquake defence stage, earthquake emergency rescue stage and calamity.The present invention effectively promoted earthquake monitoring and forecasting ability, more targetedly carry out earthquake defense work, more rapidly accurately carry out Disaster Assessment and emergency management and rescue and it is more scientific implement rebuilding in disaster-hit areas, for substantially reducing earthquake disaster bring economic loss and casualties, ensureing that people's production, living safety have important practical significance.
assignees: INST REMOTE SENSING & DIGITAL EARTH CAS

title_en: Configuration method, device and equipment for defaulting power-off and power-restoration automatic tracking work order
abstract_en: The invention discloses a configuration method, a control device, equipment and a readable storage medium for  defaulting power-off and power-off automatic tracking work orders, which are characterized in that power-off work orders are obtained, whether each power-off work order is a paid work order is judged in a polling mode, if yes, information of the paid work order is sent to a  designated address, so that a worker in charge of uploading the power-off work order is prompted to process the paid work order in time, then the power-off work orders are obtained, whether each power-off work order is a target power-off work order is judged in a polling mode, if yes, power-off monitoring is carried out on the target power-off work order according to a preset rule, and therefore the worker in charge of power-off execution is prompted to carry out timely power-off processing on the target power-off work order.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD SHANWEI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: A kind of black starting-up recovery rack planning algorithm
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of black starting-up racks to restore planning algorithm, belongs to Operation Technique of Electric Systems field.The present invention carries out in the form of breadth first algorithm is combined with dijkstra's algorithm.First in the target section to be restored determined, selection has self-startup ability and the maximum power supply point of capacity as black starting-up power supply, and black starting-up power supply is searched out to each restoration path for being alternatively activated power supply using breadth first algorithm, 4 optimal black starting-up initial stage mini systems are selected according to priority weighting function calculated result, then it uses dijkstra's algorithm with most short weight path principle, whole recovery is carried out to the rack and power supply to be restored of target section.After power grid massive blackout, the present invention rapidly can provide optimal recovery scheme for black starting-up recovery, improve efficiency and success rate that power grid"black-start" restores, Socie-economic loss caused by reducing because of long-term have a power failure.

title_en: Method and device for testing distribution characteristics of earth exogenous magnetic field by using field effect of carbon allotrope compound
abstract_en: The method and device for testing distribution characteristics of earth external magnetic field by using carbon allotrope compound field effect are characterized by that the artificial polar light induced by carbon allotrope compound field effect device formed from plane electrode plate composite body formed from foamed nickel or carbon fibre which is loaded with ELF low-frequency electric field, communicated in the form of parallel capacitor and deposited with carbon allotrope compound is used as marker, and the distribution characteristics of earth external magnetic field formed from ring band-shaped N pole and ring band-shaped S pole which are alternatively distributed along latitude line of earth are indirectly described by means of special relationship of artificial polar light and earth external magnetic field. The distribution state of the earth external source magnetic field has important values for environmental protection, natural ecology restoration, natural disaster prediction and universe energy utilization.

title_en: Evaluation and identification method for plateau lakeside ecological landscape restoration planning
abstract_en: An assessment and identification method based on plateau lakeside ecological landscape restoration planning comprises the following aspects: (1) evaluating the components of the plateau lakeside ecological landscape based on the vision field; (2) evaluating the restoration value of the ecological landscape of the lakeside of the plateau lake; (3) human activity interference intensity assessment; (4) identifying potential habitats of waterfowls in typical wetlands at plateau lakesides; (5) line selection evaluation of ecological green roads in plateau lake shores; based on the terrain indexes and the terrain humidity indexes, a lake shore ecological landscape micro-landform recognition algorithm is established and combined with visual field analysis, and the composition of a plateau lake shore ecological landscape system can be effectively recognized and analyzed.

title_en: Line first-aid repair operation identification method and device without work ticket
abstract_en: The invention provides a line first-aid repair operation identification method and a line first-aid repair operation identification device without a work ticket, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring fault information of distribution network scheduling push; s3, matching the current team information and the fault line position from a preset event data resource pool to obtain a plurality of historical emergency repair operations of the current team at the fault line position and corresponding emergency repair operation information; s4: and determining whether the emergency repair operation aiming at the fault information pushed by the power distribution network is line emergency repair operation without a work ticket according to work ticket transaction data of a plurality of historical emergency repair operations in a preset time from the corresponding historical fault starting time to the historical fault power restoration time. Aiming at the phenomenon of 10KV medium-voltage line fault emergency repair operation carried out without a work ticket, an efficient identification method is established to block the ticket-free emergency repair loophole, so that the special line control of departments such as safety supervision of provincial companies and city bureaus and the biotechnology is not relied on, and a large amount of manpower is saved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Planned power failure standard verification method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a planned power failure standard calibration method and a planned power failure standard calibration device. And matching different database table information according to the basic information of power outage and restoration, performing data extraction and information analysis, and obtaining display results of power outage and power failure and display results of on-line circulation and repair with rush repair. According to the planned power failure standard calibration method and device, comprehensive information such as planned power failure standard information and calibration results is visually displayed in real time, the workload of manual query is greatly reduced, repeated and complicated information integration analysis work is avoided, the operation condition of the distribution network switch can be effectively monitored, and an auxiliary decision function is provided for power distribution network planned power failure management and control.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Multi-objective optimization method for post-earthquake community building group recovery scheduling and toughness evaluation
abstract_en: A post-earthquake community building group restoration scheduling and toughness evaluation multi-objective optimization method comprises the following steps: s1, collecting basic information of a building group and a lifeline network of a community to be restored, and dividing work blocks; s2, determining the function loss and the restoration time of each monomer building in the community building group, the function loss and the restoration time of the buildings in each working block after the earthquake and the missing ratio of the network resources of the buildings in the blocks under the corresponding earthquake scene to obtain a function interdependence matrix among the buildings; s3, establishing a recovery objective function and constraint, and establishing a community building group recovery scheduling and toughness evaluation multi-objective optimization model considering the interdependence of building functions under resources; s6, solving the optimization model, and giving a pareto front edge of a recovery track in the optimal recovery process of the community building work block. The invention can obviously improve the post-disaster recovery efficiency of the community building group, and a decision maker can make a final decision from limited optimal scheduling according to other preferences and experiences, thereby providing a basis for disaster prevention and reduction and design planning of an urban management organization.

title_en: Power system partition recovery method and device based on hierarchical analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for recovering a power system partition based on hierarchical analysis, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power supply parameters of all power supplies in a to-be-recovered power system partition according to a preset evaluation index; constructing a main power supply selection model aiming at the to-be-recovered power system partition based on an analytic hierarchy process; constructing a first judgment matrix, a second judgment matrix and a third judgment matrix; after passing consistency check, calculating a comprehensive weight vector of each power supply by combining each weight vector; and the power supply with the maximum comprehensive weight vector is used as a main power supply for recovery. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the priority of each power supply is determined by analyzing the levels, considering the time criterion and the power generation criterion and determining the main power supply of the power system partition based on the indexes such as the starting time, the climbing speed, the rated capacity and the distance from the power supply to the important load, so that the technical problem of long power restoration time of the load is solved, more loads are restored in a short time, and the restoration efficiency is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Traffic flow restoration method and system based on space-time fusion and self-attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic flow restoration method and system based on space-time fusion and a self-attention mechanism. The invention provides a traffic flow restoration method based on space-time combination and time-space elimination, wherein the space-time combination enables a model to add spatial information, time information and numerical values and view the sum as a whole when a self-attention mechanism is used, the front-back relation of the spatial information and the time of a road network in a road is fully utilized, and the utilization rate of road map information is improved; a space-time fusion and self-attention mechanism for traffic flow restoration is provided. The space-time fusion and self-attention mechanism enables a model to extract the implicit relation of traffic flow among different roads by combining space and time information, and learns the historical flow characteristics of a road map; a method for repairing and fusing two sequence data of positive sequence and negative sequence is provided. Two sequences are obtained through two traversal methods of positive sequence and reverse sequence, various information of different sequences is extracted, and the repair accuracy is improved.

title_en: Three-quantity directional blasting pressure relief method under rapid tunneling of mine coal seam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-quantity directional blasting pressure relief method under rapid tunneling of a mine coal seam, which comprises the steps of tunneling engineering, coal body blasting drilling construction, monitoring and quality control, shock absorption and restoration, and relates to the technical field of rock burst control. According to the three-quantity directional blasting pressure relief method under the rapid tunneling of the mine coal seam, the originally designed two large-diameter pressure relief drilling holes (construction interval 2 m) are changed into two-wall coal body blasting drilling holes (construction interval 15 m), the two large-diameter pressure relief drilling holes at the head are changed into one coal body blasting drilling hole, the tunneling efficiency of the high-stress coal seam underground tunneling and anchoring integrated machine is effectively improved through monitoring, quality control, shock absorption and restoration, the corresponding impact prevention and disaster control engineering quantity is reduced, the construction investment of corresponding rock burst disaster control is saved, and the popularization and application of the tunneling and anchoring integrated machine in the deep mine high-stress coal seam are promoted, so that the method has a good application prospect.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHENGTONG COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Method, system and equipment for optimizing power restoration and supply of key areas under typhoon disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a method, a system and equipment for optimizing power restoration in a key region under typhoon disasters, which comprise the steps of obtaining the probability of cascade power failure of a key power supply region by analyzing the risk of a failure event of a power tie line of the key power supply region in a typhoon influence region so as to calculate and obtain the cascade power failure load loss power of the key power supply region under typhoon influence; and constructing a cascade power failure event power restoration optimization model of the key power supply area by taking the maximum key power supply area load loss restoration power supply power as an optimization target, and solving by utilizing an immune particle swarm optimization-based regular extreme learning machine optimization algorithm to obtain the cascade power failure event load power loss restoration power of the key power supply area. According to the invention, the grid-losing load compound electric power in the cascade power failure of the key power supply area can be rapidly and accurately obtained by adopting an immune particle swarm optimization-based regular extreme learning machine optimization algorithm, so that necessary technical support is provided for safe and stable operation of the power system.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-carbon balance defense method, system, equipment and storage medium for fusing physical and social factors of power grid information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-carbon balance defense method, system, equipment and storage medium for fusing power grid information physical social factors, which comprises the steps of constructing an information physical social system multidimensional coupling model, combining a finite state machine and historical disaster data, simulating a dynamic evolution track of the system under an extreme natural disaster condition, constructing a risk assessment model based on an event-driven mechanism, quantitatively evaluating the multidimensional coupling factors based on natural disaster events and artificial carbon emission emergency, presetting a stage collaborative defense strategy, constructing a carbon balance defense effect evaluation model, and quantitatively verifying emission reduction and restoration capacities of strategies of each stage by combining quantitative evaluation results. The method can synchronously optimize carbon emission and carbon sink layout under extreme disaster situations, enhance toughness and low-carbon transformation capacity of the power system, realize dynamic regulation and control of disaster-induced carbon unbalance, and ensure scientificity and executable performance of the scheme under complex conditions.

title_en: Method for searching non-continuity position of embedded conduit
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To promptly search for a non-continuity position of an embedded conduit, thus attaining step-by-step early restoration of conduit circulation upon earthquake disaster.  <P>SOLUTION: The method includes: the process (S1) of connecting a vibration generator to a ground branch pipe of an embedded conduit and vibrating the embedded conduit through the ground branch pipe; the vibration detection process (S2) of detecting vibration generated from the embedded conduit on the ground surface along piping of the embedded conduit from a branch position of the ground branch pipe; and the non-continuity position estimation process (S3) of estimating a position where a continuous detection vibrating level is discontinuous in the vibration detection process to be on a non-continuity position of the embedded conduit.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Computation of preemptive ranked resiliency measures, including preemptive placement and real-time dispatch of distributed energy resources, using probabilistic optimization for enhanced operational resilience of a power system
abstract_en: When an extreme weather event is forecast, an operator of a power system will typically prepare reactive measures, to facilitate the restoration of the power system after it has been damaged by the event. Disclosed embodiments utilize probabilistic optimization to identify and rank resiliency measures in advance of such an event, such that proactive measures may be implemented before the event, to increase the operational resilience of the power system during the event. This enables the power system to better withstand and recover more quickly from the event, thereby reducing downtime (e.g., power outages) and costs. In an embodiment, these resiliency measures include the preemptive placement and/or dispatch of distributed energy resources, with accompanying network-switch optimization, within the power system. This preemptive placement and/or dispatch may use a risk-driven optimal power flow model that accounts for the criticality of loads and the failure probability of power lines.

title_en: Method and system for selective acceleration of remote copy in a network of storage systems
abstract_en: Systems and methods described herein involve prioritizing remote copies for acceleration after a disaster-stricken site is operational to enable faster restore and failback operations. The remote copies accelerate processes based on a risk of a Recovery Time Objective (RTO) violation and the impact of failback delays, thereby ensuring timely data restoration and maintaining business continuity. Remote copies that are already in-sync are prioritized for deceleration to free up network resources based on the length of the RTO. Various embodiments remove the maximum bandwidth cap of the highest priority reverse resync operations to accelerate them, or lower the minimum bandwidth cap of the highest priority in-sync remote copies to decelerate them.

title_en: Service restoration method after failure under a kind of movement of power distribution network differential protection
abstract_en: Service restoration method after failure under a kind of movement of power distribution network differential protection, step are：Fault zone and non-faulting power loss regional analysis based on differential protection action signal；Scope of power outage internal fault moment load equipment current value is calculated according to the fault moment switched-current sampled value freezed；Non-faulting power loss region is turned to form quick service restoration scheme for route searching；Network optimization reconstruct is carried out, the reconfiguration scheme of whole feasibilities is obtained；Trend verification is carried out to network optimization reconfiguration scheme, selects optimal reconfiguration scheme；Removal of load decision operation is carried out to optimal reconfiguration scheme；Recovery operation is powered according to final service restoration scheme.The present invention restores after capable of carrying out failure fast and reliablely, improves power supply reliability.

title_en: Simulation and prediction method for ecological influence of inland waterway improvement project
