abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological impact simulation and prediction method for inland waterway regulation engineering, which comprises the steps of determining indicated aquatic organisms of a regulation river reach, habitat factors forming the aquatic organisms and space-time distribution of the habitat factors, and establishing a fitness model of a habitat of the aquatic organisms; establishing a three-dimensional water-sand mathematical model of the renovation river reach, and predicting three-dimensional space-time distribution data of water depth, flow velocity, flow state and sand content of the renovation river reach under different channel renovation measure parameters; in the design stage of the inland waterway regulation engineering, the predicted habitat factor three-dimensional space-time distribution data is input into the fitness model by adjusting different regulation measure parameters in the three-dimensional water-sand mathematical model, and the influence on the habitat under different waterway regulation parameters is predicted, so that the organic integration of the waterway regulation target and the aquatic environment protection is achieved. The inland waterway regulation engineering influences the three-dimensional space of the indicative biological habitat conditions, develops the river navigation function and simultaneously considers the protection and restoration of the river ecological function.

title_en: Ecological environment treatment device for preventing and controlling geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological environment treatment device for preventing and controlling geological disasters, which belongs to the technical field of ecological environment restoration and comprises two outer support plates, wherein a frame is connected to the outer support plates in a sliding manner, a main body support is fixedly connected to the frame, a cover plate is fixedly connected to the main body support, two solar panels are rotatably connected to the cover plate, and a water collecting tank is arranged on the cover plate; the frame is provided with a sowing component for sowing plant seeds; the frame is provided with a soil loosening assembly for loosening soil and digging hard objects such as stones and the like; the main body support is provided with a collapse detection assembly which is used for detecting whether the collapse risk exists on the ground or not and finishing treatment. The invention can detect whether the subsidence risk exists on the ground and solve the problem when sowing vegetation on the repair region, and prevent the loss caused by subsidence of the region under the uncontrollable condition.

title_en: Post-disaster collaborative repair scheduling method for urban power distribution network and traffic system
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-disaster collaborative repair scheduling method for an urban power distribution network and a traffic system, which comprises the steps of acquiring data information according to a fault element of the urban power distribution network and a damaged/interrupted road of the traffic system, establishing constraint conditions of post-disaster operation scheduling of the urban power distribution network, establishing constraint conditions of post-disaster operation scheduling of the traffic system, establishing association constraint of a repair decision of an electric power system repair team under the condition of road operation, establishing respective repair decision constraint, taking the maximized total electric power load recovery amount and road traffic flow as objective functions, establishing a collaborative repair scheduling optimization model for the urban power distribution network and the traffic system after disaster, and solving the acquired data information as input parameters of the collaborative repair scheduling optimization model to acquire a repair scheduling scheme. The invention considers the influence of the dynamic change of the road state of the traffic system on the rush-repair decision of the power system, improves the post-disaster recovery efficiency of the power distribution network and the traffic system, and reduces the economic loss caused by power reduction.

title_en: Dynamic wetland ecological restoration monitoring method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic monitoring method for wetland ecological restoration based on deep learning, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration and comprises the following steps of acquiring multisource wetland ecological sensor data and remote sensing image streams in real time, constructing a space-time fusion data cube, extracting ecological feature tensors, carrying out degradation mode analysis on the ecological feature tensors to generate an ecological state dynamic topological graph, calculating an ecological connectivity index, carrying out restoration demand identification based on the ecological connectivity index, positioning a degradation hot spot area through a multisystem image convolution network to generate a restoration priority area coordinate set, and constructing a full-flow technical system for intelligently optimizing a restoration scheme from ecological state dynamic perception through multisource data space-time fusion and deep learning and landscape ecology, thereby effectively solving the pain points such as data scale mismatch, degradation area positioning ambiguity, restoration path ecological suitability difference, multi-target cooperative difficulty and the like in traditional wetland restoration.

title_en: Anti-scouring grass planting system for hydro-fluctuation belt, preparation method and application thereof, and method for repairing damaged ecological system in steep slope area of hydro-fluctuation belt of lake and reservoir
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration, and particularly relates to a composite grass planting system, a preparation method and application thereof, and a restoration method of a damaged ecological system in a steep slope area of a hydro-fluctuation belt of a lake and a reservoir. The composite grass planting blanket provided by the invention mainly takes the degradable biomass material as the raw material, does not cause secondary pollution to the environment in the use process, can well improve the water retention property of the composite grass planting blanket through the layer structure design, is beneficial to vegetation growth, has good erosion resistance, and prolongs the service life of the composite grass planting blanket. When the composite grass planting blanket is used for repairing the steep slope area of the hydro-fluctuation belt of the lake and the reservoir, the steep slope area of the hydro-fluctuation belt of the lake and the reservoir is divided into a constant inundation area, a stormy wave erosion area and a slight inundation area, and different kinds of plants are planted in different areas, so that the survival rate of the plants is ensured, the water and soil loss is reduced, and the ecological repairing is effectively realized.

title_en: System for providing underground facility information using augmented reality of mobile terminal
title_ko: 증강현실을 기반으로 하는 지하매설물 정보안내시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An underground facility information guidance system based on an augmented reality is provided to enable a quick first aid according to an accident occurrence of an underground facility, a guide for contacting with a related organization and a recovery enterprise, and completion cognition of an accident post processing work. CONSTITUTION: GIS(Geographic Information System) data which represents underground facility related information is applied to image data which is generated by photographing the outside. A mobile communication terminal for an underground facility administrator receives underground facility information based on augmented reality. An underground facility management server transmits registered underground facility accident breakdown information to the mobile communication terminal for the underground facility administrator as GIS data. abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하매설물 관리자가 발생되는 지하매설물들의 사고에 따라 사고유형별 작업 우선순위의 노하우를 체득한 숙련자가 아니어도 상수도관, 하수도관, 가스관, 통신선, 전력선 등과 같이 다양한 종류의 지하매설물에서 사고발생 시 즉각적인 대처를 위한 사고유형별 작업 우선순위를 순차적으로 안내하여 주는 기능을 제공함으로써, 지하매설물의 사고발생에 따른 신속한 응급처치를 가능케 하여 주고, 다양한 종류의 지하매설물에서 사고발생 시 즉각적인 대처를 위해 순차적으로 안내되는 사고유형별 작업 우선순위에 사고가 발생된 지하매설물을 관리하는 유관기관 및 해당 복구업체의 연락처를 안내하는 기능이 추가되며, 다양한 종류의 지하매설물에서 사고발생 시 즉각적인 대처를 위해 순차적으로 안내되는 사고유형별 작업 우선순위에 지하매설물의 사고 발생 후 해당 복구업체를 통해 복구 중 또는 복구완료 등을 나타내는 지하매설물 사고관련 후처리 작업의 완료 여부를 인지할 수 있는 기능이 추가된 증강현실을 기반으로 하는 지하매설물 정보안내시스템에 관한 것으로, 외부를 촬영하여 생성된 영상데이터에 지하매설물 관련 정보를 나타내는 GIS데이터를 오버랩함으로써, 증강현실기반으로 지하매설물 정보를 제공받는 지하매설물 관리자용 이동통신단말기(100) 및 그 지하매설물 관리자용 이동통신단말기(100)에게 실시간으로 GIS데이터를 전송하여주는 지하매설물 관리서버(200)에 있어서, 상기 지하매설물 관리서버(200)는 등록된 지하매설물 사고내역정보를 상기 지하매설물 관리자용 이동통신단말기(100)로 전송하고, 상기 지하매설물 관리자용 이동통신단말기(100)에는 사고유형별 작업 우선순위 응용프로그램이 탑재되고, 전송된 상기 지하매설물 사고내역정보에서 안내된 사고지역에서 그 탑재된 사고유형별 작업 우선순위 응용프로그램의 실행에 의해 지하매설물 관리자가 발생된 지하매설물의 사고유형별로 작업의 우선순위를 단계적으로 나타낸 사고유형별 작업처리 안내화면부를 정보표시부(130)를 통해 출력함으로써 지하매설물의 사고 유형별로 작업의 우선순위에 따라 사고작업처리를 수행할 수 있게 안내하는 시스템을 제공하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: ANSE TECHNOLOGIES CO LTD;PANGAEA21 CO LTD

title_en: Electric power distribution box for apartment house
title_ko: 공동주택 전기의 전기 분전함장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electric distribution box device for apartment house electricity which comprises: an incoming wire connection means and a withdrawal wire connection means which easily facilitate connection of an input wire and an output wire with regard to a circuit breaker of a distribution box and connect an incoming wire and a withdrawal wire to the distribution box; and an incoming wire separation means and a withdrawal wire separation means which separate the incoming wire and the withdrawal wire from the distribution box. The incoming wire and the withdrawal wire are separated from the distribution box when the distribution box is overheated or a fire occurs in the distribution box so as to prevent the fire of the distribution box from being spread through the incoming wire and the withdrawal wire, thereby minimizing damage due to the fire and quickly performing restoration of incoming and distribution systems.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동주택 전기의 전기 분전함장치에 관한 것으로, 분전함의 차단기에 대한 입력전선 및 출력전선의 접속이 용이하도록 함과 아울러 인입전선과 인출전선을 분전함에 접속시키는 인입전선접속수단과 인출전선접속수단 및, 인입전선과 인출전선을 분전함으로부터 탈락시키는 인입전선탈락수단과 인출전선탈락수단을 구비함으로써 분전함에 과열되거나 화재가 발생하였을 때 인입전선과 인출전선이 분전함으로부터 탈락하도록 함으로써 분전함의 화재가 인입전선과 인출전선을 통해 확산되는 것을 방지하여, 화재로 인한 피해를 최소화하고, 인입 및 분전계통의 복구를 신속하게 수행할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Power connection control system and method
abstract_en: For each of consumers, a connection control apparatus is provided that includes an opening/closing device capable of connecting or disconnecting an electric power system and a consumer, that, when a power outage occurs in the electric power system, disconnects the electric power system and the consumer from each other by the opening/closing device at a command from an outage management apparatus or the like, and that connects the electric power system and the consumer to each other by the opening/closing device upon receiving a command from the outage management apparatus or the like at the time of restoration from the power outage. A power supply control apparatus supplies electric power from energy provision equipment to electrical appliances during a power outage in the electric power system.

title_en: Mine ecological restoration system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an ecological remediation technical field specifically is a mine ecological remediation system, including the mine hillside, the surface of mine hillside laid the non-woven fabrics, the surface of non-woven fabrics be provided with earial drainage mechanism, earial drainage mechanism including earial drainage guide cell body, filter cartridge, interception frame, first pipeline, second pipeline, mounting bracket, installation through-hole, fixing bolt and drainage way. The utility model has the advantages that: through being provided with the earial drainage mechanism, the setting of interception frame equidistance, it is internal to flow into the earial drainage guiding groove after the filter cartridge coarse filtration with the rainwater of interception, collect downwards at last along earial drainage guiding groove body and flow in the drainage, can prevent like this that the rainwater from gathering at mine layer surface and condensing into the thigh and erode mine layer surface, prevent the massif landslide like this, further reduce harm, because the drainage of non-woven fabrics, still be favorable to keeping mine layer earth's surface water content, do benefit to vegetation, prevent that dust from flying upward, the device's practicality has been improved greatly.
assignees: HENAN FUYAN ECOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for preventing spontaneous combustion of coal seam of stopping line of strip mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preventing spontaneous combustion of a coal seam of a stopping line of a strip mine. The method is suitable for preventing and treating a spontaneous combustion disaster of the stopping line of the strip mine. Firstly, leveling or sloping treatment is conducted on coal at the stopping line, a relatively gentle working surface is formed, and a mechanical method or an oriented blasting method is used for conducting stripping, so that loose coal and redundant float coal of an outcrop coal surface are removed; then a temperature sensing controlled release type coal spontaneous combustion chemical inhibitor is sprayed on the outcrop coal surface subjected to stripping; furthermore, a coal seam outcrop subjected to inhibitor treatment is filled and blocked with a high-water quick coagulating blocking material; afterward, the upper side of crop coal of the stopping line is covered with a finely ground coverage material, and the finely ground coverage material is flattened and compacted to form a material covering layer; and finally, the material covering layer is covered with soil, and soil conditions are provided for later afforestation and ecological restoration. The method can be used for effectively preventing the later spontaneous combustion disaster of the crop coal of the stopping line, provides a base for ecological restoration of a mine lot with closed pits, and has high practicality.

title_en: The method that mangrove ground suitable for afforestation is formed on grit beach
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method that mangrove ground suitable for afforestation is formed on grit beach, by determine target soil thickness, excavation and filling border determine, mechanical trench digging, implementation of banketing, banket flatten, the committed step such as artificial tidal creek construction, take engineering means increase grit beach soil to provide soil, the hydrology, elevation and the other conditions met needed for mangrove growth rapidly, the suitable for afforestation of mangrove is built so as to be formed.Practice have shown that using suitable for afforestation present invention can be implemented in grit beach formation mangrove, so as to improve afforestation success rate, Mangrove restoration region is extended, increases blue carbon, improves the ecological ragime of coastal area, lifting rocky coast is prevented and reduced natural disasters ability, promotes the sustainable development of coastal area.

title_en: Fault rate evaluation method and device for power line under typhoon disaster condition
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for evaluating the fault rate of a power line under a typhoon disaster condition, and particularly aims to obtain static information of a power grid and dynamic information of typhoon; performing space-time forecast on typhoon based on the dynamic information; and evaluating the fault rate of the power grid based on the static information and the forecasting result of the time-space forecasting to obtain the total fault rate of the power grid. By obtaining the total failure rate of the power grid under the typhoon disaster condition, objective basis can be provided for subsequent repair and power restoration.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Comprehensive energy data cleaning method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for cleaning comprehensive energy data, which comprise the following steps: screening repairable abnormal data from the comprehensive energy system; predicting repairable abnormal data by using a pre-trained wavelet neural network to obtain a predicted repair value; bringing the predicted restoration value into a pre-trained index fuzzy rule satisfaction classifier for verification to obtain a violation degree corresponding to the predicted restoration value, and taking the predicted restoration value with the violation degree smaller than a preset threshold value as a restoration value; the index fuzzy rule satisfaction classifier takes all normal data of the comprehensive energy system at the same historical moment as input and takes the violation degree of the index fuzzy rule as output to train to obtain the index fuzzy rule satisfaction classifier; the invention utilizes the fuzzy rule satisfaction classifier to detect and repair the abnormal data, can judge the data state without an accurate threshold value, and solves the problem that the comprehensive energy system can not detect and repair the abnormal data by using a definite calculation formula.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Two-stage toughness enhancement method and device for power distribution system based on structure-function coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a structure-function coupling-based two-stage toughness enhancement method and device for a power distribution system, wherein a vulnerable power distribution line list and an expected fault scene set are generated by combining the ultimate wind resistance strength of a power distribution line and a pole tower based on typhoon disaster forecast data; based on the vulnerable distribution line list and the expected fault scene set, an active loss amount of minimized line reinforcement cost and load is taken as an objective function, a two-stage toughness enhancement model of a distribution information physical system considering line reinforcement and multi-resource flexible scheduling is constructed, and under a set constraint condition, the two-stage toughness enhancement model of the distribution information physical system is solved to obtain an optimal toughness enhancement strategy of the distribution system. The invention realizes the dynamic matching of communication rush repair and power supply restoration in the fault area, and can effectively cope with the cross-domain cascading failure scene.

title_en: Mine ecological risk prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine ecological risk prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence, which are characterized in that multisource ecological monitoring data are collected through a distributed sensor network deployed in a mine area, a space-time alignment treatment is carried out to generate a space-time correlation feature set, a pre-trained ecological risk prediction model is called to predict features to generate a risk conduction mode set comprising a risk propagation path, a starting node, a propagation direction and strength, an ecological risk evolution network is constructed based on the risk conduction mode set, the topological structure and time sequence dependency relationship of risk nodes are displayed, a risk early warning instruction set comprising a risk classification result and an ecological restoration strategy is generated according to the ecological risk evolution network and is sent to an ecological management platform, so that mine ecological risks can be comprehensively and accurately predicted, effective risk early warning and ecological restoration strategies are provided, and mine ecological safety is guaranteed.
assignees: SICHUAN INST OF NUCLEAR GEOLOGICAL SURVEY

title_en: Underwater welding for restoration tubing for nuclear power generation
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To discover a crack at tubing to repair it in light water, in reference to risk of cracks occurring in a cooling pipe at a nuclear-power plant due to vibration of earthquake, and radioactivity flowing out into sea, in view of the fact that the number of cooling pipes is about 10,000; even one of them shows a crack, water contaminated with radioactivity is leaked out to sea water; and stopping of sea water pouring causes a nuclear reactor run-away to occur.SOLUTION: A synthetic silica glass incident window for feeding Nd/YAG laser beam to a steam condenser in which tubing to be repaired is stored or to an outer wall of a water steam generating unit is installed, a reflection mirror or a concave-surface mirror covered with a plurality of protective films capable of flapping in light water or water within the steam condenser and the water steam generating unit is arranged and the laser beam is applied uniformly for scanning or concentrated at a damaged location and then a laser underwater welding is carried out in real time.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Nuclear disaster-damage resisting coal thermal electric power plant and nuclear disaster-damage resisting coal thermal electric power plant of carbon dioxide gas discharge suppressed type
abstract_en: To provide a coal thermal electric power plant covered with a strong wall, allowing scram of an apparatus by stretching gamma ray detectors on the wall, provided with means allowing restoration and reconstruction in a few days after bombing.SOLUTION: A site boundary of a coal burning thermal electric power plant is enclosed with an impact protection wall, and a lot of gamma ray detectors 1 are installed on a ground surface outside the impact protection wall or on apexes. The gamma ray detectors 1 are connected to motors and fans of a coal conveyor via underground electric cables, and causes scram of the power plant when neighborhood is subjected to nuclear attack. Discharged carbon dioxide gas is removed by a carbon dioxide gas removing preheater. When carbon dioxide gas is sufficiently reduced, steam is said to have higher greenhouse effect than carbon dioxide gas. A coal burning thermal electric power generation technique is secured until then.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Photovoltaic acrylic panel for historical analysis and graphic output method thereof
title_ko: 역사해석용 태양광 아크릴 패널 및 아크릴 패널의 그래픽 출력 방법
abstract_en: According to a photovoltaic acrylic panel for historical interpretation of an embodiment, by displaying graphics combined with remnants of cultural properties outdoors and combining the displayed graphics with the remnants of cultural properties to create a completed shape of cultural properties through a photovoltaic acrylic panel for historical interpretation, a viewer can appreciate the completed shape of cultural properties. In addition, by automatically adjusting an output illuminance of the graphics according to an outdoor illuminance, the viewer can view cultural properties outdoors even in rainy weather or at night. Moreover, by automatically charging a battery of the photovoltaic acrylic panel for historical interpretation through photovoltaic power and automatically adjusting a graphic output illuminance according to a battery charge status, graphics for restoration of cultural properties can be output without manual charging of the battery and time constraints. When the viewer is recognized, graphics are output, and when no viewer objects are recognized in the surrounding area, a charging mode is executed so that the battery efficiency can be improved. The photovoltaic acrylic panel for historical interpretation comprises: a light guide plate; an LED; a control module; and a charging module.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 따른 역사해석용 태양광 아크릴패널은 야외에 있는 문화재 잔존물에 결합되는 그래픽을 디스플레이 하고, 디스플레이 된 그래픽과 문화재 잔존물을 결합하여 역사해석용 태양광 아크릴패널을 통해 완성된 문화재 형상을 생성함으로써, 관람자가 완성된 문화재 형상을 감상할 수 있도록 한다. 또한, 야외 조도에 따라 그래픽의 출력 조도를 자동 조절하여, 우천시나 야간에도 야외 문화재 관람을 가능하게 한다. 또한, 태양열을 통해 역사해석용 태양광 아크릴패널의 배터리를 자동 충전하고, 배터리 충전상태에 따라 그래픽 출력 조도를 자동 조정함으로써, 배터리의 수동 충전 및 시간 제약 없이 문화재 복원용 그래픽을 출력할 수 있도록 한다. 또한, 관람자가 인식되는 경우, 그래픽을 출력하고, 주변에 관람자 객체가 인식되지 않는 경우에는 충전모드를 실행하여 배터리 효율을 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Restoring states of real time clock devices for multiple hosts
abstract_en: A process includes, responsive to a primary power source being enabled, receiving, from a real time clock (RTC) device of a computer platform, an indication of a first time. Responsive to the primary power source being enabled, the process includes storing first data in a first non-volatile storage of the computer platform representing a snapshot of the first time and repeatedly updating the snapshot to cause the snapshot to track the first time. Responsive to the primary power source being disabled to begin a power outage, the process includes providing, by a timer of the computer platform powered by a secondary power source, a timer output that represents an accumulated time that corresponds to the power outage. The process includes restoring a state of the RTC device responsive to the primary power source being reenabled to end the power outage. The restoration includes, based on the accumulated time and the snapshot, determining a second time, and storing second data in the RTC device that represents the second time.

title_en: Ecological restoration system and method for geological disaster prevention and control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polluted water body restoration treatment, in particular to an ecological restoration system and method for geological disaster prevention and control. The ecological restoration system comprises a sedimentation tank, a first water inlet, a first biological treatment tank, a second biological treatment tank, a first disinfection tank, a second disinfection tank and a second disinfection tank, wherein a first water inlet is formed in the middle of the sedimentation tank, an overflow outlet is formed in the top of the sedimentation tank, supernatant overflowed through the overflow outlet can enter the first biological treatment tank or the second biological treatment tank under the action of a switching baffle, a first water outlet is formed in the lower portion of the first biological treatment tank, the first water outlet is connected to the first disinfection tank through a first filter tube, and a second water outlet is formed in the lower portion of the second biological treatment tank, and is connected to the second disinfection tank through a second filter tube. Can effectively remove sediment which invades the water body, reduce the contents of organic matters and pathogenic microorganisms in the water body, and further reduce the ecological environment recovery time of the polluted water body.

title_en: Railway operation and maintenance communication network optimization system integrating power grid information
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of railway operation and maintenance communication, and discloses a railway operation and maintenance communication network optimization system integrating power grid information. The system comprises a multi-source data fusion module, a communication quality assessment module, a network topology optimization module, a dynamic resource scheduling module, an abnormal collaborative processing module and a federal learning framework, wherein the multi-source data fusion module is used for acquiring electric power, railway and environment data to generate a space-time multi-dimensional data cube, the communication quality assessment module is used for analyzing the data by using a fuzzy logic fusion algorithm to obtain a communication link quality degradation index sequence, the network topology optimization module is used for constructing a dynamic Bayesian network model to calculate an optimal communication routing table, the dynamic resource scheduling module is used for designing a double-layer planning algorithm to realize spectrum and power joint scheduling, and the abnormal collaborative processing module is used for establishing a federal learning framework to generate a cross-domain collaborative restoration instruction set. By fusing the power grid information, the system can accurately evaluate the communication quality, optimize the network topology, reasonably schedule the resources and cooperatively process the anomalies, and effectively improve the performance and the reliability of the railway operation and maintenance communication network.

title_en: Ecological shoreline diagnosis method and system based on hydrologic-biological communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological shoreline diagnosis method and system based on hydrologic-biological communication, which are applied to the technical fields of water environment ecological restoration and shoreline health assessment. The method comprises the steps of dividing intertidal zones of a shoreline research area, generating evenly distributed sampling points in each tidal zone, extracting a plurality of indexes related to hydrology and biological connectivity, constructing a comprehensive hydrology-biological connectivity state index through principal component analysis, acquiring dyke feature data of the shoreline area, carrying out correlation analysis and collinearity screening, screening key shoreline features through a random forest algorithm, constructing a mechanism connectivity index based on a circuit theory, constructing and training a Bayesian network prediction model, and carrying out connectivity state diagnosis, attribution analysis and repair scheme effect simulation on a target shoreline section by utilizing the Bayesian network prediction model. The invention changes from static element evaluation to dynamic ecological process diagnosis by coupling hydrologic and biological connectivity, and accurately locates dominant factors.

title_en: Dynamic suspension of network operations by root for improved power outage recovery in low power and lossy network
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a method comprises: detecting, by a root network device in a low power and lossy network (LLN) operating in a downward-routing mode, an outage among at least a substantial number of LLN devices in the LLN; initiating, by the root network device, a dynamic suspension of network operations in the LLN during the outage, including causing existing Internet Protocol (IP) addresses of all the LLN devices to be maintained during the outage, and causing all the LLN devices to limit transmissions to Power Outage Notification (PON) messages, Power Restoration Notification (PRN) messages, or minimal-bandwidth data packets, based on the root network device switching the LLN from the downward-routing mode to a collection-only mode; and selectively restoring, by the root network device, the LLN to the downward-routing mode in response to detecting PRN messages from at least substantially all the substantial number of LLN devices.

title_en: A kind of non-river mouth suitable for afforestation Muddy Bottoms Tideland resources arbor disappears the structure in unrestrained forest belt and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of non-river mouth suitable for afforestation Muddy Bottoms Tideland resources arbor to disappear the structure in unrestrained forest belt and construction method, belong to technical field of agricultural cultivation, comprise the following steps: A, artificial ditching, fetch earth and raise ground as pier, B, plantation arbor container seedling, wholely, plantation mangrove forest, D, hands over arbor mangrove forest growing area is mixed for C, machinery, E, ditch cleaning, to foster, promote tree growth and beach alluvial; The present invention makes the arbor species such as horsetail beefwood energy normal growth on non-coastal river mouth Muddy Bottoms Tideland resources wetland suitable for afforestation, and improve shelter forest survival rate, make non-mud wetland suitable for afforestation to be built the unrestrained forest belt that disappears to succeed enforcement, be conducive to the restoration and reconstitution of the non-mud wetland ecosystem suitable for afforestation, being conducive to resisting the major natural disasters such as coastal area typhoon, Hong Chao, will positive effect being played to advancing China's marine economy development & construction.
assignees: TAIZHOU CITY JIAOJIANG DISTR FORESTRY SPECIALTY MASTER STATION

title_en: Adopt the Ecosystem restoration system in sand riverbed
abstract_en: Adopt the Ecosystem restoration system in sand riverbed, including riverbed prosthetic device and server, the riverbed prosthetic device includes connecting plate, the connecting plate includes connection ring flat-plate and lengthened plate, the connection ring flat-plate is connected with each other, the cross section of composition is closed figures, and the lengthened plate is connect with the connection ring board bottom end edge edge, for increasing the height of the riverbed prosthetic device；The connecting plate includes planting unit, and the planting unit is used to place the vegetable seeds for repairing riverbed；The server is used to store bed configuration data, calculates height and quantity that riverbed prosthetic device needs.The Ecosystem restoration system provided by the invention for adopting sand riverbed can adjust the height of riverbed prosthetic device according to riverbed situation; riverbed is tentatively fixed; and the growth of the root system by plant; prevent the landslide in riverbed; guarantee flood control results; aquatic life habitat is protected, to provide water body self-purification ability.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Gridding power failure analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a gridding power failure analysis method and a gridding power failure analysis system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining power failure related information, and determining whether a power failure event is a fault power failure or not according to the power failure event information; acquiring emergency repair process information of the power failure event, wherein the emergency repair process information at least comprises a power restoration state, historical position information and real-time position information of emergency repair personnel or emergency repair vehicles; determining an emergency repair track in the emergency repair process according to the historical coordinate information, and playing back and displaying the emergency repair track and the real-time position information on a map; determining the power failure user information influenced by the power failure event according to the power failure event information; determining corresponding grid information according to the power failure user information; and acquiring corresponding map grid information according to the grid information, and displaying the grid information on a map according to the map grid information. The invention well meets the service requirements of monitoring management personnel on monitoring the power failure emergency repair and checking the emergency repair track.

title_en: System and method for emergency repair scheduling based on ubiquitous power Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for emergency repair scheduling based on ubiquitous power Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of power scheduling management; the system comprises a first terminal, a server and a position checking module, wherein the first terminal is connected with the server through the Internet; the method is based on a first terminal, the Internet and a server, and comprises the steps of S2 checking the position, and the server acquires the position information of the first terminal and generates the position information of the first terminal; the first terminal, the internet, the server, the position checking module and the like are used for improving the working efficiency of electric power rush-repair dispatching.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;XINJI CITY POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Closed tailing pond and pollution prevention and control ecological system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecosystem for closing a tailing pond and preventing and controlling pollution and a control method thereof, belonging to the technical field of mine ecological restoration. In the reclamation area, 30cm of clean soil is covered on the tailing slag, crops are planted, the reclamation of the tailing pond is realized, and the agricultural production capacity of the areas which are not suitable for cultivation is recovered. The method can recycle precipitation and irrigation water to leach the tailings, prevent the residual heavy metals in the tailings from migrating to the soil and underground water in the mining area, avoid secondary pollution and realize ecological restoration; after the system is operated, the pressure of rainfall on the side wall of the tailing pond can be relieved, and secondary disasters such as dam break, collapse and the like are reduced or avoided; low cost, low energy consumption, convenient operation and maintenance and is suitable for popularization and application.
assignees: GUANGXI BOSSCO ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration method for coal mining subsidence land in loess hilly area
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological restoration method for a coal mining subsidence area in a loess hilly area, which comprises the following steps: 1. determining an ecological restoration scheme of the coal mining subsidence land in the loess hilly area; 2. determining the depth and width of the water storage ditch; 3. determining the height of a field ridge; 4. building a terraced field; 5. setting a water storage system; 6. setting a road system; 7. setting an irrigation system; 8. and (5) ecological management. The invention aims at ecological restoration of a subsidence area, takes water and soil loss control as a starting point, proposes to treat the coal mining subsidence area by using a sponge terrace, adopts plant hedges to treat coal mining subsidence cracks, builds a novel ecological restoration mode of the loess hilly area coal mining subsidence area, realizes efficient utilization of water resources, controls water and soil loss, and improves the ecological restoration effect of the subsidence area, the capability of coping with natural disasters and the like.
assignees: SHAANXI COAL CHEMICAL IND GROUP CO LTD;UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Coastal nitrogen migration dynamic evaluation system based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coastal nitrogen migration dynamic evaluation system based on multi-source data, which relates to the technical field of water environment health evaluation, establishes a causal link based on a multi-source nitrogen data pool, identifies key driving factor nodes and a non-dominant nitrogen input path, generates a migration map, extracts a nitrogen concentration fluctuation mode and combines historical interference data to output a future migration trend map, judges a risk level according to the migration trend, matches regulation measures and outputs an ecological restoration suggestion, the invention provides a coast nitrogen migration dynamic assessment system based on multi-source data, which is characterized in that a multi-source nitrogen data pool is constructed, migration paths and key driving factors are identified through brain-like reasoning, a time, space and event three-label migration map is generated by the system, periodic modeling and trend prediction of nitrogen flux are realized, dynamic early warning and differentiated ecological intervention are supported, and compared with the prior art, the system has the advantages of accurate path identification, non-dominant input discrimination, strong prediction capability and perfect visual interaction.

title_en: Ecological restoration evaluation method and device based on evolution toughness
abstract_en: The application discloses an ecological restoration evaluation method and device based on evolution toughness, and relates to the technical field of ecological restoration evaluation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining ecological restoration evaluation basic data of a target area, wherein the ecological restoration evaluation basic data comprises ecological disaster restoration data, ecological environment long-term monitoring data and ecological space pattern data; respectively calculating an ecological toughness index, an ecological environment evolution index and an ecological space pattern index, then constructing an evolution toughness evaluation model by adopting a network analysis method, and finally integrating the mutual influence among element clusters by adopting a super matrix weighting algorithm based on the evolution toughness evaluation model to output an evolution ecological toughness evaluation result. The application can integrate complex and various evaluation indexes, comprehensively evaluate ecological restoration from longer time scale and larger space scale, and improve the accuracy of ecological restoration evaluation.
assignees: CHINESE ACAD OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES;BEIJING CITY UNIV

title_en: Automatic operation and maintenance method and system suitable for closed system
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic operation and maintenance method and system suitable for a closed system. The method aims to solve the technical problem that the traditional operation and maintenance scheme is difficult to apply due to network isolation and sample scarcity in closed environments such as finance, energy sources and the like. The method comprises the steps of generating unique and traceable migration identifications for all operation and maintenance data, models and reasoning results through a data and migration treatment module, quantitatively calculating migration scores between a source domain and a target domain through a migration evaluation module, dynamically selecting an optimal model migration strategy according to the migration scores to achieve efficient self-adaptation of the models, executing closed-loop operation and maintenance through a multi-agent cooperation system comprising detection, diagnosis and restoration agents, and achieving self-learning and self-optimization of the system through small sample active learning and knowledge base evolution mechanisms. The invention realizes the rapid construction, continuous evolution and whole process traceability of the artificial intelligence operation and maintenance capability in the closed system, and has remarkable innovation and industrial application value.

title_en: Intelligent prediction and restoration decision method and system for soil erosion
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent prediction and restoration decision method and system for soil erosion, which relate to the technical field of ecological environment monitoring and restoration and comprise the steps of realizing dynamic updating and refinement of land utilization classification data by constructing a multi-source data space-time coupled database; the method comprises the steps of constructing a soil erosion prediction model based on a neural network model and based on classification guidance of land use, combining sensor data time correction and trend fusion analysis, improving erosion strength prediction accuracy, and simultaneously, constructing a land use type-erosion risk-repair strategy knowledge base, generating a differential repair scheme and carrying out risk early warning. According to the application, through multi-source data fusion and intelligent model application, the full-flow management from dynamic prediction to accurate restoration of soil erosion is realized, the error rate of a restoration scheme is reduced, and scientific support is provided for a ecological restoration decision.
assignees: KUNMING COMPREHENSIVE SURVEY CENTER CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY

title_en: Earthquake emergency control device for elevator
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To prevent the occurrence of such an accident that a car contacts tower equipment when restoring an elevator into a normal operation with automatic inspecting operation after earthquake, and surely prevent secondary disaster such as confinement or damage to the car or the tower equipment after restoration.  <P>SOLUTION: During earthquake, the car is stopped at the nearest floor to be out of service depending on the intensity and the quaking condition of the earthquake. When troubles are not detected with subsequent automatic inspecting operation, temporarily restoring operation is performed. This earthquake emergency operation device comprises a plurality of offset load detecting devices 4 installed on the floor of the car, and an offset load detecting device 16 for detecting the condition of offset load on the car from the output of the plurality of offset load detecting devices. When detecting the condition of offset load on the car during temporarily restoring operation, the operation of the elevator is stopped until the condition of offset load is resolved.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Construction method for replacing damaged railway viaduct column
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a construction method for replacing a damaged railway viaduct column, which enables a space under a viaduct to be widened concurrently with the replacement of the railway viaduct column damaged by an earthquake disaster and the like.SOLUTION: In a construction method for replacing a damaged railway viaduct column, concrete in plastic hinge sections 2 and 2' of a damaged existing railway viaduct column 1 is chipped; buckled axial reinforcements 3 and 3' are exposed; the existing railway viaduct column 1 is removed except for buckled axial reinforcements 5 and 5'; treatment of restoration from a buckled state is applied to the buckled axial reinforcements 5 and 5'; joints 7 and 7' make a new axial reinforcement 6 connected to the axial reinforcements undergone the treatment of restoration from the buckled state; protective caps 8 and 8' for the plastic hinge sections are installed; the new axial reinforcement 6 is wound with a hoop tie 9; and concrete 10 is placed on the axial reinforcement 6 wound with the hoop tie 9, and thus, the damaged existing railway viaduct column is replaced by the new railway viaduct column.

title_en: The penetration gutters mounted in the center that trench cover and removable filter cartridge consisting of filter fabric and fine holes
title_ko: 트랜치 뚜껑 및 여과포와 미세공으로 구성된 탈착형 여과카트리지가 중심부에 장착된 침투측구
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a penetration gutter having a detachable filter cartridge at the center. According to the present invention, the penetration gutter having the detachable filter cartridge at the center can prevent a flooding disaster and can improve a function of removing rainwater by expecting effect of newly constructing a rainwater pipe conduit of a same area as an inner area of the gutter on a road in a case that the penetration gutter is installed on an L-shaped gutter section of the road. The various kinds of components on the road corresponding to a nonpoint pollution source is contained in a filter fabric included in the detachable filter cartridge of the center and is periodically treated by being replaced (expected replacement period of about three years or greater). So, the various kinds of the components are not deposited on the rainwater pipe conduit and a street inlet. Therefore, the penetration gutter prevents contamination of a river and reduces dredging costs of deposits. Also, as the rainwater of good quality treated by the filter cartridge of the center is continuously penetrated into soil through a soil penetration hole installed on the bottom of the penetration gutter, the penetration gutter contains underground water. The penetration gutter prevents a sinkhole generated due to a lack of the underground water and improves a water circulation rate deteriorated by an impermeable layer of a city. In other words, the penetration gutter can obtain the appearance of the road by having a simple design and can prevent environmental contamination by having a filtering function and a foreign substance separating function. Also, the penetration gutter is an only environmentally friendly facility which can be directly installed on the road as an economical facility capable of helping restoration of water circulation and disaster prevention by storage and penetration of the rainwater.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른 탈착형 여과카트리지가 중심부에 장착된 침투측구는, 도로 의 L형 측구구간에 설치될 경우에는 측구의 내부면적과 동일한 면적의 우수관거를 도로에 신설하는 효과를 기대할 수 있어 우수배제기능 향상과 침수재해 예방이 가능하며, 비점오염원에 해당하는 도로 상의 각종 오염물이 중심부 탈착식 여과카트리지안에 포함된 여과포에 담겨 정기적으로 교체(예상 교체주기 약 3년 이상)되어 처리되므로 빗물받이 및 우수관거에 퇴적되지 않아 하천오염 예방 및 퇴적물 준설비용이 절감되어 진다. 
또한 중심부 여과카트리지에 의해 처리된 양질의 빗물이 침투측구 바닥에 설치된 토양침투홀을 통해 지속적으로 토양침투되므로 지하수를 함양하고, 지하수 고갈로 발생하는 싱크홀 등을 예방하며, 도시의 불투수층에 의해 악화된 물순환율을 향상시키는 효과가 있다. 
즉, 본 발명의 침투측구는 단순한 디자인에 의해 도로의 미관을 확보하는 것이 가능하고, 여과 및 이물질분리기능으로 환경오염을 예방할 수 있으며, 빗물의 저류 및 침투로 재해예방과 물순환회복에 도움을 줄 수 있는 경제적인 시설로 도로상에 직접적으로 설치할 수 있는 유일한 친환경시설이다.

title_en: System and Method for Providing Power Distribution System Information
abstract_en: A system, method and computer program product for processing utility data of a power grid is provided. In one embodiment, the system includes a datamart comprised of a plurality of physical databases storing utility data, a plurality of applications comprising an automated meter application configured to process power usage data from a plurality of automated meters, a power outage application configured to identify a location of a power outage, and a power restoration application configured to identify a location of a power restoration. The system may include an analysis engine comprising a plurality of analysis objects with each analysis object configured to process data to provide a specific analysis, wherein said analysis engine is accessible via one or more of the plurality of applications, and the system may include a report module configured to receive an output from the analysis engine and to output a report. The plurality of applications may also include a fault analysis application, a transformer analysis application, a theft detection application, a power flow application, a substation automation application, a load shed application and others.

title_en: Power outage and restoration notification in an advanced metering infrastructure network
abstract_en: A method and system are provided to transmit a meter power status. The method includes recognizing a power status change at a meter. The method includes, if the meter is scheduled to transmit first, transmitting a notification message to at least one neighboring meter towards a mesh gate, wherein the notification message includes a power status indicator and a meter identifier. The method includes, if the meter is not scheduled to transmit first, waiting a predetermined time period to receive a notification message from at least one neighboring meter. The method includes, responsive to receiving a notification message, adding a meter identifier to the received notification message before retransmitting the modified notification message to at least one neighboring meter. The method includes retransmitting the notification message.

title_en: Methods and systems for detection and notification of power outages and power quality
abstract_en: Described herein are methods and systems for detection and notification of electrical power outages and power quality. A sensor coupled to a circuit transmits a keepalive packet to a server. The sensor detects an input signal generated by electrical activity. The sensor generates an output signal based upon the input signal. The sensor monitors the output signal. During a clock cycle, the sensor determines whether a rising edge occurred and transmits a fault packet to the server when the rising edge occurred prior to a predetermined clock value or when no rising edge occurred. The server receives the fault packet from the sensor and listens for keepalive packets. The server transmits a power outage notification when no keepalive packets are received for at least a defined time period after the fault packet is received. The server transmits a power restoration notification when one or more keepalive packets are subsequently received.

title_en: Heuristic power distribution network black start reconstruction method based on tabu search
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heuristic black start reconstruction method of a power distribution network based on tabu search. The method comprises the following steps: s1, inputting original data; s2, determining relevant parameters of an optimization model according to engineering experience and actual needs; s3, establishing a black start reconstruction model of the power distribution network; s4, solving a black start reconstruction model of the power distribution network by adopting a heuristic method of tabu search to obtain a solution to be determined; s5, performing power flow verification on the recovery action corresponding to the solution to be determined, if the safety constraint is not met, adding a constraint condition in the power distribution network black start reconstruction model, setting the solution to be determined as an infeasible solution, removing the solution to be determined which does not pass the power flow verification, turning to the step 4, and re-optimizing; and S6, outputting a recovery action corresponding to the undetermined solution passing through the power flow verification. According to the method, the recovery sequence of the power-losing nodes is determined and the recovery path is optimized through heuristic black-start reconstruction of the power distribution network based on tabu search, so that the power failure loss is reduced, and the important load recovery time is shortened.

title_en: Method and system for prioritizing critical data object storage
abstract_en: A method and system for prioritizing key data object restoration during a restore operation. In particular, the methods and systems disclosed herein require reordering data objects in accordance with a sequential order based on closest criticality, waiting to be read from backup storage, and thus queuing in one or more data object queues. The order based on closest criticality can be derived by calculating a correction weight based Euclidean distance between adjacent pairs of data objects queued in any given data object queue. In addition, the calculated euclidean distance based on the correction weight incorporates a data criticality factor associated with the pair of adjacent data objects. By reordering the data objects in a sequential order based on closest criticality, the critical data objects can be restored first, thereby avoiding possible loss of critical data when a disaster occurs during a restoration operation.

title_en: Power grid emergency repair and restoration scheduling cooperative decision method and system under natural disaster
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system recovery decision-making, and provides a cooperative decision-making method and a cooperative decision-making system for power grid emergency repair and recovery scheduling under natural disasters, wherein the method considers the influence of equipment damage on the recovery scheduling, adjusts the emergency repair scheme on line, completes the repair of a power transmission line, a communication link and a transformer substation load outgoing line, effectively processes the mutual influence between the emergency repair and the recovery scheduling, and realizes the effective cooperation between the emergency repair and the recovery scheduling; the Monte Carlo tree search and the mathematical planning method are combined, so that emergency repair and scheduling recovery decisions can be completed in effective time, and the decision is ensured to be realized on line.

title_en: Degraded grassland ecological restoration method and system based on ecological water requirements inside and outside river and lake
abstract_en: The invention discloses a degraded grassland ecological restoration method and system based on ecological water requirements inside and outside a river and a lake, which comprises the steps of carrying out field investigation, analyzing main characteristics of the degraded grassland to carry out degradation grade region division, wherein the main characteristics comprise vegetation coverage, species diversity index and soil volume weight, carrying out ecological unit meshing division based on terrain adaptation, constructing a multi-objective function and constraint condition for the degraded grassland ecological restoration based on the ecological water requirements inside and outside the river and lake according to water resource allocation, grassland restoration, grazing management and economic benefit, combining specific grassland degradation grades of a degraded area on the basis of the ecological water requirements inside and outside the river and lake, and carrying out restoration priority sorting, dynamic adjustment strategy and dynamic water resource adjustment according to the multi-objective function and constraint condition to obtain an optimal degraded grassland ecological restoration scheme.

title_en: Local prestressing force assembled power consumption beam column node
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a local prestressing force assembled power consumption beam column node, including precast concrete post, precast concrete roof beam, removable power consumption stick, prestressing tendons, the ground tackle of trading, prestressing tendons pore and bracket are reserved at node area to the precast concrete post, the precast concrete roof beam is pretensioned prestressed concrete girder, is equipped with the prestressing tendons pore in the middle of the beam -ends cross -section, and the beam -ends lower part is equipped with the tongue -and -groove, the precast concrete roof beam is shelved on the bracket, fixed through the crimping of local posttension prestressing tendons, the upper surface is cast in situ concrete in the floor height, removable trade the power consumption stick install in surface about the precast concrete roof beam, quantity, specification and effect design according to difference antidetonation grade opportunity, when lieing in the lower surface, pass the preformed hole of bracket exposes the part through the mortar cladding. The utility model provides the high restorability of precast concrete frame under the earthquake has strengthened the power consumption ability, realizes hierarchical shock attenuation power consumption, is convenient for shake the back restoration.

title_en: Carbon fiber reinforced lattice beam structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a carbon fiber reinforced lattice beam structure, which comprises a lattice beam arranged on a sliding belt on a sliding bed, wherein the lattice beam is connected with an anchoring section embedded in the sliding bed through anchor cable traction, a sliding body is stacked between the lattice beam and the sliding bed, and carbon fiber cloth is uniformly pasted on the tensile surface of the lattice beam; after the lattice beam is reinforced by the carbon fiber cloth, the bending resistance of the lattice beam is obviously improved. Therefore, the utility model discloses a landslide prevention and cure lattice girder engineering has provided one set of reasonable effectual restoration, reinforcement method. The method has the advantages of simple and convenient construction, short construction period, small disturbance to the landslide body, flexible and changeable construction range, low cost and the like, prolongs the service life of the lattice beam engineering, ensures the repairing effect of the damaged lattice beam, and ensures the life and property safety of people within the disaster influence range.
assignees: INST OF EXPLOR TECH OF CHINESE ACAD OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Distribution network device status evaluating system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network device status evaluating system which comprises a device status information acquisition module, a device status information ETL module, an intelligent device status evaluation module, a device status management module, a repair schedule optimization module, a knowledge base module and a dynamic presentation module, wherein the device status information acquisition module uses a monitoring device to obtain various types of status information of a distribution network device; the device status information ETL module screens and processes device status information data to form data which can be used by the device status evaluation module; the intelligent device status evaluation module diagnoses the device status in accordance with the various types of status information of the distribution network device; the device status management module judges whether the distribution device needs to repaired in accordance with the information of the intelligent device status evaluation module; the repair schedule optimization module comprehensively optimizes a repair schedule based on repair time and load transfer paths; and the knowledge base module stores diagnosis algorithm configuration information and diagnosis results of the intelligent device status evaluation module. The distribution network device status evaluating system can provide the optimized device repair schedule, save the device repair cost and resources, and improve the operation and maintenance level and working efficiency of the distribution network system.
assignees: HUAI AN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;JIANGSU FANGTIAN POWER TECH CO

title_en: Power grid disaster real-time regulating and control device and method based on intuition fuzzy rough set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid disaster real-time regulating and control device and method based on an intuition fuzzy rough set. The method includes the steps that historical disaster data in a database unit are called; the collected historical disaster data are reduced through the method based on the intuition fuzzy rough set, and then disaster grade evaluation rules of a power grid are obtained; disaster data of the power grid are collected in real time, and the current disaster grade of the power grid is determined according to the formed historical disaster grade evaluation rules; the data which are evaluated in real time are updated to a historical database and used for addition and modification of a power grid disaster knowledge base; power grid disaster emergency responses are conducted, namely, corresponding emergency restoration measures are taken according to different disaster grades to regulate and control the power grid. According to the system and method, the situation that the data size used in the power grid disaster evaluation process has fuzziness, randomness, uncertainty, redundancy and other characteristics is taken into account, the defect that internal relations and potential relations of data attributes can not be acquired through a traditional probability theory and other method is successfully overcome by the utilization of the method based on the intuition fuzzy rough set, and evaluation accuracy is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;SHENYANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV NORTHEASTERN

title_en: Regional power stability analysis and evaluation method based on power outage and restoration event data monitoring
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of regional power stability analysis, and particularly discloses a regional power stability analysis and evaluation method based on power outage and restoration event data monitoring, which comprises the following steps: the application analyzes the meteorological data of the attribution area of each path through analyzing and calculating the stability coefficient of the power transmission structure of the appointed area, and can provide scientific and reasonable support basis for monitoring the power failure event data, reflect the comprehensive influence condition of the power failure event, analyze and calculate the power failure influence index of the appointed area through the power failure data of the appointed area, combine the power load and the electric quantity, improve the multi-dimensionality of monitoring the power failure event data and the accuracy of the data analysis, and simultaneously be beneficial to providing guarantee for the electric energy stable use requirement of the area.
assignees: ANHUI FANGNENG ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD FEIXI COUNTY POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD HEFEI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Forest tree network system and forest resource monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest tree network system and a forest resource monitoring method. According to the invention, by designing and constructing the forest Internet of things monitoring station, the high-frequency monitoring of the forest growth condition in the forest ecological system can be realized, important index data such as forest growth quantity, consumption, withering loss, forest accumulation in unit area, forest biomass in unit area and the like are directly produced, the regulation, scheduling, control and protection of the forest ecological system are developed, the forest resource investigation precision and quality are improved, the forest resource investigation monitoring cost and risk are reduced, and the forest ecological system protection and restoration precision and timeliness are enhanced.
assignees: SICHUAN FORESTRY AND GRASSLAND INVESTIG AND PLANNING INSTITUTE SICHUAN FORESTRY AND GRASSLAND ECOLOG

title_en: Ecological flow guaranteeing method based on runoff prediction and replenishment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological flow guaranteeing method based on runoff prediction and replenishment. Collecting data such as weather and hydrology of the Tonkin river basin, constructing and verifying SWAT model simulation runoff, and analyzing extended precipitation based on an R/S method and a wavelet method. And constructing a surface water and underground water coupling model, and predicting the quantity, level and quality of underground water. After the water resource supply and demand balance analysis is carried out, ecological flow guarantee measures are formulated, including optimizing configuration of water resources, strengthening management, ecological water supplementing, water environment treatment, ecological restoration engineering development and the like. The main body and the progress of implementation of measures are clear, the evaluation effect of a monitoring system is established, and the ecological flow is guaranteed by adjusting and optimizing according to the result, so that the sustainable utilization of the water resources of the river basin and the ecological environment protection are realized, the remarkable social, economic and environmental benefits are achieved, and a scientific and effective method is provided for water resource management.
assignees: HUADIAN NINGDE ELECTRIC POWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Railway operation and maintenance communication network optimization system integrating power grid information
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of railway operation and maintenance communication, and discloses a railway operation and maintenance communication network optimization system integrating power grid information. The system comprises a multi-source data fusion module, a communication quality assessment module, a network topology optimization module, a dynamic resource scheduling module, an abnormal collaborative processing module and a federal learning framework, wherein the multi-source data fusion module is used for acquiring electric power, railway and environment data to generate a space-time multi-dimensional data cube, the communication quality assessment module is used for analyzing the data by using a fuzzy logic fusion algorithm to obtain a communication link quality degradation index sequence, the network topology optimization module is used for constructing a dynamic Bayesian network model to calculate an optimal communication routing table, the dynamic resource scheduling module is used for designing a double-layer planning algorithm to realize spectrum and power joint scheduling, and the abnormal collaborative processing module is used for establishing a federal learning framework to generate a cross-domain collaborative restoration instruction set. By fusing the power grid information, the system can accurately evaluate the communication quality, optimize the network topology, reasonably schedule the resources and cooperatively process the anomalies, and effectively improve the performance and the reliability of the railway operation and maintenance communication network.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 21ST BUREAU GROUP OPERATION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Method for restoring green ecology of mine goaf
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for restoring green ecology in a mine goaf, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration and comprises the steps of firstly carrying out rock surface treatment, cleaning the exposed rock surface of a mine, preventing broken stone from falling during construction, then carrying out restoring green planting, carrying out seedling transplanting on the prepared rock surface, and then carrying out vegetation maintenance, and carrying out maintenance on planted seedlings and sown grass seeds, so that the vegetation can root and sprout. According to the invention, through vegetation reconstruction and ecological restoration, the surface coverage is quickly recovered, water and soil loss is reduced, geological disaster risks such as landslide and debris flow are effectively restrained, life and property safety of mining areas and surrounding residents are prevented from being threatened, super-accumulated plants can be utilized to purify heavy metal pollution of soil, vegetation is matched for adsorbing dust and adjusting microclimate, air quality and ecological environment of the areas are obviously improved, and meanwhile, the mining areas after being re-greened can be transformed into ecological parks, carbon-sink forests or agricultural bases, so that the land value is improved.

title_en: Unified optimization method for physical toughness and operation configuration of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a unified optimization method for physical toughness and operation configuration of an electric power system, which comprises the following steps of establishing a double-layer computing framework comprising an upper-layer electric network physical system model and a lower-layer energy community model, generating a random scene set and a robust uncertainty set, executing a numerical optimization process under a two-stage random-robust hybrid optimization framework, determining physical topology reinforcing parameters in a long-term planning stage, determining physical repair scheduling parameters in a short-term operation stage, carrying out mathematical coupling on the two stages through technical constraint, and converging and solving the unified optimization process. According to the invention, when a planning decision of long-term physical topology reinforcement is made, a power grid operator can consider physical toughness constraint and economic cost of coupling short-term emergency repair scheduling under worst-case attack, so that an engineering decision scheme with the highest physical security level and optimal economic benefit is output.

title_en: Elevator maintenance management apparatus
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To support an appropriate restoration operation of an elevator by a maintenance staff when a disaster occurs.  <P>SOLUTION: When a disaster information reception unit 14 of a center apparatus 2 in a monitor center receives disaster information indicating the occurrence of earthquake, an arithmetic unit 16 updates a priority parameter on a priority table stored in a priority information storing unit 31 of a main memory device 12 based on a current position of a maintenance staff at a predetermined time interval when and after the disaster occurs. A priority update unit 17 updates priority on the priority table based on an updated priority parameter. An assignment processing unit 19 selects an elevator maintained for restoration by the maintenance staff based on the distance between the maintenance staff current position information and the address of each building, and the priority of a property on the priority table. A notification processing unit 21 sends the instruction information of the maintenance operation of the selected elevator to a mobile communication terminal of the target maintenance staff.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Plug receptacle
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a plug receptacle capable of limiting the power supply to electric equipment connected thereto and capable of inhibiting a secondary disaster from happening when power is restored.  <P>SOLUTION: A power management outlet 10 includes: a power restoration detection part 12 that detects the arrival of an AC current from a commercial power supply by power restoration from a power-off state; a switch part 13 that opens and closes an electrical path between the commercial power supply and an insertion port 11; and a control part 15 that opens the switch part 13 based on a predetermined setting.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Method and system for outage restoration
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To efficiently perform management of electric power grid including scheduling of switching and maintenance process at power outage.SOLUTION: A system for maintenance and operation of electric grid includes a work crew team locator configured to receive a location of a work crew team based on a location of a work vehicle associated with the work crew team, a work crew team management subsystem configured to receive locations of some of a plurality of the work crew teams from the work crew team locator, and an asset management subsystem configured to determine repair requirements for electric grid assets and repair times associated with the determined repair requirements. The system also includes an outage management subsystem that determines occurrence of power outage by using a phone to indicate an obstacle/notify a fault; and a restoration optimizer configured to determine a qualified crew to execute the change request, tools and equipment required to achieve the change request, and a capable work crew team including work crew team location determined to satisfy a response timing requirement in order to respond to a grid configuration change request, and initiate crew instructions specified in work requirements and actions for the work crew team to fulfill the grid configuration change request.

title_en: Device for manually recovering from power outage
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an electrical machine capable of manually energizing the circuit without automatically energizing the circuit at a time of energizing to recover the circuit after a power outage.SOLUTION: In the event of a power outage due to an earthquake or the like inside a circuit of a building electrical equipment, or in a circuit of an intermediate interposing plug or a secondary side electric appliance at a socket outlet of a light system outlet, a power supply circuit is shut off, and when the power is restored after the power outage, it is kept in the cutoff state, after checking the state of the secondary side electric appliance, by manually pushing the button 3, restoration energization of the secondary side power supply system is enabled.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Data processing system, data processor, portable terminal device, and program
abstract_en: To provide a sales data processing system, a sales data processor, a portable terminal device, and a program that can continue coordinated operation during a power outage period.SOLUTION: A sales data processing system includes: a sales data processor that can continue to operate with a standby power supply in the event of an external power outage and that processes sales data for commercial transactions; and a portable terminal device that can be operated by an internal power supply and that makes a first communication connection with the sales data processor via a predetermined relay communication device. The sales data processor and the portable terminal device initiate a second communication connection by direct wireless communication without intervention of the relay communication device when the first communication connection is disconnected due to the cessation of external power supply to the relay communication device, and resumes the first communication connection via the relay communication device when the sales data processor detects the restoration of power supply after the start of the second communication connection.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: The method that a kind of iron and steel enterprise cost of electricity-generating optimizes
