abstract_en: The method that a kind of iron and steel enterprise cost of electricity-generating optimizes, belongs to iron and steel enterprise's integrated power-saving technical field.Step comprises determining that T dispatching cycle needing to carry out cost of electricity-generating optimization, obtains unit generation cost optimization parameter；Obtain the network section for the establishment of generation schedule a few days ago；Determine consider in the cycle coal gas mix burning in the case of generating set fuel cost；The Optimal Operation Model with the minimum target of total system cost of electricity-generating is set up according to enterprise's units consumption, outer purchases strategies and outer power transmission income practical situation；Obtain enterprise's self generating sets according to Optimization Solution to exert oneself, outer purchase of electricity, send the result etc. of electricity outside.Advantage is, can meet production load needs, generating set exert oneself, the task such as line transmission capacity, ensure the safe and stable operation of utility power grid simultaneously, in conjunction with load prediction curve, produce and repair schedule, optimize and revise self power generation further to exert oneself, and self power generation and the proportionate relationship of outer power purchase, make enterprise's cost of electricity-generating minimum.

title_en: Power outage and restoration detection for multiple meter nodes in a mesh network
abstract_en: A system for detecting a power state change (such as a power outage or a power restoration) at a multi-meter endpoint associated with a power distribution network is provided. For example, a multi-meter endpoint associated with a power distribution network may be configured to detect a power state change event, such as a power outage event or a power restoration event, occurring at the endpoint. Based on the type of event, the communication module of the multi-meter node identifies the meters contained in the multi-meter node that are affected by the event, such as meters that become unpowered due to a power outage event or meters that become powered due to a power restoration event. The communication module generates a consolidated power state change message for the affected meter and transmits the message to the headend system over the mesh network.

title_en: Self-service big data multistage closed loop restoration method and device for power enterprise
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-service big data multistage closed loop repairing method for a power enterprise, which comprises the following steps: the data acquisition is carried out in a data acquisition mode according to time intervals, abnormal data identification is carried out by adopting a threshold value method, the captured abnormal data is subjected to partition repair, so that the repair work of the abnormal data is converted into a multi-stage closed loop mode, and the system performance of repairing various data is realized. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the abnormal data identification module is optimized, a data calculation threshold value is set, abnormal data identification is achieved according to a smooth estimation threshold value algorithm, the repair grade is set according to the data type in data repair according to the data partition calculation process, the multi-stage closed-loop data repair process is completed by combining the traditional data repair technology, and the data repair integrity and the data bearing capacity are improved.

title_en: Disaster information management apparatus, disaster information system, disaster information management method, disaster information management program, portable terminal, control method of portable terminal, and control program of controlling operation of portable terminal
abstract_en: To attempt to extend a providing service by allowing collection of various kinds of information and early restoration of a defective function in a disaster response infrastructure network, in a disaster information system, a disaster information management apparatus for collecting disaster information via a network includes a terminal information acquirer that acquires terminal information including the current position and identification information of a portable terminal, a need information generator that generates, from received disaster information, need information including information about a need which can be satisfied by the operation of an apparatus, and a request information generator that generates, based on the terminal information and the need information, request information for requesting the portable terminal existing within a range of a predetermined distance from the occurrence location of the need to operate the apparatus necessary for satisfying the need, and transmits the request information.

title_en: Ecological space optimization and function improvement method for river wetland
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological space optimization and function improvement method for a river wetland, and belongs to the technical field of river treatment. Determining and analyzing the space structure of the current river to obtain the area proportion occupied by different river structures; determining the flow capacity of the river and analyzing the current flood discharge capacity of the river; on the basis of the section of the river channel, taking an earthwork balance principle, flood carrying capacity and beach water flooding duration and depth as calculation bases, analyzing by using a dichotomy, respectively determining the excavation position of the river channel, the excavation depth, a vertical dredging space and a dredging volume, and optimizing a river beach wetland; and analyzing the space structure area, the proportion condition and the ecological space change of the river channel before and after optimization respectively, and evaluating the ecological space optimization scheme of the river channel. The invention optimizes and treats the cross section of the river based on the comprehensive consideration of the structure and the function of the river system, realizes the improvement of the ecological function and the environmental optimization of the river, and provides references for the restoration protection and the function improvement of the river wetland in China and the flood control and disaster reduction of the area.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Distributed backup method and system based on locking
abstract_en: The application discloses a distributed backup method and system based on locking, comprising the following steps: the backup restoration tool is arranged in an installation package of a database in advance and deployed to each node along with the database; during the commit phase, configuring a database kernel to add a shared lock to the backup transaction commit phase of the coordinator node; in the backup stage, adding exclusive locks to the coordination node databases based on the current coordination node by utilizing the backup recovery tool; after each shared lock in the commit phase is released, a consistency point is created and the created consistency point is recorded into a database log. According to the embodiment of the application, the shared lock is added in the submitting stage of the backup transaction of the coordination node, and locking processing is performed in the process of creating the consistency point, so that the data of the whole distributed cluster are ensured to be accurate and consistent, and the disaster tolerance of the distributed database is improved.

title_en: Correlation analysis method and system based on structured multidimensional scheduling behavior
abstract_en: The invention discloses a correlation analysis method and a correlation analysis system based on a structured multidimensional scheduling behavior, which are characterized in that data are collected from a data source, preprocessing operation is carried out, corresponding labels are automatically matched with system collected data according to keywords in the collected data content, and business information of different sources is classified and organized; constructing a multidimensional scheduling behavior model in a system; inputting the acquired data into a system for data analysis to form an event model, and timely prompting when the event model is different from a multidimensional scheduling behavior model constructed by an administrator; and excavating the association relation among behaviors, and connecting single behaviors in series according to the correlation of the behavior attributes to form a complete behavior joint debugging. The method can analyze and correlate scheduling behaviors of different dimensions in the power grid outage and restoration scene more conveniently, and the analysis can help us to understand the internal relation between data better and provide more accurate basis for decision.

title_en: Optimized regulation and control method for land utilization of multiple-outlet watershed
abstract_en: The application provides an optimized regulation and control method for land utilization of multiple-outlet watersheds, which comprises the steps of constructing a spatial attribute regression model, quantitatively analyzing the influence of each land utilization type in a study area on water ecological load, optimizing the spatial attribute regression model by combining rigid boundaries of the study area to obtain corresponding regulation and control potential, evaluating land utilization regulation and control potential and ecological restoration regulation and control potential of the corresponding watersheds by using the optimized spatial attribute regression model, setting land utilization regulation and control scenes and ecological restoration regulation and control scenes, simulating environmental effects related to the land utilization regulation and control scenes by using the optimized spatial attribute regression model, and formulating an optimized restoration measure scheme.
assignees: TIANJIN TIANRONG ENVIRONMENTAL TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration method for mountain highway gangue side slope
abstract_en: The application provides an ecological restoration method for a mountain highway gangue side slope, which comprises the steps of obtaining real-time monitoring data from the gangue side slope through a sensor network, obtaining an initial feature set, carrying out preliminary grouping on the side slope according to the initial feature set by adopting a clustering analysis method, determining a classification standard threshold value, obtaining feedback data in a restoration implementation process, comparing the feedback data with the preliminary grouping, judging the deviation degree of an effect, updating the classification standard threshold value through a regression analysis model if the deviation of the effect exceeds a preset threshold value, obtaining an adjusted classification system, extracting a corresponding restoration scheme template from a database aiming at the adjusted classification system, generating an optimization scheme version, carrying out virtual test on the optimization scheme version through an analog simulation module, obtaining a prediction effect index, collecting subsequent monitoring data according to final execution parameters, carrying out iterative comparison with the prediction effect index, and obtaining a further adjustment signal.

title_en: Mud-rock flow along-path automatic diversion dredging, sand blocking and silt stopping combined structure and construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disaster prevention and reduction of hydraulic engineering, in particular to a mud-rock flow along-path automatic diversion dredging, sand blocking and silt stopping combined structure and a construction method. The combined structure comprises a plurality of automatic diversion dredging, sand blocking and silt stopping units which are sequentially arranged along the river water flow direction, and each unit comprises a crescent diversion structure, a self-dredging silt blocking dam structure and a funnel type silt stopping field structure. The crescent diversion structure is formed by distributing concrete columns or gabion columns according to the shape of crescent teeth and connecting the concrete columns or the gabion columns through waterproof geotechnical cloth, internally filling soil and stone mixtures and covering vegetation on the top, the self-dredging check dam structure is transversely arranged on a river channel and is provided with a drainage hole, a gate and an overflow port, the funnel type silt stopping field structure comprises an inclined slope, a funnel type silt stopping pond and silt discharging holes, and planting grooves are arranged on the periphery of the funnel type silt stopping field structure. The combined structure is arranged in the river channel, so that the debris flow can be effectively intercepted, automatic diversion dredging is realized, manual maintenance is reduced, disaster prevention and reduction effects are improved, and meanwhile, the ecological restoration function is realized.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Ecological regulation and control method and system for repairing water body by using substrate of culture pond fused with AI vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological regulation and control method and system for repairing a substrate of an aquaculture pond by fusing AI vision, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multidimensional sensing data of a plurality of regional nodes in the pond, wherein the multidimensional sensing data comprises vision data, substrate parameters and environment parameters; the method comprises the steps of extracting substrate characteristics in visual data based on a preset substrate image recognition network, determining evaluation indexes and corresponding degradation levels of a pond according to the substrate characteristics, multidimensional sensing data and a preset fusion judgment model, calculating restoration parameter combinations of corresponding area nodes under the current degradation levels according to sensing data corresponding to the evaluation indexes and a parameter optimization network corresponding to the degradation levels, and generating regulation execution instructions received by equipment according to the restoration parameter combinations in response to judgment results output by the fusion judgment model. Therefore, the invention can realize the recognition of microscopic substrate characteristics to macroscopic ecological regulation and control by fusing the sensing data with AI vision, and is suitable for the complex requirements of different cultivation scenes.
assignees: UNIV ZHONGKAI AGRI & ENG;GUANGDONG YUEFU ENG DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Information processing device, control method for information processing device, and program
abstract_en: To provide an information processing device capable of determining a restoration destination of an information processing system to be restored such that a function of the information processing system can be used even at the restoration destination for disaster restoration.SOLUTION: An information processing device for determining a site as a restoration destination of an information processing system from a plurality of sites where the information processing system operates comprises: an acquisition part for acquiring first information on a function that each information processing system uses and second information on a function that the information processing system can use in each site; and a determination part for, when a failure occurs in the information processing system in a first site among the plurality of sites, determining the site in which the function that the information processing system in which the failure has occurred uses can be used as a restoration destination of the information processing system in which the failure has occurred on the basis of the acquired first information and second information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Emergency response system
title_ko: 통합 화재 대응 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated fire response system. The integrated fire response system may comprise: a fire detection sensor which is installed in a section of a building and outputs a fire detection signal when fire occurs; a camera which captures the section; an image analyzing device which analyzes camera images provided by the camera to identify a person who entered the section and a person who left the section, and counts the number of people who entered or left the section to calculate the number of people remaining in the section; a communication router which transmits the fire detection signal and the number of people remaining through a mobile communication network; and a management server which receives the fire detection signal and the number of people remaining through the communication router and displays a fire occurrence location and the number of people remaining for each section on a structure drawing of the building where the fire occurs. The present invention provides an integrated fire response system which can collect/analyze information on "preparedness-response" among "prevention-preparedness-response-restoration" required in disaster managements.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 통합 화재 대응 시스템에 관한 것이다. 통합 화재 대응 시스템은 건물의 구역에 설치되며, 화재 발생시 화재감지신호를 출력하는 화재감지센서, 상기 구역을 촬영하는 카메라, 상기 카메라가 제공한 카메라 영상을 분석하여 상기 구역에 진입한 진입자와 상기 구역으로부터 나온 진출자를 식별하며, 상기 진입자의 수와 상기 진출자의 수를 카운트하여 상기 구역의 잔류인원수를 산출하는 영상분석장치, 상기 화재감지신호 및 상기 잔류인원수를 이동 통신망을 통해 전송하는 통신 라우터 및 상기 통신 라우터를 통해 상기 화재감지신호 및 상기 잔류인원수를 수신하고, 화재 발생 위치 및 구역별 잔류인원수를 화재가 발생한 건물의 구조도에 표출하는 관제 서버를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: A business method, apparatus and system for monitoring quantitative and qualitative environmental analytics and managing associated financial transactions
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system, apparatus, and business method for using financial instruments to provide investment incentive to fund disaster mitigation projects and/or ecosystem restoration projects triggered by real world events detected at set points by sensors and analyzed by computing devices. The detection of events results in the computational analysis and determination of a characteristics of a resilience bond or ecosystem-service bond to be issued or returned to investors. Examples involve sensors used to detect events, including flood damage mitigation, earthquake damage mitigation, or air quality improvement. In one preferred embodiment of the disclosure an investor may make an initial payment into a financial instrument being a resilience bond used to fund a mitigation project, said financial instrument pays phases to the mitigation project developer at the completion of phases of the project that occur prior to the occurrence of a disaster.

title_en: In-situ restoration device and in-situ restoration method for black and odorous water body substrate sludge
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water body restoration, in particular to an in-situ restoration device and an in-situ restoration method for black and odorous water body sediment. The invention provides an in-situ repair device for black and odorous water body substrate sludge, which comprises a biocatalysis system, an induction reaction system and a combined filler system which are sequentially communicated; the water outlet of the combined filler system is communicated with the water inlet of the biocatalysis system; the biocatalysis system is arranged on land; the induction reaction system and the combined filler system are arranged at the bottom of the black and odorous water body. The three systems in the device provided by the invention are operated simultaneously, so that the hydrodynamic force of a target water body can be increased, the dynamic circulation in an independent water area can be realized, the dissolved oxygen in water can be increased, the whole water area can be comprehensively repaired, and the problems of water body blackout and water quality repeated deterioration in the black and odorous water body treatment process can be solved.

title_en: Scattering chamber type floating breakwater using pe multi-room float and balance block
title_ko: Pe 멀티룸 플로트와 중추블록을 이용한 유수실형 부방파제
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a scattering chamber-type floating breakwater using a PE multi-room float and a balance block, which is able to have no problem such as high cost, corrosion, crack, penetration of water, damage, and deterioration of the conventional floating breakwater made of steel, concrete, and FRP, introduce a unit balance block, secure a wave absorbing draft depth, introduce a wave absorbing scattering chamber in a PE assembly cross-section, maximize the performance of an enclosure unit to reduce penetrating wave, use the enclosure unit's assembly rigidity increasing effects and elastic behavior characteristics by a continuous assembly method where six surfaces of a multi-room float face each other closely, and promote wave force dispersion and member safety, comprising: an enclosure unit allowing multi-room floats with six surfaces and an inner space divided by partitions to be continuously assembled in multiple layers and multiple rows by a continuous assembly method, which allows the six surfaces face each other closely, and to float on a water surface unit and make an elastic behavior toward waves; and a central block unit installed on an upper surface of the enclosure unit and supported, and including a large number of concrete unit central blocks installed in a matrix shape to be placed in rows apart from each other, and having a movement by adapting to the elastic behavior of the enclosure unit, and maintaining the inertia draft depth and buoyancy balance. The enclosure unit and the central block unit divide functions independently from each other, and the enclosure unit on the lower side maintains the buoyancy of the floating breakwater and attenuates the wave energy. The central block unit on the upper side maintains the restoration property and secures the inertia draft depth.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 강재, 콘크리트 및 FRP를 소재로 한 기존 부방파제의 고비용성, 부식, 균열 및 침수, 파손 및 열화의 문제점이 없고 단위 중추블록을 도입하여 소파 흘수심을 확보함과 아울러 PE 조립단면 내 소파 유수실 도입을 통하여 함체부의 투과파 저감성능을 극대화하고 멀티룸 플로트의 6대면이 밀접하게 대면하는 연속조립 방식에 의한 함체부의 조립강성 증강효과와 탄성거동 특성을 활용함으로써 파력 분산성과 부재 안전성을 도모할 수 있도록 한 PE 멀티룸 플로트와 단위 중추블록을 조합한 유수실형 부방파제에 관한 것으로, 내부공간이 격벽에 의해 분할된 6면체의 멀티룸 플로트가 6대면이 밀접하게 대면하는 연속조립 방식에 의해 다층, 다열로 연속조립되어 수면부에 부유하면서 파랑에 대하여 탄성거동하도록 한 함체부; 및 상기 함체부의 상면에 놓여져 지지된 상태로 설치되되, 서로 이격을 두고 열을 지어 배치된 매트릭스 형태로 설치되어 상기 함체부의 탄성거동에 순응하여 움직임을 가지면서 관성 흘수심 및 부력평형을 유지할 수 있도록 한 다수의 콘크리트 단위 중추블록으로 이루어진 중추 블록부;를 포함하며, 상기 함체부와 중추 블록부 간에 독립적으로 기능을 분담하여, 하부의 함체부는 부방파제의 부력성 유지기능과 파랑에너지 감쇠기능을 수행하고, 상부의 중추 블록부는 복원성 유지기능 및 관성 흘수심 확보기능을 수행하도록 한 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Runoff frequency spectrum similarity calculation method for quantifying sponge effect and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a runoff frequency spectrum similarity calculation method for quantifying a sponge effect, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring runoff daily value data of a long-time sequence, and generating a runoff frequency spectrum matrix to represent runoff characteristics; generating a runoff spectrogram with an X matrix and a Y matrix respectively representing a natural landform and a sponge city, and reflecting the difference of runoff characteristics; calculating the similarity of a matrix X and a matrix Y directly without calculating graph similarity, moving the flow with different accumulated frequencies in the X matrix and the Y matrix to the closest frequency position to align the accumulated frequencies of the X matrix and the Y matrix, then calculating the similarity of the aligned X matrix and the aligned Y matrix, and calculating the similarity of the aligned X matrix and the aligned Y matrix according to the contrastive difference and the water quantity weight of each group, wherein the similarity represents the nature runoff characteristic repairing degree; the runoff frequency spectrum can be used for evaluating the construction effect and optimizing the engineering scheme, and the restoration degree of the natural runoff characteristics by different development schemes is calculated respectively.

title_en: Linear shortest path indexing method on large-scale multi-attribute road traffic network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a linear shortest path indexing method applied to a large-scale multi-attribute road traffic network, which comprises the following steps: carrying out graph partitioning on the road network graph, and establishing linear astronomical line indexes in the partitions; index construction is carried out based on tree partitions; accelerating index construction by using a convex hull merging and multi-level partition method; shortest path query and path restoration are performed on the basis of a given preference vector. The invention can carry out shortest path inquiry on the multi-price road map according to arbitrary linear attribute weight distribution, and recommends paths according to different preferences of people.
assignees: TIANJIN UNIV HEFEI INNOVATION DEVELOPMENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Remote sensing evaporation model-based quantitative calculation method for ecological water demand of natural vegetation in arid region
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote sensing evapotranspiration model-based quantitative calculation method for ecological water demand of natural vegetation in an arid region, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting basic data of a research area, collecting and processing long-time sequence satellite remote sensing data, calculating actual evapotranspiration of an area based on a model set, evaluating and verifying the actual evapotranspiration, calculating a regional reference evapotranspiration ratio, calculating the evapotranspiration quantity of natural vegetation blue water, correcting the evapotranspiration of natural vegetation blue water based on water balance, calculating the evapotranspiration coefficient of the natural vegetation blue water and calculating the ecological water demand of the natural vegetation. The method can realize accurate calculation of the ecological water demand of the natural vegetation in the arid region, has the practicability and operability of regional application, and can be used for service application fields such as water resource management, ecological protection and restoration, watershed water resource planning, water resource optimization configuration and the like in the arid region.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Electrified quick repair high-voltage drop-out fuse wire clamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrified quick-repair high-voltage drop-out fuse wire clamp, which comprises two operation wire clamps, wherein each operation wire clamp comprises a clamping hook, the bottom of each clamping hook is fixedly provided with a fixed block, a threaded column is screwed and penetrated on each fixed block, the top end of each threaded column is rotatably provided with a chuck, the bottom end of each threaded column is fixedly provided with a connecting block, and two sides of each connecting block are symmetrically fixed with limiting rods; the invention relates to the technical field of drop-out fuse wire clamps; according to the invention, compared with the original live working hericium erinaceus clamp, the working clamp can be hung on the power side and the load side of the drop-out fuse more conveniently, the working clamp can be conveniently installed on the drop-out fuse by the aid of the arranged operating rod matched connector, meanwhile, the length of the working clamp can be adjusted, a worker can conveniently adjust the working clamp according to actual requirements, the working clamp can realize replacement of the high-voltage drop-out fuse without power outage of a main line, quick power restoration is realized, and the problems that spare parts are insufficient and important time nodes cannot be replaced with power outage are solved.
assignees: QINHUANGDAO POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for deducting scene of water traffic accident
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of scene simulation and discloses a method and a system for deducing scene of a water traffic accident, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an accident scene based on pre-acquired accident information, constructing scene elements of the accident scene by combining a sand box game concept to obtain an original video file of scene restoration of the accident, editing and synthesizing the original video file of scene restoration of the accident and a video of a traffic accident scene by utilizing a film and television editing technology to obtain an edited accident video file, carrying out information matching processing on the edited accident video file and the accident information, and storing a processing result to obtain an accident database. The invention can realize scene simulation of events such as ship traffic accidents, search and rescue on water and the like.
assignees: TRANSP PLANNING AND RESEARCH INSTITUTE MINISTRY OF TRANSP CHINA

title_en: Method and system for cooperatively controlling recovery after three-network disaster and multi-source resource coordination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for coordinating recovery and multi-source resources after a coordinated control three-network disaster, which belong to the technical field of recovery and toughness improvement of a multi-infrastructure system after the disaster, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a node importance evaluation function through multi-index fusion, and calculating a recovery priority score of an ash starting power supply; the method comprises the steps of estimating node state probability to obtain node state probability, setting boundary conditions of partition power grid restoration feasibility, optimizing restoration sequence through a gray start power supply-load-grid path matching model to generate a restoration path set, adopting a reinforcement learning algorithm, taking node state, resource availability and path communication matrix as state space to output an optimal restoration sequence and a resource scheduling scheme, and generating three-network restoration path recommendation, partition power grid restoration strategy and a multi-element flexible resource scheduling sequence. The invention realizes the efficient scheduling and cross-network cooperative control of the multi-source flexible resources, and effectively improves the recovery efficiency and toughness of the three networks in the scene after disaster.

title_en: Optimized configuration method for mangrove tree species in pond-returning forest
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forest breeding and seedling raising, and discloses an optimized configuration method for mangrove tree species in pond-returning and forest returning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a high-precision digital elevation model and tidal hydrologic data, simulating the submerged duration, frequency and flow rate of a global grid unit through a two-dimensional shallow water dynamics model, constructing a multi-factor ecological adaptability evaluation model by combining a mangrove species physiological tolerance database, calculating the adaptability index of each grid to candidate tree species, and establishing a nonlinear density regulation model based on the index to generate an optimal tree species and density configuration diagram of space heterogeneity. The method realizes the accuracy and the intellectualization of mangrove restoration, and remarkably improves the survival rate and the stability of an ecological system.
assignees: HAINAN ACADEMY OF FORESTRY HAINAN MANGROVE RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Operation confirmation system
abstract_en: To provide an operation confirmation system that can display operation information on a power generation facility even when the Internet line is temporarily cut off due to power outage and restoration of the Internet line is slower than start-up of a web browser.SOLUTION: An operation confirmation system has an operation information acquisition unit, a web server, and a content display unit. The web server and the content display unit are connected with each other via the Internet. The content display unit has a storage unit that stores a program file that can be read and executed by the web browser. The program file executes a connection confirmation operation in a predetermined interval until the content display unit becomes accessible to the web server, and on a condition that the content display unit has become accessible to the web server according to the connection confirmation operation, acquires a first web content from the web server with the web browser.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Computation of preemptive ranked resiliency measures, including preemptive network islanding, using probabilistic optimization for enhanced operational resilience of a power system
abstract_en: When an extreme weather event is forecasted, an operator of a power system will typically prepare reactive measures, to facilitate the restoration of the power system after it has been damaged by the event. Disclosed embodiments utilize probabilistic optimization to identify and rank resiliency measures in advance of such an event, such that proactive measures may be implemented before the event, to increase the operational resilience of the power system during the event. This enables the power system to better withstand and recover more quickly from the event, thereby reducing downtime (e.g., power outages) and costs. In an embodiment, these resiliency measures include preemptive network islanding, which determines an optimal microgrid configuration for the power system. This preemptive network islanding may be combined with network reduction, as well as two-stage microgrid dispatch planning, to make the optimization computationally tractable.

title_en: Method and system for measuring and calculating power distribution station area flooded by rainstorm induced flood
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power disaster prevention and reduction, in particular to a method and a system for measuring and calculating a power distribution area submerged by rainstorm induced flood. The method is deployed in a production monitoring command center of a provincial power grid, collects short-term weather forecast information from a provincial weather station short-term and medium-term early warning center, collects flood forecast information from a hydrological center, collects a power geographic information map from a power geographic information system, analyzes equipment coordinate information, weather forecast information and flood forecast information of a medium-voltage distribution overhead line through a neural network, measures and calculates the range of flooding a distribution station area by rainstorm induced flood, and externally releases early warning information through a Web server of the system. The invention can accurately reflect key factors such as flood arrival time, submergence range, power failure range, regional water depth and the like, and is beneficial to a production monitoring command center to guide the development of emergency response work such as load transfer, facility reinforcement, emergency repair and power restoration and the like.

title_en: Ecological protection restoration landslide drainage system
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide drainage system for ecological protection and restoration, which comprises a slope body and a protective structure arranged on the slope body, wherein the protective structure comprises a cement protective frame paved on the surface of the slope body and an anchoring piece arranged in the slope body, the anchoring piece comprises a columnar body, a drainage channel formed in the columnar body and a water permeable hole formed in the columnar body and communicated with the drainage channel, the end part of the columnar body is integrally arranged with the protective frame, one end of the drainage channel connected with the cement protective frame is communicated with the outside, the cement protective frame and the anchoring piece are integrally arranged by arranging the anchoring piece in the slope body, the strength of the cement protective frame is improved, the cement protective frame is prevented from slipping, the drainage channel is arranged in the anchoring piece, the water permeable hole is arranged in the side wall, and therefore water in the slope body can timely flow into the drainage channel through the water permeable hole, flows out along with the drainage channel, and reduces the risk of landslide.
assignees: SECOND GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT INVESTIG YARD OF HENAN PROVINCE GEOLOGICAL MINERAL EXPLORATION AND DEV

title_en: Power distribution system post-disaster multiple fault recovery process evaluation method considering maintenance strategy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating a power distribution system after-disaster multiple fault recovery process by considering a maintenance strategy, which overcomes the defects of the prior art and comprises the following steps: s1, determining a fault scene and maintenance parameters, specifically: s101, determining a power distribution system network topology parameter, including: branch information, user information, and power information; s102, determining a set of disaster-caused fault elements in the power distribution system to obtain a system fault scene, analyzing and counting power failure loads to obtain an initial state before the system starts to recover; s103, determining the number of maintenance teams in the system and the maintenance time of a single element; s2, establishing an evaluation index system of the multiple fault recovery process of the power distribution system; and S3, optimizing the maintenance attribute of the fault element, determining an optimal maintenance strategy, determining the power restoration time of each load and user in the recovery process according to the optimal maintenance strategy, obtaining a load recovery curve and a user recovery curve according to the power restoration time, and calculating evaluation indexes of each recovery process.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: BIM-based RC frame structure earthquake damage judgment and loss prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BIM-based earthquake damage judgment and loss prediction method for an RC frame structure, which comprises the following steps: through the model conversion function of RTO (Revitto OpenSEES), earthquake response analysis is directly carried out on the BIM in Revit, building damage levels under the earthquake action are respectively obtained from three layers of a member, a floor and the whole structure according to the evaluation standard of building earthquake resistance toughness, and earthquake damage information of the member is automatically stored in the BIM so as to realize the management and integration of the earthquake resistance performance information of the building structure in the whole life cycle of the building; based on the current engineering quota, the construction cost of the structure is automatically obtained in Revit, and then the post-earthquake restoration cost, the earthquake restoration time, the casualty number and the like are automatically obtained in Revit through the earthquake damage of the structure and the members, so that the building earthquake disaster evaluation directly based on BIM is realized. Therefore, effective structural anti-seismic toughness evaluation function integration and corresponding data sharing are carried out on the BIM platform.

title_en: Method and device for judging indoor power failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for judging indoor power failure, which comprises the following steps: collecting incoming line voltage V, incoming line current I and leakage current I of a user at an incoming line position of the user in real time  Leakage device  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the 2. Judging the indoor power failure: judging whether a short circuit fault, a leakage current fault and a current overrun fault are suspected to occur or not; 3. and when at least one of a short circuit fault, a leakage current fault and a current overrun fault is suspected to occur, detecting whether the power P or the incoming line current I of the user is 0 or not, and judging the reason of the indoor power failure. The invention also discloses two power outage judging devices using the indoor power outage judging method. The method and the device for judging the power failure in the house can identify the reason of the power failure in the house of the resident, thus the power failure is generatedThe method can inform the user of detailed reasons during power failure, assist the user to quickly re-power, and improve the satisfaction of the client. For the power failure caused by indoor reasons, the power grid company does not need to send people to the site for investigation, so that the manpower input is reduced, and the user is guided to realize quick power restoration.
assignees: JIANGSU INTELEVER ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network power supply restoration optimization method and system considering micro-grid and voltage regulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply restoration optimization method and a power supply restoration optimization system for a power distribution network taking micro-grid and voltage regulation into consideration, and relates to the technical field of optimization management of power systems, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting data of the micro-grid and voltage regulation equipment and preprocessing the data; and modeling the active power distribution network power supply restoration model taking the micro-grid and the voltage regulating equipment into consideration by using a mathematical modeling language AMPL, solving by using a CPLEX solver and outputting a result. The invention considers the reality of the distribution system structure, has flexible application and accurate result, accelerates the solving efficiency of the power supply recovery model, and ensures the convergence optimality through classical optimization technology. From the analysis of the results, a power restoration strategy for the active power distribution network may be defined. The method can ensure that each part of the system presents a radial topological structure and allows the part to keep in a power-off state so that other parts can be restored.
assignees: KUNMING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Processing method, device, equipment and storage medium of power data
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for processing electric power data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical power data, and displaying data points corresponding to the historical power data on a preset interface; the data points include unknown data points that are not automatically identified as anomalies; responding to the selection operation of the unknown data point, and processing the abnormal power value of the unknown data point to obtain historical power data after the abnormal processing of the unknown data point; and carrying out electric quantity consumption prediction based on the historical electric power data after the unknown data point is processed abnormally, so as to obtain an electric quantity predicted value. By giving technicians data manipulation capability and performing functional operation of a related visual interface, based on selection operation of response to the displayed unknown data points, the abnormal power values of the unknown data points are replaced, visual restoration of the data is realized, and therefore a power data model is optimized, and further efficiency and accuracy of power energy management are improved.
assignees: GREE ELECTRIC APPLIANCES INC ZHUHAI;GUOCHUANG ENERGY INTERNET INNOVATION CENTER GUANGDONG CO LTD

title_en: Multi-level regulation-oriented remote centralized control dispatching intelligent interaction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multistage regulation-oriented remote centralized control dispatching intelligent interaction method, wherein a system of the method is deployed in a safe II area and comprises an application, a database and an interface server, and the system is interconnected with each stage of dispatching system by adopting strategies such as a dual-machine hot standby and the like in a B/S architecture. The system comprises a plurality of modules, wherein the information sharing and real-time communication module promotes information flow coordination, the overhaul work management module facilitates overhaul operation and display, the starting scheme execution module is responsible for obtaining a scheme from scheduling and executing and reporting, the safety error prevention module performs multi-aspect check, the data analysis and decision support module performs operation decision, the double-factor authentication module ensures information safety, and the power failure and power restoration application module replaces the traditional application flow. The modules work cooperatively to solve a plurality of problems in the prior art, improve dispatching command efficiency and accuracy and ensure safe production of electric power.

title_en: Mangrove community succession prediction method under influence of sea level rising
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mangrove community succession prediction method under the influence of sea level rising, which relates to the field of environmental simulation and ecological protection and comprises the following steps of obtaining beach elevation, water depth, mangrove distribution, coastline, tide harmony constant and historical typhoon path data of a prediction area; the method comprises the steps of constructing self-adaptive triangular grids, spatially interpolating mangrove distribution data to grid units, defining closed boundaries by utilizing coastline data, driving a three-dimensional finite element model by combining tidal harmonic constants and typhoon path data, solving grid point water level time sequences in current and sea level rising scenes, calculating flooding duration time of each grid unit in the current and sea level rising scenes, updating community spatial distribution according to flooding time change and mangrove species tolerance threshold value, and outputting a prediction graph. The method accurately quantifies the spatial influence of flooding time change caused by sea level rising on mangrove community succession, and provides reliable technical support for ecological protection and restoration of coastal zones.
assignees: NAT MARINE DATA AND INFORMATION SERVICE

title_en: Pachinko game machine
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a Pachinko game machine which can increase the reliability in exchange of a variety of signals with a CR unit.  <P>SOLUTION: A payout control MPU 1710a is structured so as to permit the Pachinko game machine to continue the exchange of a variety of signals with the CR unit just before a momentary blackout or a power failure and continue the payout of game balls from the time of return of power as a result of restoration of the number of stocked prize balls, the actual count of balls, the number of drive commands, and the value of a nonconformity counter to the values just before the momentary blackout or the power failure at the time of return of power even if a cut-off of the exchange of a variety of signals with the CR unit due to the momentary blackout or the power failure makes the machine unable to continue the payout of the game balls when the Pachinko game machine is putting out game balls to a storage tray while exchanging the signals with the CR unit. Consequently, the reliability in exchange of a variety of signals between the Pachinko game machine and the CR unit can be improved.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&amp;INPIT

title_en: Controlling method of construction machinary
title_ko: 건설기계의 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a controlling method for a construction machine, which comprises: a vehicle mode change signal input step which inputs a signal for using a vehicle as a disaster relief vehicle; an exhaust gas processing device failure determination step which determines failure of an exhaust gas processing device of the vehicle being used in an emergency mode in the vehicle mode change signal input step; a function releasing time setting step which sets a fixed period of time in order to release a failure sensing function for an exhaust gas processing device when the exhaust gas processing device is determined as failure; a setting time determination step which determines whether or not the setting time for releasing the function in the function releasing time setting step has passed; and an exhaust gas processing device failure sensing function restoration step which maintains the releasing of the failure sensing function for the exhaust gas processing device when the setting time is determined as not passed yet in the setting time determination step, and restores the failure sensing function for the exhaust gas processing device when the setting time is determined as passed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예는 건설기계 기능 제어 방법에 관한 것으로, 차량을 재난구호용 긴급 차량으로 사용하기 위한 신호를 입력하는 차량모드 변경신호 입력 단계와, 상기 차량모드 변경신호 입력 단계에서 긴급모드로 사용중인 차량의 배기가스 처리장치의 고장여부를 판단하는 배기가스 처리장치 고장판단 단계와, 상기 배기가스 처리장치 고장판단 단계에서 차량의 배기가스 처리 장치가 고장인 것으로 판단되면, 일정시간을 설정하여 배기가스 처리 장치 고장 감지 기능을 해제하는 기능해제 시간설정 단계와, 상기 기능해제 시간설정 단계에서 기능해제를 위해 설정한 시간을 초과하였는지를 판단하는 설정시간 판단 단계, 그리고 상기 설정시간 판단 단계에서 설정된 시간을 초과하지 않은 것으로 판단되면 배기가스 처리 고장 감지 기능 해제를 유지하고, 설정된 시간을 초과한 것으로 판단되면 배기가스 처리 장치 고장 감기 기능을 복구하는 배기가스 처리장치 고장감지기능 복구 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Wirelessly controllable lifesaving member and lifesaving box automation system
title_ko: 무선제어 가능한 구명부재 및 인명 구조함 자동화 시스템
abstract_en: A wirelessly controllable lifesaving member and automated lifesaving box system according to an embodiment protects a golden time for rescuing drowning people by providing the wireless lifesaving member and an automated lifesaving system for a ship hull equipped with the lifesaving member when reporting the drowning people, and enables rapid response in the event of an accident. The lifesaving member according to an embodiment comprises a propeller, is equipped with functions such as automatic recovery and rollover restoration, and is quickly and accurately delivered to the drowning people according to situation room control and automatic route setting. In an embodiment, when an accident occurs and a rescue worker arrives and rescues the drowning people supported by the wirelessly controllable lifesaving member, the lifesaving member floating on the water is moved to a pier using overhead host transport (OHT) technology, is moved vertically, and is seated in the ship hull. In an embodiment, the ship hull can monitor accident and rescue situations in real time through CCTV, and can supply and accumulate electricity through solar energy using a solar collector.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 따른 무선제어 가능한 구명부재 및 인명 구조함 자동화 시스템 은 익수자 발생 신고접수 시 무선화 된 구명 부재 및 구명 부재가 탑재된 함체의 인명구조 자동화 시스템을 제공하여 익수자 구조 골든타임을 사수하고, 사고 발생시 신속한 대응을 가능하도록 한다. 실시예에서 따른 구명 부재는 추진기를 포함하고, 자동 회기 및 전복 복원 등 기능을 탑재하여 상황실 통제 및 자동 경로 설정에 따라 신속하고 정확하게 익수자에게 전달된다. 실시예에서는 사고 발생시 구조대원이 도착하여 무선 제어가능한 구명 부재에 지탱하고 있는 익수자를 구조하면 수면 위에 떠 있는 구명 부재는 OHT(overhead Host Transport, 천장대차장치) 기술을 적용한 교각으로 이동시켜 수직 이동하고 함체로 안착한다. 실시예에서 함체는 CCTV로 사고 및 구조 상황을 실시간 모니터링 할 수 있고, 집열판으로 태양열로 전기를 공급 및 축적할 수 있다.
assignees: KOREA COAST GUARD RES CENTER;LEE SUK HUN

title_en: Optical integration system for disaster emergency proadcasting communivation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an optical integration system for disaster emergency broadcasting communication, including: sensor units which detect surrounding temperatures and strains and are separately located from each other; a broadcasting communication integration unit for transmitting an integrated broadcasting communication optical signal by multiplexing a received broadcasting signal and a received communication signal as optical signals having different wavelengths; reception units which receive the optical signal transmitted from the broadcasting communication integration unit, demultiplex the received optical signal according to each wavelength, transmit the separated broadcasting signal and the separated communication signal to a corresponding peripheral terminal, and transmit the information detected through the sensor units to the broadcasting communication integration unit; and a management server for determining a disaster state from the information which is detected through the sensor units and is received through the reception units and the broadcasting communication integration unit, and transmitting a processing signal through the broadcasting communication integration unit to the reception units according to the disaster state when determining the disaster state, wherein the management server transmits a signal to each guiding indication lamp connected to the separately arranged reception units on the basis of a location information database in which the location information of the sensor units is stored according to the recognized disaster state, and transmits an emergency guide broadcasting signal to the peripheral terminal, and each reception unit includes a mobile remote management server which further connects wireless sensor nodes so as to perform communication through the restoration of retrievable wired/wireless networks in the disaster state, and transmits the information through the wireless sensor nodes to the reception units by enabling communication with the management server and enabling remote connection with the wireless sensor nodes. The system of the present invention can induce reconstruction of destroyed power and information communication networks as emergency networks, and active evasion from a disaster area using independent emergency power in the disaster state.
assignees: CHOI HYUN BEOM;FON SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Cyber-physical integrated restoration method and system for distribution systems based on emergency mobile communications
abstract_en: A cyber-physical integrated restoration method and system for distribution systems based on emergency mobile communications are provided. After extreme natural disasters which cause serious damage to distribution systems, damages of distribution systems are evaluated through system feedback data. When ground communication base stations are unavailable due to the damages, the method can make full use of existing wireless emergency communication resources to provide emergency communication services, and quickly restore the power supply through distribution automation functions with supports of the backup battery of automatic terminal devices, so as to effectively improve the resilience of distribution systems.

title_en: Systems and methods for prioritizing power restoration to sites after a power outage
abstract_en: A device may determine a number of user equipments (UEs) connected to an inactive site during a first period of time and determine that the inactive site experienced a power outage during a second period of time. The device may determine that the UEs connected to a set of active sites during the second period of time. The device may determine one or more key performance indicator (KPI) changes to one or more KPIs, during the second period of time, for each of the set of active sites. The device may determine a plurality of weights associated with the inactive site experiencing the power outage; determine a set of impacts, of the inactive site, on the one or more KPI changes for the set of active sites based on the plurality of weights; and cause power to be restored to the inactive site based on the set of impacts.

title_en: System and Method for Providing Power Distribution System Information
abstract_en: A system, method and computer program product for processing utility data of a power grid is provided. In one embodiment, the system includes a datamart comprised of a plurality of physical databases storing utility data, a plurality of applications comprising an automated meter application configured to process power usage data from a plurality of automated meters, a power outage application configured to identify a location of a power outage, and a power restoration application configured to identify a location of a power restoration. The system may include an analysis engine comprising a plurality of analysis objects with each analysis object configured to process data to provide a specific analysis, wherein said analysis engine is accessible via one or more of the plurality of applications, and the system may include a report module configured to receive an output from the analysis engine and to output a report. The plurality of applications may also include a fault analysis application, a transformer analysis application, a theft detection application, a power flow application, a substation automation application, a load shed application and others.

title_en: Method for estimating pollution amount of underground LNAPL
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for estimating underground LNAPL pollution amount, which relates to the technical field of underground water pollution and restoration and comprises the following steps of measuring apparent thickness of LNAPL in a plurality of monitoring wells, collecting water-containing medium in a stratum, measuring saturated water content and capillary water penetration amount of the water-containing medium and calculating effective capillary rise height, calculating actual thickness of LNAPL in the stratum according to the apparent thickness of LNAPL in the plurality of monitoring wells and the effective capillary rise height, establishing a coordinate system according to the actual thickness of LNAPL in the stratum and layout forms of the plurality of monitoring wells, endowing a plurality of different coordinate values for the plurality of monitoring wells on the coordinate system, fitting a stratum LNAPL distribution map and a distribution function, and estimating the pollution area, the pollution volume and the pollution amount of LNAPL in the stratum. The invention adopts the effective capillary rise height h  e  to replace h  a  for approximate calculation, thereby greatly reducing the error of LNAPL actual thickness estimation.

title_en: Electric power facility emergency treatment system based on earthquake early warning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power emergency control and discloses an electric power facility emergency processing system based on earthquake early warning, which comprises a region dividing module, a data acquisition module, a fault risk assessment module, an isolation decision and control module, an off-grid operation regulation module, an operation state assessment module and a reconnection restoration module, wherein the region dividing module is used for acquiring electric power topological structure data and generating a plurality of region sections, the data acquisition module is used for acquiring earthquake early warning data, equipment operation data and equipment environment data and representing the earthquake early warning data through a multisource data set, the fault risk assessment module is used for calculating the failure probability of each electric power equipment, the isolation decision and control module is used for calculating the region reliability index of a subarea, determining a target subarea, the off-grid operation regulation module is used for switching the target subarea to the off-grid operation and adjusting control parameters, the operation state assessment module is used for generating an operation health score, and the reconnection restoration module is used for restoring and connecting the target subarea to a main power grid. The intelligent isolation and safe reconnection control of the power subarea under the drive of earthquake early warning are realized.

title_en: Auxiliary device for ecological restoration of mountain
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auxiliary device for ecological restoration of a mountain, which comprises a diversion mechanism, a first collecting box, a second collecting box and a diversion groove, wherein the diversion mechanism comprises a mountain ridge, the first collecting box is arranged at the top of the mountain ridge, the second collecting box is arranged at the front of the mountain ridge, and the diversion groove is arranged at the front of the second collecting box; the filtering mechanism comprises a water storage tank and a filtering box arranged at the top of the water storage tank. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: through setting up first collecting box for collect the rainwater at mountain body ridge top, through setting up second collecting box and guiding gutter, be used for carrying out water conservancy diversion and collection to the rainwater of mountain body ridge side, and then be convenient for in time drain the rainwater, avoided appearing the condition of barren rock landslide, solved the ecological prosthetic devices of mountain body at present stage and not possess timely drainage's function, appear barren rock landslide's condition easily, cause the destruction to road building on every side, traditional device does not possess the problem of rainwater collection function simultaneously.

title_en: Underwater revetment based on ecological bags and water body ecological management method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underwater revetment based on ecological bags and a water body ecological management method. The method comprises a first step of dredging and solidifying, a second step of establishing a water bottom foundation, a third step of clearing up the revetment surface, a fourth step of paving the ecological bags in a step-shaped lamination dislocation mode from the top of the water bottom foundation, a fifth step of planting submerged plants on the ecological bags, a sixth step of stopping river closure or beginning to coffer after the water quality conforms to or superior to the fourth scale of the national surface water environment criterion GB/3838-2002, wherein when the water quality does not conform to or inferior to the fifth scale of the GB/3838-2002, microbial preparation is added into the water according to the water quality measuring result, and a seventh step adding filter feeder fishes or/and herbivorous fishes, shrimps and demersal mussel animals. The method guarantees that floodwater can be drawn off based on the fact that the underwater revetment structure of rivers and lakes is safe, and the cooperative management capacity for the water body is improved through ecological restoration of the underwater revetment.

title_en: Environment investigation method aiming at underground water chlorinated hydrocarbon pollution
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental investigation, and discloses an environmental investigation method for underground water chlorinated hydrocarbon pollution, which comprises the following steps: s1: a first stage investigation; s2: analyzing results, if the investigation at the first stage confirms that no possible pollution source exists in the working area and the surrounding area currently and historically, the investigation activity can be ended, and if the pollution source exists in the working area and outside the working area, the environmental investigation at the second stage is carried out; s3: and the second stage of investigation, and primary sampling analysis. The method finds out geological and hydrogeological conditions of the investigation region in detail, finds out pollution source distribution of the investigation region in detail, determines types and components of concerned pollutants, defines the spatial distribution range of main pollutants in soil and underground water, evaluates the pollution degree of the soil and the underground water of the investigation region and evaluates risks, and provides scientific basis and data support for the next treatment, restoration and safe utilization work; and carrying out dynamic monitoring on groundwater pollution.
assignees: JIANGSU YISHUITIAN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: TransCGAN-based seismic data reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a seismic data reconstruction method based on transcGA, which comprises the following steps: step 010: randomly deleting the complete earthquake set to obtain a deleted set; step 020: training the missing set through a transCGAN network to obtain a prediction set; the transCGAN network comprises adjustable parameters; step 030: scoring the prediction set and the seismic integrity set similarly by a discriminator; step 041: comparing the score with a threshold, adjusting the parameter through an optimizer when the score is lower than the threshold, and executing step 020; step 042: and comparing the score with a threshold, and finishing the transCGAN network training when the score is not lower than the threshold to obtain a seismic data reconstruction model. By the method, the seismic data can be restored to more than 90 percent, and the accuracy of data reconstruction and the data restoration proportion are greatly improved.

title_en: Intelligent wind power data restoration method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses an intelligent wind power data restoration method and device. According to the method, missing wind power data can be estimated from three dimensions of characteristic parameters, time sequences and spatial distribution, and a model with the highest correlation in a certain dimension is selected from a model pool to finally repair the wind power data. The device is realized based on the method. According to the embodiment of the specification, the wind power missing data can be completely and accurately repaired from multiple dimensions based on objective complex conditions of the wind power missing data.

title_en: Electric power rush-repair scheduling method and system based on vehicle-mounted electric power tool cabinet
abstract_en: The application discloses an electric power rush-repair scheduling method and system based on a vehicle-mounted electric power tool cabinet, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting various electric power operation data samples, extracting a plurality of characteristics of each data sample, and classifying attribute categories of each characteristic; calculating the information gain of each feature on all data samples to obtain the feature information gain; gain screening the characteristics according to the characteristic information to obtain screened characteristics; constructing a decision tree by utilizing the screened characteristics, and obtaining a decision information subset based on the decision tree; and constructing a scheduling processing model by utilizing the decision information subset to obtain a scheduling processing result. The application uses the information gain data as a tie, and uses the decision tree to carry out recursive computation to finally obtain the optimal scheduling processing flow, thereby effectively promoting the management and maintenance efficiency of the rush-repair operation construction.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD TONGLU COUNTY POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for evaluating reliability of power distribution network containing multiple types of distributed energy sources
abstract_en: The application provides a reliability evaluation method of a power distribution network containing multiple types of distributed energy, which comprises the steps of determining the relation between disaster intensity and element faults of the power distribution network, describing the association relation between disaster intensity characteristics and element fault rates by using a random forest model, generating disaster fault data sets of the power distribution network by a sampling method, carrying out post-disaster load recovery and line restoration at a post-disaster recovery stage of the power distribution network, establishing a fault recovery model, solving the fault recovery model to obtain a load node power supply state of the power distribution network, and accordingly calculating the reliability index of a power system.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Clonezilla-based openEuler system rapid backup and restore method, system, equipment and device
abstract_en: A openEuler system quick backup and restore method, system, device and apparatus based on Clonezilla relates to the technical field of operating system backup, and includes making Clonezilla boot disk and ext4 format storage device, starting target device by boot disk, selecting local storage mode and backup strategy, carrying out partition level or full magnetic disk compression backup on openEuler system under enterprise server with merpeng processor developed mainly, all software in system and environment required by installing software, generating bootable system mirror image ISO file, solving problems of poor compatibility, low efficiency and incomplete environmental restoration of traditional Linux backup method under domestic platform by customizing mirror image processing flow, hardware instruction set adaptation and system environment depth capturing technology, and improving response speed of system deployment and disaster recovery.
assignees: SHANXI INFORMATION INDUSTRIAL TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Elevator restoration work support system and elevator restoration work support method
abstract_en: To provide an elevator restoration work support system for performing restoration work with respect to elevators in a plurality of buildings by placing priority on safety of people having difficulty in evacuation when a wide area disaster occurs, and to provide an elevator restoration work support method.SOLUTION: Each of a plurality of elevators 10 includes: an information about people having difficulty in evacuation storage unit 123 for storing information about people having difficulty in evacuation when people having difficulty in evacuation moved to floors higher than a predetermined floor; and notification information generation unit 126 for, in the case where the information about people having difficulty in evacuation is stored when generating elevator stop notification information according to the situation in a building, adding that information to the elevator stop notification information and transmitting it to a monitor center device 40. The monitor center device 40 includes: a priority calculation unit 43 for, when receiving the elevator stop notification information in which the information about people having difficulty in evacuation is added, calculating the elevator restoration work by placing a high priority on that elevator; and a transmission control unit 45 for transmitting the information of the elevator which are restoration work objects in the order of priority to a maintenance operator terminal 50.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Confined state estimation device, dispatch planning system, confined state estimation method, control method, and program
abstract_en: To estimate an occurrence state of confinement of a passenger in an elevator facility when a disaster occurs in order to support restoration work.SOLUTION: A confined state estimation device (8) includes an operation state estimation unit (81) estimating an operation state of a caution-requiring elevator facility when a caution-requiring disaster occurs according to location information showing a location of the elevator facility and disaster information including the degree of the disaster at the location, a boarding state estimation unit (82) estimating a boarding state in the caution-requiring elevator facility when the caution-requiring disaster occurs according to operation result information of the caution-requiring elevator facility before the occurrence of the caution-requiring disaster, and a confined state estimation unit (83) estimating a confined state of a user in the caution-requiring elevator facility when the caution-requiring disaster occurs based on the operation state and the boarding state of the caution-requiring elevator facility.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Dynamically selecting optimal instance type for disaster recovery in the cloud
abstract_en: One example includes performing a VM restore instance type discovery process, creating a test VM with a VM restore instance type matching a VM restore instance type identified during discovery, using the test VM to create a test restore VM at a cloud storage site, restoring the test VM at the cloud storage site using the test restore VM, generating a 4-D baseline vector based on the restoration of the test VM, the 4-D baseline vector identifying a particular VM restore instance type, generating a 5-D vector based on the 4-D baseline vector, ranking the 5-D vector relative to other 5-D vectors, the 5-D vectors identifying the same production site VM, and restoring, at the cloud storage site, the production site VM identified in the 5-D vectors, the production site VM restored at the cloud storage site has a VM restore instance type identified in the highest ranked 5-D vector.

title_en: Method for culturing moss spores and moss cultivation kit for forest restoration using same
title_ko: 이끼 포자 배양 방법 및 이를 이용한 산림 복구용 이끼 재배 키트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for culturing moss spores and a moss cultivation kit for forest restoration, using same, and to a method for culturing moss spores, in which, after moss is artificially cultured and rested, the moss is sprayed into the lost forest when a disaster occurs, thereby being capable of restoring forest. The method for culturing moss spores, according to the present invention, comprises: a first step of cutting sporangia to 10-30 mm; a second step of drying the cut sporangia at 60-75 °C for 24 hours, and then crushing the dried sporangia; a third step of immersing the crushed sporangia in a spore culture medium, followed by resting; a fourth step of immersing the rested sporangia in a plant hormone solution for 24 hours; and a fifth step of spraying the immersed sporangia with a mixture of a nutrient solution and an adhesive solution.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 이끼 포자 배양 방법 및 이를 이용한 산림 복구용 이끼 재배 키트에 관한 것으로, 이기를 인공 배양하여 휴면시킨 뒤 재난이 발생하면 손실된 산림에 살포하여 산림을 복구할 수 있는 이끼 포자 배양 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 이끼 포자 배양 방법은, 포자낭을 10 내지 30 mm로 절단하는 제1단계; 상기 절단된 포자낭을 60 내지 75℃에서 24시간 동안 건조 후 상기 건조된 포자낭을 파쇄하는 제2단계; 상기 파쇄된 포자낭을 포자 배양액에 침지 후 휴면하는 제3단계; 상기 휴면된 포자낭을 식물호르몬액에 24시간 동안 침지하는 제4단계; 상기 침지된 포자낭을 양액 및 접착액과 혼합하여 살포하는 제5단계;를 포함하여 제조되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Using a fixed network wireless data collection system to improve utility responsiveness to power outages
abstract_en: A system for determining a service outages and restorations that includes an outage management server (OMS) that generates reports outages and restoration information for metering endpoints. The outages may be caused by faults at various locations in the distribution network. The metering endpoint may include a transmitter having a battery backup that transmits the outage information upon a failure to detect a voltage at the endpoint. The transmission of the information may be filtered based on configurable criteria. The metering endpoints may also inform the OMS when power is restored. Thus, a utility may better service its customers by focusing manpower efforts using the outage and restoration information generated by the OMS.
assignees: ELSTER ELECTRICITY LLC;MASON ROBERT T JR;BORLESKE ANDREW J;SHUEY KENNETH C

title_en: Hybrid power distribution network power restoration control
abstract_en: A power outage restoration system manages a power grid including a plurality of switching devices. The power outage restoration system includes an outage management system having a network model of the power grid. A plurality of local restoration controllers are in communication with the outage management system, and each of the local restoration controllers includes a trim network model associated with a respective area of responsibility.

title_en: Multi-space-time navigating power system restoration decision support system and restoration decision method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-space-time navigating power system restoration decision support system and a restoration decision method. The system comprises a man-machine conversation layer being responsible for related display of a restorationdecision and the man-machine interactive operation, an interface adapting layer being responsible for interfacing withEMS and receiving power grid data, a data access layer used for providing underlying data support for a field service layer, and a modeling maintenance layer used for customizing and drawing various charts, wherein the interface adapting layer and the field service layer are connected with the man-machine conversation layer through network communication buses, the field service layer is connected with the data access layer, and the data access layer is connected with the modeling maintenance layer. The system and the method have the advantages that the efficiency and the success rate of power system restoration are improved, the whole-process covering on the restoration decision and the continuous online monitoring on the restoration process are realized, a dispatcher training simulation function is integrated, and the system and the method are applicable to the related power system restoration operation training.

title_en: Elastic power distribution network restoration decision method and system
