abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for recovering and deciding an elastic power distribution network, wherein an EV scheduling model before disaster is built, a mobile energy storage temporary warehouse deployment position is determined based on power distribution network line layout and load information, a pre-disaster stage mobile resource pre-deployment model is built, the post-disaster load recovering process is accelerated while the running cost of mobile resources is saved, a configuration result is determined based on the pre-disaster stage mobile resource pre-deployment model, comprehensive economic cost for post-disaster recovery is used as an objective function, an elastic power distribution network economic post-disaster recovery model matched with mobile energy storage and electric vehicles V2G is built, the mobile resource deployment position and quantity are obtained based on the post-disaster stage mobile energy storage and electric vehicles V2G collaborative recovery model, and the post-disaster power distribution network recovery is realized. The invention can provide a practical and effective power supply recovery scheme aiming at different scenes, and guide an actual power system to quickly recover the power supply of the system while ensuring the dispatching economy.

title_en: Motor -driven formula fire -fighting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a motor -driven formula fire -fighting equipment, including mobile device and fire extinguishing system, fire extinguishing system sets up on the mobile device with the detachable mode, fire extinguishing system includes nitrogen gas emitter, fire control medium container and composite nozzle, nitrogen gas emitter includes nitrogen gas storage bottle and nitrogen gas pressure device, be equipped with the manometer on the nitrogen gas storage bottle, nitrogen gas storage bottle connects nitrogen gas pressure device, nitrogen gas pressure device connects gradually fire control medium container and composite nozzle, is fire control medium container including doing powder container and clear water foam liquid mixing tank. The utility model discloses richening the function, widening application range, reinforce mobility, convenient maintenance and restoration improve fire extinguishing efficiency and reduce use cost.

title_en: Ecological water supplementing method for river estuary area of sediment-laden river
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological water replenishing method for a river mouth area of a sediment-laden river, which is used for carrying out configuration unit division on the river mouth area based on ecological function zoning, landscape pattern distribution and communication replenishing and discharging relations and carrying out water resource optimization configuration of production, living and ecological water for aiming at the water flow characteristics of the sediment-laden river. A water taking system, a sand settling system, a water conveying system and a water storage system are arranged according to water taking and using requirements so as to meet the water using requirements of a common fresh water ecological system, a saline water ecological system and a fresh and saline water interaction ecological system. A decision maker can select a proper ecological restoration scene according to multiple scenarios, and the perfect water network configuration enables large-scale tidal ditches and tidal flat wetlands in the area to be effectively supplied with fresh water, so that the harmonious, healthy and sustainable restoration and sustainability of the estuary wetland ecosystem are effectively promoted. The invention can make the ecological water supplement of the estuary region reach the effects of ecological system consideration, comprehensive water supplement region and long-term communication of the water network, and fully ensures the sustainable recovery of the ecological system.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Assessment method, device and system for anti-exercise effect of nuclear security real soldier
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, equipment and a system for evaluating the effect of confrontation and drilling of a nuclear security real soldier, wherein the method comprises the following steps: loading a three-dimensional nuclear power plant scene, wherein the three-dimensional nuclear power plant scene comprises an infrastructure model, at least one virtual drilling device and at least one virtual character; receiving state parameters transmitted by a recording server, wherein the state parameters are acquired from drilling personnel participating in the confrontation drilling of the real soldiers or state sensors on the drilling equipment, and each virtual drilling equipment or virtual character corresponds to one group of state parameters; and controlling the action of the corresponding virtual drilling equipment or virtual character according to the state parameter so as to realize the restoration of the confrontation drilling of the real soldier. Compared with the prior art, the method can realize accurate and comprehensive countermeasures of the real soldier in the confrontation drilling, thereby ensuring the objectivity of the assessment of the drilling.
assignees: LINGAO NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD;CHINA NUCLEAR POWER ENG CO LTD;CHINA GENERAL NUCLEAR POWER;CGN POWER CO LTD

title_en: Deterioration simulation system for falling zone of reservoir area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster research, in particular to a reservoir area hydro-fluctuation belt degradation simulation system. The technical scheme simulates the rock mechanical property change of the falling zone rock mass under different water levels, different pressures and different temperature environments, the damage effect of pore water to the rock mass and the deterioration effect of dry-wet circulation to the rock mass, the method is used for improving the ecological restoration capacity and the landscape reconstruction capacity of the bank slope of the reservoir area, reducing the risk of secondary geological disasters in the reservoir area, improving the early warning and forecasting capacity of the geological disasters and guaranteeing the life and property safety of people.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST;CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster first-aid repair decision method considering information fusion of traffic network and power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network post-disaster rush-repair decision method considering information fusion of a traffic network and a power distribution network, which is used for establishing a rush-repair strategy optimization model considering traffic network interruption according to acquired non-electric quantity information such as road congestion interruption under typhoon disasters in order to adapt to the change of an external road environment; and finally, coordinating resources such as construction teams, rush-repair materials, emergency mobile power supplies, power distribution network racks, distributed power supplies and the like on the premise of meeting the safe and stable operation constraint of the distribution network, and deciding the material transportation, construction team restoration, mobile power supply scheduling sequence, network rack reconstruction and island division schemes by aiming at minimizing load loss. The invention fully considers the cooperative optimization of fault first-aid repair and load recovery, achieves the aim of minimum economic loss and simplifies the coding of each part of solution.

title_en: Process method and system for intelligently generating operation order according to power grid maintenance order
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flow method for intelligently generating an operation order according to a power grid maintenance order, which comprises the following steps of: step S1, obtaining the line maintenance information of the current equipment, and maintaining the corresponding line equipment according to the maintenance list issued by the scheduling; step S2, caching the initial information of the equipment, and performing information feedback interaction with the line maintenance information of the current equipment; and step S3, judging the line maintenance state of the current equipment, and judging whether the current equipment line is a power failure ticket or a power restoration ticket. The ticket forming function of the invention mainly helps a dispatcher to quickly generate complex and repeated ticket forming operation, improves the ticket forming efficiency, generates the ticket according to a real-time state, and reduces the error rate, thereby having the advantages of improving the intelligent level of dispatching command and improving the ticket forming efficiency of complex repeated work.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Dynamic simulation and scheduling method and device for coupling water quantity-water quality-aquatic organism integrated community
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic simulation and scheduling method and device for a coupling water quantity-water quality-aquatic organism integrated community, which can quantify the ecological response of an aquatic community to water quantity and water quality and provide scientific basis for key river and lake ecological flow, ecological restoration and scheduling. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, determining a research scene, collecting measured data of a research area, and determining an influence factor and a decision variable of population dynamics; step 2, considering the interaction relationship among multiple populations, the water quantity and water quality effect, population immigration and emigration and the influence of other factors, and constructing a dynamic model of the integrated community coupling the water quantity, the water quality and the aquatic organisms; step 3, calculating the ecological niche width, the environment optimal value and the competition coefficient parameter value in the aggregated community dynamic model based on a quantile regression method and an ecological niche theory; and 4, simulating a collaborative evolution process of a multi-population system in the collective population, and determining the influence degree of water quantity and water quality on the dynamic state of the collective population.

title_en: Urban river prevention and control unit division method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for dividing urban river prevention and control units, which aims at solving the problem of dividing the prevention and control units based on water ecology and water environment characteristics by dividing a water body unit grid and classifying the prevention and control units on the basis of a prevention and control unit dividing index system, refining and adjusting the boundary of the prevention and control unit, analyzing the priority of the prevention and control unit, adopting the method for constructing the index system, dividing the grid of the water body unit, analyzing clusters, analyzing the hierarchy and evaluating the fuzzy, aiming at the prevention and control units dividing the problem of single management and control element, dividing a cutter by unit and the like, provides the urban river prevention and control unit dividing method based on the space basis of the prevention and control units based on the water ecology and water environment characteristics, and can be used for reversely pushing a water pollution treatment and water ecology restoration scheme by a treatment target, thereby not only facilitating pollution reduction performance assessment, but also having practical operability and realizing the rank ordering of the prevention and control units and providing powerful theoretical basis for developing environmental treatment.

title_en: Data preprocessing method applied to intelligent operation platform of large hydropower station
abstract_en: A data preprocessing method applied to a large hydropower station intelligent operation platform introduces a data cleaning model based on a particle swarm optimization two-way long-short-term memory neural network model into the intelligent operation platform data preprocessing function, and realizes reconstruction and repair of 'missing values' or 'abnormal values' in an original monitoring data sequence. Firstly, carrying out iterative optimization on key parameters (m and epsilon) of a two-way long-short-term memory neural network model by utilizing a particle swarm optimization algorithm, then judging whether the data in the characteristic data of the test set is a normal value or an abnormal value or a missing value according to a threshold value P, and finally constructing a PSO-BiLSTM combined model to clean the abnormal value or the missing value in the data of the test set, so that reconstruction and restoration of the missing value and the abnormal value are realized, the information of an initial data sequence is restored to the greatest extent, and reliable data quality is provided for judging the health condition of equipment in real time.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for tamper-proof and restoration of power system data file
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for tamper resistance and restoration of a data file of an electric power system, which relate to the technical field of safety of the electric power system and comprise the steps of calculating an initial content hash value of a file to be protected; storing file names, file contents, absolute paths and initial content hash values of files to be protected into a preset database, monitoring whether the files to be protected exist at intervals of preset time, restoring the files to be protected based on the file names, the file contents and the absolute paths of the files to be protected read from the preset database if the files to be protected do not exist, calculating current content hash values of the files to be protected if the files to be protected exist, comparing whether the current content hash values are identical to the initial content hash values, deleting the files to be protected if the current content hash values are not identical to the initial content hash values, and restoring the files to be protected from the preset database. The invention relieves the technical problem that the data file of the power system in the prior art is easy to be tampered and attacked.

title_en: Real projective image generating method, storage medium and device based on three-dimensional Gaussian model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real projection image generation method, a storage medium and a device based on a three-dimensional Gaussian model, and aims to solve the problems of low image quality, low generation speed, detail loss and the like in the prior art. The method comprises the following steps of firstly obtaining image data through unmanned aerial vehicle or aerial photography, extracting camera gestures and sparse point clouds by utilizing a motion restoration structure (SfM) technology, constructing a three-dimensional Gaussian model based on the sparse point clouds, and carrying out iterative training through top-view orthographic projection combined gradient descent algorithm. In the training process, a densification strategy, a point deleting strategy, a blocking strategy and an image pyramid strategy are innovatively introduced, so that the image detail expressive force and the overall quality are remarkably improved. Specifically, the densification strategy realizes fine detail reconstruction by dynamically increasing the density of the Gaussian balls, and the point deleting strategy improves the rendering efficiency and optimizes the computing resource allocation by eliminating the redundant Gaussian balls; the image pyramid strategy generates a multi-level visual effect through multi-scale training, and the blocking strategy improves reconstruction accuracy through local optimization. Finally, based on the three-dimensional Gaussian model which is completed through training, real-time generation of high-quality real shot images in a large-scale scene can be realized. The method has remarkable advantages in the aspects of efficiency, precision and practicability, provides important technical support for the fields of geographic information systems, urban planning, disaster monitoring and the like, and has wide application prospects.

title_en: Computation of preemptive ranked resiliency measures using probabilistic optimization for enhanced operational resilience of a power system
abstract_en: When an extreme weather event is forecast, an operator of a power system will typically prepare reactive measures, to facilitate the restoration of the power system after it has been damaged by the event. Disclosed embodiments utilize probabilistic optimization to identify and rank resiliency measures in advance of such an event, such that proactive measures may be implemented before the event, to increase the operational resilience of the power system during the event. This enables the power system to better withstand and recover more quickly from the event, thereby reducing downtime (e.g., power outages) and costs. Exemplary resiliency measures include, without limitation, load curtailment, network topology optimization, preemptive electrical islanding, and distributed energy resource (DER) dispatch.

title_en: Route retrieval device, route retrieval method, and program
abstract_en: A route retrieval device according to one aspect of the present invention retrieves routes according to which vehicles are moved to a plurality of bases that provide services to users. The route retrieval device comprises a network information input unit, a status input unit, an order-of-restoration retrieval unit, and an access concentration influence degree calculation unit. The network information input unit inputs network information regarding a network which has a plurality of bases as nodes and links the nodes. The status input unit inputs the status of each of the nodes and links. The order-of-restoration retrieval unit formulates a planning problem for modelling the access concentration of traffic in the network on the basis of the network information and the statuses, and retrieves candidates for the order of restoration of the bases as routes. The access concentration influence degree calculation unit evaluates the influence degree of the access concentration for each of the orders of restoration by using an objective function value obtained by optimizing the planning problem.

title_en: Business Method, Apparatus and System for Monitoring Quantitative and Qualitative Environmental Analytics and Managing Associated Financial Transactions
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system, apparatus, and business method for using financial instruments to provide investment incentive to fund disaster mitigation projects and/or ecosystem restoration projects triggered by real world events detected at set points by sensors and analyzed by computing devices. The detection of events results in the computational analysis and determination of a characteristics of a resilience bond or ecosystem-service bond to be issued or returned to investors. Examples involve sensors used to detect events, including flood damage mitigation, earthquake damage mitigation, or air quality improvement. In one preferred embodiment of the disclosure an investor may make an initial payment into a financial instrument being a resilience bond used to fund a mitigation project, said financial instrument pays phases to the mitigation project developer at the completion of phases of the project that occur prior to the occurrence of a disaster.

title_en: Method for evaluating influence of ecological populus tomentosa on water conservation function based on InVEST model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to water conservation function influence assessment, and particularly relates to a method for assessing influence of ecological populus tremuloides on water conservation function by integrating InVEST models and a multivariate statistical method. The scheme of the invention comprises the following steps: 1) Dividing type information of the wetland remote sensing image, and detecting and analyzing the quantitative relation between the type change of the wetland and the conservation of the water source; 2) Performing hydrologic landform classification on the wetland according to the wetland coverage remote sensing data; 3) Establishing InVEST a model; 4) Calculating the water conservation quantity before and after the change of the regional landscape space pattern to be evaluated by using a InVEST model; 5) And obtaining the degree of the landscape space pattern change to the water conservation function by using a principal component and a cluster analysis method according to the calculation result. The invention adopts InVEST model to evaluate the yield by comparing the water yield before and after each coating engineering change. In addition, land cover variation characteristics of the wetland are determined, and the influence of the water conservation function is evaluated by taking the land cover, climate change and landscape pattern into consideration. The influence on the water conservation function in the ecological poplar-withdrawing engineering is accurately and scientifically evaluated, a valuable reference is provided for the ecological poplar-withdrawing engineering, and the result provides guidance for regional ecological restoration and ecological system function evaluation by the government.

title_en: Power network restoration decision method considering power-natural gas network coupling characteristics
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power network restoration decision method considering power-natural gas network coupling characteristics, which comprises the steps of establishing a power network restoration model based on the power-natural gas network coupling characteristics, establishing the power network restoration decision model based on an augmented Lagrange function, solving the power network restoration decision model based on an ADMM distributed algorithm, and obtaining a power network restoration decision scheme, wherein the power network restoration decision scheme comprises a load restoration scheme, a power supply and air source output planning scheme and a line or pipeline tide. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of high decision efficiency, quick recovery of the power network and the like.

title_en: Black-start partitioning method, system, storage medium and computing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a black-start partition method, a system, a storage medium and computing equipment, wherein the state of a unit to be restored is considered, the unit to be restored in a thermal state is distributed to each black-start partition as evenly as possible, the power restoration speed of each partition is improved to the greatest extent on the premise that the basic requirement of the black-start partition is met, the difference of restoration time of each partition is reduced, the grid-connected waiting time of the black-start partition is shortened, and the power outage loss of a power grid is reduced.

title_en: Post-disaster information-physical cooperative recovery scheme generation method and system for power distribution network considering satellite communication support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for generating a post-disaster information-physical cooperative recovery scheme of a power distribution network by considering satellite communication support, which relate to the field of power distribution networks and are characterized in that the post-disaster information-physical cooperative recovery process of the power distribution network under the satellite communication support is modeled as an MILP (minimum likelihood procedure), the method takes the restoration initial data of the information-physical system of the power distribution network as input, outputs the restoration sequence of each node of the electric power-information network, the information flow distribution path, the load and unit operation scheme, the satellite communication terminal deployment and the disaster time scheduling scheme, and realizes the efficient generation of the information-physical cooperative restoration scheme. Compared with the prior art, the method comprehensively considers the complex coupling relation between the information and the physical system of the power distribution network, considers the supporting effect of satellite communication on cooperative recovery under the background of new-era technical development, is beneficial to guiding the post-disaster efficient recovery of the power distribution network and improves the toughness of the power distribution network.

title_en: Micro-grid post-disaster power supply recovery method and system considering fuel supply elasticity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for recovering power supply of a micro-grid after disaster, which take fuel supply elasticity into consideration. Firstly, a motion path model of a fuel vehicle in a traffic network is built, then fuel consumption models of the fuel vehicle and a gas turbine are respectively built, a micro-grid power supply restoration optimization model considering fuel margin limitation is built, and finally linearization processing and solving are carried out on the built model to obtain a micro-grid power supply restoration optimization result. According to the technical scheme, the fuel supply elasticity is considered in the micro-grid power supply recovery process, so that the continuous and reliable operation of the gas turbine is ensured, and the reliability of the micro-grid power supply recovery scheme after disaster is effectively improved.

title_en: Optical integration system for disaster emergency broadcasting communication
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an optical integration system for disaster emergency broadcasting communication, including: sensor units which detect surrounding temperatures and strains and are separately located from each other;  a broadcasting communication integration unit for transmitting an integrated broadcasting communication optical signal by multiplexing a received broadcasting signal and a received communication signal as optical signals having different wavelengths;  reception units which receive the optical signal transmitted from the broadcasting communication integration unit, demultiplex the received optical signal according to each wavelength, transmit the separated broadcasting signal and the separated communication signal to a corresponding peripheral terminal, and transmit the information detected through the sensor units to the broadcasting communication integration unit;  and a management server for determining a disaster state from the information which is detected through the sensor units and is received through the reception units and the broadcasting communication integration unit, and transmitting a processing signal through the broadcasting communication integration unit to the reception units according to the disaster state when determining the disaster state, wherein the management server transmits a signal to each guiding indication lamp connected to the separately arranged reception units on the basis of a location information database in which the location information of the sensor units is stored according to the recognized disaster state, and transmits an emergency guide broadcasting signal to the peripheral terminal, and each reception unit includes a mobile remote management server which further connects wireless sensor nodes so as to perform communication through the restoration of retrievable wired/wireless networks in the disaster state, and transmits the information through the wireless sensor nodes to the reception units by enabling communication with the management server and enabling remote connection with the wireless sensor nodes. The system of the present invention can induce reconstruction of destroyed power and information communication networks as emergency networks, and active evasion from a disaster area using independent emergency power in the disaster state.

title_en: Weathering crust leaching type rare earth ore in-situ leaching method
abstract_en: The invention provides an in-situ leaching method of weathering crust eluviation type rare earth ore, which comprises the steps of adding an ore leaching agent into an ore body, and adding top water after ore leaching is finished, wherein the top water contains water-absorbent resin microspheres. The method can effectively inhibit clay mineral from water absorption and expansion, prevent landslide, and the injected microspheres have water and fertilizer retention effects, and are beneficial to mine restoration.

title_en: Mechanical embedded fire sprinkler head
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical embedded fire-fighting spray header which comprises a shell, wherein the top end of the shell and the bottom end of a water receiving pipe are integrally formed, a sliding mechanism is installed at the top end of a temperature sensing system, second sliding blocks are fixedly connected to the bottom ends of a plurality of second connecting rods, the outer walls of the second sliding blocks are in sliding sleeve joint with a supporting frame, and a plurality of clamping mechanisms are evenly installed on the lower surface of the inner side of a top cover. This embedded type fire sprinkler of mechanical type, carry out the temperature perception through temperature sensing system, and make in heat transfer to the heat-sensitive material in the splash box, make the heat-sensitive material take place the phase transition when the temperature reaches the target threshold value, make the water receiving pipe open, the fire-fighting water is through water receiving pipe and splash box contact, and the splash is to all around, realize the fire control operation, whole mechanism is lossless except that the fire-fighting water in the course of the work, after the fire control operation is accomplished, upwards promote the support frame, make fixture block and third slide bar looks joint, can realize whole mechanism's restoration, so that reuse.

title_en: Strategic allocation of vehicle energy for supporting household loads during power outages
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides "strategic allocation of vehicle energy for supporting household loads during a power outage". Systems and methods are provided for coordinating and providing bi-directional energy transfer events between an motorized vehicle and a home or other structure during a power outage condition, such as for supporting a household load associated with the structure. In some implementations, the energy available from the vehicle to the structure may be distributed based on the outage restoration estimation. The disclosed systems/methods may provide strategic allocation for bi-directional energy transfer to extend appliance operation for the duration of a power outage condition rather than supporting household loads with constant energy during the power outage condition.

title_en: Method and device for aligning spot daily electricity quantity data and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spot daily electricity quantity data alignment method, a spot daily electricity quantity data alignment device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1, dividing the time periods of each hour in one day into peaks, flat and valleys, and determining the electricity price type of each hour; step S2, performing preliminary fitting according to the daily freezing total data and the divided electricity price types to obtain a fitting hour table code; s3, performing repair calculation on the fitting hour table code to obtain repaired electric quantity data; and S4, writing the repaired electric quantity data into a push table, and marking a fitting mark. According to the invention, the power data is divided into the peaks, the flat and the valleys, and the preliminary fitting data is subjected to restoration calculation, so that the accuracy of the power data can be remarkably improved, a power supply unit can be helped to know the power demand condition more accurately, and more effective power scheduling and pricing decision can be performed.

title_en: Multi-element main body-oriented earthquake emergency treatment method, system, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of information processing, and discloses a multi-element body-oriented earthquake emergency treatment method, a system, a medium and equipment, wherein the multi-element body-oriented earthquake emergency treatment method acquires earthquake emergency treatment information and effects of different departments and different objects, carries out statistical analysis, and summarizes the requirements, effects and characteristics of the different departments and different objects on disaster information and emergency treatment in an earthquake emergency period; and constructing an emergency treatment refinement strategy in a specific scene, and providing a seismic emergency treatment scheme oriented to a multi-element main body. The system comprises a quick response module, an emergency rescue module and a transitional placement and restoration reconstruction module, wherein the system provides a multi-element main body-oriented earthquake emergency treatment scheme, improves the applicability, rationality and scientificity of the earthquake emergency treatment scheme, and provides technical support for effectively integrating earthquake emergency products and emergency decisions.

title_en: Multi-type ant colony algorithm oriented to collaborative optimization of ecological network function and structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ecological network function and structure collaborative optimization-oriented multi-type ant colony algorithm, which designs an ecological network function optimization operator and a fuzzy C-means clustering-based structure optimization operator, integrates a space function and a space structure operator into the multi-type ant colony optimization algorithm, introduces a geographic parallel computing architecture, constructs an ecological network optimization-oriented high-performance land utilization optimization model, and develops plaque-level ecological network function and structure collaborative optimization from the aspects of quantitative and dynamic simulation. The invention can enhance ecological functions such as ecological source quality, plaque connectivity and the like while improving social, economic, ecological and suitability targets, and reduce fragmentation of local ecological networks; in addition, the parallelization calculation framework based on the GPU solves the contradiction between high-precision land utilization simulation optimization and large-scale ecological network construction on calculation efficiency, and provides reference for making fine ecological restoration and land utilization planning decisions.

title_en: Wind power generation data processing system based on double-flow scoring model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power generation data processing system based on a double-flow scoring model, which comprises a data analysis module, an anomaly detection module, a semi-supervised learning module, a data restoration module and a data summarization module. Firstly, the data characteristic attribute is counted by a data analysis module, the initial abnormal condition of the data is analyzed, the quality of the input data is mastered, then the data points which are obviously normal and obviously abnormal are marked by an abnormality detection module, then the data points which are difficult to mark by a common method are thoroughly classified by a semi-supervised learning module, and after the data are repaired by a data repairing module, the data are assembled into a unified format for the subsequent use of various tasks. The invention aims to remarkably improve the abnormality detection accuracy and efficiency of wind power data by combining semi-supervised learning and advanced data processing technology.

title_en: Method for evaluating ecological effect intensity of typhoons in upper ocean layer in summer
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of typhoon strength evaluation, and provides a method for evaluating the strength of the ecological effect of typhoons on the ocean upper layer in summer, which is based on dynamic change information of the response typhoons of ocean upper layer ecological factors obtained by using ocean multidimensional stereoscopic observation modes such as satellite remote sensing, aviation remote sensing, various buoys, shore-based observation, navigation observation, field sampling and the like, and from the perspective of ecological effect, the ecological influence strength of the typhoons on the response sea area through chlorophyll a is evaluated by calculating the accumulated change of chlorophyll a concentration in a mixed layer during the period of the typhoon passing through the border and the period of 8 days at most, and the ecological phenomena such as regional algal bloom, fish shoal aggregation and the like caused by short-term increase of the primary productivity of the ocean upper layer are explained. The method can provide assessment industry decision basis for aspects such as management of China coastal typhoons in the ocean pasture and high-quality development of the deep-open sea fishery industry, management of ocean ecological disasters, restoration and protection of ocean ecology and the like, and is also a specific direction of ocean big data fusion and application.
assignees: CETC GUOHAIXINTONG TECH HAINAN CO LTD

title_en: Disaster prevention monitoring system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To rapidly and properly perform treatment after site confirmation in operation of a fire sensor.  <P>SOLUTION: The fire sensors 18-1 to 18-n connected to a sensor line 14 from a receiver 10 are provided with information transmission/reception parts 20-1 to 20-n connected to a transmission line 16 from the receiver 10. When the receiver 10 is imparted with fire reception, a manager 26 portably carries an information management terminal 24 and heads for the site confirmation. The receiver 10 transmits fire operation information and action guide information to the information transmission/reception parts 20-1 to 20-n, receives wireless transmission from the information transmission/reception parts 20-1 to 20-n, and the manager 26 displays it on the information management terminal 24. The manager 26 sends fire decision operation information or restoration operation information to the receiver 10 through the neighborhood information transmission/reception part 20-(n-1) by switch operation of the information management terminal 24 based on the spot confirmation, and remotely controls decision operation or restoration operation.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Power control system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a power control system which prevents fire caused by flashing off to a leaked gas when power supply is recovered, and performs an automatic restoration of an electric power to an electric facility.  <P>SOLUTION: The system 1 is equipped with a first supply 5, a first circuit breaker 2 installed on the first supply 5, a controller 3 connected to the first circuit breaker 2 and an alarm annunciator 12, and a second circuit breaker 4 branched from an upperstream side than the first circuit breaker 2 on the first supply 5 and connected to the alarm annunciator 12 and the controller 3. In the system 1, the first supply 5 is automatically disconnected by the first circuit breaker 2 when a power interruption occurs due to disasters such as an earthquake and the like. When the power supply is recovered, the power is fed only to the alarm annunciator 12 and the controller 3. When the alarm annunciator 12 detects no gas leakage for a predetermined period of time, the controller 3 restores to open the first supply 5 interrupted by the first circuit breaker 2. On the other hand, the first circuit breaker 2 leaves the first supply 5 as interrupting when the gas leakage is detected.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Data processing apparatus, data processing method, and data processing program
abstract_en: To provide a data processor, a data processing method, and a program capable of supporting a person in charge of restoration support.SOLUTION: The data processing device includes an input unit that inputs an inquiry from a user involved in disaster recovery, and a processing unit that performs specific processing using a data generation model that generates a predetermined inference result according to the inquiry, and the processing unit performs, as the specific processing, processing of generating a guide corresponding to the inquiry by referring to a database that holds a plurality of pieces of support information for supporting the disaster recovery and providing the generated guide to the user who is an inquiry source when the inquiry is received.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3A

title_en: A Simple House
title_ko: 집
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simple house which is a movable dry house with a space creation and restoration function having a movable green-house therein. Moreover, the simple house is manufactured by passing a test of not generating local buckling in a weight up to a designated floor height. Moreover, the simple house is a dry type residential house with excellent resistance against natural disasters. The simple house is formed as a set by a green-house moving on the ground embedded therein, and passes a local buckling test to be robust to the natural disasters, such as earthquake, typhoon, and the like. The simple house avoids a past wet construction method to be formed in an environmentally-friendly construction method so as to provide a home to humankind. Moreover, the simple house is constructed at a good price and a good restoration rate, has better performance than that constructed in the past wet construction method, and is able to be distributed at a low price. In other words, due to the good price and restoration rate, the simple house is able to be moved anywhere and anytime without damage, thereby providing a large profit. The simple house comprises a unit floor and a plurality of wheels.

title_en: Method and system for analyzing spatial heterogeneity of electric power facility affected by flood disaster
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention are a method and system for analyzing the spatial heterogeneity of an electric power facility affected by a flood disaster. The method comprises: upon receiving a disaster early warning of a heavy rainfall defense alarm and a flood disaster emergency response notification, starting an analysis process for the spatial heterogeneity of an electric power facility affected by a flood disaster; according to water level sensing and monitoring information of a disaster-affected electric power facility body, the individual area of each disaster-affected electric power facility region, and the total area of the disaster-affected electric power facility regions, constructing a neural network for measuring the range of damage caused by the disaster of the electric power facility regions, and outputting a monitoring and analysis result of the spatial heterogeneity of the disaster-affected electric power facility regions. According to the method and system of the present invention, by solving spatial distribution indexes of disaster-affected electric power facility regions and drawing a spatial distribution curve of a monitored water level, the problem of describing the spatial heterogeneity in flood damage is solved, thereby helping electric power enterprises to direct the execution of emergency early warning, load transfer, flood control reinforcement, emergency repair and power supply restoration, and material allocation, and greatly shortening the outage duration of power equipment and the outage duration of customers.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network fault reconstruction method based on improved river horse optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault reconstruction method based on an improved river horse optimization algorithm, according to the method, the connected components are used for fault recovery evaluation, the load which can be recovered by a reconstruction mode is determined in advance, and the problem solving complexity is reduced. And then, combining the minimum ring set to encode, mapping the solution space of the power distribution network fault reconstruction problem to the search space of an algorithm, wherein the encoding mode can greatly improve the duty ratio of the effective solution. Then, the traditional river horse optimization algorithm is improved by combining the proposed coding strategy, so that the river horse optimization algorithm can adapt to the discrete optimization problem. And finally, the improved river horse optimization algorithm is utilized to quickly solve the power distribution network fault reconstruction strategy, so that quick power restoration is realized.

title_en: Method and device for repairing measurement data of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for repairing measurement data of a power distribution network, which can be applied to the technical field of measurement data processing of the power distribution network. The power distribution network measurement data restoration method comprises the steps of determining a plurality of historical power distribution network measurement data sequences matched with missing measurement data from a historical data set based on different sequence time steps, generating restoration vectors based on the historical power distribution network measurement data sequences and reference data sequences matched with the historical power distribution network measurement data sequences, obtaining a plurality of target restoration vectors based on the restoration vectors and the restoration vectors after dimension reduction, wherein the restoration vectors after dimension reduction are obtained by dimension reduction of the restoration vectors to be dimension reduced, respectively inputting the plurality of target restoration vectors into a restoration model to obtain a plurality of restoration data, and obtaining target restoration data matched with the missing measurement data based on the plurality of restoration data.

title_en: Superhigh speed permeability paving system and construction method for the prevention of flood, drought, global warming, desertification, elevation of sea level and for the recovery of the underground water
title_ko: 홍수, 가뭄, 지구 온난화, 사막화, 해수면 상승 방지 및 토양지하수 복원을 위한  초고속 투수성 블록 도로포장 시스템과 그 시공 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A superhigh speed permeable block road pavement system for flood, drought, global warming, desertification, sea level lift prevention, underground water restoration and a construction method thereof are provided to filter oil, tire dust, and heavy metals with a decontamination mat installed on a floor under a surface layer and a ground. CONSTITUTION: A superhigh speed permeable block road pavement system for flood, drought, global warming, desertification, sea level lift prevention, underground water restoration is composed of a fabricated structure block(20), a retention tank(52), a water tank(51), a pollution prevention bottom mat(53), a gravel layer(54), a pollution prevention upper mat(55), a sand layer(56), and a surface layer block(10). The retention tank stores water on the top of a ground(50) and passes away water. The water tank stores the water. The pollution prevention bottom mat covers the upper surface of the fabricated structure block. The gravel layer is piled up on the upper surface of the pollution prevention bottom mat. title_en: Continuous and infinite video zoom using hierarchical and lorentzian autoencoders
abstract_en: A system and method for compressing and restoring data using hierarchical autoencoders and Lorentzian autoencoders for video processing. For general data, the system employs hierarchical autoencoders operating at multiple scales. For video data, Lorentzian autoencoders preserve three-dimensional tensor structure where spatial and temporal relationships remain intact throughout compression and decompression. A correlation network, trained on cross-correlated data sets, enhances restoration by leveraging relationships between compressed representations, recovering information lost during compression. The Lorentzian approach enables advanced video features including temporal prediction and infinite zoom, where users can examine regions beyond original resolution with synthesized yet plausible details. This architecture achieves higher compression ratios while maintaining or improving data quality, particularly for video content where spatiotemporal coherence is critical, applicable to surveillance, medical imaging, entertainment, and remote sensing.

abstract_en: The invention discloses it is a kind of for the multicycle send out defeated change repair schedule Security Checking and appraisal procedure,According to repair schedule time span automatic decision calculating cycle,Choose and calculate time point,Generate calculation interval collection,Consolidated forecast data,Planning data,Historical data generates following section,Calculate AC power flow distribution,And realize Security Checking,SCED,Unit Combination adjusts iterative flow,Ground state check analysis and the check analyses of N 1 are carried out to following section tidal current,Check obstructed out-of-date utilization SCED models adjustment unit output,Unit Combination is adjusted when SCED models are without feasible solution,Then Security Checking again,Finally,Front and rear ground state power flow changing is overhauled by comparative analysis,N 1 cut-offs front and rear power flow changing,The larger equipment of power flow changing cut-offs front and rear power flow changing in N 1 before and after maintenance,Influence of the comprehensive assessment overhaul of the equipments to power grid security,Reduce overhaul of the equipments risk,It is horizontal to lift power grid security.

title_en: Power tool acquisition method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an electric power tool acquisition method, an electric power tool acquisition device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring line fault information, and determining target emergency repair work content according to the line fault information; determining electric power tool information related to the target emergency repair work content according to the target emergency repair work content; and determining a target power tool container from the candidate power tool containers according to the power tool information, so as to obtain the power tool from the target power tool container. By operating the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the problem that after a fault occurs, emergency repair personnel often select the tools and the appliances by experience, and the situations of selecting the tools and the appliances in a missing way and selecting the tools in a wrong way often occur in a hurry, so that the tools and the appliances are returned to be taken in the emergency repair process, and the overall progress of emergency repair and power restoration work is seriously influenced can be solved, and the effect of improving the efficiency and the accuracy of obtaining the electric tools and the appliances can be realized.
assignees: MEIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for automatically generating stringing construction scheme
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for automatically generating an overhead line construction scheme, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a three-dimensional terrain model through the survey data, and establishing a working condition model on the three-dimensional terrain model; s2, importing the standard working condition data into the working condition model, determining construction data according to the actual working condition data, and generating a stringing construction scheme; s3, adjusting the disaster model data to verify the robustness of the established stringing construction scheme, generating restoration parameters according to the loss corresponding to different disaster grades, and executing S2 to readjust the working condition model; after the robustness is qualified, executing S4; and S4, inputting the actual working condition data and the construction data into the tool library model, and generating the corresponding number of the prepared tools. The construction data are automatically generated by calculating the calculation data items and the calculation rules of all the construction parts, the robustness of the formulated stringing construction scheme is verified, the list of construction devices is automatically derived, and the design efficiency of the stringing construction scheme is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD CONSTRUCTION BRANCH;ZHEJIANG HUAYUN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for generating power protection and supply full path diagram
abstract_en: The invention discloses a generating system of a power supply protection full path diagram, which comprises: the device comprises a basic data supporting module, an automatic drawing module, a drawing editing module and a drawing management module. According to the technical scheme, the method can replace manual work to carry out mechanical, repetitive and tedious work, continuously improve the dispatching operation efficiency of the distribution network, reduce the load of a basic layer, continuously improve the power supply reliability of the distribution network, and meet the requirements of quick power restoration of the fault of the distribution network and high-quality service of customers.

title_en: Ship track prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship track prediction method and a device, wherein a track distribution range is discretized into a plurality of grid units in a ship navigation area based on the space-time distribution density of ship tracks; acquiring a grid unit corresponding to a current ship track node and adjacent grid units thereof; respectively calculating a cost function of ship position transfer between the current grid unit and the adjacent grid unit; and taking the adjacent grid unit with the minimum cost function as the ship track of the predicted ship position transfer. According to the scheme, reliability evaluation and real track restoration are carried out on original data of the training track before prediction, time sequence factor constraint is added in a ship navigation network diagram, and the time sequence correlation of track data is considered while the spatial correlation of adjacent tracks is described. The size of the grid unit in the ship navigation network is flexibly set based on the space-time distribution density of the ship track.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGJIAO COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vegetation restoration construction method for fragile mountain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vegetation restoration construction method of fragile mountain, which comprises the following steps: s1, evaluating a mountain body, comprehensively evaluating the fragile mountain body, determining the fragile degree and the vegetation restoration requirement, improving the soil in an area where the fragile mountain body is corroded or barren by soil so as to improve the soil quality and the water retention capacity, selecting S3 vegetation, selecting vegetation types suitable for local environments and ecological conditions, planting S4 vegetation, planting the vegetation on the fragile mountain body so as to increase the vegetation coverage rate and the stability of a root system, setting slope protection facilities on a slope, preventing water flow from directly flushing the soil, and irrigating and maintaining S6. The vegetation restoration construction method of the fragile mountain can effectively restore the fragile mountain and manage and maintain the fragile mountain after restoration so as to reduce the risk of geological disasters and protect the safety of surrounding environments.
