title_en: Electric meter and method for cold load start management
abstract_en: Systems and methods for managing connection of a cooling load to a power distribution network are disclosed. A disclosed system for managing connection of a cooling load to a power distribution network includes an electric meter configured to detect a power restoration after a power outage and, in response to detecting the power restoration after the power outage, restart operation and enter a service limiting mode. The electricity meter remains in the service limit mode for a predetermined period of time. When in the service limit mode, the meter accumulates power and compares the accumulated power to a threshold to determine whether to control the service switch to connect or disconnect one or more loads from the power distribution network. After another predetermined period of time, the meter may reconnect one or more loads to the power distribution network and return to normal operation.

title_en: Quality risk assessment method and system for inspection and detection mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a quality risk assessment method and a quality risk assessment system for a checking and detecting mechanism, and relates to the technical field of risk assessment. According to the method, the risk assessment driven by traditional subjective experience is converted into a data-driven quantization model through dynamic weight calculation (network analytic hierarchy process quantization assessment of dependency relationship among parameters) and operation data integration (covering equipment, personnel, history non-conforming items and the like), the risk score is updated based on the operation data, dynamic early warning is triggered, a restoration suggestion scheme is generated by combining historical abnormal cases, so that 'assessment-early warning-restoration' closed-loop management is formed, and the defects of fragmentation and strong hysteresis of the traditional method are overcome. In addition, the evaluation parameters cover the core risk sources from the dimensions of scale, manpower, quality, technology and the like, are mutually dependent and are cooperatively analyzed by a network analytic hierarchy process.
assignees: NANJING CUSTOMS IND PRODUCTS TESTING CENTER

title_en: Systems and methods for restoration of essential systems for catastrophic utility emergency
abstract_en: A method of forming an emergency response and continuity of operations (COOP) area-wide grid of microgrids is provided. The method can include: upon an power outage occurring to an Utility power Distribution grid network, identifying one or more nodes having an electric vehicle service equipment (EVSE) power; forming a power microgrid comprising the one or more nodes; activating a communication payload on the one or more nodes; and forming an area-wide grid of microgrids based on the communication payload and the power microgrid.

title_en: A kind of infosystem realizing the management of distribution network failure fast power restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of infosystem realizing the management of distribution network failure fast power restoration.This system comprises: information sharing module, for providing shared real-time failure message to contact staff, repairing dispatch control person, repair personnel, monitoring management personnel at different levels; Customer service support module, for providing the information inquiry of outage information, repairing progress msg to contact staff; Decision assistant module, provides the analysis decision of problem to each link staff for the failure message that provides according to described information sharing module; Data interaction module, for described information sharing module, described decision assistant module, the conversion of communication data between described customer service support module and external data base.Adopt the present invention, can realize repairing procedural information and transmit in time, become more meticulous coverage, integration system detecting/monitoring, really achieves the unified information management system ensureing channel, assist repairing decision-making, improve telegram in reply flow process, break information barrier.

title_en: A kind of active distribution network multiple faults restorative procedure based on multi-agent system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of active distribution network multiple faults restorative procedure based on multi-agent system, method and step includes: 1) to be divided with failure power loss region division principle to power loss region, DG and active Load Regulation technology are utilized in all subregion, form all subregion autonomy recovery scheme；2) on this basis, the autonomy based on MAS, concertedness and computation capability, obtain that all subregion target is optimal and system globally optimal solution using DBCC algorithm optimization；3) in view of the new fault condition that happens suddenly, when active distribution network happens suddenly new failure, by regional agency dynamic more new strategy, to complete fault restoration work as early as possible, mixed economy loss is reduced, improves and restores efficiency.

title_en: Method for detecting and repairing drainage pipe network GIS abnormal data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for detecting and repairing drainage pipe network GIS abnormal data, which comprises the following steps of firstly preprocessing the drainage pipe network GIS data; then compiling query and repair rules in ArcGIS 'topology' tool box and SQL Server database software to process topology abnormity; constructing an attribute item semi-automatic classification method based on a Jaccard similarity coefficient matrix to classify and repair the drain pipe network text attribute items; an upstream and downstream pipe diameter filling method based on rules is provided for abnormal pipe diameter detection and repair; and the detection and restoration of the elevation of the abnormal pipe section at the multi-way node and the elevation of the abnormal inspection well are realized on the basis of a least square method. Based on the method, the MATLAB language is adopted to develop corresponding programs, man-machine interactive drainage pipe network abnormal data detection and repair are achieved, the method for solving various main data abnormal problems of the drainage pipe network with certain universality can effectively help to improve the data quality of the drainage pipe network.

title_en: Ecological geological environment restoration grade division method for ecologically fragile mining area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for dividing ecological geological environment restoration grades of an ecologically fragile mining area, which comprises the following steps of determining total ecological water demand before and after coal seam mining according to vegetation ecological water demand, surface water evaporation capacity and underground diving evaporation capacity, obtaining the ecological water demand change quantity before and after coal seam mining according to the total ecological water demand before and after coal seam mining, determining the ecological water shortage state of the mining area and dividing the mining area, obtaining the landscape pattern indexes before and after mining area mining, determining the ecological risk state of the mining area and dividing the mining area according to the change of the landscape pattern indexes before and after mining area, and determining the ecological geological environment restoration grade of the ecologically fragile mining area and dividing the mining area according to the division of the water shortage state and the division of the ecological risk state.

title_en: Mobile emergency power supply access point optimization method considering power outage distribution network recovery sequence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile emergency power supply access point optimization method considering the recovery sequence of a power failure distribution network, which comprises the steps of firstly evaluating the fault probability of the distribution network line under extreme natural disasters, and respectively constructing a mobile emergency power supply access point optimization model and a source-network-load-storage cooperative scheduling model considering the recovery sequence, and linearizing and solving the constructed model to obtain an optimized mobile emergency power supply access point optimization scheme considering the recovery sequence of the power failure distribution network. According to the invention, the optimal configuration of the mobile emergency power supply access points is considered in the sequential recovery process, so that the cooperative optimization of the black start node and the recovery path in the power distribution network is realized, the local power generation resources in the power distribution network are utilized to a greater extent, and the power failure time of important loads is reduced.

title_en: Ecological restoration method for water and soil conservation of slope surface of barren mountain in western cold and dry region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water and soil conservation ecological restoration method for a barren mountain slope in a western cold and dry region, which relates to the technical field of water and soil conservation ecological restoration for barren mountain slopes in the western cold and dry region, and aims to solve the problems of ecological weakness and uneven distribution in precipitation years of barren mountain slopes in the cold and dry region, the method effectively utilizes rainwater and ice and snow to melt water, adopts a design mode of water diversion soil ditches, drip pipes and straw grids, slows down the converging flow rate of the rainwater and ice and snow to melt water, reduces the harm of the rainwater and ice and snow to soil erosion, controls water and soil loss or debris flow and stores the slope to be used for recovering vegetation of the slope, builds a mode of retaining ecological self-repairing of the water and soil of the slope of the barren mountain, can reduce flood in mountain areas, prevent water and soil loss of the barren mountain and improve vegetation coverage of the slope of the barren mountain.

title_en: Fireproof cable sleeve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fireproof cable sleeve. The fireproof cable sleeve is composed of a cable bushing, a connection sleeve, a sealing plug and a broken cable alarming system. The cable bushing is composed of at least two sections of cable passing pipes which are connected through the connection sleeve. The connection sleeve is composed of a pipe wall and a baffle, the cable passing pipes are of a hollow tubular structure, the pipe wall is composed of an outer insulation wall and an inner hot melting wall, and the outer insulation wall and the inner hot melting wall are connected through rib plates to form a fireproof cavity. The broken cable alarming system is composed of a power source, a switch, a buzzer, an early warning wire and an adjusting resistor, and the early warning wire is embedded into the inner hot melting wall and surrounds the inner hot melting wall. On one hand, the cable ignition accident can be effectively eliminated in time and an alarm is given out in time, so that the risk that a cable triggers a fire is reduced greatly; on the other hand, the situation that after one cable breaks down and causes a fire, adjacent cables are damaged is effectively and completely eradicated, the fire damage is reduced greatly, the restoration cost needed after a disaster happens is saved largely, the restoration time spent after a disaster happens is shortened, and the efficiency for eliminating the fire accident is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;XIUWU COUNTY ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: VSC-HVDC (Voltage Source converter-high Voltage direct Current) access power system unit recovery sequence decision method
abstract_en: The invention provides a VSC-HVDC (voltage source converter-high voltage direct current) access power system unit recovery order decision method, and relates to the technical field of power systems. The method for deciding the recovery sequence of the VSC-HVDC-access-considered power system unit comprises the following specific steps: inputting system topology basic data and recovery characteristic data to form an AHP evaluation system; quantifying the system recovery process by branch addition and calculating the system strength index M SCR And setting a new recovery branch as l, and nodes at two ends as p and q, wherein p is a recovered node, and q is a newly recovered node, and gradually adding the branch from a direct current drop point k to the outside by the system to obtain the self-impedance of the point k. The invention provides a dynamic decision method combining system strength by considering the strategy research of unit recovery of VSC-HVDC access to alternating current systems with different system strengths, and adopts a step-by-step optimization methodAnd the state of the system can be quickly decided in real time.

title_en: Medium-and-long-term load prediction method considering industry relevance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medium and long term load prediction method considering industry relevance. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of firstly, preprocessing industrial load data aiming at the problems of industrial load data loss and large data magnitude difference, providing an industrial monthly load data restoration method based on iterative interpolation, restoring monthly load data of a typical industry, and carrying out normalization processing on the load data by adopting a min-max standardization method. On the basis, the industry relevance is analyzed and quantified based on the Shapiro-Wilk test and the Pearson correlation coefficient, and the strongly relevant industries are screened according to the relevance indexes. And finally, on the basis of the industry load data, the air temperature data and the industry relevance, predicting the Long-Term load in the industry by using a Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) neural network. The method can realize high-precision medium and long term load prediction by introducing industry relevance analysis.
assignees: JIANGSU FRONTIER ELECTRIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Full life cycle test system for island airport runway foundation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full life cycle test system for an island airport runway foundation, which comprises a power supply module, an upper computer and a lower computer, wherein the power supply module is used for supplying power to the system, the upper computer consists of a control module and a signal excitation and receiving module, and the lower computer consists of a data processing and early warning module. The control module is connected with the signal excitation and receiving module and generates a seismic wave signal through the electric servo control signal excitation and receiving module; the signal excitation and receiving module comprises SPGC and an array type earthquake wave excitation unit and a receiving unit which are integrated on SPGC, and SPGC is used for generating piezoelectric signals when the foundation is subjected to settlement deformation; the data processing and early warning module is connected with the signal excitation and receiving module, analyzes and evaluates the restoration degree and the traffic capacity of the restored foundation, and sends out early warning when the load exceeds the safety traffic capacity or the foundation is deformed greatly. The system of the invention realizes the real-time detection and monitoring of the full life cycle of hidden projects such as airport runway foundations and the like.

title_en: Vegetation analysis method and system for ecological fragile area and grass seed recovery device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vegetation analysis method and system for an ecological fragile area and a grass seed recovery device, and relates to the technical field of ecological vegetation recovery, wherein the method and system comprise the steps of obtaining disturbance area information of power transmission and transformation project, and dividing a zonal area and a non-zonal area based on the disturbance area information of the power transmission and transformation project; analyzing the vegetation information of the regional area to obtain a first analysis result, and analyzing the vegetation information of the non-regional area to obtain a second analysis result; determining a typical vegetation community based on the first analysis result, and performing surface layer delicately soil analysis on the typical vegetation community to obtain a primary soil specificity index; performing anti-sensitivity calculation on the second analysis result based on the influence factors of the non-zonal region to obtain a repair coefficient; and correcting the primary soil specificity index according to the repair coefficient to obtain a regulation-grade soil specificity index, and determining vegetation recovery species based on the regulation-grade soil specificity index. The grass seed recovery device comprises the analysis system and a planting system matched with the analysis system, and completes grass seed configuration operation. The analysis result of the zonal area is combined with the repair result of the non-zonal area to serve as a screening foundation of vegetation restoration species, the influence of factors of the non-zonal area on vegetation construction is considered, the planting survival rate of the finally analyzed species can be improved, and the method is more suitable for rapid restoration construction of vegetation in power transmission and transformation projects of ecological fragile areas.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID EAST INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LIMITED;UNIS SOFTWARE SYSTEM CO LTD;STATE GRID EAST INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN COMPANY LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: River channel section morphological feature recognition method based on remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of river channel segment feature recognition, and particularly relates to a method for recognizing morphological features of a river channel segment based on remote sensing. According to the invention, through multi-source remote sensing data fusion analysis, accurate identification and dynamic monitoring of river channel morphological characteristics are realized, the scientificity and efficiency of river channel management are improved, and through construction of river segment classification and morphological modules, fine data support is provided for river channel ecological restoration and management, so that the intelligent and data requirements of river channel management decisions are supported, meanwhile, through time sequence analysis of restoration nodes and current nodes, effective prediction of the river channel morphological evolution trend is realized, and after the prediction result is output, confidence verification and evaluation are also carried out, so that the reliability and applicability of the prediction result are ensured, corresponding data support can be provided for river channel repair engineering by the prediction result, the river channel morphological change trend can be prejudged in advance, and scientific basis is provided for flood control and disaster reduction and water resource management.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION ECOLOGICAL ENV GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source data set construction method and system suitable for mining damaged land
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining damaged lands, in particular to a multi-source data set construction method and system suitable for the mining damaged lands. According to the mining damage land restoration planning method, the earth surface transition characteristics and the geological transition characteristics are extracted from the image data and the geological data of the mining damage area, the earth surface transition characteristics and the geological transition characteristics are input into the deep learning model to predict the ecological restoration evolution condition and the geological disaster hidden danger probability change trend, the classification model is further combined to predict whether the current mining damage area has the classification result of restoration value or not, multi-source data are utilized to provide the user with omnibearing and valuable data display, and the mining damage land with restoration value is further determined from a plurality of mining damage lands according to the classification result whether the current mining damage area has the restoration value or not to carry out restoration planning. The method provides basic support for implementing ecological restoration of mines by utilizing mining waste lands and classifying in regions and promoting comprehensive utilization of resources such as coal gangue, tailings and the like.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INSTITUTE GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECH GUIDANCE CENTER OF MINIST;TWENTY FIRST CENTURY AEROSPACE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban traffic system toughness enhancement and restoration method based on safe linear interval
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for enhancing and recovering toughness of an urban traffic system based on a safe linear interval, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a time-varying traffic network diagram of an urban road network, identifying bottleneck links of each OD pair, defining limiting links, calculating demand weighting coefficients of the limiting links, providing the safe linear interval for describing the change rule of link quality improvement contribution to network toughness in different intervals, establishing a linear relation between link quality improvement quantity and toughness gain in the safe linear interval, combining the demand weighting coefficients and static connectivity, optimizing weight parameters of a matrix by combining a double-objective optimization method, thereby constructing a traffic network weight matrix, simulating node competition interaction, identifying key nodes, and finally simulating node removal and recovery processes. The invention quantitatively improves the disturbance rejection and recovery capacity of the urban road traffic system, and provides a unified and efficient toughness enhancement and recovery scheme for daily disturbance and post-disaster interruption.

title_en: Disaster prevention system
abstract_en: To provide a disaster prevention system capable of easily restoring an abnormality detection device.SOLUTION: The disaster prevention system 100 includes an abnormality detection device 10 including an abnormality detection unit 12 that detects an abnormality, a transfer output unit that outputs a transfer signal when the abnormality detection unit 12 detects the abnormality, and a control unit 11 that receives a restoration instruction signal and stops the output by the transfer output unit, a control means that executes an application program 26 having a function of receiving an input of a restoration instruction to the abnormality detection device 10 and transmitting a first signal indicating the received restoration instruction, and a control means connected to the control means via a communication network 60 and connected to the abnormality detection device 10. title_en: Automatic closing device and method of vacuum circuir breaker in case of failure recovery by distribution line
title_ko: 배전선로 고장 복구시 진공차단기 자동투입장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic input device and a method of a vacuum circuit breaker in repairing a distribution line fault. The present invention comprises: a relay state detection unit (10) for detecting a relay state value; a voltage current measurement unit (20) for measuring a current value and a voltage value of a distribution line; a central processing unit (30) for receiving a relay state value detected by the relay state detection unit (10), to determine a power outage or power recovery state, receiving the current value and the voltage value measured by the voltage current measurement unit (20) to determine whether or not there is an accident inside or outside, and outputting a circuit breaker control signal by determining a distribution line fault and a distribution line restoration; and a VCB control unit (40) for controlling the vacuum circuit breaker according to the circuit breaker control signal of the central processing unit (30). According to the present invention, the power outage time can be shortened by quickly recovering in the event of a power outage due to a distribution line fault, and the safety of workers can be ensured during power outage recovery.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 배전선로 고장 복구시 진공차단기 자동투입장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 계전기 상태값을 감지하는 계전기 상태감지부(10)와 배전선로의 전류값과 전압값을 측정하는 전압전류 측정부(20)와, 상기 계전기 상태감지부(10)가 감지한 계전기 상태값을 입력받아 정전 또는 복전 상태를 판단하고 상기 전압전류 측정부(20)가 측정한 전류값과 전압값을 입력받아 구내 또는 구외사고 여부를 판단하며 배전선로 고장 및 배전선로 복구를 판단하여 차단기 제어신호를 출력하는 중앙처리부(30)와, 상기 중앙처리부(30)의 차단기 제어신호에 따라 진공차단기를 제어하는 VCB 제어부(40)를 포함한다. 본 발명은 배전선로 고장에 의한 정전 발생시 신속하게 복구하여 정전시간을 단축시킬 수 있으며 정전 복구시 작업자의 안전이 확보될 수 있는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Storage system and data processing method
abstract_en: The present invention comprises a management computer which exchanges information with storage apparatuses and host computers of primary sites and a secondary site via a management network and which manages a data processing performance and a data processing status of each of the sites, wherein, when any of the primary sites is subject to disaster, the management computer selects a normal primary site for which a data transfer time of a restoration target application is within a recovery time objective as a restoration site which possesses processing performance for restoring the application, and remote-copies restoration copy data, which exists at the secondary site, to the storage apparatus of the primary site selected as the restoration site, via a data network.

title_en: System and method for automated fault control and restoration of smart grids
abstract_en: A self-organizing protection coordination system within a power network is provided. The self-organizing protection coordination system in the power network includes a plurality of distribution devices communicatively coupled to each other in a power network. The power network also includes a protection device coupled to each of the plurality of distribution devices configured to transmit power in the distribution network. The power network further includes a controller coupled to each of the plurality of distribution devices. The controller receives communication channel characteristics from a plurality of distribution devices in a distribution network at an interval of time. The controller also computes a delay in time for receiving the communication characteristics. The controller further determines a plurality of reliability indicators at each of the plurality of distribution devices. The controller adjusts tripping characteristics of the plurality of distribution devices to minimize the reliability indicators based on the computed delay.

title_en: Drainage system for landslide ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, in particular to a drainage system for landslide ecological restoration, which comprises a slope body, a protective structure and a reinforcing platform, wherein at least one horizontal water intercepting groove extending horizontally is arranged on the slope body, a supporting grid chamber is arranged at the position of the horizontal water intercepting groove, the supporting grid chamber is provided with a drainage hole, and top openings of a first vertical water collecting well and a second vertical water collecting well are positioned below the drainage hole of the supporting grid chamber; be provided with the overflow mouth in the first vertical sump pit, overflow mouth department is provided with first vertical sump pit of the oblique drainage channel intercommunication of bowing and second vertical sump pit, and the vertical sump pit open-top of second passes through the shutoff of plugging block, and the second that the vertical sump pit bottom of second set up bows oblique drainage channel and communicates to the cistern of consolidating the inside setting of platform, and this technical scheme accelerates the speed of drainage through the vertical sump pit of second when precipitation is great, different drainage speed when having realized different precipitation.

title_en: Ancient landform restoration method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ancient landform restoration method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of oil and gas geophysical exploration engineering and equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: establishing a profile restoration well-connecting grid section corresponding to a preset submerged carbonate slope area, and determining a thickness distribution relation between upper-layer granular carbonate rocks and lower-layer deep water carbonate rocks of the preset submerged carbonate rock deep slope area based on basic data of the preset submerged carbonate rock deep slope area; according to the basic data of the preset submerged carbonate deep water slope area, specific data of preferable earthquake attributes are obtained, a preferable earthquake attribute graph is constructed based on the specific data of the preferable earthquake attributes, and the thickness distribution relation between the upper granular carbonate and the lower deep water carbonate of the preset submerged carbonate deep water slope area is thrown onto the preferable earthquake attribute graph to obtain the paleo-topography of the preset submerged carbonate deep water slope area.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle communication base station and power distribution network collaborative rush-repair method and related device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative rush-repair method and a cooperative rush-repair related device for an unmanned aerial vehicle communication base station and a power distribution network, and belongs to the technical field of power distribution network rush-repair; the method comprises the steps of establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle deployment model with full coverage of fault point communication as a target, dispersing a region to be deployed into a point set by using a discretized position set coverage model, obtaining an optimal position to be hovered of an unmanned aerial vehicle through the unmanned aerial vehicle deployment model, introducing a path table and a time vector, establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle communication path planning model through path constraint and time constraint, establishing a power distribution network rush-repair scheduling model with minimum power failure loss and minimum fault rush-repair time of a power distribution network in a post-disaster rush-repair stage as targets through coupling constraint of fault rush-repair and material scheduling and unmanned aerial vehicle communication time sequence, rush-repair team scheduling constraint and power distribution network operation constraint, and obtaining a cooperative rush-repair strategy of a communication base station and the power distribution network through the unmanned aerial vehicle communication path planning model and the power distribution network rush-repair scheduling model based on the optimal position to be hovered of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Emergency exit guidance lights
title_ko: 비상구 유도등
abstract_en: The present invention provides an emergency exit guidance light which comprises: a cuboid-shaped case including a display unit which is formed on a front surface portion thereof to indicate a location of an emergency exit and an evacuation direction, and an installation space portion which is formed therein; a light-emitting means installed on the inside of the case to emit light to the display unit and having a white LED showing white light, a yellow LED displaying yellow light, and a red LED displaying red light; a heat detecting means made of a shape-memory alloy and connected to and installed on the case to have one end exposed to the outside of the case and the other end disposed inside the case; a gas detecting sensor connected to and installed on the case to detect carbon monoxide; an operation control means connected to the light-emitting means, the heat detecting means, and the gas detecting sensor to allow the light-emitting means to emit light of the white LED before a fire occurs and enable the light-emitting means to emit light of the yellow LED or the red LED when shape restoration of the heat detecting means is achieved by heat or more than a predetermined concentration of carbon monoxide is detected by the gas detecting sensor; and a power supply means connected to the light-emitting means, the gas detecting sensor, and the operation control means to supply power to the light-emitting means, the gas detecting sensor, and the operation control means. Accordingly, provided is the emergency exit guidance light which can be identified at a remote location even in case of a fire having low visibility.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 전면부에는 비상구의 위치와 대피 방향을 지시하는 표시부가 형성되며, 내측에는 설치공간부가 마련된 직육면체 형상을 가지는 케이스,  표시부에 빛을 조사하도록 케이스 내부에 설치하며, 백색빛을 표출하는 백색LED, 황색빛을 표출하는 황색LED, 적색빛을 표출하는 적색LED를 구비하는 발광수단,  일단은 케이스의 외부로 노출되고, 타단은 케이스의 내부에 배치되도록 케이스에 연결 설치하는 형상기억합금소재로 이루어진 열감지수단,  케이스에 연결 설치하며, 일산화탄소를 감지하는 가스감지센서,  발광수단과 열감지수단 및 가스감지센서와 연결되어, 화재가 발생하기 전에는 발광수단에서 백색LED의 빛이 조사되게 하고, 열감지수단의 열에 의한 복원이 이루어지거나 가스감지센서에서 일정농도 이상의 일산화탄소가 감지되면 발광수단에서 황색LED 또는 적색LED의 빛이 조사되게 하는 작동제어수단,  발광수단과 가스감지센서 및 작동제어수단과 연결되어, 발광수단과 가스감지센서 및 작동제어수단으로 전원을 공급하는 전원공급수단을 포함하는 비상구 유도등을 제공한다.

title_en: Automatic cloud-based disaster recovery system including modifying a copy command based on a copy time threshold
abstract_en: Restoration devices in a cloud storage system are paired with source containers associated with a mainframe computer, and series of commands are generated based on the pairings to cause copies of data at the source containers to be stored to the restoration devices. A point-in-time copy of the copy of the data at the source containers may be stored to some restoration devices, and a second copy of the data may be stored to other restoration devices. The restoration devices may be reallocated from inactive source containers. Execution of the commands is monitored, and the commands are modified if the execution of the commands does not satisfy one or more desired conditions. For example, a cycle time associated with copying data to a restoration device may be measured, and if the cycle time exceeds a threshold, the command may be modified.

title_en: Extending deployed cloud infrastructure for disaster recovery sequencing
abstract_en: An approach is provided in which an Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) system is established in a cloud that includes a plurality of virtual machines. Each of the plurality of virtual machines are allocated to one or more of a plurality of datastores based on one or more user inputs. Next, one of a plurality of priorities are assigned to each of the plurality of virtual machines based on the one or more of the plurality of datastores to which each of the plurality of virtual machines is allocated. In turn, the virtual machines are recovered in the cloud in an order determined, at least in part, by their assigned one of the plurality of priorities.

title_en: 0 ° 90 ° zero cement installing engineering governing systems of zero cement soil fixation cylinder and river Hu Hai lands mask
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to ecological management field, 0 ° 90 ° zero cement installing engineering governing systems of specifically zero cement soil fixation cylinder and river Hu Hai lands mask, including solid native cylinder body, the solid native cylinder body connection plunger components, the solid native cylinder body is fixed on mask by the plunger components, described solid native this body sidewall of cylinder is respectively equipped with upper pendant and lower pendant up and down, the through hole of at least one is offered on described solid native this body sidewall of cylinder, soil conservation bag is removably nested in the zero cement soil fixation cylinder, the at least two zero cement soil fixation cylinder with soil conservation bag is mutually seamlessly connected.The system is by flood control mitigation, geological disaster, water and soil conservation, purification of water quality, landscape are made, Cultural Services, restoration of the ecosystem are combined with ecological management, both solved flood, arid, landslide and it is windproof solid native the problems such as, further promote the formation of ecological self-care system, develop and maintain, and the function of ecological management system is magnified.

title_en: Distribution network failure training evaluation method based on information similarity
abstract_en: Distribution network failure training evaluation method based on information similarity, including：Fault Isolation actual information battle array FIPI, recording dispatching person's fault verification and the object information for isolating practical operation are established, establishes Fault Isolation standard information battle array FISI, record fault verification and the object information of isolation standard operation；Load transfer actual information battle array LTPI is established, the object information of recording dispatching person's load transfer practical operation, establishes load transfer standard information battle array LTSI, the load transfer object information after comprehensive description Fault Isolation standard operation；Fault Isolation comprehensive evaluation index FIFI is established, the processing described in dispatcher's process of fault isolation to each bar feeder fault is horizontal；Establish load transfer comprehensive evaluation index LTFI, the processing described during dispatcher's load transfer to each bar feeder fault is horizontal；After dispatcher's Fault Isolation and load transfer operation, comprehensive grading DTS is carried out to dispatcher's Fault Isolation and service restoration operation with weighting method.
assignees: LIAOCHENG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;INTEGRATED ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS LAB CO LTD

title_en: Network security system structure construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network security system structure construction method, which is applied to a security operation center and comprises an evaluation and improvement stage, a monitoring and analysis stage, a response loss stopping stage and a recovery and restoration stage; the evaluation improvement stage is used for providing an evaluation improvement field expert service and an evaluation improvement first-line expert service; the evaluation improvement field expert service comprises a management system construction service, a safety training service and a consultation planning service; the evaluation improvement line expert service comprises an asset identification and management service, a business risk evaluation service, a security notification service, an early warning response service and a residence operation maintenance service; the monitoring analysis stage comprises monitoring analysis field expert service and monitoring analysis first-line expert service; the monitoring analysis field expert service comprises a code audit service, a decompilation service, a penetration test service, an exploit analysis service and a sample analysis service. The invention improves the usability and confidentiality of the information system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution automation-based power grid fault self-healing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution automation-based power grid fault self-healing method, which relates to the field of power system engineering. And the deep learning is used for analyzing history and real-time data, predicting the possibility of faults, and the master station constructs a network topological graph according to the possibility of faults and accurately locates potential fault areas. Fault isolation and non-fault zone power restoration are automatically performed. The fault location is accelerated through the dynamic topological graph, the automatic isolation and recovery strategy is matched, the fault influence is effectively controlled, the power supply reliability and the user experience are greatly improved, the intelligent self-healing of the power grid is realized, the operation is optimized, and the safe and stable operation of the power grid is ensured.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Multi-level energy efficiency evaluation method for restoring polluted soil by in-situ heat treatment coupling technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-level energy efficiency evaluation method for restoring polluted soil by an in-situ heat treatment coupling technology, which comprises the following steps of S1, restoring polluted land, S2, calculating pollutant removal rate, S3, comprehensively evaluating land reuse performance, S3-1, determining a comprehensive calculation formula, S3-2, determining weights, S3-4, checking a judgment matrix, and S4, and evaluating multi-level energy efficiency. On the basis of land utilization modes, the method comprehensively considers human health risks, building safety risks, ecological risks, underground water utilization and soil fertility faced in the subsequent land development and utilization according to the use scenes of different land utilization modes, combines relevant national standards, builds an evaluation method of the comprehensive restoration effect of the localized in-situ heat treatment and the coupling technology thereof, and provides a more comprehensive evaluation method for the restoration technology comparison of the organic pollution sites in China.
assignees: NANJING INST OF ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES MEE

title_en: Three-dimensional visual management system and method for underground water resources
abstract_en: The application discloses a three-dimensional visual management system and method of groundwater resources, and relates to the field of groundwater resource management and pollution control, wherein the system comprises a groundwater data acquisition module, a control module and a control module, wherein the groundwater data acquisition module is used for acquiring groundwater dynamic monitoring data of a target area in real time; the system comprises a groundwater environment digital twin model construction module, a groundwater environment digital twin model and a decision support and knowledge management module, wherein the groundwater environment digital twin model construction module is used for constructing a groundwater environment digital twin model based on groundwater dynamic monitoring data, the groundwater change and pollution control simulation module is used for carrying out numerical simulation of groundwater resource and pollutant migration based on the groundwater environment digital twin model, carrying out pollution control region division and making a corresponding groundwater restoration scheme, and the decision support and knowledge management module is used for integrating the groundwater dynamic monitoring data, the groundwater environment digital twin model, the divided pollution control region and the corresponding groundwater restoration scheme to realize data storage, three-dimensional display, data evaluation and user interaction. The application can realize the efficient management and pollution control of groundwater resources.

title_en: Method and device for determining proper threshold value for river basin vegetation restoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of river basin vegetation restoration and discloses a method and a device for determining a proper threshold value of river basin vegetation restoration, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining reference carbon fixation and emission reduction corresponding to a river basin reference scenario scheme in a target river basin and carbon fixation and emission reduction caused by vegetation restoration corresponding to the river basin vegetation restoration scheme; the carbon sequestration emission reduction caused by vegetation restoration comprises total water energy carbon emission reduction, total vegetation carbon sequestration and total karst carbon sequestration, a carbon sequestration objective function is constructed based on standard carbon sequestration emission reduction and vegetation restoration induced carbon sequestration emission reduction, wherein the carbon sequestration objective function takes natural constraint and vegetation restoration construction constraint as constraint conditions, and the carbon sequestration objective function is solved to obtain a proper threshold value for river basin vegetation restoration. The method can quickly and reliably calculate the proper scale of the river basin vegetation construction, provides scientific and technological support for the river basin water carbon resource simulation, evaluation, regulation and control and vegetation construction planning, and has important significance for realizing the 'double carbon' target.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER THREE GORGES GROUP IND DEVELOPMENT BEIJING CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Method for repairing soil after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-fire soil remediation method which comprises the following steps of first fire soil diagnosis and pretreatment, second gradient pyrolysis biochar preparation and application, third composite microbial inoculant inoculation and fourth nutrient regulation and plant combined remediation. The invention realizes the cooperative regulation and control of the pH value of soil, heavy metals and organic pollutants after fire disaster by the combined application of the gradient pyrolysis biochar, and simultaneously adopts the carrier embedding technology to obviously improve the survival rate and the colonization capacity of functional microorganisms in a high-temperature environment. The method can effectively shorten the restoration period, remarkably restore the ecological function of the soil, greatly reduce the restoration cost through the use of localized materials, and integrally solve the problems of poor adaptability, low efficiency, high cost and the like in the traditional restoration technology.

title_en: Emergency scheduling method and system for electric automobile participating in power restoration of power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to an emergency dispatching method and system for an electric vehicle to participate in power restoration of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a quotation interval by checking own cost and estimating opposite side cost, constructing a multi-round price negotiation model of dynamic yield according to a dynamic yield negotiation mechanism, determining a final price, determining a fuzzy reasoning rule according to a state of charge and time flexibility, constructing a fuzzy model of user response will of the electric vehicle, determining user response will, calculating the total discharge capacity of the vehicle, establishing a multi-objective optimization function, and solving to obtain an electric vehicle discharge plan, wherein the optimization targets of the multi-objective optimization function comprise minimum economic loss of a power failure area, maximum user discharge compensation and maximum continuous power supply of important load, and integrating the final price, the user response will and the electric vehicle discharge plan to obtain the emergency dispatching method. The application can realize the benefit balance of the power grid and the user, improve the utilization efficiency of electric automobile resources and obviously reduce the power failure loss.

title_en: Dynamic identification and restoration decision method for underground water funnel area
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic identification and restoration decision method for a groundwater funnel area, and belongs to the technical field of water conservancy optimization based on deep learning. The method comprises the steps of constructing a high-dimensional groundwater state data set, then establishing a groundwater evolution numerical model by utilizing the data set to realize dynamic and accurate extraction of a three-dimensional boundary and key characteristic parameters of a funnel region, carrying out high-fidelity and uncertainty quantitative rapid prediction on the change of a future water head field on the premise of following a physical rule of groundwater dynamics by utilizing a deep learning prediction model cluster, and finally taking the prediction model as a decision deduction environment, training an agent by utilizing a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to enable the agent to learn autonomously and generate an optimal repair management and control strategy taking the repair benefit, the economic cost and the sustainability into consideration. The invention forms a closed loop intelligent system capable of autonomous learning and continuous optimization, and provides a scientific, efficient and system brand new solution for underground water resource management.
assignees: SHANDONG PROVINCIAL LAND SPACE ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION CENTER SHANDONG PROVINCIAL GEOLOGICAL DISASTER

title_en: Photovoltaic output prediction method and system based on QPSO-LSTM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic output prediction method and a system based on QPSO-LSTM, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation prediction. Collecting photovoltaic output historical data and relevant meteorological data, carrying out anomaly detection by combining STL decomposition with local anomaly factors, carrying out data restoration and reconstruction by using a K nearest neighbor method, and generating a training sample through normalization processing. And carrying out global self-adaptive optimization on the super parameters of the LSTM by using the QPSO to obtain an optimized QPSO-LSTM distributed photovoltaic output prediction model. And inputting the real-time observation data of the target area into the optimized model, and outputting a predicted value. The invention effectively overcomes the defects that the traditional LSTM model depends on empirical parameter adjustment and is easy to be trapped into local optimum, remarkably improves the prediction precision and model robustness, and provides reliable technical support for power grid optimization scheduling.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JINZHAI COUNTY POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Game machine
abstract_en: To simplify display control processing in a game machine.SOLUTION: A power outage restoration screen 1201 is the screen display that is constituted by at least a display layer L1 for displaying an error notification screen, a display layer L2 for displaying a power outage restoration screen and a display layer L5 including a small pattern group 502, a special pattern 1 reservation number display 503 and a special pattern 2 reservation number display 504 as display contents, the display layer L2 is arranged in front of the display layer L5, and the display layer L1 is arranged in front of the display layer L2. A performance control device generates the image display of the small pattern group 502, the special pattern 1 reservation number display 503 and the special pattern 2 reservation number display 504 even in a state where observation cannot be performed on the power outage restoration screen 1201. The error notification screen on the display layer L1 may be displayed even after switching to a customer-waiting demonstration screen, a variable display screen, and a win screen since it is displayed independently of the power outage restoration screen.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 185

title_en: System and method for managing service restoration in a utility network
abstract_en: Some embodiments include a computer-implemented restoration work plan system and method comprising a processor, a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium in data communication with the processor, and a service restoration management system executable by the processor, and configured to prepare a first distribution system operations storm outage prediction project model forecast substantially in real time based at least in part on a weather forecast. Some embodiments include calculating and displaying an expected outage category level substantially in real time for each division based on the weather forecast, and resource numbers comprising the number of personnel needed to respond to outages and the number of crew needed to repair outages. Some embodiments include calculating and displaying an estimated time of repair within the repair plan based at least in part on a historical productivity assumption, the productivity assumption including a historical rate of assessment and repair and percentage of outages requiring repair.

title_en: Compressing and Restoring Data Using Hierarchical Autoencoders and Correlation Networks
abstract_en: A system and method for compressing and restoring data using a hierarchical multi-level autoencoder architecture and correlation network. The system compresses data using a cascade of autoencoders, each focusing on different scales or features, allowing for efficient representation across various resolutions. Data restoration employs a corresponding hierarchical decoder structure and a correlation network, trained on cross-correlated data sets. This approach leverages inter-data relationships at multiple scales, potentially recovering more lost information than traditional single-scale methods. The hierarchical structure adapts to diverse data types, achieving higher compression ratios while maintaining data quality, applicable to fields such as remote sensing, IoT data processing, and multimedia compression.

title_en: System and Method for Compressing and Restoring Data Using Hierarchical Autoencoders and a Knowledge-Enhanced Correlation Network
abstract_en: A system and method for compressing and restoring data using a hierarchical multi-level autoencoder architecture and correlation network. The system compresses data using a cascade of autoencoders, each focusing on different scales or features, allowing for efficient representation across various resolutions.
