title_en: A kind of remote sensing image landslide monomer division methods
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of remote sensing image landslide monomer division methods.This method includes：Based on the multispectral image data and dem data of survey region, carries out landslide extraction and obtain landslide object；NDVI standard deviation threshold methods are set, are merged obtained landslide object using blending algorithm；Making fused landslide object using the common boundary length threshold between landslide, further fusion obtains landslide trunk；And account for landslide perimeter percentage threshold using common boundary and landslide trunk is merged with surrounding landslide object, obtain landslide monomer.The landslide object that extraction obtains can be then divided into landslide monomer one by one by landslide monomer division methods according to the present invention, avoid the occurrence of unreasonable huge landslide areas.Particularly, rapid evaluation can be carried out to a wide range of landslide disaster caused by earthquake or heavy showers, obtains the area and quantity of landslide disaster, reference is provided for emergency management and rescue after calamity and restoration and reconstruction work.

title_en: Micro-grid data fault diagnosis method based on intelligent power monitoring instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microgrid data fault diagnosis method based on an intelligent power monitoring instrument, which comprises the following steps: (10) constructing a physical constraint equation: generating a physical relation constraint equation according to the topological connection relation and the physical relation; (20) and (3) timing initiation diagnosis: initiating a diagnosis task regularly by setting a diagnosis period; (30) acquiring microgrid data: obtaining original data and power parameters of system operation, including voltage and current monitoring values; (40) establishing a data restoration and fault diagnosis model: setting a target function based on the power parameters, and establishing a centerless data restoration and diagnosis optimization model; (50) and (3) distributed optimization solution: solving an optimization equation, and solving an estimated value of the electric power parameter of the micro-point network; (60) fault diagnosis and repair: and comparing the fault database to obtain the fault type, repairing the error data and issuing a warning notice. The micro-grid data fault diagnosis method has strong robustness and high operation efficiency.

title_en: Power distribution network fault recovery method based on Monte Carlo tree search and neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network fault restoration, in particular to a power distribution network fault restoration method based on Monte Carlo tree search and a neural network, which comprises the following steps of 1, acquiring an active power flow matrix and a regional restoration time matrix of a power distribution network, and constructing a power distribution network fault restoration process through the representation of the active power flow matrix and the regional restoration time matrix; the regional repair time matrix is obtained after the historical repair time of each regional feeder line of the power distribution network is processed, and step 2, a reference value, a constraint condition and a state space of an action space of fault recovery are confirmed, wherein the constraint condition is resource constraint of fault recovery, the state space is a set of power distribution network states, and the action space is a set of repair decisions. The method can enable the maintenance guidance scheme to be applied to actual maintenance procedures filled with various accidents and compromises.

title_en: Fire scene low-quality image recovery method for rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire scene low-quality image recovery method for a rescue robot. The method is based on a region threshold segmentation algorithm to segment flame regions, avoids the influence of a flame light source on global atmospheric light estimation, designs an atmospheric light detection operator, obtains accurate atmospheric light parameters based on super pixel blocks, solves the problem of global atmospheric light estimation distortion, constructs a transmissivity estimation optimization module, realizes refinement of transmissivity based on a bilateral weighted guide filtering method, and solves the problems of halation and the like caused by the traditional method. The method provided by the invention is beneficial to improving the definition degree of the scene image restoration of the fire disaster, and improves the scene detection, identification, environment map building and path planning of the rescue robot to provide a data basis.

title_en: Improved Distribution Board seismic device
title_ko: 개선된 수배전반 내진 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an improved distribution board seismic device which implements a seismic device having seismic isolation and seismic functions and a support for bolt fastening in one device to absorb and disperse a seismic force that vertically and horizontally vibrates to lengthen a natural period so as to reduce and extinguish the seismic force, enable restoration of the original state of the seismic device to a normal state by replacing only the support after an earthquake so as to maintain intrinsic modulus of elasticity so as to maintain an intrinsic modulus of elasticity of a spring when an earthquake occurs, and enable compact design and manufacture and have no need of a concrete structure like the prior art so as to drastically reduce processes and costs according to seismic device installation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 개선된 수배전반 내진 장치에 관한 것으로, 하나의 장치에 면진 및 내진 기능과 볼트 체결용 지지대를 갖는 내진 장치를 구현함으로써, 수직 수평으로 진동하는 지진력을 흡수하고 분산시켜 고유주기를 길게 하여 지진력을 감소 및 소멸시키고, 지진 발생 이후에는 지지대의 교체만으로 내진 장치를 평소 상태로의 원상복구가 가능하여 지진이 발생할 경우 스프링의 고유 탄성계수를 유지시킬 수 있으며, 또한 콤팩트하게 설계 및 제작이 가능하고 종래 기술과 같이 콘크리트 구조물이 필요 없기 때문에 내진 장치 설치에 따른 공정과 비용을 크게 줄일 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Fast reformation in a directed acyclic graph based on deferred contention to higher devices
abstract_en: A network device stores in its nonvolatile memory, in response to detecting a power outage in a tree-based network, an identifier for a preferred parent and a distance identifier for the network device within the network. In response to power restoration, the network device starts a trickle timer based on the ring identifier, for determining whether a beacon request from a transmitting node and destined for the preferred parent is detected during the waiting interval. In response to the network device detecting the beacon request during the waiting interval, the network device sets its channel hopping schedule to the corresponding channel hopping schedule of the transmitting node in response to determining the beacon request is destined for the preferred parent, enabling rejoining with the preferred parent in response to detecting a beacon from the preferred parent to the transmitting node via the corresponding channel hopping schedule of the transmitting node.

title_en: Commercial power restore indicator for sites, such as for cellular telecommunications sites
abstract_en: Systems and methods are described herein for determining the restoration of power at a site, such as the restoration of commercial power to a cell site within a telecommunications network. The systems and methods may be utilized to determine whether power is restored at a cell site when a generator is currently or temporarily providing power to the cell site (e.g., during a power outage on a utility grid that provided the power to the cell site), such as by determining the presence of a generator is running alarm message and the absence of a commercial power failure message, among other messages.

title_en: Method for conducting ecological restoration in mine geological disaster region
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for conducting ecological restoration in a mine geological disaster region. The method includes the following steps: (1) breaking coal gangue through a breaking machine into broken blocks with the diameter as 2-5cm, utilizing the coal gangue to pave the collapsed and sedimentation region and leveling the land to be treated; (2) paving a separation layer on the surface of the land to be treated and paving a soil coal gangue partition layer on the surface of the separation layer according to the interval of the soil and the coal gangue; (3) arranging a plurality of vertical separation layers on the connection position of the coal gangue and the soil interval layer, and certain close distances are reserved between the vertical separation layers; (4) filling the gaps between the separation layers with a plant soil layer and the coal gangue mixing layer at intervals. The coal gangue mixing layer is composed of a coal gangue layer, a lime layer, a soil layer and the coal gangue layer from bottom to top. The separation layers are formed by pressing the lime, the clay, quartz sand and water. By means of the method, the ecological environment of the mine ecological disaster region can be greatly improved, the plant survival rate is improved, and the coal gangue stacking problem is solved.

title_en: Non-coal mine environment restoration engineering grading method
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-coal mine environment restoration engineering grading method, and relates to the technical field of environment restoration. The method comprises the steps of firstly, determining a non-coal mine environment restoration project grade division object; then considering the influence degree of the mine geological environment of the project area to be repaired, the risk of the mine geological disaster and the natural repair capability of the area to be repaired in the repairing and treating processes, and dividing the project area to be repaired of the non-coal mine mountain environment into four grades; and then endowing different weights for each specified evaluation index according to the importance degree, assigning the influence degree grade of each evaluation index, and linking each specified evaluation index by constructing an objective function so as to complete the grade division of the non-coal mine environment restoration engineering. The method takes the land planning attribute after restoration as a starting point to obtain a non-coal mine environment restoration project grading object, and by setting an analysis method of a target function, the grading is more objective by mainly quantitative analysis and calculation and by assisting qualitative analysis.
assignees: ZHONGMAO SHANGQING ENGINEERING TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Mining area soil restoration ecological net and restoration method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining area ecological restoration, in particular to a mining area soil restoration ecological net and a restoration method thereof. According to the invention, the ground grabbing capacity of the block net is improved through the support columns, a certain distance is reserved between the block net and the slope surface, the water and soil holding capacity of the block net is increased, the loss and landslide of foreign soil are reduced, the anchor pipes are extruded by the expansion rods due to water absorption and expansion of soil in a short period through the arrangement of the anchor pipes, so that the anchor pipes are connected with the ground more firmly, and the block net, the anchor pipes and the expansion rods are gradually decomposed and disappear by microorganisms in the soil in a long period, so that the pollution to the environment is reduced, meanwhile, the continuous constraint and extrusion of green plant root systems are avoided, and the green plant growth is facilitated.
assignees: JIANGSU VOCATIONAL TECH COLLEGE FOR SHIPPING

title_en: Post-disaster restoration method for existing bridge
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bridge treatment, in particular to a post-disaster resetting method for an existing bridge. According to the technical scheme, the earthquake-damaged beam body of the earthquake-damaged bridge is supported and centered, and then a static load test and a dynamic performance test are carried out on the centered beam body, so that the stress performance of the centered beam body is obtained; according to the stress performance, corresponding reinforcing measures are determined and the righting beam body is reinforced to obtain a reinforcing beam body so as to reset the earthquake damage section, so that the method can righting, resetting and reinforcing the earthquake damage section of the existing bridge after encountering geological disasters in the implementation process, further can repair the bridge after encountering geological disasters, and overcomes the defect that the bridge after encountering earthquake damage cannot be reset in the related technology.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 20 BUREAU GROUP CORP;NO 3 ENGINEERING CORPORATION LTD OF CR20G

title_en: Unmanned ship operation method for cooperative fish and bird identification and water ecological co-treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent water area ecological management and discloses an unmanned ship operation method for synergetic fish and bird identification and water ecological co-treatment, which comprises the following steps of S1, starting an unmanned ship and completing operation preparation; S2, acquiring real-time environment data including fish activity data, bird activity data and water environment parameters in a water area, S3, analyzing the fish activity data and the bird activity data, extracting population distribution, dynamic behaviors and activity rules of fish and birds, S4, analyzing the water environment parameters, S5, executing an ecological restoration task based on distribution characteristics of the fish and the birds and a water quality analysis result, S6, uploading the data after the task is completed to a cloud platform. According to the invention, the optimal operation path is generated by combining the real-time water quality data and the ecological requirements through the path planning and scheduling module, so that the technical effect of efficiently scheduling unmanned ship operation in a complex water area environment is achieved.
assignees: JIANGSU SHENWU ADVANCED TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ENG DESIGN INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Low-power-consumption hardware encryption system based on geological disaster monitoring scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hardware encryption and discloses a low-power-consumption hardware encryption system based on a geological disaster monitoring scene, which comprises a layering architecture module, an encryption and decryption module, a key management module and a security protection module, wherein the layering architecture module is used for constructing a terminal perception layer and a cloud platform layer, generating a three-dimensional risk thermodynamic diagram, carrying out short-term early warning model and emergency deduction, carrying out multi-dimensional identity verification based on protocol layering and national encryption algorithm fusion, carrying out dynamic management and eavesdropping monitoring on a key, optimizing a data processing flow, establishing whether encryption or decryption is needed for dynamic negotiation of a security channel, carrying out processing and risk assessment on monitored data, adopting a dynamic key period according to a generated risk level, carrying out key backup and recovery, and the security protection module is used for carrying out intelligent management on system power consumption, adopting a dynamic compression algorithm, selecting a compression strategy according to data types, carrying out security monitoring on hardware and firmware, carrying out intrusion monitoring on the system and carrying out automatic restoration.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INSTITUTE GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECH GUIDANCE CENTER OF MINIST

title_en: Water area environment restoration method for aquaculture tail water wetland
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of aquaculture, and provides a water area environment restoration method of a cultivation tail water wetland, which divides a water area of the cultivation tail water wetland into a plurality of subareas, wherein a water quality sensor is arranged in each subarea, the water quality sensor collects and stores water body data of the subareas, the water body data of the subareas are input into a preset neural network model, a water body quality evaluation value of the subareas is generated, and the water area is restored according to the water body quality evaluation value of each subarea. The method can identify the water area environment quality of the aquaculture tail water wetland in a blocking manner, analyze the distribution characteristics of the aquaculture water quality by combining a real-time sensing technology and a neural network model, further locate the water quality deterioration area and the diffusion path thereof, improve the restoration effect, reduce the cost consumption of the traditional sampling analysis method, replace the global treatment by targeted measures, and provide an economic and efficient solution for the large-scale aquaculture tail water treatment.
assignees: GUANGDONG NO 3 WATER CONSERVANCY & HYDRO ELECTRIC ENG BOARD CO LTD

title_en: Urban subway network toughness pre-disaster-post-disaster double-stage optimization method under flood disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a pre-disaster-post-disaster double-stage optimization method for toughness of an urban subway network under a flood disaster, which comprises the steps of obtaining urban subway network information, road network information and flood disaster information, constructing an urban subway topological network and a road topological network, simulating flood depth space-time changes in the subway and the road network during the duration of the flood disaster, judging a subway network failure station set based on water accumulation depth, calculating flood control resource demand based on the number of stations, the types of the stations and the flood depth of each station in the failure station set, establishing and solving a pre-disaster-post double-stage optimization model for toughness of the urban subway network to obtain an optimal pre-disaster closing station decision, a flood control resource warehouse site selection decision and a post-disaster restoration decision, wherein the double-stage optimization model is a double-layer planning model, and an upper-layer model and a lower-layer model are mutually coupled and optimized through a pre-disaster closing station set and a post-disaster restoration process.

title_en: Rubber compaction block
title_ko: 고무 다짐 블록
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A rubber compaction block is provided to reopen the passage of pedestrians or vehicles after a road construction by simply and safely covering road pavement. CONSTITUTION: A rubber compaction block comprises a main body(100) formed with a filling groove of specified depth, a filling part(200) composed of a filling frame(210) with a charge groove which is depressed opposite to the filling groove, a filler(300) inserted in the charge groove of the filling part, and a compaction part(400) with a compaction plate(410).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기존 도로 포장의 일부 또는 전체를 제거하여 시행하는 각종 도로 공사에서 제거된 포장면을 커버하기 위한 고무다짐블록에 관한 것으로서, 구체적으로 제거된 포장면 상부에 운반 및 설치, 해체가 간편한 블록을 설치하여 제거된 포장면을 신속하고 안전하게 커버하여, 공사를 수행하는 중에도 사람 및 차량의 통행을 가능하게 하여 공사로 인한 교통 정체발생을 차단하여 안전하고 쾌적한 건설환경을 제공하고, 견고한 다짐 기능을 제공하여 안전하고 신뢰성이 향상된 공사를 시공할 수 있도록 하고, 부실공사를 방지하며 기존에 이중적으로 투입되었던 공사비를 절감하며, 현재 시행하고 있는 임시포장(가포장) 또는 이중포장으로 인한 자원 낭비 및 공사비 증가를 방지하여 건설사 원가 절감을 극대화시키고, 공사의 품질을 향상시키고 부실공사를 방지하므로 궁극적으로 국가예산 절감을 도모하며, 재활용 자재의 사용으로 자원 낭비를 막고, 환경파괴를 줄일 수 있으며, 국가재난시 도로 응급복구용으로도 사용이 가능하여 국민의 안전과 재산을 지킬 수 있도록 한 고무다짐블록을 제공하려는 것이다.

title_en: Management method and device for virtualization platform disaster tolerance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management method for virtualization platform disaster tolerance, which comprises the following steps: after a fault switching node in a virtualization platform is started, when an IP address of a source host with a fault in the virtualization platform is received, a storage space is created, and backup data in the storage pool are led into the storage space according to the IP address; and determining the virtual machine which needs to be restored in the fault source host and executing the restoration operation according to the backup data imported in the storage space. By the scheme of the invention, the management of the virtualized platform disaster tolerance is more convenient, and the efficiency of the disaster tolerance is improved.

title_en: Subway dominant abdominal ground travel chain generation method based on mobile phone positioning data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a subway dominant abdomen ground travel chain generation method based on mobile phone positioning data, which comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring mobile phone positioning data; step 2: acquiring all subway link tables in the urban subway network according to the geographic information of the railway network; step 3: judging the origin-destination of the passenger flow of the subway station based on the mobile phone positioning data; step 4: space competitive advantage analysis of passenger flow abdominal land based on mobile phone positioning data generates station passenger flow travel chain OD data; step 5: checking subway passenger flow abdomen and station OD distribution based on multivariate data. The method effectively improves the accuracy of abdominal analysis and path restoration of the subway passenger flow whole sample, and greatly reduces the cost. The method has the advantages that the subway station dominant service range and subway passenger flow abdominal land analysis of different regional station classification are carried out through low-cost, wide-coverage and high-sampling-rate mobile phone positioning data, and then the source abdominal land and data check of the whole-sample distributed passenger flow of the subway are realized by combining the surrounding land utilization and population coverage of the station, so that a complete travel chain of the subway passenger flow travel is generated, and technical support is provided for traffic planning and subway design managers in the aspects of track competitive dominant analysis and passenger flow guidance.

title_en: Digital twinning lamp landscape digital restoration data analysis system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a festival lantern landscape digital restoration data analysis system and method based on a number Li Sheng, which are used for analyzing the festival lantern ornamental dangerous situation through the connection structure situation of each position of the festival lantern and the flow situation of each position of ornamental persons, predicting the festival lantern operation abnormality through the connection of the festival lantern operation situation and the connection structure situation, the application realizes the advanced prediction of the stability of the festival lamp and the abnormal fire disaster by a chain of 'data quantification risk-accurate decision-dynamic regulation', and improves the real-time performance of the hazard maintenance of the festival lamp.

title_en: Engine starting system for ships in an emergency
title_ko: 비상시 선박의 엔진 시동 시스템
abstract_en: A system for starting an engine of a ship in an emergency situation is disclosed. The system for starting an engine of a ship in an emergency situation comprises a compressed air system and a power restoration device. The compressed air system comprises: a compressed air storage tank storing compressed air; an independent compressed air container; and a compressor compressing air to supply the compressed air to the compressed air storage tank or the independent compressed air container. The power restoration device comprises: a first switch installed to supply power preserved in a battery in an emergency situation; and resistance connected with the first switch in series to prevent damage to a circuit. Moreover, the first switch is opened under normal circumstances and closed in an emergency situation.
abstract_ko:
비상시 선박의 엔진 시동 시스템이 개시된다. 
상기 비상시 선박의 엔진 시동 시스템은, 압축공기를 저장하는 압축공기 저장탱크; 독립된 압축공기병; 및 공기를 압축하여 상기 압축공기 저장탱크 또는 상기 독립된 압축공기병에 압축공기를 공급하는 압축기;를 갖는 상기 압축공기 시스템; 및 비상시 배터리에 보존된 전력을 상기 엔진에 공급하기 위해 설치되는 제 1 스위치; 및 회로 손상을 방지하기 위해 상기 제 1 스위치와 직렬로 연결되는 저항;을 갖는 전력 복구 장치;를 포함하고, 상기 제 1 스위치는 평상시에는 열려있다가 비상시 닫히도록 조절된다.

title_en: Mud-rock flow ditch bed ecological restoration system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ecological restoration system for a debris flow gully bed. The structure comprises retaining walls on two sides, a spur dike group which is arranged between the retaining walls and connected with the retaining walls and matched with the spur dike group, and a crust layer and a arbor forest which are planted among the spur dike group. The T-dam group consists of a plurality of lower-chosen T-dams with a certain burial depth, and each two stages of the T-dams are distributed according to a certain interval and are used for beam current and arbor in a protection gap. Compared with the prior art, the method reduces erosion of the gap ditch bed of the double-side spur dike by adjusting the directions of the mud-rock flow and the water flow in the ditch, provides a stable growth environment for vegetation of the ditch bed, solves the problem of high ecological restoration difficulty of the mud-rock flow ditch bed, is beneficial to ecological restoration of a river basin, can reduce erosion of the running water to the spur dike group and the retaining wall after plants in the gap grow, solves the problem of easy failure of geotechnical engineering, and is beneficial to long-term operation of the ecological restoration system.

title_en: Power system load restoration auxiliary decision system and decision generating method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system load restoration auxiliary decision system and a decision generating method of the power system load restoration auxiliary decision system. According to the power system load restoration auxiliary decision system, a B/S architecture is adopted, and the power system load restoration auxiliary decision system comprises a database server where a structured query language (SQL) Server engine is installed, an algorithm server where a load restoration calculation engine and algorithms are installed, a Web server where a load restoration project management engine is installed, a system diagram template client where a power grid primitive management engine is installed, and a Web client, wherein the database server, the algorithm server, the Web server, the system diagram template client and the Web client are connected through a network. The decision generating method includes that power grid single-line diagrams and power grid data are stored in the database server; a Web browser in the Web client is opened to operate the load restoration project management engine in a remote mode; the power grid single-line diagrams stored in the database server are managed to establish corresponding data management tables; and the load restoration project management engine invokes the algorithms in the algorithm server to generate a load partitioning scheme and load restoration grid structures of all partitioned zones. The power system load restoration auxiliary decision system is low in cost and easy to maintain, and information can be fully synchronized.

title_en: Power grid dispatching determining method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid dispatching determining method and system and relates to a power grid dispatching simulation method and system. Currently, power grid faults are frequently influenced by outside environments, and under extreme weather conditions, people can only wait for happening or developing of faults or accidents passively and cannot conduct prognosis and prevention on dispatching risks initiatively. A power grid structure and topological information are obtained from a power grid SCADA/EMS system, spare power automatic switching information is automatically generated, a repair schedule is combined, and the state information of a spare power automatic switching device is adjusted; combination with weather information can be achieved, the change of equipment outage probability is calculated, the load shedding amount is calculated specific to a threshold-crossing device and a power outage device, and early warning is given specific to large risk changes. According to the technical scheme, a dispatcher can find various risks in the operation process of a power grid in time.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Planned power failure active monitoring and scheduling method based on metering terminal alarm technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a planned power failure active monitoring and scheduling method based on a metering terminal alarm technology, which comprises the following steps of S1: creating a business model, and combing and generating a power failure event of a plan to be monitored; collecting power failure and power restoration information of a power failure event; and (4) stopping power supply and returning monitoring and abnormal condition scheduling. The invention applies the alarm information of the metering terminal to realize the real-time active monitoring of the power failure and power restoration states of the planned power failure event, and replaces the monitoring mode of manually reporting the information. Through developing the power failure incident and matching, the relation that the same power failure equipment exists in a plurality of power failure incidents in the same power failure period is clarified, and the monitoring efficiency is improved. Meanwhile, the visual management and control of the planned power failure event are strengthened by combining data acquired by the metering terminal and information reported by field workers. Finally, customer service experience is improved, and customer satisfaction is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Mixed calculation method for reliability of high-medium-low voltage integrated power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a mixed calculation method for the reliability of a high-medium-low voltage integrated distribution network, which considers the mutual influence of high-medium-low voltage distribution networks and establishes a distribution network integrated model, wherein firstly, the reliability of the high-voltage distribution network is evaluated based on the quasi-sequential Monte Carlo simulation of a state transition sampling method to obtain the annual average fault frequency and the annual average power failure time of the high-voltage distribution network; secondly, obtaining the outgoing line outage rate and the restoration rate of a transformer substation connecting a high-voltage distribution network and a medium-voltage distribution network; finally, the outgoing line outage rate and the repair rate of the transformer substation are used as the input of the reliability calculation of the medium-low voltage distribution network, and the reliability index of the medium-low voltage distribution network is calculated by using a minimum path method; the invention comprehensively considers the mutual influence among the power distribution networks with high, medium and low voltage grades, improves the accuracy of the evaluation result, relates to the low-voltage distribution network topology for the evaluation of the power distribution network, and improves the calculation accuracy of the power supply reliability of low-voltage users.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN;URUMQI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Kafka message queue-based power failure active early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Kafka message queue-based power failure active early warning method and a Kafka message queue-based power failure active early warning device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: monitoring power failure and restoration real-time messages at different nodes of a power grid by a plurality of terminal devices, and issuing the power failure and restoration real-time messages to a Kafka cluster; the Kafka cluster server receives the power failure and power restoration real-time message and pushes the power failure and power restoration real-time message to a consumer subscribing the power failure and power restoration real-time message; the dispatching automation platform subscribes the power failure and power restoration real-time message, generates an early warning power failure event and a power restoration event according to the power failure and power restoration real-time message, matches the early warning power failure event and the power restoration event with the power failure event in the current power failure market, and if the matching is successful, merges the early warning power failure event and the matched power failure event to update the current power failure market; or deleting the power failure event corresponding to the power restoration event to update the current power failure market, generating power restoration notification information, and sending the power restoration notification information to the mobile terminal of the corresponding power utilization client. According to the invention, the electricity utilization experience of the user can be improved.

title_en: Power grid overhaul data restoration method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for repairing power grid overhaul data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when the preset maintenance conditions are met, obtaining maintenance data of the power grid equipment to be maintained and equipment backup data corresponding to the power grid equipment to be maintained; determining whether the power grid equipment to be overhauled has data loss or not according to the data to be overhauled of the power grid equipment to be overhauled and the equipment backup data; if yes, determining to-be-repaired data of the to-be-repaired power grid equipment according to the to-be-repaired data and the equipment backup data; and sending the data to be repaired to the power grid equipment to be repaired so that the power grid equipment to be repaired updates the self data to be repaired based on the data to be repaired. The embodiment of the invention improves the repair efficiency of the power grid overhaul data and the data reliability of the equipment overhaul data of the power grid equipment.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Groundwater level restoration prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of groundwater level prediction, in particular to a groundwater level recovery prediction method and a groundwater level recovery prediction system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of forming a time sequence matrix by collecting related data of each period affecting the change of the underground water level; obtaining a periodic hysteresis relation of the data according to the frequency spectrum curve relation of each row of data and the water level height data; obtaining an environmental change factor according to the periodic hysteresis relationship and the bias correlation coefficient of the groundwater flow, the flow speed and the flow direction data; obtaining a hydrologic environment influence factor according to the environment change factor, the period hysteresis of each row of data and the data distribution condition; and (3) improving the initial weight of each height data in the groundwater in the Adaboost algorithm according to the hydrologic environmental impact factor, and training the prediction result of the output water level height sample of the weak classifier. The method improves the robustness and accuracy of the Adaboost algorithm.

title_en: Power grid equipment power recovery checking method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid equipment re-electricity checking method and system, and relates to the technical field of power grids. And updating the preset mode list information table by adopting all maintenance list data to generate an initial mode list set. And carrying out content adjustment according to the power outage notice corresponding to the initial mode list set to generate a to-be-started mode list set. And screening out the overhauling line according to the real-time topology data of the power grid and the mode list in overhauling in the initial mode list set, and constructing a target mode list set. And carrying out verification unit identification on the target mode list set to generate a verification unit set. And carrying out complex electricity verification statement construction based on the verification unit set and the target mode list set to generate a complex electricity verification statement set. And carrying out power grid equipment power restoration check on answer records corresponding to the power restoration check sentences in the power restoration check sentence set respectively to generate power restoration check data. The machine replacement for checking the duplicate electrical condition is realized through the intelligent voice interaction technology, and the traditional manual operation mode is changed.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Interconnected power distribution network distributed power supply recovery method based on marginal duplicate cost
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a distributed power restoration method of an interconnected power distribution network based on marginal duplicate cost, wherein the method comprises the following steps: under the condition that a fault distribution network is included in the distribution system, determining a centralized power supply recovery model; decoupling a plurality of power supply restoration models from the centralized power supply restoration model; determining a first target power supply restoration sub-model of the fault power distribution network based on the first power supply restoration model, and determining second target power supply restoration models of other power distribution networks based on the second power supply restoration model; and determining a power restoration scheme of the power distribution system by using the first target power restoration sub-model and the second target power restoration sub-model in a distributed iteration mode. The application solves the problem that an accurate power supply recovery scheme cannot be generated.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Optimized transformation and recovery method for micro-habitat ecological system of high and steep slope of pumping and storing station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, and provides an optimization reconstruction and recovery method for a micro-ecological environment ecological system of a high and steep slope of a pumping and storing station, which comprises the steps of obtaining topographic data, soil erosion data and microorganism data of the high and steep slope of the pumping and storing station in a monitoring time period, and judging the current situation of microorganism loss; the method comprises the steps of determining a microorganism loss rule and a microorganism loss amount of a steep side slope of a pumping and storing station according to the microorganism loss current situation, determining a microorganism loss and a terrain correlation according to the microorganism loss rule, water and soil loss data and the terrain data, adapting a target side slope modification process for the steep side slope of the pumping and storing station, determining a microorganism loss and microorganism content correlation according to the microorganism loss rule, the water and soil loss data and different microorganism loss amounts, adapting a target microorganism ecological package for the steep side slope of the pumping and storing station, and determining an optimized modification scheme for the steep side slope of the pumping and storing station according to the target side slope modification process and the target microorganism ecological package.
assignees: STATE GRID XINYUAN COMPANY LTD;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIS SOFTWARE SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Highway structure on barrier body, highway conservation and river drainage collaborative design method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction engineering, in particular to a co-design method for highway structure and highway conservation on a damming body and river drainage, which comprises the steps of sequentially arranging a stone falling groove, a filling roadbed road and a damming lake drainage groove along the cross section direction of a road from a slope toe to the far end of the damming body; the width of the rockfall groove accords with the distribution of the cumulative Weibull probability function, the geometric parameters of the rockfall groove meet the corresponding functional relation, the cross section of the flow discharge groove is in an inverted trapezoid shape, the geometric parameters of the flow discharge groove meet the corresponding functional relation, the geometric parameters of the filled roadbed meet the corresponding functional relation, and the sum of the width of the rockfall groove, the width of the bottom of the filled roadbed and the width of the top of the flow discharge groove is smaller than the total width from the toe to the far end of the dam plug body along the cross section direction of the road. The invention solves the practical problems that the existing post-disaster highway restoration design focuses on single road restoration, lacks dynamic change aiming at post-earthquake falling rocks, and is difficult to comprehensively consider the damming body leakage condition.
assignees: SICHUAN HIGHWAY PLANNING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration system and method for hydro-fluctuation belt
abstract_en: The application discloses an ecological restoration system and method for a hydro-fluctuation belt, and relates to the technical field of ecological engineering, wherein the ecological restoration system comprises an intelligent perception layer, a decision control layer and an execution layer; the intelligent sensing layer comprises a hydrological sensor array and an unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing platform and is used for collecting environmental monitoring data and vegetation coverage data of the hydro-fluctuation belt in real time, the decision control layer is used for predicting a water level prediction value of the hydro-fluctuation belt in a preset time period in the future based on the environmental monitoring data collected by the hydrological sensor array according to a water level prediction model, the execution layer is used for controlling a liftable floating island and mobile biomass processing equipment according to the vegetation coverage data collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing platform and the water level prediction value of the hydro-fluctuation belt, wherein the liftable floating island is controlled so that plants related to ecological restoration on the liftable floating island are in a corresponding safe water level range, and the mobile biomass processing equipment is used for recycling plant residues. The application improves the ecological restoration effect of the hydro-fluctuation belt and improves the sustainability of ecological restoration.
assignees: GUANGDONG WENKE GREEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flood disk-restoring method based on distributed hydrologic-hydrodynamic coupling mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood restoration method based on a distributed hydrologic-hydrodynamic coupling mode, which comprises the steps of compiling a data set of a historical mountain flood disaster, determining a topological structure relation of a river basin, and drawing up a key node corresponding to the river basin, and based on the key node, constructing a hydrologic model above the key node, constructing N computing units based on the data set and according to the topological relation of the river basin, adjusting the parameters to obtain an optimal flood simulation result and a parameter result, constructing a hydrodynamic model below the key node in the river basin, carrying out simulation analysis on regional application and flood evolution of the flood based on the optimal flood simulation result and the parameter result, constructing the hydrodynamic model, more accurately reflecting the generation, confluence and evolution processes of flood in the river basin, improving the application effects of the flood in aspects of flood simulation, early warning and response, helping to restore the actual situation of the flood disaster more accurately in the flood restoration process, and providing reliable basis for post-disaster assessment, reconstruction and planning.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;HYDROLOGY BUREAU OF HAIHE RIVER WATER CONSERVANCY COMMISSION MINI OF

title_en: Multi-disaster power distribution network recovery method and device considering source-load uncertainty
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-disaster power distribution network recovery method and device considering source load uncertainty, a storage medium and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring meteorological data under the current disaster, determining the fault probability of each line through a preset line fault probability calculation formula based on the meteorological data, and determining a fault line; the method comprises the steps of identifying a power supply region to be restored from a target power distribution network according to a fault line, determining the predicted load demand of each load node in the power supply region to be restored according to a preset load uncertainty model, determining the rigid load demand and the flexible load demand of the power supply region to be restored based on the predicted load demand, generating various predicted disaster scenes corresponding to the power supply region to be restored according to meteorological data under current disasters, constructing an objective function and constraint conditions according to the network topology of the power supply region to be restored, and solving the objective function under each predicted disaster scene to obtain a power supply restoration scheme under each predicted disaster scene.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Model-energized supply chain risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a model-energized supply chain risk early warning method and system, which comprise the following steps of detecting whether an abnormal ordering block exists in acquired supply chain data, if so, carrying out supply chain path restoration according to the abnormal ordering block to obtain a risk link diagram, inputting the risk link diagram into a preset time sequence diagram neural network model to carry out risk conduction analysis to obtain risk probability distribution and a prediction influence range, generating a risk early warning report based on the risk probability distribution and the prediction influence range, and pushing the risk early warning report to a relevant decision maker to support risk prevention and control and emergency response, thereby solving the technical problem that the conventional method cannot judge a path of abnormal order propagation in time, and the risk early warning is often delayed from a process of actual risk occurrence.

title_en: Anomaly detiection and repair based electrical load forecasting device and method
title_ko: 이상 탐지 및 복원 기반의 전력 수요량 예측 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a power demand forecasting device and method, and more specifically, to a device and method capable of accurately forecasting future power demand through machine learning. The power demand forecasting device according to an embodiment of the present application comprises: a data collection unit for collecting weather data, power data, and time data; a data pre-processing unit for performing a pre-processing operation on the weather data, the power data, and the time data; an outlier detection unit implemented through a variational autoencoder and classifying the preprocessed power data into abnormal data and normal data; an outlier restoration unit implemented through a random forest model and restoring the abnormal data to generate restored data; and a power demand forecasting unit implemented through a sliding window-based LightGBM model, learning a forecast model based on the normal data and the restored data, and predicting power demand. The power demand forecasting device according to the embodiment of the present application detects and restores outliers to use the same as learning data. By restoring the outliers and using the same as the learning data in a situation in which the number of data is insufficient, the power demand forecasting device according to the embodiment of the present application can provide improved forecast performance without overfitting.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전략 수요량을 예측할 수 있는 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 좀 더 자세하게는 기계학습을 통하여 미래의 전략 수요를 정확하게 예측할 수 있는 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 출원의 실시 예에 따른 전력 수요량 예측 장치는 기상 데이터, 전력 데이터 및 시간 데이터를 수집하는 데이터 수집부; 상기 기상 데이터, 상기 전력 데이터 및 상기 시간 데이터에 대한 전처리 동작을 수행하는 데이터 전처리부; 변분 오토인코더를 통하여 구현되며, 상기 전처리된 전력 데이터를 이상 데이터와 정상 데이터로 분류하는 이상치 탐지부; 랜덤 포레스트 모델을 통하여 구현되며, 상기 이상 데이터를 복원하여 복원 데이터를 생성하는 이상치 복원부; 및 슬라이딩 윈도우 기반의 LightGBM 모델을 통하여 구현되며, 상기 정상 데이터와 상기 복원 데이터에 기초하여 예측 모델을 학습하고 전력 수요량을 예측하는 전력 수요 예측부를 포함한다. 본 출원의 실시 예에 따른 전력 수요량 예측 장치는 이상치를 탐지하고 이를 복원하여 학습 데이터로 사용한다. 데이터 수가 충분하지 않은 상황에서 이상치를 복원하여 학습 데이터로 사용함으로써, 본 출원의 실시 예에 따른 전략 수요량 예측 장치는 오버 피팅 없이 향상된 예층 성능을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Data analysis device, data analysis method, and program
abstract_en: A data analysis device (10) has: a data acquiring unit (11) for, in zones to which power is supplied from a power substation and an in-house power generation device, acquiring, for each of the zones, the power substation result of current or power actually supplied from the power substation; an in-house power generation result acquiring unit (12) for, in the occurrence of a past power failure, subtracting the power substation result obtained before the occurrence of the power failure from the power substation result obtained after the restoration from the power failure, thereby acquiring the in-house power generation result of current or power that has been actually supplied to a zone by the in-house power generation device before the occurrence of the power failure; a meteorological data acquiring unit (13) for acquiring meteorological data; and an in-house power generation supply estimation unit (18) for estimating the in-house power generation result on the basis of the in-house power generation result obtained in each of the occurrences of past power failures and the meteorological data.

title_en: System and method for providing power distribution system information
abstract_en: A system, method and computer program product for processing utility data of a power grid is provided. In one embodiment, the system includes a datamart comprised of a plurality of physical databases storing utility data, a plurality of applications comprising an automated meter application configured to process power usage data from a plurality of automated meters, a power outage application configured to identify a location of a power outage, and a power restoration application configured to identify a location of a power restoration. The system may include an analysis engine comprising a plurality of analysis objects with each analysis object configured to process data to provide a specific analysis, wherein said analysis engine is accessible via one or more of the plurality of applications, and the system may include a report module configured to receive an output from the analysis engine and to output a report. The plurality of applications may also include a fault analysis application, a transformer analysis application, a theft detection application, a power flow application, a substation automation application, a load shed application and others.

title_en: Method for repairing abnormal missing of distribution power low-voltage measurement data of service center
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for repairing abnormal missing of distribution power low-voltage measurement data of a service center, which comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing a power consumption data matrix; step 2, recording a position set of missing data in the electricity data matrix; step 3, constructing a pre-filling model, and pre-filling the missing data in the electricity data matrix in the step 1; step 4, clustering the electricity utilization data matrix pre-filled in the step 3; step 5, establishing a low-rank electricity data restoration model of matrix kernel norm and L  1  norm joint optimization; and step 6, solving a matrix nuclear norm and L  1  norm combined optimized low-rank electricity consumption data restoration model to obtain a secondary restored electricity consumption data matrix. The invention can obtain higher-precision recovery data through low-rank matrix recovery, and effectively improve the data quality of the information acquisition system of the power distribution service center station.

title_en: Central monitoring system for detecting dangerous substances
title_ko: 위험물 유출 중앙 감지시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a central system for dangerous substance outflow detection. According to the present invention, a plurality of dangerous substance outflow warning means installed at dangerous facilities nationwide and terminal means of workers at the dangerous facilities are connected to one central control center using a communication network. Dangerous substance outflow information from the warning means and the terminal means is gathered to determine the presence or absence of dangerous substance outflow. Then, an automatic shutoff facility can be put into operation or a worker can take a countermeasure such as accident notification and evacuation and on-site dispatch for confirmation, accident response, and restoration. According to the present invention, a decrease in costs for constructing the facility can be achieved, a problem attributable to sensor malfunction can be solved, and an accident can be responded early and quick restoration can be performed by the dispatched facility worker even if the automatic shut-off facility does not work due to a malfunction. Those other than the worker can quickly evacuate the dangerous facility and damage to the accident can be minimized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전국 각지에 산재한 위험 시설물에 설치된 복수의 위험물 유출 경보수단 및 상기 위험 시설물에 근무하는 근무자들이 휴대하는 단말수단을 통신망으로 하나의 중앙관제센터에 연결하고, 상기 경보수단 및 단말수단으로부터 통보되는 위험물 유출정보를 종합하여 위험물 유출 여부를 판정하며, 그에 따라 자동 차단설비의 작동을 지시하거나 근무자에게 확인, 사고 수습 및 복구를 위한 현장 출동, 사고 전파 및 대피 등의 대응조치를 취하도록 구성된 위험물 유출 중앙 감지시스템을 제공함으로써, 첫째 설비 구축비용이 감소하고, 둘째 센서의 오작동에 따른 문제가 해소되며, 셋째 자동 차단설비가 고장으로 작동하지 않더라도 해당 시설 근무자가 신속히 출동하여 조기에 사고를 수습하고 긴급히 복구하며, 기타 인원들은 위험 시설물로부터 신속히 대피할 수 있도록 함으로써 사고 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of method for improving artificial breeding giant clam children's shellfish enhancement releasing survival rate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method for improving artificial breeding giant clam children's shellfish enhancement releasing survival rate.Including：The selection and processing of artificial breeding giant clam children shellfish, are transported to enhancement releasing marine site；Giant clam children shellfish is produced inside the live well and be partly embedded in the releasing in " base " of calcium carbonate material, then " base " will be released to be put into togerther in cylinder mould frame with cover together with embedded giant clam children shellfish, cylinder mould frame is fixed on seabed, make with a distance from 3 15 meters from slack tide horizontal plane of cylinder mould frame, from sea bed basal surface >=30cm height；When giant clam children shell length grow into >=6cm when, giant clam is placed in that the water flows gently, light intensity 6,000 12 together with releasing " base " and removed from cylinder mould frame, the Coral Reef Region growth of 000LX, local relatively flat, typhoon season clears up covering in time, the giant clam substrate of rollover is restored and fixed, removes harmful organisms.It is capable of the survival rate of effective giant clam children shellfish using the method for the present invention, technical support is provided to China's giant clam stock enhancement and coral reef restoration of the ecosystem.
assignees: SOUTH CHINA SEA INST OCEANOLOGY CAS

title_en: Forest recovery evaluation method and device after disaster, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest recovery evaluation method and device after disasters, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the forest recovery evaluation method after disasters comprises the following steps: acquiring forest landscape restoration index data after disasters; the forest landscape restoration index comprises ecological factor index data, economic factor index data and social factor index data; determining the weight of each factor index data in the forest landscape restoration index data by adopting an AHP evaluation model; calculating a forest landscape restoration index after disaster based on the weight of the index data of each factor; and evaluating the forest recovery state after the disaster based on the forest landscape recovery index after the disaster. The invention solves the problem of limitation of evaluating the recovery condition of a certain area after a disaster from the aspect of single index, and can evaluate the recovery process of the ecological environment, the industrial environment and the social environment of the area after the disaster by using more comprehensive indexes to evaluate the recovery state of the forest after the disaster.
assignees: SHENZHEN CITY PUBLIC SECURITY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;CITY SAFETY DEVELOPMENT TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE SHENZHEN

title_en: Wind control processing method and system based on big data and multi-feature fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a wind control processing method and a system based on big data and multi-feature fusion, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. In the invention, a member distribution network is determined; according to the association information, a fusion data description vector is mined, and a member restoration distribution network corresponding to the member distribution network is determined; vector barrel division operation is carried out on the fusion data description vector so as to form barrel division result characterization data; according to the barrel division result characterization data, the member restoration distribution network and the member distribution network, forming an updated distribution network analysis network; mining updated fusion data description vectors through an updated distribution network analysis network, and carrying out vector barrel separation operation on each updated fusion data description vector to form updated barrel separation result characterization data; and analyzing the risk wind control user combination according to the updated barrel classification result characterization data, and carrying out associated risk management and control operation on the risk wind control user combination. Based on the above, the reliability of risk management and control can be improved.
assignees: HANDAN MINGJIANG NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power station missing power restoration method based on correlation coefficient spline interpolation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic power station missing power restoration method based on correlation coefficient spline interpolation, which comprises the following steps: collecting original data of a photovoltaic power station, including meteorological data and corresponding power generation data thereof; dividing the original data into a data set to be repaired and a complete data set, wherein the data set to be repaired only comprises meteorological data, and the complete data set comprises the meteorological data and corresponding power generation data thereof; performing dimension reduction processing on the complete data set, and removing weather data with smaller correlation from the complete data set and the data set to be repaired; processing the original data by adopting a spline interpolation method to obtain preliminary missing power interpolation; calculating a correlation coefficient based on the meteorological data in the integrity data set and the meteorological data in the data set to be repaired; multiplying the correlation coefficient with the preliminary missing power interpolation to obtain the final missing power interpolation, and completing the repair operation of the missing power. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of improving interpolation accuracy and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Multi-objective optimization method for post-earthquake community building group restoration scheduling and toughness evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-objective optimization method for post-earthquake community building group restoration scheduling and toughness evaluation, which belongs to the technical field of post-earthquake community building group restoration scheduling and comprises the steps of obtaining a seismic source coordinate point, building a post-earthquake building group network based on the seismic source coordinate point, obtaining image data and building structure information of the post-earthquake building group network, obtaining building structure characteristic data based on the image data and the building structure information of the building group network, calculating the building structure characteristic data through a recurrent neural network, determining a building restoration strategy after obtaining a building toughness prediction score, obtaining schedulable resources in real time, solving balance between the building restoration strategy and the schedulable resources based on a multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm, generating an optimal solution set of building restoration scheduling, and restoring the building group based on the optimal solution set of building restoration scheduling. The invention realizes the balance between the building restoration strategy and the schedulable resources through the multi-target particle swarm optimization algorithm.

title_en: Power transmission and transformation project soil disturbance restoration method and device based on region division
abstract_en: The invention provides a soil disturbance restoration method and device for a power transmission and transformation project based on region division, which are suitable for the technical field of power systems and comprise the steps of obtaining construction information of a target power transmission and transformation project, determining project characteristics and disturbance regions of the target power transmission and transformation project based on the construction information, dividing the disturbance region into a plurality of regions based on the project characteristics, collecting region characteristics of each region, determining a sensitive region, constructing a simulation model of each sensitive region based on the region characteristics of the sensitive region, determining disturbance information of the sensitive region based on the simulation model, determining a corresponding initial restoration scheme based on the disturbance information of each sensitive region, optimizing a corresponding restoration scheme based on neighborhood information, and obtaining a restoration scheme of each sensitive region, and obtaining an integral restoration scheme of the disturbance region based on the restoration scheme of all the sensitive regions. The invention can improve the repairing accuracy by determining the sensitive area and the corresponding repairing scheme.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Goaf ecological restoration method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based goaf ecological restoration method and system, the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source remote sensing data and geological investigation data of a goaf, generating a three-dimensional geological damage model of the goaf through a space-time fusion technology, utilizing a deep convolutional neural network to conduct multi-scale feature extraction on the three-dimensional geological damage model to obtain a multi-dimensional ecological feature data set, identifying an ecological fragile area and an instability risk area, outputting an ecological risk level map, conducting parallel processing on the multi-dimensional ecological feature data set to generate an ecological assessment report containing health scores of all ecological subsystems of the goaf, and generating a vegetation-soil/rock-water collaborative restoration strategy by adopting a multi-objective optimization algorithm based on the ecological risk level map and the ecological assessment report. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, the accurate assessment and collaborative strategy generation of the goaf ecological restoration can be realized, and the scientificity, efficiency and overall ecological benefit of the restoration project are improved.

title_en: Power estimation device and power estimation method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a power estimation device and a power estimation method capable of performing power estimation, even if a load subjected to reactive power adjustment exists in the system.SOLUTION: In step S1, the learning data for performing analysis by ICA from effective power and the amount of solar radiation that have been entered up to now is created. The number of samples of the learning data can be determined arbitrarily. In step S2, a restoration matrix, that is the inverse matrix of a mixing matrix formulated using the learning data created in step S1 is calculated. In step S3, the effective power of an actual load and the effective power of solar power generation amount are estimated individually, by performing matrix operation of the effective power and the amount of solar radiation measured at an estimation time, for the restoration matrix calculated in step S2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Method and system for detection and notification of power outage and power quality
abstract_en: To provide methods and systems for detection and notification of electrical power outages and power quality.SOLUTION: A sensor coupled to a circuit transmits a keepalive packet to a server. The sensor detects an input signal generated by an electrical activity and generates an output signal on the basis of the input signal. The sensor monitors the output signal, during a clock cycle, determines whether a rising edge occurs and transmits a fault packet to the server when the rising edge occurs prior to a predetermined clock value or when no rising edge occurs. The server receives the fault packet from the sensor and listens for keepalive packets. The server transmits a power outage notification when no keepalive packets are received for at least a defined time period after the fault packet is received. The server transmits a power restoration notification when one or more keepalive packets are subsequently received.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Intelligent video management system
title_ko: 지능형 영상 감시 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An intelligent video management system is provided to increases easily the monitor system by optimizing the operation between the server-client and each application. CONSTITUTION: The management server(210) provides the camera information. The IP camera part(220) generates the event information according to the generated image. The matrix decoding unit(242) decodes the video signal and the event information inputted through a network. The network video recorder part stores the video signal and the event information inputted through a network according to the camera group. The event server(260) informs the alarm situation by analyzing all event information within the administrative area. The workstation(271) controls an operation including the display about the whole camera within the operation group, the image restoration, the various events processing, and etc.
abstract_ko:
