title_en: Manufacturing method for cultivation of moss and moss cultivation kit for forest recovery thereof
title_ko: 이끼 포자 배양 방법 및 이를 이용한 산림 복구용 이끼 재배 키트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for culturing moss spores and a moss cultivation kit for forest restoration using the same. The present invention relates to a method of culturing moss spores, which can restore forests by artificially culturing moss to dormant and then spraying the lost forests in the event of a disaster. The moss spore culture method according to the present invention comprises: a first step of cutting the sporangia into 10 to 30 mm; a second step of drying the cut sporangia at 60 to 75℃ for 24 hours and crushing the dried sporangia; a third step of immersing the crushed sporangia in a spore culture medium and dormant; a fourth step of immersing the dormant sporangia in a plant hormone solution for 24 hours; and a fifth step of mixing and spraying the immersed sporangia with a nutrient solution and an adhesive solution.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 이끼 포자 배양 방법 및 이를 이용한 산림 복구용 이끼 재배 키트에 관한 것으로, 이기를 인공 배양하여 휴면시킨 뒤 재난이 발생하면 손실된 산림에 살포하여 산림을 복구할 수 있는 이끼 포자 배양 방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따른 이끼 포자 배양 방법은, 포자낭을 10 내지 30 mm로 절단하는 제1단계; 상기 절단된 포자낭을 60 내지 75℃에서 24시간 동안 건조 후 상기 건조된 포자낭을 파쇄하는 제2단계; 상기 파쇄된 포자낭을 포자 배양액에 침지 후 휴면하는 제3단계; 상기 휴면된 포자낭을 식물호르몬액에 24시간 동안 침지하는 제4단계; 상기 침지된 포자낭을 양액 및 접착액과 혼합하여 살포하는 제5단계;를 포함하여 제조되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and device for analyzing influence of blocked passage of post-earthquake road on building repair progress
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for analyzing influence of blocked road traffic on building repair progress after earthquake, and relates to the technical field of civil engineering and computers. The method comprises the following steps: according to the post-earthquake road trafficability condition, building an abstract model of the urban road network by adopting a scale-free network model; comprehensively considering factors such as road length, vehicle speed and road condition, post-earthquake road accessibility and the like, and calculating an optimal path of the vehicle to the restoration destination; selecting 'transportation time' as an evaluation index, and calculating delay time caused by single transportation; the delay time of single transportation is used as a basic unit, influences are split into each sub-project work of the repair project, the delay time of the overall project progress is calculated, and influences of road trafficability blockage on the building repair process after an earthquake occurs are quantified. The invention provides an optimal path selection method comprehensively considering influences of factors such as material transportation travel, vehicle speed and road trafficability based on post-earthquake road trafficability, and quantifies road influences by taking transportation time as an index.

title_en: Photovoltaic power station power prediction method and system based on image restoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power station power prediction, in particular to a photovoltaic power station power prediction method and a photovoltaic power station power prediction system based on image restoration.

title_en: River and lake bottom mud-water separation device for mine restoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental engineering, in particular to a river and lake bottom mud-water separation device for mine restoration. In the use process of the existing device, the dehydrated sludge is inconvenient to collect sufficiently, the water cannot be discharged due to blockage caused by the sludge, and the adhered sludge cannot fall sufficiently due to earthquake, so that the sludge-water separation effect is poor. The invention comprises a base, wherein the base is fixedly connected with a shell, and the top of the shell is fixedly connected with a one-way valve. According to the invention, the push plate is driven to slide back and forth by the electric push rod, the push plate can be pushed to slide by continuing to move, so that the extrusion plate and the filter screen frame extrude the sludge together, water in the sludge is extruded, the sludge is dehydrated, the solid content of the sludge is effectively improved, the pollution of the sludge to the water is reduced, and the water is purified.

title_en: Method for realizing equipment fault rush repair based on GIS (geographic information System)
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing equipment fault rush-repair based on a GIS (geographic information system), which comprises the steps of collecting and preprocessing existing fault data, constructing a fault database, constructing an equipment fault prediction model, training the equipment fault prediction model by taking the fault data as input data, outputting fault prediction information, constructing and calling a GIS module based on the fault prediction information, planning the position of an optimal rush-repair base station to form a rush-repair base station topology network, acquiring real-time fault information, adopting the GIS module to calculate the nearest rush-repair base station and the optimal rush-repair route, forming a rush-repair scheduling data packet, and transmitting the rush-repair scheduling data packet to the rush-repair base station. According to the invention, through integrating the GIS system and the machine learning model, a comprehensive equipment fault rush-repair flow is provided, future fault events are effectively predicted, an optimal rush-repair route is calculated, and meanwhile, the stability and the safety of the system are ensured.

title_en: Intelligent distribution network overhaul automatic permission data model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distribution network dispatching automation technology in a power system, in particular to an intelligent distribution network overhaul automatic permission data model. The invention comprises a data acquisition module, a data verification module, an automatic permission module, a device condition verification module before power restoration and a data backfill module. The data acquisition module acquires related data from the distribution network OMS system and the OCS system, the data verification module performs device state consistency verification, logic verification and association verification, the automatic permission module automatically permits and generates permission information after verification passes, the device condition verification module performs verification before re-electrification on the device, and the data backfill module backfills the permission information to the distribution network OMS system. According to the invention, multidimensional data are integrated, the accuracy, reliability and efficiency of overhaul permission are improved through hierarchical verification, and overhaul safety and stable operation of a power grid are ensured.

title_en: Movable fire window opening and closing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a movable fire window opening and closing device, which comprises a fixed arm, a movable arm and a connecting rod, wherein the movable arm is internally provided with a rotary driving device and an energy storage reset device which are matched with each other, the fixed arm is provided with a slide block, one end of the connecting rod is connected with the rotary driving device, and the other end of the connecting rod is hinged with the slide block; an elastic locking mechanism for locking the sliding block is arranged in the fixed arm, and an unlocking device for unlocking the elastic locking mechanism when a fire disaster happens is also arranged in the fixed arm; when the utility model is used, the energy storage and restoration device is stored by the rotating driving device in the rotating process of the window sash; the stable opening of the window sash is ensured through the elastic locking mechanism; when a fire disaster happens, the elastic locking mechanism is unlocked through the unlocking device, and then the energy storage reset device is released to realize the automatic closing of the window sash; the utility model discloses when satisfying the basic fire prevention requirement of fire prevention window, realized the movable of fire prevention window and involved, improved the ventilation and the daylighting requirement of fire prevention window.
assignees: SHENZHEN JIU YAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cycle stepping recovery method based on bandwidth fairness in WDM optical network
abstract_en: The present invention provides a cycle stepping recovery method based on bandwidth fairness in a WDM optical network, belonging to the communication technology field. Aiming at the business recovery problem in the disaster damage network, the cycle stepping recovery method based on the bandwidth fairness in the WDM optical network provides the fairness bandwidth recovery for the businesses different grades. The grades of the businesses are flexibly divided and the recovery step length is regulated to perform stage (stepping) recovery for the damaged businesses with different grades and realize the relative fairness of the recovery of the businesses with each grade. The recovery priority of the damaged business with the same grade is dynamically regulated according to the bandwidth loss ratio, and through adoption of the mode of the bandwidth cycle recovery of the minimum unit, the fairness of the recovery of the business with the same grade is realized. Multiple cycle stepping recovery operations are performed to effectively improve the service fairness of business recovery and reduce the business interruption rate of the whole network.

title_en: Energy planning prediction method and device based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy planning prediction method and device based on a neural network, and relates to the technical field of electric power data analysis. The method utilizes the existing energy planning sample data set to train to obtain the data prediction algorithm model and the data restoration algorithm model, performs quality detection and restoration on the energy planning data to be detected through the data prediction algorithm model and the data restoration algorithm model, can improve the quality of the data, is convenient for subsequent energy planning, reduces the processing time of the data by a mode of acquiring the energy planning prediction data through the energy planning prediction model formed by the energy planning data training, reduces the labor cost, can quickly process all data, is not easy to omit the data, improves the accuracy of the energy planning information, and reduces the possibility of energy planning errors and the energy planning cost.

title_en: Slope ecological restoration structure for preventing landslide and soil erosion and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope ecological restoration structure for preventing landslide and soil erosion and a manufacturing method thereof. The method comprises the steps of sequentially arranging wood piles, bamboo chips and geotextiles on the surface of a side slope of a soil discharge field, vertically driving the wood piles into the slope at certain intervals, fixing the bamboo chips in the wood piles in a staggered and crossed mode, vertically stacking the geotextiles on one side of the wood piles and the bamboo chips along the ascending direction of the side slope, filling seeds and nutrient soil into an ecological bag, stacking the ecological bag on one side of the wood piles along the ascending direction of the side slope, and finally planting nursery stocks at the bag opening of the ecological bag. The slope ecological restoration structure and the manufacturing method provided by the invention can effectively prevent the surface layer landslide and water and soil loss, and can also ensure soil and nutrient elements required by vegetation growth.

title_en: Fault line power restoration knowledge reasoning method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault line power restoration knowledge inference method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of: s1, training a line fault handling Bert model; s2, constructing a fault line power restoration judgment data set; s3, constructing a fault line power restoration judgment deep learning model, and optimizing the model; s4, automatically collecting real-time collection data and advanced application analysis result data related to faults, and automatically retrieving related reference document knowledge information; s5, vectorizing and representing the standard format data and the knowledge information by using the line fault handling Bert model trained in S1; s6, carrying out reasoning calculation of the fault line power restoration judgment model; s7, analyzing the model reasoning result; s8, checking the reasoning result of the model; s9, judging whether the power recovery condition is met; s10, generating a line fault handling record; the scheme provides a quick, accurate, reliable and interpretable decision reference basis for improving the power grid fault handling efficiency and quickly recovering power supply.
assignees: SHAOXING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Method and device for analyzing influence of blocked passage of post-earthquake road on building repair progress
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for analyzing influence of blocked road traffic on building repair progress after earthquake, and relates to the technical field of civil engineering and computers. The method comprises the following steps: according to the post-earthquake road trafficability condition, building an abstract model of the urban road network by adopting a scale-free network model; comprehensively considering factors such as road length, vehicle speed road condition, post-earthquake road accessibility and the like, and calculating the optimal path of the vehicle to the restoration destination; selecting 'transportation time' as an evaluation index, and calculating delay time caused by single transportation; the delay time of single transportation is used as a basic unit, influences are split into each sub-project work of the repair project, the delay time of the overall project progress is calculated, and influences of road trafficability blockage on the building repair process after an earthquake occurs are quantified. The invention provides an optimal path selection method comprehensively considering influences of factors such as material transportation travel, vehicle speed, road trafficability and the like based on post-earthquake road trafficability conditions, and quantifies road influences by taking transportation time as an index.
assignees: BEIJING UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Pollution site restoration intelligent decision method based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pollution site repair intelligent decision method based on multi-source data, which is characterized in that pollution site sample data are collected, a to-be-repaired area higher than a risk threshold is determined, comprehensive repair demand assessment is formed by comprehensively analyzing pollutant characteristics, site characteristics and environmental factors of the to-be-repaired area, historical repair data are collected, a neural network decision model is constructed to predict optimal repair targets and repair methods under different conditions, corresponding data are input for specific to-be-repaired areas by utilizing the trained model, and decision results of the repair targets and the repair methods are intelligently output; the invention realizes the scientificalness and the accuracy of the polluted site restoration decision by integrating the multi-source data, improves the restoration efficiency and the restoration effect, and provides powerful support for the polluted site management.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based three-dimensional map construction method for natural disaster areas
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-dimensional map construction method of a natural disaster area based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of natural disaster emergency rescue. The unmanned aerial vehicle flies above the disaster area according to a preset track; estimating the internal and external parameters of the camera and sparse point clouds by adopting an incremental motion restoration structure method; calculating a direct depth map and reconstructing a dense point cloud based on PATCHMATCH method; and carrying out GPS information attachment on the dense point cloud to obtain the dense point cloud with GPS information. The method is used for generating the disaster area three-dimensional map with the GPS information after the natural disaster occurs. The verification experiment is carried out on a plurality of groups of open source high-altitude data, and the method has the characteristics of strong robustness and high reliability under the scene; the dense point cloud provided by the invention has GPS information, provides the direction and navigation of geographic information for disaster-fighting teams, and has stronger practicability and functionality.

title_en: Evaluation method for ecological restoration effect of side slope of pumped storage power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the ecological restoration effect of a side slope of a pumped storage power station, which specifically comprises the following steps: step one: acquiring an initial ecological environment image near a pumped storage power station to be built by adopting an unmanned aerial vehicle, acquiring a damaged slope ecological environment image after the pumped storage power station is built, further determining an ecological restoration implementation range, and setting a subsequent flight area, a route and a navigation period of the unmanned aerial vehicle; step two: the invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration and evaluation of a side slope, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for shooting vegetation in a pumped storage power station range by using a sensor and through an oblique photography technology and an orthographic photography technology. According to the evaluation method for the ecological restoration effect of the side slope of the pumped storage power station, the ecological restoration condition of the side slope is evaluated by establishing an evaluation method matched with the ecological restoration of the side slope, a specific restoration plan can be appointed for a specific area according to an evaluation result, the restoration difficulty is reduced, and the restoration efficiency is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;STATE GRID XINYUAN COMPANY LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Household-changing relation identification method and related device based on intelligent ammeter outage and restoration big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a household change relation identification method and device based on intelligent ammeter outage and restoration big data, and belongs to the field of data processing and analysis of electric power systems. The method comprises the steps of carrying out clock verification on the on-line electricity meter to obtain the on-line electricity meter with aligned clock time, carrying out meter outage data reading on the on-line electricity meter by using a concentrator subjected to program optimization, storing the meter outage data in a database, extracting collected meter outage data from the database, obtaining a transformer outage time record, comparing the records, and identifying the transformer to which each electricity meter belongs, thereby completing the identification of the household change relation. According to the invention, through analysis and processing of the intelligent ammeter outage and restoration big data, the automatic identification of the household change relation is realized, and the problems of low efficiency, data update lag and the like in the traditional household change relation identification are effectively solved. The invention not only improves the accuracy and efficiency of line loss management work, but also provides powerful technical support for sustainable development of power supply enterprises.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted MiniSAR real-time imaging and emergency communication system for disaster rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted MiniSAR real-time imaging and emergency communication system for disaster relief, which relates to the technical field of emergency communication and radar remote sensing, and comprises a radar path inversion modeling module, wherein the radar path inversion modeling module performs multi-time flight above a target area, acquires radar echo signals at a plurality of moments, acquires flight attitude data and imaging azimuth information of a flight platform, inverts a propagation path of the radar echo signals based on the flight attitude data and the imaging azimuth information, extracts an incident angle and a reflection path length, and generates a reflection path distribution diagram. According to the invention, through multi-time radar path modeling and image stability evaluation, the false target points under multipath interference are accurately identified and removed, image structure restoration is realized by combining a dynamic extension algorithm, a dynamic confidence distribution map is constructed, high-confidence target positioning and rescue area optimization are realized, and the anti-interference and response accuracy of the system is enhanced.
assignees: BEIJING XIONGFENG SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent low-cost groundwater pollution treatment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent low-cost groundwater pollution treatment method and system, which belong to the technical field of groundwater pollution control, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining hydrogeologic parameters of a polluted area; the method comprises the steps of calculating the total pollutant amount in a polluted area by using on-site sampling analysis and numerical simulation results, calculating the environmental capacity of the polluted area based on hydrogeologic parameters and the total pollutant amount, establishing a groundwater numerical model based on the hydrogeologic parameters, the total pollutant amount and the environmental capacity, simulating the migration rule of pollutants under different groundwater artificial supply amounts, determining the optimal artificial supply amount meeting the standard of the downstream river water quality, monitoring the water quality of the groundwater supply position and the groundwater drainage position of the polluted area in real time, and regulating and controlling the optimal artificial supply amount when the water quality exceeds the standard until the water quality meets the standard. The invention fully utilizes natural hydrologic cycle and environmental capacity, realizes low-cost and intelligent restoration of polluted groundwater, ensures the water quality safety of downstream river channels, and has remarkable economic and environmental benefits.
assignees: SICHUAN NATURAL RESOURCES SURVEY AND DESIGN GROUP ECOLOGICAL ENV CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle rescue scheduling optimization method and device based on semantic translation modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle rescue scheduling optimization method and device based on semantic translation modeling, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue intelligent scheduling, comprising the steps of obtaining emergency rescue task description information; the method comprises the steps of converting natural language rules in task description information into standardized constraint expressions, identifying response time targets, coverage area targets, resource parameters and network structure parameters, constructing an initial scheduling model, solving the initial scheduling model through an improved multi-target optimization algorithm to obtain an initial scheduling scheme of the unmanned aerial vehicle, constructing a dynamic re-optimization model by taking the initial scheduling scheme as a disturbance reference when an interference event in the execution process of the initial scheduling scheme is detected, solving the dynamic re-optimization model by taking scheme disturbance cost and arrival delay time as optimization targets, outputting a repair scheduling scheme and an interpretable decision result, and remarkably improving the accuracy, instantaneity and decision reliability of emergency rescue scheduling.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHERN SCI & TECH;PENG CHENG LAB

title_en: Wireless disaster prevention system and id setting method of wireless disaster prevention system
abstract_en: To provide a wireless disaster prevention system which wirelessly acquires an ID of a relay node within a range at which a radio wave arrives by using a setting device to read and write data with the specified ID.SOLUTION: A setting device 20 transmits a call telegram with no ID specification in which response reception intensity gradually decreasing from an initial value is set to relays 12-1 to 12-3 for reception. The relays 12-1 to 12-3 for reception transmit response telegrams including IDs of themselves when the reception intensity is equal to or more than the specified response reception intensity. When the response telegram is received, the setting device 20 acquires an ID of the relay 12-1 for reception included in the response telegram to be registered, transmits a sleep request telegram to the registered relay 12-1 for reception to suspend a telegram transmission operation. When registration of all the IDs of the relays 12-1 to 12-3 for reception within a range at which a radio wave from the setting device 20 arrives is terminated, a restoration telegram is transmitted to the relays 12-1 to 12-3 for reception to release suspension of the telegram transmission operation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: System, method, and apparatus for daisy chain network protection from node malfunction or power outage
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for protecting daisy chain networks from node malfunction or power outage are disclosed. One or more communication nodes in a daisy chain network can be bypass-capable communication nodes. Bypass-capable communication nodes can include a sensing and switching subsystem, embedded in the node or external to the node in a fiber optic cable running along the daisy chain network. In embodiments, the sensing and switching subsystem can responsively switch the bypass-capable communication node from communication node primary circuitry to primary circuitry responsive to node malfunction or node power outage. The sensing and switching subsystem also can switch back from bypass circuitry to primary circuitry responsive to restoration of node function or node power. In embodiments, switching occurs responsive to excitation or de-excitation of the node itself.

title_en: Accelerated recovery after a data disaster
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present invention, a metadata file is transferred from the first system to the second system and a database on the second system is initialized based on the metadata file. An image, including information of the first system to be restored, is transferred from the first system to the second system, and restoration of the information to the second system based on the image is initiated. Prior to completion of the restoration, one or more log files indicating actions performed on the first system relating to the information to be restored is transferred from the first system to the initialized database on the second system. In response to completion of the restoration, the actions of the log files are performed to synchronize the restored data on the second system with the first system.

title_en: Muddy coast ecological restoration and disaster reduction space system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a muddy coast ecological restoration and disaster reduction space system, which is used for muddy coasts and comprises the following components: a double submerged dike protection system, a beach energy dissipation system and a vegetation ecosystem; the system adopts three levels of protection and repair means, comprises an outermost double submerged dike protection system, a middle sand beach energy dissipation system and a vegetation ecosystem close to inland, and forms a three-prevention integrated ecological disaster reduction space system; the influence of severe weather on the coast is effectively reduced, the ecological construction of beaches is enhanced, the diversity of plants and the stability of communities are improved, and the construction and treatment cost is reduced; the method has important effects on coastal ecological safety, improvement of regional disaster prevention and reduction capacity, improvement of regional ecosystem quality and promotion of high-quality development of marine economy.

title_en: Service process fault detection method, device and service node
abstract_en: The invention discloses a service process fault detection method, device and service node, so as to simplify a service process fault detection process, and shorten HBase disaster recovery restoration response time. The service process fault detection method comprises the following steps: a first service node starts a service process and a local mirroring monitor process, wherein the first service node invokes the started service process to provide data inquiry service; the first service node regularly checks the state of the service process according to the mirroring monitor process, and confirming whether the state of the service process is abnormal or not; when the mirroring monitor process confirms that the state of the service process is abnormal, the first service node notices a cluster management node Master.

title_en: Scheduling power failure and recovery condition anti-misoperation method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-misoperation method and system for dispatching power failure and restoration conditions based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: logic checking; checking the ticket face; checking the tide; and checking the state. By adopting the anti-misoperation method and the system based on the artificial intelligence for the dispatching power failure and recovery condition, the power grid accidents caused by habitual violation can be reduced. Meanwhile, whether the execution of the operation item has a problem can be quickly identified through a condition error prevention method, and the working efficiency of a dispatcher is improved.

title_en: Land and ocean temperature restoration method and system and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of meteorological monitoring, and discloses a land and ocean temperature restoration method, a system and computer equipment, which comprise the following steps: reconstructing large-scale surface temperature data by constructing a data restoration model based on MODIS surface temperature data; and analyzing the time-space change characteristics of the surface temperature under different time dimensions from the whole, local and single pixel multiple space dimensions, determining the area of the surface temperature abnormal change, and analyzing the surface temperature time-space change, particularly the driving factors of the annual abnormal change by combining multiple data information of earth surface, atmosphere, ocean and social and economic activities. The method effectively improves the data quality of the MODIS remote sensing surface temperature. The reconstructed monthly remote sensing surface temperature data cover a more complete earth surface area, and the actual application precision of the data reaches 1.5K; the method has important reference significance for restoration and reconstruction of remote sensing surface temperature data, climate change monitoring, meteorological disaster early warning and agricultural production work.
assignees: AGRICULTURAL RESOURCE AND AGRICULTURAL REGIONALIZATION RES INSTITUTE OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTU

title_en: Drainage system for landslide ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, in particular to a drainage system for landslide ecological restoration, which comprises a slope body, a protective structure and a reinforcing platform, wherein at least one horizontal water intercepting groove extending horizontally is arranged on the slope body, a supporting grid chamber is arranged at the horizontal water intercepting groove, a drainage hole is formed in the supporting grid chamber, and top openings of a first vertical water collecting well and a second vertical water collecting well are positioned below the drainage hole of the supporting grid chamber; be provided with the overflow mouth in the first vertical sump pit, overflow mouth department is provided with first vertical sump pit of the oblique drainage channel intercommunication of bowing and second vertical sump pit, the vertical sump pit open-top of second passes through the shutoff of shutoff piece, the second that the vertical sump pit bottom of second set up bows oblique drainage channel and communicates to the cistern of consolidating the inside setting of platform, this technical scheme accelerates the speed of drainage when the precipitation is great through the vertical sump pit of second, different drainage speed when having realized different precipitation.
assignees: JILIN PROVINCE JIABO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Slope protection structure for ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope protection structure for ecological restoration, which comprises a base, wherein the upper end surface of the base is fixedly connected with an installation table, and a protection mechanism for emergently protecting landslide generated by heavy rain is arranged at an opening of the installation table; a water filtering mechanism for collecting water from the soil with high water content is arranged on the left side of the mounting table; according to the invention, the emergency protection is carried out on the side slope after heavy rain by arranging the protection mechanism, the first suspension block and the second suspension block change along with the rising of the water level, the first suspension block controls the connecting frame to rotate around the fixed shaft through the bearing rod, the protection plate moves upwards gradually, when the water level rises to the limit position, the protection plate is in a vertical state, the second suspension block carries out limit locking on the protection plate through the limit shaft, the protection plate also carries out warning effect on people on road sides while blocking landslide, and compared with the prior art, the invention can correspondingly protect the landslide so as to prevent soil from blocking the road surface.

title_en: Ecological restoration method for coal gangue pile in karst area
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological restoration method for a coal gangue pile in a karst area, which comprises the following steps: the coal gangue in the karst area is trimmed to eliminate the coal gangue pile and the geological disaster hidden trouble area around the coal gangue pile, the coal gangue pile platform is leveled, the slope gradient is smaller than 35-40 degrees, repairing plants are planted in the coal gangue platform area, a coal gangue modifier is prepared, one third of modifier is paved in a planting pit, then a pioneer species or giant fungus grass with economic value is planted, finally, the planting pit is filled with the coal gangue modifier, compacted and finally, watering is carried out. Aiming at the problems of serious water and soil loss, difficult vegetation growth, poor natural restoration, high manual restoration cost, poor effect, low economic benefit, landscape damage and the like of the coal gangue sloping field, the invention repairs the coal gangue in a karst area, applies a coal gangue modifier and plants and restores plants, thereby realizing vegetation restoration and ecological management of a coal gangue pile. The invention can harvest 25 tons of pastures per mu of land per year, the value is 1 ten thousand yuan, and the produced pastures meet the standard of forage grass.
assignees: KUNMING COMPREHENSIVE SURVEY CENTER CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY

title_en: Identification method of lakeside zone ecological restoration area under influence of climate change
abstract_en: The invention relates to a recognition method of an ecological restoration area, and particularly provides a recognition method of a lakeside ecological restoration area under the influence of climate change. The method comprises the following steps: (1) According to the predicted meteorological data of the given lake, predicting the water levels of different periods in the future of the given lake by adopting a support vector machine algorithm; (2) According to the elevation of the predicted water level of each period, combining a digital elevation model of the whole lake area of a given lake to identify a newly submerged or exposed area; (3) And determining an ecological restoration area according to the land utilization remote sensing data of the new submerged or exposed area. The method can identify areas such as lakes and the like subjected to climate change in advance, so that ecological restoration engineering is more targeted. Meanwhile, the method can be carried out only by the existing international climate change prediction database and historical water level monitoring data, so that the accuracy and convenience of the identification of the ecological restoration area of the lakeside zone are greatly improved.

title_en: Ecological restoration system and method for high-steep sandy soil slope
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological restoration system and method for a high and steep sandy soil slope, comprising a slope fixing structure, a net hanging structure, a vegetation layer and a water permeable structure, wherein the net hanging structure comprises a protective net paved on a slope, the vegetation layer is sprayed on the slope, the slope fixing structure comprises a retaining wall built on the bottom of the slope, and the retaining wall is used for supporting a slump and slide cover on the slope, a broken rock layer or a landslide. The water permeable structure is arranged in the retaining wall, so that redundant water on the slope body can be discharged. In the technical scheme provided by the invention, in order to improve the stability of the slope, a retaining wall of 2.5 m Gao Chongli is built at the bottom of the slope to support a covering, broken rock stratum or landslide which can collapse and slide on the landslide. Meanwhile, a net hanging and vegetation concrete spraying technology is adopted, so that the slope protection strength and anti-scouring capability are enhanced, the environment for plant growth is rapidly built, meanwhile, the weathering stripping of a slope is prevented, and the rapid forming, ecology and stability of vegetation are ensured.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA MENGCAO SOIL TECH CO LTD;MENGCAO ECOLOGICAL ENV GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network system fault recovery method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network system fault recovery method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining fault data and power data of a fault power distribution network system; the method comprises the steps of constructing an objective function with the aim of maximizing recovery load based on power data, constructing a power distribution system rush-repair scheduling model, a power distribution system power-on path model, a flexible load reduction model, a demand response model and a power distribution system operation model, solving the objective function under the constraints of fault data, the power distribution system rush-repair scheduling model, the power distribution system power-on path model, the flexible load reduction model, the demand response model and the power distribution system operation model, generating the load recovery amount of a key load, the load recovery amount of an interruptible load and the load recovery amount of an electric vehicle when the maximum recovery load is generated, and performing fault recovery on the power distribution system based on the load recovery amount of the key load, the load recovery amount of the interruptible load and the load recovery amount of the electric vehicle.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Simulation method for dynamically fusing multisource meteorological data into wind farm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind energy development and utilization, in particular to a simulation method for dynamically fusing multisource meteorological data into a wind farm, which comprises the steps of accessing satellite remote sensing, ground station measurement, numerical forecasting and wind farm historical operation data, and outputting standardized meteorological data through format analysis, standardized processing and cleaning; the method comprises the steps of calculating reliability scores based on multidimensional indexes such as data integrity, time consistency and the like, realizing abnormal data restoration or standby data source switching, combining wind power plant DEM topographic features and self-adaptive sliding windows, adjusting data source weights in real time through reinforcement learning to generate dynamic weight values, improving Windpowerlib framework adaptation fusion data, dynamically configuring fan parameters to generate initial simulation results, collecting wind power plant real-time data, and correcting model parameters through Kalman filtering. The wind power plant simulation method and the wind power plant simulation system can improve the simulation precision and timeliness of the wind power plant, enhance the data utilization rate and the model suitability, and reduce the deviation between the simulation result and the actual working condition.

title_en: Power distribution network rush-repair and recovery method and system considering multi-source cooperation and incomplete fault information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network rush-repair and restoration method considering multi-source synergy and incomplete fault information, which comprises the steps of 1, establishing an objective function of an upper layer model by minimizing the sum of repair completion time of all faults in a least unfavorable fault scene, 2, establishing rush-repair team scheduling constraint considering the fault scene, 3, establishing distributed robust constraint of fault scene probability, 4, converting the upper layer model into a single-layer minimization problem by utilizing a dual theory, 5, establishing an objective function of a lower layer model by taking the maximized weighted load restoration amount and the minimized network loss as targets, 6, comprehensively considering generator constraint, radial constraint, energy storage constraint, wind-driven photovoltaic constraint, mobile power generation car constraint and power distribution network flow constraint, establishing power distribution network operation constraint, 7, solving the power distribution network rush-repair and restoration double-layer model, and obtaining a power distribution network rush-repair and restoration scheme. The invention considers incomplete fault information and multisource collaborative optimization, is beneficial to accelerating load recovery, reduces power failure loss and improves the toughness of the power distribution network.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Underground reservoir method for cooperatively storing carbon dioxide and fluoride by high-alkalinity mine water and fly ash
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for cooperatively sealing and storing carbon dioxide and fluoride in high-alkalinity mine water and fly ash in an underground reservoir, which relates to the technical fields of environmental engineering, carbon capture and utilization, sealing and ecological restoration in mining areas, and comprises the following steps: in a coal-electricity integrated park, selecting a abandoned coal mine goaf which is stable in structure, has a waterproof top plate and a waterproof bottom plate and has a buried depth of 200-800m as an underground reservoir, and performing impermeable curtain reinforcement treatment on the underground reservoir by adopting a cement slurry grouting process to form a closed isolation space. The underground reservoir method for cooperatively storing carbon dioxide and fluoride by high-alkalinity mine water and fly ash realizes the cooperative coupling of five resources of CO2, fly ash, coal gangue, high-fluorine high-alkalinity mine water and abandoned goaf for the first time, synchronously solves four problems of carbon emission, solid waste storage, water pollution and geological disasters, and forms a closed loop system of waste recycling, pollutant storage and geological environment restoration.
assignees: ZHONGGUANCUN ZHIZHEN ENVIRONMENTAL PROT CO LTD

title_en: Protective work and protective work constructing method
abstract_en: To provide a technique to quickly construct an emergency countermeasure work at a disaster area after occurrence of disaster when conducting restoration activity and the like at a region where sediment and drift woods overflow due to a landslide disaster.SOLUTION: A protective work 1 is constructed so as to face an expected flow of debris flood and has a foundation 10 installed underground and a trapper 20 that is connected to the foundation 10 so as to be attachable and detachable and traps objects in the debris flood. The foundation 10 has a plurality of pile members 11, 13 formed of steel pipe. The trapper 20 is installed on the ground G and has column members 21, 23 and a beam member 25.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Business method, apparatus and system for monitoring quantitative and qualitative environmental analytics and managing associated financial transactions
abstract_en: To provide a system, apparatus, and business method for using financial instruments to provide investment incentive to fund disaster mitigation projects and/or ecosystem restoration projects triggered by real world events detected at set points by sensors and analyzed by computing devices.SOLUTION: The detection of events results in the computational analysis and determination of characteristics of a resilience bond or ecosystem-service bond to be issued or returned to investors. Examples involve sensors used to detect events, including flood damage mitigation, earthquake damage mitigation, or air quality improvement. An investor may make an initial payment into a financial instrument being a resilience bond used to fund a mitigation project, the financial instrument pays phases to the mitigation project developer at the completion of phases of the project that occur prior to the occurrence of a disaster.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: System and operation method for error restoration of distribution line
title_ko: 배전선로 고장복구 시스템 및 이의 운용방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for recovering an error of a distribution line and an operation method thereof capable of supporting the error recovery of the distribution line. The present invention comprises a distribution information obtainment unit and a distribution control unit. The distribution information obtainment unit is installed in a substation and extracts a final blackout feeder by obtaining the state information and the error recovery information of the substation when the error is generated in the substation. The distribution control unit performs the error recovery of the substation by determining whether or not the error recovery is possible through constant opening point connection or constant connecting point separation of the distribution line based on the final blackout feeder. The distribution information obtainment unit extracts the final blackout feeder when the error recovery in the substation is impossible by determining an error type through the state information and determining whether or not the error recovery in the substation is possible. [Reference numerals] (110) Substation; (120) Distribution information obtainment unit; (130) Front end processing device; (140) Distribution control unit; (150) Distribution station
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 배전선로의 고장복구를 지원하는 배전선로 고장복구 시스템 및 이의 운용방법에 관한 것으로, 변전소에 설치되어, 상기 변전소 고장 발생시 상기 변전소의 상태정보 및 고장복구정보를 취득하여 최종 정전 피더(feeder)를 추출하는 배전 정보 취득부; 및 상기 추출된 최종 정전 피더(feeder)를 토대로 상기 배전선로의 상시 개방점 연결 또는 상시 연결점 분리를 통해 고장복구가 가능한지 여부를 판단하여 상기 변전소의 고장복구가 수행되도록 하는 배전 제어부;를 포함하고, 상기 배전 정보 취득부는, 상기 상태정보를 통해 고장 형태를 판단하고, 상기 고장복구정보를 통해 상기 변전소 내부에서 고장복구가 가능한지 여부를 판단하여 상기 변전소 내부에서 고장복구가 불가능하다고 판단되는 경우 상기 최종 정전 피더(feeder)를 추출하는 것을 특징으로 하는 배전선로 고장복구 시스템을 포함한다.

title_en: Fail-safe automatic mains-electricity cutoff
abstract_en: A fail-safe automatic mains-electricity cutoff system and method for automatic disconnection from a mains service drop in the event of mains power outage or instability, and automatic reconnection after restoration of stable mains power, with indications of operational status through a unit display, an indicator light, and an RF communication link to a remote unit. A unit enclosure having a unit door and a ground bus houses the fail-safe automatic mains-electricity cutoff system which is installed on the mains service drop, below the electrical meter and above the main breaker panel or main service disconnect switch. Low-voltage DC power for system operation is supplied through a battery unit. Disconnection and connection to mains power is effected through a switching unit providing a mains-voltage sensor, a fail-safe switch and a fail-safe switch actuator. A premises-voltage sensor and current sensor can also be provided in embodiments. A controller controls operation of the fail-safe automatic mains-electricity cutoff system based on real-time measurements and programmed operational parameters, and records and reports system status and measurements.

title_en: Method and system for coordinated recovery of power and communication of power distribution network after extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network automation, in particular to a method and a system for coordinated recovery of power and communication of a power distribution network after extreme disasters, and a double-network fusion model of the power distribution network communication network and the power network is established; determining a necessary communication restoration; judging the length of necessary communication recovery time; responding to the necessary communication recovery time, and executing fixed priority order recovery of the power distribution network; and in response to the long necessary communication recovery time, partitioning the power distribution network communication network and power network double-network fusion model, and recovering communication faults and traditional power faults of each partition one by one. The invention introduces necessary communication recovery based on the influence of the communication information system on the power distribution network rush-repair process, respectively establishes a coordinated recovery strategy of power and communication of the power distribution network according to the length of the necessary communication recovery time, and is effectively used for guiding the recovery of the power distribution network after extreme disasters, helping the smooth proceeding of the post-disaster rush-repair work, thereby shortening the rush-repair time and reducing the loss caused by the power distribution network faults.

title_en: Underground water restoration process intelligent supervision method and system based on multi-mode monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring method and system for a groundwater remediation process based on multi-mode monitoring, and belongs to the technical field of groundwater monitoring. The method comprises the steps of arranging exploratory wells according to the actual conditions of a repairing area, setting sensors, adding repairing agents, initializing data acquisition nodes, constructing a water quality data cluster based on the acquisition nodes, dividing repairing stages, evaluating degradation efficiency of different water quality indexes in each stage, realizing dynamic tracking of repairing effects, constructing a degradation state feedback matrix based on degradation efficiency calculation efficiency mean value, marking the degradation state as normal or abnormal, evaluating the abnormal correlation degree of water quality repairing among exploratory wells based on the feedback matrix, identifying exploratory wells with correlation and outputting the exploratory wells to a worker port. According to the invention, through multi-mode monitoring and dynamic efficiency evaluation, the accurate supervision and anomaly traceability of the groundwater remediation process are realized, the water quality change is influenced by the same factor, the problem area can be rapidly positioned, and the remediation efficiency and decision scientificity are effectively improved.

title_en: Concrete precast segment assembly spraying concrete reinforcing soil tank
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a concrete precast segment is assembled and is spouted concrete and consolidate soil box mainly is applicable to high abrupt slope ecological restoration management such as mine, quarry, belongs to the environmental protection technology field. The technical proposal of the utility model is as follows: the mountain rock 5 is punched, and the punching depth is 25 cm; one side of the fixed rib 3 is embedded in the concrete precast slab 1, and the other side is fixed at the punching position; the concrete precast slabs 1 are closely arranged, concrete walls 4 are sprayed on the outer sides and between gaps, and the total thickness of the sprayed concrete walls 4 is 10 cm; and nutrient planting soil 2 is arranged between the concrete precast slab 1 and the mountain rock 5. The utility model discloses by a wide margin reduction ecological remediation's cost, simple and easy rapid construction, it is fast to take effect, has not only controlled further destruction of ecological environment, and geological disasters have also obtained effectual improvement simultaneously.
assignees: THE SECOND GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE OF HEBEI BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL RESOURCES;LI XIAOFENG

title_en: Typhoon emergency data automatic statistical system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic typhoon emergency data statistical system which comprises an automatic data input module, a data matching processing module, a data statistical analysis module, a query module and a data display module, wherein the automatic data input module is used for inputting typhoon emergency data; the automatic data entry module is used for automatically entering the power failure line information from the scheduling platform and automatically entering the power failure event from the marketing system; the data matching processing module is used for matching the corresponding power failure event according to the power failure line information; the data statistics and analysis module is used for counting and analyzing the power failure detail data influenced by the power failure event; the query module is used for allowing an authorized user to query the statistical power failure detail data; and the data display module is used for displaying the power failure and restoration condition, the power failure ratio and the loss load of each district according to the counted data. The invention can automatically acquire the disaster-caused loss data to be counted from the existing platform or system, reduces the labor cost and time cost of a manual counting mode, improves the working efficiency and ensures the accuracy of the data.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power consumption data restoration method and system based on Bayesian Gaussian tensor decomposition model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of data restoration, and discloses a power consumption data restoration method and a power consumption data restoration system based on a Bayesian tensor decomposition model, which are used for collecting weather, holidays, week types and power consumption data, constructing weather factors, holiday factors and week factors, and constructing a similarity objective function according to the weather factors, the holiday factors and the week factors; optimizing the similarity objective function by using a Trojan optimization algorithm, and searching M similarity days with the highest similarity with the repair day in the history days; and constructing a third-order tensor by using the electricity consumption data of M similar days with the highest similarity, and inputting the third-order tensor into a Bayesian Gaussian tensor decomposition model to carry out data restoration. According to the invention, the improved Trojan optimization algorithm is adopted to select similar days, and incomplete data is restored by inputting the similar days into the Bayesian Gaussian tensor decomposition model, so that the restoration accuracy is improved, the data quality is improved, and the accuracy of behaviors such as prediction and the like is improved.
assignees: NANCHANG INST TECH;JIANGXI BOOWAY NEW TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration method and system based on power station construction
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological restoration method and system based on power station construction, and relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring the original vegetation coverage rate of a construction area where a power station is positioned in a pre-construction stage of the power station, and determining an area to be restored according to the construction area; dividing the area to be repaired into all peripheral subareas, determining target vegetation types and target vegetation coverage, determining a repair coefficient according to the original vegetation coverage, determining expected vegetation coverage according to the repair coefficient and the target vegetation coverage, acquiring the current vegetation coverage of each peripheral subarea at the post-construction stage of the power station, and generating an indication instruction corresponding to the peripheral subarea under the condition that the current vegetation coverage is smaller than the expected vegetation coverage. According to the invention, the vegetation coverage rate and vegetation types before and after the power station construction are comprehensively analyzed, the ecological restoration is carried out in targeted sub-areas, the vegetation coverage of the surrounding environment of the power station is realized, and the ecological environment imbalance caused by the power station construction is prevented.
assignees: HUBEI ANYUAN SAFETY ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Historical culture block riding building structure reinforcement and restoration diagnosis system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for reinforcing, repairing and diagnosing a building structure of a historical cultural block, and relates to the technical field of building repair, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring deformation data of the building surface of the building by adopting a laser scanner, synchronously starting a ground penetrating radar to detect the hollowness rate and mortar compactness of the interior of a wall body, embedding a temperature and humidity sensor to acquire environmental corrosion parameters, and establishing a three-dimensional structure model fusing vibration and corrosion coupling characteristics; the method comprises the steps of generating a wall reinforcing module, a foundation reinforcing module and an earthquake-resistant reinforcing module according to a three-dimensional structure model, constructing a dynamic material database containing a gray plastic layer salt crystal growth rule, calculating a paper-reinforcement gray ratio and a thermal expansion compatible parameter of a reinforced concrete member through a multi-scale stress matching algorithm, carrying out typhoon and induced abortion coupling load simulation based on the repaired three-dimensional structure model, generating a three-dimensional activation scheme in combination with dynamic commercial streamline planning, and deploying an environment response type monitoring network.

title_en: Comprehensive ecological restoration method and system for power transmission line plots in northwest loess hilly areas of jin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a comprehensive ecological restoration method and system for power transmission line plots in a loess hilly region in northwest of jin. Aims at solving the technical problems of fragmentation, rough management and acceptance dislocation of the power transmission line trace ecological restoration technology in the loess hilly areas of northwest of jin. The technical scheme is that the ecological management system is realized by adopting a five-module three-cycle architecture, and comprises an ecological diagnosis module, a scheme generation module, an intelligent implementation module, a dynamic regulation and control module and an acceptance evaluation module.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Self-adaptive management method for groundwater resources
abstract_en: The description discloses a self-adaptive management method of groundwater resources, which comprises the steps of loading historical data and processing time information, calculating annual precipitation to classify and enrich/level/withhold water years, counting seasonal precipitation parameters of each hydrologic year, extracting historical window data to calculate accumulated precipitation, judging precipitation levels by combining hydrologic years and seasons to generate a dynamic strategy containing exploitation/source-supplementing adjustment coefficients, defining decision variables and constraints, initializing an objective function with maximized exploitation efficiency and minimized source-supplementing cost and ecological risk, creating an improved multi-objective evolution algorithm, dynamically adjusting operator parameters, applying intelligent restoration operators and matching with an optimization mechanism, calling a mixed deep learning model to predict water levels, calculating ecological risk and verifying constraints, analyzing Pareto solution sets, setting weight according to hydrologic years to select an optimal scheme and updating system states. The method improves the management adaptability and ensures the scientific and continuous decision making.

title_en: Power distribution network line disaster state sensing method and device based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring and sensing of power distribution line disaster damage states, in particular to a power distribution line disaster damage state sensing method and device based on image recognition, comprising the steps of inputting power distribution line image data into a pre-trained denoising diffusion probability model to obtain denoising image data output by the pre-trained denoising diffusion probability model; and inputting the denoising image data into a pre-trained power distribution network line disaster damage state sensing model to obtain a power distribution line disaster damage category output by the pre-trained power distribution network line disaster damage state sensing model. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the automatic judgment of different disaster-affected types such as displacement, galloping, wire-lapping, short circuit and the like can be performed, so that the disaster-affected state of the distribution line is output, and key information is provided for disaster emergency repair and power restoration after disaster.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Radio disaster prevention system and sensor node
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To appropriately perform event supporting processing by suppressing the time delay to a requisite minimum when an urgent event such as fire reporting to send early or fire restoration occurs during telegram transmission.  <P>SOLUTION: In occurrence of an event A, a transmission processing part of a radio sensor repeats, twice or more, telegram transmission A1-A3 for continuously transmitting the same telegram signal for a predetermined time T1 and telegram pause for pausing the telegram transmission for a predetermined time T2. When an urgent event B occurs during repetition of the telegram transmission A1 and the telegram pause based on the occurrence of the preceding event A by the transmission processing part, a transmission switching part repeats, once, the telegram transmission A1 and the telegram pause based on the preceding event A and pauses them, then switches them to the repetition of the telegram transmission B1, B2, etc. and the telegram pause based on the urgent event B.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Push-in fastener and fixing structure using the same
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a fixing structure which enhances earthquake resistance of a building skeleton made of wood structure material subject to deformation and vibration causing removal of a fastening nail, breaking from a nail hole, enlargement of a nail hole, and reduction or loss of surface pressure holding power, high heat insulation, and high airtight performance of ventilation furring strips.SOLUTION: A fixing structure using a push-in fastener 5 enables a foam synthetic resin plate 1 to be firmly fixed to a structural skeleton 4, so that intrinsic advantages such as shock absorbing property, visco-elasticity, and stress dispersibility can be utilized to a maximum extent, while material mechanical defects such as softness, weak resistance to a concentrated load, and inclination to local breakage are sealed or conquered. The fixing structure allows an entire wall surface of the structural skeleton to maintain excellent heat insulation property for a long period of time. The foam synthetic resin plate 1 functions as an absorber of seismic energy and as a restoring body of the absorbed seismic energy to make elastic deformation and elastic restoration, exhibiting quake resistance or seismic control property for a long period of time.

title_en: A kind of service restoration scheme generation method based on multiway tree search
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of service restoration scheme generation methods based on multiway tree search, comprising: the expecting state of default all switches of multiway tree is to close.Count the power supply number of each node of multiway tree.Count the remaining spare capacity of each node of multiway tree.Multiway tree is traversed, if the remaining spare capacity of its child node that " remaining spare capacity " is negative and its power supply number is 1 of the node that power supply number is 1 is not negative, the switch expecting state for being arranged between the two is set as point.Multiway tree is traversed, if there are the remaining spare capacities of child node and two child nodes that 2 power supply numbers are 1 not to be negative for the node that power supply number is 2, the switch expecting state between the small child node of remaining spare capacity is set as point.New multiway tree is formed, is repeated the above steps.When multiway tree root node power supply number be less than or equal to 1, then can be generated interconnection switch close control command and other switch point control commands.The present invention has the advantages that algorithm is succinctly clear, clear logic, formation speed is fast.

title_en: Path restoration method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a path restoration method, a path restoration device, path restoration equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an identification sequence of a vehicle, wherein the identification sequence comprises identifications written by the vehicle through a toll station entrance, an identification station or a toll station exit in a road network; acquiring a directed graph model of the road network constructed based on the position relationship between the toll station and the identification station in the road network; generating a basic pattern for each path between the toll station entrance and the toll station exit according to the directed graph model, wherein the basic pattern is a sequence comprising the identity of the identity station on the path; and selecting the driving path of the vehicle from paths respectively associated with all the basic modes according to the matching results of the identification sequence and all the basic modes so as to improve the accuracy and stability of the recovery path of the identification station, and further, reduce the time cost spent on manually correcting the path.

title_en: Urban waterlogging traffic network rapid restoration method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for rapidly repairing urban waterlogging traffic road network based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a graph structure of a road traffic network; generating a corresponding road dislocation degree matrix based on the adjacency matrix of the graph structure and the randomly generated feature matrix, and establishing a data set; constructing a deep learning neural network model with an attention mechanism based on the graph convolution neural network and the capsule neural network; training a deep learning neural network model through a data set; and predicting the road dislocation degree through the trained deep learning neural network model, and repairing the road network based on the road dislocation degree prediction result. According to the road network repairing method, the dislocation degree of the roads is represented by the difference of the edge medium number centrality, the dislocation degree of the roads under the rainstorm waterlogging situation is predicted by the deep learning neural network model, and the roads with high dislocation degree of the roads are preferentially selected from the dislocation degree to repair the road network, so that the timeliness of the road network repairing strategy is improved.

title_en: Methods and systems for post-disaster resilient restoration of power distribution system
abstract_en: Systems and methods for configuring micro-grids to restore some power in a power distribution grid (PDG) in response to a power disruption over the PDG. A computing system configured to receive current condition information from devices in the PDG. Form a minimum spanning forest (MSF) to identify a set of micro-grids, each spanning tree in a forest is a self-sustained islanded micro-grid network. Assign a ranking to each inter-bus link within each micro-grid according to constraints, to identify some inter-bus links above a high-ranking threshold to be switched off during a restoration period. Identify switches that restore power to some critical loads of a subset of critical loads with different forest configurations, based on buses that are switched on, to determine a subset of micro-grids less susceptible for link failures during the restoration period. Upon receiving a power disruption, activate the switches to restore some power to the PDG.

title_en: The ecological restoring method of tidal river banister pump dispatching method and tidal waterway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of tidal river banister pump dispatching method and the ecological restoring method of tidal waterway, tidal river banister pump dispatching method is included in river course dry season, closes the gate in river mouth；The gate in river mouth is opened in the river flood phase, during tide position at low ebb, is discharged into flood marine, current unidirectionally flow to marine；In the river flood phase, the gate in river mouth is closed when tide is at high tide, is discharged into flood by pumping plant marine, current unidirectionally flow to marine.The tidal river banister pump dispatching method of the present invention, using water conservancy projects such as the sluice of River Network, pumping plants, by water conservancy projects combined regulating measure, become reversing current as unidirectional stream, ensure river course upstream water body not by trend jacking, speed is let out under quickening, while increases the effect of dilution and the self-cleaning of water body, forms benign cycle, solves tidal river network, by trend and the double action of runoff, the problem of pollutant is back and forth flowed in river network, and the effect of tidal reach restoration of the ecosystem is improved simultaneously.
assignees: GUANGZHOU TAITONG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH INVESTMENT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of electronic contract generation method based on alliance's chain, information anti-fake method of tracing to the source
abstract_en: The present invention relates to block chain technical field, a kind of more particularly to electronic contract generation method based on alliance's chain, the method for anti-counterfeit for information of tracing to the source, distributed storage method, referee method and restoration methods, alliance's chain includes supervision department's credit cluster, alliance enterprise cluster, alliance arbitrates cluster and terminal and traced to the source service cluster, supervision department's credit cluster is used for the credit access of enterprise, information management, safety monitoring and behavior auditing, alliance enterprise cluster is the enterprise of credit access, alliance's arbitration cluster is used to send message broadcast, disaster recovery, terminal service cluster of tracing to the source is used for the false proof identification of information of tracing to the source.The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows：The cryptographic means of the secure content of electronic contract, ensure that data safety；All data ensure that each data of tracing to the source have the identity identification information of encryption by signature；It ensure that information truth of tracing to the source, can not change；Distributed storage, it ensure that the security of data storage；Then facilitate and confirm its authenticity.

title_en: Communication network restoration and reconstruction and dynamic networking method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of communication network restoration and reconstruction and dynamic networking methods, under disaster environment, quickly networking is carried out using the network of remaining, node searching and registration are completed by way of multi-hop, and according to node demand and monitoring demand, dynamic group net and network slice are carried out, the communication efficiency under emergency communication is further promoted；When the present invention can also change in monitoring demand, the new communication resource is added or section communication node is loss, automatic dynamic networking update and network slice update, in the fast network reconstruction when present invention can be destroyed with application communication network.

title_en: Space load prediction method and system for rapid power restoration after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space load prediction method and system for rapid power restoration after disaster, which are used for determining a period T before prediction according to typhoon disaster information 1 And load prediction target period T 2 (ii) a According to the pre-prediction period T 1 And predicting the target period T 2 Acquiring load data of a power supply grid in a disaster area, wherein the load data comprises a period T before prediction 1 Real-time load data X c (T 1 ) Historical load data X of period before prediction h (T 1 ) Historical load data X of target prediction period h (T 2 ) (ii) a Based on the period T before prediction 1 Corresponding historical load data X h (T 1 ) Obtaining T by fuzzy mean clustering 1 Historical typical load curve C of time interval power supply grid h (T 1 ) And corresponding membership degree matrix U h (ii) a Clustering the result C according to the fuzzy mean h (T 1 ) And real-time load data X c (T 1 ) Construction of Pre-prediction time-Domain real-time load data X c (T 1 ) For historical typical load curve C h (T 1 ) Membership degree matrix U c (ii) a Based on membership degree matrix U h 、U c And historical load data X of the target prediction period h (T 2 ) Constructing a load X for a target time period c (T 2 ) The load of the target period is predicted.
