title_en: Power distribution network reconstruction power restoration method and system based on island division
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply and discloses a power distribution network reconstruction restoration power supply method and system based on island division.
assignees: JIANGMEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Rural plant community configuration and dynamic optimization system suitable for composite pollution sites
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rural plant community configuration and dynamic optimization system suitable for a combined pollution site, which belongs to the technical field of environmental ecological restoration and soil pollution treatment and comprises six modules, namely a rural plant resource database, pollution site information acquisition and processing, intelligent plant community configuration, real-time monitoring and data feedback, dynamic optimization decision and visual interaction. The system realizes intelligent screening and community construction of the native plants through a multi-source data fusion and multi-target optimization algorithm, combines a sensor network and a machine learning model to monitor and dynamically regulate the repair process in real time, improves the repair efficiency, community stability and ecological safety of a heavy metal and organic pollutant composite pollution site, and supports full-period intelligent, low-cost and green sustainable ecological repair management.
assignees: RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENT INSTITUTE OF NORTHWESTERN POLYTECHNICAL UNIV IN SHENZHEN

title_en: Super real-time electric power carbon footprint metering system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a super-real-time electric power carbon footprint metering system, relates to the technical field of electric power system carbon emission metering, and solves the problems that an existing system is difficult to adapt to wind-solar second-level fluctuation, dynamic topology of a power grid, poor in instantaneity, low in accuracy, high in link delay and difficult to meet the requirements of a novel power grid and spot electric power markets. The system comprises a data acquisition module for synchronously acquiring four types of data in second level, a data processing module for completing data restoration and the like within 50ms and outputting a clean tensor, a model module for generating a carbon factor sequence meeting physical constraint by end-to-end frame parallel prediction, and an application module for realizing monitoring and early warning, wherein the overall delay is less than 1s. The system completes multi-scale parallel prediction in a single GPU through zero-copy transmission and three-level self-healing processes, can realize super-real-time metering, high-accuracy carbon factor output and continuous stable operation, and effectively supports efficient operation of a novel power system and the spot market.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Consistency group restoration from a secondary site
abstract_en: Techniques for replay of groups of I/Os for disaster recovery. At a primary site, a plurality of primary site computing entities that are to be restored from the secondary computing site after a disaster recovery event are identified as belonging to an entity group. At the primary site, I/O commands that are performed over any of the entities of the entity group are observed and streamed to the secondary site, where they are persisted into a log. Periodically, the primary site sends the secondary site an I/O map that associates a time with an indication of the last performed I/O commands pertaining to any observed I/O commands that had been performed over any one or more of the computing entities of the entity group. Upon receiving a disaster recovery request, the most recent I/O map and the secondary site log are processed to construct a snapshot for the entity group.

title_en: Method and system for online decision making of generator start-up
abstract_en: A method and system for online decision making of generator start-up, determining the lines to be restored step by step based on the real-time power system data to guide the initial stage. The black-start unit is determined, and the units waiting to be restored are selected from all units. The training set including labeled samples to establish a value network. During generator start-up, the blackout area is judged, the state of power system is identified, the availability of equipment is judged, and the characteristics of generators are collected. The total generation capability is used as search objective for Monte Carlo tree search. Based on the value network, Monte Carlo is applied to search the next line to be restored during generator start-up. Parallel computation adopted to check the constraints for the restoration of alternative lines. The results of Monte Carlo are summarized to determine the line to be restored next.

title_en: Power failure identification method based on electric power big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a power failure identification method based on electric power big data, which comprises the following steps: acquiring the daily operation time of the metering terminal; judging whether the daily running time is less than the preset time or not; if the daily running time is less than the preset time, collecting power failure and restoration alarm information, and acquiring voltage and current data and electric quantity data; and identifying power failure according to the power failure and restoration alarm information, the voltage and current data and the electric quantity data. The invention can conveniently and accurately realize power failure identification.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CSG POWER GRID TECHNOLOGY RES CT

title_en: Telephone traffic prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a telephone traffic prediction method, which comprises the following steps: the model is divided into: fault power failure, planned power failure, arrearage power failure and power restoration, electric quantity and electricity charge, customer basic information and electricity service; performing broad-table processing according to the models to obtain input and output variables of each model; data processing: after wide-table data processing is carried out on original data and before data modeling is carried out, data cleaning is carried out on the data, and the data are converted into stable dimensionless input-output variable data; and (3) modeling data, wherein the selected model is an LSTM long-short term memory network model for training, verifying and testing. The invention classifies the models of the telephone traffic, determines the input variable and the output variable of each model, and trains the selected model as an LSTM long-term and short-term memory network model, thereby ensuring the model accuracy rate which can reach more than 80%.

title_en: Method for ecological restoration and treatment of mountain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for restoring and treating mountain ecology, which comprises the following steps: and S1, mountain division, namely dividing the mountain to be repaired into a mountain exposed out of rock stratum or a mountain exposed out of broken stone on the mountain, and dividing the mountain to be repaired into a top platform, a slope slate and a slag slope according to expression forms with different heights and degrees. By the method, the structure of the mountain is changed, buffering can be achieved, the stability of the mountain is improved, landslide and collapse of the mountain are reduced, water and soil loss can be retarded, the living soil environment of plants can be rebuilt on the damaged mountain, a new vegetation community of the damaged mountain can be rapidly derived, long-term manual maintenance and management cost after the existing damaged mountain is repaired can be avoided, ecological environment-friendly repair in the true sense can be achieved, the effect is good, and the efficiency is high.
assignees: XUZHOU JIUZHOU ECOLOGICAL GARDEN CO LTD

title_en: Mining area ecological restoration artificial influence weather service benefit evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mining area ecological restoration artificial influence weather service benefit evaluation method, which can be used for selecting a target mining area and a comparison mining area, obtaining loss data of vegetation of the target mining area and the comparison mining area, which are influenced by a meteorological disaster in a restoration period, constructing a meteorological re-analysis field, acquiring cloud micro physical parameters by using the meteorological re-analysis field, inverting to obtain a diffusion influence area, acquiring validity evaluation results of a human shadow operation according to the diffusion influence area, acquiring public opinion evaluation results of each participant of different time nodes on the target mining area, fitting the loss data, the validity evaluation results and the public opinion evaluation results on a time scale, and establishing a benefit evaluation model. It can be understood that the technical scheme of the invention can establish a benefit evaluation model in three aspects of loss data, effectiveness evaluation results and public opinion evaluation results, thereby achieving the establishment of a mining area ecological restoration type figure operation benefit evaluation system and forming an ecological restoration type figure operation service benefit evaluation index system.

title_en: Cable path planning method, apparatus, device, medium and program product
abstract_en: The application provides a cable path planning method which can be applied to the technical field of power systems. The cable path planning method comprises the steps of obtaining layout data of a photovoltaic power station, wherein the layout data comprise positions of a transformer substation in the photovoltaic power station, positions of a converging box used for converging current and positions of gap points needed for connecting the converging box to the transformer substation, determining connection cost among the transformer substation, the converging box and the gap points based on position relations in the layout data, planning an initial path of the converging box connected to the transformer substation through the gap points according to the connection cost, sequentially adjusting the initial path by using a preset path destruction operator and a preset path restoration operator to obtain an updated path, and comparing the connection cost of the updated path with the connection cost of the initial path to output the updated path under the condition that preset conditions are met. The application also provides a cable path planning device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product.

title_en: Dynamic lease matching method for electric power construction equipment based on demand prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic lease matching method for electric power construction equipment based on demand prediction, and relates to the technical field of electric power construction. According to the power construction equipment dynamic lease matching method based on demand prediction, the fault range is determined based on the power system topological structure, the fault degree is determined according to the fault equipment set and the power fault data set, the lease scheme is preferentially matched with the fault range with the maximum fault degree, faults with more serious influence can be ensured to be preferentially processed, the pertinence and timeliness of fault emergency response are improved, meanwhile, the substitution degree of substitution equipment is obtained through the comparison of the required construction equipment set and the leasable equipment set and the equipment missing, and whether a substitution scheme or a replacement provider is accepted or not is judged by combining the substitution coefficient, the problem of equipment mismatch can be effectively solved, the dynamic landing of the lease scheme is guaranteed, the fault restoration due to equipment problems is avoided, the leased matching efficiency and reliability of the power construction equipment are finally improved, and powerful support is provided for rapid power fault restoration.

title_en: Fast network formation after network power restoration
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a first device in a network detects a power restoration event subsequent to a power outage event. Power is restored to the first device during the power restoration event. The first device synchronizes a channel hopping schedule to the detected power restoration event. The first device communicates with a neighboring device of the first device using the channel hopping schedule synchronized to the detected power restoration event. The neighboring device uses a corresponding channel hopping schedule to communicate with the first device that is also synchronized to the power restoration event.

title_en: Disaster recovery switchover method and system, and node
abstract_en: A disaster recovery switchover system, the disaster recovery switchover system includes a production node, a redundancy node, and a recording node, the production node currently runs a first production service, and the method includes: receiving, by the recording node, first restoration information sent by the production node, where the first restoration information is information required for restoring the first production service to a latest running status of the first production service; and sending, by the recording node when determining that the first production service needs to be restored on the redundancy node, second restoration information to the redundancy node, where the second restoration information is information that is obtained according to the first restoration information and that is required to restore the first production service on the redundancy node, so that the redundancy node switches the first production service to the redundancy node according to the second restoration information.

title_en: Network security countermeasure method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a network security countermeasure method, a network security countermeasure device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of network security. Firstly, initiating attack operation to a defending side host by utilizing each preset risk item of the defending side host. The method comprises the steps of determining an emergency response score of a defending side host according to emergency response operation of the defending side host, determining a reinforcement score of the defending side host according to attack cost and a restoration result of the defending side host to a preset risk item, and determining a counterattack score of the defending side host according to counterattack operation of the defending side host to a network security counterattack platform. And finally, determining the defending score of the defending side host according to the emergency response score, the reinforcement score and the counterattack score. The network security training of defending personnel more close to the actual network attack scene is carried out, and the defending capability of the defending personnel to the network attack is improved.

title_en: Recovery improvement method for electricity-gas comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recovery improvement method of an electricity-gas comprehensive energy system. Establishing a network structure topological model of the electricity-gas comprehensive energy system; determining an initial system operation state under an electric-gas integrated energy system network structure topological model; establishing an electric-gas comprehensive energy system recovery sequence optimization model; and processing according to the recovery sequence to obtain the recovery force parameter of the electric-gas integrated energy system, obtaining the recovery condition of the electric-gas integrated energy system, and judging according to the recovery condition to implement improvement. The method can obtain the recovery sequence of the electric power line and the natural gas pipeline after the large-range fault of the electric-gas comprehensive energy system, guide system constructors to repair the electric power line and the natural gas pipeline according to the obtained recovery sequence, and quickly recover the electric power load and the natural gas load in the system, thereby effectively improving the overall recovery capability of the electric-gas comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Device and method for adjusting electricity consumption of a plurality of lighting devices of a lighting system
abstract_en: The invention is based on the idea that control of power consumption in a system comprising power consuming devices like lighting devices, for example, can be performed by dividing the power consuming devices of the system into a plurality of groups and by taking into account power consumption or load shedding or restoration capability for each group. Further, the invention implements an auction mechanism for adjusting power consumption or load in the lighting system such that an effective, fast, user requirements considering and lighting device functions and characteristics considering adjusting is achieved.

title_en: Protecting data against malware attacks using cyber vault and automated airgap control
abstract_en: Improving data recovery and restoration times by clamping down security after malware detection, and protect a data center from a cyber recovery vault. Embodiments provide a cyber recovery vault configured to store data backed up for a production site for long-term retention and disaster recovery. The vault is coupled to the data center comprising a production site through an automated air gap controlled by the vault. Control signals transmitted by the vault trigger the air gap to close the coupling between the vault and data center upon detection of a malware attack, and the data center is configured to listen for the control signals and implement heightened security measures to protect its data in response to the control signal.

title_en: Prevent ecological recovery structure of side slope of landslide and soil erosion and water loss
abstract_en: The utility model provides a slope ecological restoration structure for preventing landslide and water and soil loss, which comprises wood piles, bamboo chips, geotextile and ecological bags, wherein seeds and nutrient soil are filled in the ecological bags, and nursery stocks are planted at openings of the ecological bags; the timber pile is according to certain interval vertical fixation in the side slope, the bamboo chip dislocation cross fixation in the timber pile, geotechnological cloth is folded perpendicularly in the timber pile with the bamboo chip is followed side slope uphill direction one side, ecological bag stack in the timber pile is followed side slope uphill direction one side. According to the slope ecological restoration structure provided by the utility model, the surface layer water and soil loss is effectively prevented through the wood piles and the bamboo chips arranged on the slope, the fine grained soil loss is prevented through the reverse filtration effect of the geotextile, a good effect is achieved when the slope ecological restoration structure is applied to a region with serious water and soil loss in a dump, the surface layer landslide and the water and soil loss can be effectively prevented, and soil and nutrient elements required by vegetation growth can be ensured.

title_en: Intelligent community electricity consumption information collecting server system and data processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power technology, particularly to an intelligent community electricity consumption information collecting server system and a data processing method. According to the technical scheme, the intelligent community electricity consumption information collecting server system comprises an application server, the application server is connected with a client, a browser, an interface server and a prepositive server, the prepositive server is connected with a database server, the client comprises a user interaction module, the browser comprises an information display module, the application server comprises a service application module and a support service module, the prepositive serve comprises a collection task module, a protocol processing module and a communication calling module. The intelligent community electricity consumption information collecting server system and the data processing method have the advantages that a database system in the intelligent community electricity consumption information collecting server system and the data processing method supports complete data backup and restoration mechanisms and can meet the requirements of storage, retrieval, mining and the like of high-capacity data.

title_en: A kind of metering device production planning optimization method based on mixed integer programming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of metering device production planning optimization method based on mixed integer programming, belong to metering production planning management field.Combing of the present invention metering production operation flow and whole-life cycle fee requirement,Requirement forecasting is considered,Material supply cycle,Central Security stock,Rotation working system,Equipment detection capability and its repair schedule,The factors such as the influence plan such as transport,Establish the metering production planning optimization model based on mixed integer programming,With cost and the minimum object function of stock,With plan for cargo arrival monthly,Calibrating plan,Distribution plan is decision variable,And solved using yalimp tool boxes,And timely feedback modifiers can be carried out according to implementation of the plan and emergency case,The method has effectively evaded the deficiency of artificial experience,Realize that the science of the whole metering production schedule is formulated,Efficiently perform,Not only meet power supply unit and its station institute (two fraction storehouses and straight with storehouse) in time uses table demand,Significantly cut down center stock and production cost,For measurement centre realizes that intelligent running provides strong support.

title_en: A kind of Dredging Construction method for the canal that drains off floodwaters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Dredging Construction method for the canal that drains off floodwaters, and from upstream to downstream channel is divided into three construction sections and including following process：First construction section and the desilting process of second segment construction section, the desilting process of the 3rd construction section, dredging residual water precipitation process process and marine stockyard antiseepage process；When carrying out the desilting process of the first construction section and second segment construction section, using environment-protective desilting and using customizing, small-sized strand inhales ship and 4010 types twist and inhale ship construction；When carrying out the desilting process of the 3rd section of construction section, using draining desilting and slush pump is constructed；When carrying out dredging residual water precipitation process process, dredging residual water precipitation process is carried out using two-stage flocculence；Side slope surface is anti-when carrying out marine stockyard antiseepage process, including in the cofferdam of stockyard blends the antiseepage of stockyard bottom surface.The Dredging Construction method of the canal that drains off floodwaters of the present invention not only solves alluvial problem, moreover it is possible to removes the pollutant in bed mud, is laid the first stone further to implement Ecological Restoration Project.

title_en: A kind of highway fast charge network intelligence cloud service system and device
abstract_en: A kind of highway fast charge network intelligence cloud service system and device provided by the invention, including set charging equipment on a highway and cloud server, charging equipment as follows in working method by network connection to cloud server, the cloud server：For each target charging equipment, its repair schedule is adjusted accordingly according to its current state；And for each target charging equipment that current state is failure, according to its current operational information, corresponding maintenance program is obtained using Knowledge of Maintenance storehouse.To the charging equipment in abnormal condition, timely inspection or maintenance are carried out, and then reduces the probability of device fails, improves the utilization rate of equipment.

title_en: A method of water demand for natural service is calculated using Technology of low altitude remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method for calculating water demand for natural service using Technology of low altitude remote sensing, include the following steps: that unmanned plane obtains river data；The screening of river dominant species；The determination of ecological flow velocity and ecological velocity；The calculating of water demand for natural service and Service Efficiency.The present invention utilizes low-altitude remote sensing unmanned air vehicle technique, obtains river accurately graphic data, and be finally inversed by river cross-section shape；Calculating river channel ecology using ecological waterpower radius method needs water and Service Efficiency simultaneously.Avoid that many method data acquisition low efficiencys, insufficient to water demand for natural service and its changing rule understanding, the biological life period is inconsiderate, seizes the problems such as water demand for natural service without limit, this method has the characteristics that comprehensive, reasonability, accuracy, this is researcher and government regulators provide restoration of the ecosystem and scheduling provides scientific basis.

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation method for restoring force of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive evaluation method for restoring force of a power system, which comprises the steps of firstly considering stage characteristics and influence factors of restoring force evaluation of the power system, constructing an evaluation index system for the restoring force of an elastic power system from multiple dimensions, and screening out key indexes from the evaluation index system; and determining the score and the weight of each level index in the restoring force evaluation index system, obtaining the overall score condition of the power system by a comprehensive scoring method, and performing transverse comparison and longitudinal comparison on the elastic construction level of the power system according to the comprehensive evaluation result. The method can synthesize the influence of a plurality of evaluation dimensions on the power grid resilience, is used for transverse comparison and longitudinal comparison of the power grid elasticity development level, and provides effective reference for system planning operation and restoration decision.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Method and system for determining groundwater pollution remediation threshold of refuse landfill
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for determining a threshold value for repairing sewage pollution in a refuse landfill, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a primary evaluation system, and carrying out primary evaluation on the environmental risk; dividing the risk into 3 grades according to the risk index, and formulating corresponding repair threshold values according to the grades; calculating a restoration threshold value of a landfill with a risk grade of a middle grade according to a target concentration method; and (4) establishing a restoration threshold value with a high-level risk level of the polluted site by using a health risk evaluation method. And (4) deducing the pollution remediation threshold of the landfill by numerically simulating the migration and transformation process of the underground water in the hydraulic gradient direction for the landfill with the intermediate and high risk levels. The method simplifies the formulation procedure of the remediation threshold of the high-risk polluted site, reduces the workload, and also enhances the pertinence and the accuracy of the remediation threshold of the pollution in the high-risk area.

title_en: Mine slope geological disaster monitoring and ecological restoration collaborative early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine slope geological disaster monitoring and ecological restoration cooperative early warning system, and relates to the technical field of mine slope monitoring. The mine side slope ecological monitoring system comprises a central processing unit, wherein the central processing unit is connected with a plurality of side slope displacement monitoring units and a plurality of side slope ecological monitoring units through a wireless communication module, the side slope displacement monitoring units are inserted into the surface of a mine side slope side by side along the transverse direction of the mine side slope, the side slope ecological monitoring units are installed at the bottom edge of the mine side slope side by side along the transverse direction of the mine side slope, and any one side slope ecological monitoring unit is arranged between any two adjacent side slope displacement monitoring units. The invention can effectively improve the collaborative early warning effect of mine slope geological disaster monitoring and ecological restoration.
assignees: ANHUI JINLIAN GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES TECH CO LTD

title_en: Construction method and device for river dike of hydraulic engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method and a construction device for a river dike of a hydraulic engineering, which relate to the technical field of edge calculation and comprise the steps of dividing the river dike into M risk dike sections through service risk distribution prediction; the method comprises the steps of carrying out non-uniform deployment of sensors, constructing M edge multi-mode sensing networks, carrying out hierarchical topological risk prediction on the returned M edge multi-mode heterogeneous data through a parallel computing container at a dike risk prediction cloud, outputting a plurality of dike risk feature vectors, dividing a plurality of risk source structures from a dike structure design, carrying out restoration strategy matching to obtain a plurality of construction restoration strategies, and dynamically executing the construction restoration strategies on the dike of the serving river channel according to the risk restoration priority. The invention solves the technical problems that the river dike management in the prior art is usually designed for a single project, the prior technical scheme cannot be directly migrated in different dike areas, and the construction cost is high and the period is long due to the lack of flexible reusability.
assignees: SHAANXI FUBA WEIYE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Park electric data privacy protection and restoration device and method based on space-time federal hidden feature learning
abstract_en: The application discloses a park electric power data privacy protection and restoration device and method based on space-time federal hidden characteristic learning in the field of incomplete electric power data restoration of a power grid. The device comprises a server and a plurality of client devices, wherein the client devices particularly comprise a space-time feature extraction module and a power data module, the power data module particularly comprises a space-time feature correlation matrix storage unit and other client hidden feature vector storage units in the same park, and the method comprises the steps of explicitly and structurally integrating the power data hidden features into a model by constructing a space Laplace matrix and a time difference matrix, so that higher power data recovery precision is obtained. The application solves the problem that the prior art is difficult to use priori knowledge to cause the limitation of the performance in the data recovery, can ensure the accurate realization of the power data recovery under the privacy protection, and effectively improves the recovery precision.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Power distribution network restoration method and apparatus, and device, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The present application relates to a power distribution network restoration method and apparatus, and a device, a storage medium and a program product. The method comprises: by taking a target restoration amount that corresponds to a power distribution network to be restored in a preset restoration period being maximized as an objective, constructing an objective function for restoring said power distribution network; acquiring a constraint condition for constraining said power distribution network, wherein the constraint condition comprises a resource scheduling constraint condition for constraining the scheduling of power restoration resources, and a power distribution network constraint condition for constraining said power distribution network; on the basis of the objective function and the constraint condition, determining a scheduling policy for the power restoration resources; and on the basis of the scheduling policy, restoring power to said power distribution network. By using the method, the restoration effect of a power distribution network can be improved.

title_en: A kind of intelligent distribution network self-healing method based on improvement ant group algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of based on the intelligent distribution network self-healing method for improving ant group algorithm, belongs to intelligent power distribution technical field.Step of the invention are as follows: one, obtain the primary data of power distribution network for currently needing to reconstruct；Two, the environmental information that initialization distribution network failure restores；Three, multiple radial networks are generated according to ant group algorithm and minimum spanning tree theory；Four, according to power distribution network primary data obtained by step 1, the network loss value for multiple radial networks that step 3 is formed is calculated, and chooses a progress directivity information element update in the path that all ants are formed in current iteration with minimum network loss value；Five, step three and four is repeated to complete next iteration, is circuited sequentially, until completing maximum number of iterations.The present invention parses distribution network failure Restoration model using improved ant group algorithm, to reduce distribution network loss as target, computational efficiency with higher, and final self-healing scheme can effectively guarantee system after a failure safety, economically run.

title_en: Method and system for testing fault processing, testing and analyzing of power distribution main station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for testing, processing and analyzing faults of a power distribution main station, which comprises the steps of collecting fault data by using an FTT 1200; injecting the fault data into a testing power distribution main station to carry out real-time information interaction, testing the fault data and outputting test information; constructing a fusion optimization analysis model based on different types of fault information and fault related characteristics to perform fault analysis on the test information to obtain an analysis result; the effectiveness of the FA function of the main station system under the normal condition of the operating environment is tested, the robustness of the main station system under the abnormal environment can be tested, various communication protocols can be adopted to inject the fault characteristic data of the tested power distribution network, and the functions of displaying the whole process of self-fault occurrence, fault positioning, fault isolation and power restoration of a non-fault area of the tested system are achieved.

title_en: Energy planning prediction method and device based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy planning prediction method and device based on a neural network, and relates to the technical field of power data analysis. According to the method, the existing energy planning sample data set is used for training to obtain the data prediction algorithm model and the data restoration algorithm model, the data prediction algorithm model and the data restoration algorithm model are used for carrying out quality detection and restoration on the energy planning data to be detected, the quality of the data can be improved, the follow-up energy planning is facilitated, the processing time of the data is shortened in the mode that the energy planning prediction data are obtained through the energy planning prediction model formed by training the energy planning data, the labor cost is reduced, all the data can be processed quickly, the data are not easy to miss, the accuracy of the energy planning information is improved, and the possibility of energy planning errors and the energy planning cost are reduced.

title_en: Dynamic risk assessment method for tanning contaminated site based on reactive solute transport
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic risk assessment method for a tanning contaminated site based on reactive solute migration, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting contaminated site soil, underground water samples and data materials, investigating the type of the contaminated site, generating working conditions and seepage prevention measures, S2, constructing a soil migration conceptual model and a numerical model according to scenes, calculating migration of pollutants in a gas-covered zone medium, S3, establishing a chemical balance system of the tanning characteristic pollutants based on a thermodynamic database, analyzing migration and transformation rules of the pollutants in an aquifer medium, S4, calculating static exposure and dynamic potential exposure of living residents around the site, and S5, deducing the dynamic exposure of the solute migration in the site by taking the acceptance degree of the exposure as a criterion, and balancing and optimizing site exposure investigation-assessment-management. Reasonable risk management and control, site restoration and ecological environment protection strategies can be further formulated to provide scientific basis.

title_en: Power connection control system and method
abstract_en: For each of consumers, a connection control apparatus is provided that includes an opening/closing device capable of connecting or disconnecting an electric power system and a consumer, that, when a power outage occurs in the electric power system, disconnects the electric power system and the consumer from each other by the opening/closing device at a command from an outage management apparatus or the like, and that connects the electric power system and the consumer to each other by the opening/closing device upon receiving a command from the outage management apparatus or the like at the time of restoration from the power outage. A power supply control apparatus supplies electric power from energy provision equipment to electrical appliances during a power outage in the electric power system.

title_en: Modularized ecological slope protection device for geological disaster treatment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a modularized ecological slope protection device for geological disaster treatment, which relates to the field of slope protection devices and comprises a main structure and a splicing structure, wherein the main structure comprises an outer frame, an inner cavity of the outer frame is fixedly connected with a protective net, the splicing structure comprises a containing groove, the containing groove is formed in the periphery of the surface of the outer frame, the outer frame is used as a supporting framework of the device, the protective net is used for blocking and slowing down the loss of slope soil and playing a role of slope protection, and can be used as a substrate for plant growth to promote ecological restoration, the containing groove is used for containing and fixing a first rotating plate and a second rotating plate, so that the modules can be conveniently and rapidly spliced and disassembled, the first rotating plate and the second rotating plate are matched, the connection and the fixation of the modules are realized through rotation, the flexibility and the expandability of the device are improved, and the fixing ring and the first inserting ring are used as connecting points in cooperation with a positioning bolt, and the fixation of the modules is realized.
assignees: JIANGSU EAST CHINA NONFERROUS DEEP GEOLOGICAL EXPLORATION CO LTD RESOURCE INVESTIGATION AND EVALUATI

title_en: A kind of Condition-based Maintenance of Substation Equipment method for diagnosing faults
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Condition-based Maintenance of Substation Equipment method for diagnosing faults, technical characteristics are：By improving typical and difference sample, establish based on the adaptive regularized learning algorithm rate model of optimization；Condition-based Maintenance of Substation Equipment fault diagnosis is carried out according to based on the adaptive regularized learning algorithm rate model of optimization.Reasonable design of the present invention, it, which carries out Condition-based Maintenance of Substation Equipment fault diagnosis by being based on optimizing adaptive regularized learning algorithm rate model, can effectively reduce redundant diagnostic information, cumbersome calculating is avoided to derive, keep fault identification neural network model more practical, it is more in line with actual conditions, overhaul efficiency is improved, fault restoration cost and user's outage cost cost are controlled；Avoid the problem that blindly overhauling grade and owing to overhaul exist, adequately achieve the balance of safety, efficiency, economy, it can instruct the development of the work such as replacement, transformation, operation and maintenance and the checking experiment of transformer equipment, or administrative decision and overhaul of the equipments of transformer equipment etc. provide direct basis.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power dispatching visual management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual management method and a visual management system for power dispatching, which relate to the technical field of data processing, and comprise the following steps: acquiring a plurality of repair data sets of a target power company; the input data access module analyzes data to obtain a plurality of demand direction label sets; constructing a first constraint condition according to the manpower condition of a target power company; constructing a second constraint condition according to the plurality of demand direction label sets; obtaining a plurality of first-aid repair scheduling schemes; performing double-term optimization on the multiple first-aid repair scheduling schemes according to the first constraint condition, the second constraint condition and the index parameter sets of the multiple first-aid repair scheduling schemes to obtain an optimal first-aid repair scheduling scheme; and inputting the data into a visual display module to perform visual repair scheduling management. The method and the device solve the technical problems of long feedback period and low management efficiency of power scheduling in the prior art, and achieve the technical effects of improving timeliness of power scheduling management, performing management visualization and improving management efficiency.

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on data restoration and residual error correction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method based on data restoration and residual error correction, which belongs to the field of new energy power prediction, and adopts a variable point grouping method and a noisy density clustering algorithm to detect and clean abnormal values of an original wind power sequence, so that the data quality is improved; the spatial characteristics among a plurality of wind turbines are learned by using a graph convolution neural network of a dynamic adjacency matrix, the time sequence characteristics of a long sequence are learned by using a gating circulation unit, and the turbine output at the future moment is obtained based on the fusion characteristics; and finally, learning an error distribution rule of the predicted power and the actual power at the historical moment by using a multi-layer convolution and multi-head attention mechanism, predicting possible prediction errors at the future moment, and returning to the predicted power obtained by the last step. According to the invention, the asymmetric connection relation between the units is obtained through the dynamic adjacent matrix, so that the method is more in line with the actual situation, the number of parameters is reduced through point-by-point convolution, the running speed and the robustness of the system are improved, and a high-precision prediction result is obtained.
assignees: LIANYUNGANG GANYU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Elevator/electric vehicle charging/power supply control system and elevator/electric vehicle charging/power supply control method
abstract_en: To smoothly perform temporary restoration of an elevator by supplying power to the elevator by using an electric vehicle during charging or an electric vehicle for power supply instead of the electric vehicle during charging when electric outage of a building occurs during charging of the electric vehicle.SOLUTION: An elevator/electric vehicle charging/power supply control system equipped with a hybrid electric vehicle charging facility which supplies power to an elevator by either a commercial power supply or an electric vehicle inquires of a dedicated application of a user smartphone of a user who owns the electric vehicle during charging whether or not power can be supplied to the elevator, and connects the electric vehicle for power supply to the hybrid electric vehicle charging facility when the user does not permit power supply to the elevator. Thus, a change request of a parking position of the electric vehicle is notified to the dedicated application of the user smartphone.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Routing field support to vehicles for maintenance
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for recovery of autonomous vehicles. In particular, systems and methods are provided for vehicle recovery prioritization in a fleet of vehicles when multiple vehicles request recovery. A vehicle recovery event is generated for vehicles in need of recovery based on the vehicle's sensor log. The recovery service type is determined based on the vehicle recovery event, and vehicles in need of recovery are prioritized based on the recovery service type and the vehicle recovery event. The recovery support can include a recovery support representative and/or a recovery support service technician. Recovery response can be based on the recovery prioritization. Vehicle sensors and computing power can be used to inform onboard processors and/or central computers of a risk profile for the vehicle, and dispatch can trigger a response plan according to a recovery response framework.

title_en: Resource Allocation for Power, Communication, and Transportation Infrastructure Restoration usingDistributed Fiber Optic Sensing
abstract_en: Disclosed are integrated systems and methods that utilize a network of DFOS sensors installed on power lines, communication networks, and transportation systems, which continuously monitor infrastructures and provide real-time data. This data is collected, processed, and analyzed, and used to identify any affected areas of infrastructure and assess severity of any damage. Prioritization and resource allocation is performed and uses this analysis to prioritize restoration efforts and allocate resources such as repair crews, equipment, and materials to areas with a highest priority.

title_en: Line first-aid repair operation identification method and device without work ticket
abstract_en: The invention provides a line first-aid repair operation identification method and a line first-aid repair operation identification device without a work ticket, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring fault information of distribution network scheduling push; s3, matching the current team information and the fault line position from a preset event data resource pool to obtain a plurality of historical emergency repair operations of the current team at the fault line position and corresponding emergency repair operation information; s4: and determining whether the emergency repair operation aiming at the fault information pushed by the power distribution network is line emergency repair operation without a work ticket according to work ticket transaction data of a plurality of historical emergency repair operations in a preset time from the corresponding historical fault starting time to the historical fault power restoration time. Aiming at the phenomenon of 10KV medium-voltage line fault emergency repair operation carried out without a work ticket, an efficient identification method is established to block the ticket-free emergency repair loophole, so that the special line control of departments such as safety supervision of provincial companies and city bureaus and the biotechnology is not relied on, and a large amount of manpower is saved.

title_en: Forest tree network system and forest resource monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest tree network system and a forest resource monitoring method. According to the invention, by designing and constructing the forest Internet of things monitoring station, the high-frequency monitoring of the forest growth condition in the forest ecological system can be realized, important index data such as forest growth quantity, consumption, withering loss, forest accumulation in unit area, forest biomass in unit area and the like are directly produced, the regulation, scheduling, control and protection of the forest ecological system are developed, the forest resource investigation precision and quality are improved, the forest resource investigation monitoring cost and risk are reduced, and the forest ecological system protection and restoration precision and timeliness are enhanced.

title_en: Identification method of lakeside zone ecological restoration area under influence of climate change
abstract_en: The invention relates to a recognition method of an ecological restoration area, and particularly provides a recognition method of a lakeside ecological restoration area under the influence of climate change. The method comprises the following steps: (1) According to the predicted meteorological data of the given lake, predicting the water levels of different periods in the future of the given lake by adopting a support vector machine algorithm; (2) According to the elevation of the predicted water level of each period, combining a digital elevation model of the whole lake area of a given lake to identify a newly submerged or exposed area; (3) And determining an ecological restoration area according to the land utilization remote sensing data of the new submerged or exposed area. The method can identify areas such as lakes and the like subjected to climate change in advance, so that ecological restoration engineering is more targeted. Meanwhile, the method can be carried out only by the existing international climate change prediction database and historical water level monitoring data, so that the accuracy and convenience of the identification of the ecological restoration area of the lakeside zone are greatly improved.

title_en: Automatic restoration smoke detector with timing function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic restore smoke and feel detector with timing function, feel the detector body, spray mechanism, warning mechanism and fixed establishment including automatic restoration smoke, the timer is installed to the inboard of automatic restoration smoke and feel the detector body, and one side of timer is provided with the circuit, the protecting box is installed in the outside of circuit, and one side of protecting box installs the pivot, and one side welding of pivot has the guard gate simultaneously, spray the mechanism and install in the below of automatic restoration smoke and feel the detector body, and spray the equal screwed connection in both sides of mechanism and have the mount. This automatic repair smoke detector with timing function sprays the mechanism through setting up, is favorable to carrying out effectual control effect to the source of smog like this, uses through the controller when smog reaches certain concentration through the timer to spray the mechanism and spray the source, has avoided the potential safety hazard that the further diffusion of the burning things which may cause of a fire disaster in source leads to, has improved the practicality and the security of device like this.
assignees: SUZHOU NABEISI SECURITY INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive system applied to ecological restoration of rock slope and ground disaster treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a comprehensive system applied to ecological restoration and ground disaster treatment of a rock slope, which comprises a plurality of anchor rods used for dividing the rock slope into a plurality of areas, wherein M multiplied by N ecological slice bags are paved in each area, openings for filling tillage soil and grass seeds are formed in the ecological slice bags, a circle of main stranded wires matched with the outline of the ecological slice bags are arranged on the bottom surface of each ecological slice bag, a plurality of retaining rings are arranged on the main stranded wires at intervals, the ecological slice bags are fixed on the rock slope through anchor nails, the ecological slice bags positioned at the edge positions of the areas are fixed through the anchor rods, and the overlapped edges of the adjacent ecological slice bags are fixed through the same anchor rod or anchor nail. The ecological slice bags are fixed on the rock slope to prevent geological disasters from occurring on the rock slope, so that the ground disaster treatment of the rock slope is realized, soil and grass seeds are planted in the ecological slice bags in a ploughing mode, the ecological slice bags can also be used for greening the rock slope, and ecological restoration of the rock slope is completed.
assignees: CHONGQING 208 GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;CHONGQING JIANGJIN PLANNING AND NATURAL RESOURCES BUREAU

title_en: Ecological restoration soil and water conservation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of soil and water conservation and discloses an ecological restoration soil and water conservation device which comprises a slope body, wherein a collecting mechanism is arranged at the top of the slope body, a filtering mechanism is arranged outside one end of the collecting mechanism, a drip irrigation mechanism is arranged at one end of the collecting mechanism, a flow guiding mechanism is arranged on one side of the slope body, the flow guiding mechanism comprises a cement block, one side of the cement block is fixedly connected with an inclined surface of the slope body, a plurality of guide grooves are formed in the surface of the cement block, a plurality of flow dividing plates are fixedly connected with the inclined surface of the slope body, and two ends of each flow dividing plate are fixedly connected with the inner wall of each guide groove. According to the utility model, the cement blocks are paved outside the slope body, and the two sides of the flow dividing plate are lower in rainy days, so that rainwater flows into the guide grooves at the two sides, and the rainwater is discharged, so that the cementability of the slope body is improved, the risks of landslide and erosion are reduced, and the erosion of the slope body by the rainwater is reduced.
assignees: CHINA NONFERROUS METALS INDUSTRY XIAN SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Modifier applicable to acid heavy metal contaminated soil and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a modifier suitable for acid heavy metal contaminated soil and application thereof. The modifier comprises, by weight, 15-25% of hydroxyapatite powder, 30-40% of sepiolite powder, 24-32% of montmorillonite powder, 15-25% of potash feldspar powder and 5-15% of dolomite powder. When the modifier is used in the construction process of an ecological restoration project of an extremely acidic mining area, excessive application of quicklime or hydrated lime and the like can be avoided, acid can be quickly eliminated, acid can be controlled, heavy metal toxicity can be reduced, the effect is quick, water and fertilizer can be preserved, crop resistance can be enhanced, meanwhile, the soil structure of the mining area can be continuously improved, medium and trace elements such as silicon, calcium, magnesium, phosphorus and the like can be slowly supplemented, the extremely acidic soil can be continuously improved for a long time, and secondary disasters can not be caused.

title_en: Regional power grid resilience assessment method based on time sequence state deduction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a regional power grid resilience evaluation method based on time sequence state deduction, which comprises the following steps of: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a scene of shutdown and line damage of a regional power grid unit under an extreme disaster, constructing a model of a shutdown unit and a related power transmission line recovery path based on unit recovery characteristics, determining a target function and constraint conditions, and obtaining an optimal path; simulating and deducing a post-disaster recovery process of the regional power grid based on a time sequence state through the optimal path, and calculating a recovery index; and calculating a regional power grid restoration efficiency index based on the restoration force index. The method realizes quantification of restoring force in the regional power grid restoring process, effectively evaluates the level of the restoring force of the regional power grid facing to the extreme disaster, helps the power grid to enhance the restoring force of the power grid, and reduces damage and loss suffered by the power grid facing to the extreme disaster.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for calculating fault loss electric quantity of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for calculating fault loss electric quantity of a power distribution network, which comprise the following steps: acquiring a distribution transformer outage and power restoration information array when the power failure of the power distribution network is determined; determining the loss electric quantity of each distribution transformer according to the distribution transformer power outage duration and the distribution transformer loss power; and acquiring the fault loss electric quantity of the power distribution network according to the loss electric quantity of each distribution transformer and the distribution transformer influenced by the power failure fault, wherein the fault loss electric quantity of the power distribution network comprises the total fault loss electric quantity of the power distribution network and the average loss electric quantity of distribution. The power distribution network fault loss electric quantity is rapidly calculated according to the power distribution network fault loss electric quantity, so that the power distribution network fault loss electric quantity can be timely and accurately obtained when the power distribution network fault occurs, and a user can evaluate an automatic system according to the obtained power distribution network fault loss electric quantity.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Emergency drop network restoration decision method and system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for decision-making of a road network restoration under an emergency event based on deep reinforcement learning, which belong to the technical field of road traffic network safety, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing an urban road network graph structure, and generating road network characteristic data according to the urban road network graph structure; taking road traffic network efficiency as a toughness evaluation index, and establishing an urban road network toughness evaluation model under an emergency; constructing a deep reinforcement learning network model, and training the deep reinforcement learning network model through the road network characteristic data and the road traffic network efficiency; and (5) performing road network recovery through the trained deep reinforcement learning network model. The road network toughness assessment and road network recovery are carried out through the pre-trained deep reinforcement learning network model, the calculation can be rapidly carried out after the emergency occurs, and the urban road network toughness under the emergency can be improved.

title_en: Wind farm SCADA data restoration method based on multiple correlation learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind farm SCADA data restoration method based on multiple correlation learning, which comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining a wind power plant standardized data set ; S2, obtaining a filling result under the global cross-correlation view angle ; S3, obtaining a filling result under the global autocorrelation view angle ; S4, obtaining filling results under the partial cross-correlation view angles ; S5, obtaining a filling result under the local autocorrelation view angle ; s6, using multiple linear regression 、 、 And Integrating, denoising and denoise the four filling results to obtain a final repair result . According to the invention, the self-correlation and the cross-correlation in the SCADA multidimensional data are analyzed from the global and the local at the same time, and the missing data are subjected to preliminary filling repair from multiple view angles; further, a residual network fine denoising model is constructed, and denoising and fine restoration are comprehensively carried out on the data after preliminary restoration, so that complete restoration of SCADA multidimensional data is realized.
assignees: UNIV HUNAN;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Micro-grid post-disaster power supply recovery method and system considering fuel supply elasticity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for recovering power supply of a micro-grid after disaster, which take fuel supply elasticity into consideration. Firstly, a motion path model of a fuel vehicle in a traffic network is built, then fuel consumption models of the fuel vehicle and a gas turbine are respectively built, a micro-grid power supply restoration optimization model considering fuel margin limitation is built, and finally linearization processing and solving are carried out on the built model to obtain a micro-grid power supply restoration optimization result. According to the technical scheme, the fuel supply elasticity is considered in the micro-grid power supply recovery process, so that the continuous and reliable operation of the gas turbine is ensured, and the reliability of the micro-grid power supply recovery scheme after disaster is effectively improved.

title_en: Outer elevation closed loop repairing method based on visual network and multi-agent RL
abstract_en: The invention provides an outer elevation closed-loop restoration method based on a visual network and a multi-agent RL, which comprises the steps of defining S1, partitioning and linkage actions, deducing S2, a space-time diagram visual network and a channel, deducing S3, estimating critical time and deducing an executable window, generating and issuing S4, generating and issuing a window-action mask, S5, controlling execution and progress comparison of an event sequence MPC and a disposable executable scheme S6, controlling execution and progress comparison of the multi-agent RL, S7, checking and closing confirmation, locking executable detection before critical evolution of an outer elevation disease of a building, restoring linkage window and action sequence, keeping locking from being damaged by disturbance of environment and channel in the execution process, defining upstream cutting off firstly and downstream sealing later by a channel mechanism, mapping material curing, dew point and weather constraint into action window and forbidden condition, realizing controlled cooperation under the mask constraint by the event sequence MPC and multi-agent reinforcement learning, and achieving the aim of one-time closing before critical evolution of the disease.

title_en: Power distribution system reconfigurations for multiple contingencies
abstract_en: System and method simulate power distribution system reconfigurations for multiple contingencies. Decision tree model is instantiated as a graph with nodes and edges corresponding to simulated outage states of one or more buses in the power distribution system and simulated states of reconfigurable switches in the power distribution system, Edges related to each outage are disconnected. A reconfiguration path is determined with a plurality of switches reconfigured to a closed state by an iteration of tree search algorithms. A simulation estimates feeder cable and transformer loading and bus voltages on the reconfigured path for comparing against constraints including system capacity ratings and minimum voltage. Further iterations identify additional candidate reconfiguration paths which can be ranked by total load restoration

title_en: Regional power grid disturbance control evaluation method based on extra-high voltage alternating current-direct current series-parallel connection background
abstract_en: The regional power grid disturbance control evaluation method based on extra-high voltage alternating current-direct current series-parallel connection background that the invention discloses a kind of, including step：The lower disturbance control evaluation criterion of setting regions power grid time dimension, the disturbance control standard include definition, expression formula and the physical significance that can report the indexs such as disturbance recovery rate under disturbance, spare shared group and different time；Control evaluation index, which is disturbed, according to each control zone divides control zone disturbance restoration grade；Restoration grade is disturbed according to control zone, each control zone is examined, the result of appraisal include that electricity punishment and electricity are returned；Each season calculates the emergency duty adjustment amount of the lower first quarter according to disturbance control evaluation index.The invention has the advantages that：Pass through design evaluatio index, calculate the disturbance restoration grade of control zone, and then the punishment and return of electricity are carried out to control zone, transfer the executive condition of state ACE instructions to net to the recovery capability of disturbance and evaluation control zone to realize evaluation control zone under time dimension.

title_en: Ecological restoration method and system for water burst slope
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological environment restoration, in particular to an ecological restoration method for a water gushing slope, which comprises the following steps of S1, checking water gushing points of the slope, and marking each water gushing point; s2, building a drainage channel communicated with each water inrush point; s3, laying a drainage guide layer for drainage on the slope surface of the constructed drainage channel, and fixing by using an anchor rod; s4, arranging a vegetation matrix layer for reinforcing the slope on the guide and drainage layer; and S5, arranging a vegetation layer on the vegetation matrix layer. The ecological restoration system is constructed by the ecological restoration method, and water gushed from a water gushing point can be discharged by arranging a drainage channel, so that uncontrollable flood disasters caused by water gushing diffusion and random channeling are avoided; in addition, the guide drainage layer is laid on the slope surface, so that water burst can be rapidly output, direct impact of the water burst on the vegetation substrate layer and the vegetation layer is avoided, geological disasters such as slumping are caused, and the water burst can be fully utilized to enable the water burst to become a water source required for plant growth.

title_en: Active power outage planning monitoring and scheduling method based on metering terminal alarm technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a planned power failure active monitoring and scheduling method based on a metering terminal alarm technology, which comprises the following steps of S1: creating a service model, and combing to generate a planned power failure event to be monitored; collecting power failure and power restoration information of a power failure event; and stopping power restoration monitoring and abnormal condition scheduling. The invention uses the warning information of the metering terminal to realize the real-time active monitoring of the power failure and the power restoration state of the planned power failure event, and replaces the monitoring mode of manually reporting information. By developing the power failure event matching, the relation that a plurality of power failure events have the same power failure equipment in the same power failure period is cleared, and the monitoring efficiency is improved. Meanwhile, the metering terminal is combined to collect data and report information to field staff, so that visual management and control of planned outage events are enhanced. And finally, customer service experience is improved, and customer satisfaction is improved.

title_en: Mechanical embedded fire sprinkler head
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical embedded fire-fighting spray header which comprises a shell, wherein the top end of the shell and the bottom end of a water receiving pipe are integrally formed, a sliding mechanism is installed at the top end of a temperature sensing system, second sliding blocks are fixedly connected to the bottom ends of a plurality of second connecting rods, the outer walls of the second sliding blocks are in sliding sleeve joint with a supporting frame, and a plurality of clamping mechanisms are evenly installed on the lower surface of the inner side of a top cover. This embedded type fire sprinkler of mechanical type, carry out the temperature perception through temperature sensing system, and make in heat transfer to the heat-sensitive material in the splash box, make the heat-sensitive material take place the phase transition when the temperature reaches the target threshold value, make the water receiving pipe open, the fire-fighting water is through water receiving pipe and splash box contact, and the splash is to all around, realize the fire control operation, whole mechanism is lossless except that the fire-fighting water in the course of the work, after the fire control operation is accomplished, upwards promote the support frame, make fixture block and third slide bar looks joint, can realize whole mechanism's restoration, so that reuse.

title_en: Pseudo-ginseng cultivation soil replantation risk evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for evaluating the risk of replanting of pseudo-ginseng cultivation soil, which belongs to the technical field of pseudo-ginseng cultivation, wherein after measuring each evaluation index in the soil, each index is subjected to risk classification, and when all the evaluation indexes are in the soil with low risk level, the risk of replanting pseudo-ginseng is lower; pseudo-ginseng can be continuously planted; a part of evaluation indexes, especially the soil with the quantity of pathogenic bacteria and the content of chemosensory substances in the soil at medium risk or medium and high risk levels, show that the re-planted pseudo-ginseng has a certain safety risk, and the management of water and fertilizer medicines should be enhanced in the growth process of the re-planted pseudo-ginseng, so that the phenomenon that the pseudo-ginseng obstacle factors such as soil-borne pathogenic bacteria accumulate too fast and threaten the healthy growth of the re-planted pseudo-ginseng is avoided. All the measurement indexes are in the soil with medium or high risk level, which indicates that the risk of re-planting pseudo-ginseng is extremely high, effective soil restoration measures should be immediately taken, and re-planting can be considered after the risk level of the risk evaluation index is reduced, otherwise, the pseudo-ginseng is not recommended to be planted continuously.

title_en: Power system missing data restoration method based on improved space-time generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system missing data restoration method based on an improved space-time generation countermeasure network, which comprises the steps of generating measurement data by using a generator based on an improved TCAN network; the method comprises the steps of inputting generated and real data into a discriminator to discriminate, training the generator and the discriminator based on a loss function, fixing parameters of the generator and the discriminator, generating reconstruction data according to reconstruction loss, and realizing data restoration. The invention uses the improved TCAN network to replace the CNN network in DCGAN, better extracts the time sequence characteristics in the time sequence data, can perform parallel calculation, has high calculation speed and good effect, replaces the self-attention mechanism in the TCAN with the GAU attention unit, and effectively extracts the data space characteristics. The method can effectively extract the space-time characteristics of the data, quickly and accurately repair the data on the basis of missing measurement data, and improves the reliability and observability of the power system.

title_en: Adaptive power grid restoration
abstract_en: A method of self-healing power grids after power outages includes providing an Adaptive Restoration Decision Support System (ARDSS) for generating a restoration solution using static and dynamic input data from power generator(s) powering transmission lines, from the transmission lines and loads. At a beginning of a restoration period a two-stage problem is solved including a first and second-stage problem with an optimal planning (OP) function as a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) problem using initial static and dynamic data to determine start-up times for the power generator and energization sequences for transmission lines involved in the power outage. Only the second-stage problem is again solved with an optimal real-time (OR) function using the start-up times and energization sequences along with updated static and dynamic data to determine operating parameters for the grid. The restoration solution is implemented over restoration time steps until all loads involved in the power outage are recovered.
assignees: UNIV CENTRAL FLORIDA RES FOUND INC

title_en: Open pit ecological environment restoration treatment system
abstract_en: Open pit ecological environment restores treatment system, including pit side slope grass planting protective structure all around, the antiseep multilayer soil planting structure of pit bottom and the cistern of pit center department: the antiseep multilayer soil planting structure of pit bottom sets gradually bottom metalling, mortar layer, water barrier and soil horizon from bottom to top, and the inlet opening with soil horizon lower part intercommunication is all seted up all around to the pool wall of cistern, and the inlet opening outside is equipped with the stainless steel filter screen. According to the method, the open pit of the mining area is ecologically repaired, so that the side slope of the pit is planted with grass to prevent landslide, the bottom of the pit is flattened and provided with the water-proof layer, a soil layer suitable for planting grain crops is paved, fruits, vegetables and grain crops are planted on the soil layer, drought and waterlogging are prevented, the stability of the ecological system of the mining area is improved, and the cultivated land area is increased for the country.
assignees: EXPLORATION INSTITUTE GUANGDONG BUREAU OF COAL GEOLOGY CHINA NAT ADMINISTRATION OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: A kind of business impact analysis method based on AHP
