abstract_en: The business impact analysis method based on AHP that the invention discloses a kind of including S1, determines the process of entire analytic process；S2, determine operation system disaster recovery priority evaluation index；S3, index importance judgement；S4, business importance determine；S5, corresponding interrupt influences evaluation score value each operation system of enterprise, the size of evaluation score value is influenced according to service disconnection, and consider the incidence relation between operation system, so that it may obtain the final goal of business impact analysis: business recovery priority.The utility model has the advantages that this programme combines mature analytic hierarchy process AHP to establish priority analysis model, keep business impact analysis more scientific by qualitative analysis and rationalize with quantitatively calculating the method combined, so that identified business recovery target and business importance do not deviate by enterprise demand.

title_en: Ecological restoration space identification method based on ecological system service view angle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological restoration space identification method and system based on an ecological system service visual angle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: selecting water conservation, wind prevention and sand fixation, soil conservation and carbon fixation as leading ecological system services, and obtaining ecological system service evaluation quantity of an evaluation period of a designated area; dividing the designated area into a plurality of grids, and determining the reverse conversion probability and the loss level of the ecosystem service of each grid according to the evaluation quantity of each ecosystem service in the evaluation period, thereby forming an ecological risk evaluation result of each grid; acquiring a land degradation evaluation result of each grid based on trend test analysis of year-by-year normalized vegetation indexes (NDVI) of the evaluation period; and averaging the ecological risk evaluation result and the land degradation evaluation result of each grid to obtain an ecological restoration priority evaluation result of the grid. The method can identify the key area of the ecological restoration project and can finely make an ecological protection restoration scheme.

title_en: BP neural network-based risk evaluation method for high consequence area of oil and gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to a BP neural network-based risk evaluation method for a high-consequence area of an oil and gas pipeline. Different from conventional error linear input and output, the evaluation system adopts a three-layer topological structure to perform an error back propagation algorithm, adds a hidden layer between an input layer and an output layer, and performs active learning optimization by alternating three layers of layers. The evaluation accuracy of the invention can be continuously optimized along with the training times, and the invention can carry out associative restoration on the missing input information and has more accuracy and cautiousness.

title_en: Desert earthquake noise suppression method based on multi-scale attention interaction network
abstract_en: A desert earthquake noise suppression method based on multi-scale attention interaction network belongs to the technical field of machine learning and earthquake image processing, the invention provides a multi-scale attention interaction network aiming at the problem of low-frequency noise suppression in desert earthquake images, the network firstly samples input earthquake data, then adaptively learns the complex characteristics of the multi-scale earthquake data by utilizing double-branch convolution layers with different kernel sizes, and then adopts a multi-attention mechanism comprising the integration and interaction of the displacement attention and the coordinate attention on the dimensions of a channel, a space and a coordinate to obtain continuous earthquake signals; according to the method, a mixed loss function of mean-square error and mean cosine similarity is adopted, a multi-scale strategy is combined with an attention mechanism, the desert seismic image denoising effect is improved, and compared with a single-scale denoising convolutional neural network, the desert seismic image denoising method has the advantages that the desert noise suppression effect is obvious, and the desert seismic image denoising method is superior to the restoration of the single-scale denoising convolutional neural network to the same-phase axis continuity.

title_en: Power failure and power restoration monitoring device and monitoring method based on GIS and UE4 system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power failure and restoration monitoring device and a monitoring method based on a GIS and a UE4 system, wherein the power failure and restoration monitoring device comprises a data integration center, the data integration center is composed of a geographic information system, a data monitoring system, a three-dimensional rendering system, a state display system and an automatic analysis system, the data monitoring system is used for acquiring power grid management platform rush repair list information and trip information, the three-dimensional rendering system is used for rendering a power failure area on a three-dimensional scene according to power failure range data provided by power failure detailed information, and meanwhile, the state display system is used for simulating a maintenance process. According to the invention, through realizing visual display and simulation of the power outage and restoration scene, information such as the power outage and restoration range, the overhaul state and the like is visually displayed, through monitoring the running conditions of the power grid and equipment in real time, the running information of the power grid is mastered in time, the accurate rush repair of the production team at the first-line post is effectively supported, and a powerful visual guarantee means is provided for the efficient running of the power grid.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL PLATFORM TECH GUANGDONG CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation method considering unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling
abstract_en: The invention aims to solve the problem of insufficient robustness of a traditional power grid state estimation method in a post-disaster recovery and emergency communication scene, and provides an electric power system emergency state estimation method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative graph neural network. The method integrates unmanned aerial vehicle dynamic communication scheduling and a space-time diagram neural network, and solves the problems of data loss, topology time variation, communication interruption and the like. By constructing a simulation data set, designing a space-time diagram convolution network, generating a node voltage estimation and confidence coefficient thermodynamic diagram by combining a diagram characteristic reconstruction module, and formulating a recovery priority strategy. Meanwhile, an unmanned aerial vehicle emergency communication optimization model is built, and efficient communication resource allocation is achieved. The invention has the beneficial effects of providing a method for collaborative optimization of an information-physical system, providing a quick and reliable communication alternative scheme and solving the problems of measurement deficiency and topology time variation. And a closed loop feedback model is established, so that the communication resource allocation scheduling is dynamically optimized, and the real-time dynamic mode of the power system is adapted.

title_en: Multi-scale feature fusion-based electricity price and load prediction method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for predicting electricity price and load based on multi-scale feature fusion, belonging to the technical field of electric power spot transaction, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out data restoration and data reconstruction on historical transaction data of an obtained electric power market to obtain a multi-scale data matrix; based on the influence of meteorological factors and time factors on the output and time-sharing electricity price of a distributed power supply, carrying out correlation analysis on a multi-scale data matrix, extracting and fusing characteristics related to electricity price change and load change to obtain multi-dimensional characteristic data, inputting the multi-dimensional characteristic data into a preset load-electricity price combined prediction model, and respectively predicting load and electricity price by considering the mutual influence between the load change and the electricity price change to obtain a load predicted value and an electricity price predicted value. Therefore, by implementing the application, the problem that the accuracy of the predicted load and electricity price is lower because the mutual influence between the load and the electricity price is not considered in the prior art can be solved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Municipal pipe network overflow detection and intelligent repair method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a municipal pipe network overflow detection and intelligent restoration method, which relates to the technical field of municipal pipe network management, and comprises the following specific steps of data fusion and basic analysis, wherein various sensors are used for collecting various data in real time, fusion and pretreatment are carried out in a data processing center, external environment change factors influencing pipe network operation are found out by comparing analysis histories with real-time data to provide basic data, and the invention can realize high-precision simulation of water flow in a pipe network by deeply fusing weather, hydrology and municipal pipe network related data and by means of an intelligent hydrodynamic simulation technology, accurately predict the occurrence position, time and influence range of overflow in advance, automatically formulate and adjust pipe network operation parameter regulation strategies in real time based on accurate overflow risk assessment, and intelligently adjust drainage pump station parameters and pipe network valve opening according to different overflow risk grades, thereby effectively optimizing pipe network operation parameters.
assignees: NANJING INST OF ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES MEE

title_en: Enterprise data management system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application provides an enterprise data management system and method based on artificial intelligence, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module for acquiring enterprise energy consumption data and equipment operation parameters through an interface in a cross-level manner, a data preprocessing module for carrying out anomaly restoration on the energy consumption data by adopting an anomaly detection model and carrying out deletion restoration on the equipment operation parameters by combining a knowledge graph and a filtering algorithm so as to generate an effective data set with a space-time label, a knowledge graph generation module for constructing an ontology model comprising equipment entities, energy media, metering points and process links based on the effective data set, and mining association relations between equipment states and the energy consumption data through a graph neural network so as to generate an energy association knowledge graph, and a management strategy generation module for generating management rules by combining carbon emission data and carrying out root cause analysis based on the energy association knowledge graph so as to generate an enterprise data management strategy and manage the enterprise energy consumption data and the equipment operation parameters accordingly.
assignees: SHANDONG HUAYIYUN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic engineering full life cycle operation and maintenance management method and platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering full life cycle operation and maintenance management method and a platform, which relate to the technical field of hydraulic engineering management, wherein a weir crest water level Hw, a gate flow Qo, a gate opening and closing pressure Pg, a structure inclination angle Gq and an iron-containing concentration cFe are accurately acquired through a multi-source physical sensing unit, the sensor type, the arrangement position and the acquisition condition corresponding to each parameter are highly matched with the hydraulic engineering operation characteristics, the stability of data sources is ensured, the coverage is wide, and a high-frequency real-time data sensing system is formed. The mechanism breaks through the problem of low parameter reliability in the past, and lays a high-quality data foundation for subsequent operation state modeling and situation map construction. And a structural stability association function constructed based on a water conservancy physical mechanism is introduced as an evaluation index, and abnormal fluctuation in the original data is subjected to sliding window identification and inversion restoration, so that the method is different from a conventional statistical removal method or interpolation filling method, and can utilize the known physical relationship of the system to carry out reasonable tracing correction.
assignees: HENAN WATER PLANNING AND DESIGN RES CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution rush repair construction method optimization method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution rush-repair construction method optimization method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data of a power distribution line in a disaster area, and constructing a basic power grid topological graph for post-disaster rush-repair according to the multi-source data; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a basic power grid topological graph, combining rush repair operation to obtain a topological evolution tensor, obtaining a preset atomic operation set to generate candidate work method sequences, evaluating the candidate work method sequences, calculating comprehensive scores of each candidate work method sequence, sequencing the candidate work method sequences by utilizing the comprehensive scores to obtain a preferable work method sequence, executing a power restoration operation according to the preferable work method sequence and the topological evolution tensor, carrying out on-line monitoring, establishing a digital twin model to simulate, correcting deviation of a monitoring result and a simulation result, optimizing the power restoration operation, and maintaining continuity and stability of voltage and current in the power restoration process.

title_en: Ecological efficacy restoration scheme generation method and system for power transmission and transformation project
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for generating an ecological efficiency restoration scheme of power transmission and transformation project, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining ecological data and power transmission and transformation project nodes, quantifying constructed three-way different patterns by utilizing a graph rolling network to obtain a gene flow resistance matrix, inputting a Multi-GNN model to simulate a gene flow blocking effect of the power transmission and transformation project on the ecological efficiency, calculating contribution weights of all nodes in the power transmission and transformation project on the obtained long-term gene flow blocking value by utilizing SHAP values, weighting and calculating the long-term gene flow blocking value and the corresponding contribution weights to obtain a long-term influence value, inputting the ecological data into a pre-constructed ecological pollution behavior quantification model to quantify short-term influence of the power transmission and transformation project on the ecological efficiency, calculating restoration priority weights of all power transmission and transformation nodes based on the long-term influence value and the short-term influence value, inputting the restoration priority weights and the contribution weights into a reinforcement learning strategy to obtain an optimal ecological restoration parameter, and converting the optimal ecological restoration parameter into the ecological restoration scheme.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power conversion device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain an interleave power conversion device having a plurality of step-up chopper circuits and capable of withstanding a rush current that possibly occurs at power on or restoration from blackout, without a large cost increase.SOLUTION: An interleave power conversion device includes reactors 3a-3d, switching elements 4a-4d and diodes 5a-5d, with a plurality of step-up chopper circuits 9a-9d in parallel connection to raise a voltage by chopping the output of a rectifier circuit 2 for rectifying AC power 1. The interleave power conversion device further includes a second diode 8 that bypasses the plurality of step-up chopper circuits 9a-9d in parallel connection, so that the rush current that occurs at power on or restoration from blackout is made to flow in an integrated manner.

title_en: Fire receiver and disaster prevention system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a fire receiver whose operation buttons are operated in appropriate order at the non-occurrence of a fire.SOLUTION: In a fire receiver A connected to a sensor line L2 and a district acoustic line L1, and equipped with a guide display/operation part 23 in which a guide area 23a for the occurrence of a fire and a guide area 23b for the non-occurrence of a fire are separately disposed, a main acoustic stop button 31 for stopping the acoustic of the fire receiver A, a district acoustic stop button 32 for stopping a district acoustic, and a restoration button 35 for restoring the fire receiver A in a monitoring state are longitudinally disposed in order from the top in the guide area 23b for the non-occurrence of a fire of the guide display/operation part 23.

title_en: Leveraging file-based backups to facilitate bare-metal and system-state recovery operations
abstract_en: A method and system for leveraging file-based backups to facilitate bare-metal recovery (BMR) and/or system-state recovery (SSR) operations. In leading to a BMR operation (which may include, but is not limited to, data protected under a SSR operation), logical groupings of data, each including multiple files and/or directories that span across one or more file-systems, may be written to backup media to comply with data backup, archiving, and/or disaster recovery strategies. Backing up said logical groupings of data relies on block-based backup technologies, which upon requiring a subset of a given logical grouping of data to be restored, makes the restoration process impossible to fulfill since determining which blocks of data belong to which files and/or directories are not tracked. Accordingly, the disclosed method and system propose an intelligent scheme through which file-based backup technology may be employed to enable BMR and/or SSR from any single BMR-compliant backup copy.

title_en: Automatic backup method based on LVM snapshot in cloud native environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic backup method based on LVM snapshot in a cloud native environment, which comprises the steps of initializing a system into an application cluster, and creating related custom resources and a custom controller by adopting an Operator expansion mode; the user-defined controller comprises a resource backup controller, a resource restoration controller, a storage volume backup controller and a storage volume restoration controller; the resource backup controller realizes discovery and retrieval of resources to be backed up, packs and stores k8s resource objects to Hami n io, acquires an associated Pod list and generates an appointed backup PodPv; aiming at the Pod list, the storage volume backup controller realizes automatic backup based on the LVM snapshot; and the like. The advantages are that: aiming at a local storage volume with larger data volume and higher requirement on data consistency in backup operation, automation, high stability and almost real-time data synchronous backup are carried out based on an LVM snapshot technology, so that the usability and manageability are greatly improved, and the downtime of a business system and the disaster recovery cost of an application system are reduced to the greatest extent.

title_en: Autonomous restoration of power systems after natural disasters
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and computer-readable media are disclosed for autonomous restoration of power systems after natural disasters. An operating mode of a circuit breaker that is in a power system grid and that is coupled to other circuit breakers in the power system grid via communication channels is determined. Based on determining that the operating mode is a normal operating mode, data to parameterize a plurality of power grid restoration scenarios is collected at the circuit breaker. Based on determining that the operating mode is an exception mode, measurement data that includes current and voltage data is received at the circuit breaker, and one of the power system grid restoration scenarios is initiated at the circuit breaker. The power system grid error restoration scenario is selected based at least in part on a status of the plurality of communication channels coupled to the circuit breaker and on the measurement data.

title_en: Ecological tubular bag revetment soil wall and filling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ecological tubular bag revetment soil wall and a filling method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of riverbank protection building. The ecological tubular bag revetment soil wall comprises filter geotextile and ecological bags. The ecological bags are filled with matrix materials mixed with grass seeds. The filter geotextile is laid at the bottom of the revetment soil wall. At least two layers of the ecological bags containing the matrix materials are laid on the filter geotextile side by side. Ecological bag connection buckles are arranged at joints of adjacent ecological bags on each layer and used for connecting the ecological bags adjacent to the ecological bag connection buckles in the longitudinal direction and in the transverse direction. An ecological revetment system is used for the surface of a dug slope and is used for preventing water and soil losses caused by rainwater washing and preventing the slope where landslide and collapse are likely to occur. The ecological bag ecological revetment system is adopted for protection construction. The bags, the layers and the ecological bags and the surface of the slope are completely and closely combined through the special connection accessories to achieve the function that the revetment is firm. Meanwhile, plants grow on the revetment, so that the slope is further fixed, then sowing is performed or plants are planted on the surfaces of the stacked bags in a greening means, and the aim of vegetation restoration is achieved.
assignees: JIANGSU SANZHENG HUAYU ENVIRONMENTAL ENGINEERING COMPANY

title_en: Configuration system and configuration method for relay protection level difference of automatic switch of distribution line
abstract_en: The invention provides a configuration system and a configuration method for a relay protection level difference of an automatic switch of a distribution line, which can scientifically configure the automatic switch of a huge distribution network, and the scientific configuration of the level difference can be beneficial to finding out faults and isolating the faults when the distribution network line fails, provide powerful support for quick power restoration of users and improvement of power supply reliability, and promote the intelligent development of the distribution network. Different technologies and management methods are respectively formulated, which is beneficial to the fine management.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Tropical forest post-disaster repair detection system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of forest restoration, and particularly relates to a tropical forest post-disaster restoration detection system based on data analysis, which comprises a server, a forest restoration area segmentation module, an area panoramic monitoring module, an area atmospheric environment diagnosis module, an area soil environment diagnosis module and a comprehensive diagnosis evaluation analysis module; according to the invention, the overall restoration evaluation and regional monitoring judgment of the forest post-disaster restoration area to be monitored are realized through the regional panoramic monitoring module, the restoration monitoring analysis effect is improved, the restoration unqualified area is subjected to atmospheric environmental analysis and soil environmental analysis through the regional atmospheric environmental monitoring module and the regional soil environmental diagnosis module, the comprehensive diagnosis evaluation analysis module generates a corresponding environment early warning signal based on the atmospheric environmental analysis information and the soil environmental analysis information through the comprehensive diagnosis analysis, and the corresponding management personnel can be helped to make corresponding targeted treatment measures subsequently, so that the planning of the subsequent corresponding regional restoration process is facilitated.
assignees: HAINAN ACADEMY OF FORESTRY SCIENCES HAINAN MANGROVE RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Flood three-dimensional visualization method based on image access inundation model result
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood three-dimensional visualization method based on an image access inundation model result, and belongs to the technical field of flood three-dimensional visualization. Aiming at the defects of large network transmission data quantity, complex Web end model result data processing and the like in the traditional GIS three-dimensional flood visualization, the invention provides flood simulation data storage, transmission and restoration technology based on image technology, which stores result data such as grid vertex elevation, water depth, flow speed, flow direction and the like in color components, transmits the result data through texture images, reduces the network transmission data quantity, greatly improves the updating efficiency of the flood state in the submerged process, and utilizes a loader technology to carry out flood rendering visualization on the Web end, so that the flood visualization presentation capability is greatly improved, and the important transition from 'good view' to 'good use' of a flood simulation twin scene is promoted.
assignees: PEARL RIVER HYDRAULIC RES INST PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: system
abstract_en: To determine by an AI, enumeration of elements in coping with restoration corresponding to a disaster, and data of a system required for coping with a disaster, for planning a plan quickly.SOLUTION: A system comprises: means for enumerating elements related to coping with restoration corresponding to a disaster; means for determining by an AI, data of a system required for coping with a disaster; and means for planning a plan quickly.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Efficient method to predict integrated circuit temperature and power maps
abstract_en: The temperature distribution associated with a design of an integrated circuit is calculated by convoluting a surface power usage represented by a power matrix with a heat spreading function. The heat spreading function may be calculated from a simulation of a point source on the integrated circuit using a finite element analysis model of the integrated circuit or other techniques. To account for spatial variations on the chip, the heat spreading function may be made dependent on position using a position scaling function. Steady-state or transient temperature distributions may be computed by using a steady-state or transient heat spreading function. A single heat spreading function may be convolved with various alternative power maps to efficiently calculate temperature distributions for different designs. In an inverse problem, one can calculate the power map from an empirically measured temperature distribution and a heat spreading function using various de-convolution techniques. While the forward problem is analogous to image blurring, the inverse problem is analogous to image restoration.
assignees: SHAKOURI ALI;KEMPER TRAVIS;ZHANG YAN;MILANFAR PEYMAN;MARTIN HERIZ VIRGINIA;WANG XI

title_en: Silt loss prevention equipment for river ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silt loss prevention device for river ecological restoration, which comprises a river channel, wherein a silt conveying device for intercepting and conveying silt is arranged in the river channel, a flow control device is arranged in the river channel and positioned on the lower side of a filter screen, the flow control device can adjust the conveying amount of the silt according to the flow velocity of water flow, and a storage device for storing redundant silt is arranged on the right side of the river channel. Can relieve drought conditions of downstream farmlands and reduce downstream flood disasters.

title_en: Prediction method for underground water level recovery amount
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method for predicting underground water level restoration amount, which includes: establishing a grid model for the target planting area, wherein the grid model comprises a plurality of grid units; acquiring grid crop irrigation water demand and sustainable irrigation water supply according to each grid unit, and acquiring annual crop net water consumption of each grid unit and annual accumulated crop net water consumption of each grid unit; obtaining the accumulated crop net water consumption of each grid unit in a target period according to the crop net water consumption year by year and the accumulated crop net water consumption year by year; acquiring underground water level monitoring data from each monitoring station, and performing relation fitting on the water level monitoring data and the annual accumulated crop net water consumption; predicting the grid fitting coefficient of each grid unit according to the fitting coefficient of the monitoring station; and obtaining groundwater level recovery data of each grid unit in the target period. The method and the device can be used for continuously utilizing underground water resources and provide a feasible scheme for recovering the underground water level in the future.

title_en: Shearing type energy-consumption beam-falling-preventing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a roof beam power consumption technical field is prevented falling by bridge, in particular to roof beam device is prevented falling by shearing type power consumption contains first mount pad and second mount pad, be equipped with yield type metal power consumption subassembly between first mount pad and the second mount pad, first mount pad and second mount pad sliding connection, first mount pad is connected with spacing part, first mount pad passes through adapting unit and connects the movable component, the movable component can drive first mount pad is relative the motion of second mount pad and then makes the type of buckling power consumption subassembly takes place to cut the type diastrophism. The device breaks through the limitation that the existing shearing type dislocation metal damper is difficult to meet the displacement requirement of seismic isolation and reduction design of bridge engineering, is favorable for reducing the cost of the device, improves the rigidity and the bearing capacity of the energy-consumption beam-falling prevention device, increases the effectiveness of energy consumption capability and continuous energy consumption, protects the bridge structure from earthquake damage, and is beneficial to restoration after earthquake.

title_en: Power failure identification analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power failure identification and analysis method and a power failure identification and analysis system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power failure alarm event information, equipment information and relevant power failure event information of a production system and a distribution and dispatching system of a metering automation system in real time; judging whether the power failure alarm event is caused by a transformer or a low-voltage user; and judging whether the power failure alarm event is a low-voltage fault power failure event, a medium-voltage fault power failure event or a main network fault power failure event according to the low-voltage user intelligent meter information, the electric meter box, the transformer, the branch line, the transformer substation, the feeder line and other equipment information and a preset strategy, and carrying out power restoration processing on the corresponding low-voltage fault power failure event, the medium-voltage fault power failure event or the main network fault power failure event. The system is used for realizing the method. The invention overcomes the technical defects that the existing power business system can not automatically identify the low-voltage fault power failure event information and actively early warn the low-voltage fault influence range.

title_en: Method suitable for topology reduction of single-power-supply tree-shaped power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method suitable for topology restoration of a single-power-supply tree-shaped power distribution network, which is suitable for system topology restoration of a power distribution network which is arranged in a tree shape, has no looped network and supplies power to a single power supply, and belongs to the field of power systems. The method is mainly used for restoring the topology of the power distribution network system according to the voltage of each node in the power distribution network and the injected current value of the node. The method utilizes the voltage and current constraint of a single power distribution network of the power system to restore an adjacency matrix for describing the connection condition between nodes of the distribution network, then utilizes the tree diagram constraint and breadth-first search in the graph theory to check the rationality of the restored distribution network, and finally completes the check of topology restoration of the distribution network by calculating and comparing the impedance matrix of the distribution network.

title_en: Deep learning-based river network dense watershed water situation trend prediction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river network dense watershed water situation trend prediction method based on deep learning and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting rainfall, water level time sequence point data and longitude and latitude information of all rainfall stations and river channel water level stations in the full watershed range, and performing whole editing; converting the integrated rainfall and water level time sequence point data into space-time data by an inverse distance weight method and an isosurface map rendering method; constructing and training a watershed high-resolution water level forecasting model, and respectively inputting rainfall and water level space-time data tensors; the watershed high-resolution water level forecasting model comprises a preliminary spatial feature extraction module, a space-time feature extraction module, a stacking module, a splicing module and a feature restoration module; and the model outputs a water level isosurface map of the whole basin in a forecast period to obtain the basin water regime change trend. The method can fully excavate the production convergence mechanism of the basin from historical hydrological data, and can accurately forecast the space-time water regime change of the whole basin.
assignees: PEARL RIVER HYDRAULIC RES INST PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Transformer substation power failure and restoration operation system and method based on Beidou high-precision positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation power failure and restoration operation system and method based on Beidou high-precision positioning, which comprises the following steps: the master station operation control system is in wireless connection with the operation terminal system; the master station operation control system comprises a data storage module, and the data storage module is connected with an operation processing module; the operation processing module is connected with the master station wireless communication module; the operation terminal system comprises a terminal wireless communication module which is respectively connected with the operation guidance module and the navigation guidance module; the operation guidance module and the navigation guidance module are respectively connected with the Beidou high-precision positioning module; the method solves the technical problems that in the prior art, the interval of operation and maintenance personnel is judged by methods such as image recognition of substation equipment labels and the like in substation operation management, the recognition error rate is high, the recognition capability at night is poor, misoperation is easy to occur, and the like.
assignees: POWERCHINA GUIZHOU ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster cooperative first-aid repair scheduling method for urban distribution network and traffic system
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-disaster cooperative first-aid repair scheduling method for an urban power distribution network and a traffic system, which comprises the following steps: acquiring data information according to fault elements of the urban distribution network and damaged/interrupted roads of the traffic system; establishing constraint conditions for operation scheduling of the urban power distribution network after a disaster; establishing a constraint condition for operation scheduling of the traffic system after the disaster; establishing an emergency maintenance team of the power system, wherein the emergency maintenance team is restricted by emergency maintenance decision of a road running state; establishing respective emergency repair decision constraints simultaneously, taking the maximum total power load recovery amount and road traffic flow as objective functions, and establishing a post-disaster cooperative emergency repair scheduling optimization model of an urban power distribution network and a traffic system; and solving by using the acquired data information as an input parameter of the collaborative emergency repair scheduling optimization model to acquire an emergency repair scheduling scheme. The method considers the influence of the dynamic change of the road state of the traffic system on the emergency repair decision of the power system, improves the recovery efficiency of the power distribution network and the traffic system after disaster, and reduces the economic loss caused by power reduction.

title_en: Mine ecological restoration carbon fixation rate prediction method
abstract_en: The invention aims to solve the problems of the existing ecological restoration carbon fixation rate prediction method and provides a mine ecological restoration carbon fixation rate prediction method. The method comprises the following steps of 1, integrating data to construct a dynamic prediction model of the carbon fixation rate change of the ecological restoration of the mine, 3, verifying and optimizing the prediction model by using historical data and field observation data, and 4, establishing a quantitative relation between the carbon fixation rate change and the ecological restoration means of land utilization, vegetation coverage and soil properties by adopting a machine learning technical means for the optimized prediction model. The method overcomes the influence of extreme climate events on the carbon sequestration rate of the ecological system, can accurately predict the carbon sequestration rate change trend under different ecological restoration strategies in the future, and provides powerful scientific basis for ecological restoration of mining areas.
assignees: ANSTEEL GROUP MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Multi-network integrated emergency communication rapid ad hoc network method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid self-networking method and system for emergency communication integrating multiple networks, and relates to the technical field of tobacco processing equipment, wherein the method encodes multiple source states and information into a token sequence through a windowed token step, and obtains context representation through calculation of a weighting coefficient matrix based on content and structure through a self-adaptive context aggregation step; the aggregation weight is injected with the difference correlation indication quantity based on the reversible bloom lookup table sketch priority analysis set difference through the difference guiding aggregation and synchronous coupling step, cross-layer control vectors including cross-link scheduling scores, coding redundancy, layering confirmation threshold values, forward error correction sheet distribution plans and the like are decoded through the cross-layer parameter synchronous decoding and issuing step, accurate difference restoration, stable performance guarantee and efficient multi-network coordination can be achieved, and convergence speed and reliability of the emergency communication ad hoc network are remarkably improved.
assignees: YUNNAN YANBEN INFORMATION SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for calculating ecological water demand of lack-of-data city river and lake based on remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention provides a calculation method of urban river and lake ecological water demand based on a remote sensing image and lack of data, which comprises the steps of firstly determining the calculation sub-items of the basic ecological water demand and the target ecological water demand of the urban river and lake; then, based on remote sensing image toilet sheets, the actual water surface of the lake is extracted, the leakage water quantity and the leakage coefficient are calculated according to water quantity balance, and then, the water quantity required by each sub-item is calculated. The seepage water quantity in the ecological water quantity is close to the real seepage water quantity, the calculated ecological water quantity is scientific and reasonable, and scientific basis and data support are provided for the ecological restoration of rivers and lakes and the reasonable optimization configuration of water resources.

title_en: Soil restoration target dynamic preparation method based on conservation function of protecting underground water source
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil remediation, in particular to a soil remediation target dynamic preparation method based on a conservation function of a protected underground water source, which comprises the following steps: and (3) acquiring repair starting points and water level data, identifying a hysteresis period, adjusting boundaries to generate dynamic drawings, extracting a water level gradient and seepage direction sequencing intervention sequence, judging a fluctuation and water stagnation capacity mark regulation section, and setting a repair schedule by superposing concentration and water level trend. According to the invention, a hysteresis relationship is explicitly interfered by extracting a water level inflection point and an infiltration difference value, the boundary response direction is adjusted according to a hysteresis period, the adaptability of a control range is enhanced, an interference priority sequence is constructed by combining a hydraulic gradient and a seepage trend, the restoration efficiency of continuous segments is highlighted, a limit area is judged by utilizing water layer fluctuation and water retention capacity, a concentration regulation position is accurately defined, the water level trend and pollution distribution are overlapped, the restoration frequency and time course are set, and the dynamic coordination of interference identification, boundary adjustment and restoration rhythm is realized.

title_en: Unit combination optimization method driven by large language model
abstract_en: A large language model driven unit combination optimization method relates to the technical field of electric power systems and comprises the steps of obtaining economic operation basic data of an electric power system, constructing an integer relaxation safety constraint unit combination model according to the economic operation basic data, solving the unit combination model, further obtaining the unit combination model, solving the unit combination model, constructing a variable dimension reduction algorithm, a constraint dimension reduction algorithm and an infeasible solution restoration algorithm, sequentially carrying out single algorithm evolution on the variable dimension reduction algorithm and the constraint dimension reduction algorithm by adopting the large language model, carrying out single algorithm evolution on the infeasible solution restoration algorithm by adopting the large language model, solving and calculating the unit combination model after the integer relaxation safety constraint, calculating the variable constraint dimension reduction safety constraint unit combination model to obtain an optimal solution, and restoring the optimal solution of the variable constraint dimension reduction safety constraint unit combination model based on the optimal infeasible solution restoration algorithm to obtain a result, wherein the method is used for solving the problem that the conventional model dimension reduction method is insufficient in terms of generality, stability and interpretability.
assignees: SICHUAN ENERGY INTERNET RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF TSINGHUA UNIV;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Flow soldering device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve such a problem that since the output of a pump must be adjusted according to the change of solder liquid level in a solder bath, the pump consumes a lot of electrical energy, and the solder liquid level must be lowered quickly for safety in the event of a disaster.SOLUTION: In the flow soldering device for supplying solder in a solder bath to a solder supply object located above via a jet nozzle, a gas chamber communicating with the solder bath and being filled with gas, and means for adjusting the volume of gas in the gas chamber are provided. Electrical energy being consumed by the pump can be saved by adjusting the volume of gas in the gas chamber thereby adjusting the liquid level of solder in the solder bath. Furthermore, quick lowering of the solder liquid level is contributive to safety measure or early restoration of earthquake.

title_en: System and method for operating risk evaluation according to working of nuclear power plant
title_ko: 원자력 발전소의 운전 상태를 반영한 리스크 평가를 위한 운영 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an operation system and method for evaluating a risk reflecting an operation state of a nuclear power plant by evaluating risk and providing a list of measures corresponding to the degree of risks when a device is suddenly broken (loses its functions) while the nuclear power plant normally operates or when the device is unavailable due to test work, emergent repair or power outage. According to the present invention, in case a device is broken (loses its functions) or is unavailable due to test work, emergent repair, or power outage while the nuclear power plant normally operates, risk may be evaluated, and a list of measures corresponding to the degree of risks is provided in real-time through a terminal of a person in charge or a server in a repair management division. Therefore, work history, current repair work history, risk color, restoration priority, and estimated work time of the device which is currently broken or unavailable according to the risk can be detected and actions may be taken in real-time.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원자력 발전소의 운전 상태를 반영한 리스크 평가를 위한 운영 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 원자력 발전소 정상운전중 불시에 기기가 고장(기능상실)나거나, 시험작업, 긴급정비 또는 정전으로 인해 기기 이용불능상태가 발생하는 경우, 이에 대하여 리스크를 평가하여 리스크의 정도 각각에 부합하는 조치내역을 제공함으로써, 원자력 발전소의 운전 상태를 반영한 리스크 평가를 위한 운영 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공함에 그 특징적인 목적이 있다.  
상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 원자력 발전소 정상운전중 불시에 기기가 고장(기능상실)나거나, 시험작업, 긴급정비 또는 정전으로 인해 기기 이용불능상태가 발생하는 경우, 이에 대하여 리스크를 평가하여 리스크의 정도 각각에 부합하는 조치내역을 담당자 단말기 또는 정비관리부서 서버를 통해 실시간으로 제공함으로써, 리스크에 따른 현재 고장 또는 이용불능 기기의 작업내용, 현재의 정비작업내역, 리스크 색상, 회복 우선순위 및 예상 작업시간을 실시간으로 확인하고 조치하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of production method of root key
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of root key production method meeting power industry power information key management system demand.In the production process of root key, use true random number component and the hybrid operation of pseudo random number component, the mode of circulation encryption produces the root key of power industry power information key management system demand, adopt key components local backup and Restoration Mechanism and M? of? N coding techniques carries out key remote backup and Restoration Mechanism two kinds of modes, these two kinds of cipher key backup and Restoration Mechanism complement one another, both facilitate user to carry out backup and the recovery of key, effectively can resist again the catastrophic failure that fire, earthquake etc. cause power information acquisition system root key.This invention meets the key management system root key producing method of current main-stream, has adaptability widely; User's property of participation is strong, and the backup of key and Restoration Mechanism are considered comprehensively, can really meet user's user demand.

title_en: Low-altitude remote sensing image rapid and automatic splicing method without POS assisting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-altitude remote sensing image rapid and automatic splicing method without POS assisting. The method comprises the first step of full-automatic restoration of a low-altitude remote sensing image test area, the second step of conducting fine matching on a preprocessed image according to fine matching seed points to obtain a fine matching result, the third step of conducting free network adjustment iteration on the fine matching result to obtain an adjustment result, and the fourth step of conducting interpolation to generate a digital ground model of the image according to the adjustment result, obtaining a relative outer orientation element of the image under the free network coordinate system according to the adjustment result, conducting orthographic rectification on the image based on the digital ground model and the relative outer orientation element, and meanwhile generating an orthographic image splicing image of the test area. The method is free of POS data assisting, the orthographic image splicing image can be rapidly produced in a full-automatic mode, the remote sensing image quasi real-time processing requirement can be met, and the method is suitable for the fields of disaster emergency response, military security and the like.

title_en: Method and device for filling maintenance list of power grid power transmission and transformation equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for filling a maintenance list of power grid power transmission and transformation equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the first OMS maintenance order is issued to a local dispatching center through a superior dispatching center, so that the local dispatching center associates a local dispatching power-off and power-restoration application with a second OMS maintenance order; converting a first DICP power failure and recovery application uploaded by a plant station into a second DICP power failure and recovery application through a local scheduling center, and uploading the second DICP power failure and recovery application to a superior scheduling center; associating, by the local scheduling center, the second DICP outage request with a second OMS service order; and after the local dispatching center receives the reply of the power-on-reply stopping application of the superior dispatching center, the local dispatching center operates according to the reply information, so that the plant station executes an instruction corresponding to the reply information and fills the reply information into a second OMS maintenance list. The technical problems that the workload of manually filling the OMS overhaul list by operators is large, mistakes are easy to occur, and the overhaul risk of the provincial and local main network equipment exists are solved.

title_en: Key road section road restoration rescue equipment considering landslide hazard
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides key road section road restoration rescue equipment considering landslide disasters, and relates to the field of road restoration. The key road section road restoration rescue equipment considering landslide hazard comprises: landslide section and broken ground subassembly. The landslide section includes road body and landslide body, the landslide body covers a section on the road body, the subassembly that breaks earth includes two sets of pieces that break earth, the tool bit spare that breaks earth, gyro wheel, a plurality of first connecting piece, second connecting piece and first enhancement frame, the tool bit spare that breaks earth is connected in two sets of one end that breaks earth. In the process of dredging the road, only the soil between two broken soil pieces is required to be cleaned, all the soil on the road is not required to be cleaned, the road can be recovered to pass, the time required for recovering the key road to pass is reduced, when the soil is dredged, the landslide body is supported by the broken soil pieces, the landslide body is reduced in the dredging process, the situation that potential safety hazards and workload are increased is caused by collapse and increase again is avoided.

title_en: Inter-city highway-railway multi-travel-path multi-agent collaborative reasoning and restoring method and system
abstract_en: Provided is an inter-city public-railway multi-agent collaborative reasoning and restoring method and system for a multi-agent travel path, which realize reasoning and restoring of a real travel path based on inter-city travel sparse track observation data of travelers. The method comprises the steps of obtaining and preprocessing original track observation data and traffic network data, carrying out rasterization processing and storage on the road network data and the track observation data, designing and training path searching intelligent bodies to achieve reasonable recovery path sequence reasoning, identifying the intelligent bodies in a design and training mode to achieve reasonable travel mode sequence reasoning, and achieving recovery of urban public-railway multi-mode travel real paths through trained cooperative reasoning of the two intelligent bodies. According to the invention, the complex inter-city public-railway multi-trip path restoration problem is decoupled into the path search and the mode identification, and two intelligent agents are constructed to respectively solve the two sub-problems, so that the inference restoration of the inter-city trip real path based on the sparse observation track is realized, and a new thought and a new method are provided for the path restoration field.

title_en: Traffic light controller and leak detection method thereof
title_ko: 교통 신호 제어기 및 그의 누전 감지 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a traffic signal controller capable of controlling traffic lights for vehicles and pedestrians at crossroads, and a short circuit detection method thereof. The traffic signal controller includes: a main control unit (MCU) performing a control function of the traffic signal controller through a central processing unit (CPU) controlling on/off of traffic lights at crossroads; a plurality of load switch units (LSU) turning on and off traffic lights for vehicles and pedestrians at crossroads in accordance with control signals of the main control unit; a ZCT configuration part connecting the plurality of load switch units with traffic lights for vehicles and pedestrians at crossroads in at least three areas; a display part; and a traffic signal short circuit detection part, when sensing an image current from a predetermined position of the ZCT configuration part, receiving signal operation state information from the CPU to determine in which signal state of signals of the traffic lights for vehicles and pedestrians a short circuit has occurred, in accordance with preset determination criteria, thereby displaying a short circuit occurrence position of the ZCT configuration part on the display part. Therefore, in a state in which power supply is not possible due to a power cutoff by a circuit breaker, a short circuit position can be identified without the restoration of power, a site location and a state can be quickly identified, a leakage cable can be identified in real time to enable quick maintenance, and a power failure accident, a traffic accident and an electric shock accident can be prevented.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 교차로 차량 신호등 및 보행자 신호등을 제어하는 교통 신호 제어기 및 그의 누전 감지 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 교통 신호 제어기는, 교차로 신호등의 온오프를 제어하는 중앙처리장치(CPU)에 의해 교통신호 제어기의 제어 기능을 하는 주제어부(MCU), 상기 주제어부의 제어신호에 따라 교차로의 차량 신호등 및 보행자 신호등을 온오프하는 복수의 등기 구동 장치(LSU: Load Switch Unit), 상기 복수의 등기 구동 장치와 3지 이상의 교차로의 차량 신호등 및 보행자 신호등을 연결하는 ZCT 구성부와, 표시부와, 상기 ZCT 구성부의 소정 위치에서 영상 전류를 감지시, 상기 CPU로부터 신호 운용 상태 정보를 입력받아, 상기 차량 신호등 및 보행자 신호등의 신호들 중에 어느 신호 상태에서 누전이 발생한 것인지 미리 설정된 판단 기준에 따라 판단하여, 상기 ZCT 구성부의 누전이 발생한 위치를 상기 표시부에 표시하는 교통 신호기 누전 감지부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 의하여, 누전 차단기의 전력차단으로 전원공급이 불가한 상태에서, 전원을 복구하지 않는 상태에서도 누전위치를 알 수 있고, 현장 위치 및 상태 파악을 신속하게 수행할 수 있으며, 실시간으로 누설 케이블을 파악하여 신속한 유지/보수가 가능하게 되고, 정전사고, 교통사고, 감전사고를 사전에 예방할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for compressing and restoring data using hierarchical autoencoders and correlation networks
abstract_en: A system and method for compressing and restoring data using a hierarchical multi-level autoencoder architecture and correlation network. The system compresses data using a cascade of autoencoders, each focusing on different scales or features, allowing for efficient representation across various resolutions. Data restoration employs a corresponding hierarchical decoder structure and a correlation network, trained on cross-correlated data sets. This approach leverages inter-data relationships at multiple scales, potentially recovering more lost information than traditional single-scale methods. The hierarchical structure adapts to diverse data types, achieving higher compression ratios while maintaining data quality, applicable to fields such as remote sensing, IoT data processing, and multimedia compression.

title_en: Assembled damage-controllable steel column base
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the building engineering antidetonation, a controllable steel column foot of pin-connected panel damage is provided, including steel basis, crab-bolt, steel column bottom plate, energy dissipater and steel column. On the premise of ensuring the bearing capacity and rigidity of the exposed steel column base, the exposed steel column base with controllable damage and quickly replaceable energy dissipaters is provided in a mode of arranging the energy dissipaters. The utility model discloses a steel column base power consumption ability is stronger, and the damage is controllable, can control the damage in the position that exposes of easy restoration changes such as energy dissipater, improves the column base and shakes the ability of repairing afterwards. After the earthquake, the energy dissipater can be replaced rapidly to realize local rapid repair. The column base is easy to construct, high in energy consumption capacity in an earthquake, controllable in damage and capable of being quickly repaired.

title_en: Intelligent command system for emergency restoration of railway disasters and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent command system for emergency restoration of railway disasters and a using method thereof, belonging to the field of railways, the intelligent command system for emergency restoration of railway disasters and the using method thereof can send real-time scenes of a disaster site to a command control center through a monitoring module and a scanning module, three-dimensional simulation software on the command control center can simulate disaster relief steps, thereby simulating the optimal disaster relief steps, and then the command control center can project the optimal disaster relief steps to a two-state projection screen plate of the disaster site through a projection module, thereby facilitating the real-time command of the disaster relief process of disaster relief personnel, further controlling the condition of expansion of disaster influence caused by improper processing of the disaster relief process to be the lowest, thereby improving the safety of disaster relief efficiency, accelerating the restoration speed of railway traffic, and converting the two states of the two-state projection screen plate, the method and the device can improve the watching of disaster relief personnel on the optimal projection step, and further improve the disaster relief efficiency.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;CHENGDU NUOBIKAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power customer appeal sensitivity supervision and early warning method based on random forest
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power customer appeal sensitivity supervision and early warning method based on a random forest, and S1, customer sensitivity associated factor sets of a production power failure appeal and an arrearage power failure and power restoration appeal are respectively constructed; s2, extracting historical data and filtering abnormal data to form a machine learning data set; s3, dividing the machine learning data set into a training set and a verification set; s4, respectively obtaining a random forest prediction model of a production power failure demand and an arrearage power failure and power restoration demand based on the training set and the verification set; s5, respectively constructing sensitivity index models of the production power failure demand and the arrearage power failure demand and the power restoration demand based on the random forest prediction models of the production power failure demand and the arrearage power failure demand and the power restoration demand; s6, determining a sensitivity index limit of an early warning grade based on the machine learning data set; and S7, carrying out early warning level prediction of the client appeal. The invention further senses the requirements of power customers and improves the power service quality.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN POWER CO LTD POWER SUPPLY SERVICE CENTER METRIC CENTER;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power grid elastic resilience evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the elastic restoring force of a power grid, which comprises the following steps of: setting a power grid data acquisition system; carrying out power grid loss data acquisition and power grid recovery data acquisition; constructing a circuit loss evaluation model according to the collected power grid loss data; constructing a power grid elastic resilience evaluation model; and adjusting and optimizing the power grid elastic resilience evaluation model through the collected power grid restoration data. According to the technical scheme, the power grid data acquisition device is arranged at the node in the power grid line, the restoring force level of the elastic power distribution network is reflected by the change of the power grid line data acquired from a plurality of stages before, during and after a disaster, the loss condition of the power grid line is reflected by the data such as the circuit state of the power grid node, the telegraph pole continuing state in the power grid line, the disaster degree and the like, a circuit loss evaluation model is constructed and a power grid elastic restoring force evaluation model is constructed through the acquired power grid loss data, the power grid restoring data are substituted and adjusted, and the system evaluation efficiency and precision are improved.
assignees: JIAXING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF ZHEJIANG PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID

title_en: Near-natural vegetation restoration method for evergreen broad-leaved forest fire burning zone
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of vegetation restoration, and particularly relates to a near-natural vegetation restoration method for evergreen broad-leaved forest fire burning lands. The near natural recovery mode is adopted, the seedlings are generated by sowing, the artificial planting and the later maintenance are not needed, and the cost is greatly reduced; the fast-growing stress-resistant species which are screened are adopted, so that the growth is fast, the coverage is good, and the ecological function is strong; the native species is adopted, so that foreign species caused by transplanting are reduced, and risks such as biological invasion, diseases and insect pests are reduced; the arbor, shrub and grass are matched to recover near nature, so that the recovery speed of the traditional method can be considered, and the long-term effect can be enhanced; the plant ash (alkaline) can effectively remove the wax layer outside pioneer seeds after fire disaster, which is beneficial to improving the germination rate of seeds of the selected species of Sorbus pohuashanensis, pinus massoniana and the like and shortening the time required for germination. Therefore, the method has obvious advantages in recovery cost, recovery speed, recovery quality and recovery stability, and has ecological benefit, economic benefit and social benefit.

title_en: Unmanned plane marshalling dynamic human body real-time three-dimensional reconstruction method based on 3D Gaussian sputtering
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time human dynamic three-dimensional reconstruction method of unmanned aerial vehicle marshalling based on 3D Gaussian sputtering, belonging to the technical field of computer vision and unmanned aerial vehicle coordination. The method comprises the steps of deploying unmanned aerial vehicle grouping carrying RGB-D cameras, constructing a forward link communication network, conducting parameter calibration, predicting human motion trend through a self-adaptive Gaussian distribution model, dividing an observation area, optimizing unmanned aerial vehicle paths, conducting incremental parameter fusion through a gradient sharing fusion algorithm, generating local dense point clouds in real time, constructing an unsupervised space-time segmentation model, distinguishing static background and dynamic human body areas, designing a 3D Gaussian weight weighting algorithm to optimize point cloud density, enhancing shielding area integrity, optimizing Gaussian parameters through a differential rendering frame, generating a high-precision surface grid, and conducting denoising restoration through a cascading filtering network to achieve real-time three-dimensional reconstruction of the dynamic human body. The invention obviously improves the reconstruction speed and the integrity of the shielding area, and is suitable for the fields of emergency rescue, film and television manufacture and the like.

title_en: Power distribution network medium-voltage power failure fusion research and judgment method and system
abstract_en: A method for judging the medium-voltage power outage of power distribution network includes such steps as collecting multi-source power outage signals, judging the effectiveness of said signals, screening out effective power outage signal set, auxiliary checking, generating power outage event set, generating power outage information list in the power outage range according to the data of equipment account, topology information of electric network, marketing user-to-user relation, distribution transformer and community relation, dividing the power outage event set according to the power outage event type, including whole-line power outage, branch power outage, single distribution transformer power outage and single-medium-voltage user power outage, setting distribution transformer re-power time for power outage distribution transformer in power outage range, and repeating power outage distribution transformer according to conventional power restoration, load negative and overtime negative three-stage progressive power restoration mode. The method can improve the accuracy of middle-voltage power failure research and judgment and the accuracy of positioning the power failure influence range, and greatly shortens the overall time of distribution network fault rush repair.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Estimation system and estimation device for outage restoration area in jurisdiction of distribution substation
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To early estimate and determine restoration from outage in a power supply area in a jurisdiction of a distribution substation, as the whole area.SOLUTION: An estimation system for outage restoration area comprises: a plurality of buildings 61 to 64 and 71 to 74 in jurisdictions of distribution substations 2 and 3; a monitoring terminal for monitoring a power supply state of an electric facility in the buildings; a monitoring center 1 for receiving detection of the power supply state from the monitoring terminal through a communication channel 4; and power restoration determination means 13 in the monitoring center 1 for determining power restoration in power supply areas 6 and 7 in the jurisdictions of distribution substations. The power restoration determination means 13 determines that power restoration is achieved as the whole power supply area, in the case where the ratio of area of a polygon formed by taking buildings which are positioned in the power supply areas 6 and 7 in the jurisdiction of the distribution substation and in which power restoration is achieved, as the polygon's vertices to the total area of the power supply areas is equal to or larger than a predetermined value.

title_en: Restoration intention determination support device and restoration intention determination support method
abstract_en: To provide a restoration intention determination support device and a restoration intention determination support method that plan individual operations in restoration from a power failure of a power distribution system and then make a restoration work plan taking an individual operation plan into consideration so as to achieve power failure restoration for as many users as possible as early as possible.SOLUTION: There is provided a restoration intention determination support device for reconnecting a power system section disconnected owing to an accident of a power system to the power system, and the restoration intention determination support device comprises: an individual operation plan part which defines switch sections divided with adjacent switches in the disconnected power system section, and makes an individual operation plan including, as an individual operation section, a switch section having at least a decentralized power supply therein or arranged with a power supply vehicle; the individual operation plan part making an individual operation plan including, as an independent operation section, a switch section in which facilities having accident or damage are present in the power system; and a restoration work plan part which makes a restoration work plan for an individual operation section in which facilities having accident or damage are present in the switch section among the individual operation plans that the individual operation plan part generates.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Maintenance Management System
abstract_en: To provide a service appropriate to restore a house to its original state.SOLUTION: The present invention relates to a maintenance management system used to calculate the cost for restoring a building damaged by generation of disasters to its original state, and the maintenance management system includes a server 1. The server 1 includes a maintenance management unit 43, a damage information acquisition unit 46, a damage determination unit 47, and an original restoration cost calculation unit 48. The maintenance management unit 43 manages, as maintenance management information, the history of works done to a house to maintain and manage the house which include at least a part of inspection, maintenance, repair, and renovation at regular intervals. The damage information acquisition unit 46 acquires information of damages on the house associated with the disasters. The damage determination unit 47 determines the locations and the degree of damages on the house by the disasters on the basis of the maintenance management information and the information of damages. The original restoration cost calculation unit 48 calculates the cost for restoring the house to its original state on the basis of the maintenance management information and the locations and the degree of damages on the house.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: The system includes a means for acquiring position information, a means for collecting damage conditions when a disaster occurs, a means for transmitting the collected position information and damage conditions, a means for analyzing the transmitted position information and damage conditions to select an optimum restoration solution, and a means for notifying a person in charge of disaster response of the analysis result and the selected restoration solution.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Memory discharge system and Energy storage system comprising the same
title_ko: 메모리 배출 시스템 및 이를 포함하는 ess
abstract_en: In accordance with one embodiment of the present invention, a memory discharge system includes: a memory housing formed in a part of a container housing a power storage device is housed, to house a memory device storing operation information about the power storage device; a striking plate placed apart from the rear side of the memory housing; an elastic member interposed between the striking plate and an inner wall surface of the memory housing; and an opening/closing device fixing the striking plate to keep the elastic member compressed, and, when detecting the occurrence of a fire in the power storage device, unfixing the striking plate such that the striking plate is moved toward the memory device by an elastic restoration force of the elastic member to discharge the memory device outward through an opening part formed in front of the memory housing. Therefore, the present invention is capable of safely protecting an ESS storage device from a fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 메모리 배출 시스템은, 전력 저장 장치를 수용하는 컨테이너의 일부에 형성되어 상기 전력 저장 장치에 관한 운영 정보를 저장하는 메모리 장치를 내부에 수용하는 메모리 하우징; 상기 메모리 하우징의 후방에 이격되어 배치되는 타격 플레이트; 상기 타격 플레이트와 상기 메모리 하우징의 내벽면 사이에 개재되는 탄성 부재; 및 상기 탄성 부재가 압축된 상태를 유지하도록 상기 타격 플레이트를 고정시키며, 상기 전력 저장 장치에 화재 발생이 감지되면 상기 타격 플레이트에 대한 고정 상태를 해제함으로써 상기 타격 플레이트가 상기 탄성 부재의 탄성 복원력에 의해 상기 메모리 장치를 향해 이동하여 상기 메모리 장치를 상기 메모리 하우징의 전방에 형성된 개구부를 통해 외측으로 배출시키도록 하는 개폐 장치; 를 포함한다.

title_en: Aggregated Real-Time Power Outages/Restoration Reporting (RTPOR) In a Secure Mesh Network
abstract_en: Embodiments of the invention provide systems and methods for the reporting of status changes, such as but not limited to power outages and/or power restorations, throughout a smart grid system. Through the use of location-based reporting period selection and/or status change report aggregation, embodiments may provide efficient reporting processes that timely and accurately report status change information from the point(s) of the change to a back-end system via an access point.

title_en: Power Outage-based Incident Report Triage and Remediation
abstract_en: A method comprises determining, by an incident management application executing on a computer system, whether a location of a cell site indicated in an incident report is in a location area of a grid power outage, obtaining, by the incident management application, an estimated restoration time of the grid power outage at the cell site from a power monitoring system, storing, by the incident management application, the incident report at a data store to hold the incident report for a period of time based on the estimated restoration time, and after the period of time, executing, by the incident management application, a remediation action for the cell site according to a rule based on at least one of equipment data describing radio and power equipment at the cell site, priority data associated with the cell site, or power equipment availability data.

title_en: Hybrid distribution network power restoration control
abstract_en: A power outage restoration system manages a power network including a plurality of switching devices. The power outage restoration system includes an outage management system having a network model of said power network. A plurality of local restoration controllers are in communication with the outage management system and each said local restoration controller includes a trimmed network model correlating to a respective area of responsibility.
assignees: ABB RESEARCH LTD;WANG ZHENYUAN;STOUPIS JAMES;DONDE VAIBHAV;LI WENPING;PETERSON WILLIAM

title_en: Power system operating mode generation method based on monthly power transmission and transforming equipment repair schedule
