abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power system operating mode generation methods based on monthly power transmission and transforming equipment repair schedule, belong to Power System and its Automation technical field.The present invention obtains method of operation initial data at power grid regulation center, according to monthly power transmission and transforming equipment repair schedule, monthly power quantity predicting data are distributed according to history same period different periods rate of load condensate, generate two kinds of methods of operation of the monthly peak load mode for having power transmission and transforming equipment repair schedule each day and low ebb load method, system losses, spinning reserve requirement, the influence of planned outage unit are considered during both modes are generated, finally obtain power system operating mode data under the power transmission and transforming equipment repair schedule by " date, load method " pattern.Electric system production requirement and custom are met according to the repair schedule method of operation that the above method generates, can be that power networks risk assessment and adjusting again for repair schedule provide data basis under electric system power transmission and transforming equipment repair schedule.

title_en: Online testing method for batch control function of D5000 system load
abstract_en: The invention relates to a test method for a load batch control function of a D5000 system, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of deploying a workstation for testing, connecting an independent PC server, and debugging network communication and system functions; the firewall interface is arranged, so that unidirectional data transmission of the SCADA real-time data to the test PC server is realized; thirdly, the workstation receives real-time data information transmitted by the test PC server, and a plant station system model is constructed; the work station end issues a load removal target value preset instruction to a remote control operation simulation client side of the server terminal for testing; after the remote control operation simulation client receives the preset command of the excision target value sent by the workstation, checking is carried out, and the result is returned to the workstation; the workstation terminal receives a calibration returning instruction of the remote control operation simulation client terminal, executes a load batch control instruction after confirmation, and automatically generates a power transmission recovery sequence; and solving the problem of functional difference in the test process in time.

title_en: Selective permeation drainage system for mine restoration
abstract_en: The invention provides a selective permeation drainage system for mine restoration, which comprises a drainage ditch cover plate, a drainage ditch, a water purifying layer, a gravel layer, a water collecting tank cover plate, a water collecting tank, a filter rod, a water diversion pipeline and a water storage tank. The invention carries out reasonable flood control planning on a mine drainage system, effectively prevents flood disasters, simultaneously carries out precipitation, filtration, purification and utilization on rainwater, provides a large amount of water source supply for mine underground water sources, vegetation greening, living and industrial water, adopts the technical process of combining temperature, microwaves and carbonization, effectively eliminates pollutants and suspended particles in the rainwater, sets an adjustable watertight film in a permeable area, carries out directional adjustment on the water outlet area and direction of the permeable area, improves the effective utilization rate of the purified rainwater, adds a self-made water purifying layer, increases the area of purified water and water, and simultaneously adds a stone layer at the lower part of the whole system to play the roles of preventing uneven sedimentation and stabilizing structures.

title_en: Deep learning multi-microgrid elastic combination decision-making method based on Boosting perception
abstract_en: The invention provides a deep learning multi-microgrid elastic combination decision method based on Boosting perception, and relates to the fields of Boosting classifiers, deep neural networks, multi-microgrid combination operation scheduling considering operation elasticity and the like. The method comprises three parts of micro-grid combination optimization modeling, learning sample generation based on NATAF transformation and deep neural network learning based on Boosting perceptrons, wherein the micro-grid combination optimization modeling aims at important load power supply restoration capacity and provides a standby power supply path for operators, the learning sample generation based on NATAF transformation expands an original sample to all feasible spaces considering variable correlation, and the deep neural network learning based on the Boosting perceptrons adjusts deep neural network weights through hierarchical iterative traversal of neurons and adopts a cross voting mechanism to upgrade binary perception learning into multi-class learning. The algorithm provided by the invention has high real-time performance, considers the overall elasticity and has no limitation on applicability.

title_en: Method and device for dynamically simulating and scheduling aggregate community of coupling water quantity, water quality and aquatic organisms
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for dynamically simulating and dispatching a water quantity-water quality-aquatic organism integrated community, which can quantify the ecological response of the aquatic community to the water quantity and the water quality and provide scientific basis for the ecological flow, ecological restoration and dispatching of key rivers and lakes. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, determining a research scene, collecting measured data of a research area, and determining an influence factor and a decision variable of population dynamics; step 2, constructing a coupling water quantity-water quality-aquatic organism aggregate community dynamic model by considering the interaction relation among multiple populations, the water quantity and water quality effect, population migration in and migration out and the influence of other factors; step 3, calculating the ecological niche width, the environment optimal value and the competition coefficient parameter value in the integrated community dynamic model based on a niche number regression method and an ecological niche theory; and 4, simulating the cooperative evolution process of a plurality of group systems in the aggregated community, and determining the influence degree of water quantity and water quality on the dynamics of the aggregated community.

title_en: Reconstruction method of mine ecological restoration soil system
abstract_en: The invention provides a reconstruction method of a mine ecological restoration soil system, and relates to the technical field of mine soil restoration. The method comprises the following steps: step S1: treating the side slope and preventing the side slope from sliding; step S2: digging surface soil; step S3: crushing surface soil; step S4: adding a repair liquid into the surface soil, wherein the repair liquid is used for reducing heavy metal pollution in the surface soil and/or is used for fattening the surface soil; step S5: watering the surface soil; step S6: and respectively sowing grass seeds and planting trees in different areas of the surface soil. When the mine ecology is restored and the soil system is reconstructed, the side slope which is easy to generate landslide is treated firstly so as to prevent the side slope from landslide. After the surface soil is crushed, the repair liquid is added into the surface soil, so that heavy metal pollution in the surface soil can be reduced, and the corresponding repair liquid can be selected to fertilize the surface soil, so that a soil system is reconstructed, and land resources are protected.

title_en: Method for estimating power outages and restoration during natural and man-made events
abstract_en: A method of modeling electric supply and demand with a data processor in combination with a recordable medium, and for estimating spatial distribution of electric power outages and affected populations. A geographic area is divided into cells to form a matrix. Within the matrix, supply cells are identified as containing electric substations and demand cells are identified as including electricity customers. Demand cells of the matrix are associated with the supply cells as a function of the capacity of each of the supply cells and the proximity and/or electricity demand of each of the demand cells. The method includes estimating a power outage by applying disaster event prediction information to the matrix, and estimating power restoration using the supply and demand cell information of the matrix and standardized and historical restoration information.
assignees: OMITAOMU OLUFEMI A;FERNANDEZ STEVEN J;US DEPT ENERGY;UT BATTELLE LLC

title_en: Storage aggregate restoration
abstract_en: One or more techniques and/or systems are provided for controlling restoration of a storage aggregate. For example, a local storage device, located at a first storage site, and a remote storage device, located at a second storage site, may be assigned to a first storage aggregate. Responsive to a disaster of the first storage site, a gate may be created for the local storage device. The gate may block automated reconstruction and/or automated synchronization that may otherwise occur with respect to the local storage device. Until the local storage device is restored, the remote storage device may be used to service I/O requests that were otherwise directed to the local storage device. Responsive to receiving a user restoration command, the gate may be removed from the local storage device. Synchronization between the local storage device and the remote storage device may then be facilitated.

title_en: Fast network formation after network power restoration
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a first device in a network detects a power restoration event subsequent to a power outage event. Power is restored to the first device during the power restoration event. The first device synchronizes a channel hopping schedule to the detected power restoration event. The first device communicates with a neighboring device of the first device using the channel hopping schedule synchronized to the detected power restoration event. The neighboring device uses a corresponding channel hopping schedule to communicate with the first device that is also synchronized to the power restoration event.

title_en: A afforestation equipment for mine side slope ecological remediation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a greening device for ecological restoration of a mine side slope, and the greening device comprises a baffle plate, a positioning plate and a first planting plate in a mode of arranging a planting plate and a planting mechanism on a green-yellow device; the baffle and the locating plate are arranged at intervals to form a structural frame, and the first planting plate is arranged in the structural frame. The first planting plate comprises a limiting hole, a corrugated groove and a planting mechanism, wherein a guide hole penetrating through the side wall of the planting mechanism is formed in the planting mechanism, and the guide hole is communicated with the second planting hole; and a filter screen is arranged in the guide hole. This afforestation equipment is as the basis of guaranteeing side slope structural stability, the effectual afforestation rate that increases the side slope surface, for the vegetation provides good planting environment, has prevented soil erosion and water loss, has guaranteed the consolidation of soil, causes the problem of massif landslide after avoiding soil erosion and water loss.
assignees: CHINESE GULAND DAM GROUP THIRD ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method for managing mine environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for managing the mine environment. The method is characterized by comprising the following steps of cutting slopes, removing dangers, hanging nets, positioning the nets, spraying and sowing base materials, covering a mine with the nets and maintaining. After a year and a half, plants grow naturally, and mine afforesting recovering is finished. According to the method, geological disasters such as collapse and creeping down do not happen on the mine with afforesting recovered, a mine body with the afforesting recovered does not need to be maintained by people, the mine body and surrounding nature mountains are in harmony as an organic whole and are synchronous in four seasons, the plants grow naturally, the natural mountains are recovered, and the method makes a contribution to nation management on the geological disasters and ecological restoration.
assignees: ZHANGJIAGANG LVYAN ECOLOGY TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method for assessing reliability of medium voltage distribution network for calculating upstream power restoration operation time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for assessing reliability of a medium voltage distribution network for calculating upstream power restoration operation time, and the method comprises the following steps of: firstly creating a calculating model, secondly acquiring parameters (including basic parameters and reliability parameters) of all elements from the calculating model, obtaining a fault model result list according to the obtained parameters, and calculating the reliability index of each load point by the list to obtain the reliability index of the whole medium voltage distribution network; because the calculating model is based on production and operation and power supply reliability management of the medium voltage distribution network in China, various influencing factors are comprehensively considered to obtain reliability assessment results with higher reliability, thus the method can solve the problem that the reliability assessment results are low in accuracy in the existing medium voltage distribution network.
assignees: INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Natural disaster comprehensive risk assessment system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of natural disaster risk assessment, and particularly discloses a natural disaster comprehensive risk assessment system based on big data analysis. The application discloses a natural disaster comprehensive risk assessment system based on big data analysis, which comprises: a target model construction unit; a mark model generation unit; a period shooting unit; a water level identification recording unit for carrying out water level identification and recording; the point location identification recording unit is used for identifying and recording the point location; and the dynamic simulation evaluation unit is used for carrying out dynamic simulation display and carrying out disaster risk evaluation according to the display result. The method can construct a target three-dimensional model at a river dam needing important precaution, periodically shoots a plurality of evaluation points at shooting points, performs water level identification and point location identification, performs corresponding dynamic simulation display, and performs disaster risk assessment according to display results, so that the possibility of natural disasters such as flood, landslide and the like can be timely assessed, and early warning and restoration processing can be conveniently performed before the natural disasters occur.

title_en: Power grid flood investigation method and system for analyzing topography surface morphology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid flood investigation method and system for analyzing topography surface morphology, comprising the following steps: collecting geographical information data of a disaster area; judging a disaster-stricken power equipment area, inputting disaster-stricken position monitoring data, and constructing a neural network; measuring and calculating disaster-related positions and inundation degrees of the power equipment areas and damage ranges of the power equipment areas due to disaster; and outputting a survey result of the topography surface morphology, and making a disaster-stricken area restoration power supply strategy. The method for surveying the flood disaster of the power grid for analyzing the topography surface morphology creatively realizes the functions of surveying flood disasters in real time all weather based on meteorological release, hydrologic release, water level monitoring and water level observation data, has excellent timeliness and accuracy in the measuring and calculating result of disaster receiving conditions, and is beneficial to an emergency command center to guide the development of emergency response, load transfer, flood control reinforcement, rush repair electricity, material allocation, customer service, grid planning and the like.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Emergency command center network security risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vegetation restoration and discloses a network security risk assessment method for an emergency command center.
assignees: GUANGKE TONGLI GUANGDONG DATA SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Mine pit repairing method combining mine waste backfill with excess sludge encapsulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine pit repairing method by combining mine waste backfill and excess sludge encapsulation. The mine pit repairing method comprises the following steps of: spreading the fly ash-lime stabilized excess sludge to a natural foundation layer at the bottom of a mine hole and to the side wall of the mine hole, compacting to form a bottom sludge lining and a side wall sludge lining respectively; sequentially backfilling excess sludge, anaerobic ammonia oxidation sludge and nitrified sludge on a bottom sludge lining to form a triple composite sludge layer; backfilling mine waste on the triple composite sludge layer to form a mine waste layer. In addition, the mine pit repairing method further comprises the step of paving a top cover layer on the mine waste after backfilling is finished. According to the invention, mine wastes are backfilled in mine pits and solid wastes such as excess sludge are used for encapsulation, so that the treatment of wastes with processes of wastes can be effectively realized, the problems of mining area geological environment disasters, ecological restoration, vegetation restoration and the like are solved, and the environment-friendly mine construction is facilitated.

title_en: Ecological restoration method for silt powder beach
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, in particular to an ecological restoration method of silt muddy beach of silt, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining bird data, knowing ecological habits of birds, including inhabitation, foraging and safety factors, and further investigating habitat requirements of the birds, wherein the inhabitation and foraging have certain requirements on ecological factors, including water areas, vegetation, food and matrixes in areas, predators serving as interference factors influence safety of target species, and finally carrying out micro-topography restoration on restoration areas by adopting control of slope releasing angles, three-level tidal ditch modeling, vegetation restoration and three kinds of piled islands according to investigation data. According to the invention, through the technical means, the silt beach of the silt powder is divided into the vegetation restoration area and the light beach area, so that the dual promotion of biodiversity and water quality purification is realized, meanwhile, the planted vegetation can play the function of preventing moisture and resisting waves, the ecological disaster reduction function is realized, and the stability of an ecological system is further improved.

title_en: AI-based intelligent restoration method and system for wind direction and wind speed history data in alpine region
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an AI-based intelligent restoration method and system for wind direction and wind speed history data in alpine regions, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. The embodiment of the application aims to effectively improve the timeliness and accuracy of meteorological data by updating a meteorological monitoring data set, applying an advanced data restoration algorithm and carrying out multi-round wind load state vector mining based on a characteristic focusing strategy. By applying the embodiment of the application, the problem of delayed update of the meteorological data can be solved, the whole quality of the meteorological monitoring data can be obviously improved through deep data mining and intelligent restoration, thereby providing a more reliable data base for meteorological prediction, disaster early warning and the like, and having obvious technical progress and application value.
assignees: METEOROLOGICAL DATA CENTER OF HEILONGJIANG PROVINCE HEILONGJIANG METEOROLOGICAL DETECTION CENTER HEI

title_en: Power supply recovery method and device for power distribution network, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply recovery method and device of a power distribution network, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical output data, historical weather data and future weather data of a distributed power supply in a power distribution network, predicting the future output of the distributed power supply based on the historical output data, the historical weather data and the future weather data by utilizing a pre-training neural network model, obtaining a future output prediction result, and performing load shedding operation on the distributed power supply based on the future output prediction result to obtain a power supply recovery result, wherein the power supply recovery result is used for representing a power supply recovery result obtained after the load shedding operation is performed on the distributed power supply. The invention solves the technical problem of lower power restoration efficiency for the power distribution network in the related technology.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Method and system for generating biodiversity restoration scheme for power transmission and transformation engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to a generation method and a generation system of a biodiversity restoration scheme for power transmission and transformation projects, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an environment change image of a target area where the power transmission and transformation projects are located, distributing information of the power transmission and transformation projects and ecology change information, identifying differential environment information of the target area through an image differential identification strategy based on the environment change image, identifying sub-ecology influence information of each ecology type of the target area based on the ecology change information of the target area, identifying ecology abnormality ranges of each ecology abnormality factor of the target area based on the differential environment information and the sub-ecology influence information of each ecology type, and generating an ecology restoration strategy corresponding to each ecology abnormality factor through an ecology diversity restoration strategy based on the power transmission and transformation project distributing information and the ecology abnormality ranges of each ecology abnormality factor to serve as an ecology diversity restoration scheme of the target area.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method and device for generating distributed flexible resource power supply scheme under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for generating a distributed flexible resource power supply scheme under extreme disasters, a storage medium and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a first-stage objective function and a first constraint condition of a target power distribution network; the method comprises the steps of solving a first-stage objective function based on a first constraint condition to obtain the optimal installation position and the installation capacity of each distributed flexible resource in a target power distribution network, generating a network topology structure of the target power distribution network according to the optimal installation position and the installation capacity of each distributed flexible resource, constructing a second-stage objective function and a second constraint condition of the target power distribution network according to the network topology structure, solving the second-stage objective function based on the second constraint condition to obtain an island division range of the network topology of the target power distribution network under extreme disasters and a load recovery sequence of each island division range, and generating a power supply scheme of the distributed flexible resources under the extreme disasters based on each island division range and the load recovery sequence.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Regional high-resolution atmospheric analysis data construction method and system based on dynamic downscaling and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional high-resolution atmospheric analysis data construction method based on dynamic downscaling, which aims to improve the depicting capability of a medium-small scale weather process. The method takes global analysis data as a background field, fuses multisource observation data and high-resolution land utilization information, and gradually constructs an analysis data set with resolution of an hour level and a kilometer level by constructing a multi-layer nested WRF area mode and executing multi-time short-period simulation in combination with an assimilation strategy of analysis Nudging and observation Nudging. Through comparison and verification of multisource observation data, the constructed data set is obviously superior to ERA5 in the aspects of ground meteorological elements and vertical profile structure restoration, and has stronger regional adaptability and simulation precision. The method is suitable for various high-resolution weather application scenes such as regional artificial intelligent weather large models, urban fine weather service, high-impact weather disaster early warning, regional weather change evaluation, energy weather resource evaluation and the like.

title_en: System and method for fault restoration blackout of electric power system
title_ko: 전력계통 광역정전 복구 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for reconstructing a wide area power outage in an electric power system, which includes: a data acquiring unit for acquiring information data in the electric power system having phase information from monitoring devices in the electric power system; a data analyzing unit for analyzing the information data therein to determine whether power outage occurs and determine the range of which the power outage occurs; and an establishing unit of power outage reconstructing procedure for establishing a power outage reconstructing procedure by checking whether an operating generator is mounted and an interconnection tie path in an external area is able to be connected within the range thereof as a determined result. [Reference numerals] (10) Remote monitoring control unit; (110) Data acquiring unit; (120) Data analyzing unit; (130) Power outage reconstructing procedure establishing unit; (140) Procedure performing mode selecting unit; (145) Information display unit; (150) Operational control unit; (20) Phase measurement unit
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전력계통 광역정전 복구 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 전력계통의 감시설비들로부터 위상각 정보를 포함하는 전력계통 정보 데이터를 취득하는 데이터 취득부; 상기 전력계통 정보 데이터를 분석하여 정전 발생 여부를 판단하고 정전 발생 범위를 판단하는 데이터 분석부; 및 상기 판단 결과를 이용하여 정전 발생 범위 내 운전 중인 발전기의 유무와 외부지역 연계선로의 연계 가능 여부를 확인하여 정전 복구 절차를 수립하는 정전 복구 절차 수립부;를 포함한다.

title_en: A fertilizer-type forest fire prevention agent with forest fire delay and restoration effects
title_ko: 비료 형태의 산불 지연 및 복원효과가 있는 산불 방재제
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a forest fire disaster prevention agent having a fertilizer type forest fire delay and restoration effect. More specifically, the forest fire disaster prevention agent composed of a triple structure layer comprises: a fertilizer layer disposed on the outermost side of the triple structure layer and formed by mixing nitrogen, phosphoric acid, and chrysanthemum; a retarder layer disposed in the middle of the triple structure layer and including second ammonium phosphate, ammonium carbonate, and urea; and a synedra sp. Disposed in the center of the triple structure layer and nitrogen, phosphoric acid, chrysanthemum, polyammonium phosphate, seed seeds, and sinedra sp. The reconstituting agent layer including is by including comprised. That is, the present invention proposes a forest fire disaster prevention agent composed of a triple composite structure layer pre-sprayed for a composite fertilizer function for a rim, delaying and restoring a forest fire, and through this, unlike an existing liquid acid meal retarder, the present invention proposes a fertilizer-type forest fire disaster prevention agent having a forest fire delay and restoration effect, which has persistence without loss due to precipitation and can naturally implement the release of the forest fire disaster prevention agent without additional help.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비료 형태의 산불 지연 및 복원효과가 있는 산불 방재제에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 3중 구조층으로 구성되는 산불 방재제에 있어서, 3중 구조층의 최외각에 배치되고, 질소, 인산 및 가리를 배합하여 형성되는 비료층; 3중 구조층의 중간에 배치되고, 제2 인산암모늄, 탄산암모늄 및 요소를 포함하는 지연제층; 및 3중 구조층의 중심에 배치되고, 질소, 인산, 가리, 폴리인산암모늄, 종자 씨앗 및 시네드라(synedra sp.)를 포함하는 복원제층;을 포함하여 이루어진다. 
즉 본 발명은 림에 대한 복합비료기능, 산불의 지연 및 복원을 위해 사전 살포되는 3중 복합 구조층으로 구성되는 산불 방재제를 제안하고, 이를 통해 기존 액상형 산분 지연제와 달리 강수에 의한 유실이 없는 지속성을 가지며, 추가적인 도움 없이 산불 방재제의 방출을 자연스럽게 구현할 수 있는 비료 형태의 산불 지연 및 복원효과가 있는 산불 방재제를 제안하고자 한다.

title_en: Power distribution network fault research and judgment post analysis system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network fault studying and judging post analysis system and method, which are characterized by comprising the following steps: the fault analysis system comprises a fault brief report generation module, a fault treatment overall process time consumption statistics module, a fault electric quantity calculation module and a fault study and judgment evaluation module; the fault brief generating module is used for abstracting and summarizing the key points of fault disposal to form brief; the fault handling overall process time consumption counting module is used for recording and analyzing each node change in the handling process to obtain overall process time consumption information aiming at each fault; the fault electric quantity calculation module is used for calculating the power failure electric quantity and the early power restoration electric quantity of the current fault; and the fault research and judgment evaluation module is used for evaluating faults from three levels of terminal action, power distribution master station research and judgment and remote control execution.

title_en: Ecological restoration method for coal mining subsidence land in loess hilly area
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological restoration method for a coal mining subsidence area in a loess hilly area, which comprises the following steps of firstly, determining an ecological restoration scheme for the coal mining subsidence area in the loess hilly area; determining the depth and width of a water storage ditch, determining the height of a field ridge, building a terraced field, arranging a water storage system, arranging a road system, arranging an irrigation system, and performing ecological management. The invention aims at ecological restoration of a subsidence area, takes water and soil loss control as a starting point, proposes to treat the coal mining subsidence area by using a sponge terrace, adopts plant hedges to treat coal mining subsidence cracks, builds a novel ecological restoration mode of the loess hilly area coal mining subsidence area, realizes efficient utilization of water resources, controls water and soil loss, and improves the ecological restoration effect of the subsidence area, the capability of coping with natural disasters and the like.

title_en: System, device and method for providing power outage and restoration notification
abstract_en: A system, computer program product and method to provide information related to a power distribution system based on information provided by a plurality of network elements electrically connected to a plurality of power lines of the power distribution system at a plurality of locations is provided. In one embodiment, the method comprises receiving a notification from a group of network elements that have detected a voltage signature indicating an imminent power outage, determining location information of the power outage, outputting the location information of the power outage, receiving a live notification from a first network element of the group of network elements indicating a first power restoration at a location of the first network element, determining location information of the first power restoration, and outputting the location information of the first power restoration.
assignees: DEAVER SR BRIAN J;YANEY DAVID S;CURRENT TECH LLC

title_en: Distributed disaster recovery file sync server system
abstract_en: Example implementations are directed to restoration of data not only from the servers, but also from the clients connected to the server. Algorithms are incorporated to identify content that was created or modified after the last backup. This algorithm also identifies and resolves changes in the mount points for shared folders, preventing information leakage. When the server recovers from a failure, it notifies the clients about the recovery on their next connection. Each client then determines the current state of its mount points and file paths and compares them with the server's mount points and file paths. After the comparison, the client comprehends and indicates the mount point differences by renaming them and sends entire local data (all files, folders, mount points) to the server. The server reconciles the differences.
assignees: HITACHI DATA SYSTEMS CORP;HITACHI VANTARA CORP

title_en: River course adds medicine aeration integrated device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of black and odorous riverway restoration and environmental protection equipment, in particular to a riverway medicine-adding and aeration integrated device, which comprises a medicine-adding system, a submersible pump (2), a river propulsion medicine-adding device (3) and a jet aerator (5); the river propulsion doser (3) comprises a jet nozzle (11) for feeding gas-liquid mixture and a doser pipe (12) for feeding medicine, the river propulsion doser (3) is also provided with an outlet, the submersible pump (2) is connected with the jet aerator (5), and the outlet of the jet aerator (5) is connected with the jet nozzle (11) of the river propulsion doser (3); the medicine feeding system is connected with a medicine feeding pipe (12) of the river propulsion medicine feeder (3). The device combines aeration and dosing, and strengthens the effect of improving the water quality of the river; the spraying effect is good, the application range is wide, the emergency response is fast, the manual operation is not needed, and the automatic operation can be realized.
assignees: SHANGHAI CHUBAR SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid operating risk recognition and prevention method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid operating risk recognition and prevention method and system. According to the method, a power grid model is extracted with the CIM as the standard, and operating measurement data of a power grid are imported into the model at a fixed period to form a near-real-time operating environment; the power grid operating risk grading standard, an electrical topology analysis algorithm and an expert rule base are introduced under the operating environment to set up a power grid operating risk recognition and prevention bank, an auxiliary platform integrating active risk recognition, accident evaluation and restoration control is set up, the data under the power grid real-time operating mode are integrated through the CIM standard, the problem that information system data set up by different manufactures can not be shared is solved, and the sound data support is provided for the power grid safety evaluation; on this basis, the evaluation standard for reasonably evaluating and grading operation risks is increased, and the power grid operating risk recognition and prevention system is constructed; an operating risk prevention and control work mode with the system operation as the center and without participation of related departments together is achieved, and the operating risk prevention and control work level of the power grid is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;NANCHANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration method for steep side slope of abandoned mining area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, in particular to an ecological restoration method for a steep side slope of a waste mining area. In order to realize the three-dimensional greening of the steep side slope and solve the problem of ecological restoration of the slope with different fall and poor stability, the soil in the planting base disc is stable after a series of operations of land preparation, planting base disc making, planting base disc laying, planting base disc proportioning, planting base disc laying, water replenishing and later period management; the plant seeds can fall down, the seed sources are sufficient, and the supplemented species are native plants, so that the ecological environment of the region is adapted, the water and soil erosion is reduced, the survival rate is high, and the vegetation coverage and species diversity recovery effect is obvious; the hidden dangers of geological disasters such as water and soil loss and damage are avoided, and the ecological water treatment device is gradually integrated with natural ecology after years.

title_en: Distribution network emergency repair scheduling system and method
abstract_en: The application provides a distribution network emergency repair scheduling system and a distribution network emergency repair scheduling method, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the distribution network running state monitoring module is used for acquiring distribution network historical state data and distribution network historical fault data; the equipment asset management module is used for acquiring the data of the distribution network equipment; the enterprise standing book module is used for acquiring personnel data of a team; the vehicle management module is used for acquiring emergency vehicle data; the voice calling module is used for acquiring fault repair data; the prediction analysis module is used for acquiring an emergency repair analysis result; the man-machine interaction module is used for displaying an emergency repair analysis result and judging a distribution network fault; and the emergency repair task management module is used for generating an emergency repair task according to the distribution network fault and sending the emergency repair task to the man-machine interaction module so that a scheduling commander can command and schedule the emergency repair task according to the emergency repair analysis result.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH HAINAN POWER GRID CO LTD;YUNNAN YUNDIAN TONGFANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Reconstruction method of mine ecological restoration soil system
abstract_en: The invention provides a reconstruction method of a mine ecological restoration soil system, and relates to the technical field of mine soil restoration. The method comprises the following steps: step S1: treating the side slope and preventing the side slope from sliding; step S2: digging surface soil; step S3: crushing surface soil; step S4: adding a repairing liquid into surface soil, wherein the repairing liquid is used for reducing heavy metal pollution in the surface soil, and/or the repairing liquid is used for fertilizing the surface soil; step S5: watering the surface soil; step S6: sowing grass seeds and planting forest trees in different areas of the topsoil. When the mine ecology is restored and the soil system is reconstructed, the side slope which is easy to generate landslide is firstly treated to prevent the landslide of the side slope. After the topsoil is broken, the repairing liquid is added into the topsoil, so that heavy metal pollution in the topsoil can be reduced, and the topsoil can be fertilized by selecting the corresponding repairing liquid to reconstruct a soil system and protect soil resources.
assignees: CHINA BUILDING MAT SOUTHWEST SURVEY & DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Method for generating subway preponderant abdominal region travel chain based on mobile phone positioning data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for generating a subway preponderant abdominal trip chain based on mobile phone positioning data, which comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring mobile phone positioning data; and 2, step: acquiring all subway link lists in an urban subway network according to the track network geographic information; and 3, step 3: judging passenger flow origin-destination points of the subway station based on mobile phone positioning data; and 4, step 4: analyzing space competitive advantage of the passenger flow abdominal area based on mobile phone positioning data to generate station passenger flow travel chain OD data; and 5: and checking the distribution of the OD of the subway passenger flow abdominal area and the station based on the multivariate data. The method effectively improves the accuracy of the abdominal area analysis and the path restoration of the subway passenger flow full sample, and greatly reduces the cost. The method comprises the steps of analyzing the superior service range and the abdominal land of subway station and subway passenger flow of different station classification by using low-cost, wide-coverage and high-sampling-rate mobile phone positioning data, and verifying the source abdominal land and the data of the subway full-sample distributed passenger flow by combining the utilization of land around the station and the coverage of population to generate a complete travel chain of subway passenger flow traveling, so that technical support is provided for traffic planning and subway design managers in the aspects of rail competitive advantage analysis and passenger flow guidance.
assignees: GUANGZHOU TRANSP PLANNING RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network and traffic network collaborative first-aid repair optimization method considering extreme disaster influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network and traffic network collaborative first-aid repair optimization method considering extreme disaster influence, which comprises the following steps: collecting information of a power distribution network and a traffic network after the influence of extreme disasters; establishing a model for recovering maximization of a power distribution network and a traffic network; modeling the recovery process of the power grid and the traffic grid; adding a virtual node and rebuilding a network; carrying out power flow constraint on the reconstructed network, and finally obtaining a power distribution network and traffic network cooperative first-aid repair optimization method by using an objective function of a maximized model; the invention provides an optimization method for cooperative first-aid repair of a power distribution network and a traffic network, wherein the repair of the power distribution network and the repair of the traffic network are performed in a cooperative manner; and converting the problem into a mixed integer linear programming model by taking the restoration resources and the working personnel of the power distribution network and the restoration resources and the construction personnel of the traffic network as optimization variables. After the restoration time is appointed, a corresponding restoration strategy can be obtained by the constraint condition and the objective function, and the power distribution network and the traffic network are restored as much as possible.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Intelligent recovery system for sharing mobile power supply battery cell
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent battery core recycling, in particular to an intelligent recycling system for a shared mobile power supply battery core, which comprises a detection module, a control module and a control module, wherein the detection module is used for acquiring the use state and the use parameters of the shared mobile power supply through a sensor network; the processing module is used for positioning the shared mobile power supply to be recovered in the monitoring area and notifying the collecting module to execute the recovery task. The invention aims to provide an intelligent recovery system for sharing a mobile power supply battery core, which can effectively predict the service life of the battery core, dynamically adjust recovery priority and optimize recovery time.
assignees: GUANGDONG JIASHANG NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power supply fault diagnosis method and system for low-voltage distribution network based on power outage and restoration logic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply fault diagnosis method of a low-voltage distribution network based on power outage and restoration logic, which belongs to the technical field of power supply fault diagnosis and comprises the steps of converting unstructured power outage complaints of a user into standardized event labels by utilizing a natural language processing technology, synchronously aligning power outage pulses of an ammeter with action records of a branch switch to construct a multidimensional space-time event sequence, establishing a fault propagation logic network through topology division of power supply units, deducing a fault diffusion path according to power outage time sequence differences of adjacent units and failure states of a protection device, and reversely positioning initial fault points. And meanwhile, dynamically correcting the fault association probability among the units to generate a weighted candidate fault chain. The fault propagation tree is modified in reverse through a variety of validation mechanisms. And finally, screening out a fault chain with optimal space-time consistency by calculating the confidence coefficient. The method solves the problems of multi-source information fracturing, time-space association weakening and insufficient verification reliability in fault location of the low-voltage distribution network.

title_en: Natural disaster ecological restoration success assessment method and assessment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster ecological restoration success assessment methods, and discloses a natural disaster ecological restoration success assessment method and an assessment system, aiming at solving the problems of imperfect index system, single assessment method, strong subjectivity, lack of systematicness, low automation degree and the like in the existing assessment method. The invention provides a method and a system for comprehensively, objectively and scientifically evaluating ecological restoration effects of natural disasters by comprehensively utilizing various evaluation methods including, but not limited to, a hierarchical analysis method, a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, a principal component analysis method and the like and combining a remote sensing technology, a geographic information system technology and a database technology.

title_en: Starting method for energy storage system, energy storage system, and starting apparatus
abstract_en: Provided is a starting method for an energy storage system (10). The energy storage system (10) comprises at least one energy storage sub-module (100). The energy storage sub-module (100) comprises a power module (101) and a battery module (102). The starting method comprises: obtaining a first instruction (S201); and controlling, according to the first instruction, the battery module (102) to charge the power module (101) (S202). According to the starting method, the battery module (102) of the energy storage sub-module (100) can be controlled to charge the power module (101) when a power grid is in a blackout state, so that the power module (101) can be charged to have power-on capability, thereby realizing the self-starting of the energy storage sub-module (100), facilitating the increase of the restoration speed of the power grid.

title_en: Strategic rationing of vehicle energy for supporting household loads during power outages
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for coordinating and providing bidirectional energy transfer events between electrified vehicles and households or other structures, such as for supporting household loads associated with the structures during power outage conditions. In some implementations, available energy may be rationed from the vehicle to the structure based on a power outage restoration estimate. Rather than supporting household loads with constant energy during power outage conditions, the disclosed systems/methods may provide strategic rationing of bidirectional energy transfer in order to extend appliance operation for the duration of power outage conditions.

title_en: Ground reinforcing structure for stone pagoda cultural heritage
title_ko: 석조문화재의 지반보강구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a ground reinforcing structure for stone cultural properties for reinforcing the ground corresponding to the location on which a stone cultural properties are put or increasing the bearing capacity of ground and more specifically, to a ground reinforcing structure for stone cultural properties performing a compaction process on part of a soil layer using an reinforced binder with the more excellent reinforcement force than soil by a ground reinforcement method, which is one of conventional soil grounding methods (plate built soil grounding), for building a foundation while compacting only soil layer upon layer. The present invention can apply the conventional ground reinforcement method and the conventional material as possible when the basement located in the lower part of the stereobate of a stone cultural properties is reconstructed, and can ensure the structural stability and the sufficient bearing power as similar as possible at the time of the stone cultural properties restoration. [Reference numerals] (A) Conventional method; (A-1,A-2,B-1,B-2,C-1,C-2) Sample; (AA) Section; (B) Compacting method; (BB,EE) Soil 10 cm rodding; (C) Reinforcement material; (CC) Soil+deviced stone 15 cm rodding; (DD) Soil+deviced stone 15 cm mechanical compaction; (FF,GG,II) Soil 10 cm mechanical compaction; (HH) Quicklime 10 cm mechanical compaction; (JJ) Inorganic binder 10 cm mechanical compaction
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 석조문화재의 기단이 놓일 위치에 해당하는 지반을 보강하거나 지반의 지지력을 증가시키기 위한 석조문화재의 지반보강구조에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하면, 예부터 알려진 지정(地定) 방법 중에 하나인 단순히 흙만을 달고질 하여 층층히 다지면서 기초를 쌓아올리는 지반보강방법(판축지정)의 흙층의 일부를 흙보다 보강력이 우수한 보강바인더를 이용하여 다짐처리한 석조문화재의 지반보강구조에 관한 것이다. 
또한 본 발명은 석조문화재의 기단 하부에 위치한 기반을 재조성함에 있어 가능한 원래의 지반보강방법과 재료를 반영할 수 있는 효과를 얻을 수 있고; 석조문화재의 복원 시점과 유사한 정도의 구조적인 안정성과 충분한 지내력을 확보할 수 있는 효과를 얻을 수 있다.
assignees: NAT RESERCH INSTITUE OF CULTURAL PROPERTIES

title_en: Be used for prosthetic green slope protection structure of planting of geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a green slope protection structure of planting for geological disaster restoration belongs to geological disaster restoration technical field, including backfill soil layer, backfill soil layer upper end both sides are provided with spacing roof beam, two be provided with ecological mould frame between the spacing roof beam, ecological mould frame inside is provided with the vegetation bag, ecological mould frame curb plate inside is provided with drainage component, the utility model discloses set up drainage component, make the rainwater discharge through wash port and outlet, thereby avoid the rainwater in the vegetation bag to accumulate and influence the growth of its inside plant, the filter screen can filter the rainwater, the soil loss appears when avoiding the rainwater to discharge, improves the protective effect of green slope protection; the utility model discloses set up coupling assembling, during the connecting hole that makes the connecting plate of an ecological mould frame chamfer department inserted another ecological mould frame chamfer department, can be convenient connect a plurality of ecological mould frames to the non-deformable is stabilized more to the structure when making it lay.
assignees: FUJIAN YANTIAN INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network fault restoration resource scheduling method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a power distribution network fault recovery resource scheduling method. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an input power distribution network fault point set, and taking the input power distribution network fault point set as the input of a resource scheduling model; calculating to obtain an optimal feasible solution of resource scheduling according to a repaired resource scheduling model, wherein the resource repairing model is a fault repairing time function under the condition of considering the emergency degree of the fault; and scheduling the fault repairing resources according to the output of the resource scheduling model. The embodiment of the application also discloses a power distribution network fault repairing resource scheduling device. The embodiment of the application improves the scheduling efficiency and the resource utilization rate of the fault repairing resource scheduling.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD;TAIYUAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: NAS data reduction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of system disaster recovery, and discloses a NAS data reduction method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a time to be restored from a received NAS data restoration instruction; acquiring to-be-restored change file information from a preset change file list from the to-be-restored time to the current time, wherein the preset change file list comprises a plurality of pieces of information obtained by carrying out deep data packet detection on network data passing through NAS equipment; and carrying out data restoration based on the file information to be restored. According to the method and the device for restoring the NAS data, the to-be-restored change file information from the to-be-restored time to the current time is obtained from the preset change file list, the information in the preset change file list is obtained through deep data packet detection on the network data of the NAS device, and then data restoration is carried out based on the to-be-restored change file information, so that the time for restoring the data can be saved, the NAS device is compatible, and the NAS data restoring performance is improved.

title_en: Power distribution network restoration deployment scheme determining method and device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a power distribution network restoration deployment scheme determination method, a device, computer equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: generating a plurality of typical waterlogging water logging disaster scenes of the power distribution network; determining a load recovery item and a maintenance time item corresponding to the typical waterlogging water immersion disaster scene, and generating an objective function corresponding to the typical waterlogging water immersion disaster scene according to the load recovery item and the maintenance time item; determining at least one element recovery constraint of the objective function; the element recovery constraint condition is used for constraining the recovery process of the power distribution network; determining a target drainage scheme and a target repair scheme that satisfy at least one element recovery constraint and maximize an objective function; and obtaining a power distribution network recovery deployment scheme based on the target drainage scheme and the target maintenance scheme. By adopting the method, the reasonability of the power distribution network recovery deployment scheme can be improved.

title_en: Intelligent power distribution network rush-repair scheduling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system management, in particular to an intelligent power distribution network emergency repair scheduling system which comprises an environment sensing module, a fault detection and positioning module, an assessment early warning module, an optimal scheduling decision module, an emergency resource allocation module and a feedback self-learning module, wherein the environment sensing module is used for collecting power distribution network environment information in real time, the fault detection and positioning module is used for detecting power distribution network faults in real time, the assessment early warning module is used for carrying out intelligent assessment on the fault information, the optimal scheduling decision module is used for generating an optimal emergency repair scheduling scheme, the emergency resource allocation module is used for dynamically allocating emergency repair personnel, equipment and materials, and the feedback self-learning module is used for self-learning and optimizing improvement. According to the invention, by integrating efficient fault detection, multi-objective optimal scheduling, dynamic resource allocation and feedback and self-learning mechanisms, the rush repair response speed and the resource use efficiency are remarkably improved, so that the reliability of a power grid is enhanced and the operation and maintenance cost is reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY GONGYI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;ZHENGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power distribution network line reinforcement decision-making method and system considering typhoon disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a line reinforcement decision-making method of a power distribution network under consideration of typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of generating fault probability of each line after the occurrence of the typhoon disasters according to a power distribution network pole fault probability generation method, acquiring fault states of each line in the power distribution network after the occurrence of the typhoon disasters, non-electric vehicle user load data and electric vehicle initial states, then establishing a post-disaster flexible resource collaborative quick recovery model, simulating a restoration process after the occurrence of the typhoon disasters according to the post-disaster flexible resource collaborative quick recovery model, obtaining restoration moments of each line, sorting according to the restoration moments of each line by using a Copride sorting method, so as to obtain line importance sorting, and making line anti-station reinforcement decisions of the power distribution network according to the line importance sorting. The method can be used for making the line reinforcement strategy of the power distribution network under typhoon extreme natural disasters.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;WUHAN NARI LTD LIABILITY CO OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Urban power grid post-disaster two-stage recovery method and system based on star-ground fusion communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster two-stage recovery method and a post-disaster recovery system for an urban power grid based on satellite-ground fusion communication, which relate to the field of post-disaster recovery of power grids, wherein in the first stage, an available post-disaster recovery time sequence of satellite communication is output through a real-time simulation result of a channel state of a post-disaster recovery period of low-orbit satellite communication; in the second stage, the coupling relation between information interaction and time sequence recovery of the power network and the information network under the star-ground fusion communication is considered, an optimization model is established to solve the post-disaster optimal recovery strategy under the satellite usable boundary, and the post-disaster efficient recovery of the urban power network under the star-ground fusion communication driving is realized. The invention considers the time-varying simulation condition of the low-orbit satellite communication during the post-disaster recovery, and also considers the complex coupling relation between the urban power grid information and the physical system and the restoration logic, thereby being beneficial to guiding the reasonable and efficient recovery of the urban power grid based on the satellite-ground fusion communication after encountering an extreme natural disaster and improving the toughness of the urban power system.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Ecological restoration area carbon sink increment real-time prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based ecological restoration area carbon sink increment real-time prediction method and system, which comprise the following steps of acquiring multi-source data, acquiring a lunar vegetation coverage image through a satellite remote sensing platform, acquiring sensor data such as soil temperature and humidity, air CO  2  concentration and the like by using a laid ground sensor network, acquiring vegetation canopy point cloud data according to a preset period by using an unmanned plane laser radar, collecting biomass actual measurement data of a restoration area in a history preset period, preprocessing the data, performing radiation calibration, atmosphere correction and cutting and splicing on the lunar vegetation coverage image acquired by the satellite remote sensing platform, extracting vegetation coverage and vegetation index time sequence, denoising, ground point separation and single wood canopy segmentation on the vegetation canopy point cloud data acquired by the unmanned plane laser radar, and calculating individual plant vegetation height and canopy width. The method can more accurately realize carbon sink increment prediction.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Disaster restoration assistance system of elevator
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster restoration assistance system of an elevator capable of grasping the disaster situation of the elevator at an early stage when an earthquake occurs, and easily setting the area for preferentially collecting information on the elevator and easily changing the setting thereof.  <P>SOLUTION: Collection of information on elevators to be transmitted to a communication control device 3 via a communication line 2 from remote monitoring terminals 1 of the elevators installed in areas A-E is started by the command of a control unit 41 of a server device 4 when an earthquake occurs, and when the predetermined time is elapsed, the control unit 41 calculates the operational ratios QA-QE of seismometers of the elevator in the areas A-E. With reference to the database 42 of the server device 4, the control unit 41 sets the monitoring preference to the areas A-E or changes the setting based on the operational ratios QA-QE of the seismometers. For example, when the disaster situation of the elevator is grasped in an early stage, the monitoring preference in the area in which the operational ratios of the seismometers are relatively high is raised. If any wasteful patrol of a restoration worker is reduced, the monitoring preference in the area in which the operational ratios of the seismometers are relatively low.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Fire disaster monitoring system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enhance a determination accuracy of a fire disaster by making a multilayer type neural network efficiently study by fire disaster input information or a non-fire disaster image adapted to a monitoring region.SOLUTION: Images of monitoring regions 14-1, 14-2 imaged by monitoring cameras 16-1, 16-2 are inputted to a multilayer type neural network provided in a determination device to determine whether a fire disaster or a non-fire disaster breaks out. When the fire disaster is determined to break out, a fire alarm is caused to be issued from a receiver of fire alarm equipment. The determination device is provided with a recording device, and moving images of the monitoring regions imaged by the monitoring camera are recorded. The determination device is provided with a study control part, and upon receipt of a fire disaster alarm signal from the receiver, if a fire disaster determination operation is performed by the receiver, the recording images at that time are read from the recording device and inputted to the multilayer type neural network as fire disaster images, thereby making a study by error reverse propagation. When a restoration operation is performed by the receiver, the recording images are inputted to the multilayer type neural network as the non-fire disaster images to be studied.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Comprehensive fault processing platform and method for power distribution and consumption network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a comprehensive fault processing platform and method for a power distribution and consumption network, and belongs to the technical field of power grid management. The platform comprises a fault information acquisition system, a fault information research and judgment system and a fault first-aid repair power supply stopping information pushing system; the method comprises the steps of collecting repair fault information, line fault information and acquisition fault information in an existing 95598 system, a distribution automation management system and a power utilization information collection system, receiving and checking the information, then carrying out equipment positioning, fault information screening, line topology analysis, equipment operation information analysis and line switch analysis, determining fault types, places and influence areas, displaying the fault types, the places and the influence areas in the existing GIS, guiding fault repair according to determined fault results, and simultaneously pushing fault power failure information and power restoration information to a user. The platform and the method realize the centralized collection and the automatic pre-judgment of the existing fault information, can also actively push the power failure and power supply recovery information to the user, and can interact with the user.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY CO JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;JIANGSU SUYUAN HIGH TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Wind power plant output data restoration method considering wind speed data segmentation characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power plant output data restoration method considering wind speed data segmentation characteristics, which comprises the following steps of: s1, screening repeated, lacked and unreasonable abnormal data from the obtained data, and dividing the abnormal data into a continuous abnormal type and a local abnormal type according to the length of a continuous time sequence corresponding to the abnormal data; s2, for the local abnormal data, obtaining the repaired wind power plant output data by adopting an interpolation method; s3, for continuous abnormal data, based on the maximum posterior probability, judging whether the abnormal data contains segmentation points by using normal data before and after the abnormal data, then obtaining the wind speed characteristics of each segment by a normal data or mode recognition method, and based on the wind speed characteristics, generating a restored wind speed by using an ARMA model, and further obtaining restored wind power plant output data; s4, verifying the validity of the repair data and outputting a repair report; the decision accuracy of auxiliary service in the power grid is improved, and unnecessary system standby is reduced.

title_en: Endless-walk formula restoration methods based on bandwidth fairness in a kind of WDM optical-fiber networks
abstract_en: The endless-walk formula restoration methods based on bandwidth fairness in a kind of wavelength-division multiplex (WDM) optical-fiber network are claimed in the present invention, belong to Communication Network Technique field.This method is directed to the business recovery problem in disaster loss network, the method restored using endless-walk formula, and providing fairness bandwidth for different brackets business restores.By flexibly dividing the grade of service and adjustment and recovery step-length, the business that is damaged to different brackets carries out interim or step-by-step movement and restores successively, realizes the relative fairness of each grade business recovery；The recovery priority of business is damaged according to bandwidth loss rate dynamic adjustment ad eundem, in a manner that least unit bandwidth cycle is restored, realizes the fairness of ad eundem business recovery；By the recovery operation of multiple endless-walk formula, effectively improve the service fairness of recovery business and reduce the Service disruption ratio of the whole network.

title_en: Seasonal river coastal ecological restoration landscape area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seasonal river coastal ecological restoration landscape area, which comprises an ecological restoration landscape area, wherein a dam body is arranged between the ecological restoration landscape area and a river, a water inlet gate and a water outlet gate are sequentially arranged on the dam body along the river direction, a partition wall dam is arranged on one side of the dam body facing the inside of the ecological restoration landscape area, the water inlet gate and the water outlet gate are respectively positioned on two sides of the partition wall dam, a partition dam is arranged between the end face of the partition wall dam and the inner wall of the ecological restoration landscape area, and the partition dam and the partition wall dam divide the space between the ecological restoration landscape area and the dam body into a dirt blocking area, a sediment adsorption landscape area and an aquatic organism cultivation area. The water storage in the high water season is realized, flood in the river can be shunted, flood disasters are prevented, water is used for irrigating or reflowing to the river channel in the dead water season to help the river channel to restore the ecological balance of the water body, and meanwhile, the requirements of landscapes are met.

title_en: Emergency command center network security risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vegetation restoration, and discloses a network security risk assessment method for an emergency command center, which comprises the steps of configuring relevant parameters in the network security of the emergency command center in real time, analyzing the relevant parameters to perform preliminary assessment on the current network security state of the emergency command center, monitoring the network flow dynamics of the emergency command center in real time, the network flow dynamic analysis is further evaluated to the current network security state of the emergency command center, the network security risk of the emergency command center is evaluated from two directions of the internal parameter configuration of the emergency command center and the external invasion, the evaluation accuracy is further improved, and finally, the method is repeated to evaluate the network security risk of other emergency command centers in sequence.

title_en: System and method for providing power distribution system information
abstract_en: A system, method and computer program product for processing utility data of a power grid is provided. In one embodiment, the system includes a datamart comprised of a plurality of physical databases storing utility data, a plurality of applications comprising an automated meter application configured to process power usage data from a plurality of automated meters, a power outage application configured to identify a location of a power outage, and a power restoration application configured to identify a location of a power restoration. The system may include an analysis engine comprising a plurality of analysis objects with each analysis object configured to process data to provide a specific analysis, wherein said analysis engine is accessible via one or more of the plurality of applications, and the system may include a report module configured to receive an output from the analysis engine and to output a report. The plurality of applications may also include a fault analysis application, a transformer analysis application, a theft detection application, a power flow application, a substation automation application, a load shed application and others.
assignees: KREISS DAVID G;BRANCACCIO DANIEL S;CURRENT COMM SERVICES LLC

title_en: Retaining wall with mine vegetation restoration hollow brick structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a hollow brick structure barricade is restoreed to mine vegetation belongs to mine vegetation restoration construction technical field. The technical scheme of the utility model is that: the retaining wall (1) with the hollow brick structure is built on a side slope (7) of a strip mine stope, a vegetation culture soil layer (8) is spread on the retaining wall (1) with the hollow brick structure, and an environment-friendly green-covering net (9) covers the vegetation culture soil layer (8) and the retaining wall (1) with the hollow brick structure. The utility model discloses a build hollow brick structure barricade by laying bricks or stones and cover the vegetation on the mining area side slope of having mined out in the open stope, draw materials on the spot, simple structure builds by laying bricks or stones the convenience, does not influence production, does benefit to environmental protection, effectively changes the ecological environment in mine open stope, resumes the mining area vegetation, reduces soil erosion and water loss, alleviates geological disasters and threatens, has guaranteed the safety in production in mine.
assignees: HEBEI IRON & STEEL GROUP MINING CO LTD

title_en: Low-power-consumption railway disaster monitoring equipment based on MEMS sensor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a low-power consumption railway disaster monitoring facilities based on MEMS sensor, its characterized in that: the system comprises an MCU module, a communication module, a GNSS module, a Beidou module, an MEMS module, a TF card module, an AD sampling module and an alarm transmission system debugging module, wherein the communication module, the GNSS module, the Beidou module, the MEMS module, the TF card module, the AD sampling module and the alarm transmission system debugging module are connected with the MCU module; the MEMS module adopts an ICM-20948 chip, a 16-bit ADC is integrated in the chip, and the working voltage is not lower than 1.71V; the chip is connected with a nine-axis acceleration sensor, a built-in temperature sensor, a communication interface and an interrupt interface, and the nine-axis acceleration sensor wakes up the MCU module through an external interrupt pin when the MEMS module vibrates or displaces. The utility model discloses awaken up the report based on MEMS sensor monitoring vibrations, measure absolute displacement and monitoring relative displacement through high accuracy GNSS module, can predict the emergence of calamity in advance, increase the restoration means, reduce economic loss.
assignees: JIANGSU QITAI INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power failure system recovery method for optimizing route based on network flow theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power failure system recovery method for optimizing route based on network flow theory, comprise the following steps, A) recovery of power failure system is described as the directed networks of single many remittances in source；B) based on network flow theory, connectivity constraint in the optimization of Analytical Expression restoration path；C) determine that circuit puts into operation state；D) the MIXED INTEGER layout of roads model of power failure system recovery path optimization is set up；E) use CPLEX to solve, obtain optimum restoration path.Nonlinear model is changed into MIXED INTEGER linear model by the present invention, make it can use quick mixed integer model method for solving, Searching efficiency is high and optimizing result stability is strong, go in the restoration path optimization of massive blackout system, the calculating time meets requirement, has a good application prospect.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES RES INST OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NANJING SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Power utilization emergency management system
