abstract_en: The invention relates to an electricity emergency management system, which comprises: the emergency information acquisition module is used for acquiring emergency information from the operation and distribution information integration platform; the statistics module is used for counting the affected clients according to the power failure accidents; the emergency package maintenance module is used for maintaining and updating the emergency package information of the customer; the emergency service module is used for starting corresponding customer emergency service according to the emergency information, and comprises: starting a power failure notification module to send power failure notification information to a client; starting a customer service module to receive the emergency information reported by the affected customer; starting an emergency resource allocation module to allocate resources for the affected customers and arrange and recover power supply according to the emergency information and the emergency package information of the customers; the emergency service monitoring module is used for acquiring the emergency condition reported by the emergency personnel in real time and dynamically updating the emergency condition; and the power restoration notification module is used for sending power restoration notification information to the client. And carrying out emergency treatment on the client according to the information of the client, and improving the emergency management level of the client.

title_en: Method for arranging cutoff valves of town gas pipe network and defining and recovering isolation area
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for arranging cutoff valves of town gas pipe networks and defining and recovering isolation areas, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining partitions of the town gas pipe network, and dividing a large pipe network structure into small pipe network structure partitions by calculating and optimizing modularity; according to the connection relation of the pipe network partitions, when a destructive event occurs, the connection between the pipe sections in the normal operation pipe network partition and the pipe sections in the affected pipe network partition is cut off by opening the cut-off valves arranged between the pipe network partitions, and the gas consumption source quantity of the gas consumption points in the normal operation area of the pipe network is increased; and determining a recovery sequence of the pipe network isolation area, and recovering the gas pipe network according to the recovery sequence. The method applies the town gas pipe network block valve to the arrangement and the division and recovery of the isolation area, improves the gas source quantity of the gas consumption points in the normal operation pipe network subarea, is beneficial to ensuring the integral safety performance of the pipe network, and controls the economic cost.

title_en: Power system network reconstruction method based on comprehensive evaluation index
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system network reconstruction method based on comprehensive evaluation indexes, which comprises the steps of reducing the load flow threshold crossing according to a load flow threshold crossing circuit and a network adjustment strategy, and searching to obtain an alternative path; determining a grid-connected loop closing circuit according to the alternative path, performing load recovery strategy control weakening a closing angle according to the alternative path and a phase angle of the grid-connected loop closing circuit, and determining a circuit recovery sequence in the alternative path; calculating a first evaluation index comprising a line operation reliability, a load flow out-of-limit reduction degree and a closing phase angle difference reduction degree according to a line recovery sequence, constructing a comprehensive evaluation index of an alternative path, and determining an optimal closed-loop path according to the comprehensive evaluation index and the alternative path; and according to the optimal closed-loop path, carrying out network recovery on the power system, and realizing network reconstruction of the power system. According to the embodiment, the network architecture of the power system is optimized, the power recovery strategy is improved, and the transient steady-state operation stability of the power system after disaster is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for determining power restoration of fault distribution network and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device and electronic equipment for determining power restoration of a fault power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an optimization model of power restoration of the fault power distribution network according to a plurality of first constraint conditions; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a main optimization model of a fault distribution network and a plurality of sub-optimization models of the normal distribution network by decomposing an optimization model according to a decomposition algorithm, solving the main optimization model and the plurality of sub-optimization models to obtain a first objective function value, a second objective function value and an objective function value respectively, determining the maximum value of the objective function value of the optimization model according to the sum of the objective function values of the sub-optimization models and the first objective function value, determining the minimum value of the objective function value of the optimization model according to the sum of the objective function values of the sub-optimization models and the second objective function value, comparing the difference between the maximum value and the minimum value with a preset threshold, and recovering power supply of the fault distribution network according to the situation. The method effectively improves the power supply recovery rate on the premise of controlling the cost.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for communicating with vending machine
abstract_en: Invented method comprises data detection by watching communication between vending machine and its payment system in unified manner, without intervention in this communication, and automated downloading this data; transmitting downloaded data via wireless network by invented device's modem/external peripheral device's resource; analyzing this data by determining events and one-time events and generating states by unifying the meaning of communication between vending machine and its payment systems performed according to multitude of standard communication protocols; extracting from analyzed data of information about technical condition of vending machine/payment systems, about operating regime of vending machine, about sales made by vending machine and revenues in its payment systems; remote control on basis of analyzed data and optional discontinuation/restoration of vending machine operation by invented device at request by external peripheral device connected to vending machine. The data is tracked or monitored and the diagnosis at the vending machine is transferred.

title_en: Systems and methods for script implemented logic for trigger for converting electromechanical relay outputs into fault indication for automatic restoration application
abstract_en: A system for automatic power outage restoration includes a conversion module, the conversion module receiving relay package input from an electro-mechanical relay package and executing code to convert the relay package input to readable output transmitted to an automatic outage restoration system. The conversion module is configured to receive the relay package input and determine whether a circuit breaker corresponding to the electro-mechanical relay package is opened manually. The conversion module is further configured to determine whether a non-fault scenario has occurred at the circuit breaker and determine whether a time from an opening of the circuit breaker has been more than a preset time. The conversion module is further configured to, based on determining that the circuit breaker was not opened manually, that a non-fault scenario has not occurred, and that the time has not been more than the preset time, outputting a set signal from the conversion module, wherein an automatic outage restoration application resets the circuit breaker based on the set signal.

title_en: Toughness recovery method for power distribution network and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a toughness recovery method of a power distribution network and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: parameters of a power distribution network with communication faults are obtained and set, wherein the parameters comprise communication platform information and total quantity of intelligent flight equipment communication base stations with wireless communication receiving and transmitting functions in power data; calculating communication platform parameters of each intelligent flight device, and obtaining a communication restoration sub-scheme set from each intelligent flight device to an intelligent power distribution terminal device or a power distribution station terminal to construct a communication platform; calculating the toughness index of the power distribution network corresponding to each recovery communication sub-scheme in the recovery communication sub-scheme set; and selecting a communication restoration sub-scheme according to the toughness index and obtaining the deployment strategy of all intelligent flight equipment. The toughness index of the power distribution network considering the influence of the communication system is provided, and a scheme for improving the controllability and the observability of the power distribution network after the communication system faults by establishing an emergency power wireless communication private network based on the intelligent flight equipment communication base station is provided.

title_en: Network attack restoration system and method suitable for power network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a network attack restoration system suitable for a power network, which comprises: the detection terminal is used for receiving the control instruction which cannot pass through the protocol filtering interface and carrying out network attack restoration on the received control instruction so as to realize detection on the control instruction, determine whether the control instruction is network attack content or not and send information of the attack content to the safety firewall when the control instruction is determined to be the network attack content, so that the safety firewall adds a new detection rule according to the attack content information. The invention also discloses a corresponding method. By implementing the embodiment of the invention, the server can be effectively prevented from receiving network attacks, and the safety of the power network is enhanced.

title_en: Task allocation system for disaster recovery and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task distribution system for disaster recovery and a use method thereof, belonging to the technical field of task distribution systems. A task distribution system for disaster recovery and a use method thereof can collect real-time parameters and real-time states of a data center through alarm modules of each data center, generate corresponding alarms when a disaster is perceived, quickly perform reasonable analysis and disaster recovery sequencing on tasks in the data center affected by the disaster at present and further provide a more reasonable and optimized task distribution solution through comprehensive analysis on the current situation of a backup data center. Compared with the traditional method, the method can deeply consider the influence of global environmental factors, effectively enhances the feasibility of the task allocation scheme, and optimizes the task disaster recovery performance.

title_en: Transmission and distribution seismic structure of the cable and a number of underground power protection devices guyong
title_ko: 송배전 케이블의 회수와 내진구조를 갖는 지중 전력구용 보호장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a protection device for an underground tunnel capable of collecting transmission and distribution cables and having an earthquake-proof structure and, more specifically, to a transmission and distribution cable protection device which is installed inside a tunnel buried underground. The present invention comprises a cover part (100), plates (200), and a buffer member (300). The cover part has a space part (101) inside and one upper side is connected to the other upper side by a hinge. The cover part is selectively opened by combining a bolt (103) with the side opposite of where the hinge is connected, and comprises a roller part (110) including a groove (111) which is formed from the inside to the outside, an elastic body (112) which has force of restoration and is formed at the lower side of the groove (111), a contact member (113) which is formed on the elastic body (112), and a rotation bearing (114) which is in contact with the upper side of the contact member (113) and rotates by being hung at both end parts of the grooves (111), and a plurality of hooks (120) formed on the outer side. The plates (200) comprise a combination groove (201) which is formed to penetrate in an up-down direction, and multiple protrusions (203) which protrude toward one side and form a groove and is selectively combined with one side of the tunnel (400) through the combination groove (201) by a combination member (205). The buffer member (300) connects each of the hooks (120) of the cover part (100) and the protrusions (203) of the plates (200). The present invention can absorb impacts through the buffer member (300) in seismic events and can easily collect only the transmission and distribution cables (c) while rotating by the roller part (110) when collecting the transmission and distribution cables (c) inserted into the space part (101).
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 송배전 케이블의 회수와 내진구조를 갖는 지중 전력구용 보호장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 지중에 매설되는 전력구의 내부에 설치되는 송배전 케이블 보호장치에 있어서, 내부에 공간부(101)가 형성되며 상부 일측이 상호 힌지 결합되고 상기 힌지 결합된 타측에 볼트(103)로 결합 구성되어 선택적으로 개폐 가능하도록 구성되되, 내측에서 외측으로 홈(111)이 형성되며 상기 홈(111)의 하측에 복원력을 갖는 탄성체(112)와 상기 탄성체(112)의 안착되는 밀착부재(113)와, 상기 밀착부재(113)의 상측에 맞닿으며 상기 홈(111)의 양측 끝부에 걸림 되어 회전하는 회전베어링(114)이 구성되는 롤러부(110)와 외측이 다수의 걸림고리(120)가 구성되는 커버부(100)와, 상, 하로 관통되게 형성되는 결합홈(201)과 일측으로 돌출되며 홈을 형성하는 다수의 걸림구(203)가 구성되어 결합부재(205)로 상기 결합홈(201)을 통해 상기 전력구(400)의 일측과 선택적으로 결합 구성되는 플레이트(200)들과, 상기 커버부(100)의 걸림고리(120)와 플레이트(200)들의 걸림구(203)를 각각 연결하는 완충부재(300)로 구성되어, 내진 발생 시 완충부재(300)를 통해 충격을 흡수 할 수 있으며 상기 공간부(101)에 끼움된 송배전 케이블(c)을 회수 시 롤러부(110)에 의해 회전하며 용이하게 송배전 케이블(c)만 회수가 가능한 유지보수가 용이한 발명인 것이다.

title_en: Disaster relief robot control system and cross over operation method
title_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 그의 교차 운전 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster rescue robot control system. The disaster rescue robot control system includes: a plurality of disaster rescue robots dispatched to a disaster environment to perform restoration and rescue operations; and a control server identifying a disaster site situation through communication with each of the disaster rescue robots and integratively controlling the restoration and rescue operations. A robot control part controlling the operation of the disaster rescue robots is formed to set priority so as to drive the disaster rescue robots by crossing manual driving or remote driving, and control the disaster rescue robots so as to drive the disaster rescue robots by crossing remote driving or manual driving based on request signals of a riding operator and a remote operator and the set priority, thereby changing a control right of the disaster rescue robots by determining intentions of the riding operator and the remote operator in a complex disaster situation by setting priority over remote driving and manual driving, and changing a determination basis of the remote operator for determining a drivable state of the riding operator and a control right in accordance with the same in case of an emergency such as an injury or death of the riding operator.
abstract_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템에 관한 것으로, 재난 환경에 투입되어 복구 및 구조 동작을 수행하는 복수의 재난 구조 로봇 및 각 재난 구조 로봇과의 통신을 통해 재난 현장 상황을 파악하고 복구 및 구조 동작을 통합적으로 관제하는 관제서버를 포함하고, 상기 재난 구조 로봇의 구동을 제어하는 로봇 제어부는 상기 재난 구조 로봇을 수동 운전 또는 원격 운전을 교차해서 운전하도록 우선 순위를 설정하며, 탑승 조작자와 원격 조작자의 의뢰 신호와 설정된 우선 순위에 기초해서 원격 운전 및 수동 운전을 교차해서 운전하도록 제어하는 구성을 마련하여, 원격 및 수동 운전에 대한 우선순위를 설정하여 복합 재난 상황에서 탑승 조작자와 원격 조작자의 의도를 판단해서 재난 구조 로봇의 제어 권한을 변경할 수 있고, 탑승 조작자의 부상 또는 사망과 같은 응급 상황에서 탑승 조작자의 운전 가능 상태를 판단하기 위한 원격 조작자의 판단 근거와 그에 따른 제어 권한 변경이 가능하다.
assignees: KOREA INST ROBOT & CONVERGENCE;NAT UNIV PUKYONG IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: Bending steel truss connecting beam with friction damper and capable of being quickly recovered after earthquake
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bending steel truss connecting beam with a friction damper and capable of quickly recovering after earthquake, which comprises an upper chord member, a lower chord member, an inclined web member, a T-shaped plate and a friction damper; the friction dampers are located at two ends of the lower chord with large deformation and comprise a T-shaped friction main plate, friction plates, a cover plate and friction type bolts. The utility model discloses utilize the friction damper power consumption on the basis of ordinary steel truss even roof beam, can select different loads that slide according to the intensity of seting up defences in different areas. Under a small earthquake, the bending steel truss connecting beam with the friction damper does not slide, is equivalent to a common steel truss connecting beam, and provides lateral rigidity for the structure; under the condition of middle earthquake, after the sliding load is reached, the friction damper generates sliding friction energy consumption, and most energy of the earthquake is consumed by the friction damper. The utility model discloses simple structure, can restore fast after the shake, the restoration expense is low.

title_en: A kind of distribution elasticity of net method for improving considering micro- energy net supporting role
abstract_en: A kind of distribution elasticity of net method for improving considering micro- energy net supporting role: the distribution elasticity of net evaluation index containing micro- energy net is provided；It proposes to resist the outage management scheme with adaptation failure phase based on micro- energy net, i.e. micro- energy net rolling scheduling model of the foundation based on Model Predictive Control in power distribution network；Establish the fault recovery model in distribution network failure Restoration stage based on power distribution network.The present invention can be suitable for the power distribution network containing mostly micro- energy net under the earth's surfaces natural calamities such as typhoon, thunderstorm, the fault characteristic of power distribution network under the extreme disaster of reply " scale is big, time long ", the overall process terminated to disaster occurs from disaster and promotes distribution elasticity of net, make full use of micro- energy net isolated operation and the two states that are incorporated into the power networks, the effect of multi-energy complementation inside micro- energy net is played to the greatest extent, provides valuable technical foundation for distribution elasticity of net operation under extreme disaster.

title_en: Plain district urban river network water circulation regulation and control method based on ecological restoration target
abstract_en: The invention relates to a plain area urban river network water circulation regulation and control method based on an ecological restoration target, which comprises the steps of surveying the basic situation of the urban river network, and constructing a water quantity-water power-water quality-water ecological index system by taking aquatic organism diversity as the basic target of the urban inland river network water ecological restoration; constructing a fine simulation model of river network hydraulics-water quality-water ecology, optimizing a running water engineering regulation and control scheme by using hydrodynamic force-water quality simulation results of each scenario scheme, constructing an urban river network large circulation system, and adjusting a section structure of a local terminal river reach to realize local small circulation; comprehensively evaluating the flood control safety, the environmental improvement benefit and the influence on a water replenishing source of the regulation and control scheme. The invention realizes that under the existing engineering system, the running water source and the kinetic energy thereof are fully utilized, and the hydraulic engineering scheduling of a gate, a pump and the like is taken as a main way to promote the orderly movement of the inland river water flow and recover and improve the inland river self-cleaning capability.
assignees: ANHUI & HUAIHE RIVER INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULIC RES ANHUI WATER CONSERVANCY PROJECT QUALITY INSPECTION C

title_en: Electric vehicle load prediction method under condition of data shortage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting electric vehicle load under the condition of data deficiency, which comprises the following steps: aiming at irregular time lag change between front and back effective observation values in EV load data caused by an empty value, a GRUI cell structure is adopted to enable a traditional GAN to learn potential relation between the observation values containing the irregular time lag, so that an interpolation method of the EV load data is adapted to carry out data restoration, and a data set is obtained; promoting LSTM network performance by adopting a Mogrifier gating mechanism to obtain EV short-term load prediction results on the processed data set; the technical problems that in the prior art, data are lacked and data are abnormal, EV load prediction accuracy is low and the like are solved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Method for remotely controlling and intensively displaying in-situ repair data of multi-site groundwater
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for remotely controlling and intensively displaying in-situ repair data of multi-site groundwater, which comprises the following steps: step 1, determining target power supply parameters based on field sensor equipment, building a power distribution system and then installing the power distribution system and a field industrial personal computer in a modularized movable management and control platform; then transported to the underground water in-situ restoration site. And 2, constructing a cloud server system to process all received underground water in-situ repair field data and perform bidirectional transmission of the data with an application layer, wherein the bidirectional transmission comprises data pushing and receiving. And 3, covering the functions of equipment monitoring, on-site state configuration, data display large screen, user interface design and equipment control by using an application layer system. The invention establishes the functions of the application layer program, such as equipment monitoring, on-site state configuration, data display large screen, user interface design, equipment control and the like.

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance system of transformer substation based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The application relates to a digital twinning-based intelligent operation and maintenance system of a transformer substation, which is characterized in that a physical facility layer collects operation and maintenance data of the transformer substation, a data management layer acquires the operation and maintenance data, mechanism model data, driving model data and a neural network architecture and builds a data operation model, a platform function layer builds a transformer substation scene component and a device component, the device component is arranged in the transformer substation scene component to obtain a transformer substation virtual model, a model building layer carries out virtual digital reduction processing through a digital twinning technology to obtain a transformer substation digital twinning model corresponding to the transformer substation, a simulation analysis layer builds a device digital model according to the operation and maintenance of the transformer substation digital twinning model according to a prediction result, and a future state of equipment in the transformer substation is predicted. The system effectively builds a semantic information model of the power distribution station, realizes virtual digital restoration of real power distribution station equipment, and is convenient for subsequent effective monitoring and operation and maintenance of the power distribution station equipment.
assignees: SHANGHAI FENGXIAN GAS TURBINE POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUADIAN ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake damage structure optimal restoration decision determining method based on quick improvement of earthquake resistance toughness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining an optimal restoration decision of a seismic damage structure based on quick improvement of seismic toughness. In order to furthest improve the anti-seismic performance of the earthquake damage structure, a practical and effective optimal restoration decision determining method is provided. Firstly, extracting end displacements of all beam and column members in a vibration loss structure, calculating the rotation angles and damage degrees of the beam and column members according to the end displacements, then, calculating the vibration resistance loss of the members, floors and the structure by combining importance coefficients of the members and the floors, calculating time and cost required by repairing each member on the basis, determining an optimal repairing strategy of the vibration loss structure by combining a greedy-genetic algorithm, and finally, further determining the optimal repairing sequence of the members on the basis of the optimal repairing strategy by taking the repairing effect of the members as an evaluation index. The method can provide powerful help for the establishment of an actual earthquake damage structure restoration decision scheme, and has higher engineering application value.

title_en: Method for studying, judging and verifying power failure recovery of meter box
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of meter box power failure recovery, in particular to a method for studying, judging and verifying the meter box power failure recovery. The method comprises the following steps of S1, judging the power failure of the meter box, S2, judging the power restoration of the meter box, S3, verifying the power failure of the meter box, S4, and verifying the power restoration of the meter box. The method and the system have the advantages that the primary station processes the power failure event reported for the first time to avoid redundant interference, the marketing in-transit flow is judged to exclude non-real scenes, in addition, the voltage threshold value and the layering confirmation mechanism are combined, the power failure studying and judging accuracy is guaranteed, the time and data double-dimensional verification mechanism is formed, the special studying and judging of the photovoltaic meter box containing the distribution can be indirectly deduced through the load recovery proportion, the scene that the equipment failure is not reported is covered, the power failure and the duplicate verification form the closed loop logic of event triggering-data verification-state confirmation respectively, the actual recovery of event authenticity and power grid state is guaranteed, meanwhile, the information storage pushing forms a complete closed loop, and the tracing and cooperative processing are facilitated.
assignees: WEIHAI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Track structure with isolation function
title_ko: 면진 기능을 갖는 궤도 구조
abstract_en: Disclosed is a track structure having a seismic insolation function, capable of reducing horizontal and/or vertical vibrations on a track caused by an earthquake and preventing the overturning of a train by preventing strong power from being applied to wheels of the train in a moment even if a lower structure of the track is rapidly moved in a horizontal direction due to the occurrence of an earthquake. The track structure having a seismic insolation function includes: a track in which a pair of rails are fixed in parallel at a distance from a rail support member; a support structure supporting the track from the bottom of the track, and having a second lateral side facing a first lateral side of the rail support member at a distance; and a damper installed between the first lateral side of the rail support member and the second lateral side to provide restoration force and relieve a shock between the support structure and the rail support member when the rail support member is moved to the support structure in a transverse direction. Occasionally, the track structure can include a damper placed between first and second lateral sides of two rail support members, installed on the support structure in a longitudinal direction of the rails to support the rails, in order to provide restoration force and relieve a shock between the rail support members.
abstract_ko: 열차가 주행할 때 지진이 발생하여 궤도 하부의 하부구조물이 횡방향으로 급격하게 이동하더라도 열차 바퀴에 횡방향으로 큰 힘이 순간적으로 가해지는 것을 방지하므로 열차가 전복되는 것이 방지되고, 지진에 의한 궤도의 횡방향 및/또는 종방향 진동이 감쇠되는 면진 기능을 갖는 궤도 구조가 개시된다. 상기 면진 기능을 갖는 궤도 구조는 한 쌍의 레일이 레일 지지부재에 간격을 두고 평행하게 고정된 궤도, 상기 궤도의 하부에서 상기 궤도를 지지하며 상기 레일 지지부재의 양측 제1측면과 간격을 두고 마주보게 배치된 제2측면을 가지는 지지구조물 및 상기 레일 지지부재 양측의 상기 제1측면과 양측의 상기 제2측면 사이에 각각 설치되어 상기 레일 지지부재가 상기 지지구조물에 대해 횡방향으로 이동할 때 상기 레일 지지부재와 상기 지지구조물 사이를 완충하여 주고 복원력을 제공하는 댐퍼를 포함하는 구성을 한다. 때에 따라 본 발명에 따른 궤도 구조는 지지구조물 상에 레일의 길이 방향으로 간격을 두고 설치되어 한 쌍의 레일을 지지하는 두 레일 지지부재의 간격을 두고 마주보는 제1측면과 제2측면 사이에 두 레일 지지부재 사이를 완충하여주고 복원력을 제공하는 댐퍼를 포함하는 구성을 할 수 있다.

title_en: Folding wings of aerogenerator
title_ko: 탄성 복원형 접철식 풍력발전기용 날개
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an elastic-restoration type foldable wing for a wind turbine and, more specifically, to an elastic-restoration type foldable wing for a wind turbine, wherein since blades are made to be tilted backward by a spring, even in case of a super strong wind such as a typhoon, the blades are tilted backward separately in accordance with wind pressure exerted to each of the blades without separate pitch control, and when the wind pressure exerted to the blades decreases, the blades are automatically restored forward by elasticity, thereby preventing damage to the wing and reducing a load applied to a wind turbine and fatigue applied to the blades. In accordance with one advisable embodiment of the present invention, the wing for a wind turbine, which is provided to a wind power facility and actuating a generator through a power transmission mechanism transmitting a rotation force when rotated by wind power, includes: a rotary shaft formed horizontally, having a fixing part formed at a front end, and having a plurality of hinge parts formed to be protruding from an outer circumferential surface of the fixing part; a blade having one shaft part formed on one side, and fixed to the hinge parts through a shaft pin to be rotated around the shaft pin; and a spring having both ends connected with the fixing part of the rotary shaft and the blade respectively, in a state in which the blade is unfolded orthogonal to the rotary shaft, and formed to be elastic.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 탄성 복원형 접철식 풍력발전기용 날개에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 블레이드가 스프링에 의하여 후방으로 젖혀질수 있도록 하여, 태풍과 같은 초강풍에도 별도의 피치 제어 없이 각 블레이드에 미치는 풍압에 따라 각각 따로 블레이드가 후방으로 젖혀지고 블레이드에 가해지는 풍압이 감소하면 탄성에 의하여 자동으로 전방으로 탄성 복원되도록 함으로써, 날개의 손상을 방지하고 풍력발전기에 걸리는 하중과 블레이드에 걸리는 피로도를 줄일 수 있는 탄성 복원형 접철식 풍력발전기용 날개에 관한 것이다.
본 발명의 바람직한 일 실시예는 풍력발전장치에 제공되고, 풍력에 의해 회전시 그 회전력을 동력전달장치를 통해 발전기를 가동시키는 풍력발전기의 날개에 있어서, 수평으로 형성되며 전면 단부에 고정부가 형성되며, 고정부의 외주면에 돌출하여 복수의 힌지부가 형성되는 회전축과; 일측에 축부가 구성되고 힌지부에 축핀으로 고정하여 축핀을 축으로 회전가능하게 형성되는 블레이드와; 블레이드가 회전축과 직각인 상태로 평쳐진 상태에서 양단부가 각각 회전축의 고정부와 블레이드에 연결되며 탄성을 갖도록 형성되는 스프링;을 포함하여 이루어진다.
assignees: JEON YONG JUN;JEON U RI;JEON MIN GYU

title_en: System for verifying restored outages, such as in the field outage restoration of public utilities using automatic meter reading (AMR)
abstract_en: Systems and methods for verifying restored outages are described. In some examples, the system samples endpoints to determine an extent of a restoration. The system may compare positive indications received by endpoints to a list of endpoints that indicate utility outages, and provide guidance to a field worker based on the comparison.

title_en: Method and device for communicating with vending machine
abstract_en: Invented method comprises data detection by watching communication between vending machine and its payment system in unified manner, without intervention in this communication, and automated downloading this data; transmitting downloaded data via wireless network by invented device's modem/ external peripheral device's resource; analyzing this data by determining events and one-time events and generating states by unifying the meaning of communication between vending machine and its payment systems performed according to multitude of standard communication protocols; extracting from analyzed data of information about technical condition of vending machine/ payment systems, about operating regime of vending machine, about sales made by vending machine and revenues in its payment systems; remote control on basis of analyzed data and optional discontinuation/restoration of vending machine operation by invented device at request by external peripheral device connected to vending machine. The data is tracked or monitored and the diagnosis at the vending machine is transferred.

title_en: Device and training method capable of realizing search and rescue training under multiple working conditions
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method capable of realizing search and rescue training under multiple working conditions, wherein the device comprises a living space module, a limiting device, replaceable broken and detached components, a ladder stand and an openable cover plate, the living space module is provided with a ceiling and walls extending downwards from four sides of the ceiling, reserved broken and detached holes are formed in the living space module, the limiting device is fixedly or detachably connected to the two opposite sides of each reserved broken and detached hole, the replaceable broken and detached components are correspondingly arranged outside each reserved broken and detached hole of the living space module, the lower part of the living space module is connected with an underground space through the openable cover plate, and the ladder stand is arranged below the underground space corresponding to the openable cover plate. According to the invention, through realizing the shape adjustment of the building ruins, flexible replacement of broken components and diversified arrangement of searching scenes, the restoration degree of the searching and rescuing scenes after disaster is improved, and the flexibility requirement of searching and rescuing training is met.

title_en: Multi-plant ecological restoration method and system for water body
abstract_en: The application discloses a water body multi-plant ecological restoration method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of detecting whether different functions exist in a water body to be detected, carrying out regional division according to the functions to obtain a water body regional division result, analyzing based on water capacity information and pollutant information to obtain a regional division index Q if the functions do not exist, dividing the water body region to be detected according to the regional division index Q to obtain a water body regional division result, analyzing plants suitable for ecological restoration of the water body to be detected based on pollutant information of the water body to obtain a plant pre-screening database, analyzing whether each plant in the plant pre-screening database is a native plant of the water body to be detected, screening according to weather similarity of a suitable survival area of each plant and the area where the water body to be detected exists if the functions do not exist to obtain a plant two-screening database, and screening plant adaptability information and plant stress resistance information of each plant in the plant two-screening database to obtain a plant selection database. The application has the effect of improving the ecological restoration efficiency of multiple plants in the water body.

title_en: Intelligent collaborative decision-making method for power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution systems, in particular to an intelligent collaborative decision-making method of a power distribution system, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting sampling frequency, uploading delay and data integrity identification of sensing nodes of each subarea, analyzing consistency of an operation data structure, identifying time alignment defects or logic coupling faults and generating a heterogeneous drift characteristic map, S2, reconstructing control input by combining historical data, a topology mechanism and boundary rules to generate a data consistency control input set, and S3, constructing and distributing a collaborative strategy based on the input set, a scheduling target and system constraint to realize intelligent collaborative regulation. According to the invention, by constructing the isomerism drift characteristic map, reconstructing the space-time consistency operation data and generating the collaborative strategy set with self-adaptive execution capacity, the accurate identification, effective restoration and intelligent collaborative regulation and control of the power distribution system under the condition of inconsistent data are realized.

title_en: Method and sysem for recovering damage of water treatment facilities
title_ko: 수처리 시설의 재난피해 복구 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a method for recovering disaster damage of a water treatment facility may comprise: a step of receiving relative importance (RI) for each of first to N^th stages, which are water treatment processes of the water treatment facility; a step of receiving a water quality reference value for each of the first to N^th stages; a step of acquiring a water quality measurement value for each of the first to N^th stages; and a step of calculating priority information for recovering disaster damage for each of the first to N^th stages by using the RI, the water quality reference value, and the water quality measurement value.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 수처리 시설의 재난피해 복구 방법은 수처리 시설의 수처리 공정인 제1 단계 내지 제N 단계 각각에 대한 상대적 중요도(RI)를 입력받는 단계; 상기 제1 단계 내지 상기 제N 단계 각각에 대한 수질 기준값을 입력받는 단계; 상기 제1 단계 내지 상기 제N 단계 각각에 대한 수질 측정값을 획득하는 단계; 및 상기 상대적 중요도, 상기 수질 기준값 및 상기 수질 측정값을 이용하여, 상기 제1 단계 내지 상기 제N 단계에 대한 재난피해 복구 우선순위 정보를 산출하는 단계;를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: G&C ENV SOLUTION CO LTD;UNIV NAT HANBAT IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Ecological water storage device is restoreed in mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ecological water storage device for mine restoration, which comprises a lead wire mesh and three rows of willow piles, wherein every two adjacent rows of willow piles are arranged at intervals in a staggered manner, transverse wickers are transversely woven on the willow piles on the rows on both sides along the respective rows of the piles, and the willow piles on the rows on both sides form woven fence walls respectively; pebbles are filled in an internal space formed by the knitted hedge wall and the willow stump, and the pebbles are wrapped by the lead wire net and filled in the knitted hedge wall; longitudinal wickers are further arranged in the vertical direction of the willow pile row, and the transverse wickers and the longitudinal wickers are alternately woven at the bottom of the willow pile to reinforce the willow pile to form a longitudinal and transverse integral structure; the lower parts of the longitudinal wickers are fixed through the peg of the wickers and are buried in the ditches. The willow piles of the utility model weave longitudinal and transverse willow twigs to form dam body space; filling sand and pebbles in the dam body space to form a check dam; block the solid particles in the trench, reduce the silt content of the surface water, reduce the erosion effect of the water flow, and achieve the aims of treating the debris flow and preventing the water and soil loss.
assignees: SHAANXI NUCLEAR INDUSTRY ENGINEERING SURVEY INST CO LTD

title_en: Highway side slope vegetation recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a vegetation restoration device for a highway side slope, which comprises a slope body, wherein a water tank is fixedly arranged on the right side surface of the slope body and close to the bottom of the slope body, the other end of a water inlet pipe penetrates through and extends to the top surface of the slope body, a spray assembly is arranged on the top surface of the slope body, a water discharge pipe is communicated with the inner wall of the right side of the water tank, electronic valves are fixedly arranged on the outer peripheral wall of the water discharge pipe, three inclined plane frames are fixedly arranged on the right side surface of the slope body, buffer base layers are fixedly connected to the bottom surfaces of the three inclined plane frames, fixed cones are fixedly connected to the bottom surfaces of the three buffer base layers, and a water collection assembly is arranged on the right side surface of the slope body. This highway side slope vegetation recovery device through the three buffering basic units that set up, and then makes the rainwater when washing away the slope body, can reduce the speed of landslide when flowing in proper order, and then reduces the destruction of landslide to the vegetation, has improved the protective rate of whole device to the vegetation.
assignees: YUNNAN COMMUNICATIONS INVEST ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Side slope supporting device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of slope support, in particular to a slope support device, which aims at solving the problems that the prior device cannot enhance the stability and safety of a slope, so that disasters such as landslide and falling rocks can occur and the ecological restoration of the slope is reduced, and the utility model provides a scheme that the slope support device comprises a slope, wherein the surface of the slope is provided with a plurality of planting areas, and a plurality of drainage ditches are arranged on the periphery of the planting areas; the device comprises a slope, a protection component and an isolation component, wherein the protection component is arranged on the slope and used for preventing the surface of the slope from sliding, and the isolation component is arranged on the slope and used for isolating and protecting falling rocks on the isolation component. According to the utility model, through the combination of the protection component and the isolation component, the stability and the safety of the side slope are obviously enhanced, the occurrence of disasters such as landslide, falling rocks and the like is effectively prevented, the ecological restoration of the side slope is promoted, and the dual aims of side slope protection and ecological management are realized.

title_en: Manufacture and application of aluminum plastic composite material light structure building and earthquake isolation device thereof
abstract_en: The invention aims at achieving the purposes of energy conservation, emission reduction, earthquake resistance and hazardous reduction by building light structure buildings. An aluminum plastic composite material, a reinforced concrete frame and a light thermal insulation material are allocated integrally, steel cement tile sandstone are mostly replaced, and therefore whole weight of the building is reduced by higher than one twice, and a new building craft process is formulated according to the feature. The aluminum plastic composite material comprises a plastic clip aluminum composite board and a big caliber aluminum plastic composite tube, the plastic clip aluminum composite board is manufactured by a full-automatic production line of the plastic clip aluminum composite board, and the big caliber aluminum plastic composite tube is manufactured by the full-automatic production line of an aluminum plastic composite tube. By utilizing a specially-made clamp device to strengthen tensile property of a floor spacing board, and scientifically utilizing a triangular inclined strut to strengthen building integrity, and therefore powerful breaking stress from any directions is resisted. The aluminum plastic composite material is not only self combustion resistant, but also extinguishes fire depending on self functions. The earthquake isolation device is manufactured at the premise of great weight reduction to consume earthquake wave in an invisible mode. A compression spring type elastic composite pier with a good elastic function and an elastic restoration function is arranged on the upper portion of the earthquake isolation device, and a specially-made universal wheel which can transform linear motion to rotary motion and eliminate elastic deformation and horizontal deformation.

title_en: Power supply system capable of automatic fault isolation and quick power transmission
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply system capable of automatic fault isolation and quick power transmission, which comprises a plurality of monitoring points and a distribution main station/distribution branch station. The power supply system comprises the distribution main station/distribution branch station, a dispatching data network, a microprocessor, and a fault information release management module connected in sequence, wherein the distribution main station/distribution branch station comprises a station and a detection transmission system; the detection transmission system comprises a fault monitoring/acquisition device; the fault monitoring/acquisition device is internally provided with a carrier communication card; two ends of the carrier communication card are connected with inductive couplers; the microprocessor has an ability of capturing fault information; and in match with the distribution main station/distribution branch station, automatic fault isolation and power supply restoration in a non-fault section for a distribution line are realized. fault happening to the power supply system can be automatically isolated, quick power supply system restoration is realized, frequent blackout is avoided, the stability of the power supply system is improved, the operation cost and the maintenance cost are reduced, the safety use performance is good, and actual use requirements are met.
assignees: LONGKOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: A kind of distribution network restoration power quantitative evaluating method for considering communication and influencing
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of distribution network restoration power quantitative evaluating methods for considering communication and influencing, and obtain the distribution network system running state information in extreme disaster coverage area first；After extreme disaster occurs, according to power distribution network physical state information, communication failure is not considered, consider the optimization aim including breakdown repair after the reconstruct of the rack of power distribution network and calamity, obtain the load variations curve A of regional distribution network；It is next assumed that the recovery of power distribution network cannot be completed according to set objective when communication system failure, distribution network load change curve B is obtained；Finally the influence by communication system under extreme disaster to distribution network restoration power is set to the area surrounded by curve A and curve B.The present invention can more accurately assess the restoring force size of power distribution network under extreme disaster, and quantitative analyze influence of the communication system failure to distribution network restoration power under extreme disaster.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Low-voltage fault diagnosis and rapid power restoration method based on mobile App
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage fault diagnosis and rapid power restoration method based on a mobile App, which comprises the steps of extending distribution network fault diagnosis and judgment to a low-voltage transformer area, utilizing a transformer area data concentrator of a low-voltage centralized meter reading system, a centralized meter reading system and a data acquisition network of a low-voltage intelligent electric meter to carry out high-frequency data acquisition on the intelligent electric meter, and judging the tripping state of a low-voltage switch, so that low-voltage state monitoring and active low-voltage fault judgment are realized. By adopting the method, the low-voltage fault can be actively discovered, the first-aid repair work order can be actively generated, the first-aid repair progress of the customer can be actively pushed, and the lean first-aid repair management and the high-efficiency customer maintenance can be realized.

title_en: Method and device for improving toughness of power distribution network and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network toughness improvement method, a device and a storage medium based on net rack reconstruction and V2G participation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the damage condition of a traffic system in a disaster scene; determining the travel selection of the electric automobile after the disaster based on a user balance principle and the damage condition of the traffic system; selecting and establishing a charging load distribution model based on the trip of the electric automobile after the disaster; determining an incentive mechanism of V2G users participating in power restoration after disasters based on a consumer psychology theory; determining the maximum V2G reverse transmission power of each charging station based on an excitation mechanism, user response rate, charging station electric vehicle flow, probability distribution of electric vehicle residual capacity and a charging load distribution model; establishing a distribution network toughness improvement model based on net rack reconstruction and V2G reverse power transmission; and determining a power supply recovery scheme based on the power distribution network toughness improvement model. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of real model, improvement of the toughness of the power distribution network, reduction of recovery cost and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Comprehensive monitoring technology based on digital operation and maintenance of data center
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital operation and maintenance, and discloses a comprehensive monitoring technology based on digital operation and maintenance of a data center, which comprises a data acquisition and storage module, wherein a sensor is arranged in the data center, the data acquired in real time is uploaded to a blockchain platform, and the data is automatically monitored and managed by utilizing an intelligent contract technology; analyzing and predicting data, analyzing and predicting the data by utilizing an artificial intelligence technology, finding potential risks in time and taking corresponding measures, providing decision support for a decision maker, automatizing operation and maintenance, data encryption technology, access right control, security audit, vulnerability restoration, introducing edge calculation, making a disaster recovery plan, and improving the efficiency and reliability of a data center: through the automatic operation and maintenance, equipment maintenance prediction and other technologies, the efficiency and reliability of the data center can be greatly improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU PAINUO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-type power source cooperative active recovery method and system after network disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for active recovery after disaster in a distribution network with cooperation of multiple types of power supplies, belonging to the field of recovery after disaster in a distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on source load switching and source load uncertainty analysis, analyzing frequency indexes of a system under dynamic disturbance in a partition expansion process, and considering supporting effects of DG and MES in a distribution network on inertia, primary frequency modulation and load electric energy, constructing partition expansion constraint considering frequency safety and electric energy demand; and establishing a multi-partition net rack continuation model taking the multi-MES as a restoration starting point, and combining partition expansion constraint and source load restoration constraint to construct an overall active restoration model. The invention utilizes the flexible movement characteristic, the electric energy supporting characteristic and the frequency supporting characteristic of the MES, considers the recovery process after the disaster of the distribution network and cooperates with the DG to ensure that new energy is possible to be connected in advance on the premise of ensuring the frequency safety, and the power generation resources in the network are utilized in advance and fully, so that a larger amount of load can be recovered.

title_en: Modeling method and system for regional water resource ecological safety evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modeling method and a system for ecological safety evaluation of regional water resources, which relate to the technical field of mountain water resource management, the system obtains the current situation of regional water resources, timely discovers subareas with insufficient groundwater supply, and constructing and evaluating a mining intensity coefficient Kc through a water resource evaluation model constructed by a convolutional neural network model CNN, screening out sub-areas with excessive mining, and adopting corresponding regulation and control measures, such as limiting the mining intensity, so as to avoid the burden of the ecological environment and water resources caused by excessive mining. The ecological environment and water quality data are acquired, an ecological pressure coefficient Ep of the subarea is generated, and the subarea with higher ecological damage risk is found in time by combining a pressure early warning threshold value. The system generates corresponding water resource exploitation regulation and control modes by combining the first important monitoring group, the second important monitoring group and the third important monitoring group, and promotes sustainable management and ecological restoration of water resources in the area.
assignees: HEBEI BAODING HYDROLOGY SURVEY RES CENTER

title_en: Big data terminal data restoration system based on power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a big data terminal data restoration system based on a power grid, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data restoration value providing unit, a data restoration value determining unit and a final restoration value determining unit, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring operation data of a power transmission line in real time through a sensor and an ammeter, when data loss or error occurs in the technical field of power grid data processing, the data restoration value providing unit in a risk prediction module is used for predicting the loss or error data, in the data restoration process, other equipment data and operation information related to the data can be acquired through a correlation model, a data inference model of the correlation data is constructed through the correlation data, the loss data or the error data is inferred, the data restoration module is used for calculating the restoration value of the loss data or the error data through a linear interpolation algorithm, and integrating the data restoration value providing unit and the inferred value of the data inference model of the correlation data, and taking the average value of the three data to be determined as the final restoration value. And the data is effectively repaired, and meanwhile, the accuracy of data repair is improved.

title_en: Emergency power supply scheduling method based on line fault pre-judgment under typhoon
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency power supply scheduling method based on line fault pre-judgment in typhoons, relates to the technical field of power system rush-repair scheduling, and solves the problems that the conventional scheduling model is relatively dead and inflexible due to the fact that the influence of a traffic network on running time and important users of different grades is not fully considered in the whole emergency power supply vehicle scheduling process in the prior art. The method mainly comprises two parts, wherein the first part calculates the fault probability of a power distribution network line, makes prediction before disaster for the subsequent emergency power supply scheduling scheme, and the second part establishes a multi-objective planning model by taking the minimum total loss of power failure as a main function and the spare capacity as a secondary function, and considers the running time of an emergency power supply vehicle under actual traffic and the condition that new energy is arranged on part of nodes to generate power. The invention combines the prediction of line faults under typhoons with the scheduling of the emergency power supply vehicles after disaster, is favorable for making an emergency power supply scheduling scheme in advance, and effectively reduces the loss caused by power failure.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Road restoration block
title_ko: 도로복구블록
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a road restoration block for covering eliminated pavements during various road constructions conducted by eliminating some of or the entire existing road pavements, and more specifically, to a road restoration block, which can quickly and safely cover the eliminated pavements by providing blocks that are simply carried, disposed, and disassembled with strong coupling power to the upper part of the eliminated pavements so that people and cars may pass even when the constructions are in progress, thereby providing a safe and pleasant construction environment by preventing the traffic congestion caused by the constructions. Further, the invention may maximize cost reduction for construction companies by preventing the increase of construction costs and waste of resources caused by temporary pavement works (provisional pavement works) that are currently in operation, and improve the construction quality and prevent poor construction. Consequently, the invention promotes reduction in the national budget, and is usable for emergent road restoration in case of national disaster and thus the safety and wealth of people can be protected.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기존 도로 포장의 일부 또는 전체를 제거하여 시행하는 각종 도로 공사에서 제거된 포장면을 커버하기 위한 도로복구블록에 관한 것으로서, 구체적으로 제거된 포장면 상부에 운반 및 설치, 해체가 간편하면서도 강한 체결이 가능한 블록을 설치하여 제거된 포장면을 신속하고 안전하게 커버하여, 공사를 수행하는 중에도 사람 및 차량의 통행을 가능하게 하여 공사로 인한 교통 정체발생을 차단하여 안전하고 쾌적한 건설환경을 제공하고, 현재 시행하고 있는 임시포장(가포장) 또는 이중포장으로 인한 자원 낭비 및 공사비 증가를 방지하여 건설사 원가 절감을 극대화시키고, 공사의 품질을 향상시키고 부실공사를 방지하므로 궁극적으로 국가예산 절감을 도모하며, 국가재난시 도로 응급복구용으로도 사용이 가능하여 국민의 안전과 재산을 지킬 수 있도록 한 도로복구블록을 제공하려는 것이다.

title_en: Power distribution network reliability data restoration method and system based on low-rank matrix
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for repairing reliability data of a power distribution network based on a low-rank matrix, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a power distribution network reliability data matrix according to power failure event record information of the power distribution network, determining a weighted low-rank matrix model of the power distribution network reliability data matrix according to the power distribution network reliability data matrix, and obtaining a repaired power distribution network reliability data matrix through the weighted low-rank matrix model of the power distribution network reliability data matrix; according to the technical scheme, the low-rank matrix introducing the weighting method and the Gaussian noise constraint term is utilized to repair the data defect of the reliability data of the power distribution network, so that the accuracy of the reliability data of the power distribution network is ensured while the data repair efficiency is improved, and the reliability data quality of the power distribution network is improved.

title_en: Protection method for dam body and dam foundation of sand blocking dam
abstract_en: A protection method for a dam body and a dam foundation of a sand blocking dam comprises the following steps: the front and back of the main dam and the front and back of the auxiliary dam are processed into planes and soil is paved; planting herbs on the upstream of the main dam and the upstream of the auxiliary dam to block silt, slow down flow rate and disperse water flow through the herbs; planting shrubs under the main dam and the auxiliary dam to reduce the flow rate of flowing water and splash erosion by using the shrubs; moss is planted on the dam body so as to reduce the erosion of the adherent flow. The invention utilizes ecological vegetation to perform step energy dissipation, and can effectively reduce the damage of upstream long-flowing water to the sand blocking dam for a long time. Compared with the existing engineering measures such as reinforced gabions, the protection effect of the invention is increased along with the time, the cost is low, the environment is protected, the ecological restoration in the debris flow channel can be accelerated by the soil accumulation around the carrying grass, and the sustainable development of the channel ecology is facilitated.

title_en: Method for realizing equipment fault rush repair based on GIS (geographic information System)
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing fault rush-repair based on GIS system equipment, which comprises the steps of collecting and preprocessing the existing fault data and constructing a fault database; constructing a device fault prediction model, training the device fault prediction model by taking fault data as input data, and outputting fault prediction information, wherein the fault prediction information comprises fault positions and occurrence probabilities of each future period; constructing and calling a GIS module based on the fault prediction information, planning the position of the optimal rush-repair base station, and forming a rush-repair base station topology network; and acquiring real-time fault information, calculating the nearest repair base station and the optimal repair route by adopting a GIS module, forming a repair scheduling data packet, and transmitting the repair scheduling data packet to the repair base station. According to the invention, through integrating the GIS system and the machine learning model, a comprehensive equipment fault rush-repair flow is provided, future fault events are effectively predicted, an optimal rush-repair route is calculated, and meanwhile, the stability and the safety of the system are ensured.
assignees: SUN NANJING AUTOMATIC EQUIPMENTS CO LTD

title_en: Slope collapse detection and evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium based on remote sensing technology
abstract_en: The application discloses a slope collapse detection and evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium based on a remote sensing technology, and relates to the technical field of remote sensing collapse detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining remote sensing slope environment data, slope restoration characteristic data and regional slope risk coefficients; and determining a side slope environment typical area based on the remote sensing side slope environment data, the side slope restoration characteristic data and the area side slope risk coefficient, and detecting the environment risk area based on the side slope environment typical area and evaluating the area side slope environment risk. According to the application, the remote sensing technology is used for comprehensively covering the slope area to obtain remote sensing slope environment data, slope restoration characteristic data and area slope risk coefficients, the slope scene model is intelligently processed and established to determine the typical area of the slope environment, the monitoring accuracy is improved, the environment risk area is detected again, the area slope environment risk is estimated, the stability and risk of the slope are estimated more accurately, the potential collapse risk is early warned in advance, and the slope collapse disaster is effectively prevented.
assignees: SHENZHEN WENKE ECOLOGICAL ENV CO LTD

title_en: Inter-city highway-railway multi-travel-path multi-agent collaborative reasoning and restoring method and system
abstract_en: Provided is an inter-city public-railway multi-agent collaborative reasoning and restoring method and system for a multi-agent travel path, which realize reasoning and restoring of a real travel path based on inter-city travel sparse track observation data of travelers. The method comprises the steps of obtaining and preprocessing original track observation data and traffic network data, carrying out rasterization processing and storage on the road network data and the track observation data, designing and training path searching intelligent bodies to achieve reasonable recovery path sequence reasoning, identifying the intelligent bodies in a design and training mode to achieve reasonable travel mode sequence reasoning, and achieving recovery of urban public-railway multi-mode travel real paths through trained cooperative reasoning of the two intelligent bodies. According to the invention, the complex inter-city public-railway multi-trip path restoration problem is decoupled into the path search and the mode identification, and two intelligent agents are constructed to respectively solve the two sub-problems, so that the inference restoration of the inter-city trip real path based on the sparse observation track is realized, and a new thought and a new method are provided for the path restoration field.

title_en: Dynamic optimization method for comprehensive evaluation index weight of ecological system restoration effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic optimization method for comprehensive evaluation index weight of ecological system restoration effect, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration evaluation, and mainly comprises the steps of preprocessing multi-source time sequence index data to obtain multi-source time sequence fusion characteristics, constructing a dynamic graph network, training the dynamic graph network to obtain a trained dynamic graph network and embedding time sequence nodes; and constructing a secondary index intelligent body model according to the index system, training the secondary index intelligent body model by using a reinforcement learning method to obtain a trained secondary index intelligent body model, and obtaining the comprehensive evaluation index weight of the ecological system restoration effect by using the trained secondary index intelligent body model. By implementing the dynamic optimization method for the comprehensive evaluation index weight of the ecological system restoration effect, which is provided by the invention, each index weight in the ecological system restoration effect evaluation index system under multi-source data can be intelligently and dynamically adjusted and optimized.

title_en: Accurate restoration method for degraded poplar stand
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precise repair method of poplar degraded stand, which relates to the technical field of poplar degraded stand repair and comprises the steps of obtaining a multi-temporal satellite remote sensing image and an unmanned aerial vehicle multi-spectral image of a target area, combining soil moisture content, rhizosphere respiration rate and microclimate data collected by ground Internet of things sensing nodes arranged in the forest, carrying out geographic coordinate registration and time sequence alignment on the data to form a multi-source observation data set, extracting vegetation index, shortwave infrared reflectivity, soil moisture and rhizosphere physiological parameters based on the multi-source observation data set, constructing degradation diagnosis indexes integrating spectral change, water stress and root system activity, calculating degradation degree of each pixel, generating a degradation grade spatial distribution map, determining an area with the degradation degree reaching a set threshold value as a to-be-repaired area, selecting a representative poplar individual in the to-be-repaired area, measuring photosynthetic capacity and calculating individual competition strength by combining three-dimensional point cloud data.
assignees: JIULIANGWA FOREST FARM SHANXI SANGGANHE YANGSHU FENGCHAN EXPERIMENTAL BUREAU

title_en: Method for identifying mao-bamboo forest snow disaster damage of airborne laser radar based on differential point cloud encryption strategy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forestry disaster monitoring, in particular to an identification method of an airborne laser radar phyllostachys pubescens disaster damage based on a differential point cloud encryption strategy; according to the method, the three-dimensional structure of the bamboo forest is reconstructed through fitting the axis of the bamboo trunk and image post-processing, different types of disaster damage are identified, virtual point clouds are generated to fill the scanning missing area, the accuracy of the axis of the bamboo trunk is effectively improved, the image expression of the bamboo trunk and the tree crowns is enhanced through layered reconstruction and principal component analysis technology, a finer disaster damage characteristic diagram is provided, and accurate disaster assessment is facilitated. In addition, the accuracy and reliability of disaster damage analysis are further improved through targeted image processing based on disaster damage types. In the whole, the invention provides high-efficiency and accurate technical support for post-disaster evaluation and ecological restoration of the bamboo forests.

title_en: Frequency domain illumination priori driving non-supervision low-light video enhancement method, system and storage medium for shield slag hole monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a frequency domain illumination priori driving unsupervised low-light video enhancement method, a system and a storage medium for shield slag hole monitoring, which are used for realizing composite noise suppression and basic restoration of a low-light image through a noise suppression module, executing two-dimensional Haer wavelet decomposition on a basic restoration image through a frequency domain illumination priori estimation module, combining a channel-space attention weighting high-low frequency sub-band and fusing to generate frequency domain illumination priori characteristics, completing accurate reconstruction of reflection components through a cross-attention converter unit of a reflection component reconstruction module, generating global index enhancement factors through an illumination enhancement coefficient module to obtain an enhanced image, realizing network unsupervised end-to-end training through gamma conversion branches and multi-dimensional loss constraint, and effectively relieving the problems of overall darkness, detail inundation and serious noise of a shield slag hole monitoring image on the premise of not increasing site continuous illumination burden, and obtaining an enhanced video with balanced brightness, clear detail and controlled overexposure.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 14TH BUREAU GROUP SHIELD ENG CO LTD

title_en: System, method, and apparatus for daisy chain network protection from node malfuncion or power outage
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for protecting daisy chain networks from node malfunction or power outage are disclosed. One or more communication nodes in a daisy chain network can be bypass-capable communication nodes. Bypass-capable communication nodes can include a sensing and switching subsystem, embedded in the node or external to the node in a fiber optic cable running along the daisy chain network. In embodiments, the sensing and switching subsystem can responsively switch the bypass-capable communication node from communication node primary circuitry to primary circuitry responsive to node malfunction or node power outage. The sensing and switching subsystem also can switch back from bypass circuitry to primary circuitry responsive to restoration of node function or node power. In embodiments, switching occurs responsive to excitation or de-excitation of the node itself.
assignees: SAUDI ARABIAN OIL CO;ARAMCO SERVICES CO

title_en: Metal-mining-area soil-water interface heavy metal pollution load forecasting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal-mining-area soil-water interface heavy metal pollution load forecasting method. The metal-mining-area soil-water interface heavy metal pollution load forecasting method mainly comprises the following steps of sample collection and pre-processing, sample detection, data processing, building of a GIS database, building of a metal-mining-area soil-water interface heavy metal migration and transformation kinetic model, and building, verification and optimization of a forecasting model method. The fitting degree of the forecasting method with a measured value of an actual load can meet the requirement for forecasting precision, and therefore theoretical foundations and scientific bases are provided for evaluation, controlling, treatment, restoration and the like of ecological risks of metal-mining-area heavy metal pollution.

title_en: Auxiliary path restoration method under complex path
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary path restoration method under a complex path. The method comprises: vehicle identification information on a current vehicle driving path is obtained, wherein the vehicle identification information contains one identification point or a combination unit of a plurality of identification points and the driving path passes through the identification points; a road network map is constructed according to basic information of a road network, wherein the basic information contains basic path information and basic information of the identification points (RFID and 5.8GHZ); and a current shortest path of the vehicle between an entrance station and an exit station of the road network map is restored by using a dynamic planning algorithm. According to the invention, with the method, the shortest path of the current vehicle between the entrance station and the exit station can be restored.

title_en: AC/DC hybrid power distribution network fault recovery method under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AC/DC hybrid power distribution network recovery method under extreme disasters, which comprises the steps of establishing a time sequence process considering fault restoration by taking the minimum system loss load and the minimum line active power network loss as objective functions, rapidly deploying a mobile emergency power supply after an accident and carrying out a model for carrying out cooperative reconstruction of an AC/DC part of the AC/DC hybrid power distribution network in real time, and solving under a given constraint condition to obtain a mobile emergency power supply deployment and switching action time sequence scheme for minimizing the system loss load and the minimum line active power network loss; according to the method, the process of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power distribution network after being affected by the extreme event is divided into a plurality of time intervals, and the recovery of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power distribution network under the extreme disaster is realized by simulating the time sequence restoration of the fault and the time sequence reconstruction of the network.

title_en: Hybrid short-term wind power prediction method considering massive loss of data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid short-term wind power prediction method considering data loss in a large amount, which comprises the following steps: 1) Establishing a data restoration model based on GAN and BiLSTM; 2) Acquiring a wind power data sequence, inputting the wind power data sequence into a data restoration model based on GAN and BiLSTM, and carrying out data enhancement on the wind power data sequence to obtain a wind power data enhancement sequence; 3) Decomposing the wind power data enhancement sequence by using a variation modal decomposition algorithm to obtain a low-fluctuation wind power subsequence; 4) Establishing an improved CNN-BiGRU mixed prediction model based on an attention mechanism; 5) And inputting the low-fluctuation wind power subsequence into an improved CNN-BiGRU mixed prediction model based on an attention mechanism to obtain a wind power prediction result at the next moment. Under the condition of poor data quality, the method can ensure that the prediction precision meets the operation requirement of the power system.
