title_en: Electric power user fault maintenance system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electric power restoration, in particular to an electric power user fault maintenance system and method, wherein a user electricity consumption monitor is used for monitoring whether user electricity consumption is abnormal or not, and transmitting user electricity consumption abnormal information to a platform area server when the user electricity consumption is abnormal; the platform area server is used for receiving the user electricity consumption abnormal information sent by the user electricity consumption monitor and sending the user electricity consumption abnormal information to the data analysis background and the handheld terminal of the maintainer; the maintenance personnel handheld terminal is used for receiving the abnormal user electricity consumption information sent by the platform area server; the data analysis background is used for receiving the user electricity consumption abnormal information sent by the platform region server and carrying out statistical analysis on the user electricity consumption abnormal information. The invention greatly saves the rush repair time and reduces the abnormal perception of the power consumption of the clients. Meanwhile, the system performs statistical analysis on the abnormal information of the electricity consumption of the user, so that the management of the electricity consumption condition of the user is improved, and the service quality of the power user is optimized.
assignees: TAIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Pump station scheduling method, equipment and medium based on image recognition farmland disaster-stricken condition
abstract_en: The application provides a pump station scheduling method based on image recognition of farmland disaster conditions, which comprises the steps of determining at least one first shooting position information corresponding to at least one first restoration image respectively under the condition that the category information of the at least one first restoration image is waterlogging category, determining a target pump station according to the at least one first shooting position information, performing image segmentation processing on the at least one first restoration image, determining waterlogging areas and non-waterlogging areas of the at least one first restoration image, determining first ratio information between the sum of areas of the waterlogging areas of the at least one first restoration image and the sum of areas of all areas of the at least one first restoration image, determining a target waterlogging level according to the first ratio information, and scheduling drainage of the target pump station according to the target waterlogging level. The application can accurately control the drainage flow and improve the drainage scheduling accuracy of the target pump station.
assignees: WUHAN RUISHAN ZHISHUI SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Method for monitoring ecological restoration index of plateau lake
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring method for ecological restoration indexes of a plateau lake, which comprises the steps of determining a monitoring area, selecting ecological restoration monitoring indexes, deploying monitoring equipment, collecting, processing and analyzing data, visualizing results and generating reports. The method divides the monitoring subareas through a GIS technology, screens key water quality indexes by using a PCA algorithm, and determines the optimal deployment position of the biodiversity monitoring equipment based on an ecological niche model. The data acquisition time interval is dynamically adjusted according to the index change characteristics, a comprehensive index evaluation method is adopted for data processing, and a monitoring report is generated through a data visualization library and a natural language processing technology. Meanwhile, a data quality monitoring system is established, and real-time quality monitoring is carried out on the data. The invention can realize the high-efficiency and accurate monitoring of the ecological restoration condition of the plateau lake and provides scientific basis for formulating and adjusting ecological restoration strategies.

title_en: Encryption protection method for network data backup and recovery
abstract_en: The invention discloses an encryption protection method for network data backup and recovery, which relates to the technical field of data protection and comprises the steps of adopting a local, cloud and remote three-terminal collaborative backup architecture to respectively implement differential backup strategies; and carrying out local data backup by a combined scheme of complete backup and incremental backup to generate a chained hash value sequence. The invention adopts three-terminal key isolation and dynamic derivation to ensure data security, adopts independent key systems in local, cloud and remote places, generates chained keys based on hash chains in local, and generates version independent keys in cloud and remote places, and the key leakage of any storage terminal does not affect the data security of other terminals. The recovery priority is automatically switched from local to cloud to different places, the incremental data is decrypted layer by layer through a hash chain locally, the cloud directly calls the independent key of the target version, the synthetic backup complete copy is used in different places, and the disaster recovery efficiency is improved through layered recovery and synthetic backup.
assignees: SHANDONG CHAOSHI INFORMATION TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Composite blocking dam system with disaster prevention and control and ecological restoration functions
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite blocking dam system with disaster prevention, control and ecological restoration functions, the blocking dam performs engineering construction by means of valley terrains in mountain areas, the blocking dam comprises a dam body, a foundation unit, an energy dissipation unit and a reinforcing unit, the middle part of the top of the dam body is provided with a plurality of concave overflow ports, the overflow ports protrude forwards in the upstream direction, the foundation unit comprises a plurality of pile foundations, the pile foundations are provided with transverse bearing platforms, the dam body is positioned on the bearing platforms of the pile foundations and is attached to the pile foundations, the energy dissipation unit comprises a plurality of buffering reinforcing piles positioned behind the dam body, the buffering reinforcing piles are positioned on the upstream of the overflow ports of the dam body and can receive impact of disasters before the overflow ports, and the reinforcing unit comprises a plurality of anchor ropes which can reinforce the pile foundations and/or the buffering reinforcing piles. The composite blocking dam system has the functions of improving the soil quality of loose piles, treating mud-rock flow/mountain torrent disasters, accumulating carbon fixation and soil fixation and water retention.

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network power restoration method based on satellite communication vehicle scheduling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power supply restoration of post-disaster power distribution networks, and particularly relates to a post-disaster power distribution network power supply restoration method based on satellite communication vehicle scheduling. The method comprises the steps of scheduling a satellite communication vehicle to move in a power distribution network area, switching communication gears according to load requirements, activating one type of load and two types of load through the communication coverage area of the satellite communication vehicle, constructing a daily front scheduling model aiming at the minimum daily running cost of the power distribution network after disaster, processing nonlinear constraint by adopting a self-adaptive piecewise linearization method to solve the daily front scheduling model, and controlling the moving path, gear switching and load activation strategy of the satellite communication vehicle according to the solving result of the daily front scheduling model. The invention flexibly activates the load through the satellite communication vehicle, improves the toughness of the system, optimizes the utilization of communication resources by distinguishing the load types, reduces the total operation cost of the system and improves the recovery efficiency of power supply after disaster.

title_en: Caisson foundation stand for restoring caisson type breakwater and restoration method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the problem at the time when a caisson type breakwater is struck by disaster that it is difficult to secure a diver and others engaged in levelling work on a rubble mound so that the disaster-affected caisson type breakwater cannot be restored early.SOLUTION: A caisson foundation stand for restoring a caisson type breakwater of this invention comprises a foundation stand 1 which is installed on a rubble mound 2 of the disaster-affected caisson type breakwater and a caisson 3 is installed on the top face of the foundation stand 1, and the foundation stand 1 is used for reinstallation of the caisson on the rubble mound. The foundation stand 1 is formed in a plate shape and a protrusion 5 for bite in the rubble mound is installed on the underside.

title_en: Unlocking and restoration control system for restricted area used in emergency evacuation
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an unlocking and restoration control system for a restricted area used in emergency evacuation, the restricted area being unlocked automatically to allow entry by the general public when an announcement (information) on earthquake, tsunami or other emergency and disaster situation is made, and is smoothly locked and restored to the normal condition after elapse of a prescribed amount of time needed for safety (or when an announcement on cancellation of the emergency and disaster situation is made) and the evacuees have left.SOLUTION: An unlocking and restoration control system for a restricted area used in emergency evacuation comprises: a gate; gate opening/closing means 120 for locking and unlocking the gate; emergency and disaster information acquisition means 110 for receiving announcement on emergency and disaster situations and other information; unlocked time setting means 130 for setting a duration of unlocked time that the gate opening/closing means keeps the gate unlocked; unlocked duration measurement and judgment means 131 that unlocks the gate in response to an emergency and disaster announcement and other information received by the emergency and disaster information acquisition means, measures the duration of unlocked state, and judges whether the duration is within the set duration; and control means 101 for controlling these means. The system locks the gate when the prescribed duration has elapsed.
assignees: SYSTEC KK;CENTRAL NIPPON HIGHWAY ENGINEERING TOKYO CO LTD

title_en: Condenser
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve earthquake resistance by suppressing relative displacement of water chambers and piping in a condenser.SOLUTION: A condenser is provided with a housing 11 of hollow shape, having a steam inflow port 21 and a condensate discharge port 22, inlet water chambers 12, 13 and outlet water chambers 14, 15 respectively disposed on end portions of the housing 11, a number of heat transfer pipes 31, 32 which are connected to the inlet water chambers 12, 13 and the outlet water chambers 14, 15 inside of the housing 11, and in which cooling water flows, intake pipes 43, 44 and drain pipes 47, 48 connected to the inlet water chambers 12, 13 and the outlet water chambers 14, 15 through expansion joints 41, 42, 45, 46, reduction members 61, 62, 63, 64 reducing displacement of the inlet water chambers 12, 13 and the outlet water chambers 14, 15, and restoration members 65, 66, 67, 68 for restoring positions of the inlet water chambers 12, 13 and the outlet water chambers 14, 15.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Disaster information management device, disaster information system, management method for disaster information, and program for managing disaster information
abstract_en: To attempt to extend a providing service by allowing collection of various kinds of information and early restoration of a defective function in a disaster response infrastructure network, in a disaster information system, a disaster information management apparatus for collecting disaster information via a network includes a terminal information acquirer that acquires terminal information including the current position and identification information of a portable terminal, a need information generator that generates, from received disaster information, need information including information about a need which can be satisfied by the operation of an apparatus, and a request information generator that generates, based on the terminal information and the need information, request information for requesting the portable terminal existing within a range of a predetermined distance from the occurrence location of the need to operate the apparatus necessary for satisfying the need, and transmits the request information.

title_en: Power restoration management method and system
abstract_en: A power restoration method and system. The method includes receiving by a computer processor of a computing apparatus, a signal indicating that a power outage has ended and that an input voltage signal used for powering power consumption devices at a first specified location power will be enabled. The computer processor disables input voltage signal connections to the power consumption devices and detects that the input voltage signal is enabled. The computer processor enables a first input voltage signal connection associated with a first power consumption device and monitors a frequency signal associated with the input voltage signal. The computer processor generates frequency level data comprising a frequency level of the frequency signal and compares the frequency level to a predetermined frequency level value. The computer processor generates results data comprising results of comparing the frequency level to a predetermined frequency level value.

title_en: Korean style house having against earthquake function
title_ko: 지진 대비 기능을 갖는 한옥
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a Korean style house with an earthquake proof function. When an earthquake occurs, an entire of a Korean style house structure is moved to reduce vibration and impact transfer, thereby minimizing damages to the Korean style house structure, and securing restoration ability by easily positioning the moved Korean style house structure in a regular location. In addition, a roof tile structure with weak durability has waterproof and vibration-proof functions, thereby securing durability. Also, durability of a column is precisely determined and simply implemented such that determination for later reinforcement operation can be easily done. The present invention comprises: a foundation; a lower portion bracket; and an upper portion bracket.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 지진 발생시 한옥 구조물이 전체적으로 이동되어 진동 및 충격 전달이 감소됨에 따라 한옥 구조물의 손상이 최소화되고, 이동된 한옥 구조물의 위치를 쉽게 정위치할 수 있음에 따라 복원성이 확보된다. 또한, 내구성이 취약한 지붕의 기와 구조를 방수 및 방진 가능하게 구성하여 내구성이 확보되고, 기둥의 내구성 판단을 정확하고 간편하게 수행하여 추후 보강 판단 여부가 용이한 지진 대비 기능을 갖는 한옥이 소개된다.

title_en: Geological environment treatment method suitable for steep wall and deep pit type abandoned mine
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological environment treatment method suitable for a steep wall and deep pit type abandoned mine. The method comprises the steps of geological environment exploration, slope clearing treatment, mine pit backfilling, reinforced soil slope filling, retaining wall arrangement, rainwater drainage, slope crest water resistance, vegetation recovery, water storage preservation, deformation monitoring and the like. The specific environment conditions and the topographic features are effectively combined, artificial treatment is conducted on mine terrains formed by mining according to local conditions, and the good effect of recovering the geological environment of the abandoned mine is achieved. An artificial soil slope attaching steep wall which is filled with dump slag and local loess removes the potential geological hazards of collapse, slide and the like existing in steep wall and deep pit landforms, solves the problem that the land is occupied by mining wastes, and also facilitates vegetational cover and land restoration; mountains which recover green are fused together with surrounding natural mountains, the mountains recovering green and the surrounding natural mountains are synchronized in the four seasons, plants grow naturally, natural mountain appearance is recovered, and a contribution is made for national geological disaster control and ecological environment restoration.

title_en: Repairing fertilizer after cold injury and disaster and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cold injury post-disaster restoration fertilizer and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of fertilizers, wherein the cold injury post-disaster restoration fertilizer comprises the following components in parts by weight: 200 parts of nitrogen fertilizer, 150 parts of phosphate fertilizer, 250 parts of potash fertilizer, 20-100 parts of organic carbon liquid, 400 parts of antifreeze microbial agent, 2-10 parts of polyglutamic acid, 1-5 parts of xanthan gum, 0-5 parts of NaOH, 5-20 parts of boric acid, 5-10 parts of EDTA calcium, 2-10 parts of soluble magnesium, 2-10 parts of soluble ferrous iron, 1-5 parts of soluble zinc, 2-5 parts of salicylic acid, 2-10 parts of biological stimulant and 400 parts of water. By optimizing the coordination of organic carbon, medium and trace elements, biological stimulants and even major elements, the effect of good cold damage repairing effect is finally achieved, and the raw materials of the cold damage post-disaster repairing fertilizer are easy to obtain and low in cost.

title_en: Treatment method for mining ground cracks of shallow coal seam in hilly area of hilly landform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating a crack of a mining land of a shallow coal seam in a hilly area of a hilly landscape. The invention is based on the differential zone development attribute of the ground fissure, takes the classification and zone of the ground fissure development as the basis, takes the ecological restoration theory and technology of the mountainous area as the guidance, scientifically divides the ground fissure development type and the preferential development area, divides the ground fissure development type into the tension type ground fissure, the open type ground fissure and the step type ground fissure, optimizes the treatment process and measures, adopts a targeted treatment method, follows the principle of local control, realizes the classified zone treatment, organically combines the ground fissure treatment with landslide control, vegetation restoration and water and soil conservation, has good pertinence, systematicness and specificity, has excellent treatment effect, promotes the ecological environment improvement and restoration of the coal mining subsidence in the mountainous area with the peak landscape, has important practical significance for building green mines, and realizes the unification of social benefit, ecological benefit and economic benefit.

title_en: Irrigation monitoring system for restoring original ecology of grass
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of grassland restoration, in particular to an irrigation monitoring system for grassland original ecology restoration, which comprises an irrigation data collection and analysis module, an irrigation demand prediction module, an irrigation strategy intelligent adjustment module, an irrigation equipment state monitoring module and an equipment fault automatic checking module, wherein a sensor network is deployed to collect data, the collected data are preprocessed, the accuracy of the data is improved, the prediction model is used to predict the irrigation demand, manual intervention is reduced, the irrigation strategy is automatically adjusted according to the predicted irrigation demand, the automatic management of irrigation is realized, the safety accidents caused by equipment faults are avoided by monitoring the state parameters of irrigation equipment in real time, and the fault reasons are positioned by utilizing Bayesian theorem and combining early warning signals and the equipment state parameters monitored in real time so as to immediately take measures. The method and the device are used for solving the technical problem that the monitoring management level of the current grassland restoration is not high.
assignees: GANSU GRASSLAND TECH PROMOTION GENERAL STATION

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based natural disaster damage intelligent assessment method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses an artificial intelligence-based natural disaster damage intelligent assessment method and system, which are characterized by acquiring images and disaster sensitive factors in a restoration period through a satellite remote sensing technology, performing intelligent interpretation of land utilization types, generating a grid layer, simultaneously automatically extracting geological disaster stress factors, innovatively coupling InVEST an ecological environment quality assessment model and an AI disaster damage assessment engine, synchronously calculating an ecological environment quality index and a disaster damage risk index, generating an ecological quality thermodynamic diagram and a disaster sensitive dynamic map, analyzing an ecological quality space pattern evolution rule by adopting a space-time-space diagram convolution network, combining a natural disaster damage degree-disaster resistance correlation matrix to quantify a synergistic effect, and finally realizing multi-dimensional visual deduction of natural disaster damage degree and disaster resistance in a three-dimensional digital twin platform to form an ecological restoration-disaster toughness double-target intelligent assessment loop.
assignees: SICHUAN HUADI CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD;SICHUAN GEOLOGICAL SURVEY RES CENTER

title_en: Pre-disaster, post-disaster and total scheduling method for community multi-element shared energy storage system under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a pre-disaster, post-disaster and total scheduling method of a community multi-element shared energy storage system under typhoon disasters, which realizes resource optimization configuration by optimizing layout of entity energy storage stations, mobile energy storage equipment and electric automobile clusters, and minimizing deployment cost while guaranteeing operation toughness of the system; and in the post-disaster stage, the recovery time, the energy loss and the scheduling cost are taken as optimization targets, and the emergency power supply requirement is responded quickly by combining the constraints of load recovery priority and the like. And feeding back toughness indexes calculated by the post-disaster power supply recovery track to a pre-disaster optimization objective function to form a closed loop iteration optimization mechanism, and adopting a particle swarm optimization algorithm and mixed integer linear programming to jointly solve, thereby considering solving precision and efficiency.

title_en: Clustering algorithm-based power distribution network line loss restoration calculation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network line loss restoration calculation method and system based on a clustering algorithm. The method comprises the steps of acquiring and processing initial data, including topological structure, distribution transformer accounts, table bottom display number, power, voltage and switch deflection data. And then, identifying the transfer line through a characteristic index extraction and threshold method, and determining the substitution line and the transfer period. Aiming at the line to be diagnosed, a voltage similarity matrix is constructed by utilizing a dynamic time warping algorithm, and a density clustering identification transfer distribution transformer set is adopted. And then, correcting the transfer distribution transformer set and the period of the transfer distribution transformer set by combining the switch segment duty ratio index. And finally, calculating and restoring the contemporaneous line loss of the transfer line and the substitution line according to the optimized data. By implementing the method, the accuracy of the synchronous line loss rate of the transfer line can be improved, and the synchronous line loss rate can be accurately calculated and restored, so that more effective power system management and energy-saving strategy implementation are supported.
assignees: JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Multi-factor driven comprehensive evaluation system for coast beach health
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-factor driven comprehensive evaluation system for the health of coast and beach sand, which aims to solve the problems of one-sided property, subjectivity and lack of systematicness in the prior evaluation technology. The multi-factor driven comprehensive coast beach health evaluation system systematically divides a plurality of factors affecting beach health into three categories, namely physical process core factors for calculating physical stability, system states and environment adjusting factors for representing landform ecological conditions, and human activities and environment pressure factors for correcting evaluation results. The invention has the innovation point that a three-layer logic evaluation framework of driving-state-pressure is constructed, and multi-section state scientific classification from healthy, sub-healthy to harmful can be realized. The method overcomes the limitation of traditional evaluation, realizes comprehensive, dynamic and accurate diagnosis of the health state of the beach, and provides powerful decision basis for scientific management, ecological restoration and disaster prevention and reduction of coastal zones.
assignees: TAIHU XINGYUN WUXI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automated tool for monitoring archaeological sites (ATMAS™)
abstract_en: An automation tool for resource managers to effectively schedule on-site visits and manage information obtained thereby. An embodiment of the present invention, the Automated Tool for Monitoring Archaeological Sites (ATMAS™), automates the process by which cultural resource (CR) managers on various installations prioritize and schedule CR sites for monitoring. Other applications for use by resource management include: environmental, safety, security, military, educational, emergency management, land use, fish and wildlife management, construction and maintenance of highways and waterways, mining, exploration, manufacturing, recreational management, urban restoration and the like. Embodiments of the present invention increase efficiency and reduce cost, while accurately and timely preserving and integrating information. Embodiments of the present invention are useful for post-processing as well as scheduling, analysis, and pro-active direction of ongoing monitoring.

title_en: Hybrid Distribution Network Power Restoration Control
abstract_en: A power outage restoration system manages a power network including a plurality of switching devices. The power outage restoration system includes an outage management system having a network model of said power network. A plurality of local restoration controllers are in communication with the outage management system and each said local restoration controller includes a trimmed network model correlating to a respective area of responsibility.

title_en: Post-disaster coupling recovery analysis method for urban infrastructure system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster coupling restoration analysis method for an urban infrastructure system, which comprises four parts, namely disaster analysis modeling, structural damage analysis, functional loss estimation and functional restoration prediction, wherein after a disaster happens, a load model with time space variability and correlation in an urban scale range is established by using a random field theory, the damage states of all monomers and infrastructure system subcomponents of an urban building community under the action of random loads are calculated based on the established load model, then a system theory method is used for researching the cascade effect generated by functional coupling between the urban building community and all types of infrastructures, the functional loss of the building community and the infrastructure system is evaluated, and finally the post-disaster restoration time and restoration tracks of all infrastructure systems are predicted; the method realizes the quantitative analysis of the post-disaster functional loss and recovery process of the urban infrastructure system, is a key step of quantitative evaluation of the toughness city, and can provide a theoretical basis for developing a decision model for improving the toughness of the city.

title_en: Intelligent stage-level studying and judging method and device for power failure and recovery events of transformer area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for intelligently studying and judging a power failure and restoration event level in a transformer area, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, monitoring power failure alarm events in a transformer area in real time, switching to a step S2 when monitoring the alarm events uploaded by a transformer area level terminal, and switching to a step S3 when monitoring the alarm events uploaded by a meter; s2, sequentially judging whether power failure occurs in the station area level terminal and the station area according to the levels, and controlling a corresponding meter to mark a power failure unit; and S3, controlling whether the meter, the terminal to which the meter belongs, the station area terminal and the station area are powered off or not according to the hierarchy according to the state of the power failure of the station area terminal, or sequentially judging whether the meter, the terminal to which the meter belongs, the station area terminal, the station area meter box and the branch line are powered off or not according to the hierarchy, and controlling the corresponding meter marking power failure unit. The method has the advantages of simple implementation method, capability of realizing the intelligent study and judgment of the power failure and power restoration of the transformer area, high study and judgment efficiency and precision and the like.

title_en: Meadow vegetation root system sampling and surface soil stripping device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a meadow vegetation root system sampling and surface soil stripping device, which comprises an outer barrel with an open bottom and a sampling barrel arranged in the outer barrel, wherein a vertical downward positioning column and a guard edge extending outwards are arranged at the bottom of the outer barrel; the sampling bucket includes the stoving separation area of upper portion and the sampling area of lower part. The invention is used for the research work of grassland vegetation roots in pasture areas, can completely acquire the plant roots in sampling areas, can quickly dry and separate the soil on the surface layer of the roots according to test requirements, provides convenience for the research of grassland vegetation ecology and ecological restoration plant breeding in pasture areas, provides important research data for drought resistance and disaster reduction in pasture areas and sustainable development of agriculture and animal husbandry, and has high automation degree and high acquisition speed.

title_en: Sectional protection and arrangement branch box for 0.4kV low-voltage line
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sectional protection and arrangement branch box for a 0.4kV low-voltage line, which sequentially connects three-phase four-wire voltage current and zero-wire current to a voltage current terminal of an LTU intelligent low-voltage state monitoring terminal, and realizes functions of user outage and power restoration event research, judgment and reporting, self-identification of household change relation of a supporting platform region, automatic fault identification and isolation and accurate supporting of line loss monitoring and management of the meter box based on a meter; the auxiliary grounding electrode is arranged at the bottom of the low-voltage line branch box, so that when a zero line in a certain area fails, the auxiliary grounding in the branch box can be effectively grounded, and 380V voltage is prevented from directly entering a household, so that electrical equipment is prevented from being burnt or even people suffer from casualties; when lightning current occurs in the line, the lightning current is led to the ground quickly, the purpose of protecting equipment is achieved, the equipment in operation is prevented from lightning damage, an external power supply quick connection device is arranged in the low-voltage line branch box, and the generator can supply power immediately through a quick plug connector when the fault occurs, so that the dual-power supply function is achieved.
assignees: ZUO WEIHUA;Ji Zaiyong;KWAN MAN KIT;SUN XILONG;LI TIANYANG;CHO EUN YONG;LIU BO;SUN YE;ZHANG TIANCHENG;ZHAO LIU;ZHANG YANLONG;REN YAN

title_en: Consider the electric system partition zone optimizing algorithm of recovery time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of electric system partition zone optimizing algorithms for considering recovery time, preliminary subregion is carried out to electric system according to network topology, startup power, climbing rate and the branch weight for considering generator establish the priority indicator of all units, optimization unit starting sequence；Establish the decision system with uncertain factor based on rough set；To minimize all subregion longest recovery times as target, the electric system partition zone optimizing model for considering recovery time is established；According to the unit that decision system screening needs to adjust, final unit subregion is determined according to electric system partition zone optimizing model adjusted, and unit recovery sequence is combined to carry out partition recovery.The electric system partition model that the present invention establishes considers influence of the recovery time to entire electric system division result, shortens the gap between the partition recovery time, improves recovery efficiency.

title_en: Method and system for inquiring power failure processing progress based on map
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for inquiring power failure processing progress based on a map, which comprises a search positioning module, a power failure processing module and a power failure processing module, wherein the search positioning module is used for inquiring and filtering basic user information according to user information and displaying power failure information, historical power failure information, power failure range information and power failure and power restoration states of relevant cells on the map; the power failure management module is used for displaying the detailed information of the selected power failure event and the first-aid repair progress information and can perform distinguishing display according to different types of the power failure events; the track management module is used for displaying the position information and the emergency repair track of the current emergency repair personnel in real time; and the event query module is used for respectively displaying the event information of all power failures occurring in the near term and the planned power failures in the future according to four dimensions of waiting power failure, power failure medium, historical power failure and frequent power failure in a list mode. The invention displays the emergency repair progress and the emergency repair flow condition of the emergency repair personnel to the client, and simultaneously facilitates the emergency repair personnel to feed back the emergency repair information and realize the map-based visual display.

title_en: Post-disaster collaborative scheduling method and system for power distribution network based on rush-repair and network reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-disaster collaborative scheduling method and system for a power distribution network based on rush-repair and network reconstruction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power distribution network information and fault line information; based on the power distribution network information and the fault line information, constructing a power distribution network fault recovery model which aims at minimizing the loss load and meets the emergency repair scheduling constraint, the fault point repair time constraint and the power distribution network constraint; and solving the power distribution network fault recovery model, obtaining a rush-repair scheduling result and a dynamic network reconstruction result, and carrying out cooperative scheduling on the power distribution network. The post-disaster collaborative scheduling method for the power distribution network provided by the invention can reduce the load loss as much as possible while meeting the requirements of rush-repair scheduling constraint, fault point repair time constraint and power distribution network constraint; the construction of the power distribution network fault recovery model synchronously considers the rush-repair work and the network reconstruction process, so that the network reconstruction process can dynamically update along with the fault rush-repair progress, the load loss is effectively reduced, and the recovery efficiency after disaster is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Method and system for optimizing reliability improvement measures of large sending end system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and particularly relates to a method and a system for optimizing reliability improvement measures of a large system at a sending end, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating the annual value of equipment investment cost and equipment investment cost; acquiring a maintenance cost set; calculating the user outage loss and the outage loss cost of the system according to the classified user outage loss function, and calculating the equipment restoration rate and the unavailability rate; and sorting the reliability lifting measures based on the marginal benefit, and optimizing the lifting measures according to the sorting. And introducing a reliability lifting measure optimization sorting algorithm based on marginal benefit, adopting power system reliability cost benefit analysis based on LCC theory, considering the influence of system elements on the reliability of the power system, finding out weak links of the system, and determining measures for improving the power supply reliability through cost benefit analysis, thereby realizing maximization of economic cost and maximization of social benefit.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Open pit mine geological environment disaster and ecological restoration simulation device and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to an open pit mine geological environment disaster and ecological restoration simulation device, which has the structure that: a vibration control platform is arranged on the bottom surface of the closed simulation chamber, and a slope simulation platform is supported above the vibration control platform through a plurality of lifting platforms; a heating device, a condensing device and a flame spraying device are arranged in the slope simulation platform, and a temperature sensor and a humidity sensor are arranged in the slope of the slope simulation platform; a spraying device is arranged above the slope simulation platform and is positioned at the top of the closed simulation chamber; an acquisition point is arranged below the slope of the slope simulation platform; a monitoring instrument group is arranged at the top of the closed simulation chamber; a control console for controlling and operating each device is arranged in the closed simulation room. The simulation device can simulate the influence of various mine environment disasters on the stability of the pit slope of the open pit coal mine and simulate ecological restoration conditions, and provides a basis for the pit slope management of the open pit coal mine.

title_en: Informationized management method, device, equipment and medium for water ecological restoration engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides an informatization management method, device, equipment and medium for water ecological restoration engineering, which can convert equipment data to obtain data to be processed, and send the data to be processed to a corresponding data processing platform according to a physical data protocol corresponding to each data processing platform for storage and operation processing to obtain data informatization management data so as to realize informatization management of the data; inputting the operation and maintenance data into a configuration database according to a data template to obtain data electronic management data so as to realize electronic management of various data; personnel management is carried out according to the working type of each person to obtain personnel information management data so as to realize effective management of personnel information; performing early warning analysis according to the river water quality change data to obtain river water quality emergency management data so as to realize emergency management of river water quality; and a plurality of management dimensions are integrated, so that informatization management on the water ecological restoration project is realized.
assignees: ZHEJIANG DINGSHENG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for repairing measurement data of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for repairing measurement data of a power distribution network, which can be applied to the technical field of power monitoring and the technical field of power data repair. The method comprises the following steps: under the condition that the missing data exists in the power distribution network measurement data set, determining the data type of the missing data and the data type of each of a plurality of measurement data in the power distribution network measurement data set; under the condition that the data types of the measurement data are different and only one missing data exists at the same monitoring time, determining first initial repair data of the missing data based on the measurement data and the electrical correlation function at the same monitoring time as the missing data; generating a power distribution network measurement data tensor based on the power distribution network measurement data set; performing tensor decomposition data restoration on the power distribution network measurement data tensor to obtain second initial restoration data matched with the missing data; and obtaining repair data matched with the missing data based on the first initial repair data and the second initial repair data.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Mortise and tenon type precast block ecological retaining wall suitable for rapid restoration of ground disaster environment slope
abstract_en: The invention provides a mortise and tenon type precast block ecological retaining wall suitable for rapid restoration of a ground disaster environment side slope. The mortise and tenon type precast block ecological retaining wall suitable for rapid restoration of a ground disaster environment side slope comprises a fixed frame, wherein the fixed frame is installed on the front face of the side slope through a plurality of anchors, a plurality of supporting rods are installed at the top of the inner wall of the fixed frame at equal intervals, a plurality of installation pieces are fixedly connected to positions, close to two sides, of the front face of the fixed frame, and first supporting bolts are fixedly connected to one ends of the front face of the installation pieces. According to the mortise and tenon type precast block ecological retaining wall suitable for rapid restoration of the ground disaster environment side slope, concrete or adhesive is not needed to fix the ecological retaining wall through the design, the ecological retaining wall is assembled through the fixing frame, the first mounting rail and the second mounting rail, the assembly efficiency of the ecological retaining wall is improved, the later disassembly difficulty is reduced, and the disassembled ecological retaining wall can be reused.
assignees: NUCLEAR IND JINHUA CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation method, system, equipment and medium for ecological restoration effect of saline-alkali water body
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for evaluating the ecological restoration effect of a saline-alkali water body, which relate to the technical field of saline-alkali water body restoration evaluation and are characterized in that a double-layer restoration evaluation framework based on a physical layer and a chemical layer is constructed, the environment and biological monitoring data are fused, and the effective matching and dynamic weight adjustment of the environment and biological index trend are realized by adopting a data-driven principal component analysis and dynamic time warping algorithm, so that the scientificity and the accuracy of the restoration effect evaluation are improved. And the time sequence prediction is carried out on the repair process by combining an autoregressive integral moving average model, so that the repair completion time can be quantitatively estimated, and scientific management and decision making are assisted. The overall scheme realizes multidimensional comprehensive evaluation and dynamic closed-loop optimization of the ecological restoration effect of the saline-alkali water body, remarkably enhances the pertinence, the instantaneity and the sustainability of ecological restoration, and provides scientific and efficient technical support for restoration of the saline-alkali soil.
assignees: CHINA CHEMICAL CITY INVEST CO LTD

title_en: Display device and information display system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To inexpensively present various kinds of information through a display device by using communication lines already installed on a telephone pole.  <P>SOLUTION: A display device 300 mounted on a telephone pole 200 receives advertisement information or disaster restoration information distributed from a server 100 by way of communication lines 400 already installed on the pole 200, and displays the information in a display unit 307. The display unit 307 is operated to set a region to display the number of the telephone pole, a region to display the location of the telephone pole, and a region to display an advertisement, QR code, PR information of the server, disaster restoration information or the like, and individual information can be simultaneously displayed.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Disaster Management System
abstract_en: To provide a disaster management system capable of accurately, efficiently calculate the cost required for restoration of each disaster area when natural disasters occur.SOLUTION: A disaster management system 1 consists of a portable information processing terminal 2 and a server 3. The portable information processing terminal 2 has an information input part 2a capable of inputting the information 4 for a damage amount calculation of the damage area D in the event of a disaster, an individual damage amount calculation part 2b to calculate the individual disaster amount of the disaster area D based on the predetermined arithmetic expression corresponding to the disaster amount calculation information 4, and a GPS function part 2c capable of measuring the disaster location information using an artificial satellite. The server 3 has an information storage part 3a to acquire the individual damage amount and the damage location information from the portable information processing terminal 2 and to store them by associating them each other, and a total damage amount calculation part 3b to tally the individual disaster amount of each different disaster area D and to calculate the total disaster amount when the disasters occur.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Electromotion type valve apparatus for restoration of power failure
title_ko: 정전복구용 전동식 밸브장치
abstract_en: An electric-powered valve apparatus for the power outage recovery is provided to control the flow of fluid smoothly by safely opening and closing a valve or rotating the valve at location value which is set up in advance. An electric-powered valve apparatus(100) comprises a motor(70), a valve position sensor(90), a data storage module(20), a panel(60), an I/O controller(110), a power supply unit(180) and secondary cell unit(220). The data storage module stores position data. The panel comprises a display(50), a valve closing switch(30), and a valve opening switch(40). The I/O controller is connected to a microprocessor(10) and performs the input/output control. The panel comprises a forward/reverse direction controller(130), an external terminal(120), a power supply unit(150), a power outage detecting circuit(170) and a power stabilizing circuit(160). The secondary cell unit comprises a charge circuit(190), and a secondary cell(200) and a DC/DC converter(210). The charge circuit is connected to the secondary battery. The DC/DC converter supplies the drive power of the motor.

title_ko: 원자력 발전소 정기 및 주기시험에 대한 위험도 평가 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a risk evaluation system and method for regular and periodic tests of a nuclear power plant, and the system includes an information input unit which generates information on a work command and a repair schedule related with regular and periodic tests of the nuclear power plant through an integrated management server and receives the information generated from the integrated management server; a regular and normal test information storing unit which stores information on a functional location according to the regular and periodic tests, and an unavailable device and work order related with the functional location; a command automatic separating unit which selects a period for the regular and periodic tests based on the information stored in the regular and periodic tests information storing unit to automatically separate work command data with respect to the to-be-evaluated unavailable device and unavailable time; a repair scenario storing unit which automatically generates and stores a repair scenario according to the work command data; and a analyzing unit which performs risk evaluation on the unavailable device and unavailable time according to the work command data separated with respect to the regular and periodic test and setting up a repair schedule according to the evaluation result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원자력 발전소 정기 및 주기시험에 대한 위험도 평가 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 통합관리 서버를 통해 원자력 발전소의 정기 및 주기시험에 관한 작업명령 및 정비일정에 관한 정보를 생성하고, 상기 통합관리 서버로부터 생성된 정보를 수신하는 정보 입력부; 정기 및 주기시험에 따른 기능위치와, 그에 대한 이용불능 기기 및 작업 순서에 대한 정보를 저장하고 있는 정기 및 주기시험 정보 저장부; 상기 정기 및 주기시험 정보 저장부에 저장된 정보를 바탕으로, 정기 및 주기시험에 대한 주기를 선택하여, 평가 대상 이용불능 기기와 그 이용불능 시간을 기준으로, 작업명령 데이터를 자동 분할하는 명령 자동 분할부; 상기 작업명령 데이터에 따라, 정비 시나리오를 자동 생성하여 저장하고 있는 정비 시나리오 저장부; 및 정기 및 주기시험에 대하여 분할된 작업명령 데이터에 따른, 이용불능 기기 및 그 이용불능 시간에 대하여 위험도 평가를 수행하고, 평가 결과에 따라 정비 일정을 설정하는 분석부; 를 포함한다.

title_en: Methods and systems for detection and notification of power outages and power quality
abstract_en: Described herein are methods and systems for detection and notification of electrical power outages and power quality. A sensor coupled to a circuit transmits a keepalive packet to a server. The sensor detects an input signal generated by electrical activity. The sensor generates an output signal based upon the input signal. The sensor monitors the output signal. During a clock cycle, the sensor determines whether a rising edge occurred and transmits a fault packet to the server when the rising edge occurred prior to a predetermined clock value or when no rising edge occurred. The server receives the fault packet from the sensor and listens for keepalive packets. The server transmits a power outage notification when no keepalive packets are received for at least a defined time period after the fault packet is received. The server transmits a power restoration notification when one or more keepalive packets are subsequently received.

title_en: Nuclear power station three-dimensional model repair control unit, system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a nuclear power station three-dimensional model restoration control unit, a system and a method, wherein the control unit comprises the following components: the coordinate registration module is used for acquiring the three-dimensional model of the nuclear power station to be repaired and the real environment data of the nuclear power station, and carrying out integral three-dimensional space superposition and registration of the three-dimensional model of the nuclear power station to be repaired and the real environment data of the nuclear power station under the same space coordinate system; the deviation analysis module is used for carrying out missing and deviation evaluation analysis on the three-dimensional model of the nuclear power station to be repaired and the real environment data of the nuclear power station after registration, and obtaining an analysis result; and the model repairing module is used for repairing the three-dimensional model of the nuclear power station to be repaired according to the analysis result to obtain a repaired three-dimensional model of the nuclear power station. The method improves the repair precision of the three-dimensional model of the nuclear power station, solves the technical problem of repairing the three-dimensional model of the area which is inaccessible and uncontrollable to personnel, reduces the field workload of engineering personnel and improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Landslide prevention vegetation net

title_en: Power grid fault diagnosis method and system based on multi-source information deep reasoning
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid fault diagnosis method and system based on multi-source information deep inference, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining data from a data source, the data source comprising: the system comprises a signal protection system, a fault recording system, a traveling wave distance measurement system, a dispatching automation system and an overhaul system; calling the knowledge required by the inference engine from a set knowledge base, wherein the knowledge base comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps of (1) a protection principle, a topology analysis algorithm, a protection correct action meaning, CT saturation characteristics and an identification method, an excitation inrush current and identification method, a fault trip judgment method, an intra-area fault judgment method and an associated action stage number judgment method; diagnosing the power grid fault by using an inference machine based on the data in the data source and the knowledge in the knowledge base; the method can quickly judge the protection action behavior of the power grid, distinguish the refusal action and the misoperation, preliminarily analyze the reason of the protection misoperation, and has important significance for supporting the dispatching of quick power restoration.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle communication base station and power distribution network collaborative rush-repair method and related device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative rush-repair method and a cooperative rush-repair related device for an unmanned aerial vehicle communication base station and a power distribution network, and belongs to the technical field of power distribution network rush-repair; the method comprises the steps of establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle deployment model with full coverage of fault point communication as a target, dispersing a region to be deployed into a point set by using a discretized position set coverage model, obtaining an optimal position to be hovered of an unmanned aerial vehicle through the unmanned aerial vehicle deployment model, introducing a path table and a time vector, establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle communication path planning model through path constraint and time constraint, establishing a power distribution network rush-repair scheduling model with minimum power failure loss and minimum fault rush-repair time of a power distribution network in a post-disaster rush-repair stage as targets through coupling constraint of fault rush-repair and material scheduling and unmanned aerial vehicle communication time sequence, rush-repair team scheduling constraint and power distribution network operation constraint, and obtaining a cooperative rush-repair strategy of a communication base station and the power distribution network through the unmanned aerial vehicle communication path planning model and the power distribution network rush-repair scheduling model based on the optimal position to be hovered of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure deduction and elastic recovery collaborative decision method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a collaborative decision method and a collaborative decision system for power grid cascading failure deduction and elastic recovery, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a state model of each power grid element in extreme weather, and acquiring the state transition probability of each power grid element in continuous time according to the state model; the method comprises the steps of constructing a system cascading failure evolution model under extreme weather according to state transition probability, calculating line real-time outage probability under a wind power grid-connected scene according to the system cascading failure evolution model, constructing an optimal power flow model according to the line real-time outage probability with minimized load shedding amount as a target, simulating a derating operation response process after grid failure to obtain a load reduction strategy of a system under each failure state, establishing a post-disaster emergency recovery model based on the load reduction strategy and system topology constraint, and determining a fault repair time sequence and a load recovery sequence. The invention can obviously improve the risk perception capability, decision scientificity and recovery efficiency of the power grid in an extreme event.

title_en: Cloud communication-based oiling machine remote data management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oiling machine data management, in particular to an oiling machine remote data management method and system based on cloud communication. The method comprises the steps of generating a batch data block by a site terminal according to a time threshold packet, executing reversible compression and anchor point insertion, generating batch metadata by taking a hash tree root value as a batch identifier, establishing a safe session with a cloud end when the site terminal is on line and uploading the session according to transaction priority, fountain-framing the data block and the metadata into an optical frame array when the site terminal is off line, broadcasting the optical frame array by a price display screen, acquiring and decoding video of a mobile terminal, and uploading the optical frame array. The cloud end restores the data block based on the reconstruction fragment and the metadata, verifies the integrity by combining frame-level verification and batch identification, writes transaction records and running states into a transaction library and a time sequence library respectively by idempotent deduplication of the site identification and the batch identification, generates a receipt short code synchronous station end, and realizes consistency reconciliation according to batch supplementary transmission according to a missing list after network restoration.

abstract_en: To provide an elevator restoration support system capable of calculating the priority of elevator restoration work in the event of a wide-area disaster such as an earthquake without pre-registering information on persons requiring assistance in evacuation, and capable of executing the restoration work for elevators in multiple buildings in an optimal order.SOLUTION: The present invention is an elevator restoration support system that provides restoration work support for an elevator system comprising a first imaging device installed in a car and multiple second imaging devices installed at landing places on multiple floors. title_en: Power transmission network emergency repair and restoration method and device based on mobile power supply
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention are a power transmission network emergency repair and restoration method and device based on a mobile power supply. The present application improves the power transmission network fault restoration efficiency by the method: reading a preset power transmission network black start strategy optimization model and parameter data acquired from a power transmission network to be restored, wherein the power transmission network black start strategy optimization model is constructed by setting an emergency repair resource constraint, a power transmission network operation constraint and a power transmission network partition constraint, with the optimization objective of minimizing power transmission network load loss; initializing the power transmission network black start strategy optimization model on the basis of the parameter data, and solving the power transmission network black start strategy optimization model by means of a solver to obtain a mobile power supply arrangement scheme and a unit restoration scheme of said power transmission network; and performing emergency repair on said power transmission network on the basis of the mobile power supply arrangement scheme and the unit restoration scheme. The present application can improve the power transmission network fault restoration efficiency and reduce power outage costs by allocating fault repair resources.

title_en: Non-volatile memory
abstract_en: Natural disasters, such as cyclones, earthquakes, landslides, etc., or manmade damages, such as structural member's theft, terrorist attacks, etc., can cause collapse of transmission line towers. If these are not restored in time, there will be monetary loss to utilities as well as loss of service to consumers leading to societal impact. Generally, permanent restoration takes several weeks. Hence, a temporary solution for quick retrieval of power transmission is required. This invention provides a temporary support structural system comprising light weight guyed masts ( 1 ) made of readymade robust modules ( 6  and  7 ), easy to connect connection system, two pin gimbal joint ( 8 ) and easy to construct foundation system ( 9  and  10 ). The invention is flexible enough to develop various configurations for single or double circuit transmission lines. It is also scalable and can be used for 33 to 800 kV transmission lines.

title_en: Complete backspacing searching method for tracing reasons of power failure after appearance of power distribution network fault
abstract_en: The invention relates to a backspacing method in the field of the electrical power system, particularly to a complete backspacing searching method for tracing reasons of power failure after the appearance of power distribution network fault. The method includes the following steps: A, performing recursion search from a node corresponding to a power-losing distribution transformer; B, judging whether a power source is searched; C, confirming a route from the power-losing distribution transformer to the power source, the distance of the route and the information of an switched off switch on the route and nearest to the starting node; and D, obtaining the reason of power failure of the power distribution network. The method is efficient for radial power distribution networks, can be used for efficiently and accurately positioning the reason of power failure, is of vital importance in guiding distribution network dispatching personnel to quickly command power restoration, can be used for clearly positioning topological error and effectively guide planners to eliminate islands and revise the topological error in the aspect of planning, has been applied to the on-line site reliability monitoring platform, and is embodying the practical engineering value.

title_en: Three-dimensional digital twin operation management system for real-time analog simulation deduction of sewage treatment

title_en: Mining area subsidence monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle photogrammetry and LiDAR technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining area subsidence monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle photogrammetry and LiDAR technology, which comprises the steps of carrying out flight shooting on a mining area by using an unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain mining area earth surface image data, processing the obtained image data through a motion restoration structure algorithm SfM to generate a digital surface model DSM, an orthophoto map DOM and a digital elevation model DEM, scanning the mining area by using an airborne LiDAR system to obtain three-dimensional point cloud data of the surface of the mining area, correcting and improving the precision of the LiDAR point cloud data by using a differential GNSS technology, carrying out registration fusion on the digital elevation model DEM generated by unmanned aerial vehicle photogrammetry and the corrected LiDAR point cloud data under a unified coordinate system, and carrying out processing and analysis on the fused data to construct a mining area subsidence model so as to realize dynamic monitoring on the subsidence condition of the surface of the mining area. The method effectively solves the problems of the traditional mining area subsidence monitoring method and provides powerful technical support for mine geological disaster prevention and control, ecological environment protection and mining area sustainable development.

title_en: Detection and deduction of urgent messages in low power and lossy networks
abstract_en: Techniques and mechanisms for detecting and deducing of urgent messages in low-power and lossy networks (LLNs) using a correlation analysis of the nodes within a network and machine learning (ML) models. Utilizing these techniques, a field network director (FND) of the network can determine neighboring devices within the network. ML models may be utilized to determine that based upon receipt of a power outage notification (PON) message and/or a power restoration notification (PRN) message from nodes, neighboring nodes of the nodes may also have suffered a power outage and/or a subsequent power restoration, even if the FND did not receive a corresponding PON message and/or a corresponding PRN message from the neighboring nodes of the network. Thus, loss of power and subsequent power restoration may be handled for large numbers of neighboring nodes within the network, even when only a few PON messages and/or subsequent PRN messages are received.

title_en: Concrete spraying floating platform structure for mine environment recovery treatment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mine environment resumes spouting concrete platform structure that wafts of administering belongs to environmental protection technical field. The technical scheme is as follows: the support of the floating platform foundation is fixed on the side slope surrounding rock (1), the bottom of the support of the floating platform foundation is arranged in a concrete pouring layer (5), and the concrete pouring layer is adjacent to the side slope surrounding rock; a reinforced mesh (9) is arranged on the floating platform foundation support, and a concrete spraying layer (2) is arranged around the reinforced mesh; the corrugated template (3) is arranged on the inner side of the concrete spraying layer and is positioned above the concrete pouring layer; a floating platform structure is formed among the concrete pouring layer, the corrugated template and the side slope surrounding rock, a drain hole (8) is formed in the bottom of the floating platform structure, and medium coarse sand (6), geotextile (7) and nutrient planting soil (4) are sequentially arranged in the floating platform structure from bottom to top. The utility model provides a mine and quarry ecological restoration administer the difficult problem of crow's steep side slope construction, reduce ecological environment's further destruction, simple and easy rapid construction, it is fast to take effect, also carries out effectual improvement to geological disasters hidden danger.

title_en: Energy-consuming and beam-falling preventing device for metal pipe for railway bridge

title_en: Ecological friendly seawall
abstract_en: An ecological friendly seawall comprises a seawall open caisson foundation, a stepped bank protection, a stone throwing foot protection, a wave prevention forest in front of a dike, a wind prevention forest behind the dike and a dike top pavement, wherein the stepped bank protection is arranged above the seawall open caisson foundation and consists of a stepped concrete slope protection and a modularized precast concrete step, a plurality of drain pipes are arranged at the bottom of the stepped concrete slope protection, drain outlets of the drain pipes are arranged in the wave prevention forest in front of the dike, the precast concrete step comprises an uppermost layer of a viewing platform and a plurality of concrete planting ponds arranged below the viewing platform in a stepped manner, the stone throwing foot protection is arranged at the outer side of the stepped bank protection, the sand soil is covered above the stone throwing to plant the wave prevention forest in front of the dike, and the wind prevention forest behind the dike and the dike top pavement are sequentially arranged at the inner side of the stepped bank protection. The seawall integrates ecological restoration, landscaping, dampproof disaster reduction, and retains the function of coping with storm surge while landscaping the seawall.

title_en: Water conservancy channel side slope landslide reinforcement prosthetic devices
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water conservancy channel slope landslide reinforcement and repair device which comprises a water conservancy channel main body, wherein the inner side of the water conservancy channel main body is of a V-shaped structure, a groove is formed in the inner wall of the water conservancy channel main body, a net box is arranged in the groove, supporting stone blocks are filled in the net box, waterproof cloth is laid on the inner wall of the water conservancy channel main body, a geocell is arranged on the outer wall of the waterproof cloth, diamond through holes are formed in the geocell, a sand stabilizing layer is filled in the diamond through holes, a sand stabilizing layer is filled in the geocell, an ecological protection layer is arranged on the geocell, a net box is arranged on the inner wall of the water conservancy channel main body, the net box, the waterproof cloth, the geocell, the sand stabilizing layer and the ecological protection layer are distributed in bilateral symmetry about bisectors of the water conservancy channel main body, and the net box is positioned at the lower end of the geocell. The device can realize the rapid restoration of the side slope of the water conservancy channel main body so as to realize the normal use of the water conservancy channel main body at the fastest speed.

title_en: A kind of river channel ecology runoff process evaluation method based on Matter Analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of river channel ecology runoff process evaluation method based on Matter Analysis, it includes：The research each moon ecological flow in basin is calculated using a variety of existing methods, and different ecological runoff processes is formed with this；Determine ecological runoff process evaluation grade and the criteria for classifying；Matter-element to be evaluated is built according to each moon ecological flow, Classical field matter-element and section domain matter-element are built according to the evaluation criterion of determination；Determine the weight of each evaluation index；Each evaluation index is calculated to the degree of association of each opinion rating and the Synthesis Relational Grade of each opinion rating, opinion rating is determined according to Synthesis Relational Grade；The opinion rating for the ecological runoff process being calculated according to distinct methods, the water demand for natural service requirement in binding basin are comprehensive to determine ecological runoff process.The present invention establishes ecological runoff process evaluation standard, can carry out objective evaluation to it, and new method is provided to inquire into river channel ecology runoff process, and the restoration of the ecosystem for also subtracting dehydration section for power station downstream provides technical support.

title_en: Radiation type loop-free power distribution network island generation method for power restoration by adopting SNOP (simple noise rejection operation)
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for generating an isolated island of a radiation type loop-free power distribution network by adopting SNOP (single operational noise) for power restoration. The method comprises the following steps: forming complete topological connection among the SNOP nodes, and classifying the topological nodes of the power distribution network containing the SNOP; gradually retrieving the island nodes according to the topological structure; and repeating the iterative retrieval algorithm to generate all the SNOP-containing power distribution network islands. The algorithm makes full use of the radial topological characteristic of the power distribution network, performs topological analysis and node definition according to the tidal current direction and the position of the SNOP equipment in the topological structure of the power distribution network, and reduces the difficulty of the analysis of the whole system. The method for generating the SNOP island algorithm according to the network topology is simple, convenient and practical, has high calculation efficiency, and is beneficial to power grid dispatching personnel to make timely optimization and adjustment according to island node combinations and power grid state indexes when an actual natural disaster occurs, so that the large-scale power failure accident of the power distribution network can be avoided by utilizing the quick power restoration capability of the SNOP.
