title_en: Two-layer repair method for attacked measured data of power system based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-layer restoration method for attacked measurement data of a power system based on data driving, which relates to the field of operation safety maintenance of the power system, and is characterized in that a measurement regression model under each topological structure is established according to network parameter information of a regional power grid, and attacked measurement vectors under FDIA working conditions are simulated; separating attacked data by using a multidimensional scaling method to reduce dimensions and combining a federal forest algorithm on the upper layer; inputting the separated normal data into a generator G of the improved CBEGAN at the lower layer to generate data G (z); injecting the G (z) and the historical measurement regression model into a discriminator D, and distinguishing authenticity by calculating a Hellinger distance between the real sample and the reconstruction error distribution of the generated sample; and judging convergence through the target M, and finally realizing data restoration. The method can effectively restore the measured data on the basis of the residual normal data, realizes the self-healing capability of the power grid recovered after being attacked, and has better measurement convergence, control distribution diversity and practicability.
assignees: UNIV YANSHAN;CHINESE ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Low-end micro-processing data processing method for distribution network on-line monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-end micro-processing data processing method of an on-line monitoring device of a distribution network, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: collecting parameter information such as voltage, current, power and the like in a power grid in real time; comparing the parameter information with a set characteristic threshold value; processing the comparison result; inputting the information obtained by operation and processing into a low-end microprocessor for operation; outputting monitoring data in one or more sections according to the operation program and recovering a sinusoidal image; the invention starts from a low-end processor and provides a method for carrying out threshold characterization, which aims at reducing the load of a microprocessor and improving the operation precision, effectively solves the problem of restoring the power grid information by using a form of a preset restoration function, monitors the power distribution network on line and realizes effective and comprehensive evaluation, analysis and control of the power distribution network.
assignees: KUNMING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Elastic power distribution network restoration decision method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recovery decision method and a recovery decision system for an elastic power distribution network, and an EV scheduling model before disaster is established; determining a deployment position of the mobile energy storage temporary warehouse based on the distribution network line layout and the load information; a pre-deployment model of the mobile resources in the pre-disaster stage is established, so that the running cost of the mobile resources is saved, and the post-disaster load recovery process is accelerated; determining a configuration result based on a pre-disaster stage mobile resource pre-deployment model, and constructing an economic post-disaster recovery model of the elastic power distribution network by combining mobile energy storage and electric vehicles V2G by taking post-disaster recovery comprehensive economic cost as an objective function; and acquiring the deployment positions and the number of the mobile resources based on the post-disaster stage mobile energy storage and the V2G cooperative recovery model of the electric vehicle, and realizing the recovery of the post-disaster power distribution network. The invention can provide a practical and effective power supply recovery scheme aiming at different scenes, and guide an actual power system to quickly recover the power supply of the system while ensuring the dispatching economy.

title_en: Desert photovoltaic ecological environment effect evaluation method based on DPSIR model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological environment, in particular to a desert photovoltaic ecological environment effect evaluation method based on a DPSIR model, which comprises the following steps: collecting desert photovoltaic ecological environment data of a photovoltaic industrial area of a target desert area; constructing an ecological environment effect evaluation model; acquiring a first ecological environment index factor, and carrying out standardized treatment to output a standardized ecological environment evaluation index; calculating the standardized ecological environment evaluation index to output the index weight of the standardized ecological environment evaluation index; the method and the system for evaluating the ecological environment of the desert photovoltaic power station based on the comprehensive index calculate formula output area ecological environment comprehensive evaluation index evaluate the ecological environment influence of the desert photovoltaic power station from a quantitative angle for the first time, systematically construct an ecological environment effect evaluation system, analyze the influence of the construction of the photovoltaic power station on the ecological environment, and provide data support for the ecological environment protection and the ecological system restoration construction of the desert photovoltaic development area.
assignees: UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY;QINGHAI HUANGHE HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Water area pollutant emergency treatment system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water area pollutant emergency treatment system and equipment in the technical field of water pollution treatment, wherein the system comprises a plurality of water quality monitoring modules, a data collection module, a prediction module, an emergency pretreatment scheme generation module and a plurality of biological filtering components, wherein the water quality monitoring modules are used for collecting water quality elements of a covered area to generate real-time water quality data, the data collection module is used for acquiring, storing and converting the real-time water quality data, the prediction module is used for analyzing and predicting pollutant component evolution conditions based on the real-time water quality data by using a big data model to generate a pollutant component evolution condition map of the water area, the emergency pretreatment scheme generation module is used for generating a corresponding pretreatment scheme and a pretreatment position based on a pollutant diffusion range map and the pollutant component evolution condition map, and the biological filtering components are deployed at the pretreatment position to filter and clean the water area. According to the invention, plants aiming at specific pollutants are planted on the biological filter assembly, so that the ecological restoration can be realized for a long time while the pollutants in the water area are treated in an emergency manner.
assignees: SHAANXI DIKUANG HANZHONG DETECTION CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration effect-based high-diving-level coal subsidence area sloping field vegetation configuration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vegetation configuration method of a high-water-level coal subsidence area sloping field based on ecological restoration effect, which constructs a three-dimensional measurement system of soil, microorganisms and water, eliminates dimension difference by a vector normalization algorithm through a multi-scale coupling evaluation mechanism, calculates a soil nutrient retention rate (R  SFI ), and calculates a soil bacterial diversity growth rate based on a 16SrRNA sequencing result And the water eutrophication index reduction rate (R  TLI ) of the downstream ponding area generates a vegetation Ecological Restoration Index (ERI), automatically screens a vegetation configuration scheme with soil holding, microorganism growth promotion and water quality purification functions, realizes multi-parameter collaborative quantitative evaluation of the ecological restoration effect of the coal mining subsidence area, provides decision support with space-time dynamic adaptability for vegetation space layout, and remarkably improves the systematicness and accuracy of ecological restoration.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for generating water-soil environment evaluation result in river basin ecological restoration project
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for generating a water and soil environment evaluation result in a river basin ecological restoration project, which relate to the field of environmental engineering and comprise the steps of collecting water and soil environment element data, dividing a target river basin into spatial scale domains with different sizes according to the water and soil environment element data, establishing a same-scale element association mechanism in the spatial scale domains and a cross-scale element association mechanism among the spatial scale domains, respectively simulating and evaluating an ecological process meeting preset water and soil environment key process standards based on the same-scale element association mechanism and by adopting corresponding models in each spatial scale domain to obtain corresponding evaluation results, constructing a cross-scale effect model according to the cross-scale element association mechanism and the evaluation results, carrying out iterative correction based on the cross-scale effect model and a pre-constructed evaluation index system to obtain a water and soil environment comprehensive evaluation result, and returning the comprehensive evaluation result to a user side. The application improves the comprehensiveness, scientificity and timeliness of the evaluation result.
assignees: EAST CHINA ENGINEERING SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Storage battery, power management system and power management method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a storage battery and a power management system which operate stably, and a power management method.SOLUTION: The storage battery includes a charge and discharge part, a detector part, a determination part and a charge and discharge control part. The charge and discharge part charges power supplied from a system power supply, to discharge the charged power to a load. The detector part detects blackout in which power supply is stopped, and power restoration in which power supply is resumed. The determination part determines whether the power restoration is made either by the system power supply or by a distributed power supply. title_en: Vessel seaway and maneuverability supporting system for safety evacuation seaway in event of vessel accident based on evacuation level determination using real-time restoration index, and method thereof
title_ko: 실시간 복원성 지수를 이용한 대피 레벨 결정 기반 선박 사고시 안전한 대피를 지원하기 위한 선박 항로 및 선박 조종 지원 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vessel seaway and control supporting system for safety evacuation in a vessel accident based on evacuation level determination using a real-time restoration index and a method thereof. According to the present invention, provided is an effect of transferring support information for minimizing damage in abnormal and accident situations of a vessel to a decision maker in the vessel to provide the decision maker with safe and correct information in an emergency situation to drop judgement so as to cope with the emergency situation. Moreover, provided is an effect of providing vessel evacuation guide support for a fast and correct sailing decision of a captain, and providing evacuation guide through a speech and visual guidance. Moreover, provided is an effect of detecting an abnormal state of the vessel based on a low power wireless communication technology and quickly determining an evacuation level of the vessel and a passenger in the vessel accident. Above this, provided is an effect of integrally managing emergency evacuation guide including sea state and sailing environment information around an accident position in the vessel accident. According to the present invention, the system comprises an information management module, an evacuation seaway setting module, a control support module, a real-time restoration index-based evacuation level decision module, and an integrated vessel evacuation support screen providing module.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 실시간 복원성 지수를 이용한 대피 레벨 결정 기반 선박 사고시 안전한 대피를 지원하기 위한 선박 항로 및 선박 조종 지원 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명은 선박의 이상 상황 발생 및 사고 상황에서 피해를 최소화하기 위한 지원 정보를 선박 내 결정권자에게 전달, 판단력이 떨어질 수 있는 긴급한 상황에서보다 안전하고 정확한 정보를 제공하여, 비상상황을 대처할 수 있는 효과를 제공한다. 또한, 여객선을 포함한 선박 비상 사태 발생시, 신속하고 정확한 선장의 선박 운항 의사결정을 위한 선박 대피 안내 지원 및 음성과 시각적 안내를 통한 인명 대피 안내를 제공할 수 있는 효과를 제공한다. 
또한, 저전력 무선통신기술 기반으로 선내 이상 상태 조기 감지 및 선박과 승객 대피레벨 신속히 결정할 수 있도록 하기 위한 선박 사고시 안전한 대피를 지원할 수 있는 효과를 제공한다. 뿐만 아니라, 사고 지점 중심 해황(sea state)·항행(sailing) 환경 정보를 포함한 긴급대피안내 통합 운용할 수 있도록 하기 위한 선박 사고시 안전한 대피를 지원할 수 있는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Multiple failure protection/restoration methods and system in Power Optical Fiber Communication Network In China
abstract_en: The present invention provides the multiple failure protection/restoration methods and system in a kind of Power Optical Fiber Communication Network In China, the described method comprises the following steps：Obtain network topological information, business demand information and link information；The grade of service, service protection in the business demand information recover the survivability priority level for requiring to determine given business；M is set up according to the network topological information, link information：N sourcesink nodes pair；When there is multiple failure in detecting Power Optical Fiber Communication Network In China, the M that judgement pre-builds：Whether N sourcesinks node is to that can protect the link that multiple failure occurs；If it is not, then priority protection/recovery survivability priority level business high.The method of the present invention and system ensure that survivability of the power optical fiber communication network under major natural disasters; ensure that the lasting of power optical fiber communication network, reliable communication capacity; Power Optical Fiber Communication Network In China protection is enhanced to the resist ability of failure risk, the property safety of power system is protected.

title_en: Power distribution network fault treatment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network fault treatment method and belongs to the technical field of power network management. A platform comprises a fault information acquisition system, a fault information study and judgment system and a fault clearing and power failure/supply information push system. The method is characterized by acquiring information of faults requested to be cleared, line faults and consumption acquisition faults in an existing 95598 system, a distribution automation management system and a power consumption information acquisition system, after receiving and verifying the information, carrying out equipment locating, fault information screening, line topology analysis, equipment operation information analysis and line switch analysis to determine and display the fault types, places and areas of influence in an existing GIS (geographic information system), guiding fault clearing according to the determined fault results and simultaneously pushing the power failure information and power restoration information to users. The platform and the method can be used for achieving centralized acquisition and advanced automatic study and judgment of existing various fault information, can be used for actively pushing the power failure and power restoration information to the users and can interact with the users.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY CO JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;JIANGSU SUYUAN HIGH TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Radiation type loop-free power distribution network island generation method for power restoration by adopting SNOP (simple noise rejection operation)
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for generating an isolated island of a radiation type loop-free power distribution network by adopting SNOP (single operational noise) for power restoration. The method comprises the following steps: forming complete topological connection among the SNOP nodes, and classifying the topological nodes of the power distribution network containing the SNOP; gradually retrieving the island nodes according to the topological structure; and repeating the iterative retrieval algorithm to generate all the SNOP-containing power distribution network islands. The algorithm makes full use of the radial topological characteristic of the power distribution network, performs topological analysis and node definition according to the tidal current direction and the position of the SNOP equipment in the topological structure of the power distribution network, and reduces the difficulty of the analysis of the whole system. The method for generating the SNOP island algorithm according to the network topology is simple, convenient and practical, has high calculation efficiency, and is beneficial to power grid dispatching personnel to make timely optimization and adjustment according to island node combinations and power grid state indexes when an actual natural disaster occurs, so that the large-scale power failure accident of the power distribution network can be avoided by utilizing the quick power restoration capability of the SNOP.

title_en: Urban river prevention and control unit division method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for dividing urban river prevention and control units, which aims at solving the problem of dividing the prevention and control units based on water ecology and water environment characteristics by dividing a water body unit grid and classifying the prevention and control units on the basis of a prevention and control unit dividing index system, refining and adjusting the boundary of the prevention and control unit, analyzing the priority of the prevention and control unit, adopting the method for constructing the index system, dividing the grid of the water body unit, analyzing clusters, analyzing the hierarchy and evaluating the fuzzy, aiming at the prevention and control units dividing the problem of single management and control element, dividing a cutter by unit and the like, provides the urban river prevention and control unit dividing method based on the space basis of the prevention and control units based on the water ecology and water environment characteristics, and can be used for reversely pushing a water pollution treatment and water ecology restoration scheme by a treatment target, thereby not only facilitating pollution reduction performance assessment, but also having practical operability and realizing the rank ordering of the prevention and control units and providing powerful theoretical basis for developing environmental treatment.

title_en: System Having Function for Repairing Communication with Isolator Coupled to Bi-directional Communication Loop
title_ko: 양방향 통신루프에 결합된 아이솔레이터를 포함하는 통신 복구 기능을 구비한 환경감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a communication restoration method using an isolator in the power line communications of shore and marine equipment capable of rapidly monitoring a situation such as cutting a part of communication path or the like and restoring the communication path in equipment for monitoring and alarming a fire or gas situation of massive spaces such as the inside and outside of a vessel and the inside and outside of a plant or a building. A monitoring device comprises the isolator which transmits address information and performs an isolating function which blocks the communication path when a short circuit situation, a ground situation, or a disconnection situation is monitored. The system comprises two line paths and performs one way communications from a terminal of a starting lint path to a terminal of an ending line path and bidirectional communications from another terminal of the ending line path to from another terminal of the starting line path in a communication loop having two terminals at the starting line path and the ending line path. When defects such as the short circuit situation, the ground situation, or the disconnection situation is monitored at a temporary point of the communication loop, the isolator performs communications regardless of the defects such as the short circuit situation, the ground situation, or the disconnection situation by enabling the monitoring device to transmit the address information and state information in a loop of a previous defect generation point to the terminal of the starting line path and enabling another device to transmit the address information and the state information of the loop to the terminal of the ending line path in the loop after the defect generation point.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 육상 및 해상 설비에서 아이솔레이터를 이용한 통신 복구 방법에 관한 것으로, 선박 내/외부, 플랜트 또는 건물의 내/외부와 같이 대규모 공간에서 화재나 가스의 감지 및 경보를 하기 위한 설비에 있어서 통신 선로의 일부가 단선되거나 단락되는 등의 상황을 신속하게 감지하여 통신 선로를 복구할 수 있는 육상 및 해상 설비의 파워 라인을 통한 통신에서 아이솔레이터(isolator)를 이용한 통신 복구 방법을 제공하고자 하는 목적은, 상기 감지장치는 자신의 주소 정보를 전송하고, 단락, 접지 또는 단선의 감지 시, 통신 선로를 차단하는 아이솔레이팅 기능을 수행하는 아이솔레이터를 포함하고, 상기 시스템은 두 선로를 포함하고, 시작 선로 및 끝단 선로에 각기 두 단자를 갖는 통신 루프에서 상기 시작 선로의 한 단자에서 상기 끝단 선로의 한 단자로의 일 방향 통신과, 상기 끝단 선로의 다른 단자로부터 상기 시작 선로의 다른 단자로의 양방향 통신을 수행하고, 상기 아이솔레이터는 상기 한 통신 루프의 임의의 한 지점에서 단락, 접지 또는 단선과 같은 장애가 감지된 경우, 하나의 감지장치가 장애 발견 지점 이전의 루프에서 자신의 주소정보와 상태 정보를 상기 시작선로의 상기 한 단자로 전송하고, 상기 장애 발견 지점 이후의 루프에서는 다른 감지장치가 자신의 주소 정보와 루프의 상태 정보를 상기 끝단 선로의 상기 한 단자로 전송하여 단락, 접지, 단선과 같은 장애에도 불구하고 이상 없이 통신을 수행하는 것을 특징으로 하는 파워라인을 통한 통신에서 아이솔레이터를 이용한 통신 복구 방법에 의해 달성된다.

title_en: A integrated control monitoring device for the local closed circuit television for crime prevention
title_ko: 방범용 cctv 로컬용 통합 제어 감시 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated control monitoring device for a local CCTV for crime prevention. The device comprises: a local equipment connection unit (110) connected to local equipment (10) including an emergency bell (11), a camera unit (12), a warning lamp (13), and a speaker (14); an SMPS (120) configured to output driving power necessary for driving each local equipment (10); an integrated control unit (130) which performs an automatic restoration function when malfunction occurs in the local equipment; and a VoIP communication connection unit (140) connected to a VoIP master server (20) through a network. Therefore, the device enables quick maintenance.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 방범용 CCTV 로컬용 통합 제어 감시 장치에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 방범용 CCTV 로컬용 통합 제어 감시 장치로서, 비상 호출을 위한 비상벨과, 감시지역을 촬영하는 카메라부와, 비상상황을 알리기 위해 경고하는 경광등, 및 음성을 출력하는 스피커를 포함하는 로컬 장비와 연결 접속되고, 상기 로컬 장비에 대한 제어신호 및 구동전원을 공급하는 로컬 장비 접속부; 외부 교류전원(AC 220V)을 공급받아 상기 로컬 장비 접속부에 연결 접속되는 상기 로컬 장비 각각의 구동에 필요한 구동전원을 출력하는 SMPS; 상기 SMPS로부터 공급되는 구동전원을 입력받아 상기 로컬 장비 접속부로 인가되는 구동전원을 제어하여 공급하며, 상기 로컬 장비의 작동상태를 감시하고, 상기 로컬 장비의 장애 발생 시 자동복구 기능을 수행하는 통합 제어부; 및 관제센터의 VoIP 마스터 서버와 네트워크망을 통해 접속되는 VoIP 통신 접속부를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 방범용 CCTV 로컬용 통합 제어 감시 장치에 따르면, 로컬 장비에 대한 제어신호 및 구동전원을 각각 공급하기 위한 복수의 접속포트를 구비하는 로컬 장비 접속부와, 로컬 장비 각각의 구동에 필요한 구동전원을 출력하는 SMPS와, 로컬 장비의 구동전원의 제어 공급 및 로컬 장비의 통합 감시 기능을 수행하는 통합 제어부 및 VoIP 통신 접속부를 통합된 하나의 장비로 구성함으로써, 여러 종류로 분류되어 다양한 구동전원을 필요로 하는 로컬 장비가 차지하는 공간을 최소화하고, 케이블 결선을 간소화하여 설치의 편리성을 도모하고, 그로 인한 설치시간을 현저히 단축시킬 수 있도록 하는 등의 작업성이 향상될 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 통합 제어부를 통해 로컬 장비로 접속되는 비상벨, 복수의 카메라를 구비하는 카메라부, 경광등, 및 스피커의 구동을 제어함으로써, 로컬 장비의 관리 제어가 용이하고, 주변 장비인 카메라, 경광등, 스피커 등의 동작유무를 자체 점검하여 장애 발생 시 자동복구를 시도하고, 그 결과에 대한 정보를 관제센터의 VoIP 마스터 서버에 통보하여 신속한 유지보수가 이루어질 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명은, 관제센터의 VoIP 마스터 서버로부터 실시간 장애 여부를 모니터링 받음으로써, 통합 제어 감시 장치의 장애에 대한 신속한 대처가 가능하고, 그로인한 방범용 CCTV로서의 본연의 기능을 최대한 가능하도록 함에 따른 범죄에 대한 신속한 대처를 통한 범죄 피해가 최소화될 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for power outage and restoration notification in an advanced metering infrastructure network
abstract_en: A method and system are provided to transmit a meter power status. The method includes recognizing a power status change at a meter. The method includes, if the meter is scheduled to transmit first, transmitting a notification message to at least one neighboring meter towards a mesh gate, wherein the notification message includes a power status indicator and a meter identifier. The method includes, if the meter is not scheduled to transmit first, waiting a predetermined time period to receive a notification message from at least one neighboring meter. The method includes, responsive to receiving a notification message, adding a meter identifier to the received notification message before retransmitting the modified notification message to at least one neighboring meter. The method includes retransmitting the notification message.

title_en: Electric power marketing charging method and electric power marketing charging engine
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power marketing charging method and an electric power marketing charging engine, wherein the electric power marketing charging engine is configured into a plurality of flow components according to a charging flow in advance, an electric quantity and electric charge calculation flow component is divided into a plurality of different primary components according to charging rules of different nationwide provinces (cities) in advance, the primary components are divided into a plurality of secondary components and expansion points according to the charging rules in advance, and places with inconsistent charging rules and inconsistent implementation modes of the nationwide provinces (cities) are unified. The client data required by charging is synchronously stored in the charging database as a snapshot, so that the subsequent electric quantity and electric charge calculation is facilitated, the electric quantity and electric charge calculation result is subjected to charge examination, the accuracy of the calculation result is improved, the problems of low charging speed and low efficiency caused by 'taking and calculating while' in the prior art are solved, the charging result is not influenced even if abnormal conditions such as power failure and power restoration occur in the charging process, and the stability and the reliability of the electric quantity and electric charge calculation are improved.

title_en: Method for determining proper planting distance for vegetation ecological restoration in arid region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining a proper planting distance for vegetation ecological restoration in a arid region, which comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring soil parameters and soil water parameters of a research area; step 2, determining vegetation parameters of a research area; step 3, collecting hydrologic data of a research area; step 4, determining the transpiration quantity of dominant plant species of vegetation communities in the research area; step 5, calculating the thickness of the diving influence layer in the research area; step 6, determining the thickness of the absorbable utilization layer; step 7, determining the water content in the thickness of the absorbable utilization layer; step 8, determining a proper planting distance of vegetation; the method can effectively solve the problem of desertification of the oasis in the arid region, and provides reliable theoretical and technical support for guiding ecological restoration and reasonable development and utilization of groundwater resources.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Intelligent management and operation guarantee system for marine ecological protection and repair
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent management and operation guarantee system for marine ecological protection and repair, which relates to the technical field of marine ecology and comprises a monitoring module, an evaluation module, a data analysis and prediction module, an intelligent decision and support module, a resource scheduling and management module and a safety management and emergency response module. The marine ecological data can be collected in real time through the monitoring module, including information such as water quality, temperature, salinity, etc., the efficiency and the accuracy of monitoring are improved, help in time discover ecological problems, the evaluation module analyzes ecological state according to the monitoring data, evaluate threat and risk that the ecology faces, provide scientific basis for formulating corresponding protection and restoration strategy, data analysis and prediction module utilizes machine learning technology to process data, generate prediction model, provide scientific support for the decision, make the decision more intelligent and accurate, resource scheduling and management module intelligently distributes resources according to demand and priority, ensure smooth going on of protection and restoration work.
assignees: SHANGHAI MIAORUI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-earthquake urban road network restoration time sequence optimization method based on toughness evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-earthquake urban road network restoration time sequence optimization method based on toughness assessment, which comprises the following steps of S1, determining a target urban traffic road network structure, obtaining a target road network earthquake damage condition, S2, confirming damaged road sections, carrying out sequencing numbering on the road sections to be restored, S3, calculating restoration time of each road section to be restored by combining constraint conditions, S4, confirming the node weight and node communication efficiency of the target road network, calculating a road network performance index, S5, taking the road network toughness optimum as a target, establishing a target function, S6, judging whether the target road network has islands, and solving the target function through a genetic algorithm to obtain the optimum restoration time sequence. Under the constraint conditions of limited time, resources and the like, the method and the system of the invention preferentially repair and eliminate the key road sections of 'island', quickly organize traffic restoration work, reduce post-disaster loss as much as possible, ensure better network restoration effect and provide theoretical support for emergency management.

title_en: Electric energy metering data restoration method based on graph neural network and time sequence attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric energy metering data restoration method based on a graph neural network and a time sequence attention mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent power grids. According to the invention, the power consumer network is modeled as a graph structure, the graph neural network model is utilized to capture the spatial dependency relationship among users, the time sequence attention module is utilized to capture the time sequence dynamic characteristics of the electric energy metering data, and finally the spatial characteristics and the time characteristics are fused, so that the high-precision electric energy metering data restoration is realized. The method specifically comprises the following steps of data preprocessing and graph construction, spatial feature extraction, temporal feature extraction, feature fusion and dynamic training.
assignees: HANGZHOU ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD;FUYANG RONGDA COMPLETE ELECTRICAL MFG BRANCH HANGZHOU ELECTRIC POWER EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: Micro-topography reconstruction and ecological restoration system for alpine arid coal mining area
abstract_en: The invention provides a micro-topography reconstruction and ecological restoration system for a severe cold arid coal mining area, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration of coal mining areas, and comprises the steps of screening out a sample area by an area screening module, and acquiring time sequence data of ground water level and landform parameters of the sample area; the model construction and simulation module acquires the underground predicted water level, the data processing and analysis module generates a terrain influence coefficient and a proper groundwater level coefficient, and the comprehensive evaluation module integrates the proper groundwater level coefficient and the terrain influence coefficient to generate a comprehensive evaluation coefficient so as to guide corresponding ecological restoration measures. The invention can capture multidimensional factors and complex correlations affecting the groundwater level, remarkably improve the accuracy and the reliability when predicting the groundwater level change, and can timely adjust the repairing measures according to the suitability of the groundwater level so as to ensure the effectiveness and the sustainability of ecological repairing.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: Wind-solar combined power generation power prediction method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a wind-solar combined power generation power prediction method and a wind-solar combined power generation power prediction system based on deep learning, which relate to the technical field of wind-solar power generation, and comprise the steps of acquiring a historical meteorological data set and a historical power generation data set in a preset area; performing outlier detection and missing value restoration on a historical meteorological data set to generate a target historical meteorological data set and a problem mask, splicing the target historical meteorological data set and the problem mask to generate a modeling input matrix, performing missing value restoration on the historical generating capacity data set to obtain a target historical generating capacity data set, constructing a wind-light generation combined prediction model based on deep learning, training the wind-light generation combined prediction model according to the modeling input matrix and the target historical generating capacity data set, obtaining a trained wind-light generation combined prediction model by monitoring the change of a preset loss function, collecting real-time meteorological data of a preset area, and predicting wind-light combined power according to the trained model and the real-time meteorological data. In this way, accurate prediction of wind and solar power generation is achieved.

title_en: Cross-domain multi-data center storage management method oriented to computational and electrical fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storage management method of a cross-domain multiple data center for computing and electrofusion, which comprises the steps of 1) carrying out cross-domain abstract modeling on data center storage resources distributed in different regions, namely distributing global unique identifications or paths for the data centers, abstracting storage nodes of the data centers into unified logic storage pools, generating a resource vector according to the storage capacity, computing power and power states of the data centers as ternary coupling virtualization representation of the data centers, 2) carrying out joint optimization on data storage based on power supply, network bandwidth and storage load, transferring task data which are determined to be high concurrent and high I/O load to the corresponding data centers, and reducing energy consumption through cache classification and I/O path optimization, and 3) carrying out consistency check on data copies among the data centers, and carrying out trend analysis on the load and power of the storage nodes by utilizing a prediction model based on time sequences, so as to realize fault tolerance and self-adaption restoration on the storage nodes.
assignees: SICHUAN TIANFU NEW AREA COSMIC RAY RES CENTER;INST HIGH ENERGY PHYSICS CAS

title_en: System and Method for Providing Power Distribution System Information
abstract_en: A system, method and computer program product for processing utility data of a power grid is provided. In one embodiment, the system includes a datamart comprised of a plurality of physical databases storing utility data, a plurality of applications comprising an automated meter application configured to process power usage data from a plurality of automated meters, a power outage application configured to identify a location of a power outage, and a power restoration application configured to identify a location of a power restoration. The system may include an analysis engine comprising a plurality of analysis objects with each analysis object configured to process data to provide a specific analysis, wherein said analysis engine is accessible via one or more of the plurality of applications, and the system may include a report module configured to receive an output from the analysis engine and to output a report. The plurality of applications may also include a fault analysis application, a transformer analysis application, a theft detection application, a power flow application, a substation automation application, a load shed application and others.

title_en: A kind of load of overload circuit is poured out and restoration methods automatically
abstract_en: The load that the invention discloses a kind of overload circuit is poured out and restoration methods automatically, and it comprises the following steps: 1) obtain real-time distribution line parameter, periodically calculates the load factor of distribution line; 2) overload early-warning; 3) overload is poured out; 4) overload recovers.Distribution wire running status in fixed cycle monitoring system of the present invention, starts overload distribution wire early warning mechanism when monitoring distribution wire overload; When distribution wire overload, automatically the sub-load on overload distribution line can be poured out light-loaded circuit by interconnection switch, thus realize this circuit and normally run; After load is poured out, do not causing under circuit overload prerequisite, overload distribution wire load can returned to and pour out front supply power mode.Present invention achieves automatically pouring out of overload distribution wire load, ensure that the safety and economic operation of power equipment, extend power equipment service life, decrease the user's power outage because distribution wire overload causes.

title_en: Distribution based on multiple agent answers calamity to recover control method for coordinating and device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of distribution based on multiple agent and answers calamity to recover control method for coordinating and device,Determine that the object function and constraints of calamity recovery are answered in distribution first,It it is the key routing restoration stage by by distribution network restoration divided stages,Local distribution Restoration stage and area networking Restoration stage,Then each stage of the distribution network restoration is respectively set to key recovery Agent,It is local to match somebody with somebody network recovery Agent,Area networking recovers Agent,Set up the MAS coordination mechanisms based on blackboard model,Set up based on MAS with network recovery control decision system,Be restored result,The restoration result is verified using verification Agent,Obtain final restoration result,The final restoration result is transferred to User interface agent by the global repair Agent,Terminating distribution answers calamity to recover,Which thereby enhance the reliability of power system power supply,Especially under the conditions of natural calamity power system power supply reliability,Improve electric grid investment income.

title_en: Large-scale ground surface arthropod space distribution simulation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-scale ground surface arthropod space distribution simulation method, which comprises the following steps of firstly, obtaining the ground surface arthropod number of each sampling point and multisource environment variables influencing arthropod distribution; then, establishing a large-scale ground surface arthropod spatial distribution simulation model according to the ground surface arthropod number of each sampling point and the multi-source environment variables; finally, collecting large-scale multi-source environment variables of the region to be simulated; and inputting the large-scale multi-source environment variable of the area to be simulated into the large-scale ground surface arthropod spatial distribution simulation model, and simulating the large-scale ground surface arthropod spatial distribution condition of the area to be simulated. The large-scale simulation of the space distribution of the arthropods on the ground surface is realized, a better basis can be provided for ecological restoration design and management decision and the like of a mining area by utilizing the large-scale simulation result of the space distribution of the arthropods on the ground surface of the mining area, and the method is a necessary means for evaluating the comprehensive treatment effect of the mountain water forest field, the lake and the grass in the mining area.

title_en: NAS data reduction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of system disaster recovery, and discloses a NAS data reduction method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a time to be restored from a received NAS data restoration instruction; acquiring to-be-restored change file information from a preset change file list from the to-be-restored time to the current time, wherein the preset change file list comprises a plurality of pieces of information obtained by carrying out deep data packet detection on network data passing through NAS equipment; and carrying out data restoration based on the file information to be restored. According to the method and the device for restoring the NAS data, the to-be-restored change file information from the to-be-restored time to the current time is obtained from the preset change file list, the information in the preset change file list is obtained through deep data packet detection on the network data of the NAS device, and then data restoration is carried out based on the to-be-restored change file information, so that the time for restoring the data can be saved, the NAS device is compatible, and the NAS data restoring performance is improved.

title_en: Efficient data restoration
abstract_en: A data center communicates with a cloud-based backup system. Client-server roles are established such that a client role is assigned to the data center and a server role is assigned to the cloud-based backup system. On an ongoing basis, backup operations are performed. In the event of disaster or other cause of an outage of the data center, a failover protocol might be invoked such that the cloud-based backup system takes on additional processing operations beyond the aforementioned backup operations. After remediation, the data center issues a data restoration message to the cloud-based backup system. The remediated data center initiates a failback protocol that reverses the client-server roles of the data center and the cloud-based backup system such that the server role is assigned to the data center and the client role is assigned to the cloud-based backup system. After performing system restoration operations, the roles may be reversed again.

title_en: Power failure and restoration analysis and emergency repair management system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stop to reply electric analysis and salvage management system, include: after the power consumption information acquisition platform receives the power-off/power-on event uploaded by the terminal, real-time data sharing is realized with the big data application management platform, the big data application management platform accurately positions the power-off branch and pushes the power-off branch to a target end for realizing emergency repair through the power supply service command platform, and therefore the technical effects of intelligent analysis and emergency repair when the power-off event happens actively are achieved.
assignees: Fuzhou Power Supply Company Of State Grid Fujian Electric Power Company;GREAT POWER SCIENCE AND TECH STOCK CO LTD STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CORPORATION

title_en: Power system black-start online recovery decision support platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power system black-start online recovery decision support platform. The decision support platform comprises a hardware frame, a software structure, a black-start recovery target grid frame intelligent generation method, and an online recovery intelligent decision support method. The black-start online recovery decision support platform can determine a target grid frame which should be recovered first according to the topological structure of a power grid and the power and load distribution in the power grid, and offer micro guidance to dispatchers in making a subsequent recovery plan. Further, on the basis of determining an optimization principle in accordance with the actual conditions of the power grid, the real-time operating condition of the system is tracked, the optimal recovery sequence of each recovery phase is calculated dynamically, and an online decision support platform aiming at the specific operation process of emergency recovery is provided for dispatchers.
assignees: YUNNAN ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCH CONTROL CT;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELEC POWER

title_en: Construction method of integral repairing structure of landslide of riverside road
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction method of an integral restoration structure of a landslide of a river-facing road, which is characterized in that a stable grouting pipe and a grouting stabilizing body are adopted to stabilize a loose soil body at the lower part of an embankment, and a reinforcing rib net and an oblique supporting rib are adopted to stabilize a soil body at the upper part of the embankment; the prefabricated bottom support body comprises a foundation anchor pier, a pier top connecting plate and a plate top connecting groove; the plate surfaces of the bottom baffle and the middle baffle are provided with conical seepage-proof holes, and the back side of the wall is sequentially provided with a loose backfill body and a light backfill body from bottom to top; synchronously carrying out hydraulic compaction and surface vibration compaction on the loose backfill body by adopting the combined compact body; a reinforcing tie bar is arranged between the tie bar anchor plate and an embankment soil body, and the periphery of the reinforcing tie bar is pressed to form an anti-pulling grouting tenon; the movable sliding grooves in the greening planting groove and the top baffle are connected through connecting sliding falcon, and the floating support connecting groove is pasted on the periphery of the greening planting groove. The invention can not only improve the bearing performance of the waterside embankment, but also reduce the difficulty of embankment greening.

title_en: Method for determining target value of restoration of target pollutants in underground water of sulfur smelting area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining a target pollutant restoration target value in underground water of a sulfur smelting area, which comprises the steps of S1, screening target pollutants, S101, determining an exceeding pollutant, S102, determining input parameters of a migration model, S103, judging whether the exceeding pollutant has pollution risks, S104, judging health risks of the exceeding pollutant with pollution risks, and S2, calculating the restoration target value, wherein the method screens key pollutants which are necessary to be restored and managed for a long time from various pollutants through model calculation, calculates the restoration target value, reduces management cost and greatly reduces underground water pollution degree of the sulfur smelting area.

title_en: Ship navigation sea wave dynamic space-time forecasting method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of marine environment prediction, and discloses a ship navigation sea wave dynamic space-time prediction method and system based on deep learning. The method comprises the steps of carrying out space-time alignment, missing value restoration and standardization processing on collected ship AIS data and ERA5 analysis data sets, generating node characteristic vectors comprising longitude and latitude, time stamps, wind speeds and effective wave heights, quantifying the importance of ship track nodes and the time-space interaction relation through node characteristic codes, center codes, space codes and time codes, constructing SeaGraph models, outputting effective wave height predicted values of target waypoints, and carrying out verification. The invention breaks through the space-time constraint of the traditional static modeling framework, integrates the advantages of a self-attention mechanism and a graph network, strengthens the predictive modeling capability of dynamic evolution of the square wave field before the ship sails, and provides high-precision sea wave forecasting support for intelligent ship sailing under complex sea conditions.
assignees: QINGDAO INNOVATION DEVELOPMENT CENTER OF HARBIN ENGINEERING UNIV;UNIV HARBIN ENG

title_en: Device and method for adjusting electricity consumption of a plurality of lighting devices of a lighting system
abstract_en: The invention is based on the idea that control of power consumption in a system comprising power consuming devices like lighting devices, for example, can be performed by dividing the power consuming devices of the system into a plurality of groups and by taking into account power consumption or load shedding or restoration capability for each group. Further, the invention implements an auction mechanism for adjusting power consumption or load in the lighting system such that an effective, fast, user requirements considering and lighting device functions and characteristics considering adjusting is achieved.

title_en: Drought recovery potential evaluation method based on improved combined drought index
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster risk assessment, in particular to a drought restoration potential assessment method based on an improved joint drought index, which comprises the following steps: s10, preprocessing original precipitation data; s20, calculating an edge distribution function of the precipitation sequence; s30, converting to obtain a standardized precipitation index SPI of the precipitation sequence with 1-12 time scales; s40, screening out main components of the standardized precipitation index SPI by adopting a main component analysis method; s50, constructing a joint distribution function among the main components by adopting a high-dimensional C-vine copula function; s60, taking the Kendall distribution function as a probability distribution function of the combined distribution function, and judging the probability that the cumulative probability does not exceed a critical value; s70, obtaining an MJDI index model through standard normal distribution conversion; s80, calculating the precipitation required when the drought is recovered to the normal state in the next month and the probability of obtaining the precipitation correspondingly. Compared with the method based on the ecological water demand prediction, the method can directly reflect the real condition of the drought severity degree, and has low calculation dimensionality and high calculation accuracy.

title_en: Green mine construction planning method based on live-action three-dimensional modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green mine construction planning method based on live-action three-dimensional modeling, which comprises the steps of obtaining geographic data of a target area, constructing a point cloud model and a TIN model, constructing an original landform live-action three-dimensional model, constructing a mining area mining planning live-action three-dimensional model and constructing an ecological restoration planning live-action three-dimensional model. Preferably, under the condition that the mine has the hidden danger of geological disasters, before the step of constructing the ecological restoration planning live-action three-dimensional model, the method also comprises the step of constructing a mining area disaster treatment planning live-action three-dimensional model. The invention has the advantages that the unmanned aerial vehicle oblique photography technology and the three-dimensional geographic information software platform are comprehensively utilized, the two-dimensional plane design conversion three-dimensional model, the design model and the current situation real scene three-dimensional model are fused, the mine exploitation, the staged exploitation and greening, the geological disaster treatment and the post-exploitation ecological restoration design scheme are truly presented in the real scene three-dimensional model, and objective and intuitive scientific evaluation support is provided for the construction of green mines.

title_en: Damping energy-consuming beam falling prevention device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a roof beam device is prevented falling by shock attenuation power consumption contains two metal damping units, metal damping unit contains at least one U type section, two stand both sides, every are located respectively to the metal damping unit connect respectively in stand and connecting plate, the deformation direction adaptation of metal damping unit the roof beam body for the moving direction of stone pad. The device has the advantages that the anti-falling beam device has remarkable damping and energy dissipation capacity, the structural form is reasonable and simple, the structural size is small, the stress of a pier is reduced, the bridge structure is protected, the post-earthquake restoration is facilitated, the secondary hard-resistance limiting capacity is realized, the direction is provided for the reconstruction of the existing bridge adopting the stone-cushioned anti-falling beam device, the application prospect is good, and the device has great significance for the construction of high-intensity areas of railway bridges in China.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY ERYUAN ENG GROUP;CHENGDU DATONG ROAD & BRIDGE COMPONENTS CO LTD;SICHUAN TIECHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional operation management system of intelligent power grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional operation management system of an intelligent power grid. The three-dimensional operation management system is constructed on a software system architecture according to the following steps: a client server system is used, a data architecture adopts a distribution and centralization combined structure so as to achieve a purpose of smooth compiling and interacting of a graphics system; an open database system is utilized, and a special power system database is used as the database system; a three-layer system architecture technology is utilized so that a GIS (Geographic Information System) simultaneously supports a Client/Server mode and an Internet mode; and a seamless data integration technology is adopted according to the following steps: a database model reflecting a real world is established through using an object oriented technology, all space data and non-space data are stored in the same relation database, and the data submission, backup and restoration technologies are provided. By using the three-dimensional operation management system of the intelligent power grid, client system resources can be utilized to the largest extent, the database of the system has flexibility and relatively good scalability, and the application requirement on the three-dimensional operation of the intelligent power grid is fully satisfied.
assignees: NANXINDA IMAGE TECHNOLOGY ENGINEERING SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: data cloud backup method and system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of data cloud backup method and system.Method includes：Persistently replicated by forward direction, by the data variation storage of data base on production server to medium storage server, after data variation is preserved by medium storage server, then be distributed to corresponding Disaster Recovery Service；When the data base on production server cannot work on, make Disaster Recovery Service adapter legacy data storehouse system, and the data variation produced after Disaster Recovery Service adapter original system is sent to medium storage server, data variation is preserved by medium storage server；To after production server, data variation of the Standby control server by Disaster Recovery Service after the system of adapter legacy data storehouse is sent to production server to interior data recovery during restoration.
assignees: BEIJING XUJI ELECTRICAL CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A kind of load restoration method for considering the cold and hot startup gap of unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of load restoration method for considering the cold and hot startup gap of unit, load to be restored is selected according to the cold and hot starting state of unit based on preference strategy, power failure network load Restoration model is set up, using artificial bee colony algorithm solving model, load restoration scheme is obtained.This method mainly includes：1st, the ranked knowledge base of each load bus is set up according to the position of the cold and hot starting state of unit and load bus；2nd, the preference strategy of selection load point to be restored is determined based on qualitative preference description language and the ranked knowledge base of load point；3rd, load restoration Optimized model is set up；4th, load restoration scheme is obtained using artificial bee colony algorithm solving model.The present invention makes full use of the cold and hot startup gap of unit to recover the load on unit starting circuit and periphery, and both avoided increases the time of load restoration due to putting into new circuit, while load restoration amount is also increased, with certain theory value and construction value.

title_en: Production safety accident scene construction and emergency capacity construction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production safety accident scene construction and emergency capacity construction system, which adopts a technical route of scene analysis, task combing and capacity evaluation, and comprises risk management and emergency work management, wherein the risk management and the emergency work management are carried out in a circulating way, and the emergency work management comprises four processes of emergency preparation, emergency response, restoration reconstruction and prevention and disaster reduction. According to the invention, through research and judgment based on a large number of related typical accident cases at home and abroad, the logic chain and the common law of occurrence and development of related major accidents are researched and mastered, the core elements of the scenes are determined, the risk list and the task combing list are listed, a foundation is laid for construction of the related scenes and improvement of emergency capacity, the typical scenes of the typical cases are constructed through quantitative analysis of accident consequences based on mathematical modeling and computer simulation, the related emergency tasks of key nodes of the scenes are determined, and the practicability of construction of production safety scenes is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHONGZHIAN CO LTD;HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUANENG CHONGQING LIANGJIANG GAS TURBINE POWER GENERATION CO LTD;CHANGCHUN THERMAL POWER PLANT OF HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Communication emergency guarantee method and device suitable for electric power scene
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of communication emergency, and discloses a communication emergency guarantee method and a device suitable for an electric power scene, the method comprises the steps of system monitoring and fault evaluation, communication recovery strategy selection, field communication guarantee and information collection and transmission, and the device corresponds to the method. The method and the system realize monitoring of the running state of the power communication system and evaluation of the influence range and severity of the fault through system monitoring and fault evaluation, further realize reasonable evaluation of the power communication fault and reservation of an elastic space, realize emergency communication means selection and determination of the order of priority restoration of communication objects through communication restoration strategy selection, realize targeted manpower and material resource distribution of emergency communication security personnel and a field command center through field communication security, realize collection of power communication fault information, emergency repair progress condition and transmission decision security information through information collection and transmission, optimize communication emergency security process, and finally realize communication emergency security applicable to power scenes.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Distribution network dynamic topology identification and self-healing control method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network dynamic topology identification and self-healing control method and device, which comprise the steps of collecting operation data of a distribution network, carrying out time synchronization processing, data quality assessment and data restoration to obtain a high-quality network state data set, carrying out dynamic topology identification by adopting a path improved by a relaxation method and a forest enhancement algorithm based on the data set to obtain a dynamic network topology model, constructing a knapsack network model by adopting a cyclic data generation method, assessing distributed photovoltaic output and load conditions, monitoring network abnormality in real time, adopting a machine learning algorithm to assist in judging fault types, positions and influence ranges, comprehensively considering power supply reliability and economy, adopting a multi-objective optimization algorithm to generate a switch operation sequence, executing switch operation to form a temporary micro-network or adjusting a power supply path, and carrying out real-time monitoring and assessment on an execution effect. The method can accurately identify the dynamic topology of the distributed photovoltaic power distribution network with high proportion, and realize fault location and high-efficiency self-healing control.
assignees: YANCHENG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;DONGTAI POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;JIANGSU MAOYUAN ELECTRICAL CO LTD

title_en: The arm of hydraulic machine comprising inside flow passage for disaster recovery
title_ko: 내부유로를 포함하는 재난 복구용 유압기계의 암
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an arm of a hydraulic machine for disaster restoration, including an inner flow path. According to the present invention, the arm of a hydraulic machine for disaster restoration includes: multiple links; multiple joints connected to the multiple links; and one or more linear actuators formed in order for the multiple joints to move. The one or more linear actuators include: a housing having an inner space capable of accommodating a fluid; a piston receiving pressure from the fluid accommodated in the inner space and reciprocating in the longitudinal direction; a piston rod connected to the piston by passing through the housing; and a hinge unit connected to the outer side of an outer end of the piston rod or the housing and having the inner flow path. The arm of a hydraulic machine for disaster restoration also includes a connection pin connecting the linear actuator and the link and supplying oil pressure to the piston through the flow path formed inside. According to the present invention, the arm of a hydraulic machine for disaster restoration, including the inner flow path, is prevented from being damaged as the arm of a hydraulic machine for disaster restoration does not have a hose exposed to the outside. So, the flow path is formed in a member, and influence by elasticity can be minimized. Therefore, the arm of a hydraulic machine for disaster restoration can be accurately controlled.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 복수의 링크, 복수의 링크가 연결되는 복수의 관절, 복수의 관절이 움직일 수 있도록 구성된 하나 이상의 리니어 액추에이터를 포함하며, 하나 이상의 리니어 액추에이터는, 유체가 수용될 수 있는 내부공간이 형성되는 하우징, 내부공간에 수용된 유체로부터 압력을 전달받아 길이방향으로 왕복운동 가능하도록 구성된 피스톤, 하우징을 관통하여 피스톤과 연결되는 피스톤 로드, 및 하우징 또는 피스톤 로드의 외측 끝단에 외부와 연결되며, 내부유로가 형성된 힌지부를 포함하며, 리니어 액추에이터와 링크를 연결하도록 구성되며, 내부에 형성된 유로로 피스톤에 유압을 공급할 수 있도록 구성된 연결핀을 포함하는 내부유로를 포함하는 재난 복구용 유압기계의 암에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 내부유로를 포함하는 재난 복구용 유압기계의 암은, 외부에 노출된 호스가 없어 파손의 위험이 없으며, 부재 자체 내부에 유로가 형성되므로 탄성에 의한 영항을 최소화 할 수 있어 정밀한 제어가 가능한 효과가 있다.

title_en: MCMC algorithm-based power acquisition data restoration method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power acquisition data restoration method based on MCMC algorithm, belonging to the field of power acquisition data restoration, wherein the method can realize restoration of null value of power acquisition data by using acquired historical data through MCMC algorithm, and fills data in a mode of combining multiple algorithms, so that the accuracy of supplemented data is higher, the demand on the historical data is relatively smaller, the restoration efficiency is higher, and the reusability is higher; the method can efficiently and accurately repair the missing data and improve the accuracy of power grid electric quantity statistics. The problems that in the prior art, the implementation mode is single, the accuracy of supplemented data is relatively low, and the calculation efficiency is low are solved.

title_en: Novel self-vibration-resistant bracket
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel self-recovery type anti-seismic bracket, which is characterized in that a weight is connected through a U-shaped hanging buckle, the outside is supported against the elastic support of channel steel through a first disc-shaped reed and a second disc-shaped reed, and the support of a first spring plate connecting piece and a second spring plate connecting piece enables a cable-stayed type stabilizing piece to laterally support a bearing screw and the outside resisting channel steel, so that the outside resisting channel steel can absorb shock and resist vibration when being stretched by external force, and natural buffering and resetting are carried out under the support of the cable-stayed type stabilizing piece, so that post-disaster restoration is not needed.

title_en: Distribution network line rapid power restoration capability analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network line quick-speed re-energizing capacity analysis method and system, which are used for providing distribution network line quick-speed re-energizing capacity indexes through a distribution network line net rack quantification analysis principle, carrying out block division on the distribution network line according to distribution network line equipment account data, distribution network line automatic switching account data and distribution network line topological structure data, analyzing the number of users of quick-speed re-energizing blocks when the blocks are failed, and analyzing the total quantity of equivalent equipment in each block, so that the block quick-speed re-energizing capacity and the distribution network line quick-speed re-energizing capacity are calculated, the fault quick-speed recovering capacity of the distribution network line is dynamically and quantitatively analyzed, and support is provided for improving the distribution network automatic construction effect and carrying out safe and reliable operation on the distribution network.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle rescue scheduling optimization method and device based on semantic translation modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle rescue scheduling optimization method and device based on semantic translation modeling, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue intelligent scheduling, comprising the steps of obtaining emergency rescue task description information; the method comprises the steps of converting natural language rules in task description information into standardized constraint expressions, identifying response time targets, coverage area targets, resource parameters and network structure parameters, constructing an initial scheduling model, solving the initial scheduling model through an improved multi-target optimization algorithm to obtain an initial scheduling scheme of the unmanned aerial vehicle, constructing a dynamic re-optimization model by taking the initial scheduling scheme as a disturbance reference when an interference event in the execution process of the initial scheduling scheme is detected, solving the dynamic re-optimization model by taking scheme disturbance cost and arrival delay time as optimization targets, outputting a repair scheduling scheme and an interpretable decision result, and remarkably improving the accuracy, instantaneity and decision reliability of emergency rescue scheduling.

title_en: Sprinkler with improved plug opening structure
title_ko: 플러그 개방 구조 개선형 스프링클러
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sprinkler with an improved plug opening structure, which comprises: a sprinkler main body having an upper inlet through which fire extinguishing water is introduced and a lower outlet connected thereto; a deflector blocking an outlet side of the inlet in the main body and ejecting the fire extinguishing water in all directions when descending; a cylindrical housing coupled to the outlet of the main body and having a vertically penetrating hollow portion for an ejection operation of the deflector therein; a plug disposed in a hollow portion of the housing to support the deflector; and an actuator for fixing the plug and separating the plug downward from the hollow portion of the housing in the event of a fire. The plug supporting the deflector is fixed by a plurality of balls, and when the rotator is rotated by contraction and restoration of a linear structure shape memory alloy wire by heat in the event of a fire, the plurality of balls are retracted when the rotator is rotated by contraction and restoration of the linear structure shape memory alloy wire by heat, so that the supported and released plug and the deflector are automatically opened to eject the fire extinguishing water.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소화수가 유입되는 상부 유입구와 이에 연결되는 하부 분출구를 갖는 스프링클러 본체; 상기 본체에서 유입구의 출구 측을 차단하며 하강 시 소화수를 사방으로 분출시키는 디플렉터(deflector); 상기 본체의 분출구에 결합되며 내부에 상기 디플렉터의 출(出) 동작을 위한 상하 관통형 중공(中空)부를 갖는 원통형 하우징; 상기 하우징의 중공부에 배치되어 상기 디플렉터를 지지하는 플러그; 및 상기 플러그를 고정하고 있다가 화재 발생 시 상기 하우징의 중공부로부터 상기 플러그를 하방 이탈시키기 위한 액추에이터(actuator);를 포함하도록 구현함으로써, 디플렉터를 지지하고 있는 플러그가 다수의 볼에 의해 고정되어 있다가 화재 발생 시 열에 의한 선형 구조 형상기억합금 와이어의 수축 복원을 이용해 로테이터를 회전시키면 다수의 볼이 후퇴됨에 따라 지지 해제된 플러그 및 디플렉터가 자동 개방되어 소화수가 분출될 수 있도록 한 플러그 개방 구조 개선형 스프링클러에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KIM SU YEOB;KIM HAN SONG;JITEL GLOBAL CO LTD

title_en: Ecological environment treatment device for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ecological environment treatment device for geological disasters, which comprises an equipment main body, a supporting seat and a material pouring port, wherein the bottom of the equipment main body is fixedly connected with the supporting seat, the middle part of the top of the equipment main body is fixedly connected with the material pouring port, the top of the material pouring port is movably connected with a sealing cover, one side of the equipment main body is embedded and connected with a water inlet part, the top of the water inlet part is embedded and connected with a control valve, the control valve can control the conveying speed of mixed liquid from the water inlet part, the material enters a treatment block, particles between a conditioner and the conditioner can be mixed to a certain degree firstly, the equipment main body can be filled with water through the water outlet and inlet part, the conditioner and the water are fully stirred and mixed, the conditioner particles are mixed, a filter screen can be detached and replaced, the efficiency and the progress of soil salinization treatment are improved, the protective effect on geology is achieved, is suitable for ecological restoration and has wide development prospect in the future.

title_en: Ecological restoration greening device for high-steep rock wall hidden grid hanging basket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of ecological restoration of high-steep slopes, in particular to an ecological restoration greening device for a high-steep rock wall hidden grid hanging basket. The utility model forms an integral U-shaped ecological restoration greening bulge by using a hanging basket, anchor rods, galvanized iron wires and an ecological bag, wherein the hidden grid hanging basket is formed by adopting a transverse 3-row sleeve (2), a middle horizontal U-shaped rib (3), a vertical 4-row U-shaped rib (4), two hanging ribs (5) on two sides, two transverse ribs (6) at the bottom end, a main anchor rod/auxiliary anchor rod (7), a vertical ecological bag (8) and a galvanized iron wire net (9), and all parts are welded and connected. The utility model has the economic effects that the hidden grid hanging basket is prefabricated by a factory, the greening device is simple, the construction process is simple, the ecological restoration cost is low, the construction speed is high, the greening effect is quick, the ecological environment is further and quickly restored, the problems of high construction cost and long time of the current high-steep slope greening are solved, and simultaneously, the geological disaster is prevented and treated to a certain extent.

title_en: Ecological restoration structure for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster ecological restoration structure, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster ecological restoration and comprises a grounding nail and a planting frame, wherein a steel wire rope is fixedly connected between the grounding nail and the planting frame, an installation disc is sleeved on the outer surface of the grounding nail, an annular groove is formed in the lower side surface of the installation disc, a clamping groove is formed in the inner wall of the annular groove, the annular groove is also formed in an annular shape, a protection cylinder is arranged on the outer surface of the grounding nail, the protection cylinder is matched with the annular groove, the inner wall of the protection cylinder is slidably connected with a displacement cylinder, the lower side surface of the displacement cylinder extends out of the lower side surface of the protection cylinder, a fixing component can be unlocked by means of displacement cylinder movement, and meanwhile, the unlocking and the taking out can be completed by means of one action due to the fact that the displacement direction of the displacement cylinder is uniform, and meanwhile, the protection cylinder cannot fall down in hands after being separated.

title_en: Power distribution network fault recovery method based on Monte Carlo tree search and neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network fault restoration, in particular to a power distribution network fault restoration method based on Monte Carlo tree search and a neural network, which comprises the following steps: step 1, obtaining an active power flow matrix and a regional restoration time matrix of a power distribution network, and constructing a fault restoration process of the power distribution network according to the representation of the active power flow matrix and the regional restoration time matrix; the area restoration time matrix is obtained by processing the historical restoration time of each area feeder line of the power distribution network; step 2, confirming a reference value, a constraint condition and a state space of a fault recovery action space; the constraint condition is resource constraint of fault repair, the state space is a set of power distribution network states, and the action space is a set of repair decisions. The method enables the maintenance guidance scheme to be adapted to the actual maintenance process full of various accidents and compromises.

title_en: Ecological maintenance method and system based on urban landscape water comprehensive restoration system
