abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of environmental engineering, an ecological maintenance method and system based on an urban landscape water body comprehensive restoration system is provided, an urban landscape water body database with different water body characteristics is obtained by classifying and extracting characteristics of the urban landscape water body, a standard water body ecology matched with water body microorganisms and aquatic animals and plants and a water body restoration strategy matched with the standard water body ecology are configured according to the urban landscape water body database, so as to obtain an urban landscape water body comprehensive restoration strategy library, an operating urban landscape water body managed according to the urban landscape water body database is monitored, so as to obtain the current water body characteristics of the operating urban landscape water body, and the corresponding restoration scheme is matched in the urban landscape water body comprehensive restoration strategy library according to the current water body characteristics, so that the systematic planning of the urban landscape water body ecology is realized, the water body characteristics of the urban landscape water body are automatically monitored, and the ecological unbalance of the urban landscape water body is restored.
assignees: SHENZHEN FLOWER IN HEART CULTURE DEV CO LTD

title_en: Soil-structure co-evolution seismic liquefaction analysis device and method based on seismic signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil-structure co-evolution earthquake liquefaction analysis device and method based on earthquake signals, which are characterized in that geology and earthquake data of a target area are obtained, a co-scaling system of geometric ratio, time ratio and acceleration ratio is constructed based on Bockingham pi similarity theory, so that a soil liquefaction process of the target area is evolved by the earthquake liquefaction multi-field coupling evolution device, a millimeter-level spatial resolution monitoring network is formed by adopting a distributed optical fiber sensor array and a micro pore pressure meter group, and a high-speed camera system is matched for synchronously capturing pore water pressure, structural strain and a soil shear band expansion process, so that full-element time sequence correlation analysis of vibration triggering-seepage development-structural catastrophe is realized, the influence degree of the full-element time sequence correlation analysis on earthquake is further analyzed, and a direct basis is provided for engineering restoration priority and reinforcement scheme.

title_en: Transparentization panorama management and control system based on low-voltage distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transparent panoramic management and control system based on a low-voltage power distribution network, and relates to the technical field of power distribution networks. Compared with the prior distribution network management and control system, the system solves the problems that the accuracy and reliability of the conventional distribution network transparency system cannot be guaranteed, the data acquisition and processing difficulty is high, the level of intelligence and automation is to be improved, the operation data of the distribution network can be obtained in real time by combining a topology optimization algorithm and a transparency management and control technology, the operation data can be accurately analyzed and predicted, and the rapid positioning, automatic isolation and power restoration of faults are realized by utilizing the technologies of artificial intelligence, the Internet of things and the like, so that the reliability and the safety of power supply are improved. The power distribution network transparence management and control platform is used for realizing the full transparence and full perception of the power distribution network, providing comprehensive, real-time and accurate power distribution network operation data, helping users to better know the real-time state of the power distribution network, predicting future operation trend, optimizing resource allocation, improving operation efficiency and ensuring the reliability and safety of power supply.

title_en: Method and device for constructing green vegetation pattern by water in semiarid region
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for constructing a green vegetation pattern by water in a semiarid region, and relates to the technical field of vegetation pattern construction and ecological restoration in the semiarid region; according to the water resource data, carrying out water resource evaluation on the semiarid region to obtain a water resource evaluation result, carrying out vegetation water demand analysis on the semiarid region according to the vegetation data and the climate data to obtain a vegetation water demand analysis result, carrying out vegetation suitability evaluation on the semiarid region, screening out vegetation species matched with the water resource condition of the semiarid region, carrying out vegetation pattern design on the semiarid region, and determining a vegetation pattern design scheme so as to facilitate the vegetation planting operation on the semiarid region. The application can realize reasonable matching of vegetation construction and water resources in semiarid regions, and effectively improve the stability and ecological service function of regional ecological systems.
assignees: INST WATER RESOURCES PASTERAL AREA MINI WATER RESOURCES PRC

title_en: Method for studying, judging and verifying power failure recovery of meter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power failure recovery maintenance, in particular to a method for researching, judging and verifying meter power failure recovery. The method comprises the following steps of S1, judging power failure, S2, judging power restoration, S3, judging whether a low-voltage branch line where a meter is located is powered off by a main station, judging whether an intelligent measuring switch in a meter box reports power failure or whether at least 1 meter reports power failure/power restoration events, S4, preliminarily confirming that the power failure event is met, S5, preliminarily confirming that the power restoration event is met, S6, judging whether a marketing process exists in the terminal on the same day by the main station, S7, packaging power failure/power restoration event information of a branch line and pushing the power failure/power restoration event information to an external system, S8, starting power restoration completion judging, S9, immediately judging whether the phase A voltage is normal after a next acquisition period of a power failure power restoration station area, a branch and a meter. According to the invention, through multi-dimensional and staged logic judgment, the false alarm of a single meter is avoided, the planned power outage interference is eliminated, and the power outage duplicate judgment is more accurate and scientific.
assignees: WEIHAI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power supply capacity evaluation method and device after disaster of power distribution network and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating power supply capacity of a power distribution network after disaster and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of determining a power failure area under the condition that equipment faults in a distribution network are affected by disasters, determining actual photovoltaic output, total V2G output and energy storage and discharge power for emergency power supply after the disasters are carried out on the power failure area based on a multi-source output model, determining target transfer load of the power failure area based on a tie switch network reconstruction model, determining predicted time sequence load of the power failure area in a current power utilization period, and determining a power supply capacity evaluation result of the distribution network in the current power utilization period based on the actual photovoltaic output, the total V2G output, the energy storage and discharge power, the transfer load and the predicted time sequence load. The method solves the technical problems of untimely power restoration caused by inaccurate power supply capacity evaluation after disaster of the power distribution network after the disaster causes the power distribution network equipment failure and power interruption in the related technology.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANGHAI ENERGY INTERNET RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Driving apparatus for elevator at disaster
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a driving apparatus for an elevator at disaster, capable of avoiding stopping of services of all elevators to be group-controlled even when minor failure is detected at one of the elevators to be group-controlled during long duration of a temporary restoration state of the elevator.  <P>SOLUTION: A control part 33 for a supervision apparatus installed in a supervision center 3 built in a remote place distant from buildings 11-11n in which elevators 112-1n2 are installed collects information of operating states of the elevators from monitoring terminals 111-1n1 connected with the respective elevators in the buildings and, if it is determined according to the collected information that any elevator whose restoration state is temporary is group-controlled with the elevators of a predetermined number or more, transmits a group control operation separation command to the monitoring terminals 111-1n1 for detecting operating states of the elevators.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Wide area disaster support device system for elevator
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a wide area disaster support device for an elevator capable of effectively implementing a restoration plan with priorities assigned to lifesaving even if a user is confined in an elevator car during wide area disaster.SOLUTION: In this system, if wide area disaster occurs and a wide area disaster support device S1 is started, an analysis result signal from an image analysis device for analyzing by image-processing imaged data by imaging devices provided in elevating machines EL1 to EL3 is issued to a monitoring center K1 through monitoring terminals T1 to T3 and a general public telephone circuit N. The image analysis device issues the analysis result signal added with a ranked urgency index if an aspect in need of rescue of users in the elevating machines EL1 to EL3 is identified. The monitoring center K1 identifies a current position of a worker based on positional information acquired from a portable terminal TM for worker, refers to the urgency index indicated in the analysis result signal, produces an optimal traveling route for the elevating machines EL1 to EL3 with priority assigned thereto, and provides it to the portable terminal TM.

title_en: Game machine
abstract_en: To provide a game machine, even when a power outage occurs during output of a security signal, capable of detecting the output of the security signal at least at any of before/after the power outage.SOLUTION: When a power outage is detected, a game control device stops output of a security signal. After power restoration, the game control device restarts the output of the security signal. When (ta+tb)ms exceeds a shortest output time 50 ms when an external device can detect the security signal, the game control device makes it possible for the external device to detect the security signal output before power shutdown. Further, when (ta+tb)ms exceeds the shortest output time 50 ms when an external device can detect the security signal, the game control device makes it possible for the external device to detect the security signal output after the power restoration.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 186

title_en: A kind of online bulk power grid recovers aid decision-making system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of online bulk power grid and recover aid decision-making system, system comprises real-time auxiliary mode and researchs and analyses pattern two kinds of mode of operations, comprises section Operations Analyst module: read and cross section regulation for section; Calculate configuration module: to arrange for calculating parameter, black starting-up Power Selection and be activated Power Selection; Computing function module: for system partitioning, Load flow calculation, EM transient calculation, electromechanical transient calculating and route searching and assessment; Management of computing module: the display generating scheme for system partitioning scheme, voltage waveform, available path rank and black starting-up.Application the present invention develops online power system recovery auxiliary decision-making support system, control centre's available data resource can be made full use of, combine the advantage of prediction scheme restoration methods and intelligent scheduling, without the need to modeling again, reduce system Construction time and cost, improve real-time and the accuracy of decision recommendation, for the fast and reliable after electrical network large-scale blackout is recovered to provide strong support.

title_en: Consider the multi-period dynamic fault-recovery method of power distribution network of distributed generation resource power curve
abstract_en: A kind of multi-period dynamic fault-recovery method of power distribution network for considering distributed generation resource power curve, distribution network failure Restoration model is usually to do static recovery to the condition at a moment, since the output of distributed generation resource (calling DG in the following text) is changing over time, it is unpractical that distribution network failure containing DG, which recovers on discontinuity surface to consider at one, the present invention is according to on-site actual situations, the fault recovery period is subjected to Time segments division according to the output situation of DG, optimal solution is tried to achieve within single period and finally obtains optimal fault recovery scheme in all the period of time, realize the multi-period dynamic fault-recovery of power distribution network for considering DG power curves.The present invention has taken into full account the output change of DG, it is proposed that the Emergency Control Strategy based on optimal fail-over path is combined on the basis of binary particle swarm algorithm is improved, solves the problems, such as the multi-period dynamic fault-recovery of power distribution network for considering DG power curves.

title_en: Wind farm SCADA data restoration method based on multiple correlation learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind farm SCADA data restoration method based on multiple correlation learning, which comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining a wind power plant standardized data set ; S2, obtaining a filling result under the global cross-correlation view angle ; S3, obtaining a filling result under the global autocorrelation view angle ; S4, obtaining filling results under the partial cross-correlation view angles ; S5, obtaining a filling result under the local autocorrelation view angle ; S6, utilizing multiple linear regression 、 、 And Integrating, denoising and denoise the four filling results to obtain a final repair result . According to the invention, the self-correlation and the cross-correlation in the SCADA multidimensional data are analyzed from the global and the local at the same time, and the missing data are subjected to preliminary filling repair from multiple view angles; further, a residual network fine denoising model is constructed, and denoising and fine restoration are comprehensively carried out on the data after preliminary restoration, so that complete restoration of SCADA multidimensional data is realized.

title_en: Power distributor, control board and distribution board having function of cut-off and recovery by stages against earthquake and optimal operation
title_ko: 내진의 단계별 차단 복구 및 최적 운전기능을 구비한 고저압 배전반, 전동기제어반 및 분전반
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a high-voltage switch board, motor control board, and distribution board having functions of short-circuiting, recovering, and optimal operating based on earthquake-resistant stages, and more particularly to a high-voltage switch board, motor control board, and distribution board having functions of short-circuiting, recovering, and optimal operating based on earthquake-resistant stages, which sequentially trip circuit breakers included in distribution equipment including any one of a high-voltage switch board, a motor control board, and a distribution board, which recover states of the circuit breakers while detecting electrical abnormality and excessive heat when recovering the states of the circuit breakers, and which prevent an electrical shock attributable to a leakage current during a process of the recovery, thereby supporting the recovery to be safely implemented. The high-voltage switch board, motor control board, and distribution board having functions of short-circuiting, recovering, and optimal operating based on earthquake-resistant stages according to the present invention determine an emergency, such as an earthquake, based on a sensing signal of a sensor unit included in distribution equipment, such as a high-voltage switch board, a motor control board, or a distribution board, safely and sequentially trip circuit-breakers of the distribution equipment, perform safe step-wise recovery for each recovery sequence of a corresponding circuit breaker by considering an internal state of the distribution equipment when the emergency is over and states of the circuit breakers are recovered, detect a leakage current generated by a damaged one of components constituting the distribution equipment, and display a result of the detection recognizable to an administrator, thereby providing effects in which safety of the administrator is ensured and the implementation of safe recovery is supported.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 내진의 단계별 차단 복구 및 최적 운전기능을 구비한 고저압 배전반, 전동기제어반 및 분전반에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세히는 이상 상황 발생시 고저압 배전반, 전동기제어반 및 분전반 중 어느 하나로 구성된 배전기기의 차단기를 순차적으로 차단하고, 이를 복구할 경우 전기적 이상 여부와 과열 여부를 확인하면서 차단기를 순차적으로 복구하며, 복구 과정에서 누설 전류에 의한 감전을 방지하도록 하여 안전한 복구가 이루어지도록 지원하는 내진의 단계별 차단 복구 및 최적 운전기능을 구비한 고저압 배전반, 전동기제어반 및 분전반에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 고저압 배전반, 전동기제어반 또는 분전반과 같은 배전기기에 구성된 센서부의 센싱 신호를 기초로 지진과 같은 이상 상황을 판단하여 안전하게 배전기기의 차단기류를 순차 차단시키도록 동작하며, 이상 상황 해제시 차단기류를 복구하는 과정에서 각 차단기의 순차 복구시마다 배전기기의 내부 상태를 고려하여 안전한 단계별 복구가 이루어지도록 하는 동시에 배전기기를 구성하는 구성요소 중 손상이 발생한 구성요소에 의해 발생하는 누설 전류를 감지하여 그 결과를 관리자가 인지할 수 있도록 표시함으로써, 관리자의 안전을 보장함과 동시에 안정적인 배전기기의 복구가 이루어지도록 지원하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Recycled aggregate plant-growing concrete precast block
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a recycled aggregate plant-growing concrete precast block, which is in a regular hexagonal prism structure and comprises an outer frame and an inner groove; the outer frame and the inner groove of the precast block are made of recycled concrete, and the concrete is formed by mixing recycled coarse aggregate and slurry made of cement and water; the height of the recycled concrete of the outer frame is higher than that of the recycled concrete of the inner groove; and the inner groove is filled with a vegetation soil layer. The precast block designed by the utility model is directly laid on the soil surface, rainwater can be prevented from directly floating on the soil surface in rainy days, the absorption of rainwater by soil and the scouring effect of rainwater on soil are greatly reduced, landslide is avoided, and the stability is improved; the soil can be prevented from being excessively dried and crushed in sunny days to cause dust emission, and the planting soil is used for planting suitable plants, can purify air, reduce air pollution and plays an important role in ecological reconstruction and restoration.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION HYDRAULIC RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Power distribution network power supply power restoration method based on photovoltaic power generation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network power supply power restoration method based on a photovoltaic power generation system, and the power distribution network power supply restoration method is characterized in that after a power grid is widely blacked out, and island division is conducted for a photovoltaic system, so that the non-fault blackout area is maximally powered on the premise of maintaining the power of important loads. The power distribution network power supply power restoration method comprises the steps of determining an after-failure photovoltaic power generation system island dividing scheme, and determining a segmental switch configuration position needing to be disconnected when the island dividing scheme is actuated; examining whether a failure branch downstream contains the photovoltaic power generation system or not after the failure happens, and switching the photovoltaic power generation system to be operated in an island form if the failure branch downstream contains the photovoltaic power generation system; finding a segmental position and a blackout area branch segmental switch position needing to be disconnected when the photovoltaic island is formed; adjusting the after-failure power distribution network structural information, searching a restorable route of a non-failure blackout area, determining the quantity of operable segmental switches and contact switches, and determining a basic particle vector; and solving a power distribution power restoration scheme of a non-failure blackout area outside the island according to a binary particle group optimization algorithm.
assignees: Changxing county power supply bureau;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Electric system WEB class application data restoration method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to electric power system data reduction technique field, especially a kind of electric system WEB class application data restoration method includes the following steps, step S101: being write as template file according to WEB class description language grammer；Step S102: system reads each WEB class template and parses, and forms chained list in memory；Step S103: the http protocol head in the application of WEB class is parsed；Step S104: template lookup is carried out in template chained list in conjunction with character string multimode matching algorithm；Step S105: HTTP data portion is according to fixed format parsed；Step S106: the corresponding content of keyword is extracted；Step S107: the key content decoded is formatted, is then exported.After adopting the above method, the present invention is not only applicable to simple power system network environment, and overcomes increase, the decline for increasing stability of power system with source code, the defect for increasing the linear decline of Power System Performance with number of protocols linearly of the increase protocal analysis personnel burden with the application of WEB class.

title_en: Disaster recovery system of anomaly identification data center
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data centers, in particular to an abnormality recognition data center disaster recovery system, which comprises a production center and a disaster recovery center which are connected with each other, wherein the disaster recovery center comprises: the system comprises a data storage module for storing data in real time, a data mirror module for generating an identical copy of the data of a production center and storing the identical copy into the data storage module, a data replication module for copying the data of the production center and storing the copied data into the data storage module, and a central switching module for switching a front-end access node, so as to perform real-time backup on the data backup and simultaneously directly restore the data, and the problems of incomplete data backup and relatively long data restoration time.

title_en: Power outage and restoration detection for multi-meter nodes in a mesh network
abstract_en: A system for detecting power status changes, such as power outages or power restorations, at a multi-meter node associated with a power distribution network is provided. For example, a multi-meter node associated with a power distribution network can be configured to detect the power status change event occurred at the node, such as a power outage event or a power restoration event. Based on the type of the event, the communication module of the multi-meter node identifies meters contained in the multi-meter node that are impacted by the event, such as meters that become unpowered due to a power outage event or meters that become powered due to a power restoration event. The communication module generates a consolidated power status change message for the impacted meters and transmits the message to a headend system over a mesh network.

title_en: Storage aggregate restoration
abstract_en: One or more techniques and/or systems are provided for controlling restoration of a storage aggregate. For example, a local storage device, located at a first storage site, and a remote storage device, located at a second storage site, may be assigned to a first storage aggregate. Responsive to a disaster of the first storage site, a gate may be created for the local storage device. The gate may block automated reconstruction and/or automated synchronization that may otherwise occur with respect to the local storage device. Until the local storage device is restored, the remote storage device may be used to service I/O requests that were otherwise directed to the local storage device. Responsive to receiving a user restoration command, the gate may be removed from the local storage device. Synchronization between the local storage device and the remote storage device may then be facilitated.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based zonal spraying device and method for ecological restoration
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based zonal spraying device and method for ecological restoration is provided. The UAV-based zonal spraying device for ecological restoration includes a UAV body. Bottom ends of two sides of the UAV body are respectively provided with support legs. The UAV body includes a scanning mechanism, a spraying mechanism, and a nozzle mechanism. The spraying device can identify geological characteristics, acquire ecological geological environment data, determine different restoration zones according to terrain characteristics, select different treatment approaches, and load different slurries to achieve zonal ecological restoration for different types of geological disasters. In this way, the UAV-based zonal spraying device and method greatly improves the treatment efficiency and effectiveness for disaster recovery.

title_en: Pre-deployment method for pre-disaster repair personnel for improving recovery speed of power grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a pre-deployment method for pre-disaster emergency repair personnel for improving the recovery speed of a power grid, which comprises the following steps: 1) After the impending disaster is predicted, combining weather prediction with the geographical information of the power grid, obtaining the fault probability of each element according to the vulnerability curve of the power grid element, and generating a fault scene under the disaster through sequential Monte Carlo simulation; 2) Acquiring information of a power grid, a repair team and a deployable position, and establishing a two-stage random planning model, wherein a deployment scheme of emergency repair personnel is formulated in the first stage, and repair and restoration collaborative optimization is performed according to a fault scene in the second stage, so that power failure loss is minimized; 3) The two-stage stochastic programming model is solved for decoupling by a Progressive Hedging (PH) algorithm. According to the method, emergency repair personnel are deployed in a key link of the power grid before the upcoming weather disaster is predicted, so that the emergency response capacity of the power grid after the disaster is improved, the repair of fault elements is accelerated, and reasonable advice is provided for the formulation of an emergency plan of the power grid.

title_en: Element importance evaluation method and device suitable for fault repair, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an element importance assessment method, device, terminal equipment and storage medium suitable for fault restoration, which are used for obtaining the importance assessment result of a power element based on the power supply coefficient, performance parameters and ideal solution set, and further obtaining the fault restoration priority of the power element, wherein the direct power supply capability of the power element to the load element is considered, the influence of the load element with high importance value on the power supply reliability of the power element is considered. The invention considers the actual power supply effect of the power supply element in the power grid and the power supply reliability of the important load element, so that the power supply element with the largest power supply reliability of the important load element has higher corresponding fault repairing priority, ensures that the important load element related to the power supply element with high importance can continuously obtain the preferential power supply when the power grid has fault or load fluctuation, and ensures the integral power supply capacity and reliability of the power grid.

title_en: Geospatial information fusion systems for natural disaster research
title_ko: 자연재해 피해조사를 위한 지형공간정보 융합시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 자연재해 피해조사를 위한 지형공간정보 융합시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 지형공간 정보를 이용하여 자연재해 피해조사를 수행하여 실시간으로 피해 위치 및 규모를 객관적이고 정량적으로 파악하여 신속한 복구 계획 수립을 위한 기초 자료 및 피해액 산정의 자료료 활용할 수 있는 자연재해 피해조사를 위한 지형공간정보 융합시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명인 자연재해 피해조사를 위한 지형공간정보 융합시스템은, 
좌표가 적용된 항공사진 이미지를 저장하는 항공사진디비(115)와, 
지적도 이미지를 저장하는 지적도디비(120)와, 
재해흔적이미지가 적용된 지형도 이미지를 저장하는 지형도디비(130)와, 
상기 디비들을 검색하도록 프로그램되어 컴퓨터에 설치되는 검색부(135)와, 
상기 검색부에 의해 디비들에서 검색한 동일 지역 이미지에서, 지형도 이미지의 재해흔적이미지와, 항공사진 이미지와, 지적도 이미지의 지번 경계선을 합성하도록 프로그램되어 컴퓨터에 설치되는 맵이미지합성부(140)와, 
재해 정보 혹은 재난 정보를 토대로 피해 위치를 추출하기 위한 피해위치추출부(145)와, 
상기 지번 경계선을 토대로 지번별 피해 규모를 추출하기 위한 피해규모추출부(150)와, 
현장조사원단말기(200)에서 제공한 현장 조사 정보를 획득하기 위한 현장조사정보획득부(155)와, 
상기 지번별 피해 규모와 현장 조사 정보를 토대로 피해액을 산정하기 위한 피해액산정부(160)를 포함하여 구성되는 지형공간융합서버(100);를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명을 통해 위성영상과 지적도를 융합한 새로운 형태의 자연재해 피해지도맵을 사용하여 지형에 대한 이해를 높이고, 피해 규모에 대한 정량적 조사를 동시에 수행할 수 있는 효과를 제공하게 된다. 
또한, 정량화된 피해 조사 구축으로 재해 담당자 업무경감 및 재난관리 역량 강화를 제공하게 되며, 대민 서비스와 연계하여 재해관련 정보를 제공하여 국민 편의성을 제고하게 된다.

title_en: Power outage management and power support restoration for devices in a wireless network
abstract_en: Techniques for power outage management and power support restoration for devices in a wireless network are disclosed herein. Such a wireless network may include a number of bi-directional nodes in bi-directional wireless communication with one or more central nodes. Each bi-directional node may have a wireless communication path to one of the central nodes that is either a direct path or an indirect path through one or more intermediate bi-directional nodes serving as relays. Each bi-directional node may be configured to detect when it has become stranded such that it can no longer communicate with its assigned central node via its assigned communication path, to determine a reason for its stranding, and to transmit a stranding notification and the reason therefore.

title_en: Accelerated recovery after a data disaster
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present invention, a metadata file is transferred from the first system to the second system and a database on the second system is initialized based on the metadata file. An image, including information of the first system to be restored, is transferred from the first system to the second system, and restoration of the information to the second system based on the image is initiated. Prior to completion of the restoration, one or more log files indicating actions performed on the first system relating to the information to be restored is transferred from the first system to the initialized database on the second system. In response to completion of the restoration, the actions of the log files are performed to synchronize the restored data on the second system with the first system.

title_en: Systems and methods for script implemented logic for trigger for converting electromechanical relay outputs into fault indication for automatic restoration application
abstract_en: A system for automatic power outage restoration includes a conversion module, the conversion module receiving relay package input from an electro-mechanical relay package and executing code to convert the relay package input to readable output transmitted to an automatic outage restoration system. The conversion module is configured to receive the relay package input and determine whether a circuit breaker corresponding to the electro-mechanical relay package is opened manually. The conversion module is further configured to determine whether a non-fault scenario has occurred at the circuit breaker and determine whether a time from an opening of the circuit breaker has been more than a preset time. The conversion module is further configured to, based on determining that the circuit breaker was not opened manually, that a non-fault scenario has not occurred, and that the time has not been more than the preset time, outputting a set signal from the conversion module, wherein an automatic outage restoration application resets the circuit breaker based on the set signal.

title_en: Optimally deploying utility repair assets to minimize power outages during major weather events
abstract_en: The disclosed embodiments relate to a system that facilitates deployment of utility repair crews to nodes in a utility network. During operation, the system determines a node criticality for each node in the utility network based on a network-reliability analysis, which considers interconnections among the nodes in the utility network. The system also determines a node failure probability for each node in the utility network based on historical weather data, historical node failure data and weather forecast information for the upcoming weather event. The system uses the determined node criticalities and the determined node failure probabilities to determine a deployment plan for deploying repair crews to nodes in the utility network in preparation for the upcoming weather event. The system then presents the deployment plan to a person who uses the deployment plan to deploy repair crews to be available to service nodes in the utility network.

title_en: A kind of exposed geology slopes restoration of the ecosystem afforestation equipment
abstract_en: A kind of exposed geology slopes restoration of the ecosystem afforestation equipment, it is related to ecological control techniques field；It includes bracket, catch basin, vegetation region, inserted link, backing plate, the first spring, coupler body, bolt, telescopic block, second spring, water seepage hole；The periphery of the bracket is provided with catch basin, is provided with vegetation region on the inside of catch basin；The bottom of the bracket is fixed with inserted link, and screw thread is installed with backing plate on inserted link, and the first spring is equipped on the inserted link above backing plate；The opposite two sides of the bracket are respectively arranged with a pair of of coupler body and a pair of of bolt, are connected in a pair of of bolt by second spring, the both ends of second spring are connected separately with telescopic block；The side of the catch basin is provided with the water seepage hole for leading to vegetation region.A kind of exposed geology slopes restoration of the ecosystem afforestation equipment described in the utility model, it is not in landslide phenomenon that vegetation, which takes root and grows front and back, can guarantee that the moisture of vegetation is sufficient, conducive to the reparation of impaired slopes, repairing effect is good.
assignees: SICHUAN XIANGHENG CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Sectional type dentate constraint energy consumption node
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the steel construction, a sectional type cusp restraint power consumption node is provided, including post, long beam section, short beam section, power consumption section. The long beam section and the short beam section are connected through the energy consumption section and the high-strength bolt group. The energy consumption section comprises a flange connecting piece and a web connecting piece, energy is dissipated by means of yielding of the energy consumption plate, and the flange connecting piece is provided with a restraining outer sleeve with tooth-shaped protrusions. Under the earthquake, the plastic deformation of the structure can be controlled on the energy consumption section, and meanwhile, due to the existence of the dentate constraint, the energy consumption performance is not reduced because the energy consumption section is excessively bent, so that the main components of the structure are ensured to be always kept elastic. The node has good energy consumption effect, small overall size, simple structure, simple processing and convenient restoration after earthquake, does not influence the spatial layout of the structure, and can be restored to use only by replacing the energy consumption section when being restored after earthquake.

title_en: A kind of circular platform type beach structure reef and its building method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of circular platform type beach structure reef and its building method, belong to fish shelter technical field.A kind of circular platform type beach builds reef, including hollow concrete cylinder and cross concrete-pile；The cross concrete-pile is vertically intersected on the rod member of any in space by three and formed；The vertical position insertion of rod member of the cross concrete-pile is fixed among mud bank, and rod member horizontal position is located at mud bank upper surface location；The hollow concrete cylinder is erected on the cross concrete-pile；The hollow concrete cylinder surrounding offers the pane of water flowing.Fish shelter of the present invention can be easily installed in sandy beach surface, and can keep for a long time；Fish shelter possesses the characteristics of necessarily combating typhoon, wind resistance, moisture resistance nighttide, seawater corrosion resistance；Restoration of the ecosystem effect is obvious, is especially suitable for the basis of the sandy beach in entrance of Changjiang River；Reef battle array reservoir storage is big, it is big to bore husky space, energy sunshade, meets that aquatile inhabites, multiplied, evading the needs of Exposure to Sunlight and natural enemy.
assignees: SHANGHAI YANGTZE RIVER ESTUARY CHINESE STURGEON NATURE RESERVE MAN OFFICE

title_en: Topology archive restoration method, device, equipment and medium based on marketing and distribution data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grids, and discloses a topology archive restoration method based on marketing and distribution data, which comprises the following steps: inquiring whether the message subscription platform contains updated data or not based on the marketing and configuration data linkage requirement; when the update data exists in the message subscription platform, acquiring data corresponding to the theme from the message subscription platform based on the theme of the update data to obtain target marketing and configuration data; decompressing the target marketing and distribution data to obtain decompressed data, and decrypting the decompressed data to obtain decrypted marketing and distribution data; restoring the decrypted marketing and distribution data based on a restoring method to obtain restored marketing and distribution data; and identifying whether the inconsistency exists in the user-variable topology file by using the real-time power failure data in the restoration marketing data, and repairing the user-variable topology file when the inconsistency exists. The invention also provides a topology archive restoration device, equipment and storage medium based on the marketing and distribution data. The invention can improve the operation efficiency of the power system.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Ecological hydrologic model guided underground water super-mining ecological restoration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological hydrologic model-guided underground water super-mining ecological restoration method, which belongs to the technical field of ecological hydrologic and comprises the following steps of S1, underground water collection and treatment, S2, model construction, evaluation and optimization, S3, underground water super-mining prediction analysis and S4, underground water super-mining ecological restoration. The invention solves the problems that the existing ecological hydrologic model can not guide the scientific and effective ecological restoration of the super-mining condition of the underground water, can not better protect the ecological environment of the underground water, and has poor ecological restoration management effect of the super-mining condition of the underground water. According to the invention, the underground water ecological real-time data is subjected to underground water super-mining prediction analysis based on the optimal ecological hydrologic model, the result of the underground water super-mining prediction analysis based on the ecological hydrologic model is determined, the underground water super-mining situation can be scientifically and effectively restored based on the ecological hydrologic model, the underground water ecological environment can be well protected, and the underground water super-mining ecological restoration management effect can be improved.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering risk coping decision recommendation method by collaboration of multi-mode knowledge graph and large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering risk coping decision recommendation method by synergy of a multi-mode knowledge graph and a large model, which comprises the following steps that a knowledge graph construction process is completed through a knowledge graph development module, a knowledge graph construction module and a knowledge graph optimization module, the advantages of the multi-mode knowledge graph and the multi-mode large model are combined, the knowledge of the related hydraulic engineering inspection field is fully known by the large model in a mode of generating collaborative iteration through retrieval, a targeted and most suitable countermeasure recommendation scheme is provided for the current engineering risk, and hydraulic engineering maintenance personnel are assisted in carrying out risk restoration by the scheme, so that safe and stable operation of the hydraulic engineering is ensured. The recovery of a large language model and the field of water conservancy inspection are inseparable.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Priori knowledge-based method and apparatus for determining road damage of earthquake disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a priori knowledge-based method and a priori knowledge-based device for determining the damage of a seismic disaster road, belongs to the technical field of computer information processing, and solves the problems that the traditional pixel or object-based method is gradually exposed and has strong dependence on data quality and insufficient feature expression. The method comprises the steps of obtaining road remote sensing data of a target area within a preset target time range, preprocessing the road remote sensing data to obtain preprocessed road remote sensing data, obtaining road network vector data of the target area, carrying out association processing on the road network vector data to obtain buffer zone data, and extracting the road remote sensing data according to the buffer zone data to obtain road damage data. According to the scheme, the efficient extraction of damaged roads after disaster is realized through the dynamic buffer zone generation, the self-adaptive threshold segmentation and the topology restoration process.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING NORMAL;NAT DISASTER REDUCTION CENTER OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT SAT

title_en: Method and system for monitoring and evaluating homeland space planning data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for monitoring and evaluating homeland space planning data, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-mode data, constructing an atmospheric diffusion model based on the multi-mode data, reversely positioning a pollution source, obtaining a pollutant responsibility matrix, carrying out space grid fusion calculation on the pollutant responsibility matrix and carbon sink data to generate a carbon source-carbon sink distribution map representing a homeland space carbon balance pattern, generating a homeland space carbon planning scheme based on regional characteristics of the carbon source-carbon sink distribution map through a low-carbon guiding algorithm, constructing a disaster model based on the multi-mode data, carrying out space coupling analysis on a disaster risk area and a high-carbon sink potential area output by the disaster model to obtain the homeland space carbon restoration scheme, constructing a digital twin platform according to the multi-mode data, the atmospheric diffusion model and the disaster model, and carrying out deduction verification on expected carbon sink increment values of the homeland space carbon planning scheme through the digital twin platform, and carrying out implementation iteration.
assignees: YANTAI PENGLAI PLANNING AND RES CENTER

title_en: NDVI prediction method and system based on ecological response space diversity of water diversion engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses an NDVI prediction method based on ecological response space diversity of water diversion engineering. The method comprises the steps of firstly, definitely analyzing objects of a water diversion project, secondly, collecting hydrologic element data under a dam after the project is operated and normalized vegetation index NDVI data month by month, thirdly, constructing buffer areas with different radiuses by taking a reservoir dam address as a center, calculating correlation coefficients of hydrologic element data and NDVI indexes of each buffer area, fourthly, constructing a function model F (r) of the variation of the correlation coefficients under different buffer area radiuses, fifthly, calculating a water diversion ecological response range of the reservoir, sixthly, introducing derivative functions of F (r) as geographic weights, and predicting the variation of the NDVI based on an improved space-time geographic weighted regression method. The invention comprehensively considers the change of the hydrological runoff condition and vegetation growth condition after water intake in the water diversion project, can more accurately evaluate the influence range and degree of reservoir water diversion on peripheral vegetation, and provides scientific basis for water diversion ecological response analysis and ecological restoration.

title_en: Power address-oriented power outage and restoration panorama monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a power address-oriented power outage and restoration panorama monitoring method and device, and relates to the technical field of power grids. According to the invention, the power failure and recovery analysis is carried out by monitoring the real-time data such as the power parameters, the switching state and the fault alarm information of each power address, so that the real-time monitoring of the power failure and recovery in the power system is realized. Furthermore, the invention respectively carries out the power-off and power-on analysis on the actual data of each power address and the related address, determines the first power-off and power-on state and the second power-off and power-on state, and after carrying out state checking, determines the power-off and power-on state, thereby improving the accuracy of power-off and power-on monitoring. According to the invention, the power failure and restoration state of each power address and the power map are combined to perform power failure and restoration panoramic display, so that real-time panoramic monitoring of power failure and restoration in a power system is realized. Compared with the traditional manual inspection and local monitoring, the power grid outage and restoration monitoring efficiency is improved.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Road restoration block
title_ko: 도로복구블록
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a road restoration block for covering eliminated pavements during various road constructions conducted by eliminating some of or the entire existing road pavements, and more specifically, to a road restoration block, which can quickly and safely cover the eliminated pavements by providing blocks that are simply carried, disposed, and disassembled with strong coupling power to the upper part of the eliminated pavements so that people and cars may pass even when the constructions are in progress, thereby providing a safe and pleasant construction environment by preventing the traffic congestion caused by the constructions. Further, the invention may maximize cost reduction for construction companies by preventing the increase of construction costs and waste of resources caused by temporary pavement works (provisional pavement works) that are currently in operation, and improve the construction quality and prevent poor construction. Consequently, the invention promotes reduction in the national budget, and is usable for emergent road restoration in case of national disaster and thus the safety and wealth of people can be protected.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기존 도로 포장의 일부 또는 전체를 제거하여 시행하는 각종 도로 공사에서 제거된 포장면을 커버하기 위한 도로복구블록에 관한 것으로서, 구체적으로 제거된 포장면 상부에 운반 및 설치, 해체가 간편하면서도 강한 체결이 가능한 블록을 설치하여 제거된 포장면을 신속하고 안전하게 커버하여, 공사를 수행하는 중에도 사람 및 차량의 통행을 가능하게 하여 공사로 인한 교통 정체발생을 차단하여 안전하고 쾌적한 건설환경을 제공하고, 현재 시행하고 있는 임시포장(가포장) 또는 이중포장으로 인한 자원 낭비 및 공사비 증가를 방지하여 건설사 원가 절감을 극대화시키고, 공사의 품질을 향상시키고 부실공사를 방지하므로 궁극적으로 국가예산 절감을 도모하며, 국가재난시 도로 응급복구용으로도 사용이 가능하여 국민의 안전과 재산을 지킬 수 있도록 한 도로복구블록을 제공하려는 것이다.

title_en: The distribution network operating safety appraisal procedure of load restoration value is lost based on distribution network failure
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of operating safety appraisal procedure losing load restoration value based on distribution network failure, belong to dispatching automation of electric power systems and grid simulation technical field. Distribution network is carried out N-1 fault scanning by the method, dead electricity load carries out under each fault recovery and optimization and calculates the dead electricity load value that can recover; After having scanned, the cumulative dead electricity load every time recovered obtains total recovery dead electricity load value. According to total dead electricity load value, total mistake load value that may recover, total recovery load value, set up distribution network Operational Safety indicators. This wherein, fault lose load restoration optimization be consider meritorious, idle, voltage and radial operation constraint the detailed recovery and optimization model of distribution network, this MIXED INTEGER quadratic constraints programming problem adopt branch and bound method solve; The present invention based on above-mentioned optimization model, the index of the distribution network operating safety assessment of formulation, it is possible to reflect the security of current distribution network operational conditions and network structure.

title_en: Apparatus and method for power supply restoration via data link after power outage
abstract_en: The invention relates to an apparatus (1) for enabling power to be supplied to a powered device (2) via a wired data link (3). The apparatus (1) is configured to provide the power to the powered device (2) according to a configuration determined based on at least one parameter transmitted by the powered device (2) via the wired data link (3) during a power cycle. Further, the device (1) comprises: a memory (12) for storing information about said configuration; and a controller (10) for controlling the apparatus (1) to supply power to the power-supplied device (2) according to the same configuration, based on the stored information, in a subsequent power cycle following a power outage. Furthermore, the invention relates to a method for operating a device (1).

title_en: Adopt ecological remediation system of sand riverbed
abstract_en: The ecological restoration system for the sand mining riverbed comprises a riverbed restoration device and a server, wherein the riverbed restoration device comprises a connecting plate, the connecting plate comprises connecting ring plates and an elongated plate, the connecting ring plates are connected with each other, the cross section of the connecting ring plates is a closed figure, and the elongated plate is connected with the bottom end edge of the connecting ring plates and used for increasing the height of the riverbed restoration device; the connecting plate comprises a planting device, and the planting device is used for placing plant seeds for repairing a riverbed; the server is used for storing the shape data of the riverbed and calculating the height and the number required by the riverbed repairing device. The ecological restoration system of the sand-collecting riverbed provided by the invention can adjust the height of the riverbed restoration device according to the riverbed condition, preliminarily fix the riverbed, prevent landslide of the riverbed through the growth of the root system of the plant, ensure the flood control effect, and protect the habitat of aquatic organisms, thereby providing the self-purification capability of the water body.

title_en: Micro-grid group energy storage capacity configuration method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for configuring energy storage capacity of a micro-grid group, which comprise the following steps: determining the source load adaptation degree of the micro-grid group according to the predicted load curve and output curve of the micro-grid, and judging whether the source load adaptation degree is larger than or equal to a preset value; if yes, determining that the micro-grid group does not need to store energy, if not, obtaining the fault average restoration time length of the upper power grid of the micro-grid group, determining the total energy storage demand capacity of the micro-grid group according to the fault average restoration time length, the load curve and the output curve, determining the energy storage distribution coefficient of each micro-grid according to the load curve and the output curve, and calculating the product of the total energy storage demand capacity and the energy storage distribution coefficient to obtain the target energy storage capacity of each micro-grid. The energy storage is realized when the source load adaptation degree of the micro-grid group is smaller than a preset value, the invalid energy storage is avoided, and the energy storage distribution coefficient is determined through the output and the load of the micro-grid, so that the energy storage distribution of the micro-grid is more perfect and reasonable, and the stability and the reliability of the grid are improved.

title_en: Progressive network recovery
abstract_en: Technologies are generally described for systems and methods effective to schedule repair (e.g., allocate repair resources, determine a repair sequence, etc.) of a system effected by a large-scale failure caused by a natural disaster, malicious attack, faulty components, or the like. In an example, the system can generate a schedule that indicates amounts of repair resources allocated for repair of specific components of a disrupted system as well as a time or sequence in which the components are to be repaired. The schedule, in some instance, can operate to maximize an amount of restoration, at each stage of a recovery process, relative to the characteristic of the disrupted system. For example, with a communications network as the disrupted system, the schedule can maximize the amount of total traffic flow capacity recovered after respective steps of the recovery process.

title_en: Ecological restoration structure for damage of mountain slope
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a damaged ecological remediation structure of massif side slope, including side slope cement protection frame, cement seat, water strainer, apotheca, the slope body, vegetable layer, polypropylene fibre coating, matrix soil layer, concrete layer, vegetation afforestation layer, clay layer, metalling, rock layer, wash port, connect water bucket and aqueduct. The utility model can better restore the damaged ecology of the side slope by arranging the mutual matching among the polypropylene fiber coating layer, the concrete layer, the vegetation greening layer, the clay layer and the gravel layer, thereby improving the greening degree of the vegetation in the mountain, being beneficial to the plant growth, improving the fixity of the surface of the mountain slope and effectively preventing the landslide phenomenon; through setting up the wash port, connect mutually supporting between water bucket, aqueduct, strainer and the water storage chamber, can be better store the moisture that runs off, the use in the later stage of being convenient for, very big loss of having avoided the soil and water has also strengthened the practicality simultaneously.
assignees: SICHUAN TAIKUN CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: River course shore protection ecological restoration structure using novel wave-resistant stone
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a river course revetment ecological restoration structure applying novel wave-resistant stones, which comprises a river bottom, a river bank and a river course, wherein a river bank concrete layer is poured on one side close to the river bank, a wave-resistant water retaining wall connected with the river bank is built above the river bank concrete layer, a river bank planting layer is arranged at the top of the river bank, a section of demolishing section with the height of 0.6-1.2 m is demolished at the top of the wave-resistant water retaining wall, a top pressing layer is arranged at the top of the demolished wave-resistant water retaining wall, a landscape retaining wall is built on the river bank close to one side of the wave-resistant water retaining wall, a restoration bed layer is dug downwards on the river bottom close to one side of the wave-resistant water retaining wall, a wave-resistant stone layer is laid above the restoration bed layer, and a pressed stone layer, a non-woven fabric layer and a river bottom planting layer are sequentially arranged above the wave-resistant stone layer from bottom to top. The utility model not only can obviously improve the bank protection and wave resistance of the river bank, but also can improve the inhabiting propagation environment for small organisms, and can play a basic role in beautifying the revetment, reducing and preventing disasters.
assignees: KUNMING SCIENCE AND TECH PAN ASIA DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Disaster-relieving multifunctional universal folding table and chair
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster-relieving multifunctional universal folding table and chair, which has the novel characteristics that: chair back connecting plates are replaced by slotted flat rods and are locked on a back plate by transverse rods and transverse pins; armrest plates are replaced by four parallel connecting rods, can be folded and locked tightly and can be collected and folded by diagonal pulling wires; scroll bars can be drawn out and detached to be used independently; the function of making various table and chairs, beds, ships, rooms and the like is retained and improved; and the table and chair can be folded quickly to leave all ground space for using an original one-room and multifunctional dinning hall, auditorium or teaching room as a dance hall, a working plate, an assembly place and the like instantly, so that indoor and outdoor completely barrier-free spaces are provided for multiple purposes. In addition, the chair is extremely convenient in folding and transportation, quick in modification, restoration, assembly and disassembly and convenient in use and can vary greatly; and the chair can create great actual profits and benefits, enlighten and pull innovation of enterprises and people as an example and promote the building of a learning-oriented, innovation-oriented and research-oriented society considerably.

title_en: Method for evaluating influence of ecological poplar returning on water source conservation function based on InVEST model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to water source conservation function influence assessment, and particularly relates to a method for assessing influence of ecological poplar withdrawal on a water source conservation function by integrating an InVEST model and a multivariate statistical method. The scheme of the invention comprises the following steps: 1) dividing the type information of the wetland remote sensing image, and detecting and analyzing the quantitative relation between the wetland type change and water source conservation; 2) carrying out hydrological geomorphology classification on the wetland according to the wetland coverage remote sensing data; 3) establishing an INVEST model; 4) calculating the water source conservation quantity before and after the change of the spatial pattern of the regional landscape to be evaluated by using an InVEST model; 5) and obtaining the degree of the landscape space pattern change affecting the water source conservation function by using the principal components and a cluster analysis method according to the calculation result. The invention adopts an InVEST model, and the yield is evaluated by comparing the water yield before and after each changed coating project is implemented. In addition, the land cover change characteristics of the wetland are determined and the impact of the water conservation function is evaluated by considering the land cover, climate change and landscape patterns. The influence on the water source conservation function in the ecological poplar withdrawing engineering is accurately and scientifically evaluated, a valuable reference is provided for the ecological poplar withdrawing engineering, and guidance is provided for regional ecological restoration and ecological system function evaluation by governments as a result.

title_en: Power grid model version control and tracing management method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid model version control and tracing management method and a device, comprising the steps of obtaining a power grid model file; analyzing the power grid model file, and storing each data component of the power grid model file obtained through analysis into a data table established in a database according to a preset mapping relation; inquiring and acquiring a corresponding version model of a corresponding date according to the data table; and combining the constraint relation of the corresponding version models according to a preset data organization rule to generate a corresponding file, and performing spot shipment calculation on the corresponding file by adopting a shipment algorithm. The invention provides a power grid model adding, editing, deleting, inquiring full-flow and closed-loop version control method, which supplements and perfects the version operation that only supports incremental data and does not support power grid model editing and deleting in the existing power grid model management method, effectively supports the requirements of the power grid model management storage and accurate restoration of the power grid model management in the power spot market, and improves the efficiency and accuracy of spot shipment.

title_en: Method for evaluating power grid restoration supporting capacity of distributed photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of elasticity evaluation of power distribution networks, in particular to a method, a device and equipment for evaluating the supporting capacity of a distributed photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system to power grid recovery and a readable storage medium, which specifically comprise the following steps: dividing the operation scenes of the photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system under extreme weather conditions based on historical statistical data, optimally calculating the recovery capacity of the supporting power grid under different operation scenes of the photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system, and finally obtaining the comprehensive evaluation value of the recovery supporting capacity of the supporting power grid by combining the occurrence probability of each operation scene of the photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system; the uncertainty influence of extreme weather conditions on the photovoltaic output can be fully considered, and the power supply recovery support capability of the photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system on the power grid after disaster is reasonably evaluated, so that the adequacy of the output of the schedulable resources and the cooperative coordination among different resources can be fully considered when an application personnel makes a recovery strategy after disaster.
assignees: STATE GRID SUZHOU URBAN ENERGY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Topology archive maintenance method, device, equipment and medium based on data update
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a topology archive maintenance method based on data updating, which comprises the following steps: acquiring power grid data which are included in dynamic monitoring based on a preset archive restoration instruction, and obtaining monitored data; carrying out polling test on the monitored data, and screening the monitored data by judging whether the monitored data has change or not; when the monitored data changes, acquiring a data section snapshot by judging whether the monitored data changes finally or not, and obtaining section snapshot data; obtaining topology archive data related to the section snapshot data, and obtaining comprehensive power grid state data according to the section snapshot data and the topology archive data; and encrypting and compressing the comprehensive power grid state data, transmitting the comprehensive power grid state data to a related system, and maintaining an initial topology file. The invention also provides a topology archive maintenance device, equipment and storage medium based on data updating. The invention can improve the stability of the power grid system.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Charging station operation data inconsistency detection and restoration method, system, equipment and medium based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging station operation data inconsistency detection and restoration method, system, equipment and medium based on multi-source data fusion, relating to the field of intelligent maintenance of charging station operation data, comprising the steps of collecting heterogeneous data sources in the operation and maintenance of a power station; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing collected data to generate a consistent fusion data set, constructing an inconsistency detection model on the basis of the fusion data, extracting data hidden structural features based on a feature learning method of a self-encoder, identifying potential abnormal points by utilizing reconstruction errors, carrying out consistency dynamic detection and classification labeling on multi-source data, inputting the identified inconsistent data to a repair module, executing a repair mechanism, and carrying out complementation, correction and reconstruction on the abnormal data. The multi-source heterogeneous data collaborative analysis framework integrating the running state of the charging pile, the power grid interaction data and the environment perception data is constructed, the limitation of the traditional single data source verification is broken through, and the cross-system data relevance and the anomaly detection coverage rate are remarkably improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Irrigation method for ecological restoration of high-steep side slope in alpine region
abstract_en: The invention provides an irrigation method for ecological restoration of a high-steep slope in a alpine region, which comprises the steps of acquiring water temperature, water flow rate, ambient temperature and at least one environmental factor parameter in a pipeline in real time, calculating target heating power required by maintaining the target water temperature through a thermal balance model and a feedforward compensation model, converting the target heating power into a pulse width modulation signal, transmitting the pulse width modulation signal to a heating device, and switching and grading control of the heating device according to a water temperature interval. According to the irrigation method for ecological restoration of the high and steep side slopes in the alpine regions, provided by the invention, the heating power required for maintaining the target water temperature is dynamically calculated by combining the heat balance model and the feedforward compensation algorithm, and the heating device is accurately regulated by the hierarchical control mode, so that the problems of freezing and blocking of the high and steep side slope pipelines in the alpine regions can be effectively solved in the irrigation process, the loss of electric energy can be reduced, and the utilization rate of water resources can be improved.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING FORESTRY

title_en: Tunnel disaster prevention system
abstract_en: To prevent a monitoring function in a tunnel from being lost by promptly enabling a temporary restoration of a power supply unit for its malfunction without increasing the circuit scale of the power supply unit or necessarily controlling the power supply unit as a reserve system.SOLUTION: An externally-attachable regulated power supply 110-1 can be switched and connected to the inputs of DC/DC converters 104-1 to 104-5 via manual switches 106-1 to 106-5. title_ko: 전두부를 함유한 전두부 플레이크 제조방법
abstract_en: A method for preparing the whole dubu (bean curd) flake containing the whole dubu is provided to improve the restoration and the texture. A method for preparing the whole dubu flake containing the whole dubu comprises the steps of cutting the whole dubu; freeze-drying the cut one at -30 to -45 deg.C; maintaining the vacuum pressure of the freeze-dryer to 1x10~1x10^-2 Torr; and removing the residual moisture of the whole dubu loaded on a drying stand with maintaining the temperature of the drying stand to be 30-90 deg.C to make the dubu flake.

title_en: Secondary battery protection integrated circuit, secondary battery protection apparatus and battery pack
title_ko: 이차전지 보호 집적 회로, 이차전지 보호 장치 및 전지팩
abstract_en: The present invention is to allow restoration from a discharge-prohibited state even though a diode exists between a control terminal and a minus terminal. The present invention provides a secondary battery protection integrated circuit comprising: a power terminal connected to a positive electrode of a secondary battery; a ground terminal connected to a negative electrode of the second battery; an input terminal connected to a minus terminal; a control terminal inputted with a control signal; a pull-down resistance connected between the control terminal and the ground terminal; a voltage monitoring circuit monitoring voltage between the control terminal and the ground terminal; an electric potential circuit comparing electric potential of the control terminal with electric potential of the input terminal; and a control circuit turning off a discharge control transistor included in a switch circuit when it is detected by the voltage monitoring circuit that voltage between the control terminal and the ground terminal is higher than a first predetermined critical value and turning on the discharge control transistor when it is detected by the electric potential comparing circuit that the electric potential of the control terminal is lower than the electric potential of the input terminal.
abstract_ko:
[과제] 제어 단자와 마이너스 단자 사이에 다이오드가 존재해도, 방전 금지 상태로부터의 복귀를 가능하게 하는 것. 
[해결 수단] 이차전지의 정극에 접속되는 전원 단자와, 상기 이차전지의 부극에 접속되는 그라운드 단자와, 마이너스 단자에 접속되는 입력 단자와, 제어 신호가 입력되는 제어 단자와, 상기 제어 단자와 상기 그라운드 단자 사이에 접속된 풀다운 저항과, 상기 제어 단자와 상기 그라운드 단자 사이의 전압을 감시하는 전압 감시 회로와, 상기 제어 단자의 전위와 상기 입력 단자의 전위를 비교하는 전위 비교 회로와, 상기 제어 단자와 상기 그라운드 단자 사이의 전압이 소정의 제1 임계값보다도 높은 것이 상기 전압 감시 회로에 의해 검출된 경우, 상기 스위치 회로에 포함되는 방전 제어 트랜지스터를 오프 하고, 상기 제어 단자의 전위가 상기 입력 단자의 전위보다도 낮은 것이 상기 전위 비교 회로에 의해 검출된 경우, 상기 방전 제어 트랜지스터를 온 하는 제어 회로를 구비하는, 이차전지 보호 집적 회로.

title_en: Method and system for comprehensive evaluation of resilience of power distribution network
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and system for comprehensively evaluating the resilience of a power distribution network. The method comprises: obtaining parameters of a power distribution network, and performing an evaluation according to a preset power distribution network resilience comprehensive evaluation system, wherein the power distribution network resilience comprehensive evaluation system comprises first-level evaluation indices and second-level evaluation indices, and each first-level evaluation index is provided with a corresponding second-level evaluation index; the first-level evaluation indexes comprises perceptibility, adaptability, defense capabilities, restoration capabilities, synergistic capabilities and learning capabilities, and on the basis of an evaluation result of each second-level evaluation index, carrying out a comprehensive calculation according to the weight of each second-level evaluation index and the weight of each first-level evaluation index to obtain a comprehensive evaluation result for the resilience of the power distribution network. Compared to the prior art, the present invention focuses on the three functions of distribution network situation awareness, disturbance response and self improvement capabilities with regards to six categories of key features of a resilient power grid, which can establish a more comprehensive and refined comprehensive evaluation system under resilience requirements, and improve the accuracy and reliability of the evaluation result.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power outage and restoration detection for multi-meter nodes in a mesh network
abstract_en: A system for detecting power status changes, such as power outages or power restorations, at a multi-meter node associated with a power distribution network is provided. For example, a multi-meter node associated with a power distribution network can be configured to detect the power status change event occurred at the node, such as a power outage event or a power restoration event. Based on the type of the event, the communication module of the multi-meter node identifies meters contained in the multi-meter node that are impacted by the event, such as meters that become unpowered due to a power outage event or meters that become powered due to a power restoration event. The communication module generates a consolidated power status change message for the impacted meters and transmits the message to a headend system over a mesh network.

title_en: Systems and methods to facilitate decision making for utility networks
abstract_en: Systems and methods are described for making repair decisions to improve resilience of a utility distribution network (UDN). A graph convolutional network (GCN) integrates reinforcement learning to provide an integrated model framework, in which the GCN encodes the information of the UDN, such as topology and operating characteristics. A neural network is connected to the GCN, and the framework trains the neural network to provide a recovery sequence based on the current state (e.g., a damaged state) of the UDN based one or more performance indicators.

title_en: Underground pipe network intelligent management method and system integrating mapping geographic information and remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground pipe network intelligent management method and system integrating mapping geographic information and remote sensing, and relates to the technical field of underground pipe network intelligent management. The method comprises the following steps of obtaining leakage types of an underground pipe network, determining pipeline aging leakage characteristic factors and pipeline burst leakage characteristic factors, respectively obtaining mapping geographic information and remote sensing data by mapping and remote sensing, constructing an underground pipe network topological structure, obtaining pipeline aging leakage characteristic factor data and pipeline burst leakage characteristic factor data, respectively constructing a pipeline aging leakage prediction model and a pipeline burst leakage prediction model by combining a Transformer and an LSTM network to obtain pipeline aging leakage prediction results and pipeline burst leakage prediction results, and generating a routing inspection path containing a restoration strategy by adopting an ant colony algorithm to intelligently manage the underground pipe network.
