The method and the device realize accurate analysis of the leakage mechanism, promote the prediction result of leakage and further promote the real-time performance of response.

title_en: Connecting structure of curtain wall for earthquake resistant
title_ko: 내진 커튼월의 연결구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a connection structure for an earthquake-proof curtain wall, capable of connecting a horizontal part installed in a horizontal direction between vertical parts inserted in a vertical direction and installed adjacently. The connection structure includes: a connection part having one side coupled with a vertical part and having the other side coupled with a horizontal part; a protrusion part coupled by being fitted into a side of the vertical part; a fixing part fixing and coupling the connection part with a side of the vertical part; and a buffer part buffering a connection part between the vertical part and the horizontal part. Therefore, since the buffer part buffering the connection part between the vertical part and the horizontal part is provided between the connection part and the fixing part, the present invention can provide effects of simplifying earthquake-proof connection work for a curtain wall while improving earthquake-proof performance and restoration performance and improving watertight and airtight properties.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 상하방향으로 입설되며 인접하게 설치된 수직부 사이에 수평방향으로 설치되는 수평부를 연결하는 커튼월의 내진 커튼월의 연결구조에 관한 것으로서, 수직부에 일방이 결합되며 타방에 수평부가 결합되는 연결부와, 수직부의 측면에 끼워맞춤 결합되는 돌기부와, 수직부의 측면에 연결부를 고정 결합시키는 고정부와, 수직부와 수평부 사이의 연결부위를 완충시키는 완충부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 따라서 본 발명은 연결부와 고정부 사이에 수직부와 수평부 사이의 연결부위를 완충하는 완충부를 구비함으로써, 커튼월의 내진 연결작업을 단순화하는 동시에 내진성능 및 복원성능을 향상시키고 수밀성 및 기밀성을 향상시킬 수 있는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Mountain fire disaster monitoring and early-warning analysis system based on power grid GIS (Gas Insulated Switchgear)
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mountain fire disaster monitoring and early-warning analysis system based on a power grid GIS (Gas Insulated Switchgear), which comprises a data acquisition device, a one-way safety isolation device and a data processing device based on the power grid GIS, wherein the data acquisition device is connected with the data processing device based on the power grid GIS through the safety isolation device; the data acquisition device acquires public network data and micro meteorological data and is integrated with a data acquisition platform; and the data of the data acquisition platform is accessed into a power grid GIS platform through the safety isolation device and is analyzed by the data processing device based on the power grid GIS. Through the system, the mountain fire spread trend and the mountain fire spread scope can be forecasted, the sphere of influence of mountain fire to power grid assets and the equipment information are forecasted, the power grid loss and the like caused by the mountain fire disaster are evaluated, a power grid company is guided to timely carry out power supply repair and power supply restoration according to the mountain fire disaster situation, and the safety, the stability and the orderly operation of a power grid are ensured.
assignees: YANGQUAN POWER SUPPLY CO LTD OF SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;HUADA TIANYUAN BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine underground network restoration and reconstruction method based on swarm robot system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine underground network restoration and reconstruction method after a disaster based on a swarm robot system. The coal mine underground network restoration and reconstruction method after the disaster based on the swarm robot system is characterized in that when a mine disaster occurs, a great number of automatically-movable intelligent robots with wireless communication functions are disposed underground, and the swarm of robots are used for searching remaining networks in an underworking and automatically form into columns to form the backbone of an underground communication network to rebuild the underground communication network. The coal mine underground network restoration and reconstruction method after the disaster based on the swarm robot system can assist a surface rescue command center to obtain underground relevant information for providing effective information support for accident rescue.

title_en: Coastal area wind prevention security power grid frame construction method based on graph theory algorithm
abstract_en: Disclosed is a coastal area wind prevention security power grid frame construction method based on a graph theory algorithm. The coastal area wind prevention security power grid frame construction method based on the graph theory algorithm includes: using a graph theory path search algorithm to identify power grid frame topology structures of 220KV and above for current and planned power grids, obtaining important degrees of each station and each circuit in topology for normal running and rapid power restoration, and forming a core backbone grid frame of 220V and above in a regional power grid; simultaneously, combing an important user power supply route, selecting a key station and a key circuit which supply power for important users according to a distribution situation and differentiation of the important users, and forming an important user security power supply radiation type fishbone grid frame; then, selecting a contact circuit of a center urban area and an outer area according to grid frame security requirements; finally, organically combining the core backbone grid frame, the radiation type fishbone grid frame and the contact circuit of the center urban area and the outer area so as to construct a coastal area wind prevention security power grid frame. The coastal area wind prevention security power grid frame construction method based on the graph theory algorithm can effectively improve the ability of the regional power grid of withstanding intrusion of natural hazards of typhoons and the like, guaranteeing the important users and supplying power for areas.
assignees: GPGC NETWORK PLANNING CT;GUANGDONG POWER GRID DEV INST CO LTD

title_en: NB-Iot network-based internet of things table user power failure and power failure judgment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Internet of things netlist user power failure and restoration judgment method based on an NB-lot network.

title_en: Ancient landform restoration method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ancient landform restoration method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of oil and gas geophysical exploration engineering and equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: establishing a profile restoration well-connecting grid section corresponding to a preset submerged carbonate slope area, and determining a thickness distribution relation between upper-layer granular carbonate rocks and lower-layer deep water carbonate rocks of the preset submerged carbonate rock deep slope area based on basic data of the preset submerged carbonate rock deep slope area; according to the basic data of the preset submerged carbonate deep water slope area, specific data of preferable earthquake attributes are obtained, a preferable earthquake attribute graph is constructed based on the specific data of the preferable earthquake attributes, and the thickness distribution relation between the upper granular carbonate and the lower deep water carbonate of the preset submerged carbonate deep water slope area is thrown onto the preferable earthquake attribute graph to obtain the paleo-topography of the preset submerged carbonate deep water slope area.
assignees: CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP;CNPC ENGINEERING TECH R & D CO LTD;BEIJING PETROLEUM MACHINERY CO LTD

title_en: Power grid accident early warning and processing method based on multi-factor coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid accident early warning and processing method based on multi-factor coupling, which comprises the steps of collecting the running state, load data and operation data of power grid equipment; extracting low-dimensional abstract features of grid accidents by using a deep convolution self-coding network; establishing a deep noise reduction self-coding network to perform early warning and processing of power grid accidents; in the accident handling process, making an auxiliary decision based on a standardized flow; and verifying the safety of the fault handling strategy through a power grid tide calculation model. The invention effectively improves the standardization and safety of the dispatching operation; the optimization scheme for fault isolation and power restoration is provided, the decision of a dispatcher is supported, and the efficiency and the accuracy of fault processing are enhanced; therefore, the safety and stability of the operation of the power grid are ensured, and higher early warning accuracy, processing efficiency and safety guarantee capability are shown in practical application.

title_en: Self-healing power recovery method and system for power distribution network and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-healing power recovery method, a self-healing power recovery system and electronic equipment of a power distribution network. The method comprises the steps of evaluating the operation state of the power distribution network based on equipment parameters and operation parameters of the power distribution network to obtain an evaluation result, determining the operation state of the power distribution network according to the evaluation result, wherein the operation state of the power distribution network comprises one of a normal state, an abnormal state, an emergency state and a self-healing recovery state, determining an objective function from a plurality of preset objective functions according to the operation state of the power distribution network, solving the objective function to obtain a self-healing power restoration strategy of the power distribution network, and carrying out power restoration on the power distribution network based on the self-healing power restoration strategy. The invention solves the technical problem of low effectiveness of the self-healing power recovery scheme of the power distribution network.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Method and system for quickly recovering power supply of shelter suitable for emergency rescue task
abstract_en: The application provides a shelter rapid power restoration method and system suitable for an emergency rescue task. The method comprises the steps of collecting power interruption signals, analyzing the power interruption signals to generate emergency response instructions, automatically identifying and accurately positioning fault points, evaluating importance levels of electric equipment in a shelter to generate a dynamic priority list and an equipment demand report, intelligently selecting a standby power supply combination scheme, starting a standby power supply switching process to generate a standby power supply activation instruction, dynamically adjusting power supply sequence and power distribution of each equipment to ensure normal operation of key facilities to generate an equipment power supply plan after the standby power supply activation instruction is received, continuously monitoring working states of the standby power supply and influences of the working states on the whole power system of the shelter, dynamically optimizing a power supply strategy, and generating an optimized power supply scheme. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the response speed and the power supply reliability of shelter hospitals or temporary emergency facilities when the power is interrupted.
assignees: CSSC HAISHEN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forest grass fire disaster land recovery monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle aircraft vision
abstract_en: A forest fire hazard site restoration monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle aircraft vision is characterized by comprising the steps of 1, constructing a forest fire hazard site restoration monitoring system, 2, carrying a multispectral camera on an unmanned aerial vehicle aircraft, shooting video stream remote sensing data of a forest site area in real time, converting the video stream remote sensing data into image frame data, 3, preprocessing the image frame data by an image preprocessing module to obtain a standard image, 4, segmenting a forest fire hazard restoration area in the standard image by using a everything segmentation algorithm by using an image segmentation module to obtain a forest fire hazard restoration area image, 5, carrying out feature enhancement on the forest fire hazard site restoration area image by using a feature enhancement network to obtain an enhanced image, and 6, carrying out forest fire hazard restoration prediction on the enhanced image by using a forest fire hazard site restoration time prediction model, and predicting to obtain a normalized forest fire hazard restoration time index of the enhanced image. The intelligent monitoring and prediction method has the advantages that intelligent monitoring and prediction of the forest fire trace restoration area are realized.

title_en: Coal mine waste land partition vegetation configuration method integrating soil and water conservation and biodiversity improvement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for configuring vegetation in a coal mine waste area, which integrates soil and water conservation and biological diversity improvement. Belongs to the field of ecological restoration in abandoned coal mine areas. The method comprehensively utilizes environment multisource data, realizes accurate ecological partition of abandoned land, intelligently screens and configures functional plant communities, optimizes ecological landscape network structures, fuses dynamic feedback and self-adaptive adjustment mechanisms, and monitors and continuously optimizes the repairing process in real time. The invention breaks through the limitation of the traditional restoration means in the aspects of extensive partition, single plant configuration, insufficient landscape connectivity and the like, effectively improves the biodiversity and the stability of an ecological system, reduces the human intervention cost, realizes the efficient and sustainable management of the ecological restoration of the mine abandoned land, and has wide popularization and application values.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF ECOLOGY PROT AND REPAIR CHINESE ACADEMY OF FORESTRY;UNIV BEIJING FORESTRY

title_en: Institution administration system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To determine an evacuation place for maintenance staff in consideration of early restoration of a facility installed in a customer's institution in a case of occurrence of a disaster.SOLUTION: Included are a current position information acquisition unit 21 that acquires current position information of maintenance staff by utilizing a GPS feature of a handheld terminal 4 in a case of occurrence of a disaster, a disaster-stricken state information acquisition unit 23 that acquires disaster-stricken state information representing a disaster-stricken state of a facility, which is installed in each building 1, in a case of occurrence of a disaster, an evacuation information production unit 25 that produces for each maintenance staff evacuation information, which represents an evacuation place of the maintenance staff in consideration of early restoration of the facility, on the basis of the current position of the maintenance staff and the disaster-stricken state of the facility, and an evacuation place instruction unit 26 that instructs a branch office 3 as the evacuation place of each maintenance staff by transmitting the evacuation information to each handheld terminal 4.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
assignees: MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC BUILDING TECHNO SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: The objectification power network topology analysis method generated for black-start scheme
abstract_en: A kind of objectification power network topology analysis method generated for black-start scheme, performance for improving black starting-up DSS, its technical scheme is, methods described regard each plant stand in system as an object, Global Topological analysis is first carried out by elementary cell of each plant stand object, then each plant stand object is considered as a mini system, partial network topology is carried out inside plant stand object, finally integrate the topologies of two levels.The present invention regard each plant stand in system as an object, the topological process of power system is clearly divided into two levels of Global Topological and local topology, not only efficiency high, validity are good for this method, and systematicness is strong, program is realized simple, the restoration path in black starting-up can be conveniently generated, it is adaptable to the topological analysis of large-scale electrical power system.

title_en: Round platform type mudflat construction reef and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a circular platform type mudflat construction reef and a construction method thereof, belonging to the technical field of fish reefs. A round platform type mudflat construction reef comprises a hollow concrete cylinder and a cross-shaped concrete pile; the cross-shaped concrete pile consists of three rod pieces which are vertically intersected at one point in space; the vertical part of a rod piece of the cross-shaped concrete pile is inserted and fixed in the mud flat, and the horizontal part of the rod piece is positioned on the upper surface of the mud flat; the hollow concrete column is erected above the cross-shaped concrete pile; and the periphery of the hollow concrete cylinder is provided with water-passing window panes. The fish reef can be conveniently arranged on the surface of a beach and can be kept for a long time; the fish reef has the characteristics of certain resistance to typhoon, wind, tide and seawater corrosion; the ecological restoration function is obvious, and the method is particularly suitable for the foundation of the sand beach of the Yangtze river mouth; the reef array has large water storage capacity and large sand drilling space, can shade the sun, and meets the requirements of inhabitation and reproduction of aquatic organisms and avoidance of sunshine and natural enemies.

title_en: Automatic damage detection method using low-resolution satellite images
title_ko: 중·저해상도 위성영상을 활용한 피해규모 자동탐지방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic method for detecting scale of damage based on a satellite for scientific investigation to figure out causes of natural disasters. An automatic system for detecting scale of damage for the method comprises: a database (120); a body (125) of the automatic system; and a module for automating scale of damage (130).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자연재해 잰나원인 과학조사를 위한 위성기반 피해규모 자동탐지방법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 위성영상과 GIS 주제도, 복구단가를 이용하여 피해조사전 개략적인 피해규모를 파악하고 신속한 복구 계획수립을 위한 기초자료 및 현장조사 우선순위 지역 선정의 근거자료로 활용하되, 고해상도의 위성영상 대신에, 보다 활용하기 쉬운 중·저해상도의 위성영상을  활용하여 자연재해 피해탐지를 자동화한 피해규모 자동탐지방법에 관한 것이다. 이를 위한 본 발명은, 인터넷망과의 네트워크 가능한 컴퓨터시스템 서버에서 연속지적도, 수치형도, 토지피복도, 행정구역도를 저장하는 GIS DB(105), 위성영상(Kompsat-2, Landsat-8)을 저장하는 영상 DB(110) 및, 복구단가를 저장하는 피해액 DB(115)를 포함하는 데이터베이스 (120); 영상 전처리 프로그램, 파일관리기능부, 피해정보 추출기능부, 기타 기능부를 포함하는 시스템인터페이스의 피해규모 자동탐지시스템 본체(125) 및; 위성기반 피해규모 자동탐지시스템 본체(125)에 적용될 자연 재해별 태풍이나 폭설의 피해규모 자동화모듈(130)을 포함하여 구성되어;  인터넷망의 USGS(United States Geological Survey) 홈페이지를 통해 누구나 무료로 다운받을 수 있는 Landsat-8 영상을 컴퓨터시스템 서버가 다운받아, 데이터베이스(120)의 영상 DB(110)로 저장하고; 영상 DB(110) 내의 Landsat-8  피해 전후 위성영상을 피해규모 자동탐지시스템 본체(125) 내에서 영상 전처리 프로그램을 통해 전처리를 수행하며; Landsat-8 영상을 피해규모 자동탐지시스템 본체(125)의 파일 관리기능부를 통해 피해규모 자동화모듈(130)에 입력하고; 이렇게 입력된 영상에 피해정보 추출 기능을 적용하기 위하여 피해규모 자동화모듈(130) 내의 범위설정 버튼을 클릭하여 변화탐지를 수행할 범위를 선택하고, 자동탐지실행 버튼을 클릭하여 피해탐지 수행하며; 피해탐지는 토지피복도 내에서 산림지역과 비산림지역을 구분하여 각각 다른 알고리즘을 적용하고, 토지피복도의 산림에 해당하는 지역의 경우에는 영상에 존재하는 분광학적 특성의 변화 크기 및 양상을 효율적으로 탐지할 수 있는 알고리즘인 CVA를 피해 전후 Landsat-8 위성영상의 R, G, B, SWIR1, SWIR2 밴드에 적용한 후 DNDVI 알고리즘을 적용하여 피해 전 영상보다 피해 후 영상에 식생이 증가한 지역은 피해지역이 아닌 것으로 간주하여 최종적인 피해면적을 산출하고;   토지피복도의 비산림에 해당하는 지역의 경우에는 위성영상의 정보를 통해 지표면의 명도, 식생, 수분 정보를 산출할 수 있게 하는 TCT 알고리즘을 통해, 명도, 식생, 수분 정보를 산출하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Novel from restoring to throne post earthquake-resistant structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel self-reset column anti-seismic structure, which comprises a base and a column body, wherein the column body is arranged perpendicular to the base, the base is provided with a mounting hole, the mounting hole is a blind hole, and the bottom of the column body is inserted into the mounting hole; a plurality of prestressed reinforcements are axially arranged in the cylinder body and penetrate through the cylinder body and the base to be fixed; the energy-consuming steel bars penetrate into the base downwards, and the energy-consuming steel bars are unbonded energy-consuming sections at the bottom of the column body. Utility model's an usage is, this from the cast-in-place structure of the relative tradition of maximum deformation and residual deformation of restoration post, through increasing the power consumption reinforcing bar, increases the power consumption performance of structure, adopts the socket joint mode between lower part base and the upper portion cylinder, has avoided the drawback of flush joint for cylinder wholeness and stability obtain improving.
assignees: CHINA STATE CONSTRUCTION PORT ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Novel ecological flexible retaining wall constructed by improved expansive soil
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel ecological flexible retaining wall constructed by improved expansive soil, which comprises a foundation built by the improved expansive soil, a wall body, a water drain hole, a geocell, geotechnical cloth and a planting platform. Compacting and filling the foundation by using improved expansive soil; the wall body is filled with improved expansive soil in a layered manner and is provided with a water discharge hole; the expansive soil is improved by mixing sodium silicate (Na  2 SiO 3 ), polyacrylamide (PAM) and sisal fiber; the geocell is vertically embedded in the wall body; laying the geotechnical water distribution halving layer, wherein one end of the geotechnical water distribution halving layer is paved on the rear wall to fill soil, and the other end of the geotechnical water distribution halving layer is connected with the geotechnical grid chamber in the wall body in a hot melt manner to be anchored; the planting platforms are arranged outside the wall body (wall surface) in a layered mode and used for greening plant growth. The utility model can be used for supporting road embankment side slope and ecological restoration field, uses local expansive soil as filling material, has the advantages of ecological environment protection, cost saving and good supporting property, and has good anti-seismic performance in earthquake areas.

title_en: Information system for realizing fast power restoration management of power distribution network faults
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information system for realizing the fast power restoration management of power distribution network faults. The system comprises an information sharing module, a customer service support module, a decision auxiliary module and a data interaction module, wherein the information sharing module is used for providing sharing real-time fault information for customer service personnel, emergency maintenance dispatching commanders, emergency maintenance personnel and each grade of monitoring management personnel, the customer service support module is used for providing the information inquiry of power failure information and emergency maintenance schedule information for the customer service personnel, the decision auxiliary module is used for providing problem analysis decisions for workers in each link according to the fault information provided by the information sharing module, and the data interaction module is used for the communication data conversion among the information sharing module, the decision auxiliary module, the customer service support module and an external database. When the information system is adopted, the in-time transmission of the information in the emergency maintenance process can be realized, the influence range is refined, the system detection and monitoring are integrated, and the information management system having functions of assurance channel unifying, emergency maintenance decision supplementing, power restoration flow process completion and information barrier breaking is really realized.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power system restoration path optimization method considering line operation risk
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power system restoration path optimization method considering line operation risk. The method comprises the following steps of: inputting a power system topological structure; calculating a relative possibility of operation failure of each restoration line; calculating a severity index of operation failure of each restoration line; calculating a mean value and a maximum error value of operation risk of each restoration line; optimizing a unit restoration sequence and inputting to-be-restored unit nodes with the same number as blackstart power nodes; solving a ''serial''-stage restoration model; if to-be-restored units are all restored, updating the power system topological structure; otherwise, combining restored lines and nodes into equivalent power points, updating the power system topological structure, and returning to the step S5; solving a ''parallel''-stage restoration model; and after the model is solved, outputting a restoration scheme. According to the method, a dispatcher can set a robust control coefficient according to the risk that the dispatcher is willing to undertake, thereby obtaining an optimal restoration path.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Power dispatching online trend early warning system based on ultra short term load prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of applying an online safety analysis result to load prediction, and particularly relates to a power dispatching online trend early warning system based on ultra short term load prediction. Particularly, through statistics, analysis and prediction on load data, a power grid future trend is calculated, and a power grid short term trend early warning and accident post-treatment plan is formed. The system of the invention comprises the following operation steps of short term load prediction based on electricity consumption large data analysis, trend tendency analysis through ultra short term load obtained based on an ARIMA algorithm, power grid risk assessment and warning, equipment maintenance schedule management, data access panoramic surveillance, treatment in the accident and power supply restoration after the accident. Linkage between the online trend early warning and dispatching plan change information can be realized, and a trend analysis early warning and assistant decision-making system with integration of a province and regions can be formed.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Based on goal-oriented failure website thematic map automatic generation method
abstract_en: The present invention provides and is based on goal-oriented failure website thematic map automatic generation method, belongs to dispatching automation and electrical power distribution automatization system technical field, and methods described includes the processes such as topological model extraction, equipment modeling, autoplacement and visual presentation.Extracted by topological model, implemented to the process such as equipment modeling, autoplacement and visual presentation, after realizing that failure occurs, according to " station track change family " relation, automatically generate related plant stand thematic map and network distribution single line diagram, complete the seamless transitions from electric network model to figure, failure is positioned to reach auxiliary power grid dispatcher, grasps involved area and the purpose of user, can targetedly carry out fast power restoration with significantly more efficient.

title_en: Recovery improvement method for electricity-gas comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recovery improvement method of an electricity-gas comprehensive energy system. Establishing a network structure topological model of the electricity-gas comprehensive energy system; determining an initial system operation state under an electric-gas integrated energy system network structure topological model; establishing an electric-gas comprehensive energy system recovery sequence optimization model; and processing according to the recovery sequence to obtain the recovery force parameter of the electric-gas integrated energy system, obtaining the recovery condition of the electric-gas integrated energy system, and judging according to the recovery condition to implement improvement. The method can obtain the recovery sequence of the electric power line and the natural gas pipeline after the large-range fault of the electric-gas comprehensive energy system, guide system constructors to repair the electric power line and the natural gas pipeline according to the obtained recovery sequence, and quickly recover the electric power load and the natural gas load in the system, thereby effectively improving the overall recovery capability of the electric-gas comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Plant-growing soil concrete suitable for slope ecological restoration engineering and construction method
abstract_en: The invention provides vegetation soil concrete suitable for side slope ecological restoration engineering and a construction method, and relates to the technical field of ecological slope protection. The plant-growing soil concrete suitable for the slope ecological restoration project is prepared by weighing the following raw materials in parts by weight: 300 parts of C10 cement, 8-9.5 parts of SR enhancer, 1650 parts of rubble, 130 parts of water and 7-8 parts of A-B bacteria, wherein the rubble is fine stone which passes through a 100-mesh sieve, and the C10 cement is pozzolanic silicate PI42.5 cement. According to the invention, the SR enhancer and the A-B bacteria are arranged, so that the strength of the vegetation soil concrete is high, slope protection is convenient to realize, the nylon net and the steel wire net which are arranged in a double-layer manner are used, so that the vegetation soil concrete is high in condensation strength, the landslide is not easy to occur, the hydrophobic air permeability is good, the growth of green plants is facilitated, the phenomenon that the green plants cannot grow due to excessive concrete drying is avoided, the green plant coverage rate of the slope protection is greatly increased, and the construction cost of the slope protection is lower.
assignees: HEBEI PROVINCIAL GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INSTITUTE HEBEI GEOLOGICAL DISASTER EMERGENCY TEC

title_en: Ecological restoration engineering management process and quality assessment method and assessment system
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological restoration project management process, a quality assessment method and an assessment system. The method comprises the steps of determining evaluation contents, evaluation ranges and evaluation periods through early investigation and according to each subsection of an ecological restoration project, each subsection of the ecological restoration project, each implementation stage, each technical means and each expected target, and establishing an index system and an index calculation method; collecting natural geography and regional background information of an engineering area, special geological investigation information, remote sensing information, unmanned aerial vehicle image investigation information and the like, and on-site verification information; and carrying out ecological restoration project implementation progress and rationality, flow standardization, achievement data completeness, project quality achievement degree and project implementation achievement evaluation, and carrying out management process and quality comprehensive evaluation. The method solves the problems of lack of management process, management standardization and project implementation quality achievement assessment in ecological restoration projects. The invention is suitable for different ecological restoration scenes including land reclamation, geological disaster prevention and control, site pollution control, vegetation restoration and the like.

title_en: Power data privacy protection and restoration method and device based on federal learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a federal learning-based power data privacy protection restoration method and device, and belongs to the field of incomplete power data restoration of power grids. Wherein the device comprises a server and N client devices; the method comprises the following steps: s1: initializing a server federal learning module; s2: initializing a client device; s3: transmitting the partial hidden characteristic matrix data and the linear deviation to all client devices; s4: receiving incomplete power load data; s5: calculating an approximate power load data matrix by using a tensor implicit characteristic decomposition method; s6: mixing and filling incomplete power load data for multiple times; s7: updating parameters of the client device and calculating federal learning gradient data; s8: transmitting federal learning gradient data to a server; s9: updating a server; s10: and iterating until all client devices complete data recovery under privacy protection. The method can ensure that the recovery of the power data can be accurately realized under the protection of privacy.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST;STATE GRID ENERGY RES INST CO LTD;ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID QIANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent arrearage early warning and automatic outage and restoration management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electricity management and discloses an intelligent arrearage early warning and automatic power outage and restoration management system which comprises a management system, an electricity consumption system and an electricity consumption list system, wherein the management system comprises a management module, a profiling register for a household residence card module and a payment module, the management module is used for authorizing a manager, the manager can use the device, the profiling register for a household residence card module is used for establishing files of the manager, and the profiling register for a household residence card module is used for establishing files of the user.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Automatic repairing method for wind power plant monitoring data based on signal frequency domain feature reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wind power plant monitoring data restoration, and particularly discloses an automatic wind power plant monitoring data restoration method based on signal frequency domain feature reconstruction, which comprises the following steps of obtaining wind power plant monitoring data to be restored and randomly generating a noise vector; the method comprises the steps of constructing a generated countermeasure network model, inputting a noise vector into a generator for generating the countermeasure network model to obtain generated data, calculating loss of the generated data and real wind power plant monitoring data, adjusting the noise vector by alternately using an optimizer strategy to obtain minimized loss of the generated data and the real wind power plant monitoring data, performing iterative optimization for a plurality of times to obtain an optimal noise vector, inputting the optimal noise vector into the generator, outputting a missing part of the wind power plant monitoring data, and completing wind power plant monitoring data restoration. The method solves the problem that the existing wind power data reconstruction and repair method ignores high-frequency detail information of data, and improves accuracy of data reconstruction and filling.
assignees: HUBEI ENERGY GROUP QIYUESHAN WIND POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power grid regulation and control operation analysis method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for analyzing power grid regulation and control operation. The method is executed by a dispatching field business digital supporting platform and comprises the steps of obtaining a change list predetermined by a dispatching OMS system from a dispatching field business digital supporting platform database, generating an operation plan according to power failure time and power restoration time in the change list, wherein the operation plan comprises operation tasks, planned power failure time and planned power restoration time of the operation tasks, analyzing task saturation according to time distribution of the operation tasks and the number of operators on duty in the operation plan, adjusting the operation plan according to analysis results, and displaying the operation tasks according to the adjusted operation plan. The embodiment of the invention can timely identify and process potential problems in an operation plan, balance the operation quantity, ensure that each operation task is completed on time, improve the overall working efficiency and provide guarantee for the safe operation of the power system.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power emergency communication recovery method and related device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power systems, and discloses a power emergency communication recovery method and a related device, wherein communication nodes corresponding to power key recovery nodes are identified based on a node coupling correlation model of a power network and a communication network to form nodes to be analyzed; the power service communication links taking the nodes as starting points are traced back to construct a communication node set to be recovered, the recovery importance of each node in the set is calculated, the importance is obtained by weighted superposition of three indexes of coupling association strength, bearing service value and network hub attribute, and the recovery priority of each communication node is determined by the recovery importance and hierarchical recovery is executed. By accurately identifying the communication nodes strongly related to the key loads of the power grid and quantitatively evaluating the recovery values of the communication nodes, a layered recovery strategy with definite priority is formed, limited emergency resources are guided to be accurately focused towards the core communication nodes, the problem that resource allocation and recovery effects are disjointed in the traditional strategy is solved, and the pertinence and the overall efficiency of power emergency communication recovery are improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power supply state collection system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a power supply state collection system that is installed and operated easily and determines the point of cause of blackout and further comprehends a power supply state of an area easily and quickly.  <P>SOLUTION: A power meter 2 having a voltage detection relay 22 for monitoring the conduction state of a power line PL and a communication modem 23 for transmitting the monitor results from the voltage detection relay 22 to the outside is arranged on the power line PL on the power supplier side near the responsibility demarcation point between the consumer side and the power supplier side. A host computer includes a blackout task 44 and a restoration task 45 for collecting power supply state of respective consumers for each power supply system based on the monitor results transmitted from the power meter 2, and a determination task 46 for determining the point of cause of blackout based on the collection results.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&amp;INPIT

title_en: Evacuation Door for Tunnel
title_ko: 회전식 갱문
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rotary portal of a tunnel, which is installed in an evacuation tunnel or an evacuation path, does not interfere with movement of passers, effectively prevents diffusion of various kinds of toxic gas in the event of an accident, and achieves a stable operation. The rotary portal of a tunnel includes: a swing door which has a door shaft; an interlocked gear which has a first link shaft interlocked with the door shaft; a second link shaft which is interlocked with the first link shaft; and an automatic closing device which generates a restoration rotation force in a direction opposite to the rotation force of the first link shaft. The interlocked gear and the automatic closing device are disposed such that the first link shaft and the second link shaft are parallel to each other. The rotary portal of a tunnel further includes: a flexible joint which has one end connected to the first link shaft and the other end connected to the second link shaft to form a round shape and interlocks the first and second link shafts with each other; and a cover-type supporter of which five faces form an elevation body to cover the flexible joint.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 터널 피난 연락 갱 또는 대피로 등에 설치되어서 통행인의 이동에 간섭을 주지 않고, 사고 발생시 각종 유해가스 등의 확산을 효과적으로 방지하며, 안정된 동작이 보장되는 회전식 갱문에 관한 것으로, 도어축을 구비한 스윙도어와, 상기 도어축과 연동하는 제1링크축을 구비한 연동기어와, 상기 제1링크축과 연동하는 제2링크축을 구비하고 상기 제1링크축의 회전력과 반대방향의 복원회전력을 일으키는 자동폐쇄장치가 포함된 회전식 갱문에 있어서, 상기 제1링크축과 제2링크축이 나란하도록, 상기 연동기어와 자동폐쇄장치가 배치되고; 일단이 상기 제1링크축에 연결되고 타단이 상기 제2링크축에 연결되어서 라운드 형태의 자세를 이루며, 상기 제1,2링크축을 연동시키는 플렉시블 조인트와; 상기 플렉시블 조인트를 덮도록 5면이 입면체를 이루는 커버형 서포터;를 더 포함하는 것이다.

title_en: Health evaluation and diagnosis method for urban landscape lake water ecosystem
abstract_en: A health evaluation and diagnosis method for an urban landscape lake water ecosystem, comprising: designing an index system as a hierarchical structure, which is divided into a target layer, a criterion layer and an index layer, the target layer representing the comprehensive health index of the urban landscape lake water ecosystem and being used for reflecting the overall level of a health status of an urban landscape lake, the criterion layer reflecting attributes and levels of the health status of the urban landscape lake from different aspects comprising water quality, sediment, biological community and lakeshore zone, the index layer being formed by selecting a plurality of indexes under the criterion layer, and the index evaluation being mainly based on quantitative evaluation, supplemented by qualitative evaluation; specifically dividing various factors influencing the water quality and health of the urban landscape lake, and performing assignment and scoring; determining evaluation weights of the criterion layer and the index layer by using an analytic hierarchy process; obtaining the comprehensive health index of the urban landscape lake water ecosystem according to the score value and weight of each index; and finally, determining the health status of the urban landscape lake according to the comprehensive health index of the urban landscape lake water ecosystem, and formulating corresponding restoration countermeasures.
assignees: GUANGDONG WATER COMPANY LTD;UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH;NATIONAL ENGINEERING RES CENTER OF URBAN WATER RESOURCE

title_en: Method and system for efficiently recovering from disaster damage to water treatment facility through simulation
title_ko: 시뮬레이션을 통한 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: A method for efficiently recovering from disaster damage to a water treatment facility, according to one embodiment of the present invention, may efficiently recover from disaster damage to a water treatment facility when an actual disaster occurs, such as an earthquake, a flood, and a typhoon, by determining, through simulation, a recovery order for water treatment process facilities included in the water treatment facility.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법은 시뮬레이션을 통해 수처리 시설에 포함된 수처리 공정 시설 각각에 대해 복구 순서를 결정하여, 지진, 홍수, 태풍과 같이 실제로 재난이 발생했을 경우, 수처리 시설에 대해 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법일 수 있다.

title_en: Determination method and internet of things (iot) system for gas supply during maintenance of gas pipeline network
abstract_en: A determination method and an Internet of Things (IoT) system for gas supply during maintenance of a gas pipeline network are provided. The determination method includes: determining a degree of a maintenance impact based on maintenance data; determining a maintenance time period; determining a supply sequence of the maintenance time period based on a first loss feature; determining a gas supply restoration time period and a second loss feature based on a gas supply restoration duration; determining a supply sequence of the gas supply restoration time period based on the second loss feature; determining a target demand for a maintenance pipeline branch in a target time period based on historical usage data; determining a target loss in the target time period based on a target supply and the target demand; determining a replenishment parameter based on the target loss; and calling backup gas from a gas storage station.
assignees: CHENGDU QINCHUAN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of electric power support method for considering adjacent system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of electric power support method for considering adjacent system, it is related to power system restoration field.The electric power support method for considering adjacent system of the invention is comprised the following steps：A. object function is set up；B. node is shunk；C. the calculating of circuit betweenness；D. optimization recovers route.The present invention finds optimal power transmission path by as far as possible many recovery generator and load, to accelerate network reconfiguration process, shortens path recovery time.And the path that the present invention is considered under disaster weather is recovered, and the electric power of adjacent power system is supported so that the black starting-up after power system full cut-off electricity recovers more safe and reliable.

title_en: A kind of method of power system restoration power after calculating is had a power failure on a large scale
abstract_en: A kind of method of power system restoration power after having a power failure on a large scale the invention discloses calculating, including：1) particular state of system after identification has a power failure, obtains data used in calculating；2) available black starting-up unit in system is filtered out, calculates the sum of capacity of all black starting-up units and corresponding perunit value；3) each unit to be restored in system is calculated to the average beeline and load bus of black starting-up unit to the average beeline of each machine group node, and the average distance both calculated；4) using the capacity of black starting-up unit and perunit value and step 3) in average distance business as power grid after having a power failure on a large scale restoring force.Advantageous effect of the present invention：Provide a kind of means of quantification to assess and analyzing restoring force of the power grid after having a power failure on a large scale, and can weak spot of the power grid easy to find in terms of restoring force is improved, proposition is correspondingly improved measure.

title_en: Text generation face method based on deep countermeasure generation network
abstract_en: Aiming at generating a face image from text description, the invention designs a face generating method based on a depth countermeasure generation network. The present invention relates generally to applications in the field of generating images from textual descriptions, and more particularly to applications in the field of social public safety for imaging a target person from a witness's description. The method comprises four parts of data set manufacturing, network model design, network model parameter training and network model performance test. The invention fully plays the superiority of the antagonism generation network in the aspect of image generation, designs a set of excellent solution for generating faces from texts, and has wider application prospect in the fields of public safety, face image restoration, film and television media, archaeological research and the like.

title_en: Service recovery priority evaluation method and device, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The invention provides a service recovery priority evaluation method, equipment, a storage medium and a product, wherein the service recovery priority evaluation method comprises the steps of respectively obtaining an RTO evaluation value, an RPO evaluation value, a tolerable minimum QoS evaluation value and a tolerable minimum QoE evaluation value of target service, and determining the target recovery priority of the target service according to the RTO evaluation value, the RPO evaluation value, the tolerable minimum QoS evaluation value and the tolerable minimum QoE evaluation value. That is, the invention realizes the purpose of making disaster recovery priority by introducing the service recovery QoS target and the service recovery QoE target and combining the service recovery QoS target and the service recovery QoE target with the RTO target and the RPO target, thereby ensuring reasonable allocation of disaster recovery resources and making a more objective and comprehensive disaster recovery strategy, and also ensuring the service quality and the experience quality after service recovery to the maximum extent.

title_en: Systems and methods for recovering virtual machines after disaster scenarios
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method for recovering virtual machines after disaster scenarios may include (1) identifying a request to restore a virtual machine disk backup image to a virtual machine disk, (2) in response to the request, identifying a block map of the virtual machine disk backup image, the block map identifying at least one allocated block as allocated on the virtual machine disk and at least one unused block as unused on the virtual machine disk, and then (3) restoring the allocated block from the virtual machine disk backup image to the virtual machine disk upon determining that the block map identifies the allocated block as allocated, but skipping restoration of the unused block from the virtual machine disk backup image to the virtual machine disk due to determining that the block map identifies the unused block as unused. Various other methods, systems, and computer-readable media are also disclosed.

title_en: Commercial power restore indicator for sites, such as cellular telecommunications sites
abstract_en: Systems and methods are described herein for determining the restoration of power at a site, such as the restoration of commercial power to a cell site within a telecommunications network. The systems and methods may be utilized to determine whether power is restored at a cell site when a generator is currently or temporarily providing power to the cell site (e.g., during a power outage on a utility grid that provided the power to the cell site), such as by determining the presence of a generator is running alarm message and the absence of a commercial power failure message, among other messages.
assignees: T-MOBILE U S A INC;T MOBILE USA INC

title_en: Pressure-adjustable intelligent underground fire hydrant
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent underground fire hydrant can adjust pressure, including main part and alarm, the outside upper end of main part is provided with the connector, and the lower extreme of main part installs the tubular column, the external connection of tubular column has the protective housing, the bottom of protective housing is provided with collection device, and the outside one end of collection device installs connecting device, the inside one end of connecting device is connected with protector, the alarm is located the outside one end of protective housing, the outside one end of protective housing rear end is provided with the installation pole. This intelligent underground fire hydrant can adjust pressure passes through the setting of collection device, fixed block, inner chamber and protective layer, can collect unrestrained water when fire fighting in the use of fire hydrant, avoids bringing more waste, and the person of facilitating the use uses water, and more convenience can also carry out timely warning when the water pipe accident splits open, and the person of facilitating the use carries out timely restoration to the fire hydrant.

title_en: High abrupt side slope prevention of seepage treatment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of steep slope treatment and discloses high-steep slope seepage-proofing treatment equipment, which comprises a slope body, wherein a first protective layer is paved on the upper surface of the slope body, an impermeable layer is poured on the upper end of the first protective layer, a second protective layer is paved on the upper surface of the impermeable layer, a stacking area is vertically paved on the upper surface of the second protective layer, a repairing layer is arranged at the upper end of the filling area, and drop-proofing nets are arranged on two sides and the front end of the repairing layer. This high abrupt side slope prevention of seepage administers equipment can avoid the rainwater to enter into the internal portion of slope through the first protective layer of laying at the slope body upper surface, and the barrier layer can play effects such as anti rain erodees, moisturizes, water retention, and then has further protected the slope body, has avoided the slope body landslide, and the second protective layer can be high the interior soil structure of slope body, avoids the slope body landslide because of the rainwater leads to, and the filling area can let the slope body face complete and thereby the basic unit under the compaction, and the last repair layer utilizes phosphogypsum base ecological restoration material to fill and carries out soil reconstruction.
assignees: YUNNAN YUNTIANHUA ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD;YUNNAN ZHONGHUAN ZHENGHAO ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of ecological reestablishment for soil-body landslide and evaluation methodology
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of ecological reestablishment for soil-body landslide and evaluation methodology, specifically include: the crack cleaning of step 1 soil body；Step 2 mixes material and prepares: by volume percentages: 3 10% polymeric consolidators and 90 97% water are uniformly mixed and be made into firming agent diluent；Step 3 pours into mixing material: mixing material step 2 formed pours at the ground fissure of the soil body or earth surface cracks and is compacted mix material；Step 4 soil body maintenance: protect around the soil body after pouring into mixing material, prevents water seepage and overload, fine day maintenance 48 120h, forms the cured layer after restoration of the ecosystem；Step 5 assessment is safeguarded: consolidation effect ecological to the damaged condition of soil-body landslide of the cured layer after step 4 restoration of the ecosystem, water-retaining property, vegetation growth situation etc. is estimated, to decide whether to add the time of maintaining.The present invention has good water-retaining property, prevents water quickly to run off at crack, is suitable to vegetation growth, ecological, environmental protective.

title_en: Active and reactive power coordination optimization scheduling method for wind farm group based on carbon emission constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind farm group active and reactive power coordinated optimization scheduling method based on carbon emission constraint, which comprises the steps of constructing a full life cycle carbon emission model containing manufacturing, construction, operation and maintenance and wind abandon punishment, introducing a carbon transaction mechanism to convert a carbon quota difference into a tradable asset, innovatively providing a carbon intensity sensitivity matrix to realize carbon weight coupling of active-reactive decision variables, adopting an upper-layer power grid scheduling center to send a dynamic carbon price and a lower-layer wind farm to solve a double-layer distributed architecture of a carbon-energy dual object in parallel, combining an improved carbon pricing ADMM algorithm to protect privacy, utilizing model prediction to control rolling update carbon price and prediction, establishing a wind abandon-carbon emission weighing mechanism and an out-of-limit relaxation-restoration strategy to ensure real-time satisfaction of carbon emission constraint, and generating carbon pass through a blockchain intelligent contract to realize real-time settlement of carbon assets among wind farm groups by an optimized result. Simulation shows that the method reduces the running cost by 4.2% while reducing the carbon emission by 18.7%, is quick in calculation and meets the requirement of online application.

title_en: Power outage and restoration detection for multi-meter nodes in a mesh network
abstract_en: A system for detecting power status changes, such as power outages or power restorations, at a multi-meter node associated with a power distribution network is provided. For example, a multi-meter node associated with a power distribution network can be configured to detect the power status change event occurred at the node, such as a power outage event or a power restoration event. Based on the type of the event, the communication module of the multi-meter node identifies meters contained in the multi-meter node that are impacted by the event, such as meters that become unpowered due to a power outage event or meters that become powered due to a power restoration event. The communication module generates a consolidated power status change message for the impacted meters and transmits the message to a headend system over a mesh network.

title_en: Biological ecological remediation system for rural sewage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biological and ecological remediation system for rural sewage, wherein a water quality prediction model unit of the system is used for constructing a water quality prediction model of a rural water environment based on the historical information of the rural water environment and predicting the water quality condition of the rural water environment at the next moment based on the water quality prediction model; the restoration execution unit is used for restoring the water quality according to the future water quality state predicted by the water quality prediction model unit; the restoration execution unit comprises a grid arranged at a sewage inlet, and sewage sequentially enters the primary sedimentation tank, the oxygen pressing tank and the oxygen-poor tank; the aerobic tank is communicated with the secondary sedimentation tank; the secondary sedimentation tank is respectively connected with the sludge concentration tank and the wetland; the wetland is communicated with a reservoir water environment or a river water environment; according to the fore-and-aft change and removal rate of different aquatic plant species and combinations thereof on water pollution indexes of ammonia nitrogen, nitrate nitrogen, total phosphorus and chlorophyll a under the still water condition, the aquatic plants are selected to be planted in the wetland.

title_en: Novel water-reducing management and control system suitable for restoring and treating mine ecological environment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel precipitation management and control system suitable for mine ecological environment restores and administers, including a plurality of according to the mountain vigor by the height to the precipitation management and control unit that the low set up step by step, adjacent precipitation management and control unit links to each other through drainage facility and realizes retaining step by step, precipitation management and control unit includes slay water storage body, slay water storage body is located between hillside tunnel face and the water control reposition of redundant personnel dam, the water control reposition of redundant personnel dam makes the residual water flow after the slay water storage body saturation to the mine platform of next precipitation management and control unit and opposite side through drainage facility, the mine platform is including the dregs protective layer that from top to bottom sets gradually, passenger soil layer and original place layer, original place layer is equipped with the pit water storage body, the mine platform edge is equipped with the enclosure ridge, the inboard region of enclosure ridge is equipped with the desludging sediment ridge of square shape, the vegetation has been planted between the desludging sediment ridge. The utility model discloses can reduce soil erosion and water loss and mud-rock flow natural disasters's emergence, improve the natural precipitation utilization ratio, be applicable to mine ecological environment restoration technical field.
assignees: HEBEI GEOLOGICAL AND MINERAL CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: A kind of city elasticity distribution network restoration force estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of city elasticity distribution network restoration force estimation methods, are specifically divided into five steps, and the first step divides urban power distribution network power supply zone；Second step builds district power distribution elasticity of net evaluation system；3rd step determines each index weights using AHP analytic hierarchy process (AHP)s；4th step：Representative region is chosen to be assessed；Judge representative region restoring force size.This method from prevention stage, penetration stage and recovers three dimensions respectively, and science systematic constructs a set of elastic power distribution network evaluation system.Pass through the foundation of evaluation system, the Emergency Preparedness situation of enterprise is analyzed, it was found that advantage and deficiency in contingency management and emergency capability process of construction, in-depth analysis there are the problem of, it suggests improvements and constructive direction, it is finally reached and organically combines assessment with building, scientific basis is provided for enterprise investment and resource rational allocation.
assignees: YANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Fire-fighting facility operator real-operation online examination system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of remote examination and discloses a fire-fighting equipment operator real-operation online examination system and a method, wherein the fire-fighting equipment operator real-operation online examination system comprises an encryption and contract management module, a multi-factor identity authentication module, a behavior monitoring and risk assessment module, a skill and decision analysis module, an examination question self-adaptive updating module, a fault diagnosis and system feedback module and a security maintenance and vulnerability restoration module; the invention uses SHA-256 encryption algorithm, ethereum intelligent contracts and IPFS to store in a decentralization way, improves the data security, uses the behavior feature analysis, logistic regression model, openCV library and Isolation Forest algorithm to carry out identity verification and behavior monitoring, uses the support vector machine, BERT model and convolutional neural network to analyze the skills of examinees, carries out multi-dimensional ability assessment, uses TF-IDF and potential Dirichlet allocation algorithm, combines natural language generation technology, updates the questions, adopts logistic regression and clustering algorithm to predict system faults, and improves the system stability.
assignees: WEIFANG PINGAN FIRE PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Abnormal moment power restoration method and system based on multiple photovoltaic stations
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power energy, and comprises the steps of collecting data of similar power stations at the moment to be repaired and obtaining geographic coordinates of each photovoltaic power station; determining a photovoltaic power station with similar weather conditions, and determining the similar power station by adopting a fuzzy clustering algorithm for improving the similarity; and establishing an offline data correction model, and inputting clustering result data of a similar power station as a training sample into the data correction model for correction to obtain a measured power data correction result at the moment to be corrected. According to the method, the accuracy of the identification of the similar power station is improved by comprehensively considering the similarity identification method of the distance correlation degree and the curve shape correlation degree; meanwhile, by constructing a data prediction model based on the deep neural network, accurate correction of actual measurement power at the moment to be repaired is realized, and the output stability and reliability of the photovoltaic power generation system are improved.
assignees: NANJING GUODIAN NANZI VALMET AUTOMATION CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution system recovery method and device under rainstorm waterlogging disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power distribution network fault handling and reliability research, in particular to a power distribution system recovery method and device under a storm waterlogging disaster, comprising the steps of generating a typical scene during the storm waterlogging disaster by adopting a Monte Carlo method based on a power distribution network equipment failure probability function during the occurrence of the storm waterlogging disaster; the method comprises the steps of solving a power distribution network reconstruction optimization model under a typical scene of a storm waterlogging disaster occurrence period to obtain a switch optimization result of the storm waterlogging disaster occurrence period, carrying out power distribution network reconstruction by utilizing the switch optimization result, solving a power distribution network fault recovery model after the storm waterlogging disaster is over to obtain a mobile emergency energy storage device dispatching result, carrying out power distribution network restoration after the storm waterlogging disaster by utilizing the mobile emergency energy storage device dispatching result, and obviously improving the recovery capability of a system, and particularly showing unique advantages in a complex scene of serious traffic disaster.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power distribution network power supply recovery method and device, computer equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a power supply restoration method and device for a power distribution network, computer equipment and a readable storage medium, relates to the technical field of power systems, and can quickly restore power supply of the power distribution network after disasters. The method comprises the steps of predicting the fault probability of a power distribution network line and the fault probability of power distribution equipment after extreme disasters, marking a power distribution network node diagram to obtain a power distribution network node diagram to be recovered, inputting the power distribution network node diagram to be recovered to a first recovery model which is built in advance, enabling the number of nodes in a power restoration area to be maximized to be an objective function, generating a power restoration node list based on power output constraint and rigid load demand, inputting the power restoration node list to a second recovery model which is built in advance, enabling the load weight to be maximized to be the objective function by the second recovery model, generating a target power distribution strategy based on flexible load adjustment capacity and power output constraint, and controlling power distribution network switching action according to the target power distribution strategy.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Abnormal node identification system and method based on Fenriver basin ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses an abnormal node identification system and method based on Fenhe river basin ecological restoration, which relate to the technical field of water area monitoring and solve the problems of simple comparison of index data and standard values which depend on single time points and lack of comprehensive analysis on index time sequence change characteristics; the process converts abstract index fluctuation into quantifiable trend characteristics and curve segments, solves the problem that the pain points which are only dependent on single-point data and are difficult to capture a mutation process in the traditional abnormal period identification, provides clear time direction for tracing abnormal sources, accurately identifies abnormal nodes and traces the sources, can clearly define key areas with poor ecological restoration effects in a river basin, and clearly identifies transmission paths and core sources of abnormal pollution.

title_en: Switch
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a switch capable of suppressing a secondary disaster which occurs at the restoration of power interruption caused by the occurrence of a disaster such as an earthquake while suppressing malfunction.  <P>SOLUTION: When predetermined vibration is detected by a vibration sensing device 14, a vibration detection signal is output from a vibration detecting relay circuit and input to an overcurrent detecting circuit 46 of a control device 13. Then the control device 13 is put in a tripping operation preparing state (in the power interruption waiting state of an electric line). When the power to the electric line is interrupted, the control device 13 puts a switch body into tripping operation, that is, the switch body is opened when detecting vibration attended with power interruption. The secondary disaster caused by the return of power can thereby be prevented even if a load facility has collapsed or the like. The control device does not put the switch body in tripping operation in the case of detecting vibration not attended with power interruption. This results in suppressing the malfunction of the switch body caused by the erroneous detection of vibration.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Electrical power failure related information provision system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide electrical power failure related information including information of images and positions expressing the cause of power failure, restoration states, etc. to power consumers, a local government, and so on.  <P>SOLUTION: An electrical power failure related information provision system is provided with a portable terminal apparatus 1 for transmitting electrical power failure caused place site information and a server apparatus 3 for transmitting the received electrical power failure caused place site information and map information to a customer terminal 2 as the electrical power failure related information. The terminal apparatus 1 comprises a GPS positional information calculation means 11, a photographing means 17 for acquiring image information, a terminal communication means 12, and a terminal control means 19. The server apparatus 3 comprises an electrical power failure information database 21, a map information database 22, an electrical power failure related information preparation means 25 for preparing electrical power failure related information on the basis of the electrical power failure information and the map information, a transmission destination customer database 23, a notification mail preparation means 27 for preparing notification mail of the electrical power failure related information, a communication means 28, and a control means 29, wherein the control means 29 transmits the notification mail prepared by the notification mail preparation means 27 to the customer terminal 2 which is a transmission destination.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Disaster recovery support system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recovery support system, capable of attaining rapid recovery work by labor-saving or automating field survey and preparation operation of a plan document required for recovery construction at a disaster.SOLUTION: The disaster recovery support system uses a GIS (geographical information system) including a storage device which stores drawing data and three-dimensional measurement image data for original form facilities before occurrence of the disaster in a target area, three-dimensional measurement image data after occurrence of the disaster in the target area, and quantity-unit price data linked with a structure in the drawing data of the original form facilities. The drawing data includes a plan view with symbol in which structures are shown by performance management models obtained by classifying performances to several types of models for each process. An estimation affected sediment amount necessary for restoration to original form is calculated from difference information for the three-dimensional measurement data before and after the disaster to form an after-disaster integrated control diagram, and plan document data is formed with respect to a facility designaged by a user in the after-diaster integrated control diagram.

title_en: Vegetation soil composition for restoration damaged land
title_ko: 훼손지 복원용 식생토 조성물
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vegetation soil composition comprising: vegetation soil; a soil activator; a soil neutralizer; and a soil anti-caking agent, wherein the vegetation soil comprises 40-50 wt% of purified water sludge, 15-30 wt% of cocopeat, 10-20 wt% of granite soil, 5-10 wt% of loess, and 0. 1-0. The present invention relates to a vegetation soil composition for restoring a damaged area, which is formed by mixing 5 wt% of the vegetation soil composition.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 식생토 조성물에 있어서, 상기 식생토 조성물은 식생토와; 토양활성재와; 토양중화재와; 토양고결방지재를 포함하여 조성하되, 상기 식생토는 정수슬러지40~50중량%, 코코피트 15~30중량%, 마사토 10~20중량%, 황토 5-10중량%, 접착제 0.1~0.5중량%를 혼합하여 조성하는 것을 특징으로 하는 훼손지 복원용 식생토 조성물에 관한 발명이다.
assignees: KSECO TECH CO LTD;CHEONGJU UNIV INDUSTRY & ACADEMY COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: System and method for power outage and restoration notification in an advanced metering infrastructure network
abstract_en: A method and system are provided to transmit a meter power status. The method includes recognizing a power status change at a meter. The method includes, if the meter is scheduled to transmit first, transmitting a notification message to at least one neighboring meter towards a mesh gate, wherein the notification message includes a power status indicator and a meter identifier. The method includes, if the meter is not scheduled to transmit first, waiting a predetermined time period to receive a notification message from at least one neighboring meter. The method includes, responsive to receiving a notification message, adding a meter identifier to the received notification message before retransmitting the modified notification message to at least one neighboring meter. The method includes retransmitting the notification message.

title_en: A kind of load restoration method considering the cold and hot starting gap of unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of load restoration methods in cold and hot starting gap of consideration unit, load to be restored is selected according to the cold and hot starting state of unit based on preference strategy, power failure network load Restoration model is established, using artificial bee colony algorithm solving model, obtains load restoration scheme.This method specifically includes that 1, establishes the ranked knowledge base of each load bus according to the position of the cold and hot starting state of unit and load bus；2, the preference strategy for selecting load point to be restored is determined based on qualitative preference description language and the ranked knowledge base of load point；3, load restoration Optimized model is established；4, load restoration scheme is obtained using artificial bee colony algorithm solving model.The present invention makes full use of on the cold and hot starting gap recovery unit starting route of unit and the load on periphery, had both avoided and has increased the time of load restoration due to putting into new route, while having also increased load restoration amount, and had had certain theoretical value and engineering value.

title_en: Ecological restoration system and restoration method for eroded coastal zone
