abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological restoration system for an eroded coastal zone, which comprises a coastal biological reef structure constructed at a coastal joint of the coastal zone, a low beach biological reef structure constructed in a low beach area of the coastal zone and positioned behind the coastal biological reef structure, a first restoration rural vegetation planted in the low beach area of the coastal zone and positioned behind the low beach biological reef structure, a second restoration rural vegetation planted in the first half section of the middle-high beach area of the coastal zone, a plurality of tidal tunnels constructed in the first half section of the middle-high beach area of the coastal zone at intervals along the direction perpendicular to a coastline, a tidal pool constructed in the second half section of the middle-high beach area of the coastal zone, and an ecological reconstruction slope protection constructed on a coastal slope. The method for repairing the ecological restoration system of the eroded coastal zone is also disclosed. The invention has the advantages of obvious treatment effect, obvious ecological support effect, outstanding disaster reduction effect and the like.

title_en: Multi-scale toughness assessment method, device, terminal and medium for urban underground space
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scale toughness assessment method, a device, a terminal and a medium for urban underground space, wherein the method is used for determining index data of nodes in an urban underground space network according to underground space information, determining node toughness assessment results of the nodes according to the index data of the nodes respectively, determining failure nodes according to the node toughness assessment results, determining a plurality of node restoration schemes according to the failure nodes, respectively calculating comprehensive toughness assessment results of the urban underground space network when the node restoration schemes are adopted, and selecting the node restoration scheme as a target node restoration scheme according to the comprehensive toughness assessment results. According to the method, the nodes and the urban underground space network are subjected to toughness assessment according to different indexes, and a node repairing scheme is formulated and selected according to the toughness assessment result, so that the problem of how to carry out toughness assessment on the urban underground space network after the urban underground space network is damaged is solved, and a repairing scheme is formulated for the nodes according to the toughness assessment result.

title_en: Secure data replication to, and recovery of data from, air-gapped data storage pools
abstract_en: An illustrative air-gapped data storage site for storing secure copies at the air-gapped storage site. Using specialized air-gapped media agents installed within the air-gapped storage pool site, the illustrative system, at an unpredictable time, establishes a one-way tunnel from secondary storage site to air-gapped site to receive backup copies of the data stored at primary site. In another embodiment, during disaster recovery, backup copies stored within the air-gapped site are replicated to a non-air gapped site (e.g., secondary storage pools) as “tertiary copies.” Those copies are then restored to the primary site in original application data formats for quick recovery. As restoration of data is complete, the tertiary copies are promoted to “secondary copies” to receive incremental backups.

title_en: Intelligent quick power restoration emergency box convenient to maintain and repair
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent quick power restoration emergency box convenient for maintenance and repair, which comprises an emergency box, wherein four corners of one side of the inner wall of the emergency box are respectively fixedly connected with four corners of a mounting plate through fixing devices, a plurality of emergency sockets are fixedly arranged at the middle part of the mounting plate, and the top ends of the plurality of emergency sockets are hinged with a protective cover respectively, the utility model relates to an intelligent quick power restoration emergency box convenient for maintenance and repair, a wire thinning device can comb wires connected with the mounting plate, the inconvenience in maintenance caused by winding is avoided, the four fixing devices can fix the mounting plate under the combined action, the mounting plate is prevented from loosening in the using process, when the emergency box fails, the fixing device is convenient to disassemble and maintain the mounting plate, the plurality of heat dissipation holes and the heat dissipation fan act together, the emergency box is cooled, and the phenomenon that a circuit is softened and short-circuited or even a fire disaster is caused due to overhigh local temperature is avoided.
assignees: FUJIAN DAFU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Assembled fish blocking net device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an assembled fish blocking net device, wherein blocking net frames are arranged continuously and are perpendicular to the water flow direction, modularized meshes are detachably arranged in each blocking net frame, and supporting rods are respectively connected with the top end and the lake bottom of the blocking net frame from the upstream and the downstream; on the premise of not influencing river flood discharge, the utility model is arranged at the position of the river inlet and outlet, which not only does not influence the water flow, but also can intercept upstream fishes, thereby protecting the healthy ecological system established in the lake region. Meanwhile, the modularized mesh is convenient to detach, can be replaced in whole when damaged, is convenient and fast, is suitable for underwater operation, and the arrangement of the support rods can ensure the overall stability of the barrier frame, so that the modularized mesh has great popularization prospect in ecological restoration of urban landscape lakes and large-scale lake fishery cultivation.
assignees: NANJING ZHONGKE WATER ENV ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Power system grid structure reconfiguration and optimization method based on fuzzy chance constraint
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power system grid structure reconfiguration and optimization method based on fuzzy chance constraints, which belongs to the field of power system security defense and restoration control. The power system grid structure reconfiguration and optimization method comprises a grid structure reconfiguration and optimization model establishing module and a grid structure reconfiguration and optimization algorithm module. The power system grid structure reconfiguration and optimization method adopts triangular fuzzy variables for representing line operation time and restoration reliability, defines an restoration reliability index for evaluating performance of a target grid structure, considers unit start-up time limit, establishes a grid structure reconfiguration and optimization model based on fuzzy chance constraints under the framework of the fuzzy chance constraints, adopts a solution method of combining fuzzy simulation, a crossed particle swarm optimization algorithm and a Dijkstra algorithm, optimizes and determines unit start-up sequence, and reconfigures a restoration grid structure with shortest reconfiguration time and highest reliability. According to the power system grid structure reconfiguration and optimization method based on fuzzy chance constraints, the fuzziness of operation time and restoration reliability when the line is put into operation at the grid structure reconfiguration stage is reasonably considered, the optimized and determined optimal grid structure reconfiguration scheme takes both system reconfiguration speed and safety requirements into account, and the power system grid structure reconfiguration and optimization method has more practical significance.
assignees: YUNNAN ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCH CONTROL CT;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELEC POWER

title_en: Ecological restoration method and system for water burst slope
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological environment restoration, in particular to an ecological restoration method for a water gushing slope, which comprises the following steps of S1, checking water gushing points of the slope, and marking each water gushing point; s2, building a drainage channel communicated with each water inrush point; s3, laying a drainage guide layer for drainage on the slope surface of the constructed drainage channel, and fixing by using an anchor rod; s4, arranging a vegetation matrix layer for reinforcing the slope on the guide and drainage layer; and S5, arranging a vegetation layer on the vegetation matrix layer. The ecological restoration system is constructed by the ecological restoration method, and water gushed from a water gushing point can be discharged by arranging a drainage channel, so that uncontrollable flood disasters caused by water gushing diffusion and random channeling are avoided; in addition, the guide drainage layer is laid on the slope surface, so that water burst can be rapidly output, direct impact of the water burst on the vegetation substrate layer and the vegetation layer is avoided, geological disasters such as slumping are caused, and the water burst can be fully utilized to enable the water burst to become a water source required for plant growth.
assignees: BEIJING GENERAL RES INST MINING & METALLURGY

title_en: Wind farm output power data restoration method considering segmental characteristics of wind speed data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind farm output power data restoration method considering the segmental characteristics of wind speed data. The method includes the following steps that: S1, repeated, missing and unreasonable abnormal data are screened out from obtained data, and the abnormal data are divided into continuous abnormal type data and local abnormal type data according to the lengths of continuous time sequences corresponding to the abnormal data; S2, as for the local abnormal data, an interpolation method is adopted to obtain restored wind farm output power data; S3, as for the continuous abnormal type data, whether the continuous abnormal type data contain segmentation points is judged through using normal data before and after the abnormal data and based on a maximum posterior probability, and an ARMA model is obtained through the normal data or a mode recognition method and based on the wind speed characteristics of each segment, and restored wind speed is generated through using the ARMA model based on the wind speed characteristics, and therefore, restored wind farm output power data can be obtained; and S4, the validity of the restored data is verified, and a restoration report is outputted. With the method adopted, the decision-making accuracy of auxiliary services in a power grid can be improved, and unnecessary system backup can be reduced.
assignees: WIND POWER TECHNOLOGY CT GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV XIAN JIAOTONG;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Method and device for filling maintenance list of power grid power transmission and transformation equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for filling a maintenance list of power grid power transmission and transformation equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the first OMS maintenance order is issued to a local dispatching center through a superior dispatching center, so that the local dispatching center associates a local dispatching power-off and power-restoration application with a second OMS maintenance order; converting a first DICP power failure and recovery application uploaded by a plant station into a second DICP power failure and recovery application through a local scheduling center, and uploading the second DICP power failure and recovery application to a superior scheduling center; associating, by the local scheduling center, the second DICP outage request with a second OMS service order; and after the local dispatching center receives the reply of the power-on-reply stopping application of the superior dispatching center, the local dispatching center operates according to the reply information, so that the plant station executes an instruction corresponding to the reply information and fills the reply information into a second OMS maintenance list. The technical problems that the workload of manually filling the OMS overhaul list by operators is large, mistakes are easy to occur, and the overhaul risk of the provincial and local main network equipment exists are solved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: NLP and KG technology-based power grid data intelligent management method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid data management, and discloses a power grid data intelligent management method based on NLP and KG technologies. According to the power grid data intelligent management method based on the NLP and KG technologies, the automatic construction of data assets and the guarantee of data quality are achieved through main data directory generation, data standard generation, quality rule engine generation and quality automatic exploration, data relation and influence chain analysis, automatic data problem restoration and the like.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL POWER GRID RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Greening recovery method for mine stable rock high-steep side slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine stable rock high-steep side slope greening recovery method, which belongs to the technical field of side slope restoration, and comprises the following steps: firstly, the purpose of eliminating geological disaster hidden trouble is to thoroughly clean loose pumice stones, unstable blocks and the like on the slope surface, so that the rock slope surface forms a stable main body. Then spraying mineral substance-dissolving microorganisms on the slope surface, and spraying and maintaining matrix materials on the slope surface in two batches after the surface corrosion process is finished, wherein the first batch of matrix materials mainly comprises moss seed sources, planting matrixes, polymer aggregate agents, colloidal particle agents, water-retaining agents and adhesives; the second batch of matrix materials consists of herbaceous and vine seeds, planting soil, polymer aggregate, colloidal particle agent, water-retaining agent, adhesive and slow-release compound fertilizer. The matrix material is sprayed and attached and then is matched with later-period water and nutrient solution for maintenance, so that basic greening of the slope can be expected to be completed within half a year, and the greening effect and stability are stronger along with the time.
assignees: POWERCHINA MUNICIPAL PLANNING AND DESIGN INST CO LTD;POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD

title_en: Power grid fault positioning and outage duplicate strategy verification method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a power grid fault positioning and outage duplicate strategy verification method and device. The method comprises the steps of determining a target area distribution network model, at least one candidate fault positioning strategy and at least one candidate power outage and power restoration strategy, respectively setting fault points of the target area distribution network model according to at least one group of preset fault setting points to obtain a fault distribution network model corresponding to each group of fault setting points, and determining at least one target fault positioning strategy and at least one target power outage and power restoration strategy from the candidate fault positioning strategies and the candidate power outage and power restoration strategies for each fault distribution network model. By adopting the technical scheme of the application, the target fault positioning strategy and the target outage power restoration strategy which can rapidly realize fault positioning and outage restoration are realized under different fault conditions.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration method for centralized drinking water source area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for ecologically restoring a centralized drinking water source, which particularly relates to the technical field of ecological restoration of drinking water, and comprises the following steps: S1 partition diagnosis and planning, S2 exogenous pollution interception, S3 substrate improvement and habitat reconstruction, S4 collaborative restoration system construction, S5 hydrologic ecological regulation, S6 intelligent dynamic restoration, S7 long-acting maintenance and evaluation and S8 water supply safety guarantee mechanism. The invention accurately positions pollution hot spots based on partition diagnosis, drives a stepped wetland system to efficiently intercept exogenous pollution, simultaneously lays three-level biological barriers at a water intake to reduce suspended matters, thoroughly blocks the diffusion of pollutants to a deepwater area, and improves the sediment oxygen content by cooperatively lifting submerged plants and carbon sink materials, overlaps quaternary water level regulation and control, improves the submerged vegetation coverage rate, simultaneously automatically triggers an algae control device for real-time water quality monitoring, shortens the outbreak response time of algae, and reduces the annual maintenance cost.
assignees: CHONGQING YIKE ENVIRONMENTAL PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Multi-constraint particle swarm optimization power overhaul scheduling method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-constraint particle swarm optimization power overhaul scheduling method, equipment and medium, which are used for enhancing global searching capacity by combining a dynamic inertia weight adjustment mechanism and a midpoint guiding variation strategy, and introducing elite retention, random mask crossover and a genetic evolution mechanism of self-adaptive probability variation to improve population diversity and optimization stability. In addition, a multi-neighborhood local mountain climbing search and multi-constraint feasibility restoration function is designed, and the high quality of the scheduling scheme is ensured on the premise of meeting the constraint. Experimental results show that the method is superior to the traditional algorithm in terms of convergence speed, solution feasibility and scheduling quality, and has good engineering applicability and optimization effect.
assignees: BOZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO;ANHUI HONGJI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and Apparatus for prediction of Abnormal Situation through Aging Analysis of Battery Cell
title_ko: 에너지 저장장치의 노화도 분석을 통한 화재사고 예측 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a device for predicting a fire accident through aging analysis of an energy storage device. The device of the present invention, comprises: a data collection unit for collecting data for analysis on the aging of an energy storage device including input/output data, temperature data and external data of a battery cell through a 3-axis acceleration sensor and an infrared camera; a data processing unit for performing data conversion, data synchronization, data classification, and data restoration for the data collected by the data collection unit; a remaining lifespan prediction unit for predicting a remaining lifespan of the data processed by the data processing unit through a neural network; and an abnormality detection unit for analyzing a state of the battery cell as result of prediction of the remaining lifespan prediction unit. Therefore, the probability of the occurrence of an abnormal situation can be predicted.
abstract_ko: 에너지 저장장치의 노화도 분석을 통한 화재사고 예측 방법 및 장치가 제시된다. 본 발명에서 제안하는 에너지 저장장치의 노화도 분석을 통한 화재사고 예측 장치는 3축 가속도 센서 및 적외선 카메라를 통해 배터리 셀의 입/출력 데이터, 온도 데이터 및 외부 데이터를 포함하는 에너지 저장장치의 노화도 분석을 위한 데이터를 수집하는 데이터 수집부, 상기 데이터 수집부에서 수집된 데이터에 대한 데이터 전환, 데이터 동기화, 데이터 분류 및 데이터 복원을 수행하는 데이터 처리부, 상기 데이터 처리부에서 처리된 데이터에 대하여 신경망 네트워크를 통해 잔존 수명을 예측하는 잔존 수명 예측부 및 상기 잔존 수명 예측부의 예측 결과에 따라 배터리 셀의 상태를 분석하는 이상 감지부를 포함한다.

title_en: Traffic flow restoration method and system based on space-time fusion and self-attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic flow restoration method and system based on space-time fusion and a self-attention mechanism. The invention provides a traffic flow restoration method by combining space-time with time-space rejection, wherein the space-time combination enables a model to add space information, time information and numerical values to be seen as a whole when a self-attention mechanism is used, the front-back relation of the space information and time of a road network in a road is fully utilized, the utilization rate of road map information is improved, and a space-time fusion and self-attention mechanism for traffic flow restoration is provided. The space-time fusion and self-attention mechanism combines the space and time information to enable the model to extract the hidden relation of the traffic flow between different roads and learn the historical flow characteristics of the road map, and a method for restoring and fusing the two sequence data of the positive sequence and the reverse sequence is provided. Two sequences are obtained through a forward sequence reverse sequence traversing method, multiple information of different sequences is extracted, and repair accuracy is improved.

title_en: Turning sowing device for ecological restoration of slope surface of mine storage yard
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration equipment, in particular to a turning sowing device for slope ecological restoration of a mine storage yard, which comprises a telescopic suspension arm, a turning sowing mechanism and two groups of roller mechanisms, wherein the telescopic suspension arm is used for providing power for movement of the turning sowing mechanism and the roller mechanisms, the telescopic suspension arm is connected with the turning sowing mechanism, the turning sowing mechanism is used for carrying out turning sowing treatment on soil on the slope, the two groups of roller mechanisms are respectively arranged at two sides of the turning sowing mechanism, a plow blade turns the soil and forms a groove, a discharge pipe directly feeds seeds and other additives into the groove, the seeds are ensured to be positioned in the soil, the condition that the seeds are dried or eaten by animals due to wind and insolation is avoided, the survival rate of the seeds is improved, and meanwhile, the root system can penetrate through the soil deeply along with plant growth, so that the stability of the soil is enhanced, and the occurrence of water and soil loss and geological disasters is effectively prevented.

title_en: Evacuation instrument
title_ko: 피난기구
abstract_en: The present invention provides evacuation equipment to light up an evacuation path for evacuation when an emergency state, such as blackout or poor visibility due to disasters, occurs in various kinds of buildings or public places. According to the present invention, in the evacuation equipment comprising: a holder installed in a wall-mount type; and a flashlight kept in the holder in an attachable/detachable method and embedding, in the inside, a battery elastically making contact with a load side installed in a circuit board by using a restoration element, the evacuation equipment comprises: an actuator installed on a lower surface of the circuit board of the flashlight to be operated in a seesaw method, and placed between the load side and the battery; and a push bar installed as a cam type in an inner wall of the holder, and inserted into the inside of the flashlight to make the actuator operated when the flashlight is stored. Thereby, when the flashlight is mounted in the holder to be stored, the battery is pushed down by a rotation action of the actuator due to the push bar and separated from the load side.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 각종 건물이나 공공장소에서 재난 발생으로 인한 정전 또는 시계가 확보되지 않는 등의 비상사태 발생시 대피를 위해 탈출 경로를 조명시키게 하는 피난기구를 제공함에 의해 달성되게 되는데, 이 피난기구는 벽걸이식으로 설치되는 거치대와 이 거치대에 탈착방식으로 보관되고 복원요소를 이용해 기판에 구비되는 부하 측과 탄력적으로 접속하는 배터리가 내장되는 손전등으로 이루어 재난 발생 시 대피 탈출로의 조명을 위해 사용하는 피난기구로써, 손전등의 기판 저면에서 시소방식으로 구동되게 설치되고, 부하 측과 상기 배터리의 사이에 개재되는 작동자와, 거치대의 내벽에 캠형으로 구비되어 손전등의 보관 시 그 손전등 내부로 삽입되어 작동자를 구동시키게 하는 밀대를 포함하여서, 손전등이 보관을 위해 거치대에 장착 시 밀대에 의한 작동자의 회전작용으로 배터리를 밀어내려 상기 부하 측으로부터 이탈하게 된다.

title_en: High-performance foam mortar filling method for mine stope
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-performance foam mortar filling method for a mine stope. The method comprises the following steps of: adding a foaming agent into dilution water in a foaming and mixing device to prepare foaming solution; feeding compressed air into the foaming solution to form bubble flow; and then constructing an upper stope and a deep stope respectively according to conditions of the mine stope. In the method, under lubrication action of dense foams which are not interconnected with one another, the using amount of cement in unit cubic meter can be averagely reduced by over 20 percent, the using amount of water can be reduced by over 35 percent, the filling efficiency can be improved by over 20 percent, the firmness rate is enhanced from below 70 percent at present to over 95 percent, and the comprehensive filling cost is reduced by over 10 percent; furthermore, the segregation phenomenon of materials is eliminated essentially; overflowing water is avoided in an underground filling body; as the foam light soil is applied to a foam mortar filling body which is filled in the stope, multiple effects of improving the whole quality of the filling body, reducing the filling cost, improving an underground working environment and the like can be achieved; therefore, the method has great significance for sustainable development of mineral resources, environment restoration and disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: A kind of network load based on information gap decision theory recovers robust Optimal methods
abstract_en: Recover robust Optimal methods the invention discloses a kind of network load based on information gap decision theory, certainty load restoration Optimized model is changed into Robust Optimization Model, solved using artificial bee colony algorithm, is counted and probabilistic load restoration scheme.This method includes：1st, deterministic load restoration Optimized model during power system restoration is set up；2nd, deterministic models are solved using artificial bee colony algorithm, obtains the optimal solution of certainty load restoration Optimized model；3rd, the acceptable minimum restoring amount of load restoration is determined according to master mould optimal solution；4th, set up based on information gap decision theory and consider the probabilistic Robust Optimization Model of load restoration；5th, robust Model is solved using artificial bee colony algorithm, obtains that the expected load restoration scheme for recovering target can be reached.The load restoration scheme that this method is obtained can bear a range of load fluctuation, it is ensured that the security of power system restoration process, with certain theory value and construction value.

title_en: A kind of preferential recovery district of aquatic ecosystem and its preferentially restore factor determination method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of determining preferential recovery district of aquatic ecosystem and its preferential methods for restoring the factor, the present invention adds up model using dominance and identifies aquatic organism dominant species, aquatic organism dominant species key environmental factors are analyzed using CCA, simultaneously based on IHSI and MHSI accurate quantification single species to the adaptability of whole key environmental factors and whole dominant species to the responsiveness of the single environment factor, then according to IHSIA w It determines preferential recovery district, finally obtains preferentially repairing the preferential recovery factor in area using MHSIF value.Strong operability of the present invention, required measured data is few, has a wide range of application; eco-environment restoration can be made to have more purpose and high efficiency; simultaneously; determine that preferential recovery district, the preferential mode for restoring factor progress Ecology emphasis recovery can fan out from point to area; the effect of Water Ecological Recovery engineering is improved, aquatic organism diversity is protected.

title_en: Method for rapidly culturing dicranopteris pedata prothallium into mature sporophyte
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly culturing dicranopteris pedata prothallium into mature sporophyte, which takes dicranopteris pedata prothallium material as breeding base material, the culturing process adopts a mode of combining tissue culture and facility culture and is divided into 4 processes, which are respectively as follows: the method comprises the steps of germinating the prothallium, maturing the prothallium, promoting the prothallium to generate juvenile sporophytes in an artificial environment, and promoting the juvenile sporophytes to develop into mature spores through facility cultivation. The invention utilizes tissue culture induction technology and facility cultivation, can obtain a large amount of dicranopteris pedata seedlings which have strong stress resistance and can be directly planted in difficult places such as mines and the like in a short time, is not influenced by seasonal climate change and natural disasters, and provides technical support for factory seedling culture of dicranopteris pedata and culture of clones thereof. The method shortens the cultivation time of the dicranopteris pedata plants, saves the seedling cultivation cost of dicranopteris pedata, and can provide plant planting materials for difficult in-situ ecological restoration of mines, slopes, tailing spoil areas, strong acid soil and the like.
assignees: GUANGZHOU YUEDA FORESTRY CO LTD;JIANGXI ACAD OF FORESTRY

title_en: Seismic signal P wave detection method based on PPNet network
abstract_en: The invention provides a seismic signal P wave detection method based on a PPNet network, belonging to the technical field of seismic signal processing; the network can realize higher precision and lower error pickup of earthquake P waves; combining UNet + + coding and a decoder, designing a lightweight P wave arrival time pickup Network PPNet (P-wave radar Network) with seismic facies feature analysis and fusion capability by integrating a feature filter, carrying out depth feature extraction on input seismic signals by adopting a convolution layer with a large convolution kernel low channel number by an encoder module, pressing and filtering other interference information while enhancing the seismic facies arrival time weight in a signal sequence, adding a feature fusion mechanism in the feature restoration process of the decoder module, complementing feature information, realizing accurate identification of each time step in the seismic signal sequence, processing the output feature sequence by only adding the feature filter to three down-sampling modules behind the encoder, refining P wave arrival time features, and improving arrival time pickup precision; the invention is applied to seismic P-wave pickup.

title_en: Vegetation restoration monitoring method after geological disaster based on high-resolution remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention provides a vegetation restoration monitoring method after geological disaster based on high-resolution remote sensing images, which comprises the following steps: constructing a fused spectrum-vegetation index-texture characteristic set; under the condition of clear weather, n typical vegetation sample local areas in the target area are selected more uniformly; building a bag-like type ensemble learning model; analyzing the obvious differences of tree, shrub and herb vegetation in the vegetation height, the horizontal projection coverage area of single vegetation, the root depth and the root extension range; by analyzing the vegetation change rate index of the remote sensing images in a plurality of continuous time phases and the on-time phase change information of the vegetation type change rate index, the vegetation recovery condition of the target area is quantitatively analyzed, so that the precision of the pixel classification method is effectively improved, the precision of quantitative analysis of the vegetation of the target area is greatly improved, and the cost of long-term accurate monitoring can be greatly reduced.

title_en: Power load data missing value restoration method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device and a storage medium for repairing a missing value of power load data, which are applied to the technical field of power systems and comprise the steps of classifying a data set to be repaired according to the length of the missing data, adopting different repairing methods according to classification results, adopting an interpolation method if the missing data is short, ensuring accuracy while calculating simply, and acquiring the missing value to fill if the missing data is long by adopting a Markov chain or an adjacent data filling method.
assignees: WUWEI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Photovoltaic data processing method and system based on abnormal scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic data processing method and system based on an abnormal scene, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an abnormal value in photovoltaic data and setting the abnormal value as a null value; predicting and filling null values in photovoltaic data through a random forest interpolation algorithm, performing correlation analysis on the filled photovoltaic data by using a Pearson correlation analysis method to screen key features, collecting historical features of the photovoltaic data by using a sliding window method, combining the historical features and the key features to form a new data set, constructing an LSTM model, training the LSTM model by using the new data set to obtain a trained LSTM model, and predicting the power generation at the next moment by using the trained LSTM model. The invention combines the LSTM prediction framework of random forest anomaly data restoration and feature optimization, and aims to improve the prediction accuracy of the generated power in an anomaly scene.
assignees: HENAN YUANWANG HECHU ELECTRIC RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;XUJI GROUP CORP;KECHUANG BRANCH OF XUJI GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Watershed multi-scale water network optimization scheduling model system based on ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a watershed multi-scale water network optimization scheduling model system based on ecological restoration, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration and comprises the steps of constructing a coupling model and simulating different scheduling situations through data acquisition, hydrologic simulation and hydraulic engineering digitization, establishing a scheduling rule base with ecological flow as a target according to the coupling model, and finally intelligently generating a scheduling scheme based on real-time flow monitoring and rule base to realize the optimization scheduling and ecological guarantee of the watershed water network. The method and the system ensure the downstream ecological flow and repair the aquatic ecological system by constructing the ecological dispatching rule base and monitoring the real-time flow, optimize reservoir dispatching by means of hydrologic simulation and engineering digitization, improve the water resource utilization efficiency, integrate the intelligent decision module to realize quick response and automatic dispatching, provide scientific basis for river basin planning by virtue of multiple conditions Jing Tuiyan, and reduce the test cost and uncertainty.
assignees: SHUIFA PLANNING & DESIGN CO LTD;SHUIFA CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Flood three-dimensional visualization method based on image access inundation model result
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood three-dimensional visualization method based on an image access inundation model result, and belongs to the technical field of flood three-dimensional visualization. Aiming at the defects of large network transmission data quantity, complex Web end model result data processing and the like in the traditional GIS three-dimensional flood visualization, the invention provides flood simulation data storage, transmission and restoration technology based on image technology, which stores result data such as grid vertex elevation, water depth, flow speed, flow direction and the like in color components, transmits the result data through texture images, reduces the network transmission data quantity, greatly improves the updating efficiency of the flood state in the submerged process, and utilizes a loader technology to carry out flood rendering visualization on the Web end, so that the flood visualization presentation capability is greatly improved, and the important transition from 'good view' to 'good use' of a flood simulation twin scene is promoted.

title_en: Nature-friendly construction method for the greening of slope using vegetational wire mesh basket and structure
title_ko: 식생철망바구니를 이용한 자연 친화적 사면 녹화 시공 방법 및 구조물
abstract_en: The present invention provides a nature-friendly construction method for greening of a slope using a vegetational wire mesh basket and a structure thereof. The method comprises: (a) a slope clearing and topsoil obtaining step of clearing the sloping slope and obtaining topsoil of a site obtained from a slope clearing work; (b) a rock layer forming step of connecting a plurality of vegetational wire mesh baskets to the cleaned slope and installing the vegetational wire mesh baskets in a horizontal direction, and fixing a rear wire mesh to the slope with a horizontal nail; (d) a soil layer forming step of filling and compacting the soil into a soil filling space to form a soil layer; (e) a cover soil layer forming step of covering the topsoil obtained in the slope cleaning and topsoil obtaining step on the outer surface of the soil layer; (f) a seed sowing step of sowing seeds on the front and top of the cover soil layer with a front cover open, installing an eco-net which prevents soil and plant seeds from leaking and in which the plant seeds decomposes after germination and establishment to provide nutrients necessary for plant seed vegetation, and closing the front cover and a top cover; (g) a soil backfilling step of backfilling and compacting, with the soil, the space between the vegetational wire mesh basket and the slope; and (h) a repeating step of repeatedly performing the steps (b) to (g) until reaching the top along the entire length of the slope. The present invention can satisfy both a disaster prevention effect and ecological restoration.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, (a) 경사진 사면을 정리하고, 사면 정리 작업에서 얻어진 현장의 표토를 수득하는 사면정리 및 표토수득 단계; (b) 정리된 사면에 식생철망바구니를 복수 개 연결하여 수평 방향으로 배열 설치하고, 후면철망을 가로네일로 사면에 고정하는 암석층 형성 단계; (d) 토사충진공간으로 토사를 충진하고 다짐하여 토사층을 형성하는 토사층 형성 단계; (e) 상기 사면정리 및 표토수득 단계에서 수득된 표토를 토사층의 외면에 복토하는 복토층 형성 단계; (f) 전면덮개를 개방한 상태에서 복토층의 전면과 상부에 종자를 파종하되, 토사와 식물 종자의 유출을 방지하고 식물 종자가 발아 및 활착된 후 분해되어 식물 종자의 식생에 필요한 영양분을 제공하는 에코네트를 설치한 후 전면덮개와 상부덮개를 닫는 종자 파종 단계; (g) 식생철망바구니와 사면 사이의 공간을 토사로 되메우고 다져주는 토사 뒷채움 단계; 및 (h) 사면의 경사를 따라 상부에 도달할 때까지 상기 (b) 내지 (g) 단계를 반복하여 실시하는 반복 실시 단계를 포함하는 식생철망바구니를 이용한 자연 친화적 사면 녹화 시공 방법 및 구조물을 제공한다.

title_en: Methods and systems for efficiently recovering from disaster damage to water treatment facilities through simulation
title_ko: 시뮬레이션을 통한 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for efficiently recovering from disaster damage to water treatment facilities is a method of efficiently recovering disaster damage to water treatment facilities in the event of an actual disaster such as an earthquake, flood, or typhoon by determining a recovery sequence for each of water treatment process facilities included in the water treatment facilities through simulation. The method comprises: a facility information acquisition step of acquiring facility information, which is information about each of first to N^th process facilities in the water treatment facility, in which first to N^th steps which are water treatment processes are sequentially performed; a standard information acquisition step of acquiring standard information which is acceptable water quality information for each of the first to N^th process facilities; a measurement information acquisition step of acquiring measurement information, which is information obtained by measuring water quality for each of the first to N^th process facilities; and generating, based on the facility information, the standard information, and the measurement information, priority information for disaster damage recovery in the event of an actual disaster by simulating the disaster damage to each of the first to N^th process facilities due to the occurrence of the disaster.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법은 시뮬레이션을 통해 수처리 시설에 포함된 수처리 공정 시설 각각에 대해 복구 순서를 결정하여, 지진, 홍수, 태풍과 같이 실제로 재난이 발생했을 경우, 수처리 시설에 대해 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법에 관한 것으로서, 수처리 시설 내, 수처리 공정인 제1 단계 내지 제N 단계가 순차적으로 수행되는 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 정보인 시설 정보를 획득하는 시설 정보 획득 단계; 상기 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 허용 가능한 수질 정보인 기준 정보를 획득하는 기준 정보 획득 단계; 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 수질을 측정한 정보인 측정 정보를 획득하는 측정 정보 획득 단계; 상기 시설 정보, 상기 기준 정보 및 상기 측정 정보를 기초로 재난 발생에 따른 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 재난 피해를 시뮬레이션하여 실제 재난 발생 시, 재난피해 복구에 대한 우선순위 정보를 생성하는 시뮬레이션 단계;를 포함하는, 시뮬레이션을 통한 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법일 수 있다.

title_en: Leveraging file-based backups to facilitate bare-metal and system-state recovery operations
abstract_en: A method and system for leveraging file-based backups to facilitate bare-metal recovery (BMR) and/or system-state recovery (SSR) operations. In leading to a BMR operation (which may include, but is not limited to, data protected under a SSR operation), logical groupings of data, each including multiple files and/or directories that span across one or more file-systems, may be written to backup media to comply with data backup, archiving, and/or disaster recovery strategies. Backing up said logical groupings of data relies on block-based backup technologies, which upon requiring a subset of a given logical grouping of data to be restored, makes the restoration process impossible to fulfill since determining which blocks of data belong to which files and/or directories are not tracked. Accordingly, the disclosed method and system propose an intelligent scheme through which file-based backup technology may be employed to enable BMR and/or SSR from any single BMR-compliant backup copy.

title_en: Sliding sand disaster prevention and control device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sliding sand disaster prevention and control device used for fixing sliding sand on a sand slope. The sliding sand disaster prevention and control device comprises timber piles, timber pile connecting battens and vegetation planting bags. The timber piles are placed into the sand slope, the tops of the timber piles are connected through the timber pile connecting battens, and the vegetation planting bags are placed beside the timber piles. Compared with the prior art, the sliding sand disaster prevention and control device has the advantages that survival of vegetation can be well promoted by placing the timber piles in the sand slope; restoration and rehabilitation of the ecological environment are facilitated because a protection effective period is long with the method of fixing the sand through the vegetation; construction is simple and convenient because when the device is used, a worker only needs to place the timber piles into the sand slope, connect the tops of the timber piles through the battens and place the vegetation planting bags.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Water environment restoration and purification device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water purification technology field, concretely relates to purifier is restoreed to water environment, including purifying box, inlet tube and outlet pipe, the upper end through connection who purifies the box has the inlet tube, and the right-hand member through connection who purifies the box has the outlet pipe. The utility model overcomes prior art's is not enough, through carrying the conveyer trough with the water through the inlet tube in, carry out the sintering through the silt of heater to the aquatic, and the conveyer trough is slope form setting, make the silt that the sintering finishes can be rapid in transporting to depositing the mud case, it raises to have avoided in the water silt too much to make the water, the probability of taking place flood disasters scheduling problem has been reduced, transmit the heat to the metal pole through the heating rod, and the metal pole is the heliciform setting, make the area increase of heating, it leads to heating inhomogeneously to have avoided the too high accumulation of heat, thereby produce the dry combustion method phenomenon, the holistic factor of safety of purifier has been improved, make the life-span extension of heater equipment simultaneously.

title_en: Lake optimal water level determination method considering coexistence relation of water level and hydrologic connectivity
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of water resource planning and management, in particular to a lake optimal water level determination method considering the coexistence relation of water level and hydrologic connectivity. The method comprises the following steps: analyzing and processing the remote sensing image of the set lake to obtain hydrologic connectivity data; acquiring water level data of a set lake; calculating a correlation coefficient between hydrologic connectivity and water level, and judging the correlation between hydrologic connectivity and water level series; respectively constructing an edge distribution function of hydrologic connectivity and water level; obtaining a joint probability distribution function of the Copula function and the Copula function by utilizing the Copula function; and setting different water supplementing scenes of hydrologic connectivity and water level by combining lake water supplementing management requirements and ecological restoration targets, and determining the optimal lake water level by utilizing joint probability and conditional probability analysis. The invention considers the coexistence relation between the water level and hydrologic connectivity and the uncertainty of the coexistence relation on the water supplementing management, determines the optimal water level of the lake, and provides a quantitative basis for the water supplementing management of the lake.

title_en: Dynamic risk assessment method for tanning contaminated site based on reactive solute transport
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic risk assessment method for a tanning contaminated site based on reactive solute transport, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting contaminated site soil, underground water samples and data, and investigating the type of the contaminated site, the generation working condition and the seepage prevention measures; s2, constructing a soil migration conceptual model and a numerical model according to scenes, and calculating migration of pollutants in the air-packing belt medium; s3, establishing a chemical balance system of the tanning characteristic pollutant based on a thermodynamic database, and analyzing migration and transformation rules of the pollutant in an aquifer medium; s4, calculating static exposure risks and dynamic potential exposure risks of living residents around the site; s5, deducing the dynamic exposure risk of solute transport in the field by taking the acceptance degree of the exposure risk as a criterion, and balancing and optimizing the field exposure risk investigation-evaluation-management. Reasonable risk management and control, site restoration and ecological environment protection strategies can be further formulated to provide scientific basis.
assignees: CHINA 19TH METALLURGICAL CORP;SICHUAN CHUANGONG HUANYUAN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD;SICHUAN INST OF INDUSTRIAL ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING

title_en: Method for treating metal surface after fire by using tetra sodium ethylenediamine tetraacetate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating the surface of metal after fire by using tetra sodium ethylenediamine tetraacetate, which belongs to the field of metal material restoration, and comprises the following specific steps: (1) collecting and cleaning metal parts affected by disaster; (2) Placing the cleaned metal part into reducing gas for reduction; (3) preparing Na4EDTA solution to soak the metal part; (4) Collecting image information of the metal part and spraying a protective coating; the invention realizes the real-time monitoring and adjustment of the coating application, improves the construction precision and efficiency, and can lead the metal parts to resist corrosion and oxidation for a longer time, thereby reducing the cost of subsequent maintenance and repair, and simultaneously realizing the precise control of the treatment process so as to meet the requirements of different metals and applications.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHULEI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network outage information resource pool design method and system based on topology analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power failure information resource pool design method and system for a power distribution network based on topology analysis, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring electricity consumption data of the distribution transformer in real time, and acquiring position change information of an automatic switch; regarding various automatic switches as branches in the topological graph to obtain the topological graph of the nodes and the branches; judging switch deflection information and distribution transformer power failure signal information, and judging a power failure area range and listing power failure information by combining the logic topological relation of an automatic switch and a distribution transformer; and constructing a multi-time real-time power outage information resource pool by utilizing the power outage area range and the power outage information, and establishing a full-quantity power outage information resource pool of the power distribution network. According to the invention, the information is calibrated with a plurality of priorities, the multi-source power failure and restoration information is subjected to data cleaning, the effective information is accurately researched and judged, the power failure area range and the power failure information are determined, a full-quantity power failure information resource pool is constructed, the transparentization level of the power distribution network is improved, and the safe, reliable and efficient operation of the active power distribution network is effectively supported.
assignees: XUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for plugging water in pit slope footrill
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for plugging water on an open pit side slope, which belongs to the technical field of mine facilities, comprehensively adopts multi-level measures such as retaining walls, waterproof cloth, dike protection, plant ecological systems and the like to ensure that an excellent waterproof effect is realized under extreme hydrologic conditions, effectively reduces the risks of water invasion and soil erosion, passes engineering means such as bearing columns, pile foundations, anchoring treatment and the like, enhances the stability of a footbed structure, reduces the potential risks of geological landslide and soil settlement, ensures the sustainability and safety of the pit side slope, ensures that amphibious plants adopted in the method not only play a role in waterproof aspects, but also provide important habitats for ecological systems, improves vegetation coverage and wild animal and plant habitat, is beneficial to ecological restoration and protection, has lower construction cost of the whole scheme, does not need subsequent maintenance operation, and has high construction flexibility.

title_en: Heavy metal polluted water area restoration evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heavy metal polluted water area restoration evaluation method and system, in particular to the field of heavy metal polluted water area restoration evaluation systems, which comprises a data acquisition module for acquiring water area data, the data acquisition module is electrically connected with a data analysis module for analyzing and acquiring data information, and the data analysis module is electrically connected with a recording module for recording treatment data information and a treatment module for designing a new treatment scheme. According to the invention, the data acquisition module is used for acquiring water in the water area, the data analysis module is used for analyzing the water, so that whether pollution can be repaired after the polluted water area passes through treatment can be checked, meanwhile, the recording module is used for recording an initial treatment scheme which can be repaired, the treatment module is used for collecting data information and formulating other treatment schemes according to the data information, and secondary treatment is carried out on the treated water area, so that progressive treatment effect is achieved, and water area repair is more perfect.
assignees: SHENZHEN GREEN CENTURY ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Exterior Emergency Reinforcement Method of Concrete Structures Using Steel Band
title_ko: 스틸밴드를 이용한 철근콘크리트 구조물의 응급 외부 보강공법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an emergency exterior reinforcement method of a reinforced concrete structure comprises a first and a second reinforcing step. The first reinforcing step includes: a step of arranging a support member on a reinforced concrete structure; a step of arranging a steel band of a grid structure supported on the support member around the structure; and a step of giving tension to the steel band. The second reinforcing step includes: a step of using a fixing bolt to attach a first reinforcing plate to an outer circumferential surface of the reinforced concrete structure, and using a fixing bolt to attach a second reinforcing plate in a direction opposite to the attached first reinforcing plate; a step of installing one or more eyebolts through the first and the second reinforcing plate; a step of coupling a ring of one side of a steel wire rope to an eyebolt installed on the first reinforcing plate, and coupling a ring of the other side of the steel wire rope to an eyebolt installed on the second reinforcing plate to connect the eyebolts and the steel wire rope; and a step of adjusting tension by adjustment nuts and the eyebolts to which both ends of the steel wire rope are coupled. Simple assembly and installation at a site are possible by binding devices such as steel bands, steel wire ropes, reinforcing plates, and bolts to provide excellent constructability. Therefore, improved effects as a seismic reinforcing method before an earthquake occurs can be expected. The emergency exterior reinforcement method of a reinforced concrete structure using a steel band can be applied as effective emergency reinforcement in earthquake restoration requiring quickness to suppress abrupt collapses by destruction or deformation immediately after an earthquake disaster.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 철근콘크리트 구조물의 응급 외부 보강공법은, 철근콘크리트 구조물에 지지부재를 구비하는 단계; 상기 구조물 둘레를 따라 상기 지지부재에 지지되는 격자 구조의 스틸밴드를 구비하는 단계; 상기 스틸밴드에 긴장력을 부여하는 단계를 포함하는 제1 보강단계와, 상기 보강된 철근콘크리트 구조물의 외주면에 제1 보강판을 고정볼트를 이용하여 부착시키고, 부착된 상기 제1 보강판과 반대 방향으로 제2 보강판을 고정볼트를 이용하여 부착시키는 단계; 상기 제1 보강판 및 상기 제2 보강판에 하나 이상의 아이볼트를 관통시켜 설치하는 단계; 상기 제1 보강판에 설치되는 아이볼트에 스틸와이어로프의 일측 고리를 체결하고, 상기 제2 보강판에 설치되는 아이볼트에 상기 스틸와이어로프의 타측 고리를 체결하여 연결하는 단계; 및 상기 스틸와이어로프의 양단부가 체결된 상기 아이볼트와 조절너트로 인장을 조절하는 단계를 포함하는 제2 보강단계로 구성되는 공법으로서, 현장에서 스틸밴드, 스틸와이어로프, 보강판, 볼트 등과 같은 결속장치로 간단하게 조립, 설치할 수 있어 시공성이 뛰어나며, 따라서, 지진 발생 전, 내진 보강공법으로 높은 효과를 기대할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 지진 재해 직후 파괴 또는 변형으로 인해 급격한 붕괴를 억제할 수 있도록 신속성이 요구되는 지진 복구에도 유효한 응급 보강으로 적용할 수 있는 스틸밴드를 이용한 철근콘크리트 구조물의 응급 외부 보강공법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KOREA NATIONAL UNIV OF TRANSPORTATION INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION;SEON ARCHITECTS & ENG GROUP

title_en: Directed unmanned aircraft for enhanced power outage recovery
abstract_en: Methods, systems and computer program products for enhancing power outage recovery using a drone are provided. Aspects include identifying a predicted damage area based on one or more forecast models of a weather event and staging a drone in the predicted damage area prior to the weather event. Aspects also include dispatching the drone to survey one or more portions of the predicted damage area after the weather event and assessing damage to infrastructure equipment in the one or more portions of the predicted damage area. Aspects further include dispatching a repair crew based on the assessed damage.

title_en: Disaster restoration plan generation apparatus, disaster restoration plan generation method and program
abstract_en: A disaster recovery plan producing device produces a disaster recovery plan for at least one geographically dispersed location and includes an embedding unit which calculates, using a neural network, a feature quantity for each of the locations from input data including at least position information and a priority about the location, a plan producing unit which determines, using a neural network, an order for performing disaster recovery to the at least one location as a disaster recovery plan on the basis of the feature quantity, and a reinforcement learning unit which learns parameters of the neural network which constitutes the embedding unit and parameters of the neural network which constitutes the plan producing unit by reinforcement learning.

title_en: Geological disaster and ecological restoration greening spray seeding device and maintenance method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a greening spray-seeding device for geological disasters and ecological restoration and a maintenance method thereof, and relates to the technical field of greening spray-seeding devices. Including mobile device, first driving motor, blowing device, the blowing device includes blowing case, storehouse seat, second sieve charging tray, first sieve charging tray, the fixed discharge chassis that is provided with of bottom outer wall of blowing case. Through starting second driving motor drive mixer rotation, the reaction efficiency of ratio liquid medicine is accelerated, drive the clear scraper blade of mixer outer wall simultaneously and continuously scrape the fertilizer of adsorbing at the inner wall of first sieve charging tray and blowing case, thereby guarantee that the medicine can intensive mixing, the pulling control handle drives the spacer pin downwards and breaks away from corresponding spacing hole, start second driving motor drive first sieve charging tray rotation, make the bin outlet expose, the liquid medicine drops via the bin outlet, carry out secondary filtering again via the second sieve charging tray, start and adjust the shower nozzle and spray the medicine.

title_en: Ecological comprehensive restoration and intelligent monitoring method for dry lake basin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dry lake basin ecological comprehensive restoration and intelligent monitoring method, which comprises the steps of realizing edge locking and sand control inside a dry lake basin by carrying out soil-alien transplanting and the like on primary plants in the dry lake basin, forming sand substance sealing and controlling plant strips by planting native plants on the edge of the dry lake basin along the circumferential direction, fixing surface quicksand by planting sandy plants on quicksand lands on the periphery of the dry lake basin and the like, and constructing plant sand fixation grids by planting sand fixation arbor and shrubs in a upwind area on the periphery of the dry lake basin and covering a sand fixation net and the like. The invention can obviously improve the wind prevention and sand fixation efficiency of the surrounding area of the dry lake basin, effectively reduce the frequency of wind and sand disasters, provide firm guarantee for the regional safety, and simultaneously effectively promote the optimization of the soil structure and the natural recovery of vegetation, not only enhance the water and fertilizer retention capacity of the soil, but also obviously improve the service functions of regional ecosystems, such as water conservation, climate regulation and the like.

title_en: Operation risk assessment method and device based on network security situation awareness system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation risk assessment method and device based on a network security situation perception system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data of a network security situation perception system in advance and analyzing and processing the historical data; performing feature selection and data preprocessing on historical data of the network security situation perception system to generate a training set and a test set of a training learning model; training a learning model by adopting a machine learning algorithm, and exporting an intelligent analysis model after the learning model meets the requirement of average accuracy; calculating the expected recovery power supply time and the loss load of the intelligent analysis model by adopting a general recovery target algorithm of the power system; and performing risk evaluation calculation according to the expected power restoration time, the loss load and the threat intrusion probability of the intelligent analysis model to obtain a corresponding network safety operation loss risk value. The method and the system can be combined with the power system intrusion probability model and the network security situation perception system to evaluate and calculate the operation risk, and improve the accuracy of risk evaluation.
assignees: CHINA ENERGY ENG GROUP GUANGDONG ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Power supply reliability assessment method considering island division and network reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply reliability assessment method considering island division and network reconstruction, which comprises the following steps: s1, classifying the system load nodes according to the fault occurrence position of the power distribution system, the power supply capacity of the power distribution system and the load requirements, and completing the division of the network fault area of the system; s2, forming an island through a distributed power supply to supply power to nodes in the region, reconstructing the network to recover the power supply of the rest nodes, and determining the recovery sequence of each node according to the system node parameters; and S3, evaluating the power supply reliability of the power distribution network containing the distributed power supply by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method according to different running states of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;EAST CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Power grid duplicate decision generation method and system based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid duplicate decision generation method and system based on a knowledge graph. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: in response to a power grid failure, power grid operation data of the power grid and a power grid structure are obtained, wherein the power grid structure comprises at least one of the following: a centralized power generation grid, a distributed power generation grid; generating a target complex electricity decision map corresponding to a power grid structure, wherein the target complex electricity decision map is used for representing the relationship between a plurality of complex electricity strategy influence elements and a plurality of complex electricity strategy influence elements in the power grid, and the plurality of complex electricity strategy influence elements are used for representing elements influencing the complex electricity operation of the power grid; and processing the power grid operation data based on the target power restoration decision map to obtain a power restoration strategy of the power grid, wherein the power restoration strategy is used for representing a strategy adopted for restoring the power grid to a normal operation state. The invention solves the technical problem of lower generation efficiency of the power grid double-electricity strategy in the related technology.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for realizing strong consistency synchronization of elastic search cluster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for realizing strong consistency synchronization of an elastic search cluster, wherein the method comprises the following steps: writing data into a main partition of a main index to which a document belongs, after the data is written successfully, sending a writing request to a node where the main partition of a slave index to which the document belongs is located, simultaneously regarding the main partition of the slave index as a remote copy of the main partition of the main index, and writing the data into the remote copy to realize real-time data synchronization; the main fragment of the main index sends the segment file which is stored and dropped to the remote copy, and analyzes the storage information of the actual data in the segment file; and the main shard of the main index sends translog logs storing the non-dropped disk to the remote copy, so that the remote copy is restored to a data state consistent with the main shard, and the historical data restoration is realized. The method and the device copy the index in the remote cluster to the local cluster, and ensure the strong consistency of the master-slave data, thereby providing high availability and quick disaster recovery capability and realizing uninterrupted inter-cluster index migration.
assignees: ZHONGYING YOUCHUANG INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent distribution network overhaul automatic permission data model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distribution network dispatching automation technology in a power system, in particular to an intelligent distribution network overhaul automatic permission data model. The invention comprises a data acquisition module, a data verification module, an automatic permission module, a device condition verification module before power restoration and a data backfill module. The data acquisition module acquires related data from the distribution network OMS system and the OCS system, the data verification module performs device state consistency verification, logic verification and association verification, the automatic permission module automatically permits and generates permission information after verification passes, the device condition verification module performs verification before re-electrification on the device, and the data backfill module backfills the permission information to the distribution network OMS system. According to the invention, multidimensional data are integrated, the accuracy, reliability and efficiency of overhaul permission are improved through hierarchical verification, and overhaul safety and stable operation of a power grid are ensured.

title_en: Power grid planning method and system based on load prediction and energy storage cooperation
abstract_en: The application discloses a power grid planning method and a system based on load prediction and energy storage cooperation, and relates to the technical field of load prediction, comprising the following steps of obtaining load data, wherein the load data comprises load change and load time sequence data; the method comprises the steps of dynamically mapping load change into pseudo-seismic wave amplitude, converting the pseudo-seismic wave amplitude into pseudo-seismic wave signals matched with the time-space characteristics of load time sequence data based on Morlet wavelet basis function, predicting future seismic wave signals according to the pseudo-seismic wave signals, converting the future seismic wave signals into predicted load values based on a dynamic integral restoration algorithm, and verifying the predicted load values and carrying out power grid planning. According to the application, the load change is converted into the earthquake wave form through mathematical mapping, and the earthquake wave analysis technology is multiplexed to realize high-sensitivity load prediction.
assignees: ANHUI FANGNENG ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Network updating method for post-disaster road restoration map fused with heterogeneous disaster sensing data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of emergency management and discloses a network updating method of a post-disaster road restoration map fused with heterogeneous disaster sensing data, which comprises the steps of converting acquired heterogeneous data into basic probability distribution of observation evidence; the method comprises the steps of predicting a physical field state based on a physical process simulator, generating basic probability distribution of prediction evidence, fusing the two to obtain posterior basic probability distribution, deciding and updating a road map network state according to the posterior basic probability distribution, and feeding the updated state back to the simulator as a dynamic boundary condition to form bidirectional coupling of the physical simulation and the road map state. According to the application, by constructing the simulation assimilation framework of the bidirectional coupling, the technical problems of physical simulation and infrastructure state fracture in the traditional method are solved, the uncertainty of data is effectively processed by utilizing the evidence theory, and the authenticity of disaster evolution prediction and the reliability of road state update are improved.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Method for evaluating repairing effect of panel vertical joint water stop structure
abstract_en: The application discloses a panel vertical joint water stop structure restoration effect evaluation method ‌, which comprises the steps of firstly synchronously acquiring surface crack and internal defect data through the cooperative detection of infrared thermal imaging and ultrasonic flaw detection. And (3) carrying out spatial alignment on the point cloud data generated by the three-dimensional laser scanning and the ultrasonic detection result, and establishing a BIM model containing the three-dimensional form of the crack. And (3) simulating an actual engineering environment in a laboratory to perform material accelerated aging, testing key indexes such as elastic recovery rate and the like, evaluating the basal plane state through a temperature and humidity sensor array in a construction stage, performing accurate filling by adopting a six-axis grouting robot, monitoring a curing process by using a synchronous embedded optical fiber sensor, continuously acquiring deformation data by using a distributed optical fiber network after a hydraulic test is combined with climate simulated aging, constructing a comprehensive evaluation model based on mechanical, durability and tightness indexes, and finally optimizing material selection and process parameters through machine learning.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Reliability evaluation method, system, equipment and storage medium for active power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reliability evaluation method, a system, equipment and a storage medium of an active power distribution network, which are applied to the technical field of power, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining topological structure data of a target active power distribution network and fault influence data of all power utilization elements on a user side in the target active power distribution network, performing simulated overhaul processing on a plurality of first power utilization elements by using a graph traversal technology based on the topological structure data to obtain a plurality of overhaul power outage matrixes, performing simulated isolation processing on a plurality of second power utilization elements by using the graph traversal technology to obtain a plurality of isolation power outage matrixes, inputting the overhaul power outage matrixes and the isolation power outage matrixes into a power outage restoration relation to obtain power outage restoration data, and processing the power outage restoration data by taking time sequence output of the target active power distribution network as constraint to generate a reliability evaluation result corresponding to the target active power distribution network. The method provided by the invention can realize the effect of accurately and quantitatively evaluating the toughness of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL RESEARCH INST CO LTD;ECONOMIC AND TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Emergency disaster information receiver
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an emergency disaster information receiver which improves peripheral safety by receiving a television broadcast signal from a broadcast station transmitting emergency disaster information by using an AC carrier of a television broadcast signal when disaster occurs, informing a periphery that the emergency disaster information is included in a reception signal when the emergency disaster information is included in the reception signal and operating an external device such as a television receiver.SOLUTION: In emergency earthquake prompt report reception processing, restoration of an emergency earthquake prompt report in an AC demodulation section is displayed on a display section when the report is restored in the AC demodulation section (S110) and an alarm sound is generated from an alarm sound generation section in accordance with setting of a user (S130). A control signal for safely operating an external device such as an elevator is outputted from an output terminal 8 (S190). A command signal (power-on command, emergency broadcast channel selection command) for receiving emergency broadcast is transmitted to an external television receiver from a remote control transmission section (S170 and S180).

title_en: Temporary support structural system for power lines
abstract_en: Natural disasters, such as cyclones, earthquakes, landslides, etc., or manmade damages, such as structural member's theft, terrorist attacks, etc., can cause collapse of transmission line towers. If these are not restored in time, there will be monetary loss to utilities as well as loss of service to consumers leading to societal impact. Generally, permanent restoration takes several weeks. Hence, a temporary solution for quick retrieval of power transmission is required. This invention provides a temporary support structural system comprising light weight guyed masts (1) made of readymade robust modules (6 and 7), easy to connect connection system, two pin gimbal joint (8) and easy to construct foundation system (9 and 10). The invention is flexible enough to develop various configurations for single or double circuit transmission lines. It is also scalable and can be used for 33 to 800 kV transmission lines.
assignees: COUNCIL OF SCIENT AND INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH AN INDIAN REGISTERED BODY INCORPORATED UNDER THE REGN OF S

title_en: Power system restoring force evaluation method considering network attack
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system restoring force evaluation method considering network attack, which comprises the following steps: 1, establishing an electric power-communication composite system model; 2, calculating the probability of success of each node attack, simulating the influence caused by the attack, and carrying out cooperative recovery on the power transmission information physical system; 3, restoring force calculation and evaluation. The invention considers the influence of the network attack on the power system of the power system information network and evaluates the power grid restoration force, thereby improving the disaster resistance capability of the power system under the network attack.

title_en: Method for restoring green ecology of mine goaf
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for restoring green ecology in a mine goaf, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: A. preparing soil; B. paving a component; C. filling a culture medium and soil; D. planting plants and trees; E. and (5) management. The novel artificial mountain is quickly constructed in the mine goaf through the supporting function of the components, meanwhile, effective greening is carried out through planted plants and trees, water storage and water retention can be carried out when rainwater arrives, the water conservation capacity is improved, the water release speed is reduced, the water retention period is prolonged, the growth requirements of the plants and the trees are met, the survival rate is improved, the greening effect of the goaf mine is consolidated, the greening landscape is promoted, and landslide and soil erosion of the mountain are effectively prevented.
