The invention has the advantages of convenient, quick and safe construction, no energy consumption, low restoration cost and good effect, and provides convenient and practical technical support for restoring the ecological environment and restoring the vegetation of the large-area mine goaf.

title_en: Emergency repair method under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency repair method under typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of firstly determining a disaster area of a power grid according to typhoon monitoring information in a first stage before the disaster, collecting meteorological data, distribution network data, geographic data and other data of the disaster area, calculating line fault probability based on the collected data, establishing a temporary allocation center site selection model according to the fault probability and the position, and solving to obtain a temporary allocation center position. And then, a post-disaster broken line scene is generated by utilizing a Monte Carlo simulation and synchronous back-up scene reduction method in the post-disaster stage, a post-disaster distribution network emergency repair restoration optimization model is established based on the post-disaster broken line scene, and the model is solved to obtain a post-disaster area distribution network emergency repair restoration optimization strategy, so that rapid emergency repair restoration of the distribution network fault under typhoon disasters is realized.

title_en: Cloud communication-based oiling machine remote data management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oiling machine data management, in particular to an oiling machine remote data management method and system based on cloud communication. The method comprises the steps of generating a batch data block by a site terminal according to a time threshold packet, executing reversible compression and anchor point insertion, generating batch metadata by taking a hash tree root value as a batch identifier, establishing a safe session with a cloud end when the site terminal is on line and uploading the session according to transaction priority, fountain-framing the data block and the metadata into an optical frame array when the site terminal is off line, broadcasting the optical frame array by a price display screen, acquiring and decoding video of a mobile terminal, and uploading the optical frame array. The cloud end restores the data block based on the reconstruction fragment and the metadata, verifies the integrity by combining frame-level verification and batch identification, writes transaction records and running states into a transaction library and a time sequence library respectively by idempotent deduplication of the site identification and the batch identification, generates a receipt short code synchronous station end, and realizes consistency reconciliation according to batch supplementary transmission according to a missing list after network restoration.

title_en: Smart wearable device with multiple functions and Safety Monitoring System using the same
title_ko: 멀티기능을 갖는 스마트 웨어러블 디바이스 및 이를 이용한 안전 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a safety monitoring system using a smart wearable device with multiple functions comprises: a smart wearable device detecting or capturing images of wearer′s biometric information, motion information, and surrounding view information when the wearer is located in an emergency area, a disaster area, or a restoration area and then, transmitting the images; a smart workwear module including a plurality of bioelectrodes for measuring wearer′s bio-information and an inner skin provided with a thermoelectric element layer for adjusting internal temperature according to external temperature; a smart helmet module transmitting a captured image of a surrounding view using infrared or visible light depending on an illuminance value of a surrounding environment to the smart workwear module; a smart boots module sensing wearer′s ankle muscular strength information and ankle angular velocity and transmitting the same to the smart workwear module; and a smart gloves module sensing pressure information applied to the wearer′s hand and wrist muscular strength information relative to finger movement and transmitting the same to the smart workwear module, wherein each module is activated when worn by the wearer.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 멀티기능을 갖는 스마트 웨어러블 디바이스 안전 모니터링 시스템은 구급지역 또는 재난지역 또는 복구지역에 착용자가 위치할 경우, 착용자의 생체정보, 모션정보 및 주변영상정보를 검출 또는 촬영하여 송출하는 스마트 웨어러블 디바이스; 착용자의 생체정보를 측정하기 위한 복수 개의 생체전극 및 외부 온도에 따라 내부온도를 조절하는 열전소자층이 구비된 내피를 포함하는 스마트 작업복 모듈; 주변환경의 조도값에 따라 적외선 또는 가시광으로 주변영상을 촬영한 촬영영상을 상기 스마트 작업복 모듈로 전송하는 스마트 헬멧 모듈; 착용자의 발목 근력정보 및 발목의 각속도를 센싱하여 상기 스마트 작업복 모듈로 전송하는 스마트 부츠 모듈; 및 착용자의 손에 가해진 가압정보 및 손가락 움직임에 손목 근력정보를 센싱하여 상기 스마트 작업복 모듈로 전송하는 스마트 장갑모듈을 포함하고, 각 모듈은 착용자의 착용시에 동작이 활성화되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Comprehensive prevention and control facility structure suitable for wind and sand of railway of plateau river wide-valley section
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wind and sand comprehensive prevention and control facility structure suitable for wind and sand of a railway of a plateau river wide-valley section. The structure comprises a wide-valley overflow dam, a bank slope eave type T-shaped sand retaining wall, a high vertical V-shaped energy-dissipation, wind-prevention and sand-blocking fence and a chemical sand-fixing, net-covering and artificial vegetation-restoration area, and is arranged on a wide-valley bank slope at the peripheries of the railway and a wide-valley bridge. According to the principle of adjusting measures to local conditions and fortifying to disasters, the comprehensive protection system which integrates sand prevention, sand blocking, sand fixing and sediment discharge is formed, the blind area of the wind and sand prevention and control technology of the plateau railway is filled, and the theoretical basis and technical reserves are provided for the wind and sand prevention and control of the railway of the plateau river wide-valley section. The structure has been applied to the prevention and control of wind and sand disasters of Tuotuo river wide-valley section of Qinghai-Tibet railway, the better ecologic and economic benefits are generated, and the promotion on the safe running of the Qinghai-Tibet railway and the improvement of local ecologic environments is ensured.
assignees: COLD & ARID REGIONS ENVIRONMENTAL & ENG RES INST CAS

title_en: Upright post for flood area and street lamp applying same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a street lamp that is used for stand and applied this stand in flood area that sends out more, include the hollow cylinder with the vertical rigid coupling of installation face, be equipped with the terminal box that can controlled lift in the hollow cylinder, originally all be located the wiring board of inner chamber lower part in this stand, a controller, inductor etc. can place in the terminal box specially, when needs overhaul the maintenance, open and overhaul the hole and fall the terminal box to the entrance to a cave can, the terminal box all is located cylinder inner chamber upper portion under the conventional condition, even proruption flood disaster, the wiring board of no parcel, a controller, inductor etc. also can not submerged or drench, can effectively reduce street lamp damage rate, the restoration degree of difficulty has still avoidd the electric leakage, potential safety hazards such as electric shock, have very big spreading value and wide application prospect.

title_en: Distribution network failure isolation and quick power service restoration decision support system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power network safety operation, and in particular relates to a distribution network failure isolation and quick power service restoration decision support system. The system is connected with a distribution automation system, comprises a real-time subsystem, a simulation subsystem, an accident inversion subsystem and a knowledge generating subsystem, and acquires power network operation monitoring data from the distribution automation system through a data interface, automatically tracks the real-time operating state of the power network, can quickly provide a power supply restoration scheme and intuitive simulation effect for a dispatcher to determine a proper restoration sequence after a failure happens, and provides accident simulation and accident inversion function; and the subsystems can be subjected to interface switching. The system is suitable for a distribution network which has a complicated network structure and of which the failure cannot be treated by automation equipment.

title_en: Feeder fault handling method
abstract_en: The invention introduces a feeder fault handling method, which comprises the following steps of: 1) conducting online search and locating a feeder fault; 2) conducting network topology analysis to draw a conclusion; 3) finding out the section of the fault; 4) searching for the boundary switch of the fault section and making a fault isolation plan; 5) defining non-fault power outage areas; 6) making power supply restoration plans for outage areas on the upstream side and the downstream side of the fault; 7) conducting safety evaluation to the downstream power supply restoration plan; and 8) executing the plans according to the safety evaluation obtained at the step 7. The feeder fault handling method has the advantages that: 1) the method is suitable for the automatic construction of feeders of a power distribution network which is wired in any way; 2) the practicability is high, the impedance parameters of the equipment of the distribution network are not required and the power flow calculation module is not required to be called; and 3) the power supply restoration can be separately conducted to the non-fault sections, so as to reduce the power outage range and decrease the power outage duration as much as possible.
assignees: SCIENCE RES INST HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;BEIJING SIFANG AUTOMATION CO

title_en: Method and device for evaluating power supply reliability of low-voltage user and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating the power supply reliability of a low-voltage user and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method for evaluating the power supply reliability of the low-voltage user comprises the following steps: collecting power failure and restoration information of the intelligent electric meters in the statistical area to form a first power failure event set; calculating the power failure duration time of each power failure event according to the formed first power failure event set; removing non-effective power failure events from the first power failure event set to form a second power failure event set; calculating the total number of the households in the power supply reliability statistical area during power failure according to the second power failure event set and the power failure duration time; calculating the average power failure time of the users according to the total number of users and the total number of users in power failure; and calculating the power supply reliability in the statistical area according to the average power failure time of the user. The method can be combined with the user power failure data collected by the intelligent ammeter to evaluate the power supply reliability of the low-voltage users, and provides statistical technology and theoretical support for extending the power supply reliability of the power distribution network to the low-voltage users.

title_en: Operation method and system for simulating flood of reservoir hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention provides an operation method and system for simulating flood of a reservoir hydropower station, which are characterized in that a flood peak value is found out by counting the last year of flood, the flood is used as comparison flood, the reservoir water level in the process of carrying out flood simulation is taken as the upstream water level of the hydropower station, the total full-water flow of the hydropower station at the upstream water level is calculated, the total full-water flow is compared with the maximum flood peak value to obtain a simulation coefficient, the comparison flood process is scaled according to the simulation coefficient, the hour-by-hour operation flow of the hydropower station is obtained, the operation is carried out according to the flow, the flood process simulation is realized, and the restoration function of the reservoir hydropower station to a downstream river channel is improved.

title_en: Quantum encryption-based power system scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system dispatching method and a power system dispatching system based on quantum encryption, which relate to the technical field of power dispatching and comprise the steps of designing a power system dispatching network architecture, determining a dispatching control center and a control node, and carrying out information transmission between the dispatching control center and the control node by adopting a quantum encryption communication link; the method comprises the steps of generating and distributing an encryption key between a dispatching center and each node through a quantum channel, encrypting information and dispatching instructions in the power system, transmitting the encrypted data and dispatching instructions to a target site for restoration, and adjusting operation parameters of the power system to dispatch the power system. The invention effectively reduces the vulnerability of the whole system, enhances the defending capability against external interference, ensures the continuity and efficiency of power grid dispatching, ensures that the power grid can keep stable operation under various conditions, and ensures the real-time performance of signals on the premise of ensuring the accuracy of the signals.

title_en: Multi-parameter comprehensive evaluation method for ecological health of underground water body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-parameter comprehensive evaluation method for ecological health of underground water, which relates to the technical field of water resource protection and ecological environment evaluation, and aims to collect multi-source data such as water quality, hydrology, ecology, human society and the like through a sensor network and comprehensively cover key elements of an ecological system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a model framework for coupling ecological-hydrologic processes, fusing an ecological process model and a groundwater dynamics model, simulating interaction of the ecological process model and the groundwater dynamics model, excavating a pollution source-water body-organism complex relationship by using a groundwater ecological cognition map and a graph neural network, and optimizing an inference rule by combining a dynamic inference engine for autonomous learning, so that high accuracy and strong adaptability of an evaluation model are realized. And finally, according to the reasoning result, outputting management decision suggestions such as pollution prevention and control, water resource scheduling, ecological restoration and the like in a grading manner. Provides a scientific, reliable and operable technical scheme for groundwater resource protection and environment management, and has important application value.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;NANJIANG HYDROLOGY GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING GEOLOGICAL TEAM CHONGQING BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERALS E;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Configuration system of computer system in which front server capable of continuing immediate online operation is arranged when large scale disaster occurs
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To immediately continue an online business without being influenced by conditions such as hard resources of a backup system and conditions and the like of system operations.  <P>SOLUTION: Functions of software is divided into a counter operation processing and processing except a counter operations and the hardware resources are hierarchized by a front SV and a backup computer. When a large scale disaster occurs, system restoration is performed by restoration levels. 1-3. At the restoration level. 1, two front SVs executes a single (virtual HOST) operation to stack transaction data, At the restoration level. 2, starting of operation of a 6 backup system is detected and the transaction data stacked by a 5 front SV is handed over to a backup system. Until processing of all the pieces of stacked transaction data is completed, the 5 front SV continues the single (virtual HOST) operation. By the restoration level. 3, a 9 backup system completes processing of all the pieces of stacked data to be restored to a state of normal operation.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Online dynamic decision-making method and system for unit restoration
abstract_en: An online dynamic decision-making method and system for unit restoration. Said method comprises: determining a black-start power source when a system is restored, and from all the units, selecting as a set of units to be restored units needing to be preferentially started; generating a labeled training set including, as much as possible, various states of the units in the restoration process; constructing a value estimation network; determining a power outage range of the system, identifying the state of the system, determining availability of various devices in the system, and acquiring unit characteristics; perform a Monte Carlo tree search with the value estimation network and taking the total power generation capability of the units as a search target; performing a constraint check on various candidate lines using a parallel computation method; summarizing Monte Carlo tree search results, selecting a power transmission line to be restored in the next step and enabling same; and according to real-time system restoration data, performing online dynamic decision-making of power transmission lines that need to be enabled during unit restoration, and instructing the unit restoration in the early stage of power system restoration.

title_en: Distributed disaster recovery file sync server system
abstract_en: Example implementations are directed to restoration of data not only from the servers, but also from the clients connected to the server. Algorithms are incorporated to identify content that was created or modified after the last backup. This algorithm also identifies and resolves changes in the mount points for shared folders, preventing information leakage. When the server recovers from a failure, it notifies the clients about the recovery on their next connection. Each client then determines the current state of its mount points and file paths and compares them with the server's mount points and file paths. After the comparison, the client comprehends and indicates the mount point differences by renaming them and sends entire local data (all files, folders, mount points) to the server. The server reconciles the differences.

title_en: Fire mitigation and downed conductor detection systems and methods
abstract_en: A transformer monitoring device has one or more voltage sensors and/or one or more current sensors integral with a housing for detecting voltage and/or current of a power cable of a transformer. The transformer monitoring device can be configured to monitor voltage data, current data, voltage imbalance, phase angle, outage detection and restoration detection, and/or transformer temperature changes, etc., and cause alerts to be issued directly and/or by a remote central computing device if voltage levels drop and/or spike beyond operator-established tolerance(s), and/or if transformer temperature changes occur outside of operator-established tolerance(s), and/or if a power outage or power restoration occurs, and/or if voltage imbalance occurs, along with additional alert messaging capabilities to be provided by the transformer monitoring device where utility operator personnel would find value. The transformer monitoring device further has one or more onboard, and/or external wired and/or wireless environmental and/or transformer conditions sensor(s) and/or sensor packs, including a smoke sensor, ambient temperature sensor, external transformer temperature sensor, a fire/wildfire sensor (e.g., infrared camera, etc.), a humidity sensor, a noxious gases sensor, a nuclear radiation sensor, a seismic or vibration sensor, and/or a surface and/or ground temperature sensor (e.g., infrared camera, etc.) configured to detect smoke, and/or temperature change indicators, and/or other environmental changes in an area surrounding the transformer and/or associated with the transformer, and a processor configured to monitor the smoke sensor, temperature sensors, and/or other environmental change sensors, and/or associated transformer sensors; the processor being configured to transmit data indicative of conditions concerning the transformer and/or surrounding the transformer, and/or issue an alert or critical alert if certain smoke, temperature and/or other environmental conditions are detected surrounding the transformer and/or occurring at or near the transformer. The transformer monitoring device, when used for voltage drops and/or voltage spikes monitoring or detection indicative of broken, down, and/or faulty conductors (e.g., high-impedance faults), and/or when coupled with one or more environmental surroundings sensors (i.e., internal and/or external to the transformer monitoring device), wired and/or wirelessly coupled to the transformer monitoring device, and/or for monitoring transformer and/or intra-grid conditions, becomes a fire mitigation device. The fire mitigation device(s) is used singly or in aggregate to help detect public safety events and/or fire/wildfire conditions, and/or to provide event prevention data to utility operators. When used in aggregate, the fire mitigation devices serve to create an electric distribution grid and/or environmental surroundings monitoring solution. The added implementation of alerts and critical alert messages, in combination with or separately from event prevention data, help to facilitate accelerated awareness and response efforts by operators, first responders, and/or authorities concerning present and/or emerging public safety events and/or fires/wildfires, separately and/or in addition to useful event prevention information.

title_en: Building group earthquake damage simulation visualization system and method based on BIM
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of earthquake disaster early warning analysis, and relates to a building group earthquake disaster simulation visualization system and method based on BIM, wherein the system comprises a user management module, a model management module and a model display module, the user management module comprises a user query and user deletion unit, the model management module comprises a model query, a model uploading unit, a model deleting unit and a time course data uploading unit, the model display comprises a BIM three-dimensional model display, a BIM shaking display, a BIM collapse display, a BIM damage display and a regional fire disaster simulation unit, the accurate modeling of a building entity from appearance design to internal structure can be realized, the high-reality restoration of the conditions such as shaking, collapsing and damage of the building group when an earthquake disaster occurs is realized, the expansion of earthquake disaster reduction series work is facilitated, and the earthquake disaster damage in urban areas is effectively reduced.

title_en: Information update method and the real-time automatic update system for disaster damage investigation using wireless communication technology and web-gis
title_ko: 무선통신과 웹-지아이에스를 이용한 재해피해조사 실시간자동화 업데이트 시스템 및 그 운영방법
abstract_en: A system for automatically updating disaster damage investigation in real-time by using wireless communication and a web-GIS, and an operation method thereof are provided to quickly make a disaster prevention/restoration plan by automatically processing/uploading data received from various investigation equipment to a homepage and a bulletin board in connection with the web-GIS. A field equipment end(110) comprises portable damage investigation equipment capturing picture, moving picture, and sound data of a disaster area, obtaining coordinates of the disaster area, and receiving measurement from each measurer, and an ultra high speed wireless Internet modem transmitting data recombined and completed in the portable damage investigation equipment to a damage investigation information reception server(120). The damage investigation information reception server analyzes the received data by comparing the received data with basic damage data, registers the data to a disaster database, and transmits the data to a web server(130) and a web-GIS server(140) by classifying and converting the data into a protocol corresponding to each server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선통신과 웹-지아이에스를 이용한 재해피해조사 실시간 자동화 업데이트 시스템 및 그 운영방법에 관한 것으로, 각종 자연재해에 의해 발생한 인명피해 및 자연물, 인공물 등의 각종 피해에 대한 재해피해조사를 시행할 시에 디지털카메라, GPS, 음성녹음기 및 무선 초고속 통신장비 등의 장비를 이용하여 각 피해규모 산정의 객관성 확보와 과학적 근거를 확보하고 조사 과정을 신속하고 정확하게 할 수 있는 조사장비를 구비하고, 조사된 결과를 정리 및 입력하여 저장하고 가공하는 각종 데이터 작업과, 정리된 데이터를 각 서버단으로 전송하여 정해진 유형에 맞는 정보의 형태로 실시간으로 자동 가공하고 홈페이지 메인페이지, 게시판에 게시함은 물론 표준화된 재해 대장 형태로 가공하여 웹페이지를 생성하고, 발생 지점 좌표 등을 통해 Web-GIS 상에 피해 발생 지점 등록 및 그 속성을 표출하며, 이러한 홈페이지, 재해대장, Web-GIS 등을 연계하여 신속하게 각종 정보를 검색하고 확인할 수 있도록 함으로써 신속한 피해복구 대책 수립과 방재 정책 수립을 진행을 지원할 수 있고, 일반 인터넷상에 재해조사의 각종 정보를 게시함으로써 방재 및 재해복구 대책의 투명성을 확보하여 대민 정책 신뢰도를 제고할 수 있도록 지원하는 무선통신과 웹-GIS를 이용한 재해피해조사 실시간 자동화 업데이트 시스템 및 그 운영방법을 제공함에 그 목적이 있다.
