title_en: Anti-seismic damping bridge support
abstract_en: Aims to improve the anti-seismic performance and avoid the post-quake adjustment procedures, the utility model provides an anti-seismic damping bridge support. The anti-seismic damping bridge support comprises a pair of an upper anchor plate (10) and a lower anchor plate (20) which are vertically arranged at an interval and are parallel to each other, and is characterized in that a top basin (11), a bottom basin (21) and a support body (22) are further included, wherein the top basin (11) is fixedly arranged on the upper anchor plate (10), the bottom basin (21) is fixedly arranged on the lower anchor plate (20), the support body (22) is arranged between the top basin (11) and the bottom basin (21), and sliding friction pairs are formed between the support body (22) and the top basin (11) as well as between the support body (22) and the bottom basin (21). The utility model has the benefits that self-restoration is realized, so as to avoid the post-quake adjustment procedures; the structural stress is optimized, so as to prolong the structure service life and prevent earthquake and other natural disasters from destructively damaging a bridge structure; and the anti-seismic damping bridge support can greatly reduce the construction costs, and is convenient to mount and maintain.

title_en: Network-assistant management system and method of electrical power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network-assistant management system and method of an electrical power system. The network-assistant management system comprises a scan module, an analysis module, a storage module, a data interface and a client, wherein the scan module is used for scanning data of a network channel, an exchanger, a router and DHCP device, and interacted with other modules; the analysis module is used for synthetically comparing and analyzing data input of the scan module, the data interface and a manager to conduct analysis and statistic so as to acquire the design result. The network-assistant management system uses a B/S structure. The network-assistant management system and method of the electrical power system have the advantages that 100% control of internal and external network desktop terminal access is achieved, network interrupt caused by a Beijing VRV desktop terminal ARP mechanism is avoided, and hidden troubles of viruses of the ARR are solved; real-time alarming of network device failures is achieved; real-time statistics of unit network device and module are achieved; data analysis of unit network resources is achieved; internal network device management tools are integrated, and efficiency is improved; the multithreading design is adopted to acquire data in real time and then achieve real-time control, identification backup, restoration and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ZHUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Stratum monitoring data four-dimensional real environment reduction system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-dimensional real-world restoration system and a four-dimensional real-world restoration method for stratum monitoring data, wherein a plurality of inclined observers are respectively arranged in a plurality of inclined observation pipes and used for monitoring the monitoring data of corresponding stratum areas, a graph drawing device is used for respectively obtaining the monitoring data from the inclined observers and carrying out corresponding data calculation, and a four-dimensional diagram of the surface of a monitored sloping field and the stratum of the monitored sloping field is drawn according to geographic information, data calculation results and time points or time ranges, so that the technical effects of data monitoring analysis of the sloping field stratum and sloping field disaster early warning of real-world restoration can be achieved.

title_en: Groundwater pollution monitoring natural attenuation restoration prediction method, system and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system and a device for nature attenuation repair prediction in underground water pollution monitoring, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the standard establishing module is used for establishing an MNA conceptual model of the polluted site and determining a monitoring target and an MNA control standard of the polluted site; the on-site monitoring network determines a monitoring position, a monitoring object, a monitoring index and a monitoring frequency based on the conceptual model so as to realize on-site monitoring of a polluted site; the evaluation module is used for evaluating the feasibility of the MNA repair technology through an indoor simulation test and field monitoring; if not, strengthening natural attenuation is carried out; and if the MNA is feasible, outputting a final MNA validity evaluation result. The method and the device realize effective prediction of groundwater pollution monitoring natural attenuation restoration, are simple to execute, can realize accurate prediction of medium and long periods, and greatly reduce time cost of evaluation.

title_en: Automatic driving vehicle content safe caching method based on data disaster recovery
abstract_en: The invention relates to a data disaster backup-based automatic driving vehicle content safe caching method, which is based on a safe caching system and comprises a backup process and a restore process, wherein the backup process comprises the following steps: s100, when an internal and external disaster occurrence signal is obtained, a data disaster backup early warning signal is sent; s200, encrypting data to be cached of the automatic driving vehicle by the privacy protection module; s300, the vehicle node module receives encrypted data; s400, the reverse auction module receives the encrypted data and the auxiliary calculation key and auctions the ECS; s500, the safety buffer module receives encrypted data for disaster recovery; the reduction process comprises the following steps: s600, after receiving the restoration signal, the feedback module feeds back disaster recovery data to the vehicle node module; s700, the vehicle node module decrypts disaster recovery data through the privacy protection module. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of high efficiency, good safety and the like.

title_en: Supply side-oriented national network material supply chain network toughness improvement method
abstract_en: A method for improving network toughness of a national network material supply chain facing a supply side belongs to the field of material supply management. For a certain disaster event, determining a feasible restoration scheme and a restoration state of each provider; for each feasible recovery scheme, defining an importance index of the recovery scheme for a provider; summing the importance indexes corresponding to all feasible recovery schemes, and defining the importance indexes of all suppliers; defining a kepram index for each provider damaged by a given disaster, taking into account all possible events; defining a toughness importance index of the provider based on probability distribution of the provider number value damaged by disaster; the improvement of the network toughness of the national network material supply chain facing the supply side is realized by selecting suppliers with toughness importance indexes meeting requirements. The method quantifies the importance of suppliers based on the supply level and recovery time of each state, sorts the importance of the suppliers, and provides an important decision reference for how to improve the toughness of the national net material supply chain from the supply side.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Abnormality identification method and system for power dispatching overhaul opinions
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anomaly identification method and system for power dispatching maintenance opinions, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly collecting dispatching behavior data related to power outage and power restoration, establishing an association rule between a power outage and power restoration event and dispatching behavior through an association analysis method, then extracting power equipment state information and maintenance information in a maintenance list through a natural language processing method to form an error prevention condition, finally judging whether the current dispatching behavior accords with safety constraint according to the association rule and the error prevention condition, alarming the abnormal dispatching behavior and taking corresponding countermeasures; the invention can solve the problems of associated analysis and error prevention of the scheduling behavior in the power system power failure and power restoration scene, and effectively improves the safety and stability of the power system.

title_en: Vegetation configuration method and system for mine ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vegetation configuration method and a vegetation configuration system for mine ecological restoration, which relate to the technical field of ecological restoration, and are used for collecting flat slope plant data, flat slope soil data and slope state data, analyzing whether the stability of a current slope area is in a controllable range according to the flat slope plant data, the flat slope soil data and the slope state data, outputting a first comparison result, calculating the number of deep root plants according to the first comparison result, outputting a planting signal, and outputting an early warning signal according to the first comparison result. According to the invention, by comprehensively monitoring the physical states of the flat slope plants, the soil and the side slope, the side slope stability is accurately estimated, the deep root plant configuration is scientifically guided, the side slope stability is improved, and the resource waste is avoided. When the side slope is unstable, early warning is timely carried out, irrigation is stopped, geological disasters are effectively prevented, the cost is low, the environment is friendly, ecological restoration and regional economic development are promoted, and ecological and economic win-win is realized.
assignees: SHANDONG PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCESNO 801 HYDROGEOLOGICAL ENG GEOLOGICAL BRIGA

title_en: Low-voltage distribution network reliability real-time evaluation and promotion system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for evaluating and improving the reliability of a low-voltage power distribution network in real time, and relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and alarming. The edge computing node realizes real-time data processing and second-level computation of the power supply reliability index, remarkably improves the response speed of the system, combines a genetic algorithm to optimize weights and thresholds, improves the accuracy of reliability analysis and fault positioning, dynamically generates strategies such as load balancing, equipment replacement priority ordering, complex electric path optimization and the like by the cloud coordination module, and enhances the dynamic optimization capacity of the system. The quick power restoration method combining the dichotomy and the dynamic programming algorithm is provided, so that the power failure time is effectively shortened, and the energy loss in the power restoration process is reduced.

title_en: Photovoltaic power station data restoration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power station data restoration method, aims to solve the problem of power data loss of a photovoltaic power station caused by sensor faults, communication interruption and the like, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic power station data processing. And selecting meteorological features strongly related to power through pearson correlation coefficients, constructing a Stacking integrated model with SVR, KNN, RF as a base learner and RR as a meta learner, supplementing reference power station data by combining data normalization and K-fold cross validation, and finally quantifying and repairing precision by using NMAE and NRMSE. Through data verification of a certain 120MW photovoltaic power station, the method is superior to a single model under the condition of 20% -50% loss rate, NMAE is reduced by 9.62% compared with SVR under the condition of 50% loss rate, NRMSE is reduced by 20.69%, repair accuracy is high, robustness is strong, and reliable data support is provided for operation and maintenance of the photovoltaic power station.
assignees: STATE GRID GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY QINGYANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Testing system for tunnel disaster prevention facility
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve work efficiency in a fire alarm test using a tester of a fire detector installed in a tunnel, thereby reducing work cost.SOLUTION: In an alarm test of a fire detector 12, when an examiner 34 irradiates with flame testing light a translucent window of the fire detector 12 by operating a tester 36, a fire signal is transmitted to a disaster prevention receiving panel, and a fire alarm sound is outputted. When the tester 36 emits test restoration light after the fire alarm operation of the disaster prevention receiving panel 10 is confirmed, a remote restoration signal is transmitted from the fire detector 12 and the disaster prevention receiving panel 10 is restored. Then, the fire alarm sound from a telephone call output device 40 is halted, whereby the restoration of the disaster prevention receiving panel 10 is confirmed. The examiner 34 can confirm an alarm operation and the restoration because the alarm sound of the disaster prevention receiving panel 10 is transmitted through an emergency telephone line 15 to be outputted from a loudspeaker.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Pond dissolved oxygen prediction method based on data restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pool dissolved oxygen prediction method based on data restoration, which comprises the steps of determining a prediction object, defining a meteorological comprehensive index, restoring data, constructing a GRNN neural network model, initializing a GRNN neural network and training the neural network, and relates to 11 index parameters in meteorological factors and aquaculture environment factors related to pool dissolved oxygen prediction, taking the 11 index parameters as input quantities, restoring lost and abnormal data collected by a sensor by using the meteorological comprehensive index and a linear interpolation method based on the short-time continuity of the meteorological environment data and water quality data, taking the dissolved oxygen concentration as output quantity, determining the GRNN neural network prediction model, wherein the GRNN algorithm has higher precision compared with a BP algorithm in the dissolved oxygen prediction training effect of the traditional BP model, can better reflect the basic trend of the change of the dissolved oxygen in the pond within a period of time.

title_en: Power data privacy protection and restoration method and device based on federal learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a federal learning-based power data privacy protection restoration method and device, and belongs to the field of incomplete power data restoration of power grids. The method comprises the following steps of S1, initializing a server federation learning module, S2, initializing client devices, S3, sending partial hidden characteristic matrix data and linear deviation to all the client devices, S4, receiving incomplete power load data, S5, calculating an approximate power load data matrix by using a tensor hidden characteristic decomposition method, S6, mixing and filling the incomplete power load data for a plurality of times, S7, updating parameters of the client devices, and calculating federation learning gradient data, S8, sending federation learning gradient data to the server, S9, updating the server, and S10, iterating until all the client devices complete data recovery under privacy protection. The method can ensure that the recovery of the power data can be accurately realized under the protection of privacy.

title_en: Temporary support structural system for power lines
abstract_en: Natural disasters, such as cyclones, earthquakes, landslides, etc., or manmade damages, such as structural member's theft, terrorist attacks, etc., can cause collapse of transmission line towers. If these are not restored in time, there will be monetary loss to utilities as well as loss of service to consumers leading to societal impact. Generally, permanent restoration takes several weeks. Hence, a temporary solution for quick retrieval of power transmission is required. This invention provides a temporary support structural system comprising light weight guyed masts ( 1 ) made of readymade robust modules ( 6  and  7 ), easy to connect connection system, two pin gimbal joint ( 8 ) and easy to construct foundation system ( 9  and  10 ). The invention is flexible enough to develop various configurations for single or double circuit transmission lines. It is also scalable and can be used for 33 to 800 kV transmission lines.
assignees: COUNCIL OF SCIENT AND INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH AN INDIAN REGISTERED BODY INCORPORATED UNDER THE REGN OF S;COUNCIL OF SCIENT AND INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH AN INDIAN REGISTERED BODY INCORPORATED UNDER THE REIGN OF

title_en: Ecological prosthetic devices in mine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration of mines, in particular to a ecological restoration device for mines, which comprises a mine, wherein uniformly distributed planting grooves are formed in the slope surface of the mine, anti-slope protection slopes are formed in the slope surface of the mine, uniformly distributed rectangular through grooves are formed in the anti-slope protection slopes, the uniformly distributed rectangular through grooves are formed in the anti-slope protection slopes and are communicated with the planting grooves, the planting grooves are used for planting greening vegetation, the protection slopes are connected with rectangular frames through connecting rods, the side ends of the rectangular frames are connected with spray heads through the connecting rods, nutrient solution is sprayed on the greening vegetation through the spray heads, watering and fertilizing effects are achieved on the greening vegetation, good survival of the vegetation is guaranteed, greening restoration effects on the ecological environment of the mine are achieved, soil on the mine slope surface is fixed through the vegetation, and landslide problems are prevented.
assignees: HEBEI DIKUANG CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method for replacing and repairing branch dam-splitting habitat in main and branch hydroelectric development basin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for replacing and repairing a branch dam-splitting habitat in a main and branch hydroelectric development basin. The method comprises the steps of establishing an evaluation index system for the fish habitat restoration potential after tributary dam splitting and a dam splitting-loss evaluation index system; surveying the fish population, hydrology and geographical conditions, natural disaster conditions and hydropower station conditions in the target basin, and collecting data; calculating each index weight in an evaluation index system of the fish habitat restoration potential after the tributary dam splitting and a value P of the fish habitat restoration potential after the tributary dam splitting, and predicting the fish habitat restoration potential after the tributary dam splitting is carried out; calculating index weight and potential dam-dismantling loss L value in dam-dismantling and loss evaluation index system, and comprehensively evaluating the value after the power station is dismantledPotential loss; calculating feasibility score P of branch dam-splitting habitat alternative scheme F If P is F >60, selecting the highest score to demolish the dam; and after the tributary dam is removed, performing environmental investigation on fish population and habitat in the tributary, and repairing the fish habitat in the tributary river section.

title_en: Big data-based artificial intelligent power grid regulation and control operation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence power grid regulation and control operation method and system based on big data, the system comprises a main control module, and a bill acquisition unit, a machine language understanding unit, an equipment object matching unit, a sorting binding result library, a sorting binding rule library, a network topology analysis unit, a graph-model integrated introduction unit, a feature extraction unit and a safety check unit which are respectively connected with the main control module, wherein the output end of the bill acquisition unit is sequentially connected with the machine language understanding unit, the equipment object matching unit, the sorting binding result library and the sorting binding rule library, and matching association is carried out on historical comprehensive power failure application tickets and historical scheduling operation tickets to form historical sorting binding result information, and the equipment object sorting binding rule library is established. According to the invention, intelligent functions such as automatic generation and simulation of the equipment power restoration dispatching operation ticket are realized, the intelligent level of power grid regulation operation is improved, the working pressure of a regulator is greatly reduced, and the safe and stable operation level and the working efficiency of a power grid are improved.

title_en: Method, system and device for detecting behavior of personnel on electric power operation site
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power operation monitoring protection, and discloses a method, a system and a device for detecting the behavior of personnel in a power operation field, wherein the method for detecting the behavior of the personnel in the power operation field comprises the following steps: collecting real-time scene images of an operation site, evaluating the illumination quality of the collected real-time scene images, and repairing and enhancing scene images with insufficient illumination and uneven illumination; detecting the real-time scene image subjected to quality restoration in real time, and marking the detected violation behavior on the real-time scene image; transmitting the detected real-time scene image to mobile terminal equipment for a safety manager to watch; and when the operator is found to have illegal behaviors, sending out alarm information. The invention has high automation degree, and once the workers with illegal behaviors are found, the sound and light alarm is carried out on the spot to persuade the related workers to leave the power distribution room and immediately inform the safety management personnel of short messages, thereby realizing the automatic detection of the illegal behaviors and saving manpower and material resources.
assignees: XIAN YONGSHENGDA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ecological vulnerability evaluation method for key water source area in natural resource monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological vulnerability evaluation method of a key water source area in natural resource monitoring, which relates to the technical field of natural resource management and comprises the following steps: data preprocessing, namely, a step two: and (3) analyzing patterns for developing and utilizing the homeland space and step three: and (5) analyzing ecological vulnerability. According to the method, the interaction relation and effect of the mountain and water Lin Tianhu grass multi-class natural resource elements and the ecological system in the key water source area are deeply researched, the ecological protection restoration path is determined according to local conditions, the quality and stability of the ecological system can be improved, the problem of ecological vulnerability and sensitivity is prevented, the harmful inhibition on the stability of the structure and the function of the land space is prevented, and the potential natural disaster risk high-incidence area can be identified by analyzing the ecological vulnerability and sensitivity of the area.

title_en: Correlation method and system of power grid data model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a correlation method of a power grid data model, which relates to the technical field of power grids, and comprises the steps of establishing a data construction model of a power grid, and processing the power grid data according to the constructed model; and detecting the processed data based on the processing result, performing vulnerability optimization restoration on the detected result, and constructing a power grid data model association system. The invention realizes the intelligent monitoring and comprehensive management of the running state of the power grid, and has the advantages of realizing the automatic processing and intelligent analysis of the power grid data, effectively improving the efficiency and reliability of the power grid management and reducing the labor cost and the maintenance cost. In addition, through the full utilization of historical data and effective treatment of abnormal conditions, the potential faults can be timely early-warned and quickly repaired, the safe and stable operation of the power system is finally ensured, and powerful support is provided for sustainable development of power supply.

title_en: Urban drainage system carbon emission reduction accounting method suitable for pipeline restoration scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon emission reduction accounting method of an urban drainage system, which is suitable for a pipeline restoration scene and comprises the following steps of (1) collecting water supply data, a drainage water quality background value and running data of a sewage treatment plant in an accounting area, calculating and evaluating pipe network defects of the urban drainage system, (2) collecting relevant carbon footprint evaluation parameters in the urban drainage system, calculating historical carbon emission of the drainage pipeline, the sewage treatment plant and a receiving water body in the urban drainage system, (3) setting the pipe network restoration scene according to control targets of sewage collection rate and external water invasion rate, and (4) inputting the carbon footprint evaluation parameters of the urban drainage system into a Monte Carlo simulation model to obtain dynamic prediction results of the carbon emission of the urban drainage system under different conditions. The invention can quickly determine the influence degree of different pipe network defects on carbon emission in sewage/rainwater collection, transportation, treatment and emission scenes of the drainage system, and assist the urban drainage system to realize the aim of carbon neutralization.

title_en: Rock mine side slope protection restoration structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a rock mine slope protection and restoration structure, which belongs to the technical field of slope ecological restoration and comprises a slope main body, a reinforcing anchor rod, L-shaped nails, a multistage gentle slope platform arranged on the slope main body, a spraying maintenance assembly and an induction protection assembly, wherein a drainage system is constructed by arranging a multistage gentle slope belt, a drainage ditch and a water interception ditch, so that the water content of a slope body is reduced, geological disasters are prevented, the ecological sustainable development is realized based on a high-performance soil-plant-microorganism composite technology, the relief landscape restoration, geological disaster elimination and ecological system function restoration are considered, precise irrigation is realized according to soil humidity control, the water resource utilization efficiency is improved, an automatic cleaning mechanism in a water spray pipe is used for cleaning blockage by means of an electromagnet, a distance sensor and the like, and during initial heavy rainfall, a telescopic cylinder is controlled by a soil humidity sensor to spread out and prevent matrix from sliding down, so that slope vegetation flushing is lightened, and slope body stability is maintained.
assignees: GUANGXI TRANSP SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Fault reasoning analysis method and system based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault reasoning analysis method and system based on a large language model, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a multi-source operation and maintenance data set of a system to be diagnosed, comprising a structural performance index, a semi-structural service log and unstructured text description data, then carrying out semantic enhancement on the multi-source operation and maintenance data set to obtain semantic data units containing entity, relation and attribute semantic labels, constructing a semantic association network based on the semantic data units, calling a pre-training large language model to carry out root cause reasoning analysis on the network, generating a candidate root cause set ordered according to confidence, generating an operation and maintenance decision instruction containing entity operation sequences and priority orders according to the candidate root cause set, and sending the operation and maintenance decision instruction to a system management terminal to trigger an automatic restoration process, thereby improving the operation and maintenance efficiency and reliability of the system.

title_en: Lightning arrester insulation protection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an insulation protection method for a lightning arrester, and relates to the technical field of electric power insulation protection. The method comprises the steps of generating comprehensive insulation risk indexes based on collected insulation state parameters, determining repair penetration strength according to material structural characteristics, constructing electric field compensation factors by combining operation electric field distribution, carrying out periodic data accumulation and analysis on the comprehensive insulation risk indexes, the repair penetration strength and the electric field compensation factors to generate long-term life prediction results covering an operation period, a material subarea and a sampling point, and corresponding the life prediction results to an insulation protection management module to realize subarea level life management and operation risk early warning. The accurate life prediction is realized through multi-dimensional data fusion, the differential protection of the subareas is supported, and the consistency of the operation period and the restoration strategy is maintained, so that the reliability and the stability of the long-term operation of the lightning arrester are comprehensively improved.

title_en: Long-acting solid-state restoration method for iron ore tailing heavy metal chromium based on dynamic regulation and control rhizosphere microorganism network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for long-acting solid-state restoration of iron ore tailing heavy metal chromium based on a dynamic regulation and control rhizosphere microorganism network, and relates to the technical field of environmental data processing. The method comprises the specific steps of data extraction and fusion, microorganism application and feedback data acquisition, and finally, a model is updated to reflect the states of microorganisms and heavy metal Cr, so that the effective solid storage and management of the heavy metal Cr in the iron ore tailings are realized, and the ecological restoration of mines and the safety of ecological environment are promoted.
assignees: LANGFANG COMPREHENSIVE SURVEY CENTER OF NATURAL RESOURCES CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY

title_en: Network for sustainable aquatic ecosystem development
abstract_en: A network for the sustainable aquatic ecosystem development, characterized by comprising a pipeline, an unattended intelligent and automated measurement, control, and operation and maintenance system for network management, a water inlet, and a water outlet. A straight pipe, a vertical pipe, a circular pipe, an inclined pipe, an intersection pipe, a water inlet pipe, a water outlet pipe, a pipe branch, a power pipe, a four-way pipe, a water well pipe, and a pipe connector are connected to form a national and global pipeline; an access and exit channel gate is provided and an access and exit bundling cable is laid in the entry and exit; a pipe gate is provided in the four-way pipe; a flow meter, a motor, an equalization wheel, and rotating blades are arranged in the power pipe; the bundling cable, the wireless communication, and the global communication are connected to the unattended intelligent and automated measurement, control, and operation and maintenance system for network management; and an intelligent lens water level meter is mounted outside the water well pipe, and the flow meter is arranged in the water well pipe. The pipeline network system in the present invention is applied to manage the network in accordance with related regulations to diligently coordinate water supply and drainage on a national scale. This can prevent water-related disasters and pollution, mitigating their harm to both humanity and nature and achieving the safe and efficient conveyance and distribution of water resources from the Four River Sources in the Tibetan Plateau to regions across the entire country. By means of innovative restoration of the Earth's aquatic ecosystems, harmonious five spheres and a stable climate are achieved. This paves the way for the synergistic development of humanity and nature, ensuring human health, well-being, longevity, and happiness, and achieving the sustainable development of both aquatic ecosystems and human civilization.

title_en: Method for realizing emergency traffic of debris flow silted road section by adopting bearing umbrella
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing emergency traffic of a debris flow silted road section by adopting a bearing umbrella, wherein the bearing umbrella has the structure that: it includes: the device comprises a metal rod, high-strength waterproof cloth, an anchoring bolt and an exhaust valve; the high-strength waterproof cloth is enclosed into a round table with a closed upper bottom surface and an opened lower bottom surface; the metal rods are arranged in the direction of the circular truncated cone generatrix, the plurality of metal rods are uniformly distributed on the side surface of the circular truncated cone, and the length of each metal rod is the same as that of the circular truncated cone generatrix; the anchoring bolt is arranged at the center of the upper bottom surface of the circular table, and the exhaust valve is arranged at a position close to the anchoring bolt on the upper bottom surface of the circular table; the bearing umbrella can be folded. The invention also discloses a method for realizing the emergency traffic of the debris flow silted road section by adopting the bearing umbrella. The beneficial technical effects of the invention are as follows: the method is suitable for emergency restoration of road traffic of the debris flow silt-buried road section, can effectively shorten the time of road traffic break of the debris flow silt-buried road section, and can restore traffic generally within 2-3 days when the debris flow stops moving.

title_en: A kind of Dredging Construction method for the canal that drains off floodwaters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Dredging Construction methods of canal that drains off floodwaters, and channel from upstream to downstream are divided into three construction sections and including following process: the dredging process of the first construction section and second segment construction section, the dredging process of third construction section, dredging residual water precipitation process process and marine stockyard antiseepage process；When carrying out the dredging process of the first construction section and second segment construction section, using environment-protective desilting and using customizing, small-sized strand inhales ship and 4010 types twist and inhale ship construction；When carrying out the dredging process of third section construction section, constructed using dredging and slush pump is drained；When carrying out dredging residual water precipitation process process, dredging residual water precipitation process is carried out using two-stage flocculence；Side slope surface is anti-when carrying out marine stockyard antiseepage process, including in the cofferdam of stockyard blends the antiseepage of stockyard bottom surface.The Dredging Construction method of the canal that drains off floodwaters of the invention not only solves siltation problem, moreover it is possible to remove the pollutant in bed mud, lay the foundation further to implement Ecological Restoration Project.

title_en: Method, device and system for evaluating operation sequence of recoverable equipment after fault
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a system for evaluating operation sequence of recoverable equipment after a fault, which comprises the steps of obtaining an expected power grid model, wherein the expected power grid model is established on the basis that all cut-off equipment in a power grid to be recovered after the fault is completely cut off in a power grid model before the fault; calculating the power grid risk probability corresponding to each recoverable device in the expected power grid model; sequencing all the calculated power grid risk probabilities to obtain a recovery sequence of each recoverable device; and calculating the real-time evaluation score of the operation condition of the dispatcher based on the recovery sequence of each recoverable device and the sequence of the devices actually operated by the dispatcher in all the recoverable devices, and finishing the evaluation of the operation sequence of the recoverable devices. The method firstly analyzes and calculates the optimal recovery sequence of the power grid recoverable equipment after the fault, and then evaluates the actual operation result of the dispatcher based on the calculated optimal recovery sequence, thereby realizing effective evaluation of the power grid operation rationality after the fault of the dispatcher.

title_en: Post-disaster recovery method and system for elastic power distribution network based on information physical collaborative optimization
abstract_en: The disclosure belongs to the technical field of elastic lifting of power distribution networks, and provides a post-disaster recovery method and system of an elastic power distribution network based on information physical collaborative optimization, wherein the post-disaster recovery method and system comprises the following steps: acquiring post-disaster physical information of an elastic power distribution network; according to the acquired information and a preset recovery model, post-disaster recovery of the power distribution network is realized; the recovery model comprises a first-stage recovery sub-model and a second-stage recovery sub-model, wherein the first-stage recovery sub-model takes the minimum load loss after the occurrence of faults as an objective function, and takes scheduling path constraint of maintenance personnel, time unified constraint of parallel maintenance personnel and network reconstruction constraint under the influence of information physical coupling as constraint conditions; and the second-stage restoration sub-model takes the minimum time cost of restoring the residual fault element after the load is fully restored as an objective function and takes the scheduling path constraint of maintenance personnel and the time unified constraint of parallel maintenance personnel as constraint conditions.

title_en: Power equipment displacement detection restoration device and method based on visual recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for detecting and recovering displacement of power equipment based on visual identification, which relate to the field of fault identification and have the technical scheme that: the image monitoring device is used for judging whether the displacement change of each measuring point of the power equipment exceeds a set displacement limit value; the displacement sensor is used for sending out an overrun signal when each measuring point of the power equipment exceeds a set displacement limit value; and the reset leveling device is used for adjusting the position of the power equipment according to the position information when the overrun signal is received so as to enable the power equipment to be restored to a horizontal state. The invention solves the problem that the prior art can not realize the real-time adjustment of the abnormal response of the power equipment in the normal use process or after earthquake.

title_en: Handshake synchronization by adjusting status of status machine of receiving end to a state indicated by status reset signal
abstract_en: A handshake synchronization restoration method and system based on visible light communication are provided. The method includes: after a transmitting end in which a state machine varies with unit time is powered on again, transmitting in the form of a visible light signal, to a receive and control system, a status reset signal which varies with unit time, wherein the receive and control system comprises one or multiple receiving ends; and receiving, by the receive and control system, the visible light signal, and when it is determined that the received visible light signal is a status reset signal, adjusting status of a state machine of a receiving end to a state indicated by the status reset signal. Status synchronization with the transmitting end is restored, avoiding a case in which the transmitting end is asynchronous with the receiving end after encountering power outage and being powered on again.

title_en: Disaster recovery data sync
abstract_en: Various embodiments for failure recovery in a computing environment following a data restoration are provided. A catalog locate is performed for each of a plurality of data sets on a base catalog structure (BCS), identifying a plurality of BCS entries. If a first BCS entry is cataloged incorrectly, the first BCS entry is designated to be re-cataloged. The plurality of BCS entries is compared with a plurality of volume table of contents and a plurality of VSAM volume data set (VTOC/VVDS) entries. If a second BCS entry found in the plurality of BCS entries is not found in the plurality of VTOC/VVDS entries, and the second BCS entry indicates that a data set associated with the second BCS entry is located on a volume, an attempt is made to vary on the volume. If the volume cannot be varied on, a request is created to restore the volume.
assignees: CLARKE DARRELL CHRISTOPHER;DUDGEON KYLE BARRET;PEREZ MIGUEL ANGEL;REED DAVID CHARLES;SMITH MAX DOUGLAS;IBM

title_en: Method and system for restoring power after fault of power distribution network containing DGs (distributed generation)
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for restoring power after fault of a power distribution network containing DGs. According to the method, the DGs integrated in the power distribution network are processed in a classified manner according to the control method of the DGs and are divided into main power supplies and ordinary power supplies, wherein the main power supplies are controllable DGs, and the ordinary power supplies are random and uncontrollable DGs; and meanwhile, a standby contact wire is used as a main power supply, then, a multi-agent system for power restoration after fault of the power distribution network containing the DGs is established, and the optimum power supply scheme of a power-losing area is planned in a master-slave control mode. Compared with the prior art, the standby contact wire and the DGs integrated in the power distribution network are fully utilized in the restoration process, the power outage load is restored to the maximum, and the isolated island operation capacity of the DGs and randomness and volatility of output power are given full consideration, so that a restoration scheme can continuously and stably operate.

title_en: A kind of power distribution network service restoration method considering failure disturbance degree
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power distribution network service restoration methods for considering failure disturbance degree, pass through analysis distribution network failure impact evaluation failure disturbance degree caused by load and grid structure, it divides failure menace level and matches service restoration model, execute failure recovering algorithm and generate service restoration scheme.The present invention passes through the intrinsic contradictions between the assessment of introducing failure disturbance degree and Controlling model Adaptive matching mechanism coordination service restoration algorithm speed and tactful quality, in power grid occurrence of large-area power loss, system regard the power supply of fast quick-recovery load as unique objects, power supply strategy is turned using particle swarm algorithm search, exits search after obtaining the feasible solution for restoring global load power supply；The load loss of outage caused by electric network fault is relatively light and when will not influence important load power supply, it regard the runnability after load power loss amount, control cost, reconfiguration of electric networks as evaluation index simultaneously, optimal case is searched using multi-objective particle swarm algorithm, promotes the tactful quality of failure recovering algorithm.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network toughness improvement method based on cooperative micro-grid after natural disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of restoration and evaluation of a power distribution system, in particular to a toughness improvement method for a power distribution network based on a cooperative micro-grid after natural disasters, wherein the natural disasters cause the power distribution network to fail to normally operate, distributed power supplies in the power distribution network participate in a power distribution network failure recovery strategy to form a plurality of micro-grid isolated islands powered by the distributed power supplies, so that the survival capacity of the power distribution system is improved, and the normal power supply of key loads of the power system is ensured; the method comprises the following steps: s1, setting the position of the distributed power source in the power distribution system; s2, analyzing the fault probability of each node of the power distribution system, and determining a fault node; s3, controlling the states of the switch equipment and the distributed power supply according to the positions of the fault node and the distributed power supply in the power distribution system, and forming a plurality of micro-grids capable of continuously supplying power; s4, recovering the key load in the power distribution network by the aid of the distributed power sources in consideration of the load priority; and S5, evaluating the toughness improvement effect of the power distribution network according to the proposed toughness evaluation index.

title_en: Intelligent first-aid repair method for power distribution network faults
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution networks and discloses an intelligent rush-repair method for power distribution network faults. The method comprises the following steps: through combining sensor technology, data analysis and artificial intelligence algorithm, realize the quick detection, location and the restoration to distribution network trouble, include: (1) fault detection and localization: the method comprises the steps of utilizing sensors distributed at all nodes of a power distribution network to monitor parameters such as current, voltage and the like in real time; (2) data transmission and processing: transmitting the data acquired by the sensor to a data center, processing and analyzing the data through a data analysis technology, and identifying the possible fault type and position; (3) intelligent decision: based on the data analysis result, diagnosing and positioning the fault by using an artificial intelligent algorithm, rapidly judging the fault point, and generating an optimal rush-repair scheme; (4) performing rush repair; (5) monitoring and optimizing. The method fully utilizes the sensor technology and the artificial intelligent algorithm, and realizes the rapid and accurate rush repair of the power distribution network faults.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Method and system for scheduling multiple distributed resources before and after disaster in cooperation with each other
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of safe operation of power systems, and discloses a method and a system for scheduling a plurality of distributed resources in coordination with pre-disaster and post-disaster, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on the coupling information of the traffic network and the power grid, constructing a power supply restoration service framework for pre-disaster pre-dispatching and post-disaster collaborative restoration of various distributed resources; based on a power supply restoration service framework of pre-disaster pre-dispatching and post-disaster cooperative restoration, designing a guiding mechanism of the pre-disaster electric automobile and the electric bus to perform pre-disaster pre-dispatching; and building a post-disaster multi-resource collaborative recovery model according to post-disaster information of the electric automobile and the electric bus, and recovering an electric system by cooperating with the electric automobile, the electric bus, the optical storage bus station and the mobile energy storage. The invention can fully exert the advantages of recovering power supply of different distributed resources after disaster, solves the problem of difficult cooperation of various distributed resources, and provides reference advice for decision-making departments when being applied to various distributed resource scheduling of the power system before and after disaster.

title_en: Method and system for managing rush repair operation and maintenance of low-voltage power network by combining real-time power failure recovery information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rush-repair operation and maintenance management method of a low-voltage power network, which combines real-time power failure and power restoration information, combines a research and judgment result of the real-time power failure and power restoration, senses the occurrence of a power failure and power restoration event in real time, combines an area of the real-time power failure and power restoration event, utilizes an operator GPS or a network equipment base station to access and position actual personnel in a corresponding area, accurately senses the personnel affected by the power failure event, combines progress feedback of the rush-repair personnel and verification of the power restoration event, and pushes the rush-repair situation to the actual affected user in real time, thereby realizing accurate and humanized pushing of information, improving service quality and reducing the occurrence of complaint events.

title_en: Power grid outage result analysis method considering supply chain-gas-electricity fault conduction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a power grid outage result analysis method considering supply chain-gas-electric fault conduction, which comprises the following steps of S1, modeling an electric network coupling relation, S2, analyzing a supply chain weak link, S3, modeling a gas pipe network fault, establishing a pressure and flow calculation model of a natural gas pipe network, S4, modeling a gas-electric coupling component, establishing a mathematical model of a gas turbine and a compressor, S5, modeling an urban power grid fault, evaluating the running state of the power grid under the fault, S6, constructing a power outage result evaluation index, and quantifying social influence and recovery priority under different fault scenes.

title_en: Evaluation method, system, equipment and medium for ecological restoration effect of saline-alkali water body
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for evaluating the ecological restoration effect of a saline-alkali water body, which relate to the technical field of saline-alkali water body restoration evaluation and are characterized in that a double-layer restoration evaluation framework based on a physical layer and a chemical layer is constructed, the environment and biological monitoring data are fused, and the effective matching and dynamic weight adjustment of the environment and biological index trend are realized by adopting a data-driven principal component analysis and dynamic time warping algorithm, so that the scientificity and the accuracy of the restoration effect evaluation are improved. And the time sequence prediction is carried out on the repair process by combining an autoregressive integral moving average model, so that the repair completion time can be quantitatively estimated, and scientific management and decision making are assisted. The overall scheme realizes multidimensional comprehensive evaluation and dynamic closed-loop optimization of the ecological restoration effect of the saline-alkali water body, remarkably enhances the pertinence, the instantaneity and the sustainability of ecological restoration, and provides scientific and efficient technical support for restoration of the saline-alkali soil.

title_en: A prevent soil erosion and water loss guardrail for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration, in particular to a guard bar for preventing soil erosion and water loss for geological disasters, which comprises a baffle plate, wherein fixed rods are symmetrically and fixedly connected with two sides of the front surface of the baffle plate, a square groove is arranged on the front side of each fixed rod, a first circular hole is arranged on each square groove, a fixed groove is arranged in the center of each square groove, a rubber pad is bonded in the inner cavity of each fixed groove, each fixed rod is movably connected with a portable rod through each square groove, a trapezoidal groove is arranged on one side of the baffle plate, and a trapezoidal block is fixedly connected with; through being equipped with the dead lever, be convenient for fix the dead lever by the end point, then combine together portable pole and fixed slot, and then further fix the dead lever, guarantee the stability of device, through being equipped with trapezoidal piece and dovetail groove, the trapezoidal groove that is equipped with by a device combines together the use with the trapezoidal piece that the same device of opposite side was equipped with, and the extension of being convenient for is installed length, and then guarantees the availability factor of device.

title_en: Power distribution automation protecting method achieved by matching of master station and distributed terminals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution automation protecting method achieved by matching of a master station and distributed terminals. When single failure happens to a power distribution network, a failure area is determined by a power distribution automation terminal, a circuit breaker at the line outgoing position of the power distribution network is controlled to be disconnected, afterwards, section switches at the two ends of the failure area are disconnected by the power distribution automation terminal, so that failure isolation is carried out, at last, the power distribution automation terminal controls the circuit breaker at the line outgoing position of the power distribution network, an interconnection switch and the section switches to be closed, the load in a failure-free area of the power distribution network is supplied in a turning mode, and thus power restoration of the failure-free area is achieved. The power distribution automation protecting method is high in power distribution reliability, short in failure recovery time, small in power outage range and low in transformation, operation and maintenance cost, improves the distribution network planning level, lowers power grid line loss, improves the distribution network dispatching management level and improves first-aid repair working efficiency.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: A kind of more gate dam plain tract wintering ecology flow calculation methods
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of more gate dam plain tract wintering ecology flow calculation methods, for more gate dam plain tract biology Habitat Characteristics, based on fish overwinter phase Habitat requirement, methods described specifically includes：Survey region Status of Fisher Resources is investigated first, the alternative fish that ecological flow calculates is determined, Fish of interest is further then screened using Hierarchy Analysis Method；Experiment is responded by indoor water temperature for the Fish of interest filtered out and historical summary is collected, establishes quantitative response curve of the Fish of interest Wintering Period to water temperature；According to river temperature Characteristics of Vertical Distribution, combining target species wintering ground Habitat requirement determines to ensure the eco-grounderwater level of Fish of interest safe overwintering, is calculated using water balance formula and maintains flow needed for eco-grounderwater level.The invention can instruct the more restorations of the ecosystem of gate dam plain tract and protection, and watershed water resources and configuration have important theory and practice meaning.

title_en: Digital asset disaster recovery method
abstract_en: A digital asset disaster recovery method, comprising the steps of: dividing the digital asset into N parts of digital subfiles, wherein N is a positive integer greater than 1; the N parts of digital subfiles are dispersedly backed up; when the storage disaster occurs and the complete digital asset needs to be restored, the restoration of the digital asset can be completed only by obtaining M parts of the digital subfiles in N parts, wherein M is less than or equal to N, and M is a positive integer.
assignees: SHANGHAI YINGHAI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network switched-mode power supply recovery policy optimization method based on complete distributed algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power distribution network switched-mode power supply recovery policy optimization method based on complete distributed algorithm, it is up to optimization aim with the income amount during distribution network restoration, load is put into operation into state as decision variable, isolated island division is carried out to non-faulting power loss region, to reduce the scope of power outage of power distribution network.The present invention utilizes complete distributed algorithm, it can solve the distribution network restoration decision problem when powerup issue occurs in control centre, power supply is provided to important load as much as possible on the basis of guaranteeing power distribution network safe operation, improves the self-healing ability of power distribution network under major network fault condition.

title_en: Regional spare power automatic switching control system and operation risk management and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a regional spare power automatic switching control system and an operation risk management and control method thereof.A main processor and a slave processor are arranged in a regional spare power automatic switching device for cooperative coordination processing, so that data can be acquired in time, and data acquisition and data analysis are divided into two processors for processing, so that the data processing speed is improved, the trip time of regional spare power automatic switching is further shortened, the regional spare power automatic switching can effectively isolate faults in time, the power failure range is shortened, the power restoration time is shortened, and the condition that the regional spare power automatic switching fails is avoided; the invention sets the priority for each spare power automatic switching device in the serial supply loop, when a certain device is in fault, a plurality of device spare power automatic switching actions can be caused, and not all the spare power automatic switching device actions are necessary.
assignees: PUER POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD;WUHAN HUADIAN SHUNCHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind power plant wind speed combined prediction method and device based on decomposition and aggregation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power plant wind speed combined prediction method and a device based on decomposition and aggregation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a historical wind speed sequence of a wind power plant, and decomposing the historical wind speed sequence of the wind power plant to obtain residual components corresponding to wind speeds and characteristic components at different scales; calculating the complexity of the feature components, and attributing the feature components with the complexity difference smaller than a preset threshold value to one class to obtain a plurality of feature component classes; overlapping the feature components of the same feature component category to obtain a plurality of aggregation components; respectively and independently predicting each aggregation component to obtain an aggregation prediction sequence corresponding to each aggregation component; predicting the residual component to obtain a residual prediction sequence corresponding to the residual component; and superposing the residual prediction sequence and each aggregation prediction sequence to obtain a final wind speed prediction sequence. The method not only ensures the restoration of the original sequence to the multi-scale characteristic of the predicted sequence, but also improves the prediction precision.
assignees: GRID POWER PLANNING & RES CT GUANGDONG GRID POWER CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Method for determining optimal underground water burial depth of grassland vegetation communities in semiarid area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological and environment-friendly hydrology and water conservancy, and provides a method for determining the optimal underground water burial depth of grassland vegetation communities in semiarid regions, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: determining vegetation community compositions and community species compositions in a grassland vegetation ecosystem of a research area; step two: establishing a regional vegetation species physiological characteristic database and a regional soil attribute database; step three: calculating capillary water rising height of each vegetation community distribution area; step four: determining the relationship between the root systems of different vegetation species and the maximum rising height of capillary water; step five: and calculating the optimal underground water burial depth of the grassland vegetation community. The method for determining the optimal buried depth of the grassland vegetation community in the semi-arid region has clear physical process and action mechanism, has universality for determining the optimal buried depth of the grassland vegetation community, a grassland underground water level control target and the like, and provides reliable theoretical and technical support for guiding the protection and ecological restoration of the grassland in the semi-arid region.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Engineering implementation feasibility assessment method for isolated network operation control in flexible direct current zone
abstract_en: The invention discloses an engineering implementation feasibility assessment method for isolated network operation control in a flexible direct current zone, which comprises the following steps: according to a isolated network scene, a data model and operation boundary conditions of a target flexible straight zone region, evaluating the matching degree of the total power supply and the total load in the isolated network, and providing a first control measure according to an evaluation result; constructing a regional isolated network simulation model according to the isolated network scene, the data model and the operation boundary conditions; and evaluating the AC networking restoration measures of the target flexible straight band region after the isolated network accident, and proposing feasible AC networking restoration measures aiming at the AC networking restoration measures. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: corresponding control measures are provided for the isolated network system of the target soft direct-current zone region, simulation verification is carried out, feasibility suggestions are obtained through re-verification of the simulation model, safety and reliability of actual operation of isolated network operation in the soft direct-current zone region are improved, and a practical and effective theoretical basis is provided for engineering implementation.
