title_en: Configuration method of plants in photovoltaic power station system
abstract_en: The application discloses a plant configuration method in a photovoltaic power station system in the field of desert ecological restoration, which comprises the following steps: carrying out detailed evaluation on the environment of the photovoltaic power station; step two: selecting plants suitable for planting according to the evaluation result of the step one and the requirements of the photovoltaic power station; step three: determining the plant planting position and density according to the layout design of the photovoltaic power station; step four: making a cultivation management plan of plants; step five: the growth status of plants and factors affecting the performance of the photovoltaic system are monitored periodically. The application reasonably plans the plant configuration, ensures the coordinated operation of the plant configuration and the photovoltaic power station, avoids the adverse effect of the plant on the performance of the photovoltaic system, and simultaneously, the automatic planting system can improve the planting efficiency, reduce the cost and reduce the manual operation.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: Ecological restoration method for water and soil conservation of slope surface of barren mountain in western cold and dry region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water and soil conservation ecological restoration method for a barren mountain slope in a western cold and dry region, which relates to the technical field of water and soil conservation ecological restoration for barren mountain slopes in the western cold and dry region, and aims to solve the problems of ecological weakness and uneven distribution in precipitation years of barren mountain slopes in the cold and dry region, the method effectively utilizes rainwater and ice and snow to melt water, adopts a design mode of water diversion soil ditches, drip pipes and straw grids, slows down the converging flow rate of the rainwater and ice and snow to melt water, reduces the harm of the rainwater and ice and snow to soil erosion, controls water and soil loss or debris flow and stores the slope to be used for recovering vegetation of the slope, builds a mode of retaining ecological self-repairing of the water and soil of the slope of the barren mountain, can reduce flood in mountain areas, prevent water and soil loss of the barren mountain and improve vegetation coverage of the slope of the barren mountain.

title_en: Data quick recovery method applied to server cluster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers and discloses a data quick recovery method applied to a server cluster, which comprises the following steps of S1, storing a plurality of data copies in at least two cloud platforms and at least two geographic areas through cross-cloud platform and cross-regional redundancy design, S2, deploying computing and storage resources on edge computing nodes in the server cluster, and recovering data of the local copies preferentially through the edge computing nodes when a disaster occurs, and S3, intelligently selecting a recovery path according to real-time network bandwidth and delay, and dynamically optimizing a network path for data recovery. The method comprises the steps of deploying computing and storage resources at edge computing nodes, realizing local priority recovery, optimizing network paths, improving data recovery speed, adopting cross-cloud platform and cross-regional redundancy design, solving the problem of single-point failure, improving system reliability, combining intelligent recovery priority computing and dynamic scheduling, ensuring priority recovery of key data, and optimizing disaster recovery efficiency.

title_en: Ecological shoreline diagnosis method and system based on hydrologic-biological communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological shoreline diagnosis method and system based on hydrologic-biological communication, which are applied to the technical fields of water environment ecological restoration and shoreline health assessment. The method comprises the steps of dividing intertidal zones of a shoreline research area, generating evenly distributed sampling points in each tidal zone, extracting a plurality of indexes related to hydrology and biological connectivity, constructing a comprehensive hydrology-biological connectivity state index through principal component analysis, acquiring dyke feature data of the shoreline area, carrying out correlation analysis and collinearity screening, screening key shoreline features through a random forest algorithm, constructing a mechanism connectivity index based on a circuit theory, constructing and training a Bayesian network prediction model, and carrying out connectivity state diagnosis, attribution analysis and repair scheme effect simulation on a target shoreline section by utilizing the Bayesian network prediction model. The invention changes from static element evaluation to dynamic ecological process diagnosis by coupling hydrologic and biological connectivity, and accurately locates dominant factors.

title_en: Program and restoration planning support device
abstract_en: To support restoration planning for quickly restoring transportation capacity when failure occurs in a transportation network such as a railway network due to the occurrence of disaster.SOLUTION: A draft plan relating to devoting resources for complete restoration in all failure sections of a transportation network is calculated so that a sum total of amounts of transportation loss which cannot be handled, of transportation OD data satisfies a prescribed minimum condition. The transportation OD data is determined by, until the all failure sections are completely restored, determining a restoration level of each failure section in each day as a result of devoting resources in accordance with the draft plan so that the sum total of amounts of resources devoted to the failure sections in each day is equal to or smaller than an upper limit amount of resources to be devoted, and calculating an anticipated amount of handled results obtained by applying transportation OD data before the occurrence of a disaster, on the basis of an upper limit amount of transportation determined in accordance with the restoration level.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Forest Restoration Method
title_ko: 산림 복원 방법
abstract_en: In general, damage to forests is classified into natural damage and artificial damage, natural damage corresponds to forest fires caused by climate change (e.g., drought) or spontaneous ignition, and artificial damage includes transmission towers, wind power generation, forest clearing, logging, and the like. In the case of transmission towers and wind power generators corresponding to artificial damage, regular or irregular forest damage is repeated according to maintenance as well as forest damage caused by the installation of facilities. The present invention is to quickly restore damaged forests through trees without environmental pollution and manage planted trees to be stably grown. The present invention proposes a container capable of containing soil and nutrient-rich soil that can grow together with planting trees in a forest restoration (P40) stage.
abstract_ko:
일반적으로 산림의 훼손은 자연적인 훼손과 인공적인 훼손으로 분류되고, 자연적인 훼손은 기후 변화(ex, 가뭄)나 자연발화 등에 의한 산불등이 해당되며, 인공적인 훼손은 송전탑, 풍력발전, 산림 개간, 벌목 등이 있다. 
상기에서 인위적인 훼손에 해당하는 송전탑, 풍력발전기의 경우, 시설 설치에 따른 산림 훼손 뿐아니라, 유지보수에 따라 정기적 또는 비정기적인 산림 훼손이 반복된다. 
본 발명은 훼손된 산림을 환경오염 없이 식목을 통해 빠르게 복원하고, 식목된 나무가 안정적으로 생육될수 있도록 관리하는 것이다. 
본 발명은 산림복원(P40) 단계에서 식목과 함께 식목이 성장할 수 있는 토양과 양분이 구비된 토양을 담을 수 있는 용기를 제시한다.
assignees: SHINTAEJIN CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;SHIN SANG IL

title_en: Associating security tags to continuous data protection checkpoints/snapshots/point-in-time images
abstract_en: An in-guest agent in a virtual machine (VM) operates in conjunction with a replication module. The replication module performs continuous data protection (CDP) by saving images of the VM as checkpoints at a disaster recovery site over time. Concurrently, the in-guest agent monitors for behavior in the VM that may be indicative of the presence of malicious code. If the in-guest agent identifies behavior (at a particular point in time) at the VM that may be indicative of the presence of malicious code, the replication module can tag a checkpoint that corresponds to the same particular point in time as a security risk. One or more checkpoints generated prior to the particular time may be determined to be secure checkpoints that are usable for restoration of the VM.

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster rush repair scheduling and load recovery collaborative optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage power distribution network post-disaster rush repair scheduling and load recovery collaborative optimization method and a system, which are used for evaluating the element damage condition of a power distribution system; partitioning the fault point; performing primary recovery by using a distributed power supply, establishing a nonlinear programming model of the primary recovery to obtain a linearized network reconstruction model, and solving to obtain a load recovery result of a first stage without considering a maintenance process as an initial recovery result; and solving a cooperative optimization model of allocation and load recovery of the first-aid repair personnel by taking the maximum load recovery amount and the minimum repair time as targets to obtain a network reconstruction time sequence change process, a first-aid repair personnel advancing line and a load recovery sequence result of a second stage of maintenance scheduling, which are taken into consideration, and taking the results as final results for guiding operating personnel to carry out post-disaster recovery to realize cooperative optimization. The invention improves the recovery capability of the power distribution network after the disaster, reduces the downtime and economic loss and enhances the recovery force of a distribution system.

title_en: Water resource regulation and utilization system for ecological restoration of abandoned opencast limestone mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ecological restoration water resource regulation and storage utilization system for abandoned opencast limestone mine, which comprises a trough positioned in a karst area and a slope positioned in a non-karst area, wherein a plurality of mined pits are distributed in the trough; a water blocking ditch which is consistent with the extending direction of the trough is arranged at the position close to the lower part of the slope and is combined with a plurality of hair branch ditches for blocking surface water and underground water in the slope; a plurality of grit chambers are arranged in the trough at intervals along the extending direction of the trough, a water diversion canal or a water diversion pipeline is arranged between each grit chamber and the water retaining ditch, between each mine pit and at least one grit chamber and between each vegetation recovery remodeling area and at least one grit chamber, and adjacent grit chambers are connected in series through connecting pipelines to realize regulation and distribution. The method not only can provide water source guarantee for the mining pit water landscape construction and vegetation restoration, greatly improve the utilization rate of water resources in the karst area, but also can quickly dredge atmospheric precipitation in the slope area and buffer surface runoff flowing to the karst trough valley area, thereby playing the roles of disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: CHONGQING GEOLOGY AND MINERAL EXPLORATION AND DEVELOPMENT BUREAU 208 HYDROGEOLOGY ENGINEERING GEOLOG

title_en: Fault urgent repair site auxiliary mobile platform based on distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault urgent repair site auxiliary mobile platform based on a distribution network. The fault urgent repair site auxiliary mobile platform comprises a master station terminal system, a mobile terminal and client side system and a wireless communication network, wherein the master station terminal system is in communication connection with the mobile terminal and client side system through the wireless communication network. The master station terminal system comprises a server and a database, and the server carries out operation such as fault work order dispatch, exceptional process execution and work order filing and storage by carrying out related operation on the database; the mobile terminal and client side system transmits fault urgent repair information back to the master station terminal system through the wireless network; the master station terminal system stores the related information to the database, and the mobile terminal and client side system can print customer evaluation return receipts in a Bluetooth mode. According to the fault urgent repair site auxiliary mobile platform, the informationalized level in the distribution network urgent repair process is improved, urgent repair scheduling resources of the electric power department are saved, and therefore the service level of the electric power department is improved substantially.

title_en: A kind of method and its system that the same city strange land calamity based on cloud computing is standby
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of same city strange land calamity based on cloud computing standby method and its system, build a set of distributed memory system Ceph, multiple copies are distributed in two computer rooms of different geographical, are interconnected between two computer rooms by optical fiber special line, realize that the calamity each other of data is standby；Two sets of cloud platforms are built, same set of Ceph cluster is docked, a set of to be used for production environment, a set of for backing up, two sets of platform databases use cluster mode, realize the real-time synchronization of data；A set of centre management service system is developed, while managing two sets of Openstack platforms, and realize that outer net opens function；By public network DNS service function, corresponding two IP of a domain name reach main equipment room and disaster occur, are quickly switched into the purpose of spare computer room.The present invention can effectively realize long-distance data backup, while realize the second level restoration of service.
assignees: JIANGSU HONGXIN SYSTEM INTEGRATION CO LTD

title_en: Method for generating human face based on attributes of cross-modal attention generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: Aiming at generating a face image from a visual attribute text, the invention designs a method for generating a face based on the attribute of a cross-modal attention generation countermeasure network. The method relates to the application of generating a face image from an attribute text description, and in particular to the application of portraying a target character according to a language description. The method comprises four parts of data set preprocessing, network model design, network optimal model training and network model performance evaluation. The invention gives full play to the superiority of the generation countermeasure network in the aspect of image generation, designs an end-to-end solution for generating the human face from the visual attribute text, and has very wide application prospect in the fields of image restoration, public safety, archaeological research, movie and television animation and the like.

title_en: Water area ecological resuscitation scheme assessment method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a water area ecological restoration scheme assessment method, a device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of polluted water area treatment and ecological restoration. The method comprises the steps of determining a target water area scale matrix based on an ecological restoration target and an implementation initial stage, determining a fuzzy consistency matrix corresponding to the scale matrix based on a fuzzy consistency algorithm, normalizing the fuzzy consistency matrix to obtain a weight vector corresponding to a feedback index, determining comprehensive weights, determining a target protection scheme based on sequencing of the comprehensive weights, determining the comprehensive weights based on the fuzzy consistency algorithm by scaling the water area feedback index and the protection scheme, determining the target protection scheme, defining the initial point of water area ecological restoration, comprehensively focusing on the feedback index, determining different protection schemes for different restoration stages, reducing resource waste and improving water area ecological restoration efficiency.

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation method for implementation effect of ecological bottom protection engineering of inland waterway
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive evaluation method for implementation effects of an ecological bottom protection project of a inland waterway, belongs to the field of ecological environment protection of water transport projects, aims at the limitation and the deficiency of the existing evaluation method for implementation effects of the ecological bottom protection project of the inland waterway and the limitation and the deficiency of long-term tracking monitoring of ecological restoration effects of the ecological bottom protection project, comprises three parts, namely an integrated evaluation index system of the ecological bottom protection project of the inland waterway, a weight and scoring criterion system of each item based on the integrated evaluation index system of the ecological bottom protection project of the inland waterway and an implementation effect evaluation criterion system of the ecological bottom protection project based on a ecological compliance index (ECIR-RBPE) of the bottom protection project, and provides a clear, complete, detailed and quantifiable evaluation criterion system for implementation effect evaluation of the ecological bottom protection project of the inland waterway, thereby providing a simple and easy evaluation method for guiding structural design, material selection, engineering arrangement and long-term tracking monitoring of restoration effects of the ecological system of the ecological bottom protection project.

title_en: Power distribution network fault rush-repair scheduling system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault rush-repair scheduling system and method, which relate to the technical field of rush-repair scheduling and comprise the following steps of collecting power distribution network operation data, constructing a device health degree evaluation index set, and outputting a device fault probability distribution map through a fault probability prediction model; the method comprises the steps of establishing a device space topology database based on a geographic information system, positioning fault points through a Dijkstra algorithm and generating three-dimensional geographic coordinate labels, establishing a multi-dimensional rush repair resource portrait library, recording the skill level of a rush repair team, the stock state of materials and the real-time position information of a vehicle, establishing a dynamic priority evaluation model, generating a rush repair task priority sequence according to the emergency degree of the fault, influencing the user level and the criticality of the device, solving a rush repair resource scheduling scheme through a multi-objective gray-wolf optimization algorithm, setting an objective function in the direction of minimizing response time, path cost and resource wave rate, issuing an optimal scheduling instruction through a cooperative scheduling platform, and continuously monitoring the task execution state.

title_en: Underground pipe network intelligent management method and system integrating mapping geographic information and remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground pipe network intelligent management method and system integrating mapping geographic information and remote sensing, and relates to the technical field of underground pipe network intelligent management. The method comprises the following steps of obtaining leakage types of an underground pipe network, determining pipeline aging leakage characteristic factors and pipeline burst leakage characteristic factors, respectively obtaining mapping geographic information and remote sensing data by mapping and remote sensing, constructing an underground pipe network topological structure, obtaining pipeline aging leakage characteristic factor data and pipeline burst leakage characteristic factor data, respectively constructing a pipeline aging leakage prediction model and a pipeline burst leakage prediction model by combining a Transformer and an LSTM network to obtain pipeline aging leakage prediction results and pipeline burst leakage prediction results, and generating a routing inspection path containing a restoration strategy by adopting an ant colony algorithm to intelligently manage the underground pipe network. The method and the device realize accurate analysis of the leakage mechanism, promote the prediction result of leakage and further promote the real-time performance of response.
assignees: THE THIRD EARTH SURVEY TEAM OF MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES OF SICHUAN PROVINCE SICHUAN PROVINCE SURVEY

title_en: Backup restoration method and system based on time sequence database
abstract_en: The invention discloses a backup and restore method and a system based on a time sequence database, which belong to the technical field of time sequence databases and comprise full-quantity backup and restore and incremental backup and restore, wherein the full-quantity backup comprises metadata information and stored data information which are all in the time from establishment to current backup execution, and the incremental backup comprises metadata change information and stored data information which are all in the time from last backup to current backup. All the backup and restore operations comprise a plurality of layers, namely an SQL layer, a JOB layer, a metadata layer, a distributed layer and a storage layer, wherein the SQL layer is used for analyzing backup and restore grammar, the JOB layer is used for starting backup and restore tasks, the metadata layer is used for backing up and restoring metadata information of a database/table, the distributed layer is used for sending the backup and restore tasks to each node, and the storage layer is used for acquiring data of a disk. The invention can solve the problem of data migration of the database system, and has better effect on disaster recovery of data, thereby improving the competitiveness of the product.

title_en: Dynamic optimization system, method and computer-readable storage medium for ecological restoration of photovoltaic power generation area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, in particular to a dynamic optimization system, a dynamic optimization method and a computer readable storage medium for ecological restoration of a photovoltaic power generation area, wherein the system comprises an ecological monitoring module, a monitoring module and a storage module, wherein the ecological monitoring module is used for acquiring environmental data in real time through a sensor network and monitoring equipment deployed in the photovoltaic area; the system comprises a data analysis module, a restoration scheme generation module, an engineering measure management module and a biological measure management module, wherein the data analysis module is used for analyzing the acquired data based on a big data processing technology and a machine learning algorithm to establish an ecological degradation evaluation model to quantify ecological conditions, the restoration scheme generation module is used for combining the result of the evaluation model, regional ecological environment characteristics and a restoration target, and generating a restoration scheme comprising vegetation restoration, soil improvement and water resource management by utilizing a GIS analysis and remote sensing image processing technology, the engineering measure management module is used for managing the implementation process of ecological restoration engineering, and the biological measure management module is used for managing the implementation of biological restoration measures. The invention realizes the collaborative management of engineering and biological measures and improves the ecological restoration efficiency.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANGJIANG NEW ENERGY CO LTD;YUNNAN LYUXUE FORESTRY CONSULTATION CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;YUNNAN BINGCHENG FORESTRY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Arc dual standby power automatic shutdown receptacle including overload that enables real-time remote monitoring based on IoT
title_ko: IoT 기반의 실시간 원격감시가 가능한 과부하를 포함하는 아크겸용 대기전력 자동차단 콘센트장치
abstract_en: An arc and standby power automatic blocking socket device including overload and capable of real-time remote monitoring based on IoT of the present invention comprises: a power side in which commercial power is input; a detecting unit including a plurality of detectors which are connected between a switch and a load side and detect minute electric currents, series arc, parallel arc, ground arc, and present currents by sockets; a converting unit for receiving a plurality signals detected in the detecting unit and converting the signals; an analyzing unit for receiving a plurality signals converted in the converting unit and analyzing a size of an impulse wave, a repetition rate, continuous time, pattern conversion, a shoulder, a form change of a wave, and voltage drop; a comparing unit for comparing a plurality of signals analyzed in the analyzing unit with a preset value; a judging unit for judging quality of the signals compared in the comparing unit; a controlling unit for driving the switch by the signals judged in the judging unit; a communicating unit for communicating the signals judged in the judging unit with the outside by wire or wireless for remote control; and a reset unit for restoration to an original condition after blocking operation of the switch. Minute electric currents, series arc, parallel arc, ground arc, and overload by socket devices are detected by using a plurality of detectors, among a hall sensor, a converter, or a zero phase converter. In addition, a load line of the socket is only blocked by individually judging whether sockets which are connected to a circuit breaker line for a socket embedded in a panel board have a defect or not. As a result, power outage section is minimized and defect content by sockets is grasped exactly, and reaction can be quick.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 IoT 기반의 실시간 원격감시가 가능한 과부하를 포함하는 아크겸용 대기전력 자동차단 콘센트장치는 상용전원이 입력되는 전원측과; 스위치와 부하측 사이에 연결되어 미세한 전류 검출, 직렬아크 검출, 병렬아크 검출, 접지아크 검출, 콘센트별 현재전류 검출하는 복수의 검출기를 포함하는 검출부와; 검출부에서 검출된 복수의 신호를 받아 변환하는 변환부와; 변환부에서 변환된 복수의 신호를 받아 임펄스 파형의 크기, 발생빈도, 지속시간, 패턴변환, 숄더, 파형의 형상변화, 전압강하를 분석하는 분석부와; 분석부에서 분석된 복수의 신호를 미리 설정된 값과 비교하는 비교부와; 비교부에서 비교된 복수의 신호의 양부를 판단하는 판단부와; 판단부에서 판단된 신호에 의해 스위치를 동작시키는 제어부와; 원격으로 제어할 수 있도록 판단부에서 판단된 신호를 유선 또는 무선으로 외부와 통신하는 통신부와; 스위치가 차단동작 후 원상태로 회복시키는 리셋부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하며, 홀센서 또는 변류기 또는 영상변류기 중에서 복수의 검출기를 사용하여 콘센트장치별로 미세한 전류, 직렬아크, 병렬아크, 접지아크, 과부하를 검출하여 분전반에 내장 된 콘센트용 차단기 선로에 연결된 복수의 콘센트 각각의 결함여부를 판단하여 해당 콘센트의 부하선로만을 차단하도록 함으로써 정전구역을 최소화하고 콘센트별 결함내용을 정확하게 파악하고, 대처를 신속하는 효과가 있다.
assignees: DIGITAL POWER NET CO LTD;SO YOUNG JU;SO BYUNG SOO

title_en: Transmission line fault location, isolation & system restoration (flisr) system
abstract_en: An electrical power network employing fault location, isolation and system restoration. The system includes a plurality of switching devices electrically coupled along a power line downstream of a fault interrupting device. The switching devices each have current and voltage sensing capability and the capability to provide pulse tests for detecting fault presence. The fault interrupting device performs reclosing operations, and when the plurality of switching devices detect fault presence a predetermined number of times in coordination with a number of reclosing operations performed by the fault interrupting device and detect loss of voltage, each switching device opens. The fault interrupting device closes when the switching devices open, and the switching devices sequentially pulse test and close from a furthest upstream switching device when detecting return of voltage and no fault presence until a switching device closest to the fault pulse tests and detects fault presence and locks open.

title_en: Mud-rock flow pile-up fan ecology and rock-soil measure cooperation silt stopping system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mud-rock flow accumulation fan ecology and rock-soil measure cooperative silt stopping system. The system organically integrates two major types of rock and soil and ecological measures, and is arranged in a three-dimensional mode in a ground flow area and an impact height space area of the debris flow. And sequentially arranging a rock-soil measure section, an ecological rock-soil combination measure section and an ecological measure section along the dredging movement direction. And in each section, the system sequentially generates three layers of stopping effects of opposite impact energy dissipation, diversion peak clipping, ground resistance increasing, space grading blocking and ground resistance increasing and silt stopping on the debris flow by utilizing the measure type selection and the structural characteristics thereof. The technology aims to cooperatively integrate the control efficacy of the rock soil and the ecological measures, enhance the natural ecological restoration capability of the silt stopping system, prolong the service life of the system and eliminate the hidden danger of secondary disasters. The optimized ecological rock-soil combination measure section adopts a staged construction method of matching spatial arrangement with dynamic time, so that stable and organic combination of the two measures is ensured. The invention also provides a design and calculation model of the blocking height of the structures in the system.

title_en: Small fire extinguishers equipped with infiltration fire extin
title_ko: 침윤소화약제와 튜브를 구비한 소형 소화장치
abstract_en: In general, a small fire extinguisher with a fire extinguishing gas and a tube are used for rapid fire detection and rapid fire extinguishing of small spaces for fire extinguishing costs, rapid initial suppression and rapid restoration of facilities. The small fire extinguisher is widely used in an electrical panel. Even if the small fire extinguisher is intended to be applied to cables of cable trays that are linearly stacked in multiple stages, the fire extinguishing gas only extinguishes the surface and does not remove embers from the stacked interior. Therefore, the small fire extinguisher cannot be used for the cable of the cable tray being stacked. In order to solve this problem, the present invention has developed the small fire extinguisher using filtration fire extinguishing chemicals that can be applied to the cable tray in which the cables are stacked by penetrating microcavities.
abstract_ko:
일반적으로 소화비용 및 빠른 초기 진압, 빠른 시설물 복구를 위하여 작은 공간을 신속하게 화재감지하고 신속하게 소화하는 소화가스와 튜브를 구비한 소형 소화장치를 사용한다. 이들 소형 소화장치는 수배전반에 많이 사용하고 있다. 이를 선형적으로 길게 다단으로 적층되는 케이블트레이의 케이블에 적용하고자 하나 소화가스는 표면을 소화하지 적층된 내부의 불씨를 제거하지 못하는 단점이 있어 적층되는 케이블트레이의 케이블에 사용할 수 없는 단점이 있다.    
본 발명에서는 이러한 문제를 해소하기 위해서 미세공간을 침투하여 케이블이 적층된 케이블트레이에 적용할 수 있는 침윤소화약제를 사용하는 소형 소화장치를 개발하였다.

title_en: Disaster recovery using mirrored network attached storage
abstract_en: A system, architecture for initializing and utilizing a mirrored Network Attached Storage (NAS) system is described. The architecture includes a plurality of processing layers that define and control the operation and relationship of component groups in a primary NAS and associated component groups in a secondary NAS. The groups may include, for example, file server groups and disk device groups. The processing layers may include an execution layer, a transaction layer and a storage layer. The modularized architecture of the invention allows NAS systems to be easily apportioned into logical groups at varying levels of granularity with varying relationships. As a result, the component groups are abstracted from their underlying physical characteristics and constraints, thereby enabling complex processes such as initialization, activation and restoration to be performed using simple commands at a command line interface.
assignees: SRINIVASAN KARTHIKEYAN;DEAN ROYCE T;TIAN XUN;EMC CORP

title_en: Remote power outage and restoration notification
abstract_en: Power outages and restorations at customer premises can be automatically detected and reported. A method may include receiving, from a network terminal, a first notification associated with a power outage; retrieving location information associated with the network terminal; sending a second notification indicating that the outage has occurred and that includes the location information associated with the network terminal; retrieving prior outage information that corresponds to a set of network terminals associated with a group of set top boxes; determining that an outage event is triggered, when a quantity of outages is greater than a threshold, where the quantity of outages is based on the outage and other outages obtained from the prior outage information; and sending a third notification based on the determination that the outage event is triggered.

title_en: Ecological floating island in tidal flood water area
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an ecological engineering technical field specifically discloses an ecological chinampa in tide flood waters, float a unit including a plurality of, a plurality of floats a unit and is "saying" the font and arranges, and every floats a unit and includes the bed frame body of floating, the bed frame body of floating and the bed matrix of floating that a plurality of set up side by side, and a plurality of floats the bed frame body and connects through connecting the rope, connects the rope to fix in floating the bed frame body, and the outer parcel of the bed frame body of floating has the net piece, floats on the bed frame body, is equipped with a plurality of through-hole, floats the bed matrix of floating and inlays the dress in the through-hole, floats the planting in the bed matrix and floats the. The utility model discloses ecological chinampa is arranged by a plurality of floating bed unit "saying" font, reduces the windward area of ecological chinampa to reduce the influence of stormy waves, strengthen the stability and the security of ecological chinampa, be applicable to ecological waters restoration under the influence of the river low reaches flood.

title_en: System for dynamically predicating power load of iron and steel enterprise in short period
abstract_en: The invention provides a system for dynamically predicating the power load of an iron and steel enterprise in a short period and belongs to the technical field of energy predication of iron and steel enterprises. According to hardware, the system comprises an application server, a relational data base server, a client side PC and a network device connecting all computers. The network device comprises a switch, network cables, a firewall and a router device. The application server and the relational data base server are connected to the switch through the network cables. The external client side PC is connected to a router. The router is connected with the switch through the firewall, so that communication between a client side and a server side is achieved. A software system comprises a heterogeneous data platform and a load predicating system. The load predicating system is composed of a load analyzing module, a predication configuration module and a load predicating module. The system for dynamically predicating the power load of the iron and steel enterprise in the short period has the advantages that the power utilization characteristics of each power utilization link, the technological feature, a production plan, a repair schedule and production working condition information are comprehensively considered, classified modeling is conducted, a predication value of the total load is obtained according to superposition of predication results, the predication value is in line with the reality of the iron and steel enterprise, information, technological rhythms and dynamic working condition information are fully considered in the process of dynamic predication, and models are better in adaptability.
assignees: AUTOMATION RES & DESIGN INST METALLURG INDUSTRY

title_en: Multilayer oblique slotted bidirectional arrangement steel plate shear wall
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multilayer oblique slotted bidirectional arrangement steel plate shear wall comprising multilayer oblique slotted steel plates, an edge frame, and polyfluortetraethylene plates arranged between different steel plates; the oblique slots of two adjacent steel plates are in different direction; the total thicknesses of steel plates with different oblique slot directions are same; the layer number of the steel plates is an odd number bigger than 1; connecting plates and the edge frame are welded for fixation; the thickness of the polyfluortetraethylene plate is not bigger than 1mm; the surrounding of the steel plate shear well and the connecting plates on the edge frame are connected through high strength bolts in one side shearing manner, so maintenance and post-disaster restoration replacement are convenient; the oblique slot holes in each column of the steel plates of the shear wall are slot holes at intervals; the oblique direction of oblique slot holes in each column of the steel plates with different aspect ratio is parallel to the steel plate diagonal direction.

title_en: Data disaster recovery reconstruction method, system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a data disaster recovery reconstruction method, a system, a device and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of disaster recovery reconstruction. When the method is applied to an access platform of a data disaster recovery reconstruction system, the data disaster recovery reconstruction system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a main cluster platform, a standby cluster platform and an access platform. The access platform is respectively in communication connection with the main cluster platform and the standby cluster platform; the access platform receives an access request, wherein the access request comprises: an address of a primary cluster platform; and if the main cluster platform fails, the access platform forwards the access request to the standby cluster platform. By simultaneously establishing the main cluster platform and the standby cluster platform, when the main cluster platform fails, the standby cluster platform can be switched to in time, so that the service data can be restored in time, and the timeliness and the stability of the restoration of the power data system are improved.

title_en: Urban water supply pipe network anti-seismic toughness comprehensive calculation method considering water quality and water quantity indexes
abstract_en: A comprehensive calculation method for the earthquake-resistant toughness of an urban water supply pipe network taking water quality and water quantity indexes into consideration belongs to the field of water supply pipe network earthquake-resistant performance evaluation. The method comprises the following steps: probability P of pipeline shock hazard  f  Is calculated; pipeline lineConfirming the post-earthquake state; determining the area of a leakage hole of a leakage pipeline; establishing a pipe network hydraulic model of the earthquake damage scene; simulating a pipe network post-earthquake recovery process, and adopting a pipeline dynamic importance ranking method to collect the pipeline water source distance to determine the post-earthquake recovery sequence; establishing a hydraulic power and water quality model of a pipe network in the post-earthquake recovery process; calculating the anti-seismic toughness; and (5) calculating the mean value of the anti-seismic toughness. According to the method, the water quality index is incorporated into the evaluation index of the anti-service performance of the urban water supply network, and the anti-seismic toughness of the urban water supply network is comprehensively calculated; the method for integrating the pipeline water source distances by adopting the pipeline dynamic importance sorting method is adopted to determine the post-earthquake repair order, so that the determined pipeline repair order is more reasonable; the water supply toughness evaluation index disclosed by the invention can comprehensively reflect the post-earthquake anti-seismic toughness, the hydraulic power and water quality change characteristics and the relative difference of a pipe network, considers the uncertainty of pipeline damage under an earthquake scene and the uncertainty of leakage type of a leakage pipeline, and generates a sufficient number of random earthquake damage scenes through Monte Carlo simulation. Has guiding significance for post-earthquake disaster relief and repair work.

title_en: Target backbone network frame optimization method for power system restoration decision support
abstract_en: Some embodiments of the present application provide a target backbone network frame optimization method for power system restoration decision support, including: and circularly executing the following operations until the verification result of the target grid frame scheme to be verified is passing, obtaining a target backbone grid frame scheme based on a target grid frame optimization model, and obtaining the target grid frame scheme to be verified, wherein the target grid frame optimization model comprises the following components: an objective function and an objective constraint, the objective constraint comprising: grid connectivity constraints and linearized ac power flow constraints; checking the target net rack scheme to be checked to obtain the checking result; and when the verification result is confirmed to be failed, acquiring abnormal out-of-limit information in the target grid frame scheme to be verified, and updating the target constraint condition based on the abnormal out-of-limit information. Some embodiments of the present application may enable decision support for power system security restoration.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Method for quickly recovering degraded wetland by utilizing micro-relief assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly recovering degraded wetland by utilizing micro-landform assembly, belonging to the technical field of wetland ecological engineering. The method aims to solve the limiting problem of poor heterogeneity of degraded wetland habitat and low sustainability after wetland recovery. The method comprises the steps of site selection and habitat quality assessment of a restored wetland, form optimization of the restored wetland base and construction of a flood water network, collection and micro-landform assembly of a grass dune pier body, sectional hydrologic regulation and dynamic management, and assessment and medium control of restoration effects. The method provided by the invention has clear principle and strong operability, can strengthen the habitat heterogeneity through micro-landform assembly so as to promote the diversity improvement of plants, and has the design thought fitting the near-natural recovery concept, and no engineering implementation hidden danger and secondary ecological risk exist. The method provided by the invention is applied to develop the near-natural recovery of the degraded wetland. The method is used for the near-natural recovery of the degraded wetland with the loss of the habitat heterogeneity.

title_en: Power distribution network rapid maintenance decision method and system considering incomplete fault information
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system rush repair scheduling, and provides a power distribution network quick maintenance decision method and system considering incomplete fault information, wherein in the training process of an offline stage, historical fault scene information is preprocessed to generate a fault scene set, the similarity of any two fault scenes is calculated, and the fault scenes are clustered; calculating weak rules of all fault scenes to obtain an alternative weak rule set to form a global maintenance rule set, obtaining current fault scene information, calculating similarity of the current fault scene and fault scenes in a fault scene set, obtaining a neighborhood of the scene on the basis of the similarity, calculating total association degree, and finally identifying an optimal rule as an optimal maintenance decision according to similarity statistics and Bayesian theorem. The invention fully considers the influence of incomplete fault information of the large-scale power distribution network, and identifies the optimal rule in the global maintenance rule set obtained by training in a mode of combining offline training and online decision.
assignees: DEZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Regional level electricity-heat-disaster storage post-intelligent recovery method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent recovery method and system after regional electricity-heat-disaster storage, belongs to the technical field of power grid planning, and solves the problem that a power distribution network cannot recover autonomously under an extreme event. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical data related to power grid equipment fault diagnosis, preprocessing, extracting features, constructing various extreme event scenes, evaluating survivability index prediction redundancy requirements, constructing island division and path optimization scheduling models and constraint conditions thereof to optimize load recovery efficiency, constructing a graph neural network model to predict energy storage configuration requirements, energy storage types and energy storage time windows, and constructing an area level recovery mechanism oriented to an electric-thermal-storage multi-energy system to generate a step recovery sequence through state vector modeling, block autonomous judgment, rule engine reasoning and state evolution simulation. The energy supply maintainability of the load points is measured through the viability index, and the recovery path is dynamically optimized by combining a strategy scoring mechanism, so that the autonomy, self-healing and efficient scheduling of the post-disaster system are realized.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Optimally deploying utility repair assets to minimize power outages during major weather events
abstract_en: The disclosed embodiments relate to a system that facilitates deployment of utility repair crews to nodes in a utility network. During operation, the system determines a node criticality for each node in the utility network based on a network-reliability analysis, which considers interconnections among the nodes in the utility network. The system also determines a node failure probability for each node in the utility network based on historical weather data, historical node failure data and weather forecast information for the upcoming weather event. The system uses the determined node criticalities and the determined node failure probabilities to determine a deployment plan for deploying repair crews to nodes in the utility network in preparation for the upcoming weather event. The system then presents the deployment plan to a person who uses the deployment plan to deploy repair crews to be available to service nodes in the utility network.

title_en: Methods and systems for detection and notification of power outages and power quality
abstract_en: Described herein are methods and systems for detection and notification of electrical power outages and power quality. A sensor coupled to a circuit transmits a keepalive packet to a server. The sensor detects an input signal generated by electrical activity. The sensor generates an output signal based upon the input signal. The sensor monitors the output signal. During a clock cycle, the sensor determines whether a rising edge occurred and transmits a fault packet to the server when the rising edge occurred prior to a predetermined clock value or when no rising edge occurred. The server receives the fault packet from the sensor and listens for keepalive packets. The server transmits a power outage notification when no keepalive packets are received for at least a defined time period after the fault packet is received. The server transmits a power restoration notification when one or more keepalive packets are subsequently received.

title_en: Hybrid distribution network power restoration control
abstract_en: A power outage restoration system manages a power network including a plurality of switching devices. The power outage restoration system includes an outage management system having a network model of said power network. A plurality of local restoration controllers are in communication with the outage management system and each said local restoration controller includes a trimmed network model correlating to a respective area of responsibility.
assignees: ABB RESEARCH LTD;WANG ZHENYUAN;STOUPIS JAMES;DONDE VAIBHAV;LI WENPING;PETERSON WILLIAM

title_en: Combined emergency bridge and erection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention puts forward a combined emergency bridge and an erection method thereof which are designed for solving the problems that in the prior art, the quick restoration on the traffics at the gap positions of highway subgrades and the derogative areas of subgrades is realized by way of building shortcuts, therefore, the restoration is restricted by terrain conditions and affected by secondary geological disasters, meanwhile, the restoration is long in time, time-consuming, labor-consuming and the like. The combined emergency bridge comprises cubic steel frames, triangular prism-shaped steel frames, bearing wire cables, fixing wire cables and road slabs. The combined emergency bridge and the erection method thereof have the following beneficial effects: the bearing wire cables and combined steel frames of the bridge constitute a statically indeterminate self-bearing structure system, horizontal pressures produced by the steel frames are transmitted to the ends of the bridge, and the loads of the triangular prism-shaped steel frames are balanced by the tension of the bearing wire cables; the steel frames of the combined emergency bridge provided by the invention can not be fabricated on site, and the fabrication of the steel frames can be standardized and serialized; and the erection method of the combined emergency bridge is simple without carrying out excessive treatments on disaster sites, therefore, the method has the characteristics of emergency, speediness and convenience.

title_en: New energy power station output data restoration method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for restoring output data of a new energy power station, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring abnormal output data of the new energy power station; determining similar days and related power stations of the new energy power station; restoring abnormal output data of the new energy power station according to the similar day of the new energy power station and/or the related power station; the method provided by the invention can correct the abnormal data of the new energy power station by using the similar day of the new energy power station and the related power stations, and improves the accuracy and the reliability of the identification and repair of the abnormal data of the new energy power station.

title_en: User electric quantity data restoration method based on load curve and historical electric quantity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a user electric quantity data restoration method based on a load curve and historical electric quantity, and relates to the field of electric power data acquisition. At present, abnormal data is often directly discarded, so that subsequent judgment is affected. The method comprises the following steps: judging whether electric quantity abnormality or meter reading data deletion exists or not; when the electric quantity is abnormal or meter reading data is missing, the corrected electric quantity data; if the electricity quantity cannot be corrected, the normal electricity quantity of the meter on the last day T in the first two days is multiplied by the total electricity quantity of the meter with normal rest electricity quantity in the county where the meter is located, and the total electricity quantity is taken as corrected electricity quantity data; if the electricity quantity of the first two days of the meter cannot be corrected, the month electricity quantity of the meter used for settlement in the marketing system is taken, and the daily average electricity quantity is calculated and used as corrected electricity quantity data. According to the technical scheme, adverse effects on data analysis caused by wrong electric quantity data under the conditions of abnormal electric quantity such as electric quantity flying away, electric quantity rewinding away and the like are avoided, and the accuracy of the data analysis is improved.

title_en: Power failure recovery analysis and rush repair method and management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of outage analysis and rush repair, and discloses an outage analysis and rush repair method, wherein an intelligent electric energy meter is adopted to measure the load value of each node in a platform region, the load value is transmitted to a power utilization information acquisition system main station through a concentrator, the complex phase voltage of each node is calculated according to the known load value of each node, then the real-time outage state of each node in the platform region is estimated according to the calculated complex phase voltage of each node, the power utilization information acquisition system carries out reverse tracing treatment on the estimated node with the power failure event, deduces the specific position of the node with the power failure event, pushes the specific position to a target end for realizing the rush repair, and power repair personnel arrive at a designated position to implement the rush repair. The invention realizes the technical effect of actively and conveniently monitoring the fault power failure and power restoration event of each node in the platform area in real time.

title_en: Data disaster recovery method and device
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of data storage and provides a data disaster recovery method and device, comprising the steps of determining the fault type and the range of data to be recovered in a distributed cluster system; the method comprises the steps of obtaining state parameters of a plurality of normal nodes in a distributed cluster system, obtaining service sensitivity characteristics and data block access characteristics of data to be recovered, carrying out data preprocessing operation, determining a data recovery priority list and a node priority list by adopting a service sensitivity evaluation model and a node state evaluation model respectively, determining a fault processing strategy according to the data recovery priority list and the node priority list, and executing the fault processing strategy. According to the method, the real-time evaluation algorithm of the heterogeneous large data node is added on the basis of dynamically updating the data recovery priority based on the service sensitivity evaluation model, and compared with the prior art, the method can reduce the fault perception of a service system and improve the data disaster recovery efficiency.

title_en: Construction method for disaster recovery of river-approaching Gao Douge binded retaining wall foundation undercut
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method for disaster recovery of a river-passing Gao Douge binded retaining wall foundation undercut, and belongs to the technical field of water conservancy and hydropower bank slope water-passing maintenance engineering construction technology. The construction method for disaster recovery of the river Gao Douge binded retaining wall foundation undercut is convenient to construct and operate, and can remarkably improve stability and safety of disaster recovery parts. The construction method comprises the steps of firstly adopting tetrahedral strings to enclose a shoal construction area comprising undercut disaster areas in a high-speed water flow river channel in a dead water period, then erecting concrete casting templates with narrow outside and wide inside in the shoal construction area, then filling block stones in the shoal construction area on two sides of the concrete casting templates, casting cavity concrete of an emptying disaster area based on filling block stones and casting concrete of the block stone filling area, and finally obtaining a temporary Gao Douge bine cage retaining wall restoration foundation comprising tetrahedral string enclosing structures, concrete casting templates, cavity concrete of the emptying disaster area and concrete of the block stone filling area through maintenance.

title_en: Structural design optimization method for deepwater catenary mooring rope
abstract_en: The invention relates to a structural design optimization method for a deepwater catenary mooring rope. The method aims at an 'anchor chain-steel rope-anchor chain' three-section combined deepwater catenary mooring rope, structural parameters of length of each section of the rope, top pretension, mooring horizontal radiation distance and the like are determined through iterative computation by giving consideration to specific requirements of design specifications on various indicators under the condition of given rope specifications, operating water depth and allowable limit horizontal offset of a floating body, and accordingly horizontal restoration characteristics of the rope reaches optimum under the condition of controlling total steel consumption and mooring load, and then structure types and stress situations of the rope under different states are computed to bring convenience to type selection of mooring equipment. Compared with existing commercial software such as mooring analysis software MOSES and SESAM, the method has the advantages of oriented design, high practicality, high convergence speed and the like, achieves optimal selection of various design parameters and can be used for preliminary scheme design and performance evaluation of deepwater floating type platform catenary mooring systems.
assignees: CHINA NAT OFFSHORE OIL CORP;CNOOC RES INST

title_en: Micro-grid data fault diagnosis method based on intelligent power monitoring instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microgrid data fault diagnosis method based on an intelligent power monitoring instrument, which comprises the following steps: (10) constructing a physical constraint equation: generating a physical relation constraint equation according to the topological connection relation and the physical relation; (20) and (3) timing initiation diagnosis: initiating a diagnosis task regularly by setting a diagnosis period; (30) acquiring microgrid data: obtaining original data and power parameters of system operation, including voltage and current monitoring values; (40) establishing a data restoration and fault diagnosis model: setting a target function based on the power parameters, and establishing a centerless data restoration and diagnosis optimization model; (50) and (3) distributed optimization solution: solving an optimization equation, and solving an estimated value of the electric power parameter of the micro-point network; (60) fault diagnosis and repair: and comparing the fault database to obtain the fault type, repairing the error data and issuing a warning notice. The micro-grid data fault diagnosis method has strong robustness and high operation efficiency.

title_en: Uncertainty-considered dynamic assessment method for recovery value of to-be-recovered object of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dynamically evaluating recovery value of an object to be recovered of a power distribution network, which takes uncertainty into account, and comprises the following steps: evaluating the recovery value of the ith load unit to be recovered and evaluating the recovery value V of the ith load bus ι‑self Calculating the adequacy in the partition at the current moment, evaluating the uncertainty of the unit on the generatrix of the No. g unit, and traversing J preferentially from the generatrix of the No. g unit to the outside width g Layer, evaluator and perimeter J g G-th strip set bus recovery value V of layer bus recovery value g (ii) a Breadth-first traversal J outward from third iota load busbar ι Layer, evaluator and perimeter J ι Iota of layer bus recovery valueBar load bus recovery value V ι . The potential recovery value brought to the peripheral objects by the recovery of the object to be recovered is considered, the recovery priority of the object to be recovered in the recovery process is effectively determined, the urgency of the object to be recovered needing power supply recovery is fully reflected, and help is provided for the optimization decision of the recovery scheme.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY;NANJING INST TECH

title_en: Dynamic monitoring method and system for vegetation recovery after fire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic monitoring method and a dynamic monitoring system for vegetation restoration after fire, which relate to the technical field of ecological environment monitoring and comprise the following steps: acquiring time sequence data of a biomass change index NDVI and a normalized burning index NBR of a vegetation area of a fire passing area to be monitored and an adjacent vegetation area thereof in a period of time before and after the vegetation area is burnt on fire based on a remote sensing cloud platform GEE, and determining the fire time of the fire passing area; respectively calculating the difference value between the mean value of the annual enhanced vegetation index EVI in a period of time after fire disaster and the mean value of the enhanced vegetation index EVI in a period of time before the fire time in the fire passing area, and forming an annual dynamic change curve of the difference value; and analyzing the vegetation recovery condition of the fire area to be monitored after the fire according to the annual dynamic change curve of the difference. The invention improves the working efficiency of vegetation recovery condition monitoring after fire and is beneficial to solving the problem of vegetation index saturation in high vegetation areas.
assignees: INST OF GEOGRAPHICAL SCIENCES HENAN ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Power supply restoration strategy determination method, device and equipment of comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device and equipment for determining a power supply restoration strategy of a comprehensive energy system. The method comprises the following steps: under the condition that the fault distribution transformer area exists in the comprehensive energy system, obtaining transformer area operation constraint of the fault distribution transformer area, branch constraint of a coupling branch of the fault distribution transformer area and switch operation constraint of an intelligent soft switch based on the current topological structure of the fault distribution transformer area; constructing a load recovery loss function of the fault distribution transformer area according to load information of loads in the fault distribution transformer area and operation information of the intelligent soft switch; and solving the load recovery loss function according to the operation constraint of the transformer area, the branch constraint, the operation constraint of the switch and the control mode of the intelligent soft switch by taking the minimum function value of the load recovery loss function as a target, and determining the power supply recovery strategies of the fault distribution transformer area in different time periods. By adopting the method, the power supply recovery efficiency of the fault distribution transformer area in the comprehensive energy system during the fault period can be improved.

title_en: Performance assessment-based natural resource project evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a performance assessment-based natural resource project evaluation method and system, which relate to the technical field of project evaluation, and are used for acquiring vegetation coverage influence values, soil damage values and rainfall influence values of a target area to calculate disaster influence values of the target area, comparing the disaster influence values of the target area with preset disaster influence value thresholds, determining disaster severity grades of the target area according to comparison results, determining performance assessment standards of environmental restoration in a corresponding natural project of the target area at the next stage according to different disaster severity grades, and thus, in performance assessment of environmental restoration projects of a forest ecological area, when the forest ecological area experiences natural disasters such as typhoons, the environmental restoration performance index assessment of the forest ecological area at the next stage can be adjusted according to actual conditions, so that the performance assessment judgment of the project at the next stage is reasonable and correct, and the influence of a manager on project decision is reduced.
assignees: THE SECOND SURVEYING AND MAPPING INST OF ANHUI PROVINCE

title_en: Cluster electric automobile regulation and control method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a cluster electric automobile regulation and control method and device. The method comprises the steps of collecting departure time, return time and vehicle transfer probability data of electric vehicles in an electric vehicle cluster in a preset area, generating an electric vehicle travel chain based on a Meng Daka method, collecting charging and discharging behaviors of the electric vehicles, carrying out emergency power supply response potential evaluation based on the electric vehicles of the cluster, generating an emergency power supply response potential evaluation result, establishing a power equation for recovering power supplied by the electric vehicle cluster support step by step under an emergency condition, screening the electric vehicles participating in scheduling according to the power equation for recovering the power supplied by the electric vehicle cluster support step by step, and generating an optimal scheduling strategy based on a particle swarm optimization algorithm with the aim of minimizing total loss of whole power loss. The method and the device realize comprehensive consideration of the load recovery priority and the electric vehicle dispatching priority, and are an optimized solution for emergency power supply of the electric vehicle.

title_en: Power failure analysis method for intelligent fusion terminal of transformer area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power failure analysis method for an intelligent fusion terminal of a platform area, which comprises the following steps of step 1, step 2, analyzing power failure events, studying and judging a power failure range and determining a power failure level, step 3, comprehensively judging a fault type, an influence range and a predicted power failure duration by combining the power failure level, the number of influencing users and a historical power failure record, step 4, automatically generating an active first-aid repair work order containing fault positioning coordinates based on a judging result, pushing the active first-aid repair work order to a mobile client, and step 5, monitoring and confirming the power failure events, and generating a power restoration notification completion work order closed loop. The invention realizes real-time accurate sensing of the power failure event of the transformer area and rapid and automatic research and judgment of the faults, shortens the response time of the faults from more than 15 minutes to less than 2 minutes, and achieves the service mode transition from passive repair to active repair.
assignees: QINGDAO TOPSCOMM COMMUNICATION CO LTD;QINGDAO ZHIDIAN NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD;QINGDAO TUOWEI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent distribution board, distribution device, power outage countermeasure system and distribution method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To realize avoidance of an effect on a power supply system, and power supply from a dispersed power to a load at the time of power outage, and power supply automation from the power supply system at the time of power supply restoration.SOLUTION: The power outage countermeasure system comprises: first switching means (electromagnetic switch 42) which supplies power to a specific load (12B) connected to a power supply system (electric power system 10) and which blocks the power supply system at the time of power outage of the power supply system; second switching means (electromagnetic switch 44) which connects a dispersed power to the load and supplies power to the load from the dispersed power after the first switching means blocks the system; the power supply system which blocks the second switching means and unblocks the first switching means, and then restores the power supply therefrom to the load at the time of power supply restoration.

title_en: Sewage treatment apparatus and method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a sewage treatment apparatus and method which can quickly cope with fluctuations in the amount of inflow water and the pollution loading amount at normal times, and can be used for emergency restoration measures against a sewage treatment facility having become dysfunctional by disaster or natural phenomena, such as an earthquake, a tidal wave, or local severe rain.SOLUTION: A sewage treatment apparatus includes: a biological reaction tank 1 which performs aerobic biological treatment of inflow sewage; a filter material module 2 which is provided in the biological reaction tank 1 and arranged with a plurality of string-like filter materials; air diffusers 3a which are provided below the filter material module 2; a solid-liquid separation apparatus 4 which solid-liquid separates a mixed liquid from the biological reaction tank 1 into treated water and separated sludge; and a sludge return pipe 9 which returns the separated sludge to the biological reaction tank 1.

abstract_en: To relief people who are not actually damaged by a disaster but suffer from rumored damages.SOLUTION: A sightseeing actual disaster area specification part 51 specifies a region in which damages (a damage rate of accommodations is equal to or more than 30%, a period to the restoration of transportation is equal to or more than eight days, or the like) equal to or more than a predetermined value occurs in a sightseeing infrastructure including the accommodation and the transportation, and the region in which indexes represented by an accommodation reduction rate and a non-operation rate of guest rooms satisfy reference (the accommodation reduction rate is 30% or more, the non-operation rate of guest rooms is 30% or more, the period to the restoration of transportation is equal to or more than eight days, or the like) as a sightseeing damaged area among regions around a disaster area damaged by a disaster. title_en: Apparatus selectively opening and closing floodgate
title_ko: 수동수문 및 자동수문을 선택적으로 개폐할 수 있는수문권양장치
abstract_en: A winch apparatus of a water gate is provided to open and close a manual water gate and an automatic water gate selectively, and to prevent the loss of property caused by flood damage and the waste of the budget caused by restoration. A winch apparatus of a water gate capable of opening and closing a manual water gate and an automatic water gate selectively comprises a power unit(100) generating the power for opening and closing first and second water gates(20,30) and rotating a driving shaft, a lock bar(25) coupled to the first water gate and extended upward, a winch unit(200) winding or unwinding a rope connected to the second water gate, a first power transmission unit(300) ascending and descending the lock bar, a second power transmission unit(400) transferring rotary force to the winch unit, and a power conversion unit(500) transferring the power of the power unit to one of the first and second power transmission units selectively.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 수동수문 및 자동수문을 선택적으로 개폐할 수 있는 권양장치에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명의 수동수문 및 자동수문을 선택적으로 개폐할 수 있는 수문권양장치는 수로를 가로질러 설치되며 하부에 물이 유통되는 유로가 형성된 구조물에 설치되어 유로의 입구를 수직방향에서 개폐하는 제 1수문과, 제 1수문으로부터 이격되어 구조물에 회동가능하게 설치되며 유로의 출구를 수로의 수위의 변동에 의해 개폐하는 제 2수문 중 어느 하나의 수문을 선택적으로 개폐하기 위한 것으로, 구조물에 설치되며 제 1 및 제 2수문을 개폐하기 위한 동력을 발생시켜 구동축을 회전시키는 동력부와, 제 1수문에 결합되어 상방으로 연장되는 락크바와, 제 2수문을 강제적으로 회동시킬 수 있도록 제 2수문에 연결된 로프를 감거나 풀어주는 윈치부와, 락크바를 승강시킬 수 있게 락크바와 결합된 제 1동력전달부와, 윈치부에 회전력을 전달할 수 있게 윈치부와 결합된 제 2동력전달부와, 동력부의 동력을 상기 제 1동력전달부와 제 2동력전달부 중 어느 하나에 선택적으로 전달할 수 있는 동력전환부를 포함한다.

title_en: Network management device, method, and program
abstract_en: A network management device according to one embodiment includes: a generation unit that generates an optimization problem for determining a suitable installation form of a disaster countermeasure facility on the basis of information on the installation location of a communication facility requiring restoration when affected by a disaster and information on a location where a disaster countermeasure facility that is a communication facility for replacing the function of the communication facility requiring restoration can be installed; and an analysis unit that analyzes a suitable installation location of the disaster countermeasure facility by determining a solution of the generated optimization problem.

title_en: Interval data for a utility meter during a power outage without a battery
abstract_en: A utility meter includes a consumption measurement unit for generating consumption data, a meter processor, and a RTC for time stamping the consumption data to provide interval meter data during interval meter operation. A memory stores the interval meter data. The meter processor implements/initiates responsive to a power loss that suspends RTC operation, switching from interval to relative time operation where consumption data is stored as relative consumption data together with a relative time as relative meter data. Responsive power restoration and receiving a current time, the meter switches from relative time to interval meter operation. The restoration time is calculated using the current and an elapsed time since the restoration. The time of restoration and current time is used to generate calculated times. The consumption data from relative time operation is time stamped with the calculated times to provide time-corrected relative meter data that is stored to the memory.

title_en: System for multi-phase management of a natural disaster incident
abstract_en: A computerized system for multi-phase management of a natural disaster incident is disclosed. In one embodiment of the invention, the computerized system incorporates a pre-incident risk reduction management module, a crisis response management module, and a restoration and rehabilitation management module to correspond to these three distinct phases of managing a natural disaster incident. This multi-phase natural disaster management system can be utilized by private entities, community groups, state, national, and/or international agencies to assist prevention or reduction of damage to human and natural resources in a particular disaster incident. Furthermore, the multi-phase natural disaster management system can assist or enable protection of lives, health, and safety of community members and disaster incident response personnel. A prioritization model in the pre-incident risk management module can take an empirical or subjective weighting factor in evaluating a particular geographic section to optimize disaster prevention and management.

title_en: Method and system for decision-making of power distribution line recovery sequence after bus fault power loss
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for deciding a recovery sequence of a distribution line after a bus fault and power failure. And finally, determining the total sequence of each line for each evaluation index in the user evaluation classification model by using a sequence method, and obtaining a recovery sequence after the power failure of the distribution line. Based on the method, a power distribution line recovery sequence decision-making system is also provided. The invention ensures that important users can recover power transmission at the highest speed, establishes a hierarchical analysis model for determining the optimal recovery sequence of the distribution line, and integrates various factors such as social and economic losses caused by power loss of the distribution line into the hierarchical analysis model, thereby facilitating calculation and modeling. On the basis of the hierarchical model, the relative order and the total order are calculated by using a level preference order method, so that better operability is achieved.

title_en: Small-scale source load power abnormal data identification and restoration method based on curve clustering
