abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-scale source load power abnormal data identification and restoration method based on curve clustering, which mainly comprises the following steps: 1) Acquiring basic data of a power network; 2) Establishing a source charge power curve; 3) Excluding curves with abnormal mutations; 4) Determining a normal curve cluster and an abnormal curve cluster; 5) Normalization; 6) Determining an optimal initial clustering center candidate set U of a normal source load power curve; 7) Determining an optimal clustering number k for a normal source-to-charge power curve  opt  (ii) a 8) Clustering the normal source load power curve; 9) Determining physical characteristic influence factors of each type of typical periodic source charge power curve; 10 Based on physical characteristic influencing factors, repairing the abnormal periodic source charge power curve. The method takes the daily source load power curve as a basic unit, clusters by considering the trend of the curve to realize the identification of abnormal data, and repairs the abnormal source load power curve data by improving a k-means clustering algorithm.

title_en: Landslide monitoring device for ecological restoration of mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide monitoring device for mine ecological restoration, and belongs to the technical field of monitoring equipment; the device comprises a mounting frame, a first detection mechanism, a second detection mechanism and a signal emission mechanism; the first detection mechanism comprises a collecting cylinder, and a first contact block and two symmetrically arranged water outlet pipes are arranged on the collecting cylinder; the second detection mechanism comprises a detection rod, a contact is fixedly arranged on the detection rod, the detection rod is arranged on a pneumatic assembly, and the pneumatic assembly comprises a contact plate; the signal emission mechanism comprises two signal bullet emission barrels, the signal bullet emission barrels are internally filled with signal bullets, and when the first detection mechanism or the second detection mechanism detects landslide danger, the signal bullet emission barrels emit the signal bullets. According to the invention, the first detection mechanism, the second detection mechanism and the signal emission mechanism are used for automatically monitoring the vicinity of the mine, so that the risk of landslide can be predicted in advance, and the device is simple in structure and convenient to operate.

title_en: Environment diagnosis method and device based on numerical simulation and SVM efficient modeling
abstract_en: The invention relates to an environment diagnosis method and device based on numerical simulation and SVM high-efficiency modeling, belonging to the technical field of soil-groundwater pollution prevention and control and risk management and control, wherein the environment diagnosis method comprises the following steps: the method selects related characteristic variables related to the state of the groundwater environment and the space-time evolution, establishes an environment diagnosis model based on numerical simulation and SVM high-efficiency modeling aiming at a complex groundwater environment system under a typical condition frame, can simply realize reliable diagnosis and prognosis of soil and groundwater environment states, evolution processes and related influences of different application scenes on the premise of meeting a given condition frame, improves the accuracy, the high efficiency and the practicability of evaluation and prognosis of the environment evolution and the risk level of the complex groundwater system, protects the water and soil environment system and utilizes the resources safely, and particularly can provide powerful support for precise prevention and control restoration and high-efficiency risk management and control of soil and groundwater pollution, thereby having important practical value.

title_en: Non-volatile flip-flop with enhanced-scan capability to sustain sudden power failure
abstract_en: Non-volatile flip-flops (NVFFs) based circuitries and schemes that incorporate magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs) are provided to ensure fast data storage and restoration from an intentional or unintentional power outage. The NVFFs based circuitries and schemes also include enhanced scan mode testing capability by exploiting the nonvolatile latch to function as hold latch for delay testing. The NVFFs based circuitries and schemes eliminate additional write drivers, and may operate at an operation frequency of, for example, up to 2 GHz at a supply voltage of 1.1 V and with 0.55 pJ of energy consumption. A near uniform write latency can be achieved through transistor sizing, given write asymmetry of MTJs. NVFFs based circuitries and schemes incorporating data-dependent power gating circuitries can be used to mitigate high static currents generated during retention and back-to-back writing of identical input data.
assignees: GHOSH SWAROOP;IYENGAR ANIRUDH SRIKANT;JANG JAE-WON;UNIV SOUTH FLORIDA

title_en: Shear type steel truss coupling beam with friction damper and capable of being quickly recovered after earthquake
abstract_en: The utility model provides a take friction damper's even roof beam of shearing type steel truss that resumes fast after shake, including chord member, diagonal web member and friction damper. The utility model discloses utilize friction damper power consumption on the basis of ordinary steel truss even roof beam, friction damper includes: the friction main plate, the friction plate, the cover plate and the friction type bolt are arranged on the friction main plate; simple structure and convenient construction. Under a small earthquake, the shear type steel truss connecting beam with the friction damper does not slide, is equivalent to a common steel truss connecting beam, and provides lateral rigidity for the structure; under the condition of middle earthquake, after the skidding load is reached, the friction damper slips, so that the friction energy is consumed, and most of the energy of the earthquake is consumed by the friction damper. The utility model discloses take friction damper's the even roof beam of shearing shaped steel truss that resumes fast after the shake under the earthquake effect, intensity does not take place the degradation, and does not take place to destroy, only needs the friction disc of inspection, change friction damper after the shake, has the advantage that the low, in time use of restoration expense after the shake.

title_en: Remote measuring terminal for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster remote measuring terminal, which comprises a processing module, a wireless communication module, a main sensor, a hot standby sensor and a selection module; the main sensor, the selection module, the processing module and the wireless communication module are sequentially connected, and the hot standby sensor is connected to the selection module. The utility model discloses geological disaster remote sensing terminal through setting up above-mentioned circuit, has realized that the heat of remote sensing terminal is equipped with the design under low cost to switching speed is very fast, can also accomplish the activestandby automatic switch-over after the restoration simultaneously.

title_en: Fast search method for active splitting surfaces for power system on the basis of multilayer graph partitioning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system stability and control. According to the technical scheme allowing for fast search of splitting surfaces, the fast search method for active splitting surfaces in a power system on the basis of multilayer graph partitioning includes the steps of firstly, combining points or edges in an original graph to obtain simplified graphs G0, repeating combination till final simplified graphs Gn include few nodes only; secondly, initially partitioning the simplified graphs Gn to obtain initial splitting surfaces; and thirdly sequentially restoring the simplified graphs Gn into original graph G0, and improving partitioning results by optimization in each step of restoration. According to impact of coarsening upon solution space of system optimal solutions, a coarsening process in the first step is divided into three sub-steps, namely equivalent coarsening, coarsening based on power flow tracing, and coarsening based on weight edge matching. The method is mainly applied to power system stability and control.

title_en: Soil and water conservation device for ecological restoration of stone slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water and soil retaining device for ecological restoration of a stone slope, which comprises a stone slope protection body, wherein the surface of the stone slope protection body is vertically and downwards dredged along the slope of the stone slope protection body from top to bottom and is provided with a plurality of pore canals, anchor rods are arranged in each pore canal, a slope protection net is laid on the surface of the stone slope protection body, a concrete layer is sprayed on the surface layer of the stone slope protection body, a concrete enclosure is poured on the edge of the upper end of the concrete, a plurality of first partition columns and second partition columns are arranged on the inner wall of the concrete enclosure in a crisscross manner, a first soil layer, a straw layer and a second soil layer are laid in each planting frame from bottom to top, reservoir tanks are downwards arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the stone slope protection body, and a cover plate is detachably connected to the opening end of each reservoir tank. The invention not only can strengthen the inside of the stone slope and improve the stability of cairn so as to reduce the risk of landslide, but also can reduce the probability of water and soil loss of the slope in the later ecological restoration so as to achieve the effect of water and soil conservation.

title_en: Method and system for interpolating missing value of reduction current voltage monitoring data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a method and a system for interpolating missing values of reduction current and voltage monitoring data, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining isolated missing values of historical load data in a micro-grid; estimating a target missing value based on a neighboring value of the isolated missing value, carrying out data randomness restoration on the historical load data based on the target missing value by adopting a missing value interpolation network to obtain restored load data, wherein the missing value interpolation network is obtained by combining a particle swarm algorithm and a back propagation neural network, training the missing value interpolation network based on the restored load data to obtain a trained network, and carrying out load prediction on the micro-grid based on the trained network to obtain the load data of the micro-grid. The method can accurately repair the data randomness of the historical load data, and improves the accuracy of load data prediction.
assignees: TIANTAI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Slope reinforcement and restoration device based on pumped storage power station and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope reinforcement and restoration device based on a pumped storage power station and a use method thereof, wherein a plurality of reinforcement and restoration mechanisms are paved on a slope body of the storage power station, four corners of the reinforcement and restoration mechanisms are respectively connected with an anchoring mechanism, the lower ends of the anchoring mechanisms are anchored into the slope body, the reinforcing repair mechanism is internally provided with a water collecting mechanism, the water collecting mechanism is connected with a spraying mechanism, and the risk of landslide caused by softening of soil ponding is reduced by arranging an anchoring mechanism, the water collecting mechanism and the spraying mechanism, and the self-supporting effect of irrigation can be realized through a spraying pipe frame in dry seasons.

title_en: Method, system and equipment for extracting road topology structure of remote sensing image through multitasking cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing image processing, in particular to a method, a system and equipment for extracting a road topological structure of a multi-task collaborative remote sensing image, which comprise the steps of data preparation, model training and road extraction, wherein a multi-task collaborative mechanism is introduced to fuse segmentation tasks with topology modeling tasks, and the process from feature extraction, key point detection and dynamic prompt generation to topology restoration forming end-to-end collaborative optimization is realized, so that unified modeling of road mask segmentation and topology structure reconstruction is realized, the topology connectivity and structural consistency of a road network are obviously improved while high segmentation precision is maintained, and the method has the advantages of clear structure, high calculation efficiency, strong generalization capability and the like, and can be widely applied to the fields of intelligent traffic, urban planning, disaster emergency, map automatic drawing and the like.

title_en: Safety storage method for electromagnetic wave emitting substance such as radiation
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for safely sealing environmental pollutants by radioactivity and surely and stably storing them for long periods, as well as the collection of radioactive materials scattered to environment as known publicly and the restoration of the radiation ray disaster at Fukushima nuclear power plant caused by the earthquake disaster on 11th March is an urgently needed subject.SOLUTION: Waste collected as radioactive waste is safely stored in container cabinets 3, 4, 5, etc. that are treated by radiophylaxis countermeasures, and a storage area is set. This method can ensure the long-term storage of the radioactive waste under an accumulation safety control by techniques such as multi-stage loading technique and a burying technique.

title_en: Switchgear isolation device
title_ko: 수배전반 면진장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a switchgear seismic isolator which forms upper and lower protrusion type uneven surface portions in contact with each other on an upper surface of a bottom member and a lower surface of a center member, moves the upper protrusion type uneven surface portion of the bottom member along a curved surface of the protrusion type uneven surface portion of the center member so that vibration is not transmitted to the center member to prevent a power distribution panel supported in the center member from being shaken by an earthquake so as to have a seismic isolation effect when vibration is transmitted to the bottom member during an earthquake, and elastically supports movement of the bottom member by a restoration spring installed between the bottom member and the center member to automatically restore the bottom member to an initial state, wherein the bottom member is simultaneously inclined to one side while vibration stops.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 바닥부재의 상면 및 센터부재의 하면에 서로 접촉하는 상, 하부 돌출형 굴곡면부를 형성하여, 지진 발생시에 진동이 바닥부재로 전해지면, 바닥부재의 상부 돌출형 굴곡면부가 센터부재의 하부 돌출형 굴곡면부의 굴곡면을 따라 곡면 이동하며 진동의 흔들림이 센터부재로 전해지지 않도록 하여 센터부재에 지지되어 지는 배전반이 지진에 의해 흔들리지 않도록 하여 면진 효과를 가지도록하며, 또한 바닥부재와 센터부재 사이에 설치된 복귀스프링이 바닥부재의 이동을 탄력지지함과 더불어 진동의 멈춤과 동시에 한쪽으로 치우쳐진 바닥부재를 초기상태로 자동 복귀시킬 수 있도록 한 수배전반 면진장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Pressure drop recovery system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pressure drop recovery system. The pressure drop recovery system comprises: the equipment recovery scheduling module is used for providing equipment recovery priority; the risk analysis module is used for evaluating the risk level of the affected product and providing a real-time risk level; the product processing module is used for processing the affected products according to the real-time risk level and interacting with the risk analysis module in real time to update the real-time risk level; and the health degree monitoring module is used for monitoring whether the recovered equipment is normal or not. The voltage drop recovery system can efficiently realize factory production recovery after power failure.

title_en: Constructed wetland system for river-core continent and flood plain
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial wetland system for river-center continents and flood lands, which mainly comprises the following steps that 1) an artificial wetland is arranged into a second-level ladder type, wherein a first-level ladder is an emergent aquatic plant planting area, and a second-level ladder is a irrigation and grass mixed planting area; 2) The outer side of the first-stage ladder of the constructed wetland is provided with a sand setting device; 3) Spraying an erosion-resistant planting substrate layer with the thickness of 3-5cm on the surface of the constructed wetland region; 4) Respectively selecting plants in the emergent aquatic plant planting area and the arbor-shrub mixed planting area according to local climatic environment conditions; 5) Mixing the seeds into the matrix, spraying the mixture on the surface of the matrix layer in the corresponding area, and forming a seed layer with the thickness of 2 cm. The invention effectively solves the problems that the constructed wetland technology is easy to cause sediment accumulation and difficult to preserve plants when applied to the river core continents and the river flood lands, reduces the exposed area of the river core continents and the river flood lands in the dead water period, reduces the wind-blown sand source, prevents sediment accumulation, further expands the river core continents and the river flood lands, and realizes ecological restoration.

title_en: Intelligent protection device for forest breeding in ecological restoration of geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent protection device for wood breeding in ecological restoration of geological disasters, which relates to the technical field of ecological environment management and comprises a multidirectional impact-resistant base, a rotary connecting device, a plurality of anchoring mechanisms, a control adjusting device, a dynamic protection device, an auxiliary adjusting device and a control adjusting device, wherein the multidirectional impact-resistant base is horizontally arranged and fixed in a soil layer, wood seedlings are planted in the middle of the soil layer, the rotary connecting device is fixed at the top of the multidirectional impact-resistant base, the anchoring mechanisms are annularly distributed and provided with a plurality of anchoring mechanisms, the anchoring mechanisms are fixed at the outer side of the rotary connecting device and correspond to the vertexes of the multidirectional impact-resistant base, the control adjusting device is fixed at the top of the rotary connecting device, the dynamic protection device is fixed on the control adjusting device, and the auxiliary adjusting device is movably arranged at the top of the dynamic protection device and is fixedly connected with the control adjusting device through a telescopic arc plate. The intelligent impact-resistant protection device disclosed by the invention realizes intelligent impact-resistant protection under the complex terrain and dynamic geological conditions of the geological disaster area, simultaneously has an ecological restoration function, and remarkably improves the protection effect and ecological benefit of forest breeding in a geological disaster scene.

title_en: Path restoration method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a path restoration method, a path restoration device and a path restoration equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an identification sequence of a vehicle, wherein the identification sequence comprises an identification written by the vehicle through an entrance of a toll station, an identification station or an exit of the toll station in a road network; acquiring a directed graph model of the road network constructed based on the position relation between toll stations and identification stations in the road network; generating a basic pattern of each path between the toll gate entrance and the toll gate exit according to the directed graph model, wherein the basic pattern is a sequence including the identities of the identified stations on the path; according to the matching result of the identification sequence and all the basic patterns, the driving path of the vehicle is selected from the paths respectively associated with all the basic patterns, so that the accuracy and stability of restoring the path by using the identification station are improved, and further, the time cost spent on manually correcting the path is reduced.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS HUARUAN INFORMATION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent well spacing system and method integrating natural gas hydrate exploitation and geological restoration
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent well spacing system integrating natural gas hydrate exploitation and geological restoration, which comprises: a vertical well in which a main gas production line and CO injection are arranged 2 A main pipeline; a horizontal well communicated with the vertical well and divided into a branch pipeline for gas production and a branch pipeline for CO injection 2 Gas recovery well and CO injection for branch pipeline 2 Well, said gas production branch line and CO injection 2 The branch pipeline is respectively connected with the gas production main pipeline and the CO injection main pipeline 2 The main pipeline is communicated; an artificial intelligence slotting robot, the number of which is a plurality, arranged in the CO injection 2 Main pipeline and CO injection 2 In the branch line. The invention also provides an intelligent well distribution method integrating natural gas hydrate exploitation and geological restoration, and the invention divides areasThe block can repair geology quickly and efficiently. The CO2 and the depressurization production pipelines are alternately arranged in a blocking and fixed-distance mode in the multiple horizontal wells, the geology in a small area is efficiently repaired in the blocking and fixed-distance mode, and the possibility of disasters caused by geological damage in the hydrate production process is greatly reduced.

title_en: Task allocation system for disaster recovery and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task allocation system for disaster recovery and a using method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of task allocation systems. A task allocation system for disaster recovery and a using method thereof can collect real-time parameters and real-time states of a data center through alarm modules of each data center, generate corresponding alarms when perceiving disasters, quickly carry out reasonable analysis and disaster recovery sequencing on tasks in the data center affected by the disasters at present, and further provide a more reasonable and optimized task allocation solution through comprehensive analysis on the current conditions of a backup data center. Compared with the traditional method, the method can deeply consider the influence of the global environment factors, effectively enhances the feasibility of the task allocation scheme and optimizes the task disaster recovery performance.
assignees: HLJ E LINK NETWORK CORP LTD

title_en: River course adds medicine aeration integrated device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of black and odorous river channel restoration and environment-friendly equipment, in particular to a river channel dosing and aeration integrated device. The device has simple structure and convenient operation and control, and can realize an automatic medicine feeding system; the problems of poor mass transfer and mixing, narrow jet flow range and low aeration efficiency of a riverway aeration gas-liquid mixed liquid and a non-aerated low-dissolved oxygen water body in the prior art are solved; the river course adds the medicine and relies on the manual work to spray, and the medicament only is the loading surface of water, is difficult to the diffusion, influences the medicament treatment effect, causes the medicament to use extravagantly, increases the medicament cost and still can bring secondary pollution scheduling problem for the water. The device has the advantages that aeration and dosing are combined, and the effect of improving the water quality of the river is enhanced; the spraying effect is good, the application range is wide, the emergency response is fast, the manual operation is not needed, and the automatic operation can be realized.
assignees: SHANGHAI EMPEROR OF CLEANING HI TECH CO LTD

title_en: One-key sequential control-based automatic issuing system for maintenance order associated operation order
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic issuing system of an overhaul order associated operation order based on one-key sequence control, which comprises an overhaul data acquisition unit, an overhaul order forming unit, an operation order monitoring unit, an issuing order scheduling unit and a database server, wherein the overhaul data acquisition unit comprises a data import module, a data coordination module, a data export module and a data storage module and is used for receiving dynamic data from a power grid in real time, coordinating and calling the dynamic data and exporting the data of a main network scheduling and overhaul order. According to the automatic issuing system of the maintenance order association operation tickets based on the one-key sequence control, the continuous automatic issuing and error prevention of the multiple operation tickets are realized based on the one-key sequence control through designing the sequencing and closing sequence adjusting functions of the multiple power-off/power-restoration operation tickets associated in the maintenance order and according to the operation purposes of the multiple operation tickets and the arrangement and combination relation of the operation orders, and the operation and maintenance work of a dispatching desk and a distribution network working site is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU LTD COMPANY

title_en: Power distribution network recovery control method and system with uncertain event adaptability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network recovery control method and system with uncertain event adaptability, wherein the method and system determine the running states of stations and equipment in a target power distribution network according to the acquired running information, and determine power failure scene information; determining whether to start, end or update judgment information for optimizing a restoration scheme of the global power distribution network or a restoration scheme of the local power distribution network, and whether to suspend execution of the restoration scheme of the global power distribution network or the restoration scheme of the local power distribution network; performing operation mode optimization adjustment on a charged area of the target power distribution network, wherein the power supply of the charged area is recovered; performing online global restoration sub-region division on the target power distribution network; and generating a recovery scheme of each online global recovery sub-region, and optimizing the recovery scheme to obtain a final recovery scheme. The advantages are that: and the recovery subareas are adaptively adjusted according to the uncertain events, and the optimization scheme is updated, so that the influence of the uncertain events on the recovery process is reduced, the power supply of the power distribution network is ensured to be recovered rapidly, safely and economically, and recovery benefits are effectively improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method for realizing fee clearing electricity overtime early warning by big data technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing overtime early warning of charge clearing and power restoration by a big data technology, which comprises an information acquisition module connected with a power system and used for acquiring user payment information and searching user specific information, an information processing module which is constructed and used for dividing users into primary, secondary and tertiary power restoration according to power failure time, an external service staff management module which is arranged for managing the states of the external service staff and supporting the external service staff scheduling of the tertiary power restoration requirements, and a scheduling module which is used for predicting the time of the external service staff to reach the scene. In addition, an inspection time prediction module is further arranged, the inspection time is predicted according to the historical power equipment overhaul information, and overhaul reports are generated and sent to the field crews. And the early warning module is used for comprehensively scheduling and checking the time prediction result and sending the duplicate time early warning to the user. The method realizes the efficient and automatic management of the charge clearing current flow, and improves the power service efficiency and the user satisfaction.

title_en: Karst big spring monitoring early warning and repair system based on four pre-treatment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of hydrologic monitoring, in particular to a karst big spring monitoring, early warning and repairing system based on four pre-detection, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module, a groundwater forecasting module, a groundwater early warning module and a groundwater planning module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring karst big spring groundwater data; the underground water prediction module is used for constructing an underground water prediction model to perform three-dimensional dynamic prediction, water level trend analysis and visual display, the underground water prediction module is used for establishing a spring field simulation engine adapting to karst big springs, supporting different spring protection measures and simulating artificial supply effects, the underground water early warning module is used for constructing a karst big spring current breaking early warning model to judge the current breaking risk level, and the underground water early warning module is used for outputting an ecological restoration scheme adapting to the mode. Therefore, the problems of lack of three-dimensional dynamic and visual performance, single early warning index, early warning and repairing dislocation and the like are solved.
assignees: NO 9 GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE OF HEBEI PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL EXPLOR AND DEVELOPMENT;XINGTAI GEOLOGICAL AND MINERAL GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIG INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network operation risk prompting method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network operation risk prompting method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of performing image restoration on a detected power distribution network operation image to obtain a restoration image; the method comprises the steps of constructing a data pair of a repair image and text description to form a training set, carrying out pre-training quantization treatment on a pre-trained multi-modal large language model by utilizing an AWQ algorithm to obtain a quantized multi-modal large language model, carrying out fine tuning training on the quantized multi-modal large language model in a Lora fine tuning mode to obtain and utilize the adjusted model to carry out power distribution network operation risk prompt. The method and the system solve the technical problems that the accuracy of predicting the operation risk of the power distribution network is not high and the risk prompt cannot be effectively carried out due to the fact that the data types are multiple in the operation process of the power distribution network.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ANHUI

title_en: Big data-based artificial intelligent power grid regulation and control operation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence power grid regulation and control operation method and system based on big data, the system comprises a main control module, and a bill acquisition unit, a machine language understanding unit, an equipment object matching unit, a sorting binding result library, a sorting binding rule library, a network topology analysis unit, a graph-model integrated introduction unit, a feature extraction unit and a safety check unit which are respectively connected with the main control module, wherein the output end of the bill acquisition unit is sequentially connected with the machine language understanding unit, the equipment object matching unit, the sorting binding result library and the sorting binding rule library, and matching association is carried out on historical comprehensive power failure application tickets and historical scheduling operation tickets to form historical sorting binding result information, and the equipment object sorting binding rule library is established. According to the invention, intelligent functions such as automatic generation and simulation of the equipment power restoration dispatching operation ticket are realized, the intelligent level of power grid regulation operation is improved, the working pressure of a regulator is greatly reduced, and the safe and stable operation level and the working efficiency of a power grid are improved.

title_en: Method for rapidly cultivating mature sporophytes from dicranopteris pedata protophylls
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly cultivating a dicranopteris pedunculata protoleaf into mature sporophytes, which takes a dicranopteris pedunculata protoleaf material as a breeding base material, adopts a mode of combining tissue culture and facility cultivation in the cultivation process, and is divided into 4 processes, namely, the development and the germination of the protoleaf, the development and the maturation of the protoleaf, the promotion of the artificial environment of the development of the protoleaf into the juvenile sporophytes and the promotion of the facility cultivation into the mature sporophytes. The invention utilizes the tissue culture induction technology and facility cultivation, can obtain a large number of dicranopteris pedata seedlings which have strong stress resistance and can be directly planted in difficult places such as mines and the like in a short time, is not influenced by seasonal climate change and natural disasters, and provides technical support for industrial seedling culture and clone culture of the dicranopteris pedata. The invention shortens the cultivation time of the dicranopteris pedata plants, saves the seedling raising cost of the dicranopteris pedata, and can provide plant planting materials for ecological restoration of difficult sites such as mines, slopes, tailing waste sites, strong acid soil and the like.

title_en: Fault reasoning analysis method and system based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault reasoning analysis method and system based on a large language model, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a multi-source operation and maintenance data set of a system to be diagnosed, comprising a structural performance index, a semi-structural service log and unstructured text description data, then carrying out semantic enhancement on the multi-source operation and maintenance data set to obtain semantic data units containing entity, relation and attribute semantic labels, constructing a semantic association network based on the semantic data units, calling a pre-training large language model to carry out root cause reasoning analysis on the network, generating a candidate root cause set ordered according to confidence, generating an operation and maintenance decision instruction containing entity operation sequences and priority orders according to the candidate root cause set, and sending the operation and maintenance decision instruction to a system management terminal to trigger an automatic restoration process, thereby improving the operation and maintenance efficiency and reliability of the system.

title_en: System and method for providing power distribution system information
abstract_en: A system, method and computer program product for processing utility data of a power grid is provided. In one embodiment, the system includes a datamart comprised of a plurality of physical databases storing utility data, a plurality of applications comprising an automated meter application configured to process power usage data from a plurality of automated meters, a power outage application configured to identify a location of a power outage, and a power restoration application configured to identify a location of a power restoration. The system may include an analysis engine comprising a plurality of analysis objects with each analysis object configured to process data to provide a specific analysis, wherein said analysis engine is accessible via one or more of the plurality of applications, and the system may include a report module configured to receive an output from the analysis engine and to output a report. The plurality of applications may also include a fault analysis application, a transformer analysis application, a theft detection application, a power flow application, a substation automation application, a load shed application and others.
assignees: KREISS DAVID G;BRANCACCIO DANIEL S;CURRENT COMM SERVICES LLC

title_en: Based on cloud calamity for the processing method and system of data backup restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses the processing methods and system based on cloud calamity for data backup restoration, and when the Backup Data in local backup server changes, the data having backed up are downloaded to local backup server by the interface routine provided using cloud platform server；By the reading data folding of local backup server, the record information of cloud platform server and local backup server is compared, triggering merges queue, changed data set is merged, the data after merging are transferred to cloud platform server again；When the wherein playscript with stage directions disaster occurs for backup server, by another playscript with stage directions backup server connects cloud platform server, and the data backed up in its cloud platform server are restored in local backup server, and is continued to run in the local backup server.The invention has the advantages that: can effectively realize data from this geological disaster public cloud to the utmost, management and space utilization rate of the raising cloud platform server to Backup Data.

title_en: Thermal stratification type reservoir scheduling optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal stratification type reservoir dispatching optimization method, which comprises the following steps: collecting water quality data during thermal stratification of a reservoir, analyzing change characteristics of a dissolved oxygen stratification structure during thermal stratification, extracting control factors of the change characteristics of the dissolved oxygen during thermal stratification of the reservoir, establishing a three-dimensional hydrodynamic-water quality model of the reservoir, checking the model by adopting monitoring data, simulating thermal stratification hypoxia time under different water levels, scheduling operation modes and pumped storage scheduling working conditions by utilizing a control equation, and establishing a scheduling scheme of the reservoir according to distribution of the hypoxia time. The scheme can truly simulate the influence factors of the dissolved oxygen of the reservoir, can accurately provide a scheduling scheme for optimizing the dissolved oxygen, provides a countermeasure for improving the dissolved oxygen of the temperature-stagnation layer of the reservoir, provides effective scientific guidance for the protection and restoration of the water environment of the thermal stratification reservoir, and has good prevention and control effects on the oxygen deficiency of the temperature-stagnation layer of the reservoir.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;HEILONGJIANG PROVINCE INVESTIGATION DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE OF WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER

title_en: Method for predicting power restoration time of post-disaster power grid by considering toughness of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting the power restoration time of a post-disaster power grid by considering the toughness of a power distribution network, which comprises the following steps of: step S1: acquiring power grid data information of a power distribution network; step S2, according to the power grid data information, introducing a power distribution network toughness index described by the integration of the weighted loss load of the power distribution network and a time axis under natural disasters, and constructing a power distribution network function curve model; s3, acquiring related parameters of the natural disaster, and establishing a natural disaster model according to the related parameters of the natural disaster; s4, constructing a basic calculation model of the post-disaster power grid power restoration total time considering the toughness of the power distribution network; step S5, correcting a basic calculation model of the post-disaster power grid power restoration total time considering the toughness of the power distribution network to obtain an accurate calculation model of the power distribution network fault treatment total time; and step S6, acquiring power grid data information of the post-disaster power distribution network, and acquiring the power restoration time of the post-disaster power distribution network based on an accurate calculation model of the total time of power distribution network fault processing. The method can quickly acquire the power restoration time of the power grid after disaster, has high precision and can effectively improve the reliability of the power distribution network.
assignees: FUJIAN YONGFU POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Assembled viscoelastic damping device and concrete frame node of restoration reinforcing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an assembled viscoelastic damping device and a concrete frame node for repairing and enhancing, which comprise an assembled viscoelastic damping device, a viscoelastic damping block and a connecting piece unit; the assembly type viscoelastic damping devices are symmetrically arranged around the earthquake damage concrete frame node, and adjacent assembly type viscoelastic damping units are assembled and connected by adopting connecting piece units to form a closed integral damping system; the assembled viscoelastic damping device comprises two arc-shaped middle steel plates, viscoelastic material blocks, constraint steel plates and connecting steel plates, wherein the middle steel plates, the viscoelastic material blocks and the outer constraint steel plates are connected in an assembled mode through the combination of pretightening force and powerful adhesion exerted by a plurality of pretightening bolts.

title_en: Business influence analysis method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of information security, and provides a business impact analysis method, a business impact analysis device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: analyzing interruption influence of various services to determine disaster recovery priorities of the various services; determining the incidence relation between various services and an information system; determining disaster recovery priorities of information systems of different levels according to disaster recovery priorities of various services and incidence relations between various services and the information systems; determining disaster recovery indexes of various services according to disaster recovery priorities of the various services; and determining the disaster recovery indexes of the corresponding information system according to the disaster recovery indexes of various services. The method and the system determine the disaster recovery target of the information system through the incidence relation between the service and the information system, can confirm the importance of the information system, and implement the service influence analysis on the information system supporting the service operation, thereby providing an important basis for the construction of a disaster recovery and service continuity management system.

title_en: Bus journey time prediction method based on space-time diagram attention network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bus journey time prediction method based on a space-time diagram attention network, which comprises the steps of preprocessing bus arrival time data, including bus number definition, repeated record deletion, abnormal record deletion and missing record restoration, calculating interval journey time of each bus number based on the bus arrival time data to obtain average journey time of different time periods of each interval, constructing a directed network by taking the middle point of a station interval as a node of the network and taking a connecting line between the middle points of the station interval as a network edge, fusing a distance matrix and a communication matrix of the nodes to represent space characteristics between the nodes to weight the station interval network, constructing the space-time diagram attention network by taking the historical average journey time of the station interval and the journey time of the latest bus number as inputs, adopting a transfomrer encoder, a graph attention network and a full-connection layer, extracting and fusing time characteristics and space characteristics, and realizing multi-step prediction of the station interval journey time.

title_en: Forest fire monitoring system based on satellite remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire monitoring system based on satellite remote sensing, in particular to the field of forest fire monitoring, which is used for solving the problems of incomplete data coverage, inaccurate boundary identification, difficult restoration of a shielding area and the like in the forest fire monitoring process. The spectrum and vegetation dynamic change before and after the fire are continuously tracked, and continuous basic data is provided for evaluating the fire influence. The analysis of spectrum extremely poor and thermal signal propagation is combined, so that the fine recognition capability of a fire disaster high-temperature area and an edge area is enhanced, and particularly, the boundary recognition of a low disturbance area is effectively optimized. The space-time reconstruction and interpolation algorithm is adopted to comprehensively recover the data loss caused by the shielding of smoke and cloud, so that the integrity and continuity of the image are ensured, and the precision of disaster assessment and decision support is improved.
assignees: LINGBAO HUAXIANG WIND POWER DEV CO LTD;HENAN BRANCH OF CHINA THREE GORGES RENEWABLES GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power system recovery method and system considering social function and load starting characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system recovery method and system considering social functions and load starting characteristics, and belongs to the technical field of power system power supply recovery. The method comprises the steps of solving a power supply restoration importance parameter according to absolute power failure duration, solving a correction coefficient of the power supply restoration importance parameter which takes into account social functions, correcting the power supply restoration importance parameter by using the correction coefficient of the power supply restoration importance parameter which takes into account social functions to obtain the power supply restoration importance of a user, solving the node power supply restoration importance which takes into account the topology connection correction coefficient, generating a strategy for restoring power supply according to the node power supply restoration importance which takes into account the topology connection correction coefficient, and realizing the restoration of a power system which takes into account social functions and load starting characteristics. The invention improves the accuracy of resource allocation and reduces the extra economic loss in the power supply recovery process.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Digital twinning lamp landscape digital restoration data analysis system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of numbers Li Sheng, in particular to a festival lantern landscape digital restoration data analysis system and method based on numbers Li Sheng, which are used for analyzing festival lantern ornamental dangerous conditions through connection structure conditions of all positions of the festival lantern and ornamental traffic conditions of all positions, predicting the abnormal operation of the festival lantern through the connection of the operation conditions of the festival lantern and the connection structure conditions, the application realizes the advanced prediction of the stability of the festival lamp and the abnormal fire disaster by a chain of 'data quantification risk-accurate decision-dynamic regulation', and improves the real-time performance of the hazard maintenance of the festival lamp.
assignees: CAPITAL UNIV OF ECONOMICS AND BUSINESS

title_en: Piping device for restoring inclination of building
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide piping for infusion beforehand, so that fluid such as cement milk is infused into the bottom of a mat foundation whose pressure lifts a building for restoration when the building sinks and tilts by the influence of an earthquake, ground water, and its own weight.  <P>SOLUTION: A plurality of pipes (2) are planned and provided beforehand on the bottom of the mat foundation (1) of the building, and infusion passages of the fluid (3) are prepared and secured. When the building sinks and tilts later, the fluid (3) such as the cement milk is pressure-injected through the pipes (2). Then the building is elevated by an amount corresponding to the sinking by the pressure. In this manner, piping fixtures are attached and placed so that the subsidence and tilt of the building can be easily restored.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Device and method for supporting facility operation, and program
abstract_en: To accomplish task implementation, such as plan creation for a facility, more accurately in line with actual conditions.SOLUTION: A power network restoration plan support device 10 for supporting operation of a power network 2 comprises: a UI part 15 for receiving sensor data 111 regarding operation of the power network 2; a data evaluation part 132 for calculating a degree of certainty of the sensor data 111 which is defined by a combination of a plurality of factors in acquiring the sensor data 111 and indicates certainty of the operation data; a data regeneration part 133 for regenerating the sensor data 111 according to the degree of certainty; and a data storage part for storing the operation data and the degree of certainty of the operation data in association with each other in a storage part. The facility operation support device implements creation of an operation plan of a facility by using the operation data stored in the storage part, in accordance with the degree of certainty stored in the storage part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Traveling non-contact power supply system
abstract_en: To enable a user to confirm a remaining use time and a drivable distance till power outage of a vehicle with a user riding.SOLUTION: A traveling non-contact power supply system for supply power from a roadside power supply device to a traveling vehicle with a vehicle side power reception device in a non-contact manner, includes a server that can communicate information with the vehicle, and the server acquires a power consumption state and a power remaining amount in the vehicle from the vehicle if power failure occurs, and predicts a restoration time from the power failure and a power supply amount in a route of the restored vehicle, transmits a prediction time till restoration to the vehicle by a wide area communication, and the vehicle predicts an occurrence of power outrage, and outputs a remaining use time or a drivable distance of the vehicle on the basis of the received prediction time.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: The device of multiple using a cold and warmth mattress not to use electricity
title_ko: 전기를 사용하지 않는 냉온겸용 매트리스 장치
abstract_en: A combined cooling and heating mattress device without using electricity does not use an electric heating coil to make it not necessary to pay electric charges due to the consumption of electricity, prevent an electromagnetic wave from being generated, and remove a fire risk due to overheating of the mattress device. A combined cooling and heating mattress device without using electricity comprises: a foldable device body which is divided into a head part(1-a), a back part(1-b), and a leg part(1-c); storage spaces(3,3-1) for the cold and hot water containers, which are formed in the back part and leg part of the device body, and in which the cold and hot water containers are stored; covers(2,2-1) covering the storage spaces for the cold and hot water containers; magic tapes(4,4-1) adhered onto edge portions of the covers to fix the covers to the back part and leg part of the device body; magic tapes(5,5-1) adhered onto the back part and leg part of the device body correspondingly to the magic tapes adhered onto the covers; sewing lines(6,6-1) formed on the device body to fold the device body in three stages; cold and hot water containers(7,7-1); lids(7-a,7-a-1) of the cold and hot water containers; double anti-frost cases(8,8-1) for summertime; and restoration sponges(9,9-1) filling the storage spaces when the cold and hot water containers are not used.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전기를 사용하지 않는 냉온겸용 매트리스 장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 온수나 얼음 등을 이용하여 온열 또는 냉기 매트리스를 계절에 관계없이 사용할 수 있도록 하는 전기를 사용하지 않는 냉온겸용 매트리스 장치에 관한 것이다. 
     상기의 문제를 해결하기 위해 본 발명은 첫째, 전기를 사용하지 않아 전기료가 발생 되지 않게 하고 둘째, 전기 발열코일을 사용하지 않아 전자파의 발생 소지가 없고 셋째, 전기 발열코일을 사용하지 않아 화재의 위험성을 근본적으로 없애고 넷째, 온수 코일이나 모터장치를 사용하지 않아 소음이나 고장의 소지를 없애고 다섯째, 계절에 관계없이 냉온겸용으로 사용 할 수 있게 하고 여섯째, 실외나 야외에서도 사용할 수 있게 하며 일곱째, 사용 후 남은 냉 온열을 이용하여 타 용도로 전이하여 사용할 수 있는 전기를 사용하지 않는 냉온겸용 매트리스 장치를 제공하고자 하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
     상기의 목적을 달성하기 위해 본 발명은, 전기를 사용하지 않고 고온을 유지하기 위하여서는 제공된 냉온수통에 온수를 채워 매트리스 특정 부분을 제외한 공간에 삽입한 후 덮개를 덮고 온열 매트리스로 사용하는 단계, 상기 단계 후 제공된 냉온수통의 온수를 익일 아침 세면 또는 샤워를 하는 단계, 전기를 사용하지 않고 냉기를 유지하기 위하여서는 제공된 냉온수통에 냉수나 음료수를 채워 얼리거나 드라이아이스를 채워 매트리스 특정 부분을 제외한 나머지 부분의 공간에 삽입한 후  덮개를 덮고 냉기 매트리스로 사용하는 단계, 상기 단계 후 제공된 냉온수통의 얼음이 반쯤 녹았을 때 냉수나 냉 음료수를 음용하고, 남은 얼음을 이용하여 다른 탄산음료, 주스, 주류 등을 부어 차게 한 후 음용하는 단계, 상기 단계를 이용할 시 제공된 냉온수통의 외부 표면에 성애가 생겨 매트리스 특정 부분을 제외한 나머지 부분인 냉온수통이 들어가는 부분에 습기가 머금지 못하도록 조처하는 성애 방지용 이중 케이스를 사용하는 단계로 이루어진 것에 특징이 있다. 
     상기의 특징으로 하여 본 발명은, 전기를 사용하지 않아 전기료가 발생되지 않고, 전자파의 발생 소지가 없고, 화재의 위험성이 근본적으로 없으며, 온수코일이나 모터 등의 장치를 사용하지 않아 제작비가 저렴하고 고장의 여지없이 반영구적으로 사용할 수 있고, 계절에 관계없이 냉온겸용으로 사용할 수 있고, 실내외 및 야외에서 모두 사용 할 수 있고, 사용 후 남은 냉 온열을 이용하여 타 용도로 전이하여 사용 할 수 있어 에너지를 거의 버림 없이 고 효율적으로 사용할 수 있게 하는 효과가 있는 전기를 사용하지 않는 냉온겸용 매트리스 장치이다.

title_en: Dry preaction valve
title_ko: 건식 프리액션 밸브
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a preaction valve, which remarkably removes possibility of freeze due to a leakage and enables a user who has expertise to perform a test drive and restoration, wherein the construction of the preaction valve is convenient as necessity of a setting pipe is removed. According to the present invention, the dry type preaction valve comprises: a valve main body (10); a connection unit (101) maintaining a primary water pressure by being connected to a primary side; an opening and closing unit (11) opening and closing the connection unit (101) and an outlet (102); a diaphragm unit (12) controlling the opening and closing unit (11) when a fire breaks out; a guide unit (13) guiding the water pressure to maintain the water pressure of the diaphragm unit (12) in an ordinary day; and an alarm unit (14) operating an emergency signal by the water pressure when the fire breaks out. The guide unit (13) includes: a first flow path (130) formed by passing through from an inner wall of the connection unit (101) to an outer wall of the valve main body (10); a second flow path (136) formed to pass from the outer wall of the valve main body (10) to the inner wall of the valve main body (10) and a compartment of the diaphragm unit (12); and a first cock (134). The alarm unit (14) includes: a third flow path (140) passing from the inner wall of the connection unit (101) to the outer wall of the valve main body (10); a fourth flow path (146) passing from the outer wall of the valve main body (10) to the outer wall and the inner wall of the valve main body (10); a second cock (144) installed between the third flow path (140) and the fourth flow path (146); and a sensing valve (148) installed at an end of the second flow path (146).
abstract_ko: 세팅 배관의 필요성을 제거하여 시공이 편리하고 전문지식이 없는 사용자도 시운전 및 복구가 가능하며 누설에 의한 동파 가능성을 획기적으로 제거한 프리액션 밸브가 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 건식 프리액션 밸브는 밸브본체(10)와, 1차측과 연통되어 1차측 수압을 유지하는 연통부(101)와, 상기 연통부(101)와 배출구(102)를 개폐시키는 개폐부(11)와, 화재 발생시 상기 개폐부(11)를 제어하는 다이어프렘부(12)와, 평상시 상기 다이어프렘부(12)의 수압을 유지하도록 수압을 안내하는 안내부(13), 및 화재 발생시 수압에 의하여 비상신호가 작동되는 알람부(14)로 구성되는 소방용 건식 프리액션 밸브로서, 안내부(13)는 상기 연통부(101)의 내벽으로부터 밸브본체(10)의 외벽까지 관통하여 형성되는 제1 유로(130)와, 밸브본체(10)의 외벽으로부터 밸브본체(10)의 내벽 및 다이어프렘부(12)의 격실까지 관통하여 형성되는 제2 유로(136)와, 제1 코크(134)를 포함하고, 알람부(14)는 상기 연통부(101)의 내벽으로부터 밸브본체(10)의 외벽까지 관통하여 형성되는 제3 유로(140)와,  밸브본체(10)의 외벽으로부터 밸브본체(10)의 외벽 및 내벽까지 관통하여 형성되는 제4 유로(146)와, 제3 유로(140)와 제4 유로(146) 사이에 구비되는 제2 코크(144)와, 제2 유로(146)의 단부에 설치되는 감지밸브(148)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: T G FIRE CO LTD;KWON SEUNG HEON

title_en: Automation system for disaster damage investigation
title_ko: 고해상도 위성영상을 활용한 재난피해조사 자동화시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic disaster damage investigating system using a high-resolution satellite image, which comprises: a database (120) including a GIS DB (105), an image DB (110), and a damage DB (115); an automatic damage investigating system main body (125) of a system interface; and an automatic damage investigating module (130) of a typhoon or heavy snow for each natural disaster.

title_en: Accelerated recovery after a data disaster
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present invention, a metadata file is transferred from the first system to the second system and a database on the second system is initialized based on the metadata file. An image, including information of the first system to be restored, is transferred from the first system to the second system, and restoration of the information to the second system based on the image is initiated. Prior to completion of the restoration, one or more log files indicating actions performed on the first system relating to the information to be restored is transferred from the first system to the initialized database on the second system. In response to completion of the restoration, the actions of the log files are performed to synchronize the restored data on the second system with the first system.

title_en: Power distribution network fault assessment and scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating and scheduling power distribution network faults, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing and obtaining a city digital distribution network topological map based on a geographic information system and distribution network construction information; positioning fault point distribution information based on distribution network terminal monitoring data and marketing data; planning a routing inspection path; the unmanned aerial vehicle group shoots images of the routing inspection path and fault points; inputting the shot image into a pre-trained convolutional neural network, and evaluating the disaster situation and the traffic situation to obtain an evaluation result; constructing and obtaining an optimal scheduling model according to a preset strategy; solving the optimal scheduling model by using a simulated annealing algorithm to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme; and implementing scheduling according to the optimal scheduling scheme. The method and the system can quickly locate the fault point and evaluate the disaster situation after the extreme meteorological event occurs, and provide an optimal emergency repair scheduling scheme and an emergency repair progress monitoring function.

title_en: Active power failure early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power failure active early warning method and device based on a Kafka message queue, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a plurality of terminal devices monitor power outage and restoration real-time messages at different nodes of a power grid and issue the power outage and restoration real-time messages to a Kafka cluster; the Kafka cluster server receives the power-off and power-on real-time message and pushes the power-off and power-on real-time message to a consumer subscribing the power-off and power-on real-time message; the dispatching automation platform subscribes to the power outage real-time message, generates an early warning power outage event and a power outage event according to the power outage real-time message, matches the early warning power outage event and the power outage event with the power outage event in the current power outage market, and if the matching is successful, combines the early warning power outage event with the matched power outage event to update the current power outage market; or deleting the power failure event corresponding to the power restoration event to update the current power failure bazaar, generating power restoration notification information, and sending the power restoration notification information to the mobile terminal of the corresponding power utilization client. According to the invention, the electricity consumption experience of the user can be improved.

title_en: Construction method of integral repairing structure of landslide of riverside road
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction method of an integral restoration structure of a landslide of a river-facing road, which is characterized in that a stable grouting pipe and a grouting stabilizing body are adopted to stabilize a loose soil body at the lower part of an embankment, and a reinforcing rib net and an oblique supporting rib are adopted to stabilize a soil body at the upper part of the embankment; the prefabricated bottom support body comprises a foundation anchor pier, a pier top connecting plate and a plate top connecting groove; conical anti-seepage holes are arranged on the plate surfaces of the bottom baffle and the middle baffle, and a loose backfill body and a light backfill body are sequentially arranged on the back side of the wall from bottom to top; synchronously performing hydraulic compaction and surface vibration compaction on the loose backfill body by adopting a combined compact body; a reinforcing tie bar is arranged between the tie bar anchor plate and the soil body of the embankment, and the periphery of the reinforcing tie bar is pressed with slurry to form an anti-pulling grouting falcon; the movable sliding grooves in the green planting groove and the top baffle are connected through connecting sliding falcon, and the floating support connecting groove is pasted on the periphery of the green planting groove. The invention can not only improve the bearing performance of the waterside embankment, but also reduce the difficulty of embankment greening.

title_en: Rice field water purifying agent with sludge as matrix and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a rice field water purifying agent with sludge as a matrix and relates to the technical field of sewage treatment. The water purifying agent is prepared from 500-650 parts of sludge, 50-150 parts of quick lime, 50-150 parts of montmorillonite powder, 20-50 parts of crystal powder and 20-35 parts of sodium hydrogen phosphite. The water purifying agent has the advantages that the characteristics of fast adhesion settling of the sludge and the sludge containing rich plant auxin are adopted and combined with the quick lime for sterilization and deodorization, sodium hydrogen phosphite is used for activating lime ions, the sterilizing effect of the lime can be better, pesticide residues in the sludge can be removed, by the cooperation with the montmorillonite powder and the crystal powder, total suspended solids in water in a rice field can be eliminated thoroughly, a fertilizer mixture mixed and dissolved in the water can be wrapped to deposit on the water bottom, when it rains, the fertilizer mixture can not run off along with rainwater, nutrients of the sludge can support growth of rice seedlings, and the quick lime in the composition has an inhibition effect of rice blast. The water purifying agent is used in the dry field, can preserve moisture, resist disasters and improve soil, and plays important roles in sludge return to the field, sludge water purification and country ecology scene protection and restoration.
assignees: ANHUI RUIYU ENV PURIFICATION CREATIVE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dispatching operation robot device for automatically commanding power equipment to stop and recover power
abstract_en: The application discloses automatic command power equipment stops dispatch operation robot device of reply electricity includes: the checking module, the operation ticket compiling module and the operation ticket executing module; the checking module is used for checking power failure notice and a section to be controlled, or checking five necessary checks, namely one confirmation and equipment state double checks; the operation ticket compiling module is used for compiling operation tickets after the checking is passed, and sending the operation tickets to a dispatcher for auditing, wherein the operation tickets comprise power failure tickets and power restoration tickets; the operation ticket execution module is used for executing the operation tickets which pass the auditing, and solves the technical problems that the overhauling process of the existing power grid operation management system is very complicated, and particularly in the dispatching operation signing link, a large amount of confirmation and verification operations of a dispatcher are needed, so that the dispatching operation efficiency and the power grid operation safety are influenced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: First-aid repair full-flow method based on gridding distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a first-aid repair full-flow method based on gridding distribution, which comprises the following steps of: after the system receives the work order, the address of the fault position in the work order is analyzed, the analyzed longitude and latitude coordinates are led into a grid model which is constructed in advance, and the work order is distributed to a unit grid where the longitude and latitude coordinates are located; and generating an emergency repair scheme according to the fault position and the fault content of the work order, and selecting service personnel in the unit grid to execute the emergency repair scheme. The substantial effects of the invention include: the mode of gridding distribution is adopted to realize the automatic distribution of the work orders, the distribution is more accurate and faster, the first-aid repair efficiency is improved, and the first-aid repair power restoration time is shortened.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HANGZHOU CITY HANGZHOU AREA POWER SUPPLY LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID;HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF ZHEJIANG PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID

title_en: Electric power system missing data repairing method based on improved space-time generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system missing data repairing method based on an improved space-time generation countermeasure network, which comprises the steps of generating measurement data by using a generator based on an improved TCAN network; inputting the generated and real data into a discriminator for discrimination; training the generator and the discriminator based on the loss function; and fixing the parameters of the generator and the discriminator, and generating reconstruction data according to the reconstruction loss to realize data restoration. The invention uses the improved TCAN to replace the CNN in the DCGAN, better extracts the time sequence characteristics in the time sequence data, can calculate in parallel, and has high calculation speed and good effect; and replacing a self-attention mechanism in the TCAN with a GAU attention unit to effectively extract data space features. The method can effectively extract the time-space characteristics of the data, quickly and accurately repair the data on the basis of the missing measurement data, and improve the reliability and observability of the power system.

title_en: Power restoration method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a power restoration method, a power restoration device, a computer device, a storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: determining a target fault type to which the power supply equipment causing power failure belongs according to fault information and state information corresponding to the power supply equipment causing power failure; searching a target operation ticket corresponding to the target fault type from a first mapping relation, wherein the first mapping relation is used for indicating a one-to-one correspondence relation between a plurality of fault types and a plurality of operation tickets; sequentially executing corresponding operation tasks according to the operation numbers contained in the target operation ticket, and obtaining the execution duration and the execution result of each operation task; for each operation task, determining the completion degree of the current operation task based on the execution duration and the execution result of the current operation task; and executing power supply recovery operation according to the target fault type and the completion degree of each operation task. By adopting the method, the power supply recovery efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Intelligent data protection method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster recovery processing of electric digital data, in particular to an intelligent data protection method and system, which are characterized in that the predicted access frequency of each target data is firstly predicted through data attribute and access frequency records, then the recovery priority of each target data is obtained by further combining comprehensive consideration of the predicted access frequency, the preset priority and the data quantity, and then the data in a cache data center is updated by utilizing the recovery priority of the target data, so that the latest and most important data can be dynamically cached in the cache data center. Therefore, by utilizing the characteristic that the data recovery speed of the cache data center is higher than that of the disaster recovery backup data center, important data can be recovered in priority through the cache data center rapidly when a disaster occurs, so that basic or hot business functions can be recovered rapidly, loss caused to enterprises is reduced, and the problem that the business functions cannot be recovered rapidly due to low data recovery speed in the prior art is solved perfectly.
assignees: SHENZHEN FEICHUANGYUN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power network asset attack surface restoration method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for repairing an attack surface of an electric power network asset, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of determining an asset attack surface according to asset data, constructing an attack surface model according to the asset attack surface and the asset data, formulating an attack surface management strategy according to the attack surface model, and repairing the attack surface model according to the attack surface management strategy. According to the method, an attack surface model is constructed according to the asset attack surface, and the attack surface model is repaired according to an attack surface management strategy generated by the attack surface model, so that the probability of each electric asset being attacked in various activities can be reduced while the accurate defense of each electric asset in the attack surface model against attacks can be improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for accurately selecting heavy metal pollution farmland restoration measures based on rhizosphere evaluation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological environment protection, and discloses a method for accurately selecting heavy metal polluted farmland restoration measures based on rhizosphere evaluation. The method for accurately selecting heavy metal polluted farmland restoration measures based on rhizosphere evaluation comprehensively considers the heavy metal pollution conditions in soil and agricultural products and the heavy metal pollution level of soil microorganisms under heavy metal stress, comprehensively evaluates the heavy metal pollution level of farmland, combines the pH of the soil and the heavy metal content condition in irrigation water, selects proper soil restoration measures, can accurately restore heavy metal polluted farmland, reduces heavy metal content and ensures the quality of agricultural products, compared with large-scale soil restoration, can carry out partition restoration on farmland through accurate evaluation, improves restoration effect, reduces restoration cost, basically does not influence normal production of farmers, and realizes restoration-side production.

title_en: Quantification method and system for planning toughness improvement contribution before disaster of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantification method and a quantification system for planning toughness improvement contribution before power distribution network disaster, which belong to the technical field of analysis of toughness improvement effectiveness of power distribution network, and the method comprises the steps of generating various disaster scenes through Latin hypercube sampling, and generating a pre-disaster reinforcement scheme of reinforcement grade based on topological structures of the power distribution network and a traffic network; the method comprises the steps of calculating fault probabilities of electric lines and traffic roads under different scenes according to disaster scene parameters to generate a fault state set, optimizing a repair team path and a repair time sequence through a post-disaster repair scheduling model, calculating post-disaster accumulated disaster damage cost, inputting data into XGBoost for training, and analyzing toughness contribution of each reinforcement action by using a SHAP method according to reinforcement planning conditions and full link cost. The method can accurately identify the reinforcement priority of the key lines in the power distribution network and the traffic network, improves the fineness and the interpretability of the pre-disaster resource allocation, can guide the accurate release of limited pre-disaster resources, and has practicability and popularization significance.

title_en: Multi-mode power data restoration method for local-global association learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-mode power data restoration method for local-global association learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining initial data and preprocessing, obtaining abnormal values of power data, wherein the initial data comprises power operation data, external association data and multi-mode data, carrying out local association learning based on the preprocessed power operation data and the abnormal values of the power data, mining local data association, obtaining a local restoration scheme of the abnormal values of the power data, carrying out global association learning based on the preprocessed initial data and the abnormal values of the power data, mining global association rules of time and source, obtaining a reasonable correction range of the abnormal values of the power data, and generating a power operation data restoration result by combining the local restoration scheme and the reasonable correction range. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can accurately identify the abnormality of the repair data and greatly improve the accuracy of data repair.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: BIM data disaster recovery and restoration method based on domestic cloud computing platform
