abstract_en: The invention relates to the crossing field of Building Information Model (BIM) technology and cloud computing technology, in particular to a BIM data disaster recovery and recovery method and system based on a domestic cloud computing platform, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition layer, a data preprocessing layer, a data storage layer, a disaster recovery management layer, a recovery execution layer and a user interaction layer which are cooperated; the data acquisition layer acquires project data from BIM software in real time, the data preprocessing layer performs necessary preprocessing operation on the acquired BIM data, the data storage layer is constructed based on a domestic cloud computing platform and provides efficient and reliable data storage service, the disaster recovery management layer is responsible for formulating and executing a data disaster recovery strategy, the recovery execution layer is responsible for quickly recovering the BIM data when needed, and the user interaction layer provides a friendly operation interface.

title_en: Dual-channel service recovery method based on link life cycle in elastic optical network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dual-channel service recovery method based on a link life cycle in an elastic optical network, belonging to the technical field of communication networks. Aiming at the damage and influence of large-scale natural disasters on the elastic optical network, the method fully utilizes the limited life cycle of a post-disaster link and adopts a dual-path strategy to carry out routing and bandwidth recovery on the interrupted service connection with limited service time. The invention determines the recovery priority according to the remaining service time of the affected service, evaluates the availability of the spectrum resource according to the maximum flow loss threshold in the remaining service time of the service, flexibly utilizes the limited life cycle of the link resource and the dual-channel strategy, and improves the spectrum resource utilization rate of the network, thereby maximizing the connectivity and bandwidth recovery rate of the service in the remaining service time.

title_en: Method for replacing and repairing branch dam-splitting habitat in main and branch hydroelectric development basin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for replacing and repairing a branch dam-splitting habitat in a main and branch hydroelectric development basin. The method comprises the steps of establishing an evaluation index system for the fish habitat restoration potential after tributary dam splitting and a dam splitting-loss evaluation index system; surveying the fish population, hydrology and geographical conditions, natural disaster conditions and hydropower station conditions in the target basin, and collecting data; calculating each index weight in an evaluation index system of the fish habitat restoration potential after the tributary dam splitting and a value P of the fish habitat restoration potential after the tributary dam splitting, and predicting the fish habitat restoration potential after the tributary dam splitting is carried out; calculating index weight and a potential dam-dismantling loss L value in a dam-dismantling and loss evaluation index system, and comprehensively evaluating the potential loss after the power station is dismantled; calculating feasibility score P of branch dam-splitting habitat alternative scheme F If P is F >60, selecting the highest score to demolish the dam; and after the tributary dam is removed, performing environmental investigation on fish population and habitat in the tributary, and repairing the fish habitat in the tributary river section.

title_en: Landslide monitoring device for ecological restoration of mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring equipment, in particular to a landslide monitoring device for mine ecological restoration. Including the shell body, the inside of shell body is provided with along its axial equidistance distribution connecting rod, be located the connecting rod of top and shell body and pass through the universal joint and be connected, the bottom rigid coupling of connecting rod has spherical conducting block, the connecting rod top rigid coupling that does not contact with the shell body has the connecting block, adjacent conducting block and connecting block form spherical connection, the power is installed through the link to the shell body, the electric wire is installed to the power, the power passes through the electric wire and is connected with the conducting block electricity, the inside of conducting block is provided with the monitoring piece, the shell body rigid coupling has the flexible sealing member along its different high circumference array of axial, the flexible sealing member is provided with the movable rod, the movable rod rigid coupling has the push pedal of circumference equidistance distribution. According to the invention, the position and the offset of the mine surface are monitored through the monitoring piece, and information is fed back to an operator to prevent the mine landslide.

title_en: Damaged road network recovery order optimization method based on user balance distribution and targeting maximum toughness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a damaged road network recovery sequence optimization method based on user balance distribution and aiming at maximum toughness, which aims to solve the problems of low recovery efficiency of traffic road networks after disaster and lack of scientific basis for decision making. The method comprises the following implementation steps of firstly constructing a damaged road network toughness assessment framework, combining a traffic network topological structure and traffic demands, defining toughness indexes as the reciprocal of the product of recovery time and total transit time, secondly, establishing damaged road network toughness optimization scene parameters, abstracting the road network into a connected graph and defining a recovery scheme set, then constructing a mixed integer linear programming model with maximum toughness as a target, converting a nonlinear problem into a linear problem through line approximation, setting constraint conditions such as traffic balance and travel demands, and finally, carrying out overall optimization solution on the model by utilizing a high-performance solver to generate an optimal recovery scheme. The method can scientifically quantify the toughness of the road network and optimize the recovery sequence, avoid blindness of empirical decision, rapidly improve the traffic efficiency of the traffic system after the disaster, provide high-efficiency and scientific decision support for the traffic recovery after the disaster, and have important practical application value.

title_en: New energy wind-light sample data processing method and device based on regularity constraint
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of energy data processing, in particular to a new energy wind-light sample data processing method and device based on regularity constraint, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a regular interpolation model and carrying out interpolation supplementation on data missing which easily occurs in a complex environment of a new energy wind power and photovoltaic system; the method comprises the steps of establishing a data quality assessment model based on a topology perception local reversible attention mechanism, automatically assessing the quality of data generated by different interpolation modes, establishing a dynamic weight fusion model, automatically adjusting the weight of each data source in the data complement process, thereby realizing the optimization of the data restoration effect, establishing an abnormal data rejection model, and improving the integrity and reliability of new energy data. Therefore, the problems that the generalization of the prior art for dealing with complicated and changeable severe weather conditions is poor, the data integrity and accuracy are difficult to be considered effectively, the requirement of a new energy power generation system on high-quality data cannot be met and the like are solved.

title_en: Clonezilla-based openEuler system rapid backup and restore method, system, equipment and device
abstract_en: A openEuler system quick backup and restore method, system, device and apparatus based on Clonezilla relates to the technical field of operating system backup, and includes making Clonezilla boot disk and ext4 format storage device, starting target device by boot disk, selecting local storage mode and backup strategy, carrying out partition level or full magnetic disk compression backup on openEuler system under enterprise server with merpeng processor developed mainly, all software in system and environment required by installing software, generating bootable system mirror image ISO file, solving problems of poor compatibility, low efficiency and incomplete environmental restoration of traditional Linux backup method under domestic platform by customizing mirror image processing flow, hardware instruction set adaptation and system environment depth capturing technology, and improving response speed of system deployment and disaster recovery.

title_en: Multi-mode data fusion farmland soil accurate variable fertilization method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a farmland soil accurate variable fertilization method and device integrating multi-mode data, which comprises the steps of integrating multi-source data such as soil, topography and the like collected by taking a slope mini-fracture as a center, constructing a spatial heterogeneity map, utilizing a convolutional neural network to extract vegetation root competition characteristics, determining a multi-species nutrient absorption demand mode, integrating the information into a three-dimensional voxel model, combining a hydrologic model, simulating a migration path of water and fertilizer along the fracture, foreseeing a downhill nutrient enrichment risk, and finally generating a three-dimensional voxel model adjustment scheme for carrying out accurate adjustment on the slope, the soil moisture content and a predicted loss path so as to guide accurate variable fertilization and fertility restoration. The invention also provides a device for executing the method. The invention can remarkably improve the precision, foresight and timeliness of precision fertilization and fertility management under complex terrains.

title_en: Method for greening side slopes with greening brick cages
abstract_en: A method for greening side slopes with greening brick cages includes the following steps that restoration is performed, wherein the slope surfaces of the side slopes are finished according to slope ratios, slope heights and flatness of the side slopes, sundries on the slope surfaces are cleaned up, and thus the handled slope surfaces are regular and consistent in slope ratio; meshes are hung, wherein after anchor rods are fixed to the side slopes, the wire meshes are connected with the anchor rods, and the wire meshes are fixed to the side slopes; the cages are hung, the wire mesh brick cages are connected with the anchor rods and the wire meshes so that the wire mesh brick cages can be fixed to the side slopes; borrowed-soil spray-seeding is performed, wherein mixed soil is sprayed in the mesh cages and the wire meshes, and continuous hardened bodies with plant growth matrixes are formed; mixture spraying is sprayed, wherein a mixture made of grass seeds is sprayed onto the mixed soil to form spray-seeding faces; covering is performed, the spray-seeding faces are covered with covering materials. With the method, the side slopes can be effectively greened, borrowed soil can be fixed to the side slopes more firmly, the borrowed soil layers are high in constitutive property, fast greening of the side slopes is achieved, the problem about water and soil loss is solved, and the side slopes have the advantages of being resistant to scouring and landslide, firm, durable and long in greening effect time.

title_en: Mine side slope repairing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine slope repairing method, which comprises the following steps of S1: cleaning the slope surface of the mine to level the slope surface; s2: arranging a reinforcing belt for stabilizing the slope surface on the mine slope surface; s3: fixing the manufactured flexible steel wire mesh on the reinforcing belt and the mountain body; s4: fixing the plant growth tank on the flexible steel wire mesh and the reinforcing belt; s5: filling soil with loose structure, strong ventilation, water retention and fertilizer retention capacities into the plant growing tank; s6: planting and repairing green plants in the plant growth tank; s7: and installing a drip irrigation water supply pipeline and a water collecting pipeline. According to the invention, the reinforcing belt, the flexible steel wire mesh and other fixing devices are arranged on the exposed mine side slope, the vegetation groove is attached to the mine side slope, and green plants in the vegetation groove can grow on the mine side slope, so that an ecological layer is established on the mine side slope, the greening restoration of the mine side slope is effectively realized, the ecological environment of the side slope is improved, the slope surface structure is reinforced, and the occurrence of natural disasters such as rockfall, debris flow, landslide and the like is greatly avoided.

title_en: Slope ecological restoration system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a side slope ecological restoration system and a side slope ecological restoration method, wherein the side slope ecological restoration system comprises a reservoir dug at the top of a side slope, and a waste residue layer, a slope protection grid and a growth matrix layer which are sequentially paved on the slope surface of the side slope, the growth matrix layer is formed by paving a plurality of sacks filled with plant growth mixed matrix, the gaps between the adjacent sacks are filled with loam soil, the growth matrix layer is covered with an irrigation fixing pipe network, a water suction pump is arranged in the reservoir, the water outlet of the water suction pump is connected with a water outlet pipe, and the other end of the water outlet pipe is communicated with a. The invention has the effects of preventing water and soil loss, slope landslide and the like, and has the function of irrigating the vegetation on the slope. The slope anchoring and the ecosystem repairing are combined together, the top of the slope can be used as a road, and the service life of the whole slope is effectively prolonged.
assignees: SHENZHEN GUIREN ECOLOGICAL CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Method for determining ecological water demand of anti-season lake
abstract_en: A method for determining ecological water demand of an anti-season lake comprises the steps of firstly, respectively determining a key month of the ecological water demand of the anti-season lake and a water level variation range of the key month for a germination period of aquatic plants, a growth diffusion period of aquatic plants and a mature period of the aquatic plants. Then, for the key months, the relationship between the water level and the area of the aquatic plants is respectively established, and the relationship between the water level and the area of the water bird habitat is established according to the requirement of protecting the water birds on the habitat. And finally, determining the ecological water demand of each key month according to a relation curve of the water level and the area of the water bird habitat. The method aims at the special water level change mode of the anti-season lake, takes the requirement of protecting the habitat of waterfowls as a core, obtains the ecological water demand of the anti-season lake in a key month, and has important theoretical and practical significance for water resource management and ecological protection and restoration of the anti-season lake.

title_en: System and method for judging and automatically repairing integrity of multi-source measurement data of power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system and a method for judging and automatically repairing the integrity of multisource measurement data of a power grid, which comprises the following steps: a plurality of power distribution and utilization multi-source measuring devices and a power grid service resource center platform; the power distribution and utilization multi-source measuring devices are respectively connected with the power grid service resource center station and used for outputting power distribution and utilization multi-source measuring data to the power grid service resource center station; and the power grid service resource middle platform is used for carrying out integrity judgment and automatic restoration on the power distribution and utilization multi-source measurement data uploaded by the power distribution and utilization multi-source measurement device and then uploading the power distribution and utilization multi-source measurement data to the master station. According to the invention, the integrity of the power distribution and utilization multi-source business measurement data is deeply researched, and the missing data is accurately and effectively repaired.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID TIANJIN UTILITY ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method and system for determining restoration sequence of non-passable path under flood disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for determining the recovery sequence of an unvented path under a flood disaster, which relate to the technical field of flood disaster risk avoidance and acquire the unvented paths of a road network under different rainfall reproduction periods; the method comprises the steps of establishing a non-directional topology network of a research area, establishing an adjacency matrix to obtain network efficiency, namely quantifying road network connectivity by utilizing the network efficiency, aiming at each side corresponding to an unvented path, obtaining the network efficiency of the non-directional topology network formed by the rest sides after the side is removed as the reference network efficiency of the side, obtaining a change value of each side corresponding to the unvented path by making a difference between the reference network efficiency and the original network efficiency, arranging the change values in a descending order, determining the recovery order of the unvented path by taking the maximum connectivity lifting amplitude after path recovery as a target in the process based on the connectivity actually submerged by the road in a specific disaster scene, and thus efficiently determining the road network recovery order and arranging timely rescue.

title_en: Desert ecological active restoration collaborative management method based on technology water production
abstract_en: The application relates to a desert ecological active restoration collaborative management method based on technology water production. The method comprises the steps of dividing and generating a plurality of ecological units with similar internal environmental characteristics by adopting a K-means clustering algorithm based on the environmental characteristics of a target area, matching suitable plants for each ecological unit, monitoring the water content of soil and the growth state of the plants at fixed time, dynamically determining the water resource requirements of each unit by combining a preset plant water demand model through time sequence analysis based on monitoring data, generating a cross-unit water resource allocation path by adopting a maximum flow algorithm, and generating and executing a water resource supply scheme by combining the operation parameters of water producing equipment. According to the method, through environmental characteristic clustering, plant water demand dynamic prediction and cross-unit hydraulic network optimization, accurate collaborative supply of water resources in a desert restoration area is realized, and ecological restoration efficiency and resource utilization rate are effectively improved.

title_en: Direct-current power distribution network reliability assessment method considering source-load uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a direct-current power distribution network reliability assessment method considering source-load uncertainty, which relates to the field of direct-current power distribution systems, and aims at two operation modes of direct-current power distribution network grid connection and island, and calculates the system side power grid fault rate and the restoration rate of each load point of a direct-current power distribution network in the grid connection operation mode based on a network equivalence method; and calculating a sufficiency conversion rate parameter considering uncertainty of a power supply and a load during the operation of the island, a mechanical fault parameter of the distributed power supply and a starting switching parameter of the island system. Finally, two operation modes are combined, and a Markov model is adopted to calculate the reliability index of the direct-current power distribution network. The method can account for the uncertainty of the power supply and the load, and the influence of the topological structure of the grid frame and equipment factors on the reliability of the direct current distribution network; the dynamic matching relation between the distributed power supply and the load demand in the island operation is fully considered, the influence of source-load uncertainty on the reliability evaluation of the direct current distribution network can be more accurately reflected, and the method has good accuracy.

title_en: Slope protection structure for landscaping ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope protection structure for landscaping ecological restoration, which relates to the field of garden protection and aims to solve the problems that the existing slope protection structure can only dredge water overflowing from soil generally, the soil still contains a large amount of water after heavy rain, so that the soil is relatively conveyed, and the risk of landslide still exists; the front end of the flow guide mechanism is provided with a connecting mechanism; the front end of the connecting mechanism is connected with a filtering mechanism; and a fixing mechanism is arranged above the filtering mechanism. After rainstorm weather, moisture passes through water conservancy diversion spare in the hillside soil and flows the back, and remaining moisture can adsorb through adsorbing the piece, adsorbs the board that the inside capillary of piece is constituteed, can be effectual with the moisture absorption of residing among the soil and send into inside the water conservancy diversion spare, and then can be quick make soil resume appropriate amount moisture state to this avoids behind the rainstorm soil moisture too much to cause the landslide.

title_en: Disaster damage situation sensing method and system for power distribution network based on emergency communication under rain and flood
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network disaster situation awareness method and system based on emergency communication under a rainflood, which are used for establishing a power distribution network disaster situation awareness model under urban rainstorm waterlogging, establishing a communication working point location model, determining possible stop points of a mobile unmanned aerial vehicle station and an emergency communication vehicle, determining a scheduling scheme and a transfer path of the mobile unmanned aerial vehicle station and the emergency communication vehicle based on the possible stop points of the mobile unmanned aerial vehicle station and the emergency communication vehicle, taking into consideration path constraint and time constraint, establishing a vehicle-computer cooperative communication restoration model, establishing a power distribution network disaster situation awareness lifting model under urban rainstorm waterlogging based on the constructed power distribution network disaster situation awareness model under urban rainstorm waterlogging and the constructed vehicle-computer cooperative communication restoration model, and solving the power distribution network disaster situation awareness lifting model under urban rainstorm waterlogging to obtain a situation awareness lifting strategy. The invention improves the disaster situation awareness capability of the distribution network and realizes the rapid recovery of the distribution network after disaster.

title_en: Geological disaster ecological restoration structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster ecological restoration structure, which comprises a slope body and a planting frame, wherein the slope body has a certain inclination angle, an installation groove is formed in the inclined plane of the slope body, interference holes communicated with the inner bottom of the installation groove are formed in four corners of the upper surface of the planting frame, and a planting area for planting different ecological restoration plants is further arranged on the upper surface of the planting frame; the planting frame is fixed on a slope body through the first fixing nail and the second fixing nail, double protection is conducted on the slope body, the fixing effect is better than that of a traditional soil nail, the reinforcement range between plants and soil is deeper, slope plants with weaker survival ability on the slope body are not prone to death or even leave vegetation to shift along with scouring of flood or torrential rain, and the long-term ecological protection effect can be effectively achieved.
assignees: NORTHWEST COLORED SURVEY PROJECT LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Ecological anti-slip retaining wall
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, and discloses an ecological anti-slip retaining wall which comprises a slope bedrock top surface and a surface layer pile body, wherein a retaining wall is arranged on the left side of the surface layer pile body, a gravity type wall body is arranged inside the retaining wall, an anchor rod bearing platform is fixedly connected to the bottom of the retaining wall, an ecological foot wall is fixedly connected to the left side of the anchor rod bearing platform, a vegetation ecological groove is fixedly connected to the top of the anchor rod bearing platform, a plurality of locking anchor rods are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the anchor rod bearing platform and the ecological foot wall, rotating grooves are formed in the left side and the right side of the outer portion of each locking anchor rod, and rotating rods are rotatably connected to the inner portion of each rotating groove. In the utility model, the sizes of the ecological foot wall and the vegetation ecological groove are planned, then soil is filled in the vegetation ecological groove, arbor, shrub or herb is planted, the anti-slip retaining of the surface layer stack is realized, and the ecological restoration of arbor and shrub vegetation is considered.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 14TH BUREAU GROUP QINGDAO ENG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Hydrological data anomaly identification and repair method based on federated learning framework
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrological data anomaly detection and restoration method based on a federal learning framework, which comprises a model training process and a recognition and restoration process, wherein the model training process comprises the following steps: firstly, preprocessing training hydrological data and carrying out abnormal processing, secondly, building a federal learning framework, initializing model parameters by a server, and sending a global model to each client; the client starts to learn the local data characteristics after receiving the model, the model extracts context information by using a bidirectional LSTM with an attention mechanism, then simultaneously optimizes the functions of anomaly detection and data restoration in a mode of resisting learning, and finally updates the functions of the model through iterative interaction between the client and the server. According to the invention, by providing a new method, on the premise that the privacy of hydrological telemetering data is protected, abnormality identification and restoration are simultaneously carried out, and support is provided for improving hydrological forecasting performance and reducing loss caused by uncertain disasters.

title_en: Wind power base planning method based on WRF mesoscale nesting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power base planning method based on WRF mesoscale nesting, which comprises the following steps: performing WRF mesoscale nesting based on the Fitch parameterized model; performing WRF simulation result post-processing; assessing wind resources based on the WRF post-processing data; selecting a planning area according to the wind resource evaluation result; determining a planning capacity through a fitting formula; calculating field-level wake flow of the wind power plant in the main wind direction by adopting an improved BP-Gaussian model; normalized design of wake restoration bands. The invention provides a wind power base planning method based on WRF mesoscale nesting, so that the wind resource evaluation result of the large wind power base is more in line with measured data, and the established design method of the wake flow restoration belt of the large wind power base has better economic benefit and good application prospect in actual engineering.
assignees: POWERCHINA NORTHWEST ENG CORP LTD;UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Mud-rock flow ditch bed ecological restoration system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological restoration system for a debris flow gully bed. The structure comprises retaining walls on two sides, a spur dike group which is arranged between the retaining walls and connected with the retaining walls and matched with the spur dike group, and a crust layer and a arbor forest which are planted among the spur dike group. The T-dam group consists of a plurality of lower-chosen T-dams with a certain burial depth, and each two stages of the T-dams are distributed according to a certain interval and are used for beam current and arbor in a protection gap. Compared with the prior art, the method reduces erosion of the gap ditch bed of the double-side spur dike by adjusting the directions of the mud-rock flow and the water flow in the ditch, provides a stable growth environment for vegetation of the ditch bed, solves the problem of high ecological restoration difficulty of the mud-rock flow ditch bed, is beneficial to ecological restoration of a river basin, can reduce erosion of the running water to the spur dike group and the retaining wall after plants in the gap grow, solves the problem of easy failure of geotechnical engineering, and is beneficial to long-term operation of the ecological restoration system.

title_en: Intelligent duplicate electricity research and judgment method and system based on operation sensing of metering device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, and provides an intelligent duplicate power supply research and judgment method and system based on operation perception of a metering device, wherein the method comprises the steps of matching power failure distribution transformer equipment associated with an emergency repair work order based on the emergency repair work order identifier of the emergency repair work order; the method comprises the steps of carrying out time sequencing on the basis of initial time stamps of operation data recorded by a metering device in power outage distribution transformer equipment to obtain a sequenced time stamp sequence, comparing the earliest time stamp in the sequenced time stamp sequence with power outage starting time of the power outage distribution transformer equipment to obtain a distribution transformer restoration state judgment result, determining whether each power outage distribution transformer equipment associated with a repair work order is powered up or not on the basis of the distribution transformer restoration state judgment result, determining that the repair work order is powered up if the repair work order is powered up, and determining that the repair work order is powered up if the power outage distribution transformer equipment which is not powered up is powered up. The embodiment of the invention improves the sensing speed of the power grid duplicate and the transmission timeliness of the power supply recovery information, and improves the timeliness of power grid power dispatching.

title_en: Island energy system based on deep reinforcement learning and scheduling method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to an island energy system based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises an energy device, an electrolysis device, an energy storage battery, a hydrogen storage device, an oxygen storage device, a pressure swing adsorption device, an ammonia synthesis device, a sea water desalination device and a scheduling device, wherein the energy device inputs electric energy to the electrolysis device, the energy storage battery, the pressure swing adsorption device and the sea water desalination device, the electrolysis device decomposes water provided by the sea water desalination device into hydrogen and oxygen, the pressure swing adsorption device provides nitrogen, the hydrogen storage device stores the hydrogen and the nitrogen and inputs the hydrogen to the ammonia synthesis device, the oxygen storage device stores the oxygen, the scheduling device constructs a real-time running state of the system into a multidimensional state vector to form an equilibrium constraint system of electric-hydrogen-oxygen-ammonia-water multipotent coupling, and the multidimensional state vector is decided based on a near-end strategy optimization algorithm to output optimal strategy parameters. The application optimizes the global relation of electrolytic hydrogen production and multi-energy co-supply by taking the electrolytic device as a pivot, and realizes the low-carbon energy supply, ecological restoration and load demand.
assignees: NO 719 RES INSTITUTE CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CO LTD

title_en: Counter-disaster manhole pumping station backup system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a counter-disaster manhole pumping station backup system for making it possible to rapidly perform restoration when a pump has stopped.SOLUTION: A counter-disaster manhole pumping station backup system comprises: a standby pump installed outside a sewage tank; a suction hose that is hung down from the standby pump into the sewage tank in order to suck sewage water in the sewage tank; and a discharge hose that is hung down from the standby pump into the sewage tank while connecting with a force-feed pipe in order to discharge sucked sewage water. The standby pump is installed when a sewage pump has stopped, and sucks sewage water in the sewage tank through the suction hose and discharges the sewage water to the force-feed pipe through the discharge hose.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Support system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reliably support restoration of facilities by providing terminals carried by working personnel with information related to work procedures for operating disaster prevention facilities and state information representing states of equipment related to the operation object facilities.SOLUTION: A support system includes a support device connected to disaster prevention facilities installed in a building, and a plurality of terminals carried by working personnel. The support system transmits information related to work procedures for operating the disaster prevention facilities, to the terminals so as to be displayed thereon, and causes state information terminals to display the information, the state information terminals representing states of the equipment related to the operation object facilities.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Asphalt concrete paving block
title_ko: 아스콘포장블록
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An asphalt concrete paving block is provided to prevent poser construction by improving the quality and function of the block. CONSTITUTION: An asphalt concrete paving block is composed as follows. Nonslip rough parts(300) are formed on the surface of the block. The corners of the block are rounded. A groove for guiding rainwater to the outside is formed in the block. An asphalt emulsion is spread to gaps between the blocks and cuts off rainwater. Fixing and tamping protrusions are formed in the bottom of the block to prevent the block from moving.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 신규 아스팔트 도로포장 공사나 도로굴착복구 아스팔트 도로포장 공사에서 사용하는 아스팔트콘크리트, 일명 아스콘 재료의 일부 또는 전체를 폐아스콘을 재활용하거나, 신규 아스콘을 블록으로 성형하여 기존 아스팔트 포설 장비 인 휘니셔,각종 로울러,등 많은 장비의 사용없이 아스팔트 포장 밀도,강도 등 재료의 품질확보와 함께 포설하는 아스콘 포장블록에 관한 것으로서, 구체적으로 기존기계투입 포장 아스콘공사를 인력으로도 쉽게설치 할수있게 하여  공사원가를 획기적으로 줄이어 국가예산을 절감하고, 아스콘 포장공사 방법상 기층 포설 후 표층 포설 하기전까지 토사 되메우기 후 다짐작업의 많은 시간과 비용이 투입되는바, 아스콘 기층을 블록성형화 하여 설치하면 아스콘 표층 포설 전까지 차량의 통행하는 자체하중으로 인하여 자연적 다짐이 발생 되고,차량의 통행도 가능하게 되어 다짐장비 사용비의 절약은 물론 도로포장공사중 차량통행금지나,차량정체로 인한 국가적 에너지 절약이 실천되어 국익에 경제적 효과와 민원이 획기적으로 개선될 것이다. 그리고, 수거된 폐아스콘을 재생처리하여 사용할 경우 폐기물처리비용의 막대한 경제적 손실을 억제하고, 도로 아스콘 포장공사로 인한 국가적 예산을 절감시켜 이로인한 경제적 가치는 실로 막대할 것이다. 또한, 현재 시행하고 있는 임시포장(가포장) 또는 이중포장으로 인한 자원 낭비 및 공사비 증가를 방지하여 건설사 원가 절감을 극대화시키고, 공사의 품질을 향상시키고 부실공사를 방지하므로 궁극적으로 국가예산 절감을 도모하며, 국가재난시 도로 응급복구용으로도 사용이 가능하여 국민의 안전과 재산을 지킬 수 있도록 한 도로복구블록을 제공하려는 것이다.

title_ko: 녹조를 발생시키지 못하도록 작용시켜서 친환경 전기를 생산함과 동시에 인공양어장 기능을 발휘시켜서 어족자원을 증대시킴과 동시에 홍수 피해 방지용 대형 빗물 저류조 기능과 오염된 바닷물과 오염된 하천수를 깨끗한 하천수가 되도록 작용하는 상.하 작동식 녹조 발생 방지용 친환경 가동보가 발생시켜주는 주는 수력과 조력을 이용하여 3중으로 친환경 전기를 생산하는 자연친화적인 친환경 공법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an eco-friendly construction method utilizing a movable weir for preventing algal blooms, while simultaneously restoring river ecosystems. The invention enables the generation of eco-friendly electricity using a fishway that restores aquatic ecosystems without promoting algal growth, and functions as an artificial fish farm to enhance fishery resources. Additionally, it serves as a large-scale rainwater retention reservoir to prevent flood damage. By using the eco-friendly movable weir, polluted river water flowing through rivers, lakes, dams, and reservoirs is naturally purified into clean water. This invention thus provides a nature-friendly, eco-conscious method for improving water quality and supporting ecological restoration.
