title_en: Efficient application-aware disaster recovery
abstract_en: Embodiments are directed to efficiently backing up portions of data and to performing a scoped data recovery. In an embodiment, a computer system preloads data images with data corresponding to various different software applications or operating systems. The computer system chunks the data images, so that each data image is divided into multiple data chunks, and where each data chunk is represented by a hash value. The computer system then receives, from a user, portions of delta data representing data differences between the received user data and the data in the preloaded data images. The computer system also generates a logical backup representation that includes the data chunk hash values for the preloaded data images as well as the delta data received from the user. This logical representation allows restoration of the user's data using only the hash values and the delta data.

title_en: Method and device for predicting pollutant solute distribution under karst landform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for predicting pollutant solute distribution under karst landforms, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting pollutant solute concentration and karst landform characteristics in a preset time period, and determining the arrival time and model parameters of pollutants through a plurality of migration paths based on the pollutant solute concentration and the karst landform characteristics in the preset time period; constructing a three-stage truncated fractional solute transport model based on the concentration of the contaminant solute in the preset time period, the arrival time of the contaminant through a plurality of transport paths and the model parameters; collecting the current concentration of the pollutant solute, and inputting the current concentration of the pollutant solute into the three-stage cut-off fractional order solute transport model to generate the distribution of the pollutant solute. According to the method, the solute transport process in the aquifer under karst landforms is simulated through a three-stage cut-off fractional order solute transport model, the pollutant solute distribution of a target area is identified, and data support is provided for underground karst water pollution assessment and restoration.

title_en: Vegetation restoration scheme generation method for construction of ecological circle of power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention provides a vegetation recovery scheme generation method for constructing an ecological ring of a power transmission line, which comprises the following steps: soil sampling is carried out on a line area to obtain soil matrix information corresponding to each planting range in the line area, a three-dimensional environment model in the line area is built by combining with climate information of the line area, corresponding optional seeds are matched for the planting ranges, a plurality of planting schemes are generated, a planting conceptual diagram corresponding to each planting scheme is generated in the three-dimensional environment model in a simulation mode, vegetation survival rate corresponding to each planting scheme is analyzed, a vegetation recovery scheme of the line area is generated according to a target planting scheme with the highest vegetation survival rate and a planting mode corresponding to each optional seed, vegetation of a power transmission line construction area is effectively recovered through construction of an ecological circle, and proper plant seeds are selected to adapt to natural environment and climate conditions of a place.

title_en: Distribution network dispatching instruction ticket safety checking system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distribution network dispatching instruction ticket safety checking system and a distribution network dispatching instruction ticket safety checking method, and belongs to the technical field of electric power system dispatching operation. The system comprises a collecting device, an instruction ticket classifying module, a keyword identifying module, a power failure operation ticket checking module, a power restoration operation ticket checking module, a fault log/abnormal defect recording list checking module, a power restoration control module and the like. After the distribution network scheduling instruction ticket safety checking system is formally on line, the human resource waste is reduced, the human resource benefit maximization is achieved, and the problem of shortage of the human resources of the distribution network is solved to a certain extent. And secondly, the safety measure arrangement is changed from the traditional manual input manual check into an automatic intelligent check process, so that the scheduling operation efficiency, the power supply reliability and the safety are improved.
assignees: KUNMING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Meadow vegetation root system sampling and surface soil stripping device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a meadow vegetation root sampling and surface soil stripping device which comprises an outer barrel with an open bottom and a sampling barrel arranged in the outer barrel, wherein a vertical downward positioning column and a protective edge extending outwards are arranged at the bottom of the outer barrel; the sampling barrel comprises an upper drying separation area and a lower sampling area. The method is used for researching the roots of grassland vegetation in the pastoral area, can completely obtain the roots of plants in the sample plot, can quickly dry and separate the surface soil of the roots according to the test requirements, provides convenience for the research on the ecology of the meadow vegetation in the pastoral area and the breeding of ecological restoration plants, provides important research data for the drought and disaster reduction in the pastoral area and the sustainable development of agriculture and animal husbandry, and has high automation degree and high acquisition speed.
assignees: WATER CONSERVANCY SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE FOR PASTURING AREA OF WATER CONSERVANCY DEPARTMENT

title_en: Municipal works water conservancy construction bank protection restoration structure
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of slope protection repair, in particular to a municipal engineering water conservancy construction slope protection repair structure which comprises a slope body, a growth base layer, a grid frame and a plurality of vertical plates, wherein the growth base layer covers the slope surface of the slope body; wherein a first fixing component used for reinforcing the growth base layer is arranged between the growth base layer and the slope surface of the slope body; a second fixing component for reinforcing the grid frame is arranged between the grid frame and the growth base layer; soil base layers, stone layers and grid cloth layers are sequentially paved in a plurality of grid units surrounded by the transverse vertical plates and the vertical plates of the grid frame from inside to outside, and the edges of the grid cloth layers are connected with the transverse vertical plates and the vertical plates adjacent to the grid cloth layers. This application can reduce the rainy season bank protection and the possibility of landslide appears, improves bank protection repairing effect.
assignees: TIANJIN XIN ROAD AND BRIDGE CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Landslide monitoring device for ecological restoration of mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring equipment, in particular to a landslide monitoring device for mine ecological restoration. Including the shell body, the inside of shell body is provided with along its axial equidistance distribution connecting rod, be located the connecting rod of top and shell body and pass through the universal joint and be connected, the bottom rigid coupling of connecting rod has spherical conducting block, the connecting rod top rigid coupling that does not contact with the shell body has the connecting block, adjacent conducting block and connecting block form spherical connection, the power is installed through the link to the shell body, the electric wire is installed to the power, the power passes through the electric wire and is connected with the conducting block electricity, the inside of conducting block is provided with the monitoring piece, the shell body rigid coupling has the flexible sealing member along its different high circumference array of axial, the flexible sealing member is provided with the movable rod, the movable rod rigid coupling has the push pedal of circumference equidistance distribution. According to the invention, the position and the offset of the mine surface are monitored through the monitoring piece, and information is fed back to an operator to prevent the mine landslide.
assignees: SHANDONG LUDI CONSTRUCTION DEV CO LTD

title_en: Community flood toughness and external relation analysis method based on facility accessibility
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for analyzing community flood toughness and external relations based on facility accessibility, and relates to the technical field of community disaster toughness assessment. In the invention, the complex connection and interaction among elements such as urban roads, facilities, crowds and the like are considered based on the constructed composite space network. In the case of heavy rain, the service flow between community residents and facilities may be disturbed, the road serves as a bridge to connect the community residents and the service facilities, and road interruption caused by heavy rain may cause isolation between part of communities and the service facilities, influence accessibility heterogeneity change, and make community toughness present complex spatial distribution. According to the method, the supporting degree of the service facilities inside and outside the community on the restoration capability of the community can be determined by analyzing the contribution of the road-community inner service facility-community outer service facility to the comprehensive toughness of the community. Based on community disaster toughness evaluation and external association analysis, the embodiment of the invention provides a reliable scientific basis for community disaster prevention and reduction construction.

title_en: Method and medium for calculating reverse compensation electric quantity for three-phase user
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a medium for calculating the reverse and complementary electric quantity of a three-phase user, and relates to the technical field of electric quantity reduction. The method comprises the steps of calculating three-phase unbalance of a user based on acquired electric energy consumption data, judging whether a power restoration quantity condition is met according to the three-phase unbalance, if not, carrying out power restoration, if so, calculating to obtain a balance correction coefficient according to the acquired user type and the three-phase unbalance, calculating to obtain total power consumption of an abnormal phase of the electric energy meter during a fault period based on the balance correction coefficient, metering data and the wiring type of the electric energy meter, and calculating to obtain the power restoration quantity of the three-phase user according to the total power consumption and the metering data of the abnormal phase of the electric energy meter during the fault period. According to the invention, the three-phase unbalance degree is introduced as an applicability criterion, and different user types and wiring modes are combined to design a differential processing strategy, so that the adaptability and accuracy of the calculation method are remarkably improved.

title_en: Power restoration system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To ensure power after disasters as much as possible.SOLUTION: When a HEMS receives an emergency disaster prompt report, charging a PHV/EV starts in the case that a vehicle is connected. For example, a vehicle storage battery of the PHV/EV is charged with system power and natural energy. Thereby, the charged vehicle storage battery becomes available after disasters. After occurrence of the disasters, replacement by available power is performed depending on the extent of the disasters. Specifically, when the system power is not available, a power source is switched from the system power to available power (the natural energy or PHV/EV). Thereby, power can be supplied to houses without suspension.

title_en: Water spray head
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a water spray head enabled to prevent the adhesion of a dirt by closing a nozzle opening without requiring a restoration work such as the return of cap fitting accompanying a drainage stop.SOLUTION: A short-range nozzle 38 is slidably disposed in a cylinder hole 32 of a nozzle holder 30 disposed, for example, in a short-range nozzle unit 24 mounted in a head body, and a holder opening 34 of the cylinder holder 30 is openably closed by a cover plate 46. In the case where water for fire-fighting is fed from the head body, the short-range nozzle 38 moves forward against a return spring 35 thereby to push and open the cover plate 46, so that the nozzle leading end is protruded forward from the holder opening 34 thereby to perform a water spray. When the supply of the fire-fighting water is stopped, the short-range nozzle 38 returns to the initial position, and the cover plate 46 closes the holder opening 34.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Communicating Power Distribution Event and Location
abstract_en: A system, device, and method of providing information for a power distribution system is provided. In one embodiment, a method of using a device that receives power from the low voltage power of the power distribution system and experiences a power loss during a local power outage may perform the processes of monitoring a voltage of the low voltage power line, detecting a voltage reduction below a threshold voltage for a predetermined time period, storing information of the voltage reduction in a non-volatile memory prior to the power outage, and transmitting a notification to a remote computer system prior to the outage. The monitoring may comprise making a plurality of measurements of the voltage during a time interval and averaging the plurality of voltage measurements. In addition, the method may include transmitting an alert message upon power up after the outage to indicate a power restoration local to the device.

title_en: Method of optimising the performance of a computer and a main non-volatile memory unit optimised using specific-use sections
abstract_en: A method is revealed to optimize the performance of a computer by establishing purpose-specific sections in its main non-volatile storage medium. This method creates a basic set of purpose-specific sections in order to store, separated at a physical level and at a logical level, basic elements associated to equipment operation such as operating system, dynamic files, applications and user related files; and, optionally, creates an additional set of purpose-specific sections to store other elements separated in like manner. A secondary method is also described to supplement the previous one, in order to quickly optimize an unlimited number of identical computers. In addition, the optimized main non-volatile storage medium that results from employing either of the previous methods is described. For users, owners and technicians of an optimized equipment, the use of this invention generates numerous advantages: minimized file fragmentation; better defragmentation techniques; top operating speed; easier file and disk backups as well as faster restoration; improved system security, operation continuity, and disaster recovery; superior configuration techniques on installed software; optimal system operation; and, thus, minimized total cost of ownership. It is impossible to simultaneously accomplish said advantages using traditional techniques or other optimization approaches published to date.

title_en: Disaster tolerance switching method, system and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for switching disaster-tolerance, which includes the steps that: a disaster-tolerance client at a production side instructs a first database at the production side to write data in the cache into a first storage device at the production side and empty a log after the disaster-tolerance switching is started; the written data is synchronized from the first storage device to a second storage device at a disaster-tolerance side; a disaster-tolerance service terminal at the disaster-tolerance side makes a snapshot to the data in the second storage device; a second database at the disaster-tolerance side is started by using the snapshot, and the started second database carries out self-restoration operation according to the newly-generated log after being emptied. The invention also provides a disaster-tolerance switching system, a disaster-tolerance switching device at a service terminal and a disaster-tolerance switching device at the client. The invention shortens the restoration time of the database during the disaster-tolerance restoration period.

title_en: Distribution network failure isolation and quick power service restoration decision support system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power network safety operation, and in particular relates to a distribution network failure isolation and quick power service restoration decision support system. The system is connected with a distribution automation system, comprises a real-time subsystem, a simulation subsystem, an accident inversion subsystem and a knowledge generating subsystem, and acquires power network operation monitoring data from the distribution automation system through a data interface, automatically tracks the real-time operating state of the power network, can quickly provide a power supply restoration scheme and intuitive simulation effect for a dispatcher to determine a proper restoration sequence after a failure happens, and provides accident simulation and accident inversion function; and the subsystems can be subjected to interface switching. The system is suitable for a distribution network which has a complicated network structure and of which the failure cannot be treated by automation equipment.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Road network traffic time sequence characteristic data quality diagnosis and restoration method
abstract_en: A road network traffic time sequence characteristic data quality diagnosis and restoration method comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining a regional road network topological structure, and constructing a traffic data prediction model; s2, acquiring historical traffic data, training a model and checking the prediction precision of the model; s3, fusing the traffic data acquired by the traffic detector with the traffic data generated, and detecting and repairing the abnormal data in real time; and S4, performing incremental training on the prediction model to ensure the prediction precision of the model. The invention has the beneficial effects that: and predicting a mode of the data on the day and the comprehensive production data of the combined road network data based on historical data and comprehensively judging the quality of the data, and finally realizing high-quality data with reasonable continuous output and strong relevance.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted MiniSAR real-time imaging and emergency communication system for disaster rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted MiniSAR real-time imaging and emergency communication system for disaster relief, which relates to the technical field of emergency communication and radar remote sensing, and comprises a radar path inversion modeling module, wherein the radar path inversion modeling module performs multi-time flight above a target area, acquires radar echo signals at a plurality of moments, acquires flight attitude data and imaging azimuth information of a flight platform, inverts a propagation path of the radar echo signals based on the flight attitude data and the imaging azimuth information, extracts an incident angle and a reflection path length, and generates a reflection path distribution diagram. According to the invention, through multi-time radar path modeling and image stability evaluation, the false target points under multipath interference are accurately identified and removed, image structure restoration is realized by combining a dynamic extension algorithm, a dynamic confidence distribution map is constructed, high-confidence target positioning and rescue area optimization are realized, and the anti-interference and response accuracy of the system is enhanced.

title_en: River channel section morphological feature recognition method based on remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of river channel segment feature recognition, and particularly relates to a method for recognizing morphological features of a river channel segment based on remote sensing. According to the invention, through multi-source remote sensing data fusion analysis, accurate identification and dynamic monitoring of river channel morphological characteristics are realized, the scientificity and efficiency of river channel management are improved, and through construction of river segment classification and morphological modules, fine data support is provided for river channel ecological restoration and management, so that the intelligent and data requirements of river channel management decisions are supported, meanwhile, through time sequence analysis of restoration nodes and current nodes, effective prediction of the river channel morphological evolution trend is realized, and after the prediction result is output, confidence verification and evaluation are also carried out, so that the reliability and applicability of the prediction result are ensured, corresponding data support can be provided for river channel repair engineering by the prediction result, the river channel morphological change trend can be prejudged in advance, and scientific basis is provided for flood control and disaster reduction and water resource management.

title_en: Multi-threaded server control automation for disaster recovery
abstract_en: Systems and methods for multi-threaded server control automation for disaster recovery are described. A method may include initiating a disaster recovery sequence on two or more processors, wherein the disaster recovery sequence comprises a plurality of subsequences. The method may also include implementing the disaster recovery sequence on the two or more processors in parallel, wherein one or more subsequences of the disaster recovery sequence are implemented on the two or more processors in parallel. Upon completion of the disaster recovery sequence, at least one server partition is repurposed from a first configuration, such as a test configuration, to a second configuration, such as a production configuration.

title_en: Coral reef repair system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coral reef repair system mainly comprises spherical reef base, reef body spud pile and cultivation connecting device triplex, cultivates connecting device and passes through reef body spud pile with a plurality of spherical reef base interconnect. The spherical reef base serves as a stable artificial reef body attached to the coral amputated limbs to provide a place for quick breeding of the coral amputated limbs, and meanwhile, the function of the artificial fish reef is considered. The utility model has simple manufacture, low cost, simple installation and wide application range, is used for the artificial repair of the underwater coral reef, and integrates the three functions of permanent artificial reef fixation, coral broken limb asexual culture and artificial fish reef; particularly, in the coral reef area which is strongly influenced by the monsoon, frequently suffers from disasters such as typhoons and the like, has strong land source input and strong artificial interference, can ensure the artificial restoration effect of the coral, improves the biological diversity and is beneficial to the sustainable development of the coral reef ecosystem.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION ACAD OF OCEANOGRAPHY

title_en: River and lake bottom mud-water separation device for mine restoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental engineering, in particular to a river and lake bottom mud-water separation device for mine restoration. In the use process of the existing device, the dehydrated sludge is inconvenient to collect sufficiently, the water cannot be discharged due to blockage caused by the sludge, and the adhered sludge cannot fall sufficiently due to earthquake, so that the sludge-water separation effect is poor. The invention comprises a base, wherein the base is fixedly connected with a shell, and the top of the shell is fixedly connected with a one-way valve. According to the invention, the push plate is driven to slide back and forth by the electric push rod, the push plate can be pushed to slide by continuing to move, so that the extrusion plate and the filter screen frame extrude the sludge together, water in the sludge is extruded, the sludge is dehydrated, the solid content of the sludge is effectively improved, the pollution of the sludge to the water is reduced, and the water is purified.
assignees: HUNAN KAI DI ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD;UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH FORESTRY & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Fault processing method and device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a fault processing method, a fault processing device and computer equipment. Determining a priority recovery sequence of each load according to the importance level of each load in a fault area to a user, acquiring a current scheduling strategy for recovering power supply of each load, and controlling the recovery power supply of each load in the fault area according to the priority recovery sequence of each load and the current scheduling strategy of each load. By adopting the method, the priority recovery sequence of each load can be determined according to the importance level of each load in the fault area to the user, so that the power can be recovered preferentially to the load with higher sensitivity to the power supply in the fault area based on the priority recovery sequence of each load, and the power can be recovered to the load with lower sensitivity to the power supply in the fault area, thereby improving the recovery effect when the power is recovered to each load in the fault area.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: River mouth water quality health system evaluation and ecological restoration method based on microorganism identification
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental science and ecological restoration, in particular to a estuary water quality health system evaluation and ecological restoration method based on microorganism identification. The method has the advantages that the accuracy of predicting pollution risk areas is improved by identifying multiple sources of a water body and calculating the contribution degree of the multiple water body sources to sampling points and combining real-time meteorological and topographic data to simulate pollution diffusion paths, the prediction capability of the pollution source types is improved by evaluating the microbial population distribution mode in the water body samples, the data support provided for identifying the pollution source positions is provided, the multiple source positions of pathogenic microorganisms are identified by combining the comparison with microbial samples of the multiple pollution sources, scientific basis is provided for taking effective water quality protection and disease prevention measures, and the quality and efficiency of environmental management are improved.
assignees: YANTAI INST COASTAL ZONE RES CAS

title_en: Method and system for improving toughness of AC/DC distribution area based on mobile energy storage soft switch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for improving toughness of an AC/DC distribution area based on a mobile energy storage soft switch, which belong to the technical field of power distribution network fault recovery, wherein the method comprises the steps of considering a moving path of a meteorological center, constructing a line fault rate model under extreme ice and snow weather, and sampling to obtain a fault scene; the method comprises the steps of traversing all fault scenes, obtaining deployment positions with minimum total loss load of a network reconstruction and island division distribution network under different deployment positions of a mobile energy storage soft switch, carrying out pre-disaster placement according to the deployment positions, taking the positions with faults into consideration when traffic is not recovered after extreme weather faults occur, carrying out power restoration by adopting island division and network reconstruction modes around the pre-placement positions, and optimizing a repair strategy and updating the system topology by taking the sequence and the pre-placement scheme of fault position repair after traffic recovery after the disaster. The invention is based on the mobile energy storage soft switch, and obviously improves the power supply recovery capability and the operation reliability of the urban power distribution network for coping with extreme ice and snow disasters.
assignees: QINGDAO POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Apparatus of road safety panel
title_ko: 도로복구판넬
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A road recovery panel which can be rapidly and conveniently transferred is provided to enable pedestrian to pass through a sidewalk by safely covering a construction filed. CONSTITUTION: A road recovery panel comprises the panels formed in order to install on a floor(20) between the both cut parts of pavement(10). The panel is composed of a lower panel(100) and an upper panel(200). The lower panel adheres closely to a floor between both sides of a package. The upper panel is placed on the lower panel with a plurality of ribs formed in horizontal or vertical directions and covers both sides of the package.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로의 각종 보수 공사에서 들어낸 포장을 커버하기 위한 도로복구판넬에 관한 것으로서, 상기 들어낸 포장의 양측 절단부 사이의 바닥에 안치하도록 형성된 패널;로 이루어짐에 따라, 도로의 들어낸 포장을 간편하고 안전하게 커버하여 통행시 사고 및 국가재난시 도로 응급복구용으로 국민의 안전과 재산을 지키고 건설현장의 부실공사를 방지할 수 있도록 한 도로복구판넬을 제공하려는 것이다.

title_en: A kind of Mine Communication network recovery based on group grey relational grade and reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method based on downhole network restoration and reconstitution after the colliery calamity of group robot technology, the method is characterised in that after mine disaster occurs, by shed to down-hole there is wireless communication function in a large number can the intelligent robot of autonomous, element is searched and the trunk of autonomous formation formation underground communica tion network to the remaining network of underworkings, to rebuild underground communica tion network by group robot.The present invention can assist aboveground rescue command center to grasp down-hole relevant information in time, for accident rescue provides effective Informational support after mine disaster occurs.

title_en: Precipitation management and control system suitable for ecological environment restoration of mine is administered
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precipitation control system suitable for restoration and treatment of mine ecological environment, which comprises a plurality of precipitation control units arranged step by step from high to low according to mountain ranges, wherein adjacent precipitation control units are connected through a drainage facility to realize step by step water storage, each precipitation control unit comprises a slag water storage body, the slag water storage bodies are positioned between a hill face and a water control diversion dam, the water control diversion dam enables residual water after the slag water storage bodies are saturated to flow to a next precipitation control unit and a mine platform on the other side through the drainage facility, planting ridge platforms arranged transversely are arranged on the ground surface of each slag water storage body at intervals, the table surfaces of the planting ridge platforms are of inward inclined structures, enclosing ridges are arranged at the edges of the mine platforms, and grid-shaped slag reduction ridges are arranged in the inner side areas of the enclosing ridges, and grass and wood vegetation is planted between the slag reduction ridges. The invention can reduce water and soil loss and natural disasters of debris flow, improve the utilization rate of natural rainfall and is suitable for the technical field of mine ecological environment restoration.

title_en: Power distribution network fault emergency repair dispatching-fault recovery cooperative method and device
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of fault self-healing, and provides a distribution network fault emergency repair dispatching-fault recovery cooperative method and a distribution network fault emergency repair dispatching-fault recovery cooperative device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: coordinating a fault emergency repair scheduling scheme and a fault recovery scheme, taking into account the master-slave relation of decision variables of the two schemes, modeling by adopting a two-layer planning theory, taking the control variable of an upper layer planning model as a fault emergency repair scheme, constructing a target function by taking into account the minimized power loss load loss and the repair time, considering the geographical constraint of the repair scheme, and meeting necessary constraint conditions such as constraint and the like by repair resources and time; the lower-layer planning model takes a fault recovery scheme as a decision maker, takes the minimized power loss load loss as a target function, and considers necessary constraint conditions such as network radial constraint, node voltage constraint, fault recovery and emergency repair progress coordination constraint and the like. And solving the optimal scheme by adopting a particle swarm algorithm design model, thereby improving the efficiency of fault emergency repair and reducing the loss of power load under the fault state of the distribution network system.

title_en: N-1 automatic verification method based on power distribution network full model
abstract_en: The invention provides an N-1 automatic verification method based on a power distribution network full model, which comprises the following steps: establishing a power distribution network full model based on a preset general modeling standard; acquiring fault conditions of elements in the power distribution network based on the power distribution network full model, and determining elements to be checked based on the fault conditions; obtaining topology data of a power distribution network, and generating a power restoration scheme corresponding to elements to be verified in the power distribution network according to the topology data; performing N-1 verification on the power restoration scheme according to a first operation index of the power distribution network; and if the N-1 verification is passed, selecting an optimal power restoration scheme according to the second operation indexes of the power distribution network before and after the N-1 verification. The invention can rapidly and safely carry out the automatic verification of N-1 when a certain element fails. And meanwhile, the optimal power restoration scheme is determined by executing the operation indexes of the power distribution network before and after the power restoration scheme, so that the N-1 verification result is more comprehensive and reliable.

title_en: Regional power stability analysis and evaluation method based on power outage and restoration event data monitoring
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of regional power stability analysis, and particularly discloses a regional power stability analysis and evaluation method based on power outage and restoration event data monitoring, which comprises the following steps: the application analyzes the meteorological data of the attribution area of each path through analyzing and calculating the stability coefficient of the power transmission structure of the appointed area, and can provide scientific and reasonable support basis for monitoring the power failure event data, reflect the comprehensive influence condition of the power failure event, analyze and calculate the power failure influence index of the appointed area through the power failure data of the appointed area, combine the power load and the electric quantity, improve the multi-dimensionality of monitoring the power failure event data and the accuracy of the data analysis, and simultaneously be beneficial to providing guarantee for the electric energy stable use requirement of the area.

title_en: Accelerated recovery after a data disaster
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present invention, a metadata file is transferred from the first system to the second system and a database on the second system is initialized based on the metadata file. An image, including information of the first system to be restored, is transferred from the first system to the second system, and restoration of the information to the second system based on the image is initiated. Prior to completion of the restoration, one or more log files indicating actions performed on the first system relating to the information to be restored is transferred from the first system to the initialized database on the second system. In response to completion of the restoration, the actions of the log files are performed to synchronize the restored data on the second system with the first system.

title_en: Be used for prosthetic green slope protective structure of planting of geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a green plant side slope protection structure for geological disaster restoration, which comprises a protection breaking body, wherein the inner side of the protection breaking body is fixedly connected with a first reinforcing rod and a second reinforcing rod, the tops of the first reinforcing rod and the second reinforcing rod are fixedly connected with a protection layer, a concrete filling layer is poured on the inner side of the protection layer and the inner side of the protection breaking body, and the right side of the protection layer is fixedly connected with a fixed sleeve. According to the utility model, the right side of the protective layer is fixedly connected with the fixed sleeve, the right side of the fixed sleeve is movably connected with the telescopic loop bar, the surface of the telescopic loop bar is sleeved with the buffer spring, and the right side of the telescopic loop bar is fixedly connected with the baffle plate, so that the effect of buffering the impact force of water flow is achieved, the slope protection soil loss caused by impact can be effectively prevented, the fixed block is fixedly connected to the inner side of the fixed sleeve, the right side of the fixed block is fixedly connected with the return pipe, and the right side of the return pipe is fixedly connected with the water collecting cover, so that the further buffering effect is achieved.
assignees: GANSU PROVINCE GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING YARD

title_en: Urban power distribution network participation black start auxiliary service profit and capability assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for evaluating the benefits and the capabilities of an urban power distribution network participating in black start auxiliary service, which comprises the following steps: step S1, selecting two black start service market pricing modes, and constructing a black start service market settlement cost model comprising DG operator black start capacity compensation cost, DG operator black start use compensation cost and DG operator black start default reimbursement cost; wherein DG is a distributed power supply; and S2, determining an evaluation index of the black start capability of the distributed power supply for the auxiliary service market, and evaluating the benefits and the capability by adopting the evaluation index. Compared with the prior art, the method fully considers the complexity of the black start power restoration auxiliary service market pricing mode, is beneficial to encouraging operators to improve the black start capability of the unit, and excites the enthusiasm of participating in the black start service.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Evaluation method for ecological restoration effect of side slope of pumping and storing power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a slope ecological restoration effect evaluation method of a pumping and storage station, which comprises the following steps: constructing an ecological restoration effect evaluation index system; constructing an ecological restoration effect evaluation index set based on an ecological restoration effect evaluation index system, dividing the evaluation results of the evaluation indexes into a plurality of grades and constructing an evaluation grade set; the ecological restoration effect of the side slope of the pumping power storage station is evaluated through an ecological restoration effect evaluation index system, and the weight of each evaluation index in the ecological restoration effect evaluation index system is calculated through an entropy method based on the evaluation result, so that an evaluation index weight set is obtained; and constructing a fuzzy relation matrix of each evaluation index corresponding to each evaluation grade in the evaluation grade set, and carrying out multistage fuzzy comprehensive evaluation on the comprehensive evaluation index weight set and the fuzzy relation matrix to obtain an evaluation conclusion of the current pumping power storage station slope.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV FUZHOU

abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reduce its large loss unignored even by the nation and residents suffered from damage, about enormous expense and a long-term period for restoration although a small-scale disaster occurrence in natural disaster country Japan, damage and stress of a psychological aspect caused by a human injury, a life loss, a temporary refuge place living and a temporary house living not at all inferior to its result, and a severe blow to the psychological aspect of a human being by its large damage.  <P>SOLUTION: This invention is provided for combining, fixing and constructing a reinforced concrete sill, a ceramic block and a foundation steel frame in advance for attaining short-term restoration and cost reduction when an inclination and strain of the ground are caused by a disaster occurrence.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Disaster prevention interlocking system
abstract_en: To enable effectively utilizing system-interlocking by which simultaneous unlocking is performed for fire reception by reducing the simultaneous unlocking of an entry and exit management system interlocked with a non-fire alarm of a fire alarm system.SOLUTION: A fire receiver 14 transmits an information transfer signal to an entry and exit control panel 26 when receiving a fire signal via re-notifying of a fire sensor 16 after a predetermined time elapses from restoration by temporarily cutting off a power supply to the fire sensor 16 giving notice thereof for the restoration after the predetermined time elapses, when outputting a fire alarm by receiving the fire signal via notification of the fire sensor 16. title_en: Methods and systems for efficiently recovering from disaster damage to water treatment facilities through simulation
title_ko: 시뮬레이션을 통한 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: A method for efficiently recovering from disaster damage to water processing facilities according to an embodiment of the present invention relates to a method which, when a disaster occurs such as earthquakes, floods, and typhoons, decides a recovery order with respect to each water processing process facility included in water processing facilities through a simulation to efficiently recover from the disaster damage. The method for efficiently recovering from disaster damage to water processing facilities through a simulation may comprise: a facility information-obtaining step of obtaining facility information which is information with respect to each of first to N process facilities in which water processing processes of first to N steps are sequentially performed in water processing facilities; a basic information-obtaining step of obtaining basic information which is water quality information acceptable for each of the first to N process facilities; a measurement information-obtaining step of obtaining measurement information which is information measuring water quality with respect to each of the first to N process facilities; and a simulation step of generating priority information with respect to disaster damage recovery of each of the first to N process facilities when an actual disaster occurs by simulating disaster damage according to disaster occurrence on the basis of the facility information, basic information, and measurement information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법은 시뮬레이션을 통해 수처리 시설에 포함된 수처리 공정 시설 각각에 대해 복구 순서를 결정하여, 지진, 홍수, 태풍과 같이 실제로 재난이 발생했을 경우, 수처리 시설에 대해 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법에 관한 것으로서, 수처리 시설 내, 수처리 공정인 제1 단계 내지 제N 단계가 순차적으로 수행되는 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 정보인 시설 정보를 획득하는 시설 정보 획득 단계; 상기 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 허용 가능한 수질 정보인 기준 정보를 획득하는 기준 정보 획득 단계; 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 수질을 측정한 정보인 측정 정보를 획득하는 측정 정보 획득 단계; 상기 시설 정보, 상기 기준 정보 및 상기 측정 정보를 기초로 재난 발생에 따른 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 재난 피해를 시뮬레이션하여 실제 재난 발생 시, 재난피해 복구에 대한 우선순위 정보를 생성하는 시뮬레이션 단계;를 포함하는, 시뮬레이션을 통한 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법일 수 있다.

title_en: Barrier-free tripping system of ultrahigh voltage or high voltage circuit breaker
abstract_en: The invention discloses an obstacle-free tripping system of an extra-high voltage or high-voltage circuit breaker, which mainly comprises a power circuit with a voltage value larger than 600 volts, at least one circuit breaker, at least one current detection device, a current supply and reduction unit, at least one microswitch and a linkage device. By means of the structure, a breaker safety tripping device without extra power supply is arranged on any breaker of an ultrahigh voltage or high voltage power circuit, and by utilizing a simple mechanical action principle, when the breaker encounters a major accident disaster and the power supply of a tripping control circuit is damaged and powered off, so that the original designed tripping isolation function is lost, the self-emergency tripping breaker can still automatically and emergently trip to achieve self protection, the whole power system and a switch bus are not damaged by overlarge fault current, the power system is isolated in real time, and self power-off protection is performed; waiting for the last defense line of the power restoration at any time.

title_en: Groundwater level restoration prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of groundwater level prediction, in particular to a groundwater level recovery prediction method and a groundwater level recovery prediction system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of forming a time sequence matrix by collecting related data of each period affecting the change of the underground water level; obtaining a periodic hysteresis relation of the data according to the frequency spectrum curve relation of each row of data and the water level height data; obtaining an environmental change factor according to the periodic hysteresis relationship and the bias correlation coefficient of the groundwater flow, the flow speed and the flow direction data; obtaining a hydrologic environment influence factor according to the environment change factor, the period hysteresis of each row of data and the data distribution condition; and (3) improving the initial weight of each height data in the groundwater in the Adaboost algorithm according to the hydrologic environmental impact factor, and training the prediction result of the output water level height sample of the weak classifier. The method improves the robustness and accuracy of the Adaboost algorithm.

title_en: Water supply optimizing and scheduling method and system for water works
abstract_en: The invention provides a water supply optimizing and dispatching method and a system for a water supply plant, which relate to the technical field of resource dispatching and comprise the steps of obtaining real-time water supply data of a water supply route; the method comprises the steps of monitoring real-time water supply data of a water supply route to obtain real-time fault nodes and real-time fault information of the water supply route, inquiring scheduling requirements through a constructed emergency scheduling model based on the water supply route according to the real-time fault nodes and the real-time fault information to obtain scheduling requirement data corresponding to the real-time fault nodes, obtaining an optimal rush repair scheduling plan according to the scheduling requirement data, and executing corresponding scheduling tasks according to the optimal rush repair scheduling plan. The optimal scheduling method and the optimal scheduling system can improve the matching of the scheduled manpower and material resources and the fault site, and effectively improve the emergency repair efficiency.

title_en: Method and system for health rank based virtual machine restoration using a conformal framework
abstract_en: A method and system for health rank based virtual machine restoration using a conformal framework. With respect to enterprise data protection, solutions need to address two primary responsibilities: at the onset of failure or disaster, restore any running applications, as well as any lost or damaged data; and minimize (if not eliminate) the future occurrence of such failures or disasters. In tackling the latter responsibility, the disclosed method and system leverage health-score assessments to ensure the restoration of virtual machines onto healthy infrastructure. The aforementioned health-score assessments employ clustering to identify, and a conformal framework to rank, healthy hosts onto which virtual machines may be restored.

title_en: Multifunctional equipment for comprehensively managing coal gangue dumps
abstract_en: The utility model relates to multifunctional equipment for comprehensively managing coal gangue dumps, and belongs to the field of mining machinery and ecological restoration engineering multi-subject technologies. The multifunctional equipment has the advantages that the multifunctional equipment is mainly used for grouting shallow holes; the integral equipment which is provided with an independent framework and is suitable to be carried by different types of vehicles is modified on the basis of a forest mud fire-fighting truck, an additional belt gun driven by a screw pump (10) is specially used for a shallow hole grouting fire extinguishing and fireproofing paddle mixer system with a horizontal shaft, blades (17) can be repositioned and are detachably arranged on a rotary shaft (16), and the multifunctional equipment is specially provided with a water injection system and a safety operation platform (30); the multifunctional equipment is multifunctional, is particularly applicable to shallow hole grouting fire extinguishing, fireproofing and vegetation soil dressing for comprehensively managing the coal gangue dumps, also can be used for extinguishing fire in forests and spraying water in gardens, is easy to popularize and apply and can be easily manufactured on a large scale in a standard manner.

title_en: Quick and efficient reinforcing structure for side force resisting prestressed diagonal draw bar of urban bridge disaster damage pier stud
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick and efficient strengthening structure of an anti-side force prestressed diagonal draw bar of an urban bridge disaster damage pier stud, which comprises a concrete foundation bearing platform, a concrete pier stud, an anti-side force prestressed diagonal draw bar, a steel backing plate, a rejection area, a stress conversion angle steel, a structural adhesive and an anchor rod; the concrete foundation bearing platform is provided with a concrete pier column, a plurality of lateral force resisting prestressed diagonal draw bars are arranged at the column root of the concrete pier column, and a 45-degree included angle is formed between the bar body of each lateral force resisting prestressed diagonal draw bar and the horizontal plane of the concrete foundation bearing platform. The utility model discloses it is little only to need to reject the former pier stud protective layer area that partial pier stud concrete protective layer destroyed than the tradition and consolidate the restoration method to reduce and consolidate repair time and reduce the disaster and decrease bridge and resume to use required time and material, speed is faster, can also reduce the indirect economic loss because of bridge repair time is many and cause.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;CHINA ACADEMY OF BUILDING RES;NANJING SHENGYUAN CIVIL ENG HIGH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Steel frame structure staggered truss node with post-earthquake restorable function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel frame structure staggered truss node with a post-earthquake restorable function, and relates to the technical field of steel frame structures. This but steel frame structure staggered truss node with function is restoreed after shake, through setting up prestressing steel, friction power consumption board and power consumption coupling assembling etc., connect the girder steel of both sides by the prestressing steel of both sides, alleviate the burden of connecting piece, and realize friction power consumption through friction power consumption board, when the node takes place to deform, friction power consumption board is located friction rotation between the mechanical hinge, increase the power consumption effect, alleviate the atress of power consumption board, and carry out the centre gripping spacing through upper cover plate and lower cover plate to the power consumption board that slits, make things convenient for the restoration of power consumption board after shake, the practicality is improved, and then the stability of steel frame structure has been improved.
assignees: SHAANXI RAILWAY INST;UNIV XIAN ARCHITECTUR & TECH

title_en: Power distribution network big data restoration method based on countermeasure game
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network big data repairing method based on a countermeasure game, which relates to the technical field of electrical engineering, and adopts the technical scheme that a sample class label is obtained; building a generator frame; building a discriminator frame; training a network; and generating the missing data of the power distribution network according to the trained network. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the scheme adopts a mutual confrontation game model between a generator and a discriminator which are composed of a deep neural network. The generator tries to generate samples that are consistent with the true data distribution, and the discriminator discriminates as far as possible the samples generated by the generator, and the two networks advance together in an amount that is a trade-off between each other. The method can be used for establishing a conditional countermeasure game model with gradient punishment optimization to guide the generation process of the multi-class missing samples and overcome the problem of unstable training of the original countermeasure game model, so that the data missing problem caused by the influences of measurement faults, distributed energy and the like in the power distribution network can be solved.
assignees: CHINESE PETROCHEMICAL INDUSTRY LTD COMPANY;TECH DETECTION CENTER OF SHENGLI OIL FIELD BRANCH COMPANY OF CHINA PETROCHEMICAL INDUSTRY LIMITED CO;SHENGLI OILFIELD DETECTION EVALUATION RES LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent power grid fault handling system and method based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid fault intelligent disposal system based on a knowledge graph, wherein a fault disposal plan analysis module of the system is used for acquiring fault disposal entities and relation knowledge; the map generation module is used for storing the identified entity and the entity relation in a triple form to obtain an equipment entity knowledge map, an accident plan knowledge map and a disposal process knowledge map; the fault perception module intelligently perceives and collects information related to the power grid fault in the power grid system; the fault risk evaluation module is used for carrying out risk identification; the intelligent fault handling module is used for reasoning out handling measures suitable for the current fault based on the accident plan knowledge graph and the handling process knowledge graph and by combining topological changes before and after the power grid fault, the power flow and the alternating current power supply frequency after the power grid has the line fault. The comprehensive intelligent alarm system can sense comprehensive intelligent alarm information in an all-round way, and guides dispatching personnel to perform intelligent treatment on power grid risks and power restoration based on the established knowledge graph.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD ULANQAB ELECTRIC POWER BUREAU

title_en: Distribution network-based typical fault first-aid repair method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a first-aid repair method based on a typical fault of a distribution network, which comprises the following steps: disassembling links of a distribution network fault emergency repair process, and researching optimization promotion of multi-source data linkage of FA protection action information in a power distribution automation system, equipment defect hidden danger information in an intelligent inspection terminal and station area power failure and restoration information in a metering automation system on each link of emergency repair; establishing a new mode and a new flow of distribution network line fault emergency repair with multi-professional cooperation of scheduling, emergency repair, operation, protection and customer service, and forming a 'one-line one-strategy' emergency repair operation instruction template; an active first-aid repair system which is suitable for the operation characteristics of a regional distribution network is researched, the information data requirements of all service departments in the first-aid repair link are cooperated, new mode application is developed in a test point area and a test point line, and the application effect of feedback analysis is collected. The invention realizes the timely inquiry and cooperative operation of fault points, solves various problems in time, avoids delaying the rush repair opportunity and increasing the safety risk and reduces complaints.

title_en: Power distribution network recovery method based on controllable recovery output of photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network recovery method based on controllable recovery output of photovoltaic power generation, which comprises the following steps: acquiring weather information and photovoltaic equipment information of a prediction day, and predicting photovoltaic output by adopting a photovoltaic output prediction method based on multi-factor correction; generating a photovoltaic output prediction curve according to a photovoltaic output prediction result, decomposing the photovoltaic output prediction curve, and decomposing the photovoltaic power station into a plurality of virtual power supply combinations which are available in a specific period and controllable in output power; selectively recovering unrecovered charges by adopting constraint conditions according to the power distribution network and virtual power supply data, constructing an objective function, and solving to obtain an island division result and a load recovery sequence; and recovering the power distribution network according to the island division result and the load recovery sequence. The invention reduces the influence of photovoltaic output fluctuation on the recovery of the power system, so that the system has higher stability and reliability.

title_en: Geological ecological restoration evaluation method and system for preventing and controlling geological disasters, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration evaluation, and provides a geological ecological restoration evaluation method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for preventing and treating geological disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of researching data acquisition, setting of geological disaster types, initial evaluation, data preprocessing, model construction and training, risk determination before restoration, information acquisition after restoration, geological disaster risk prediction and geological ecological restoration evaluation; according to the method, the model is trained by utilizing the remote sensing image, the sound wave data and the initial evaluation data, prediction of an evaluation result by the remote sensing image and the sound wave data is achieved, difficulty and time of risk evaluation are reduced, in addition, surface features and structural features are simultaneously extracted by combining the remote sensing with the sound wave, a prediction effect of the model is optimized, the sensing capability of surrounding environment is improved by a multi-mode adjacent sensing model, prediction precision of a single block is improved, and a repair effect evaluation mechanism is optimized by a repair effect evaluation rule.

title_en: Power grid outage plan optimization method and system based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid dispatching and intelligent optimization, and discloses a power grid outage plan optimization method and system based on multi-agent reinforcement learning. The system comprises a node importance evaluation model based on a power grid topological structure and operation data, a node importance coefficient vector is calculated, a steady-state power flow equation and steady-state operation constraint are constructed, node steady-state voltage, current and branch steady-state power flow power are obtained, an optimization model aiming at minimizing power supply loss of important nodes and system out-of-limit risk is established, an optimal switching operation and transfer scheme is determined, a multi-agent system comprising a switching operation agent, a load transfer agent and an overhaul scheduling agent is designed, an optimal strategy set is obtained by utilizing a concentrated training and decentralized execution mechanism, a power outage plan and transfer path are optimized, and a power outage sequence and a power restoration strategy are output. The method realizes the intellectualization, the dynamics and the self-adaptive optimization of the power failure scheme, and effectively improves the safety and the economy of the power grid overhaul plan.
assignees: SHENYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Storage aggregate restoration
abstract_en: One or more techniques and/or systems are provided for controlling restoration of a storage aggregate. For example, a local storage device, located at a first storage site, and a remote storage device, located at a second storage site, may be assigned to a first storage aggregate. Responsive to a disaster of the first storage site, a gate may be created for the local storage device. The gate may block automated reconstruction and/or automated synchronization that may otherwise occur with respect to the local storage device. Until the local storage device is restored, the remote storage device may be used to service I/O requests that were otherwise directed to the local storage device. Responsive to receiving a user restoration command, the gate may be removed from the local storage device. Synchronization between the local storage device and the remote storage device may then be facilitated.

title_en: Secure data replication to, and recovery of data from, air-gapped data storage pools
abstract_en: An illustrative air-gapped data storage site for storing secure copies at the air-gapped storage site. Using specialized air-gapped media agents installed within the air-gapped storage pool site, the illustrative system, at an unpredictable time, establishes a one-way tunnel from secondary storage site to air-gapped site to receive backup copies of the data stored at primary site. In another embodiment, during disaster recovery, backup copies stored within the air-gapped site are replicated to a non-air gapped site (e.g., secondary storage pools) as “tertiary copies.” Those copies are then restored to the primary site in original application data formats for quick recovery. As restoration of data is complete, the tertiary copies are promoted to “secondary copies” to receive incremental backups.

title_en: Mining area ecological environment restoration system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mining area ecological environment restoration system, which relates to the field of ecological restoration, and aims to solve the problem that landslide disasters can occur under the rainy condition in the current ecological environment restoration scheme, and the environmental restoration effect is poor, the system comprises a waterproof layer laid on a side slope and a bearing component arranged on the upper side of the waterproof layer, wherein the bearing component comprises a plurality of mutually connected bearing trays, each bearing tray comprises a bottom plate and side plates vertically and fixedly connected at the edge positions of four sides of the bottom plate, the outer side surfaces of the side plates are respectively and fixedly connected with a clamping block, the outer side surfaces of the side plates are provided with clamping grooves, and the two bearing trays are attached to ensure that the clamping blocks are respectively embedded into the corresponding clamping grooves; the bottom plate is respectively provided with a plurality of through holes; a plurality of fixed drill rods are respectively arranged on the bottom plate and penetrate through the bottom plate to be inserted into the side slope; the bearing tray is provided with a soil improvement layer. The utility model discloses have the promotion and carry out prosthetic effect to the ecology, reduce the effect that phenomenons such as landslide appear.
assignees: BEIKUANGCHENG ECOLOGICAL TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power grid dispatching and field operation ticket generating method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for generating a power grid dispatching and field operation ticket, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a line to be powered off in a GIS single line diagram and/or a main switch distribution diagram; the line to be power-off is used for determining a power-off line segment; determining head-end equipment and tail-end equipment in the power failure line section; generating a corresponding operation task description based on the head-end equipment and the tail-end equipment; collecting the operation task description, the head-end equipment and the tail-end equipment to generate a scheduling power-off operation order; the scheduling power-off operation ticket comprises: the method comprises the following steps of (1) power failure line segment information, head end equipment information, tail end equipment information, operation step information and operation project information; and identifying the operation step information and the operation item information, and generating a corresponding field power failure and power restoration operation order by combining the operation task description. Therefore, the method replaces the mode that the existing dispatcher and field personnel agree to fill in the operation ticket, and the dispatching efficiency is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Fire-fighting injection water track real-time restoration simulation algorithm and application thereof in virtual environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time restoration simulation algorithm for a fire-fighting water monitor jet flow track and application thereof in a virtual environment, wherein hardware equipment required for predicting the jet flow track is less and calculation speed is higher by a mathematical calculation mode of adding a correction coefficient, and a corrected fire-fighting water monitor jet flow track model based on an air resistance theory can accurately and effectively predict the fire-fighting water monitor jet flow track in a Unity virtual scene so as to improve the accuracy of predicting the fire-fighting water monitor jet flow track and verify an established model by an actual jet flow track. The fire-fighting water injection track real-time restoration simulation algorithm and the application thereof in a virtual environment are characterized in that an object pool technology is adopted, an instantiation object of a water drop preform is stored instead of being directly destroyed when the fire-fighting water injection track real-time restoration simulation algorithm is not used, and the cached object is directly given to the user when the fire-fighting water injection track real-time restoration simulation algorithm is used next time without being instantiated, so that resources are fully utilized, the process is accelerated, and the system performance is improved.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Ultrasonic metering instrument data management method, device and equipment based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses ultrasonic metering device data management method, device and equipment based on the Internet of things, relate to the technical field of data management, through increasing outage and keep the module, under the circumstances that power module cuts off the power supply, can immediately switch to outage and keep the module according to outage signal fast and supply power, ultrasonic metering device object platform independent work, do not interact with other platforms in the Internet of things system, the operation data during outage is gathered in ultrasonic metering device object platform inside, the quantity of ultrasonic metering devices that is inserted at present is confirmed immediately in response to the power restoration signal, the ultrasonic metering devices that make it switch to the power module when supplying power are fewer under the circumstances that its is less than threshold value quantity, each platform is interconnected again, upload outage operation data to gas management platform by ultrasonic metering device object platform, even if there is outage condition, the Internet of things system also can all acquire complete information in order to realize gas data's management.
assignees: CHENGDU QINCHUAN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic data repair method, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic data restoration method, a device, equipment and a computer readable storage medium, which take periodicity and seasonality of photovoltaic output data into consideration, adopt a K-means++ clustering algorithm to cluster photovoltaic data according to weather types, then independently train each clustered cluster, namely a data set of each class, to generate an anti-filling network to fill the class of missing data, and pre-fill an original photovoltaic historical output sequence containing the missing data by using the generated anti-filling network before clustering the photovoltaic data to obtain a complete pre-filling sequence, and then cluster the complete sequence after pre-filling by using the K-means++ algorithm, thereby improving the restoration accuracy and robustness of the missing data and solving the technical problems that the existing data restoration method does not take the seasonality and the periodicity of the photovoltaic data into consideration, and the restoration accuracy and robustness of the missing data are lower.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Geological environment treatment and ecological restoration method for abandoned mine
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a geological governance and ecological restoration method for abandoned mines, and belongs to the technical field of mine geological disaster governance and ecological environment restoration. The geological environment treatment and ecological restoration method for the abandoned mine comprises the following steps: performing current situation investigation on the abandoned mine to obtain investigation results; the presence survey includes: geological, environmental and ecological aspects; designing a geological governance scheme for survey results of the geological aspects in the current situation survey; designing an environmental governance scheme for a survey result of the environmental aspect in the current situation survey; an ecological restoration scheme is designed for the results of the ecological aspects in the current situation survey. Solves the problems of geological treatment and ecological restoration of abandoned mines.
assignees: ENERGY SAVING AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROT CO LTD MCC GROUP;CENTRAL RES INST BUILDING & CONSTR CO LTD MCC GROUP

title_en: Recovery strategy generation method and device suitable for fault rush repair, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recovery strategy generation method, a device, a terminal device and a storage medium suitable for fault first-aid repair, which are used for constructing a first-aid repair scheduling model for measuring the efficiency of the fault first-aid repair and a communication recovery scheduling model for measuring the recovery speed of a communication network, so that the first-aid repair capacity of a construction team, the power supply capacity of a power supply and the recovery requirement of a power distribution network path can be comprehensively considered, the first-aid repair resources of the construction team, a mobile power supply and the like are comprehensively and cooperatively scheduled, and the utilization efficiency of the first-aid repair resources is improved. The invention also fully considers the fault rush-repair and recovery of the communication network, ensures that the state of the router can be adjusted in time, and the switch can be operated normally, thereby avoiding the limitation of the recovery of the power distribution network due to the communication problem.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Underwater data center annular layout method combining offshore wind turbine pile foundation scour inhibition and ecological breeding
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater data center annular layout method combining offshore wind turbine pile foundation scouring inhibition and ecological breeding, and belongs to the technical field of offshore wind power engineering. The method solves the scouring problem of the pile foundation of the offshore wind power facility caused by ocean currents and waves. The method comprises the steps of arranging a plurality of UDC modules on the seabed around the pile foundation of the offshore wind turbine to form annular layout, inducing water flow to form reverse secondary vortex so as to reduce the main vortex strength, and arranging an ecological breeding system above the annular area, wherein the ecological breeding system comprises an algae plant area positioned at the upper layer, a mollusc breeding area positioned at the middle layer and a sedimentation area positioned at the lower layer. The annular layout and the biological anti-scour mechanism of the ecological breeding system cooperate to realize comprehensive optimization of ecological restoration, carbon sink gain and economic benefit, and the ecological anti-scour system is suitable for various offshore wind power installation environments, and is particularly suitable for high scour risk or typhoon frequent areas.

title_en: Multi-source data sorting and conveying method for power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides a power plant multisource data arrangement and transportation method, which comprises the steps of constructing a multiscale data alignment model, using a B spline curve fitting algorithm to perform time axis mapping, introducing data with large time deviation into a quantum genetic algorithm to optimize a time window, carrying out data fusion, using an improved Dempster-Shafer synthesis rule, combining cloud model quantization uncertainty, carrying out gray correlation analysis on key parameters to calculate correlation, carrying out abnormal data detection and restoration, using an improved isolated forest algorithm to detect, kalman filtering interpolation restoration, implementing data transportation optimization, using an ant colony algorithm optimization route, using a fountain code technology of LDPC codes to schedule real-time data by using a token bucket algorithm, constructing LSTM and ESN fusion model prediction trend, and updating parameters by a sliding window. The intelligent level of the power plant data management is improved, and the intelligent level and the decision accuracy of the power plant data management are improved by the method.
