assignees: HUBEI GUCHENG YINLONG ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Landslide barrier lake landform utilization and restoration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide barrier lake landform utilization restoration method, which comprises the steps of carrying out backfill back pressure on a slope foot river channel at the front edge of a landslide, respectively arranging reinforced concrete retaining walls at the two ends of the upper and lower ends of a backfill back pressure area to firmly backfill back pressure area backfill bodies and intercept water coming from the upper stream of a river channel to form a water storage area, arranging reinforced concrete flood discharge sand holes in foundation rocks of a stable mountain outside the landslide area in a linear mode, connecting the inlet end of the flood discharge sand holes with the river channel bank of the upper stream water storage area, connecting the outlet end of the flood discharge sand holes with the bank slope of the lower stream river channel, constructing water pumping stations and pipeline water lifting in a geological stable area of the water storage area, introducing water storage into the landslide area, and carrying out land recycling in the landslide area.
assignees: INST OF GEOLOGY AND NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION GANSU ACADEMY OF SCIENCE

title_en: Earthquake damage evaluating system for water pipe network using asset management, and method for the same
title_ko: 자산관리를 이용한 상수관망의 지진피해 평가 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Provided are an earthquake damage evaluating system for a water pipe network using asset management and a method thereof which classify attributes for each segment of a water pipe network, predict a deterioration degree of each attribute, accurately predict earthquake damage of the water pipe network based on this, accurately predict damage to the water pipe network when an earthquake occurs, and easily perform decision-making on earthquake damage restoration, including a restoration priority, restoration costs, and a restoration period.
abstract_ko: 상수관망의 체계적인 관리를 위해 자산관리기법을 이용하여 상수관망의 세그먼트별 속성을 분류하여 각각의 속성의 노후도를 예측하고, 이를 기반으로 정밀한 지진피해를 예측할 수 있고, 또한, 지진 발생시 상수관망의 피해를 정밀하게 예측하고, 회복의 우선순위, 회복비용 및 회복기간을 포함하는 지진피해 복구에 대한 의사결정을 을 용이하게 수행할 수 있는, 자산관리를 이용한 상수관망의 지진피해 평가 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH;UNIV DANKOOK IACF

title_en: The power failure restorative procedure of power failure repair system and the application system
abstract_en: The present invention provides the power failure restorative procedures of a kind of power failure repair system and the application system.Wherein, which includes controlling main website, the one or more control sub-stations connecting with control main website and the one or more connecting with each control sub-station to execute station；Station is executed to connect with the element in electric system；Control main website is for monitoring fault restoration strategy is broken down and determined to electric system whether；It is also used to obtain the quantity of controlled member and the weight coefficient of control sub-station to one or more control sub-stations, and fault restoration strategy is decomposed；Control sub-station is for decomposing fault restoration substrategy according to the quantity of controlled member；Station is executed for determining strategy execution object according to preset strategy execution rule, fault restoration policy unit is executed to strategy execution object.The present invention improves the efficiency of power failure reparation.

title_en: Ecological self-repairing system and construction method for artificial tidal flat
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial tidal flat ecological self-repairing system, which belongs to the technical field of coastal wetland ecological repairing and comprises a highland, a transverse artificial tidal flat, a longitudinal artificial tidal flat, a layered coastal wetland system and an open sea; the transverse artificial tidal channels and the longitudinal artificial tidal channels are arranged between the beaches in a staggered mode to form a net structure, so that tidal water from open sea can freely flow in the middle; the layered coastal wetland system is a transition zone between a beach and a transverse artificial tidal channel and between the beach and a longitudinal artificial tidal channel; the transverse artificial tidal channel and the longitudinal artificial tidal channel are used for introducing tidal water, so that the ecological and biological diversity of the system is restored; when the wave and tide action is strong, a protection project is built in open sea. The invention also discloses a construction method thereof, which effectively regulates the action of waves and tides so as to reduce natural disasters; the coastal wetland can effectively degrade pollution and restore the original ecological system and natural balance mechanism; through ecological restoration, the diversity of species is increased.

title_en: Method for determining proper planting distance for vegetation ecological restoration in arid region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining a proper planting distance for vegetation ecological restoration in a arid region, which comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring soil parameters and soil water parameters of a research area; step 2, determining vegetation parameters of a research area; step 3, collecting hydrologic data of a research area; step 4, determining the transpiration quantity of dominant plant species of vegetation communities in the research area; step 5, calculating the thickness of the diving influence layer in the research area; step 6, determining the thickness of the absorbable utilization layer; step 7, determining the water content in the thickness of the absorbable utilization layer; step 8, determining a proper planting distance of vegetation; the method can effectively solve the problem of desertification of the oasis in the arid region, and provides reliable theoretical and technical support for guiding ecological restoration and reasonable development and utilization of groundwater resources.

title_en: Post-disaster power communication network collaborative recovery system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid dispatching and communication network recovery, and provides a post-disaster power communication network collaborative recovery system and a post-disaster power communication network collaborative recovery method, wherein the system comprises a power network model, a power distribution system and a communication network collaborative recovery system, wherein the power network model is used for distributing power supply resources to each node by taking power supply of power network nodes of a shortest time recovery target area as a target; the system comprises a line restoration model, an electric vehicle path planning model, an unmanned aerial vehicle deployment communication network restoration model, an optimal scheme solving unit and a power communication network node, wherein the line restoration model is used for taking an electric vehicle as a load supply and mobile restoration unit, and realizing joint optimization of power network topology reconstruction and power restoration of a target area by coordinating path planning and resource allocation of the electric vehicle, the electric vehicle path planning model is used for taking maximum restoration of power supply of the target area as a target, enabling the electric vehicle to quickly restore the power network within a limited time by optimizing a moving path of the electric vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle deployment communication network restoration model is used for taking minimum restoration of the communication network as a target, and combining cooperative work of the electric vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle is deployed as a temporary air base station while power is supplied by a base station node, and the optimal scheme solving unit is provided with a layered multi-target optimization problem for maximizing total power communication coverage time as a target function under the condition of minimizing the restoration time of the power communication network.

title_en: Urban subway network toughness pre-disaster-post-disaster double-stage optimization method under flood disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a pre-disaster-post-disaster double-stage optimization method for toughness of an urban subway network under a flood disaster, which comprises the steps of obtaining urban subway network information, road network information and flood disaster information, constructing an urban subway topological network and a road topological network, simulating flood depth space-time changes in the subway and the road network during the duration of the flood disaster, judging a subway network failure station set based on water accumulation depth, calculating flood control resource demand based on the number of stations, the types of the stations and the flood depth of each station in the failure station set, establishing and solving a pre-disaster-post double-stage optimization model for toughness of the urban subway network to obtain an optimal pre-disaster closing station decision, a flood control resource warehouse site selection decision and a post-disaster restoration decision, wherein the double-stage optimization model is a double-layer planning model, and an upper-layer model and a lower-layer model are mutually coupled and optimized through a pre-disaster closing station set and a post-disaster restoration process.

title_en: seismic device for distribution board
title_ko: 진동 감쇠 기능을 가지는 수배전반용 내진장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a seismic device for a distribution board and, more specifically, to a seismic device for a distribution board with a vibration damping function capable of minimizing damage to electric devices of a distribution board by effectively reducing and absorbing energy when a shock or a vibration produced from an earthquake occurs. According to the present invention, the seismic device comprises: an upper housing fixed to a lower part of a cubicle frame; a lower housing fixed to an upper part of a foundation frame installed on a concrete floor; a buffer member interposed between the upper and lower housings; a compression spring interposed between the upper and lower housings; assembly bolts and nuts penetrating the cubicle frame, the upper and lower housings, the buffer member and the compression spring to assemble the components; and an elastic plate interposed between the upper and lower housings and having its own elastic restoration force through an elastic adhesion part protruding convexly. Therefore, a vibration is effectively absorbed through the elastic plate having its own elastic restoration force, the buffer member and the compression spring and, in particular, the elastic adhesion part absorbs large vibrations and an elastic curved part absorbs small vibrations so both large and small vibrations can be effectively absorbed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 수배전반용 내진장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 지진 등의 진동이나 충격 발생 시 그 에너지를 효과적으로 감소 및 흡수시켜 수배전반의 전력기기 피해를 최소화하는 진동 감쇠 기능을 가지는 수배전반용 내진장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 수배전반용 내진장치는, 큐비클 프레임 하부에 고정 설치되는 상부 하우징; 콘크리트 바닥에 설치되는 기초 프레임 상부에 고정되는 하부 하우징; 상기 상부 하우징과 하부 하우징 사이에 개재되는 완충부재; 상기 상부 하우징과 하부 하우징 사이에 개재되는 압축 스프링; 상기 큐비클 프레임, 상부 하우징, 하부 하우징, 완충부재, 압축 스프링을 관통하여 조립하는 조립볼트 및 너트; 및 상부 하우징과 하부 하우징 사이에 개재되며 볼록하게 돌출되는 탄성 밀착부에 의해 자체 탄성 복원력을 가지는 탄성판; 으로 구성되어, 자체 탄성 복원력을 가지는 탄성판, 완충부재, 압축 스프링에 의해 진동을 효과적으로 흡수하고, 특히, 큰 진동 발생 시 탄성 밀착부에서 흡수하고, 작은 진동 발생 시 탄성 절곡부에서 흡수하여 큰 진동과 작은 진동 모두 효과적으로 흡수하는 효과가 있다.
assignees: DAE SAN ENG CO LTD;DONGSAN TECK CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode operation breathing type tidal flow constructed wetland
abstract_en: A multi-mode operation breathing type tidal flow constructed wetland and an operation method thereof relate to the technical fields of natural ecological restoration, ecological comprehensive treatment of rivers and lakes and environmental protection, and comprise a surface flow constructed wetland system, a lifting pump station, a water inlet distribution valve well, a tidal flow subsurface flow constructed wetland system, a water outlet flow making well, a deep total nitrogen removal constructed wetland unit, a water outlet valve well and a river and lake water body, wherein the tidal flow subsurface flow constructed wetland system operates according to the multi-modes of the tidal flow constructed wetland, namely, four stage periods of water inlet, inundation, water discharge and emptying, simulate the natural tide law of seawater, and realize multi-mode operation repeatedly; the tidal flow wetland is operated in a multi-mode, intermittent water inflow and instant water drainage are carried out, and the wetland bed can be more beneficial to the removal of pollutants in a shorter submerging time and a longer emptying time.
assignees: HEBEI HENGTE ENVIRONMENTAL PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Slope ecological restoration structure of damaged mountain
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of slope restoration, and particularly relates to a slope ecological restoration structure of a damaged mountain. The technology includes concrete layer, the concrete layer has been seted up a plurality of and has been used for planting the logical groove of vegetation, is provided with the manger plate frame that is used for the rainwater to shunt in the logical inslot, is provided with the stock that is used for being connected with the mountain body between the logical groove. According to the utility model, the concrete layer is arranged to facilitate the protection of the mountain surface to avoid landslide, the anchor rod is arranged to facilitate the connection between the concrete layer and the mountain, so that the firmness and stability of the mountain are improved, and the water flowing over the mountain and the soil sliding down are conveniently blocked and split by the arrangement of the water retaining frame, so that the influence on vegetation is conveniently reduced, and the soil erosion caused by direct scouring of the vegetation is conveniently avoided.
assignees: GANNAN TIBETAN AUTONOMOUS PREFECTURE ECOLOGICAL ENV BUREAU

title_en: Ecological restoration system for habitat of buffer area of river and gulf
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a habitat ecological restoration system of a buffer area of a warehouse river bay, which comprises the warehouse river bay and river banks arranged on two sides of the warehouse river bay, wherein a river bed is arranged on one side of the river bank, which is close to the center of the warehouse river bay, a plurality of river dams are arranged on one side of the river bed and the other river bank, which is close to the center of the warehouse river bay, floating beds are arranged in the river bed and on the downstream of the river dam, and aquatic plants are planted on the periphery of the river bed and the river dam. The ground ecological restoration system can achieve the purposes of effectively improving the biodiversity of the buffer area of the reservoir and river, restoring the habitat, preventing the disaster caused by heavy rain and reducing the peak value of flood peak.
assignees: URBAN PLANNING & DESIGN INST CO LTD OF SHENZHEN

title_en: System for fuzzy evaluation of underground gas pipe net risk
abstract_en: The utility model provides a system for a fuzzy assessment on the risk of the underground fuel gas pipe network, which comprises an information acquisition input end and an enterprise management end connected through the network; wherein, the information acquisition input end is arranged into a plurality of computers which can receive and output the test data related to a gas pipeline and the environmental data around the gas pipeline; the enterprise management end comprises a pipeline subsection management module, a management module of information around a pipeline section, a pipeline fuzzy risk assessment module, a pipeline risk pre-alarming module and an auxiliary management module; and the computers of the information acquisition input end are connected with the enterprise management end through the network. The  system for a fuzzy assessment on the risk of the underground fuel gas pipe network establishes an integrated underground fuel gas pipe network safety assessment system through a network connection of the information acquisition end and the enterprise management end and the cooperation of four modules of the enterprise management end by using the computer technology, thus realizing the goal of Tracking inspection-safety assessment-programmatic restoration, and changing a positive emergency repairing method of the gas leakage rescue into an active safe inspection and assessment management mode.

title_en: Power distribution network dynamic power restoration method based on load curve
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network dynamic power restoration method based on a load curve, which belongs to the technical field of power distribution system automation. The method utilizes a computer, realizes computing through programs and comprises the steps of inputting basic parameters; computing active load and reactive load of each node in each hour and determining a grid structure in normal operation; determining a fault section, a power supply path of the power side of the fault section and a grid structure after failure isolation; applying a traditional genetic algorithm to determine a candidate grid structure set of the least loss load in each hour during fault restoration; finally determining the optimum dynamic power restoration scheme during fault restoration. The method fully utilizes the load curve, and the dynamic restoration scheme is formulated by hour, so that the grid structure changes along with the change of the load during fault restoration, and accordingly, the method has the characteristics of being capable of effectively reducing power failure areas caused by fault, shortening power failure time for users, reducing the power failure loss of the users, and the like. The method can be widely applied to power distribution network power restoration.

title_en: BIM-based building group earthquake damage simulation visualization system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of earthquake disaster early warning analysis, and relates to a building group earthquake disaster simulation visualization system and method based on BIM, which comprises a user management module, a model management module and a model display module, wherein the user management module comprises a user query unit and a user deletion unit, the model management module comprises a model query unit, a model upload unit, a model deletion unit and a time-course data upload unit, the model display comprises a BIM three-dimensional model display unit, a BIM model shaking display unit, a BIM model collapse display unit, a BIM damage display unit and a regional fire simulation unit, so that accurate modeling from appearance design to internal structure of a building entity can be realized, high-fidelity restoration of conditions such as shaking, collapsing and damage of the building group when an earthquake disaster occurs is realized, the expansion of earthquake disaster prevention and reduction series work is facilitated, and earthquake disaster damage in urban regions is effectively reduced.

title_en: Real-time power failure and restoration identification method, device and system based on power big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time power failure and restoration identification method based on large electric power data, which comprises the steps of constructing a data transmission platform by additionally installing related detection equipment and transmission equipment through a fixed structure, and guaranteeing the reliability and timeliness of the data; acquiring power failure power restoration data of the equipment in real time, and judging whether a power failure power restoration event occurs according to the power failure power restoration data; if no power failure and power restoration event occurs, finishing the research and judgment, and if the power failure and power restoration event occurs, entering the research and judgment; analyzing event information according to the power-down power restoration data, and acquiring related information of the event information; judging whether the event is power failure or power restoration according to the event information, and pushing related information. The real-time push of the stop point emergency repair situation and the duplicate electricity to the actual affected users, thereby realizing the accurate and humanized push of the information, improving the service quality and reducing the occurrence of complaint events.

title_en: Distribution network fault rush-repair method, rush-repair scheduling system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a distribution network fault rush-repair method, a rush-repair scheduling system and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical rush repair information of a plurality of distribution network fault worksheets and a plurality of rush repair personnel; classifying the multiple distribution network fault worksheets to obtain multiple types of distribution network fault worksheets, and determining fault keywords of each type of distribution network fault worksheets; determining the rush-repair keywords of each rush-repair person according to the history rush-repair information of each rush-repair person; for each type of distribution network fault work order set, determining the matching degree between the type of distribution network fault work order set and each rush repair person according to the fault keywords of the type of distribution network fault work order set and the rush repair keywords of each rush repair person; and determining the rush-repair teams for processing each type of distribution network fault work order set according to each matching degree, and issuing corresponding rush-repair tasks to the rush-repair teams for processing each type of distribution network fault work order set. The application can ensure the working reliability of the distribution network.
assignees: INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION BRANCH COMPANY STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Active power distribution network fault rush-repair method and system considering road-source uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for proactively repairing faults of an active power distribution network by considering the uncertainty of a road-source, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring daily road saturation data, constructing a road network uncertainty scene set by using a road impedance function, and determining a scheduling constraint condition of a rush repair person considering the road network uncertainty; constructing a distributed power supply uncertainty set according to a sunlight photovoltaic output prediction curve, and determining a power distribution network reconstruction and island division constraint condition considering the distributed power supply uncertainty; and coupling the traffic network with the power distribution network, establishing a robust optimization model of the road-source uncertainty, solving the robust optimization model of the road-source uncertainty, and generating a power distribution network fault rush-repair scheduling strategy. The invention can simultaneously account for the uncertainty of the two layers of the traffic network and the power distribution network, and accurately delineates the passing time uncertainty set, thereby not only ensuring the feasibility of a dispatching scheme, but also considering the recovery efficiency of the power distribution network faults.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Power system restoration decision method based on LSTM neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an LSTM neural network-based power system recovery decision method, relates to the technical field of power system recovery, and solves the problems that photovoltaic prediction is not accurate enough and decision output is not complete enough in power system recovery. According to the invention, the photovoltaic output prediction LSTM network is trained through the collected data such as time, irradiance, humidity, air pressure, actual photovoltaic output power and the like, the power output data of a future time period is accurately predicted based on the photovoltaic output prediction LSTM network, and the output of a recovery decision of the power system is carried out based on the predicted data, so that the hysteresis of the recovery decision of the power system is eliminated. In the process of recovering the decision-making output of the power system, the invention takes the most recovered load quantity as an objective function, and constraint conditions comprise unit state constraint, load state constraint, power balance constraint of the power system and the like, thereby further ensuring the accuracy and the effectiveness of the recovery decision-making of the power system.

title_en: Multi-strategy-enhanced African bald-awkward algorithm-based pump station multi-objective optimal scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pump station multi-objective optimization scheduling method based on a multi-strategy enhanced African baldness algorithm, and relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering. By acquiring basic data of operation of a pump station, establishing a multi-objective optimization scheduling model taking the minimum electric charge and the minimum water shortage square sum of a water receiving area during operation of the pump station as an objective function, taking the constraint conditions of water pump power constraint, water pump pumping capacity constraint and water pump starting number constraint as constraint conditions, establishing a multi-objective optimization scheduling model adopting a crowding degree distance ordering mechanism and a hypercube mechanism to select double leaders to guide a population, adopting an archiving-based cross variation strategy to reduce the possibility of the multi-objective algorithm to sink into local optimum, adopting a multi-strategy enhanced multi-objective African pattern bald algorithm for restoring out-of-limits solutions after a main cycle is finished by adopting a progressive restoration strategy, so as to enhance the competitiveness of the population to ensure the diversity of the population, and adopting the multi-strategy enhanced multi-objective African pattern bald algorithm to conduct multi-objective optimization scheduling simulation of the pump station, thereby being capable of improving the operation efficiency of the pump station.
assignees: CHONGQING WEST WATER RESOURCES DEV CO LTD;UNIV YANGZHOU;CHONGQING YUFA WATER CONSERVANCY SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of pier-type road
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a construction method of a pier-type road combining early opening of a road at the disaster restoration or the like and subsequent proper restoration work.  <P>SOLUTION: The height of each of a plurality of driven steel pipe piles 3 is set to a predetermined height, and then a cylindrical pile head cap 2 with a plate member 12 mounted to the upper part is put on the head top of each steel pipe pile 3. A plurality of bolts 13 are screwed into threaded holes of nuts 18 welded to a cylindrical part 11 of each pile head cap 2, from the outside of the cylindrical part 11, and the outer periphery of the steel pipe pile 3 is pressed by the tip parts of the bolts 13 to fix the pile head cap 2 to the head top of the steel pipe pile 3. An H-shape steel cross beam 4 is fixed to the plate members 12 of a plurality of pile head caps 2 by bolts 15 and nuts 16, and H-shape steel main girders 5 are fixed to the H-shape steel cross beam 4 by bolts 15 and nuts 16. Lining plates 6 are laid on the H-shape steel main girders 5.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Solar power generation module, solar battery cel coating member, and solar power generation system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To secure safety at the time of maintenance work or disaster restoration work of solar power generation system.SOLUTION: A solar power generation module 1 comprises: a solar battery cell 10 which converts the energy of sunlight incident on a light receiving surface into electric energy; and a dimmer film 11 which covers the light-receiving surface of the solar battery cell 10 and which switches between a light transmitted state and a light shielded state depending on the presence of voltage application. In a solar power generation system 200, the dimmer film 11 is connected to a commercial power supply 60. The dimmer film 11 is placed into a light transmitted state by voltage application. Sunlight is incident on the light-receiving surface of the solar battery cell 10, thereby generating electric power. When voltage application to the dimmer film 11 stops, the dimmer film 11 is placed into a light shielded state. Sunlight incident on the light-receiving surface of the solar battery cell 10 is shielded and power generation is thereby stopped.

title_en: A kind of spontaneous combustionof coal is burnt the ecological restoration and management method in hidden danger district
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of spontaneous combustionof coal and burn ecological restoration and management method and the standard in hidden danger district, it is a kind of relatively fragile and have Mode of Ecologic Restoration and the technology of the Gullied Rolling Loess Region of disaster hidden-trouble for ecological environment that object is to provide, to meet the needs of its large area Ecological Restoration Works. The present invention is made ground, carries out erosion and torrent control works, is utilized engineering and biological method to reclaim, finally carry out a series of ecological recovery methods such as planting greening by the mining limit, mode limit that the stripping of utilization table soil resource is dug, interior row combines with outer row, for the ecological recovery of administering district provides method and technology.

title_en: Interface process-based underground water pollution risk rapid assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly evaluating underground water pollution risks based on an interface process, which comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out investigation on site pollution conditions and hydrogeological conditions, S2, constructing a site conceptual model based on site pollution conditions and hydrogeological condition investigation results, determining the distance between polluted soil and underground water-bearing layers, inquiring the underground water function classification of an area where a site is located, determining a protection target value of underground water, S3, calculating attenuation coefficients of pollutant distribution processes in different soil textures, S4, calculating attenuation coefficients of a gas-over-air belt soil layer transmission process, S5, calculating the total attenuation coefficient of pollutants entering the underground water-bearing layers, S6, calculating the concentration of the pollutants entering the underground water, S7, evaluating whether the pollutants in soil enter the underground water to pollute the underground water, S8, and calculating a soil restoration target value aiming at the condition that the evaluation result is the pollutants which can pollute the underground water.

title_en: Irrigation method for ecological restoration of high-steep side slope in alpine region
abstract_en: The invention provides an irrigation method for ecological restoration of a high-steep slope in a alpine region, which comprises the steps of acquiring water temperature, water flow rate, ambient temperature and at least one environmental factor parameter in a pipeline in real time, calculating target heating power required by maintaining the target water temperature through a thermal balance model and a feedforward compensation model, converting the target heating power into a pulse width modulation signal, transmitting the pulse width modulation signal to a heating device, and switching and grading control of the heating device according to a water temperature interval. According to the irrigation method for ecological restoration of the high and steep side slopes in the alpine regions, provided by the invention, the heating power required for maintaining the target water temperature is dynamically calculated by combining the heat balance model and the feedforward compensation algorithm, and the heating device is accurately regulated by the hierarchical control mode, so that the problems of freezing and blocking of the high and steep side slope pipelines in the alpine regions can be effectively solved in the irrigation process, the loss of electric energy can be reduced, and the utilization rate of water resources can be improved.

title_en: Network updating method for post-disaster road restoration map fused with heterogeneous disaster sensing data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of emergency management and discloses a network updating method of a post-disaster road restoration map fused with heterogeneous disaster sensing data, which comprises the steps of converting acquired heterogeneous data into basic probability distribution of observation evidence; the method comprises the steps of predicting a physical field state based on a physical process simulator, generating basic probability distribution of prediction evidence, fusing the two to obtain posterior basic probability distribution, deciding and updating a road map network state according to the posterior basic probability distribution, and feeding the updated state back to the simulator as a dynamic boundary condition to form bidirectional coupling of the physical simulation and the road map state. According to the application, by constructing the simulation assimilation framework of the bidirectional coupling, the technical problems of physical simulation and infrastructure state fracture in the traditional method are solved, the uncertainty of data is effectively processed by utilizing the evidence theory, and the authenticity of disaster evolution prediction and the reliability of road state update are improved.

title_en: Disaster recovery switchover method and system, and node
abstract_en: A disaster recovery switchover system, the disaster recovery switchover system includes a production node, a redundancy node, and a recording node, the production node currently runs a first production service, and the method includes: receiving, by the recording node, first restoration information sent by the production node, where the first restoration information is information required for restoring the first production service to a latest running status of the first production service; and sending, by the recording node when determining that the first production service needs to be restored on the redundancy node, second restoration information to the redundancy node, where the second restoration information is information that is obtained according to the first restoration information and that is required to restore the first production service on the redundancy node, so that the redundancy node switches the first production service to the redundancy node according to the second restoration information.

title_en: Interval data for a utility meter during a power outage without a battery
abstract_en: A utility meter includes a consumption measurement unit for generating consumption data, a meter processor, and a RTC for time stamping the consumption data to provide interval meter data during interval meter operation. A memory stores the interval meter data. The meter processor implements/initiates responsive to a power loss that suspends RTC operation, switching from interval to relative time operation where consumption data is stored as relative consumption data together with a relative time as relative meter data. Responsive power restoration and receiving a current time, the meter switches from relative time to interval meter operation. The restoration time is calculated using the current and an elapsed time since the restoration. The time of restoration and current time is used to generate calculated times. The consumption data from relative time operation is time stamped with the calculated times to provide time-corrected relative meter data that is stored to the memory.

title_en: Combined drilling tool with drill hole control grouting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a combined drilling tool with a drill hole control grouting device. At present, the method of grouting consolidation is usually adopted in our country, which has the weaknesses of large construction quantity and long construction period, and has lower engineering reliability caused by poor aggregate and slurry retention condition for hydrodynamic condition projects, and is difficult to control the grouting range. The combined drilling tool comprises a drill rod, a drill bit and a casing, wherein a control grouting device is arranged between the drill rod and the drill bit, a high-strength nonwoven slurry protecting bag is arranged between an isolating pipe and the casing, and a power transmission device is arranged between the casing and the drill bit, and is connected on the upper middle portion of the drill rod through an intermediate connector. The combined drilling tool can guarantee the control grouting with quickness and high efficiency to the largest extent for satisfying the grouting rescue and relief works and production restoration requirements of mines, railways, roads, tunnels for water conservancy and laneway projects to the sudden flood and weather disasters with large passage, large flux and high concentration, and reduces the construction cost.
assignees: XI AN INST OF COAL SCIENCE RES INST

title_en: Rubber concrete energy dissipation and shock absorption device of super high-rise steel structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rubber concrete power consumption damping device of super high-rise steel construction, the device include the steel pipe, the steel pipe outside be provided with anti-oxidant flame retardant coating, the steel pipe inboard is provided with rubber concrete layer. The utility model has simple structure and safe and convenient use, and mainly utilizes the plastic deformation of the steel pipe after yielding to play the energy dissipation role; simultaneously, before the steel pipe yields, the rubber concrete layer part of the device enters the plastic state in advance, also can consume a large amount of seismic energy and be unlikely to damage this device, thereby can consume a large amount of energy through this device temporarily when powerful earthquake comes and reduce the destruction of major structure, also can not influence the inside service function of major structure during the restoration.

title_en: Combined emergency bridge and erection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention puts forward a combined emergency bridge and an erection method thereof which are designed for solving the problems that in the prior art, the quick restoration on the traffics at the gap positions of highway subgrades and the derogative areas of subgrades is realized by way of building shortcuts, therefore, the restoration is restricted by terrain conditions and affected by secondary geological disasters, meanwhile, the restoration is long in time, time-consuming, labor-consuming and the like. The combined emergency bridge comprises cubic steel frames, triangular prism-shaped steel frames, bearing wire cables, fixing wire cables and road slabs. The combined emergency bridge and the erection method thereof have the following beneficial effects: the bearing wire cables and combined steel frames of the bridge constitute a statically indeterminate self-bearing structure system, horizontal pressures produced by the steel frames are transmitted to the ends of the bridge, and the loads of the triangular prism-shaped steel frames are balanced by the tension of the bearing wire cables; the steel frames of the combined emergency bridge provided by the invention can not be fabricated on site, and the fabrication of the steel frames can be standardized and serialized; and the erection method of the combined emergency bridge is simple without carrying out excessive treatments on disaster sites, therefore, the method has the characteristics of emergency, speediness and convenience.

title_en: Power restoration scheme generation algorithm based on multi-way tree search
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power restoration scheme generation algorithm based on multi-way tree search. The algorithm comprises the following steps: presetting expected states of all switches of a multi-way tree to be closed; summarizing power supply number of each node of the multi-way tree; summarizing residual spare capacity of each node of the multi-way tree; traversing the multi-way tree, and if the residual spare capacity of the node, the power supply number of which is 1, is negative, and the residual spare capacity of a child node thereof, the power supply number of which is 1, is not negative, setting the switch expected state between the two nodes to be open; traversing the multi-way tree, and if the node, the power supply number of which is 2, has two child nodes, the power supply number of each of which is 1, and the residual spare capacities of the two child nodes are not negative, setting the switch expected state between the node and the child node, the residual spare capacity of which is small, to be open; forming a new multi-way tree and repeating the steps above; and when the power supply number of a root node of the multi-way tree is smaller than or equal to 1, generating a tie switch closing control command and other switch opening control commands. The algorithm has the advantages of being concise and clear, clear in logic and fast in generation speed and the like.

title_en: Wind power plant output data restoration method based on ARMA model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, relates to a wind power generation operation monitoring method, and particularly relates to a wind power plant output data repairing method based on an ARMA model. According to the method, abnormal data are divided into local abnormal data and continuous abnormal data, the local abnormal data are repaired by a polynomial interpolation method of a benchmarking fan, the continuous abnormal data are repaired by an ARMA model, corresponding data are repaired, and output data of other units are obtained based on Cholesky decomposition by taking a test unit as a reference. The invention effectively improves the structural completeness of the power generation and operation data of the wind power plant.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Work order management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power failure emergency repair, and provides a work order management system, which comprises: an operation interface and a login module; the system comprises a work order module, a fault location module and a fault equipment module, wherein the work order module is used for issuing an emergency repair work order, and the content of the emergency repair work order comprises a fault user, a fault location and fault equipment; and the progress monitoring module is connected with the operation interface and the work order module and used for acquiring the work progress of the monitoring construction team and updating the state of the work order according to the work progress. The system is provided with an operation interface, a login module, a work order module, a progress monitoring module, a confirmation module, an evaluation module, a reward and punishment module and the like, and is used for monitoring all links after the order of a construction team, including the aspects of arrival time, investigation condition, estimated power restoration time, whether maintenance is finished and the like, so that a power supply bureau and a fault reporting user can better understand the maintenance progress of the construction team; and a reward and punishment system is also arranged so as to supervise the work of the construction team.

title_en: Aeration control system for river ecological restoration and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aeration control system for river ecological restoration and a control method thereof, wherein the system comprises a sensing module, a control module and an aeration module, the sensing module is used for collecting river basic data of four dimensions of river profile, river water quality, river hydrodynamic force and river biology, and the control module is used for analyzing and processing the data collected by the sensing module, converting the data into parameters for controlling the aeration module and sending control signals to the aeration module. The method comprises the steps of acquiring data of four dimensions, preprocessing the input data by a control module, inputting the preprocessed input data into a neural network model, and calculating a target value of river restoration through aeration; starting an aeration module, monitoring the aeration condition of the river in real time, and maintaining the dissolved oxygen concentration of the river at an expected level; and stopping aeration and informing managers until the current situation of the river reaches the target value of the aeration repair river obtained by the neural network model. The invention reduces the energy consumption of the aeration equipment on the premise of ensuring the aeration effect.

title_en: Phosphogypsum harmless treatment as ecological restoration material and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phosphogypsum harmless treatment as an ecological restoration material and a method, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 5-10 parts of lime milk, 0.01-0.05 part of water reducing agent and 0.01-0.05 part of dispersing agent. The invention is realized through chemical reaction, even soluble phosphorus and fluorine in the phosphogypsum form insoluble compounds to passivate the phosphogypsum, the phosphogypsum can be used for leveling terraces of concave terrains in building construction and needing miscellaneous filling soil, and open-pit mining needs surface backfill lamps, and can be used for ecological restoration, so that the phosphogypsum is harmless to the environment, the added water reducing agent can enhance the fluidity and play a role in lubrication, the dispersing agent can enhance the capability of particles, the time and the energy needed for completing the dispersing process are reduced, the phosphogypsum can be harmless and can be used as a filling material for ecological restoration after being modified, and the environmental influence and the natural disasters of landslide caused by no restoration after various mines are mined are solved.

title_en: Computer room data backup and disaster recovery method
abstract_en: The invention provides a computer room data backup and disaster recovery method, which comprises the following steps: computer centralized backup and bare computer restoration; backup and restoration of a physical server; backing up and restoring a file server; backing up and restoring a virtualized environment; backup and restore from a backup server. The invention provides a 3-2-1 principle of data backup by constructing a framework based on a master-slave backup server, realizes the centralized backup, bare computer recovery and multiple backup insurance mechanisms of a computer, and can realize data recovery from multiple aspects by the master-slave backup server framework if the computer room fails, thereby ensuring that the data safety problem caused by the computer room failure is reduced.

title_en: Restoration method for restoring geological disaster area ecology of mining area by utilizing coal gangue
abstract_en: The invention provides a restoration method for restoring geological disaster area ecology of a mining area by utilizing coal gangue, and relates to the field of coal gangue restoration of mining areas. The method for repairing the geological disaster area ecology of the mining area by using the coal gangue comprises the following specific repairing steps of 1, cleaning and constructing a disaster collapse area, cleaning loose broken stones and dangerous rocks of the collapse area, trimming a slope surface to enhance the adhesive force of a filling body, 2, repairing the coal gangue, namely, using type II coal gangue mixed cement with the particle size of 30-100mm as a bottom foundation, adding lime accounting for 3% -5% of the total weight of the mixed material and fly ash accounting for 10% -15% of the total weight of the mixed material, reinforcing the middle layer, namely, after the coal gangue blocks are mixed with the cement, forming a compound body with higher compressive strength, and discharging bubbles in the coal gangue blocks after the cement is mixed by a vibrating rod. The mixture has outstanding environmental benefits, can greatly utilize coal gangue and fly ash, reduces solid waste accumulation, and simultaneously can solidify heavy metals by lime, thereby reducing pollution risk.
assignees: SHANDONG PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCESNO 801 HYDROGEOLOGICAL ENG GEOLOGICAL BRIGA;PENGLAIGE SCENIC AREA MAN SERVICE CENTER;UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Rapid construction bridge, and construction method thereof
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a rapid construction bridge capable of expanding the scale of a bridge which can be installed by a crane with a restricted capability in the case where rapid construction for early restoration is required in disasters, and to provide a construction method thereof.SOLUTION: A main girder unit 2a is installed from one side of a river by a crane 11 such as a rafter crane, and a plurality of main girder units 2a are connected in a lateral direction, thereby obtaining a main girder 2. The main girder units 2a are connected with each other by joining connection plates mounted to webs between upper and lower flanges by welding or the like, with bolts. The connection plate is mounted to the main girder unit 2a before installation in advance. Next, a cover plate retaining girder 3 crossing the main girder 2 is successively installed on the main girder 2 by the same crane 11 and fixed to the main girder 2 with a bolt or a fastening metal fitting. Thereafter, a cover plate 4 as a floor slab is installed on the cover plate retaining girder 3 by the crane 11, such that a rapid construction bridge is completed.

title_en: Portable smoking room
abstract_en: To provide a portable smoking room transportable to and installable at a construction site or a job site of a building, a house, etc. or a restoration work site of a disaster area or a building, etc. where smoking is prohibited, and capable of providing a person with a relaxed space allowing smoking, while taking a rest without worrying about others when the person wants to smoke.SOLUTION: In a portable smoking room which is transportable and is formed of a rectangular parallelepiped housing allowing in-and-out through an opening/closing door provided on one side face, ventilation means is installed at an upper part of the one side face of the housing, an air cleaner is installed on a floor, power cords are connected to the ventilation means and the air cleaner, an illumination lamp is installed on a ceiling board inside the housing or at the upper part of the side face, a power cord is connected to the illumination lamp, and a foldable chair is installed at a lower part of the housing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: System and Method For Power Outage and Restoration Notification in an Advanced Metering Infrastructure Network
abstract_en: A method and system are provided to transmit a meter power status. The method includes recognizing a power status change at a meter. The method includes, if the meter is scheduled to transmit first, transmitting a notification message to at least one neighboring meter towards a mesh gate, wherein the notification message includes a power status indicator and a meter identifier. The method includes, if the meter is not scheduled to transmit first, waiting a predetermined time period to receive a notification message from at least one neighboring meter. The method includes, responsive to receiving a notification message, adding a meter identifier to the received notification message before retransmitting the modified notification message to at least one neighboring meter. The method includes retransmitting the notification message.

title_en: Extending Deployed Cloud Infrastructure for Disaster Recovery Sequencing
abstract_en: An approach is provided in which an Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) system is established in a cloud that includes a plurality of virtual machines. Each of the plurality of virtual machines are allocated to one or more of a plurality of datastores based on one or more user inputs. Next, one of a plurality of priorities are assigned to each of the plurality of virtual machines based on the one or more of the plurality of datastores to which each of the plurality of virtual machines is allocated. In turn, the virtual machines are recovered in the cloud in an order determined, at least in part, by their assigned one of the plurality of priorities.

title_en: Disaster recovery data sync
abstract_en: Various embodiments for failure recovery in a computing environment following a data restoration are provided. A catalog locate is performed for each of a plurality of data sets on a base catalog structure (BCS), identifying a plurality of BCS entries. If a first BCS entry is cataloged incorrectly, the first BCS entry is designated to be re-cataloged. The plurality of BCS entries is compared with a plurality of volume table of contents and a plurality of VSAM volume data set (VTOC/VVDS) entries. If a second BCS entry found in the plurality of BCS entries is not found in the plurality of VTOC/VVDS entries, and the second BCS entry indicates that a data set associated with the second BCS entry is located on a volume, an attempt is made to vary on the volume. If the volume cannot be varied on, a request is created to restore the volume.

title_en: A kind of power distribution network methods of risk assessment considering communication failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power distribution network methods of risk assessment for considering communication failure, the service restoration process after distribution network line i failure is divided into multiple service restoration subtasks influenced by communication failure including (1), and each subtask is abstracted as an input-output system；(2) state set of each subtask is constructed, and calculates each subtask shape probability of state；(3) construct service restoration system mode collection, and calculate each service restoration system mode probability and the state under restore capacity；(4) expected loss of load after route i failure is calculated；(5) power distribution network Risk Evaluation Factors are calculated.In risk indicator proposed by the present invention, the failure rate of each distribution network line embodies influence of the power distribution network physical system risk to risk indicator；And the expected loss of load in power distribution network after each line fault is related to the reliability of communication link, embodies influence of the power distribution network Risk of Information System to risk indicator.

title_en: Emergency operation and maintenance method for energy storage system in bottom-protection power grid based on disaster full period
abstract_en: According to the emergency operation and maintenance method for the energy storage system in the safety bottom power grid based on the disaster full period, firstly, the power elements and the corresponding restoration time of the regional power system, which are in failure in the disaster full period, are predicted according to the latest disaster intensity distribution information, so that the power grid state and the risk degree of the regional power system are quantified, a basis is provided for determining the response action and the restoration time of the regional power system, after the response action of the regional power system is determined, the failed power elements are restored in the corresponding restoration time, the regional power system is restored, the elasticity assessment result when the regional power system and the safety bottom power grid are affected by the disaster is determined through the elasticity assessment technology, and the emergency operation and maintenance scheme of the energy storage system, which is determined based on the elasticity assessment result, can guarantee the supporting effect of the safety bottom power grid energy storage station on the safety bottom power grid to the maximum extent, and guarantee the stable operation of the energy storage system in the disaster full period.

title_en: Power distribution system damage and restoration dynamic process assessment method under extreme event
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution system damage and restoration dynamic process assessment method under an extreme event, which solves the defects of the prior art and comprises the following steps of S1, determining relevant parameters of the power distribution system and extreme event disaster information, specifically S101, determining network topology parameters of the power distribution system, wherein the parameters comprise line information, user information and power supply information, S102, determining disturbance intensity and duration of the extreme event, S103, determining failure rate of elements of the power distribution system and restoration rate of failed elements in the restoration process according to disturbance intensity and element vulnerability curves of the extreme event, S2, simulating the failure process of the power distribution system, S3, simulating the restoration process of the power distribution system, S4, repeating the steps of S2 and S3 for a plurality of times until the curves converge, S5, and calculating reliability indexes according to the obtained element damage curves, user damage curves, element restoration curves and user restoration curves.

title_en: Farmland heavy metal restoration path planning system based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing data drive
abstract_en: The invention discloses a farmland heavy metal restoration path planning system based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing data driving, which relates to the technical field of farmland restoration and comprises a data acquisition module, a pollution restoration subarea dividing module, an attribute identifying module, a heavy metal restoration means evaluating module, a pollution restoration subarea association effect evaluating module, a composite restoration coefficient calculating module, a global restoration optimizing module and a scheme output module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time remote sensing image data, the pollution restoration subarea dividing module is used for dividing the pollution restoration subareas, the attribute identifying module is used for identifying land block attribute information, the heavy metal restoration means evaluating module is used for evaluating initial restoration coefficients, the pollution restoration subarea association effect evaluating module is used for evaluating restoration migration effects, the composite restoration coefficient calculating module is used for comprehensively evaluating composite restoration coefficients, the global restoration optimizing module is used for globally planning implemented heavy metal restoration means of each pollution restoration subarea, and the scheme output module is used for outputting restoration paths of each heavy metal restoration means. The method has the advantage of providing a powerful intelligent decision support for efficient, accurate and collaborative restoration of heavy metal pollution of the complex farmland.

title_en: Shallow lake submerged plant community configuration method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, and discloses a shallow lake submerged plant community configuration method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a submerged plant hierarchical screening model; the submerged plant classifying and screening model comprises a habitat condition classifying model, a substrate condition classifying model and a water quality classifying model, wherein the submerged plant classifying and screening model is used for screening a plurality of submerged plants to determine the types of the submerged plants after screening, the submerged plant character parameters of the plurality of types are obtained, comprehensive tolerance indexes of the submerged plants of the various types are calculated respectively based on the submerged plant character parameters of the plurality of types, the species priority is determined based on the comprehensive tolerance indexes of the submerged plants of the various types, and shallow lake submerged plant communities are configured based on the types, the species priority and engineering parameters of the submerged plants after screening. The invention comprehensively considers the elasticity of the ecological system and the diversity of the species, ensures the functional complementation configuration of the species, and ensures the long-term stability of the configuration of the submerged plant community in the water ecological restoration.

title_en: Combined screening and field planting method for lakeside aquatic plants based on complementary ecological niches
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological environment restoration, solves the technical problems of lack of systematicness, insufficient optimizing means and unstable communities of aquatic plant configuration in the prior art, and particularly relates to a lakeside zone aquatic plant combination screening and field planting method based on complementary niches. And carrying out double-objective optimization on the aquatic plant combination through a non-dominant sequencing genetic algorithm to obtain the optimal aquatic plant combination. The selected aquatic plants are configured in a zoning mode according to the proper water depth, and are subjected to feedback regulation and control by combining the ecological monitoring result, so that dynamic optimization of the community structure is realized. The method can utilize the quantitative index and the intelligent algorithm to carry out combination optimization on the basis of fully considering the difference of plant ecological niches and the complementation of functions, so as to construct a lakeside zone plant community with higher stability and functionality, and has obvious ecological restoration and application popularization values.

title_en: Pipe-repairing reaming device for drainage pipe network
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drain pipe network's pipeline is restoreed and is used reaming device relates to drain pipe restoration technical field, including motor housing, motor housing's inside fixed mounting has the coolant liquid case, the top fixed mounting of coolant liquid case has the spray pipe, the one end of spray pipe is passed and is extended to motor housing's outside, the outside fixed mounting of coolant liquid case has the motor, the pivot one end and the axle sleeve fixed connection that takes precautions against earthquakes of installation on the output of motor, plant in the axle sleeve that takes precautions against earthquakes and install the connecting axle, the one end fixed mounting of connecting axle has the drill bit, motor housing's lower fixed surface installs fan housing, fan housing's inside fixed mounting has the fan, the cover is equipped with the shock pad on the outer wall of the axle sleeve that takes precautions against. The utility model discloses a mutually supporting between motor, coolant liquid case, the pull rod has realized the device's function diversification, has also improved the device's work efficiency simultaneously.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HYDROPOWER CONSTRUCTION AND INSTALLATION CO LTD

title_en: Smooth slope vegetation building device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a device is built to level and smooth domatic vegetation relates to side slope vegetation recovery technical field, including domatic base member, planting weak soil has been laid at domatic base member's top, the side slope protection network has been laid at the top of planting weak soil, the top of side slope protection network is provided with the backup pad that the equidistance was arranged, the solid fixed ring of the equal fixedly connected with in the left and right sides of backup pad. The utility model discloses a, through the level and smooth domatic planting weak soil and the side slope protection network of laying of domatic base member, make the spray-seeding substrate adhere to at level and smooth domatic more easily, it is difficult for receiving the precipitation influence to plant the weak soil, cause the circumstances such as soil erosion and water loss, landslide, two adjacent backup pads can be pegged graft to the socket in by the limiting plate in to reach the effect that makes the limiting plate compress tightly the side slope protection network, and then make the side slope protection network difficult because rainwater influences distortion, make grass seeds and vegetation can stably grow, be favorable to the ecological restoration of side slope.
assignees: BEIJING SHOUFA TIANREN ECOLOGICAL LANDSCAPE CO LTD

title_en: Portable support backfill structure for mine subsidence area
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine geological disaster management and ecological restoration, in particular to a portable supporting backfill structure of a mine subsidence area, which comprises a soil body, wherein a composite geomembrane for isolating crushed rock soil is paved at a subsidence pit of the soil body, a supporting frame component for stably supporting the soil body is arranged at the inner side of the composite geomembrane, after the supporting frame component is deployed and locked, a stable U-shaped supporting space formed by a base and two vertical supporting plates is formed, namely, backfill layer construction can be carried out in the space and at the outer side of the supporting plates, vertical load is mainly borne by the base and the composite geomembrane below the base, lateral soil pressure is borne by the two vertical supporting plates which are locked, and is effectively dispersed into surrounding original soil body through positioning piles, so that rotary force is converted into unfolding power of the supporting plates through a connecting rod and a sliding block structure, and mechanical self-locking is realized by utilizing screws.

title_en: Method and device for communicating with vending machine
abstract_en: Invented method comprises data detection by watching communication between vending machine and its payment system in unified manner, without intervention in this communication, and automated downloading this data; transmitting downloaded data via wireless network by invented device's modem/ external peripheral device's resource; analyzing this data by determining events and one-time events and generating states by unifying the meaning of communication between vending machine and its payment systems performed according to multitude of standard communication protocols; extracting from analyzed data of information about technical condition of vending machine/ payment systems, about operating regime of vending machine, about sales made by vending machine and revenues in its payment systems; remote control on basis of analyzed data and optional discontinuation/restoration of vending machine operation by invented device at request by external peripheral device connected to vending machine. The data is tracked or monitored and the diagnosis at the vending machine is transferred.

title_en: Financial time sequence data prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a financial time sequence data prediction method and a device, which can be used in the technical field of artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a plurality of groups of financial time sequence data in the same time period and reaction time difference data among the groups of financial time sequence data; carrying out gray level transformation on each group of financial time sequence data respectively to obtain a gray level image corresponding to each group of financial time sequence data; according to the reaction time difference data, translating the gray level image corresponding to each group of financial time sequence data; sequentially sliding and selecting the time periods by using a window with a preset length, respectively capturing images of the time periods from each group of gray level images for each sub-time period, and arranging the captured images in sequence to obtain a combined image; inputting the combined images except the target image into a pre-established generation countermeasure network for training; and carrying out image restoration on the target image by using the trained generation countermeasure network, and carrying out financial time sequence data prediction. The invention can improve the prediction accuracy and reduce the error.
assignees: INDUSTRIAL & COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional vulnerability risk rating method for power monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multidimensional vulnerability risk rating method for a power monitoring system, which comprises the steps of establishing a security vulnerability set, a sound asset metadata set, intelligently scanning vulnerabilities, rediscovery of new vulnerabilities, multidimensional vulnerability risk rating and the like. Compared with the traditional method, the method provided by the invention has the advantages that the functions of vulnerability autonomous thermal reproduction, thermal pudding restoration, multi-dimensional risk rating and the like are added. Has the advantages of scientific and reasonable method, strong applicability, good effect and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Power and communication coordination recovery method and device for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for coordinated recovery of power and communication of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing a region to be restored into a plurality of primary regions to be restored and secondary regions to be restored; taking a first-stage to-be-recovered area where the fault base station is located as an emergency communication recovery area, and determining all emergency communication recovery areas where the fault base station is located; calculating the recovery return of the fault base station in each emergency communication recovery area according to the power parameters of the secondary to-be-recovered area and the communication parameters of the emergency communication recovery area, and recovering the communication faults of the emergency communication recovery area according to the sequence of the recovery returns from large to small; establishing a power communication double-layer optimization model of the region to be restored by taking rapid restoration of power supply of the important load level region as a general target; and solving the power communication double-layer optimization model by using a depth-first traversal path search algorithm to determine a final repair scheme. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the rush-repair time of the power distribution network after disaster can be greatly shortened, and the power failure loss of the power distribution network is reduced.
