title_en: Ice melting and rush repair scheduling method and system for comprehensive energy system of emergency power supply vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ice melting and rush repair scheduling method and system for an emergency power supply vehicle comprehensive energy system, wherein the method and system comprise the steps of acquiring icing data and meteorological data of a power transmission line, and establishing a mathematical model of icing increment characteristics of the power transmission line; according to the mathematical model of the icing increment characteristic of the power transmission line, an upper-layer optimization model and a lower-layer optimization model are established by combining with a preset comprehensive energy system scheduling constraint condition of the emergency power supply vehicle; and solving the upper-layer optimization model and the lower-layer optimization model by combining a sperm whale algorithm, and simulating an ice melting decision according to the improved test system to realize ice melting and rush repair scheduling of the comprehensive energy system of the emergency power supply vehicle. The ice melting is maximized and the economy is good on the basis of the safety of the power grid, and the long-time power failure accident is effectively avoided. And the dispatching of the comprehensive energy system and the mobile energy storage system can be optimized according to the deicing emergency repair progress condition, so that the electricity consumption of important load nodes is ensured, and the economic loss of load shedding is further reduced.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering ecological environment treatment system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and ecological environment protection, and particularly relates to a hydraulic engineering ecological environment management system which comprises an intelligent monitoring network, a data integration and analysis platform, an ecological assessment and early warning module, ecological restoration and protection measures, an intelligent scheduling and optimization module and a public participation and education module. According to the hydraulic engineering ecological environment treatment system, the cooperative management of the hydraulic engineering and the ecological environment is realized through an intelligent and systematic means, the accuracy and the efficiency of ecological environment monitoring are effectively improved, scientific basis is provided for ecological environment assessment and restoration, and sustainable utilization of water resources and virtuous circle of the ecological environment are promoted. In addition, the system has higher flexibility and expandability, can be customized and developed according to the characteristics and requirements of different hydraulic engineering, and has popularization and application values.
assignees: ZHONGKE MINGRUI TIANJIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise operation efficiency optimization method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an enterprise operation efficiency optimization method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps of collecting and preprocessing operation data of each department of an enterprise, and extracting the characteristics of department organization, innovation, capital flow, talents and the like by constructing an operation characteristic analysis model; the method comprises the steps of collecting information exchange intensity, fund flow and personnel flow among departments, forming comprehensive connection influence characteristics through weighted summation, constructing a self-adaptive multi-scale attention mechanism graph neural network based on the data, taking the departments as nodes and comprehensive connection as edges, realizing characteristic optimization and generating enterprise comprehensive operation efficiency indexes, detecting abnormal departments based on historical operation characteristics by using an abnormal department identification model when the indexes are lower than a preset threshold, and generating a restoration strategy.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Quick recovery method for degraded marsh based on hydrologic and biological communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid recovery method of degraded marsh based on hydrologic and biological communication, which aims at the problems of water resource shortage and biological isolation of a degraded marsh area, and accurately opens a controllable hydrologic communication channel between the degraded marsh area and an adjacent natural river by constructing the controllable hydrologic communication channel in a natural river flooding season, and synchronously realizes natural and efficient replenishment of water resources to the recovered degraded marsh area and direct input of various aquatic organisms in the natural river by utilizing flood power. According to the key stage of the life cycle of the target aquatic organism, the time, frequency and period of opening the controllable hydrologic communication channel are regulated and controlled, and the biological input effect is maximized. After closing the controllable hydrologic communication channel, the degraded marsh zone is kept stable in the non-flood period, and is assisted with the establishment and monitoring of habitats. The invention has low cost, high efficiency and small ecological risk, can quickly reconstruct aquatic organism communities and ecological network functions, and is particularly suitable for large-scale restoration projects of returning to the soil and degraded marshes.

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance scheduling method and system applied to wind power generation
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent operation and maintenance scheduling method and system applied to wind power generation, which relate to the technical field of wind power generation, firstly, a performance influence association network of a wind generating set is constructed, the directed association edges among equipment operation elements, environment action elements and performance output elements are covered, then a performance fluctuation sensitive node set is identified based on the performance influence association network, operation and maintenance demand prediction is executed for the set, generating an operation and maintenance task planning scheme comprising a node restoration priority and a node collaborative maintenance strategy, constructing a resource collaborative scheduling model according to the operation and maintenance task planning scheme and a real-time operation and maintenance resource state comprising a personnel skill matrix and a tool adaptation vector, outputting an operation and maintenance resource allocation instruction through the resource collaborative scheduling model, updating the associated edge weight of the efficiency influence associated network according to an operation and maintenance execution result, and realizing intelligent scheduling of wind power generation operation and maintenance.
assignees: HUANENG RENEWABLES CO LTD SHANXI BRANCH

title_en: Flood damage shelter difficult to turn over and capable of easily recovering from turned-over state to erect state
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a flood damage shelter having a structure difficult to turn over as compared to conventional type and capable of quickly recovering to an erect state even when it turns over.SOLUTION: A body part 10 has a predetermined length, and is formed so that a cross-sectional shape can be oval, and its center of gravity G is set at a position lower than the center of vertical direction of the body part 10 and higher than a center of buoyancy B in an erect state (state where bottom surface part 14 is positioned below water surface). Thus, even when the body part 10 inclines in a horizontal direction due to waves, a restoration force for restoring an original state is applied, and when the body part turns over to an inverted state due to large waves, the body part can be quickly restored to the erect state.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Gas meter, control method of gas meter, and gas monitoring system
abstract_en: To provide a gas meter capable of improving a user's convenience and fully considering safety, and capable of executing restoration processing in line with a surrounding disaster situation following earthquake motion, and to provide a control method of the gas meter, and a gas monitoring system.SOLUTION: A control method of a gas meter executes: earthquake motion index derivation control for deriving an earthquake motion index as an index for indicating an influence of earthquake motion on gas facilities from a point of time when gas shutoff control is executed to a current point of time based on a value equivalent to seismic intensity stored from a point of time when gas shutoff control is executed by control for storing a value equivalent to seismic intensity to a current point of time; and restoration processing setting control for setting selectable restoration processing from among plural pieces of restoration processing for shifting a cutoff valve 30 in a closed state to an open state by gas cutoff control based on a seismic intensity index derived by earthquake motion index derivation control.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method and system for remote software installation, recovery, and restoration over a data network
abstract_en: System and method for disaster recovery, remote installation and restoration of software and/or data over a data network, when a computer system includes a CPU, read/write internal memory means, an optional display, an optional input device, means for communicating with a data network, a bootable device input port and a hard disk, a bootable removable media means with a live operating system that is stored therein is coupled to the computer system A server that comprises a CPU and memory and software components for exchanging encrypted data, software packages, optional subscriber database with licensing information of each subscriber, and optional data files is adapted to communicate with a plurality of computer systems. The removable memory means performs a first boot operation, to scan hardware of the computer system and network connections, to establish networking connections, to establish a secured channel between the communicating means of the computer system and the server, over the networking connection, either within one data network, or over multiple data networks, and to transmit an optionally unique hardware signature over the secured channel to the server, for checking if the configuration that corresponds to the signature exists, and for executing a default process or otherwise, proposing relevant recovery options to the user of the computer system and for preparing appropriate files and software packages for the selected recovery option.

title_en: Power distribution network maintenance embodiment optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power distribution network maintenance embodiment optimization method, its step is as follows: the collection of power distribution network and controller switching equipment information; Calculate the fault rate of controller switching equipment; The operation risk of assessment power distribution network, the maintenance earning rate of calculating maintenance scheme; Adopt particle swarm optimization algorithm to be optimized maintenance scheme, particle fitness value is the maintenance earning rate of maintenance scheme. Beneficial effect of the present invention is as follows: compared with power distribution network Maintenance Schedule Optimization method instantly, power distribution network Maintenance Schedule Optimization method of the present invention to the assessment of power distribution network risk more comprehensively accurately, consider the interaction of many factors, optimize the repair schedule scheme that obtains more scientific and reasonable, be conducive to effectively carrying out and the reduction of cost of service work.

title_en: Reasonable space allocation method for belt-type shrub protection forest in semiarid grassland area
abstract_en: The invention provides a reasonable space allocation method of a belt type shrub protection forest in a semiarid grassland area, which mainly comprises the following steps of (1) firstly determining potential maximum density of shrub forest belts, (2) determining key ecological hydrologic function parameters of shrub forest belts with different row distances, (3) comprehensively evaluating the ecological hydrologic function parameters of sand-fixing shrub forest belts with different row distances by adopting a hierarchical analysis-entropy weight method, and finally determining the optimal row distance and plant distance of the shrub forest belts by combining the potential maximum density of the shrub forest belts in the step (1) and the key ecological hydrologic function parameters of the shrub forest belts with different row distances in the step (2). The invention has reasonable conception, not only can promote the growth stability of the protective forest, but also can synchronously enhance the wind-proof effect and other ecological functions of the protective forest, and can provide theoretical basis for the efficient utilization of water resources and ecological restoration in arid grassland areas.

title_en: Mine is administered with multistage side slope ecological remediation structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ecological restoration of abandoned mines, in particular to a multistage slope ecological restoration structure for mine treatment. Including domatic and adjacent domatic between the horse way platform, the horse way platform is close to the domatic one end in the top adjacent with it and is provided with the drainage slot, set up thick liquid masonry Dan Long between drainage slot and the horse way platform, the horse way platform is close to the domatic one end in the below adjacent with it and is provided with the rectangle gabion, the height of rectangle gabion is greater than thick liquid masonry Dan Danlong, the domatic surface cover has dense mesh. The utility model can discharge precipitation and redundant maintenance water along the drainage groove, reduce flushing, ensure that the re-green plants at the catwalk platform are not flushed when the water quantity is large, ensure that sundries of the catwalk platform are not easy to enter the drainage groove to cause blockage, limit the sundries of the catwalk platform to flush to a lower slope surface, be favorable for stabilizing the slope and prevent landslide phenomenon.
assignees: NO 3 ENG CO LTD CCCC FIRST HARBOR ENG CO LTD;CCCC FIRST HARBOR ENG CO LTD

title_en: Power grid restoration path searching method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid restoration path searching method, including the steps of: S1, obtaining the quantity of circuit breakers and the opening and closing status of the circuit breakers in a power gird and setting a path solution according to a preset power grid common information model; S2, calculating the fitness of the path solution; S3, determining the crossover probability and the mutation probability of the path solution; S4, crossing and mutating the path solution according to the crossover probability and the mutation probability; S5, calculating the fitness of the path solution after crossing and mutation; S6, judging whether fitness according with preset conditions exists according to the fitness of the path solution after crossing and mutation, if yes, adopting the path solution corresponding to the fitness as a power grid restoration path, and otherwise, executing the steps S3 to S6. The power grid restoration path searching method dynamically changes the crossover probability and the mutation probability of the path according to the fitness of the path, and thereby the path searching efficiency is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Unpowered reclaimed water recycling urban three-dimensional agriculture-urban ecological restoration system
abstract_en: A smart city Internet of things reclaimed water recycling ecological circle zeroing and unpowered reclaimed water recycling urban three-dimensional agriculture/urban ecological restoration system is also called a sponge water-saving urban and artificial wetland ecological corridor; absorb carbon dust, PM2.5 particulate matter haze and noise. The system conforms to the world agricultural development and urban ecological agricultural construction, reduces the damage of the existing reclaimed water utilization mode to the urban ecological environment, omits the municipal construction investment of huge fund for reclaimed water reuse, and is modularly designed; convenient installation, simple maintenance, plant aquatic organism harvesting and full-automatic road cleaning. The system is linked with the Internet of things of a smart city, the intelligent scheduling operation of a reclaimed water reuse three-dimensional agricultural system is realized, the urban flood discharge and underground water storage capacity is multiplied, and the aims of reducing three wastes, not discharging sewage to rivers, lakes and seas and recovering the urban ecology are basically fulfilled.

title_en: Device and training method capable of realizing search and rescue training under multiple working conditions
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method capable of realizing search and rescue training under multiple working conditions, comprising a living space module, a limiting device, a replaceable breaking and dismantling component, a ladder stand and an openable cover plate, wherein the living space module is provided with a ceiling and walls extending downwards from four sides of the ceiling, and a reserved breaking and dismantling hole is formed; the limiting devices are fixedly or detachably connected to the two opposite sides of each reserved broken-open hole, so that the replaceable broken-open components are correspondingly arranged outside each reserved broken-open hole of the living space module; the lower part of the living space module is connected with the underground space through an openable cover plate, and a crawling ladder is arranged below the underground space corresponding to the openable cover plate. According to the invention, through realizing the shape adjustment of the building ruins, flexible replacement of broken components and diversified arrangement of searching scenes, the restoration degree of the searching and rescuing scenes after disaster is improved, and the flexibility requirement of searching and rescuing training is met.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for cooperating fault repair and fault recovery
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for cooperating fault repair and fault recovery. The method comprises the steps of constructing a fault rush-repair and fault recovery cooperative scheduling model combining source network charge storage resource calling by taking the minimum comprehensive economic loss as an objective function, wherein the comprehensive economic loss is the sum of total loss of power loss and source network charge storage resource calling cost in the power distribution network fault rush-repair period, and constraint conditions of the objective function comprise rush-repair team arrangement coefficient constraint, rush-repair scheduling plan geographic constraint and rush-repair time meeting task constraint and source network charge storage resource calling constraint; and solving the cooperative scheduling model by adopting a binary chaotic particle swarm algorithm to obtain a rush repair scheduling plan and a fault recovery plan. In this way, the economic cost of power distribution network fault rush repair and fault recovery can be reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID HEBEI ENERGY TECH SERVICE CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for treating mining subsidence land of shallow-buried coal seam in channel region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating a mining subsidence land of a shallow coal seam in a channel region, which comprises the following steps of dividing treatment strips; step two, mining subsidence land zonal treatment: the method comprises the steps of sequentially treating a plurality of treatment strips in a downstream-to-upstream sequence, firstly stripping and digging a subsidence land treatment area, and then filling a bottom water-resisting layer, a bottom water-bearing layer, a bottom soil layer, a top water-resisting layer, a water storage type core soil layer and a surface soil layer from bottom to top sequentially, and simultaneously setting a impervious wall and a drainage ditch. According to the invention, residual coal is recovered through stripping and digging type treatment, the spontaneous combustion hidden danger is removed, layered backfilling is carried out, the hidden danger of roof collapse is eliminated, a sponge stratum structure suitable for ecological restoration is reconstructed, water can be stored, permeated and purified during raining, the stored water is released and utilized during drought, the ecological restoration effect of a subsidence area and the capability of coping with natural disasters are improved, and the social and ecological benefits of a treatment area are improved.

title_en: Emergency information management system
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency information management system which comprises a data acquisition module, a power failure and power restoration monitoring module, a data processing module, a visualization module and an information pushing module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring information of a user; the emergency data acquired by the data acquisition module are integrated and analyzed through the data processing module to obtain target data, a power failure area in the target area is determined through the power failure and power restoration monitoring module, and power failure information is generated, so that the visualization module can be combined with GIS service to visually display weather conditions, the target data and the power failure area. Therefore, the power grid staff can intuitively know the integrated and analyzed emergency data, accurately master the power failure area affected by the disaster, avoid the problems of multi-head report, repeated report and the like, furthest realize information sharing, assist the emergency decision of the power grid, enable the power grid unit to timely and effectively develop emergency actions such as equipment rush repair, power failure and power restoration information report and the like, and further improve the efficiency of emergency management of the power grid.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Optical fiber wiring control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of optical fibers, in particular to an optical fiber distribution control method, which comprises at least one idle optical fiber connection line, wherein a first terminal and a second terminal of the optical fiber connection line are respectively inserted into two idle optical fiber ports, the optical fiber connection line is used for controlling a manipulator to pull out the first terminal and the second terminal from the idle optical fiber ports respectively, insert the first terminal and the second terminal into a first optical fiber port and a second optical fiber port to be connected and arrange the optical fiber line from a storage area to a use area, the optical fiber distribution control method is used for solving the technical problems of long time consumption, high labor power and low efficiency of optical cable network operation and maintenance, slow optical cable interruption positioning, disaster influence restoration efficiency, long fiber core detection time consumption and inconvenient data analysis, and realizing remote operation by using the manipulator to replace manpower to execute cable jump tasks in remote areas or dangerous areas, thereby improving the automation degree of the operation and realizing the quick positioning of optical cable interruption and the restoration efficiency of disaster influence.

title_en: Power connection control system and method
abstract_en: For each of consumers, a connection control apparatus is provided that includes an opening/closing device capable of connecting or disconnecting an electric power system and a consumer, that, when a power outage occurs in the electric power system, disconnects the electric power system and the consumer from each other by the opening/closing device at a command from an outage management apparatus or the like, and that connects the electric power system and the consumer to each other by the opening/closing device upon receiving a command from the outage management apparatus or the like at the time of restoration from the power outage. A power supply control apparatus supplies electric power from energy provision equipment to electrical appliances during a power outage in the electric power system.

title_en: Flisr without communication
abstract_en: A control system and method for a feeder, or portion of the distribution grid, which enables fault location, isolation and service restoration without communications between the feeder switches. The method uses definite time coordination between feeder switches and local measurements to determine which switches should open or close in order to isolate the fault and restore service downstream of a faulted section. Time-current characteristics and feeder topology are shared with all switches in the feeder prior to a fault event. When a disturbance occurs, a timer is started at each switch. When a switch measures voltage loss in all three phases, it stops its timer. Each switch evaluates the timer values and, when a particular switch determines based on the time-current characteristics that the immediate upstream switch opened to isolate the fault, that particular switch also opens. Power upstream of the particular switch is then provided by an alternative source.

title_en: System and method for automated fault control and restoration of smart grids
abstract_en: A self-organizing protection coordination system within a power network is provided. The self-organizing protection coordination system in the power network includes a plurality of distribution devices communicatively coupled to each other in a power network. The power network also includes a protection device coupled to each of the plurality of distribution devices configured to transmit power in the distribution network. The power network further includes a controller coupled to each of the plurality of distribution devices. The controller receives communication channel characteristics from a plurality of distribution devices in a distribution network at an interval of time. The controller also computes a delay in time for receiving the communication characteristics. The controller further determines a plurality of reliability indicators at each of the plurality of distribution devices. The controller adjusts tripping characteristics of the plurality of distribution devices to minimize the reliability indicators based on the computed delay.

title_en: Power distribution network fault restoration resource scheduling method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a power distribution network fault recovery resource scheduling method. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an input power distribution network fault point set, and taking the input power distribution network fault point set as the input of a resource scheduling model; calculating to obtain an optimal feasible solution of resource scheduling according to a repaired resource scheduling model, wherein the resource repairing model is a fault repairing time function under the condition of considering the emergency degree of the fault; and scheduling the fault repairing resources according to the output of the resource scheduling model. The embodiment of the application also discloses a power distribution network fault repairing resource scheduling device. The embodiment of the application improves the scheduling efficiency and the resource utilization rate of the fault repairing resource scheduling.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD;TAIYUAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER C

title_en: Accelerated recovery after a data disaster
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present invention, a metadata file is transferred from the first system to the second system and a database on the second system is initialized based on the metadata file. An image, including information of the first system to be restored, is transferred from the first system to the second system, and restoration of the information to the second system based on the image is initiated. Prior to completion of the restoration, one or more log files indicating actions performed on the first system relating to the information to be restored is transferred from the first system to the initialized database on the second system. In response to completion of the restoration, the actions of the log files are performed to synchronize the restored data on the second system with the first system.

title_en: Internet of things early warning device for forest fire prevention
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an Internet of things early warning device for forest fire prevention and belongs to the field of forest fire prevention. An omnidirectional antenna in the device receives fire situation signals and sends the fire situation signals to a radio frequency (RF) communication module, the RF communication module sends interrupt signals to awake a micro-control unit after receiving the fire situation signals, and the micro-control unit reads the fire situation signals sent by the RF communication module and then analyzes fire situation signals. A state indication circuit and a sound and light alarm circuit respectively send indication lamp early warning information and sound alarm and indication lamp alarm information according to control signals of the micro-control unit. A RJ45 communication module and a global system for mobile (GSM) module respectively send alarm information to the internet and a corresponding mobile terminal according to the control signals of the micro-control unit. The Internet of things early warning device is a measurement and control master station machine for forest fire prevention integrating network fire situation receiving, remote fire situation transfer, detector network management and fire situation alarm prompt, has the remarkable advantages of high reliability, high stability, self-restoration and the like, and achieves intelligentized and informationalized development of monitoring for domestic forest fire prevention.

title_en: Quick-diversion mine side slope restoration net fence structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rapid diversion mine side slope restoration net fence structure, which comprises a main body and a diversion frame, wherein the diversion frame is embedded in the top end of the main body; the main part is including water drainage tank, the water catch bowl, inflow groove and lift groove, the reposition of redundant personnel frame is including the flow groove, the lift wheel, embedding ring sum rotation axis, the embedding ring is including the reset block, the rotation axis is including rotating groove and compression tank, the device is provided with the reposition of redundant personnel frame, can guide rivers through the reposition of redundant personnel frame and shunt and reduce its impact force, then discharge rivers through the surface of its net fence for can not direct contact slope surface cause the landslide when its rainwater flows.

title_en: Terminal-to-terminal enterprise-level dynamic virtual desktop delivery method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a terminal-to-terminal enterprise-level dynamic virtual desktop delivery method. A virtual desktop is supplied to a user in a way of distribution according to needs, so that the user can safely and efficiently access a data centralized data center from any place, and based on a management mode of a B/S architecture, the deployment and management of applications are simplified; and the desktop management cost is decreased by saving the operation expense and improving the flexibility, and the familiar PC application experience, enterprise-level desktop reliability, data protection and disaster restoration capacity are provided for the final user. The data reliability is improved in the aspect of mechanism, and rich management and control means are provided to prevent the data leakage. The virtual desktop issued by the entire data center is managed and maintained in a centralized manner without considering the type of a client machine, so that the management and dispatching and deployment of the virtual desktop are simplified, and the IT resource utilization rate of enterprises is increased.
assignees: JIANGSU PANSHU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: The power system rack reconstruction and optimization method of meter and microgrid as black starting-up power supply
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the power system rack reconstruction and optimization method of meter and microgrid as black starting-up power supply, including step：Input electric power systematic parameter；Using maximize recovery system generating capacity and minimize microgrid in load loss amount for target build count and microgrid as black starting-up power supply rack reconstruction and optimization model；It is determined that the constraints of meter and microgrid as the rack reconstruction and optimization model of black starting-up power supply；Based on pitch point importance and path recovery time structure integration schedules evaluation index, to optimize the restoration path of unit to be restored；Joint is combined solving model using ant colony algorithm with quantum theory.The rack reconstruction strategy proposed by the present invention for making black starting-up power supply using the microgrid containing regenerative resource at high proportion, has certain feasibility and validity.In the case of system convention black starting-up inadequate resource, startup power can be provided for non-black starting-up unit by the use of microgrid as black starting-up power supply, recover non-black starting-up unit quickly, reach the purpose of rack reconstruct.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for predicting spininess of camel sparsifolia in extremely arid region
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for predicting the growth vigor of leaf-thinning camel spines in an extremely arid region, which comprises the steps of surveying a sample area, obtaining underground water flow field information, determining the weight and water content of soil, determining the salt content of the soil, shooting spectrograms of the sample area and the sample area by adopting an unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing technology, analyzing the coverage rate of vegetation in the sample area through vegetation coverage data in the spectrograms, and simultaneously analyzing the vegetation type and distribution condition in the sample area; combining with ecological investigation, analyzing the change condition of the vegetation in the sample prescription; and (4) establishing a groundwater numerical model, and predicting vegetation growth by combining regional water use planning. The method plays a positive role in exploring the restoration and ecological function protection of the ecological fragile area under the extreme drought condition, provides a practical method for the reasonable development and ecological function protection research of the underground water of the extreme arid area, and provides favorable data support for the reasonable development and ecological function protection of the underground water of the extreme arid area.
assignees: THE FIRST HYDROLOGICAL ENGINEERING GEOLOGY BRIGADE OF XINJIANG BUREAU OF GEO EXPLOR & MINERAL DEVELO

title_en: Handheld operation and maintenance equipment of electric power intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a handheld operation and maintenance device of an electric power intelligent terminal, wherein a software module comprises a tool authorization module, a user management module, a work preparation module, a commissioning setting module, a device diagnosis module, a terminal test module, a backup restoration module and a terminal operation and maintenance module; the module is used for debugging the power distribution terminal device before and after commissioning, ex-factory inspection, warehouse acceptance, installation and debugging and operation maintenance; the invention carries out information authentication through the two-dimension code information of the scanning device, can complete the functions of software upgrading, data calibration, automatic test, configuration downloading/backup, fault diagnosis/repair, automatic point alignment of a main station, real-time data monitoring, historical file retrieval, control command issuing, device restarting and the like of the device, carries out targeted function research and development and operation optimization on the operation related to the life cycle of the power distribution terminal device in the whole process from production debugging to delivery operation, reduces the operation difficulty of personnel in each link, shortens the debugging and operation and maintenance time and improves the working efficiency of the personnel.
assignees: JIANGSU SHENRUI HUIYANG ENERGY TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network power failure transition strategy generation method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power systems and discloses a power distribution network power failure transition strategy generation method, a power distribution network power failure transition strategy generation system and a storage medium. The power failure transition strategy generation method of the power distribution network comprises the steps of obtaining all buses under a target voltage-loss substation, traversing all buses, determining whether ring network points exist on all buses, obtaining all opposite-side electrified lines of the buses aiming at each bus with the ring network points, and determining the transition strategy of the target voltage-loss substation based on a constraint strategy and load parameters of all the opposite-side electrified lines. According to the power-failure transition strategy generation method for the power distribution network, by acquiring all buses and all opposite-side live lines of each bus under the voltage-loss substation, a power-failure transition scheme is automatically generated based on the constraint strategy and the load parameters of each opposite-side live line of each bus, intelligent generation of the voltage-loss and power-restoration lines of the substation is realized, and the operation is simple and the efficiency is high.
assignees: CHANGSHA ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Method for diagnosing and treating degree and flow direction of gas pipe network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a diagnosis and treatment method for the degree and flow direction of a gas pipe network, which comprises the steps of obtaining pipe network topology data of the gas pipe network; acquiring actual degrees corresponding to each node in the gas pipe network according to the pipe network topology data, and constructing an illegal degree list and a degree restoration scheme according to the actual degrees of each node; and calculating the actual flow direction of each node according to the pipe network topology data, and constructing an illegal flow direction list and a flow direction restoration scheme according to the actual flow direction of each node. The invention can automatically check the illegal degree and illegal flow direction of the pipe network topology data, and repair the checked illegal degree nodes and illegal flow direction nodes, thereby improving the correctness and reliability of the pipe network topology data.

title_en: Hydropower station group historical runoff data reduction method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a hydropower station group historical runoff data reduction method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the step of obtaining a runoff hydropower station reference of a reservoir hydropower station according to the runoff similarity between the runoff hydropower station and the reservoir hydropower station in the hydropower station group. According to the hydraulic characteristics of the radial hydropower station, a radial flow process referenced by the radial hydropower station is obtained, the radial flow trend is obtained based on the radial flow process, and the radial flow trend is used as a radial flow trend reference of the reservoir hydropower station. Expanding the same-time ratio of the runoff trend reference, and restoring the water level process in the period of the expanded runoff trend reference, determining the runoff process of the reservoir-capacity hydropower station by adjusting the same-time ratio of the runoff trend reference, and taking the runoff process of the reservoir-capacity hydropower station as historical runoff restoration data of the hydropower station. The method solves the problem that the historical runoff data of the hydropower station group in the related art is low in accuracy, and improves the accuracy of the historical runoff data recovery.
assignees: CHITAN HYDROPOWER PLANT OF FUJIAN HUADIAN FURUI ENERGY DEV CO LTD;HUADIAN ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Pumped storage power station side slope near natural ecology monitoring method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for monitoring the near-natural ecology of a side slope of a pumped storage power station. The method comprises the following steps of S100, preprocessing an ecological environment point cloud picture of a pumped storage power station side slope to generate a sample data set, S300, taking the sample data set as input of a neural network, obtaining a prediction network model through learning and training the neural network, S400, predicting the current pumped storage power station side slope through the prediction network model, realizing comprehensive monitoring and evaluation of the natural ecological environment of the pumped storage power station, and taking the natural state before the pumped storage power station is built as an evaluation standard, and taking the natural ecological environment which is as close as possible to the natural ecological environment before the pumped storage power station is built as a restoration target.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;STATE GRID XINYUAN GROUP CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Data processing method, device, equipment and medium based on spoil field
abstract_en: The application relates to a data processing method, a device, equipment and a medium based on a spoil field. The method comprises the steps of carrying out water and soil loss evaluation calculation on each target area by utilizing a water and soil loss model according to water and soil loss evaluation parameters of each target area in a target spoil field to obtain respective soil loss amount of each target area, determining respective erosion risk levels of each target area according to the respective soil loss amount of each target area, determining respective soil protection and restoration measures of each target area according to the respective erosion risk levels of each target area, obtaining rainfall and soil humidity of each target area, determining drainage demand of the target area according to the rainfall, soil humidity and soil loss amount of the target area, and controlling automatic drainage equipment installed in the target area to adjust the drainage according to the drainage demand under the condition that the soil protection and restoration measures of the target area are implemented. By adopting the method, the transformation efficiency of the spoil field can be improved.
assignees: CHINA RESOURCES QINGYUAN SOLAR POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Power failure system restoration path optimization method based on network flow theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power failure system restoration path optimization method based on network flow theory, includes the following steps, A) recovery for the system that has a power failure is described as the directed networks that single source is converged more；B network flow theory, connectivity constraint in the optimization of Analytical Expression restoration path) are based on；C) determine that route puts into operation state；D the MIXED INTEGER layout of roads model of power failure system restoration path optimization) is established；E it) is solved using CPLEX, obtains optimal restoration path.Nonlinear model is changed into MIXED INTEGER linear model by the present invention, allow to using quick mixed integer model method for solving, Searching efficiency is high and optimizing result stability is strong, it can be adapted in the restoration path optimization of massive blackout system, the calculating time meets the requirements, and has a good application prospect.

title_en: Power distribution network power supply recovery method considering fault influence degree
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply restoration method of a power distribution network, which is used for considering the influence of faults on a load and a grid structure, evaluating the influence of the faults by analyzing the influence of the faults of the power distribution network on the load and the grid structure, dividing the severity level of the faults to match with a power supply restoration model, and executing a fault restoration algorithm to generate a power supply restoration scheme. According to the invention, the inherent contradiction between the speed of the power supply restoration algorithm and the strategy quality is coordinated by introducing a fault influence degree evaluation and control model self-adaptive matching mechanism, under the condition that a large-area power failure occurs in a power grid, the system takes the rapid restoration load power supply as a unique target, adopts a particle swarm algorithm to search for a power supply conversion strategy, and exits from searching after obtaining a feasible solution for restoring the global load power supply; when the load power failure loss caused by the power grid fault is light and the important load power supply cannot be influenced, the load power loss, the control cost and the operation performance of the power grid after reconstruction are simultaneously used as evaluation indexes, a multi-target particle swarm algorithm is adopted to search an optimal scheme, and the strategy quality of a fault recovery algorithm is improved.

title_en: Running risk assessment method and device based on network security situation awareness system
abstract_en: The application discloses an operation risk assessment method and device based on a network security situation awareness system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data of a network security situation awareness system in advance and analyzing and processing the historical data; performing feature selection and data preprocessing on historical data of the network security situation awareness system to generate a training set and a testing set for training a learning model; training a learning model by adopting a machine learning algorithm, and deriving an intelligent analysis model after the learning model meets the average accuracy requirement; calculating expected recovery power supply time and loss load of the intelligent analysis model by adopting a general recovery target algorithm of the power system; and carrying out risk assessment calculation according to the expected power restoration time, the loss load and the threat invasion probability of the intelligent analysis model to obtain a corresponding network security operation loss risk value. The application can combine the intrusion probability model of the power system and the network security situation awareness system to evaluate and calculate the running risk, and improve the accuracy of risk evaluation.

title_en: Prevention and treatment method for algal bloom disasters of eutrophic water body
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water body ecological restoration, and particularly relates to a method for preventing and treating algal bloom disasters of an eutrophic water body, which comprises the following steps: (1) seed selection: determining harmless or low harmful algal species having a competitive relationship with the main algal bloom species; (2) propagation: culturing the harmless or low-harm algae; (3) suppressing: by paving the semi-open type photobioreactor clusters in a specific interval of a target water body, harmless or low-harm algal species can more easily obtain survival factors in the target water body, and the competitive advantage and the inhibition effect on harmful algal blooms in the target water body are formed; (4) recovering: through continuous recovery of algae liquid in the semi-open type photobioreactor cluster, high-efficiency removal of nitrogen, phosphorus and other rich nutrient elements in target water is achieved. According to the invention, the artificial culture algae is used for replacing ecological niches of harmful algal blooms, so that the algal blooms are inhibited, and the water quality is improved; the method has the advantages of reducing high investment, high energy consumption and ecological risks in the algal bloom treatment process.

title_en: Project cost approximate calculation method and device special for soil remediation project
abstract_en: The invention relates to a project cost general calculation method and a device special for soil remediation project, which automatically judges whether the current project should adopt a rating mode or a market rating mode by using a binary decision tree, and selects project characteristics of splitting trees based on the principle that the prediction precision is improved to the maximum when splitting the decision tree, so that the decision tree is split most rapidly; meanwhile, for numerical data, data processing is carried out in advance, the grouping limit value is determined according to the principle of maximum prediction precision, the algorithm is concise, and the computer computing power is saved; for the soil restoration project without guiding pricing specification, corresponding model training is carried out, so that the current project can be matched to a proper historical project record, and the accuracy of project cost general calculation is improved; meanwhile, the method also provides the option of independently deciding which pricing mode to use for the user, and can be respectively adjusted by manual, material and machinery, thereby being convenient for the user to use.

title_en: Post-disaster circuit-circuit collaborative restoration method, system and equipment based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster circuit-circuit collaborative restoration method, a system and equipment based on reinforcement learning, wherein a time sequence Markov decision network is constructed through network topology, fault information, maintenance station positions and maintenance team positions of a power distribution network and an urban traffic network, restoration objects of the maintenance team are selected according to the current state of a circuit-circuit combined system and a time sequence Markov decision network by using a Monte Carlo tree search method, a data set taking the state of the circuit-circuit combined system as a sample and the best restoration object in the current state as a sample label is formed, and a quick decision network taking the state of the circuit-circuit combined system as an input and the restoration object in the next step of the circuit-circuit combined system as an output is constructed.

title_en: Consistency group restoration from a secondary site
abstract_en: Techniques for replay of groups of I/Os for disaster recovery. At a primary site, a plurality of primary site computing entities that are to be restored from the secondary computing site after a disaster recovery event are identified as belonging to an entity group. At the primary site, I/O commands that are performed over any of the entities of the entity group are observed and streamed to the secondary site, where they are persisted into a log. Periodically, the primary site sends the secondary site an I/O map that associates a time with an indication of the last performed I/O commands pertaining to any observed I/O commands that had been performed over any one or more of the computing entities of the entity group. Upon receiving a disaster recovery request, the most recent I/O map and the secondary site log are processed to construct a snapshot for the entity group.

title_en: Ecological restoration method for tailing depot reclamation after tailing depot closure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological restoration method for tailing depot reclamation after tailing depot closure. According to the ecological restoration method, a water storage system, a water drainage system and an irrigation system are designed; construction restoration measures adopted by each system accord with environmentally friendly ecological restoration; an interrelated overall system can be formed through the water storage system, the water drainage system and the irrigation system; much water can be impounded in dry seasons so as to be used for irrigation, and floodwaters can be rapidly drained in flooding in rainy seasons, and therefore, the safety of a tailing depot can be ensured, and gravity irrigation can be realized; and regulation can be performed according to the needs of crops, water level in the tailing depot, and weather conditions. The ecological restoration method of the invention can be applied to reclamation ecological restoration and effective utilization of tailing depots after tailing depot closure in various kinds of mines.

title_en: Meter and the load restoration ability estimation on line method of key sections limit constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses meter and the load restoration ability estimation on line methods of key sections limit constraint, generate load aggregation to be restored based on system protection, source net G system cutting load action message and are ranked up according to load priority and load restoration performance indicator；Restore the online regulation measure spaces of generations such as plan, new energy predictive information based on the current method of operation of power grid and direct current, and is ranked up according to measure priority and measure performance of control index；It is generated based on the current method of operation of power grid and recovery scheme and envisions mode after restoring and carry out Load flow calculation, key sections are out-of-limit if it exists, comprehensively consider trend sensitivity under priority and anticipation mode and resequence to load restoration set and regulation measure space, be then based on ranking results select measure eliminate it is out-of-limit, and according to aid decision result update load restoration ability.The present invention counts and the load restoration ability rapid evaluation of key sections limit constraint, and period regulation personnel are to load restoration capability analysis calculating speed and accuracy requirement under real time operation mode after meeting the disposition of extra-high voltage direct-current failure.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Geological and geomorphic engineering restoration method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a geological and geomorphic engineering restoration method which comprises the steps of measuring the boundary of a mining pit, calculating the backfill elevation of the mining pit, backfilling muck into the mining pit, backfilling soil into the mining pit, and covering the muck with the soil. By the geological landform engineering restoration method, the mining pit is coordinated with surrounding landforms, the slope meets the vegetation greening requirement, and geological disasters are basically eliminated.
assignees: CCTEG BEIJING LAND CONSOLIDATION AND ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;CCTEG ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: N-1 automatic calibration method based on power distribution network full model
abstract_en: The invention provides an N-1 automatic calibration method based on a power distribution network full model, which comprises the following steps: establishing a power distribution network full model based on a preset general modeling standard; acquiring the fault condition of an element in the power distribution network based on the full model of the power distribution network, and determining the element to be verified based on the fault condition; acquiring topological data of the power distribution network, and generating a power restoration scheme corresponding to an element to be verified in the power distribution network according to the topological data; performing N-1 verification on a power restoration scheme according to a first operation index of the power distribution network; and if the N-1 verification passes, selecting an optimal power restoration scheme according to second operation indexes of the power distribution network before and after the N-1 verification. The invention can rapidly and safely carry out the automatic verification of the N-1 when a certain element fails. Meanwhile, the optimal power restoration scheme is determined by executing the operation indexes of the power distribution network before and after the power restoration scheme, so that the N-1 verification result is more comprehensive and reliable.
assignees: HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Plant restoration method for severe slope of soil engineering wound surface in alpine region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plant restoration method for a steep slope of a soil engineering wound surface in a alpine region. The existing technology for repairing the soil steep slope is weak, and if the form of slope protection is selected unreasonably or is not implemented in place, serious natural and geological disasters such as water and soil loss, collapse and the like can be caused. The invention firstly trims the engineering wound surface and then digs out the planting hole; mixing water, nutrient soil and seeds and filling the planting holes; and after the plant seeds germinate, carrying out manual maintenance management on the repair area. The invention adopts the plant restoration method to restore the steep slope of the engineering wound surface of the soil texture in the alpine region, thereby reducing the engineering cost, and the vegetation coverage rate and species abundance of the engineering wound surface in the third year after restoration are basically consistent with the method for restoring the hanging net spray-seeding ecological slope protection.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY FIRST SURVEY & DESIGN INST GROUP LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power station power prediction method and system based on image restoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power station power prediction, in particular to a photovoltaic power station power prediction method and a photovoltaic power station power prediction system based on image restoration.

title_en: Ecological restoration method and system for power transmission and transformation engineering line in stone mountain area
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological restoration method and system for a power transmission and transformation project in a rocky mountain area, wherein a target area is divided into a core protection area, a side slope disturbance area and a project line restoration area based on unmanned aerial vehicle aerial survey and ground actual measurement results, so that a partition basis is provided for soil pertinence enhancement and vegetation type determination, a soil enhancement strategy is determined based on area characteristics of the core protection area, the side slope disturbance area and the project line restoration area, physical and chemical properties of soil in the rocky mountain area can be remarkably improved, an adaptation environment is provided for follow-up vegetation rooting and growing, after soil enhancement is completed, a directional planting strategy for vegetation types in the target area is determined based on monitoring data of the target area, a planting strategy is definitely designed by combining engineering line requirements, and the core contradiction between vegetation height and root depth can be controlled pertinently, and ecological restoration and power transmission and transformation safety is solved from a source.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Safety evaluation system for base isolated building
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a safety evaluation system for a base isolated building, capable of performing suitable safety evaluation considering changes in a building and ground property characteristics after a seismic disaster in the base isolated building.SOLUTION: Acceleration sensors are attached to ground 4 and a building 2. Usual microvibration values of the ground 4 and the building 2 before and after an earthquake and acceleration values during the earthquake are measured, and a base isolation strength restoration characteristic K' and residual displacement δ' of a base isolation layer are found out. Further, an amplification rate G' of surface ground is found out. These values K', δ', G' are reset and base isolation layer response displacement after the earthquake is calculated. Whether the base isolation response displacement is included within a design limit or not is determined to perform safety determination. A residual energy absorption amount of the base isolation layer is calculated from the residual displacement δ' and whether residual energy absorption capacity for an aftershock exists or not is determined.

title_en: Temporary restoration method for damage place of building and repair structure for damage place of building
abstract_en: To effectively protect a damage place to prevent rainwater from entering the damage place in a period up to a start of main construction even if the period is long in the case that a roof surface part or external wall surface part of a building is damaged by a disaster such as a typhoon, an earthquake, and a flood.SOLUTION: An outdoor surface part 5 of a building 2 is covered with a repair net 9 capable of holding a water-proof resin liquid so that the entire damage place 6 of the outdoor surface part 5 is covered from an outdoor side, and a net edge part 11 of the repair net 9 is fixed to the outdoor surface part 5 with a pressure-sensitive adhesive tape 12. Then the water-proof resin liquid is blown entirely over the repair net 9 and a range protruding by a necessary width from a net edge 13 of the repair net 9 toward the outward surface part 5. The water-proof resin liquid is hardened to form a water-proof surface part 15, and the net edge 13 is embedded in the resin forming the water-proof surface part 15.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Disaster influence evaluation system, disaster influence evaluation method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a disaster influence evaluation system capable of evaluating an influence of a disaster exerted from the disaster to an evaluation object system in more accordance with a real state of the disaster.SOLUTION: A disaster influence evaluation system according to an embodiment includes: a function loss frequency evaluation unit which evaluates a function loss frequency of each facility when a disaster has occurred in an evaluation object system in which a plurality of facilities are installed; a restoration time evaluation unit which evaluates restoration time when the disaster has occurred according to an intensity of the disaster; and a disaster influence evaluation unit which evaluates the disaster influence to the evaluation object system on the basis of the function loss frequency and the restoration time.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
