title_en: Restoration ability recovering device of the ship and car carrier with the same
title_ko: 선박의 복원력 회복 장치 및 이것을 구비한 자동차 운반선
abstract_en: [PROBLEMS] To provide a righting moment recovery apparatus for a marine vessel that takes conventionally required measures to ensure the stability in the event of damage in the marine vessel. [MEANS FOR SOLVING PROBLEMS] The righting moment recovery apparatus for the marine vessel is characterized in that a remotely openable seawater leading means is provided on a bottom layer watertight flat (5a) which forms a void space (8) at a bottom of the marine vessel. Consequently, in the event that seawater flows into the marine vessel due to damage of ship-side outer plates or the like on the marine vessel, seawater flowing into the marine vessel can be led to the void space (8) by opening the seawater leading means provided on the bottom layer watertight flat (5a). As a result, the void space (8) which is usually served as an enormous backup buoyancy can be made to function as a kind of seawater ballast tank, thereby allowing the righting moment of the marine vessel to be recovered.
abstract_ko:
종래 선박의 손상시에 있어서의 복원성을 확보하기 위한 대책이 요구되고 있다. 
     선박의 선 바닥의 보이드 공간을 형성하는 최하층의 수밀 갑판에 원격으로 개방 가능한 해수 도입 수단을 구비한 것을 특징으로 한다.  이에 의해, 선박의 선측 외판 등이 파손되어, 해수가 선 내에 진입한 경우, 최하층의 수밀 갑판에 구비된 해수 도입 수단을 개방함으로써, 선 내에 진입한 해수를 보이드 공간에 도입할 수 있기 때문에, 통상은 방대한 예비 부력인 보이드 공간을, 일종의 해수 밸러스트 탱크로서 기능시킬 수 있어, 선박의 복원력을 회복시킬 수 있다. 
       
     자동차 운반선, 수밀 도어, 해수 도입 구멍, 침수 표시기, 복원력 감시 제어 장치

title_en: Earthquake-proof distributor and control method thereof
title_ko: 내진 배전기기 및 그의 제어 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an earthquake-proof power distribution apparatus and a control method thereof. That is, the present invention can provide a more exact recognition about an emergency situation, a guidance about the recognized emergency situation, and an evacuation inducing function as transmitting and receiving mutual situation information by the linkage between the earthquake-proof power distribution apparatus, an emergency control center, and an emergency light by providing a sequential blocking function of an internal component of a power distribution apparatus in accordance with blocking main power due to an earthquake by the linkage between the power distribution apparatus, the emergency control center, and the emergency light and by controlling an emergency action of the emergency light in accordance with the emergency situation, and improve operation efficiency of the power distribution apparatus by providing a unified management system composing function associated with notification, preparation, and restoration about the emergency situation which is managed by being individually independent.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 내진 배전기기 및 그의 제어 방법을 개시한다. 즉, 본 발명은 배전기기와 비상 관제 센터와 비상등 간의 연동에 의해 지진에 의한 주전원 차단에 따른 배전기기 내부 구성 요소의 순차적인 차단 기능을 제공하고, 비상 상황에 따른 상기 비상등의 비상 동작을 제어함으로써 내진 배전기기와 비상 관제 센터와 비상등 간의 연동에 의해 상호 상황 정보를 주고 받으면서 보다 정확한 비상 상황에 대한 파악과 그에 대한 안내 및 대피 유도 기능을 제공하고 개별적으로 독립되어 관리되는 비상 상황에 대한 알림과 대비 및, 복구에 관련된 일원화된 관리 체계 구성 기능을 제공하여 배전기기의 운용 효율을 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Ultra-high-speed, water-permeable block paving system for preventing floods, droughts, global warming, desertification and sea level rise and for restoring soil groundwater, and a method of constructing therewith
title_ko: 홍수, 가뭄, 지구 온난화, 사막화, 해수면 상승 방지 및 토양지하수 복원을 위한 초고속 투수성 블록 도로포장 시스템과 그 시공 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an ultra-high-speed, water-permeable block paving system for preventing floods, droughts, global warming, desertification and sea level rise and for restoring soil groundwater, and to a method of constructing therewith; wherein high-performance water-permeable paving blocks which are outstandingly water permeable are used in such a way that runoff water from a road and a wide area surrounding the road permeates below the paved surface, and building blocks are placed in layers so as to construct an assembled structure having a large retention and water storage capacity below the paved surface such that the runoff water which has permeated through is either dispersed by seeping into the ground and earth or is conveyed to a separate reservoir space where it is treated, and, more particularly, there are the advantageous effects of flood regulation, drought prevention, water resource preservation, sea level rise prevention and soil groundwater restoration, in that effects can be obtained whereby a considerable amount of water can also be stored and retained in spaces in the permeable blocks themselves, and not only rainfall falling onto the road but also rainwater running off the surrounding land can be collected through water drainage holes in the blocks laid on the road such that rainwater from a wide surface area of 2 to 100 times or more the area of the road can be stored and retained even on roads of a predetermined area if the built space per unit area is enlarged, and rainwater running off to the sea can be held in the ground, and oil, tire dust and various heavy metals can be trapped by pollution-removing mats provided on the bottoms of the surface block lower floors and on the ground so as to trap clean rainwater in the underground space.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 홍수, 가뭄, 지구 온난화, 사막화, 해수면 상승 방지 및 토양지하수 복원을 위한 초고속 투수성 블록 도로포장 시스템과 그 시공 방법에 관한 것으로서, 투수 기능이 탁월한 고성능 투수 포장 블록을 사용하여 도로 및 도로주변 넓은 면적의 유출수를 포장 면 하부로 투수시키고, 투수된 유출수를 포장 면 하부에 저류 및 저수 용량이 큰 조립식 구조물을 구조물용 블록을 적층 시공하여 지반과 지중으로 침투, 확산시키거나 별도의 저수공간으로 송수 처리하도록 한 것으로, 특히 투수성 블록 자체 공간에도 상당량의 물을 저장 및 저류 할 수 있어 도로상에 내리는 강우는 물론 주변 토지로부터 유출되는 우수를 도로에 포설된 블록 배수홀을 통해 집수할 수 있고 단위 면적당 구조물 공간을 확대할 경우 일정면적의 도로에서도 도로보다 2~100배 이상의 넓은 면적의 우수를 저장, 저류할 수 있어, 바다로 유출되는 우수를 지반 내에 가둘 수 있고 표층 블록 하부 바닥 및 지반에 설치된 오염제거 매트로 기름, 타이어 분진, 각종 중금속이 걸러지게 되어 깨끗한 우수를 지하 공간에 가두는 효과를 얻을 수 있는 홍수조절, 가뭄 방지, 수자원 보존, 해수면 상승 방지 및 토양지하수 복원의 효과가 있다.
assignees: KGC CO LTD;YU HEUNG SIK;JIN SEONG KYUN

title_en: Construction method of landslide repairing structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction method of a landslide restoration structure, which mainly comprises a bank slope, sand cobbles, gabions above a normal water level, inverted filter geotextile, planting soil, a concrete prefabricated frame beam, a grass planting revetment, a precast slab, a normal water level line, a fixed pile top plate, an outer-coated film bag grouting gabion locking pin, a dredging groove, a timber pile, L steel plates, steel nails, U-shaped steel plates, a gabion embedded fixing rod, a concrete prefabricated frame beam preformed hole, a gabion below the normal water level, a steel plate and a gabion groove.

title_en: Power grid scheduling exception handling aid decision-making method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid scheduling exception handling aid decision-making method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data of a power grid, predicting the load of the power grid according to the historical data, and formulating an emergency mechanism according to a prediction result; setting preferences of the power grid prediction result in different periods, and carrying out risk prompt according to the preferences of the prediction result; acquiring real-time data of a power grid, and generating a load transfer and power grid restoration scheme as a reference scheme of a dispatcher according to the real-time data of the power grid; the invention can realize the load analysis of the power grid, adopt the pre-control measures to the heavy load equipment, realize the real-time risk analysis of the power grid, reveal the risks in different time intervals, is more efficient and more comprehensive than the prior manual analysis, and can also realize the intelligent generation of a load transfer scheme and the automatic generation of a bus voltage loss power recovery scheme, thereby reducing the workload of a dispatcher for writing a plan to a certain extent.

title_en: VSC-HVDC (Voltage Source converter-high Voltage direct Current) access power system unit recovery sequence decision method
abstract_en: The invention provides a VSC-HVDC (voltage source converter-high voltage direct current) access power system unit recovery order decision method, and relates to the technical field of power systems. The method for deciding the recovery sequence of the VSC-HVDC-access-considered power system unit comprises the following specific steps: inputting system topology basic data and recovery characteristic data to form an AHP evaluation system; quantifying the system recovery process by branch addition and calculating the system strength index M SCR Setting a new recovery branch as l, and nodes at two ends as p and q, wherein p is a recovered node, q is a newly recovered node, the system gradually adds the branch from a direct current drop point k to the outside, and obtains the point kSelf-impedance. The invention provides a dynamic decision method combining system intensity by considering the strategy research of unit recovery of VSC-HVDC access to alternating current systems with different system intensities, and a step-by-step optimization method is adopted to quickly decide the state of the system in real time.

title_en: Method for multi-failure power restoration of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for multi-failure power restoration of a power distribution network. The method overcomes the defect that a traditional method for multi-failure power restoration of the power distribution network cannot solve multiple failures. The method for multi-failure power restoration of the power distribution network comprises the steps that multi-failure judgment is conducted on multiple failures with processing unfinished, and multiple failures and multiple independent failures are formed; then independent failure restoration area division is conducted on the multiple failures, and power restoration is conducted on independent failure restoration areas one by one; after the multiple failures are processed, power restoration is conducted on each independent failure. By the adoption of the method for multi-failure power restoration of the power distribution network, the power restoration efficiency is greatly improved, and the real-time performance of power restoration is improved; the factor of load balance is considered when public power restoration lines are decoupled, so that the load rates of the power restoration lines participating in power restoration are more similar after failure restoration, and therefore the power supply reliability of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;LAIWU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for rapidly restoring water storage capacity of highly-degenerated tropical forest soil
abstract_en: A method for rapidly restoring water storage capacity of highly degenerated tropical forest soil belongs to the field of environmental ecology restoration, and comprises (1) taking adjacent undisturbed mountains as reference, comprehensively designing a proper slope, singly planting a plurality of fast-growing tree species, and consolidating a refilled soil layer to prevent serious landslide and other hazards caused by external interference, (2) carrying out mixed planting on original species in adjacent undisturbed areas and the singly planted fast-growing tree species to restore soil moisture storage, thereby providing a method for rapidly restoring water storage capacity of highly degenerated tropical forest soil.

title_en: Adaptive multifocal restoration method based on plankton digital holographic image
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, and particularly discloses a self-adaptive multifocal restoration method based on plankton digital holographic images, which comprises the steps of firstly shooting a holographic in-situ image, then reconstructing the in-situ image, performing edge detection and threshold segmentation on the reconstructed image to obtain contour information of plankton in the reconstructed image, shearing the reconstructed image data set according to the contour information to obtain a target image data set, generating a definition index based on the gradient and variance of the target image, screening out the clearest target image based on the definition index, splicing the clearest target image to the in-situ image according to the original coordinates, clear images of plankton can be extracted, the problem of huge data processing existing in an acquisition system is effectively solved, the engineering quantity of marine plankton detection is effectively simplified, and further, the change of the number of plankton is effectively monitored, so that disasters such as red tide are forecasted.

title_en: Landslide body side slope ecological restoration structure and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide mass side slope ecological restoration structure and a restoration method, comprising the following steps: a plurality of water reservoirs are arranged and dug on the slope surface of the landslide body; the bottom rock layer is formed by large rocks paved on a flat ground at the slope bottom of the landslide body; the geotextile is laid on the surface of the bottom rock layer; the drainage pipes are arranged on the geotextile, are horizontally and uniformly arranged along the direction vertical to the landslide body, a water suction pump is arranged at a water outlet of each reservoir, water guide pipes are connected to two ends of each water suction pump, the other ends of the water guide pipes are connected with the drainage pipes, and finally, an upper rock layer is formed by small rocks laid above the drainage pipes, and the steel reinforcement framework is arranged by penetrating through the upper rock layer; the geocell foreign soil cultivation layer is arranged on the upper rock layer; the slope ecological restoration structure and the slope ecological restoration method disclosed by the invention have a good slope ecological restoration effect.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: Intelligent management and control method and device for network cut-over risk operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network cut-over risk operation intelligent control method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: a cutting process is formulated, departments needing to participate in the consultation are determined according to the professional type and the emergency degree of cutting, and cutting pre-approval is sequentially carried out; judging whether risk operation exists, carrying out a corresponding accident risk auditing flow according to the risk level, and calling the capability to realize the restoration verification of the cut-over service; and providing a cut-over view and rule management for the user. The method and the device construct a full life cycle cutting process, which comprises the stages of pre-approval, risk examination in accidents, repeated disc after accidents and the like, form transparent views, audit and manage risk operation of each cutting link, integrate various digitization capacities and promote operator management class digitization transformation.
assignees: ZHONGYING YOUCHUANG INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Healthy river ecosystem construction method based on water ecological function partition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a healthy river ecosystem construction method based on water ecological function partition, which comprises the following steps: determining all levels of rivers in the target watershed and watersheds corresponding to all levels of rivers through an ArcGIS module based on DEM data of the target watershed, and taking the (i + 1) th level of river watershed as a partition basic unit of the ith level of water ecological functional partition; acquiring natural geographical driving factor data and partition characterization index data of an i + 1-th level river basin; performing cluster analysis on natural geographical driving factor data and partition characterization index data of each i + 1-level river basin in the target basin to obtain partitions on the i-level water ecological function partition; acquiring watershed ecological health index data of each subarea on the ith-level water ecological function subarea, and evaluating the health condition of each subarea on the ith-level water ecological function subarea; and (3) setting ecological restoration measures of different levels based on the health condition of each subarea and the level of the water ecological function subarea corresponding to the subarea, and constructing a healthy river ecological system.
assignees: EAST CHINA SURVEY DESIGN RES INSTITUTE ZHENGZHOU LIMITED COMPANY OF ZHONGZHOU JIANGZHOU PROVINCE;CHINA POWER CONSTRUCTION GROUP EAST CHINA SURVEY DESIGN RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Metal mine ecological restoration method based on EOD mode
abstract_en: An EOD mode-based metal mine ecological restoration method comprises the following steps: s1: surveying the landform of the waste stone slope; s2: constructing a cofferdam at the toe of the slope, and then chamfering and pressing the waste stone slope; s3: building a water seepage well in the cofferdam, and filling a water filtering filler in the cofferdam; s4: filling new waste residue stones, and heightening the height of the infiltration well along with the increase of the waste residue stone layer; s5: covering the soil and constructing a ditch; s6: sowing, and irrigating the foreign soil through the seepage well and the ditch; s7: after vegetation recovery, livestock breeding is performed. The invention has at least the following beneficial effects: 1. solves the problem of leaving over the existing waste rock slopes, and avoids the occurrence of geological disasters; 2. solves the problem of placement of redundant waste residue stones; 3. solves the problem of water source and provides precondition for restoration of mine ecology; 4. the ecological restoration scheme of the coordination of vegetation restoration and livestock breeding is provided, and the profitability and sustainability of ecological environment management are improved.
assignees: HENAN FAENDE MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Ecological perching fish nest optimal design method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological perching fish nest optimization design method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring environment information of an ecological restoration water area and determining rationality of an ecological restoration target; constructing AQUATOX model prediction calculation to determine the quantity requirements of various types of fish shoals, and respectively determining the quantity requirements of fish nests corresponding to each type of fish shoals; carrying out material selection design on the fish nest based on fish habit; carrying out structural design of the fish nest based on the material selection design result; manufacturing a fish nest based on the material design result and the structure design result, and adjusting and optimizing the design of the fish nest through a test until the attraction effect of the fish shoal reaches the preset requirement; and finally, arranging and designing the fish nest in the ecological restoration water area. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the design quality of the fish nest can be improved, the attraction effect, the ecological restoration effect and the biodiversity improvement effect on the fish shoals can be ensured to reach the preset requirements through experiments and adjustment and optimization, and the effect of ecological restoration measures is enhanced.
assignees: CCCC THIRD HARBOR ENG CO LTD

title_en: Airport-high-speed rail traffic infrastructure double-layer network disaster-resistant toughness recovery analysis method
abstract_en: An airport-high-speed rail traffic infrastructure double-layer network disaster-resistant toughness recovery analysis method. The method comprises the steps of establishing an airport-high-speed rail traffic infrastructure double-layer network model, performing characteristic analysis on the model, calculating relative importance of an airport and a high-speed rail network layer and intra-layer importance of nodes, calculating global importance of the nodes in the model, selecting an airport and high-speed rail node with a node value, an aggregation coefficient value and a global importance value to damage, obtaining failure nodes in the airport-high-speed rail traffic infrastructure double-layer network model, evaluating the toughness of the model through changes of double-layer network efficiency before and after failure of the calculation nodes, determining optimal recovery sequence of the failure nodes based on a genetic algorithm and the like. The invention effectively improves the disaster resistance toughness of the double-layer network of the airport-high-speed rail traffic infrastructure, and provides an analysis method for improving the operation efficiency of the comprehensive three-dimensional traffic infrastructure in China and integrally allocating the recovery resources under the disaster.

title_en: Power supply restoration decision method for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply restoration decision method of a power distribution network, which comprises the steps of firstly, obtaining data required by a power supply restoration simulation environment of the power distribution network, and establishing a power distribution network power supply restoration simulation environment based on the acquired data. Secondly, a Markov decision process for power restoration of the power distribution network is defined based on the constructed simulation environment, wherein the Markov decision process comprises a state space, an action space and a reward function. Based on the decision process, a power supply recovery reinforcement learning intelligent agent based on DDQN algorithm is constructed, and is interacted with a simulation environment to obtain a training sample and train. After the training of the intelligent agent is finished, the importance of each input feature to the decision result of the intelligent agent is calculated by using a Shapley value analysis method, visual feature importance ordering is provided for a dispatcher, an interpretable power supply recovery strategy is provided for the dispatcher, and the interpretability and the credibility of the decision are improved.

title_en: Communication device, management method of storage unit in the same communication device, and management program of storage unit in the same communication device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve a problem of being unable to deliver reception data which a management PC has not obtained to a user due to the data disappearance when blackout and the like occurs because of property of a volatile memory, although the volatile memory is used in the storage area of an external storage.SOLUTION: When a first communication unit communicates with an external device, a first storage unit stores reception data received from the external device regardless of on or off of electric power. In addition, a second storage unit stores conversion data converted to a prescribed format from the data received from the external device only when electric power is on, and an output unit is capable of outputting the conversion data. Here, an electric power determination unit is capable of determining whether electric power is on or off, and based on determination that power has been turned on, a restoration management unit converts the reception data in the first storage unit into conversion data to make the second storage unit store the conversion data.

title_en: Impact Buffering Range Extended Quake Resistant Electric Distribution Cabinet
title_ko: 충격 완충 범위가 확장된 내진 기능 수배전반
abstract_en: The present invention provides a switchgear having an earthquake resistant function with an extended shock buffering range, which can more widely absorb and alleviate impacts caused by an earthquake with a large deviation transmitted to the switchgear. To this end, the present invention is provided with an earthquake resistant structure formed by embedding a standing spring and a horizontal backup spring in order to absorb and alleviate impact force applied from top, bottom, left, right, front, and rear sides, while in particular, a spiral spring, to which restoration force is imparted by winding thin metal plate, is installed on the inner side of the horizontal backup spring and a central shaft, protruding to a lower side of the bottom of a cabinet, passes a sleeve located at the center of the spiral spring. Accordingly, the present invention allows the existing standing spring and horizontal backup spring to handle impacts with high seismic intensity, and allows the spiral spring to handle impacts with very high frequency and low seismic intensity, such that many expensive electrical facilities embedded in the switchgear can be protected by absorbing and alleviating the impact energy with more wide-ranged seismic intensity, thereby enhancing reliability as well as a service life of the switchgear.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 수배전반에 전달되는 편차가 큰 크기의 지진에 의한 충격을 보다 폭넓게 흡수, 완화할 수 있도록 한 완충 범위가 확장된 내진 기능 수배전반을 개시한다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은 상, 하, 좌, 우, 전, 후에서 가해지는 충격력을 흡수, 완화하기 위하여 기립스프링과 수평백업스프링을 내장하여서 된 내진구조체를 구비하되, 특히 상기 수평백업스프링 내측으로 얇은 금속판을 감아서 복원력을 부여한 스파이럴스프링을 설치하고, 상기 스파이럴스프링 중심의 슬리브에 캐비닛 저면 하방으로 돌출된 중심축이 관통되도록 한다. 
이에 따라, 본 발명은 높은 진도의 충격은 기존의 기립스프링과 수평백업스프링이 감당하게 되고 빈도가 매우 높은 낮은 진도의 충격은 스파이럴스프링이 감당하게 됨으로써 보다 보다 폭넓은 진도의 충격 에너지를 흡수, 완화하게 되어 수배전반에 내장된 많은 고가의 전기 설비들을 보호할 수 있게 됨으로써 수배전반의 수명은 물론 신뢰성을 향상시킬 수 있게 되는 완충 범위가 확장된 내진 수배전반을 제공하게 된다.

title_en: Digital twin-based method for performing source tracing on power supply path at important place
abstract_en: Disclosed is a digital twin-based method for performing source tracing on a power supply path at an important place. In order to overcome the problems in the existing technology of requiring restoration of mapping of a single object in a digital space on the basis of the actual on-site situation, and requiring manual collection of data and mapping, which consumes time and labor, according to the present invention, digital twin scenarios are established at separate levels, a power supply path is constructed and refined on the basis of a signal-flow relationship between power topology and devices, and, when a device breaks down, source tracing is performed on a power supply path to determine the range of influence, said source tracing being rapid and accurate.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG TONGXIANG ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Accelerated recovery after a data disaster
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present invention, a metadata file is transferred from the first system to the second system and a database on the second system is initialized based on the metadata file. An image, including information of the first system to be restored, is transferred from the first system to the second system, and restoration of the information to the second system based on the image is initiated. Prior to completion of the restoration, one or more log files indicating actions performed on the first system relating to the information to be restored is transferred from the first system to the initialized database on the second system. In response to completion of the restoration, the actions of the log files are performed to synchronize the restored data on the second system with the first system.

title_en: Method and system for health rank based virtual machine restoration using a conformal framework
abstract_en: A method and system for health rank based virtual machine restoration using a conformal framework. With respect to enterprise data protection, solutions need to address two primary responsibilities: at the onset of failure or disaster, restore any running applications, as well as any lost or damaged data; and minimize (if not eliminate) the future occurrence of such failures or disasters. In tackling the latter responsibility, the disclosed method and system leverage health-score assessments to ensure the restoration of virtual machines onto healthy infrastructure. The aforementioned health-score assessments employ clustering to identify, and a conformal framework to rank, healthy hosts onto which virtual machines may be restored.

title_en: Protecting data against malware attacks using cyber vault and automated airgap control
abstract_en: Improving data recovery and restoration times by clamping down security after malware detection, and protect a data center from a cyber recovery vault. Embodiments provide a cyber recovery vault configured to store data backed up for a production site for long-term retention and disaster recovery. The vault is coupled to the data center comprising a production site through an automated air gap controlled by the vault. Control signals transmitted by the vault trigger the air gap to close the coupling between the vault and data center upon detection of a malware attack, and the data center is configured to listen for the control signals and implement heightened security measures to protect its data in response to the control signal.

title_en: Maritime unmanned aerial vehicle video image defogging method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maritime unmanned aerial vehicle video image defogging method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of: 1) shooting a marine clear video image through an airborne camera of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and establishing a marine video image database according to an atmospheric scattering model; 2) establishing a multi-scale convolution neural network model, and training by using an offshore video image database; 3) acquiring a marine video image through a visible light camera arranged on an unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain a shot fog-containing image I' (x); 4) inputting the fog-containing image I' (x) into a trained multi-scale convolutional neural network model for processing to obtain an intermediate variable k (x); 5) and obtaining a final defogged image J' (x) by using a clear image restoration formula, wherein the clear image restoration formula is as follows: j '(x) ═ k (x) (I' (x) -1) + b, I '(x) is a captured video image containing fog, J' (x) is a restored clear image, k (x) is an intermediate variable, and b may take an arbitrary constant. The method can effectively solve the problem that the video image acquired by the unmanned aerial vehicle vision system is fuzzy under the foggy weather condition, thereby improving the search and rescue capacity of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Landslide body side slope ecological restoration structure and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide mass side slope ecological restoration structure and a restoration method, comprising the following steps: a plurality of water reservoirs are arranged and dug on the slope surface of the landslide body; the bottom rock layer is formed by large rocks paved on a flat ground at the slope bottom of the landslide body; the geotextile is laid on the surface of the bottom rock layer; the drainage pipes are arranged on the geotextile, are horizontally and uniformly arranged along the direction vertical to the landslide body, a water suction pump is arranged at a water outlet of each reservoir, water guide pipes are connected to two ends of each water suction pump, the other ends of the water guide pipes are connected with the drainage pipes, and finally, an upper rock layer is formed by small rocks laid above the drainage pipes, and the steel reinforcement framework is arranged by penetrating through the upper rock layer; the geocell foreign soil cultivation layer is arranged on the upper rock layer; the slope ecological restoration structure and the slope ecological restoration method disclosed by the invention have a good slope ecological restoration effect.

title_en: Carbon fixation and emission reduction effect evaluation method and device for river basin vegetation recovery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon sequestration emission reduction effect evaluation, and discloses a carbon sequestration emission reduction effect evaluation method and device for river basin vegetation restoration, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating reference carbon sequestration emission reduction corresponding to a river basin reference scenario scheme by using a river basin land ecological system water-carbon coupling model; setting leaf area indexes and vegetation types in a target river basin, constructing a river basin vegetation recovery scheme based on the leaf area indexes and the vegetation types, calculating carbon sequestration emission reduction caused by vegetation recovery corresponding to the river basin vegetation recovery scheme by using a water-carbon coupling model of a river basin land ecological system, wherein the carbon sequestration emission reduction caused by vegetation recovery comprises total water energy carbon sequestration, total vegetation carbon sequestration and total karst carbon sequestration, and evaluating carbon sequestration effect of the river basin vegetation recovery based on reference carbon sequestration emission reduction and carbon sequestration emission reduction caused by vegetation recovery to obtain a carbon sequestration effect evaluation result. The invention comprehensively and reliably evaluates the carbon sequestration emission reduction effect of river basin vegetation restoration.

title_en: Safety check apparatus for korean style house and korea style house having against earthquake function having safety check apparatus
title_ko: 한옥용 안전점검장치 및 한옥용 안전점검장치가 구비된 지진 대비 기능을 갖는 한옥
abstract_en: According to the present invention, when an earthquake occurs, a hanok (traditional Korean house) structure is totally moved to reduce vibration and shock transmission; thereby damage to the hanok structure being minimized, and a position of the moved hanok structure being able to easily be moved at an original position to secure restoration properties. Moreover, provided are a safety check apparatus for the hanok and the hanok having an earthquake proof function having a safety check apparatus for the hanok capable of securing durability by forming a roof tile structure with weak durability of a roof with waterproof and vibration proof functions to secure durability; and is able to easily determine whether following reinforcement is required by accurately and conveniently determining durability of a column.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 지진 발생시 한옥 구조물이 전체적으로 이동되어 진동 및 충격 전달이 감소됨에 따라 한옥 구조물의 손상이 최소화되고, 이동된 한옥 구조물의 위치를 쉽게 정위치할 수 있음에 따라 복원성이 확보된다. 또한, 내구성이 취약한 지붕의 기와 구조를 방수 및 방진 가능하게 구성하여 내구성이 확보되고, 기둥의 내구성 판단을 정확하고 간편하게 수행하여 추후 보강 판단 여부가 용이한 한옥용 안전점검장치 및 한옥용 안전점검장치가 구비된 지진 대비 기능을 갖는 한옥이 소개된다.

title_en: Aggregated real-time power outages/restoration reporting (RTPOR) in a secure mesh network
abstract_en: Embodiments of the invention provide systems and methods for the reporting of status changes, such as but not limited to power outages and/or power restorations, throughout a smart grid system. Through the use of location-based reporting period selection and/or status change report aggregation, embodiments may provide efficient reporting processes that timely and accurately report status change information from the point(s) of the change to a back-end system via an access point.

title_en: Power transfer weak ring quantitative identification method influencing power distribution network fault recovery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quantitatively identifying a transfer power supply weak ring influencing fault recovery of a power distribution network, which comprises the following steps of: s1: modeling a main network and a distribution network, and selecting a starting point; s2: calculating the bus security load; s3: calculating the total restoration load of the single-switching-supply path feeder line; s4: calculating the total load of the multi-turn supply path recovery; s5: calculating the primary load recovery rate of the transformer substation; s6: judging whether the calculation of all the substations is finished or not, if not, repeating the steps S1-S5; s7: sequencing the transformer substations according to the load primary recovery rate, and sequencing the transformer substations according to the load primary recovery rate; s8: and positioning and improving the weak link according to the threshold value. The invention provides a power transfer and supply weak link quantitative identification method which can carry out quantitative calculation on power transfer and supply weak links of a power grid and provides a basis for planning, regulating and controlling a power distribution network and power grid transformation and influences the fault recovery of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Optimization restoration method for urban ponding road and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimization restoration method for urban ponding roads and a computer readable medium. The method comprises the steps of constructing a road undirected network topology model; carrying out traffic simulation through the SUMO open source model to obtain a traffic flow set of nodes in the road undirected network topology model and a traffic flow set of edges in the road undirected network topology model; generating a shortest time point path set among nodes of the road undirected network topology model based on dijkstra algorithm; calculating the betweenness centrality of edges and the betweenness centrality of nodes in the road undirected network topology model; sorting by utilizing a merging sorting algorithm to respectively obtain a set of descending sorted edges and a node set of descending sorted edges in the road undirected network topology model; and further repairing the ponding road section and the ponding intersection. The invention has the advantages of considering the traffic time and the traffic flow optimization betweenness centrality and dynamically and accurately reflecting the road network state.

title_en: Power distribution network fault reconstruction method based on improved river horse optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault reconstruction method based on an improved river horse optimization algorithm, according to the method, the connected components are used for fault recovery evaluation, the load which can be recovered by a reconstruction mode is determined in advance, and the problem solving complexity is reduced. And then, combining the minimum ring set to encode, mapping the solution space of the power distribution network fault reconstruction problem to the search space of an algorithm, wherein the encoding mode can greatly improve the duty ratio of the effective solution. Then, the traditional river horse optimization algorithm is improved by combining the proposed coding strategy, so that the river horse optimization algorithm can adapt to the discrete optimization problem. And finally, the improved river horse optimization algorithm is utilized to quickly solve the power distribution network fault reconstruction strategy, so that quick power restoration is realized.

title_en: Spare power automatic switching device management method and management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a management method of a spare power automatic switching device, which comprises the steps of acquiring and analyzing station equipment data, wherein the station equipment data comprises transformer data, bus data, spare power automatic switching device data, circuit breaker data and connection point number data, judging whether the spare power automatic switching device needs to be deactivated according to the transformer data, the circuit breaker data and preset deactivation conditions, sending out a spare power automatic switching device deactivation early warning when the deactivation conditions are met, and sending out a spare power automatic switching device restoration early warning when the deactivation conditions are not met. The invention can pre-warn the linkage analysis of the main transformer load of the transformer substation and the backup automatic switching, analyze the running condition of the main transformer load of the transformer substation in real time, stop the backup automatic switching and timely pre-warn when the total load of the main transformer exceeds a certain limit, and timely remind the backup automatic switching when the main transformer load is recovered to be normal, so that the dispatcher takes corresponding measures to avoid serious power grid accidents.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WUXI POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based water body sand content measuring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water body sand content measuring method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps of firstly establishing an inference model from a digital quantized value of a target water body image to the target water body sand content, secondly enabling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly along the target water body and collect images of different areas of the target water body and transmit the images back to a remote computer, thirdly, manually calibrating the water body areas in all the images collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle, fourthly, calculating an average value DN1 of the digital quantized values of all pixels by the computer aiming at the water body areas calibrated in all the images, and thirdly, obtaining the sand content corresponding to all the images collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle by the computer through the inference model established in the first step. The invention realizes high-efficiency, accurate and low-cost monitoring of the sand content of the water body through 'model driving + unmanned aerial vehicle dynamic acquisition + data processing', is applicable to river management requirements in a large-scale and complex environment, and provides reliable technical support for water resource protection, disaster early warning and ecological restoration.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Real time automatic update system and method for disaster damage investigation using wireless communication and web-gis
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a real time automatic update system and method for disaster damage investigation using wireless communication and web-GIS.  <P>SOLUTION: The real time automatic update system provides investigation equipment capable of ensuring the objectivity of estimation of each damage scale, ensuring a scientific basis therefor and quickly and accurately performing an investigation process by the use of equipment such as a digital camera, a GPS, a voice recorder, wireless ultrahigh-speed communication equipment and so on when a disaster damage investigation for damage of lives and other various kinds of damages of natural objects, artificial objects, etc. is conducted, which performs various data operations for arranging, entering, storing and processing an investigated result, sends the arranged data to each server to automatically process them in real time in the form of information suited to a given type and post them in the homepage, main page and bulletin and processes them in the form of a standardized disaster register to generate a web page, and which registers a disaster point on the web-GIS through disaster point coordinates or the like and displays the properties thereof and links the homepage, the disaster register, the web-GIS and so on in order to quickly search and check various information, whereby it is possible to support in rapidly establishing damage restoration measures and disaster prevention measures.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Paddy field restoration method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a paddy field restoration method for restoring a paddy field affected by a tsunami to the paddy field capable of cultivating rice.SOLUTION: A paddy field restoration method to restore a paddy field affected by a tsunami comprises: an excavation process to excavate paddy soil 5 with foreign objects mixed therein due to damage by the tsunami; a cleaning process to clean the excavated paddy soil 5 with cleaning water; a fine debris removal process to remove fine debris, which is the foreign object, from slurry of the paddy soil 5 produced in the cleaning process; a sand component removal process to remove sand, which is also the foreign object, from the slurry which undergoes the fine debris removal process; and a fine grain fraction recovery process to recover a fine grain fraction included in the slurry by flocculating the same through addition of a flocculation agent 50 having mineral as a main component to the slurry which undergoes the sand component removal process. The paddy field restoration method recovers the fine grain fraction as the fine grain fraction with diameters available for the paddy field and returns the recovered fine grain fraction to the paddy field.
assignees: HITACHI SHIPBUILDING ENG CO;ASTECH CO LTD

title_en: Base isolation structure capable of adjusting inclination of building
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the problems associated with the conventional base isolation devices: in which the constriction cost is high because special materials are used; they are difficult to be used for general houses; and only insufficient consideration is given for a method of restoration when the whole building is inclined due to a step and the like occurring in a site, in the event of a natural disaster such as ground subsidence.SOLUTION: A base isolation structure has such a separation structure that building side is formed into a slip part and a ground side is formed into a fixed part. A metal frame is fastened to and integrated with a lower part of a building foundation in the slip part, and a metal member for slip and a metal member for height adjustment are mounted on the lower part of the metal frame at a position corresponding to each column portion on the foundation. A stopper for horizontal and vertical swing range regulation and a metal sole plate are mounted on the fixed part. Due to a slip effect generated between the slip part and the fixed part, resonance of the ground and the building is avoided and swing and inclination of the building are reduced, if the building is inclined, a height adjustment bolt is vertically moved, a laminated metal plate is increasingly or decreasingly adjusted and inserted into a gap generated in the lower part of the metal frame of the slip part, and thereby the inclination of the building can be restored to a normal position, and the base isolation structure can be easily used by general available materials and construction methods.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Restoration plan formulation device, restoration plan formulation method and restoration plan formulation program
abstract_en: To provide a restoration plan formulation device which performs efficient restoration, a restoration plan formulation method and restoration plan formulation program.SOLUTION: In a risk management system 1, a restoration plan formulation device 10 comprises: a restoration priority calculation unit 12d which calculates a restoration priority indicating a degree to make restoration preferential for each facility based on a disaster degree of each facility in the case where a crisis event occurs, and a preset degree of influences onto services in the case where each facility is damaged by the disaster; and a restoration plan formulation unit 12e which forms a restoration plan including resource distribution for restoring each facility based on the restoration priority of each facility calculated by the priority calculation unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Service recovery priority evaluation method, device, storage medium, and product
abstract_en: The present invention provides a service recovery priority evaluation method, a device, a storage medium, and a product. The service recovery priority evaluation method comprises: respectively obtaining an RTO evaluation value, an RPO evaluation value, a minimum tolerable quality of service (QoS) evaluation value, and a minimum tolerable quality of experience (QoE) evaluation value of a target service; and determining a target recovery priority of the target service according to the RTO evaluation value, the RPO evaluation value, the minimum tolerable QoS evaluation value, and the minimum tolerable QoE evaluation value. That is, according to the present invention, a service recovery QoS object and a service recovery QoE object are introduced, and the service recovery QoS object and the service recovery QoE object are combined with an RTO and an RPO, so that the purpose of formulating a disaster recovery priority is achieved so as to guarantee that disaster recovery resources are reasonably allocated and formulate a more objective and comprehensive disaster recovery policy, and the QoS and the QoE after service recovery can be guaranteed to the maximum extent.

title_en: Method and apparatus for regulating and controlling energy stored by power distribution network in participating in power supply restoration of loads in disaster area, terminal device, and storage medium
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention are a method and apparatus for regulating and controlling energy stored by a power distribution network in participating in power supply restoration of loads in a disaster area, a terminal device, and a storage medium. The method comprises: on the basis of acquired typhoon disaster area data, power distribution network state data and power distribution network energy storage data, constructing a disaster area load power supply restoration optimization model with the objectives of minimizing a disaster area power distribution network frequency deviation and power distribution network energy storage frequency modulation power, and constructing a stationary energy storage station power constraint, a mobile energy storage vehicle power constraint, a grid-connected point voltage constraint, and an active power exchange constraint; under the constructed constraints, solving for the disaster area load power supply restoration optimization model, so as to generate the proportion of loads borne by the energy stored by a power distribution network when the disaster area power distribution network frequency deviation and the power distribution network energy storage frequency modulation power are minimum; and on the basis of the proportion of the loads borne by the energy stored by the power distribution network, performing regulation and control again on the energy stored by the power distribution network in participating in power supply restoration of the loads in a disaster area. By implementing the present invention, the energy stored by the power distribution network in participating in power supply restoration of the loads in the disaster area is regulated and controlled.

title_en: The transmission of electricity rack restoration methods emulated based on multiple agent and fired power generating unit cluster
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of transmission of electricity rack restoration methods emulated based on multiple agent and fired power generating unit cluster.This method includes scheduling intelligent body, using simulation for thermal power plant cluster as power plant's intelligent body of kernel and intelligent substation body.First, this method simulates power generation and power transformation link can be used recovery information in scheduling in transmission of electricity rack recovery process in real time identification and acquisition by the two-way information interaction between power plant's intelligent body, intelligent substation body and scheduling intelligent body.In turn, realize that the centralized decision-making to unit recovery sequence and rack structure optimizes based on scheduling intelligent body.Finally, by dispatching intelligent body to the unidirectionally controlled of power plant's intelligent body and intelligent substation body, the simulated operation of recovery process is completed.This method fully simulates the response process that fired power generating unit is restored and different power transformations and power transmission operation complexity, the parameters such as obtained recovery time, recovery generated energy can fully reflect the actual effect after recovery policy execution, and practical guided significance is had more to transmission of electricity rack recovery process.

title_en: Damaged mountain modeling, stability and design integrated analysis method based on remote sensing and GIS
abstract_en: A damaged mountain modeling, stability and design integrated analysis method based on remote sensing and GIS belongs to the technical field of damaged mountain ecological restoration. The integrated analysis technology is suitable for analyzing damaged mountain bodies with steep topography, and firstly, data are collected and used for assisting in early-stage route design; implementing unmanned aerial vehicle oblique photography according to the early-stage on-site survey condition and the route design parameters to obtain oblique multi-view image data with complete area; combining the acquired data and other parameter files, constructing a real-scene three-dimensional model of the measuring area by means of fine modeling software, and analyzing the stability of the real-scene three-dimensional model; and (5) carrying out geological disaster prevention and ecological restoration engineering design on the damaged mountain according to the model analysis result. The invention is an engineering example for accurately detecting and analyzing damaged mountain based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing, GIS and other means, and has important reference value for detecting and managing relevant damaged mountain.

title_en: Urban multi-mode traffic network post-disaster restoration strategy efficiency evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an urban multi-mode traffic network post-disaster restoration strategy efficiency assessment method and system, which belong to the technical field of urban traffic operation management, and are characterized in that a multi-mode traffic network structure model is constructed by utilizing road network and public transport network open source data, a multi-mode traffic network function model is constructed by utilizing traffic travel demand data to simulate urban traffic distribution, a multi-mode traffic network structure restoration model is constructed based on the multi-mode traffic network function model according to disaster space distribution characteristics and post-disaster network restoration strategies, the structure restoration efficiency is assessed, travel demands are reloaded based on the multi-mode traffic network structure restoration model, the multi-mode traffic network function restoration model is constructed, and the function restoration efficiency is assessed. The invention can comprehensively consider multiple traffic modes and complex dynamic games among travelers, provides more accurate and comprehensive repair strategy evaluation, can enhance the toughness of the urban comprehensive traffic system, and can better cope with various disasters and emergency situations.

title_en: Systems and methods for managing power at an optical network terminal
abstract_en: Systems and methods presented herein provide for operating an optical network terminal (ONT) during a power outage. In one embodiment, an ONT includes an opto-electrical converter operable to receive an optical signal and to convert the optical signal to a data signal, and a data processing module operable to process data from the data signal. The ONT also includes a power management unit operable to detect a power outage of a power supply, to initiate a low power mode, to terminate a portion of data processing by the data processing module based on the low power mode, to convert the optical signal to electrical power, and to maintain operation of the low power mode utilizing the electrical power. The power management unit is further operable to monitor the power supply for restoration of power, and to reinitialize the data processing module upon restoration of power.

title_en: Elevator device
abstract_en: The present invention can foreshorten to elevator and operate required time again when power supply is from service restoration.Elevator device has：Position detection signal and the travel speed comprising the car and the code device signal of traveling-position based on the test position for being shown in the car lifted in elevator hoistways, calculate the car position computing device of the absolute position of the car；Control the elevator operation controller of elevator operating；Detect the power cut detection device for the power outage powered to car position computing device；Detect the presence of the releasing of brake detection means for implementing manual release brake action；And storage carries out the storage device of the testing result of releasing of brake detection means when power failure detects using power cut detection device, elevator operation controller can be with reference to the storage content of storage device in power up, can not obtain represent to implement the information of manual release brake action when, based on the absolute position of the car calculated using car position computing device, the operating of car is controlled.

title_en: A kind of research and development of multifunctional low-voltage distribution net equipment electronics account
abstract_en: The invention discloses the research and development of the multifunctional low-voltage distribution net equipment electronics account of press-fitting net equipment technical field, including acquisition system, input system, central processing unit, storage system, comparative analysis system, output system and display system, the input terminal of the central processing system passes through data line and input system respectively, storage system and comparative analysis system are electrically connected, the present invention is by primary cable, the equipment such as shaft tower are acquired and typing, improve low-voltage network equipment account, form real-time electronics account, it realizes and statistics and analysis function is carried out to the quantity of low-voltage distribution apparatus, by the distribution of the equipment such as low-voltage distribution network route and metering device and moves towards geography information and be acquired and typing, establish distribution line distribution electronic map；Realize low pressure O&M from traditional mode to intelligence, visual O&M Mode change；Realize low pressure O&M, fast power restoration, with robbing integrated management mode.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Civil aviation route planning method with limit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil aviation route planning method with restriction, which comprises the steps of obtaining route data and route restriction data, and generating a route network diagram according to the route data and the route restriction data; calculating the shortest route from a preset starting point to a preset end point under the condition of no route restriction according to the route network diagram; performing route restriction inspection on the shortest route; outputting the shortest route as the shortest route with the route limit when the shortest route passes the route limit check; when the shortest route does not pass the route limit check, carrying out path restoration and neighborhood construction according to the shortest route to obtain a plurality of candidate routes meeting the route limit, and adding the plurality of candidate routes into a preset candidate solution pool to carry out optimal route iterative computation until the preset constraint condition is met; and outputting the optimal route in the candidate solution pool as the shortest route with route restriction. The embodiment of the invention can quickly find out legal paths meeting all the route restrictions, and improves the route optimizing efficiency.

title_en: Data disaster recovery method, system, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a data disaster recovery method, a system, a storage medium and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the corresponding backup environment is deployed for the main environment, and a distributed database synchronization system is deployed in the main environment; synchronizing data of the main environment to the standby environment in a full-volume synchronization mode and an incremental synchronization mode based on a distributed database synchronization system; responding to the failure of the main environment, disabling the incremental synchronization mode, and enabling the standby environment to accept all business services of the main environment; and responding to the restoration of the main environment, and restoring the data of the standby environment to the main environment in a full-scale synchronous mode. The invention realizes the automation of the switching flow of the main environment and the standby environment, and solves the problems of untimely data synchronization, multiple manual participation of the main and standby switching, complicated steps, high error rate, long recovery time and the like in the traditional disaster recovery scheme; the service system can be switched smoothly in the disaster scene, so that the user service can be recovered more quickly.
assignees: JINAN INSPUR DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mud-rock flow pile-up fan ecology and rock-soil measure cooperation silt stopping system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mud-rock flow accumulation fan ecology and rock-soil measure cooperative silt stopping system. The system organically integrates two major types of rock and soil and ecological measures, and is arranged in a three-dimensional mode in a ground flow area and an impact height space area of the debris flow. And sequentially arranging a rock-soil measure section, an ecological rock-soil combination measure section and an ecological measure section along the dredging movement direction. And in each section, the system sequentially generates three layers of stopping effects of opposite impact energy dissipation, diversion peak clipping, ground resistance increasing, space grading blocking and ground resistance increasing and silt stopping on the debris flow by utilizing the measure type selection and the structural characteristics thereof. The technology aims to cooperatively integrate the control efficacy of the rock soil and the ecological measures, enhance the natural ecological restoration capability of the silt stopping system, prolong the service life of the system and eliminate the hidden danger of secondary disasters. The optimized ecological rock-soil combination measure section adopts a staged construction method of matching spatial arrangement with dynamic time, so that stable and organic combination of the two measures is ensured. The invention also provides a design and calculation model of the blocking height of the structures in the system.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Suck-out preventive injection method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To particularly quicken rising of strength, infiltrate into every part of an injection area, and improve suck-out resistance in a suck-out preventive injection method for use in reinforcement or cut-off of the soft ground, restoration of a building (righting the building) inclined by ground subsidence due to an earthquake, excavation work, or the like, backfilling of a tunnel or the like, filling of a cavity, consolidation under the water surface such as the sea bottom or underwater, or the like.  <P>SOLUTION: Fluidized plastic gel is used as an injection material, and injection materials different in plasticity holding time are used in an initial stage of injection and a subsequent stage of injection. Further, a soil grain infiltrating type nonplastic injection material is injected in the ground in an injection area injected with plastic gel or every part of the injection area. Rising of strength is thereby quick, infiltration into every part of the injection area is attained, and suck-out resistance is improved.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title_en: water heater
abstract_en: To provide a water heater which can perform an operation while assuming a disaster even if the operation is not performed by a user when power interruption caused by the disaster occurs.SOLUTION: A water heater comprises control means for detecting the occurrence of power interruption and restoration from the power interruption, and operation means which can be operated by a user. The water heater can perform an operation in a temporary power interruption mode, and an operation in a disaster power interruption mode. When the control means detects the restoration from the power interruption after the detection of the occurrence of the power interruption, the control means makes the operation means issue a notification for prompting to select either of the temporary power interruption mode or the disaster power interruption mode. After the lapse of a certain amount of time from the execution of the notification by the operation means, when either of the temporary power interruption mode or the disaster power interruption mode is not selected, the operation in the disaster power interruption mode is performed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Distributed disaster recovery file sync server system
abstract_en: Example implementations are directed to restoration of data not only from the servers, but also from the clients connected to the server. Algorithms are incorporated to identify content that was created or modified after the last backup. This algorithm also identifies and resolves changes in the mount points for shared folders, preventing information leakage. When the server recovers from a failure, it notifies the clients about the recovery on their next connection. Each client then determines the current state of its mount points and file paths and compares them with the server's mount points and file paths. After the comparison, the client comprehends and indicates the mount point differences by renaming them and sends entire local data (all files, folders, mount points) to the server. The server reconciles the differences.

title_en: System and method for compressing and restoring data using multi-level autoencoders and correlation networks
abstract_en: A system and method for compressing and restoring data using multi-level autoencoders and a correlation network. The system compresses data, such as hyperspectral images, using a multi-level autoencoder. Data restoration employs a correlation network trained on image sets to leverage inter-image correlations. Latent space vector grouping may be used to enhance reconstruction accuracy. The approach achieves efficient compression while maintaining data quality through learned correlations.

title_en: Power system load recovers aid decision-making system and decision making method thereof
abstract_en: A kind of power system load recovers aid decision-making system and decision making method thereof, this system uses B/S framework, including being provided with the database server of SQL Server engine, being provided with load restoration computing engines and the arithmetic server of algorithm, be provided with the Web server of load restoration engineering management engine, the system diagram masterplate client being provided with electrical network primitive control engine and Web client, they are connected by network.The method includes: at database server storage electrical network line chart and electric network data；Open the long-range operating load of Web browser in Web client and recover engineering management engine, the electrical network line chart of storage in database server is managed, sets up corresponding data management table；Algorithm on load restoration engineering management engine calling arithmetic server, generates overloaded partition scheme and the instauration net shelf structure of each subregion internal loading.Native system low cost, it is easy to safeguarding, information can Complete Synchronization.

title_en: Repairing fertilizer after cold injury and disaster and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cold injury post-disaster restoration fertilizer and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of fertilizers, wherein the cold injury post-disaster restoration fertilizer comprises the following components in parts by weight: 120-200 parts of nitrogenous fertilizer, 150-250 parts of phosphate fertilizer, 20-100 parts of potash fertilizer, 200-400 parts of organic carbon liquid, 5-20 parts of antifreeze microbial agent, 2-10 parts of polyglutamic acid, 1-5 parts of xanthan gum, 0-5 parts of NaOH, 5-20 parts of boric acid, 5-10 parts of EDTA calcium, 2-10 parts of soluble magnesium, 2-10 parts of soluble ferrous iron, 1-5 parts of soluble zinc, 2-5 parts of salicylic acid, 2-10 parts of biological stimulant and 100-400 parts of water. By optimizing the coordination of organic carbon, medium and trace elements, biological stimulants and even major elements, the effect of good cold damage repairing effect is finally achieved, and the raw materials of the cold damage post-disaster repairing fertilizer are easy to obtain and low in cost.

title_en: Computing method and computing system for black start restoration network in zone
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calculation method and a calculation system for a black start recovery network in a zone, which utilize a constructed energy function to determine an optimal network among all units during black start, and naturally consider constraint that the reactive power absorption capacity of a black start power supply is larger than that of capacitive reactive power in a mode of minimizing line reactive power. The optimal starting network can be obtained quickly by solving the differential equation set, and a linear programming tool is not needed, so that a new method is provided for solving the starting network.

title_en: Gardens side slope protective structure for ecological remediation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a garden side slope ecological restoration protection structure capable of effectively preventing water and soil loss, which comprises a side slope, a water-proof structure and a water-proof structure, wherein planting soil is arranged in the side slope, and a steel wire mesh covers the outer surface of the planting soil; the protective frame is positioned on the outer surface of the side slope, a support frame is arranged at the bottom end of the protective frame, a movable shaft is connected inside the support frame, and windmill blades are arranged on the outer surface of the movable shaft; the concrete skeleton is located the surface of planting soil, the surface of concrete skeleton is provided with keeps off the backplate. This can effectively prevent soil erosion and water loss's gardens side slope protective structure for ecological restoration, the skeleton bottom anchors the wire net to enclose in the skeleton outside after forming and keep off protective frame, can avoid the rainwash side slope to lead to not hard up and the landslide that leads to of earth, also can reduce the destruction that soil erosion and water loss caused to the vegetation simultaneously, thereby increase the coverage of side slope vegetation.

title_en: Cross-modal attention-based attribute generation face method for generating countermeasure network
abstract_en: Aiming at generating a face image from a visual attribute text, the invention designs a method for generating a face based on the attribute of a cross-modal attention generation countermeasure network. The method relates to an application for generating face images from attribute text descriptions, and in particular to an application for portraying a target person according to language descriptions. The method comprises four parts of data set pretreatment, network model design, network optimal model training and network model performance evaluation. The invention fully plays the superiority of the generation countermeasure network in the aspect of image generation, designs a solution for generating the face from the visual attribute text end to end, and has very broad application prospect in the fields of image restoration, public safety, archaeological research, movie animation and the like.

title_en: Application of fire-fighting injection water track real-time restoration simulation algorithm in virtual environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of a fire-fighting water monitor jet flow path real-time restoration simulation algorithm in a virtual environment, which comprises less hardware equipment required for predicting a jet flow path in a mathematical calculation mode of adding a correction coefficient, has higher calculation speed, and can accurately and effectively predict the fire-fighting water monitor jet flow path in a Unity virtual scene through a corrected fire-fighting water monitor jet flow path model based on an air resistance theory so as to improve the accuracy of fire-fighting water monitor jet flow path prediction, and verify an established model through an actual jet flow path. The application of the fire-fighting injection water track real-time restoration simulation algorithm in the virtual environment is that the object pool technology is adopted, the water drop pre-cast instantiation object is stored instead of being directly destroyed when not in use, and the cached object is directly given to the next use without being instantiated, so that the resources are fully utilized, the process is accelerated, and the system performance is improved.

title_en: System and method for monitoring quantitative and qualitative environmental analytics and managing associated transactions
abstract_en: A system and method for using financial instruments to provide investment incentive to fund disaster mitigation projects and/or ecosystem restoration projects triggered by real world events detected at set points by sensors and analyzed by computing devices. The detection of events results in the computational analysis and determination of a characteristics of a resilience bond or ecosystem-service bond to be issued or returned to investors. Examples involve sensors used to detect events, including flood damage mitigation, earthquake damage mitigation, or air quality improvement. In one preferred embodiment of the disclosure an investor may make an initial payment into a financial instrument being a resilience bond used to fund a mitigation project, said financial instrument pays phases to the mitigation project developer at the completion of phases of the project that occur prior to the occurrence of a disaster.

title_en: Small-scale source load power abnormal data identification and restoration method based on curve clustering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-scale source load power abnormal data identification and restoration method based on curve clustering, which mainly comprises the following steps: 1) acquiring basic data of a power network; 2) establishing a source charge power curve; 3) excluding curves with abnormal mutations; 4) determining a normal curve cluster and an abnormal curve cluster; 5) normalization; 6) determining an optimal initial clustering center candidate set U of a normal source load power curve; 7) determining an optimal clustering number k for a normal source-to-charge power curve opt (ii) a 8) Clustering the normal source load power curve; 9) determining physical characteristic influence factors of each type of typical periodic source charge power curve; 10) and repairing the abnormal periodic source load power curve based on physical characteristic influence factors. The invention takes the daily source load power curve as a basic unit, and clusters by considering the trend of the curve to realize the abnormal dataAnd identifying, namely repairing the abnormal source load power curve data by improving a k-means clustering algorithm.
assignees: STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Method and system for testing fault processing, testing and analyzing of power distribution main station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for testing, processing and analyzing faults of a power distribution main station, which comprises the steps of collecting fault data by using an FTT 1200; injecting the fault data into a testing power distribution main station to carry out real-time information interaction, testing the fault data and outputting test information; constructing a fusion optimization analysis model based on different types of fault information and fault related characteristics to perform fault analysis on the test information to obtain an analysis result; the effectiveness of the FA function of the main station system under the normal condition of the operating environment is tested, the robustness of the main station system under the abnormal environment can be tested, various communication protocols can be adopted to inject the fault characteristic data of the tested power distribution network, and the functions of displaying the whole process of self-fault occurrence, fault positioning, fault isolation and power restoration of a non-fault area of the tested system are achieved.

title_en: Power grid auxiliary decision tool based on meteorological factors
