abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power grid auxiliary decision devices, and relates to a power grid auxiliary decision tool based on meteorological factors, which comprises a data layer, a service component layer and an application layer; the data layer comprises a plurality of data, is communicated with the service component layer and is used for providing the data to the service component layer for comprehensive analysis and study and judgment of the data; the service component layer comprises a power grid fault characteristic identification service component, a trip circuit rapid restoration research and judgment service component, a real-time meteorological information display and equipment analysis service component and a fault comprehensive emergency auxiliary decision-making service component, and is used for fault characteristic information identification, trip information positioning, meteorological and equipment correlation analysis and fault comprehensive auxiliary decision-making result generation, and the service component layer is communicated with the application layer; the application layer comprises a plurality of display pages for viewing analysis results of the front-end operation and service component layer; through the combination of the data layer, the service component layer and the application layer, the temporary operation management and control of the power grid in disasters are facilitated.
assignees: CSG DIGITAL POWER GRID RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Method for comprehensively treating regional water environment
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for comprehensively treating regional water environment, which comprises the following steps: step S10, adjusting regional water system layout; step S20, setting a control gate; s30, ecological restoration of regional water systems; and S40, checking the construction scale of the control gate by using a numerical model. The application optimizes the water system layout, improves the flood prevention, waterlogging removal and drainage and water diversion and regulation capabilities of regional water systems, improves the water quality, improves the water surface landscape effect and ensures the flexible dispatching of regional drainage modes.
assignees: SHANGHAI WATER ENG DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network fault recovery method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network fault recovery method and system based on artificial intelligence, which relate to the technical field of distribution network fault recovery and comprise the following steps: after the distribution network line fails, locating a failure point and generating a failure alarm; after the fault points are positioned, executing a fault isolation strategy according to the distribution network topology model; executing a power restoration strategy of the non-fault area; generating a fault repair list according to the fault type, tracking a fault repair state, and executing a recovery strategy of an operation mode before a fault after the repair is finished; and judging whether the self-installed device and the protection device need to be reset according to fault isolation, power restoration and network reconstruction conditions. The distribution network fault recovery method based on artificial intelligence can more accurately locate fault points, improve the fault processing efficiency, rapidly implement fault isolation strategies, recover power supply for non-fault areas as soon as possible, improve recovery accuracy and efficiency, greatly reduce the possibility of manual judgment, and ensure safe and stable operation of a power grid.

title_en: GSA-GWO algorithm-based island division method and system for local power grid containing distributed power supply
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system regulation and control, and the method comprises the steps of evaluating loads by adopting an optimal-worst method to obtain load weight values, and determining island division important load recovery priority under local power grid faults; secondly, determining a load grade weight coefficient value by combining the load priority, and constructing a local power grid island division model containing a distributed power supply; then, introducing a chaotic reverse learning and genetic annealing algorithm (GSA) to improve a gray wolf optimization algorithm (GWO); and finally, solving the fault model of the local power distribution network by adopting an improved GSA-GWO algorithm to obtain a better island division result. According to the method, the diversity of the load and the preference of the user to the important load are fully considered, and the model is solved by adopting an improved algorithm, so that the solving efficiency is improved, the island division optimal strategy under the local power grid fault is realized, and the recovery power supply of the important load is ensured.

title_en: Vegetation restoration quality judging method based on mirror image characteristics
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of vegetation restoration monitoring and discloses a vegetation restoration quality judging method based on mirror image characteristics, which comprises the steps of obtaining remote sensing images corresponding to a plurality of time points respectively, performing geometric registration on the remote sensing images corresponding to the time points respectively to obtain a plurality of target remote sensing images, and determining a target power grid construction area in each target remote sensing image; and detecting a vegetation index of the target power grid construction area in each target remote sensing image to obtain target vegetation indexes corresponding to the target remote sensing images respectively, wherein the target vegetation indexes comprise comprehensive indexes of vegetation coverage rate, vegetation growth rate and vegetation weather indexes, and determining a vegetation recovery quality index of the target power grid construction area according to the target vegetation indexes corresponding to the target remote sensing images respectively. The application utilizes the remote sensing image to detect and judge the vegetation restoration quality, and can evaluate the environmental protection effect of vegetation restoration on the power grid construction area by utilizing the remote sensing image.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIS SOFTWARE SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Combined screening and field planting method for lakeside aquatic plants based on complementary ecological niches
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological environment restoration, solves the technical problems of lack of systematicness, insufficient optimizing means and unstable communities of aquatic plant configuration in the prior art, and particularly relates to a lakeside zone aquatic plant combination screening and field planting method based on complementary niches. And carrying out double-objective optimization on the aquatic plant combination through a non-dominant sequencing genetic algorithm to obtain the optimal aquatic plant combination. The selected aquatic plants are configured in a zoning mode according to the proper water depth, and are subjected to feedback regulation and control by combining the ecological monitoring result, so that dynamic optimization of the community structure is realized. The method can utilize the quantitative index and the intelligent algorithm to carry out combination optimization on the basis of fully considering the difference of plant ecological niches and the complementation of functions, so as to construct a lakeside zone plant community with higher stability and functionality, and has obvious ecological restoration and application popularization values.

title_en: Intelligent maintenance system and method for ecological restoration of side slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent maintenance system and method for ecological restoration of a side slope, and relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, wherein the intelligent maintenance system comprises a data acquisition module, a sensor array deployed from a road network, and an environment monitoring signal, wherein the environment monitoring signal comprises side slope surface displacement, soil humidity, vegetation coverage and rainfall intensity, an emergency preliminary position and severity description are obtained by fusing multi-source input signals, an event judgment module judges whether an event exceeds a single area processing capability or not by adopting a preset threshold value according to the obtained emergency preliminary position and severity description, and if the event exceeds the single area processing capability, state records and position coordinates of ecological restoration equipment in adjacent areas are extracted from a central database; the intelligent maintenance system and the intelligent maintenance method for the ecological restoration of the side slope have the beneficial effects of intelligent monitoring, rapid response and accurate restoration.
assignees: SENYUANDA ECOLOGICAL ENV GROUP CO LTD;RES INST HIGHWAY MINI TRANSP

title_en: Surface polishing method, surface polishing device, and surface polishing plate
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To carry out mirror finishing without a polishing flaw even on a silicon wafer and the like of a large area, and to improve the flatness of a disaster restoration system 16 by polishing the whole of the wide disaster restoration system 16 while applying uniform pressure.  <P>SOLUTION: While slury 26 mixed with diamond abrasive grains 24 is pressed from one surface 18 toward a second surface 20 of a porous plate 12 having a large number of continuous pores 22 communicating with the second surface 20 from the first surface 18, the second surface 20 is pressed against the disaster restoration system 16 of a polished material 14. The second surface 20 and the disaster restoration system 16 are rubbed with each other, thereby polishing the polished material 14. A large number of the diamond abrasive grains 24 are trapped at a continuous pore 22 opening 28 at the second surface 20 of the porous plate 12, thereby showing a favorable and stable polishing function.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Game machine
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a game machine which can execute read-ahead performance even after power restoration when a power outage occurs.SOLUTION: Game control means includes: prior determination means which performs prior determination of an execution content of a variable display game on the basis of start storage stored in start storage reservation means and generates prior determination information; prior determination information transmission means which transmits prior determination information to performance control means before a target game is executed; backup means which can store and reserve information about the game in a prescribed storage area when power outage occurs; means of prior determination during power restoration means which again determines the execution content of the variable display game of the start storage when power outage occurs and generates prior determination information during power restoration; and transmission means of prior determination information during power restoration which transmits to the performance control means the prior determination information during power restoration when the power is restored. The performance control means is provided with prior notification performance means which, before the game execution starts, notifies a player of a degree of expectations that a result mode of the variable display game becomes a special result on the basis of the prior determination information or the prior determination information during power restoration.

title_en: Power generation plant and system stabilization method
abstract_en: The present invention supplies inertial force and reactive power to a system without waiting the restoration of a house power supply. A power generation plant (1) comprises: a power generator (7); a switch (41) that switches whether or not to electrically connect the power generator (7) and an external system (31) to each other; a drive machine (6); another switch (42) that switches whether or not to electrically connect the drive machine (6) and the external system (31) to each other; a power transmission mechanism (51) that switches whether or not to transmit the drive force of the drive machine (6) to the power generator (7); and a synchronous phase adjustment control unit (21) that, when detecting the occurrence of a blackout, closes the switch (41) and, when performing a black start, opens the switch (42) to electrically connect the drive machine (6) and an external system (32) to each other and transmits the drive force of the drive machine (6) to the power generator (7) by the power transmission mechanism (51).

title_en: Commercial power restore indicator for sites, such as for cellular telecommunications sites
abstract_en: Systems and methods are described herein for determining the restoration of power at a site, such as the restoration of commercial power to a cell site within a telecommunications network. The systems and methods may be utilized to determine whether power is restored at a cell site when a generator is currently or temporarily providing power to the cell site (e.g., during a power outage on a utility grid that provided the power to the cell site), such as by determining the presence of a generator is running alarm message and the absence of a commercial power failure message, among other messages.

title_en: Configuration system and configuration method for relay protection level difference of automatic switch of distribution line
abstract_en: The invention provides a configuration system and a configuration method for a relay protection level difference of an automatic switch of a distribution line, which can scientifically configure the automatic switch of a huge distribution network, and the scientific configuration of the level difference can be beneficial to finding out faults and isolating the faults when the distribution network line fails, provide powerful support for quick power restoration of users and improvement of power supply reliability, and promote the intelligent development of the distribution network. Different technologies and management methods are respectively formulated, which is beneficial to the fine management.

title_en: Airport infrastructure network disaster resistance toughness analysis method under unfavorable meteorological disasters
abstract_en: An airport infrastructure network disaster resistance toughness analysis method under unfavorable weather disasters. The method comprises the steps of establishing an airport network model, analyzing characteristics of the airport network model by using Ucinet software, obtaining a service efficiency function of the network model by taking the number of flights and the distance of the airlines as parameters, calculating importance of airport nodes, respectively obtaining the number of the airport nodes which fail in the network model under random interference and intentional destruction, determining an optimal recovery sequence of the failed nodes based on a genetic algorithm and the like. The method has the advantages that two damage modes of random interference and intentional damage are considered by establishing an airport network model, the recovery time of an airport infrastructure network and airport guarantee resources are used as optimization targets, and the optimal recovery sequence of failure nodes under different damage actions is analyzed and determined to realize the improvement of the toughness of the airport network, so that the service efficiency of the airport network is ensured, and an analysis means is provided for the improvement of the disaster resistance toughness of the airport infrastructure network.

title_en: System, device and method for providing power outage and restoration notification
abstract_en: A system, computer program product and method to provide information related to a power distribution system based on information provided by a plurality of network elements electrically connected to a plurality of power lines of the power distribution system at a plurality of locations is provided. In one embodiment, the method comprises receiving a notification from a group of network elements that have detected a voltage signature indicating an imminent power outage, determining location information of the power outage, outputting the location information of the power outage, receiving a live notification from a first network element of the group of network elements indicating a first power restoration at a location of the first network element, determining location information of the first power restoration, and outputting the location information of the first power restoration.

title_en: Intelligent power line repair scheduling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent power line repair scheduling system, comprising an intelligent repair scheduling centre, a warehouse management information system, a vehicle-mounted GPS system and a GPS intelligent terminal; the intelligent repair scheduling centre and the warehouse management information system carry out network communication; the intelligent repair scheduling centre carries out two-way communication with the vehicle-mounted GPS system and the GPS intelligent terminal through a GPRS wireless network; the power pipe network facilities, traffic network facilities and various repair resources are fused together by taking the advantage of GIS geographic information processing and visualization and are displayed uniformly in a map form; the intelligent mobile power line repair scheduling system is built by combing the GPS and GPRS technology; intelligent positioning of the power fault points, repair vehicle advancing path planning and monitoring, site information communication, and personnel and device scheduling are realized; therefore the power repair efficiency is improved; the repair speed of the fault is increased; and the economic loss is reduced.
assignees: HENGSHUI POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: System for detecting signal during power grid equipment power restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for detecting signals when power grid equipment is in power restoration, which comprises: the system comprises an intelligent dispatching command platform, a dispatching master station, a telemechanical system terminal and a measurement and control device, wherein the intelligent dispatching command platform is in communication connection with the dispatching master station, the dispatching master station is in communication connection with the telemechanical system terminal, and the telemechanical system terminal is in communication connection with the measurement and control device. The invention utilizes the dispatching intelligent command platform to construct a detection signal system during power restoration, realizes automatic detection of the restoration signal, and improves the detection efficiency and accuracy.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Method and related device for checking multiple objects of distribution network operation order
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a related device for checking multiple objects of a distribution network operation ticket, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation task information, operation step information and operation equipment information of an operation ticket, wherein the type of the operation ticket comprises: transferring power supply, power failure and power restoration; according to the disconnecting link gisid and the feeder line id to which the disconnecting link belongs in the operation step information, performing logic sequence checking on the operation step information of the operation ticket to obtain a logic checking result; according to the operating equipment information, performing text information check on the operating step information of the operating ticket to obtain a text check result; according to the operating equipment information, performing text information checking on the operating task information of the operating ticket to obtain a task text checking result; and feeding back the logic checking result, the step text checking result and the task text checking result to a user in a popup window mode. The problems that in the prior art, the labor cost for checking the operation tickets of the distribution network is high and the checking efficiency is extremely low are solved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Mining area water and soil pollution treatment and ecological restoration cooperative control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mining area water and soil pollution treatment and ecological restoration cooperative control method, and belongs to the technical field of mining area ecological restoration. Step 1: treating water and soil pollution; step 2: laying a bottom soil layer; and step 3: laying a core soil layer on the bottom soil layer; and 4, step 4: paving a surface soil layer on the core soil layer and tamping; and 5: excavating a plurality of inverted trapezoidal ditches on the surface soil layer; step 6: paving a protective net in each inverted trapezoidal ditch; and 7: excavating a longitudinal ditch on each trapezoidal ridge, and then paving a plurality of U-shaped grooves which are connected end to end in each longitudinal ditch; and step 8: and filling an organic soil layer in each U-shaped groove, and then planting plants on the organic soil layer. The method uses slag, sludge, purified water and the like generated by water and soil pollution treatment of the mining area for ecological restoration of the area, uses local materials, restores organic soil layers and surface vegetation of the mining area, is beneficial to water and soil conservation of the mining area, prevents water and soil loss and desertification, and effectively reduces the occurrence probability of natural disasters such as landslide and the like.
assignees: NANJING INST OF ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES MEE

title_en: Method for recovering stone vegetation of wind power plant in stony desertification area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recovering stone vegetation in a wind power plant in a stony desertification area, which comprises the following steps: s1: determining a habitat investigation range, investigation objects, investigation contents and investigation modes of a wind power plant soil-stone blower platform in a stony desertification region; s2: acquiring plant resources in the habitat investigation range; s3: according to the plant type, utilizing the plant resource to prepare initial stony vegetation, and utilizing the initial stony vegetation to simulate a community; s4: and if the total relevance index value of the simulated community meets the requirement, carrying out stone vegetation restoration by using the initial stone vegetation of the simulated community and the plant resources meeting the requirement. According to the method, the stone vegetation recovery is carried out on the wind farm fan platform in the stony desertification area, so that the fragile ecological environment of the fan platform is improved, and the ecological function of the wind farm is improved.
assignees: SPIC YUNNAN INTERNATIONAL POWER INVEST CO LTD;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Limestone mine stope slope ecological restoration structure and restoration method
abstract_en: The application provides a limestone mine stope slope ecological restoration structure and a restoration method. The limestone mine stope slope ecological restoration structure comprises a plurality of arbor areas, a plurality of first vine areas, a plurality of second vine areas and climbing protection components. According to the application, the slope is repaired and greening through the hierarchical combination of the shielding of the green barrier of the big arbor and the climbing of the plant Kong Tengben, and the method has the characteristics of good stability, high durability, low engineering cost, strong anti-scouring capability and the like, meanwhile, the structural design is reasonable, the later maintenance is easy, the occurrence of geological disasters is controlled in an auxiliary way, the repairing and greening speed is high, the repairing effect is good, a self-maintaining and self-succession biological community can be formed in a stope in a short time, the subsequent investment is reduced, the comprehensive benefit is increased, and the method has good popularization and practical value.
assignees: SHAANXI BRANCH OF CHINA BUILDING MAT INDUSTRY GEOLOGIC EXPLORATION CENTER

title_en: Disaster recovery data restoration method, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster recovery data restoration method, equipment, a storage medium and a program product, which relate to the technical field of data processing, wherein a disaster recovery end actively generates read information after receiving a routing inspection instruction, judges whether the storage medium is abnormal according to the read information, generates error reporting information under the condition that the storage medium is abnormal, acquires a data writing request of hard disk data containing a production end hard disk according to the error reporting information, and writes the hard disk data again by the disaster recovery end to finish data restoration under the condition that the storage medium is abnormal, thereby solving the problem that the storage medium is difficult to identify in the related technology, ensuring the data safety and increasing the reliability of data backup.
assignees: SUZHOU YUANNAO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Analysis method, device, equipment and storage medium for self-repairing tunnel lining
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering maintenance and discloses a method, a device and equipment for analyzing self-repairing of tunnel lining and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of collecting real-time monitoring data comprising crack distribution images and stress strain readings through a sensor network, and identifying damage types and severity levels through feature extraction and damage classification models. And retrieving a matched repair material formula generation scheme from a material library, and coupling tunnel environment parameters to simulate a repair process so as to obtain a predictive simulated repair track. And then extracting key control points from the track to make a repair scheduling plan, and dynamically adjusting the plan according to feedback data in actual repair. According to the method, the repair operation is converted from experience judgment to accurate prediction through digital process simulation, and the execution process is dynamically optimized through a closed-loop self-adaptive control mechanism, so that the accurate customization of a repair scheme and the dynamic optimization of the repair operation are realized, and the reliability and consistency of the repair effect are improved.

title_en: Game device having troubleshooting function
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a game device which can compensate for not only a bet amount but also a game condition in an important phase even when a trouble such as a blackout occurs in the important phase in a game involving betting operations.  <P>SOLUTION: The game device includes: a judgment means for judging whether or not the kind of distribution of game media to a player and the order of distribution are fixed; a troubleshooting data storage means for storing troubleshooting data necessary for restoring a game condition in a nonvolatile storage medium at every checkpoint including at least a first timing when virtual game values owned by the player increases or decreases and a second timing when the kind of distribution and the order of distribution are fixed as the result of the game by the betting operation in a prescribed phase of a game as checkpoints; and a troubleshooting means for reading the troubleshooting data from the storage medium at the time of restoration including an outage during the execution of the game and for automatically restoring the game condition at the latest of the checkpoints on the basis of the troubleshooting data.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Information transmission/reception system, apparatus for moving object and information transmission/reception method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an information transmission/reception system acquiring the restoration status of a road when a disaster occurs in details and in real time, and guiding a route corresponding to the restoration status.  <P>SOLUTION: The information transmission/reception system includes an information distribution organization for distributing disaster-stricken road information indicating the damaged road and an apparatus for a moving object. The apparatus for the moving object includes a disaster-stricken road information acquisition part for acquiring disaster-stricken road information, a display, a position detection part, and a route guide for guiding a route. The system further includes a route guide control part for indicating an impassable road at the display on the basis of the disaster-stricken road information and controlling the route guide to guide the route excluding the impassable road. The system further includes a passing information transmission part for transmitting passing information indicating a passed road and vehicle size information to the information distribution organization. The information distribution organization updates the disaster-stricken road information on the basis of the received passing information and size information and distributes the updated disaster-stricken road information.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT
assignees: SANYO ELECTRIC CO;SANYO CONSUMER ELECTRONICS CO

title_en: Multifunctional ecological management method for cavernous body
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional ecological management method for a cavernous body. The method comprises the construction of a water-retention storage pipe network and an ecological management layer (containing a plant oxygen production layer formed by plants on the water-retention storage pipe network); the water retention storage pipe network collects and stores water from the ground surface and/or the underground, and also conveys the stored water to plants of the ecological management layer to supply water for the growth and evolution of organisms of the ecological management layer. The method combines the reuse of water resource with ecological management engineering, solves the problems of flooding and drought, promotes the formation, development and maintenance of an ecological management system, and helps to promote the great development and revolution of biological oxygen movement. The ecological restoration method is suitable for being applied to the construction fields of cities, towns, new rural areas, constructed wetlands, industrial and mining enterprises and the like, and particularly can be applied to ecological management of areas such as mines, oil fields, geological disaster prone areas, desert lands, saline-alkali soil, desert lands, estuaries, coasts, mudflats, wetlands, hydro-fluctuation belts, traffic roads and the like, and other areas needing ecological restoration in the production and living environment of people.

title_en: Groundwater pollution monitoring natural attenuation restoration prediction method, system and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system and a device for nature attenuation repair prediction in underground water pollution monitoring, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the standard establishing module is used for establishing an MNA conceptual model of the polluted site and determining a monitoring target and an MNA control standard of the polluted site; the on-site monitoring network determines a monitoring position, a monitoring object, a monitoring index and a monitoring frequency based on the conceptual model so as to realize on-site monitoring of a polluted site; the evaluation module is used for evaluating the feasibility of the MNA repair technology through an indoor simulation test and field monitoring; if not, strengthening natural attenuation is carried out; and if the MNA is feasible, outputting a final MNA validity evaluation result. The method and the device realize effective prediction of groundwater pollution monitoring natural attenuation restoration, are simple to execute, can realize accurate prediction of medium and long periods, and greatly reduce time cost of evaluation.

title_en: Rapid intelligent detection method for remote sensing image destroyed house of post-earthquake unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid intelligent detection method for a damaged house by using a remote sensing image of an unmanned aerial vehicle after a earthquake, which comprises the following steps of A, collecting a remote sensing image sample of the unmanned aerial vehicle, establishing a damaged house sample set, B, based on a YOLOv deep learning model, firstly, introducing a Vision Transformer structure to optimize a Backbone network, improving detection precision, secondly, replacing a PANet network by BiFPN according to the multi-scale characteristics of a target, enhancing multi-scale information fusion capability, further constructing a YOLOv s-ViT-BiFPN model, C, cutting an input remote sensing image of the unmanned aerial vehicle, recording geographic position coding information of the input remote sensing image, D, carrying out the damaged house detection on the cut image based on the model, obtaining a target detection frame, and E, carrying out geographic position information restoration and vectorization on the target detection frame, thus obtaining a damaged house detection frame vector diagram. The method realizes rapid high-precision intelligent detection of the remote sensing image damage house of the post-earthquake unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Emergent handling system of highway incident
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of expressway management systems, and particularly relates to an expressway emergency handling system. The system comprises an expressway network emergency treatment database, an expressway emergency element basic data processing module and an expressway emergency resource supporting module, wherein the expressway network emergency treatment database comprises a data server, a data integration unit and a data sharing conversion unit, the expressway emergency element basic data processing module comprises a basic data processing unit and an expressway emergency place network restoration unit, the system is used for establishing an expressway emergency treatment scheme, perfecting and screening multiple schemes, is suitable for fast optimization generation of emergency associated lines and nodes, planning in advance to configure or optimize the distribution mode of the existing emergency treatment resources, improves the coverage of emergency treatment resources, and optimizes the effectiveness of emergency treatment of the emergency.

title_en: Quick afforestation equipment of high steep side slope in flexible mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flexible mine high and steep slope quick greening device, which comprises a flexible protective net laid on a mountain slope and a planting disc fixed at the intersection of the flexible protective net, wherein the edge of the planting disc is fixedly provided with a fixing part, the tail end of the fixing part is in a sharp-thorn shape, and a plant fiber mesh belt is fixedly connected with the flexible protective net by winding on the fixing part; the utility model discloses close flexible protection network and planting dish as an organic whole, realize the afforestation restoration of massif simultaneously on the basis that firm substrate prevents the landslide to plant the dish through the better and domatic laminating of flexible protection network, be favorable to planting the dish plant and the massif combination growth.
assignees: HUNAN CHINA NUCLEAR CONSTRUCTION ENG COMPANY

title_en: A kind of power system restoration power calculation method and system based on load restoration process
abstract_en: The present invention relates to network system recovery technology fields, provide a kind of power system restoration power calculation method and system based on load restoration process, and method includes：Network system state in which is identified, the basic data for calculating the network system is obtained, and based on the basic data of the network system got, establishes the corresponding weighted network connection matrix M of system；Using the black starting-up machine group node for polymerizeing the broad sense generated as root node, the minimum spanning tree T1 comprising all recoverable plant stand nodes is generated；Calculate the number of nodes N in the sum of the weight on the included side minimum spanning tree T1 W and minimum spanning tree T1 in addition to the black starting-up machine group node of broad sense, and the ratio of the sum of calculate weight W and number of nodes N, to provide a kind of means of quantification to assess and analyzing the power system restoration power after network system generation large-scale blackout on the basis of fully considering load restoration process.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Slope protection structure for landscaping ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope protection structure for landscaping ecological restoration, which relates to the field of garden protection and aims to solve the problems that the existing slope protection structure can only dredge water overflowing from soil generally, the soil still contains a large amount of water after heavy rain, so that the soil is relatively conveyed, and the risk of landslide still exists; the front end of the flow guide mechanism is provided with a connecting mechanism; the front end of the connecting mechanism is connected with a filtering mechanism; and a fixing mechanism is arranged above the filtering mechanism. After rainstorm weather, moisture passes through water conservancy diversion spare in the hillside soil and flows the back, and remaining moisture can adsorb through adsorbing the piece, adsorbs the board that the inside capillary of piece is constituteed, can be effectual with the moisture absorption of residing among the soil and send into inside the water conservancy diversion spare, and then can be quick make soil resume appropriate amount moisture state to this avoids behind the rainstorm soil moisture too much to cause the landslide.

title_en: Distribution network tie switch configuration optimization method and terminal based on toughness improvement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network tie switch configuration optimization method and terminal based on toughness improvement, which are characterized in that a tie switch configuration optimization model is established based on distribution network structure parameters, the maximum assembly quantity of tie switches, tie line assembly position sets, prediction fault scene sets, remote control switch assembly positions, distributed power supply assembly positions and capacity thereof and bus load shedding cost parameters, the model takes the minimum load shedding cost of a distribution network caused by extreme weather disasters as an objective function, constraint conditions of the model comprise tie switch configuration constraint in a pre-disaster stage and distribution network topology constraint in a post-disaster load restoration stage, and load is transferred to other power supply paths by coordinately considering the remote control switches and tie switch action processes, so that the quick recovery of critical load after disaster is ensured, the resistance and recovery capacity of a distribution system to extreme weather are comprehensively improved, and the toughness level of the distribution system is effectively improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power grid real-time operation risk identification and power restoration management system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of deep learning, in particular to a power grid real-time operation risk identification and power restoration management system based on deep learning, which comprises a data center: the system is used for collecting multisource information of a power grid and storing data in a classified mode; analysis processing unit: the data fusion correlation analysis is used for preprocessing the received data and carrying out data fusion correlation analysis; risk identification unit: the risk position and the cause are determined according to the analyzed data; and (3) a management and control center: for taking corresponding measures against the impact of the risk event. According to the invention, risk real-time sensing and identification can be carried out, range reasons related to fault information and cascading fault events can be obtained through analysis based on deep learning, intelligent early warning is carried out, the fault information can be displayed on a large screen in real time, and after fault burst, a reasonable and safe power supply restoration path can be quickly selected based on historical fault information.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD ZUNYI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Power grid node recovery priority evaluation method and system in extreme environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid node recovery priority evaluation method and a system under extreme environment, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating and determining disaster influence factors of all nodes according to fault probability of lines in all nodes; the method comprises the steps of determining the output of a unit in each node and the load of the node after being affected by disasters according to disaster influence factors and disaster information of each node, determining the expected recovery benefits after correction of the unit in each node according to the output of the unit in each node and the unit recovery benefits of the unit in each node after being affected by disasters, determining the expected recovery benefits after correction of the load in each node according to the unit recovery benefits of the unit load in each node after being affected by disasters, adding the expected recovery benefits after correction of the unit in each node and the expected recovery benefits after correction of the load to obtain the expected recovery benefits of each node, and determining the recovery priority of each node in a power grid according to the expected recovery benefits of each node. Accurate determination of recovery priority of each node in the power grid is achieved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Watershed vegetation restoration optimization layout method, device, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronics and discloses a river basin vegetation restoration optimization layout method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product, wherein the method is characterized in that through annual average water supply capacity and vegetation ecological water demand of each partition in a target area, partitions with annual average water supply capacity larger than vegetation ecological water demand in different partitions are determined as target partitions, vegetation degradation areas are determined based on the target partitions and are used as target units for vegetation restoration construction, target construction areas respectively corresponding to different types of vegetation in the target partitions are determined, gridding treatment is carried out on the target units to obtain a plurality of grids, and fitness grade indexes respectively corresponding to different types of vegetation are calculated in the corresponding grids based on weather geographic element information of each grid obtained in advance; and determining a river basin vegetation restoration optimization layout scheme in the target area based on the fitness grade indexes respectively corresponding to different types of vegetation and the target construction areas respectively corresponding to different types of vegetation laid in the grid.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER THREE GORGES GROUP IND DEVELOPMENT BEIJING CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Method for emergency water supplement of degraded wetland by clean energy
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for emergency water supplement of degraded wetland by clean energy, which specifically comprises the following steps: 1) Determining a water replenishing source according to local hydrological conditions; 2) Determining a water replenishing position according to local terrain conditions; 3) Determining the minimum ecological water supplement amount and water supplement time according to the wetland restoration target; 4) Determining the power and specification of the wind power water elevator and the solar and wind power integrated water pump according to the local wind and solar water resource gap; 5) Installing water supplementing equipment on site, determining a water supplementing scheme according to site detection data, and implementing accurate water supplementing; 6) And tracking, detecting and evaluating the water replenishing effect. The invention can couple solar energy and wind energy water lifting equipment aiming at the water-deficient wetland with a surface water source or a groundwater water source nearby, and determines the optimal water replenishing time and the optimal water replenishing quantity according to the seasonal difference of the water demands of the wetland at different stages of dominant vegetation and waterfowl so as to fulfill the aims of accurate, ecological and efficient water replenishing.

title_en: Business method, apparatus and system for monitoring quantitative and qualitative environmental analytics and managing associated financial transactions
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system, apparatus, and business method for using financial instruments to provide investment incentive to fund disaster mitigation projects and/or ecosystem restoration projects triggered by real world events detected at set points by sensors and analyzed by computing devices. The detection of events results in the computational analysis and determination of a characteristics of a resilience bond or ecosystem-service bond to be issued or returned to investors. Examples involve sensors used to detect events, including flood damage mitigation, earthquake damage mitigation, or air quality improvement. In one preferred embodiment of the disclosure an investor may make an initial payment into a financial instrument being a resilience bond used to fund a mitigation project, said financial instrument pays phases to the mitigation project developer at the completion of phases of the project that occur prior to the occurrence of a disaster.

title_en: Intelligent well spacing system integrating natural gas hydrate exploitation and geological restoration
abstract_en: The utility model provides a natural gas hydrate exploitation and geological remediation in intelligent well spacing system of an organic whole, include: a vertical well in which a main gas production line and CO injection are arranged 2 A main pipeline; a horizontal well communicated with the vertical well and divided into a branch pipeline for gas production and a branch pipeline for CO injection 2 Gas recovery well and CO injection for branch pipeline 2 Well, said gas production branch line and CO injection 2 The branch pipeline is respectively connected with the gas production main pipeline and the CO injection main pipeline 2 The main pipeline is communicated; an artificial intelligence slotting robot, the number of which is a plurality, arranged in the CO injection 2 Main pipeline and CO injection 2 In the branch line. The utility model discloses divide the quick high efficiency of blocking to restore the geology. The CO2 and the depressurization production pipelines are alternately arranged in a blocking and fixed-distance mode in the multiple horizontal wells, the geology in a small area is efficiently repaired in the blocking and fixed-distance mode, and the possibility of disasters caused by geological damage in the hydrate production process is greatly reduced.

title_en: Geological disaster ecological restoration structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disasters ecological remediation structure belongs to ecological remediation technical field, including the ground nail, the fixed surface of ground nail is provided with the connecting plate, the below of connecting plate is inserted and is equipped with protection component, the top of connecting plate is provided with around the post, just it is located the surface of ground nail to wind the post, the surface of winding the post is provided with the tractive rope, the other end of tractive rope is provided with plants frame one, the other end of planting frame one is provided with through the tractive rope and plants frame two, the other end of planting frame two also is provided with the ground nail through the tractive rope, the equal symmetry in one side of planting frame one and planting frame two is provided with the subassembly that shocks resistance, the utility model discloses a set up protection component, conveniently protect the ground nail, by the scratch when avoiding the staff to carry. The utility model discloses a set up the subassembly that shocks resistance, be convenient for cushion the dynamics that the planting frame received.
assignees: FUJIAN YANTIAN INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-adaptive data restoration, analysis and distribution system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive data restoration, analysis and distribution system, belonging to a part of a weather-eye environment monitoring and disaster early warning system. A high-reliability cluster server system is used to process data transmitted back from monitoring points distributed in field and to distribute the data to a monitoring center for the use of an early warning system and mobile monitoring personnel. Since no high-bandwidth channel exists in partial field areas and MMS or SMS signaling channels can be used only for transmission, the data is required to be compressed, encoded or documented before transmission. After the data is received, restoration processing is conducted to the data first, then uniform formatting processing is conducted to the data, and finally analysis processing, sorting processing, storage processing and distribution processing are conducted to the data. The format of the distributed data also supports mobile communication network (3G) transmission and MMS and SMS signaling channel transmission other than HTTP format.
assignees: TELE UNION BEIJING COMM TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Underground gasifier quenching and burnt-out area restoration treatment method for coal underground gasification process
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underground gasifier quenching and burnt-out area restoration treatment method. The method includes the steps of (a) cutting off injection of an oxidant; (b) conducting nitrogen sweeping; (c) removing oxidant injection equipment; (d) injecting a coolant at a fixed point to quench a gasifier; and (e) terminating a chemical reaction in a burnt-out area. The underground gasifier quenching and burnt-out area restoration treatment method has the following advantages that small amount of nitrogen, which is a byproduct of air separation, is used for sweeping a whole system, so that the problems that re-combustion is caused by leakage of the oxidant in the quenching stage and equipment is damaged due to burn-back are solved; the small amount of coolant or the nitrogen, which is the byproduct of air separation, is injected to carry out fixed-point rapid fire extinguishing on a combustion area of the gasifier, continuous and circulating injection of a large amount of gas is not needed, and the operation cost is effectively lowered; and geologic structures and conditions of coal seam top/bottom plates and overlying/underlying rock stratums are comprehensively considered, and various geological disasters and secondary pollution in the quenching stage are avoided.

title_en: Visualization fault handling method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses one kind visualization fault handling method and device.Wherein, the method includes：The troublshooting request that first client sends is received by the second client；Asked by the second client acknowledgement troublshooting, and repairing information in troublshooting request determines the information related to repairing, wherein, after the second client acknowledgement troublshooting is asked, the first client shows the information related to repairing；And after the confirmation that the second client receives fault restoration, troubleshooting result is returned to the first client, wherein, the first client analysis troubleshooting result obtains troubleshooting evaluation result.The present invention solves existing power supply trouble and reports the technical problem that first-aid repair efficiency present in the course of work is low, customer experience is poor for repairment.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: The electric power system intelligent information method for pushing and system of a kind of based role
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical fields of information push, and in particular to the electric power system intelligent information method for pushing and system of a kind of based role；The technical issues of solution is：It is accurate, comprehensive to provide a kind of pushed information, and the electric power system intelligent information method for pushing and system of based role；The technical solution used for：Receive the Business Information of backstage typing and storage；The Business Information includes：Related service job instruction, relevant device primary connection figure, geographical wiring diagram；The repair schedule of staff's input is received, finds out the relevant information that repair schedule is related to；Response service personnel's checks request, and the repair schedule of pre-review and relevant information are sent to maintenance related personnel；The arrangement, excavation and analysis to mass datas such as business datum, content-data, customer data, character datas are completed on the basis of big data, information push list is provided so as to push management system for information；The present invention is suitable for power domain.
assignees: JINCHENG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;SHANXI HELI INNOVATION SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic backup method based on LVM snapshot in cloud native environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic backup method based on LVM snapshot in a cloud native environment, which comprises the steps of initializing a system into an application cluster, and creating related custom resources and a custom controller by adopting an Operator expansion mode; the user-defined controller comprises a resource backup controller, a resource restoration controller, a storage volume backup controller and a storage volume restoration controller; the resource backup controller realizes discovery and retrieval of resources to be backed up, packs and stores k8s resource objects to Hami n io, acquires an associated Pod list and generates an appointed backup PodPv; aiming at the Pod list, the storage volume backup controller realizes automatic backup based on the LVM snapshot; and the like. The advantages are that: aiming at a local storage volume with larger data volume and higher requirement on data consistency in backup operation, automation, high stability and almost real-time data synchronous backup are carried out based on an LVM snapshot technology, so that the usability and manageability are greatly improved, and the downtime of a business system and the disaster recovery cost of an application system are reduced to the greatest extent.
assignees: BEIJING TONGCHUANG YONGYI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Landslide monitoring devices for ecological restoration of mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide monitoring device for mine ecological restoration, and belongs to the technical field of equipment for mine ecological restoration. The utility model provides a mine is landslide monitoring devices for ecological remediation, includes PMKD, and PMKD top surface rear portion left side is equipped with the backplate, and the terminal surface upside is equipped with the water-collecting box before the backplate, and water-collecting box bottom surface middle part front side has set firmly the rack, and both sides all are equipped with first spring around the water-collecting box bottom surface, and PMKD top surface left side is equipped with the suggestion subassembly, and PMKD top surface middle part top is equipped with the drive cover, and drive cover inner chamber middle part is equipped with the carousel, and the carousel right side is equipped with the warning subassembly. According to the invention, through the cooperation between the water collecting box arranged on the upper side of the front end surface of the back plate, the rack arranged on the front side of the middle part of the bottom surface of the water collecting box and the prompting component arranged on the left side of the top surface of the fixed bottom plate, when the rainfall of the mine to be repaired is large, rainwater can be gathered in the water collecting box, the water collecting box can drive the rack to move downwards, and the prompting component can make a sound to prompt related workers to repair the mine, so that landslide is avoided.

title_en: Island ecological environment management and evaluation platform based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of island ecological environment management and evaluation, in particular to an island ecological environment management and evaluation platform based on big data analysis, which comprises a map display module, a data management module, an evaluation management module and a system management module, wherein the map display module is used for viewing any island attribute information in the system; the evaluation management module comprises an island ecological bearing capacity evaluation module and an ecological safety evaluation module; the platform for managing and evaluating the ecological environment of the island realizes scientific and standardized management of data of the island, realizes an interactive and friendly evaluation and analysis function, and provides technical support for making scientific and reasonable decisions; the method strengthens the consciousness of people in all circles on the protection of the sea areas and the islands, lightens the economic, environmental and social influences on the sea areas and the islands caused by natural disasters, improves the capability of various levels of sea area management departments and social masses in implementing the remediation, restoration and protection of the sea areas and the islands, and has obvious ecological benefit and wide social benefit.
assignees: LIAONING OCEAN AND FISHERIES SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Method for rapidly resisting earthquake and reinforcing pier
abstract_en: A method for rapidly reinforcing a pier against earthquake comprises the step of reinforcing by adopting fiber reinforced epoxy resin concrete, wherein the fiber reinforced epoxy resin concrete is obtained by uniformly stirring a cementing material, a recycled aggregate, natural river sand and fibers, and the reinforcing method is to pour the fiber reinforced epoxy resin concrete on the surface of a damaged pier for reinforcement. The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake resistance and disaster reduction, can ensure that a bridge is quickly repaired after an earthquake and meets the requirement of emergency traffic, and remarkably shortens the time for rescue and restoration reconstruction after the disaster.

title_en: Method and system for optimizing recovery sequence of damaged facilities after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization method of a recovery sequence of a post-disaster damaged facility, which comprises the following steps: constructing a recovery sequence model of the damaged facility according to the attribute information of the damaged facility, the attribute information of the user, the attribute information of the facility-user service arc and the decision information; iteratively solving the damaged facility recovery sequence model by using a heuristic algorithm to obtain an optimized feasible solution of the damaged facility recovery sequence; and according to the damaged facility recovery sequence optimization feasible solution, recovering the damaged facility. The invention also provides an optimization system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for the recovery sequence of the post-disaster damaged facilities.

title_en: Airport infrastructure network disaster resistance toughness analysis method under unfavorable meteorological disasters
abstract_en: An airport infrastructure network disaster resistance toughness analysis method under unfavorable weather disasters. The method comprises the steps of establishing an airport network model, and analyzing the characteristics of the airport network model by using Ucinet software; taking the number of flights and the route distance as parameters to obtain a service efficiency function of the network model; calculating the importance of airport nodes; respectively obtaining the number of the airport nodes which fail in the network model under random interference and intentional destruction; determining the optimal recovery sequence of the failure node based on a genetic algorithm. The invention has the advantages that: by establishing an airport network model, two damage modes of random interference and intentional damage are considered, the optimal recovery sequence of failure nodes under different damage actions is analyzed and determined by taking the recovery time of an airport infrastructure network and airport guarantee resources as optimization targets, so that the toughness of the airport network is improved, the service efficiency of the airport network is guaranteed, and an analysis means is provided for the disaster resistance toughness improvement of the airport infrastructure network.

title_en: Safety early warning method based on along-mining seismic exploration, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety early warning method, a storage medium and electronic equipment based on the detection of an accompanying earthquake, the method comprises the steps of determining the position of an accompanying area, configuring a first safety radius taking the accompanying area as the center according to the position of the accompanying area, arranging a first earthquake sensing edge network on the first safety radius, detecting in real time according to the first earthquake sensing edge network, outputting a first earthquake sensing signal set corresponding to the first safety radius, carrying out signal restoration on the first earthquake sensing signal set by using a signal restoration module, outputting an earthquake restoration signal set, inputting the earthquake restoration signal set into an earthquake safety early warning module for safety analysis, outputting an earthquake risk index, and generating a safety early warning signal based on the earthquake risk index. The invention achieves the technical effects of improving the accuracy of the identification of the seismic signals and monitoring stability.
assignees: CHN ENERGY XINJIANG ENERGY CHEMICAL CO LTD

title_en: Opening/closing device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an opening/closing device whose problem caused by manual operation during a power outage can be corrected.SOLUTION: An opening/closing device comprises: an opening/closing body 10 for opening/closing a closing-direction end thereof by sliding; a rotational drive source 31 for driving the opening/closing body 10 to open/close; a power restoration detection means for detecting a power restoration after a power outage; and a full-closure detection part 34 for producing a full-closure detection signal when the opening/closing body 10 is in a fully-closed position, with the opening/closing body 10 being opened/closed by control of the rotational drive source 31, the opening/closing body 10 is opened when a closing command is produced after the power restoration is detected by the power restoration detection means, the opening/closing body 10 is closed after a predetermined period of time from the opening operation, and the closing operation is stopped on condition that the full-closure detection signal is produced.

title_en: Method for estimating power outages and restoration during natural and man-made events
abstract_en: A method of modeling electric supply and demand with a data processor in combination with a recordable medium, and for estimating spatial distribution of electric power outages and affected populations. A geographic area is divided into cells to form a matrix. Within the matrix, supply cells are identified as containing electric substations and demand cells are identified as including electricity customers. Demand cells of the matrix are associated with the supply cells as a function of the capacity of each of the supply cells and the proximity and/or electricity demand of each of the demand cells. The method includes estimating a power outage by applying disaster event prediction information to the matrix, and estimating power restoration using the supply and demand cell information of the matrix and standardized and historical restoration information.

title_en: Power failure identification analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power failure identification and analysis method and a power failure identification and analysis system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power failure alarm event information, equipment information and relevant power failure event information of a production system and a distribution and dispatching system of a metering automation system in real time; judging whether the power failure alarm event is caused by a transformer or a low-voltage user; and judging whether the power failure alarm event is a low-voltage fault power failure event, a medium-voltage fault power failure event or a main network fault power failure event according to the low-voltage user intelligent meter information, the electric meter box, the transformer, the branch line, the transformer substation, the feeder line and other equipment information and a preset strategy, and carrying out power restoration processing on the corresponding low-voltage fault power failure event, the medium-voltage fault power failure event or the main network fault power failure event. The system is used for realizing the method. The invention overcomes the technical defects that the existing power business system can not automatically identify the low-voltage fault power failure event information and actively early warn the low-voltage fault influence range.

title_en: Multi-source cooperative power supply recovery method and device considering agricultural biogas power generation support
abstract_en: A multi-source collaborative power restoration method and device considering agricultural biogas power generation support comprises the steps of establishing a power restoration model, establishing an objective function according to load restoration maximization in the power restoration process, determining the number of micro-grids in a system according to dynamic radial constraint of a power distribution network, considering photovoltaic inverter constraint, cold load starting constraint and linear load flow constraint of self-adaptive network topology of the power distribution network in the power restoration model, adding grid-built inverter constraint based on battery energy storage, grid-built inverter synchronous constraint, agricultural biogas power generation constraint and power transmission network power failure and restoration process constraint in the power restoration model, initializing the power restoration model, and solving by using Gurobi solver to obtain a load restoration state of the power distribution network. In the invention, the support of agricultural biogas power generation is considered in the power supply recovery process, dynamic radial constraint is developed to support the synchronization process, and the multi-source cooperative power supply recovery is realized.

title_en: System and method for providing power distribution system information
abstract_en: A system, method and computer program product for processing utility data of a power grid is provided. In one embodiment, the system includes a datamart comprised of a plurality of physical databases storing utility data, a plurality of applications comprising an automated meter application configured to process power usage data from a plurality of automated meters, a power outage application configured to identify a location of a power outage, and a power restoration application configured to identify a location of a power restoration. The system may include an analysis engine comprising a plurality of analysis objects with each analysis object configured to process data to provide a specific analysis, wherein said analysis engine is accessible via one or more of the plurality of applications, and the system may include a report module configured to receive an output from the analysis engine and to output a report. The plurality of applications may also include a fault analysis application, a transformer analysis application, a theft detection application, a power flow application, a substation automation application, a load shed application and others.
assignees: KREISS DAVID G;BRANCACCIO DANIEL S;CURRENT COMM SERVICES LLC

title_en: Phased network formation for power restoration
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a device receives a router advertisement message after a power outage event in a network. The device joins the network, in response to receiving the router advertisement message. The device sends a power restoration notification message via the network. The device selectively delays a disconnected node from joining the network.

title_en: Accelerated recovery after a data disaster
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present invention, a metadata file is transferred from the first system to the second system and a database on the second system is initialized based on the metadata file. An image, including information of the first system to be restored, is transferred from the first system to the second system, and restoration of the information to the second system based on the image is initiated. Prior to completion of the restoration, one or more log files indicating actions performed on the first system relating to the information to be restored is transferred from the first system to the initialized database on the second system. In response to completion of the restoration, the actions of the log files are performed to synchronize the restored data on the second system with the first system.

title_en: Novel geological disaster bare rock greening treatment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for a afforestation treatment equipment field, concretely relates to novel geological disaster bare rock afforestation treatment equipment, it includes the rock drill that is used for cutting the bare rock, the liquid reserve tank that provides the restoration liquid for the rock drill and the hose that is used for connecting the rock drill and the liquid reserve tank; the rock drill comprises a shell, a liquid distribution assembly and a crushing assembly, wherein the crushing assembly penetrates through the liquid distribution assembly. Run through the broken subassembly that sets up and join in marriage the liquid subassembly and can carry the restoration liquid to the deep rock base that the drill bit top was right in the breakage for the restoration of restoration liquid is effectual, and influence range is big, has removed simultaneously from to distribute and has consumeed the inconvenient part of a large amount of manpowers.

title_en: Novel power distribution network frame construction method based on multi-state switch
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel power distribution network frame construction method based on a multi-state switch, which is characterized by being safe, reliable, economical, efficient, environment-friendly, low-carbon, high-quality in service, optimized and interactive, and the like, wherein 8 loop lines are collected to form independent feeder line clusters, a stronger energy configuration platform is built, and the novel power distribution network frame construction method has the characteristics of flexible load transfer, high efficiency benefit, adaptation to accommodate more new elements of an energy Internet, and the like. Each feeder line in the snowflake grid structure is reasonably segmented and connected, has the self-healing capability of fault automatic detection, isolation, network reconstruction and power restoration, can meet the power supply requirements of various users, improves the utilization efficiency of power distribution equipment, and has the characteristics of clear structure, flexibility, reliability, coordinated development, economy and high efficiency.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY CHENGDONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Turning sowing device for ecological restoration of slope surface of mine storage yard
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration equipment, in particular to a turning and sowing device for slope ecological restoration of a mine storage yard, which comprises a telescopic boom, a turning and sowing mechanism and two groups of roller mechanisms, wherein the telescopic boom is used for providing power for movement of the turning and sowing mechanism and the roller mechanisms, the telescopic boom is connected with the turning and sowing mechanism, the turning and sowing mechanism is used for turning and sowing soil on the slope, and the two groups of roller mechanisms are respectively arranged at two sides of the turning and sowing mechanism; through the coulter stirring soil and forming the slot, arrange the material pipe and directly send into the slot with seed and other additives inside, can ensure that the seed is located inside the soil, avoided the condition that the seed is dry or by animal feeding because of the insolateing of wind, improved the survival rate of seed, after the seed is buried underground simultaneously, along with vegetation, the root system can penetrate through soil deeply to the stability of soil has been strengthened, has effectively prevented the emergence of soil erosion and geological disasters.

title_en: Multi-target library real-time data synchronization method for electric power metering
abstract_en: The invention provides a power metering-oriented multi-target library real-time data synchronization method which comprises the steps of constructing a metering data dependency model based on a power load curve theory, optimizing a multi-target scheduling strategy by utilizing an improved non-dominant sorting genetic algorithm, processing power data by applying an intelligent slicing and mixed compression strategy, executing synchronization based on a multi-level buffering strategy and a batch writing algorithm, and implementing multi-dimensional consistency verification and generating a layered restoration scheme. The scheme realizes the real-time synchronization of the power metering data with high efficiency, high reliability and low resource consumption, and provides a high-quality data base for the power grid dispatching decision.
assignees: NANJING YISHUNHONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Assembly type frame beam column node containing replaceable energy consumption connection
abstract_en: The application provides an assembled frame beam column node with replaceable energy consumption connection, which comprises frame columns and frame beams, wherein beam cantilevers are transversely arranged on one sides of the frame columns in a protruding mode, the beam cantilevers are connected with one ends of the frame beams through web connection plates and high-strength bolts, and the assembled frame beam column node also comprises energy consumption connectors arranged between the beam cantilevers and the frame beams, wherein the energy consumption connectors dissipate external energy through good axial hysteresis performance. The full prefabrication of the components can be realized on a construction site by using bolts by means of the energy-consuming connectors and the web connecting plates. The damaged accessible changes energy consumption connector quick replacement restoration after the shake, and when the structure received disturbance or earthquake, energy consumption connector participated in the power consumption and first entering plastic yield stage as energy consumption first echelon, only need dismantle the quick restoration of change attenuator can accomplish the node afterwards.

title_en: Space perception type modularized wind resource perception method suitable for offshore wind farm
