abstract_en: The invention discloses a space perception type modularized wind resource perception method suitable for an offshore wind farm, which comprises the following steps of 1, arranging a wind farm three-dimensional perception system, 2, carrying out multi-source data acquisition and edge preprocessing, 3, carrying out space-time feature modeling and intelligent prediction, and 4, carrying out wind energy evaluation and system feedback optimization. The invention provides a multi-source layout strategy combining a tower barrel, a jacket, a booster station and a buoy, which fully utilizes the structure positions of different heights and areas in a wind power plant to form a three-dimensional sensing network covering vertical wind speed gradient, boundary layer disturbance and overall wind power plant dominant trend. Compared with the traditional single-point or linear layout mode, the scheme realizes higher space resolution and wind farm state restoration capability on the premise of not increasing a large amount of hardware investment, and provides a solid data base for high-precision prediction.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR HUINENG CO LTD;Yangjiang offshore wind power laboratory

title_en: Efficient application-aware disaster recovery
abstract_en: Embodiments are directed to efficiently backing up portions of data and to performing a scoped data recovery. In an embodiment, a computer system preloads data images with data corresponding to various different software applications or operating systems. The computer system chunks the data images, so that each data image is divided into multiple data chunks, and where each data chunk is represented by a hash value. The computer system then receives, from a user, portions of delta data representing data differences between the received user data and the data in the preloaded data images. The computer system also generates a logical backup representation that includes the data chunk hash values for the preloaded data images as well as the delta data received from the user. This logical representation allows restoration of the user's data using only the hash values and the delta data.

title_en: Phased network formation for power restoration
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a device receives a router advertisement message after a power outage event in a network. The device joins the network, in response to receiving the router advertisement message. The device sends a power restoration notification message via the network. The device selectively delays a disconnected node from joining the network.

title_en: Outage restoration time prediction during weather events and optimized solutions for recovery
abstract_en: A method, a computer system, and a computer program product for restoration time predictions and optimized recovery solutions is provided. Embodiments of the present invention may include selecting a dataset based on time series data. Embodiments of the present invention may include building one or more models, wherein the one or more models include a classification and regression tree model, a cross validated decision tree model or a bootstrap aggregating model. Embodiments of the present invention may include selecting a model for predictions using decision trees to reduce a variance of the model. Embodiments of the present invention may include rebuilding the model based on additional data attributes. Embodiments of the present invention may include determining an outage prioritization for each outage node. Embodiments of the present invention may include transmitting results of the outage prioritization.

title_en: Power outage restoration in distribution systems assisted by state estimation
abstract_en: Embodiments described herein provide for power distribution control systems and methods. The power distribution control systems and methods estimate one or more signal measurements of one or more nodes of a power distribution network using state estimation, identify a location of an outage in the power distribution network, identify a status of one or more switches that form a configuration to restore power to one or more cells of the power distribution network based on the one or more signal measurements estimated using state estimation, and output control signaling to control the one or more switches based on the identified status.

title_en: Power system partition optimization algorithm considering recovery time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recovery time considered power system partition optimization algorithm, which is characterized in that a power system is initially partitioned according to network topology, the starting power, the climbing rate and the branch weight of a generator are considered, priority indexes of all units are established, and the starting sequence of the units is optimized; establishing a decision system with uncertain factors based on a rough set; establishing a power system partition optimization model considering the recovery time by taking the longest recovery time of all partitions as a target; and screening the unit to be adjusted according to the decision system, determining the final unit partition according to the adjusted power system partition optimization model, and performing partition recovery by combining a unit recovery sequence. The electric power system partition model established by the invention considers the influence of the recovery time on the partition result of the whole electric power system, shortens the difference between the partition recovery times and improves the recovery efficiency.

title_en: Method and system for detecting and notifying power interruption and power quality
abstract_en: Methods and systems for detecting and notifying power interruptions and power quality are described herein. A sensor coupled to the circuit transmits a keep-alive packet to the server. The sensor detects an input signal generated by the electrical activity. The sensor generates an output signal based on the input signal. The sensor monitors the output signal. During a clock cycle, the sensor determines whether a rising edge occurs and transmits a failure packet to the server when the rising edge occurs before a predetermined clock value or when no rising edge occurs. The server receives the failure packet from the sensor and listens for keep-alive packets. The server transmits a power down notification when no keep-alive packets are received for at least a defined period of time after the failed packet is received. When one or more keep-alive packets are subsequently received, the server transmits a power restoration notification.

title_en: Electric load completion method and system based on DBSCAN clustering
abstract_en: The application relates to an electric load completion method and system based on DBSCAN clustering, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical power data, and establishing a plurality of electric quantity completion strategies based on the historical power data; and matching corresponding electric quantity completion strategies for the target users according to the historical electricity utilization conditions of the target users in the historical electricity data, and obtaining the completed electric quantity of the target users on the analysis day through the corresponding electric quantity completion strategies, wherein the electric quantity completion strategies comprise DBSCAN density clustering completion strategies. By means of the method and device for restoring the abnormal power data, the problem of how to restore the abnormal power data accurately is solved, the difference of the power utilization characteristics of residential users is considered to be large, the distribution rule of the power utilization data of different users is explored through descriptive statistical analysis, the purpose of restoring the power loads of different users in a targeted mode is achieved, missing data can be restored with high accuracy, and meanwhile the combination of multiple restoration strategies has strong robustness.

title_en: Event-based water damage seawall facing block repairing weight calculation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the restoration weight of a water damaged seawall protecting block based on an event, which comprises the steps of determining a typical typhoon according to tropical cyclone optimal path data, seawall completion time, protecting block arrangement and a pre-seawall tide level process, collecting multi-element collaborative observation data during the typical typhoon, constructing an astronomical tide-storm tide mathematical model and a typhoon wave mathematical model according to the typical typhoon, correcting the two mathematical models by utilizing the multi-element collaborative observation data, calculating the pre-seawall tide level and the washout corrected typhoon wave after correction, designing a protecting block stable weight parameterization scheme, obtaining stable calculated weight based on the pre-seawall tide level and the typhoon wave, combining the actual weight of the protecting block to determine an optimal scheme, calculating a design wind speed according to weather station wind speed data, calculating the design tide level and washout corrected design wave based on the tide level data and the washout tide relation, and obtaining the protecting block restoration weight by adopting the optimal scheme. The method has higher guiding function on coast protection engineering design.

title_en: Ecological restoration device for mining area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ecological restoration device for mining areas, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration of mines and comprises the following components: an ecological restoration blanket, a release mechanism of the ecological restoration blanket is paved, and an irrigation pool for watering the ecological restoration blanket is used; the ecological restoration blanket includes: the silk screen outer cover is arranged in the silk screen outer cover, the vetiver seeds are arranged in the silk screen outer cover and are mixed with nutrient media of the vetiver seeds, and the irrigation pipeline is arranged in the silk screen outer cover. The ecological restoration blanket and the irrigation pool overcome the problems that the bare broken organic matters in the mining area are deficient, the soil water storage capacity is poor, landslide is easy, the newly planted vegetation needs to be supplemented with fertilizer and water for multiple times, the vegetation maintenance difficulty is high and the consumption is high.
assignees: WANG XIAOQUAN;YUNNAN XIANGGENCAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Side slope prefabricated triangular steel pipe net piece protective structure with reverse filtering function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a side slope prefabricated triangular steel pipe net piece protection structure with a reverse filtering function, which comprises connecting pieces, a steel pipe net piece body and planting bags, wherein the connecting pieces are fixedly arranged on anchor rods on the surface of a side slope, a plurality of steel pipe net piece bodies are fixedly arranged above the side slope through the connecting pieces, the planting bags are fixedly arranged in the middle of the steel pipe net piece body, the steel pipe net piece body is pre-built and the middle of the steel pipe net piece body is filled with the replaceable planting bags in the installation process of the protection structure, then the steel pipe net piece body and the planting bags are fixedly arranged on the anchor rods on the surface of the side slope through the connecting pieces, so that side slope soil is effectively stabilized, water and soil loss and landslide phenomena are prevented, vegetation growth is promoted, ecological restoration capability of the side slope is enhanced, meanwhile, the replaceable modularized design obviously reduces construction difficulty, flexibly copes with different side slope conditions and environmental changes, meanwhile, interference to the environment is reduced, and later operation and maintenance difficulties and cost are reduced.

title_en: Water conservancy prevents soil erosion and water loss device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of water conservancy, in particular to a water conservancy soil erosion prevention device, which comprises a splicing column, wherein the splicing column is in a regular hexagon shape, a plurality of groups of water outlets for water drainage are formed in the outer side of the splicing column, a female buckle is fixedly connected to one side of the splicing column, a male buckle is fixedly connected to the other side of the splicing column, and a plurality of groups of female buckles and male buckles are arranged at intervals on the outer side of the splicing column. The utility model is provided with the degradable non-woven fabric, the water outlet and the planting matrix, can avoid completely blocking the substance exchange of soil, water and vegetation through the cooperation of the three, does not destroy the living environment of microorganisms and violates ecological restoration targets, and is provided with the snap fastener, the bolt and the nut, so that the device for preventing water and soil loss can be directly paved on a steep slope needing soil fixation through the cooperation of the three, the cost expenditure of a user is reduced, and secondary disasters such as small-scale landslide and the like are avoided.

title_en: A kind of active power distribution network islet operation method of consideration source lotus operation characteristic
abstract_en: A kind of active power distribution network islet operation method of consideration source lotus operation characteristic：According to selected distribution system, distribution system structure and parameter are inputted；The mathematical modeling of the active power distribution network islet operation problem of consideration source lotus operation characteristic is established, including：The burden with power amount for being set in distribution system service restoration in fault time is up to object function, considers isolated island main power source unique constraints, system load flow constraint, working voltage constraint, branch current constraint, uncontrollable distributed power source operation constraint and the operation constraint of controlled distribution formula power supply respectively；Obtained mathematical modeling is solved to obtain using prim al- dual interior point m ethod：Target function value, each node voltage amplitude, each node load recovery coefficient, the operation reserve of distributed power source and block switch cut-off state；Export solving result.The present invention establishes a kind of active power distribution network isolated island partitioning model of consideration source lotus operation characteristic, and its mathematics essence is non-linear programming problem, is solved using prim al- dual interior point m ethod, obtains service restoration scheme.

title_en: A kind of river ecological Restoration system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of river ecological Restoration systems; including river ecological data analysis system and ecological implementation system; the analysis method of river ecological data analysis system specifically includes following steps; S1, water balanced calculation; S2, water amount of seepage calculate; the separation reasoning of S3, climate change and mankind's activity to Southeast Tibetan Plateau amount the present invention relates to basin protection of resources and utilizes technical field.The river ecological Restoration system, the comparative analysis degree of protection of river basin ecological water before and after large watershed integrated management, and the Variation Features of natural vegetation cover degree, soil drought, the safeguard effects that large watershed comprehensive management mode supplies ecological water under quantitative evaluation climate change background, pass through the causes between building river ethic, leakage and tree ring standard chronology, the new approaches that river water amount of seepage is rebuild with tree-ring width index are proposed, for the groundwater optimal management for realizing arid biogeographic zone analogy basin.

title_en: Electric energy prediction and restoration method based on LSTM neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric energy prediction and restoration method based on an LSTM neural network, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out standardization processing on acquired electric energy data, then building a deep learning model after constructing a standard data format; and finally, predicting, precision testing and abnormal value repairing by using the LSTM model. The invention standardizes the original data, readjusts the distribution of values, avoids reducing the speed of network learning and convergence, and improves the learning efficiency of the network; the method comprises the steps that linear stacking of a plurality of network layers is built, an LSTM layer is added to serve as a bridge for input information and hidden states, a full-connection layer is added to link the hidden states and output information, a model is fitted, and model prediction accuracy is improved; the abnormal electric energy data are restored based on the LSTM prediction model, so that the accuracy of restoring the abnormal electric energy data is improved.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;NARI GROUP CORP

title_en: Seasonal river coastal ecological restoration landscape area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seasonal river coastal ecological restoration landscape area, which comprises an ecological restoration landscape area, wherein a dam body is arranged between the ecological restoration landscape area and a river, a water inlet gate and a water outlet gate are sequentially arranged on the dam body along the river direction, a partition wall dam is arranged on one side of the dam body facing the inside of the ecological restoration landscape area, the water inlet gate and the water outlet gate are respectively positioned on two sides of the partition wall dam, a partition dam is arranged between the end face of the partition wall dam and the inner wall of the ecological restoration landscape area, and the partition dam and the partition wall dam divide the space between the ecological restoration landscape area and the dam body into a dirt blocking area, a sediment adsorption landscape area and an aquatic organism cultivation area. The water storage in the high water season is realized, flood in the river can be shunted, flood disasters are prevented, water is used for irrigating or reflowing to the river channel in the dead water season to help the river channel to restore the ecological balance of the water body, and meanwhile, the requirements of landscapes are met.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION ECOLOGICAL ENV GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Scene self-adaptive fault first-aid repair scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a scene self-adaptive fault repair scheduling method and system, which relate to the technical field of fault detection and comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of monitoring the running state of a target power grid in real time, identifying a plurality of running fault scene parameters, performing fault detection, traversing a fault detection data set, determining a plurality of fault points, evaluating the plurality of fault points, generating a fault rush-repair scheduling scheme, performing dynamic feedback and self-adaptive adjustment, and generating a fault rush-repair scheduling optimization scheme. The application can solve the technical problem of low fault first-aid repair efficiency caused by complex and changeable power grid fault conditions and lack of a dynamic feedback mechanism in the prior art, and the generated fault first-aid repair scheduling scheme is dynamically fed back and adaptively adjusted by integrating multiple data sources for real-time monitoring, so that the technical effect of improving the power grid fault first-aid repair efficiency is achieved.

title_en: Scheduling method of mobile energy storage device after extreme disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a scheduling method of a mobile energy storage device after an extreme disaster, and belongs to the technical field of scheduling of mobile energy storage devices. The method comprises the steps of constructing an objective function of a scheduling model by taking minimum scheduling cost of the mobile energy storage device and minimum equivalent load loss cost of the power distribution network as targets, constructing constraint conditions of the scheduling model, solving the scheduling model, and scheduling the mobile energy storage device according to a solving result, wherein the constraint conditions comprise traffic network constraint, radial network constraint, power flow constraint, node balance constraint, mobile energy storage device scheduling constraint and distribution line restoration constraint. According to the invention, the mobile energy storage device is scheduled in real time under the condition of considering the influence of extreme disasters on traffic conditions, and the obtained scheduling scheme has optimal economy.
assignees: NANZHAO POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Geological exploration mountain side slope ecological restoration device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mountain slope restoration, and discloses a geological exploration mountain slope ecological protection device which comprises at least one group of first water blocking areas (5) arranged on two sides of a slow-flow water area (1), wherein a first communication plate (6) is arranged between the first water blocking areas (5) and the slow-flow water area (1), a plurality of first through holes (7) are formed in the first communication plate (6) so as to communicate the slow-flow water area (1) and the first water blocking areas (5), a first water blocking plate (8) is arranged in the first water blocking areas (5), a first buoyancy member (9) is arranged at the bottom of the first water blocking plate (8), and by constructing the slow-flow water area at the top of a slope and the water storage area at the lower part of the slope and matching with the water blocking plate lifting along with water flow, the ecological protection of the mountain slope is effectively realized, and damage caused by disaster phenomena such as landslide, mud flow and the like is reduced.
assignees: NINGBO METALLURGICAL SURVEY & DESIGN RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source cooperative power supply recovery method and device considering agricultural biogas power generation support
abstract_en: A multi-source collaborative power restoration method and device considering agricultural biogas power generation support comprises the steps of establishing a power restoration model, establishing an objective function according to load restoration maximization in the power restoration process, determining the number of micro-grids in a system according to dynamic radial constraint of a power distribution network, considering photovoltaic inverter constraint, cold load starting constraint and linear load flow constraint of self-adaptive network topology of the power distribution network in the power restoration model, adding grid-built inverter constraint based on battery energy storage, grid-built inverter synchronous constraint, agricultural biogas power generation constraint and power transmission network power failure and restoration process constraint in the power restoration model, initializing the power restoration model, and solving by using Gurobi solver to obtain a load restoration state of the power distribution network. In the invention, the support of agricultural biogas power generation is considered in the power supply recovery process, dynamic radial constraint is developed to support the synchronization process, and the multi-source cooperative power supply recovery is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Multi-mode data fusion farmland soil accurate variable fertilization method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a farmland soil accurate variable fertilization method and device integrating multi-mode data, which comprises the steps of integrating multi-source data such as soil, topography and the like collected by taking a slope mini-fracture as a center, constructing a spatial heterogeneity map, utilizing a convolutional neural network to extract vegetation root competition characteristics, determining a multi-species nutrient absorption demand mode, integrating the information into a three-dimensional voxel model, combining a hydrologic model, simulating a migration path of water and fertilizer along the fracture, foreseeing a downhill nutrient enrichment risk, and finally generating a three-dimensional voxel model adjustment scheme for carrying out accurate adjustment on the slope, the soil moisture content and a predicted loss path so as to guide accurate variable fertilization and fertility restoration. The invention also provides a device for executing the method. The invention can remarkably improve the precision, foresight and timeliness of precision fertilization and fertility management under complex terrains.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA AUTONOMOUS REGION ACAD AGRICULTURAL & ANIMAL HUSBANDRY SCIENCES

title_en: Wind and rain, earthquake and wave disaster coupling experiment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind and rain, earthquake and wave disaster coupling experiment system, relates to the field of ocean engineering experiment equipment, and aims to solve the problem that the degree of restoration of natural disaster experiments is not high. The system comprises a wind and rain simulation unit, a wave simulation unit, an earthquake simulation unit and a cooperative control unit, wherein the wind and rain simulation unit comprises a wind tunnel main body, a fan arranged in the wind tunnel main body and a rainfall simulation mechanism arranged in the wind tunnel main body, the wave simulation unit comprises a wave making pool arranged in the wind tunnel main body, a wave making mechanism and a flow making mechanism arranged in the wave making pool, the earthquake simulation unit comprises a vibrating table arranged in the wave making pool and used for bearing a building model, and the wind and rain simulation unit, the wave simulation unit and the earthquake simulation unit are all electrically connected with the cooperative control unit, and the cooperative control unit is used for controlling the working state of each simulation unit. The method is used for realizing the restoration simulation of multiple disasters of the traffic infrastructure in the coastal extreme environment.
assignees: UNIV SHIJIAZHUANG TIEDAO;HEBEI TRANSP INVESTMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Beach vegetation restoration evaluation method based on image feature analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image analysis, in particular to a beach vegetation restoration evaluation method for image feature analysis, which comprises the steps of obtaining remote sensing images of two time phases of a target beach restoration area before and after an environmental disturbance event occurs, respectively dividing the remote sensing images of the two time phases in an object-oriented manner to generate a plurality of vegetation objects, extracting morphological stability features and ecological stress resistance features of each vegetation object in the two time phases, calculating the functional toughness index of each vegetation object based on the changes of the morphological stability features and the ecological stress resistance features before and after the environmental disturbance event, and evaluating the overall effect of vegetation restoration according to the functional toughness index. The invention changes the uncertainty problem of the traditional graph selection according to the fixed time interval, so that the vegetation restoration evaluation has the advantages of event driving, accurate time phase and effective data, and provides technical support for post-disaster ecological monitoring, post-coastal engineering evaluation and the like.
assignees: FIRST INSTITUTE OF OCEANOGRAPHY MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Physiologically active substance measuring system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a physiologically active substance measuring system capable of contributing to promoting a restoration of the infrastructure, when a lifeline is disconnected by a natural disaster, or the like, while maintaining health of a local resident by taking a prompt measure against an infecting bacteria including a bacterial pathogen such as virus concurrently with addressing an important challenge to secure infrastructure.SOLUTION: The present invention is a physiologically active substance measuring system which has a fuel cell as a power source to enable the same to be portable and effectively used. With the physiologically active substance measuring system, an infecting bacteria can be effectively and promptly identified in an environment where a commercial power source is not put in place or in a time of disaster.

title_en: Resource allocation for power, communication, and transportation infrastructure using distributed fiber optic sensing
abstract_en: Disclosed are integrated systems and methods that utilize a network of DFOS sensors installed on power lines, communication networks, and transportation systems, which continuously monitor infrastructures and provide real-time data. This data is collected, processed, and analyzed, and used to identify any affected areas of infrastructure and assess severity of any damage. Prioritization and resource allocation is performed and uses this analysis to prioritize restoration efforts and allocate resources such as repair crews, equipment, and materials to areas with a highest priority.

title_en: Power distribution network power supply recovery system and method meeting differentiated reliability requirements
abstract_en: The invention provides a power supply restoration system and a power supply restoration method for a power distribution network, which meet the requirements of differentiated reliability. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module and a database, wherein the data acquisition module and the data processing module are connected with the database. In the invention, the user power consumption data is considered in the making process of the power supply restoration measures, so that the made measures are more practical and can meet the requirements of users on the power supply reliability.

title_en: Maximum flow-based power grid elasticity modeling and quantitative evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maximum flow-based power grid elasticity modeling and quantitative evaluation method, which comprises the steps of firstly, introducing a maximum flow idea to comprehensively consider the vulnerable characteristics of elements and the structural characteristics of a system, and establishing a vulnerability model for real-time measurement of damage of hurricane to a power distribution system; on the other hand, the targets of the shortest power supply recovery time and the fastest power supply quantity lifting of the system are comprehensively considered, the PERT/CPM algorithm is utilized to solve the optimal fault recovery sequence, the recovery performance of the system is estimated according to the maximum current value, finally, the IEEE-30 node network is taken as an example to simulate the damage and the recovery process of the system under hurricane attack, the feasibility and the effectiveness of the method are verified, and the result shows that the method is helpful for identifying key elements of the system and enables the system to recover the power supply of the system in the shortest time.

title_en: Ecological net for restoring soil in mining area and restoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration of mining areas, in particular to an ecological restoration net for soil in mining areas and a restoration method thereof. According to the invention, the ground grabbing capacity of the barrier net is improved through the support columns, a certain distance exists between the barrier net and the slope, the water and soil retaining capacity of the barrier net is increased, the loss and landslide of soil are reduced, the anchor pipe is extruded by the expansion rod in a short period due to the water absorption and expansion of the soil, the anchor pipe is more firmly connected with the ground, and the barrier net, the anchor pipe and the expansion rod are gradually decomposed and disappeared by microorganisms in the soil in a long period, so that the pollution to the environment is reduced, the continuous constraint and the extrusion of green plant root system are avoided, and the green plant growth is facilitated.

title_en: Health evaluation index system and evaluation method for single-inflow river
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of river health evaluation, in particular to a health evaluation index system and an evaluation method for a single-inflow river. The index system comprises 5 criterion layer indexes of hydrology, water quality, biology, habitat and social service functions, wherein the 5 criterion layer indexes comprise 11 common indexes and 5 individual indexes respectively. The evaluation method comprises an Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), a comprehensive index evaluation method and river health grading. The invention effectively fills the blank of the lack of the single-inflow-sea-river health evaluation index system in the current river research field, and after the technical scheme of the invention is used for evaluating the health condition of the single-inflow-sea river, river restoration suggestions and management countermeasures proposed according to the evaluation result are scientific, reasonable and highly targeted, thereby laying a solid foundation for the long-term treatment and the healthy development of the single-inflow-sea river.

title_en: Low-cost repair decision method for cable
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power cable engineering, in particular to a low-cost repair decision method for a cable, which comprises the steps of monitoring the insulation state of the cable on line by a spread spectrum time domain reflection method, recording the service life end time of the cable, and collecting the service life end time of a plurality of different cables; the method comprises the steps of establishing a cable reliability model according to the Weibull distribution rule of life end time of a plurality of different cables, establishing an average cost rate model according to preventive restoration probability, fault probability, preventive restoration cost and fault restoration cost, introducing chaos factors into a mathematical model of a chimpanzee optimization algorithm, and carrying out optimization solving on objective functions according to the preventive restoration cost and the fault restoration cost through the chaos chimpanzee optimization algorithm to obtain minimum average cost rate, and outputting an optimal maintenance period and a restoration threshold value of the cable. The invention can output the optimal maintenance period and the repair threshold value of the cable under the condition of ensuring the reliability of the cable, and realize low-cost repair decision.

title_en: Water supply control system for restoration ecological of water bodies
title_ko: 수공간에서의 생태복원용 처리수 공급 제어시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a water supply control system suitable for representative ecological fish species in a water body. The invention sets a reference range of quality, quantity and flow rate of treated water, to satisfy inhabitation conditions of ecological fish species in the water body, and supplies a certain amount of the treated water for ecological restoration with improved water quality at a constant flow rate according to the reference range. Accordingly, a habitat environment for the ecological fish species in the water body is improved to the optimum condition, thereby maximizing the restorative effects on the ecological target species, and satisfying various treated waters and complicated water quality management standards, so it is possible to efficiently manage the water body economically, ecologically and environmentally. In order to achieve the above object, a treated water supply control system for the ecological restoration in the water body of the present invention includes: a measurement unit for measuring water depth, flow rate, and physicochemical quality of water with respect to water in a water body of an ecosystem restoration target, and transmitting the measured water information through the wired/wireless communication network; a simulation processing unit for simulating the rate of change of supply flow rate and flow speed of the treated water for the ecological restoration while comparing the measured information transmitted and processed by the measurement unit with stored reference information; a control unit for determining the supply flow rate and flow speed of the treated water for the ecological restoration from the simulation result processed by the simulation processing unit, and generating a remote control signal corresponding thereto; and a treated water discharging unit for discharging the treated water for the ecological restoration at a constant flow rate to the restoration target water body at a constant flow speed in accordance with the remote control signal generated from the control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수공간에서의 대표생태어종에 적합한 용수원 공급 제어시스템을 개시한 것으로, 이러한 본 발명은 수공간에 서식하는 생태어종의 서식조건을 만족하기 위한 처리수의 수질 및 수량과 유속의 기준범위를 설정하고 그 기준범위에 따라 수질이 개선된 일정수량의 생태복원용 처리수를 일정 유속으로 공급하는 것이며, 이에따라 수공간에서의 생태어종에 대한 서식환경을 최적의 조건으로 개선하여 복원대상 생태어종의 복원효과를 극대화하고, 다양한 처리수와 복잡한 수량적 수질적 관리기준을 만족하면서 경제적, 생태적 친환경적으로 수공간을 효율적으로 관리할 수 있는 것이다.

title_en: Associating security tags to continuous data protection checkpoints/snapshots/point-in-time images
abstract_en: An in-guest agent in a virtual machine (VM) operates in conjunction with a replication module. The replication module performs continuous data protection (CDP) by saving images of the VM as checkpoints at a disaster recovery site over time. Concurrently, the in-guest agent monitors for behavior in the VM that may be indicative of the presence of malicious code. If the in-guest agent identifies behavior (at a particular point in time) at the VM that may be indicative of the presence of malicious code, the replication module can tag a checkpoint that corresponds to the same particular point in time as a security risk. One or more checkpoints generated prior to the particular time may be determined to be secure checkpoints that are usable for restoration of the VM.

title_en: Mine ecological remediation circulation system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of mine ecological restoration, in particular to a mine ecological restoration circulation system, which comprises a reservoir and a side slope system, wherein the upper end of the reservoir is provided with a screen mesh for filtering impurities in rainwater, an adsorption layer is laid at the bottom of the reservoir and used for neutralizing acid mine wastewater, a water inlet at the left side of the reservoir is connected with a water outlet of a water inlet pipe, a solenoid valve is arranged inside a water outlet pipe, underground water can be introduced in the water shortage process, the right side of the reservoir is provided with a filter tank, a filter layer is arranged between the reservoir and the filter tank for filtering impurities in the reservoir, a liquid level sensor is arranged inside the filter tank, a water outlet at one end of the filter tank is connected with a water inlet end of a water outlet pipe, a water discharge end of the water outlet pipe is communicated with the ground and is connected with a water pump arranged on the ground through, the vegetation is planted in the metal grid, so that landslide caused by vegetation growth is prevented, and the vegetation survival rate is improved.
assignees: SHANXI ZHONGLIAN CHUANGTOU ECOLOGICAL ENV ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Power failure early warning signal verification method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power failure early warning signal verification method and a power failure early warning signal verification system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining a plurality of power failure early warning signals of all terminal equipment in a target power distribution area, wherein the power failure early warning signals comprise power failure equipment information and power failure time information; step S2, merging the plurality of power failure early warning signals to obtain a plurality of power failure early warning events; step S3, calling mining operation is carried out on the power failure equipment corresponding to the power failure early warning event so as to obtain three-phase current information of the power failure equipment; step S4, judging whether the mining calling operation is successful, if so, judging whether the corresponding power failure equipment is in a normal working state according to the comparison result of the obtained three-phase current information and a preset threshold value; and if the corresponding power failure equipment is in a power failure working state or fails in recovery, informing emergency repair personnel to go to the site to perform emergency repair and restoration treatment on the power failure equipment. The off-line state of the equipment is timely and accurately verified according to the power failure signal of the terminal equipment.

title_en: River channel ecological management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a river channel ecological management method and a river channel ecological management system, and relates to the field of river channel ecological restoration. The method comprises the steps that firstly, at least two gabion nets in the river are transversely arranged in the river at intervals along the river flow direction in the river, a backflow pond is formed at the upstream of the gabion nets in the river, and aquatic vegetation is planted in the backflow pond; step two, presetting a flood water level, a design water level and a normal water level; planting flooding-resistant herbs and/or shrubs on the riverway or the side slope between the normal water level and the designed water level; and planting trees on the riverway or the side slope between the designed water level and the flood water level. Has the advantages that: the river channel can not only ensure the proper flow of the river, but also can not cause siltation formed by flood scouring, and can meet the flood standard for ten years; by means of the measures of arranging plants by matching arbor and shrub, original monotonous concrete gray of the revetment is covered, the diversity of ecological landscape of the river channel is realized, and the comprehensive ecological benefit is improved.

title_en: Regional power supply reliability assessment method
abstract_en: The regional power supply reliability evaluation method solves the problem that the existing regional complex power system power supply reliability evaluation efficiency and precision are low, and belongs to the technical field of security inspection systems. The invention comprises the following steps: determining a power grid parameter of a target area; inputting power grid parameters into a power distribution network equipment model to obtain failure outage rates of various equipment in the power distribution network; simulating the running state, forced outage state and prearranged outage state of the equipment, and determining the repair rate of forced outage of the equipment and the repair rate of prearranged outage of the equipment; according to the tripping, fault isolation and power restoration processes of the circuit breaker after a single equipment fault, determining the influence of the fault on the power failure of each load point, and determining the annual power failure time and the power failure times of each load point; and calculating the reliability index of the load point and the system reliability index according to the obtained data.
assignees: HEIHE POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Household transformer relation analysis method based on power outage correlation theory
abstract_en: The application provides a household transformer relation analysis method based on a power failure correlation theory, which comprises the steps of obtaining power utilization data, wherein the power utilization data comprises first data, second data and historical power failure recovery data; extracting a user electricity characteristic curve and user electricity behavior according to a clustering algorithm, and making a power failure and power restoration data acquisition scheme; determining a target period of time in which the influence of the power failure on normal power consumption behavior is minimum and collecting target power failure data; constructing a power-off and power-on judging model to obtain simulated power-off and power-on data; constructing a user-variable relation analysis and identification model; and judging whether the user change relation accords with the user change rule or not by utilizing the user change relation analysis and identification model. The application reduces the influence of the acquisition process on the normal electricity consumption behavior of the user to the minimum through the analysis method, improves the data acquisition efficiency, ensures the data authenticity, reduces the labor cost of user transformer verification, provides a theoretical basis for the line loss of the transformer area, and achieves the purposes of reducing the line loss and improving the management efficiency of the user transformer relation.
assignees: LIJIANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Anti-seismic ecological restoration method for abandoned mine
abstract_en: An earthquake-resistant ecological restoration method for abandoned mines relates to an earthquake-resistant restoration method for abandoned strip mines, which comprises the steps of slope repair, piling, concrete pouring, water collecting tank installation, water collecting tank maintenance, soil paving, watering penetration, soil pit filling, tree planting, grass planting and periodical maintenance; according to the application, concrete is poured into the space between the fixed pile pipe external pulling and the conical body, so that the enlarged cement blocks formed by gathering the concrete at the positions of the reinforcement cage and the space are obtained, and the anti-pulling and anti-sedimentation effects are also achieved while the anti-seismic effect is increased.
assignees: ECOLOGICAL ENV GEOLOGICAL SERVICE CENTER OF HENAN GEOLOGICAL BUREAU

title_en: Power supply restoration method, system and storage medium considering controllable load regulation capability
abstract_en: A power supply restoration method, system and storage medium considering controllable load regulation capability includes: modeling an air-conditioner load and an electric vehicle load; evaluating the adjustment capability of the air-conditioning load and the electric vehicle load; solving an optimal power supply path for adjusting the air-conditioning load and the electric vehicle load. The advantages are that: modeling an air-conditioner load and an electric vehicle load, and accurately describing the load; the power utilization habit of a user is fully considered, the user load adjustable quantity can be accurately calculated, finally, the on-off state of each branch of urban power supply to be recovered is obtained according to the air conditioner load adjustment capability and the electric vehicle load adjustment capability through a quantum evolution algorithm based on alleles, and an optimal path is sought, so that the controllable load on the load side is adjusted, important load power supply is ensured, and the toughness of a power distribution network is improved.
assignees: FUXIN POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SHENYANG INST ENGINEERING;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intelligent decision-making method for restoration and treatment of heavy metal polluted farmland
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural environment, and provides an intelligent decision method for repairing and controlling heavy metal polluted farmland, which comprises the following steps: investigation and evaluation are carried out on heavy metal polluted farmland areas, the types and the concentrations of heavy metals are determined, pollutant data of the areas to be repaired are obtained, and repair indexes are determined; a multi-technology combination mode is adopted, and a repairing scheme is provided; constructing an optimized repair model, and solving optimal repair parameters and measures; implementing a restoration scheme, monitoring heavy metal dynamic data such as soil, crops, water quality and the like in the restoration process, evaluating restoration effects, and timely adjusting restoration parameters; managing and maintaining the restored farmland; in the method, an intelligent restoration scheme is provided by using a multi-technology combination mode, an optimal restoration parameter and measure are solved by constructing an optimal restoration model, restoration efficiency is improved, and finally a way of digitally restoring the heavy metal polluted area of the cultivated land is realized.

title_en: Optimal configuration method of off-grid wind power hydrogen production system considering full life cycle benefits
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimal configuration method of an off-grid wind power hydrogen production system considering full life cycle benefits, which comprises the following steps of receiving original data, carrying out abnormal value detection and missing value restoration, obtaining multi-scale component data through empirical mode decomposition, generating a time sequence feature matrix, extracting equipment performance feature parameters, establishing a performance prediction model, establishing a system dynamic model based on a Bond Graph method, carrying out stability analysis, calculating various costs and system benefits of the full life cycle, generating a comprehensive evaluation matrix by combining risk analysis, constructing a multi-objective optimization function, solving by adopting a gray wolf algorithm, generating an optimal configuration scheme, and carrying out simulation verification and sensitivity analysis on the optimal configuration scheme to generate a final configuration scheme. The invention fully considers the equipment performance attenuation law and the system dynamic characteristic, and improves the accuracy and the reliability of the optimal configuration.
assignees: ANHUI HUASAI ENERGY TECH CO LTD;ANHUI YOUSAI TECH CO LTD;ANHUI YOUSAI ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Ecological comprehensive restoration and intelligent monitoring method for dry lake basin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dry lake basin ecological comprehensive restoration and intelligent monitoring method, which comprises the steps of realizing edge locking and sand control inside a dry lake basin by carrying out soil-alien transplanting and the like on primary plants in the dry lake basin, forming sand substance sealing and controlling plant strips by planting native plants on the edge of the dry lake basin along the circumferential direction, fixing surface quicksand by planting sandy plants on quicksand lands on the periphery of the dry lake basin and the like, and constructing plant sand fixation grids by planting sand fixation arbor and shrubs in a upwind area on the periphery of the dry lake basin and covering a sand fixation net and the like. The invention can obviously improve the wind prevention and sand fixation efficiency of the surrounding area of the dry lake basin, effectively reduce the frequency of wind and sand disasters, provide firm guarantee for the regional safety, and simultaneously effectively promote the optimization of the soil structure and the natural recovery of vegetation, not only enhance the water and fertilizer retention capacity of the soil, but also obviously improve the service functions of regional ecosystems, such as water conservation, climate regulation and the like.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: Regional ecological restoration effect evaluation system is renovated in soil and land space based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of national space ecological restoration, and discloses a national space remediation area ecological restoration effect evaluation system based on big data. The system continuously captures ecological restoration original monitoring data through a multi-source ecological data acquisition engine to form a multi-source ecological data stream. And the space-time serialization processor performs serialization recombination and standardization conversion on the data stream according to the time dimension and the space dimension to generate an ecological parameter sequence with unified space-time reference. The ecological association network constructor analyzes the ecological elements in the sequence and constructs an ecological association network of the interaction relationship among the elements. The repair path digger extracts a plurality of potential repair paths from the network, performs path fusion and optimization, and generates a repair path set. The dynamic evaluation generator calculates and outputs an ecological restoration effect evaluation index based on the path set and the real-time ecological state data. The system realizes dynamic and accurate evaluation of ecological restoration effect.

title_en: Power distribution system reconfigurations for multiple contingencies
abstract_en: System and method simulate power distribution system reconfigurations for multiple contingencies. Decision tree model is instantiated as a graph with nodes and edges corresponding to simulated outage states of one or more buses in the power distribution system and simulated states of reconfigurable switches in the power distribution system, Edges related to each outage are disconnected. A reconfiguration path is determined with a plurality of switches reconfigured to a closed state by an iteration of tree search algorithms. A simulation estimates feeder cable and transformer loading and bus voltages on the reconfigured path for comparing against constraints including system capacity ratings and minimum voltage. Further iterations identify additional candidate reconfiguration paths which can be ranked by total load restoration

title_en: Fast network formation after network power restoration
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a first device in a network detects a power restoration event subsequent to a power outage event. Power is restored to the first device during the power restoration event. The first device synchronizes a channel hopping schedule to the detected power restoration event. The first device communicates with a neighboring device of the first device using the channel hopping schedule synchronized to the detected power restoration event. The neighboring device uses a corresponding channel hopping schedule to communicate with the first device that is also synchronized to the power restoration event.

title_en: A kind of ecological environment treatment device for geological disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of ecological environment treatment device for geological disaster, including compartment, walking structure and scraper bowl, the side in the compartment is welded with hanging plate, and the side of the hanging plate is welded with lantern ring；Hydraulic cylinder is socketed on the inside of the lantern ring, and the cylinder ends are fixedly connected with scraper bowl；The bottom of the hanging plate is equipped with symmetrical first connecting rod, the top of the first connecting rod is fixedly connected with hanging plate, the bottom end of the first connecting rod is equipped with the second connecting rod, the first connecting rod and second connecting rod one end are hinged, and the other end of second connecting rod is bolted with scraper bowl；Compared with the ecological environment treatment device for being currently used for geological disaster, stable operation can be carried out on rough ground and mud-stone flow disaster ground by having, while the advantages that can repair while smooth, substantially increase remediation efficiency, make the quickening of eco-environment restoration speed.

title_en: Bending steel truss connecting beam with U-shaped damper and capable of being quickly recovered after earthquake
abstract_en: The utility model provides a take crooked shaped steel truss that resumes fast after shake of U-shaped attenuator even roof beam, including the U-shaped attenuator, the utility model discloses utilize U-shaped attenuator power consumption on the basis of ordinary steel truss even roof beam, the U-shaped attenuator includes: the U-shaped upper cover plate, the U-shaped lower cover plate and the bolt; the structure is simple, the construction is convenient, and the disassembly is simple. Under a small earthquake, the bending steel truss connecting beam with the U-shaped damper does not generate plastic deformation, is equivalent to a common steel truss connecting beam, and provides vertical rigidity for the structure; under heavy shock, after the U-shaped damper yield load is reached, the damper is subjected to plastic deformation, so that energy is consumed. Most of the energy in the earthquake is dissipated by the U-shaped damper. The utility model discloses take the curved steel truss that the back of shaking of U-shaped attenuator resumes fast even roof beam is under the earthquake effect, and intensity does not take place the degradation, and does not take place to destroy, only needs the U-shaped apron of inspection, change attenuator after shaking, has the advantage that the low, in time use of restoration cost after shaking.

title_en: Power outage protection and restoration using low power states in data storage devices/systems
abstract_en: Systems and methods for early warning of power loss in solid state storage drives are disclosed. An early power loss warning may be used to activate the drive into a low power state before using the energy in the backup power source (e.g., backup capacitor). This low power state may allow for a reduction in power used by the drive, which may provide cost savings and reduce the risk of: the drive will be rendered as reconfigurable by a power outage event.

title_en: A kind of hierarchy optimization dispatching method and system for more microgrids of fast recovery of power supply after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of hierarchy optimization dispatching methods and system for more microgrids of fast recovery of power supply after disaster, improve the ability that electric system maintains critical load supply of electric power under Disaster Event, enhancing power grid elasticity：1) when Disaster Event causes electric network fault, microgrid off-the-line is run, and more microgrids form interacted systems in region；2) each microgrid is contributed according to new energy and load prediction data formulates multi-period machine unit scheduling plan using rolling scheduling pattern with cutting load loss and the minimum target of operating cost；3) the coordination mutual assistance that electric power is carried out between interconnection microgrid, realizes global optimization.Important load can be maintained to power to greatest extent after grid collapses using the method for the invention, reduce loss of outage.Dispatching method is layered take into account economy and high efficiency while, the ownership of each microgrid ownership unit of effective guarantee.The quick service restoration that the present invention can be used for after electric power system fault provides practicable decision-making foundation to promote power system restoration power.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Silt loss prevention equipment for river ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silt loss prevention device for river ecological restoration, which comprises a river channel, wherein a silt conveying device for intercepting and conveying silt is arranged in the river channel, a flow control device is arranged in the river channel and positioned on the lower side of a filter screen, the flow control device can adjust the conveying amount of the silt according to the flow velocity of water flow, and a storage device for storing redundant silt is arranged on the right side of the river channel. Can relieve drought conditions of downstream farmlands and reduce downstream flood disasters.
assignees: LONGYOU KAYI ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Equipment for repairing and improving soil ecology after soil and water disasters in mid-swimming areas of yellow river
abstract_en: The invention relates to equipment for restoring and improving soil ecology after a soil and water disaster in a midstream region of a yellow river in the technical field of soil restoration and improvement equipment, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein the bottom end of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with a support plate, a first rotating shaft is arranged between the right side support plates, a second rotating shaft is arranged between the left side support plates, two ends of the first rotating shaft and the second rotating shaft are respectively fixedly provided with a roller, the top end of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with a mixing assembly feeding and stirring assembly, two sides of the bottom end of the mounting plate are provided with a plowing assembly and a plowing assembly, the bottom of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with a placing plate through a connecting rod, the placing plate is provided; the invention can effectively and fully mix the herbicide and water, ensures the use effect of the herbicide, can supplement soil fertility in a targeted manner, and has the advantages that the arranged driving assembly drives the whole device to move, the pesticide spraying assembly and the fertilizer applying assembly are driven to work in the moving process, and the waste of the fertilizer and the herbicide is avoided.

title_en: Text face generation method based on deep confrontation generation network
abstract_en: Aiming at generating a face image from text description, the invention designs a text face generation method based on a depth confrontation generation network. The invention relates to applications in the field of generating images from text descriptions, and in particular to applications in the field of social public security for imaging descriptions of target characters according to witnesses. The method comprises four parts of data set manufacturing, network model design, network model parameter training and network model performance testing. The invention gives full play to the superiority of the anti-generation network in the aspect of image generation, designs a set of excellent solutions for generating the human face from the text, and has wider application prospect in the fields of public safety, human face image restoration, video media, archaeological study and the like.

title_en: Method for backfilling open pit to build underground gas storage and underground gas storage
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of compressed air energy storage, and provides a method for backfilling open pit and building an underground gas storage, and the underground gas storage, which comprises the steps of deep digging the bottom of an open abandoned pit to excavate partial bedrock, and building the underground gas storage on the bedrock; building a vertical shaft, enabling the bottom of the vertical shaft to be communicated with an underground gas storage, paving a plurality of gas pipelines communicated with the inside of the underground gas storage in the vertical shaft, building artificial surrounding rock at the bottom of a pit, and wrapping the underground gas storage and the bottom of the vertical shaft; backfilling stripping waste slag in the adjacent mine to be mined into an open-air waste pit to form a backfill area, exposing the top of the vertical shaft from the top of the backfill area, and connecting a plurality of gas pipelines in the vertical shaft with a compressor and an expander on the ground surface. The invention can solve the problems of high construction cost and high difficulty of the traditional gas storage chamber, and can also solve the problems of digestion of the adjacent stripping slag, ground disaster prevention and ecological restoration.

title_en: Method, system and equipment for recovering faults of power distribution network under new energy access
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for recovering faults of a power distribution network under new energy access, which relate to the technical field of power distribution network control and comprise the following steps: generating a pre-reconstruction scheme set according to the operation experience of reconstruction after the power distribution network faults, constructing a double-time section power flow calculation equation for obtaining new energy access to the lower power distribution network, calculating the distribution network power flow and node voltage under the double-time section at the initial stage and the later stage of recovery for each reconstruction scheme, calculating the evaluation values of the corresponding schemes according to the distribution network power flow and the node voltage under each reconstruction scheme, sorting the evaluation values, wherein the scheme with the minimum evaluation value is the current optimal particles, carrying out mutation operation on the current optimal particles to obtain variant particles, and replacing the particles with higher evaluation values in the sorting by the variant particles to obtain the optimal scheme for the power distribution network faults reconstruction. The invention ensures that the selected reconstruction scheme can meet the voltage safety constraint of the distribution network in the whole process of power restoration, and avoids power restoration failure caused by incapability of grid connection and power shortage of distributed new energy.

title_en: Greening side slope drainage structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of slope restoration, and discloses a greening slope drainage structure which comprises a top drainage groove arranged at the top of a slope and arranged along the length direction of the slope, wherein a bottom drainage groove arranged along the length direction of the slope is arranged at the bottom of the slope, an inward concave rough filtering groove is formed above one side, close to the top drainage groove, of the bottom drainage groove, a stabilizing plate is fixedly connected above one side, close to the bottom drainage groove, of the rough filtering groove, and a rough filtering mechanism is arranged on one side, far away from the bottom drainage groove, of the stabilizing plate. According to the invention, greening repair and installation are rapidly carried out on the side slope, the side slope repair efficiency is improved, the operation difficulty of repair personnel is reduced, the impact force of surface rainwater on the side slope is reduced, the damage degree of the side slope due to the impact of the rainwater is reduced, the side slope landslide condition is effectively prevented, the side slope rainwater can be collected, reverse water supply is carried out on green planting of the side slope during drought, the side slope rainwater is filtered and separated, sediment is separated and isolated, maintenance personnel is reminded to clean the sediment in time, and the cleaning operation is convenient.
assignees: SICHUAN YANJIANG PANNING EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Power distribution network power failure time prediction method and system considering distributed resource access
abstract_en: The invention particularly discloses a power distribution network outage time prediction method and a power distribution network outage time prediction system considering distributed resource access, wherein when a certain element fails, power supply is restored to an upstream area of a failure point after fault isolation, power supply switching area division and switching load analysis are performed to all power supplies in a downstream area of the failure point and connection switches connected with a power failure line, if no connection switch and fault line segment exist in the power failure area, power supply restoration is waited after fault restoration, the outage time of the area is calculated, if the connection switches exist in the switching area and standby power supplies can provide electric energy support, power supply switching is performed to the area, the outage time of the area is calculated, if the standby power supplies do not exist, the situation that the distributed resources are used as power supplies is considered, and the accuracy of power outage time prediction under a novel power distribution system is improved according to different areas related to power outage.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Knowledge graph construction method in rainstorm flood disaster chain monitoring field
abstract_en: The application provides a method for constructing a knowledge graph in a storm flood disaster chain monitoring field, which relates to the technical field of knowledge graph construction and comprises the steps of preprocessing original multi-source disaster data to obtain multi-class quality controlled data, calling a disaster field fine adjustment large model and a body inference machine based on a preliminary corpus and the multi-class quality controlled data to generate a core body and a sub-document set, screening the sub-document set to construct a document association graph, calling a mapping model to match a structured data field and a core body attribute, carrying out triplet extraction according to the sub-document set and a constructed three-level prompt word template, carrying out vectorization and clustering on the body instance attribute, generating a three-level collaborative system and a graph core structure through field conflict restoration and pruning adjustment, obtaining an instance implicit relation of the disaster field fine adjustment large model complement graph core structure based on the processing process, and constructing a target knowledge graph. The application realizes the construction of the knowledge graph in the disaster field.

title_en: Output estimation method and output estimation device for photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To implement output estimation for photovoltaic power generation more easily with few sensors than in a conventional way.SOLUTION: The output estimation method for photovoltaic power generation includes: a step for measuring changes in active power and reactive power at an observation point 50b provided on the more upstream side than a plurality of photovoltaic power generation devices PV1-PV3 and a plurality of load devices LD1-LD6 connected to a distribution system 1; a step for calculating a restoration signal by independent component analysis using data of active power and reactive power measured at the observation point 50b; and a step for estimating a change in active power totally consumed at the plurality of load devices LD1-LD6 based on the restoration signal and a change in the active power totally output from the plurality of photovoltaic power generation devices PV1-PV3.
assignees: KANSAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV OSAKA PREFECTURE

title_en: Disaster prevention receiver
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster prevention receiver capable of reducing the stress of an operator by displaying information related to progress in a time of starting or in time of restoration of the disaster prevention receiver itself to make the operator acquire the state of the disaster prevention receiver.  <P>SOLUTION: The disaster prevention receiver 100 includes: a starting processing part 191 performing the prescribed starting processing of the disaster prevention receiver 100; an output means outputting various kinds of information related to the starting processing; and a progress information output part 193 outputting the information related to the progress of the starting processing through the output means when the starting processing is performed by the starting processing part 191. The disaster prevention receiver includes a plurality of output means according to processing items of the starting processing. The progress information output part 193 outputs information which is information related to the progress of the starting processing and indicates the presence/absence of the execution of processing related to the processing item of the starting processing through the output means corresponding to the processing item of the starting processing.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Information processing device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To disable automatic restoration at first supply of power after being shipped without normally terminated in a manufacturing process, and enable automatic restoration to the state prior to a power outage at recovery from a power outage.SOLUTION: An information processing device comprises: a processing unit, supplied with a first power source, for performing prescribed information processing and outputting a timer reset signal at prescribed time intervals when normally operating; a power control unit, supplied with a second power source, for controlling the supply of the first power source; a power source unit for supplying the second power source and supplying the first power source under control by the power control unit; a push switch for operating the indication of supplying the first power source; and a timer unit, supplied with a third power source independently of the first and second power sources, for outputting an automatic restoration disable signal when a prescribed time has elapsed after being reset by a timer reset signal. When the supply of the second power source is resumed and when the processing unit was previously terminated in error and the automatic restoration disable signal is outputted from the timer unit, the power control unit stops the supply of the first power source and keeps it stopped until the power source is turned on via the push switch.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Tunnel disaster prevention system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable correct determination of an insulation deterioration state, by continuing measurement and recording of a line current without troubled by a current value abnormality alarm, if a current value abnormally alarm is raised through the periodic measurement of a signal line current to which terminal equipment is connected.SOLUTION: A tunnel disaster system prevention performs monitoring by connecting terminal equipment, having a report device and detectors 16, 18, to a signal line extracted from a disaster prevention board 10 to the inside of a tunnel. Line current monitor means 72 provided on the disaster prevention board 10 measures and records a current value which flows through the signal line, to which the terminal equipment is connected, for each predetermined period. When the measured current value becomes a predetermined threshold or larger, or exceeds the threshold, the line current monitor means 72 determines a current value abnormality, to raise an alarm and report the current value abnormality to external remote monitor control equipment 27. On detecting a restoration operation at the disaster prevention board 10 or the remote monitor control equipment 27, the line current monitor means 72 cancels the current value abnormality and resumes the current value measurement at each predetermined period.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Automatic cloud-based disaster recovery system
abstract_en: Restoration devices in a cloud storage system are paired with source containers associated with a mainframe computer, and series of commands are generated based on the pairings to cause copies of data at the source containers to be stored to the restoration devices. A point-in-time copy of the copy of the data at the source containers may be stored to some restoration devices, and a second copy of the data may be stored to other restoration devices. The restoration devices may be reallocated from inactive source containers. Execution of the commands is monitored, and the commands are modified if the execution of the commands does not satisfy one or more desired conditions. For example, a cycle time associated with copying data to a restoration device may be measured, and if the cycle time exceeds a threshold, the command may be modified.

title_en: Intelligent electric quantity restoration system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent electric quantity restoration system, which comprises a model construction subsystem and an electric quantity restoration subsystem; the method has the advantages that the transmission reliability analysis of communication signals is realized by constructing a position network and a packet network, meanwhile, the acquisition of the type of the power utilization terminal is realized, the local historical power utilization data of the power utilization terminal is combined, and the repairing waveform is generated in a weight superposition mode, so that the information can be fed back and repaired at the first time when the power utilization information is distorted, and the subsequent real-time complete analysis of the power utilization data is facilitated.

title_en: Mine restoration water and soil loss prevention device
