abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mine restoration waterproof soil loss device which comprises a spliced protective structure and inclined fixing pin rods, wherein the spliced protective structure is provided with a plurality of groups, the plurality of groups of spliced protective structures are arranged and fixed, the side ends of two adjacent groups of spliced protective structures are connected and fixed through the inclined fixing pin rods, the spliced protective structure consists of ground fixing piles, a protective blocking net structure, ground entering anchor rods and blocking net fixing bolts, the protective blocking net structure is fixed on the top side surface of the ground fixing piles through the blocking net fixing bolts, the ground entering anchor rods are provided with a plurality of groups, and the upper ends of the plurality of groups of ground entering anchor rods are fixed in the ground fixing piles. The utility model optimizes the setting of mine restoration for preventing water and soil loss, designs the problem that soil and water can be locked, landslide and water and soil loss are prevented, and the structure sectional type design can be used for process installation operation, has simple connection and fixing modes and is suitable for popularization and use.

title_en: A kind of power telecom network service restoration method based on SDN multimode channel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power telecom network service restoration methods based on SDN multimode channel, it include: after perceiving former network link and breaking down, network topology is updated, forms new network link, and not available smart grid business is put into smart grid collection of services to be restored；Based on the new network link, the priority of each of described smart grid collection of services to be restored not available smart grid business is determined；According to priority from high to low sequence, the not available smart grid business in the smart grid collection of services to be restored is restored one by one.A kind of power telecom network service restoration method based on SDN multimode channel provided by the invention can satisfy smart grid business to network bandwidth, delay, the requirement of reliability, can effectively promote the income and smart grid traffic restoration capability of powerline network.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Road network traffic time sequence characteristic data quality diagnosis and restoration method
abstract_en: A road network traffic time sequence characteristic data quality diagnosis and restoration method comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining a regional road network topological structure, and constructing a traffic data prediction model; s2, acquiring historical traffic data, training a model and checking the prediction precision of the model; s3, fusing the traffic data acquired by the traffic detector with the traffic data generated, and detecting and repairing the abnormal data in real time; and S4, performing incremental training on the prediction model to ensure the prediction precision of the model. The invention has the beneficial effects that: and predicting a mode of the data on the day and the comprehensive production data of the combined road network data based on historical data and comprehensively judging the quality of the data, and finally realizing high-quality data with reasonable continuous output and strong relevance.

title_en: Method for optimizing urban water environment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization method of an urban water environment system, which relates to the technical field of water environment restoration and comprises the following steps: monitoring the water quality of the water environment; acquiring the capacity of the water environment; carrying out ecological purification treatment on the water environment; performing bypass circulation purification treatment on the water environment; controlling the pollutant input amount of the water environment; the method improves the water quality of the urban water environment by carrying out ecological purification and bypass circulation purification on the urban water environment, and simultaneously controls the discharge amount of reclaimed water according to the water quality and the capacity of the urban water environment, thereby controlling the pollutant input amount of the urban water environment and optimizing the urban water environment system.

title_en: Rapid disposal method for collapse roof of shallow buried section of tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid treatment method for collapse roof collapse of a shallow tunnel buried section, and belongs to the technical field of tunnel disaster treatment. The method comprises the steps of removing residual saturated weak soil in a collapse cavity, constructing a sealing structure to seal a cavity formed by collapse roof-falling on a tunnel vault, constructing a protection structure to protect a side slope of the side wall of the collapse cavity between the sealing structure and the ground surface, constructing a backfill structure to backfill the collapse cavity, and constructing a ground surface greening restoration structure on the backfill structure to further backfill the collapse cavity to the original ground surface. In addition, no extra backfill exists, and the extra backfill is not needed to be chiseled in the follow-up, so that the treatment workload of the collapse roof is obviously shortened, and the treatment time of the collapse roof is shortened.
assignees: GUIZHOU TRANSPORTATION PLANNING SURVEY & DESIGN ACADEME CO LTD

title_en: Resistant plant screening and configuration equipment for ecological restoration of antimony mine slope
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, in particular to screening and configuration equipment for resistant plants for ecological restoration of antimony mine hillsides. The resistant plant screening and configuration equipment for ecological restoration of the antimony mine hillside slope comprises a side slope frame, a traveling component, a planting box, a seed discharging component and a seed throwing component. The invention can loosen soil, ditching and planting on the slope, is beneficial to improving the permeability of soil and the penetration of moisture, promotes the growth of plant root systems, ensures the continuity and stability of slope vegetation recovery, realizes the full-automatic flow of plug seedlings from conveying, turning and guiding to planting, greatly improves the planting efficiency, ensures that the plug seedlings can be accurately and completely planted in the slope soil, improves the planting survival rate and uniformity, enhances the structural stability of the slope soil through the soil fixation effect of the vegetation root systems, reduces the occurrence risk of geological disasters such as landslide, collapse and the like, and ensures the safety of mining areas and surrounding environments.
assignees: LENGSHUIJIANG SHIZISHAN ANTIMONY IND CO LTD

title_en: Automatic analyzer
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an automatic analyzer capable of obtaining down time of a cooling function of a reagent storage by monitoring times, when a power outage occurs, from a power outage start time to a power outage restoration time and preventing the automatic analyzer from getting large in size by eliminating necessity of installing an uninterruptible power source device.SOLUTION: An automatic analyzer 1 comprises: a power source 110 which is connected to a commercial power source section PS; an analysis section 104 which has reagent storage 10A and 10B; a computer 5 which can send and receive information with the analysis section 104 and controls performance thereof; a reagent storage cooling circuit board 120 which is capable of sending and receiving information with the analysis section 104 and has a cooling circuit 160 to cool the reagent storage 10A and 10B getting power input through the power source 110, a counter circuit 202 to count time in synchronization with time information of the computer 5 and a power storage section such as the reagent storage cooling circuit board 120 having a backup capacitor 150 to store power getting the power input through the power source 110.

title_en: Calculation method for number of function restoration days in disaster
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To develop a system of correctly estimating a restoration period required for starting to operate the plant again from the damage caused by the disaster such as an earthquake.SOLUTION: A calculation method for the number of function restoration days is provided, in which, a failure that occurs by an earthquake is predicted with a highly accurate production device of a semiconductor plant and the like in which a monetary damage becomes tremendous when the earthquake occurs as an object, and with a fragility curve (a probability distribution of the damage) based on a vibration amplification factor of the production device derived from a vibration test and earthquake damage data in the past as a base, and when the restoration of a life line and other elements are assumed outside a period in which actual operations are performed, even these elements are added to be regarded as the number of restoration days, and by comparing each of these elements, an estimation system rich in flexibility and developable over a complicated facility configuration or a high level dependency relation is provided.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Aeration control system for river ecological restoration and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aeration control system for river ecological restoration and a control method thereof, wherein the system comprises a sensing module, a control module and an aeration module, the sensing module is used for collecting river basic data of four dimensions of river profile, river water quality, river hydrodynamic force and river biology, and the control module is used for analyzing and processing the data collected by the sensing module, converting the data into parameters for controlling the aeration module and sending control signals to the aeration module. The method comprises the steps of acquiring data of four dimensions, preprocessing the input data by a control module, inputting the preprocessed input data into a neural network model, and calculating a target value of river restoration through aeration; starting an aeration module, monitoring the aeration condition of the river in real time, and maintaining the dissolved oxygen concentration of the river at an expected level; and stopping aeration and informing managers until the current situation of the river reaches the target value of the aeration repair river obtained by the neural network model. The invention reduces the energy consumption of the aeration equipment on the premise of ensuring the aeration effect.

title_en: Optimization method and system for power failure recovery scheme of single partition of power transmission network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization method and a system of a power failure recovery scheme of a single partition of a power transmission network, which constructs a power failure recovery tree with a certain depth based on a given power failure scene of the single partition of the power transmission network, and calculating the net gain index of the unit electric quantity of each power outage restoration scheme in the power outage restoration tree, and realizing the optimization of the power outage restoration scheme of the single partition of the power transmission network according to the net gain index of the unit electric quantity.

title_en: Disaster recovery data restoration method, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster recovery data restoration method, equipment, a storage medium and a program product, which relate to the technical field of data processing, wherein a disaster recovery end actively generates read information after receiving a routing inspection instruction, judges whether the storage medium is abnormal according to the read information, generates error reporting information under the condition that the storage medium is abnormal, acquires a data writing request of hard disk data containing a production end hard disk according to the error reporting information, and writes the hard disk data again by the disaster recovery end to finish data restoration under the condition that the storage medium is abnormal, thereby solving the problem that the storage medium is difficult to identify in the related technology, ensuring the data safety and increasing the reliability of data backup.

title_en: Complete backspacing searching method for tracing reasons of power failure after appearance of power distribution network fault
abstract_en: The invention relates to a backspacing method in the field of the electrical power system, particularly to a complete backspacing searching method for tracing reasons of power failure after the appearance of power distribution network fault. The method includes the following steps: A, performing recursion search from a node corresponding to a power-losing distribution transformer; B, judging whether a power source is searched; C, confirming a route from the power-losing distribution transformer to the power source, the distance of the route and the information of an switched off switch on the route and nearest to the starting node; and D, obtaining the reason of power failure of the power distribution network. The method is efficient for radial power distribution networks, can be used for efficiently and accurately positioning the reason of power failure, is of vital importance in guiding distribution network dispatching personnel to quickly command power restoration, can be used for clearly positioning topological error and effectively guide planners to eliminate islands and revise the topological error in the aspect of planning, has been applied to the on-line site reliability monitoring platform, and is embodying the practical engineering value.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for regularly and remotely duplicating database by utilizing linux time pool
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for regularly and remotely duplicating a database by utilizing a linux time pool, and belongs to the technical field of the management of a database. The method comprises the steps: creating a timing task by utilizing a linux system time pool, executing a script file of a backup database, generating a database backup file, and transmitting the backup file to a remote server by virtue of a remote transmission protocol. By adopting the method, the cost is low, the timed remote backup of the database can be realized, the fault safety of an application program can be guaranteed, and a relatively high disaster restoration capacity grade can be achieved.

title_en: Power grid line fault first-aid repair scheduling simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid line fault emergency repair dispatching simulation method and system, which are characterized in that a power grid structure topological graph is obtained according to power grid line data, the types of switches in the power grid lines and the connection relations between various switches and lines are set according to the power grid structure topological graph, a power grid simulation line is constructed, when a line fault at a certain position in a power grid is simulated, the state of the switches in the power grid simulation line is read, a dispatching instruction is generated, emergency repair personnel are dispatched to the position of a section switch to check and send the front section line in a trial mode according to the dispatching instruction, the operation is repeated until the line in the power grid simulation line trips again, and a line section where the fault is located is determined. In the whole process, the power grid simulation circuit is constructed and the fault simulation processing is carried out, so that the training of power grid workers can be realized, the power grid workers can coordinate and cooperate to quickly isolate faults as soon as possible, and the power supply can be quickly recovered.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: A kind of service restoration method after the power distribution network calamity based on path search algorithm
abstract_en: Service restoration method after the power distribution network calamity based on path search algorithm that the present invention relates to a kind of, has initially set up the power distribution network topological model of fault recovery after calamity.The search of load supply path is completed on the basis of the topological model, establishes the supply path collection of load.Using supply path on-off as variable, establish power distribution network main transformer capacity constraint, line energizing flow amount constraint, important load do not power off constraint etc. constraints algebraic expression.Finally using service restoration problem after mixed integer programming tool solution power distribution network calamity.Solving result maximizes the power supply of recovery system power loss load on the basis of ensuring that important load does not power off, and can obtain the corresponding power distribution network topographic morphologies of the maximization result.The present invention can promote emergency disposal ability after power distribution network calamity, enhance power distribution network reliability of operation.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Large-scale ground surface arthropod space distribution simulation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-scale ground surface arthropod space distribution simulation method, which comprises the following steps of firstly, obtaining the ground surface arthropod number of each sampling point and multisource environment variables influencing arthropod distribution; then, establishing a large-scale ground surface arthropod spatial distribution simulation model according to the ground surface arthropod number of each sampling point and the multi-source environment variables; finally, collecting large-scale multi-source environment variables of the region to be simulated; and inputting the large-scale multi-source environment variable of the area to be simulated into the large-scale ground surface arthropod spatial distribution simulation model, and simulating the large-scale ground surface arthropod spatial distribution condition of the area to be simulated. The large-scale simulation of the space distribution of the arthropods on the ground surface is realized, a better basis can be provided for ecological restoration design and management decision and the like of a mining area by utilizing the large-scale simulation result of the space distribution of the arthropods on the ground surface of the mining area, and the method is a necessary means for evaluating the comprehensive treatment effect of the mountain water forest field, the lake and the grass in the mining area.
assignees: UNIV SHENYANG AGRICULTURAL;JIANPING SHENGDE RIXIN MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Method for quickly recovering power grid after earthquake disaster under V2G auxiliary support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly recovering a post-earthquake power grid under V2G auxiliary support, which comprises the following steps: establishing a power distribution network element fault rate model, and generating a power distribution network fault scene under the earthquake disaster through random sampling; based on the travel characteristics of the EV and the travel demand of the user, travel data are fitted by adopting a travel chain theory, and an EV scheduling model in the early stage of the disaster is built on the basis of a power distribution network fault scene; based on a consumer psychology theory, bringing an EV scheduling model in the early stage of a disaster into consideration of post-disaster response selection behaviors of EV users, formulating a post-disaster reverse transmission incentive response mechanism, guiding the EV to participate in power supply recovery, and obtaining the output of each V2G station; considering power distribution network reconstruction and V2G station reverse charging, and establishing a power distribution network reconstruction alternating current optimal power flow model considering two-dimensional cone constraints; and solving the distribution network reconstruction alternating current optimal power flow model to obtain an optimal reconstruction power supply recovery scheme. The invention improves the restoring force of the power grid after earthquake disaster and the economical efficiency of power supply restoration.

title_en: Power distribution network line fault power failure rush-repair method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power failure emergency repair method for a power distribution network line fault, which relates to the technical field of power distribution networks and comprises the following steps: establishing a rush-repair task according to tripping information of the distribution network line breaker, and compiling a distribution network rush-repair task list pool; selecting a first-aid repair team according to an optimal selection strategy of the first-aid repair team, distributing first-aid repair tasks, and establishing a distribution network fault first-aid repair schedule; the first-aid repair team performs first-aid repair according to the first-aid repair task and feeds back first-aid repair information to the allocation and adjustment center; the distribution center issues instructions according to the progress of the emergency repair task, and issues instructions for restoring power supply after the emergency repair task is completed; and carrying out fault repair task early warning according to the repair progress of the repair team and the fault repair predicted time. The invention discloses a power failure emergency repair system for a power distribution network line fault. The invention helps to ensure safe operation of the power grid and high-quality service of the power grid in the accident processing process, and solves the problems of excessive time limit of rush repair, increased demand of customer power supply capacity, reduced high-quality service capacity and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG POWER CO LTD HAMI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Primary load re-electricity optimization method and system for distribution line reverse pole under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a primary load re-electricity optimizing method and a primary load re-electricity optimizing system for a distribution line reverse pole under typhoon disasters, wherein the primary load re-electricity optimizing method comprises the steps of obtaining the cascade reverse pole fault probability of a plurality of special power supply distribution lines of a primary load user under typhoon disasters according to the single line reverse pole fault probability so as to calculate the cascade reverse pole fault load loss power of the primary load user in a typhoon influence area; and constructing a cascade reverse pole fault power restoration optimization model of the primary load user line by taking the maximized primary load user load loss recovery power supply as an optimization target, and solving by using a long-short-term memory artificial neural network and a Markov chain method to obtain the grid loss primary load power restoration optimization power when the cascade reverse pole fault occurs. According to the invention, by combining the long-term memory artificial neural network and the Markov chain method, the high-efficiency and accurate solving of the primary load re-electricity optimization problem in typhoon multi-line reverse pole disasters is realized, and necessary technical support is provided for safe and stable operation of an electric power system.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power supply recovery method and device for power distribution network, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply recovery method and device of a power distribution network, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining feeder line group data of a power distribution network to be subjected to power restoration, wherein the feeder line group data are used for representing data of a line set formed by a plurality of distribution feeder lines with a connection relationship in the power distribution network, performing fault analysis on the power distribution network based on the feeder line group data to obtain a power restoration initial solution set, constructing a power restoration cost objective function based on the power restoration initial solution set, wherein the power restoration cost objective function is used for representing a cost prediction function for performing power restoration on the power distribution network based on the power restoration initial solution set, and determining a power restoration objective solution set for performing power restoration on the power distribution network based on the power restoration cost objective function and the power restoration initial solution set. The invention solves the technical problem of lower power restoration efficiency of the power distribution network in the related technology.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD ZHAOQING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Cooperative power restoration scheduling method and device for power distribution system in typhoon disaster scene
abstract_en: The application discloses a cooperative power restoration scheduling method and a device of a power distribution system in a typhoon disaster scene, which relate to the technical field of power grid operation and are characterized in that by fusing a high-precision typhoon disaster model, the improved beluga optimization algorithm is applied to dynamic island division, so that the reconstruction time of the power distribution system can be greatly shortened, and the minute-level decision requirement for post-disaster power restoration is met. The method comprises the steps of constructing a device fault probability model in a typhoon disaster scene in advance, carrying out island division on a power distribution system according to the device fault probability model in the typhoon disaster scene to obtain islands meeting first constraint conditions in the power distribution system, constructing a fault re-electricity optimization model on the basis of the islands obtained by division in the power distribution system, and solving the fault re-electricity optimization model by utilizing an improved white whale optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal power supply path suitable for collaborative re-electricity scheduling in the typhoon disaster scene.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Fire extinguisher and fire extinguishing method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a fire extinguisher and a fire extinguishing method, which enable efficient fire extinction and rapid restoration to a state before a fire disaster.SOLUTION: A fire extinguisher 1 includes: a container 20 in which a storage space 20A formed inside is put into a vacuum state; and a suction part 10 which connects the container 20 and a burning space S arranged with a material to be burnt, which sucks in the material to be burnt and a produced material, produced in association with burning of the material to be burnt, toward the container 20, and which has one end 10A arranged toward the burning space S arranged with the material to be burnt, in case of fire.

title_en: Self-diagnosis type earth leakage breaker
title_ko: 자가 진단형 누전차단기
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an earth leakage circuit breaker with self-diagnosis determines fault and defect status of a unique function of an earth leakage circuit breaker through a self-diagnosis function to notify a user of the fault and defect status, prevents a power outage of an entire household even during an earth leakage shutoff test, allows automatic restoration even after the earth leakage shutoff test is completed, diagnoses mechanical and electrical fault status by creating the same earth leakage situation as a real situation by performing the self-diagnosis function through a simple operation of a user or an inspection worker or regular inspection through a schedule in the unique function of the earth leakage circuit breaker, sounds an alarm with naked eyes and noise to notify the user of fault status to be replaced to prevent electrical problems, reduces a heavy burden of human and physical inspection resources for the regular inspection of the Korea Electrical Safety Corporation, and prevents a power outage of an entire household during a self-diagnosis test to safely maintain electrical loads in use without interruption to prevent user complaints and accidents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명인 자가 진단형 누전차단기는 자가진단 기능을 통해 누전차단기 고유 기능의 고장, 불량 여부를 판별하여 사용자에게 알리고, 누전 차단 시험 중에서도 가구 전체의 정전을 방지하게 하며, 누전 차단시 시험이 완료된 후에도 자동으로 복원이 가능하게 하고, 누전차단기의 고유 기능에 있어서 스케줄을 통한 정기적 또는 사용자 및 점검재원이 간단한 조작을 통해 자가진단 기능을 수행하여 실제와 똑같은 누전상황을 발생시켜 기계적, 전기적 고장발생 여부를 진단하고, 소음 및 육안으로 알람을 발생시켜 고장여부를 사용자에게 알려 교체할 수 있도록 하여 전기안전사고를 예방하게 하며, 한국전기안전공사의 정기점검을 위한 인적, 물적 점검재원의 과중을 줄여주고, 자가진단 시험 시 가구 전체의 정전을 방지하여, 사용중인 전기부하를 중단 없이 안전하게 유지하여 사용자 민원 및 사고를 미연에 방지하데 그 특징이 있다.

title_en: Fast network formation after network power restoration
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a first device in a network detects a power restoration event subsequent to a power outage event. Power is restored to the first device during the power restoration event. The first device synchronizes a channel hopping schedule to the detected power restoration event. The first device communicates with a neighboring device of the first device using the channel hopping schedule synchronized to the detected power restoration event. The neighboring device uses a corresponding channel hopping schedule to communicate with the first device that is also synchronized to the power restoration event.

title_en: A kind of grid maintenance working strength graphical representation method based on GIS technology
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of grid maintenance working strength graphical representation method based on GIS technology, comprises the following steps：Obtain repair schedule data；Count the repair schedule duration；Count repair schedule working strength；Repair schedule working strength is defined the level；Obtain GIS data and structure mapping relations；Repair schedule working strength graphical representation.The present invention solves grid maintenance working strength in power system and can not intuitively shown, the defects of being unfavorable for statistical analysis, grid maintenance working strength is intuitively showed with GIS patterned ways, it is easy to comprehensive and plans as a whole reasonable arrangement, avoids occurring the wasting of resources even power outage caused by service arrangement work is inconsiderate.

title_en: Ecological stability-oriented surface water and underground water combined regulation and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological stability-oriented surface water and groundwater combined regulation and control method, which comprises the steps of establishing a bottom layer model and a top layer model, wherein the bottom layer model comprises a river basin middle stream sub-model and a river basin downstream sub-model, targets tend to maximize economic and ecological benefits respectively, and the top layer model targets tend to maximize the river basin comprehensive benefits based on a multi-target and multi-water source ecological stability-oriented double-layer water resource optimization regulation and control model of a large system decomposition coordination principle, a water balance principle and a supply and demand water prediction model. The model can coordinate the contradiction between agricultural water and ecological water by optimally adjusting the planting structure, the industrial structure and the water distribution and the groundwater level of each area, thereby realizing ecological stabilization and restoration of the desert oasis.

title_en: Slope protection structure for ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope protection structure for ecological restoration, which comprises a base, wherein the upper end surface of the base is fixedly connected with an installation table, and a protection mechanism for emergently protecting landslide generated by heavy rain is arranged at an opening of the installation table; a water filtering mechanism for collecting water from the soil with high water content is arranged on the left side of the mounting table; according to the invention, the emergency protection is carried out on the side slope after heavy rain by arranging the protection mechanism, the first suspension block and the second suspension block change along with the rising of the water level, the first suspension block controls the connecting frame to rotate around the fixed shaft through the bearing rod, the protection plate moves upwards gradually, when the water level rises to the limit position, the protection plate is in a vertical state, the second suspension block carries out limit locking on the protection plate through the limit shaft, the protection plate also carries out warning effect on people on road sides while blocking landslide, and compared with the prior art, the invention can correspondingly protect the landslide so as to prevent soil from blocking the road surface.

title_en: Dynamic scheduling method, system and readable storage medium for power disaster relief and repair
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power disaster relief and repair scheduling, in particular to a power disaster relief and repair dynamic scheduling method, a power disaster relief and repair dynamic scheduling system and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps of S1, S2, S3, S4, calculating an optimal repair strategy, wherein the dynamic network topology model G of a disaster relief scene is built, the dynamic power recovery model GP is built, the first-aid repair dynamic decision model is built through an objective function, the optimal repair strategy is calculated according to the latest dynamic network topology model G, the power recovery model GP and the current position of an electric facility node of a rescue team, and the optimal repair strategy is obtained by solving the current position of the electric facility node based on a Monte Carlo tree search algorithm. The method considers that the situation of the disaster relief site can change dynamically, and the emergency repair strategy is adjusted dynamically according to the changing situation of the site.

title_en: Multi-space-time navigating power system restoration decision support system and restoration decision method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-space-time navigating power system restoration decision support system and a restoration decision method. The system comprises a man-machine conversation layer being responsible for related display of a restorationdecision and the man-machine interactive operation, an interface adapting layer being responsible for interfacing withEMS and receiving power grid data, a data access layer used for providing underlying data support for a field service layer, and a modeling maintenance layer used for customizing and drawing various charts, wherein the interface adapting layer and the field service layer are connected with the man-machine conversation layer through network communication buses, the field service layer is connected with the data access layer, and the data access layer is connected with the modeling maintenance layer. The system and the method have the advantages that the efficiency and the success rate of power system restoration are improved, the whole-process covering on the restoration decision and the continuous online monitoring on the restoration process are realized, a dispatcher training simulation function is integrated, and the system and the method are applicable to the related power system restoration operation training.

title_en: A kind of method of intelligent allocation Power Material demand
abstract_en: A kind of method of intelligent allocation Power Material demand, step are as follows：1) based on GPS location and Location based service；2) mobile terminal, submits material requirements application to by 3G/4G networks；Service end receives mobile terminal and submits information to；3) service end calculates dispensing weighted value by comprehensive analysis such as material storage information, warehouse gps coordinate, road datas, formulates goods and materials outbound and distribution project；4) mobile terminal downloads dispensing task, and upgrade in time distribution information；The invention has the beneficial effects as follows：Improve Power Material adjustmenting management flow process, improve existing electric power first-aid personnel and other material requirements personnel complete fast power restoration work, completing engineering duty also needs to consider the present situation of materials measurement work matters, it is that material request personnel and inventory managers provide visualization and informationalized supporting method, logistics center and production division's responsibility are further divided in detail, Each performs its own functions, improves the specialized dispensing of stock in storage and produces the efficiency of fast power restoration.
assignees: LINCANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD;KUNMING ENERSUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Network multipoint fault restoration methods based on stateful datum plane
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of network multipoint fault restoration methods based on stateful datum plane, the feature of status information can be safeguarded based on stateful datum plane, failure backtracking is carried out by the way of active-standby path and data packet reflux, make upstream node obtain the fault condition of downstream node, avoid data packet from entering failure path；When there is the equal failure of active-standby path, by using the mode of controller again routing, active-standby path is avoided to cause deadlock.A kind of network multipoint fault restoration methods based on stateful datum plane proposed by the present invention, can solve the problems, such as overhead issues caused by network reliability and the frequent access controller caused by multipoint fault, network disaster recovery works well.

title_en: Power grid fault handling plan generation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid fault handling plan generation method and a power grid fault handling plan generation system, which relate to the technical field of power grid dispatching, and comprise the following steps: s1: acquiring preset fault equipment information and a power grid topological structure; s2: analyzing and obtaining a tripping switch around the fault equipment according to preset fault equipment information and a power grid topological structure, and obtaining position information of a current power-off station and a power-off bus by taking the tripping switch around the fault equipment as a fault source through a preset judgment process; s3: generating a power restoration plan of the current power loss station and the power loss bus according to a preset power restoration flow; s4: and carrying out preset analysis on the multiple complex power supply plans to obtain an optimal fault handling plan. The method solves the problems of omission and negligence caused by the fact that a dispatcher obtains a power supply path only by means of observation and experience.
assignees: NINGBO TIANLING INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hilly terrain vegetation recovery evaluation system used in power grid construction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of power grid construction vegetation restoration, and discloses a hilly terrain vegetation restoration evaluation system used in power grid construction, which comprises a basic evaluation module, a feature evaluation module, a case data module and a scheme evaluation module, wherein the basic evaluation module is used for evaluating the vegetation restoration commonality characteristics of the area of a target restoration construction site, the feature evaluation module is used for evaluating a plurality of target characteristics of the target restoration construction site, the case data module is used for generating vegetation restoration case data according to the vegetation restoration commonality characteristics and the plurality of target characteristics of the area of the target restoration construction site, the restoration evaluation module is used for evaluating the vegetation restoration state of a vegetation restoration case to obtain the vegetation restoration state characteristics, and a vegetation restoration case evaluation model is generated according to the vegetation restoration case data and the vegetation restoration state characteristics. The power transmission and transformation tower foundation vegetation recovery state of hilly terrain is effectively monitored and evaluated, and the vegetation recovery effect is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Coal mining subsidence wetland pollution control, carbon fixation and sink increase collaborative restoration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mining subsidence wetland pollution control, carbon fixation and sink increase collaborative restoration method, which comprises the following steps: construction of a coal mining subsidence wetland sewage treatment water system network and collaborative restoration of pollution control, carbon fixation and sink increase. The method of the invention promotes the research and development of the collaborative restoration technology for pollution control, carbon fixation and carbon increment of the coal mining subsidence wetland, can form engineering demonstration (construction of the coal mining subsidence wetland) in the high-water-level mining area so as to be better popularized and applied, can be popularized and applied to coal resource type cities and old industrial bases in the high-water-level area, and provides theoretical and technical references for the coal resource type cities and old industrial bases in the high-water-level area of China by utilizing the coal mining subsidence wetland to realize the 'double carbon' target.

title_en: Supply chain optimization safety system based on artificial intelligence fuzzy test
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supply chain optimization safety system based on an artificial intelligence fuzzy test, which comprises a data acquisition preprocessing module, a risk identification and evaluation module, a fuzzy test generation module, a fuzzy test execution and monitoring module, an anomaly detection and response module, a security hole restoration and optimization module, a real-time monitoring and reporting module, a user authority management and access control module, a supply chain network analysis module, a simulation and optimization module, a continuous learning and improvement module and a block chain integration module.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;INF CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Automatic detection and restoration discrimination method for side slope damage area based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope damage area automatic detection and restoration judging method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of obtaining multi-time-phase slope monitoring data and preprocessing the multi-time-phase slope monitoring data to form multi-source input data, inputting the multi-source input data into a variant DeepLab to divide a network to generate slope damage area boundary data, carrying out time sequence analysis based on the slope damage area boundary data to generate slope damage evolution data, combining the boundary data with the evolution data, extracting areas, crack widths, displacement rates and slopes to form restoration judging parameter sets, inputting the restoration judging parameter sets into an improved multi-parameter restoration judging network to output restoration grade data, introducing an uncertainty modeling module into the network to generate restoration judging confidence coefficient data, matching restoration measure libraries according to the restoration grade data and the restoration judging confidence coefficient to generate restoration measure recommendation results and outputting a judgment report. The detection and discrimination are integrated, and the method is suitable for geological disaster monitoring and treatment.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION

title_en: System and method
abstract_en: To provide a new technique which can be used for realizing early restoration of a life line such as electricity and water supply to a disaster area.SOLUTION: By a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles, objects 4 to be laid which are either electric wires, hoses, or cord-like objects are suspended at intervals. The plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles autonomously fly in tandem flight along a laying route. When the unmanned aerial vehicle 5a of 1-st flight in flight order arrives at a final destination point 22, the plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles release the suspended installation objects 4 to be laid all at once and arrange the objects 4 to be laid on the ground surface.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Geospatial information fusion systems for natural disaster research
title_ko: 자연재해 피해조사를 위한 지형공간정보 융합시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a geospatial information fusion system for natural disaster damage research. The geospatial information fusion system for natural disaster damage research includes: an aerial photograph DB (115); a land registration map DB (120); a topographic map DB (130); a search unit (135); a map image composition unit (140) programmed to compose lot number boundary lines of a disaster trace image, an aerial photograph image, and a land registration image and installed in a computer; a damage location extraction unit (145); a damage scale extraction unit (150); a field survey information acquisition unit (155); a damage calculation unit (160); and a geospatial fusion server (100).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 자연재해 피해조사를 위한 지형공간정보 융합시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 지형공간 정보를 이용하여 자연재해 피해조사를 수행하여 실시간으로 피해 위치 및 규모를 객관적이고 정량적으로 파악하여 신속한 복구 계획 수립을 위한 기초 자료 및 피해액 산정의 자료료 활용할 수 있는 자연재해 피해조사를 위한 지형공간정보 융합시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명인 자연재해 피해조사를 위한 지형공간정보 융합시스템은, 
좌표가 적용된 항공사진 이미지를 저장하는 항공사진디비(115)와, 
지적도 이미지를 저장하는 지적도디비(120)와, 
재해흔적이미지가 적용된 지형도 이미지를 저장하는 지형도디비(130)와, 
상기 디비들을 검색하도록 프로그램되어 컴퓨터에 설치되는 검색부(135)와, 
상기 검색부에 의해 디비들에서 검색한 동일 지역 이미지에서, 지형도 이미지의 재해흔적이미지와, 항공사진 이미지와, 지적도 이미지의 지번 경계선을 합성하도록 프로그램되어 컴퓨터에 설치되는 맵이미지합성부(140)와, 
재해 정보 혹은 재난 정보를 토대로 피해 위치를 추출하기 위한 피해위치추출부(145)와, 
상기 지번 경계선을 토대로 지번별 피해 규모를 추출하기 위한 피해규모추출부(150)와, 
현장조사원단말기(200)에서 제공한 현장 조사 정보를 획득하기 위한 현장조사정보획득부(155)와, 
상기 지번별 피해 규모와 현장 조사 정보를 토대로 피해액을 산정하기 위한 피해액산정부(160)를 포함하여 구성되는 지형공간융합서버(100);를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명을 통해 위성영상과 지적도를 융합한 새로운 형태의 자연재해 피해지도맵을 사용하여 지형에 대한 이해를 높이고, 피해 규모에 대한 정량적 조사를 동시에 수행할 수 있는 효과를 제공하게 된다.

assignees: UNIV HANNAM INST IND ACAD COOP

title_en: River channel ecological management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a river channel ecological management method and a river channel ecological management system, and relates to the field of river channel ecological restoration. The method comprises the steps that firstly, at least two gabion nets in the river are transversely arranged in the river at intervals along the river flow direction in the river, a backflow pond is formed at the upstream of the gabion nets in the river, and aquatic vegetation is planted in the backflow pond; step two, presetting a flood water level, a design water level and a normal water level; planting flooding-resistant herbs and/or shrubs on the riverway or the side slope between the normal water level and the designed water level; and planting trees on the riverway or the side slope between the designed water level and the flood water level. Has the advantages that: the river channel can not only ensure the proper flow of the river, but also can not cause siltation formed by flood scouring, and can meet the flood standard for ten years; by means of the measures of combining arbor irrigation with plant arrangement, original monotonous concrete gray of the revetment is covered, the diversity of ecological landscape of the river channel is realized, and the comprehensive ecological benefit is improved.

title_en: Method for ecological restoration and treatment of mountain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for ecological restoration and treatment of mountain bodies, which comprises the following steps: s1, dividing mountain bodies to be repaired into mountain bodies to be repaired, wherein rock strata are exposed on the mountain bodies to be repaired or mountain bodies covered by broken stones are exposed on the mountain bodies, and the mountain bodies to be repaired are divided into a top platform, slope slates and slag slopes according to different expression forms of heights and gentle degrees. By the method, the structure of the mountain is changed, buffering can be achieved, so that the stability of the mountain is improved, landslide, collapse and other events of the mountain are reduced, water and soil loss can be retarded, living soil environments of plants can be rebuilt on the damaged mountain, new damaged mountain vegetation communities can be quickly derived, long-term manual maintenance and management cost after the existing damaged mountain is saved, ecological environment-friendly restoration in a real sense can be realized, and the method is good in effect and high in efficiency.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle obstacle avoidance method capable of effectively tracking preset route
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle obstacle avoidance method for effectively tracking a preset route, which is used for solving the technical problems of slower track recovery speed and larger track deviation degree in the prior art, and comprises the following steps of 1) calculating track recovery point coordinates of an unmanned aerial vehicle; 2) defining an internal common tangent equation of a track recovery turning circle and a threat circle, 3) planning a track of a obstacle avoidance section of the unmanned aerial vehicle by utilizing improved artificial potential field regulations, 4) planning a track recovery section of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and 5) obtaining an obstacle avoidance result of the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the invention, the whole obstacle avoidance process of the unmanned aerial vehicle is divided into the obstacle avoidance section tracks and the track restoration section tracks for planning respectively, the unmanned aerial vehicle can fly sequentially along the two sections of tracks and finally return to the preset track, the track restoration speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle is improved, the track deviation degree is reduced, and the unmanned aerial vehicle can be used in the fields of collaborative search, communication relay, disaster rescue and the like of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic power missing data restoration method based on similar matching and cross-domain associated modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed photovoltaic power missing data restoration method based on similar matching and cross-domain associated modeling, and belongs to the technical field of new energy and power systems. According to the method, a deep-layer similarity matching strategy is utilized, deep features of a historical irradiance sequence are extracted through a self-encoder, feature reconstruction is carried out, multidimensional similarity between a period to be repaired and a historical period is calculated, a similar power candidate set is constructed, an optimal matching sample is screened out, and a similar feature matrix is formed. On the basis, a depth crossover network model is introduced to perform association modeling on cross-time domain similar features, high-order nonlinear features are extracted through feature crossover, and accuracy and robustness of power data restoration are improved. The method can effectively relieve the problem of power data missing caused by abnormal acquisition, channel congestion or equipment failure, remarkably improve the input data quality of the power prediction model and support the safe and efficient operation of the distributed photovoltaic system.

title_en: Automated tool for monitoring archaeological sites (ATMAS™)
abstract_en: An automation tool for resource managers to effectively schedule on-site visits and manage information obtained thereby. An embodiment of the present invention, the Automated Tool for Monitoring Archaeological Sites (ATMAS™), automates the process by which cultural resource (CR) managers on various installations prioritize and schedule CR sites for monitoring. Other applications for use by resource management include: environmental, safety, security, military, educational, emergency management, land use, fish and wildlife management, construction and maintenance of highways and waterways, mining, exploration, manufacturing, recreational management, urban restoration and the like. Embodiments of the present invention increase efficiency and reduce cost, while accurately and timely preserving and integrating information. Embodiments of the present invention are useful for post-processing as well as scheduling, analysis, and pro-active direction of ongoing monitoring.

title_en: Transmission line fault location and emergency repair scheduling device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a transmission line fault location and emergency repair scheduling device, includes online data acquisition end, high in the clouds server and handheld data end triplex of synthesizing, high in the clouds server including the server host computer cabinet that has network function, connect online data acquisition end and handheld data end of synthesizing, main function is the trouble and the fault location data that receive online data acquisition end and send, confirms fault location to the handheld data end of synthesizing nearest apart from the fault point sends fault information and fault location information. The utility model discloses detecting the distance between fault point and the transformer substation, through the distance between the position of fault point and the transformer substation, confirm the nearest shaft tower apart from the fault point, give the dispatch center with trouble information transfer, the dispatch center passes through GPS and trails positioning function commander vehicle and personnel of salvageing recently, reachs the scene rapidly according to best route instruction and salvages. The product is easy to install, strong in practicability and high in cost performance, and is suitable for fault location and emergency dispatching of all power transmission lines.

title_en: A kind of monthly GENERATOR MAINTENANCE SCHEDULING IN optimization method based on bi-level programming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of monthly GENERATOR MAINTENANCE SCHEDULING IN optimization method based on bi-level programming, comprise the following steps：(1) basic data is counted；(2) first layer planning is carried out, that is, considers the unit maintenance optimization of balance of electric power and ener；(3) second layer planning is carried out, that is, considers the Security Checking that power transmission and transforming equipment maintenance requires；(4) judge that Security Checking passes through situation；(5) maintenance for generation companies constraint is increased；Calculation process of the present invention is simple, and amount of calculation is small, and development difficulty is small, and computational methods are practical, and result of calculation is accurate.The method of the present invention has two aspect remarkable advantages compared with other method：1) consider the requirement of power transmission and transforming equipment repair schedule and balance of electric power and ener requirement, meet actual motion needs；2) two layer models are based on, is two subproblems by the decoupling of former problem, reduces the difficulty of model solution, it is ensured that the solution property of model.

title_en: A kind of power system restoration power calculation method and system based on black starting-up and load restoration process
abstract_en: The present invention relates to network system recovery technology fields, a kind of power system restoration power calculation method and system based on black starting-up and load restoration process is provided, method includes: to identify to network system state in which, the basic data for calculating network system is obtained, the corresponding network connection matrix M of system is established；The power plant for filtering out available black starting-up unit in system calculates the sum of weighting capacity of all available black starting-up units and corresponding per unit value in each power plant；The minimum spanning tree T1 comprising all recoverable plant stand nodes is generated, and calculates average shortest distance D1 and average shortest distance D2；Calculate the average value D of D1 and D2；The per unit value of the weighted sum of black starting-up unit capacity and the ratio of D are calculated, to provide a kind of means of quantification on the basis of fully considering black starting-up and load restoration process to assess and analyzing the power system restoration power after network system generation large-scale blackout.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Spray-seeding matrix for rush, spray-seeding method and application thereof
abstract_en: A spraying substrate of medulla Junci and its spraying method and application are disclosed, wherein the spraying substrate comprises the following raw materials (by weight portion): 25-80 parts of rush seeds, 100-200 parts of chicken manure biochar, 240-900 parts of sawdust, 50-170 parts of magnetite, 1550 parts of plant biomass and 3500 parts of tailings. The invention uses the rush seeds to prepare the spray-seeding matrix material, thus expanding the application of the spray-seeding matrix material in acid tailing waste land; the addition of the chicken manure and the magnetite ensures that the substrate has good heat capacity and can resist frost disasters; the saw dust is loosened and ventilated to create a microenvironment, magnetite, biochar and the like drive the crystalline phase transformation of the iron oxide, the soil forming process is accelerated, and the adaptability and the survival rate of plants are enhanced. The method is suitable for ecological restoration of extreme geographical positions and environments, and solves the problem of acid tailings.

title_en: Mobile emergency power supply access point optimization method considering power failure distribution network recovery sequence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile emergency power supply access point optimization method considering a power failure distribution network recovery sequence. According to the method, the optimal configuration of the access points of the mobile emergency power supply is considered in the sequential recovery process, the cooperative optimization of the black start nodes and the recovery paths in the power distribution network is realized, the local power generation resources in the power distribution network are utilized to the greatest extent, and the power failure time of important loads is reduced.

title_en: OSG-based three-dimensional geological disaster investigation and treatment scheme system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster investigation, and particularly discloses an OSG-based three-dimensional geological disaster investigation and treatment scheme system, which comprises the following steps: the system comprises a collection and analysis module, a field investigation and monitoring module, a risk assessment and treatment module and an early warning module; according to the invention, a large-scale and high-resolution geological disaster picture is obtained by utilizing an OSG technology, and geological disaster characteristic information is extracted by utilizing an image processing technology, so that geological disaster information can be accurately obtained in real time, in-situ investigation can be timely carried out, geological disaster phenomena, landform characteristics and environmental background are known, monitoring work is carried out to obtain real-time data, the risk degree of the geological disaster is evaluated, an early warning system is established, early warning information is issued, and an adaptive geological disaster prevention and control plan and design scheme including land utilization adjustment, engineering measures and ecological restoration are formulated according to the risk degree; according to the planning and design scheme, geological disaster management projects such as protection facility construction, vegetation recovery and geologic body stabilization measures are implemented.
assignees: NO 10 GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE OF JIANGXI GEOLOGICAL BUREAU;JIANGXI NONFERROUS GEOLOGICAL AND MINERAL EXPLORATION AND DEVELOPMENT INST

title_en: Method for improving root-crown ratio of newly planted forest after typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the root-crown ratio of newly planted trees after typhoon. A method for improving root-crown ratio of newly planted forest after typhoon disaster comprises the following steps: and (3) planting in a 4 (2-4) planting mode of the complementary adjacent type of three different woods in the ecological restoration area, so that the different woods are fully contacted with other woods in space, and the root-crown ratio of the planted woods is improved. The method provided by the invention adopts a ' 4 (2-4): (2-4) planting mode of fully adjacent different tree species, so that three newly planted tree species are fully contacted with other tree species in space, and the growth of individuals is changed into reciprocal symbiotic cooperative growth of communities, thereby obviously improving the development and turnover speed of underground root systems of the tree species, obviously improving the ' root cap ratio ' index of the tree species, improving the wind resistance of communities, and effectively improving the ecological restoration quality of urban forests after typhoons.

title_en: Groundwater quality maintenance capability assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a groundwater quality maintenance capability assessment method, which comprises the following steps: A. acquiring data related to the tolerance of underground water; B. acquiring data related to the groundwater restoration capacity; C. and (5) evaluating the quality maintaining capacity of the underground water. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the invention considers the tolerance capability and the recovery capability of the groundwater environment system, and evaluates the groundwater quality maintenance capability more scientifically. Compared with an evaluation method which simply depends on microorganism data, the evaluation method is more systematic, more scientific, more reasonable and more practical, and can provide powerful support for groundwater development and utilization and protection; the invention quantifies the quality maintenance capability of underground water, so that dynamic early warning becomes possible; in addition, the method has the advantages of small data volume requirement and small data acquisition difficulty, and can be applied under different complex hydrogeological conditions.
assignees: SICHUAN ACADEMY OF ENV SCIENCES;SICHUAN GANZI ECOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING CENTER STATION;UNIV CHENGDU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power supply fault recovery strategy generation method, device, equipment and medium based on artificial buzzing algorithm
abstract_en: The application relates to a power supply fault recovery strategy generation method, device, equipment and medium based on an artificial buzzing algorithm. The method comprises the steps of obtaining fault types and fault isolation areas reported by a distributed FA control system, obtaining current system parameters of the power grid system, mapping preset multi-target indexes into an adaptability evaluation function of an artificial bee bird algorithm according to the fault types, the fault isolation areas and the current system parameters, and generating a power restoration strategy for a non-fault isolation area in the power grid system by using the artificial bee bird algorithm, wherein the preset multi-target indexes comprise maximization of power restoration quantity of an island area, minimization of operation quantity of a circuit breaker and minimization of power transmission loss of the island area. By adopting the method, the power supply fault can be responded quickly, and the recovery efficiency of recovering the power supply in the non-fault isolation area in the power grid system is improved.
assignees: HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Task chain self-healing transfer prediction method and system based on parameter fingerprint holographic perception
abstract_en: The invention provides a task chain self-healing transfer prediction method and a task chain self-healing transfer prediction system based on parameter fingerprint holographic perception, which relate to the technical field of parameter transfer and comprise the steps of deploying a probe array to collect task chain parameter flow, and extracting feature tensors through a chaotic feature network to generate feature fingerprints. And storing the characteristic fingerprints into a dynamic certificate chain, and constructing a high-dimensional transfer matrix to track the performance change. And constructing a self-adaptive sensing network according to the dynamic certificate chain and the high-dimensional transfer matrix, and training an improved chaotic twin model for constructing an anomaly identification network. And generating a self-adaptive restoration strategy according to the abnormal characteristics and the historical data, and storing the self-adaptive restoration strategy into a distributed knowledge graph. And training a prediction engine based on the knowledge graph and the chaotic twin model, predicting task chain risks, and finally realizing continuous optimization through deep reinforcement learning evaluation system performance. The method and the device can effectively predict the risk of the task chain, realize self-adaptive repair and improve the stability and reliability of the task chain.

title_en: Intelligent decision method for blocking-resistant aging emergency material transportation toughness based on chaotic annealing ant colony
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent decision method for blocking-resistant aging emergency material transportation toughness based on a chaotic annealing ant colony, and relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency scheduling and optimization. The method comprises the steps of firstly extracting scene data and converting the scene data into model parameters, secondly constructing a mathematical model with optimized survivability, thirdly initializing algorithm parameters and generating an initial path, fourthly dynamically adjusting the temperature and the volatilization rate of the pheromone, fifthly generating an anti-blocking perception path and implementing bypass restoration, sixthly updating the pheromone distribution based on an annealing criterion, and seventhly locking a key path and outputting an optimal transportation scheme. The method can ensure the timely delivery of materials in the complex road network blocking and sudden demand scene, improves the timeliness and toughness of the emergency transportation system through a chaotic annealing mechanism and an anti-blocking simulation technology, can be widely applied to the fields of natural disaster rescue, public health event response and the like, and provides scientific basis for emergency decision.

title_en: Dynamic rush repair scheduling and path planning method and system for power transmission line under disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for dynamic rush-repair scheduling and path planning of a power transmission line under a disaster, and relates to the technical field of electric power emergency rush-repair, wherein the method is used for constructing a dynamic resource scheduling model under various constraint conditions by sensing the dynamic change of the topology of the power transmission line under the disaster in real time and fusing the geographical position priority of important users and the distribution information of rush-repair resources; and generating a rush-repair path based on a fastest path algorithm, establishing a restorability evaluation system containing the dimensions of resource matching degree, topology connectivity and the like, and triggering the rush-repair action when the evaluation value reaches 80% or more. The invention solves the problems of delayed response of the traditional rush-repair scheduling, departure of path planning from a disaster real-time scene and mismatching of resource allocation and recovery requirements, realizes the accuracy, the dynamism and the high efficiency of the rush-repair of the power transmission line under the disaster condition, and remarkably improves the recovery efficiency of the power grid after the disaster.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Vegetation damage identification and ecological assessment method for power transmission and transformation construction area
abstract_en: The application relates to a vegetation damage identification and ecological assessment method for a power transmission and transformation construction area, which comprises the following steps of data preparation and pretreatment, vegetation damage area identification, result optimization and verification, ecological system service value loss assessment, ecological restoration suggestion generation, restoration priority partition is carried out by fusing space distribution information of vegetation damage degree and ecological system service value loss, differential ecological restoration measures are provided for different partitions, and a partition ecological restoration planning chart and an assessment report are output.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST

title_en: Integrated management system of ecological water for multiple water resources and method using the same
title_ko: 다중 용수원을 활용한 생태용수 통합관리시스템 및 이를 이용한 관리방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An ecology water integrated management system utilizing plural water sources and management method using the same are provided to offer additional services by utilizing a monitoring result. CONSTITUTION: A water treatment apparatus(80) supplies water by receiving the water from plural water sources(10, 20, 30, 40, 50). A monitoring apparatus(11, 21, 31, 41, 51) measures information about the quality and quantity of water in restoration target water or the water sources. A calculation control apparatus(61) analyzes the quantity and quality of water received from the water sources through a measured value. The calculation control apparatus controls the calculation control apparatus according to a simulation result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실개천, 하천, 연못 또는 호수 등의 수체를 생태적 친환경적으로 복원하거나 복원된 수체를 관리하기 위해서 필요한 생태용수를 확보하는데 있어서, 생태용수를 적정하게 확보하는 과정의 의사결정을 지원하고, 수량 및 수질의 통합적인 관리방법을 제공하는 네트워크화된 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 생태적 친환경적으로 복원하고자 하는 실개천, 하천, 연못 또는 호수 등 대상 수체의 현황을 조사하고, 생태용수로 활용이 가능한 여러 용수원의 수량 및 수질에 대한 현황을 모니터링하고, 생태적 친환경적으로 복원하고자 하는 하천이나 호수에서 복원대상으로 하는 생물종을 하나 또는 복수로 선정하고, 생물종의 생애주기에 따라 변화하는 해당 생물종에 적합한 하천의 수리적, 수질적 관리기준을 결정하고, 복원된 수체에서 사전에 설정된 하나 또는 복수의 모니터링 지점의 수리적, 수질적 상태가 대상 생물종에 적합한지 여부를 검토하고 평가하는 방법을 제공함으로써, 복원의 대상이 되는 수체에 필요한 생태용수를 적정하게 확보하는 과정의 의사결정을 지원하고, 수량 및 수질의 통합적인 관리가 가능한 네트워크화된 장치 및 방법을 제공할 수 있는 이점이 있다.

title_en: System for multi-phase management of a natural disaster incident
abstract_en: A computerized system for multi-phase management of a natural disaster incident is disclosed. In one embodiment of the invention, the computerized system incorporates a pre-incident risk reduction management module, a crisis response management module, and a restoration and rehabilitation management module to correspond to these three distinct phases of managing a natural disaster incident. This multi-phase natural disaster management system can be utilized by private entities, community groups, state, national, and/or international agencies to assist prevention or reduction of damage to human and natural resources in a particular disaster incident. Furthermore, the multi-phase natural disaster management system can assist or enable protection of lives, health, and safety of community members and disaster incident response personnel. A prioritization model in the pre-incident risk management module can take an empirical or subjective weighting factor in evaluating a particular geographic section to optimize disaster prevention and management.

title_en: Geological environment treatment method suitable for steep wall and deep pit type abandoned mine
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological environment treatment method suitable for a steep wall and deep pit type abandoned mine. The method comprises the steps of geological environment exploration, slope clearing treatment, mine pit backfilling, reinforced soil slope filling, retaining wall arrangement, rainwater drainage, slope crest water resistance, vegetation recovery, water storage preservation, deformation monitoring and the like. The specific environment conditions and the topographic features are effectively combined, artificial treatment is conducted on mine terrains formed by mining according to local conditions, and the good effect of recovering the geological environment of the abandoned mine is achieved. An artificial soil slope attaching steep wall which is filled with dump slag and local loess removes the potential geological hazards of collapse, slide and the like existing in steep wall and deep pit landforms, solves the problem that the land is occupied by mining wastes, and also facilitates vegetational cover and land restoration; mountains which recover green are fused together with surrounding natural mountains, the mountains recovering green and the surrounding natural mountains are synchronized in the four seasons, plants grow naturally, natural mountain appearance is recovered, and a contribution is made for national geological disaster control and ecological environment restoration.

title_en: Seismic mitigation and isolation system applied to seismic resistance of long-span continuous beam of single-track railway
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a seismic mitigation and isolation system applied to seismic resistance of a long-span continuous beam of a single-track railway. The long-span continuous beam is supported by piers which are distributed at intervals. A double-curved-surface spherical seismic mitigation and isolation support seat is arranged on the top of each pier, and a viscous damper is vertically mounted on the top of each pier. Limiting devices used for transversely limiting are arranged on two sides of each double-curved-surface spherical seismic mitigation and isolation support seat. The seismic mitigation and isolation system has the advantages that the double-curved-surface spherical seismic mitigation and isolation support seats and the viscous dampers are connected in parallel to form the seismic mitigation and isolation system, and the seismic mitigation and isolation system has a function of bidirectional seismic mitigation and isolation in the horizontal direction, can effectively improve the seismic resistance of the long-span continuous beam in the longitudinal direction of a bridge, enables the bidirectional seismic mitigation and isolation function in the horizontal direction of the double-curved-surface spherical seismic mitigation and isolation support seats to be fully played, can effectively control displacement of bridge beam components when a seismic hazard happens, has certain self-restoration capacity, and brings convenience to post-disaster repair, is reasonable, compact, clear in stress, stable in performance, and convenient to maintain in the future.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY SHANGHAI DESIGN INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method for restoring building construction with bottom frame posts damaged by vibration
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for restoring a building construction with bottom frame posts damaged by vibration. The method comprises the following steps of: firstly, determining a bottom layer or a lower collapse layer of the building construction as a vibration isolation layer according to the vibration damage condition of the building construction, then arranging a lifting jack (10) between a frame girder (12) of the vibration isolation layer and a foundation, jacking up a basically intact structure (6) at the upper part horizontally, afterwards cutting off each frame post (7) of the vibration isolation layer a section the length of which is greater than the height of a vibration-isolation supporting seat (1), increasing horizontal and vertical reinforcing steel bars, enhancing restoration, installing the vibration-isolation supporting seat (1) at a truncation position, reinforcing a girder post joint (5) of the vibration isolation layer, disassembling the lifting jack (10), varnishing the inside and the outside and then putting into use.
