The method can be used for the reinforcement and the restoration of the building construction with the frame posts damaged by vibration at the bottom layer after a disaster and the basically intact structure at the upper part and has the advantages of convenient construction, definite mechanism, economy and high applicability.

title_en: Ecological recovery system for field planting of slope protection plants
abstract_en: The invention discloses a revetment plant field planting ecological restoration system. Comprises a fixing component and a planting bucket component. The fixing component comprises a slope protection panel and a fixing ground pile, so that the plant planting system is fixed; slope protection panel contains two bulges and agrees with the structure and two sunken agreeing with the structure on the fixed subassembly, satisfies a plurality of plants field planting systems and makes up. Planting bucket subassembly and fixed subassembly closely combine, plant the bucket and bury the bank protection below fixed subassembly bank protection panel, plant bucket bank protection earth's surface below and combine with the slope body, plant the deep root system plant in the planting bucket, realize the fixed and soil and water conservation effect to slope body soil. The invention not only has the greening function, but also can improve the stability of the side slope, stabilize the structure of the side slope and prevent the danger of side slope landslide. The invention realizes ecological protection on the slope body, has wide size range, convenient installation and operation, compact structure and practical function, and is suitable for wide popularization and application on large-area slopes.

title_en: Restoration method for restoring geological disaster area ecology of mining area by utilizing coal gangue
abstract_en: The invention relates to a restoration method for restoring the ecology of a geological disaster area of a mining area by utilizing coal gangue, which adopts a geological restoration paving device of the mining area, wherein the geological restoration paving device of the mining area comprises a mounting plate, an electric slide block, a paving frame, a positioning spring, a supporting frame and a guide mechanism; the method for restoring the ecology in the geological disaster area of the mining area by adopting the geological restoration paving device of the mining area comprises the following steps: s1, crushing coal gangue; s2, processing a mine road foundation; s3, locking the mounting plate; s4, uniformly scattering coal gangue; s5, coal gangue rolling. The invention can solve the problems existing in the prior art when the coal gangue is paved: the unable comprehensive uninstallation of gangue is on the road bed, and the later stage is comparatively loaded down with trivial details, adopts the excavator to carry out the efficiency of shakeout to the gangue lower to the shakeout processing of gangue, and the shakeout roughness of gangue is relatively poor to cause the unsmooth scheduling problem in later stage gangue road surface.

title_en: Drainage pipe network GIS abnormal data detection and repair method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for detecting and repairing drainage pipe network GIS abnormal data, which comprises the steps of preprocessing drainage pipe network GIS data; then writing query and repair rules in ArcGIS 'topology' toolbox and SQL Server database software to process topology abnormity; constructing an attribute item semi-automatic classification method based on a Jaccard similarity coefficient matrix to classify and repair the drain pipe network text attribute items; an upstream and downstream pipe diameter filling method based on rules is provided for abnormal pipe diameter detection and repair; and the detection and restoration of the elevation of the abnormal pipe section at the multi-way node and the elevation of the abnormal inspection well are realized on the basis of a least square method. Based on the method, the MATLAB language is adopted to develop corresponding programs, man-machine interactive drainage pipe network abnormal data detection and repair are achieved, the method for solving various main data abnormal problems of the drainage pipe network with certain universality can effectively help to improve the data quality of the drainage pipe network.

title_en: Slope ecological restoration method
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope ecological restoration method, which specifically comprises the following steps: (1) leveling the top end of the side slope after cleaning the side slope; (2) building a drainage groove at the upper end of the side slope, and building a gentle belt between the drainage groove and the side slope; (3) paving meshes on the side slope, and carrying out compound organic matter spray seeding; (4) digging planting holes on the side slope, and planting climbing plants in an embedded mode. The slope ecological restoration method is a slope ecological restoration method for planting customized climbing plants in an embedded mode after compound organic matters are sprayed and sown, and has the advantages of preventing landslide and water and soil loss and guaranteeing evergreen slope bodies in winter.
assignees: QINGDAO ZHONGYUANYE ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent research and judgment and power restoration method and system based on low-voltage power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent studying, judging and re-electrifying method and system based on a low-voltage distribution network, which relate to the technical field of intelligent power grid and power system automation and comprise the steps of collecting monitoring data, carrying out fusion check based on geographic and power management information, dynamically generating a topology file, and constructing a hierarchical visual power grid model; analyzing the state of the breaker and the protection equipment, calculating the main backup protection deviation, analyzing the electric quantity change by combining wavelet transformation and singular value decomposition, identifying a fault section, constructing a whole network sensing system, monitoring three-phase unbalance and zero sequence current in real time, and carrying out quick power restoration and active research and judgment by combining a dichotomy and an intelligent switch optimized power restoration strategy. The intelligent studying, judging and recharging method based on the low-voltage distribution network improves the reliability and the safety of the distribution network by constructing an environment monitoring system, improves the accuracy of fault analysis of a low-voltage transformer area by topology accurate checking and intelligent fusion, improves the fault recovery efficiency by a dichotomy fault isolation and intelligent recharging strategy, and achieves better effects in the aspects of safety, accuracy and efficiency.

title_en: Three-stage combined treatment method for urban water consumption prediction
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent water affairs, in particular to a three-level combined processing method for urban water consumption prediction, which comprises the following steps of S1, data restoration, S2, characteristic decoupling, S3, prediction fusion, wherein an abnormal value in a urban water consumption time sequence is corrected by using a dynamic threshold correction method based on multi-scale wavelet decomposition. The method in the technical scheme adopts a dynamic threshold correction method based on multi-scale wavelet decomposition, realizes signal layering analysis through discrete wavelet transformation, combines MAD robust statistics to construct a dynamic threshold mechanism, effectively identifies and corrects abnormal points, constructs a dynamic frequency band division joint model of variable-division modal decomposition and spectrum energy balance, proposes a dynamic frequency band recombination strategy guided by amplitude sequencing, carries out energy balance division and inverse transformation reconstruction on VMD high-frequency subcomponents through fast Fourier transform spectrum analysis, realizes fine separation of high-frequency mutation characteristics and periodic fluctuation and multi-frequency band phase synchronization, and finally constructs a long-period memory network to predict and reconstruct all subcomponents.

title_en: Power distribution network source-network-storage multi-resource collaborative optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrical engineering, and discloses a power distribution network source-network-storage multi-resource collaborative optimization method and a system, wherein the method and the system are used for segmenting estimated fault restoration time, acquiring SOP control modes and the number of uncharged islands in each time period, constructing a controllable power supply-new energy coordinated micro-network partition model taking total power of restoration load as an optimization target and taking various resource constraints as conditions according to the SOP control modes and the number of uncharged islands, and solving to obtain SOP open and closed states in each time period as a fault restoration scheme. The method fully considers various flexible resources such as distributed new energy, controllable power supply, energy storage and the like in the future power distribution network, and realizes the optimization coordination of the resources in fault recovery through sectional processing and model construction. The method effectively solves the problem that the existing fault recovery means cannot fully consider various resources, can more reasonably integrate various flexible power generation resources, effectively improves the recovery effect of the power distribution network after faults, and reduces the influence caused by power failure.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method, equipment, medium and product for stable and proper coordination of river basin mountain water Lin Tianhu and grass sand
abstract_en: The application discloses a stable and proper coordination method, equipment, medium and product for river basin mountain water Lin Tianhu grass sand, which relates to the field of ecological hydrologic protection and treatment and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of carrying out gridding treatment on a research area, dividing a river basin into a plurality of research units, solving a model according to river basin basic data corresponding to each research unit, aiming at ecological optimum and hydrologic function balance optimum, aiming at grain and livestock yield maximization, aiming at water resource allocation efficiency optimum, aiming at environmental restoration cost minimization, aiming at social change minimization and aiming at environmental risk minimization, constructing a multi-objective optimization model facing the river basin of an inland river, and solving the model through a mixed algorithm combining a genetic algorithm and a particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain a river basin mountain Lin Tianhu grass sand stable proper coordination result. The application can realize the integral optimization and dynamic coordination of multiple elements on the drainage basin scale, and meet the long-term stability and suitability requirements of the complex drainage basin ecological system.

title_en: Rapid power recovery method, system, equipment and storage medium for multi-type clean energy distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid power restoration method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for a multi-type clean energy power distribution network, which are used for solving the technical problems that the existing power distribution network power restoration system is dependent on physical topology switching during dynamic network reconfiguration, the dynamic reconfiguration is dependent on physical switching action, the response speed is limited, in addition, fault recovery and oscillation suppression strategies are separated, and the rapidity and the stability are difficult to consider. The method comprises the steps of determining a complex electricity area according to fault data of a power distribution network, generating a logic power supply path diagram according to virtual nodes of the power distribution network and a power grid topological graph, obtaining weight of each power supply path in the logic power supply path diagram, determining an optimal power supply path based on the weight and the complex electricity area, obtaining response speeds of all clean energy sources, dividing the clean energy sources into a fast response cluster and a slow response cluster according to the response speeds, calculating real-time inertia of the fast response cluster and real-time damping coefficients of the slow response cluster, and supplying the clean energy sources to the complex electricity area according to the optimal power supply path, the real-time inertia and the real-time damping coefficients.
assignees: ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network self-recovery method based on distributed resources
abstract_en: The invention provides a distribution network self-recovery method based on distributed resources, which is used for constructing a black start process recovery characteristic model aiming at different types of power supplies, constructing a distributed resource start sequence optimization model aiming at maximizing available power generation amount and active load recovery amount, constructing a comprehensive path evaluation index based on node importance and path recovery time to optimize a recovery path of a unit to be started, and repeatedly solving the start sequence optimization model, the recovery path optimization model and the load recovery optimization model according to time steps to obtain a final distribution network recovery scheme, so that power outage loads are input in time-sharing steps to minimize power outage loss, and meanwhile, the recovery resources are effectively allocated in consideration of the load recovery sequence, so that the rapidity and the stability of a distribution system recovery process are improved.

title_en: Method for optimizing sand area and occupancy rate of Lin Tiancao sand area in semiarid sand area
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization method of a sand area and a proportion of the sand area in a semiarid sand area Lin Tiancao, which comprises the steps of establishing relations among deep leakage amount of soil moisture, rainfall and vegetation coverage under different land utilization types, constructing an estimation model of deep leakage total amount of the soil moisture in the sand area to be optimized, estimating the deep leakage total amount of the soil moisture in the sand area to be optimized every year according to the land area and the deep leakage amount of the soil moisture in Lin Tiancao sand, constructing a linear model of the deep leakage total amount of the soil moisture in the sand area to be optimized, and inverting the optimization area and the proportion of Lin Tiancao sand in the sand area to be optimized by using a machine learning regression model under the constraint condition of ensuring the water resource safety of the sand area to be optimized. The method solves the problems that the prior northern semiarid sand area treatment does not comprehensively consider the relationship between regional water resource utilization and ecological restoration of main land utilization types such as forests, grasses, sand, fields and the like, and the stability of sand-fixing vegetation and the safety of regional water resources can not be ensured.

title_en: Power distribution network fault rush-repair scheduling system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault rush-repair scheduling system and method, which relate to the technical field of rush-repair scheduling and comprise the following steps of collecting power distribution network operation data, constructing a device health degree evaluation index set, and outputting a device fault probability distribution map through a fault probability prediction model; the method comprises the steps of establishing a device space topology database based on a geographic information system, positioning fault points through a Dijkstra algorithm and generating three-dimensional geographic coordinate labels, establishing a multi-dimensional rush repair resource portrait library, recording the skill level of a rush repair team, the stock state of materials and the real-time position information of a vehicle, establishing a dynamic priority evaluation model, generating a rush repair task priority sequence according to the emergency degree of the fault, influencing the user level and the criticality of the device, solving a rush repair resource scheduling scheme through a multi-objective gray-wolf optimization algorithm, setting an objective function in the direction of minimizing response time, path cost and resource wave rate, issuing an optimal scheduling instruction through a cooperative scheduling platform, and continuously monitoring the task execution state.

title_en: Emergency recovery system of burned site using gis
title_ko: Ｇｉｓ를 이용한 산화지의 응급복구시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An emergency restoration system of a burned place using a GIS(Geographic Information System) is provided to predict a secondary damage place and a damage degree after a forest fire. CONSTITUTION: A burned place analysis module(210) predicts second damage information of an area, of which the location information is analyzed, by analyzing the location information of a burned place which is inputted from a first user terminal and a second user terminal. An emergency restoration place calculation module(230) calculates place information which is preferentially restored among the location information of two or more inputted burned places. An emergency restoration method management module(220) provides a restoration method based on the corresponding emergency restoration information. A disaster information output module(240) provides the predicted second damage information and the provided emergency restoration information to the first user terminal and the second user terminal. [Reference numerals] (200) Emergency restoration server of a burned place; (210) Burned place analysis module; (220) Emergency restoration method management module; (230) Emergency restoration place calculation module; (240) Disaster information output module;
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 산불재해지역에 대한 관련정보를 데이터베이스화하여 산불이 발생한 지역에 대한 정보를 미리 파악하고, 우수유출, 토사유출 및 재 유출 등 2차 재해를 예측하여 효율적으로 산화지를 응급복구함으로써, 산불로 인한 2차 재해를 미연에 방지할 수 있는 GIS를 이용한 산화지의 응급복구시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 GIS(Geographic Information System)를 이용한 산화지의 응급복구시스템은, 적어도 하나 이상의 지형정보, 공법정보 및 강수량 정보로 이루어지는 복구 정보를 저장하는 응급복구 정보 DB; 산화지의 위치 정보 및 상기 응급복구 정보 DB에 포함된 해당 위치 정보에 대응하는 복구 정보로부터 응급복구 정보를 산출하는 산화지 응급복구 서버; 및 상기 응급복구 서버에 연결되어, 산화지의 위치 정보 입력 및 입력된 위치 정보에 해당하는 응급복구 정보를 제공하는 사용자 단말;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Connecting structure of curtain wall for earthquake resistant
title_ko: 커튼월의 내진 연결구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an earthquake proof connecting structure of a curtain wall installed at a connection portion between a vertical part and a horizontal part of the curtain wall, comprising: a fixing unit fixedly coupled to a side surface of one side of the vertical part; a first rotating unit supported at one end of the fixing unit to be able to rotate; a second rotating unit supported at the other end of the fixing unit to be able to rotate; a first rotating support unit supporting the first rotating unit to be able to rotate the first rotating unit; and a second rotating support unit supporting the second rotating unit to be able to rotate the second rotating unit. Therefore, the present invention is provided with the fixing unit, the rotating units and the rotating support units at the connection portion between the vertical part and the horizontal part, thereby simplifying an earthquake proof connecting work of the curtain wall, simultaneously enhancing earthquake proof performance and restoration performance, and enhancing the watertight and airtight properties.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 커튼월의 수직부와 수평부 사이의 연결부위에 설치되는 커튼월의 내진 연결구조에 관한 것으로서, 수직부의 일방 측면에 고정 결합되는 고정부와, 이 고정부의 일단에 회전가능하게 지지되는 제1 회전부와, 고정부의 타단에 회전가능하게 지지되는 제2 회전부와, 제1 회전부를 회전가능하게 지지하는 제1 회전지지부와, 제2 회전부를 회전가능하게 지지하는 제2 회전지지부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 따라서 본 발명은 수직부와 수평부 사이의 연결부위에 고정부와 회전부와 회전지지부를 구비함으로써, 커튼월의 내진 연결작업을 단순화하는 동시에 내진성능 및 복원성능을 향상시키고 수밀성 및 기밀성을 향상시킬 수 있는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Loose soil revolves soil preparation machine
abstract_en: A kind of loose soil revolves soil preparation machine, belongs to agricultural machinery technological field.Comprise the drive transmission that deep soil loosing shovel, soil crushing device, broken stubble roller, ridging shovel, pack roller and frame that frame sets gradually backward by direct of travel end are arranged, each hack axle of described soil crushing device connects a little gearbox respectively, described each little gearbox connects drive transmission respectively, and described broken stubble roller one end connects drive transmission by side gearbox.Application the present invention is constant at maintenance original soil Rotating fields, realize hack operation, and soil pore space, effectively adjustment three Phase Proportion can be increased, heat cold-proof, slow down water and soil loss and wind erosion, strengthen soil restoration ability, reduce casualty loss, improve soil property, cultivate soil fertility, raising agricultural prevents and reduces natural disasters ability, promote Agricul tural Sustain able Development, ensure agricultural produce.
assignees: LIAONING AGRICULTURAL MECHANIZATION RES INST;INST AGRI RESOURCES CAAS

title_en: Mine restoration side slope protective structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mine restoration slope protection structure which comprises a slope body, an upper collecting tank and a lower collecting tank, wherein first filter screens are fixedly arranged at the inner ends of the upper collecting tank and the lower collecting tank respectively, planting soil layers are fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the slope body and are arranged between the upper collecting tank and the lower collecting tank, side partition plates are arranged at the front end and the rear end of each planting soil layer respectively, the two side partition plates are fixedly connected to the outer wall of the slope body, a plurality of planting pots are fixedly arranged on the upper end face of each planting soil layer, and the planting pots are arranged between the two side partition plates. The method has the advantage of high watering efficiency, improves the restoration and greening of the side slope by improving the stability of the surface layer of the planting layer, and realizes a good supporting effect, thereby effectively avoiding landslide and ensuring the safety of the mountain side slope structure.
assignees: KELINWEIER SUZHOU ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method of servicing and system are reported in a kind of equipment fault for repairment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of equipment faults to report method of servicing and system for repairment, including：It establishes equipment fault and reports service public network platform for repairment；The device type selected on public network platform according to user and input or the user information transferred generate maintenance service request, push to the mobile phone of maintenance personal；After one of maintenance personal receives the maintenance service request, the information of order maintenance personal is sent to the mobile phone of user；After fault restoration, order maintenance personal sends repair receipt to third-party platform by mobile phone；Third-party platform sends fault restoration to user mobile phone and confirms short message, and after receiving user and replying, return information is sent to the public network platform and is recorded.Method of servicing is reported in equipment fault using the present invention for repairment, and the process of maintenance service can be made more transparent, and the communication between user and maintenance personal is more efficient, improves maintenance efficiency, without configuring backstage contact staff, saves manpower and materials.
assignees: SHEN YUE;QINGDAO YINGKAILI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: The appraisal procedure of recovery capability after a kind of electric system calamity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of appraisal procedures of recovery capability after electric system calamity：1) clear electric system damage situations, acquisition system recovery scheme；2) repair process of analog line carries out Temporal Sampling using sequential Monte Carlo simulation to faulty line operating status；3) analysis system state carries out the system minimum tangential load based on direct current optimal power flow and calculates；4) it calculates land restoration index, draw recovery curve.Equipment after being destroyed by disaster to electric system using the method for the invention carries out rapid evaluation with load restoration ability, the evaluation process has taken into account the transportational process of disaster relief personnel and disaster relief supplies, and relevant evaluation index can be utilized, the economy of system is restored after analysis calamity response speed, recovery efficiency and recovery, and the desired effect of more different recovery policies can be used for providing reference proposition for the formulation of recovery policy after electric system calamity and calamity mitigation and relief.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power grid dispatching and maintenance application form processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid dispatching and maintenance request form processing method and system, and belongs to the technical field of maintenance and power failure dispatching. The method comprises the steps that maintenance request forms needing to be packaged are selected according to associated equipment of reported applications, and maintenance application packages are obtained; automatically screening out the main application according to the main equipment and the power failure and restoration time for the maintenance application sheet in the maintenance application packet, and marking the rest as auxiliary applications; the screened maintenance application packages are subjected to circulation and replication, a cover sheet is generated according to the replication result, and the cover sheet is added into the maintenance application packages; and scheduling and executing according to the obtained maintenance application packet. The invention can reduce the workload of personnel in each link of dispatching, can improve the refinement level of power grid dispatching and ensures the safe and stable operation of the power station.

title_en: Precipitation management and control system suitable for ecological environment restoration of mine is administered
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precipitation control system suitable for restoration and treatment of mine ecological environment, which comprises a plurality of precipitation control units arranged step by step from high to low according to mountain ranges, wherein adjacent precipitation control units are connected through a drainage facility to realize step by step water storage, each precipitation control unit comprises a slag water storage body, the slag water storage bodies are positioned between a hill face and a water control diversion dam, the water control diversion dam enables residual water after the slag water storage bodies are saturated to flow to a next precipitation control unit and a mine platform on the other side through the drainage facility, planting ridge platforms arranged transversely are arranged on the ground surface of each slag water storage body at intervals, the table surfaces of the planting ridge platforms are of inward inclined structures, enclosing ridges are arranged at the edges of the mine platforms, and grid-shaped slag reduction ridges are arranged in the inner side areas of the enclosing ridges, and grass and wood vegetation is planted between the slag reduction ridges. The invention can reduce water and soil loss and natural disasters of debris flow, improve the utilization rate of natural rainfall and is suitable for the technical field of mine ecological environment restoration.
assignees: HEBEI GEOLOGICAL MINING CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network power supply safety capability evaluation standard quantification method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for quantifying evaluation criteria of distribution network power supply safety capacity, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out local topology on a feeder line group of a distribution network, and respectively carrying out grid analysis on each feeder line of the feeder line group; calculating a reference risk value corresponding to each feeder line according to the number of medium-voltage users, the number of low-voltage users and the load value which are caused by the feeder lines in the N-1 condition through a corresponding power restoration means and have the greatest influence, and the fault occurrence probability of the line section of the weakest link of each feeder line; determining the grid frame reference risk level corresponding to each feeder line according to the preset corresponding relation between different reference risk value ranges and different grid frame reference risk levels; evaluating the power supply safety capability of the distribution network according to the network frame reference risk level of the feeder group; according to the invention, by establishing the distribution network power supply safety standard which is matched with the super-huge urban distribution network, a user can conveniently and intuitively know the power supply safety capability of the feeder line.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Data disaster tolerance recovery method and device
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of data storage, and provides a data disaster recovery method and a data disaster recovery device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the fault type and the range of data to be recovered in the distributed cluster system; acquiring state parameters of a plurality of normal nodes in a distributed cluster system, service sensitivity characteristics of data to be recovered and data block access characteristics; carrying out data preprocessing operation; respectively adopting a service sensitivity evaluation model and a node state evaluation model to determine a data recovery priority list and a node priority list; determining a fault handling strategy according to the data recovery priority list and the node priority list; and executing a fault processing strategy. According to the method, on the basis of dynamically updating the data recovery priority based on the service sensitivity evaluation model, the real-time evaluation algorithm of the heterogeneous big data node is added, and compared with the prior art, the method and the system can improve the data disaster recovery efficiency while reducing the fault perception of a service system.
assignees: XIAN TIANHE DEFENSE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent repair method and system for power grid data based on graph attention network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent repair method for power grid data based on a graph attention network, and relates to the technical field of power grids. Constructing a heterogeneous graph power grid model based on a graph neural network, and learning association weights between nodes and edges by utilizing the heterogeneous graph attention network; enhancing interaction and updating of node information by using a space-time attention mechanism to capture space and time associations between nodes; designing a dual learning-based framework to perform topology-state joint repair so as to complement power grid topology connection and predict the time sequence state of the missing node; and performing reinforcement learning by adopting a PPO algorithm to automatically search the optimal model structure and super-parameter configuration, and performing data restoration by using the optimized graph annotation force network model. The invention constructs a highly-automatic and self-adaptive heterogeneous depth map learning solution, and remarkably enhances the prediction capability and regulation level of stable operation of the power grid.

title_en: Emergency power restoration method, power restoration device and emergency power restoration system for power distribution network
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency re-electricity method, a re-electricity device and an emergency re-electricity system of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: quickly positioning the fault section to obtain fault positioning information and identifying whether the complex electric path is multipath; under the condition that the complex electric path has multiple paths, analyzing and acquiring complex electric information of a fault section according to the fault positioning information; calculating normalized recoverable charges, normalized predicted recovery time and normalized rush repair cost according to the recovery information; constructing an objective function based on the normalized recoverable charge, the normalized predicted recovery time and the normalized rush repair cost, and iterating the objective function by adopting a particle swarm algorithm until reaching an iteration termination condition to obtain an optimal scheme; and generating a scheduling instruction according to the optimal scheme, wherein the scheduling instruction is used for guiding a rush-repair personnel to carry out the rush-repair of the fault section. The method solves the problem of low scheduling efficiency of power distribution network duplicate under large-area power failure in the prior art.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network fault training evaluation method based on artificial intelligent model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network fault training, and discloses a power distribution network fault training evaluation method based on an artificial intelligent model, which comprises the steps of establishing a power restoration speed actual information array, a power restoration speed standard information array, a resource allocation actual information array, a resource allocation standard information array, a preventive measure actual information array, a preventive measure standard information array, a decision quality actual information array, a decision quality standard information array, a risk assessment actual information array and a risk assessment standard information array, and a comprehensive evaluation index of the power restoration speed, a comprehensive evaluation index of the resource allocation, a comprehensive evaluation index of the preventive measure, a comprehensive evaluation index of the decision quality and a comprehensive evaluation index of the risk evaluation are established, the comprehensive evaluation index is calculated to obtain a comprehensive score, a plurality of key aspects of a dispatcher in fault processing are comprehensively considered, the learning degree and the operation effect of the dispatcher are evaluated, and the stability and the power supply reliability of the whole power grid system are improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Environment diagnosis method and device based on numerical simulation and SVM efficient modeling
abstract_en: The invention relates to an environment diagnosis method and device based on numerical simulation and SVM high-efficiency modeling, belonging to the technical field of soil-groundwater pollution prevention and control and risk management and control, wherein the environment diagnosis method comprises the following steps: the method selects related characteristic variables related to the state of the groundwater environment and the space-time evolution, establishes an environment diagnosis model based on numerical simulation and SVM high-efficiency modeling aiming at a complex groundwater environment system under a typical condition frame, can simply realize reliable diagnosis and prognosis of soil and groundwater environment states, evolution processes and related influences of different application scenes on the premise of meeting a given condition frame, improves the accuracy, the high efficiency and the practicability of evaluation and prognosis of the environment evolution and the risk level of the complex groundwater system, protects the water and soil environment system and utilizes the resources safely, and particularly can provide powerful support for precise prevention and control restoration and high-efficiency risk management and control of soil and groundwater pollution, thereby having important practical value.
assignees: UNIV CAS;ZHONGKE YUNHUI BEIJING INTELLIGENT PIPE CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Element importance evaluation method and device suitable for fault repair, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an element importance assessment method, device, terminal equipment and storage medium suitable for fault restoration, which are used for obtaining the importance assessment result of a power element based on the power supply coefficient, performance parameters and ideal solution set, and further obtaining the fault restoration priority of the power element, wherein the direct power supply capability of the power element to the load element is considered, the influence of the load element with high importance value on the power supply reliability of the power element is considered. The invention considers the actual power supply effect of the power supply element in the power grid and the power supply reliability of the important load element, so that the power supply element with the largest power supply reliability of the important load element has higher corresponding fault repairing priority, ensures that the important load element related to the power supply element with high importance can continuously obtain the preferential power supply when the power grid has fault or load fluctuation, and ensures the integral power supply capacity and reliability of the power grid.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Two-stage elastic recovery method, system, equipment and storage medium for power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage elastic recovery method, a system, equipment and a storage medium of a power distribution system, which comprise the following steps of S1, calculating the minimum repair time of a fault through a route and schedule model of a maintainer based on post-disaster data, S2, setting the recovery duration based on the minimum repair time, minimizing the load shedding in the recovery duration based on an optimal power distribution system recovery model, and outputting to obtain an optimal recovery strategy. A balance is struck between recovery duration and load shedding, an appropriate fault recovery duration is determined, and partitioning and fusion of the microgrid are considered, in comparison with existing dynamic network reconstructed recovery models. Finally, when a disaster occurs, the provided model can comprehensively consider the shortest restoration time and the tolerance of a decision maker, comprehensively consider the fusion between island micro-grids and the self-splitting of the micro-grids, and restore as much load as possible within one restoration duration time, thereby greatly improving the restoration capacity of the power distribution system.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Dynamic treatment method, system and storage medium for agricultural non-point source pollution
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic treatment method for agricultural non-point source pollution. The method comprises the steps of setting an intelligent monitoring network in an agricultural watershed, and monitoring key data in real time through a sensor. The method comprises the steps of utilizing a wireless communication module to transmit data to a central control center for storage and pretreatment, utilizing big data analysis and an artificial intelligent algorithm to deeply analyze the pretreated data, accurately identifying pollution sources and predicting diffusion trend, generating a personalized treatment scheme comprising fertilization and medication guidance, sewage treatment process selection, runoff management measures and the like, dynamically adjusting the treatment scheme according to agricultural production period and climate change, integrating biological restoration, ecological engineering, efficient chemical fertilizer and pesticide preparations and other technical means, constructing a collaborative treatment technical system, realizing accurate and efficient dynamic treatment of agricultural non-point source pollution, improving the quality of agricultural production and promoting sustainable development of agricultural ecology.
assignees: JIANGXI RUIJIE ECOLOGICAL ENV CO LTD

title_en: Power image processing method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power image processing method, a device, equipment and a medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an original power image, carrying out sensitive target identification on the original power image to obtain a target area set, determining a target mask map based on the target area set and the original power image, and carrying out image desensitization restoration based on the target mask map to obtain a target power image. According to the technical scheme, sensitive information in the electric power image can be accurately identified, and the image with a natural structure and consistent semantics is generated, so that the visual consistency and usability of the target electric power image are ensured.
assignees: BIG DATA CENTER STATE GRID CORP

title_en: Multi-degradation flame image recovery method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-degradation flame image recovery method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting a smoke sample and a flame real image of a cable fire in real time by simulating the situation of a high-voltage cable fire of an underground pipe gallery in reality, constructing an atmospheric scattering model, combining the smoke sample characteristics of the cable fire, generating smoke degradation images under various working conditions based on the flame real image, constructing and training a smoke image enhancement model based on an improved DCGAN framework, wherein the smoke image enhancement model comprises a generator and a discriminator, the generator is used for reconstructing the smoke degradation image to generate a flame restoration image, and the discriminator is used for carrying out true and false judgment on the flame restoration image and the real flame image, so that the difference between the flame restoration image and the flame real image is ensured to be continuously optimized by the generator. The invention effectively removes the dense smoke interference, restores the occluded image details and provides clear and reliable visual information for the subsequent fire disaster identification.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;FUZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intercom system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To notify a control unit of abnormality of a commercial power supply by detecting it in an early stage, before the operation of an intercom master unit surely stops due to blackout of the commercial power supply.SOLUTION: Abnormality of a commercial power supply is detected with an early power supply abnormality detection circuit 12 at a timing earlier than the detection timing with a blackout detection circuit 11 which detects blackout of commercial power supplies 2, 2, ... for supplying power to intercom master units 1a, 1b, ..., which is notified to a control unit CPU40 of a control unit 4 from a master unit CPU14. The control unit CPU can confirm such power conduction state as the abnormality of commercial power supply restores so that the voltage level of a DC power source, detected with the blackout detection circuit, restores to a threshold level or higher after restoration to the power conduction state, as well as such blackout state of commercial power supply as the voltage level of the DC power source detected with the blackout detection circuit is less than the threshold level as before.

title_en: Restoration decision-making assistance apparatus and restoration decision-making assistance method
abstract_en: Provided are a restoration decision-making assistance apparatus and a restoration decision-making assistance method with which it is possible to perform restoration from power outage in a power distribution system for as many customers as possible at the earliest possible time, by planning individual operation during the restoration from power outage and by drafting a restoration work plan by taking the individual operation plan into consideration. This restoration decision-making assistance apparatus is for re-connecting power system sections, which have been cut off due to an accident of a power system, to the power system. The restoration decision-making assistance apparatus is characterized by comprising: an individual operation planning unit that, with respect to the cut-off power system sections, defines switch sections demarcated by adjacent switches, and that drafts an individual operation plan by setting a switch section in which at least a distributed power supply is provided or a power supply vehicle is disposed, as an individual operation section; the individual operation planning unit that drafts an individual operation plan by setting, in the power system, a switch section in which an accident has occurred or a damaged facility is present, as an individual operation section; and a restoration work planning unit for drafting a restoration work plan with respect to the individual operation section in which an accident has occurred or a damaged facility is present, in the individual operation plans created by the individual operation planning unit.

title_en: System, Device and Method For Providing Power Outage and Restoration Notification
abstract_en: A system, computer program product and method to provide information related to a power distribution system based on information provided by a plurality of network elements electrically connected to a plurality of power lines of the power distribution system at a plurality of locations is provided. In one embodiment, the method comprises receiving a notification from a group of network elements that have detected a voltage signature indicating an imminent power outage, determining location information of the power outage, outputting the location information of the power outage, receiving a live notification from a first network element of the group of network elements indicating a first power restoration at a location of the first network element, determining location information of the first power restoration, and outputting the location information of the first power restoration.
assignees: DEAVER SR BRIAN J;YANEY DAVID S

title_en: Methods and Systems for Post-Disaster Resilient Restoration of Power Distribution System
abstract_en: Systems and methods for configuring micro-grids to restore some power in a power distribution grid (PDG) in response to a power disruption over the PDG. A computing system configured to receive current condition information from devices in the PDG. Form a minimum spanning forest (MSF) to identify a set of micro-grids, each spanning tree in a forest is a self-sustained islanded micro-grid network. Assign a ranking to each inter-bus link within each micro-grid according to constraints, to identify some inter-bus links above a high-ranking threshold to be switched off during a restoration period. Identify switches that restore power to some critical loads of a subset of critical loads with different forest configurations, based on buses that are switched on, to determine a subset of micro-grids less susceptible for link failures during the restoration period. Upon receiving a power disruption, activate the switches to restore some power to the PDG.

title_en: A kind of network reconfiguration dual blank-holder based on pitch point importance Evaluations matrix
abstract_en: A kind of network reconfiguration dual blank-holder based on pitch point importance Evaluations matrix, is related to supply network reconstructing method.At present, weighted network pitch point importance evaluation result is excessively unilateral.The present invention comprises the following steps：Input the initial parameter of particle cluster algorithm；For each particle, call bi-level optimal model, wherein solve upper strata Optimized model to obtain the Startup time of unit and calculate the available generating capacity of system, solve underlying model and obtain the restoration path of generator node, so as to obtain the target function value of each particle；The fitness of each particle is calculated according to target function value；The position of more new particle and speed, obtain new particle；Repeat step, until reaching population reproductive order of generation M c ；Optimal particle is selected, the solution of its corresponding upper strata Optimized model is the optimal unit starting moment, and the solution of underlying model is restoration path.Evaluation of the technical program to pitch point importance is more comprehensive, effectively avoids the situation of unit delayed recovery from occurring.

title_en: Restoration method for restoring geological disaster area ecology of mining area by utilizing coal gangue
abstract_en: The invention relates to a restoration method for restoring the ecology of a geological disaster area of a mining area by utilizing coal gangue, which adopts a geological restoration paving device of the mining area, wherein the geological restoration paving device of the mining area comprises a mounting plate, an electric slide block, a paving frame, a positioning spring, a supporting frame and a guide mechanism; the method for restoring the ecology in the geological disaster area of the mining area by adopting the geological restoration paving device of the mining area comprises the following steps: s1, crushing coal gangue; s2, processing a mine road foundation; s3, locking the mounting plate; s4, uniformly scattering coal gangue; s5, coal gangue rolling. The invention can solve the problems existing in the prior art when the coal gangue is paved: the unable comprehensive uninstallation of gangue is on the road bed, and the later stage is comparatively loaded down with trivial details, adopts the excavator to carry out the efficiency of shakeout to the gangue lower to the shakeout processing of gangue, and the shakeout roughness of gangue is relatively poor to cause the unsmooth scheduling problem in later stage gangue road surface.

title_en: Method for inhibiting thermal stratification of reservoir by exciting water flow oscillation through reservoir day adjustment and scheduling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of improvement and restoration of lake and reservoir water, and discloses a method for inhibiting reservoir thermal stratification by exciting water flow oscillation by reservoir daily regulation and scheduling, wherein gravity waves are formed by reservoir main flow caused by the daily regulation and scheduling process of a reservoir, and high-frequency water flow oscillation phenomenon is induced in a tributary bay; the water flow oscillation process causes the water level of the warehouse bay to have high-frequency fluctuation characteristics, intermittently increases or reduces the water flow rate of the warehouse bay, and causes the water to intermittently mix through the periodic high-frequency oscillation process to cause the high-frequency fluctuation of the water temperature, thereby realizing the function of inhibiting water temperature stratification. According to the invention, by adjusting the drainage flow of the water power station, the fluctuation of the water level in front of the dam is generated, the gravity wave of the main flow is induced, and then the high-frequency water flow oscillation phenomenon of the tributary warehouse bay is induced. The invention can effectively improve the density stratification characteristics of deep water lakes and reservoirs, and has the advantages of simple operation, easy realization, obvious effect and the like compared with the existing common engineering measures such as layered water taking, water pumping and aeration.

title_en: Data acquisition and analysis method of electric power concentrator based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power data analysis, and particularly relates to a data acquisition and analysis method of a power concentrator based on the Internet of things, which is characterized in that operation information of each power device in a power grid is acquired by utilizing the power concentrator, so that fault devices are identified, the power supply lines where the fault devices are located are positioned, the abnormal operation detection and the fluctuation operation detection of the corresponding power supply lines are carried out, further, the fault cause prediction is carried out according to the detection result, the effective and comprehensive prediction of the fault cause is realized, the misjudgment rate of the fault cause is greatly reduced, the prediction accuracy is facilitated to be improved, meanwhile, the fault influence degree and the operation load of the fault lines are combined and considered when the fault emergency repair scheduling is carried out according to the fault detection result of the power grid, the importance of the operation load in the fault emergency repair scheduling is highlighted, the emergency repair priority of the fault lines can be more accurately and reasonably determined, and the scientific optimization allocation of emergency repair resources is realized.

title_en: Method for quickly recovering degraded wetland by utilizing micro-relief assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly recovering degraded wetland by utilizing micro-landform assembly, belonging to the technical field of wetland ecological engineering. The method aims to solve the limiting problem of poor heterogeneity of degraded wetland habitat and low sustainability after wetland recovery. The method comprises the steps of site selection and habitat quality assessment of a restored wetland, form optimization of the restored wetland base and construction of a flood water network, collection and micro-landform assembly of a grass dune pier body, sectional hydrologic regulation and dynamic management, and assessment and medium control of restoration effects. The method provided by the invention has clear principle and strong operability, can strengthen the habitat heterogeneity through micro-landform assembly so as to promote the diversity improvement of plants, and has the design thought fitting the near-natural recovery concept, and no engineering implementation hidden danger and secondary ecological risk exist. The method provided by the invention is applied to develop the near-natural recovery of the degraded wetland. The method is used for the near-natural recovery of the degraded wetland with the loss of the habitat heterogeneity.

title_en: System and method for establishing disaster recovery plan based on digital twin using disaster resilience index evaluation
title_ko: 재난회복력 지표 평가를 이용한 디지털 트윈 기반 재해 복구 계획 수립 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 디지털 트윈 기반 재해 복구 계획 수립 시스템은 재난 피해 지역의 위치 정보와 피해 현황을 포함하는 피해 정보를 입력받아 상기 피해 지역의 3차원 디지털 트윈 모델을 생성하는 디지털 트윈 생성부; 상기 디지털 트윈 모델로부터 피해 시설물의 물리적 제약 조건을 추출하고, 복구 공법 데이터베이스를 조회하여 적용 가능한 복수의 복구 공법을 자동으로 추출하며, 각 복구 공법을 적용한 복수의 복구 시나리오를 자동으로 생성하는 시나리오 생성부; 상기 복수의 복구 시나리오 각각에 대하여, 재난 저항성, 복구 속도, 탄력성 및 유지보수 용이성을 포함하는 재난회복력 지표와, 안정성, 경제성, 시공성을 포함하는 일반 평가 지표를 이용하여 정량적 평가를 수행하는 시나리오 평가부; 및 상기 평가 결과에 기초하여 최적의 복구 시나리오를 추천하는 추천부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Dynamically selecting optimal instance type for disaster recovery in the cloud
abstract_en: One example includes performing a VM restore instance type discovery process, creating a test VM with a VM restore instance type matching a VM restore instance type identified during discovery, using the test VM to create a test restore VM at a cloud storage site, restoring the test VM at the cloud storage site using the test restore VM, generating a 4-D baseline vector based on the restoration of the test VM, the 4-D baseline vector identifying a particular VM restore instance type, generating a 5-D vector based on the 4-D baseline vector, ranking the 5-D vector relative to other 5-D vectors, the 5-D vectors identifying the same production site VM, and restoring, at the cloud storage site, the production site VM identified in the 5-D vectors, the production site VM restored at the cloud storage site has a VM restore instance type identified in the highest ranked 5-D vector.

title_en: Method for restoring database and equipment
abstract_en: The invention aims at providing a method for restoring a database and equipment. A mirror image is made for a physical magnetic disk where a Sybase database of a client side is located, so that a mirror image roll of the Sybase database is obtained; the mirror image roll of the Sybase database is snapshot, and a snapshoot picture of the mirror image roll and the snapshooting time point are obtained; backup of the Sybase database is achieved; when the Sybase database suffers from disaster recovery, the Sybase database is restored based on the snapshot picture of the mirror image roll and the snapshooting time point. Backup of the Sybase database is guaranteed, and it is guaranteed that when data is lost, the Sybase database can be fast restored to any restoration time point target.

title_en: Promote resource distribution and the network reconfiguration optimization method of elastic distribution network restoration power
abstract_en: A kind of resource distribution for promoting elastic distribution network restoration power of the present invention and network reconfiguration optimization method, input distribution net work structure parameter, load, the initial data of photovoltaic dispatching cycle；Input upper layer optimized variable: distributed generation resource on-position and capacity, interconnection connecting node position, population scale, the initialization of maximum number of iterations particle group parameters；Input lower layer's optimized variable: interconnection switch switching state, extreme disaster scene, population scale, the number of iterations parameter initialization；According to upper layer flexible resource Optimal Allocation Model, carries out flexible resource and distribute rationally, obtain economic optimum, restoring force is maximum to distribute result rationally；It is distributed rationally according to upper layer as a result, executing lower layer's network reconstruction and optimization model using PSO algorithm, optimization lower layer's network reconfiguration interconnection switch switching state obtains the maximum reconstruction result of restoring force.The present invention realizes the restoring force after promoting the extreme disaster accident of elastic power distribution network, and distribution network planning, operating management department is instructed to carry out the planning of science.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV TIANJIN;TIANJIN XIANGHE ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Water burst disaster treatment system and method suitable for crack development side slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for treating water burst disaster of a crack development side slope, wherein the system comprises the following components: the crack development slope, the drainage groove, and the liquid guide hole, the liquid seepage hole and the drainage hole which are arranged in the slope; a curing layer, a matrix layer and a vegetable layer are laid on the slope surface of the fracture development slope and used for slope surface reinforcement, water plugging and ecological restoration; the liquid guide holes are positioned at the water seepage position at the upper part of the crack development side slope and are arranged in parallel with the slope surface, liquid guide pipes are arranged in the liquid guide holes, and small liquid guide holes are distributed on the surface of each liquid guide pipe; the liquid seepage holes are arranged along the direction vertical to the slope surface, a liquid seepage pipe is arranged in the liquid seepage holes, and liquid seepage small holes are distributed on the surface of the liquid seepage pipe; the drainage grooves are arranged along the slope toe at the water seepage position of the crack development slope, the side surface is provided with drainage holes which obliquely extend upwards to the inner part of the slope surface, drainage pipes are arranged in the drainage holes, and small drainage holes are distributed on the surfaces of the drainage pipes; and (4) pouring microorganism curing liquid into the liquid guide pipe to cure the slope toe and the shallow layer of the slope. The invention has the characteristics of low cost, strong applicability and environmental protection.

title_en: Fault risk assessment method and device for power transmission line and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault risk assessment method and device for a power transmission line and electronic equipment. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring external fault influence factors of the power transmission line, wherein the external fault influence factors are influence factors causing unplanned outage of the power transmission line; determining a preset fault rate and a preset restoration rate corresponding to each external force fault influence factor; calculating the probability of the power transmission line in each operation state based on the preset fault rate and the preset repair rate, wherein the operation state comprises a normal operation state and at least one of the following states: transient fault state caused by each external fault influencing factor and permanent fault state caused by each external fault influencing factor. The invention solves the technical problems of low fault risk evaluation accuracy and high loss risk in the fault risk evaluation method of the power transmission line in the prior art.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Data acquisition and analysis method of electric power concentrator based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power data analysis, and particularly relates to a data acquisition and analysis method of a power concentrator based on the Internet of things, which is characterized in that operation information of each power device in a power grid is acquired by utilizing the power concentrator, so that fault devices are identified, the power supply lines where the fault devices are located are positioned, the abnormal operation detection and the fluctuation operation detection of the corresponding power supply lines are carried out, further, the fault cause prediction is carried out according to the detection result, the effective and comprehensive prediction of the fault cause is realized, the misjudgment rate of the fault cause is greatly reduced, the prediction accuracy is facilitated to be improved, meanwhile, the fault influence degree and the operation load of the fault lines are combined and considered when the fault emergency repair scheduling is carried out according to the fault detection result of the power grid, the importance of the operation load in the fault emergency repair scheduling is highlighted, the emergency repair priority of the fault lines can be more accurately and reasonably determined, and the scientific optimization allocation of emergency repair resources is realized.

title_en: Green value coordinated electric power market operation simulation deduction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power market operation simulation deduction system with a cooperative green value, which relates to the technical field of green energy, and comprises a characteristic record extraction module, a deviation range calculation module, a data correction module and an early warning prompt module, wherein the characteristic record extraction module is used for obtaining a historical carbon emission record of an electric power enterprise, extracting the characteristic record from the carbon emission record according to the carbon content and the generated energy in the carbon emission record, the deviation range calculation module is used for analyzing the carbon content and the generated energy change in the characteristic record to obtain a deviation range, the data correction module is used for obtaining the current carbon emission record and obtaining data with abnormal carbon content and correcting the data, and the early warning prompt module is used for judging whether to early warn a data correction technology according to the corrected virtual carbon content. According to the invention, by summarizing the historical carbon emission rules, the current carbon content correction data is analyzed, and whether the current data correction technology needs to be prompted is judged, so that the accuracy and the rationality of current data restoration are improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network rush-repair scheduling method and system based on fault prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network rush-repair scheduling method and system based on fault prediction, which solve the problem of low rush-repair scheduling efficiency in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of collecting a power distribution network basic data time sequence in a historical period in a scheduling area, preprocessing to obtain multivariable time sequence data, dividing the scheduling area into a plurality of grids, predicting the number of user power failures at the current moment based on the historical multivariable time sequence data and the corresponding number of user power failures in each grid, constructing a dispatching center address selection optimization model with the minimum dispatching center repair efficiency and the comprehensive influence of power failure loss as targets based on the multivariable time sequence data and the predicted number of user power failures at the current moment, solving to obtain an optimal dispatching center address selection position, constructing a repair team scheduling multi-target model with the minimum repair path distance and repair time as targets based on the optimal dispatching center address selection position and the acquired current fault point list and repair team parameters, and solving to obtain an optimal repair scheduling route of the power distribution network. Realizing scientific rush repair scheduling.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Water environment ecological protection allocation evaluation method and system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water environment ecological protection allocation evaluation method and system based on data analysis, which relates to the technical field of water environment ecological protection, the method firstly analyzes the data in the history protection allocation record, analyzes the stress coefficients of each social parameter to ecological restoration in different social activity types, analyzes the protection coefficients of each water ecological restoration measure set to ecological restoration in each social activity type, constructing a mutual feedback relationship thermodynamic diagram, then simulating and optimizing an optimal water ecological restoration measure set of each social activity type, realizing a closed loop system of social activity identification, strategy targeting design, ecological effect evaluation and dynamic optimization, realizing targeted and comprehensive strategy protection of the water environment, and guaranteeing the ecological protection effect.

title_en: Reasonable space allocation method for belt-type shrub protection forest in semiarid grassland area
abstract_en: The invention provides a reasonable space allocation method of a belt type shrub protection forest in a semiarid grassland area, which mainly comprises the following steps of (1) firstly determining potential maximum density of shrub forest belts, (2) determining key ecological hydrologic function parameters of shrub forest belts with different row distances, (3) comprehensively evaluating the ecological hydrologic function parameters of sand-fixing shrub forest belts with different row distances by adopting a hierarchical analysis-entropy weight method, and finally determining the optimal row distance and plant distance of the shrub forest belts by combining the potential maximum density of the shrub forest belts in the step (1) and the key ecological hydrologic function parameters of the shrub forest belts with different row distances in the step (2). The invention has reasonable conception, not only can promote the growth stability of the protective forest, but also can synchronously enhance the wind-proof effect and other ecological functions of the protective forest, and can provide theoretical basis for the efficient utilization of water resources and ecological restoration in arid grassland areas.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF ECOLOGY PROT AND REPAIR CHINESE ACADEMY OF FORESTRY

title_en: Radio disaster prevention system and sensor node
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To appropriately perform event corresponding processing by preventing the information lack when state change of a fire and restoration occurs between telegram transmission and telegram pause based on an occurring event and the state change returns by the next telegram transmission timing.  <P>SOLUTION: In occurrence of an event A, a transmission processing part of a radio sensor repeats, twice or more, telegram transmission A1-A6 for continuously transmitting the same telegram signal for a predetermined time T1 and telegram pause for pausing the telegram transmission for a predetermined time T2. When a fire reporting event B and fire restoration event C occur before start of the next telegram transmission in a state where the telegram transmission A1 and A2 and the telegram pause are repeated based on the occurrence of the preceding event A by the transmission processing part, a transmission switching part repeats, at least twice, telegram transmission B1 and B2 based on the fire reporting event B, and then switches them to transmission where telegram transmission C1 and C2 and the telegram pause based on the fire restoration event B are repeated at least twice.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Biological manipulation-based ecological system restoration simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological system research, and discloses an ecological system restoration simulation method based on biological manipulation, which comprises the following steps: a) Inputting input parameters of different functional groups and the mutual nutrition relation into a Ecopath model to serve as initial data before repair; b) Performing biological manipulation simulation by using Ecosim model; c) And (3) acquiring a food network structure before and after repair, analyzing the energy transmission quantity between each nutrition stage according to the food network structure, acquiring the transmission efficiency between each nutrition stage, and comparing and analyzing the transmission efficiency before and after repair. The structure and function change of the ecological system are researched, the repairing effect is evaluated from the angle of the ecological system, and a theoretical basis can be provided for scientific management of biological repairing.

title_en: Multi-objective optimization method for post-earthquake community building group restoration scheduling and toughness evaluation
abstract_en: A multi-objective optimization method for restoration scheduling and toughness evaluation of post-earthquake community building groups comprises the steps of S1 collecting basic information of building groups and life network of communities to be restored and dividing working blocks, S2 determining function loss and restoration time of each single building in the community building groups, function loss and restoration time of buildings in each working block and resource loss ratio of life network in the blocks under corresponding earthquake scenes to obtain inter-building function interdependence matrixes, S3 establishing a restoration objective function and constraint, establishing a multi-objective optimization model for restoration scheduling and toughness evaluation of the community building groups taking the interdependence of building functions into consideration under resources, and S6 solving the optimization model to give a restoration track pareto front of an optimal restoration process of the community building working blocks. The invention can obviously improve the recovery efficiency of the community building after disaster, and a decision maker can make a final decision from limited optimal scheduling according to other preferences and experiences, thereby providing a basis for disaster prevention and reduction and design planning of the city management mechanism.

title_en: Power distribution network collaborative power restoration method and system based on disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster-based collaborative power restoration method and system for a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time supply and demand condition data and network topology constraint information, analyzing and extracting key load node sets and power flow distribution boundary conditions to construct a resource distribution model, and obtaining an optimal distribution strategy by combining power flow analysis and a multi-objective optimization method; and determining temporary power supply network configuration and a capacity allocation scheme by combining temporary equipment access parameters, and further planning a deployment path of the temporary power supply configuration so as to deploy the temporary power supply network to perform cooperative power restoration on the power distribution network. The method can rapidly evaluate the supply and demand conditions in the post-disaster environment, optimize resource allocation, ensure key load power supply, improve the recovery efficiency and stability of the power distribution network, and provide an effective solution for rapid recovery of a post-disaster power system.

title_en: Formation methods of Functional forest
title_ko: 다양한 기능을 가지는 기능숲 조성방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for implementing a functional forest capable of providing various functions to cope with climate change or to implement eco-friendly functions. On-site investigation and restoration models are set up to realize the forest having various functions, and damaged lands are restored to a simple ecological forest by optimizing correcting and restoring methods accordingly. Further, the forest can be implemented as a functional forest having a function of coping with climate change, preventing air pollution, preventing forest disaster, or having a function of eco-friendly health promotion forest.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기후변화에 대응하거나 친환경적인 기능을 구현하는 다양한 기능을 제공할 수 있는 기능성 숲을 구현하는 방법에 대한 것으로, 다양한 기능을 구현하는 기능숲을 구현하기 위한 현장조사 및 복원모델을 설정하고, 이에 맞는 수정과 복원방법을 최적화하여 단순한 생태숲으로 훼손지를 복원하는 데에서 더 나아가 기후변화, 대기오염방지, 산림재해방지나 친환경적인 건강증진숲의 기능을 가지는 기능숲으로 구현할 수 있도록 한다.
assignees: ILSONG GEOTECH CO LTD;ILLIM CO LTD

title_en: System and method for power outage and restoration notification in an advanced metering infrastructure network
abstract_en: A method and system are provided to transmit a meter power status. The method includes recognizing a power status change at a meter. The method includes, if the meter is scheduled to transmit first, transmitting a notification message to at least one neighboring meter towards a mesh gate, wherein the notification message includes a power status indicator and a meter identifier. The method includes, if the meter is not scheduled to transmit first, waiting a predetermined time period to receive a notification message from at least one neighboring meter. The method includes, responsive to receiving a notification message, adding a meter identifier to the received notification message before retransmitting the modified notification message to at least one neighboring meter. The method includes retransmitting the notification message.

title_en: Ecological permeable dam for improving water environment capacity of river channel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a river course water environment among the environmental protection engineering water treatment handles technical field, especially relates to an ecological permeable dam for promoting river course water environment capacity, including building by laying bricks or stones the relative gabion on the riverbed, concrete foundation has been pour between the gabion, set up the ecological interception dam body that permeates water of seepage type on the concrete foundation.
