Based on the constructed wetland principle and the rapid infiltration mechanism, the capacity of a ditch in front of a dam is utilized to store river water, the controllable seepage of a permeable dam is intercepted through seepage type ecology to adjust the overflow of the dam, and meanwhile, the upstream water level is raised to provide enough water for upstream ecological restoration content; the biological filler-enriched runoff storage dam can block runoff and has a certain purification effect, and the runoff has certain retention time in the dam body, so that the water quality purification effect can be further improved through microorganisms enriched by the biological filler, and the river flood discharge is not influenced.
assignees: SHANDONG LYUZHIXING ENV ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Mining spoil heap rainfall infiltration experimental apparatus and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mining spoil heap rainfall infiltration experimental apparatus and a method, and belongs to the field of environment geotechnical engineering. The mining spoil heap rainfall infiltration experimental apparatus comprises a control platform, an observing device, a rainfall device, a natural wind stimulator, and a stimulator. The mining spoil heap rainfall infiltration experimental apparatus is capable of stimulating, with consideration of influences of different wind speeds and wind directions, erosion effects, which are caused by different rainfall conditions on mining spoil heaps with different slop angles and different inner structure characteristics, and leaching characteristics which are caused by infiltrated rain in the inner parts of mining spoil heaps. It is beneficial for analysis of environmental geology disasters caused by mining spoil heaps under rainfall conditions. The mining spoil heap rainfall infiltration experimental apparatus is also capable of realizing verification and demonstration on implementation effects of mining spoil heap ecological restoration technology by changing materials in stimulated mining spoil heaps. In addition, in verification processes, parameter setting, data monitoring, recording and processing can all be completed via centralized control processing of the control platform, so that experimental effect is ensured, and experimental efficiency is improve greatly.
assignees: UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL;INST OF ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: Method, device and system for evaluating operation sequence of recoverable equipment after fault
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a system for evaluating operation sequence of recoverable equipment after a fault, which comprises the steps of obtaining an expected power grid model, wherein the expected power grid model is established on the basis that all cut-off equipment in a power grid to be recovered after the fault is completely cut off in a power grid model before the fault; calculating the power grid risk probability corresponding to each recoverable device in the expected power grid model; sequencing all the calculated power grid risk probabilities to obtain a recovery sequence of each recoverable device; and calculating the real-time evaluation score of the operation condition of the dispatcher based on the recovery sequence of each recoverable device and the sequence of the devices actually operated by the dispatcher in all the recoverable devices, and finishing the evaluation of the operation sequence of the recoverable devices. The method firstly analyzes and calculates the optimal recovery sequence of the power grid recoverable equipment after the fault, and then evaluates the actual operation result of the dispatcher based on the calculated optimal recovery sequence, thereby realizing effective evaluation of the power grid operation rationality after the fault of the dispatcher.
assignees: BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;NARI GROUP CORP;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Layered backfill compacting method for dolomite tailing pit
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mine restoration, and discloses a layered backfilling and compacting method for a dolomite tailing pit, which solves the problems that the overall structure stability of a field is not high, the field is easy to sink and collapse, geological disasters are easy to occur and the like after the existing pit is backfilled and compacted. The invention comprises the following steps: (1) selecting graded stones with the grain size of less than or equal to 50cm for backfilling; (2) spreading upward from the bottom of the backfill pit in a layered manner; (3) and (5) rolling each layer by using a vibration roller at 15-30t after paving. According to the layered backfilling compaction method for the dolomite tailing pit, the backfilling compaction degree is guaranteed by optimizing the components of the graded stone and adopting a layered paving mode, the overall structural stability of the field can be improved in large-area backfilling compaction of the pit, a backfilling area cannot sink and collapse, and geological disasters are avoided.
assignees: CHENGDU SURVEYING GEOTECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE CO LTD OF MCC

title_en: Soil heavy metal pollution early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil heavy metal pollution early warning system, which adopts a neural network to analyze pollution factors and degree, backs up data through a cloud storage module, encrypts and manages the data through an intelligent contract and a block chain, can verify the integrity of the data, accurately locate data abnormity, encrypt information and effectively control the data safety problem caused by data destruction behaviors by virtue of a traceability chain while ensuring the integrity of monitored data, not only meets the data processing amount and processing speed in a big data era, facilitates the sharing and calling of polluted data, but also solves the problems of privacy disclosure, unsafe transmission and the like. The modules of the invention have definite, clear and complete description and close connection, and play a good early warning role on the heavy metal pollution of the soil, thereby guiding the pollution control and restoration and being beneficial to the engineering of the soil heavy metal pollution restoration technology.

title_en: Virtual power plant intraday data rolling prediction and restoration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rolling prediction and restoration method for data in a virtual power plant day, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: collecting historical data in the future and preprocessing the historical data in the future; the pretreatment comprises the following steps: filling missing values; processing a noise value; and (5) initialization treatment. Step two: inputting the preprocessed historical data into a data prediction model to obtain next-day prediction data; the prediction model adopts a GRU model added with a dropout layer; step three: and checking the next-day prediction data and updating the coverage. The checking comprises establishing a threshold value according to a residual value of the next-day prediction data and the day-ahead historical data and checking the next-day prediction data by using the threshold value. And step three, recognizing the abnormal prediction data and updating and covering the abnormal prediction data. The method for rolling prediction and restoration of the data in the day of the virtual power plant can obviously improve the accuracy of the predicted data in the next day and is beneficial to the virtual power plant to make a more accurate and reasonable scheduling plan.

title_en: Power equipment displacement detection restoration device and method based on visual recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for detecting and recovering displacement of power equipment based on visual identification, which relate to the field of fault identification and have the technical scheme that: the image monitoring device is used for judging whether the displacement change of each measuring point of the power equipment exceeds a set displacement limit value; the displacement sensor is used for sending out an overrun signal when each measuring point of the power equipment exceeds a set displacement limit value; and the reset leveling device is used for adjusting the position of the power equipment according to the position information when the overrun signal is received so as to enable the power equipment to be restored to a horizontal state. The invention solves the problem that the prior art can not realize the real-time adjustment of the abnormal response of the power equipment in the normal use process or after earthquake.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Ecological restoration partition spraying device and spraying method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster restoration, and particularly relates to an ecological restoration partition spraying device based on an unmanned aerial vehicle and a spraying method thereof, wherein the ecological restoration partition spraying device based on the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, supporting legs are arranged at the bottom ends of two sides of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, and the unmanned aerial vehicle body comprises a scanning mechanism, a spraying mechanism and a spray head mechanism; the spraying device provided by the invention can identify geological features, acquire ecological geological environment, partition according to the topographic features, select different treatment ways and load different slurries, and can perform partition ecological restoration aiming at different geological disaster types, thereby greatly improving the treatment efficiency and treatment effect of disaster restoration.

title_en: Method and device for determining restoration strategy of power distribution network, storage medium and processor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a restoration strategy determining method, a restoration strategy determining device, a storage medium and a processor of a power distribution network. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring performance indexes and initial constraint conditions of the power distribution network, wherein the performance indexes are used for indicating stability and/or reliability of the power distribution network, and the initial constraint conditions are used for indicating constraint conditions of the power distribution network in the operation process; based on the performance index and the initial constraint condition, respectively determining a target recovery function and a target constraint condition of the power distribution network, wherein the target recovery function is used for indicating a triggering condition to be achieved for recovering the power distribution network, and the target constraint condition is used for indicating a constraint condition of the power distribution network in a recovery process; and determining a recovery strategy of the power distribution network based on the target recovery function and the target constraint condition, wherein the recovery strategy is used for representing a rule for recovering the power distribution network. The method and the device solve the technical problem of low efficiency of determining the recovery strategy of the power distribution network.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Deep sea mining ecological restoration comprehensive partitioning method based on efficient attachment base
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of deep sea mining ecological restoration, in particular to a deep sea mining ecological restoration comprehensive partitioning method based on an efficient attachment base, which comprises the following steps of S1, dividing a deep sea mining area, and primarily dividing a restoration area according to geographic information, substrate type, water flow mode and ecological characteristics of the mining area; S2, carrying out demand analysis on each divided repair area, including ecological diversity recovery demand, water quality improvement demand and biological population recovery demand, and evaluating resource demand of each primarily divided repair area, and S3, carrying out optimization on the divided repair areas by combining the result of the demand analysis of the repair areas, so that the repair resources reach optimal configuration. The invention improves the utilization efficiency of resources, ensures the effect of deep sea ecological restoration and optimizes the sustainability of an ecological system.

title_en: Construction method of karst landform oversized-section tunnel chamber inner pilot tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a pilot tunnel in a karst landform ultra-large section tunnel chamber, which comprises the following steps of 1), geological investigation before construction, 2), advanced geological forecast, 3), pilot tunnel excavation, 4), primary support, 5), karst cave and solution cavity treatment, 6), water-proof and drainage measures, 7), monitoring and measurement, 8) and ecological restoration. The invention has the following technical advantages that 1, collapse, water burst, mud burst and other disasters in the construction process are effectively avoided through detailed geological investigation, advanced geological forecast and reasonable construction schemes, and the safety of constructors and equipment is guaranteed, 2, a proper excavation method and supporting measures are adopted, the construction process is optimized, the construction period is shortened, the construction efficiency is improved, 3, the loss caused by geological disasters and improper construction is reduced, the engineering investment is saved, 4, the ecological restoration is paid attention to, the damage of the construction to the surrounding environment is reduced, and the coordinated development of engineering construction and environmental protection is realized.
assignees: SHANGHAI BAOYE GROUP CORP LTD;BAOYE ZHENGZHOU CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Reservoir group optimal scheduling method, system and medium based on hydrologic sequence real-time restoration
abstract_en: The application relates to a reservoir group optimal scheduling method, a system and a medium based on hydrologic sequence real-time reduction, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting measured data of reservoir groups in a research area, extracting runoff reduction amounts in the dimensions of day, month and ten days, collecting historical predicted flow data of reservoir groups in the research area, sequentially adopting at least two distribution methods to construct a reservoir group month runoff ten-day distribution scheme in the research area, inputting the reservoir group month runoff distribution scheme in the research area into a pre-constructed reservoir group optimal scheduling model, adopting a self-adaptive elite simulated annealing multi-target particle swarm algorithm solution model to obtain a non-inferior solution set, and adopting a fuzzy TOPSIS and gray correlation-based decision-making method to make decisions on the non-inferior solution set to obtain an optimal solution, namely the reservoir group optimal scheduling scheme in the research area. The application improves the utilization efficiency of water resources in various fields, reduces the water resource waste, reduces the flood risk, maintains the ecological integrity of the water area, and promotes the sustainable utilization of the water resources and the protection of ecological environment.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Diversion route calculation method in emergency
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the conventional problem that channel quality to be prioritized may not be secured, due to simultaneous and frequent occurrence of service interruption channels during a large-scale fault in a serious disaster etc. and further the restoration time may be long.SOLUTION: A network supervision and control device connecting a plurality of transmission devices calculates a diversion route from a relatively high priority between channels, on the basis of a service level regulation in an emergency, including the upper limit value of a service interruption time and the channel quality, so as to set a schedule including a path route, a sequence and a time limit.

title_en: Disaster response system for disaster response vehicles and respond method for disasters using therefor
title_ko: 위성망 기반 차량용 재해 대응 시스템 및 이를 이용한 재해 대응 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A disaster response system for disaster response vehicles, and a responding method for disasters using the same are provided to promptly construct an emergency communication network which supports the restoration of power facility by sending an emergency satellite vehicle having mobility to a disaster spot. CONSTITUTION: A satellite communication device(110) searches a satellite repeater(200) through a DVB-S signal confirmation method, and transmits and receives information to and from a central local system by using a TDM(Time Division Multiplexer) mode and/or a TDMA(Time Division Multiple Access) mode. An image transmission device(120) is connected to a satellite communication device through an Ethernet hub(150), photographs and outputs an image for a disaster spot, and transfers the photographed image to the satellite communication device. A wall box(130) includes plural terminals connected to the power facility located in the disaster spot by being installed at a disaster response vehicle. A digital TRS(Trunked Radio System) base station includes a TDMGW(141) which converts a protocol for digital TRS into an Ethernet protocol.
abstract_ko: 영상송출과 디지털 TRS 기지국장치 장애 발생시 긴급 복구기능까지 갖추도록 한 재해 대응 차량용 재해 대응 시스템 및 이를 이용한 재해 대응 방법이 제시된다. 제시된 재해 대응 차량용 재해 대응 시스템은, 재해 대응용 차량에 설치되는 재해 대응 시스템에 있어서, DVB-S 신호 확인방식을 통해 위성중계기를 탐색하고, 탐색된 위성중계기를 통해 TDM 및 TDMA 중에 하나의 방식으로 중심지구국시스템과 정보를 송수신하는 위성통신장치; 이더넷 허브를 통해 위성통신장치와 연결되고, 재해 지역에 대한 재해 영상을 촬영하여 출력하고, 촬영한 재해 영상을 위성통신장치로 전송하는 영상송출장치; 재해 대응용 차량에 설치되어 재해 지역에 위치한 전력설비와 연결되는 다수의 단자가 형성된 월박스; 및 이더넷 허브를 통해 위성통신장치와 연결되고 월박스를 통해 전력설비와 연결되고, 디지털 TRS용 프로토콜을 이더넷 프로토콜로 변환하는 TDMGW를 구비하는 디지털 TRS 기지국 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Distribution board responding to earthquakes
title_ko: 내진형 배전반
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a switchboard capable of protecting components installed inside the switchboard in the event of an earthquake. More specifically, the seismic switchboard comprises: a housing forming the outer shape of the switchboard; a base unit disposed inside the housing and in which components of the switchboard are installed; a buffer unit including an air ball having one end constrained to the base unit and the other end constrained to the housing; and a restoration unit including an elastic body for restoring the position of the base unit while constraining the base unit between the housing and the circumference of the base unit. When vibration or impact is applied to the housing, the base unit moves in any one of four directions of the base unit by the air ball to block the impact from being transmitted to the internal components to protect the internal components. Accordingly, it is possible to protect components embedded in the switchboard from vibration or impact flowing in four directions when an earthquake occurs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지진 발생시 배전반의 내부에 설치된 부품을 보호할 수 있는 배전반에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 배전반의 외형을 형성하는 하우징과, 상기 하우징의 내부에 배치되고 상기 배전반의 부품이 설치되는 베이스부와, 일단은 상기 베이스부에 구속되고 타단은 상기 하우징에 구속되는 에어볼을 포함하는 완충부 및 상기 하우징과 상기 베이스부 둘레 사이에 상기 베이스부를 구속하면서 상기 베이스부의 위치를 복원시키는 탄성체를 포함하는 복원부를 포함하되, 상기 하우징에 진동 또는 충격이 가해지면 상기 베이스부가 상기 에어볼에 의해 상기 베이스부의 사방향(四方向) 중 어느 한 방향으로 유동함으로써 상기 내장부품으로 충격이 전달되는 것을 차단하여 상기 내장부품을 보호하는 것을 특징으로 하는 내진형 배전반에 의해 달성된다. 이에 따라, 지진 발생시 사방향(四方向)으로 유입되는 진동 또는 충격으로부터 배전반에 내장된 부품을 보호할 수 있다.

title_en: Efficient application-aware disaster recovery
abstract_en: Embodiments are directed to efficiently backing up portions of data and to performing a scoped data recovery. In an embodiment, a computer system preloads data images with data corresponding to various different software applications or operating systems. The computer system chunks the data images, so that each data image is divided into multiple data chunks, and where each data chunk is represented by a hash value. The computer system then receives, from a user, portions of delta data representing data differences between the received user data and the data in the preloaded data images. The computer system also generates a logical backup representation that includes the data chunk hash values for the preloaded data images as well as the delta data received from the user. This logical representation allows restoration of the user's data using only the hash values and the delta data.
assignees: VALIYAPARAMBIL MANOJ K;SINGLA AMIT;SEN VIJAY;ALI ABID;MICROSOFT CORP

title_en: A kind of power system restoration power computational methods for considering black starting-up process
abstract_en: A kind of method of power system restoration power after having a power failure on a large scale the invention discloses calculating, including：The relevant parameter information of black starting-up unit, unit to be restored and transmission line of electricity in acquisition system；Establish the corresponding weighted network connection matrix of system；Calculate the sum of weighting capacity of all available black starting-up units and corresponding perunit value in the power plant of each available black starting-up unit；Using the black starting-up machine group node of broad sense as root node, search generation includes the minimum spanning tree T of all plant stand nodes 1 ；Calculate tree T 1 The black starting-up machine group node of middle broad sense is to the average shortest distance D of each machine group node to be restored 1 ；Calculate tree T 1 The machine group node of middle broad sense is to the average shortest distance D of remaining each load bus 2 ；Calculate D 1 And D 2 Average value；Calculate the restoring force of power grid.Advantageous effect of the present invention：Contribution of the different black starting-up unit of preferred sequence to power system restoration is distinguished so that the calculating of power system restoration power is more objective.

title_en: Ship navigation sea wave dynamic space-time forecasting method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of marine environment prediction, and discloses a ship navigation sea wave dynamic space-time prediction method and system based on deep learning. The method comprises the steps of carrying out space-time alignment, missing value restoration and standardization processing on collected ship AIS data and ERA5 analysis data sets, generating node characteristic vectors comprising longitude and latitude, time stamps, wind speeds and effective wave heights, quantifying the importance of ship track nodes and the time-space interaction relation through node characteristic codes, center codes, space codes and time codes, constructing SeaGraph models, outputting effective wave height predicted values of target waypoints, and carrying out verification. The invention breaks through the space-time constraint of the traditional static modeling framework, integrates the advantages of a self-attention mechanism and a graph network, strengthens the predictive modeling capability of dynamic evolution of the square wave field before the ship sails, and provides high-precision sea wave forecasting support for intelligent ship sailing under complex sea conditions.

title_en: Mud-rock flow along-path automatic diversion dredging, sand blocking and silt stopping combined structure and construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disaster prevention and reduction of hydraulic engineering, in particular to a mud-rock flow along-path automatic diversion dredging, sand blocking and silt stopping combined structure and a construction method. The combined structure comprises a plurality of automatic diversion dredging, sand blocking and silt stopping units which are sequentially arranged along the river water flow direction, and each unit comprises a crescent diversion structure, a self-dredging silt blocking dam structure and a funnel type silt stopping field structure. The crescent diversion structure is formed by distributing concrete columns or gabion columns according to the shape of crescent teeth and connecting the concrete columns or the gabion columns through waterproof geotechnical cloth, internally filling soil and stone mixtures and covering vegetation on the top, the self-dredging check dam structure is transversely arranged on a river channel and is provided with a drainage hole, a gate and an overflow port, the funnel type silt stopping field structure comprises an inclined slope, a funnel type silt stopping pond and silt discharging holes, and planting grooves are arranged on the periphery of the funnel type silt stopping field structure. The combined structure is arranged in the river channel, so that the debris flow can be effectively intercepted, automatic diversion dredging is realized, manual maintenance is reduced, disaster prevention and reduction effects are improved, and meanwhile, the ecological restoration function is realized.

title_en: Biological symbiotic seawall ecological member
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bionics sea wall ecological member, which comprises an ecological groove body, an ecological bed and wetland plants, wherein the ecological groove body is arranged on a sea wall through a base; ecological groove cell body is equipped with notch holding tank up, tank bottom and cell wall and sets up the through-hole that a plurality of permeates water, install ecological bed in the holding tank, ecological bed cultivates wetland plant in holding tank opening direction and forms the wetland plant, ecological groove cell body forms marine organism's habitat at cell wall, notch. According to the bionics sea wall ecological component, the green ecological channel is arranged on the traditional sea wall substrate, and a method combining artificial restoration and natural restoration is adopted to form a dike ecological protection system for resisting marine natural disasters, and the composite ecological system has ecological functions and aesthetic values.
assignees: CHINA POWER CONSTRUCTION GROUP EAST CHINA SURVEY DESIGN RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Power grid measurement data checking method and system based on artificial intelligence algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid measurement data checking method and system based on an artificial intelligence algorithm, comprising the following steps: step S1, acquiring electric quantity data of equipment in each link to obtain an initial data set; step S2, preprocessing the collected initial data set to obtain a training data set; s3, constructing an abnormal data identification model based on One-Class SVM; s4, constructing an abnormal data restoration model according to a ridge regression algorithm; s5, inputting the data to be checked into a trained abnormal data identification model, identifying abnormal data points, and repairing the data to be repaired by using an abnormal data repairing model to obtain repaired data; and S6, fitting the probability density function of the repaired data, and comparing the fitted probability density function with the distribution characteristics of the original data to evaluate the repairing effect. The method can effectively identify and repair abnormal data, improve the quality and reliability of the data, and provide important support for power grid operation and management.
assignees: GREAT POWER SCIENCE AND TECH STOCK CO LTD STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CORPORATION

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network power supply recovery method based on expert demonstration guidance reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster power distribution network power restoration method based on expert demonstration guidance reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of firstly, constructing an expert demonstration data set, establishing a multiple priority experience playback pool, including expert demonstration, normal operation and constraint violation experience playback pool, extracting experiences in batches from the expert demonstration experience playback pool, pre-training a reinforcement learning model, constructing and integrating an invalid action shielding module after the pre-training is completed, shielding invalid operation, then simulating operation in a large number of fault scenes, respectively storing the normal operation and constraint violation experience into the corresponding playback pool, extracting experiences in proportion for priority playback, training the model, and finally, recursively solving in a real-time fault scene by utilizing the trained model, and outputting an approximate optimal decision of post-disaster power restoration. The invention obviously improves the accuracy and efficiency of power supply recovery of the post-disaster power distribution network, and solves the problems of high calculation complexity and poor real-time performance in the prior art.

title_en: Ecological vegetation blanket for slope ecological restoration and restoration method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration, and particularly relates to an ecological vegetation blanket for slope ecological restoration and a restoration method. Aiming at the slope landforms with serious soil pollution and low microorganism and organic matter content, an ecological vegetation blanket is paved. The ecological vegetation blanket is formed by combining and paving a structural layer woven by gunny bag fiber yarns, a vegetation layer containing straws, fertilizers and grass seeds, a nutrition layer formed by paving activated sludge and a protection layer formed by paving crushed corn straws, wheat straws and coal gangue. The activated sludge not only can provide a large amount of microorganism groups for the soil, promote the ecological cycle in the soil and the formation of humus, improve the soil and the fertility, but also has the purification effect on water quality. The method is simple to operate, low in cost and quite considerable in restoration effect on landslide features, can play roles in fixing the side slope and beautifying the environment, provides proper conditions for vegetation growth, and has wide feasibility.

title_en: Ecological restoration system and restoration method for post-earthquake high-steep loose slope
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ecological restoration system and a restoration method for a post-earthquake high-steep loose side slope, wherein the ecological restoration system comprises lattice grids, planting units and irrigation units, the lattice grids are composed of lattice beams which are vertically and horizontally staggered and paved on the side slope and divide the side slope into a plurality of planting areas, the planting units comprise soil retaining plates arranged on the outer side of each planting area and vegetation climbing nets which are covered on the side slope of each planting area, the soil retaining plates, the lattice beams and the side slope jointly enclose to form planting grooves, planting soil is backfilled in the planting grooves, the irrigation units comprise main pipes which are arranged on the lattice beams, branch pipes which are vertically communicated with the main pipes and water outlet parts which are arranged on the branch pipes, and the branch pipes are distributed along the planting areas so as to irrigate the planting soil in the planting grooves at fixed points. The method has the advantages of wide applicability, good re-greening effect, convenient construction, controllable irrigation and remarkable ecological restoration effect, and is particularly suitable for ecological management and re-greening of the post-earthquake high-steep loose side slope.

title_en: Game machine
abstract_en: To provide a game machine, even when a power outage occurs during output of a security signal, capable of detecting the output of the security signal at least at any of before/after the power outage.SOLUTION: When a power outage is detected, a game control device stops output of a security signal. After power restoration, the game control device restarts the output of the security signal. When (ta+tb)ms exceeds a shortest output time 50 ms when an external device can detect the security signal, the game control device makes it possible for the external device to detect the security signal output before power shutdown. Further, when (ta+tb)ms exceeds the shortest output time 50 ms when an external device can detect the security signal, the game control device makes it possible for the external device to detect the security signal output after the power restoration.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 186

title_en: Electric power system and control method therefor
abstract_en: To terminate DC power supply from a fuel cell power generation system to an inverter on restoration of electricity of a system power supply.SOLUTION: The blackout of a system power supply 200 causes the execution of: DC power supply from a fuel cell power generation system 40 to an inverter 13 through a DC output route 354; DC-AC conversion by the inverter 13; and AC power supply from the inverter 13 to a second power distribution board 90 through an autonomous operation time route 353 and a power switchover unit 28. When defining, as a first condition, a condition that the measurement value of a current detector unit 27 is a value indicating that the power of the system power supply 200 is restored during power consumption in an AC load 56, DC power supply is terminated if detection that the first condition is satisfied is made for M1 times.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: A method of providing frequency restoration reserves
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method of providing secondary frequency reserves. The method comprising the steps of building an uncertainty set by computing probabilities for the activation of thermal loads, placing energy bids by solving an optimization model, and predicting the merit order position of the aggregator in a scale of other secondary frequency reserves providers, wherein the flexibility is limited by energy constraints, wherein the aggregator is configured to estimate a volume of a bid power P<sub>bid</sub> to be released, and wherein the volume of a bid power P<sub>bid</sub> volume is based on a grid request for a total volume of power and wherein a corresponding price per power is based on a prediction of a merit order supply curve.

title_en: Mobile self-organization based method for optimizing and recovering communication network of distribution network in disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile self-organization based method for optimizing and recovering a power distribution network in a disaster, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring the multi-element data in the power distribution network; s2, determining the state of the power distribution network in the disaster by using a grid method; s3, judging whether the power distribution network communication system needs transient recovery or not, and determining a restoration mode of the power distribution network communication system according to a judgment result; s4, researching an optimized repair scheme of the power distribution network communication network based on the characteristics of the mobile ad hoc network; s5, finding out a feasible scheme set under the target by using a path search algorithm of network simplification and depth-first traversal, solving each feasible scheme, and selecting the optimal result as a final repair scheme. According to the method, the state of the power distribution network communication system in the disaster is rapidly determined and the optimal recovery scheme in a corresponding mode is found out through the integration processing of the multivariate information in the power distribution network when the disaster occurs, so that the rush repair time of the power distribution network communication network is shortened to the maximum extent.

title_en: Mountain ecological remediation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mountain ecological restoration device, which belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration and comprises a mountain ridge part, wherein a sludge protection plate is fixedly installed at the top of the mountain ridge part, a drain pipeline is fixedly connected to the bottom of the sludge protection plate, a landslide prevention baffle is fixedly installed at the bottom of the sludge protection plate, ground thorns are fixedly installed on the surface of the landslide prevention baffle, a water outlet is formed in the bottom of the mountain ridge part, a vegetation platform is fixedly installed on the surface of the mountain ridge part, a platform perforation is formed in the surface of the vegetation platform, a penetrating nail is fixedly installed on the platform perforation, and a reverse buckle grab hand is movably installed on the penetrating nail. The utility model adopts the combination of the landslide prevention rubberpost and the ground thorn to tightly buckle the interior of the mountain body by the exquisite design, avoids the damage caused by the debris flow formed by landslide of the mountain body, and can realize the automatic irrigation of vegetation in arid weather and promote the growth of the vegetation by the combined arrangement of the water accumulator and the irrigation system.
assignees: HUBEI ENAN GEOLOGICAL FOUND ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Ultrasonic water meter data restoration method based on deep learning model
abstract_en: An ultrasonic water meter data restoration method based on a deep learning model calculates an ultrasonic flight time difference through an ultrasonic water meter time chip to obtain ultrasonic water meter time sequence original data r m Screening abnormal values of the ultrasonic water meter time sequence data set by adopting a dynamic threshold method; preprocessing is carried out, abnormal values in the data set are removed, and configuration of a training set and a testing set is carried out according to the characteristics of the LSTM model; predicting the ultrasonic water meter time sequence data by the forward LSTM prediction model, and predicting the ultrasonic water meter time sequence data by the forward LSTM prediction model; reverse LSTM modeModeling and deducing ultrasonic water meter time sequence data, wherein the reverse LSTM model comprises model optimization parameter setting, model construction and training, carrying out ultrasonic water meter time sequence data deduction according to the reverse LSTM model, and deducing according to a predicted value y' t And the derived value y ″) t And calculating the recovery value of the abnormal data in a weighted mode. The invention has higher repairing precision and higher repairing efficiency.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG TECHNOLOGY;HANGZHOU LAISON TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric quantity and electricity charge day measurement and calculation and remote power outage and restoration management system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data management, and particularly relates to an electric quantity and electricity charge day measurement and remote power outage and restoration management system, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a data acquisition access platform, a computing service platform, a management platform and an external data service interface component; the data acquisition access platform is used for managing the data channel and realizing the acquisition of the power use data; the computing service platform is used for processing the acquired data; the management platform is used for managing the data acquisition access platform and the computing service platform; the external data service interface component is used for shielding the external operation on the bottom database and is used as a container for WEB deployment to realize data interaction between platforms. The remote intelligent acquisition and control of the electricity utilization data can be realized, and the electricity utilization management efficiency is improved.
assignees: GUANGXI BOLIAN INFORMATION COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rapid power distribution system restoring force assessment index and assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid evaluation index and an evaluation method and a rapid evaluation system for restoring force of a power distribution system, which are used for modeling power distribution system elements and simplifying topology division cells of the power distribution system elements; according to the method, responses of the power distribution system in various stages under natural disasters are comprehensively considered, recovery power evaluation indexes of the power system in various layers before the disaster and in various stages after the disaster are respectively represented through expected values of system load loss, expected power failure load loss of node cells in the disaster and expected maintenance load loss of node cells after the disaster, the evaluation indexes are calculated through analysis and expression of fault probability events, a system function diagram of the power distribution system is obtained, and the recovery power level of the system is intuitively reflected; the method is used for guiding the line planning, the reinforcement of elements, the configuration of the connecting lines, the configuration of redundant resources and the like of the power system when the disaster does not arrive, and provides a quantitative basis for emergency response scheduling in the disaster and emergency repair restoration decision after the disaster.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD;NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power proxy service system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based power agent service system and method, which comprise the steps of collecting power data in real time through a smart electric meter and a sensor, uploading the power data to a cloud platform for preprocessing and marking through an Internet of things, utilizing time sequence analysis, regression, SVM and LSTM methods, combining weather, season and holiday factors to predict power load, optimizing power grid load dispatching through reinforcement learning or genetic algorithm, automatically allocating, monitoring power equipment states in real time through the sensor, predicting fault risks, giving an alarm in advance, providing energy-saving advice according to historical power utilization data of a user, adjusting equipment operation modes in real time, pushing personalized power utilization advice by intelligent customer service based on natural language processing, guaranteeing data safety by adopting encryption technology and multiple identity authentication, and periodically conducting security audit and vulnerability restoration.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LESHUN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Damaged road network recovery order optimization method based on user balance distribution and targeting maximum toughness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a damaged road network recovery sequence optimization method based on user balance distribution and aiming at maximum toughness, which aims to solve the problems of low recovery efficiency of traffic road networks after disaster and lack of scientific basis for decision making. The method comprises the following implementation steps of firstly constructing a damaged road network toughness assessment framework, combining a traffic network topological structure and traffic demands, defining toughness indexes as the reciprocal of the product of recovery time and total transit time, secondly, establishing damaged road network toughness optimization scene parameters, abstracting the road network into a connected graph and defining a recovery scheme set, then constructing a mixed integer linear programming model with maximum toughness as a target, converting a nonlinear problem into a linear problem through line approximation, setting constraint conditions such as traffic balance and travel demands, and finally, carrying out overall optimization solution on the model by utilizing a high-performance solver to generate an optimal recovery scheme. The method can scientifically quantify the toughness of the road network and optimize the recovery sequence, avoid blindness of empirical decision, rapidly improve the traffic efficiency of the traffic system after the disaster, provide high-efficiency and scientific decision support for the traffic recovery after the disaster, and have important practical application value.

title_en: Commercial power restore indicator for sites, such as for cellular telecommunications sites
abstract_en: Systems and methods are described herein for determining the restoration of power at a site, such as the restoration of commercial power to a cell site within a telecommunications network. The systems and methods may be utilized to determine whether power is restored at a cell site when a generator is currently or temporarily providing power to the cell site (e.g., during a power outage on a utility grid that provided the power to the cell site), such as by determining the presence of a generator is running alarm message and the absence of a commercial power failure message, among other messages.

title_en: Weathering crust leaching type rare earth ore in-situ leaching method
abstract_en: The invention provides an in-situ leaching method of weathering crust eluviation type rare earth ore, which comprises the steps of adding an ore leaching agent into an ore body, and adding top water after ore leaching is finished, wherein the top water contains water-absorbent resin microspheres. The method can effectively inhibit clay mineral from water absorption and expansion, prevent landslide, and the injected microspheres have water and fertilizer retention effects, and are beneficial to mine restoration.

title_en: Lake wetland ecological hydrologic regulation and control method considering dynamic requirements of waiting bird habitat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lake wetland ecological hydrologic regulation method considering the dynamic demand of a waiting bird habitat, which comprises the following steps of (1) selecting typical emergent aquatic plants and submerged plants as important habitat factors of the waiting bird through investigation and analysis of waiting bird habitat types, (2) determining habitat suitability curves of the typical emergent aquatic plants and submerged plants, and (3) simulating and evaluating the waiting bird habitat suitability and calculating an annual average suitability index. According to the method, a bird waiting habitat suitability evaluation model based on hydrodynamic force simulation is constructed, the potential bird waiting habitat area and spatial distribution characteristics are analyzed, the influence degree of the hydrologic process on the bird waiting habitat suitability is quantized, and finally a lake wetland bird waiting habitat simulation and regulation method considering dynamic matching of habitat factors is provided. The invention enriches the system of the method for regulating and controlling the ecological hydrology of the shallow lake wetland, and is helpful for providing references for the operation management and ecological protection restoration of the regulation type lake in the heavy water diversion project.

title_en: Multi-source data set construction method and system suitable for mining damaged land
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining damaged lands, in particular to a multi-source data set construction method and system suitable for the mining damaged lands. According to the mining damage land restoration planning method, the earth surface transition characteristics and the geological transition characteristics are extracted from the image data and the geological data of the mining damage area, the earth surface transition characteristics and the geological transition characteristics are input into the deep learning model to predict the ecological restoration evolution condition and the geological disaster hidden danger probability change trend, the classification model is further combined to predict whether the current mining damage area has the classification result of restoration value or not, multi-source data are utilized to provide the user with omnibearing and valuable data display, and the mining damage land with restoration value is further determined from a plurality of mining damage lands according to the classification result whether the current mining damage area has the restoration value or not to carry out restoration planning. The method provides basic support for implementing ecological restoration of mines by utilizing mining waste lands and classifying in regions and promoting comprehensive utilization of resources such as coal gangue, tailings and the like.

title_en: Efficient application-aware disaster recovery
abstract_en: Embodiments are directed to efficiently backing up portions of data and to performing a scoped data recovery. In an embodiment, a computer system preloads data images with data corresponding to various different software applications or operating systems. The computer system chunks the data images, so that each data image is divided into multiple data chunks, and where each data chunk is represented by a hash value. The computer system then receives, from a user, portions of delta data representing data differences between the received user data and the data in the preloaded data images. The computer system also generates a logical backup representation that includes the data chunk hash values for the preloaded data images as well as the delta data received from the user. This logical representation allows restoration of the user's data using only the hash values and the delta data.
assignees: VALIYAPARAMBIL MANOJ K;SINGLA AMIT;SEN VIJAY;ALI ABID;MICROSOFT TECHNOLOGY LICENSING LLC

title_en: Multicore fiber cable heat-shrinkable tube suitable for electric power emergency communication
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multicore fiber cable heat-shrinkable tube suitable for electric power emergency communication. The tube comprises an external-layer pipe body and an internal-layer reinforcing core; a temperature indicator, a waterproof layer 1 and an anti-corrosion layer 1 are successively arranged on the external surface of the external-layer pipe body from outside to inside; a spiral hot melt adhesive wire, a waterproof layer 2 and an anti-corrosion layer 2 are successively arranged on two end positions of the inner surface of external-layer pipe body from outside to inside; and spiral hot melt adhesive wires are uniformly arranged on other positions of the inner surface of the external-layer pipe body. The beneficial effects of the tube are that heating frequency of the tube is greatly reduced and welding time of fiber cable is greatly reduced, so precious time is gained for restoration of emergency communication fiber cable; waterproof layers and anti-corrosion layers are arranged on the external-layer pipe body, so sealing effects of the heat-shrinkable tube and the fiber cable are ensured simultaneously; and via the design of the spiral hot melt adhesive wires, air in the heat-shrinkable tube can be thoroughly squeezed out, and it can be ensured that a gap between the fiber cable and the heat-shrinkable tube can be sufficiently filled with hot melt glue after hot melting.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;INFORMATION COMM COMPANY STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: A kind of listed assistance system of intelligence and implementation method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the monitoring of dispatching of power netwoks control, more particularly to a kind of listed assistance system of intelligence and implementation method.The system includes real-time data base, OMS, monitoring backstage module, data processing module and visualizes module；The real-time data base is used to store real time data；The monitoring backstage module obtains real time data from real-time data base, and repair schedule information is obtained from OMS, accessible data is translated the information into, transfers data to the data processing module；The data processing module should be listed by the calculating of series of algorithms, automatic decision, answer delisted position, and result of calculation is passed into the visual presentation module；The visual presentation module is used to show result of calculation.The present invention provides a kind of listed security mechanism for monitoring, dispatcher, can effectively prevent the situation of sign board leakage extension or misplaced, improves the monitoring to dispatching of power netwoks control, is advantageous to the lifting of operating efficiency.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: A kind of restoration methods of the earthquake-stricken area Chuan Xi slopes soil and vegetation
abstract_en: The present invention discloses the restoration methods of a kind of earthquake-stricken area Chuan Xi slopes soil and vegetation, soil horizon is divided into according to deposit partition structure type behind the earthquake-stricken area Chuan Xi slopes landslide: silting type: being distributed in accumulation slope surface top, it is connected with surface of a wound slopes lower part, soil is based on soil, silt, contain certain chad, for chad content less than 50%, soil texture is loose, Yi Fasheng soil erosion；Gravel mud type: being distributed in the middle part of accumulation slope surface or middle and upper part, and deposit has certain silt, soil based on chad, rock, and content is lower than 50%, and afforestation land occupation condition is poor；Gravel type: being distributed in accumulation lower slope or middle and lower part, all avalanches of deposit, collapsing big rock and chad, no silt, soil can not cultivated plants；It is handled respectively according to region, it is low for the barren property of degenerated soil nutrient, fertility, the characteristics of plant long potential difference, it is transformed in the earthquake-stricken area Chuan Xi by slopes, reduces soil erosion, meet the needs of vegetation growth is to water and fertilizer condition.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF FOREST ECOLOGY ENVIRONMENT AND PROT CHINESE ACADEMY OF FORESTRY

title_en: Ecological restoration method for pyrite mine waste land
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration, and discloses an ecological restoration method for a pyrite mine waste land, which is used for detecting surface parameters of the positions of the pyrite mine waste land and judging the positions where landslide or collapse is easy to occur; selecting a safe position to excavate, carrying out foreign soil restoration on an excavation pit, and planting vegetation at the restoration position; detecting the water quality parameters of underground water at the position of the pyrite mine waste site; and the pumped underground water is treated by the underground water circulating treatment module and then is discharged into the ground. According to the invention, the judged position which is easy to slide or collapse is avoided, the safe position is selected for excavation, the excavation pit is used for carrying out foreign soil remediation, the vegetation is planted at the remediation position, the soil in the deep layer of the abandoned mine land can be treated, the pumped underground water is treated by the underground water circulating treatment module and then is returned to the underground, the underground water in the abandoned mine land can be treated, and the treatment is more comprehensive and thorough.

title_en: Lake risk prevention and control method based on water volume exchange and ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lake risk prevention and control method based on water volume exchange and ecological restoration, which comprises the following steps: evaluating the water quality risk according to the historical water quality data of the target lake, and increasing the water quantity exchange quantity of the target lake when the water quality risk exists so as to prevent and control the water quality risk; evaluating the ecological risk of the target lake, and implementing wetland ecological restoration engineering on the target lake when the target lake has a certain degree of ecological risk; the ecological risk of the target lake is evaluated as follows: and carrying out ecological risk assessment by using the loss of the shoal wetland habitat area after the superposition water quantity exchange working condition. The method takes the water quality risk prevention and control and the ecological risk prevention and control as targets, can simultaneously realize the alleviation of the water quality risk and the ecological risk of the target lake, has more systematicness and operability, and is applicable to the risk prevention and control of different lakes.
assignees: ANHUI SURVEY & DESIGN INST OF WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER CO LTD;CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES PROT INSTITUTE

title_en: Method and system for solving airport station interruption under air-iron intermodal cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air-iron intermodal transportation, in particular to a method and a system for solving the problem of airport station interruption under the cooperation of air-iron intermodal transportation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step one, acquiring an interrupted airport, an airport flight recovery time period, affected flights, flight information and available high-speed rail train section information; step two, establishing an aircraft recovery model based on air-iron intermodal transportation; the aircraft restoration model comprises an aircraft restoration objective function and constraint conditions; the aircraft recovery objective function is the minimum cost of aircraft recovery, and the constraint conditions are airport capacity and passenger balance; step three, optimizing an aircraft recovery model according to whether the influence of subsequent flights is considered; step four, solving an aircraft recovery model by utilizing a Lagrangian heuristic algorithm; step five, determining an airport station interruption solution; the system is adapted to perform the steps of the method described above. And the good surface communication network is fully utilized through air-rail intermodal transportation cooperation, so that the cost of flight recovery is reduced.

title_en: Campus energy consumption monitoring method based on behavior trace aggregation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a campus energy consumption monitoring method based on behavior trace aggregation, in particular to the field of energy consumption monitoring for campus energy consumption big data acquisition, which comprises the steps of acquiring access control data, wireless access data and video anonymous trace data to form a behavior trace sequence; and when the results of different data sources are different, returning to execute track collection again until the mutation area set and the mutation intensity matrix which are consistent are output. The multi-system power consumption unified scheduling method comprises the steps of carrying out aggregation processing on multi-source data such as access control, wireless access, video tracks and the like, identifying mutation areas, constructing a multi-system causal relationship graph, and generating coordinated actions and recovery sequences by combining constraint conditions to realize unified scheduling of multi-system power consumption in a burst scene.
assignees: SHANGHAI YULONG INFORMATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network fault rush-repair scheduling method, system, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a power distribution network fault rush-repair scheduling method, a system, a terminal and a medium, which belong to the technical field of power distribution network fault treatment, wherein the rush-repair scheduling method comprises the steps of obtaining the number of fault points, judging whether the number of the fault points is not less than 2, obtaining actual index information of sub-indexes corresponding to each fault point if the number of the fault points is not less than 2, determining the dimension of the sub-index corresponding to each fault point according to a pre-constructed three-dimensional rush-repair urgency evaluation matrix, obtaining a corresponding urgency total score according to the actual index information corresponding to each fault point and the dimension of the sub-index, generating a fault treatment priority according to the urgency total score of each fault point, and generating a rush-repair scheduling plan according to the fault treatment priority;    The application has the beneficial effects of realizing multidimensional and dynamic fault repair scheduling so as to improve the repair efficiency.
assignees: SHANDONG DENENG IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Technology for repairing ecological landscape of common graves ying in mountain park
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological landscape restoration, in particular to a mountain park common object ying community ecological landscape restoration technology which comprises the steps of acquiring relevant data of a mountain park common object ying community and surrounding mountain areas through a topography maintenance and geological survey technology, excavating and arranging mountain terrains after the mountain common object ying community is excavated and moved outside, arranging a flood discharge channel to be connected with a landscape, economically and adaptively arranging retaining walls with corresponding heights and types, planting different plant varieties according to the difference of ecological restoration habits, wherein the restoration technology is based on water and soil conservation, and avoids the ecological restoration of the mountain common object ying community developed on the ecological restoration level of a ground disaster, thereby effectively avoiding the problems of instability of a mountain surface layer and damage to surrounding municipal facilities due to overflow of the surface runoff in a heavy rain season caused by the excavation and the outside of the common object ying community, and forming an excellent ecological environment restoration effect while preventing and controlling the mountain water and soil conservation through selection and multidimensional planting of ecological vegetation on the change of the season.
assignees: FUZHOU PLANNING DESIGN & RESEARCH INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Protection and restoration support system for it system, using urgent earthquake news flash of
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the problem wherein it is necessary that evacuation of data and change of systems are performed just before occurrence of an earthquake in order to check damages due to the earthquake to the minimum, but current systems can not deal with them when the damages occur in an IT system in enterprises, and thereby it is considered that enterprise activities actually stop until they are restored when a large scale earthquake disaster occurs.  <P>SOLUTION: The protection and restoration support system restores damaged IT systems in teh shortest time by using urgent earthquake news flash newly provided by meteorological agency just before large scale earthquake disaster occurs, and performing working so that possible damages to the IT systems is the smallest, before vibration of earthquake occurs.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Circuit breaker and distribution switchboard
abstract_en: To receive information that a user requires when needed with a higher probability via a terminal when power fails.SOLUTION: A circuit breaker 1 includes: an acquisition part 121; a storage part 10a; a reception part 11; a communication part 13; and a backup power supply. The acquisition part 121 acquires power failure information including cause information and power restoration information including procedure information according to occurrence of power failure. The cause information is related to a cause of the power failure, and the procedure information is related to procedures of power restoration corresponding to the cause. The storage part 10a stores the power failure information and the power restoration information. The reception part 11 receives predetermined operation. The communication part 13 starts a communication process according to the predetermined operation, and transmits at least one of the power failure information and the power restoration information to a terminal. The backup power supply supplies power at least to the communication part 13 during a power failure period from the power failure to the power restoration.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Device and method for adjusting electricity consumption of a plurality of lighting devices of a lighting system
abstract_en: The invention is based on the idea that control of power consumption in a system comprising power consuming devices like lighting devices, for example, can be performed by dividing the power consuming devices of the system into a plurality of groups and by taking into account power consumption or load shedding or restoration capability for each group. Further, the invention implements an auction mechanism for adjusting power consumption or load in the lighting system such that an effective, fast, user requirements considering and lighting device functions and characteristics considering adjusting is achieved.

title_en: Progressive Network Recovery
abstract_en: Technologies are generally described for systems and methods effective to schedule repair (e.g., allocate repair resources, determine a repair sequence, etc.) of a system effected by a large-scale failure caused by a natural disaster, malicious attack, faulty components, or the like. In an example, the system can generate a schedule that indicates amounts of repair resources allocated for repair of specific components of a disrupted system as well as a time or sequence in which the components are to be repaired. The schedule, in some instance, can operate to maximize an amount of restoration, at each stage of a recovery process, relative to the characteristic of the disrupted system. For example, with a communications network as the disrupted system, the schedule can maximize the amount of total traffic flow capacity recovered after respective steps of the recovery process.

title_en: Remote power outage & restoration notification
abstract_en: Power outages and restorations at customer premises can be automatically detected and reported. A method may include receiving, from a network terminal, a first notification associated with a power outage; retrieving location information associated with the network terminal; sending a second notification indicating that the outage has occurred and that includes the location information associated with the network terminal; retrieving prior outage information that corresponds to a set of network terminals associated with a group of set top boxes; determining that an outage event is triggered, when a quantity of outages is greater than a threshold, where the quantity of outages is based on the outage and other outages obtained from the prior outage information; and sending a third notification based on the determination that the outage event is triggered, where the third notification includes information associated with the quantity of outages that enables a server to remedy the outage event in a manner that does involve users of the group of set top boxes.
assignees: MEYNARDI ALESSANDRO M;DUBOIS JEAN F;DOEHRING MARTIN;CHENG C P;VERIZON PATENT & LICENSING INC

title_en: The monthly repair schedule coordination approach of power transmission and transforming equipment based on integrated risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of monthly power transmission and transforming equipment repair schedule coordination approach based on integrated risk, belongs to power system and automation technology.The present invention includes the following steps：For the monthly candidate repair apparatus of repair schedule, relevant information is obtained；Based on the analysis that overhaul of the equipments influences operation of power networks, candidate repair apparatus is grouped, forms several maintenance tasks；From two dimensions of asset of equipments loss risk and safe operation of electric network risk, calculates and planning the integrated risk in monthly without maintenance；Risk-warning and urgent classification are carried out to maintenance task；It calculates operation of power networks control cost caused by corresponding maintenance and overhauls the safe operation of electric network risk reduced after task-cycle；Coordinate the plan period of emergency service task；Coordinate the plan period of suggestion maintenance task.The present invention provides technical support to realize that power transmission and transforming equipment overhauls maximum revenue with maintenance cost minimization, to improve the science and operability of repair schedule.

title_en: Communication base station monitoring extension system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a communication base station monitoring extension system, which comprises a PC server. The utility model is characterized in that the communication base station monitoring extension system additionally comprises a monitoring extension which interactively transmits data to the PC server through a wireless network, the monitoring extension comprises a wireless network module, a CPU control chip, a power supply management module and a control module, the wireless network module is connected with the CPU control chip, and the CPU control chip, the power supply management module, a field data acquisition module and the control module are interconnected with each other through wires or data cables. To sum up, the utility model has the advantages that the structure is simple, the installation is convenient and abnormal alarm for the storage battery, air conditioning outdoor unit, antenna feeder, ground wire, transformer, bus plate and wall body in the base station can be realized; environment monitoring function for parameters such as temperature, humidity, water immersion, smoke and the like can be extended; the monitoring extension system has access control monitoring function, power outage alarm function and power restoration alarm function; and the monitoring extension system also has field monitoring and intercommunication function, the filed situation can be known in time, the monitoring of the communication base station is realized and the goal of safety protection is realized.

title_en: Mobile platform of goaf three-dimensional laser scanner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable platform of a goaf three-dimensional laser scanner, which belongs to the technical field of general investigation of hidden disaster-causing factors of strip mines and comprises a vehicle body and an operation table, wherein a rubber gasket is arranged at the inner bottom of the vehicle body, two fixed steel plates are fixedly connected to the top of the rubber gasket, a fixed frame is arranged at the inner side of the fixed steel plates, a winch is arranged in the fixed frame, a drilling goaf scanner cable is arranged at the outer side of the winch, four supporting legs are fixedly connected to the bottom of the operation table, a control box is arranged at the top of the operation table, a probe rod is arranged at the right side of the fixed steel plates, the operation steps are basically only carried out two steps of assembly and scanning after the integration, the operation efficiency is improved by more than 1 time, the opened trunk tail door can also be used for assisting an operator in sunshade and rain-shielding, the humanization and comfortableness of the operation are greatly improved, only one main operator and one auxiliary operator can easily finish the operation after the integration, the manpower is reduced, the detachable connection mode is adopted, and the vehicle can be quickly restored to the original vehicle state, and the normal use of the vehicle is not affected after the restoration.

title_en: Business method, apparatus and system for monitoring quantitative and qualitative environmental analysis and managing associated financial transactions
abstract_en: A system, apparatus and business method are disclosed for using financial instruments to provide investment incentives to fund disaster mitigation projects and/or ecosystem restoration projects triggered by real world events detected by sensors at set points and analyzed by computing devices. The detection of the event results in the computational analysis and determination of the characteristics of the elastic bond or ecosystem service bond to be issued or returned to the investor. Examples include sensors for detecting events including mitigating flood damage, mitigating seismic damage, or improving air quality. In a preferred embodiment of the present disclosure, the investor can make an initial payment into a financial instrument, which is a resilient bond for funding a mitigation project, that pays the project developer for the stage of the mitigation project that occurred prior to the occurrence of the disaster when that stage is completed.

title_en: Virtual card power restoration instruction transmission method and device based on digital token
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual card power restoration instruction transmission method and a virtual card power restoration instruction transmission device based on a digital token, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the power restoration instruction generating module generates a remote power restoration instruction; the digital token encryption module encrypts the remote power restoration instruction and the encryption transmission key and generates a ciphertext digital token; the digital token sending module converts the ciphertext digital token into a two-dimensional code digital token and sends the two-dimensional code digital token to a power consumption user; the power utilization user displays the two-dimension code digital token on a power recovery terminal; the complex power terminal restores the two-dimension code digital token into the ciphertext digital token and sends the ciphertext digital token to a security chip in the terminal; the safety chip restores the ciphertext digital token into the remote power restoration instruction; and the power recovery terminal sends the remote power recovery instruction to the intelligent charge control electric energy meter, and the intelligent charge control electric energy meter completes authentication and power recovery operation. In the implementation of the invention, convenient and quick power restoration service is provided.

title_en: Emergency operation and maintenance method for energy storage system in bottom-protecting power grid based on disaster full cycle
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency operation and maintenance method of an energy storage system in a bottom-preserving power grid based on a disaster full cycle, which comprises the steps of firstly predicting power elements of a regional power system which has faults in the disaster full cycle and corresponding restoration time according to latest disaster intensity distribution information, quantifying the power grid state and the risk degree of the regional power system, providing basis for determining the response action and the restoration time of the regional power system, restoring the power elements which have faults in the corresponding restoration time after determining the response action of the regional power system, restoring the regional power system, determining an elastic evaluation result when the regional power system and the bottom-preserving power grid are influenced by the disaster through an elastic evaluation technology, determining an emergency operation and maintenance scheme of the energy storage system based on the elastic evaluation result, and ensuring the support effect of a bottom-preserving power grid energy storage station on the bottom-preserving power grid to the maximum extent, and ensure the stable operation of the energy storage system in the whole disaster period.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Distribution network maintenance request form generation system and method based on ring network diagram and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network maintenance request form generation system and method based on a ring network diagram and a storage medium. Distribution network maintenance work is divided into a plurality of dimensions through construction, and task description of high-quality and high-efficiency completion of operation and maintenance personnel applying for maintenance work to dispatching is completed from nine dimensional standardization guide area bureaus of working lines, working places, pre-drawing, post-drawing, load transferring, equipment power failure, equipment power restoration, load transferring and information confirmation. Can mark work place and power failure equipment on the looped netowrk diagram, improve the visual degree that presents of overhauing key information, be convenient for applicant and audit personnel confirm fast. By implementing the method, the system and the device, the applicant can be guided to quickly generate the distribution network maintenance request form, the generation efficiency and accuracy of the request form are improved, and the verification is facilitated.

title_en: Power distribution network rush-repair command platform
