abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological restoration system for an erosion coastal zone, which comprises: constructing a bank-connecting biological reef structure at the bank-connecting position of the coastal zone; a low beach biological reef structure which is constructed in a low beach area of the coastal zone and is positioned behind the shore-receiving biological reef structure; a first restored native vegetation planted in a beach area of the coastal zone and located behind the beach biological reef structure; a second remedial rural vegetation planted in a first half of the high beach area of the coastal zone; a plurality of tidal ditches are constructed in the front half section part of the middle and high beach area of the coastal zone at intervals along the direction vertical to the coastline; constructing a tidal pool in the latter half section of the mid-beach area of the coastal zone; and the ecological reconstruction slope protection is constructed on the sea wall slope protection. Also discloses a method for repairing the ecological repair system of the erosion coastal zone. The invention has the advantages of obvious treatment effect, obvious ecological support effect, outstanding disaster reduction effect and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI WATER ENG DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Data security protection method of electric energy quality monitoring system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data security protection method of an electric energy quality monitoring system based on edge calculation. According to the invention, a data transmission optimization scheme is established between the edge computing node and the cloud computing node, and the original monitoring data is subjected to security processing such as encryption, masking, fragmentation and the like, and optimization processing such as compression, filtering, aggregation and the like, so that the security, efficiency, reliability and quality of the data in the processes of storage, transmission and computation are ensured; and the processed data are subjected to restoration processing such as decryption, mask removal, merging and the like, and functional processing such as result display and advanced application functions and the like on the sink node, so that richer and more intelligent power quality monitoring service is provided.
assignees: STATE GRID SIJI DIGITAL TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Interface process-based underground water pollution risk rapid assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly evaluating underground water pollution risks based on an interface process, which comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out investigation on site pollution conditions and hydrogeological conditions, S2, constructing a site conceptual model based on site pollution conditions and hydrogeological condition investigation results, determining the distance between polluted soil and underground water-bearing layers, inquiring the underground water function classification of an area where a site is located, determining a protection target value of underground water, S3, calculating attenuation coefficients of pollutant distribution processes in different soil textures, S4, calculating attenuation coefficients of a gas-over-air belt soil layer transmission process, S5, calculating the total attenuation coefficient of pollutants entering the underground water-bearing layers, S6, calculating the concentration of the pollutants entering the underground water, S7, evaluating whether the pollutants in soil enter the underground water to pollute the underground water, S8, and calculating a soil restoration target value aiming at the condition that the evaluation result is the pollutants which can pollute the underground water.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE OF ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT PROT;AEROSPACE PLANNING & DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Shallow lake submerged plant community configuration method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, and discloses a shallow lake submerged plant community configuration method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a submerged plant hierarchical screening model; the submerged plant classifying and screening model comprises a habitat condition classifying model, a substrate condition classifying model and a water quality classifying model, wherein the submerged plant classifying and screening model is used for screening a plurality of submerged plants to determine the types of the submerged plants after screening, the submerged plant character parameters of the plurality of types are obtained, comprehensive tolerance indexes of the submerged plants of the various types are calculated respectively based on the submerged plant character parameters of the plurality of types, the species priority is determined based on the comprehensive tolerance indexes of the submerged plants of the various types, and shallow lake submerged plant communities are configured based on the types, the species priority and engineering parameters of the submerged plants after screening. The invention comprehensively considers the elasticity of the ecological system and the diversity of the species, ensures the functional complementation configuration of the species, and ensures the long-term stability of the configuration of the submerged plant community in the water ecological restoration.
assignees: THREE GORGES ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Handshake synchronization method and system based on visible light communication
abstract_en: A handshake synchronization restoration method and system based on visible light communication are provided. The method includes: after a transmitting end in which a state machine varies with unit time is powered on again, transmitting in the form of a visible light signal, to a receive and control system, a status reset signal which varies with unit time, wherein the receive and control system comprises one or multiple receiving ends; and receiving, by the receive and control system, the visible light signal, and when it is determined that the received visible light signal is a status reset signal, adjusting status of a state machine of a receiving end to a state indicated by the status reset signal. Status synchronization with the transmitting end is restored, avoiding a case in which the transmitting end is asynchronous with the receiving end after encountering power outage and being powered on again.

title_en: Autonomous restoration of power systems after natural disasters
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and computer-readable media are disclosed for autonomous restoration of power systems after natural disasters. An operating mode of a circuit breaker that is in a power system grid and that is coupled to other circuit breakers in the power system grid via communication channels is determined. Based on determining that the operating mode is a normal operating mode, data to parameterize a plurality of power grid restoration scenarios is collected at the circuit breaker. Based on determining that the operating mode is an exception mode, measurement data that includes current and voltage data is received at the circuit breaker, and one of the power system grid restoration scenarios is initiated at the circuit breaker. The power system grid error restoration scenario is selected based at least in part on a status of the plurality of communication channels coupled to the circuit breaker and on the measurement data.

title_en: System and method for power outage and restoration notification in an advanced metering infrastructure network
The monthly repair schedule economy optimization method of equipment based on decreasing concentration index under network loss
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of monthly repair schedule economy optimization method of the equipment based on decreasing concentration index under network loss, including：Generate the benchmark power system operating mode data under monthly repair schedule economy optimization；The power system operating mode calculating data in initial time section under different maintenance Start Dates can overhauled by generating each adjustable repair apparatus；Calculate decreasing concentration index under the monthly network loss of each adjustable repair apparatus；Considering security scleronomic constraint carries out monthly interior adjustable repair apparatus economy and optimizes layout.The present invention is based on electric power system tides to calculate and time-domain-simulation technology, pass through the optimization layout of the monthly repair schedule of equipment, the total network loss of power system operating mode under the monthly repair schedule of equipment is reduced, sending out the monthly repair schedule economy optimization layout of power transmission and transforming equipment for electric system provides decision support.

title_en: Black-start path restoration optimization method under composite disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a black start path recovery optimization method under a composite disaster scene, which establishes a fatigue damage degree model based on disaster time according to the changes of typhoon wind speed and influence range, and solves the line fault probability under the wind disaster condition; meanwhile, considering the influence of rainfall on a power grid under typhoon conditions, recording disasters through a geographic information system, dividing a region by a grid method, solving the landslide probability of the region, establishing an effective rainfall dynamic correction model and a landslide probability model considering the effective rainfall, and simultaneously establishing a slope impact model and a tower impact model, and solving the line fault rate; and determining a black start power supply by adopting an improved entropy weight method combining subjective and objective, establishing an objective function considering importance degree of a line and a node, and determining a black start path through a genetic algorithm and a shortest path algorithm. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of more accurately evaluating the fault rate of the line, avoiding the black start path from passing through the high-risk line and the like.

title_en: Side slope ecological restoration structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a side slope ecological remediation structure belongs to ecological restoration engineering technical field, including the prosthetic devices main part, the prosthetic devices main part includes barrier plate, connecting rod, fixed block and inserted bar, fixed connection between the top of inserted bar and the bottom of fixed block, the last fixed surface of fixed block is connected with the lower surface of connecting rod, the last fixed surface of connecting rod is connected at the lower surface of barrier plate, the fixed block includes mobile jib, auxiliary rod and injection device. The utility model discloses an injection device conveniently injects soil curing agent into the underground to improve the firm degree of soil, avoid appearing landslide, the occurrence that the rainwash leads to the soil erosion and water loss condition, thereby be favorable to the root of firm compound green vegetation, and then reach the purpose of the compound green vegetation of protection, the inserted bar can be fixed the barrier plate on soil surface, thereby form vegetation scour prevention protective layer, solved the easy problem that is erodeed and destroyed of compound green vegetation.

title_en: Replaceable friction energy-consumption prefabricated partially-wrapped concrete combined connecting beam
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a prefabricated assembled part parcel concrete combination even roof beam of removable friction power consumption, including combination beam section, left friction power consumption beam section, filling plate, right friction power consumption beam section, the combination beam section is including controlling two sections beam sections, left side friction power consumption beam section is connected to the one end of left beam section through screw rod and nut, right side friction power consumption beam section is connected to the one end of right beam section through screw rod and nut, left side friction power consumption beam section is connected just through screw rod and nut with right friction power consumption beam section be provided with the filling plate between left side friction power consumption beam section and the right friction power consumption beam section. The utility model discloses a combination is roof beam even has better deformation and power consumption ability, realizes linking the mechanism that the roof beam yields the power consumption easily, and after the combination is linked the roof beam and is surrendered, removable its power consumption spare of surrendering the position realizes shaking the back and to the quick restoration of impaired structure. Meanwhile, the form of partially wrapping the concrete is adopted, so that the post-earthquake reinforcement of the combined coupling beam is more convenient.

title_en: A prevention of seepage drainage and vegetation recovery integrated structure for spoil field reclamation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-seepage drainage and vegetation restoration integrated structure for reclamation of a waste soil field, which relates to the technical field of vegetation restoration and comprises a waste soil field, wherein an anti-seepage layer is covered on the outer surface layer of the waste soil field; the anti-seepage device is characterized in that a gravel drainage layer is arranged above the anti-seepage layer, a plurality of water collecting pipes are embedded in the gravel drainage layer, a plurality of water inlet holes are formed in the water collecting pipes, the water collecting pipes are connected with a water draining pipe, the lower end of the water draining pipe extends into the water collecting tank, a water collecting well is arranged at one end of the water collecting tank, and a vegetation protection frame is arranged above the gravel drainage layer. According to the utility model, the non-woven fabric is paved as the impermeable layer, so that the infiltration of moisture into the waste soil field is effectively prevented, the risk of water and soil loss is reduced, the possibility of occurrence of geological disasters such as landslide caused by the infiltration of the moisture is reduced, and the safety and stability of the waste soil field and surrounding areas are ensured.

title_en: Floating type wave-eliminating enclosure for ecological treatment of water body
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water ecological treatment equipment, in particular to a floating type wave eliminating enclosure for water ecological treatment, which comprises a rubber enclosure and floating shell components, wherein the rubber enclosure is of a strip-shaped flexible structure and is distributed along a preset boundary of a water treatment area, the floating shell components are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the rubber enclosure, a plurality of floating shell components are uniformly distributed at intervals along the length direction of the rubber enclosure and provide stable buoyancy support for the rubber enclosure, the floating shell components comprise floating shells, the floating shells are hollow light structures in the interior and are made of high-density polyethylene materials, long-term use requirements of the water ecological treatment are met, the relative independence of a target water area and an external water body is realized in a physical isolation mode, suspended pollutants, algae and the like in the water body are effectively intercepted, the accurate implementation of ecological treatment measures is guaranteed, and the floating shell components can be widely applied to water eutrophication treatment, emergency management and control of the polluted water body, ecological restoration subarea division and other scenes.

title_en: Urban water supply pipe network post-earthquake analysis and optimization method based on time delay simulation
abstract_en: A post-earthquake analysis and optimization method for an urban water supply pipe network based on time delay simulation relates to the technical field of safety risk assessment and comprises the following steps: s1: generating a leakage scene after the urban water supply pipe network is shaken: s2: analyzing the water demand space-time characteristics of the urban water consumption node after the earthquake: s3: calculating the delay reliability of the post-earthquake urban water supply node: s4: determining the optimized repair sequence of the damaged pipelines after the earthquake: s5: and (4) optimizing a dispatching model by a post-earthquake pipe network restoration team. The method adopts a Monte Carlo method to simulate a randomly generated earthquake damage scene of the water supply network, determines the time-space change relation of water demand/water consumption of user nodes after the earthquake by combining with the population evacuation rule, analyzes the hydraulic function of the water supply network after the earthquake based on a pressure driving node water distribution model, establishes an optimized model for restoring the functions of the pipe network after the earthquake by considering pipeline repair sequencing and maintenance team dispatching, and determines the restoration strategy of the earthquake damage pipeline in the water supply network.
assignees: UNIV HEBEI TECHNOLOGY;TIANJIN URBAN PLANNING AND DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Fault diagnosis and power restoration method, device and equipment for regional power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device and equipment for fault diagnosis and power restoration of a regional power grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: simulating at least one first power equipment to break down by a PAS of the power-on system to obtain a first voltage-loss and power-loss equipment set; if the second power equipment fails in the regional power grid, acquiring section data before and after the accident time point; analyzing the section data to obtain a third power device with a fault; and matching the third power equipment with the first voltage loss and power loss equipment set to obtain a second voltage loss and power loss equipment set, and performing load transfer and/or power restoration on the power equipment of the second voltage loss and power loss equipment set. When the power grid fails, the method carries out rapid recovery processing on the power grid according to a simulated fault recovery mode, reduces processing time, improves stability of power operation and power supply reliability, and makes full use of power grid resources to realize power conversion without power outage, so that the power grid continues to keep safe, economical and high-quality operation.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY;ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Cable protection pipe repair kit that does not have a power failure to change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable protection pipe repair kit without power outage for replacement, which comprises a repair mechanism, an installation assembly and a waterproof assembly, wherein the repair mechanism comprises a repair sleeve, a first installation block and a second installation block, at least 2 groups of repair sleeves are arranged, and the first installation block and the second installation block extend from two ends of each of the 2 groups of repair sleeves respectively. Can wrap original protective case through this restoration pipe fitting, need not have a power failure, restore on original basis, do the original structure of furthest utilization and material, the consumptive material is few, it is low to maintainer technical ability requirement, need not to demolish original protective case, the novel protective case of dismantled and assembled combination formula that can change at any time, it is inseparable to be connected with original protection tube, do not seep water, the later stage need not anticorrosive treatment, moreover, the steam generator is simple in operation, and materials, the instrument is purchased conveniently, and easy operation is mastered, adopt stainless steel to compare with the PVC material, mechanical strength is better, oxidation resistance, corrosion resistance, can carry out different processing according to original tubular product diameter.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating elasticity of power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating elasticity of an electric power system, which comprises the steps of modeling the electric power system to obtain an electric power system model; modeling a disaster to obtain a disaster model; applying a disaster model to a power system model to obtain a first operation condition of the power system when encountering a disaster; modeling the post-disaster recovery to obtain a post-disaster recovery model; applying the post-disaster recovery model to the post-disaster power system model to obtain one or more second operating conditions of the recovery power system after the recovery measures are taken in sequence; quantifying an effect of a disaster on the power system in a process from when the power system encounters a disaster to when the restoration measures are taken based on the first operating condition and the one or more second operating conditions; evaluating elasticity of the power system based on influence of the disaster on the power system; therefore, the elasticity of the power system can be more comprehensively and accurately evaluated, and a complete post-disaster recovery strategy can be formulated.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP;SICHUAN NEW POWER SYSTEM RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Road network restoration strategy formulation method for post-earthquake city emergency rescue stage based on entropy weight method
abstract_en: The invention provides a road network restoration strategy formulation method in a post-earthquake city emergency rescue stage based on an entropy weight method. The method comprises the steps of 1, drawing a target city road network, 2, calculating indexes related to road network topology and post-earthquake traffic capacity for each road section in the road network, and 3, calculating the indexes by adopting an entropy weight method to obtain a road section comprehensive evaluation value of each road section, and further, carrying out identification and classification of key road sections by sequencing the road section comprehensive evaluation values. The method integrates and analyzes multidimensional information of the post-earthquake road network, establishes a strategy for repairing the post-earthquake road network in an emergency rescue stage, and can provide a more scientific and comprehensive analysis framework for identifying key road sections in the post-earthquake road network based on an entropy weight method.
assignees: INST ENG MECH CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Ecological protection and restoration climate feasibility demonstration system for mountain wind power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological environment protection, and discloses a system for demonstrating the feasibility of ecological protection and restoration of a wind farm in a mountain area, which comprises a data importing and calculating subsystem and an evaluation data displaying subsystem, wherein the data importing and calculating subsystem comprises a data initializing module, a grid point weather data processing module, a classification factor calculating module and a comprehensive calculating module, and the evaluation data displaying subsystem is a B/S architecture program and comprises a data layer, a logic layer, an interface layer and an application layer and can carry out element distribution and comprehensive evaluation. The dominant effect of meteorological factors on restoration is verified, and particularly water and soil loss caused by heavy rainfall in the construction period is required to be paid attention to. The method provides scientific basis for regional differential restoration strategies, fills the blank of large-scale ecological restoration areas, and has the potential of being popularized to other inland mountain areas.
assignees: HUBEI METEOROLOGICAL SERVICE CENTER HUBEI PROFESSIONAL METEOROLOGICAL SERVICE STATION

title_en: Dynamic path planning method and system considering sudden disturbance and transportation characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic path planning method and a system considering sudden disturbance and transportation characteristics. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting road network topology, transportation tasks and disturbance event information, secondly, generating an undisturbed driving route plan for each vehicle by adopting an improved Dijkstra algorithm fused with road compatibility and time window constraint, randomly triggering disturbance events through dynamic simulation and updating road network states, then, adaptively selecting a local restoration or global reconstruction strategy to carry out path re-planning by evaluating the criticality of affected vehicle proportion and a failure road section, and finally outputting an optimization scheme integrating the plan and a dynamic adjustment result. The method effectively overcomes the technical defects that the traditional static planning is difficult to cope with dynamic disturbance, neglect the physical compatibility of the transport means and the road network, and the efficiency and the global optimization are difficult to balance during re-planning, and remarkably improves the robustness and the instantaneity of path planning.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM HONGXIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water area ecological restoration scheme evaluation method and apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of polluted water area treatment and ecological restoration, and provides a water area ecological restoration scheme evaluation method and apparatus, an electronic device, and a readable storage medium. The method comprises: determining a target water area scale matrix on the basis of an ecological restoration goal and an implementation starting stage; on the basis of a fuzzy consensus algorithm, determining a fuzzy consensus matrix corresponding to scale matrixes; performing normalization processing on the fuzzy consensus matrix to obtain weight vectors corresponding to feedback indexes, and then determining comprehensive weights; and determining a target protection scheme on the basis of the sorting of the comprehensive weights. By performing scaling on the water area feedback indexes and protection schemes, then determining the comprehensive weights of the scale matrixes on the basis of the fuzzy consensus algorithm, and determining the target protection scheme, a starting point of water area ecological restoration is determined, the feedback indexes are comprehensively concerned, and different protection schemes are determined for different restoration stages, thereby reducing resource waste, and improving the water area ecological restoration efficiency.

title_en: Elevator device
abstract_en: The present invention can foreshorten to elevator and operate required time again when power supply is from service restoration.Elevator device includes the code device signal of position detection signal and the travel speed comprising the carriage and traveling-position based on the detection position for being shown in the carriage gone up and down in elevator shaft, calculates the car position computing device of the absolute position of the carriage；Control the elevator operation controller of elevator operating；Detect the power cut detection device for the power outage powered to car position computing device；Detect the presence of the releasing of brake detection device for implementing manual release brake movement；And storage carries out the storage device of the testing result of releasing of brake detection device when power failure detects using power cut detection device, elevator operation controller can be referring to the storage content of storage device in power up, when the information for indicating to implement manual release brake movement can not be obtained, based on the absolute position using the calculated carriage of car position computing device, the operating of carriage is controlled.

title_en: Classification interpolation method and system for missing values of power equipment state monitoring data
abstract_en: The application discloses a classification interpolation method and a classification interpolation system for missing values of power equipment state monitoring data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power equipment state online monitoring data set X  m×n  ，X  m×n  M samples are contained, and each sample contains n types of state variables; according to X  m×n  Lack of measured value, for X  m×n  The missing values in (1) are classified; and constructing interpolation models of different types of missing values and performing missing value interpolation to realize the restoration of the missing values of the state monitoring data. The application follows the principle of easy to arrive and difficult, and provides a classification interpolation method for realizing the sequential repair of three types of missing values. Compared with the method using a single data interpolation model, the classification interpolation method establishes reasonable data interpolationAnd the repair process is suitable for repairing state monitoring data with complex deletion condition and high deletion rate.

title_en: Water burst disaster treatment system and method suitable for crack development side slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for treating water burst disaster of a crack development side slope, wherein the system comprises the following components: the crack development slope, the drainage groove, and the liquid guide hole, the liquid seepage hole and the drainage hole which are arranged in the slope; a curing layer, a matrix layer and a vegetable layer are laid on the slope surface of the fracture development slope and used for slope surface reinforcement, water plugging and ecological restoration; the liquid guide holes are positioned at the water seepage position at the upper part of the crack development side slope and are arranged in parallel with the slope surface, liquid guide pipes are arranged in the liquid guide holes, and small liquid guide holes are distributed on the surface of each liquid guide pipe; the liquid seepage holes are arranged along the direction vertical to the slope surface, a liquid seepage pipe is arranged in the liquid seepage holes, and liquid seepage small holes are distributed on the surface of the liquid seepage pipe; the drainage grooves are arranged along the slope toe at the water seepage position of the crack development slope, the side surface is provided with drainage holes which obliquely extend upwards to the inner part of the slope surface, drainage pipes are arranged in the drainage holes, and small drainage holes are distributed on the surfaces of the drainage pipes; and (4) pouring microorganism curing liquid into the liquid guide pipe to cure the slope toe and the shallow layer of the slope. The invention has the characteristics of low cost, strong applicability and environmental protection.

title_en: Hybrid short-term wind power prediction method considering massive loss of data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mixed short-term wind power prediction method considering data loss in a large quantity, which comprises the following steps of 1) establishing a GAN and BiLSTM-based data restoration model, 2) obtaining a wind power data sequence, inputting the wind power data sequence into the GAN and BiLSTM-based data restoration model, carrying out data enhancement on the wind power data sequence to obtain a wind power data enhancement sequence, 3) decomposing the wind power data enhancement sequence by utilizing a variation modal decomposition algorithm to obtain a low-fluctuation wind power subsequence, 4) establishing an attention mechanism-based improved CNN-BiGRU mixed prediction model, and 5) inputting the low-fluctuation wind power subsequence into the attention mechanism-based improved CNN-BiGRU mixed prediction model to obtain a wind power prediction result at the next moment. Under the condition of poor data quality, the method can ensure that the prediction precision meets the operation requirement of the power system.

title_en: Distribution line restores Sequence Decision method and system after a kind of bus-bar fault power loss
abstract_en: The invention proposes distribution lines after a kind of bus-bar fault power loss to restore Sequence Decision method and system, and this method initially sets up user's evaluation disaggregated model, then establishes optimal recovery sequence hierarchy model, determine the weight of each index factor.Finally recovery sequence of the every route for total excellent ordinal number of each evaluation index in user's evaluation disaggregated model, after obtaining distribution line power loss is determined using excellent sequence method.Based on this method, it is also proposed that distribution line restores Sequence Decision system.The present invention guarantees that responsible consumer restores power transmission with prestissimo, it establishes and determines the optimal Analytic Hierarchy Process Model for restoring sequence of distribution line, the many factors such as the society caused by distribution line power loss, economic loss, are incorporated Analytic Hierarchy Process Model, convenient for calculating and modeling.On the basis of hierarchical model, relatively excellent ordinal sum always excellent ordinal number is calculated using the excellent sequence method of grade preference, there is better operability.
assignees: JINAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Soil restoration management device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil remediation management device, and relates to the technical field of soil remediation. The system comprises a management room and a plurality of ground detection modules arranged on a ground base layer; a vertical isolation plate, a central processing module, two vertical plates and a plurality of transverse plates are arranged in the management room; the vertical plate is provided with a sliding block which is fixedly connected with two ends of the transverse plate respectively; the transverse plate is provided with a sliding block which is fixedly connected with the middle vertical partition plate; the ground detection module comprises a storage box, a first air cylinder, a first servo motor, a wind power generation module, a solar power generation module, a storage cylinder, a second air cylinder, a second servo motor, a soil detection module, a processor and a drill bit. According to the system, the soil detection module and the central processing module are arranged, the comparison module compares the characteristic points of the soil pollutants, the characteristic code module generates the characteristic codes for the characteristic points, the analysis module analyzes the soil restoration condition sent by the characteristic points and the unmanned aerial vehicle module, the generation module generates a table to be conveniently checked, the soil restoration management efficiency is improved, and the use cost is reduced.

title_en: Resident arrearage power-off and power-restoration management method and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a resident arrearage power-off and power-restoration management method and a related device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the RPA robot receives the power failure list data and stores the power failure list data in a database; the RPA robot regularly acquires resident arrearage data in a marketing system; the RPA robot matches the resident arrearage data with the power failure list data to screen out paid users; and the RPA robot sends the information of the paid user to the power recovery staff, so that the power recovery staff recovers power according to the information of the paid user. According to the power restoration management method, the RPA robot is adopted to acquire data from the marketing system and the customer service list system, and the automation of processes such as analysis, classification, distribution and the like is performed, so that manual operation links are reduced, process nodes are reduced, and the power restoration is managed and planned more effectively and uniformly. Thereby solved prior art work load big and the inefficiency technical problem.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY;FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Power grid equipment power failure and recovery method and system, readable storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a readable storage medium and a device for power grid equipment power failure and restoration, which are applied to a command receiving end of the power grid equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving an operation permission request, and sending the operation permission request to a dispatching terminal after the operation permission request is checked to be correct, wherein the operation permission request comprises a power failure permission request and/or a power restoration permission request; when the received command issued by the dispatching end according to the operation permission request is a confirmation command, controlling the power grid equipment to perform power failure or power restoration; and when the power grid equipment finishes the power failure or power restoration operation, sending an operation finishing instruction to the dispatching end so that the dispatching end archives the power failure or power restoration operation. The invention solves the problem of low safety of unmanned goods delivery in the prior art.

title_en: Ecological environment restoration and treatment method
abstract_en: An ecological environment restoration and treatment method comprises the following steps: arranging an irrigation well in the center of the pit, and arranging water reservoirs around the outside of the irrigation well; slope protection trimming is carried out on side slopes around the mine pit, and the bottom of the mine pit is leveled, so that the topography of the bottom of the mine pit is gradually reduced from the periphery to the center; a gravel layer, a mortar layer, a water-resisting layer and a soil layer are sequentially arranged at the bottom of the pit from bottom to top; erecting an irrigation water supply pipeline system above the soil layer; the invention carries out ecological restoration on the mine pit of the mine area, so that the side slope of the mine pit plants grass to prevent landslide, the bottom of the mine pit is flattened and provided with a water-proof layer, a soil layer suitable for planting grain crops is paved, an irrigation water supply pipeline system is arranged above the soil layer, automatic spray irrigation, pesticide spraying and fertilizer application are realized, mechanized farming operation, drought and waterlogging conservation and harvest preservation are realized, the stability of the ecological system of the mine area is improved, and the cultivated land area is increased for the country.
assignees: INVESTIG YARD OF GUANGDONG COAL GEOLOGY BUREAU OF CHINA COAL GEOLOGICAL ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Personalized insurance product recommendation engine system based on big data analysis and machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of insurance products, and discloses a personalized insurance product recommendation engine system based on big data analysis and machine learning, which comprises data acquisition and storage; machine learning; data analysis and data mining; data encryption, adopting a high-strength encryption algorithm and a security protocol to ensure the security of user data in the transmission and storage processes; the recommendation engine is used for quickly acquiring an insurance product list meeting the requirements of the user based on the user characteristics, the behavior analysis, the insurance product characteristics and other data and generating personalized insurance product recommendation; a user interface; reporting and visualizing; vulnerability restoration, namely timely discovering and restoring security vulnerabilities in a system based on a vulnerability scanning tool, security assessment and real-time monitoring; and (5) making a disaster recovery plan.
assignees: SHENZHEN BAND OF BROTHERS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Optimization method for Lin Tiancao sand area and duty ratio of semiarid sand area
abstract_en: The application discloses an optimization method of the sand area and the occupied ratio of a semi-arid sand region Lin Tiancao, which comprises the following steps: establishing a relation between deep leakage amount of soil moisture and rainfall and vegetation coverage under different land utilization types; constructing an estimation model of the total amount of deep soil moisture leakage of the sand area to be optimized, and estimating the total amount of deep soil moisture leakage of the sand area to be optimized every year according to the soil area and the amount of deep soil moisture leakage of Lin Tiancao sand; and (3) constructing a linear model of the total amount of soil moisture deep seepage of the sand area to be optimized, and inverting the optimized area and the occupation ratio of Lin Tiancao sand in the sand area to be optimized by using a machine learning regression model under the constraint condition of ensuring the water resource safety of the sand area to be optimized. The method solves the problems that the prior northern semiarid sand area treatment does not comprehensively consider the relationship between regional water resource utilization and ecological restoration of main land utilization types such as forests, grasses, sand, fields and the like, and the stability of sand-fixing vegetation and the safety of regional water resources can not be ensured.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF ECOLOGY PROT AND REPAIR CHINESE ACADEMY OF FORESTRY

title_en: Multi-plant ecological restoration method and system for water body
abstract_en: The application discloses a water body multi-plant ecological restoration method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of detecting whether different functions exist in a water body to be detected, carrying out regional division according to the functions to obtain a water body regional division result, analyzing based on water capacity information and pollutant information to obtain a regional division index Q if the functions do not exist, dividing the water body region to be detected according to the regional division index Q to obtain a water body regional division result, analyzing plants suitable for ecological restoration of the water body to be detected based on pollutant information of the water body to obtain a plant pre-screening database, analyzing whether each plant in the plant pre-screening database is a native plant of the water body to be detected, screening according to weather similarity of a suitable survival area of each plant and the area where the water body to be detected exists if the functions do not exist to obtain a plant two-screening database, and screening plant adaptability information and plant stress resistance information of each plant in the plant two-screening database to obtain a plant selection database. The application has the effect of improving the ecological restoration efficiency of multiple plants in the water body.
assignees: HUNAN JINGYUAN ENV ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Carbon fixation and emission reduction effect evaluation method and device for river basin vegetation recovery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon sequestration emission reduction effect evaluation, and discloses a carbon sequestration emission reduction effect evaluation method and device for river basin vegetation restoration, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating reference carbon sequestration emission reduction corresponding to a river basin reference scenario scheme by using a river basin land ecological system water-carbon coupling model; setting leaf area indexes and vegetation types in a target river basin, constructing a river basin vegetation recovery scheme based on the leaf area indexes and the vegetation types, calculating carbon sequestration emission reduction caused by vegetation recovery corresponding to the river basin vegetation recovery scheme by using a water-carbon coupling model of a river basin land ecological system, wherein the carbon sequestration emission reduction caused by vegetation recovery comprises total water energy carbon sequestration, total vegetation carbon sequestration and total karst carbon sequestration, and evaluating carbon sequestration effect of the river basin vegetation recovery based on reference carbon sequestration emission reduction and carbon sequestration emission reduction caused by vegetation recovery to obtain a carbon sequestration effect evaluation result. The invention comprehensively and reliably evaluates the carbon sequestration emission reduction effect of river basin vegetation restoration.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER THREE GORGES GROUP IND DEVELOPMENT BEIJING CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Land degradation area vegetation restoration planning method based on AI image recognition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of land degradation restoration, and discloses a land degradation area vegetation restoration planning method based on AI image recognition, which integrates multi-source data such as satellite remote sensing, unmanned aerial vehicle, weather station, soil sensor and the like, generates a composite environment grid with unified space-time reference through a space-time diagram convolution network, extracts drought and heavy rain precursor characteristics, and predicts disaster probability by utilizing a space-time converter model; dividing a degraded area and a non-degraded area by UNet, embedding a 3-PG vegetation growth model in UNet, constructing a vegetation type library by combining meteorological areas, outputting planting parameters, carrying out regression optimization and verification through a Gaussian process, constructing a vegetation knowledge map by integrating multi-source data and logistics data, generating a restoration scheme through a graphic neural network, constructing a digital twin body based on a Unity engine, simulating the feasibility of the vegetation growth verification scheme, and updating model parameters by combining unmanned plane data through a set Kalman filter. The method realizes the precision and dynamic optimization of repair planning through the AI technology.
assignees: YANTAI LAND RESERVE AND UTILIZATION CENTER YANTAI MINERAL RESOURCES RESERVE CENTER YANTAI GEOLOGICAL

title_en: A rapid kill and restoration system for blowout wells
abstract_en: Well blowouts, such as happened in the PTTEPAA Montara gas well in the Timor Sea in August 2009 and the BP Macondo oil well in the Gulf of Mexico in April 2010, caused colossal disasters. The existing top kill technique by pumping in kill- weight mud failed. The relief well technique worked, however it was very costly and very late due to drilling the relief well. This invention is a rapid and reliable kill and restoration technique and its implementation system for the well blowout accidents. It uses solid particles to block, suppress and greatly reduce the blowout flow to gain time for repair or replacement of the damaged blowout preventer and other devices, and connection of production pipelines; It then takes out some of the solid particles to restore well production. In such a way, environmental damage is greatly reduced and the well is kept as a valuable production asset. While any shape of solid particles may be used, the ball shape is an optimum for the kill and restoration operation; hence kill balls are the recommended solid particles. The kill procedure is to sequentially release large, medium and small density balls into the blowout well. Balls of different densities can be made of different materials such as lead, iron, stone or rubber and can have a shell cover made of iron, steel or other environmental friendly material. An implementation system for the kill procedure consists of a tubing system, a blower or a pump, a ball injection device and a cage. The transporting fluid can be air, nitrogen, carbon dioxide, oil or other fluid depending on the operation safety assessment in regarding to the specific well blowout situation. The cage mounted on the tubing and sits on top of the well will temporally contain the blown out balls at the early stage of the kill process. Balls in the cage will fall down to the well as the flow is reduced. A technique for taking out some of the balls from the well to restore production is carried out by a tubing system, a pump and a balls storage tank.

title_en: Power outage management and power support restoration for devices in a wireless network
abstract_en: Techniques for power outage management and power support restoration for devices in a wireless network are disclosed herein. Such a wireless network may include a number of bi-directional nodes in bi-directional wireless communication with one or more central nodes. Each bi-directional node may have a wireless communication path to one of the central nodes that is either a direct path or an indirect path through one or more intermediate bi-directional nodes serving as relays. Each bi-directional node may be configured to detect when it has become stranded such that it can no longer communicate with its assigned central node via its assigned communication path, to determine a reason for its stranding, and to transmit a stranding notification and the reason therefore.

title_en: A kind of isolated island division methods containing distributed power distribution network
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of isolated island division methods of electric system, and in particular to a kind of isolated island division methods containing distributed power distribution network.This method comprises the following steps：(1) isolated island partition problem models；(2) the non-directed graph weights of power distribution network are adjusted；(3) radial distribution networks are formed based on minimum spanning tree；(4) division of isolated island containing distributed power distribution network based on improved adaptive GA-IAGA；(5) the power distribution network isolated island division containing multiple distributed generation resources.The method that the present invention is combined using minimal spanning tree algorithm and improved adaptive GA-IAGA solves the isolated island partition problem of power distribution network.According to the characteristics of power distribution network, electricity distribution network model is simplified, power distribution network containing ring network structure is reduced to by the optimal radial distribution networks of load restoration order by minimal spanning tree algorithm, optimal isolated island is finally obtained using improved adaptive GA-IAGA again, improve search efficiency, optimal solution can be fast and effectively obtained, there is good practicality.

title_en: System for detecting signal during power grid equipment power restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for detecting signals during power grid equipment power restoration, which comprises: the intelligent dispatching command platform is in communication connection with the dispatching master station, the dispatching master station is in communication connection with the remote control system terminal, and the remote control system terminal is in communication connection with the measurement and control device. The invention utilizes the dispatching intelligent command platform to construct the detection signal system during the power restoration, realizes the automatic detection of the restoration signal and improves the detection efficiency and accuracy.

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network dynamic rush-repair method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-disaster power distribution network dynamic rush-repair method and a post-disaster power distribution network dynamic rush-repair system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring state information of a post-disaster power distribution network to be dynamically rush-repaired through an environment side; inputting the state information of the post-disaster power distribution network to be dynamically rush-repaired to an intelligent body side comprising a reinforcement learning model, and obtaining a post-disaster power distribution network dynamic rush-repair result output by the intelligent body; the intelligent agent side acquires a reinforcement learning state from the environment side, acts on the power distribution network based on strategy selection actions, receives corresponding rewarding values and the next state for iterative training, and continuously updates network parameters to obtain the reinforcement learning model. The embodiment of the invention realizes the high-efficiency and high-accuracy emergency repair effect of the post-disaster emergency repair of the power distribution network under the conditions of deep coupling of multi-emergency repair team cooperative allocation, emergency repair recovery and power supply transfer and restoration.

title_en: Pump station scheduling method, equipment and medium based on image recognition farmland disaster-stricken condition
abstract_en: The application provides a pump station scheduling method based on image recognition of farmland disaster conditions, which comprises the steps of determining at least one first shooting position information corresponding to at least one first restoration image respectively under the condition that the category information of the at least one first restoration image is waterlogging category, determining a target pump station according to the at least one first shooting position information, performing image segmentation processing on the at least one first restoration image, determining waterlogging areas and non-waterlogging areas of the at least one first restoration image, determining first ratio information between the sum of areas of the waterlogging areas of the at least one first restoration image and the sum of areas of all areas of the at least one first restoration image, determining a target waterlogging level according to the first ratio information, and scheduling drainage of the target pump station according to the target waterlogging level. The application can accurately control the drainage flow and improve the drainage scheduling accuracy of the target pump station.

title_en: River submerged plant recovery method based on flow velocity regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of river vegetation restoration of hydraulic engineering, and particularly relates to a river submerged plant restoration method based on flow rate regulation, which comprises the steps of measuring adaptive threshold values Vu and Vs of flow rate of tilapia, dynamically regulating and controlling water supplementing quantity in combination with a hydrodynamic model MIKE, constructing flow rate gradient of an rapid flow region Vu and a slow flow region Vs, realizing space isolation by utilizing flow rate adaptive difference of fish and plants, and simultaneously introducing snakeheads and benthos to form ecological cooperative control. The invention solves the problems that the traditional enclosing method hinders flood discharge and the fish-preventing device is easy to damage, and constructs the rapid flow area and the slow flow area through the water supplementing quantity regulation and control, thereby replacing the traditional physical blocking device, solving the contradiction between flood discharge safety and fish control, enhancing flood discharge safety and reducing maintenance cost.

title_en: Ecological restoration area carbon sink increment real-time prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based ecological restoration area carbon sink increment real-time prediction method and system, which comprise the following steps of acquiring multi-source data, acquiring a lunar vegetation coverage image through a satellite remote sensing platform, acquiring sensor data such as soil temperature and humidity, air CO  2  concentration and the like by using a laid ground sensor network, acquiring vegetation canopy point cloud data according to a preset period by using an unmanned plane laser radar, collecting biomass actual measurement data of a restoration area in a history preset period, preprocessing the data, performing radiation calibration, atmosphere correction and cutting and splicing on the lunar vegetation coverage image acquired by the satellite remote sensing platform, extracting vegetation coverage and vegetation index time sequence, denoising, ground point separation and single wood canopy segmentation on the vegetation canopy point cloud data acquired by the unmanned plane laser radar, and calculating individual plant vegetation height and canopy width. The method can more accurately realize carbon sink increment prediction.

title_en: Method and system for outage restoration
abstract_en: The title of the invention is method and system for outage restoration. The electric grid repair and operations system includes a work crew locator configured to receive a location of a work crew based on a location of a work vehicle associated with the work crew, a work crew management subsystem configured to receive a location of at least some of a plurality of work crews from the work crew locator, an asset management subsystem (128) configured to determine repair requirements for electric grid assets and repair times associated with the determined repair requirements, an outage management subsystem (124) configured to determine an outage occurrence using at least one of fault indications and trouble calls, and a restoration optimizer configured to determine a capable crew to respond to a grid configuration change request where the capable crew includes crew members qualified to perform the change request, tools and equipment required to effect the change request, and a work crew location determined to satisfy a response timing requirement, and initiate crew instructions detailing work requirements and actions for the work crew to fulfill the grid configuration change request.

title_en: Black start path generation method and device and nonvolatile storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a black start path generation method and device and a nonvolatile storage medium. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: determining a target function, a recovery power utilization sequence of a plurality of black-start power supply nodes in a target area and a power grid connection diagram, wherein the power grid connection diagram represents the connection relation between power equipment in the target area; and generating a black start path of a target area by adopting an improved Floiede algorithm according to the power recovery sequence of the black start power supply nodes, the power grid connection diagram and the target function. The invention solves the technical problem that the black start process is not used as a dynamic process when the black start path is generated in the prior art.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;BEIJING DINGCHENG HONGAN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating secondary disasters of earth-covered fire extinguishing bomb based on pre-dangerous analysis and AHP analysis method
abstract_en: The invention provides a secondary disaster evaluation method of a covered fire extinguishing bomb based on pre-dangerous analysis and AHP analysis. The invention determines the evaluation object, then surveys the related data and divides the related data into a plurality of evaluation subunits, evaluates each subunit according to a pre-dangerous analysis method, determines the weight of each subunit by using an AHP analysis method, and finally calculates the comprehensive evaluation grade of the secondary disaster. The invention makes up the gap in the field of evaluating the secondary disasters of the earthing fire extinguishing bomb and provides a judgment basis for quantifying the safety of workers in the fire and the ecological restoration condition after forest disaster.

title_en: Transformer substation vulnerability assessment method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation vulnerability assessment method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are used for solving the problems that the existing related assessment method has higher requirements on the technical level of assessment personnel and the assessment method has low practicability. The method comprises the following steps: if the transformer substation is detected to suffer from network attack, an attack target of an attacker is obtained, and when the attack target is a potential vulnerability, a vulnerability cracking list of the attacker and a vulnerability cracking detection list of an defender are generated; potential vulnerability scanning data and vulnerability restoration probability of an defender in each game are calculated, and a vulnerability cracking list and a vulnerability cracking detection list are updated based on the potential vulnerability scanning data and the vulnerability restoration probability; determining final vulnerability cracking data of an attacker according to the updated vulnerability cracking list and the vulnerability cracking detection list; and calculating the invaded probability of the transformer substation by adopting the final vulnerability cracking data so as to evaluate the vulnerability of the transformer substation.

title_en: Exterior Emergency Reinforcement Concrete Structures Using Steel Band
title_ko: 스틸밴드를 이용한 철근콘크리트 구조물의 응급 외부 보강구조물
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an emergency exterior reinforcement structure of a reinforced concrete structure comprises: a support member arranged on a reinforced concrete structure; a steel band of a grid structure supported on the support member around the structure to give tension; a reinforcing plate attached to an outer circumferential surface of the reinforced concrete structure reinforced by the steel band by using a fixing bolt; and a steel wire rope coupled to one or more eyebolts installed through the reinforcing plate. The tension is adjusted by adjustment nuts and the eyebolts to which both ends of the steel wire rope are coupled. The emergency exterior reinforcement structure can be simply assembled and installed at a site by binding devices such as steel bands, steel wire ropes, reinforcing plates, and bolts to have excellent constructability. Therefore, improved effects as a seismic reinforcing method before an earthquake occurs can be expected. The emergency exterior reinforcement structure of a reinforced concrete structure using a steel band can be applied as effective emergency reinforcement in earthquake restoration requiring quickness to suppress abrupt collapses by destruction or deformation immediately after an earthquake disaster.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 철근콘크리트 구조물의 응급 외부 보강구조물은, 철근콘크리트 구조물에 구비되는 지지부재 및 상기 구조물 둘레를 따라 상기 지지부재에 지지되어 긴장력을 부여하도록 구비되는 격자 구조의 스틸밴드를 포함하고, 상기 스틸밴드로 보강된 철근콘크리트 구조물의 외주면에 고정볼트를 이용하여 부착시키는 보강판 및 상기 보강판에 관통시켜 설치하는 하나 이상의 아이볼트에 체결되는 스틸와이어로프를 포함하고, 상기 스틸와이어로프의 양단부가 체결된 상기 아이볼트와 조절너트로 인장을 조절하도록 형성되는 것으로서, 현장에서 스틸밴드, 스틸와이어로프, 보강판, 볼트 등과 같은 결속장치로 간단하게 조립, 설치할 수 있어 시공성이 뛰어나며, 따라서, 지진 발생 전, 내진 보강구조물로서 높은 효과를 기대할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 지진 재해 직후 파괴 또는 변형으로 인해 급격한 붕괴를 억제할 수 있도록 신속성이 요구되는 지진 복구에도 유효한 응급 보강으로 적용할 수 있는 스틸밴드를 이용한 철근콘크리트 구조물의 응급 외부 보강구조물에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KOREA NATIONAL UNIV OF TRANSPORTATION INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION;SEON ARCHITECTS & ENG GROUP

title_en: Wildfire suppressant and forest damage restoration agent comprising eco-friendly biodegradable soil coagulant
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wildfire spread suppressing agent and a forest damage restoration agent comprising a biodegradable eco-friendly soil coagulant, wherein the eco-friendly soil coagulant of the present invention comprises starch and nanocellulose, and an aldehyde group of the starch is acetal-crosslinked with the nanocellulose, thereby being non-toxic and biodegradable and capable of absorbing a large amount of water, and thus can function as a wildfire spread suppressing agent and a forest damage restoration agent.

title_en: System and method for automated fault control and restoration of smart grids
abstract_en: A self-organizing protection coordination system within a power network is provided. The self-organizing protection coordination system in the power network includes a plurality of distribution devices communicatively coupled to each other in a power network. The power network also includes a protection device coupled to each of the plurality of distribution devices configured to transmit power in the distribution network. The power network further includes a controller coupled to each of the plurality of distribution devices. The controller receives communication channel characteristics from a plurality of distribution devices in a distribution network at an interval of time. The controller also computes a delay in time for receiving the communication characteristics. The controller further determines a plurality of reliability indicators at each of the plurality of distribution devices. The controller adjusts tripping characteristics of the plurality of distribution devices to minimize the reliability indicators based on the computed delay.
assignees: GEN ELECTRIC;BUSH STEPHEN FRANCIS;MAHONY MICHAEL JOSEPH

title_en: Power load missing data restoration method based on power utilization mode decomposition and reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power load missing data restoration method based on power consumption mode decomposition and reconstruction, and relates to the field of analysis and processing of large power data. The method comprises the steps of firstly, acquiring power load data of a power consumer, and dividing a data set into a complete load data set and a load data set to be repaired; based on the sparsity and diversity of the user power load, a K singular value decomposition dictionary learning algorithm is adopted to extract a base vector dictionary matrix representing the user power electronic mode from the complete load data set; decomposing and coding the load curve to be repaired based on the basis of the base vector dictionary matrix, and determining the load curve to be repaired to be composed of electronic modes; and finally, reconstructing the load curve according to the coding vector of the load curve to be repaired based on the base vector dictionary matrix, and filling and repairing the data of the missing part of the power load. The method can be applied to multi-day load data loss or load data loss repair in continuous time periods.

title_en: Yun Bianduan-coordinated user outage and restoration monitoring method, system and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a cloud edge end cooperative user outage and restoration monitoring method, a cloud edge end cooperative user outage and restoration monitoring system, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of receiving an edge power outage event list generated by combining effective power outage alarm events collected at the same time point in an area where an Internet of things is located by an edge terminal based on an edge side transformer-split phase line-branch line-user topology model, generating a distribution network power outage event list based on a transformer substation-line-branch line-transformer topology model according to acquired position information and line fault information of a distribution network line outgoing switch, a branch switch and a station transformer combined breaker of an external system, matching the edge power outage event list with the distribution network power outage event list, determining an actual power outage early warning list and a power outage type at the current moment, and powering on and monitoring each power outage area in the actual power outage early warning list based on the power outage type to obtain composite power outage data. By adopting the method, the real-time performance and accuracy of monitoring the power failure event can be improved.

title_en: Disaster tolerance switching method, system and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for switching disaster-tolerance, which includes the steps that: a disaster-tolerance client at a production side instructs a first database at the production side to write data in the cache into a first storage device at the production side and empty a log after the disaster-tolerance switching is started; the written data is synchronized from the first storage device to a second storage device at a disaster-tolerance side; a disaster-tolerance service terminal at the disaster-tolerance side makes a snapshot to the data in the second storage device; a second database at the disaster-tolerance side is started by using the snapshot, and the started second database carries out self-restoration operation according to the newly-generated log after being emptied. The invention also provides a disaster-tolerance switching system, a disaster-tolerance switching device at a service terminal and a disaster-tolerance switching device at the client. The invention shortens the restoration time of the database during the disaster-tolerance restoration period.

title_en: Data center remote parallel connection method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a system for connecting data centers in parallel in different places, wherein the method comprises the following steps: a first data center and a local first disaster recovery center establish a synchronous relation; the first data center only backs up the incremental data to a second disaster recovery center in different places each time in an incremental cloud backup mode; and using a cloud restoration technology to freely restore the data of any backup time point of the second disaster recovery center in different places to the first data center or the first disaster recovery center. According to the embodiment of the invention, any backup point-in-time data can be freely recovered by using the cloud backup and cloud restoration technology.
assignees: SUZHOU INSPUR INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Novel self-recovery anti-seismic support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel self-restoring anti-seismic support, wherein weights are connected through a n-shaped hanging buckle, the external abutting channel steel is elastically supported through a first butterfly reed and a second butterfly reed, and the first spring plate connecting piece and the second spring plate connecting piece are supported, so that a cable-stayed type stabilizing piece laterally supports a bearing screw and the external resisting channel steel, the external resisting channel steel can be subjected to shock absorption and anti-seismic when being stretched by external force, and natural buffering and resetting are performed under the support of the cable-stayed type stabilizing piece, and post-disaster restoration is not needed.

title_en: Method for evaluating damage condition of equipment of sewage treatment plant in flood
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method of damage conditions of equipment of a sewage treatment plant in flood, aiming at the problem that the damage conditions of extremely complicated equipment in the sewage treatment plant after the flood are difficult to accurately and truly evaluate by artificial subjective judgment, according to the principle of easy acquisition and representativeness, the appearance damage grade, the equipment integrity grade, the water inlet damage grade and other damage grades are selected as the evaluation indexes of the damage conditions of the equipment, and an equipment damage evaluation system of the sewage treatment plant after the flood is constructed. And grading the 4 state indexes according to an index evaluation principle, and quantitatively assigning values to the evaluation grades. On the basis, the influence of the equipment short plate problem on the normal operation of the equipment is considered according to the wooden barrel theory, the damaged condition of the equipment is comprehensively and quantitatively evaluated by adopting a mathematical model, and the treatment measures of the damaged equipment are determined according to the evaluation result. The method can reasonably judge the treatment measures of the original equipment, promote the orderly implementation of the project and provide a basis for scientific estimation of the post-disaster restoration and reconstruction project investment.
assignees: SHAANXI INST OF URBAN & RURAL PLANNING AND DESIGN

title_en: Automatic restoration system and method for abnormal data of asset account of power grid equipment
abstract_en: An automatic restoration system for abnormal data of an asset account of power grid equipment comprises a power grid asset data management module, an abnormal data positioning and marking module, an abnormal data clustering analysis module and an abnormal data automatic restoration module, wherein when the system is operated, the power grid asset data management module acquires the original data information of the power grid equipment assets from an external system, the abnormal data positioning and marking module identifies and marks abnormal fields in the original data, and determining the data abnormal type and the associated field corresponding to each abnormal field, then constructing a weighted clustering algorithm model by the abnormal data clustering analysis module based on the marked abnormal field, carrying out clustering analysis on the marked abnormal field according to the data abnormal type to form a plurality of abnormal classified data sets, and finally adopting a corresponding repairing scheme to carry out abnormal data repairing by the abnormal data automatic repairing module aiming at each abnormal classified data set. The design realizes rapid, accurate and reliable positioning detection and repair of the abnormal data of the asset ledger of the power grid equipment.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID HUBEI POWER CO LTD;WUHAN EASY MORNING CREEPING SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Electricity stealing prevention analog simulation system and method based on digital simulation and physical scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-electricity-stealing analog simulation system and method based on digital simulation and a real scene, and relates to the field of electricity stealing of a power grid. The existing simulation means can not meet the increasing diversification trend, and the simulation environment of large scale, system level and complex environment is lacked; the system comprises a control center, a physical scene control device, a digital simulator, a data application analysis module and an acquisition simulation module, wherein the control center is connected with the physical scene control device, the digital simulator and the data application analysis module; the technical scheme adopts a simulation technology of mixing digital and real objects, provides a practical training environment consistent with the field for the specialties of electricity stealing prevention, electricity utilization inspection and the like, and meets all-round technical training and application training of model operation, system operation, equipment application and the like. And the real restoration of various electricity stealing scenes is realized through a digital simulation technology.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LTD MEASUREMENT CENTER;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ZHEJIANG HUAYUN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mountain ecological restoration treatment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain ecological restoration treatment method, which comprises the steps of dividing a mountain to be restored according to height and gradient, wherein the mountain at least comprises a top platform, a slope and/or a slope toe; the gradient of the top platform is adjusted and the top platform is repaired; pouring lattice beams and carrying out vegetation planting on the processed slope based on the lattice beams; constructing a toe and communicating the lattice beams. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the dual functions of stabilizing the side slope and ecologically coordinating, so that the landslide and the water and soil loss risk are lower, and the plants do not need to be frequently fertilized and watered manually, thereby effectively saving the labor cost.
assignees: POWERCHINA CHONGQING ENG CORP LTD;WUHAN BOTANICAL GARDEN CAS;CHONGQING INST GREEN & INTELLIGENT TECH CAS

title_en: Ecological restoration system and method for geological disaster prevention and control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polluted water body restoration treatment, in particular to an ecological restoration system and method for geological disaster prevention and control.
