The ecological restoration system comprises: the sedimentation tank is provided with a first water inlet in the middle part of the sedimentation tank, and an overflow port is arranged at the top of the sedimentation tank; the supernatant overflowed from the overflow port can enter the first biological treatment tank or the second biological treatment tank under the action of the switching baffle plate; the first disinfection tank is provided with a first water outlet at the lower part of the first biological treatment tank, and the first water outlet is connected into the first disinfection tank through a first filter tube; and the second disinfection tank is provided with a second water outlet at the lower part of the second biological treatment tank, and the second water outlet is connected into the second disinfection tank through a second filter tube. Can effectively remove sediment which invades the water body, reduce the contents of organic matters and pathogenic microorganisms in the water body, and further reduce the ecological environment recovery time of the polluted water body.

title_en: River submerged plant recovery method based on flow velocity regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of river vegetation restoration of hydraulic engineering, and particularly relates to a river submerged plant restoration method based on flow rate regulation, which comprises the steps of measuring adaptive threshold values Vu and Vs of flow rate of tilapia, dynamically regulating and controlling water supplementing quantity in combination with a hydrodynamic model MIKE, constructing flow rate gradient of an rapid flow region Vu and a slow flow region Vs, realizing space isolation by utilizing flow rate adaptive difference of fish and plants, and simultaneously introducing snakeheads and benthos to form ecological cooperative control. The invention solves the problems that the traditional enclosing method hinders flood discharge and the fish-preventing device is easy to damage, and constructs the rapid flow area and the slow flow area through the water supplementing quantity regulation and control, thereby replacing the traditional physical blocking device, solving the contradiction between flood discharge safety and fish control, enhancing flood discharge safety and reducing maintenance cost.

title_en: Data management device, data division device, and data restoration device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reduce the possibility of data losses due to disasters or troubles while maintaining confidentiality under a secrete dispersion law.SOLUTION: A data management device 10 creates divided data of cipher text in addition to divided data of plain text used under a well-known secrete dispersion law, and stores the divided data of plain text and the divided data of cipher text in storage devices 301 to 305. If there are k pieces or more of divided data of plain text, the original data can be restored, and if there l pieces or more of divided data of cipher text, the original data can be restored. A threshold value l used in restoring the original data from the divided data of cipher text is smaller than a threshold value k used in restoring the original data from the divided data of plain text. The data management device 10 normally restores the original data from the divided data of plain text, but if the number of the divided data of plain text is less than the threshold value k, the original dada is restored from the divided data of cipher text.

title_ko: 악취, 역류차단 배관
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technique for blocking backflow and blocking bad smells and insects and, more specifically, to a technique capable of playing a role of flooding prevention when a blocking film of a window frame of an underground home or an outdoor door is installed together. Damage is increasing each year by typhoons and flooding in the rainy season. Heavy rain caused by global warming causes countless disasters of flooding in lowland apartments and underground parking lots and causes property losses and taxes for restoration. The backflow prevention technique may contribute to the alleviation of future disasters. The technique may have value as intellectual property. And the patented flooding prevention apparatus of the inventor of the present invention is expected to be realized together.
abstract_ko:
역류차단과 악취와 벌레들을 차단시키는 기술이며 옥외 문이나 지하가구 창틀의 차단막이 함께 설치가 되면 침수차단의 역활을 할 수가 있는 기술이며 우기 때 태풍과 홍수로 해마다 피해가 늘어나고 있고 온난화로 인한 폭우가 저지대 노후된 아파트 민가 등 지하 주차장까지 셀 수 없는 재난을 당하고 재산상의 손실과 복구에 대한 혈세가 너무 많이 발생하고 있고 그 대처법으로 미약하나마 앞으로 일어날 재해에 역류차단의 기술이 기여할 수 있는 발명으로 거듭나기를 바라고 이 기술이 지적자산으로서의 가치가 발생되기를 바라며 발명한 기술이다 
그리고 본 발명자의 특허등록된 침수차단 장치가 함께 실현되기를 기대한다.

title_en: System and method for collecting data during occurrence of disaster
abstract_en: The present invention comprises: a first processing unit that collects data including power distribution information including the position of a power distribution system and/or equipment and the power distribution state of the power distribution system and/or equipment; a second processing unit that calculates an area in a power outage state to be restored, on the basis of the position and power distribution state of the power distribution system and/or equipment included in the data; and a third processing unit that determines the timing of executing a restoration plan creation application for the area on the basis of the typhoon passage status of the area obtained by using area weather information, the status of generation of accident points indicating locations in the power outage state in the area, and the status of collecting the data including power distribution information.

title_en: System and Method for Providing Power Distribution System Information
abstract_en: A system, method and computer program product for processing utility data of a power grid is provided. In one embodiment, the system includes a datamart comprised of a plurality of physical databases storing utility data, a plurality of applications comprising an automated meter application configured to process power usage data from a plurality of automated meters, a power outage application configured to identify a location of a power outage, and a power restoration application configured to identify a location of a power restoration. The system may include an analysis engine comprising a plurality of analysis objects with each analysis object configured to process data to provide a specific analysis, wherein said analysis engine is accessible via one or more of the plurality of applications, and the system may include a report module configured to receive an output from the analysis engine and to output a report. The plurality of applications may also include a fault analysis application, a transformer analysis application, a theft detection application, a power flow application, a substation automation application, a load shed application and others.

title_en: Method for quickly recovering power grid after earthquake disaster under V2G auxiliary support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly recovering a power grid after an earthquake disaster under V2G auxiliary support, which comprises the following steps: establishing a power distribution network element fault rate model, and generating a power distribution network fault scene under the earthquake disaster through random sampling; based on the travel characteristics of the EV and the travel demand of the user, travel data are fitted by adopting a travel chain theory, and an EV scheduling model in the early stage of the disaster is built on the basis of a power distribution network fault scene; based on a consumer psychology theory, bringing an EV scheduling model in the early stage of a disaster into consideration of post-disaster response selection behaviors of EV users, formulating a post-disaster reverse transmission incentive response mechanism, guiding the EV to participate in power supply recovery, and obtaining the output of each V2G station; considering power distribution network reconstruction and V2G station reverse charging, and establishing a power distribution network reconstruction alternating current optimal power flow model considering two-dimensional cone constraints; and solving the reconstructed AC optimal power flow model of the distribution network to obtain an optimal reconstructed power supply recovery scheme. The invention improves the restoring force of the power grid after earthquake disaster and the economical efficiency of power supply restoration.

title_en: Lake optimal water level determination method considering coexistence relation of water level and hydrologic connectivity
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of water resource planning and management, in particular to a lake optimal water level determination method considering the coexistence relation of water level and hydrologic connectivity. The method comprises the steps of analyzing and processing remote sensing images of a set lake to obtain hydrologic connectivity data, obtaining water level data of the set lake, calculating correlation coefficients between hydrologic connectivity and water levels, judging correlation between hydrologic connectivity and water level series, respectively constructing edge distribution functions of hydrologic connectivity and water levels, obtaining joint probability distribution functions of hydrologic connectivity and water levels by using Copula functions, setting different water supplementing situations of hydrologic connectivity and water levels by combining lake water supplementing management requirements and ecological restoration targets, and determining the optimal lake water level by using joint probability and conditional probability analysis. The invention considers the coexistence relation between the water level and hydrologic connectivity and the uncertainty of the coexistence relation on the water supplementing management, determines the optimal water level of the lake, and provides a quantitative basis for the water supplementing management of the lake.

title_en: Modeling method and system for regional water resource ecological safety evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modeling method and a system for ecological safety evaluation of regional water resources, which relate to the technical field of mountain water resource management, the system obtains the current situation of regional water resources, timely discovers subareas with insufficient groundwater supply, and constructing and evaluating a mining intensity coefficient Kc through a water resource evaluation model constructed by a convolutional neural network model CNN, screening out sub-areas with excessive mining, and adopting corresponding regulation and control measures, such as limiting the mining intensity, so as to avoid the burden of the ecological environment and water resources caused by excessive mining. The ecological environment and water quality data are acquired, an ecological pressure coefficient Ep of the subarea is generated, and the subarea with higher ecological damage risk is found in time by combining a pressure early warning threshold value. The system generates corresponding water resource exploitation regulation and control modes by combining the first important monitoring group, the second important monitoring group and the third important monitoring group, and promotes sustainable management and ecological restoration of water resources in the area.

title_en: But prosthetic combination column base of normal position
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti -seismic performance better and shake after can quick prosthetic but prosthetic combination column base of normal position, connect including steel sheet bucket, one end the attenuator of steel sheet bucket lateral surface and with the connecting plate of the other end connection of attenuator, connecting plate fixed mounting with on the corresponding grade beam of reinforced concrete column, the attenuator has detachable mild steel board, the mild steel board is vertical to be placed. Through setting up attenuator (mild steel board), it is better relatively owing to plasticity as the mild steel board of attenuator power consumption board when taking place the small earthquake, can produce to concentrate and warp, absorb most seismic energy, when the strong earthquake of emergence, the mild steel board produces cuts the surrender, consumes seismic energy, protects reinforced concrete column not take place destruction or collapse well, and anti -seismic performance is better, simultaneously, because the mild steel board detachable, after strong earthquake, can take off the replacement with impaired mild steel board and be undamaged mild steel board, realize shaking the quick restoration in back.
assignees: UNIV HUAQIAO;XM SPECIAL REAL ESTATE CONSTRUCT ENGINEERING GROUP COMPANY LTD

title_en: Be used for prosthetic green slope protection structure of planting of geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of geological disaster treatment, in particular to a green plant slope protection structure for geological disaster restoration, which comprises a fixed seat fixed on a hillside, wherein the outer wall of the fixed seat is fixedly connected with a rock plate, one end of the rock plate far away from the fixed seat is fixedly connected with a protection plate, the bottom of the protection plate penetrates through the ground and extends to the interior of a mountain body, and a clamping groove is arranged between the fixed seat and the protection plate at the bottom of the rock plate; let fixing base, form a whole between guard plate and the massif, increased the firm degree of bank protection bottom, the rethread guard plate blocks the soil of slope body top, slows down the impact force of the downward landing of soil to green plant the layer to on the fixing base and protect, protected ecological environment, the rethread guard plate supports the soil of slope body top, the guard plate has played the effect of accepting, can effectually alleviate the landslide phenomenon that soil on the slope body is landing and causes downwards.

title_en: Suburb type river and lake ecological buffer zone
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural non-point source treatment and ecological restoration of rivers and lakes, and provides a suburb type ecological buffer zone for the rivers and the lakes. The planting method comprises a planting area positioned in a river and lake bank zone, wherein the planting area comprises a plurality of planting units, and each planting unit is closed loop through a first ecological water permeable brick; a regulating and accumulating well is arranged in the interval area between the planting units, and the regulating and accumulating well is communicated with the planting units; and a purification ditch is arranged at one side of the planting area along the river and lake bank zone, and is communicated with the regulation well and the river channel or the lake. Aiming at the situation that small villages and small micro-riverways and lakes with river flood control and drainage functions are not received, and the land zone is used for reclamation to be a planting field, the river and lake buffer system is constructed, the land zone non-point source pollution is effectively intercepted, the land zone landscape of the river and lake is improved, and meanwhile the original agricultural production function is considered.
assignees: JIANGSU PROVINCIAL ENVIRONMENTAL ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster power grid outage and restoration monitoring method based on night lamplight satellite remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster power grid outage and restoration monitoring method based on night lamplight satellite remote sensing data, which comprises the following steps of: step 1, determining the longitude and latitude of a geographic boundary and the monitoring time span of a monitored area; step 2, acquiring a night lamplight remote sensing data set of a monitoring area for data processing to obtain a night lamplight matrix set and a quality marking matrix set; step 3, introducing the night light matrix set and the quality mark matrix set as inputs into an aggregation algorithm and executing to obtain an aggregation night light matrix; and 4, performing data visualization expression on the aggregate night light matrix to obtain a night light change curve of the monitoring area in the monitoring time span, and monitoring the power failure event and the recovery process. The invention meets the requirements of power failure and recovery process observation after urban disaster, and is favorable for promoting the research of urban disaster resistance; can provide references for local government and policy makers, and is beneficial to supporting disaster response and restoration decisions.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering ecological slope protection maintenance method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering ecological slope protection maintenance method which comprises the steps of carrying out comprehensive physical inspection on a slope surface of the slope protection, adopting a sample method or unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing to evaluate vegetation coverage degree, detecting physical properties and chemical properties of slope protection soil, inspecting the growth change of the slope protection vegetation, the stability condition of the slope surface and the running condition of a drainage system, carrying out vegetation maintenance, optimizing an irrigation strategy and a fertilization strategy by using a genetic algorithm, regularly trimming the vegetation, reinforcing the slope surface when the slope surface is slightly loosened or cracked, timely repairing the slope surface when the slope surface is damaged by great damage, carrying out inspection and maintenance on the drainage system, carrying out pest control on the slope protection vegetation, and carrying out monitoring and ecological restoration on the surrounding environment of the slope protection. The method can find potential slope problems and vegetation changes in time, has scientific decision basis and advanced technical means in the operations of watering, fertilizing, pest control and the like in maintenance measures, and avoids resource waste and negative influence on the environment.

title_en: Power supply sequence recovery method for cooperation of urban idle resources and emergency resources in extreme scene
abstract_en: The application provides a power supply sequence recovery method for cooperation of urban idle resources and emergency resources under an extreme scene, which comprises the steps of constructing a first scheduling model of available electric vehicles based on the first number of electric vehicles reaching a parking lot during a fault period, constructing a second scheduling model of a mobile energy storage vehicle based on a road impedance model and a time-varying congestion coefficient under the extreme scene delay, constructing an emergency repair team model based on a fault interrupt line, constructing a multi-source cooperation power supply active supporting model taking the sum of load loss cost and each resource scheduling cost as an objective function based on the first scheduling model, the second scheduling model and the emergency repair team model, solving the multi-source cooperation power supply active supporting model, and determining a power supply recovery sequence. The multi-source cooperative power supply active support model comprising the sum of the scheduling cost of each resource is constructed to participate in the power distribution network support power supply, so that the load rapid support power supply and the rapid recovery of a fault line are realized.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD ZHAOQING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;UNIV HUNAN

title_en: Dynamic wetland ecological restoration monitoring method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic monitoring method for wetland ecological restoration based on deep learning, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration and comprises the following steps of acquiring multisource wetland ecological sensor data and remote sensing image streams in real time, constructing a space-time fusion data cube, extracting ecological feature tensors, carrying out degradation mode analysis on the ecological feature tensors to generate an ecological state dynamic topological graph, calculating an ecological connectivity index, carrying out restoration demand identification based on the ecological connectivity index, positioning a degradation hot spot area through a multisystem image convolution network to generate a restoration priority area coordinate set, and constructing a full-flow technical system for intelligently optimizing a restoration scheme from ecological state dynamic perception through multisource data space-time fusion and deep learning and landscape ecology, thereby effectively solving the pain points such as data scale mismatch, degradation area positioning ambiguity, restoration path ecological suitability difference, multi-target cooperative difficulty and the like in traditional wetland restoration.
assignees: THE SECOND EXPLOR TEAM OF SHANDONG COALFIELD GEOLOGY BUREAU

title_en: Anti-scouring grass planting system for hydro-fluctuation belt, preparation method and application thereof, and method for repairing damaged ecological system in steep slope area of hydro-fluctuation belt of lake and reservoir
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration, and particularly relates to a composite grass planting system, a preparation method and application thereof, and a restoration method of a damaged ecological system in a steep slope area of a hydro-fluctuation belt of a lake and a reservoir. The composite grass planting blanket provided by the invention mainly takes the degradable biomass material as the raw material, does not cause secondary pollution to the environment in the use process, can well improve the water retention property of the composite grass planting blanket through the layer structure design, is beneficial to vegetation growth, has good erosion resistance, and prolongs the service life of the composite grass planting blanket. When the composite grass planting blanket is used for repairing the steep slope area of the hydro-fluctuation belt of the lake and the reservoir, the steep slope area of the hydro-fluctuation belt of the lake and the reservoir is divided into a constant inundation area, a stormy wave erosion area and a slight inundation area, and different kinds of plants are planted in different areas, so that the survival rate of the plants is ensured, the water and soil loss is reduced, and the ecological repairing is effectively realized.

title_en: Active power distribution network distributed fault recovery method based on section sequential recovery evaluation
abstract_en: The invention relates to an active power distribution network distributed fault recovery method based on section sequence recovery evaluation, firstly, comprehensively considering the roles of source charges in the recovery process, and quantifying the recovery value of the load and the supporting potential of the distributed power supply. And secondly, extracting potential information of the downstream section to be restored by multiple layers, establishing a local rolling optimization framework based on a model predictive control idea, and improving the prospective and global optimality of a distributed fault restoration decision. And finally, introducing rapid tide calculation to carry out feasibility verification before each step of decision, and ensuring that the recovery scheme meets the actual operation constraint of the power grid. The design method comprehensively considers regional endogenous load and distributed recovery characteristics, provides a fault recovery method combining comprehensive regional recovery value evaluation with a prospective optimization decision framework, and achieves faster, stable, efficient and reliable power supply recovery of the power distribution network in a distributed environment.

title_en: A kind of power distribution network dynamic power restoration method based on load curve
abstract_en: Based on a power distribution network dynamic power restoration method for load curve, belong to technical field of power distribution system automation.The present invention utilizes computer, pass through program, first input basic parameter, calculate meritorious, the load or burden without work of each node each hour again and determine grid structure when normally running, determine the grid structure after the supply path of fault section and mains side and Fault Isolation, then candidate's grid structure set of each hour minimum mistake load during using traditional genetic algorithm determination fault restoration, the optimum dynamic power recovery scheme during finally determining fault restoration.The present invention makes full use of load curve, formulate Dynamic-Recovery scheme by the hour, grid structure is changed with load variations during fault restoration, thus there is the power supply interrupted district that can effectively reduce because fault causes, shorten customer outage hours, reduce the features such as Custom interruption cost.The present invention can be widely used in power distribution network service restoration.

title_en: Power grid measurement data checking method and system based on artificial intelligence algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid measurement data checking method and system based on an artificial intelligence algorithm, comprising the following steps: step S1, acquiring electric quantity data of equipment in each link to obtain an initial data set; step S2, preprocessing the collected initial data set to obtain a training data set; s3, constructing an abnormal data identification model based on One-Class SVM; s4, constructing an abnormal data restoration model according to a ridge regression algorithm; s5, inputting the data to be checked into a trained abnormal data identification model, identifying abnormal data points, and repairing the data to be repaired by using an abnormal data repairing model to obtain repaired data; and S6, fitting the probability density function of the repaired data, and comparing the fitted probability density function with the distribution characteristics of the original data to evaluate the repairing effect. The method can effectively identify and repair abnormal data, improve the quality and reliability of the data, and provide important support for power grid operation and management.

title_en: Multi-target library real-time data synchronization method for electric power metering
abstract_en: The invention provides a power metering-oriented multi-target library real-time data synchronization method which comprises the steps of constructing a metering data dependency model based on a power load curve theory, optimizing a multi-target scheduling strategy by utilizing an improved non-dominant sorting genetic algorithm, processing power data by applying an intelligent slicing and mixed compression strategy, executing synchronization based on a multi-level buffering strategy and a batch writing algorithm, and implementing multi-dimensional consistency verification and generating a layered restoration scheme. The scheme realizes the real-time synchronization of the power metering data with high efficiency, high reliability and low resource consumption, and provides a high-quality data base for the power grid dispatching decision.

title_en: Novel ecological restoration structure for high-steep side slope and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel high-steep slope ecological restoration structure and a construction method thereof, wherein the novel high-steep slope ecological restoration structure comprises a slope stabilizing base unit, a soil nail anchoring assembly and a dynamic permeable guard plate, the surface of the slope stabilizing base unit is covered with an ecological base material layer, the slope stabilizing base unit comprises a plurality of anti-slip stabilizing slope modules distributed along a slope surface array, each anti-slip stabilizing slope module comprises a rigid supporting body, a mortise part is formed on the outer surface of one side of each rigid supporting body, a continuous anti-slip action surface is formed on the inner surface of the other opposite side of each rigid supporting body, the adjacent rigid supporting body is connected with the mortise part through the tenon part in an embedded mode, the soil nail anchoring assembly is connected with the rigid supporting body through a telescopic permeable connecting piece, and the telescopic permeable connecting piece comprises an elastic energy storage supporting assembly and a water absorption expansion body. According to the invention, by constructing the slope stabilizing matrix unit, the ecological restoration effect of the slope is greatly improved, and the occurrence risk of geological disasters such as landslide is reduced.

title_en: Roof of korean style house having against earthquake function and korean style house having roof of korean style house having against earthquake function
title_ko: 지진대비 기능을 갖는 한옥의 지붕 및 지진대비 기능을 갖는 지붕이 구비된 한옥
abstract_en: According to the present invention, when an earthquake occurs, a Korean style house structure is totally moved to reduce vibration and shock transmission. Therefore, damage to the Korean style house structure is minimized, and a position of the moved Korean style house structure can be easily moved at an original position to secure restoration properties. Moreover, provided are a roof of a Korean style house having an earthquake proof function and a Korean style house having the roof of a Korean style house having an earthquake proof function, which can secure durability by forming a roof tile structure with weak durability of a roof with waterproof and vibration proof functions to secure durability, and can easily determine whether following reinforcement is needed by accurately and conveniently performing durability determination of a column.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 지진 발생시 한옥 구조물이 전체적으로 이동되어 진동 및 충격 전달이 감소됨에 따라 한옥 구조물의 손상이 최소화되고, 이동된 한옥 구조물의 위치를 쉽게 정위치할 수 있음에 따라 복원성이 확보된다. 또한, 내구성이 취약한 지붕의 기와 구조를 방수 및 방진 가능하게 구성하여 내구성이 확보되고, 기둥의 내구성 판단을 정확하고 간편하게 수행하여 추후 보강 판단 여부가 용이한 지진대비 기능을 갖는 한옥의 지붕 및 지진대비 기능을 갖는 지붕이 구비된 한옥이 소개된다.

title_en: Self-healing control method for urban power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-healing method for urban distribution networks. The method comprises the following steps: (1) defining a system state function with respect to voltage, current, active power and reactive power, and setting ranges of a function value in an emergency state, a function value in a restoring state, a function value in an error state, a function value in an alert state and a function value in a safe state; (2) acquiring an electric capacity parameter;(3) calculating the function value of the state function, comparing the function value with the system set function values and carrying out related control processing steps according to the results of the comparison; (4) emergency control processing; (5) restoring control processing; (6) calibrating control processing; and (7) prevention control processing. The method carries out hierarchical control on the operation state of the urban distribution network and makes the urban distribution network be capable of self-prevention, self-restoration and handling extreme disasters and big power grid emergencies and improves the reliability of the urban distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Silt reducing system for drainage beach of artificial ditch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drainage beach silt reducing system of an artificial ditch, which belongs to the technical field of coastal wetland ecological restoration, is arranged at the side of a silt beach of an open sea and comprises a water injection ditch, a drainage passage, an outer wall and a water injection system, wherein the water injection ditch is arranged on the land behind the silt beach, the water injection system is matched with the water injection ditch to always inject water into the water injection ditch, the outer wall is arranged at two sides of the water injection ditch, water in the water injection ditch is drained to the beaches at two sides through the drainage passage, fine-particle mud in the drainage passage is started and moved under the action of water flow and is output along with the leaving shoal flow during the ebb period, and the beach is prevented from being argillized. The invention effectively adjusts the action of waves and tides through the ditches which are excavated manually so as to reduce natural disasters; the coastal wetland can effectively degrade pollution and restore the original ecological system and natural balance mechanism; through ecological restoration, the diversity of species is increased. Provides a good foundation for further building leisure tourism and inhabitation facilities and provides a foundation for developing the tourism industry.

title_en: Two-stage power distribution network post-disaster rush repair scheduling and load recovery collaborative optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage power distribution network post-disaster rush repair scheduling and load recovery collaborative optimization method and a two-stage power distribution network post-disaster repair scheduling and load recovery collaborative optimization system, which are used for evaluating the element damage condition of a power distribution system; partitioning the fault points; performing primary recovery by using a distributed power supply, establishing a nonlinear programming model of the primary recovery to obtain a linearized network reconstruction model, and solving to obtain a load recovery result of a first stage without considering a maintenance process as an initial recovery result; and solving a cooperative optimization model of allocation and load recovery of the first-aid repair personnel by taking the maximum load recovery amount and the minimum repair time as targets to obtain a network reconstruction time sequence change process, a first-aid repair personnel advancing line and a load recovery sequence result of a second stage of maintenance scheduling, which are taken into consideration, and taking the results as final results for guiding operating personnel to carry out post-disaster recovery to realize cooperative optimization. The invention improves the recovery capability of the power distribution network after disaster, reduces the downtime and economic loss and enhances the recovery force of the distribution system.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Preparation method of composition for ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a composition for ecological restoration, and relates to the technical field of ecological restoration. The preparation method of the composition for ecological restoration comprises the following specific raw materials: dry clay, animal waste, crop straws, farmyard plant ash, rotten vegetable leaves, soybean cakes, organic-organic composite flocculant, phosphogypsum and grass seeds. Through adopting common material, both acquireing easily, also can realizing the utilization of wastes material simultaneously, can also promoting the growth of grass seed, treat grass seed germination, growth back, can make naked massif or the domatic regreening of rock fast, form the bank protection lawn, both can play ecological remediation effect, also can utilize plant roots to keep soil and water simultaneously to play and prevent geological disasters such as massif landslide or mud-rock flow.

title_en: Main network overhauls single flow intelligence processing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a main network overhaul single-flow intelligent processing system which comprises a main network overhaul single-processing unit, an operation ticket processing unit and a command ticket processing unit, wherein all flows of intelligent processing from main network dispatching overhaul application form notification to automatic export power restoration information are completed; the main network overhaul list processing unit comprises a data receiving module, a data drawing module, a data analyzing module and a data training module. By the automatic processing technology of the single overhaul process based on intelligent ticket formation, automatic command sending and automatic permission completion, intelligent error prevention and automatic processing of the full business process of a single overhaul scheduling side are realized, automatic receiving of power failure operation arrival report is completed, automatic command sending power failure is completed, power failure scheduling logs and automatic export power failure information are automatically recorded, automatic permission is completed, automatic receiving of power restoration operation arrival report is automatically received, automatic command sending power restoration is automatically performed, power restoration scheduling logs and automatic export power restoration information are automatically recorded.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU LTD COMPANY

title_en: Delayed power failure punctuality management method based on distribution network operation management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system dispatching operation, in particular to a delay-failure-recovery-power-on-time management method based on a distribution network operation management system. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out stage division on the development progress of the maintenance application work; presetting a delay calculation rule and a reward and punishment rule; establishing a maintenance request form; collecting work development progress information on a maintenance request form; performing punctuality calculation to obtain punctuality data; the reward and punishment rule module calculates and obtains reward and punishment data; and comprehensively displaying the comprehensive indexes of all dimensions. The invention designs the functional arrangement based on the distribution network oms, can automatically track the root cause of delay, and fully reduces the working cost of a dispatcher; by adopting an accurate reward and punishment method, the working enthusiasm of the staff is improved, the on-time of the power failure and restoration is improved, the reliability of the power supply of a user is enhanced, the normal sequence of planned power failure and restoration is maintained, and the safe operation level of a power grid is improved; the automatic statistics and reasonable display of the delay basic data and reward and punishment cashing can be realized, and the edge working pressure of a dispatcher is reduced.
assignees: ZHAOTONG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional digital twin operation management system for real-time analog simulation deduction of sewage treatment
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional digital twin operation management system for carrying out real-time analog simulation deduction on sewage treatment, and relates to the technical field of sewage treatment. The model based on the digital twin technology also realizes scene simulation and restoration of the sewage treatment plant by the atomic system, realizes transparentization and visual management, can centrally manage a plurality of sewage treatment plant areas in multiple areas, realizes unified management, unified allocation and unified operation of water plant resources, and improves resource utilization rate and operation management efficiency. According to the invention, the sewage treatment process is simulated through the process simulation subsystem and the data association subsystem, real-time monitoring data are obtained, real-time simulation deduction is carried out in a virtual three-dimensional digital twin scene, the operation management layer is helped to realize remote and immersive real-time monitoring and management and control without going to the scene, and the management efficiency is improved.
assignees: WUCHAN ZHONGDA PUBLIC ENVIRONMENT INVEST CO LTD

title_en: Urban multi-mode traffic network post-disaster restoration strategy efficiency evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating the efficiency of a post-disaster restoration strategy of an urban multi-mode traffic network, which belong to the technical field of urban traffic operation management and construct a multi-mode traffic network structure model by utilizing road network and public transport network open source data; simulating urban traffic distribution by using traffic travel demand data, and constructing a multi-mode traffic network function model; based on the multimode traffic network function model, constructing a multimode traffic network structure recovery model according to disaster space distribution characteristics and post-disaster network recovery strategies, and evaluating structure recovery efficiency; based on the multi-mode traffic network structure recovery model, the travel demands are reloaded, the multi-mode traffic network function recovery model is constructed, and the function recovery efficiency is evaluated. The invention can comprehensively consider multiple traffic modes and complex dynamic games among travelers, provides more accurate and comprehensive repair strategy evaluation, can enhance the toughness of the urban comprehensive traffic system, and can better cope with various disasters and emergency situations.

title_en: Power grid power failure and restoration monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid power failure and restoration monitoring system and a method, wherein the power grid comprises a plurality of power supply lines, and the power grid power failure and restoration monitoring system comprises: the power grid state acquisition module and the power outage/restoration determination module are used for acquiring power grid states; the power grid state acquisition module is in communication connection with the power outage/restoration determination module; the power grid state acquisition module is used for acquiring the power supply state of each power supply line and sending the power supply state to the power outage/restoration determination module; the power supply state comprises a power failure state and a power restoration state; the power failure/power restoration determining module is used for determining that the power supply line fails when the power supply state is a power failure state and sending a notification of the power failure of the power supply line; and when the power supply state is the power restoration state, determining power restoration of the power supply line and sending a notification of the power restoration of the power supply line. According to the technical scheme, the power grid outage/restoration information can be timely sent to the client, and satisfaction degree of the client on power grid service is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;MEIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power communication network toughness evaluation method and system considering network topology association
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power communication network risk assessment, and in particular relates to a power communication network toughness assessment method and system considering network topology association, comprising the steps of obtaining a power communication super-network based on network topology; the method comprises the steps of performing supernuclear decomposition on an obtained power communication supernetwork, calculating the core centrality of the supernetwork, performing risk prediction on topological nodes of the power communication network by adopting a power communication risk prediction method, calculating the damage probability and the damage form of the power communication network, determining the node importance according to the obtained core centrality, performing node restoration by combining the node importance and the damage form, calculating the performance time response function of the power communication network according to the unblocked state of a network topological link, obtaining the damage toughness evaluation value of the power communication network based on the obtained performance time response function, and completing the evaluation of the toughness of the power communication network.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Automatic partitioning method, device, equipment and medium for power grid recovery after extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automatic power grid partitioning, and particularly relates to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for automatic power grid restoration partitioning after extreme disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a two-dimensional model of a region according to geographic information and meteorological information; the method comprises the steps of taking a power supply building as a node in a two-dimensional model, taking geographic information and meteorological information as attributes of the node, adding fault condition information of a power distribution network into the attributes of the node to obtain an information fusion model, clustering the node according to the attributes of the node based on the information fusion model to obtain clusters, and taking the nodes divided by each cluster center as nodes of the same area. According to the method, the power grid is automatically partitioned according to the types of the power distribution faults, quick rush repair can be conducted according to the types of the power distribution faults after the power grid is partitioned, and the recovery speed of the power grid is high.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Proliferation and release decision control method and system for habitat ecological optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a proliferation and release decision control method and system for habitat ecological optimization. According to the method, firstly, historical release records of different proliferation release areas and corresponding ecological parameter change data are obtained, characteristic association analysis is carried out by utilizing a gradient lifting tree model, and a release-ecological response association network is constructed, so that the influence of different species and release intensity on ecological restoration effects is revealed. And secondly, identifying key ecological factors to be improved by collecting real-time water ecological parameters of the target habitat. And then combining the associated network to determine the proper release species and quantity, and further combining the water quality adaptability data of the selected species to accurately determine the optimal release time point. And finally, a proliferation and release decision strategy is formed, and water quality optimization and ecological balance recovery of the target habitat are realized.
assignees: SOUTH CHINA SEA FISHERIES RES INST CHINESE ACAD FISHERY SCIENCES;BEIHAI MARINE ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT SERVICE CENTER BEIHAI AQUATIC TECH PROMOTION STATION

title_en: Residual displacement restoration mechanism
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a residual displacement restoration mechanism capable of restoring residual displacement of a structure due to an earthquake or the like and suppressing the cost for installation.SOLUTION: A residual displacement restoration mechanism 1 is provided to a base-insulation structure body (base-insulation structure) 11 having a trench 12 supported by soil G, a liquid 13 held in the trench 12, and a structure 14 arranged in the liquid 13 so as to form a clearance 2 with the trench 12, and displaceable in a horizontal direction relatively to the trench 12, and restores residual displacement of the structure 14 from the trench 12. The clearance 2 is divided into a plurality of sections 3, 3, ..., and the liquid 13 is held in the plurality of sections 3, 3, ..., so that when the structure 14 is arranged at a normal position in the trench 12, water levels are equal to one another. The plurality of sections 3, 3, ..., can deform following up horizontal relative displacement of the trench 12 and structure 14, and the liquid 13 is stopped or suppressed from flowing in and out between adjacent sections 3, 3.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Facility operation assistance device, method, and program
abstract_en: The present invention addresses the problem of more accurately executing tasks such as planning in facilities in accordance with the actual situation. In this facility operation assistance device, a power grid restoration planning assistance device 10 for assisting in operating a power grid 2 comprises: a UI unit 15 that receives sensor data 111 regarding the operation of the power grid 2; a data evaluation unit 132 that calculates the degree of certainty of the sensor data 111 as defined by a combination of a plurality of factors associated with the acquisition of the sensor data 111, said degree of certainty of the sensor data 111 indicating the certainty of data of the operation; a data correction unit 133 that corrects the sensor data 111 in accordance with the degree of certainty; and a data saving unit that associates and stores the operation data and the degree of certainty of the operation data in a storage unit. The facility operation assistance device achieves the creation of an operation plan for the facilities using the operation data stored in the storage unit according to the degree of certainty stored in the storage unit.

title_en: Aggregated real-time power outages/restoration reporting (rtpor) in a secure mesh network
abstract_en: Embodiments of the invention provide systems and methods for the reporting of status changes, such as but not limited to power outages and/or power restorations, throughout a smart grid system. Through the use of location-based reporting period selection and/or status change report aggregation, embodiments may provide efficient reporting processes that timely and accurately report status change information from the point(s) of the change to a back-end system via an access point.

title_en: Visual management method and system for power dispatching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual management method and a visual management system for power dispatching, which relate to the technical field of data processing, and comprise the following steps: acquiring a plurality of repair data sets of a target power company; the input data access module performs data analysis to obtain a plurality of demand direction label sets; constructing a first constraint condition according to the manpower condition of a target power company; constructing a second constraint condition according to the plurality of demand direction label sets; obtaining a plurality of rush repair scheduling schemes; according to the first constraint condition, the second constraint condition and the index parameter sets of the multiple first-aid repair scheduling schemes, performing double-term optimization on the multiple first-aid repair scheduling schemes to obtain an optimal first-aid repair scheduling scheme; and inputting the visual information into a visual display module for visual rush repair scheduling management. The invention solves the technical problems of long feedback period and low management efficiency of power dispatching in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of improving the timeliness of power dispatching management, carrying out management visualization and improving the management efficiency.

title_en: Comprehensive investigation and evaluation method for mine geological environment influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive investigation and evaluation method for mine geological environment influence, which is beneficial to comprehensively evaluating the target mine in multiple aspects based on 6 factors of mine geological disasters, land resource occupation damage, water resource damage, water environment damage, earth and stone environment damage and landform landscape damage by analyzing the comprehensive sampling data. The comprehensive investigation and evaluation method for the mine geological environment influence disclosed by the invention can obtain the comprehensive evaluation result about the mine geological environment according to the environmental data in multiple aspects, is favorable for the accuracy of the mine geological environment evaluation, and is favorable for providing basis for the later development of mine ecological protection and restoration engineering.

title_en: Power distribution network fault line restoration method and system considering extreme weather oscillation stage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for repairing a fault line of a power distribution network by considering an extreme weather oscillation stage, and belongs to the field of power system optimization operation; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power distribution network line information, and acquiring time nodes of an extreme weather final oscillation stage and power distribution network line fault information; constructing constraint conditions of operation of the power distribution network; according to the power distribution network line information, a virtual network with the same topological structure as the original network of the power distribution network is established by combining a single commodity flow method, and a power distribution network reconstruction constraint condition based on the virtual network is obtained; constructing an objective function of a fault line repair model considering generalized resource time scheduling in an extreme weather oscillation stage; establishing constraint conditions of a fault line repair model considering generalized resource time scheduling in an extreme weather oscillation stage; and solving a fault line repair model considering the generalized resource time scheduling in the extreme weather oscillation stage to obtain a generalized maintenance resource time scheduling scheme of the fault line in the extreme weather oscillation stage.

title_en: Method and device for determining proper threshold value for river basin vegetation restoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of river basin vegetation restoration and discloses a method and a device for determining a proper threshold value of river basin vegetation restoration, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining reference carbon fixation and emission reduction corresponding to a river basin reference scenario scheme in a target river basin and carbon fixation and emission reduction caused by vegetation restoration corresponding to the river basin vegetation restoration scheme; the carbon sequestration emission reduction caused by vegetation restoration comprises total water energy carbon emission reduction, total vegetation carbon sequestration and total karst carbon sequestration, a carbon sequestration objective function is constructed based on standard carbon sequestration emission reduction and vegetation restoration induced carbon sequestration emission reduction, wherein the carbon sequestration objective function takes natural constraint and vegetation restoration construction constraint as constraint conditions, and the carbon sequestration objective function is solved to obtain a proper threshold value for river basin vegetation restoration. The method can quickly and reliably calculate the proper scale of the river basin vegetation construction, provides scientific and technological support for the river basin water carbon resource simulation, evaluation, regulation and control and vegetation construction planning, and has important significance for realizing the 'double carbon' target.

title_en: Method and device for seismic strengthening of shape memory alloy pipe networks
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and device for seismic strengthening of shape memory alloy pipe networks, and the method and device provided by the invention are used for reducing the tensile stress and bending stress of pipelines in earthquakes, dissipating the earthquake input energy, decreasing the earthquake reaction of pipe networks and protecting the pipe networks from being damaged and destroyed under the action of the earthquake. The device provided by the invention is composed of pipelines, a fixed connecting piece flange, a pipeline flange, a pipeline connecting bolt, a shape memory alloy bar and a shape memory alloy bar connecting bolt, wherein the pipelines are connected with the pipeline flange; the pipeline flange is connected with the pipeline connecting bolt; the fixed connecting piece flange is positioned at two sides of the pipeline flange, and is connected with the shape memory alloy bar; and the shape memory alloy bar is connected with the shape memory alloy bar connecting bolt. The method and device provided by the invention have the advantages that the earthquake input energy is dissipated, the pipeline earthquake reaction is decreased, and the nonoccurrence of damage and destroy of the pipelines under the action of earthquake is prevented; and after the earthquake, because the shape memory alloy has the capability of self restoration, the deformation of the pipelines is reset automatically without any maintenance and replacement.

title_en: A kind of power network restorability appraisal procedure based on multi-agent Technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power network restorability appraisal procedure based on multi-agent Technology, it includes：The dynamic frame model of the power network restorability evaluation factor based on multiple agent is built, dynamic frame model at least includes restorability index intelligent body alliance, pregnant calamity ambient intelligence body alliance and supporting body intelligent body alliance；The intelligent body assessment models matched with each intelligent body alliance are set up respectively, the intelligent body assessment models can carry out typing to the electric network information in default monitoring area in advance and repeat following processes untill the power system restoration normal power supply of disaster area in identified assessment time interval after there is disaster, the process is to obtain disaster-stricken data in real time, restorability is scored and preserved after carrying out data abstraction to disaster area power network the present situation, while carrying out recovery action to disaster area power network by rule base.The present invention realizes the real-time dynamic evaluation to the restorability of fault recovery this dynamic process.

title_en: Power distribution and utilization low-voltage measurement data abnormal missing repairing method for service center station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution and utilization low-voltage measurement data abnormal missing repairing method for a service center platform, which comprises the following steps of: step 1, constructing a power utilization data matrix; step 2, recording a position set of missing data in the electricity utilization data matrix; step 3, constructing a pre-filling model, and pre-filling missing data in the electricity utilization data matrix in the step 1; step 4, clustering the electricity utilization data matrix pre-filled in the step 3; step 5, establishing matrix kernel norm and L 1 A norm joint optimization electricity utilization data low-rank restoration model; step 6, solving the matrix kernel norm sum L 1 And (5) obtaining a power utilization data matrix after secondary restoration by using the norm combined optimized power utilization data low-rank restoration model. The invention can obtain higher-precision recovery data through low-rank matrix recovery, and effectively improve the data quality of the information acquisition system in the power distribution service.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Control device and control method for GIM engineering project
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a control device for a Grid Information Model (GIM) engineering project, the control device including: the decompression device is used for decompressing and analyzing the GIM compressed file so as to obtain a GIM level and a GIM equipment model; the analysis device is used for analyzing the GIM levels step by step so as to obtain the nesting relation between the GIM levels and the GIM equipment model; calculating means for calculating a GIM equipment model instance by using the GIM equipment model and a nesting relationship of the GIM hierarchy and the GIM equipment model; and the restoration device is used for restoring the three-dimensional engineering scene based on the GIM equipment model instance. Embodiments of the present disclosure also relate to a control method, a control apparatus, a storage medium, and a program product for a GIM engineering project. The invention simultaneously supports a control platform end and a Web end and supports lightweight display of a large-volume model item level. By the method and the device, hierarchical management display can be performed on the three-dimensional design GIM result of the power engineering, editing and repairing of the three-dimensional result based on the GIM format are realized, and a bottom foundation is established for subsequent national network GIM three-dimensional application and even digital twins.

title_en: Power grid enterprise warehousing and distribution network optimization method based on improved genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid enterprise storage and distribution network optimization method based on an improved genetic algorithm, which comprises the steps of coding, establishing a planning model, collecting relevant information of storage and distribution of a region to be planned, coding a region library RDC, a turnover library FDC and a demand unit, generating a total network, namely a chromosome according to a supply and demand relationship, and establishing the planning model; copying, namely copying the chromosome to obtain a population; dividing, namely performing local network division on genes of each chromosome in the population; before mutation operation is carried out, local network division is carried out on each chromosome in the population, effective mutation occurs in the local network according to the division result, and network restoration is carried out on the result after the mutation and the crossover through multiple constraint conditions, so that invalid mutation and crossover can be effectively reduced, the calculation amount is reduced, and the efficiency of storage and distribution network optimization is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network rush-repair method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network rush-repair electricity method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: firstly, considering the uncertainty of the output of wind-light power generation during typhoon disasters, and predicting the power generation of wind power and photovoltaic by using a phase space reconstruction and Stacking integrated model; secondly, using pumped storage as a black start power supply, and establishing a mixed integer linear programming model of emergency power generation vehicles, gas generators, hydrogen fuel cells, wind-solar storage and other distributed power supplies participating in power distribution network rush repair scheduling and fault recovery; and solving by using a CPLEX solver to obtain scheduling strategies of the rush-repair teams and the emergency power generation cars under different scenes, and analyzing the influence of the output of each device on the power distribution network. The invention can accurately predict the output of the wind-light power generation equipment when key information such as meteorological environment is lost, greatly improves the power distribution network re-electricity efficiency under typhoon disasters, and effectively reduces the loss caused by power failure.

title_en: Transmission and distribution network distributed collaborative power restoration method based on feasible region projection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission and distribution network distributed collaborative power restoration method based on feasible region projection. Firstly, establishing an optimization model of a power transmission network, a fault power distribution network subarea and a normal power distribution network subarea, establishing a collaborative optimization model of the power transmission network, the normal power distribution network subarea and the fault power distribution network subarea, then, establishing a power transmission network feasible region projection model comprising a power transmission network objective function and a partition analysis mapping function of an optimization variable, decomposing the power transmission network, the normal power distribution network subarea and the fault power distribution network subarea collaborative optimization model into a main problem and a sub problem based on the power transmission network feasible region projection model, and finally, carrying out distributed iterative solution on the main problem and the sub problem until the difference value between the upper boundary and the lower boundary of a global optimization objective meets a threshold value. By projecting the feasible region into the parameter space of the active power of the boundary node of the transmission and distribution network, establishing a partition analytic mapping function only containing the active power of the boundary node, the equivalent conversion of the high-dimensional power grid optimization problem into the low-dimensional parameter space is realized, and the calculation complexity is effectively reduced.

title_en: Photovoltaic area vegetation index prediction method integrating environment driving element hysteresis feedback
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic area vegetation index prediction method integrating environment driving element hysteresis feedback, and belongs to the technical field of vegetation monitoring of photovoltaic power stations. According to the method, meteorological data and soil data of a target area are acquired, and hysteresis effects between each environmental element and vegetation indexes are analyzed by combining vegetation image data, so that the significant hysteresis time is determined, and hysteresis variables are constructed. And a random forest model is adopted, environmental elements and hysteresis variables thereof are used as input, a prediction model is trained, and the performance of the model is improved through an optimization algorithm. And identifying key ecological factors influencing the vegetation index, and providing an ecological restoration strategy according to the importance ranking. The invention can accurately capture the dynamic change of the microclimate environment and vegetation growth lag response caused by the photovoltaic array, obviously improve the prediction precision of the vegetation index of the photovoltaic area, provide scientific basis for ecological management of the photovoltaic power station by the aid of the repair strategy of comprehensive variable lag feedback, and realize 'photovoltaic+ecological' collaborative optimization by aid of assistance.

title_en: Maintenance/inspection management system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To suitably respond to inquiry from a customer by acquiring a restoration scheduled time of respective objects when a wide-area disaster such as an earthquake occurs.  <P>SOLUTION: When elevators of the respective objects are stopped by generation of the earthquake, the troubles are informed to a remote monitoring center (step S11-S13). The remote monitoring center receives the information, and working lists of the respective objects requiring the restoration work are prepared and transmitted to a maintenance person (step S14-S18). Here, the remote monitoring center calculates the restoration scheduled time of the respective objects based on the time when the maintenance person arrives at the field and starts the restoration work, and displays this on a monitoring screen or the like (step S19-S22). Re-calculation is performed to renew the display when there is notification of a delay time from the maintenance person and when the work is finished at the field (step S23-S26). Thereby, the restoration scheduled time of the respective objects is acquired and the countermeasure is suitably made to the inquiry from the customer.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title_en: system
abstract_en: To effectively issue information related to measures and actions necessary for the present day which requires the enhancement of disaster prevention consciousness by providing means for acquiring local hazard information from positional information, and analyzing a time necessary for the measures and restoration at the occurrence of a disaster.SOLUTION: A system includes means for acquiring local hazard information from positional information, and means for analyzing a time necessary for measures and restoration at the occurrence of a disaster on the basis of the acquired information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Using a fixed network wireless data collection system to improve utility responsiveness to power outages
abstract_en: A system for determining a service outages and restorations that includes an outage management server (OMS) that generates reports outages and restoration information for metering endpoints. The outages may be caused by faults at various locations in the distribution network. The metering endpoint may include a transmitter having a battery backup that transmits the outage information upon a failure to detect a voltage at the endpoint. The transmission of the information may be filtered based on configurable criteria. The metering endpoints may also inform the OMS when power is restored. Thus, a utility may better service its customers by focusing manpower efforts using the outage and restoration information generated by the OMS.
assignees: ELSTER ELECTRICITY LLC;MASON ROBERT T JR;BORLESKE ANDREW J;SHUEY KENNETH C

title_en: Real-time video restoration system that provides location information of rescuers in case of disaster and safety accident
title_ko: 재난 및 안전사고시 구조자의 위치정보를 제공하는실시간 영상 복원 시스템
abstract_en: A real-time video restoration system for providing the location information of rescuees in the event of a disaster or a safety accident according to the present invention comprises: a camera part for photographing a preset monitoring area; a thermal imaging sensor part for detecting thermal images in the monitoring area; an object detection sensor part for transmitting and receiving signals in a predetermined frequency range to detect an object in the monitoring area; and a video restoration part for determining whether there is a rescuee requiring rescue based on the detection data of the thermal imaging sensor part and the detection result of the object detection sensor part, and generating a real-time fusion image by fusing a photography video of the camera part at a past point of time, in which objects are visually identified, and the video of the rescuee. Therefore, provided is a real-time video restoration system capable of generating a real-time fusion video.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 재난 및 안전사고시 구조자의 위치정보를 제공하는 실시간 영상 복원 시스템은, 미리 설정된 감시영역을 촬영하는 카메라부와, 상기 감시영역의 열상을 감지하는 열화상센서부와, 소정의 주파수 영역의 신호를 송수신하여 상기 감시영역의 객체를 검출하는 객체감지센서부와, 상기 열화상센서부의 감지 데이터와 상기 객체감지센서부의 검출결과를 토대로 구조를 요하는 구조자인지를 판단한 후, 사물이 시각적으로 식별되는 과거시점의 상기 카메라부의 촬영영상에 상기 구조자의 영상을 함께 융합하여 실시간 융합영상을 생성하는 영상 복원부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A soil and water protection device for mine ecological remediation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water and soil protection device for mine ecological restoration, which comprises a base plate, wherein a positioning rod is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the base plate, a shielding mechanism is fixedly connected to the front surface of the base plate, a warning mechanism is fixedly connected to the back surface of the shielding mechanism, the shielding mechanism comprises two positioning disks fixedly connected to the front surface of the base plate, a rotating rod is movably connected to the inner parts of the positioning disks, a main pressing plate is fixedly connected to the outer side of the rotating rod, sliding grooves are formed in the left side and the right side of the main pressing plate, and side pressing plates are movably connected to the inner parts of the sliding grooves. This a soil and water protection device for mine ecological remediation, under the effect that shelters from the mechanism, makes the cooperation of main clamp plate and side pressure board, presses in the loose department of soil property, promotes its intensity, avoids the emergence of landslide phenomenon, and under the cooperation of protection network in warning mechanism simultaneously, encloses main clamp plate and side pressure board inside it, if the landslide phenomenon takes place, and utilizes the protection network to shelter from.
assignees: HEBEI PROVINCE GEOLOGICAL AND MINING BUREAU TERRITORIAL RESOURCE EXPLOR CENTER

title_en: Electric power utilization information remote control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electric power utilization information remote control system. The electric power utilization information remote control system comprises a marketing business system, a marketing real-time charge remote control system, a load control system, an electric power utilization information collection system, a short message platform and a headquarter customer service system. The marketing real-time charge remote control system comprises a charge control and management program, an electric charge calculation program as well as a charge control strategy application and exception management program. The system can comprehensively, safely and efficiently achieve full support for all businesses of the marketing real-time charge remote control application as well as performs operations such as alarming, power cutting and power restoration according to calculation results, thereby playing a role of a smart meter, achieving interaction between purchase and sale, ensuring business smoothness and electric charge recovery, improving work efficiency, reducing labor costs, saving energy, being user-friendly and enhancing customer satisfaction.
assignees: BENXI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power load missing data restoration method based on power utilization mode decomposition and reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power load missing data restoration method based on power consumption mode decomposition and reconstruction, and relates to the field of analysis and processing of large power data. The method comprises the steps of firstly, acquiring power load data of a power consumer, and dividing a data set into a complete load data set and a load data set to be repaired; based on the sparsity and diversity of the user power load, a K singular value decomposition dictionary learning algorithm is adopted to extract a base vector dictionary matrix representing the user power electronic mode from the complete load data set; decomposing and coding the load curve to be repaired based on the basis of the base vector dictionary matrix, and determining the load curve to be repaired to be composed of electronic modes; and finally, reconstructing the load curve according to the coding vector of the load curve to be repaired based on the base vector dictionary matrix, and filling and repairing the data of the missing part of the power load. The method can be applied to multi-day load data loss or load data loss repair in continuous time periods.

title_en: Method for ecological restoration of waterfowl breeding habitat
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, in particular to a method for restoring the ecology of a waterfowl breeding habitat. According to the method, the existing bird species, the vegetation conditions, the water quality and the breeding risk are investigated, so that an ecological restoration scheme and a construction management strategy are conveniently formulated according to the obtained investigation result; because habitat restoration is a long-term and dynamic process, the restoration target of the waterfowl breeding habitat needs to be determined, meanwhile, the target bird species is determined, and the ecological requirements of the target waterfowl on the habitat are analyzed; the inhabitation demand and the breeding demand of the target bird species are fully considered, and the quality of the aquatic bird breeding habitat is improved through strategies such as functional area division, habitat design, hydrological management and plant configuration; the diversity of waterfowl communities is monitored during the overwintering season of each year, and the reproductive success of various waterfowl species is monitored during the reproductive season of each year. And comparing various indexes before and after ecological restoration, and evaluating the ecological restoration effect.
assignees: SOUTH CHINA BOTANICAL GARDEN CAS;GUANGDONG PROVINCIAL LABORATORY OF SOUTHERN MARINE SCIENCE AND ENG GUANGZHOU

title_en: Ecological restoration method for partial collapse of high fill road
