abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological restoration method for partial collapse of a high fill road, which comprises the following steps: s01, performing temporary support on a collapsed surface of an original road by adopting first vertical floral tube grouting and first transverse floral tube grouting, performing temporary support on the far end of a non-collapsed high fill subgrade by adopting second vertical floral tube grouting and second transverse floral tube grouting, and fastening a stepped light retaining wall with an original foundation through a vertical prestressed anchor rod at the boundary position of the original road; s02, finishing the collapsed surface of the original road into a step shape; and S03, sequentially layering filling wall back layered filling soil, EPS light backfill layers and pervious concrete layers from bottom to top between the stepped light retaining wall and the collapsed surface of the original road. The method solves the problems that in the prior art, when a high-fill collapsed road is repaired, the engineering quantity is large, the disturbance to a foundation 7 is large, secondary disasters are easy to generate, and the manufacturing cost is high.
assignees: POWERCHINA GUIZHOU ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic power data restoration method based on multivariate information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed photovoltaic power data restoration method based on multiple pieces of information, and belongs to the field of data processing. According to the invention, on the basis of realizing missing value reconstruction by utilizing satellite remote sensing information and interpolation functions, the time dependence relationship between a power missing sequence and two-side continuous complete power sequences is fully considered, a power restoration model based on a two-way time sequence feature modeling unit and a cross correlation focusing algorithm is established, and multiple information such as two-side time sequence association information, satellite remote sensing information and the like is effectively integrated in the power data restoration process. The method is suitable for the distributed photovoltaic field station which is not provided with special meteorological measurement equipment and has strong output fluctuation and a small number of high-correlation space-time similar samples, solves the adverse effects caused by the fluctuation research of the light resource and the excavation of the correlation between the photovoltaic output and meteorological influence factors due to the loss of distributed photovoltaic power data, improves the prediction precision of the distributed photovoltaic power, and ensures the safe and stable operation of the active power distribution network.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING;STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD CHENGDE POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power grid restoring force assessment method and system under extreme weather disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid restoration force evaluation method and a power grid restoration force evaluation system under extreme weather disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring power grid operation basic data and power grid restoration data for coping with expected faults under the extreme weather disasters, and performing power generation energy diversity evaluation, power preservation rate evaluation, emergency power supply availability evaluation, power supply capacity evaluation and path active power margin evaluation; and carrying out weighted summation on the evaluation results to obtain a comprehensive evaluation result of the power grid restoring force under the extreme weather disasters. The method can accurately identify potential weak links in the power grid, provide scientific basis for reasonable allocation of emergency resources, and help to formulate more effective preventive measures and emergency response plans by quantifying the influence of extreme weather disasters on the recovery capacity of the power grid, thereby remarkably improving the capacity of the power grid for resisting natural disasters, reducing economic loss and social influence caused by disaster and power failure, and showing important theoretical value and practical application value.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Roadbed cavity accurate grouting device and grouting method
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of road disaster restoration, in particular to a roadbed cavity accurate grouting device and a grouting method, comprising a first detection unit, a second detection unit and a grouting device, wherein the first detection unit is used for detecting a roadbed cavity; the invention discloses a roadbed cavity grouting device, which comprises a first detection unit, a hole digging mechanism, a second detection unit and a grouting mechanism, wherein the first detection unit is used for detecting the roadbed cavity, the hole digging mechanism is used for punching a first filling hole communicated with the roadbed cavity above the roadbed cavity detected by the first detection unit, the second detection unit comprises a detection rod and a detection end head, the detection end head is positioned at one end of the detection rod, the detection rod is connected with one end of the detection end head and is used for being inserted into the roadbed cavity from the first filling hole, and the detection end head is used for scanning the shape of the roadbed cavity.
assignees: SHANDONG HI SPEED ENG CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic engineering control method and system based on water system communication condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering control method and a hydraulic engineering control system based on a water system communication condition, and relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering. Inputting the data into a river and lake health evaluation multichannel, generating a health evaluation vector, and calculating standard state deviation to form a health deviation vector. And (5) making a hydraulic engineering control decision based on the deviation vector, and constructing a river and lake resuscitation decision space. And optimizing the decision space by combining the recovery optimizing factors to generate a first strategy of river and lake recovery. And carrying out water system communication evaluation, constructing communication conditions, and optimizing a resuscitation strategy based on the communication conditions to form a final river and lake resuscitation scheme. Thereby achieving the technical effects of comprehensively considering the effective river and lake resuscitating decision of the water system communication and water ecological restoration mutual feedback process and remarkably improving the ecological restoration effect.
assignees: WATER RESOURCES RES INST SHANDONG PROVINCE

title_en: Intelligent river ecological water replenishing and water quality regulating and controlling system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and ecological restoration, in particular to an intelligent river ecological water replenishing and water quality regulating and controlling system and method based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting river water quality data and environmental parameters; the method comprises the steps of carrying out local real-time preprocessing, eliminating abnormal data, generating an emergency response instruction when dissolved oxygen is detected to be lower than a set value, uploading the preprocessed data to a cloud decision platform, merging an ecological water demand model based on a machine learning model, predicting a water quality change trend, generating a collaborative regulation and control suggestion, calling a dynamic water supplementing algorithm to calculate the rotating speed of a variable-frequency pump station and the opening of an intelligent electromagnetic valve, controlling the multi-stage variable-frequency pump station to start and adjust the flow after receiving the instruction, controlling the intelligent electromagnetic valve to supply water according to the opening, monitoring the running state of equipment in real time, identifying the abnormal state of the pump station, automatically closing an upstream valve, and triggering an emergency stop button to cut off a power supply when the inclination angle of the detection equipment is larger than the set angle. Improving the treatment efficiency and stability.
assignees: INSPUR SMART TECH INNOVATION SHANDONG CO LTD

title_en: Support system for forest restoration and growth and method for supporting forest restoration and growth
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To structure a support system for forest restoration and growth capable of supporting business entities working on forest restoration and growth so that more people can participate in the program.SOLUTION: A support system for forest restoration and growth 100 includes forest value evaluation means 110 which quantifies the value of a target forest for a forest restoration and growth program. The forest value evaluation means 110 comprises: an afforestation pattern value evaluation part 111 for calculating an evaluation value of commercial values including aesthetic, tourism, and advertisement values of afforestation patterns offered by investors; a growth and maintenance cost evaluation part 113 for calculating an evaluation value of forest growth and maintenance costs; a CO2 absorption amount value evaluation part 112 for estimating carbon fixation amounts of the forest to calculate an evaluation value of CO2 absorption amounts of an afforestation pattern; and a disaster prevention and environmental protection value evaluation part 114 for quantifying a disaster-preventing and environmental protection value of the forest offered by experts as an evaluation value. Actual forest maintenance and growth conditions are disclosed on the investors' terminals by forest observation means.

title_en: Systems and methods for prioritizing power restoration to sites after a power outage
abstract_en: A device may determine a number of user equipments (UEs) connected to an inactive site during a first period of time and determine that the inactive site experienced a power outage during a second period of time. The device may determine that the UEs connected to a set of active sites during the second period of time. The device may determine one or more key performance indicator (KPI) changes to one or more KPIs, during the second period of time, for each of the set of active sites. The device may determine a plurality of weights associated with the inactive site experiencing the power outage; determine a set of impacts, of the inactive site, on the one or more KPI changes for the set of active sites based on the plurality of weights; and cause power to be restored to the inactive site based on the set of impacts.

title_en: A kind of method for multi-failure power restoration of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method for multi-failure power restoration of power distribution network, the method overcome the shortcoming that traditional distribution network failure restoration methods can not solve multiple failure, multiple untreated complete faults are carried out multiple failure judgement, form multiple multiple failure and multiple substance fault, then multiple failure is carried out independent failure recovery district subregion, and be powered independent failure recovery district one by one recovering, after having processed multiple failure, then it is powered substance fault recovering.The present invention substantially increases service restoration efficiency, be conducive to the real-time of service restoration, the decoupling of public service restoration circuit when, consider the factor of load balancing, so that after fault recovery, the rate of load condensate of the service restoration circuit participating in service restoration is more nearly, and improves the power supply reliability of power distribution network.

title_en: A kind of operation reliability evaluation method of power distribution network in power system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of operation reliability evaluation method of power distribution network in power system, belong to Power System Reliability Analysis technical field.The method is calculated based on each monolithic element health index in power distribution network by the conversion of health index and health index Probability Forms, and the system health index is evaluated with reference to its connected mode.And according to its analysis result, rationally determine the time between overhauls(TBO) of equipment, reduce operation of power networks and electric power apparatus examination expense and improve equipment operational reliability.This method evaluates power distribution network health status in 0 to 10 numerical indication forms, can be that reliability service and the repair schedule formulation of power distribution network are provided fundamental basis.So as to further lift distribution network planning, O＆M and managerial skills, power distribution network asset management system is improved.

title_en: Thermal stratification type reservoir scheduling optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal stratification type reservoir dispatching optimization method, which comprises the following steps: collecting water quality data during thermal stratification of a reservoir, analyzing change characteristics of a dissolved oxygen stratification structure during thermal stratification, extracting control factors of the change characteristics of the dissolved oxygen during thermal stratification of the reservoir, establishing a three-dimensional hydrodynamic-water quality model of the reservoir, checking the model by adopting monitoring data, simulating thermal stratification hypoxia time under different water levels, scheduling operation modes and pumped storage scheduling working conditions by utilizing a control equation, and establishing a scheduling scheme of the reservoir according to distribution of the hypoxia time. The scheme can truly simulate the influence factors of the dissolved oxygen of the reservoir, can accurately provide a scheduling scheme for optimizing the dissolved oxygen, provides a countermeasure for improving the dissolved oxygen of the temperature-stagnation layer of the reservoir, provides effective scientific guidance for the protection and restoration of the water environment of the thermal stratification reservoir, and has good prevention and control effects on the oxygen deficiency of the temperature-stagnation layer of the reservoir.

title_en: Performance assessment-based natural resource project evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a performance assessment-based natural resource project evaluation method and system, which relate to the technical field of project evaluation, and are used for acquiring vegetation coverage influence values, soil damage values and rainfall influence values of a target area to calculate disaster influence values of the target area, comparing the disaster influence values of the target area with preset disaster influence value thresholds, determining disaster severity grades of the target area according to comparison results, determining performance assessment standards of environmental restoration in a corresponding natural project of the target area at the next stage according to different disaster severity grades, and thus, in performance assessment of environmental restoration projects of a forest ecological area, when the forest ecological area experiences natural disasters such as typhoons, the environmental restoration performance index assessment of the forest ecological area at the next stage can be adjusted according to actual conditions, so that the performance assessment judgment of the project at the next stage is reasonable and correct, and the influence of a manager on project decision is reduced.

title_en: Ecological environment restoration device for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an ecological environment restoration device for geological disasters, which comprises a pool body, a supporting block, a first baffle, a camera, a solar panel, a storage battery, a fixed pin, a sand suction pipe, a sand suction pump, a sand discharge pipe, a second baffle, an irrigation water inlet pipe, an irrigation pump, an irrigation water outlet pipe and a filter screen; the pool body comprises a pool part and edge parts, wherein a first edge part and a second edge part in the edge parts are respectively arranged at two sides of the pool part; the supporting block is positioned right above the first edge part, and the top of the supporting block is connected with the first baffle; the top of the first baffle is provided with a solar panel and a storage battery, and the bottom surface is provided with a camera; one end of the second baffle is fixedly connected to the bottom surface of the first baffle, and the other end of the second baffle is suspended in the air; the storage battery is respectively connected with the solar panel, the camera, the sand suction pump and the irrigation pump; the fixed pins are arranged on the lower surfaces of the first edge part and the second edge part, and the sand discharge system and the irrigation system are further arranged, so that the ecological environment can be really treated and repaired.
assignees: CNNC DADI SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power distribution network fault treatment platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent power distribution network fault treatment platform and belongs to the technical field of power network management. The platform comprises a fault information acquisition system, a fault information study and judgment system and a fault clearing and power failure/supply information push system. A method is characterized by acquiring information of faults requested to be cleared, line faults and consumption acquisition faults in an existing 95598 system, a distribution automation management system and a power consumption information acquisition system, after receiving and verifying the information, carrying out equipment locating, fault information screening, line topology analysis, equipment operation information analysis and line switch analysis to determine and display the fault types, places and areas of influence in an existing GIS (geographic information system), guiding fault clearing according to the determined fault results and simultaneously pushing the power failure information and power restoration information to users. The platform and the method can be used for achieving centralized acquisition and advanced automatic study and judgment of existing various fault information, can be used for actively pushing the power failure and power restoration information to the users and can interact with the users.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY CO JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;JIANGSU SUYUAN HIGH TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: A kind of interruption maintenance planning professional skill appraisal procedure and system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of interruption maintenance planning professional skill appraisal procedure and system, including：It is determined that assessment object repair schedule professional skill deduction of points index；It is determined that assessment object maintenance efficiency of the practice evaluation index；It is determined that assessment object planning cycle imperfection evaluation index；Determine weight coefficient β 1 、β 2 、β 3 ；It is determined that the assessment score of assessment object, and generate assessment report.Planning procedure, performance of the present invention for interruption maintenance plan, set up the index of the comprehensive examination interruption maintenance planning business of energy, with reference to rational assessment models, ranking assessment is carried out to assessment object by the method for quantifying, each assessment object is promoted to improve the mode of production of maintenance with this, improve production efficiency, and then ensure the safe operation of power network.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Reliability determination method, device, equipment and medium for flexible direct power distribution system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for determining the reliability of a flexible-direct power distribution system. The method comprises the steps of determining each system load point of a target flexible-direct power distribution system, determining the predicted restoration time relative to a main power supply for each system load point, further determining the power failure time of each system load point according to the predicted restoration time and the fault rate of a flexible-direct network in the target flexible-direct power distribution system, and determining the reliability index of the target flexible-direct power distribution system according to the power failure time of each system load point so as to quantify the reliability of the power distribution system comprising the flexible-direct network, thereby realizing the determination of the reliability of the flexible-direct power distribution system and facilitating the analysis and the improvement of the reliability of the power distribution system.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power grid emergency repair and restoration scheduling cooperative decision method and system under natural disaster
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system recovery decision-making, and provides a cooperative decision-making method and a cooperative decision-making system for power grid emergency repair and recovery scheduling under natural disasters, wherein the method considers the influence of equipment damage on the recovery scheduling, adjusts the emergency repair scheme on line, completes the repair of a power transmission line, a communication link and a transformer substation load outgoing line, effectively processes the mutual influence between the emergency repair and the recovery scheduling, and realizes the effective cooperation between the emergency repair and the recovery scheduling; the Monte Carlo tree search and the mathematical planning method are combined, so that emergency repair and scheduling recovery decisions can be completed in effective time, and the decision is ensured to be realized on line.

title_en: Environment risk assessment method for building material recycling after heavy metal contaminated soil restoration
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heavy metal contaminated soil environment risk evaluation, and particularly relates to an environment risk evaluation method for building material recycling after heavy metal contaminated soil restoration. The method adopts simulated rainwater to leach the risk assessment system, calculates the diffusion coefficient of the heavy metal in the restored soil, and thus constructs a one-dimensional diffusion model of the heavy metal; then calculating the concentration level of the heavy metal released into the underground water in the building material recycling process according to the dilution attenuation coefficient of the heavy metal in the underground water; and finally quantitatively evaluating the risk of potential drinking groundwater pollution possibly generated by the reuse of the restored soil in the first type of land (residential land). The method of the invention has the advantages of simplicity, definite process, short period, high efficiency, science and reasonability, can accurately predict and evaluate the pollution risk of building material recycling to the local groundwater after the polluted soil is restored, is beneficial to the protection of the groundwater environment, and has wide applicability.
assignees: INST GEOCHEMISTRY CAS;INST OF ECO ENVIRONMENT AND SOIL SCIENCES GUANGDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: River water level information missing restoration method based on water conservancy big data
abstract_en: According to the river water level information deletion restoration method based on the water conservancy big data, different solutions are constructed for different water level data deletion situations, when the water level information deletion occurs at discrete time points, the data are restored by adopting a cubic spline interpolation method based on time adjacent correlation of the water level information; when the water level information is absent in a continuous time period, repairing data by adopting a multiple linear regression model based on the spatial adjacent correlation of the water level information; when some monitoring stations monitor water level and flow simultaneously, the relation between the water level and the flow is fitted by using semi-supervised regression by utilizing the data relevance between the water level and the flow, and the missing water level information is repaired by using the functional relation; the data of the repair is accurate and reliable, the problem of data missing of the water conservancy informatization system is effectively solved, the accuracy, the practicability and the applicability of the data repair all reach higher level, the utilization efficiency of the hydrologic data is improved, and the use value of the hydraulic engineering is perfected.

title_en: Ecological restoration method for hydraulic engineering construction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydraulic ecological restoration, and particularly relates to an ecological restoration method used in hydraulic engineering construction. The invention aims at a pollution area with serious river water pollution in hydraulic engineering construction as a repair area, and the repair of the pollution area comprises three aspects of river channel treatment, river flood beach treatment and step treatment. When dredging in river course treatment, the extracted sludge is filtered by a mesh screen, on one hand, the difficult degradation garbage can be removed by filtration, on the other hand, the filtered sludge is paved on the trimmed river flood beach, and the sludge can be used as waste for plant planting, so that the effective utilization of the waste is realized. Meanwhile, when the land is treated, the comprehensive vegetation system is established by utilizing plant measures of herb, arbor and shrub collocation, and the diversity of the river ecological landscape is realized. The invention adopts the form of regional treatment, can effectively improve the self-purification capability of the river channel, solves the pollution problem of the river channel and realizes ecological restoration.

title_en: Slope protection method combining multidirectional water guide channel and ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope protection method combining a multidirectional water guide channel and ecological restoration, which relates to the technical field of ecological slope protection, and is characterized in that seed vegetation layers are arranged between adjacent transverse water guide channels at equal intervals, rainwater is guided into a vertical water guide channel and a transverse water guide channel which are communicated with each other at two sides through water guide grids arranged on the upper surfaces of the seed vegetation layers, excessive rainwater is prevented from penetrating into the seed and the planting base layer in the seed vegetation layers, on the one hand, the seed and the planting base layer are prevented from being washed out, on the other hand, a large amount of rainwater is prevented from penetrating into loess side slopes to cause landslide, in addition, the seed and the raw soil of the vegetation are fully stirred and mixed, a layer of planting matrix is paved on the planting blanket in a spraying mode, the compactness of the planting matrix can be effectively improved, the whole transverse water guide channel and the vertical water guide channel are prevented from being linked and fixed on the basis of the above matters, and the fixing effect and slope protection effect of a slope protection structure are improved.

title_en: Power grid line emergency repair scheduling and distributing method for complex multi-constraint disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid line emergency repair dispatching distribution method for a complex multi-constraint disaster scene, and belongs to the technical field of power grid emergency management. The method comprises the steps of decomposing a complex rush-repair task into a plurality of quantifiable subtasks, establishing a matrix description of task requirements and technical capability requirements, establishing a multi-dimensional technical capability assessment index system, dynamically quantifying the technical capability level of emergency personnel through assessment and scoring, establishing an assessment model based on the technical capability satisfaction rate, estimating the rush-repair man-hour by combining a Monte Carlo simulation method based on Latin hypercube sampling, carrying out team internal task allocation by using a Hungary algorithm, and optimizing the multi-team task allocation by utilizing an ant colony algorithm of multiple traveling companies by combining the rush-repair man-hour estimation. The method can effectively improve the efficiency and accuracy of emergency task allocation, improve the utilization rate of limited resources and provide technical support for rush repair work in disaster scenes.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Cooperative development method for offshore wind power and ocean pasture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative development method of offshore wind power and ocean pasture, belonging to the field of comprehensive development and utilization of ocean resources. The method comprises the steps of acquiring ecological data of different depths, determining ecological adaptation parameters of a net cage and a wind power pile foundation, simulating the influence of pile foundation layout on hydrodynamic force by using a genetic algorithm, optimizing the space allocation proportion of the net cage, generating pile foundation and net cage differential design parameters by combining the water depth and tide characteristics, adopting modularized parallel construction flow to make a construction time cooperation plan, constructing a digital twin virtual interaction platform, optimizing operation parameters in real time, deploying a sensor network, acquiring real-time data of pasture management, analyzing biological attachment and water quality changes, designing an ecological coating of the pile foundation, generating ecological restoration parameters, and driving pasture water pumps and oxygenation equipment by using surplus wind power to realize power allocation of energy and ecological cooperation. The invention realizes multidimensional coordination of wind power and pasture in space, time, energy and ecology, and improves the utilization rate of resources.

title_en: Quantitative evaluation method for loss degree of main transformer equipment after disaster
abstract_en: The application provides a method for quantitatively evaluating loss degree of main transformer equipment after disasters, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining natural disaster types and main transformer equipment fault data, constructing a disaster-induced fault influence factor system, calculating disaster weights and fault mode weights, then enumerating equipment maintenance evaluation indexes and preprocessing based on historical disaster damage data and equipment operation states, identifying a core evaluation index set, calculating core index importance weights, then establishing a loss index calculation model according to the weights, calculating basic loss indexes of fault sample data, presetting a loss grade interval, then carrying out nonlinear calibration on the basic loss indexes, fusing multidimensional features to generate comprehensive loss indexes, and finally optimizing the comprehensive loss indexes through a random forest regression model, outputting final loss prediction indexes, and judging equipment restoration priority according to the obtained result. The evaluation method outputs unified and quantifiable loss indexes and grades, and provides decision basis for post-disaster repair priority judgment and manpower and material resource scheduling.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL RESEARCH INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Waste dump oxygen inhibition covering method based on reverse ventilation structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waste dump oxygen inhibition covering method based on a reverse ventilation structure, which belongs to the technical field of coal gangue disaster prevention and ecological restoration and comprises the steps of carrying out tertiary screening on discarded waste rocks to obtain coarse-grain waste rocks, medium-grain waste rocks and fine-grain waste rocks, sequentially carrying out layered filling and compaction from bottom to top according to the coarse-grain waste rocks, the medium-grain waste rocks and the fine-grain waste rocks obtained by screening to form a reverse ventilation structure with the upper average particle size smaller than the lower average particle size, and after each waste rock layer is paved and compacted, synchronously constructing an oxygen inhibition covering layer matched with the waste rock layer on the surface to form a gradient oxygen inhibition covering system with waste rock layers and covering layers alternately nested. The invention effectively blocks the oxygen diffusion path through the synergistic effect of physical separation, chemical inhibition, structure regulation and dynamic management, solves the technical problem of spontaneous combustion caused by oxygen permeation of the waste dump, and combines ecological restoration and long-term stability.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;UNIV HENAN POLYTECHNIC;INNER MONGOLIA INST OF GEOLOGICAL SURVEY;UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_en: Restoration planning management device, restoration planning program and restoration planning method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a restoration planning management device which calculates the number of days and a procedure necessary to restore pieces of equipment while updating BCP in real time, on the basis of actual damage state and restriction of each piece of equipment and a priority showing a restoration order determined in accordance with sales ratios of such pieces of equipment, etc in disaster situations.SOLUTION: The restoration planning management device has a priority calculation part and a restoration procedure creation part. The priority calculation part calculates a priority which serves as an index to determine an order of restoring pieces of equipment on the basis of an impact level which is an index showing an impact given by each piece of equipment to the business. The restoration procedure creation part creates a restoration procedure which is a procedure to restore the pieces of equipment in descending order of the priority.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Reconstruction of Structural Section Using Waterproofing and Polishing Material of Ceramic Mortar
title_ko: 세라믹 몰탈 방수·방식 재료를 이용한 구조물 단면복구공법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a structure cross section restoration method using a waterproof and anti-corrosive material of ceramic mortar. The method comprises: a step (S10) of performing a penetrative coating on a cracked part of a cross section to be restored by using a hardener including 30-60 parts by weight of S.B.R latex, 20-40 parts by weight of E.V.A adhesive, 5-10 parts by weight of sodium bentonite, 4-8 parts by weight of acrylic adhesive, and 10-20 parts by weight of lactate based on 100 parts by weight of distilled water; a step (S20) of forming a primer layer by coating a cross section to be restored by using the hardener; a step (S30) of forming a restoration layer on the upper part of the primer layer by using a mortar mixture mixed with the hardener and a powder main substance including 80-120 parts by weight of jade powder, 150-250 parts by weight of silica sand, 40-60 parts by weight of silicate powder, 3-10 parts by weight of a vitric material, 1-3 parts by weight of earth, 3-10 parts by weight of methylcellulose, 3-10 parts by weight of microfiber, 5-15 of steel slag, and 0.1-0.5 part by weight of pigment based on 100 parts by weight of Portland cement; and a step (S40) of forming a finishing layer by coating the upper part of the restoration layer with the hardener. The method of the present invention increases durability such as corrosion resistance.

title_en: Device and method for aligning the reference position of the shape restoration device
title_ko: 형상 복원 장치의 기준위치 정렬 장치 및 정렬 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for aligning a reference position capable of improving accuracy and reducing an error of a shape restoring device using an ultrasonic probe to confirm a shape of an object to be photographed in three dimensions without a risk of radiation exposure. The method for aligning a reference position of a shape restoring device according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: an aligning apparatus preparing step of mounting a position reference pin in the shape restoring device, and mounting a position adjusting jig in a water tank including an ultrasonic propagation medium; a reference position aligning step of positioning an image obtaining phantom in the water tank by moving the position adjusting jig after fixing the image obtaining phantom to a phantom fixing member of the position adjusting jig, and allowing a temporary reference plane or a center line of the image obtaining phantom to correspond to a position reference pin; and a reference position aligning confirming step of moving an ultrasonic probe of the shape restoring device to photograph the image obtaining phantom, displaying a marker on an ultrasonic image, confirming an aligning state depending on movement of the ultrasonic probe based on the displayed marker, and modifying the aligning state of the shape restoring device when aligning modification is necessary.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 방사능 피폭의 위험이 없이 피촬영 대상의 형태를 3차원으로 확인할 수 있는 초음파 프로브를 활용한 형상 복원 장치의 정확도 향상 및 오차 감소를 위한 기준위치 정렬 장치 및 정렬 방법에 관한 것으로,  
본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 형상 복원 장치의 기준위치 정렬 방법은, 형상 복원 장치에 위치 기준 핀을 장착하고, 위치 조정 지그를 초음파 전파 매질이 담긴 수조에 장착하는 정렬 장치 준비 단계; 영상 획득 팬텀을 위치 조정 지그의 팬텀 고정 부재에 고정시킨 후, 상기 위치 조정 지그를 움직여 상기 영상 획득 팬텀이 수조 내에 위치되도록 위치시키고, 영상 획득 팬텀의 임의의 기준 평면 또는 중심선이 상기 위치 기준 핀과 일치되도록 정렬하는 기준위치 정렬 단계 및 상기 형상 복원 장치의 초음파 프로브를 상기 영상 획득 팬텀을 촬영하도록 움직이면서, 초음파 영상에 마커를 표시하고 표시한 마커를 기준으로 초음파 프로브의 이동에 따른 정렬 상태를 확인하며, 정렬 수정이 필요할 경우에 상기 형상 복원 장치의 정렬 상태를 수정하는 기준위치 정렬 확인 단계를 포함하여 구성될 수 있다.

title_en: Cooking control device and method for controlling cooking status when power failure is restored during cooking
title_ko: 취반 중 정전 복귀 시 취반 상태 제어장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a device and a method for controlling a rice cooking state when power is restored during rice cooking. The device may comprise: cooking tools having a heating source; and a control part controlling the cooking device to execute a cooking process, detecting power outage and power restoration state through a power outage detection unit, and when the power outage detection unit detects the power outage, storing a currently ongoing cooking process and a measured temperature through a memory unit, and counting a power outage time during the power outage state.
abstract_ko: 취반 중 정전 복귀 시 취반 상태 제어장치기 및 방법에 관하여 개시한다. 본 발명은, 가열원을 구비하는 조리기기; 및 상기 조리기기를 제어하여 취사 공정을 실행하고, 정전 검출부를 통해 정전 및 복전상태를 검출하며, 상기 정전 검출부에서 정전 검출시 현재 진행 중인 취반 공정과 측정된 온도를 메모리부를 통해 기억 저장하고, 정전 상태에서 정전 시간을 카운터 하는 카운터부로 구성된 제어부;를 포함하여 구성될 수 있다.

title_en: Power distribution network automation system comprehensive planning method based on reliability constraint
abstract_en: The present application relates to the technical field of power system planning and evaluation, and provided is a power distribution network automation system comprehensive planning method based on reliability constraint. The method comprises performing overall planning on a power distribution network automation system, wherein the power distribution network automation system comprises a circuit breaker, a knife switch, a feeder terminal control unit, and a control center; establishing a power distribution network reliability evaluation and optimization model consisting of a target function and constraint conditions; and solving for the model to obtain installation positions of the circuit breaker, the knife switch, and the feeder terminal control unit which meet system reliability requirements, and determining whether a power distribution automation system control center needs to be built. In calculating the reliability constraint, the present application considers approaches of circuit breaker tripping after a fault, fault automatic and manual isolation, and affected load power supply restoration based on network reconstruction, and the method is simple and convenient, and effectively reduces costs while meeting the system reliability.

title_en: Device and method for adjusting electricity consumption of a plurality of lighting devices of a lighting system
abstract_en: The invention is based on the idea that control of power consumption in a system comprising power consuming devices like lighting devices, for example, can be performed by dividing the power consuming devices of the system into a plurality of groups and by taking into account power consumption or load shedding or restoration capability for each group. Further, the invention implements an auction mechanism for adjusting power consumption or load in the lighting system such that an effective, fast, user requirements considering and lighting device functions and characteristics considering adjusting is achieved.

title_en: Distributed disaster recovery file sync server system
abstract_en: Example implementations are directed to restoration of data not only from the servers, but also from the clients connected to the server. Algorithms are incorporated to identify content that was created or modified after the last backup. This algorithm also identifies and resolves changes in the mount points for shared folders, preventing information leakage. When the server recovers from a failure, it notifies the clients about the recovery on their next connection. Each client then determines the current state of its mount points and file paths and compares them with the server's mount points and file paths. After the comparison, the client comprehends and indicates the mount point differences by renaming them and sends entire local data (all files, folders, mount points) to the server. The server reconciles the differences.

title_en: Accelerated recovery after a data disaster
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present invention, a metadata file is transferred from the first system to the second system and a database on the second system is initialized based on the metadata file. An image, including information of the first system to be restored, is transferred from the first system to the second system, and restoration of the information to the second system based on the image is initiated. Prior to completion of the restoration, one or more log files indicating actions performed on the first system relating to the information to be restored is transferred from the first system to the initialized database on the second system. In response to completion of the restoration, the actions of the log files are performed to synchronize the restored data on the second system with the first system.

title_en: Frequency domain illumination priori driving non-supervision low-light video enhancement method, system and storage medium for shield slag hole monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a frequency domain illumination priori driving unsupervised low-light video enhancement method, a system and a storage medium for shield slag hole monitoring, which are used for realizing composite noise suppression and basic restoration of a low-light image through a noise suppression module, executing two-dimensional Haer wavelet decomposition on a basic restoration image through a frequency domain illumination priori estimation module, combining a channel-space attention weighting high-low frequency sub-band and fusing to generate frequency domain illumination priori characteristics, completing accurate reconstruction of reflection components through a cross-attention converter unit of a reflection component reconstruction module, generating global index enhancement factors through an illumination enhancement coefficient module to obtain an enhanced image, realizing network unsupervised end-to-end training through gamma conversion branches and multi-dimensional loss constraint, and effectively relieving the problems of overall darkness, detail inundation and serious noise of a shield slag hole monitoring image on the premise of not increasing site continuous illumination burden, and obtaining an enhanced video with balanced brightness, clear detail and controlled overexposure.

title_en: Switching fire watch control unit
title_ko: 배전반 화재감시제어기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A switchboard fire watch controller for a semi-permanent failure free state is provided to perform the functions of warning and automatic extinguishment control through an unmanned automatic precision analysis according to the situation of an outbreak of a fire by the installation of a fire watch controller(WB-FR2) and perform multiple functions of remote restoration, power outage monitoring and self-malfunction diagnosis notification through digitalized communications, thereby reinforcing the prevention of malfunction and non-operation using the switchboard fire watch controller which is subminiature and highly effective. CONSTITUTION: A switchboard fire watch controller includes a first power circuit(10) generating and outputting a first voltage for the operation of a relay and a solenoid, a CPU(16) from the output voltage of the first power circuit, a communications module(15) and a second power circuit(14) generating and outputting a second voltage(Vcc) for the operation of an alarm circuit(17) and a display unit(18). The first voltage outputted by the first power circuit composes a dual fire watch circuit by being respectively connected to a first watch serial circuit and a second watch serial circuit. The first voltage outputted by the first power circuit is connected to be applied to a serial circuit formed by a fire extinguisher operating solenoid(19), the contact point of a first line relay, the contact point of a second line relay and resistance for detecting the overcurrent. On both ends of a first sensor socket(34-1) and a second sensor socket(35-1), where a first heat and smoke sensor(24-1) and a second heat and smoke sensor(25-1) are to be mounted, a first sensor test switch and a second sensor test switch are composed in parallel. Terminating resistance which is to be installed on each of a first monitoring line(28) and a second monitoring line(29) are respectively mounted in between the connecting terminals on both ends of the first and second heat and smoke sensors, and the terminating resistance on the first and second heat and smoke sensors are electrically connected to the first and second monitoring lines only in case the first and second heat and smoke sensors are mounted on the first and second sensor sockets. [Reference numerals] (13) External battery; (15) Communications module; (17) Alarm circuit; (18) Display; (AA,CC) Disconnection detection; (BB,DD) Operation detection; (EE) SOL overcurrent input; (FF) Fuse disconnection, power outage input; (GG) Circuit 1 disconnection input; (HH) Circuit 2 disconnection input; (II) Circuit 1 fire alarm input; (JJ) Circuit 2 first alarm input; (KK) Communication Rx; (LL) Remote communication reset output; (MM) Overcurrent block reset output; (NN) Communication number; (OO) BAT voltage; (PP) Integrated warning(buzzer) signal; (QQ) Communication Tx; (RR) SOL coil disconnection detection;
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 배전반 및 시설물 등에 화재감시제어기(WB-FR2)를 설치함으로서 배전반 또는 시설물에서의 화재발생시 상황별로 무인 자동 정밀분석을 통하여 경보 및 자동소화제어 기능을 수행하고, 디지털화 통신을 통해 원격복구, 정전감시 및 자기고장 진단통보 등의 기능들을 복합적으로 수행할 수 있는 자기 진단형 제어기로서 오동작과 미작동 차단을 강화시킨 초소형, 고성능형 배전반 화재감시제어기를 제공한다. 본 발명의 배전반 화재감시제어기는 AC 또는 DC 입력전압으로부터 계전기 및 솔레노이드 구동용 제1전압을 생성 출력하는 제1전원회로(10)와, 상기 제1전원회로의 출력전압으로부터 CPU(16), 통신모듈(15), 알람회로(17) 및 디스플레이(18)의 구동용 제2전압(Vcc)을 생성출력하는 제2전원회로(14)를 포함하며, 상기 제1전원회로에서 출력되는 제1전압은 리세트스위치(SW1)의 접점, 과전류차단 및 통신리세트 계전기의 접점, 외부리세트단자(TER1), 제1라인계전기(K3), 제1라인도통테스트회로(20), 제1감시라인(28)상의 제1단선검출회로(22), 제1단선/동작분석회로(26) 및 제1감지기소켓(34-1)에 접속 결합된 제1열,연감지기(24-1)에 의해 형성되는 제1감시직렬회로와, 리세트스위치(SW1)의 접점, 과전류차단 및 통신리세트 계전기의 접점, 외부리세트단자(TER1), 제2라인계전기(K4), 제2라인도통테스트회로(21), 제2감시라인(29)상의 제2단선검출회로(23), 제2단선/동작분석회로(27) 및 제2감지기소켓(35-1)에 접속 결합된 제2열,연감지기(25-1)에 의해 형성되는 제2감시직렬회로에 각각 인가되게 연결하여 듀얼화재감시회로를 구성하고, 상기 제1전원회로에서 출력되는 제1전압은 소화기 작동용 솔레노이드(19), 상기 제1라인계전기(K3)의 접점, 제2라인계전기(K4)의 접점 및 과전류검출용 저항(R5)에 의해 형성되는 직렬회로에 인가되게 연결하고, 상기 제1,2열,연감지기(24-1,25-1)가 장착될 제1,2감지기소켓(34-1,35-1)의 각 양단간에는 제1,2감지기테스트스위치(SW4,SW5)를 병렬로 접속하여 구성하되, 상기 제1,2감시라인(28,29)의 각 종단에 설치될 종단저항(R2,R3)은 각각 상기 제1,2열,연감지기(24-1,25-1)의 양단간 접속단자(1,2)사이에 장착하여 상기 제1,2감지기소켓(34-1,35-1)에 각각 제1,2열,연감지기(24-1,25-1)를 온전히 결합 장착시킬 경우에만 상기 제1,2감시라인(28,29) 상에 제1,2열,연감지기(24-1,25-1)상의 종단저항(R2,R3)이 각각 전기적으로 접속되게 구성한 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Can repair, formula that restores to throne certainly rectangular concrete -filled steel tube frame column base node
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a can repair, formula that restores to throne certainly rectangular concrete -filled steel tube frame column base node, include the square steel tube concrete column, prevent bucking steel sheet, base and concrete foundation. Wherein the base includes base and lower base, and lower crab -bolt anchor in concrete foundation for the base goes up base and rectangular concrete -filled steel tube support connnection, be equipped with unbonded prestressed tendons in the rectangular concrete -filled steel tube post, the bucking steel sheet is prevented in being provided with all around of rectangular concrete -filled steel tube post, can be divided into epirelief type column base, three kinds of forms of recessed type column base and spin type column base according to the difference of column base. title_en: Ecological restoration district side slope soil and water conservation structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a slope water and soil conservation structure of an ecological restoration area, which comprises a support main pipe arranged in a slope, wherein the support main pipe is connected with a plurality of support branch pipes, the support branch pipes are connected with a plant frame through connecting plates positioned on the slope, the connecting plates are provided with a plurality of through holes, the support branch pipes and the support main pipe are communicated, and a water absorbing piece for supplying water is arranged between the support main pipe and a planting area of the plant frame. The utility model strengthens the stability of the side slope, is not easy to generate soil erosion and landslide, stably connects the plant frame with the supporting branch pipe, namely, the plant frame is firmly connected with the side slope and is not easy to fall off, the service life is long, the plant frame, the supporting main pipe and the supporting branch pipe are all assembled, the installation and the disassembly are simple and quick, and the damaged part is convenient to be independently replaced in the later period.
assignees: HENAN FOURTH GEOLOGICAL EXPLORATION INST CO LTD

title_en: Method for ecological restoration of mountain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for ecological restoration of a mountain, which comprises the following steps: (1) forming holes on a rocky mountain; (2) filling cement mortar (1 : 3) in the holes; (3) inserting foundation steel bars into the cement in the holes and allowing the foundation steel bars to protruding out of the rocky mountain at a certain length, and pouring a cement frame or not with the foundation steel bars as center; (4) laying a vertically consecutive planting soil layer along the rock slope of the rocky mountain, wherein the planting soil layer comprises plant growth bags stacked along the rock slope and filling soil for filling gaps; (5) coating a steel mesh on the outer surface of the planting soil layer, wherein the steel mesh is fixedly connected with the foundation steel bars to fix the plant growth bags and is formed of a plurality of steel wires by crossing each other; and (6) watering and curing the plant growth bags. The method provided by the invention perfectly combines plants, soil and the mountain; and not only has rapid and good greening effect and effectively solves the problems of mountain landslide, collapse and the like, but also forms a stable long-life plant community, achieving an original ecological effect.
assignees: BEIJING ZHENGHE HENGJI BINSHUI ECOLOGY ENVIRONMENTAL MAN CO LTD

title_en: Method for manufacturing assembled type bridge pier by utilizing steel fiber reinforced self-compacting concrete
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for manufacturing an assembled type bridge pier by utilizing steel fiber reinforced self-compacting concrete. The method comprises the steps of preparing the concrete, prefabricating bridge pier segments, assembling the bridge pier segments, fixing the bridge pier segments and the like. By the adoption of the assembled type bridge pier manufactured through the method, construction and pouring quality can be guaranteed, the construction efficiency of a bridge is enhanced, and the seismic performance of the bridge pier can also be improved. The assembled type bridge pier is made of certain steel fiber reinforced self-compacting concrete, the comprehensive power performance of the segments is superior, and seismic performance of connector parts is 2-3 times that of existing common concrete prefabricated segments under the condition that structures and sizes are equal. The bridge pier segments in the structure are assembled in the mode that a shear key is connected with a short reinforcing steel bar in an inserted mode, the shock resistance, pier energy consumption, post-earthquake restoration in potential plastic hinge areas between the segments and other seismic-area dynamic properties are superior, and the method can be applicable to construction of the bridge pier. By the adoption of the steel fiber reinforced self-compacting concrete, concrete on the surface of a finished bridge pier is not prone to cracking, and therefore durability is good.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMM RES & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster emergency repair scheduling method and device based on greedy algorithm combination
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network post-disaster first-aid repair scheduling method based on greedy algorithm combination, which comprises the following steps of: building greedy algorithms of three emergency repair prevention strategies, respectively seeking optimal solutions according to the current load state of the power distribution network, and selecting the optimal solution with the minimum loss of the power distribution network as the emergency repair strategy of the power distribution network; each greedy algorithm includes: starting from an emergency repair center, each emergency repair team respectively selects the fault points which best meet the corresponding emergency repair strategy for emergency repair, and after the emergency repair of each emergency repair team is finished, the fault points which best meet the corresponding emergency repair strategy are selected from the fault points which are not yet subjected to emergency repair for emergency repair until all the faults are finished; the emergency repair strategies corresponding to the three greedy algorithms are respectively the closest distance, the best emergency repair effect and the highest emergency repair efficiency. Compared with the prior art, the method can quickly obtain a satisfactory solution, save a large amount of time consumed by exploration in the whole space, ensure optimality as far as possible and improve the efficiency of post-disaster solution.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Mine goaf re-greening ecological restoration method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine goaf re-greening ecological restoration method which is characterized by comprising the following steps: A. soil preparation; B. laying a component; C. filling a culture medium and soil; D. planting plants and trees; E. and (5) managing. The supporting function of accessible component had both found out new artifical massif at the mine collecting space area fast again, and the plant through planting, trees carry out effective afforestation simultaneously to can impound, protect water when the rainwater arrives, improve moisture conservation ability, reduce moisture release speed, prolong and protect the water cycle, satisfy plant, trees growth demand, improve the survival rate, consolidate the afforestation effect in mining the sky mine, promote the afforestation view, effectively prevent massif landslide, soil erosion loss. The method has the advantages of convenient, rapid and safe construction, no energy consumption, low restoration cost and good effect, and provides convenient and practical technical support for ecological environment restoration and vegetation restoration of large-area mine goafs.
assignees: KUNMING INST OF ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES

title_en: Ecological space network optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological space network optimization method, which is a research method for solving the problems of various ecologies and landscape deterioration caused by urbanization by improving the association degree between various landscapes through the connection of broken and dispersed habitat patches. According to the related theory of plaque-gallery-matrix and network structure analysis, on the basis of MSPA and landscape connectivity analysis, an ecological network is constructed by using an MCR model, the whole ecological network structure is evaluated by using a gravity model and network structure analysis, and then an ecological space network optimization strategy is provided. According to the invention, an optimization study is put forward on the whole ecological pattern through an ecological space and network structure analysis method, the overall layout construction of ecological restoration and protection space becomes a typical ecological system space structure, further improvement and optimization are carried out, the regional ecological environment is improved, and the broken ecological space is repaired by improving the surrounding land utilization value.

title_en: Data restoration method, device and equipment based on photovoltaic envelope
abstract_en: The application provides a data restoration method, device and equipment based on photovoltaic envelope, which relate to the technical field of data processing and comprise the following steps: acquiring photovoltaic power generation data of each of a plurality of photovoltaic meters, wherein the photovoltaic power generation data comprises original accumulated power generation amounts of each of a plurality of moments; based on the photovoltaic power generation data of each of the plurality of photovoltaic tables, carrying out region clustering on the plurality of photovoltaic tables to obtain a plurality of photovoltaic table clusters; determining a light Fu Baolao curve corresponding to each photovoltaic meter cluster based on photovoltaic power generation data of each photovoltaic meter in the photovoltaic meter cluster aiming at each photovoltaic meter cluster; and (3) repairing photovoltaic power generation data of each photovoltaic meter in the photovoltaic meter cluster based on the photovoltaic Fu Baolao curve to obtain target photovoltaic power generation data corresponding to each photovoltaic meter in the photovoltaic meter cluster, wherein the target photovoltaic power generation data comprises target accumulated power generation amounts at a plurality of moments. According to the scheme, the repair of the photovoltaic power generation data can be realized, and the precision of the photovoltaic power generation data is improved.

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic power missing data restoration method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed photovoltaic power missing data repairing method and device, comprising the following steps: extracting cloud cover features of a target distributed photovoltaic based on satellite remote sensing data, and dividing weather types of the cloud cover features to obtain a preset number of weather types; aiming at the photovoltaic power generation power data of the target distributed photovoltaic under each weather type, obtaining a low-rank tensor decomposition optimization model according to a graph regularization term and a low-rank tensor optimization function; and solving the low-rank tensor decomposition optimization model to obtain a photovoltaic power generation power reconstruction tensor, and judging and repairing power abnormal data according to the photovoltaic power generation power reconstruction tensor. According to the invention, the low-rank tensor decomposition modeling method is utilized to carry out refined low-rank tensor decomposition modeling on different weather types, and the obtained solving result of the low-rank tensor decomposition optimization model can be used for carrying out power abnormal data identification and restoration, so that compared with the prior art, the robustness is higher and the expansibility is better.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION COMPANY STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Automatic operation and maintenance method based on intelligent agent technology and cooperative network
abstract_en: The application discloses an automatic operation and maintenance method and a collaborative network based on an agent technology, wherein an operation and maintenance agent responds to an alarm event and initializes an operation and maintenance task, a data agent is triggered to collect multi-source heterogeneous operation and maintenance data and conduct preprocessing, the operation and maintenance agent initiates a deep root cause analysis request according to the preprocessing data, a code agent is driven to generate an analysis code and execute the analysis code, the operation and maintenance agent positions the root cause and generates a restoration scheme based on an execution result of the code agent, the restoration effect is verified after the execution, an agent collaborative path and an evidence chain in the operation and maintenance process are presented in real time through a preset visual protocol by a visual agent, and a structural report is generated by reporting the agent. The multi-agent cooperative architecture drives dynamic code generation and safe execution, so that end-to-end automatic root cause positioning and repairing closed loop is realized, meanwhile, an evidence chain and a cooperation process are presented in real time by means of protocol visualization, and the intelligent level of operation and maintenance and the transparency of fault diagnosis are improved.

title_en: Mangrove forest ecological restoration system after standardized typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration, and particularly relates to a mangrove ecological restoration system after a standardized typhoon disaster. The method comprises the steps of dividing disaster degrees of typhoon damaged mangroves into heavy disasters, medium disasters and light disasters based on remote sensing images and field investigation, carrying out lodging tree classification cleaning operation and landform restoration aiming at the heavy disasters, selecting large seedlings for field planting in combination with tidal flat elevation to form reconstruction of a standardized mangrove ecological system, carrying out pruning and supplementing planting operation based on forest windows aiming at the medium disasters, improving primary forest stand recovery efficiency, adopting unmanned motor to monitor forest stand canopy closure degree aiming at the light disasters, and adopting corresponding grade intervention to realize accurate restoration. According to the method, the tidal flat environment and the salinity are based to adapt to the species of the rural tree, and differential restoration operation is adopted, so that the cooperative reconstruction of the mangrove ecological system structure and the coast protection function is realized, and the limitation of traditional restoration is broken through by a standardized operation system.
assignees: HAINAN ACADEMY OF FORESTRY HAINAN MANGROVE RESEARCH INST

title_en: Secret distribution system and secret distribution method of file
abstract_en: To provide a file secret distribution system and method capable of maintaining enough secrecy by complicating file restoration, restoring an original file by using a remaining file even though a partial file disappears during a hardware failure occurrence, a disaster, or the like, and securing business continuation.SOLUTION: A file secret distribution system comprises: a transmission user terminal 2 and a reception user terminal 3 for transmitting/receiving an encrypted file through a network 1; a plurality of online storage 4 for storing the encrypted file to be transmitted/received; and a management server 5 for holding and managing restoration information attached to the encrypted file. An encrypted original file is divided, and a plurality of connection files configured by connecting one or more files among the divided files are created and distributedly stored in the online storage 4.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Apparatus and method for determining location and capacity of distributed generation
title_ko: 분산 전원의 위치와 용량을 결정하는 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an apparatus and a method for determining a position and a capacity of a distributed power source, and more particularly, to an apparatus and a method for determining a position and a capacity of a distributed power source capable of maximizing a recovery load amount by calculating the recovery load amount in accordance with an optimal recovery sequence when a power failure occurs in a distribution network. In addition, the present disclosure may provide an apparatus and a method for determining a position and a capacity of a distributed power source capable of minimizing large-scale human and property damage caused by a power failure by determining an optimal position and an optimal capacity of a distributed power source capable of a black start function for initiating power failure recovery in a distribution network.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 분산 전원의 위치와 용량을 결정하는 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 특히, 배전망의 정전 발생 시, 최적의 복구 시퀀스에 따라 복구 부하량을 계산함으로써, 복구 부하량을 최대화할 수 있는 분산 전원의 위치와 용량을 결정하는 장치 및 방법을 제공할 수 있다. 또한, 배전망 내 정전 복구를 개시하기 위한 블랙 스타트(black start) 기능이 가능한 분산 전원의 최적 위치와 최적 용량을 결정함으로써, 정전으로 인한 대규모 인적, 물질적 피해를 최소화시킬 수 있는 분산 전원의 위치와 용량을 결정하는 장치 및 방법을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Environment risk assessment method for building material recycling after heavy metal contaminated soil restoration
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heavy metal contaminated soil environment risk evaluation, and particularly relates to an environment risk evaluation method for building material recycling after heavy metal contaminated soil restoration. The method comprises the steps of carrying out leaching on a risk assessment system by adopting simulated rainwater, calculating the diffusion coefficient of heavy metal in restored soil, constructing a one-dimensional diffusion model of the heavy metal, calculating the concentration level of the heavy metal released into the underground water in the building material recycling process after restoration according to the dilution attenuation coefficient of the heavy metal in the underground water, and finally quantitatively evaluating the pollution risk of the underground water potentially produced by the reuse of the restored soil in first-class land (residential life land). The method of the invention has the advantages of simplicity, definite process, short period, high efficiency, science and reasonability, can accurately predict and evaluate the pollution risk of building material recycling to the local groundwater after the polluted soil is restored, is beneficial to the protection of the groundwater environment, and has wide applicability.

title_en: A Composition for Reinforcing Pile of Reinforcing Soft Ground and Restoring Disparity Sinking Construction Comprising Urethane for Solidifying Ground and Constructing Methods Using Thereof
title_ko: 지반 고결용 우레탄을 포함하는 연약지반 보강 및 침하구조물 복원에 관한 보강파일 조성물 및 이의 시공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for a reinforced pile and a construction method thereof. The composition for a reinforced pile of the present invention comprises: based on 100 parts by weight of a polymer resin, 20 to 80 parts by weight of a polyol compound; 10 to 60 parts by weight of an isocyanate compound; 5 to 20 parts by weight of an amine compound; 1 to 10 parts by weight of a surfactant; 5 to 30 parts by weight of re-emulsification type polymer powder; 1 to 10 parts by weight of a dispersant; 3 to 40 parts by weight of fiber; 2 to 20 parts by weight of a bonding agent; and 3 to 15 parts by weight of nanoceramic particles. According to the present invention, the reinforced pile can be manufactured by using the composition for the reinforced pile for reinforcing poor ground and restoring a subsided structure. Also, reinforcement and restoration operations can be completed in a short period of time based on simple construction using the composition. Further, according to the present invention, damage of human life and property can be prevented by reinforcing ground under and around an underground structure comprising subways, drainages, underground commercial facilities, and underground power stations, which is poor due to construction of the underground structure and by reinforcing ground which becomes poor over time or due to poor compaction of embankment which is embanked in the construction of housing sites, roads, and railways.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 고분자 수지 100중량부 기준으로, 폴리올 화합물 20 내지 80중량부; 이소시아네이트 화합물 10 내지 60중량부; 아민 화합물 5 내지 20중량부; 계면활성제 1 내지 10중량부; 재유화형 폴리머 분말 5 내지 30중량부; 분산제 1 내지 10중량부; 파이버 3 내지 40중량부; 결합제 2 내지 20중량부; 및 나노세라믹입자 3 내지 15중량부를 포함하는 보강파일 조성물 및 이를 이용한 시공방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 연약지반 보강 및 침하구조물 복원에 관한 보강파일 조성물을 이용하여 보강파일을 제조할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 이를 이용한 간단한 시공으로 짧은 시간에 보강 및 복원작업을 완료할 수 있도록 하는 것에 효과가 있다. 
또한, 본 발명은 지하철, 배수로, 지하 상업 시설 및 지하 발전소 등을 포함하는 지하 구조물의 건설에 따른 구조물 하부 및 주변의 연약 지반을 보강하고, 나아가 택지 조성, 도로, 철도 시공 시 성토된 성토체의 다짐 불량 또는 시간이 지남에 따라 연약 지반화된, 연약 지반을 보강하여 인명 사고는 물론 재산 피해를 예방하는 것에 효과가 있다.

title_en: Prefabricated assembled concrete-filled steel tube self-resetting pier with earthquake damage replaceable components
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a prefabricated assembly steel pipe concrete self-resetting pier with removable component of loss of earthquake, including concrete cushion cap, upper portion steel pipe concrete prefabricated segment, bottom steel pipe concrete prefabricated segment, removable component of loss of earthquake, post-tensioned prestressing tendons and power consumption stop device, upper portion steel pipe concrete prefabricated segment, bottom steel pipe concrete prefabricated segment and concrete cushion cap are pieced together into a whole through the post-tensioned prestressing tendons, and the prestressing tendons pass pier segment pore and cushion cap pore, anchors the ground tackle respectively at concrete cushion cap bottom and pier top; the earthquake damage replaceable component comprises an external steel sheet of the earthquake damage replaceable component and earthquake damage replaceable component concrete. The utility model discloses can not only make the pier realize the quick restoration after shaking, and power consumption stop device can reduce pier earthquake displacement response, increase pier power consumption ability under the condition that does not influence the remaining displacement of pier.

title_en: Heat source system and method for controlling number of start-up machines at heat source system power restoration time
abstract_en: The purpose of the invention is to quickly start up heat source machines up to the number of activated machines before blackout, at the power restoration time, without providing a device for controlling the number of heat source machines with an uninterruptible power supply. Provided is a heat source system comprising an upper level control device (20) equipped with a non-volatile first storage unit (22) for storing the number of heat source machines that have been activated immediately before blackout. When being restored from the blackout, the upper level control device (20) controls the number of heat source machines at the power restoration time according to the number of heat source machines stored in the first storage unit (22).

title_en: Building restoration method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a building repair method, a device and electronic equipment, which belong to the technical field of digital repair, and are characterized in that 3D modeling is performed based on related data of a building to be repaired to obtain a target design model and a current situation model, the two models are compared and analyzed to determine a member to be repaired, after determining a material piece of the member to be repaired, a starting point, an end point and a path network of cutting are determined on the material piece according to the shape structure of the member to be repaired, and then the path network is processed by adopting a shortest path algorithm based on the starting point and/or the end point to obtain a shortest path and optimized to obtain an optimal path, so that the optimal path is encoded into codes, a numerical control machine tool is controlled to execute the codes to cut the material piece to obtain a target member, and the shortest path is obtained by processing the path network and optimizing the shortest path, so that the cutting path and the cutting cost are greatly reduced, the repair period is shortened, and the repair cost is reduced.
assignees: CSCEC SOUTHWEST DESIGN & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic compensation restoration method, system and medium for electric quantity data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic uncompensated reduction method, a system and a medium of electric quantity data, and relates to the technical field of electric measurement, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing direct connection between an electric power center station and a first data source end as well as between an electric power center station and a second data source end; and a bidirectional asymmetric compensation protocol is introduced, a compensation decision device is deployed in a power grid center station, data interaction is carried out between the compensation decision device and a first data source end and a second data source end, compensation decision under double-end decision is executed, electric quantity compensation reduction data are determined, and compensation reduction management of power metering of the power grid is executed according to the electric quantity compensation reduction data. The invention solves the technical problems that the existing electric quantity compensation method cannot effectively cope with bidirectional metering deviation caused by electric energy quality fluctuation and metering information loss, and the precision and adaptability of compensation treatment are poor, and achieves the technical effects of realizing the precision quantization and responsibility division of two types of metering deviation and improving the precision and adaptability of compensation treatment by constructing a double-end decision mechanism of electric energy quality spectrum and information enthalpy quantization.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ZHENJIANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To decide which restoration work is critical restoration work most affecting a period required for production activity resumption of a production facility of one or more pieces of restoration work necessary for production activity resumption of each production process, when the production facility having the plurality of production processes is damaged by a prescribed disaster.  <P>SOLUTION: The critical restoration work decision system 1 has: each process production period storage part 40; each restoration work content storage part 42; each restoration work period storage part 44; and a critical restoration work decision part 28 deciding which restoration work is the critical restoration work most affecting the period required for the production activity resumption of the production facility.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Operation management device, operation system, and definition data synchronization method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reduce the time required for restoration in a disaster recovery system.  <P>SOLUTION: The DR system 8 is provided with a primary system data center 2 and a DR data center 6. The primary system data center 2 and the DR data center 6 are connected by a network 4. The DR data sensor 6 is configured to backup the primary system data center 2.
