A DR management server 14 of the DR data center 6 is configured to acquire primary system definition data 18 having definition on a job in the primary system data center 2 from the primary system data center 2, and to filter the acquired primary system definition data 18 according to necessity in the DR data center 6, and to update DR definition data 20 having definition on a job in the DR data center 6 by using the primary system definition data 18 filtered.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Methods and Systems for the Prevention, Treatment and Management of Disease and Effects of Aging Via Cell-to-Cell Restoration Therapy Using Subcellular Transactions
abstract_en: This invention describes an cellular and subcellular “social network” at a biomolecular level that provides systems and methods for life extension, disease prevention and cellular rejuvenation through the transfer or exchange of biochemical, electrophysiological and sub-cellular biomolecular constructs and/or their assemblies, either in their totality or in part as carriers of material and/or information through interactions and continuous intercourses between neighboring cells. First responder cells are engineered or primed to support such conveyances including, but not limited to: organelles, macromolecules, lipids, ions, etc. from cells able to dispose of said biomaterials, etc. to cells requiring or standing to benefit therefrom. Among other advantages, these systems and methods provide increased capacity for managing intact mitochondrial (switching) mechanisms for the restoration or improved functionality of compromised cells. As cells or cellular clusters signal or are recognized by neighboring cells, cellular assemblage(s) or biomass, they receive mitochondria that are tagged, selected or engineered for cyto-enhancement. First responder cells may be cells native to the organism in situ; cells native to the organism, but removed and cultured or modified in growth media, optionally synthetically induced to express improved functionality, and returned per ipsis or combined with restorative media to aid healing. Additional immunologically compatible cells cultured from sources other than those native to the organism may be provided as an aid to healing. This process may be activated by using chemical, physical or harmonic activators or a combination thereof.

title_en: River course adds medicine aeration integrated device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of black and odorous river channel restoration and environmental protection equipment, in particular to a river channel dosing and aeration integrated device. The device has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation and control, and realization of an automatic dosing system, and solves the problems of mass transfer mixing difference between the aeration gas-liquid mixed liquid and the unaerated low-dissolved oxygen water body of the river channel in the prior art, narrow jet flow range, low aeration efficiency, and the problems that the dosing of the river channel depends on manual spraying, the medicament is only loaded on the water surface, is difficult to diffuse, influences the medicament treatment effect, causes medicament use waste, increases medicament cost, and can cause secondary pollution to the water body. The device has the advantages of combining aeration and chemical addition, strengthening the improvement effect of the water quality of the river channel, along with good spraying effect, wide application range, quick emergency response, no need of manual operation, automatic operation and the like.

title_en: Building restoration method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a building repair method, a device and electronic equipment, which belong to the technical field of digital repair, and are characterized in that 3D modeling is performed based on related data of a building to be repaired to obtain a target design model and a current situation model, the two models are compared and analyzed to determine a member to be repaired, after determining a material piece of the member to be repaired, a starting point, an end point and a path network of cutting are determined on the material piece according to the shape structure of the member to be repaired, and then the path network is processed by adopting a shortest path algorithm based on the starting point and/or the end point to obtain a shortest path and optimized to obtain an optimal path, so that the optimal path is encoded into codes, a numerical control machine tool is controlled to execute the codes to cut the material piece to obtain a target member, and the shortest path is obtained by processing the path network and optimizing the shortest path, so that the cutting path and the cutting cost are greatly reduced, the repair period is shortened, and the repair cost is reduced.

title_en: Systems and methods for advancing the restoration process for interdependent critical infrastructures
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for advancing the restoration process for interdependent critical infrastructures (CIs) after a disaster. A modeling and solution approach can leverage the strengths of reinforcement learning (RL) to enhance the computational capability of optimization techniques to advance the restoration process. The gap can be bridged between integrative and distinct decision-making, enabling coordinated restoration planning for CIs within a decentralized decision-making context.
assignees: SAHA NAMRATA;AMINI MOHAMMADHADI;REZAPOUR SHABNAM;THE FLORIDA INTERNATIONAL UNIV BOARD OF TRUSTEES

title_en: Barrier-free tripping system of ultrahigh voltage and high voltage circuit breaker
abstract_en: The invention discloses an obstacle-free tripping system of an extra-high voltage and high voltage circuit breaker, which mainly comprises a power circuit with a voltage value larger than 600 volts, at least one circuit breaker, at least one current detection device, a current supply and reduction unit, at least one microswitch and a linkage device. By means of the structure, a breaker safety tripping device without extra power supply is arranged on any breaker of an ultrahigh voltage or high voltage power circuit, and by utilizing a simple mechanical action principle, when the breaker encounters a major accident disaster and the power supply of a tripping control circuit is damaged and powered off, so that the original designed tripping isolation function is lost, the self-emergency tripping breaker can still automatically and emergently trip to achieve self protection, the whole power system and a switch bus are not damaged by overlarge fault current, the power system is isolated in real time, and self power-off protection is performed; waiting for the last defense line of the power restoration at any time.

title_en: Power distribution network repair schedule optimization method for access distributed photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of smart power grids, and provides a power distribution network repair schedule optimization method for access distributed photovoltaic power generation. The method comprises the following steps that 1, the access distributed photovoltaic power generation output and the distribution network load are used as random fuzzy uncertain source loads for modeling; 2, a power distribution network repair schedule optimization model based on the credibility theory is built; 3, two-layer optimization solving is carried out on the repair schedule, and finally a result is output. The fuzzy factors in the power distribution network repair process are described by introducing the credibility theory, the uncertainty theory and the optimal method are organically combined, and the repair schedule applicability is improved; meanwhile, repair cost and reliably indexes are introduced during repaid schedule optimization, and both economy and reliability of the repair schedule are achieved. In addition, according to the different confidence levels, different optimization schemes can be obtained, and a decision maker can flexibly select the corresponding optimization repair scheme according to the repair cost, reliability and the confidence levels.

title_en: Photovoltaic output data restoration method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic output data restoration method and a photovoltaic output data restoration system, which are used for acquiring historical output data of a target photovoltaic power station where a photovoltaic output sequence to be restored is located and photovoltaic power stations adjacent to the target photovoltaic power station; calculating correlation coefficients of the target photovoltaic power station and the adjacent photovoltaic power stations thereof based on the historical output data; based on the correlation coefficient, repairing the photovoltaic output data of the photovoltaic output sequence to be repaired in a set time period; the photovoltaic output sequence to be repaired is a photovoltaic output sequence with abnormal data. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the photovoltaic output repaired by the method takes the spatial correlation of the output of each photovoltaic power station into consideration, and the photovoltaic output repairing accuracy is improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Mobile self-organization based method for optimizing and recovering communication network of distribution network in disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile self-organization based method for optimizing and recovering a power distribution network in a disaster, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring the multi-element data in the power distribution network; s2, determining the state of the power distribution network in the disaster by using a grid method; s3, judging whether the power distribution network communication system needs transient recovery or not, and determining a restoration mode of the power distribution network communication system according to a judgment result; s4, researching an optimized repair scheme of the power distribution network communication network based on the characteristics of the mobile ad hoc network; s5, finding out a feasible scheme set under the target by using a path search algorithm of network simplification and depth-first traversal, solving each feasible scheme, and selecting the optimal result as a final repair scheme. According to the method, the state of the power distribution network communication system in the disaster is rapidly determined and the optimal recovery scheme in a corresponding mode is found out through the integration processing of the multivariate information in the power distribution network when the disaster occurs, so that the rush repair time of the power distribution network communication network is shortened to the maximum extent.

title_en: Evaluation method of fault recovery scheme of direct-current power distribution network based on AHP-TOPSIS
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method of a fault recovery scheme of a direct-current power distribution network based on AHP-TOPSIS. Firstly, fault characteristic analysis is carried out on faults occurring at all positions of a direct current distribution network, a typical direct current distribution network fault restorability index which takes direct current distribution network fault restoration as a target is defined, an Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is utilized to classify the restorability index, and the weight of the defined fault restorability index relative to the direct current distribution network fault restoration is determined. And then, determining a plurality of feasible fault recovery schemes under the fault of the direct current distribution network according to the fault type. And finally, evaluating the relative merits of the various proposed fault recovery schemes by combining a top-down order method (TOPSIS) approaching an ideal value with typical DC distribution network fault recoverability index values under different schemes.

title_en: Software robot-based automatic management and control platform and method for electricity consumption fee tracking
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic management and control platform and method for electricity consumption fee tracking based on a software robot. The method comprises the following steps: 1. logging in the system, opening the power failure work order module, judging whether the current work order is a target work order, if so, sending a short message, and writing the short message into an excel table record; 2. judging whether all work orders are checked, if so, opening the power restoration work order module, and judging whether the current work order is a target work order; 3. if yes, judging whether the target work order exceeds 5 hours and the call reply time is not filled, if yes, sending a short message, and writing the short message into an excel form record; if not, judging whether the target work order exceeds 8 hours and does not fill the call reply time, if so, sending a short message, and writing the short message into an excel form record. The invention inquires the payment condition of the defaulting user in real time, automatically creates the power restoration worksheet for the user who does not restore the power in time and tracks the whole process, reduces the human input, improves the service efficiency, shortens the power restoration time and reduces the overtime condition.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD SHANWEI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Hillock-caving-volume-caving rapid vegetation recovery technology without soil preparation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of water and soil loss treatment, and discloses a rapid restoration method of collapsed vegetation without soil preparation. The collapsed volume is extremely aggressive and bad, the conditions of vegetation growing are poor, and the conventional collapsed volume vegetation recovery often needs to be firstly prepared with soil preparation engineering. According to the method, water and soil conservation herbaceous plants with the pressure-resistant burying characteristic are preferably planted firstly, then the surface erosion is prevented by using a mountain grass covering method, and the furrow erosion is prevented by building the branch check dam, so that a good field condition is provided for vegetation growth. According to the invention, the whole coverage of the collapsed body ground vegetation can be realized after 3-4 months of construction. The required materials can be basically obtained from local materials, and are particularly suitable for the treatment of collapse caused by traffic inconvenience. The invention successfully realizes vegetation restoration of the landslide body under the condition of no land preparation by taking various plant residues as assistance, and is a landslide control method adopting pure plant measures. Because the land preparation construction is not needed, a large amount of construction cost can be saved.
assignees: INST OF ECO ENVIRONMENT AND SOIL SCIENCES GUANGDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Electricity sales prediction method based on data restoration and decomposition sequence prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting electricity sales amount based on data restoration and decomposition sequence prediction, which belongs to the technical field of economic planning of a distributed energy storage system of a power distribution network, and comprises the steps of firstly, detecting abnormal values of historical electricity sales data by adopting Box-plot; then, interpolating the missing electricity selling data by using the countermeasure generating network; decomposing the electricity selling data into subsequences with different frequencies by adopting an improved adaptive noise complete set empirical mode algorithm; and finally, predicting the low-frequency subsequence by adopting an LEAR method, predicting the high-frequency subsequence by adopting LSTNet, and reconstructing a prediction result into a final electricity sales amount prediction result. The method provided by the invention improves the prediction precision from two aspects of data and a prediction model, and compared with the existing prediction algorithm, the prediction aspect provided by the invention is more accurate and stable.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN;SICHUAN ENERGY INVEST COMPREHENSIVE ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Pollution prevention and control method for ion type rare earth green exploitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ion type rare earth green exploitation pollution control method, which comprises the following steps: determining mining area boundaries and ecosystem classifications using the topography measurements and the remote sensing images; calculating an ecological restoration rate based on the NDVI data, constructing an environment accommodation quantity model, and determining the exploitation quantity; analyzing hydrologic conditions by using a hydrogeologic model and a GIS technology, and optimizing exploration network; establishing a hydrological response model, and optimizing a liquid injection and collection system; using numerical simulation to prevent landslide, and setting an early warning threshold value; the integrated exploitation control system realizes real-time monitoring and early warning; and (3) carrying out ecological restoration and tail water treatment after ore closing by adopting a zonal liquid injection technology. According to the invention, through calculation of the exploitation quantity, analysis and display of the spatial variation rule of the rare earth ore resources, the arrangement of the liquid injection project and the liquid collection project is guided, the leaching mother liquor leakage is reduced while the leaching rate and the recovery rate of the rare earth resources are improved, the influence on the groundwater environment is reduced, the water balance in the production of mining areas is ensured, and the pollution is controllable.
assignees: CHANGTING BRANCH OF ZHONGXI FUJIAN RARE EARTH MINING CO LTD

title_en: Power supply output curve data quality restoration method, system, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, a medium and equipment for repairing the quality of power output curve data, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting the power output curve data of a target photovoltaic power station; the method comprises the steps of determining data to be repaired, which has problems, from the power output curve data, repairing the data to be repaired by adopting a proportion repairing method if the data to be repaired is multi-day data, and repairing the data to be repaired by adopting a linear interpolation method if the data to be repaired is single-day data. According to the method, single-day data or multi-day data or the combination of the single-day data and the multi-day data are selected for repairing according to the data missing condition, so that the accuracy of repairing the power output curve data of the target photovoltaic power station is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;BEIJING GUODIANTONG NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Power load prediction method for multichannel deep learning based on attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power load prediction method based on multichannel deep learning of an attention mechanism, which comprises the steps of carrying out data preprocessing operation of outlier restoration on power load data by adopting IQR quartile range and cubic spline interpolation, setting a fluctuation channel and a smoothing channel according to fluctuation characteristics and smoothing characteristics of the power load data, constructing a load prediction model based on the deep learning of fluctuation-smoothing characteristics fusion based on the fluctuation channel and the smoothing channel, optimizing super parameters of the load prediction model based on the deep learning of fluctuation-smoothing characteristics fusion by adopting an improved leader-guided fishing optimization algorithm, training the load prediction model based on the deep learning of fluctuation-smoothing characteristics fusion by adopting the power load data after the data preprocessing operation, and predicting the power load by adopting the trained load prediction model. The comprehensive efficiency of power load prediction is improved, and the coping capability of the system to power load uncertainty is improved.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD;CHANGDIAN ZHANGYE ENERGY DEV CO LTD;ZHANGYE JINYUAN ELECTRIC POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Modular coast sand stabilization device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coast protection and ecological restoration, and particularly relates to a modularized coast sand fixation device. The sand fixing device comprises a device main body, an electrodeposited sand fixing module, a power supply module, a control system, a communication module and an amphibious motion module, wherein the electrodeposited sand fixing module, the power supply module, the control system, the communication module and the amphibious motion module are all arranged on the device main body, the electrodeposited sand fixing module is used for realizing electrifying operation on sand beach, the power supply module is used for supplying power for running of the device, the communication module is used for realizing communication interconnection among a plurality of devices, and the amphibious motion module is used for driving the device to move. According to the invention, ca  2+ 、Mg 2+  plasma in sea water can be activated by applying current to the sand beach to generate mineral binders such as calcium carbonate, magnesium hydroxide and the like to form a solidified layer, so that sand grains are effectively solidified, the stability of the sand beach is enhanced, the corrosion of the sea water is lightened, the corrosion disaster resistance of the coast is improved, and the ecological environment of the sand beach is protected.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for evaluating acidic underground water of abandoned mine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of ecological assessment, and particularly relates to an ecological assessment method, system, equipment and storage medium for acidic underground water of a abandoned mine, which are characterized in that physical and chemical parameters of the acidic underground water of the abandoned mine, including pH value, heavy metal concentration, dissolved oxygen content, temperature and conductivity, are obtained through analysis of a sensor and a laboratory, the collected physical and chemical parameters are subjected to denoising, normalization and interpolation treatment to eliminate abnormal values and ensure the integrity of data, an ecological risk assessment model is trained by using historical data based on a machine learning algorithm, the model comprises a support vector machine, a random forest and a neural network, the ecological risk is classified into three grades of low risk, medium risk and high risk according to the output result of the model, corresponding risk reports are generated, and restoration and treatment suggestions, including an acidic water treatment scheme, a groundwater monitoring plan and ecological restoration measures, are automatically generated according to the risk grades, so that the method has the effect of providing more comprehensive and more detailed assessment results and providing scientific basis for environmental protection decisions.
assignees: HYDROGEOLOGY BUREAU CHINA NAT ADMINISTRATION COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: New energy wind-light sample data processing method and device based on regularity constraint
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of energy data processing, in particular to a new energy wind-light sample data processing method and device based on regularity constraint, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a regular interpolation model and carrying out interpolation supplementation on data missing which easily occurs in a complex environment of a new energy wind power and photovoltaic system; the method comprises the steps of establishing a data quality assessment model based on a topology perception local reversible attention mechanism, automatically assessing the quality of data generated by different interpolation modes, establishing a dynamic weight fusion model, automatically adjusting the weight of each data source in the data complement process, thereby realizing the optimization of the data restoration effect, establishing an abnormal data rejection model, and improving the integrity and reliability of new energy data. Therefore, the problems that the generalization of the prior art for dealing with complicated and changeable severe weather conditions is poor, the data integrity and accuracy are difficult to be considered effectively, the requirement of a new energy power generation system on high-quality data cannot be met and the like are solved.

title_en: Folding field orthopaedics traction restorer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a folding field orthopaedics traction restorer, and belongs to the technical field of medical first-aid appliances. The device comprises a fixing frame and a folding frame hinged with the fixing frame, wherein a traction support driven by a screw rod is arranged in the fixing frame, the rear end of the folding frame is provided with a fixed support, the fixing support and the folding frame are both used for fixing limbs through a fixed belt with ladder buckles, a sliding seat at the rear end of the screw rod, a first connecting rod and a second connecting rod form a sliding block connecting rod mechanism, rapid traction or fine screw rod traction can be achieved, and a pressure sensor is integrated on the traction support for monitoring traction in real time. The invention is foldable, is convenient to store and carry, can provide two traction modes, namely a rapid traction mode and a slow traction mode, has stable and controllable traction process, effectively avoids secondary damage, and is suitable for the first aid restoration in the severe environments such as field operations, disaster rescue and the like.
assignees: THE 920TH HOSPITAL OF JOINT LOGISTICS SUPPORT FORCE OF THE CHINESE PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY

title_en: Paint composition
title_ko: 결로 및 수중 조건하의 중성화된 콘크리트의 성능복원 기능성 도료 조성물
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A functional paint composition is provided to enable a performance restoration of the concrete structure which is neutralized on the condition of flooding, condensation by strengthening the alkalinity of the underwater-hardening epoxy- silicate hybrid resin. CONSTITUTION: A manufacturing method of a functional paint composition comprises the following steps. An underwater-hardening epoxy resin and aqueous potassium silicate are provided. A deformed epoxy resin of high viscosity (1,500 CPS) is changed to low viscosity (100-500 CPS) by using a diluent, and less than 5% parts by weight of natural resin is added base on the total weight. 23% of potassium silicate resin compare to the total weight of solid content is stirred at 70-80°C, RPM 1500-2500 for 1-2 hours; potassium hydroxide which is catalyst and water are dropped down. 20-30°C, and the RPM 500-3,000 condition are maintained in the potassium silicate resin. The epoxy resin of low viscosity is dropped down as a small amount (100g) to the edge of vortex. The temperature is increased to 60-100°C and the RPM 200-1,000 condition is maintained. 40-60% of water and dilutent are evaporated base on the total weight of the added water and dilutent. The evaporated resin is cooled at a room temperature and less than 1% of anticoagulation agent is added.
abstract_ko:
하수 및 정수처리장, 지하저장탱크류, 및 해양구조물 등의 콘크리트 구조물들은 침수 혹은 다습한 결로조건하에 항상 노출되어 있으며, 이로 인한 콘크리트의 염해 및 중성화는 가속화된다. 또한 이러한 결로 및 수중 조건하의 중성화된 콘크리트의 보수 및 성능복원은 결로및 수중조건으로 인하여 각종 코팅재 및 성능복원재 등의 시공이 힘들며, 또한 코팅재 등의 건조 및 경화조건을 갖추기가 어려워 사실상 경화반응 및 건조과정이 수반되는 코팅재 및 복원재의 적용이 불가능하다. 
따라서 이러한 결로 및 수중 조건하의 중성화된 콘크리트의 성능복원이 가능한  수중경화형 에폭시 - 실리케이트 하이브리드 기능성도료 조성물과 이를 제조하는 방법을 제시 한다.

title_en: Pumped storage power station side slope ecological restoration method and system based on near-natural concept
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pumped storage power station side slope ecological restoration method and system based on a near natural concept, and relates to the field of ecological restoration, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the landform characteristics of a current pumped storage power station side slope and analyzing to obtain a characteristic factor sequence, obtaining the geographic position of the pumped storage power station side slope and generating a virtual model proportionally; screening plant materials in a plant material library according to the current demand condition and the characteristic factor sequence to obtain target plant materials, marking the target plant materials in a virtual model, generating a sowing strategy, simulating plant material growth vigor in the virtual model, recording virtual plant material growth vigor conditions under different periods, collecting the current plant material growth vigor conditions of a pumped storage power station side slope, comparing and analyzing the current plant material growth vigor conditions with the virtual plant material growth vigor conditions under the same period to obtain the ecological restoration evaluation of the pumped storage power station side slope, and adjusting the sowing strategy according to the ecological restoration evaluation of the pumped storage power station side slope and performing current remediation.

title_en: FLISR without communication
abstract_en: A control system and method for a feeder, or portion of the distribution grid, which enables fault location, isolation and service restoration without communications between the feeder switches. The method uses definite time coordination between feeder switches and local measurements to determine which switches should open or close in order to isolate the fault and restore service downstream of a faulted section. Time-current characteristics and feeder topology are shared with all switches in the feeder prior to a fault event. When a disturbance occurs, a timer is started at each switch. When a switch measures voltage loss in all three phases, it stops its timer. Each switch evaluates the timer values and, when a particular switch determines based on the time-current characteristics that the immediate upstream switch opened to isolate the fault, that particular switch also opens. Power upstream of the particular switch is then provided by an alternative source.

title_en: A afforestation equipment for alumina mine side slope ecological remediation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a afforestation equipment for ecological remediation of alumina mine side slope, including the base, the water tank is installed at the top of base, is equipped with sprinkling irrigation mechanism in the water tank, and the top of water tank is equipped with first collection respectively and fights and the second is collected and fight, and the bottom fixedly connected with connecting pipe that first collection was fought, and the connecting pipe is the slope state setting, and in the one end that first collection was fought was kept away from to the connecting pipe extended to the second and is collected and fight, the second was collected and is fought and is equipped with the power generation mechanism who is used for driving sprinkling irrigation mechanism work. In the utility model, the sprinkling irrigation mechanism is arranged, so that the phenomenon that the vegetation is dry due to the fact that the people cannot water on the steep slope is avoided, and the survival rate of the vegetation is improved; and through the arranged power generation mechanism, the wind energy of the nature can be utilized, the energy is saved, the aims of conserving water sources and preventing water and soil loss and landslide are fulfilled on the mine slope, and the aims of ecological restoration and greening are fulfilled.
assignees: SHANXI MECH CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Life saving radio station beacon signal simulation transmitting device
abstract_en: The invention provides a beacon signal simulation transmitting device of a lifesaving radio station, which comprises a radio station signal simulation module, a frequency conversion module, a power amplification module, a control module, a power supply module and an antenna. The invention can generate the beacon simulation signal which is completely consistent with the lifesaving radio station through the ways of sample acquisition, digital processing and inverse processing and signal restoration by the digital cloning technology under the condition of not mastering the technical system and the waveform characteristics of the beacon signal of the lifesaving radio station, thereby providing a new means for researching and developing search and rescue training equipment required by maritime search and rescue training and meeting the guarantee requirement of the search and rescue training equipment on the maritime of a rescue army.
assignees: GUANGDONG SHANFENG MEASUREMENT & CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Network attack restoration system and method suitable for power network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a network attack restoration system suitable for a power network, which comprises: the detection terminal is used for receiving a control command which cannot pass through the protocol filtering interface and carrying out network attack restoration on the received control command so as to realize detection on the control command, determine whether the control command is network attack content or not, and when the control command is determined to be the network attack content, send information of the attack content to the safety firewall so that the safety firewall adds a new detection rule according to the attack content information. The invention also discloses a corresponding method. By implementing the embodiment of the invention, the server can be effectively prevented from receiving network attacks, and the safety of the power network is enhanced.

title_en: Evaluation method and device for complex electricity effect of distribution network line and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating complex electricity effect of a distribution network line and electronic equipment. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring fault probability of a unit length of a distribution network line, a power failure area distribution variable and a complex power area distribution variable; determining net rack complex electricity effect of the distribution network circuit based on the fault probability of unit length, the power failure area distribution variable and the complex electricity area distribution variable, wherein the net rack complex electricity effect is used for representing the recovery degree of the distribution network circuit; determining the power restoration success probability of the distribution network line based on the unit length fault probability and the power restoration action times of the power restoration area, wherein the power restoration action times are used for representing the times of the power restoration actions executed by the power supply function in the power restoration area; and carrying out complex electricity effect evaluation on the distribution network line based on the complex electricity success probability and the net rack complex electricity effect to obtain a complex electricity effect evaluation result of the distribution network line. The invention solves the technical problem of high evaluation difficulty of complex electric effect of the distribution network line.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Soil quality assessment method and device for power transmission and transformation project influence area
abstract_en: The invention provides a soil quality assessment method and device for an influence area of power transmission and transformation engineering, and belongs to the field of data analysis. The method comprises the steps of collecting soil data, biological data and environmental data in an influence area to be evaluated in power transmission and transformation engineering, determining influence variable data in the influence area to be evaluated according to the data in the influence area to be evaluated, obtaining soil quality change prediction data according to the influence variable data, and obtaining a soil quality evaluation result in the influence area to be evaluated according to the soil quality change prediction data, the biological variable data and the environmental variable data. According to the invention, the predicted data of the soil quality change obtained by prediction is evaluated, so that the problem that the soil quality evaluation result deviates from the actual soil ecological restoration and repair can be effectively solved. In the process of evaluating the soil quality, the influence of pollutants on organisms including animals and plants is considered, so that the evaluation result is more comprehensive and accurate.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power grid outage result analysis method considering supply chain-gas-electricity fault conduction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a power grid outage result analysis method considering supply chain-gas-electric fault conduction, which comprises the following steps of S1, modeling an electric network coupling relation, S2, analyzing a supply chain weak link, S3, modeling a gas pipe network fault, establishing a pressure and flow calculation model of a natural gas pipe network, S4, modeling a gas-electric coupling component, establishing a mathematical model of a gas turbine and a compressor, S5, modeling an urban power grid fault, evaluating the running state of the power grid under the fault, S6, constructing a power outage result evaluation index, and quantifying social influence and recovery priority under different fault scenes.

title_en: Water supply optimizing and scheduling method and system for water works
abstract_en: The invention provides a water supply optimizing and dispatching method and a system for a water supply plant, which relate to the technical field of resource dispatching and comprise the steps of obtaining real-time water supply data of a water supply route; the method comprises the steps of monitoring real-time water supply data of a water supply route to obtain real-time fault nodes and real-time fault information of the water supply route, inquiring scheduling requirements through a constructed emergency scheduling model based on the water supply route according to the real-time fault nodes and the real-time fault information to obtain scheduling requirement data corresponding to the real-time fault nodes, obtaining an optimal rush repair scheduling plan according to the scheduling requirement data, and executing corresponding scheduling tasks according to the optimal rush repair scheduling plan. The optimal scheduling method and the optimal scheduling system can improve the matching of the scheduled manpower and material resources and the fault site, and effectively improve the emergency repair efficiency.

title_en: Geographic information system of pipe network GIS
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of a pipe network GIS geographic information system, in particular to a pipe network GIS geographic information system, which solves the problem of engineering potential safety hazards caused by the traditional fixed threshold value by dynamically correcting the maximum allowable length of a pipe section, automatically screening a compliant pipe section and marking abnormal types, constructs a water supply communication network based on a graph traversal algorithm and intelligently identifies isolation sections, generates restoration suggestions containing newly added node coordinates and quantity, ensures full-coverage water supply of mountain areas or scattered villages, adopts a multi-objective optimization mechanism, quantifies the influence of pressure gradients and pipe diameter parameters on path priorities, dynamically adjusts weight coefficients to balance water pressure guarantee and pipe cost, and generates a candidate path pool covering all water points through a topology model. The method solves the problems that the efficiency of the traditional pipe network geographic information system in the planning of the water supply branch is low, and the cost, the water pressure and the coverage of the isolation section are difficult to be considered.

title_en: Method and system for detecting and notifying power interruption and power quality
abstract_en: Methods and systems for detecting and notifying power interruptions and power quality are described herein. A sensor coupled to the circuit transmits a keep-alive packet to the server. The sensor detects an input signal generated by the electrical activity. The sensor generates an output signal based on the input signal. The sensor monitors the output signal. During a clock cycle, the sensor determines whether a rising edge occurs and transmits a failure packet to the server when the rising edge occurs before a predetermined clock value or when no rising edge occurs. The server receives the failure packet from the sensor and listens for keep-alive packets. The server transmits a power down notification when no keep-alive packets are received for at least a defined period of time after the failed packet is received. When one or more keep-alive packets are subsequently received, the server transmits a power restoration notification.

title_en: Simulation determination method and simulation determination device for restoration operation procedure
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To easily discriminate whether a restoration operation procedure for a virtual accident is correct or not.  <P>SOLUTION: A load dispatching office sets the virtual accident and communicates the set virtual accident to a plurality of power relevant facilities. Each power relevant facility which receives the report of the virtual accident analyzes the content of the virtual accident to determine a time for executing a restoration operation to the virtual accident. All of procedure information of the restoration operations executed in the respective power relevant facilities is collected to the load dispatching office, and arranged into one restoration operation procedure. This is the executed restoration operation procedure which was actually executed, and collation of a recommended restoration operation procedure with combination examples thereof is performed. Whether a linkage mistake of the restoration operation procedure is minor or serious can be easily acquired by reporting the corresponding combination. Whether a wrong restoration operation procedure is executed as the procedure for restoring the virtual accident or not can be confirmed in a field where the restoration operation is actually executed.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Pachinko game machine
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a Pachinko game machine which can increase the reliability of exchange of a variety of signals with a CR unit.  <P>SOLUTION: A payout control MPU 1710a is structured so as to permit the Pachinko game machine to continue the exchange of a variety of signals with the CR unit just before the momentary blackout or the power failure and continue the payout of game balls from the time of return of power as a result of restoration of the number of stocked prize balls, the actual count of balls, the number of drive commands, and the value of a nonconformity counter to those just before the momentary blackout or power failure at the time of return of power even if a cut-off of exchange of signals with the CR unit due to the momentary blackout or power failure makes the Pachinko game machine unable to continue to put out game balls when the Pachinko game machine is putting out game balls to a storage tray while exchanging the signals with the CR unit. Consequently, the reliability of the exchange of signals between the Pachinko game machine and the CR unit can be increased.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&amp;INPIT

title_en: Disaster evaluation device, disaster evaluation method, and program
abstract_en: The present invention provides a disaster evaluation device, etc. that make it possible to comprehensively evaluate the status of restoration associated with the occurrence of a disaster. A disaster evaluation device according to the present invention is configured to: perform simulations, in response to the occurrence of a disaster, of the status of damage individually in relation to a plurality of types of events due to the disaster; convert data indicating the status of damage as the results of the simulations into data indicating a common social value; evaluate changes in the social value due to the disaster on the basis of the plurality of items of converted data; and recommend one or more countermeasures to the plurality of types of events on the basis of the degrees of decrease in the social value due to the evaluated disaster. The disaster evaluation device should perform simulations of the status of restoration from the disaster in relation to the plurality of types of events on the basis of received restoration plan information, should convert the data indicating the status of restoration into data indicating the common social value, and should evaluate changes in the social value due to restoration from the disaster on the basis of the plurality of items of converted data.
assignees: NEC CORP;UNIV TOHOKU;NEC SOLUTION INNOVATORS LTD

title_en: Constrained service restoration with heuristics
abstract_en: A method of determining service routes for a plurality of crews is provided. Outage data identifying a plurality of service outage source locations, a number of affected customers associated with each location of the plurality of locations, and a type of repair to perform at each location of the plurality of locations is received. A repair time is estimated for each location. Crew data identifying a plurality of crews and a start location for the plurality of crews is received. A service route for each crew is determined based on a crew skill indicator associated with each crew satisfying the type of repair to perform at each location and based on the estimated repair time for each location. The service route for a crew of the plurality of crews includes the start location as a first location and at least one location of the plurality of locations.

title_en: Dynamically selecting optimal instance type for disaster recovery in the cloud
abstract_en: One example includes performing a VM restore instance type discovery process, creating a test VM with a VM restore instance type matching a VM restore instance type identified during discovery, using the test VM to create a test restore VM at a cloud storage site, restoring the test VM at the cloud storage site using the test restore VM, generating a 4-D baseline vector based on the restoration of the test VM, the 4-D baseline vector identifying a particular VM restore instance type, generating a 5-D vector based on the 4-D baseline vector, ranking the 5-D vector relative to other 5-D vectors, the 5-D vectors identifying the same production site VM, and restoring, at the cloud storage site, the production site VM identified in the 5-D vectors, the production site VM restored at the cloud storage site has a VM restore instance type identified in the highest ranked 5-D vector.

title_en: System, Device and Method For Providing Power Outage and Restoration Notification
abstract_en: A system, computer program product and method to provide information related to a power distribution system based on information provided by a plurality of network elements electrically connected to a plurality of power lines of the power distribution system at a plurality of locations is provided. In one embodiment, the method comprises receiving a notification from a group of network elements that have detected a voltage signature indicating an imminent power outage, determining location information of the power outage, outputting the location information of the power outage, receiving a live notification from a first network element of the group of network elements indicating a first power restoration at a location of the first network element, determining location information of the first power restoration, and outputting the location information of the first power restoration.
assignees: DEAVER SR BRIAN J;YANEY DAVID S

title_en: Accelerated recovery after a data disaster
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present invention, a metadata file is transferred from the first system to the second system and a database on the second system is initialized based on the metadata file. An image, including information of the first system to be restored, is transferred from the first system to the second system, and restoration of the information to the second system based on the image is initiated. Prior to completion of the restoration, one or more log files indicating actions performed on the first system relating to the information to be restored is transferred from the first system to the initialized database on the second system. In response to completion of the restoration, the actions of the log files are performed to synchronize the restored data on the second system with the first system.

title_en: A kind of ecological slope protection structure of breakage mountain body
abstract_en: The utility model relates to breakage mountain body ecological restoration technical fields, and disclose a kind of ecological slope protection structure of breakage mountain body, including massif, the upper end on slope is equipped with concrete pit, concrete blend stop has been poured inside concrete pit, the top and bottom on slope are equipped with transformation platform, and concrete blend stop is fixedly connected with transformation platform；By setting concrete pit and concrete blend stop, casting concrete in concrete pit is formed into concrete blend stop, massif can be consolidated using the connecting structure between concrete blend stop and vegetation is prevented to be flushed away；By setting flume and drainage ditch, water flow is introduced into drainage ditch using flume, is drained water flow by drainage ditch, avoiding water flow and can not being discharged leads to landslide；By setting drainage hole and filter screen, when water flow is discharged into flume by drainage hole, filter screen can reduce the loss of water and soil；The loss of water and soil is avoided using vegetation growth on hillside by the way that vegetation is arranged.
assignees: JINAN LANDSCAPE ARCHITECTURE DEV & CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Mountain vegetation resumes support frame
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mountain vegetation restoration support frame which comprises a protection mechanism and a support mechanism, wherein the protection mechanism comprises a collection cover, a collection cavity is integrally formed in the collection cover, water passing holes are formed in one side of the collection cover in an equidistant mode and communicated with the collection cavity, a water outlet pipe is communicated with one side of the collection cover, a connecting ring is fixedly connected to the bottom of the collection cover, a slot is integrally formed in one side of the connecting ring, the support mechanism comprises two fixing plates, one sides of the two fixing plates are fixedly connected with limiting plates, one side of each limiting plate is clamped with the connecting ring through the slot, and the protection mechanism is used for collecting and guiding rainwater in overcast and rainy weather while protecting a part of vegetation, and dispersing and collecting part of rainwater into the collection cavity and discharging the rainwater to other areas through the water outlet pipe, so that the situation that the mountain local landslide is influenced by excessive flushing of the mountain is prevented.
assignees: HEILONGJIANG HAOMIAO ENG DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Power load prediction method and system based on abnormal restoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power load prediction method and a system based on abnormal restoration, wherein the method comprises the following steps: 1) training based on power load sample data to obtain a power load prediction model; 2) acquiring current power load data, and predicting by using the power load prediction model to obtain a predicted value at the moment t +1, wherein t is the current moment; 3) and acquiring an actual value at the t +1 moment, comparing the difference between the predicted value at the t +1 moment and the actual value at the t +1 moment, judging whether an abnormality exists based on the difference, if so, restoring the abnormality and then returning to the step 2), and if not, directly returning to the step 2). Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of capability of realizing abnormal restoration, high prediction accuracy and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Biological ecological remediation system for rural sewage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biological ecological restoration system for rural sewage, wherein a water quality prediction model unit is used for constructing a water quality prediction model of a rural water environment based on rural water environment historical information and predicting the water quality condition of the rural water environment at the next moment based on the water quality prediction model; the restoration execution unit is used for restoring the water quality according to the future water quality state predicted by the water quality prediction model unit; the restoration execution unit comprises a grid arranged at a sewage inlet, and sewage sequentially enters the primary sedimentation tank, the oxygen pressing tank and the oxygen-poor tank; the aerobic tank is communicated with the secondary sedimentation tank; the secondary sedimentation tank is respectively connected with the sludge concentration tank and the wetland; the wetland is communicated with a reservoir water environment or a river water environment; according to the fore-and-aft change and removal rate of different aquatic plant species and combinations thereof on water pollution indexes of ammonia nitrogen, nitrate nitrogen, total phosphorus and chlorophyll a under the still water condition, the aquatic plants are selected to be planted in the wetland.
assignees: ANHUI & HUAIHE RIVER INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULIC RES ANHUI WATER CONSERVANCY PROJECT QUALITY INSPECTION C

title_en: High-speed calculation system for electric charge
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-speed electric charge calculation system, comprising: the data integration module is used for extracting the charge control calculation charge related data, initializing the charge control calculation charge related data into the high-performance calculation distributed storage, and performing preprocessing operation; the electric quantity calculation module is used for storing the synchronous surface code data in the marketing management information system in a distributed column storage format in a data processing platform and calculating the electric quantity through an electric quantity calculation algorithm; the electric charge calculation module is used for calculating the electric charge corresponding to each metering point according to the electric quantity calculation result, wherein the electric charge comprises electric charge, fund and additional charge, basic electric charge and power factor adjustment electric charge; the remote charge control management module is used for realizing measurement management and power failure and power restoration management in charge control service; and the result write-back module is used for writing back the generated result data to the marketing management information system after the relevant calculation, the check and the comparison are completed. The invention can assist the marketing management information system to meet the processing requirement of massive user data.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID HAINAN DIGITAL POWER GRID RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent voice outbound method for deep learning fault text information extraction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent voice outbound method for deep learning fault text information extraction. The method comprises the following steps: collecting a large amount of power line fault text data and carrying out preprocessing operation; vectorizing the preprocessed data text and carrying out manual labeling to obtain a data set to be trained; training the obtained data set through a deep pyramid convolution neural network to obtain corresponding network model parameters; extracting equipment information; inquiring a signal table related to the state and reclosing of the circuit breaker through the equipment ID, judging whether the circuit breaker is successfully reclosed according to the time interval of power loss and power restoration, and generating an outbound text by data; and sending the outbound text to the transformer substation operation and maintenance class for scheduling. According to the invention, whether the circuit breaker is successfully reclosed can be quickly judged according to the extracted information, and meanwhile, the voice outbound scheduling is sent to the transformer substation to which the fault equipment belongs, so that the power supply reliability is effectively improved.
assignees: Jiangsu electric power information technology co ltd

title_en: Underground water restoration process intelligent supervision method and system based on multi-mode monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring method and system for a groundwater remediation process based on multi-mode monitoring, and belongs to the technical field of groundwater monitoring. The method comprises the steps of arranging exploratory wells according to the actual conditions of a repairing area, setting sensors, adding repairing agents, initializing data acquisition nodes, constructing a water quality data cluster based on the acquisition nodes, dividing repairing stages, evaluating degradation efficiency of different water quality indexes in each stage, realizing dynamic tracking of repairing effects, constructing a degradation state feedback matrix based on degradation efficiency calculation efficiency mean value, marking the degradation state as normal or abnormal, evaluating the abnormal correlation degree of water quality repairing among exploratory wells based on the feedback matrix, identifying exploratory wells with correlation and outputting the exploratory wells to a worker port. According to the invention, through multi-mode monitoring and dynamic efficiency evaluation, the accurate supervision and anomaly traceability of the groundwater remediation process are realized, the water quality change is influenced by the same factor, the problem area can be rapidly positioned, and the remediation efficiency and decision scientificity are effectively improved.
assignees: CHINA CHEMICAL CIVIL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for communicating with vending machine
abstract_en: Invented method comprises data detection by watching communication between vending machine and its payment system in unified manner, without intervention in this communication, and automated downloading this data; transmitting downloaded data via wireless network by invented device's modem/ external peripheral device's resource; analyzing this data by determining events and one-time events and generating states by unifying the meaning of communication between vending machine and its payment systems performed according to multitude of standard communication protocols; extracting from analyzed data of information about technical condition of vending machine/ payment systems, about operating regime of vending machine, about sales made by vending machine and revenues in its payment systems; remote control on basis of analyzed data and optional discontinuation/restoration of vending machine operation by invented device at request by external peripheral device connected to vending machine. The data is tracked or monitored and the diagnosis at the vending machine is transferred.

title_en: Handheld system for information acquisition, verification, recording, processing, display and communication
abstract_en: A portable system and method that automates collection, integration, analysis, reporting and archiving of data and collection and archiving of specimens in a variety of applications while insuring chain of custody integrity not attainable conventionally. Applications include: forensics, municipal management, utility management, real estate, insurance, environmental protection and remediation, safety, security, education, emergency management, land use, fish and wildlife management, construction and maintenance of highways and waterways, mining, timber, agricultural, resource exploration, manufacturing, recreational management, urban restoration, military, and archaeological preservation. Select embodiments integrate a number of functions in a handheld device, employing digital technology, integrated sensors, marking, tracking and monitoring tags, and specialized software as well as processors for analysis, such as CPUs, ASICs, PCs and the like. Select embodiments are useful to increase efficiency and reduce cost for post-processing and real-time data and specimen collection, reporting, analysis, and facilitate pro-active direction of ongoing field studies.

title_en: Methods and systems for detection and notification of power outages and power quality
abstract_en: Described herein are methods and systems for detection and notification of electrical power outages and power quality. A sensor coupled to a circuit transmits a keepalive packet to a server. The sensor detects an input signal generated by electrical activity. The sensor generates an output signal based upon the input signal. The sensor monitors the output signal. During a clock cycle, the sensor determines whether a rising edge occurred and transmits a fault packet to the server when the rising edge occurred prior to a predetermined clock value or when no rising edge occurred. The server receives the fault packet from the sensor and listens for keepalive packets. The server transmits a power outage notification when no keepalive packets are received for at least a defined time period after the fault packet is received. The server transmits a power restoration notification when one or more keepalive packets are subsequently received.

title_en: A kind of power distribution network repair method based on automatic division unit and evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power distribution network repair method based on automatic division unit and evaluation, comprise the following steps: 1) automatic division unit: 2) information; 3) evaluate guide, the idiographic flow of step 3) is as follows: 31) unit evaluation; 32) circuit report; 33) Strategies of Maintenance; 34) formulate repair schedule. The present invention and PMS full information are shared, use the unified workflow platform of production management information system, realize the unit evaluation of analyzing based on full mesh topology, and take the lead at home having realized distribution line evaluation unit and automatically divide, distribution net equipment state evaluation guide function has been researched and developed in innovation, one-touch procedure management distribution repair based on condition of component overall process, has realized distribution net equipment resume, operation information gathers auxiliary evaluation function, set up a kind of distribution repair based on condition of component accurately, method easily.

title_en: Mixed calculation method for reliability of high-medium-low voltage integrated power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a mixed calculation method for the reliability of a high-medium-low voltage integrated distribution network, which considers the mutual influence of high-medium-low voltage distribution networks and establishes a distribution network integrated model, wherein firstly, the reliability of the high-voltage distribution network is evaluated based on the quasi-sequential Monte Carlo simulation of a state transition sampling method to obtain the annual average fault frequency and the annual average power failure time of the high-voltage distribution network; secondly, obtaining the outgoing line outage rate and the restoration rate of a transformer substation connecting a high-voltage distribution network and a medium-voltage distribution network; finally, the outgoing line outage rate and the repair rate of the transformer substation are used as the input of the reliability calculation of the medium-low voltage distribution network, and the reliability index of the medium-low voltage distribution network is calculated by using a minimum path method; the invention comprehensively considers the mutual influence among the power distribution networks with high, medium and low voltage grades, improves the accuracy of the evaluation result, relates to the low-voltage distribution network topology for the evaluation of the power distribution network, and improves the calculation accuracy of the power supply reliability of low-voltage users.

title_en: Power system sequence recovery method and device based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system sequential recovery method and device based on deep reinforcement learning. Based on the electric power network after cascade failure, the recovery capability of the electric power network system to cascade failure in the system recovery process is evaluated through the bus recovery sequence obtained after deep reinforcement learning, reinforcement learning is combined with the electric power network, the recovery problem of the electric power network is considered in the angle of an defender, and the combination of the reinforcement learning and the neural network expands the realization range of the electric power network, so that the recovery optimal strategy of the large-scale electric network can be found.

title_en: Optical fiber wiring control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of optical fibers, in particular to an optical fiber distribution control method, which comprises at least one idle optical fiber connection line, wherein a first terminal and a second terminal of the optical fiber connection line are respectively inserted into two idle optical fiber ports, the optical fiber connection line is used for controlling a manipulator to pull out the first terminal and the second terminal from the idle optical fiber ports respectively, insert the first terminal and the second terminal into a first optical fiber port and a second optical fiber port to be connected and arrange the optical fiber line from a storage area to a use area, the optical fiber distribution control method is used for solving the technical problems of long time consumption, high labor power and low efficiency of optical cable network operation and maintenance, slow optical cable interruption positioning, disaster influence restoration efficiency, long fiber core detection time consumption and inconvenient data analysis, and realizing remote operation by using the manipulator to replace manpower to execute cable jump tasks in remote areas or dangerous areas, thereby improving the automation degree of the operation and realizing the quick positioning of optical cable interruption and the restoration efficiency of disaster influence.

title_en: Outage restoration time prediction during weather events and optimized solutions for recovery
abstract_en: A method, a computer system, and a computer program product for restoration time predictions and optimized recovery solutions is provided. Embodiments of the present invention may include selecting a dataset based on time series data. Embodiments of the present invention may include building one or more models, wherein the one or more models include a classification and regression tree model, a cross validated decision tree model or a bootstrap aggregating model. Embodiments of the present invention may include selecting a model for predictions using decision trees to reduce a variance of the model. Embodiments of the present invention may include rebuilding the model based on additional data attributes. Embodiments of the present invention may include determining an outage prioritization for each outage node. Embodiments of the present invention may include transmitting results of the outage prioritization.

title_en: Mining area ecological environment restoration system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the ecological remediation technique and specifically relates to a mining area ecological environment repair system is related to. The mine comprises a side slope and a mine arranged on the side slope, wherein a filling layer is arranged in the mine; the side slope comprises a top surface and an inclined surface, and a water-resisting layer, a soil improvement layer and a seed layer are sequentially arranged on the top surface and the surface of the inclined surface from bottom to top; the seed layer is arranged on the seed layer, the inclined plane is provided with a protective net, the protective net is arranged on the surface of the seed layer, and an anchor rod is fixedly connected between the protective net and the side slope. The utility model provides a pair of mining area ecological environment repair system realizes the improvement of mining area geological disasters, ecological environment's restoration.
assignees: BEIJING GEOTECHNICAL ENGINEERING SURVEY INST CO LTD

title_en: Ecological ditch structure is restoreed in river course
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a riverway restoration ecological ditch structure, which comprises a riverbank, wherein a water channel is laid in the middle of the riverbank, a fine sand layer is laid above the water channel, a gravel layer is laid at the upper end of the fine sand layer, a planting layer is laid at the uppermost part of the gravel layer, side slopes are arranged on two sides above the water channel, planting grids are arranged on the side slopes, and landscape trees are planted on the planting grids. This ecological ditch structure is restoreed in river course, the planting check of echelonment has been set up on the both sides side slope of river levee, the planting that is used for the vegetation through the planting check repairs the river course side slope, avoid serious soil erosion and water loss and landslide phenomenon to appear in the side slope, ensure the planting and the reinforcement of vegetation on the side slope, and seted up the drain pipe on the planting check, communicate through drain pipe and river course bottom, ensure the water of the inside vegetation of planting check, and the vegetation net has been laid to the top of planting check, the online turf of planting of vegetation, cover the upper surface of planting check through the vegetation net, avoid the rainwater to produce to erode the damage to the planting check.

title_en: Ecological restoration structure for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ecological restoration structures, in particular to a geological disaster ecological restoration structure which comprises an ecological restoration structure main body, wherein a fixing assembly is fixedly arranged in the ecological restoration structure main body, a first protection belt is fixedly arranged below the fixing assembly, a second protection belt is fixedly connected below the first protection belt, a first mounting column is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the second protection belt, a second fixing seat is connected with the tail end of the first mounting column in a meshed manner, a second mounting column is fixedly arranged on the right side of the top surface of the second fixing seat, the first protection belt and the second protection belt have water permeability, redundant rainwater received in a planting frame is evacuated downwards, a straw cushion is additionally arranged on a grid plate, and a meadow adsorbs rainwater to meet vegetation growth requirements.
assignees: SICHUAN HUADI ENVIRONMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration structure for slope protection of ecological mining area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ecological restoration structure for slope protection of an ecological mining area, which relates to the technical field of slope protection of the ecological mining area and comprises a water guiding slope body and a plurality of planting boxes, wherein each planting box is fixedly arranged on the side wall of the water guiding slope body, two water outlet pipes are symmetrically arranged on the side wall of the water guiding slope body, a plurality of first water guiding channels are formed in the inner wall of each planting box, a guide pipe is fixedly connected to the inner wall of each first water guiding channel, and each first water guiding channel is obliquely arranged. According to the utility model, the plurality of first water guide channels are obliquely arranged, so that the guiding-out effect of water and sediment can be improved, the guiding-out speed of the sediment is accelerated, the sediment accumulation probability is reduced, the water guide effect of the planting box is improved, the growth of plants is facilitated, and the landslide phenomenon caused by excessive water quantity can be avoided.

title_en: Predication method for load peak in power distribution area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a predication method for load peak of a power distribution area. Based on a predication model established by a time sequence of long-term data acquisition, the predication method comprises the following steps of (1) obtaining daily peak data of the load of the area according to the historical load data of the area; (2) carrying out discrimination and restoration on distortion and deletion in the data; (3) establishing a periodicity equation according to an autocorrelation function of the daily peak data of the load; (4) establishing a gradient equation according to the autocorrelation function of the data with periodicity; (5) establishing a predication model of the daily peak of the load by combination of the periodicity equation and the gradient equation; (6) obtaining estimation of model parameters by enabling the quadratic sum of errors to be minimum; and (7) obtaining a load predication value of the daily peak of time points in the future according to the established model. The predication method has the advantages that the blank and the defects in the prior art are filled and overcome, the accuracy is high, the operability is high and the predication of the daily peak of the load of the area is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;USTC UNIV SCIENCE TECH CN

title_en: Selective permeation drainage system for mine restoration
abstract_en: The invention provides a selective permeation drainage system for mine restoration, which comprises a drainage ditch cover plate, a drainage ditch, a water purification layer, a crushed stone layer, a water collecting tank cover plate, a water collecting tank, a filter rod, a water diversion pipeline and a reservoir. The invention reasonably plans flood control of the mine drainage system, effectively prevents flood disasters, simultaneously precipitates, filters, purifies and utilizes rainwater, provides a large amount of water source supply for mine underground water sources, vegetation greening, domestic and industrial water, adopts a technical process combining temperature, microwave and carbonization to efficiently eliminate pollutants and suspended particles in the rainwater, arranges an adjustable impermeable membrane in a permeable area, directionally adjusts the water outlet area and direction of the permeable area, improves the effective utilization rate of the purified rainwater, adds a self-made water purification layer, increases the areas of purified water and water, and simultaneously adds a gravel layer at the lower part of the whole system to play roles of preventing uneven settlement and stabilizing a structure.
assignees: DALIAN DEETOP ENV TECH CO LTD

title_en: Visual whole-process monitoring system for power grid arrearage power failure and power restoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of whole-process monitoring of a power grid, and discloses a visual whole-process monitoring system for arrearage, power failure and power restoration of the power grid; the power grid arrearage power failure and power failure visual whole-process monitoring system comprises a GIS geographic information system, wherein the GIS geographic information system is used for visually displaying and reflecting different information on all data in the power grid arrearage power failure and power failure visual whole-process monitoring system, such as different geographic environments, line ranges, power supply of important users, thematic analysis charts of a distribution network and the like, the data can be displayed and analyzed in an overlapping or layered mode, the power supply radius of each line and the load condition of each line can be automatically counted and listed according to query requirements, the model and the production date of equipment to which the line belongs are displayed, and even the operation health condition is displayed, so that weak links of the distribution network are found out for analysis, a reliable basis is provided for distribution network planning, the visualization of the whole process from collection to power supply is realized, and convenience is brought for users to check when power failure occurs and reduce user anxiety.
