assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network power supply recovery method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network power supply recovery method and a power distribution network power supply recovery device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a line state index, a line load index and a line guarantee index of the power distribution network to be recovered; calculating the component fragility of the power distribution network to be recovered based on a Monte Carlo simulation method; calculating ideal correlation degrees of line state indexes, line load indexes, line guarantee indexes and component fragility degrees according to a grey correlation analysis method; calculating a line state index, a line load index, a line guarantee index and a weight coefficient of the component fragility degree according to an analytic hierarchy process; calculating a line state index, a line load index, a line guarantee index and a line restoration contribution degree of the component vulnerability degree according to a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method; and performing power supply recovery on the power distribution network to be recovered according to the ideal correlation degree, the weight coefficient and the line recovery contribution degree. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the recovery efficiency of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: New energy-based power utilization rush-repair analysis method for topology of under-construction power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power consumption rush-repair analysis method of a constructed power distribution network topology based on new energy, which comprises the steps of loading running power grid topology grid frame data before failure; when a fault occurs, determining a fault influence range and the number of influencing users; the method comprises the steps of obtaining latest electronic handover single item information of a station area in a fault influence range, and importing sections of fault feeder lines into running state power grid topology grid frame data to obtain building state power grid topology grid frame data; selecting an optimal access scheme by a rush-repair simulation method, and accessing a standby power supply as a power point into the topology grid frame data of the power grid in a building state to obtain the topology grid frame data of the power grid in a quasi-running state; based on the power grid topological net frame data of the quasi-running state power grid, simulating the power-off and restoration operation of the rush-repair, and after the rush-repair is completed, the standby power supply is withdrawn from the access and restored to the power grid topological net frame data of the running state power grid. The invention solves the problems of low efficiency, long rush-repair time, insufficient personnel safety guarantee and the like of the traditional power utilization rush-repair mode by means of manual field investigation.
assignees: XIAMEN HERETOP INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fault prediction method and management system of intelligent energy storage power station
abstract_en: The application provides a fault prediction method and a management system of an intelligent energy storage power station, wherein enhanced information is added to a monitoring log, operation state semantic detection is carried out to obtain an operation state semantic detection result, so that monitoring log recovery operation is carried out according to the operation state semantic detection result to obtain a second monitoring log of energy storage power station equipment, and finally fault information corresponding to the monitoring log of the first energy storage power station equipment is determined based on a characteristic information commonality metric value between the two monitoring logs. In other words, based on the mode of performing operation state semantic detection on the first energy storage power station equipment monitoring log to obtain an operation state semantic detection result, the operation state semantic detection result guides the log to perform information restoration, the sequence of data items in the restored log is ensured to be consistent, fault information of the sequence of data items in the first energy storage power station equipment monitoring log is determined by comparing the characteristic information commonality metric value, and the precision and the speed of fault detection of the sequence of data items can be increased.
assignees: GUANGDONG AER PAL ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-scale toughness assessment method, device, terminal and medium for urban underground space
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scale toughness assessment method, a device, a terminal and a medium for urban underground space, wherein the method is used for determining index data of nodes in an urban underground space network according to underground space information, determining node toughness assessment results of the nodes according to the index data of the nodes respectively, determining failure nodes according to the node toughness assessment results, determining a plurality of node restoration schemes according to the failure nodes, respectively calculating comprehensive toughness assessment results of the urban underground space network when the node restoration schemes are adopted, and selecting the node restoration scheme as a target node restoration scheme according to the comprehensive toughness assessment results. According to the method, the nodes and the urban underground space network are subjected to toughness assessment according to different indexes, and a node repairing scheme is formulated and selected according to the toughness assessment result, so that the problem of how to carry out toughness assessment on the urban underground space network after the urban underground space network is damaged is solved, and a repairing scheme is formulated for the nodes according to the toughness assessment result.

title_en: Mining area subsidence monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle photogrammetry and LiDAR technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining area subsidence monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle photogrammetry and LiDAR technology, which comprises the steps of carrying out flight shooting on a mining area by using an unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain mining area earth surface image data, processing the obtained image data through a motion restoration structure algorithm SfM to generate a digital surface model DSM, an orthophoto map DOM and a digital elevation model DEM, scanning the mining area by using an airborne LiDAR system to obtain three-dimensional point cloud data of the surface of the mining area, correcting and improving the precision of the LiDAR point cloud data by using a differential GNSS technology, carrying out registration fusion on the digital elevation model DEM generated by unmanned aerial vehicle photogrammetry and the corrected LiDAR point cloud data under a unified coordinate system, and carrying out processing and analysis on the fused data to construct a mining area subsidence model so as to realize dynamic monitoring on the subsidence condition of the surface of the mining area. The method effectively solves the problems of the traditional mining area subsidence monitoring method and provides powerful technical support for mine geological disaster prevention and control, ecological environment protection and mining area sustainable development.

title_en: Intelligent ecological filtering system for water pollution control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water environment treatment, in particular to an intelligent ecological filtering system for water pollution treatment, which is characterized in that a data acquisition module is used for acquiring contour, image and topography data of a river and a historical pollution database, a data processing module is used for analyzing the data, extracting river boundaries and constructing a shape mathematical model, a water sample analysis module is used for acquiring a water sample according to the river shape and analyzing pollutant types and concentration distribution, a pollution source tracing module is used for determining a pollution source by utilizing pollutant data and surrounding environment information and combining a tracing algorithm, a permeable dam construction module is used for constructing an initial permeable dam according to the pollution source and the shape mathematical model, a parameter adjustment module is used for monitoring the water quality and the hydrologic data in real time, constructing a pollution diffusion model, calculating water flow adjustment quantity and adjusting operation parameters of the permeable dam to form a target permeable dam. The invention realizes accurate treatment and ecological restoration of water pollution through intelligent analysis and real-time adjustment.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGKEYUQING ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic evaluation method and system for influence of photovoltaic power station on ecological environment
abstract_en: The application provides a dynamic evaluation method and a system for the influence of a photovoltaic power station on ecological environment, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-element real-time monitoring system of the photovoltaic power station, and continuously collecting various ecological environment data inside and outside the power station; the method comprises the steps of acquiring data, transmitting the acquired data to the rear end in real time for data processing to construct a multi-element environment characteristic database, analyzing the data monitored for a long time in the database, determining evolution rules of various environment parameters in a power station, influence change rules of the power station on various ecological environment factors and various ecological influence weights, determining AHP weights based on the various ecological influence weights, constructing various ecological evolution prediction models and operation and maintenance decision prediction models of the power station based on the AHP weights, and determining operation and maintenance strategies and ecological restoration schemes of the power station by using the prediction models. According to the method, the influence of the photovoltaic power station on the ecological environment is dynamically evaluated by fusing multi-source real-time monitoring and multi-dimensional data analysis, so that the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of the evaluation are improved.
assignees: HUANENG XINJIANG ENERGY DEV CO LTD NANJIANG CLEAN ENERGY BRANCH;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST

title_en: Loess gully landform classification method and device based on coupling of unmanned aerial vehicle and remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention provides a loess gully landform classification method and device based on coupling of an unmanned aerial vehicle and a remote sensing image, which are based on fusion of a new generation information technology and the manufacturing field of high-end equipment, and carry out advanced treatment on the unmanned aerial vehicle and the remote sensing image through computer vision by means of an AI-driven image analysis technology, so that the loess gully landform classification with high precision is realized. The invention not only improves the accuracy and efficiency of image analysis, but also expands the application range of unmanned aerial vehicle and remote sensing technology in loess plateau valley landform research, provides powerful technical support for ecological restoration, emergency disaster relief and the like, and shows important practical value.

title_en: Elevator widespread disaster restoration support system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an elevator widespread disaster restoration support system capable of accurately predicting elevator stop due to an earthquake.SOLUTION: The present invention comprises: an observation-site locating unit 12 comparing observation site information acquired from an earthquake and seismic intensity information distribution service 1 with an elevator installation location, and locating a closest observation site to the elevator; a seismic-intensity identifying unit 13 identifying a seismic intensity of the closest observation site to the elevator located by the observation-site locating unit 12 as a seismic intensity of the elevator while referring to seismic information acquired from the earthquake and seismic information distribution service 1; an earthquake-caused-elevator-stop information recording unit 17 recording earthquake-caused elevator stop information; and a stopped elevator identifying unit 14 identifying whether the elevator is to be stopped by the earthquake on the basis of the earthquake-caused-elevator-stop information recorded in the earthquake-caused-elevator-stop information recording unit 17 and the seismic intensity of the elevator identified by the seismic intensity identifying unit 13.

title_en: Hydroelectric power plant control device and method
abstract_en: To suppress the congestion of a rising speed of a main machine at an activation restart with a stop operation when a water level of a river reaches a flood water level, and an activation restart operation when the water level of the river is restored to a water acquisition restart water level, and to remarkably alleviate restoration work.SOLUTION: Tilt control means 33 stops a main machine 19 after performing a tilt operation for repeatedly performing opening/closing operations of a guide vane of a water turbine several times at which a water level of a river reaches a flood water level, and speed-increase assist control means 34 opens the guide vane of the water turbine at which a water level of a water tank 15 reaches a full water level. The speed-increase assist control means further performs a speed rise assist for excessively opening the guide vane of the water turbine if the main machine 19 is not raised in a speed up to a synchronization speed within a prescribed time, a generator is consolidated to a power system when the main machine 19 is raised in the speed up to the synchronization speed, and the main machine is stopped if the generator cannot be consolidated to the power system even if repeatedly performing the speed increase assist operations several times.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Reinforcement device of rail
title_ko: 레일 보강장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rail reinforcement device. More specifically, provided is a rail reinforcement device which is able to reinforce and fill soft ground using a bogie with grouting on train railroads, to reinforce the ground by being operated on the railroads, to maximize pleasant and stable operation by reinforcing soft ground through mutual operation and preventing fatigue of soft ground and sinking of underground, to be free from time constraints on the reinforcement work of railroads as both daytime work and nighttime work are easily performed, to easily perform a restoration work after natural disaster, and to be free from interference on train operation owing to reinforcement work as soft ground section can be reinforced without having train operation stopped in the case of double tracks.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 레일 보강장치에 관한 것으로, 그 구성은 한 쌍으로 구비되며, 상호 이격되어 설치되며, 철로의 휨 정도를 측정하고 그에 상응하는 신호를 발송하는 계측센서부재와, 철로 위에서 운행 가능한 대차부재와, 상기 대차부재에 탑재되며, 물과 반응하여 응고되는 가루 상태의 벌크를 수용하는 벌크탱크와, 상기 대차부재에 탑재되며, 물을 수용하는 물탱크와, 상기 대차부재에 탑재되며, 상기 물과 벌크를 교반하는 교반부재와, 상기 벌크탱크에 수용된 벌크를 상기 교반부재로 이송시키는 벌크이송관과, 상기 벌크이송관에 결합되며, 상기 벌크의 이송을 허용 및 차단하는 벌크이송밸브와, 상기 물탱크에 수용된 물을 상기 교반부재로 이송시키는 물이송관과, 상기 물이송관에 결합되며, 상기 물의 이송을 허용 및 차단하는 물이송밸브와, 상기 대차부재에 탑재되며, 지면에 구멍을 천공시키며 상하방향으로 이동되는 외부천공부와, 상기 외부천공부에 삽입되며, 상기 교반부재로부터 이송되는 물과 벌크의 혼합물을 분사하는 내부분사부를 포함하는 천공시추부재와, 상기 교반부재에 수용되는 물과 벌크의 혼합물을 상기 천공시추부재로 이송시키는 혼합물이송관과, 상기 혼합물이송관에 결합되며, 상기 혼합물의 이송을 허용 및 차단하는 혼합물이송밸브 및 상기 벌크이송밸브와 물이송밸브를 열어서 상기 교반부재에 물과 벌크의 혼합물이 교반되도록 제어하며, 상기 계측센서부재로부터 신호를 인가받아 철로가 휘어진 부위로 상기 대차부재가 지나면, 상기 천공시추부재를 가동시켜 지면에 천공을 하며, 상기 혼합물이송관을 열어서 물과 벌크의 혼합물을 상기 내부분사부로 이송시키도록 제어를 하는 제어부재를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 것으로서, 기차가 지나는 선로에 그라우팅을 이용한 대차를 사용하여 연약 지반에 보강 및 충족을 할 수 있으며, 선로를 운행하면서 지반을 보강할 수 있으며, 서로 운행상 연약지반 구간을 보강하고 연약지반 피로도 및 침하를 방지하므로 쾌적하고 안정한 운행을 극대화시킬 수 있으며, 주간 및 야간작업도 용이하여 선로를 보강하는데 시간적 구애를 받지 않을 수 있으며, 천재지변으로 인한 복구를 용이하게 할 수 있으며, 복선 구간인 경우에는 기차의 운행을 중지시키지 않으면서 연약지반 구간을 보강할 수 있으므로 보강작업으로 인한 기차 운행의 간섭을 받지 않을 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: SHIN WOO HITE CO LTD;BUKMA CO LTD

title_en: Restoration decision-making assistance apparatus and restoration decision-making assistance method
abstract_en: A restoration decision-making assistance apparatus and method are capable of restoring customers of a power outage by planning an isolated operation at the time of power outage restoration of a power distribution system and preparing a restoration work plan in consideration of the plan. A power system section, disconnected due to a power system accident, is connected to a power system again. A planning unit defines a switch section divided by adjacent switches for the disconnected section, and prepares an isolated operation plan with at least a switch section which includes a distributed power source therein or in which a power source vehicle is arranged as an isolated operation section. An isolated operation planning unit prepares an operation plan with a switch section in which a system accident is present as an isolated operation section and a restoration work plan is prepared for the isolated operation section.

title_en: Method for ecological restoration of mountain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for ecological restoration of a mountain, which comprises the following steps: (1) forming holes on a rocky mountain; (2) filling cement mortar (1 : 3) in the holes; (3) inserting foundation steel bars into the cement in the holes and allowing the foundation steel bars to protruding out of the rocky mountain at a certain length, and pouring a cement frame or not with the foundation steel bars as center; (4) laying a vertically consecutive planting soil layer along the rock slope of the rocky mountain, wherein the planting soil layer comprises plant growth bags stacked along the rock slope and filling soil for filling gaps; (5) coating a steel mesh on the outer surface of the planting soil layer, wherein the steel mesh is fixedly connected with the foundation steel bars to fix the plant growth bags and is formed of a plurality of steel wires by crossing each other; and (6) watering and curing the plant growth bags. The method provided by the invention perfectly combines plants, soil and the mountain; and not only has rapid and good greening effect and effectively solves the problems of mountain landslide, collapse and the like, but also forms a stable long-life plant community, achieving an original ecological effect.
assignees: BEIJING ZHENGHE HENGJI BINSHUI ECOLOGY ENVIRONMENTAL MAN CO LTD

title_en: A kind of provincial power network black starting-up and large area blackout processing method
abstract_en: A kind of provincial power network black starting-up and large area blackout processing method, the black starting-up of provincial power network is divided into two stages, several subsystem black-start scheme is generated when meeting black starting-up power supply and other constraintss, relatively independent between each subsystem black-start scheme, possess the possibility simultaneously carrying out recovering; After each subsystem recovers, remain non-power transmission node to target grid and carry out power transmission, now power supply point is be with electrical nodes in system, and optimizing has been carried out in power transmission path, and not necessarily black starting-up unit.The present invention for core, utilizes black starting-up optimized algorithm to propose black starting-up prioritization scheme with the quick recovery and optimization algorithm of large area blackout.The black starting-up of provincial power network is divided into two stages and subsystem independence Restoration stage and interconnected, cooperation Restoration stage, makes the formulation systematic science more of black-start scheme.

title_en: Highway structure on barrier body, highway conservation and river drainage collaborative design method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction engineering, in particular to a co-design method for highway structure and highway conservation on a damming body and river drainage, which comprises the steps of sequentially arranging a stone falling groove, a filling roadbed road and a damming lake drainage groove along the cross section direction of a road from a slope toe to the far end of the damming body; the width of the rockfall groove accords with the distribution of the cumulative Weibull probability function, the geometric parameters of the rockfall groove meet the corresponding functional relation, the cross section of the flow discharge groove is in an inverted trapezoid shape, the geometric parameters of the flow discharge groove meet the corresponding functional relation, the geometric parameters of the filled roadbed meet the corresponding functional relation, and the sum of the width of the rockfall groove, the width of the bottom of the filled roadbed and the width of the top of the flow discharge groove is smaller than the total width from the toe to the far end of the dam plug body along the cross section direction of the road. The invention solves the practical problems that the existing post-disaster highway restoration design focuses on single road restoration, lacks dynamic change aiming at post-earthquake falling rocks, and is difficult to comprehensively consider the damming body leakage condition.

title_en: Cut-off system of distribution lines by section
title_ko: 구간별 배전선로의 차단 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for blocking distribution lines for each section, wherein when left and right cables are blocked, a connector is sufficiently maintained to be spaced from a left conductor end unit to reliably prevent an arc occurrence between the left conductor end unit and a joint of the connector, and an operation space is not formed on a shelf and a connector driving means is installed to reliably secure insulation between the cables mounted on a corresponding floor shelf and upper and lower shelves. An insulating film is formed around the exposed conductor end unit of the left cable, which is a power supply cable, to effectively prevent the arc occurrence between the left conductor end unit and the connector and a fire occurrence caused by the same when the left and right cables are blocked, and when a failure occurs, a resin applied to form the insulating film around the left conductor end unit does not scatter to a portion in which the applied resin is unnecessary not to remove the insulating film unnecessarily formed when the underground distribution line is restored to an original state in the future, thereby quickly and easily performing the restoration work.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 구간별 배전선로의 차단 시스템에 관한 것으로, 좌우측케이블이 차단되었을 때 커넥터가 좌측도체단부로부터 충분히 이격된 상태로 유지되어 좌측도체단부와 커넥터의 접속재 간의 아크발생을 확실하게 방지할 수 있고, 선반에 작동공간을 형성하지 않고 커넥터구동수단을 설치하여 당해 층 선반과 상, 하층 선반에 안착된 케이블 간의 절연이 확실하게 확보되며, 전원측 케이블인 좌측케이블의 노출된 도체단부의 주위에 절연피막을 형성함으로써 좌우측케이블의 차단시 좌측도체단부와 커넥터 간의 아크발생과 이로 인한 화재발생을 효과적으로 방지할 수 있고, 고장이 발생하여 좌측도체단부 주위에 절연피막을 형성하기 위하여 도포되는 수지가 불필요한 부분까지 비산되지 않게 하여 추후 지중배전선로를 원상복구할 때 불필요하게 형성된 절연피막을 제거하지 않아도 되어 원상복구 작업을 신속, 간편하게 수행할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Mine ecological remediation soil-fixing and flow-dredging structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine soil fixation and drainage, in particular to a mine ecological restoration soil fixation and drainage structure. Including burying a plurality of drain pipes in the mine, the drain pipe slope sets up, the soil horizon has been laid on the mine, be equipped with top water drainage tank and bottom water drainage tank on the mine, the both ends of drain pipe extend to top water drainage tank and bottom water drainage tank respectively in, soil horizon upper berth is equipped with solid soil net, a plurality of diaphragm and the planting board that the interval set up have been laid on the solid soil net, it has a plurality of planting holes to run through on the planting board, the bottom fixed mounting of planting board has a plurality of anchor pipes, anchor pipe and the planting hole intercommunication that corresponds. Through simple drainage structures to can in time discharge the unnecessary moisture in the infiltration mine soil stone, can effectively prevent that mine soil stone moisture content is too high, thereby can prevent to appear landslide and collapse the problem, bring very big facility for the ecological remediation work of mine.
assignees: HUNAN ZHONGHE CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power station output data restoration method based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, relates to a photovoltaic power generation operation monitoring method, and particularly relates to a photovoltaic power station output data restoration method based on a BP neural network. The method divides abnormal data into local abnormal data and continuous abnormal data, repairs the local abnormal data by a polynomial interpolation method, repairs the continuous abnormal data by a BP neural network, repairs corresponding data, and obtains output data of other units based on Cholesky decomposition by taking a test unit as a reference. The invention improves the power generation data quality and data management level of the energy resource enrichment area, and provides a data analysis basis for light abandoning evaluation and photovoltaic absorption early warning.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Cloud-side-end-coordinated user outage and restoration monitoring method and system and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a cloud edge-end cooperative user power failure and power restoration monitoring method and system, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an edge power failure event list generated by combining effective power failure alarm events collected at the same time point in an area where an Internet of things gateway is located by an edge end based on an edge side 'transformer-split phase line-branch line-user' topological model; generating a distribution network power failure event list according to the acquired position information and the line fault information of the outgoing line switch, the branch switch, the transformer combined breaker switch of the external system distribution network line based on a 'transformer substation-line-branch line-transformer' topological model; matching the edge power failure event list with the distribution network power failure event list, and determining an actual power failure early warning list and a power failure type at the current moment; and based on the power failure type, powering on and monitoring each power failure area in the actual power failure early warning list to obtain power restoration data. By adopting the method, the real-time performance and the accuracy of monitoring the power failure event can be improved.
assignees: CSG DIGITAL POWER GRID RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Micro-grid group energy storage capacity configuration method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for configuring energy storage capacity of a micro-grid group, which comprise the following steps: determining the source load adaptation degree of the micro-grid group according to the predicted load curve and output curve of the micro-grid, and judging whether the source load adaptation degree is larger than or equal to a preset value; if yes, determining that the micro-grid group does not need to store energy, if not, obtaining the fault average restoration time length of the upper power grid of the micro-grid group, determining the total energy storage demand capacity of the micro-grid group according to the fault average restoration time length, the load curve and the output curve, determining the energy storage distribution coefficient of each micro-grid according to the load curve and the output curve, and calculating the product of the total energy storage demand capacity and the energy storage distribution coefficient to obtain the target energy storage capacity of each micro-grid. The energy storage is realized when the source load adaptation degree of the micro-grid group is smaller than a preset value, the invalid energy storage is avoided, and the energy storage distribution coefficient is determined through the output and the load of the micro-grid, so that the energy storage distribution of the micro-grid is more perfect and reasonable, and the stability and the reliability of the grid are improved.
assignees: SHAOGUAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster and ecological restoration greening spray seeding device and maintenance method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a greening spray-seeding device for geological disasters and ecological restoration and a maintenance method thereof, and relates to the technical field of greening spray-seeding devices. Including mobile device, first driving motor, blowing device, the blowing device includes blowing case, storehouse seat, second sieve charging tray, first sieve charging tray, the fixed discharge chassis that is provided with of bottom outer wall of blowing case. Through starting second driving motor drive mixer rotation, the reaction efficiency of ratio liquid medicine is accelerated, drive the clear scraper blade of mixer outer wall simultaneously and continuously scrape the fertilizer of adsorbing at the inner wall of first sieve charging tray and blowing case, thereby guarantee that the medicine can intensive mixing, the pulling control handle drives the spacer pin downwards and breaks away from corresponding spacing hole, start second driving motor drive first sieve charging tray rotation, make the bin outlet expose, the liquid medicine drops via the bin outlet, carry out secondary filtering again via the second sieve charging tray, start and adjust the shower nozzle and spray the medicine.
assignees: CSCEC GEOTECHNICAL ENG SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Power parameter damage recovery method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for recovering damaged electric power parameters and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target power data and environment parameters corresponding to power equipment, retrieving a data recovery model corresponding to the environment parameters, adopting an item identification module in the data recovery model to determine damaged parameter items and non-damaged parameter items from the target power data, adopting a characteristic determination module in the data recovery model to determine first characteristics corresponding to the non-damaged parameter items, adopting a parameter recovery module in the data recovery model to determine recovery parameter values corresponding to the damaged parameter items according to the damaged parameter items and the first characteristics, and adopting a parameter combination module in the data recovery model to recover the target power data according to the recovery parameter values to obtain recovery power data. The invention solves the technical problems of time and labor waste and difficult realization of integral restoration when the electric power parameters with larger damage degree are restored in the related technology.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;BEIJING DINGCHENG HONGAN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent extraction method for coal mining subsidence area ground surface cracks based on improved transducer model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent extraction method for earth surface cracks in a coal mining subsidence area based on an improved transducer model, and belongs to the technical field of remote sensing image processing. The unmanned aerial vehicle with the high-resolution optical camera is used for collecting images, the image overlapping rate of 70% -80% is guaranteed, and a training data set is constructed through professional labeling, cutting screening and data enhancement. The encoder of the innovative model has the characteristics that the self-adaptive multi-scale patch mapping layer can dynamically adjust the patch size according to the local complexity degree of the image, the characteristics are extracted efficiently, double-attention fusion is combined with optimized position encoding, long-distance dependency capture is enhanced, and the calculation amount and the overfitting of the dynamic sparse connection full-connection layer are reduced. And the residual attention enhancing pyramid pooling and space-channel attention bottleneck mechanism highlights key characteristics and suppresses noise, and the break point detection and connection rule determining module is utilized to realize complete restoration of the ground cracks. The data set is used for deployment after a model is trained, and the ground crack information can be accurately obtained through pretreatment, encoding and decoding and post-treatment, so that the data base is firmly built for mining area safety management and geological disaster prevention.

title_en: Intelligent construction method for loess plateau region water forest conservation engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent construction method for a loess plateau region water conservation project, and relates to the field of forestry ecological restoration and water and soil conservation projects. The method comprises the steps of collecting and carrying out normalization processing on various original physical quantities based on space-time sliding windows to obtain normalization values of various physical quantities, constructing a composite physical state function based on the normalization values of various physical quantities, introducing a disturbance propagation response function to construct a measurement evaluation function, carrying out spatial threshold screening processing based on the measurement evaluation function to generate a planting candidate point set, generating a spatial aggregation planting block set based on the planting candidate point set, and determining planting parameters based on gradient change conditions of the measurement evaluation function in the spatial aggregation planting block so as to execute planting operation. The method solves the problems that the traditional water conservation engineering construction method lacks modeling on space disturbance and neighborhood consistency, the construction parameter configuration lacks intelligent adjustment, and the whole flow does not form a closed loop structure of measurement, analysis, decision-making and execution.
assignees: SHANXI CONSTR ENG GROUP CO LTD;SHANXI JINDIYUAN GEOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Food safety monitoring data disaster recovery method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a food safety monitoring data disaster recovery method and a system based on edge calculation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a food safety monitoring data set uploaded by a plurality of edge calculation nodes in a target monitoring area, wherein the food safety monitoring data set comprises a plurality of monitoring data units; the method comprises the steps of carrying out data feature extraction processing on a food safety monitoring data set to obtain data integrity features and data relevance features of each monitoring data unit, carrying out policy matching processing on the data integrity features and the data relevance features based on a preset disaster recovery policy model to generate disaster recovery priority identifiers and disaster recovery storage policies of the monitoring data units, and indicating the edge computing nodes to execute corresponding data disaster recovery backup operation according to the disaster recovery priority identifiers and the disaster recovery storage policies.

title_en: road restoration block
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of road restoration block, remove existing road mat formation part or all carry out different kinds of roads construction time, described road restoration block covers the face of mating formation of removing, more specifically, relate to road restoration block, on the top in the face of mating formation of removing, conveyance is set, arrange and dismounting simple and there is the block of very strong adhesion, cover rapidly and safely the face of mating formation of removing thus, pedestrian and vehicle can be made to pass through during carrying out constructing, thus solve the traffic jam occurred because of construction, safe and comfortable built environment is provided, also prevent because of mating formation of carrying out now or dual mating formation temporarily and the increase of the wasting of resources caused and construction cost, lower the cost of Construction Company thus, improve construction quality, prevent bad construction, finally, seek to lower national budget, also the emergency repair of road can be used in when disaster occurs in country, thus national safety and property can be guarded.

title_en: Feeder fault handling method
abstract_en: The invention introduces a feeder fault handling method, which comprises the following steps of: 1) conducting online search and locating a feeder fault; 2) conducting network topology analysis to draw a conclusion; 3) finding out the section of the fault; 4) searching for the boundary switch of the fault section and making a fault isolation plan; 5) defining non-fault power outage areas; 6) making power supply restoration plans for outage areas on the upstream side and the downstream side of the fault; 7) conducting safety evaluation to the downstream power supply restoration plan; and 8) executing the plans according to the safety evaluation obtained at the step 7. The feeder fault handling method has the advantages that: 1) the method is suitable for the automatic construction of feeders of a power distribution network which is wired in any way; 2) the practicability is high, the impedance parameters of the equipment of the distribution network are not required and the power flow calculation module is not required to be called; and 3) the power supply restoration can be separately conducted to the non-fault sections, so as to reduce the power outage range and decrease the power outage duration as much as possible.
assignees: SCIENCE RES INST HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;BEIJING SIFANG AUTOMATION CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Component-level building earthquake economic loss fine evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction earthquake economic loss fine evaluation method at a component level, and belongs to the technical field of earthquake engineering. The method comprises the steps of firstly, constructing a component earthquake damage evaluation module, evaluating the earthquake damage of each component according to a building information model and a vulnerability database through the component earthquake damage evaluation module, then constructing a loss evaluation module, and calculating the earthquake economic loss of each component and the whole building through the loss evaluation module according to the building information model, the vulnerability database and a restoration standard library; and finally, constructing a visualization module, and carrying out three-dimensional visualization display on the earthquake damage and the loss of the building through the visualization module. The method can accurately evaluate the loss to the component, provides specific component loss distribution, and provides important reference for building earthquake repair strategy or disaster prevention design.

title_en: Steam invasion risk rapid assessment method based on interface process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vapor invasion risk rapid assessment method based on an interface process, which comprises the following steps of S1, finding out site pollution conditions and hydrogeological conditions, S2, constructing a site indoor vapor invasion risk conceptual model, S3, calculating attenuation coefficients of volatile transmission of pollutants in soil or underground water in a pollution area to a building room, S4, calculating cancerogenic health risks and non-cancerogenic health risks of vapor invasion exposure in different volatile organic pollutants, S5, taking 1X 10  ‑6  as an acceptable cancerogenic risk level to assess the cancerogenic health risk of target pollutants, taking 1 as an acceptable cancerogenic health risk level to assess the non-cancerogenic health risk of the target pollutants, S6, determining the target pollutants with the health risk exceeding the acceptable level through assessment, calculating a target pollutant restoration value under the acceptable cancerogenic risk level condition and a target pollutant restoration target value under the acceptable non-cancerogenic risk level condition, and taking the low value in the two as a final target pollutant restoration value.

title_en: Novel artificial plant roots net
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the ecological maintenance and the restoration, specific saying is a novel artificial plant roots net, including the root system filament, the net hole is woven by root system filament longitude and latitude and is made, and the net muscle comprises 3~4 root system filaments, and the minimum in net hole is connected with net muscle no. 1, adopts net muscle no. 2 to connect between two net holes, the utility model discloses because the existence in structure china net hole for the plant can be online attached to artificial plant roots better, also more holds simultaneously easily fixable in the side slope, makes growth that the plant can be firmly in the side slope, avoided since rainstorm run off to washing away of side slope and the soil erosion and water loss or even the landslide disaster that lead to the fact.
assignees: SHANGHAI NEW TECHTEXTILES CO LTD;YIKANGJI ECOLOGICAL ENV ENG (SHANGHAI) CO LTD

title_en: Based on the modified power failure system restoration path optimization method of redundancy encoding
abstract_en: The invention discloses one kind to be based on the modified power failure system restoration path optimization method of redundancy encoding, power outage power grid to be restored non-directed graph topological representation will occur, restoration path is solved using genetic algorithm, round redundant path correction algorithm amendment round redundancy is first added in genetic algorithm, dendroid redundant path correction algorithm amendment redundancy not in the target is added to put into operation path, irredundant path solution is obtained, the fitness value of each solution is calculated, exports revised optimal path solution.The present invention is by redundant path correction algorithm, and making the path generated, there is no redundancy branches, improves the Searching efficiency of intelligent algorithm.

title_en: Method for grading recovery suitability of fresh water wetland in delta region
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of wetland restoration, in particular to a method for grading the restoration suitability of fresh water wetland in delta areas, which comprises the following steps: step (1), evaluating underground water constraint conditions of a target area; step (2), evaluating the restraint conditions of the aeration zone of the target area; step (3), evaluating the target area earth surface constraint conditions; and (4) grading the suitable recovery range of the fresh water wetland in the delta region based on the underground water constraint condition, the aeration zone constraint condition and the surface constraint condition of the target region.

title_en: Intelligent active filter system
abstract_en: The intelligent active filter system comprises an active filter body and an industrial personal computer, and also comprises a switching unit, a fault detection unit, a software updating unit, a prompting unit, a power supply quality detection unit, a networking control unit, a data transmission unit, a data receiving and controlling unit, a communication identification access unit and a communication simulation unit; the fault monitoring unit is also provided with a voiceprint and noise data acquisition subunit, a voiceprint and noise identification subunit and a database subunit. The device of the invention occupies less space, is more compact, reduces cost, can automatically realize communication networking between the devices after installation and maintenance, can realize communication simulation operation, can automatically switch to another device when a fault occurs, can display related managers to maintain when a corresponding part has a problem, can realize software restoration and update, can realize networking by active filters in different installation areas, can detect working data and performance, and can remotely control opening and closing and adjust output power.
assignees: ONTON SCIENCE AND TECH SHANGHAI LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Method for inhibiting reservoir thermal stratification by utilizing reservoir daily regulation and scheduling to excite water flow oscillation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lake reservoir water ecology improvement and restoration, and discloses a method for inhibiting reservoir thermal stratification by utilizing reservoir daily regulation scheduling excitation water flow oscillation, wherein a reservoir main flow is caused to form gravity waves through a daily regulation scheduling process of a reservoir, and a high-frequency water flow oscillation phenomenon is induced in a branch reservoir bay; the water level of the bay has high-frequency fluctuation characteristics through the water flow oscillation process, and the flow velocity of the water body of the bay is increased or reduced intermittently; the intermittent mixing of the water body is caused through the periodic high-frequency oscillation process, the high-frequency fluctuation of the water temperature is caused, and the effect of inhibiting the water temperature stratification is further realized. According to the invention, the water level fluctuation in front of the dam is generated by adjusting the downward discharge flow of the hydropower station, so that the gravity wave of the main flow is triggered, and the high-frequency water flow oscillation phenomenon is further induced in the branch reservoir bay. The invention can effectively improve the density stratification characteristic of deep water lakes and reservoirs, and has the advantages of simple operation, easy realization, obvious effect and the like compared with the prior common engineering measures of stratified water taking, water pumping aeration and the like.

title_en: Method for determining construction scale of medium and small-sized river and lake purification facilities
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining the construction scale of a medium and small river and lake purification facility. The method aims at solving the technical problems that the construction scale of the purification facility is determined by relying on engineering experience in the prior art, and large deviation is easy to occur between the construction scale of the purification facility and the actual demand. The adopted technical scheme is as follows: the method for determining the construction scale of the medium and small river and lake purification facilities comprises the following steps: detecting the water quality of the river or the lake to determine out-of-standard pollutants in the river or the lake; estimating pollution load, water environment capacity and ecological restoration reduction amount of the river or lake corresponding to each pollutant; subtracting the water environment capacity and the ecological restoration reduction amount from the pollution load, and calculating the amount to be purified of the river or lake corresponding to each pollutant; according to the to-be-purified amount of each pollutant, respectively calculating the corresponding design scale of the purifying facilities; and taking the maximum value in each design scale as the guiding construction scale of the purification facility.

title_en: Post-disaster information-physical cooperative recovery scheme generation method and system for power distribution network considering satellite communication support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for generating a post-disaster information-physical cooperative recovery scheme of a power distribution network by considering satellite communication support, which relate to the field of power distribution networks and are characterized in that the post-disaster information-physical cooperative recovery process of the power distribution network under the satellite communication support is modeled as an MILP (minimum likelihood procedure), the method takes the restoration initial data of the information-physical system of the power distribution network as input, outputs the restoration sequence of each node of the electric power-information network, the information flow distribution path, the load and unit operation scheme, the satellite communication terminal deployment and the disaster time scheduling scheme, and realizes the efficient generation of the information-physical cooperative restoration scheme. Compared with the prior art, the method comprehensively considers the complex coupling relation between the information and the physical system of the power distribution network, considers the supporting effect of satellite communication on cooperative recovery under the background of new-era technical development, is beneficial to guiding the post-disaster efficient recovery of the power distribution network and improves the toughness of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Discrimination method for terrain transformation elevation interval of shoal-removing ecological restoration engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a discriminating method of a land relief and restoration ecological restoration project terrain transformation elevation interval, which relates to the technical field of terrain transformation, and comprises the steps of establishing an elevation relation between a tidal water level and the measured terrain of a to-be-restored area of a culture pond, carrying out high Cheng Fuzhi for the measured tidal water level in a hydrological annual cycle range, and determining the tidal inundation elevation of the area; and defining retire a filling area, a leveling area and a retaining area of the restoring area according to the determined high Cheng Gaizao area so as to guide the construction of the ecological restoration project of the back-raising restoring beach. By utilizing the method provided by the invention, the accurate judgment of the terrain transformation elevation interval of the shoal-returning ecological restoration area can be realized, the implementation of the shoal-returning ecological restoration project is effectively guided, the restoration of the water system of the shoal-returning restoration area retire is facilitated, and the ecological restoration efficiency of the coastal-raising abandoned land is improved.

title_en: Ecological restoration method for mine slope
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of mine slope restoration, in particular to a mine slope ecological restoration method which comprises the following steps of S1, on-site investigation and evaluation, and comprehensive mapping of mine slope topography and topography development by using a high-precision mapping instrument. The application has outstanding effect on the aspects of earthquake resistance and soil erosion prevention, and has the advantages that on the aspect of earthquake resistance, a deep rock mass is anchored and strengthened, large-diameter high-strength anchor ropes are adopted, foundation rocks are deeply stabilized, prestress is applied, the rock mass integrity is enhanced, reinforced concrete anti-slip piles are arranged near potential sliding surfaces, the anti-slip capability is improved, a damping ditch is excavated between a slope top and a blasting area, loose sand and stone are filled to weaken vibration energy, the earthquake resistance of a slope is comprehensively improved, a drainage system is constructed to intercept surface water when the soil erosion is prevented, vegetation is reasonably configured, planting grooves and fish scale pits are arranged, an ecological restoration composite structure layer is created, and the water erosion and soil erosion is reduced under the condition of multiple pipes in combination with a spraying grass planting and vine climbing system.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULIC RES

title_en: Intelligent environment monitoring and controlling system for surface mine
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of mine restoration and discloses an intelligent environment monitoring and controlling system for an open-pit mine, which comprises an environment monitoring and multi-mode data acquisition module, an environment computing and decision-making module, a data acquisition end, a real-time processing and complex multivariate analysis module and a data processing and decision-making module, wherein the environment monitoring and multi-mode data acquisition module is arranged at a key position of a mine area and is used for acquiring various types of environment data such as air quality, noise, water pollution, soil erosion, geological disasters and the like through a sensor network, an unmanned plane, satellite remote sensing and other detection devices and carrying out local data processing, and the environment optimization and decision-making module is configured to deploy computing resources at a data acquisition end close to a mining area by utilizing an edge computing technology and carry out real-time processing and complex multivariate analysis on the multi-source environment data through a deep learning algorithm. Through multi-mode data acquisition and an environment optimization and decision module based on edge calculation and deep learning, multi-dimensional environment data from a mining area can be rapidly processed.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 19TH BUREAU GROUP MINING INVESTMENT CO LTD

title_en: Regenerative power supply
title_ko: 회생전압공급 전원장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: By being connected with the restoration voltage to three phase power source by using the switching unit the restoration voltage supply power supply unit minimizes the energy consumption. CONSTITUTION: The regeneration power supply unit(110) is however and parallel connected the plus of the DC link to the minus platform. The restoration voltage is inputted to the regeneration power supply unit. Supplies three phase power source the inputted restoration voltage is switched to the switching unit(120) is the regeneration power supply unit. The controller(130) supplies the restoration voltage to three phase power source by driving the switching unit.
