title_en: Phased network formation for power restoration
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a device receives a router advertisement message after a power outage event in a network. The device joins the network, in response to receiving the router advertisement message. The device sends a power restoration notification message via the network. The device selectively delays a disconnected node from joining the network.

title_en: Optical integration system for disaster emergency broadcasting communication
title_ko: 재해 비상 방송통신 광통합 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an optical integration system for disaster emergency broadcasting communication, including: sensor units which detect surrounding temperatures and strains and are separately located from each other; a broadcasting communication integration unit for transmitting an integrated broadcasting communication optical signal by multiplexing a received broadcasting signal and a received communication signal as optical signals having different wavelengths; reception units which receive the optical signal transmitted from the broadcasting communication integration unit, demultiplex the received optical signal according to each wavelength, transmit the separated broadcasting signal and the separated communication signal to a corresponding peripheral terminal, and transmit the information detected through the sensor units to the broadcasting communication integration unit; and a management server for determining a disaster state from the information which is detected through the sensor units and is received through the reception units and the broadcasting communication integration unit, and transmitting a processing signal through the broadcasting communication integration unit to the reception units according to the disaster state when determining the disaster state, wherein the management server transmits a signal to each guiding indication lamp connected to the separately arranged reception units on the basis of a location information database in which the location information of the sensor units is stored according to the recognized disaster state, and transmits an emergency guide broadcasting signal to the peripheral terminal, and each reception unit includes a mobile remote management server which further connects wireless sensor nodes so as to perform communication through the restoration of retrievable wired/wireless networks in the disaster state, and transmits the information through the wireless sensor nodes to the reception units by enabling communication with the management server and enabling remote connection with the wireless sensor nodes. The system of the present invention can induce reconstruction of destroyed power and information communication networks as emergency networks, and active evasion from a disaster area using independent emergency power in the disaster state.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재해 비상 방송통신 광통합 시스템에 관한 것으로, 주변의 온도 및 스트레인을 검출하며 분산되어 위치하는 센서부와, 수신된 방송신호와 통신신호를 서로 다른 파장을 갖는 광신호들로 다중화하여 융합된 통신 방송 광신호를 전송하는 방송통신 융합부와, 방송통신 융합부에서 전송된 광신호를 수신하여 파장대별로 역다중화하여 분리된 방송신호와 통신신호를 대응되는 주변 단말기로 전송하고, 센서부에서 검출한 정보를 방송통신 융합부에 전송하는 수신부와, 센서부에서 검출되어 수신부 및 방송통신 융합부를 통해 수신된 정보로부터 재해상황인지를 판단하고, 재해상황으로 판단된 경우 재해상황에 따라 방송통신 융합부를 통해 수신부에 처리신호를 전달하는 관리 서버를 구비하고, 관리 서버는 인지한 재해상황에 따라 상기 센서부에 대한 위치 정보가 저장된 위치 정보 데이터 베이스를 바탕으로 분산 배치된 수신부와 연결된 각 안내 지시등에 신호를 전달하고, 주변 단말기에 비상 안내 방송을 전달하며, 수신부는 재해 시 복구 가능한 유무선 망을 복구하여 통신하기 위해 무선 센서 노드를 더 연결하며, 관리 서버와 교신할 수 있으면서 무선센서노드와 원격으로 접속 가능하도록 구축되어 무선센서노드를 통해 수신부에 정보를 전달하는 이동형 원격 관리서버를 구비한다. 이러한 시스템에 의하면, 재해 시 파괴된 전력 및 정보통신 망을 비상망으로 재구축하고 자체 비상 전원으로 능동적으로 재해 장소를 피할 수 있도록 유도하는 효과가 있다.
assignees: FON SYSTEM CO LTD;CHOI HYUN BEOM

title_en: A kind of calamity based on center, two places three is for information system simulation method
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a kind of calamity based on center, two places three for information system simulation method.This emulation builds the calamity of simulation for infosystem according to the actual demand of user, realize the injection of the fault that disaster causes, fault restoration, fault detect, data center the calamity such as switching and switchback, data storage, Validation of Data drill process for infosystem, there are system signal three kinds of states: normal condition, malfunction and center alternative state in system, system signal is utilized to realize the control of calamity for flow process, reduce cost, improve work efficiency, use calamity to share the storage mode of storage for data and production data simultaneously, save space.

title_en: Power grid power failure event identification method based on multidimensional data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid power failure event identification method based on multidimensional data, which comprises the following steps: step one, constructing a multi-dimensional data model by taking a transformer, a bus, a line and a load as main equipment; reading a remote signaling deflection signal in a detection time period to generate a power failure/power restoration event; reading a current or voltage value in a detection time period, detecting telemetering mutation by a sliding extreme value removing method, and generating a power failure/power restoration event; step four, judging by integrating remote measurement and remote signaling, and identifying the power failure type by associating a protection signal, remote control, listing information and maintenance information; and step five, writing the power failure event into a database. The invention effectively judges the power failure type by combining with multidimensional operation data, thereby automatically triggering and generating corresponding records and expanding other related information, realizing the automation of recording, analyzing and counting power failure events and effectively improving the efficiency of analyzing the power failure events of equipment.

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster first-aid repair decision method considering information fusion of traffic network and power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster rush-repair decision method for a power distribution network, which is used for realizing information fusion of a traffic network and the power distribution network, and is used for establishing a rush-repair strategy optimization model considering traffic network interruption in order to adapt to the change of an external road environment and according to collected non-electric quantity information such as road congestion interruption under typhoon disasters, firstly, mapping key nodes of the power distribution network to the traffic network in order to conveniently plan a specific path of a rush-repair main body, and reducing the scale of a subsequent optimization problem by using a Floyd algorithm and clustering; and finally, coordinating resources such as construction teams, rush-repair materials, emergency mobile power supplies, power distribution network racks, distributed power supplies and the like on the premise of meeting the safe and stable operation constraint of the distribution network, and deciding a material transportation scheme, a construction team restoration scheme, a mobile power supply scheduling sequence scheme, network rack reconstruction scheme and an island division scheme aiming at minimizing load loss. The invention fully considers the cooperative optimization of fault first-aid repair and load recovery, achieves the aim of minimum economic loss and simplifies the coding of each part of solution.

title_en: Method for evaluating functional toughness of urban multi-mode traffic network under flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaluation method for the functional toughness of an urban multi-mode traffic network under flood disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining and researching urban road network data, ground public transportation network data and rail public transportation network data, and constructing a multi-mode traffic network structure model. And integrating the multi-mode traffic network structure model and the individual daily trip chain to construct a multi-mode traffic network function model of the city. According to the space destruction characteristics of the flood disasters, constructing a failure model of the multi-mode traffic network function model based on the structural failure model of the multi-mode traffic network, and evaluating the function toughness of the multi-mode traffic network function model under the flood disasters from the two aspects of passable demands and travel delays. The method can be applied to aspects of disaster prevention and reduction strategy evaluation, post-disaster infrastructure restoration strategy evaluation and the like of pre-disaster engineering and management, and can enhance urban toughness, thereby realizing sustainable development.

title_en: Black and odorous water body substrate sludge in-situ remediation integrated equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses in-situ restoration integrated equipment for black and odorous water body substrate sludge, and relates to the technical field of water body restoration. The device comprises a biocatalysis system, an induction reaction system and a combined filler system which are sequentially communicated, wherein a water outlet of the combined filler system is communicated with a water inlet of the biocatalysis system, the biocatalysis system is arranged on land, and the induction reaction system and the combined filler system are arranged at the bottom of a black and odorous water body. The three systems in the device provided by the invention are operated simultaneously, so that the hydrodynamic force of a target water body can be increased, the dynamic circulation in an independent water area can be realized, the dissolved oxygen in water can be increased, the whole water area can be comprehensively repaired, and the problems of water body blackout and water quality repeated deterioration in the black and odorous water body treatment process can be solved.

title_en: The device of restorer for an incline
title_ko: 경사지의 생태복원장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a slope ecology restoring apparatus which includes an environment monitoring unit for monitoring the degree of submersion of a river slope to be restored, a flow velocity of water flowing along the river, an inclination angle of the river slope, and an environment of soil to restore a slope ecology. The slope ecology restoring apparatus of the present invention comprises: a pair of first and second side frames spaced apart from each other in parallel; an end frame for connecting one end and the other end of the first and second side frames; a subframe for connecting inner surfaces of the first and second side frames; at least one sub-connector on which both ends of the subframe are separately seated on the inner surfaces of the first and second side frames; a vegetation part provided by sequentially stacking a gabion, an ecology restoration soil, a natural fiber net, and an aggregate in at least one vegetation space divided by the first and second side frames, the subframe, and the end frame; a cover net provided in a net shape which covers the vegetation part; an end connector for connecting and fixing the first and second side frames and the end frame with a corner of the cover net at four corner portions to which the first and second side frames and the end frame are connected; and a seed composition sprayed on the top of the vegetation part, and including vegetation soil, a corrosion stabilizer, and seeds capable of naturally growing on soil.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 복원하고자 하는 하천 경사지의 침수 정도와, 하천을 따라 흐르는 물의 유속, 하천 경사지의 경사각 및 토양의 환경을 모니터링하여 상기 경사지의 생태를 복원하기 위한 환경모니터링부를 구비한 생태복원장치로, 서로 나란하게 이격되어 구비되는 한쌍의 제1 및 제2 사이드프레임; 상기 제1 및 제2 사이드프레임의 일단 및 타단을 연결하는 엔드프레임; 상기 제1 및 제2 사이드프레임의 내부면을 연결하는 서브프레임; 상기 제1 및 제2 사이드프레임의 내측면에 상기 서브프레임의 양말단이 각각 안착되는 하나 이상의 서브커넥터; 상기 제1 및 제2 사이드프레임과, 상기 서브프레임 및 상기 엔드프레임에 의하여 구획된 하나 이상의 식생공간 내에 순차적으로 돌망태, 생태복원토, 천연섬유네트 및 골재를 적층하여 구비된 식생부; 상기 식생부를 커버하는 망상 형태로 구비된 커버네트; 상기 제1 및 제2 사이드프레임과 상기 엔드프레임이 연결되는 네개의 각 모서리부에 상기 커버네트의 모서리와 함께 상기 제1 및 제2 사이드프레임 및 상기 엔드프레임을 연결하는 고정시키는 엔드커넥터; 및 상기 식생부의 상부에 스프레이되고, 식생 토양, 침식 안정제 및 토양에 자생할 수 있는 종자를 포함하는 시드 조성물;을 포함하는 환경모니터링부를 구비한 생태복원장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Thing networking smoke transducer
abstract_en: The utility model provides a smoke sensor of the internet of things, which comprises a control base and a sensing base, wherein a light-emitting device and a light-receiving device are arranged inside the sensing base, and a power supply circuit, a circuit detection module, a GSM information transmission chip, a microprocessor, a relay and a factory restoration module are arranged inside the control base; compared with the prior art, the utility model discloses following beneficial effect has: when a fire disaster occurs, early warning information can be sent to short message software of user intelligent mobile equipment, the function of warning is achieved, the existence of a working state lamp can facilitate a user to know whether the smoke sensor is in a normal working state, if the smoke sensor is in a fault state, the user can send a control instruction to a microprocessor through the short message software on the intelligent mobile equipment, the smoke sensor can be restarted or a factory leaving module is controlled to be recovered, and then the smoke sensor is recovered to a factory leaving state, so that the function of automatic maintenance is completed.

title_en: Assembled reinforced concrete pier based on grouting sleeve
abstract_en: The utility model provides a based on grout sleeve assembled reinforced concrete pier belongs to bridge engineering technical field to solve traditional pier frusta face when receiving the great seismic force of load capacity, take place bending deformation fracture even easily, restore very trouble problem, including the cushion cap subassembly: the bottom of the grouting sleeve structure is connected with the bearing platform assembly; the bottom of the pier stud assembly is connected with a grouting sleeve structure; one end of the top of the external energy consumption device is connected with the pier stud assembly; the pier stud in the device is prefabricated in a workshop, a bearing platform can be prefabricated in the workshop or cast in place, and two components are connected and installed in the site by a grouting sleeve; in order to improve the seismic performance of the bridge, an energy consumption device is arranged outside the pier stud body and used for absorbing seismic wave energy and preventing the seismic waves from further propagating to the upper part of the bridge body; the bridge anti-seismic design is facilitated, and the bridge anti-seismic method is suitable for rapid bridge restoration after an earthquake disaster.

title_en: Backup interactive method based on remote on-line data disaster tolerance and system for executing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a backup interactive method based on remote on-line data disaster tolerance and a system for executing the method. The system comprises a server platform side, a client side, an on-line backup web side and an on-line backup safety service module, wherein, the server platform side comprises a backup engine server, a WEB restore engine server, a medium engine server, a web server and a database engine server; the client side comprises a data source service module, a data encryption and decryption module, a data service module, a shortcut Shell functional module and a platform backup module; the on-line backup web side is used for the users to carry out an on-line data backup and restoration request, and the web side is connected with the server platform side and the client side through a public network; and the on-line backup server module is distributed in the server platform side, the client side and the on-line backup web side.

title_en: A kind of mandarin tree is by the restoration methods after hail
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of mandarin trees by the restoration methods after hail, the following steps are included: (1) is trimmed in time: trimming cutting back, which has been pounded, breaks or damages overweight branch, wipe out the blade being seriously damaged, retain the less branches and leaves of injured degree, flowers and fruits, fruit tree excessive to fruit losses, that branches and leaves are mixed and disorderly is pruned off, and focuses on the branches and leaves cut;(2) spray pre- disease prevention in time: clearing up orchard, fungicide of full garden spraying after trimming to disaster-stricken fruit tree in time, 80% big raw 500 times of M45 800-1000 times, 1000 times of 70% thiophanate methyl or 65% zineb liquid can be selected in medicament;(3) timely supplementary fertilizer: spraying potassium dihydrogen phosphate or the high potassium Water soluble fertilizer of high phosphorus is continuously sprayed 3-4 times;(4) hormone is sprayed in due course: can spray fruit preservative to improve fruit-setting rate and yield.The influence of hail disaster can be effectively relieved in the present invention, restore tree vigo(u)r, and insect-pest reduces loss.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN JIAXIN FRUIT & VEGETABLE CO LTD

title_en: Riverbank zone structure for urban river ecological restoration and restoration method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river bank zone structure for ecological restoration of an urban river and a restoration method thereof, and river channel areas related to the technology comprise a deep water area, a shallow water area, a river flood area, a revetment and a river channel slope of the urban river. The river channel ecological restoration technology takes river channel habitat restoration as a core, is used as a part of a river channel ecological restoration comprehensive system, and is respectively restored from four aspects of reconstruction of a river channel plane and a section structure, control and regulation of river channel hydrology, change of river bottom matrix, introduction of fast-growing organisms, reconstruction of revetments and reconstruction of river channel slopes to form a stable river channel ecological system and a natural landscape. Different from the traditional 'engineering' river channel reconstruction project, the technology mainly aims at improving the functions of river bank zones as the habitat of river channel aquatic, wet and terrestrial animals and plants, recovering the biological diversity of the river channel, and can essentially improve the ecological integrity and sustainability of the river channel and recover the functions of a natural ecological system of the river channel.
assignees: KESHENG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ecological reinforcement and vegetation restoration method and system for soil slope in cold and arid desertification region
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for ecological reinforcement and vegetation restoration of soil slopes in cold and arid desertification areas. Which comprises the following steps: preparing an ecological degradable container, growing seedlings by the ecological degradable container, arranging a side slope cutting and drainage ditch, cleaning a slope surface, hanging a three-dimensional degradable net, reserving holes in the side slope ecological degradable container for punching, preparing a reinforcing material, preparing reinforced soil, spraying the reinforced soil, spraying grass seeds, placing the ecological degradable container, and maintaining the reinforced soil and vegetation. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the ecological reinforcement and vegetation restoration technology is beneficial to improving the stability of soil body and preventing the geological disasters such as side slope peeling, erosion, slumping, slope collapse, landslide and the like caused by precipitation, strong wind and sand and other factors; the influence of the adverse climate environment on the growth and development of the vegetation is reduced; the frequency and the difficulty of vegetation maintenance management in the later stage of engineering are reduced; is favorable for quickly forming richer arbor, shrub and grass vegetation community levels and improving the greening effect and landscape appearance.
assignees: SHANXI PROVINCE TRAFFIC ENVIRONMENTAL PROT CENTER STATION CO LTD

title_en: Muddy coast ecological restoration and disaster reduction space system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a muddy coast ecological restoration and disaster reduction space system, which is used for muddy coasts and comprises the following components: a double submerged dike protection system, a beach energy dissipation system and a vegetation ecosystem; the system adopts three levels of protection and repair means, comprises an outermost double submerged dike protection system, a middle sand beach energy dissipation system and a vegetation ecosystem close to inland, and forms a three-prevention integrated ecological disaster reduction space system; the influence of severe weather on the coast is effectively reduced, the ecological construction of beaches is strengthened, the diversity of plants and the stability of communities are improved, and the construction and treatment cost is reduced; the method has important effects on the ecological safety of the seaside, the improvement of the disaster prevention and reduction capability of the area, the improvement of the quality of the ecological system of the area and the promotion of the high-quality development of marine economy.

title_en: Method for determining power supply recovery requirement of key electricity utilization facilities required by evacuation of post-disaster traffic network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining power restoration requirements of key electricity utilization facilities required by evacuation of a traffic network after disaster, which belongs to the technical field of power distribution network fault restoration and comprises the following steps: determining a relationship between charging station flow and an interior vehicle; determining a relationship between the power supply of the charging station and the function; based on the relation between the flow of the charging station and the internal vehicles and the relation between the power supply and the functions of the charging station, constructing an evacuation model considering the recovery decision of the post-disaster power distribution network; and solving an evacuation model considering the recovery decision of the post-disaster power distribution network to obtain the electricity consumption requirement decision result of the traffic network electricity utilization equipment. According to the invention, a traffic network dynamic traffic evacuation model considering the influence of traffic key electricity utilization facilities is constructed, and the dynamic traffic flow constraint, the evacuation curve characteristic, the charging station dynamic traffic flow characteristic constraint and the like are considered, so that the personnel evacuation path is determined in the estimated evacuation period, the shortest overall evacuation time is realized, and the traffic evacuation electricity utilization demand reference basis is provided for the recovery decision of the power distribution network.

title_en: Health evaluation index system of single-river inflow sea river and evaluation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of river health evaluation, in particular to a health evaluation index system of a single-river inflow sea river and an evaluation method thereof. The index system comprises 5 criterion layer indexes of hydrology, water quality, biology, habitat and social service functions, wherein the 5 criterion layer indexes respectively comprise 11 common indexes and 5 individual indexes. The evaluation method comprises an Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), a comprehensive index evaluation method and river health grade division. The invention effectively fills the blank that the health evaluation index system of the single-inflow sea river is lacked in the current river research field, and after the health condition evaluation is carried out on the single-inflow sea river by using the technical scheme of the invention, the river restoration proposal and the management strategy proposed according to the evaluation result are more scientific, reasonable and highly targeted, thereby laying a solid foundation for the long-term treatment and the health development of the single-inflow sea river.

title_en: Automatic searching method and system for fault self-healing electric paths of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for automatically searching a fault self-healing electric path of a power distribution network, comprising the steps of obtaining the equipment connection relation of the power distribution network; traversing and searching the power distribution network line to obtain a trunk path of the power distribution network line; identifying a diverted path based on status information of switches in the trunk path; and identifying a fault area of the power distribution network, performing remote control isolation on the fault area according to the transferable paths, and performing transfer power supply and power restoration on the non-fault area. According to the power distribution network topology, the method and the device for automatically identifying the power distribution network can search and identify the rotatable supply paths in the power distribution network in real time, can solve the problem of misoperation and refusal of operation caused by inconsistency between the actual power distribution network line and the self-healing model, realize automatic change of the self-healing model according to the power distribution network line topology, and can reduce the workload of manually designating feeder groups. When the distribution network line breaks down, the fault section is rapidly and accurately isolated through the self-healing program, and the non-fault section recovers power supply, so that the power supply reliability of the distribution line is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Intelligent image oil leakage monitoring method and system for new energy wind generating set
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of application of new energy wind power generation systems, and particularly discloses an intelligent image oil leakage monitoring method and system for a new energy wind power generator set, comprising the following steps of collecting visible light and infrared images in a fan cabin by using an industrial-grade double-spectrum camera; performing image restoration and quality enhancement based on deep learning on the visible light image; identifying potential oil leakage points on the surface of the pipeline in the enhanced visible light image by using a target detection model; registering the visible light and the infrared image, and analyzing the temperature distribution of the corresponding potential oil leakage points; and comprehensively judging whether oil leakage exists or not according to the image and the temperature information, and pushing and early warning. The invention has the beneficial effects that: meanwhile, intelligent oil leakage monitoring is carried out by utilizing visible light and infrared bimodal information, and the two are mutually verified, so that the accuracy of oil leakage identification is greatly improved; when oil leakage is detected, early warning can be responded in time, accident response time is obviously shortened, and safety and reliability of wind power equipment are greatly improved.
assignees: NANJING NANZI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network power supply restoration method based on optical storage optimal configuration under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power control, in particular to a power supply recovery method of a power distribution network based on optical storage optimization configuration under extreme disasters, which comprises the steps of obtaining photovoltaic operation maintenance evaluation parameters, energy storage operation maintenance evaluation parameters, network loss evaluation parameters and load evaluation parameters, and determining a multi-objective optimization function; optimizing the multi-objective optimization function based on photovoltaic power generation constraint and energy storage charge-discharge constraint to obtain an optical storage site selection and volume determination planning model; determining the position and the capacity of photovoltaic and energy storage based on an optical storage site selection and volume determination planning model, and determining an initial island; and recovering power supply based on the result obtained by dynamic island division. According to the invention, a double-layer optimization model comprising optical storage location and volume selection and operation dynamic island division of the power distribution network is constructed, and through iterative optimization of an upper layer and a lower layer, the efficiency is considered in a planning layer, the reliability of power supply recovery of an extreme disaster is considered in an operation layer, and the balance of high-efficiency utilization of power distribution network resources and reliable power supply protection of the extreme disaster load is realized.
assignees: JINAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Middle-low voltage model through auxiliary method for power distribution network based on regulation cloud
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-voltage model through auxiliary method in a power distribution network based on regulation cloud, which comprises the steps of 1, generating a feeder relation comparison table according to dispatching and marketing information, 2, carrying out accurate matching of private transformer, user, public transformer and station area according to each transformer substation and each feeder according to the feeder relation comparison table generated in the step 1,3, generating a visual chart according to an accurate matching result, 4, carrying out fuzzy matching aiming at the matching failure of the accurate matching in the step 2, 5, comparing the matching with the voltage values of electric meters before and after power restoration according to the historical power restoration information of the feeder where the private transformer and the private transformer are located, and if the voltage value of the electric meter just falls to zero in a power failure time period, enabling the surface fuzzy matching result to be in accordance with the actual, and realizing verification of the fuzzy matching relation, and 6, carrying out manual verification aiming at the matching failure of the fuzzy matching in the step 4 and the matching failure matching in the step 5. The invention greatly reduces the number of medium-low pressure modes needing manual checking.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;TORAY POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Virtual power plant collaboration and transaction settlement-based power distribution network toughness improvement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network toughness improving method based on virtual power plant cooperation and transaction settlement, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a multi-type virtual power plant participation power grid dispatching and power transaction whole-flow management framework comprising a virtual power plant management platform, a power transaction platform and a dispatching platform to conduct planning on VPP disaster accidents, S2, constructing a multi-type VPP cooperation optimized power distribution network power supply restoration model before and after disaster to formulate a network reconstruction strategy, a real-time dispatching strategy of emergency resources and a regulation strategy of the VPPs in each period, and S3, calculating the power supply restoration incentive unit price and compensation income of each VPP participation according to the actual response quantity of the VPPs issued by the dispatching platform, the declared response quantity reported by the virtual power plant management platform and the VPP historical participation degree by the power transaction platform. The invention solves the key problems of insufficient resource coordination, stage cutting, excitation rigidification and the like by integrating the full-flow closed-loop management of pre-disaster plan generation, post-disaster dynamic adjustment and transaction settlement.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Mountain highway disaster identification method and system based on multi-source remote sensing image restoration and super-resolution reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plateau mountain road disaster identification method and system based on multi-source remote sensing image restoration and super-resolution reconstruction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source remote sensing images of mountain areas of a plateau, preprocessing, extracting geomorphic metering parameters based on a digital elevation model, constructing a super-resolution reconstruction network integrating deformable convolution and a Transformer, reconstructing low-resolution images by utilizing composite loss function constraint training comprising the geomorphic metering parameters, carrying out feature extraction and self-adaptive weighted fusion on the preprocessed images and the high-resolution images obtained by reconstruction, identifying landslide, debris flow and subgrade subsidence disasters along the road by utilizing a multi-task deep learning model based on the fused images, carrying out morphological optimization and boundary refinement under GIS constraint on identification results, and outputting disaster thematic map. The invention effectively improves the accuracy and reliability of highway disaster identification under complex terrain environments.

title_en: Energy storage control method of energy storage system based on cloud edge cooperation and energy storage system
abstract_en: The application discloses an energy storage control method and an energy storage system based on cloud edge cooperation. The method comprises the steps of generating first energy storage control information of energy storage equipment through a cloud server, wherein the energy storage control information is used for indicating and controlling the energy storage equipment to execute corresponding power charging and discharging operation, controlling the energy storage equipment to conduct electric energy ownership transfer and control on the energy storage equipment to conduct electric energy scheduling on the energy storage equipment, responding to network connection interruption between the cloud server and an edge end controller, generating second energy storage control information of the energy storage equipment through the edge end controller, responding to network connection interruption restoration between the cloud server and the edge end controller, and restoring to use the cloud server to generate new first energy storage control information. The scheme of the application can enable the energy storage system to have self-running capability when communication is interrupted, and realize energy efficiency optimization and system robustness of the system.
assignees: SHENZHEN HELLO TECH ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: System and method for automated fault control and restoration of smart grids
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a system and method for automated fault control and restoration of smart grids.SOLUTION: A self-organizing protection coordination system in a power network includes a plurality of distribution devices 10 communicatively coupled to each other in a power network. The power network also includes a protection device 12 coupled to each of the plurality of distribution devices configured to transmit power in a distribution network. The power network further includes a controller 14 coupled to each of the plurality of distribution devices. The controller receives communication channel characteristics from the plurality of distribution devices in the distribution network at a constant interval of time. The controller also computes a delay in time for receiving the communication characteristics. The controller further determines a plurality of reliability indicators at each of the plurality of distribution devices. The controller adjusts tripping characteristics of the plurality of distribution devices to minimize the reliability indicators on the basis of the computed delay.

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: This system includes a means for collecting data in real time, a means for analyzing the collected data and predicting a disaster, a means for analyzing a state of damage, a means for proposing an optimum countermeasure plan for relief and restoration, a means for providing necessary information, and a means for proposing an optimum moving route.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Disaster prevention facility
abstract_en: To reduce a setting space, to avoid duplicate display at the occurrence of a fire and to improve the operability of fire handling and broadcasting by incorporating the function of broadcasting equipment into the receiver of disaster prevention equipment.SOLUTION: In the disaster prevention equipment, a fire is monitored by an analog fire sensor 14 connected to a receiver 10. A reception control part 62 of a receiver 10 performs fire alarm processing when receiving a fire alarm signal from an analog fire sensor 14. The receiver 10 is provided with an emergency broadcast control part 64 and broadcasts for fire alarm and evacuation guidance from a speaker 28 connected at the time of fire occurrence. A receiver 10 is provided with a display 42 provided inside a small door and having a restoration switch for completing all fire alarm processing and restoring to a normal monitoring state and a broadcast restoration switch.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method and apparatus for reconstructing time series data of climate
title_ko: 기후시계열 데이터 복원 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and device for restoring climate time series data, which comprises the steps of: allowing a climate time series data input unit to receive climate series data of a target area and climate time series data of one or more surrounding areas located around the target area to restore a climate reference average value of the target area from single-year climate time series data of the target area; allowing a reference climate station selection unit to analyze a correlation between the climate time series data of the target area and the climate time series data of the surrounding area and select a reference climate station of the surrounding area for correcting the time series data of the target area through the analyzed correlation; and allowing a climate reference average value restoration unit to correct the climate time series data of the target area based on the climate time series data of the selected reference climate station and restore the climate reference average value for estimating an amount of power generation through the corrected climate time series data of the target area. Therefore, the accuracy and reliability of feasibility evaluation can be improved.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기후시계열 데이터 복원 방법 및 장치에 관한 것으로서, 기후시계열 데이터 입력부가, 대상 지역의 단일해 기후시계열 데이터로부터 대상 지역의 기후표준평년값을 복원하기 위해, 대상 지역의 기후시계열 데이터 및 대상 지역의 주변에 위치한 하나 이상의 주변 지역의 기후시계열 데이터를 입력받는 단계, 기준 기후측정소 선택부가, 대상 지역의 기후시계열 데이터와 주변 지역의 기후시계열 데이터 간의 상관성을 분석하고, 분석된 상관성을 통해 대상 지역의 기후시계열 데이터를 보정하기 위한 해당 주변 지역의 기준 기후측정소를 선택하는 단계, 및 기후표준평년값 복원부가, 선택된 기준 기후측정소의 기후시계열 데이터에 기초하여 대상 지역의 기후시계열 데이터를 보정하고, 보정된 대상 지역의 기후시계열 데이터를 통해 발전량 추정을 위한 기후표준평년값을 복원하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRIC POWER CORP;DAEMYOUNGGEC CO LTD

title_en: Mobile disaster chattel restoration unit
abstract_en: A mobile disaster restoration unit designed to facilitate cleaning efforts by a crew at a disaster recovery site. The mobile unit comprises a modified trailer designed to be parked by a restoration service provider at a disaster site long term. The trailer is modified to include a storage bin, a cleaning room with a variety of cleaning equipment for use by the restoration crew, and a swing office for combined use of the restoration crew, insurance claims adjuster, and homeowner. The cleaning room stocks an array of restoration equipment including a commercial dishwasher and sink, an ultrasonic cleaning tank, shop vac, etc., all powered by a solar-charging battery bank. The mobile disaster restoration unit avoids the need to pack and transport the contents of a disaster-stricken home or building (after a fire or flood) to a commercial cleaning facility. Instead, all cleaning can be done expeditiously onsite.
assignees: BENFIELD JASON P;VON HENDRICKS II BURNELL F

title_en: Remote power outage and restoration notification
abstract_en: Power outages and restorations at customer premises can be automatically detected and reported. A method may include receiving, from a network terminal, a first notification associated with a power outage; retrieving location information associated with the network terminal; sending a second notification indicating that the outage has occurred and that includes the location information associated with the network terminal; retrieving prior outage information that corresponds to a set of network terminals associated with a group of set top boxes; determining that an outage event is triggered, when a quantity of outages is greater than a threshold, where the quantity of outages is based on the outage and other outages obtained from the prior outage information; and sending a third notification based on the determination that the outage event is triggered, where the third notification includes information associated with the quantity of outages that enables a server to remedy the outage event in a manner that does involve users of the group of set top boxes.

title_en: Smart circuit breaker, system including the same, and method of managing power
abstract_en: A smart circuit breaker includes a communication interface, separable contacts, a processing unit having a memory with a routine stored therein which, when executed by the processing unit causes the processing unit to: sense a power outage in an electrical grid, control a meter to open contacts to disconnect from the electrical grid, sense power restoration to the electrical grid, control contacts corresponding to a secondary power source to open, control the meter to close contacts to reconnect to the electrical grid, sense that a frequency of power from the electrical grid matches a frequency of power from the secondary power source, and control the contacts corresponding to the secondary power source to close.

title_en: A kind of electric power rack timing recovery optimization method considering element potential damage probability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of electric power rack timing recovery optimization methods for considering element potential damage probability, this method for natural calamity may result in a wide range of power outages and to force device bring potential damage, carry out the recovery of electric power rack using timing recovery strategy.Restore in the period at each, substep carries out unit starting sequential optimization and sequential optimization is restored in path.The first step is up to objective optimization unit starting sequence with system generating capacity in rack recovery time；Second step path optimizing recovery sequence, establishes transmission of electricity component wear probabilistic model and recovery time model.First step unit starting sequential optimization and second step path recovery sequential optimization passage path operating time are associated, effectively realize two compatibilities of goals optimizations.The present invention considers the transmission of electricity element such as route, transformer, and there are different degrees of potential damage probability scenarios, have been formed simultaneously the rack recovery scheme of timing to Guiding Practice, have had more realistic meaning.

title_en: A kind of data disaster restoration methods, system and server virtualization system
abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of data disaster restoration methods, comprising: backs up to the metadata on the working terminal of server virtualization system；Working terminal is monitored in real time；It breaks down when monitoring working terminal, then utilizes metadata backup file, corresponding data recovery process is carried out in backup site, then starts backup site.It needs to carry out metadata backup to working terminal in the application, in the case where monitoring working terminal and breaking down, data recovery process will be carried out in backup site using metadata backup file, then the progress of work of the working terminal to break down before being taken over using the backup site Jing Guo data recovery process, it is possible thereby to reduce the business interruption time after system jam, the system failure of server virtualization system is reduced to adverse effect caused by user security risk.In addition, the application further correspondingly discloses a kind of data disaster recovery device and the server virtualization system including the device.

title_en: Underground gasification furnace parking and burned out area restoration processing method for coal underground gasifying technology
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of parking of underground gasification furnace and burned out area restoration processing methods, this method comprises: a) cutting off the injection of oxidant；B) nitrogen purges；C) oxidant injection device removes；D) fixed point injection coolant carries out parking fire extinguishing；E) chemically reacted in termination burned out area and etc., underground gasification furnace parking of the invention and method for subsequent processing, which have the advantage that, purges whole system using a small amount of space division byproduct nitrogen, prevents the leakage of shutdown phase oxidant from causing re-ignition and flashing back that equipment is caused to damage problem；It injects a small amount of coolant or space division byproduct nitrogen and fixed point quick extinguishing is carried out to gasification furnace combustion zone, injection is continuously recycled without bulk gas, significantly reduces operation cost；Comprehensively consider and coal seam top/bottom plate and above covered/geologic structure and condition of underlying stratum, has avoided the various geological disasters and secondary pollution problem of shutdown phase.

title_en: Electric power marketing billing method and electric power marketing billing engine
abstract_en: The invention provides a power marketing billing method and a power marketing billing engine, wherein the power marketing billing engine is configured into a plurality of flow components in advance according to billing flow, the electric quantity and electricity charge calculation flow components are divided into a plurality of different primary components in advance according to billing rules of different nationwide provinces (cities), the primary components are divided into a plurality of secondary components and expansion points in advance according to the billing rules, and unified is realized in places with inconsistent billing rules and inconsistent implementation modes of the nationwide provinces (cities). Customer data required by charging is stored in a charging database as a snapshot synchronously, so that the subsequent electric quantity and electricity charge calculation is facilitated, the electric quantity and electricity charge calculation result is subjected to quantity and charge auditing, the accuracy of the calculation result is improved, the problems of low charging speed and low efficiency caused by 'taking and calculating' in the prior art are avoided, the charging result is not influenced even if abnormal conditions such as power failure and power restoration occur in the charging process, and the stability and reliability of the electric quantity and electricity charge calculation are improved.

title_en: Civil aviation route planning method with limit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil aviation route planning method with restriction, which comprises the steps of obtaining route data and route restriction data, and generating a route network diagram according to the route data and the route restriction data; calculating the shortest route from a preset starting point to a preset end point under the condition of no route restriction according to the route network diagram; performing route restriction inspection on the shortest route; outputting the shortest route as the shortest route with the route limit when the shortest route passes the route limit check; when the shortest route does not pass the route limit check, carrying out path restoration and neighborhood construction according to the shortest route to obtain a plurality of candidate routes meeting the route limit, and adding the plurality of candidate routes into a preset candidate solution pool to carry out optimal route iterative computation until the preset constraint condition is met; and outputting the optimal route in the candidate solution pool as the shortest route with route restriction. The embodiment of the invention can quickly find out legal paths meeting all the route restrictions, and improves the route optimizing efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent data protection method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster recovery processing of electric digital data, in particular to an intelligent data protection method and system, which are characterized in that the predicted access frequency of each target data is firstly predicted through data attribute and access frequency records, then the recovery priority of each target data is obtained by further combining comprehensive consideration of the predicted access frequency, the preset priority and the data quantity, and then the data in a cache data center is updated by utilizing the recovery priority of the target data, so that the latest and most important data can be dynamically cached in the cache data center. Therefore, by utilizing the characteristic that the data recovery speed of the cache data center is higher than that of the disaster recovery backup data center, important data can be recovered in priority through the cache data center rapidly when a disaster occurs, so that basic or hot business functions can be recovered rapidly, loss caused to enterprises is reduced, and the problem that the business functions cannot be recovered rapidly due to low data recovery speed in the prior art is solved perfectly.

title_en: Power distribution network power failure time prediction method and system considering distributed resource access
abstract_en: The invention particularly discloses a power distribution network outage time prediction method and a power distribution network outage time prediction system considering distributed resource access, wherein when a certain element fails, power supply is restored to an upstream area of a failure point after fault isolation, power supply switching area division and switching load analysis are performed to all power supplies in a downstream area of the failure point and connection switches connected with a power failure line, if no connection switch and fault line segment exist in the power failure area, power supply restoration is waited after fault restoration, the outage time of the area is calculated, if the connection switches exist in the switching area and standby power supplies can provide electric energy support, power supply switching is performed to the area, the outage time of the area is calculated, if the standby power supplies do not exist, the situation that the distributed resources are used as power supplies is considered, and the accuracy of power outage time prediction under a novel power distribution system is improved according to different areas related to power outage.

title_en: Excavation downhill slag slide pile body slope zoning grading durable control method
abstract_en: The application discloses a regional and hierarchical durable control method for a side slope of an excavation downhill slag pile, which belongs to the technical field of geological disaster management and ecological restoration, the method comprises the steps of firstly carrying out detailed investigation on the excavated side slope of a collapse pile to obtain basic data, then carrying out overall and local stability evaluation according to the basic data and the actual condition of the side slope, and obtaining the overall and local stable states of the excavated slope, classifying the excavated slope according to the deformation damage characteristics and the stable states in a partitioning way, integrating the partitioning and classifying results, and finally, formulating corresponding geological disaster management and ecological restoration schemes based on the partitioning and classifying comprehensive results. Aiming at the characteristics Shi Ce of different areas and grades of slopes, the method organically combines geological disaster management and ecological restoration, can improve the stability of the slopes, reduce the risk of collapse and landslide, ensure engineering safety, promote ecological protection and recovery, reduce the negative influence of disasters on surrounding ecology, realize win-win of engineering construction and ecological protection, and lay a foundation for sustainable development.

title_en: Apparatus of road safety block
title_ko: 도로복구블록
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A road restore block is provided to enable provisional passage by installing sub base layer materials and facilitate the collection of existing materials during pavement restoration. CONSTITUTION: A road restore block(100) comprises a unity protrusion, a unity groove, and a compaction part. The unity protrusion mutually couples blocks in the traverse direction, wherein the upper side of a block body is projected in the lateral direction. The unity groove is formed to mount a unity protrusion on the opposite side of the block body. The compaction part compacts the bottom of the construction field. Temporal paved sides are interconnected in order to cover the construction field of the road.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기존 도로 포장의 일부 또는 전체를 제거하여 시행하는 각종 도로 공사에서 제거된 포장면을 커버하기 위한 도로복구블록에 관한 것으로서, 구체적으로 제거된 포장면 상부에 운반 및 설치, 해체가 간편하면서도 강한 체결이 가능한 블록을 설치하여 제거된 포장면을 신속하고 안전하게 커버하여, 공사를 수행하는 중에도 사람 및 차량의 통행을 가능하게 하여 공사로 인한 교통 정체발생을 차단하여 안전하고 쾌적한 건설환경을 제공하고, 현재 시행하고 있는 임시포장(가포장) 또는 이중포장으로 인한 자원 낭비 및 공사비 증가를 방지하여 건설사 원가 절감을 극대화시키고, 공사의 품질을 향상시키고 부실공사를 방지하므로 궁극적으로 국가예산 절감을 도모하며, 국가재난시 도로 응급복구용으로도 사용이 가능하여 국민의 안전과 재산을 지킬 수 있도록 한 도로복구블록을 제공하려는 것이다.

title_en: Intellectual power distribution system
title_ko: 배전선로의 지능화 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an intelligent system of a distribution line, having first and second ground bypass cables, first and second underground bypass cables, and first and second bypass switches. The intelligent system supplies power of another distribution line of the opposite side installed side by side with a road therebetween when a failure section is generated in the distribution line to continuously supply power without power failure to a customer of the failure section. In addition, the intelligent system enables bypass of power without installing a bypass cable crossing the road, which enables a vehicle of a high height due to a large structure stacked therein to pass, so cable removal and restoration processes are not required and power can be continuously supplied without a blackout.

title_en: Ecological restoration engineering structure of metal mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a metal mine ecological restoration engineering structure which comprises a dam body, wherein a restoration layer for planting is arranged on an inclined plane of the dam body, a fixing frame for fixing the restoration layer is arranged on the restoration layer, a plurality of mounting grooves are uniformly formed in the side surface of the restoration layer, the mounting grooves are sequentially formed from top to bottom along the inclined plane of the restoration layer, and a water storage tank for storing rainwater is arranged in the mounting grooves. The ecological restoration device has the advantages of simple integral structure, low restoration cost, reduction of the economic burden of ecological restoration, improvement of the soil-fixing capability of the ecological restoration device by planting vegetation for soil fixing through the restoration layer, prevention of water and soil loss and improvement of the ecological restoration effect, and further reduction of the restoration cost by arranging the fixing frame on the restoration layer to fix the vegetation, so that the restoration layer is prevented from sliding along with rainwater when the rainwater is flushed down from a dam body, the landslide is prevented, the fixing frame can be made of rubber or alloy, and the vegetation can be recycled after the restoration layer is not in landslide risk after soil fixing is completed.
assignees: HENAN FAENDE MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Long-term scheduling and Maintenance Schedule Optimization method in market environment lower step power station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to step power station scheduling and long-term scheduling in service technique field, more particularly to a kind of market environment lower step power station and maintenance dual blank-holder.To reduce influence of the step power station repair schedule to running income, the present invention is by building long-term scheduling and repair schedule bi-level optimal model in step power station, the combined optimization of long-term scheduling and repair schedule in realization.During Mid-long Term Optimized Scheduling, using runoff and price expectation as reference, decision-making is carried out according to runoff and price expectation, is contributed using genetic algorithm optimization day part step power station, searches optimal benefit space；During Maintenance Schedule Optimization, emphasis considers step upstream and downstream hydraulic, influence of the electric power coupled relation to repair schedule, using medium-term and long-term scheduling intermediate result as boundary condition, using minimum maintenance loss as optimization aim, it is total revenue by maintenance loss optimum results and medium-term and long-term gene-ration revenue merger, so as to realize combined optimization.
assignees: BEIJING WEIKENFULAI TECH CO LTD;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD;KUNMING POWER EXCHANGE CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise ordered power utilization decision method considering load limit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise ordered power utilization decision method considering load limitation, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring load data of a special transformer enterprise and public transformer load data in a region respectively, and classifying the special transformer enterprise according to the principles of industrial characteristics, protection degree and the like; s2, performing data processing on the MTLAB, combining the special variable and the public variable data, and obtaining a daily load curve of the region through a program; and S3, obtaining the type and name of the enterprise cut in one day, the corresponding load cutting time, the power restoration time of the enterprise cut in the peak valley period and the power restoration amount according to the regional load limit required by the superior through a program. The method has simple implementation process, can effectively solve the increasingly prominent problem of power supply and demand balance, is favorable for relieving the peak load regulation pressure of the power grid in the peak period, improves the load rate of the power grid and the operation efficiency of power grid enterprises, and has obvious economic value and social benefit.

title_en: Elastic power distribution network multipoint fault first-aid repair method and system considering emergency resource scheduling
abstract_en: The disclosure belongs to the technical field of power distribution network optimization, and provides an elastic power distribution network multipoint fault first-aid repair method and system considering emergency resource scheduling, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S01: acquiring fault node position information and load node index weight, judging whether the power distribution network completely recovers power supply, if so, turning to the step S03, otherwise, turning to the step S02; step S02: performing network reconstruction of the power distribution network by taking the maximum power restoration load as a target until power supply is completely restored, and turning to step S03; step S03: judging whether the fault node in the power distribution network is completely recovered, if so, ending the first-aid repair, otherwise, turning to the step S04; step S04: and (4) repairing the fault node by taking the highest restoring force of the power distribution network as a target until the fault node is completely repaired, and finishing the first-aid repair.

title_en: Debris flow treatment device and treatment method based on ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow treatment device and a treatment method based on ecological restoration, in particular to the field of debris flow treatment, which comprises a main connection buffer mechanism and a central pressure transmission mechanism, wherein the main connection buffer mechanism comprises a buffer outer frame, a central connecting block is inserted into the outer surface of the buffer outer frame, a curved pressure plate frame is clamped on one side of the central connecting block, the outer side of the curved pressure plate frame is rotatably connected with a torsion block, two sides of the buffer outer frame are slidably connected with pressure blocks, the blocking equipment is convenient to disassemble and assemble at the later stage by recording the data of each area, and as the number of the blocking equipment is large, if the equipment is damaged, the maintenance personnel can quickly reach the designated area to repair the equipment through the three-dimensional coordinates of each area in a three-dimensional building function diagram, and simultaneously, after debris flow passes, the recording is carried out according to the condition of a large blocking area, and rapidly carrying out ecological restoration on the area by using the water flow obtained by the water flow collecting and filtering frame.

title_en: Damaged mountain modeling, stability and design integrated analysis method based on remote sensing and GIS
abstract_en: A damaged mountain modeling, stability and design integrated analysis method based on remote sensing and GIS belongs to the technical field of damaged mountain ecological restoration. The integrated analysis technology is suitable for analyzing damaged mountains with steep terrain, and data are collected firstly and used for assisting in early-stage route design; carrying out unmanned aerial vehicle oblique photography according to the earlier stage site survey condition and the air route design parameters to obtain complete oblique multi-view image data of the survey area; combining the acquired data and other parameter files, constructing a three-dimensional model of the real scene of the measuring area by means of fine modeling software, and performing stability analysis on the three-dimensional model; and (4) performing geological disaster prevention and control and ecological restoration engineering design on the damaged mountain according to the model analysis result. The method is based on means such as unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing and GIS, accurately detects and analyzes the engineering examples of the damaged mountains, and has important reference value for related damaged mountain detection and treatment engineering.

title_en: Intelligent networking type movable floating device for modular basin governance
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent networking type movable floating device for modular watershed management. The prior art can not monitor the water quality of the designated position in the flow field and the hydraulic structure; the cost is high in the plugging emergency rescue process. The invention is a hexagonal hull structure, and the top area is used for the production and storage of electric energy; the middle area is a functional area, the central control area is used for receiving, processing and transmitting signals, the hydrological monitoring area is used for monitoring hydrological information at a specified position in a basin, the water quality monitoring area is used for monitoring the water quality condition at a specific position in the basin, the nondestructive detection area is used for monitoring a hydraulic structure in the basin, the structure restoration area is used for storing a plugging filling material of the hydraulic structure, and a dredging device and water body aeration and water quality restoration microorganism equipment are arranged in the ecological restoration area; the bottom area is provided with special equipment and a driving device. The invention can quickly reach any place, quickly plug the dike breach through splicing and combining, and improve the emergency rescue efficiency.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY FIRST SURVEY & DESIGN INST GROUP LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration method for rock slope of mine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration of mine rock slopes, and discloses a method for ecological restoration of mine rock slopes. According to the method, the landslide disaster can be subjected to scientific cause analysis by the judging method of the mine rock slope instability mechanism, and a relatively accurate mine rock slope instability judging result is obtained, so that a theoretical basis is provided for reinforcing the mine rock slope; meanwhile, the point cloud data of the side slope is divided into a block part and a non-block part by a monitoring method for the deformation of the mine rock side slope, the block deformation method is used for detecting the deformation such as rotation and offset of a block, the point cloud subtraction method is used for detecting the change of the non-block part, and the two parts of results are overlapped together to comprehensively analyze and judge the overall deformation condition of the side slope. Compared with the traditional point cloud subtraction method, the deformation condition of the rock mass can be accurately and comprehensively detected.

title_en: Farmland heavy metal restoration path planning system based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing data drive
abstract_en: The invention discloses a farmland heavy metal restoration path planning system based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing data driving, which relates to the technical field of farmland restoration and comprises a data acquisition module, a pollution restoration subarea dividing module, an attribute identifying module, a restoration means evaluating module, a composite restoration coefficient calculating module, a global restoration optimizing module and a scheme output module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time remote sensing image data, the pollution restoration subarea dividing module is used for dividing the pollution restoration subareas, the attribute identifying module is used for identifying land block attribute information, the restoration means evaluating module is used for evaluating initial restoration coefficients, the pollution restoration subarea association effect evaluating module is used for evaluating restoration migration effects, the composite restoration coefficient calculating module is used for comprehensively evaluating composite restoration coefficients, the global restoration optimizing module is used for globally planning implemented heavy metal restoration means of each pollution restoration subarea, and the scheme output module is used for outputting restoration paths of each heavy metal restoration means. The method has the advantage of providing a powerful intelligent decision support for efficient, accurate and collaborative restoration of heavy metal pollution of the complex farmland.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF AGRICULTURAL QUALITY STANDARDS AND MONITORING TECH GUANGDONG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SC

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster rush repair scheduling optimization method considering load three-phase imbalance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system rush-repair scheduling, and discloses a power distribution network post-disaster rush-repair scheduling optimization method considering load three-phase imbalance, which adopts the technical scheme that the weighting of the maximum load accumulation recovery amount and the minimum fuel cost of a mobile generator during the rush-repair of the power distribution network is adopted as a target, the three-phase unbalanced safety constraint and the wind power output uncertainty are considered, a random optimization model is built by modeling wind power output, coupling rush repair team scheduling, mobile generator scheduling and power distribution network operation constraint through a scene probability method, and a CPLEX solver is adopted to solve after linearization so as to coordinate various resources to promote the three-phase load accumulation recovery amount and ensure the operation safety of a system and equipment.

title_en: Construction method and system of microorganism and vegetation synergistic greening system of coastal saline soil engineering plot
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing a microorganism and vegetation synergistic greening system of a coastal saline soil engineering plot. Belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration engineering. The method comprises the steps of carrying out micro-topography characteristic analysis on a coastal saline soil engineering plot, identifying a natural micro-topography heterogeneous area, generating micro-topography characteristic data, designing a differential micro-topography modification scheme according to the micro-topography characteristic data, constructing a micro-topography modification model with spatially differential characteristics, providing a proper micro-environment foundation for the synergistic effect of subsequent microorganisms and vegetation, carrying out deep coupling on a MICP flora induced calcium carbonate mineralization technology and salt-tolerant plant functional group screening, and combining the differential micro-topography modification design, thereby breaking the situation of traditional improvement and planting and cutting, effectively improving the soil structure of the coastal saline soil, enhancing the soil water holding capacity, providing a proper soil environment for vegetation stable establishment, and avoiding the re-greening failure caused by the uncontinuous soil structure improvement.
assignees: QINHUANGDAO POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED

title_en: Regional energy management method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a regional energy management method which instantaneously restores a surrounding area by: securing a power source, after a disaster strikes, for a disaster control base, a disaster prevention base as well as fluctuating number of shelters on a community center level; installing distributed power sources such as photovoltaic power generation as well as wind power generation; and establishing cooperation between the surrounding area and a large-scale facility such as a factory operating an emergency power source.SOLUTION: A regional energy management method comprises the steps of: constructing a system which interchanges a portable battery function, when a disaster strikes, between a restoration base using a business facility and a shelter in a surrounding area; securing a power source at the shelter as well as optimally operates a power supply facility of a factory by using the system; and deciding a power source delivery amount with respect to power supply demand of the shelter on the basis of a business continuation state of the business facility, a power system interconnection state as well as operation information on a battery.

title_en: An engineering wood for cultural assets restoration
title_ko: 문화재복원용 목재
abstract_en: PURPOSE: Timber for a cultural assets restoration is provided to reduce manufacturing time and cost, and to enhance preservation property of the timber. CONSTITUTION: Timber for a cultural assets restoration is manufactured by mixing 5~60wt% of polyethylene glycol, 2~20wt% of antiseptic including copper, chrome, an arsenide-based compound, zinc, and fluorine, and 2~20% of flame retardant represented by aluminum hydroxide, for 100 weight of water using an ultrasonic wave emulsification. The timber is precipitated into this solution after processing the timber for 15 minutes using the ultrasonic wave.
abstract_ko:
문화재는 소중한 우리 문화유산으로 그 유지와 복원의 중요성은 시간이 흐를수록 증대된다. 복원용으로 사용되는 목재는 금강송으로 대표되는 형질이 우수한 목재를 사용하지만 이렇게 우량한 목재도 보존성을 향상시키기 위하여 보존성유지에 필요한 여러가지 처리를 한다. 
     과거에는 팔만대장경의 예에서 보듯이 바닷물에 절여 삼투압에 의해 목재를 치밀하게 만들었지만 현대의 기술은 플라스틱물질을 목재조직 내의 공극 속으로 주입시켜 보존성을 향상시킨 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     폴리에틸렌글리콜(Polyethyleneglycol, 이하 PEG)처리는 목재의 색에도 영향을 미치지 않고, 생체실험에도 사용할 만큼 안정된 물질이며, 낮은 온도에서도 액상으로 되기 때문에 보존처리에 많이 이용하지만 장기간에 걸쳐 농도를 5％씩 서서히 높여가야만 하는 단점이 있었다. 또한 문화재용목재에 PEG를 처리한 후에 미생물로 인한 목재의 열화 등을 방지하기 위한 방부처리와 화재 등을 예방하기 위한 난연처리는 별도로 시행하여 작업과정이 복잡하고 인력과 자원이 많이 소요되었다. 
     초음파는 목재 조직 내의 수분을 빼내 목재의 강도를 단단하게 만들어 주는 효과와 PEG의 침투를 도와주는 효과가 있다. 또한 약품의 혼합도 도와주는 효과가 있다. 
     본 발명에서는 초음파의 장점을 이용하여 문화재보호용 목재에 사용하는 PEG와 방부제, 난연제를 미리 초음파로 혼합하고 이 혼합용액을 초음파로 목재에 주입 함으로써 3번의 절차를 한번으로 줄여서 시간을 단축하고 절차를 대폭 간소화하여 인력과 자원을 절감하면서도 소기의 목적을 이룰 수 있는 방법을 제공하고자 한다. 
     초음파로 혼합약제를 주입하여 PEG를 목재세포내로 침투시켜 외관상으로는 목재의 색이나 형상에 변화를 주지 않고도 기존목재보다 수분저항성이 높으면서도 난연성이 6배나 증가시킬 수 있는 문화재 복원용 목재의 제조가 가능하다. 
     이 목재는 문화재보호용 뿐만 아니라 통나무집과 같은 다른 목조건축물의 자재 용도로도 사용이 가능하다.

title_en: Power connection control system and method
abstract_en: For each of consumers, a connection control apparatus is provided that includes an opening/closing device capable of connecting or disconnecting an electric power system and a consumer, that, when a power outage occurs in the electric power system, disconnects the electric power system and the consumer from each other by the opening/closing device at a command from an outage management apparatus or the like, and that connects the electric power system and the consumer to each other by the opening/closing device upon receiving a command from the outage management apparatus or the like at the time of restoration from the power outage. A power supply control apparatus supplies electric power from energy provision equipment to electrical appliances during a power outage in the electric power system.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering control method and system based on water system communication condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering control method and a hydraulic engineering control system based on a water system communication condition, and relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering. Inputting the data into a river and lake health evaluation multichannel, generating a health evaluation vector, and calculating standard state deviation to form a health deviation vector. And (5) making a hydraulic engineering control decision based on the deviation vector, and constructing a river and lake resuscitation decision space. And optimizing the decision space by combining the recovery optimizing factors to generate a first strategy of river and lake recovery. And carrying out water system communication evaluation, constructing communication conditions, and optimizing a resuscitation strategy based on the communication conditions to form a final river and lake resuscitation scheme. Thereby achieving the technical effects of comprehensively considering the effective river and lake resuscitating decision of the water system communication and water ecological restoration mutual feedback process and remarkably improving the ecological restoration effect.

Slope supporting structure for mine restoration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a side slope bearing structure for mine restoration, including the bank protection bed frame, the top fixed connection of bank protection bed frame has the foundation layer, one side fixedly connected with gravel layer of bank protection bed frame is kept away from to the foundation layer, one side fixedly connected with cement layer of foundation layer is kept away from to the gravel layer, one side fixedly connected with gravel layer of gravel layer is kept away from on the cement layer.
