title_en: Ecological protection, restoration and planning zoning method for lakes and grasses in mountain and water forest fields
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for planning and partitioning ecological protection and restoration of lake and grass in mountain and water forest fields, which takes an ecological function partitioning diagram as a base diagram and combines the administrative divisions at county level and the boundary diagram data of a small watershed to determine the range of the ecological protection and restoration partitioning; respectively drawing a leading ecological function diagram and an ecological sensitivity distribution diagram, and comprehensively forming an ecological protection important area; refining various problems into an ecological protection restoration subarea, and determining the spatial distribution characteristics of resource environment problems of each area; the area factors of ecological protection important areas and resource environment problem distribution areas of all the subareas are comprehensively considered, and the subarea ecological protection restoration direction is determined; on the premise of defining the partition range, leading functions, highlighting problems and protecting and repairing directions, forming an ecological protection and repairing partition scheme; the method is convenient for taking small watersheds as units in counties and counties to integrally plan the ecological protection and restoration engineering of the mountainous water, forest, field, lake and grass, comprehensively considers the problems of ecological protection and resource environment, and quantificationally determines the initial direction of ecological protection and restoration in each district.

title_en: Surface water and underground water combined regulation and control method for ecological stability
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological stability oriented surface water and underground water combined regulation and control method which comprises the steps of establishing a bottom layer model and a top layer model, and establishing a multi-target multi-water-source ecological stability oriented double-layer water resource optimization regulation and control model based on a large system decomposition coordination principle, a water balance principle and a supply and demand water prediction model, wherein the bottom layer model comprises a watershed midstream sub model and a watershed downstream sub model, targets tend to maximize economic and ecological benefits respectively, and a top layer model target tends to maximize the comprehensive benefits of a watershed. The model can coordinate contradictions between agricultural water and ecological water by optimizing and adjusting the planting structure, the industrial structure, the water distribution amount of each area and the underground water level, and further realize ecological stability and restoration of desert oasis.

title_en: Power distribution network power failure rush-repair system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power failure emergency repair system for a power distribution network, which relates to the field of power distribution networks and comprises a fault detection module, a fault positioning module, an emergency repair scheduling module, a user notification module, a data recording and analyzing module, a security and authority management module, an interface and integration module, a processing result notification management module and a system maintenance and upgrading module. The power failure rush-repair system for the power distribution network is implemented, so that the quick circulation and the processing efficiency of information are promoted, and meanwhile, the effectiveness of rush-repair work is improved through modern communication and scheduling means. By optimizing the whole rescue process, the stability and reliability of power supply are ensured, and the system is an important support for the management of a modern power system.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;KAIFENG XIANGFU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Steam invasion risk rapid assessment method based on interface process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vapor invasion risk rapid assessment method based on an interface process, which comprises the following steps of S1, finding out site pollution conditions and hydrogeological conditions, S2, constructing a site indoor vapor invasion risk conceptual model, S3, calculating attenuation coefficients of volatile transmission of pollutants in soil or underground water in a pollution area to a building room, S4, calculating cancerogenic health risks and non-cancerogenic health risks of vapor invasion exposure in different volatile organic pollutants, S5, taking 1X 10  ‑6  as an acceptable cancerogenic risk level to assess the cancerogenic health risk of target pollutants, taking 1 as an acceptable cancerogenic health risk level to assess the non-cancerogenic health risk of the target pollutants, S6, determining the target pollutants with the health risk exceeding the acceptable level through assessment, calculating a target pollutant restoration value under the acceptable cancerogenic risk level condition and a target pollutant restoration target value under the acceptable non-cancerogenic risk level condition, and taking the low value in the two as a final target pollutant restoration value.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE OF ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT PROT;AEROSPACE PLANNING & DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for tracing on-site power supervision service behavior based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power correlation, and provides a tracing method and a tracing system of field power supervision service behavior based on a block chain, which are used for solving the problem of difficult video tracing in the current power service, saving video data of a power monitoring area to the block chain, and extracting abnormal events from the collected video data of the power monitoring area, matching the extracted abnormal events with the complete video data stored in the power monitoring area of the blockchain, and calling the video data corresponding to the abnormal events on the blockchain according to a matching result. When the data is stored in the blockchain server and confirmed, the data cannot be tampered or deleted, so that the integrity and the safety of the data can be ensured, the data is prevented from being tampered or damaged maliciously, the tracing time can be increased, and the abnormal events in the video are extracted and the corresponding video data are called, so that more comprehensive and three-dimensional event restoration is provided.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY METERING CENTER

title_en: Intelligent diagnosis and autonomous management method and system for line loss of power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of line loss management, in particular to an intelligent diagnosis and autonomous management method and system for line loss of a power distribution network. The method comprises the steps of collecting various data, carrying out restoration and normalization processing, checking the space consistency of topology, standing accounts and files through a blockchain intelligent contract, calculating a load space-time matrix, constructing a line loss genetic map, identifying abnormal lines, generating and executing a treatment strategy, updating the genetic map according to the treatment effect, and carrying out closed loop iteration. The application solves the problems of difficult data processing, inconsistent topology and station account, and non-intelligent line loss diagnosis and treatment in the prior art, realizes the full-flow intellectualization and automation from data acquisition to treatment, and effectively improves the efficiency and accuracy of the line loss management of the power distribution network.
assignees: JIZE COUNTY POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;HANDAN HUILONG ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN RES CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Wireless type alarm
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To complete a wireless disaster prevention system by considering the case when an alarm such as a fire sensor is installed at a place where any wireless wave does not reach.  <P>SOLUTION: According to the combination of a wireless communication part 26, a wired input part 34 or a wired output part 38, a transmission selection part 54 selects only a wireless output, or a wired input and a wireless output, or only a wired output, or the wired input and a wired output. An internal event processing part 56 makes, when detecting abnormality by itself, the wireless communication part or the wired output part selected by the transmission selection 54 output an event signal showing abnormality to the outside. An external event processing part 58 makes, when accepting the event signal from the other wireless type alarm through the wired input part 34, the wireless communication part 26 or the wired output part 38 selected by the transmission selection part 54 output the event signal from the other wireless type alarm to the outside. Thus, it is possible to achieve remote restoration control or test control by a bi-directional transmission function.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Adaptive power grid restoration
abstract_en: A method of self-healing power grids after power outages includes providing an Adaptive Restoration Decision Support System (ARDSS) for generating a restoration solution using static and dynamic input data from power generator(s) powering transmission lines, from the transmission lines and loads. At a beginning of a restoration period a two-stage problem is solved including a first and second-stage problem with an optimal planning (OP) function as a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) problem using initial static and dynamic data to determine start-up times for the power generator and energization sequences for transmission lines involved in the power outage. Only the second-stage problem is again solved with an optimal real-time (OR) function using the start-up times and energization sequences along with updated static and dynamic data to determine operating parameters for the grid. The restoration solution is implemented over restoration time steps until all loads involved in the power outage are recovered.
assignees: UNIV CENTRAL FLORIDA RES FOUND INC

title_en: Accelerated recovery after a data disaster
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present invention, a metadata file is transferred from the first system to the second system and a database on the second system is initialized based on the metadata file. An image, including information of the first system to be restored, is transferred from the first system to the second system, and restoration of the information to the second system based on the image is initiated. Prior to completion of the restoration, one or more log files indicating actions performed on the first system relating to the information to be restored is transferred from the first system to the initialized database on the second system. In response to completion of the restoration, the actions of the log files are performed to synchronize the restored data on the second system with the first system.

title_en: System and method for power outage and restoration notification in an advanced metering infrastructure network
abstract_en: A method and system are provided to transmit a meter power status. The method includes recognizing a power status change at a meter. The method includes, if the meter is scheduled to transmit first, transmitting a notification message to at least one neighboring meter towards a mesh gate, wherein the notification message includes a power status indicator and a meter identifier. The method includes, if the meter is not scheduled to transmit first, waiting a predetermined time period to receive a notification message from at least one neighboring meter. The method includes, responsive to receiving a notification message, adding a meter identifier to the received notification message before retransmitting the modified notification message to at least one neighboring meter. The method includes retransmitting the notification message.

title_en: Active power distribution network fault recovery method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for recovering faults of an active power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, outputting distribution network disaster affected probability distribution data according to the current accumulated rainfall of a designated distribution area and weather forecast information of a preset period in the future by combining with historical flood disaster data of the distribution area; s2, processing the distribution network disaster influence probability distribution data, and outputting updated distribution network fault network topology after removing equipment or areas with disaster damage probability larger than a threshold value; s3, after the on-off state of the switch is determined through the updated fault network topology of the power distribution network, controlling the SOP and the MT to restore power to the load, so that the load restoration amount is maximum, and the voltage unbalance amount is minimum. And obtaining disaster probability distribution through weather prediction, removing equipment which is not in a recovery range, and realizing power supply recovery through controlling SOP and MT.

title_en: Storage aggregate restoration
abstract_en: One or more techniques and/or systems are provided for controlling restoration of a storage aggregate. For example, a local storage device, located at a first storage site, and a remote storage device, located at a second storage site, may be assigned to a first storage aggregate. Responsive to a disaster of the first storage site, a gate may be created for the local storage device. The gate may block automated reconstruction and/or automated synchronization that may otherwise occur with respect to the local storage device. Until the local storage device is restored, the remote storage device may be used to service I/O requests that were otherwise directed to the local storage device. Responsive to receiving a user restoration command, the gate may be removed from the local storage device. Synchronization between the local storage device and the remote storage device may then be facilitated.

title_en: Pressure reduction and energy saving method for communication power supplies
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pressure reduction and energy saving method for communication power supplies and aims at providing a method to reduce float charge supply voltage of the communication power supplies. The method is used to reduce power consumptions of communication equipment. The method includes the following steps that: a storage battery pack is divided into a main storage battery pack and an auxiliary storage battery pack, wherein the storage battery pack is formed by 24 storage batteries which are connected in series; a main charger and an auxiliary charger are correspondingly parallelly connected with the main storage battery pack and the auxiliary storage battery pack; a load and a directional diode are parallelly connected with two ends of the main storage battery pack to form a float charge power supply circuit, wherein the load is connected in series with the directional diode; a normally open contact of a relay is connected between a cathode and the load of the storage battery pack so as to form a discharge circuit; a controller is used to monitor conditions of power restoration and power outage, wherein the controller is connected in the float charge power supply circuit and the discharge circuit; the controller controls a motion of the relay according to the conditions of the power restoration and the power outage. By using the invention, a requirement of load working voltage can be satisfied, charging quality of the storage batteries can be guaranteed, the power consumptions of the load during float charge power supply can be reduced. The method of the invention is an ideal method which can be used to reduce the power consumptions of the communication equipment.

title_en: Extranet client management and control method for electric power working site management and control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an extranet client management and control method for an electric power working site management and control system. The method comprises the following steps: providing a page displaying a repair schedule of a team of all users in a work period, and performing dispatch commands; providing a repair schedule detailed information page, wherein the page displays all information of the repair schedule, and work tickets and site survey lists, which are related to the repair schedule; providing an operating page of a camera, and saving a user name of mobile equipment and a global position system (GPS) position where pictures are taken when the pictures are saved; and providing an input page and a signature for filling the work tickets. By the method, multifunctional and visual processing process can be provided for implementation, monitoring and maintenance of electric power overhaul operation so as to improve operation and maintenance, overhaul and first-aid repair management level of power enterprises, standardize work flow of daily operation and maintenance, overhaul and fault first-aid repair, improve fault first-aid repair efficiency, enhance field operation scheduling, improve the ruling capacity of the power enterprises to the modern power grid and ensure that the power grid works reliably, efficiently and economically.
assignees: Fuyang power supply bureau;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: The mixed function station design scheme of digital seismograph cross-station and power station
abstract_en: In using wire-link telemetry seismographic oil exploration production, frequent occurrence because cable fracture or individual site disasters, which cause communication disruption, to stop production the case where.Ground observation construction team is huge, and the reparation for falling into a long wait communication network will cause heavy economic losses.The present invention relates to the manufacturing technologies of wire-link telemetry digital seismograph, provide the mixed function station design scheme of a kind of digital seismograph cross-station and power station.The mixed function station that the present invention designs, which can be switched fast, executes cross-station function or power station function, and in field, prospecting network network occurs quickly establish redundant communication links when communication failure, can reconstructing system communication function without waiting for fault restoration.The seismic data being previously interrupted not only can be all recycled, and normal production process can be recovered immediately, realizes the field seismic prospecting production process without downtime.
assignees: NANJING XIANGTONGZHOU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dual-channel service recovery method based on link life cycle in elastic optical network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dual-channel service recovery method based on a link life cycle in an elastic optical network, belonging to the technical field of communication networks. Aiming at the damage and influence of large-scale natural disasters on the elastic optical network, the method fully utilizes the limited life cycle of a post-disaster link and adopts a dual-path strategy to carry out routing and bandwidth recovery on the interrupted service connection with limited service time. The invention determines the recovery priority according to the remaining service time of the affected service, evaluates the availability of the spectrum resource according to the maximum flow loss threshold in the remaining service time of the service, flexibly utilizes the limited life cycle of the link resource and the dual-channel strategy, and improves the spectrum resource utilization rate of the network, thereby maximizing the connectivity and bandwidth recovery rate of the service in the remaining service time.

title_en: Electric energy indication value fitting repair method for electric power spot transaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric energy indication value fitting repair method for electric power spot transaction, which comprises the following steps of: s1, determining a user category distinguishing basis by analyzing user composition participating in spot transaction, and acquiring electric energy indicating value curve data successfully acquired by various users; s2, conducting abnormity study and judgment on the user electric energy indicating curve, and emptying abnormal node indicating values in the electric energy indicating curve, namely rejecting abnormal points; s3, after the abnormal node indicating values are eliminated, according to actual requirements of a spot trading market, different fitting rules are designed for various users distinguished in the step S1, and missing data after the electric energy indicating value curves of various users are emptied are subjected to complete restoration according to the fitting rules; and S4, carrying out anomaly study and judgment verification on the data fitted in the step S3 again, and repeating the steps S2 and S3 until the abnormal points of the electric energy indicating value curve are completely repaired.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;GREAT POWER SCIENCE AND TECH STOCK CO LTD STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CORPORATION

title_en: Vegetation restoration scheme generation method for construction of ecological circle of power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention provides a vegetation recovery scheme generation method for constructing an ecological ring of a power transmission line, which comprises the following steps: soil sampling is carried out on a line area to obtain soil matrix information corresponding to each planting range in the line area, a three-dimensional environment model in the line area is built by combining with climate information of the line area, corresponding optional seeds are matched for the planting ranges, a plurality of planting schemes are generated, a planting conceptual diagram corresponding to each planting scheme is generated in the three-dimensional environment model in a simulation mode, vegetation survival rate corresponding to each planting scheme is analyzed, a vegetation recovery scheme of the line area is generated according to a target planting scheme with the highest vegetation survival rate and a planting mode corresponding to each optional seed, vegetation of a power transmission line construction area is effectively recovered through construction of an ecological circle, and proper plant seeds are selected to adapt to natural environment and climate conditions of a place.
assignees: BEIJING JIANGHE HUIYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital regulation task management flow and execution control method in nuclear power station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nuclear power digital regulations, and particularly relates to a task management flow and execution control method of a digital regulation in a nuclear power station. Establishing a standard flow of a digital procedure task according to a flow of daily work task development in a nuclear power station, wherein the standard flow comprises task approval, task creation, task issuing, task acquisition, pre-job meeting, task execution, post-job meeting, task auditing, task archiving, task suspension/restoration, task handover, task rollback, task revocation and an operation step inapplicability identification function; the method for remote execution control of the digital procedure in the off-line mode comprises the steps of randomly generating an authorization code when the task creation procedure is issued, downloading the authorization code to the mobile terminal along with the task, providing a remote off-line execution control application, acquiring and providing the authorization code, and matching and verifying the authorization code to realize off-line execution control. The invention solves the problem that the task management and execution of the digital regulation in the nuclear power station are not mature and uniform in standard form.
assignees: CNNC NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION MAN CO LTD;CNNC 3RD QINSHAN NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD

title_en: Landslide monitoring mechanism for ecological restoration of mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide monitoring mechanisms, and discloses a landslide monitoring mechanism for ecological restoration of mines, which comprises a supporting plate, wherein a supporting rod is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the supporting plate, a holding triggering mechanism for receiving water when the supporting plate is rained is arranged on the supporting plate, a pressure sensor is arranged on the supporting plate and is used for supporting and sensing the holding triggering mechanism, and a limiting mechanism for downwards moving and preventing the holding triggering mechanism from moving backwards is arranged on the supporting plate. The landslide monitoring mechanism for mine ecological restoration has the advantages that the trigger mechanism is contained to contain rainwater, the pre-warning effect is achieved, and the vibration is sensed by matching with the use of the liquid level sensor, so that the vibration detection effect is achieved.
assignees: UNIV SHAANXI TECHNOLOGY;SHAANXI MOSICHI NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water quality improvement method for water supply reservoir
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water quality improvement method of a water supply reservoir, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration and comprises the steps of firstly preprocessing reservoir image and silt data, evaluating the turbidity of a water body, if the water body is turbid, adding a curing agent into an unmanned aerial vehicle, repeatedly monitoring until the water body is clear, analyzing the water body components after the water body is clear, evaluating the eutrophication degree, and if the water body is eutrophicated, adding aquatic plant seeds until the water quality is normal, otherwise, continuously monitoring. According to the invention, the curing agent is put into the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the curing of reservoir silt is facilitated, the water body is prevented from being smelly caused by loosening of the silt, and the aquatic plant seeds are put into the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the water quality is improved, and the water body is prevented from being eutrophicated.
assignees: NANJING WEIMI ELECTRONIC INDUSTRY INST CO LTD;NANJING FAERYIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unit combination feasible solution calculation method based on system constraint restoration contribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a unit combination feasible solution calculation method based on system constraint restoration contribution, which specifically comprises the steps of solving a unit combination system constraint relaxation model of starting and stopping of a fixed part, calculating a system constraint restoration starting and stopping variable contribution index and updating a starting and stopping variable fixed range; according to the method, the constraint out-of-limit degree of the system is identified by solving the constraint relaxation model of the unit combination system, the contribution degree of the unit start-stop variation to the constraint out-of-limit restoration of the system is estimated by adopting the start-stop variable contribution index, so that the selection of start-stop variables to be optimized in the next iteration is guided, the efficient feasibility restoration of the system constraint infeasible start-stop solution can be realized, the unit combination high-quality feasible solution can be quickly obtained, and the optimal operation of the electric power system is strongly supported.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Marine wind power plant collaborative operation and maintenance method based on atmospheric marine environment dynamic simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a marine wind farm collaborative operation and maintenance method based on dynamic simulation of an atmospheric marine environment, which is applicable to the field of new energy. The method comprises the steps of S1, carrying out clock synchronization, coordinate conversion, anomaly rejection, missing value restoration and dimension standardization on collected multi-source heterogeneous data to generate a standardized data set in a unified format, S2, constructing an atmospheric ocean environment field dynamic model and an equipment state evolution model, carrying out coupling training on the two models through a multi-scale space-time fusion algorithm to generate an environment change trend prediction result and an equipment running state prediction result, dynamically correcting model parameters according to prediction errors, S3, carrying out quantization grading on equipment fault early warning and environment risks, carrying out matching scheduling on the combination of real-time operation and maintenance resource states, generating a collaborative operation and maintenance plan through a space-time optimization algorithm, executing the collaborative operation and maintenance plan and feeding back an execution state in real time, and realizing iterative optimization of the operation and maintenance plan.

title_en: Disaster response assistance method and disaster response assistance system
abstract_en: To respond to situation changes in a place of disaster and efficiently provide information for restoring regional roads and planning commodity transportation.SOLUTION: In a disaster response assistance system, a central control device executes the processes of: storing information pertaining to commodity supply and demand bases, importance information of commodities and regional road network information including the supply and demand bases, and estimating a commodity delivery route between the supply and demand bases on the basis of the position of each base and the road network information; specifying the commodity delivery quantity delivered between the bases at a prescribed point of time, on the basis of the transition of commodity supply or demand state along the passage of time since a disaster time at each base; acquiring the damaged point information of the road network from the device that manages disaster information; narrowing down a road among the roads on the delivery route where the disaster has occurred; determining the priority of restoration on the basis of the length of the target road based on the road network information and the commodity delivery quantity and importance information of commodities having been specified regarding the target road; and outputting recommended information for the commodity delivery route in a manner conforming to the priority of restoration.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Fish ladder block structure with an arc-shaped hole on the inside
title_ko: 내측이 원호 형상의 잠공을 갖춘 잠월류 어도블록 구조체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a submersible fishway block structure having an arc-shaped submersible hole on the inside and a construction method thereof. The submersible hole of a conventional submersible fishway having an excellent passage rate of floating fish is improved to the submersible hole having an arc-shaped inner side to shorten a maximum flow rate section, and an inlet and an outlet are widened to be gradually narrowed. Therefore, the submersible fishway block structure has a structure in which a cross section is gradually narrowed and a flow rate is increased when fish sensing a flow of water discharged from the submersible hole changes a direction to enter the submersible fishway block structure. Therefore, the submersible fishway block structure has a short maximum flow rate section to allow benthic fish to move at an instant rush speed. The submersible fishway block structure has a high passage rate of all fish species from the submersible fishway to the floating fishway to the benthic fishway to contribute to restoration of a healthy river ecosystem. Moreover, the submersible fishway block structure is improved to complete a structure in which a bottom of the submersible fishway block is structurally connected between upper and lower fishway blocks on a site without a connection ring between blocks to resist a flowing water force in case of a flood. Therefore, the submersible fishway block structure has excellent structural safety and safety during construction to reduce construction convenience and costs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 본 발명은 내측이 원호형상의 잠공을 갖춘 잠월류 어도블록 구조체 및 그 시공방법에 관한 것으로, 부유성 어류의 통과율이 우수한 종래의 잠월류 어도의 잠공을 내측이 원호 형상으로 갖춘 잠공으로 개선하여 유속 최대 구간을 짧게하고, 입·출구는 넓게 하여 점차 좁아지는 구조로 갖춤으로써 잠공에서 배출되는 물 흐름을 감지한 어류가 방향을 바꾸어 진입하면 단면이 점차 좁아지며 유속이 빨라지는 구조로서 최대 유속 구간이 짧아 저서성 어류가 순간의 돌진속도로 이동이 가능하고, 잠월류 어도에서 부유성 어류 및 저서성 어류까지 모든 어종들의 통과율이 높아 건강한 하천생태계 복원에 기여함과 아울러 잠월류 어도블록을 구조체로 개선하여 홍수시 유수력에 저항하기 위한 블록간 연결 고리 없이 잠월류 어도블록 바닥을 현장에서 상·하류 어도블록 간 구조적으로 연결되는 구조체로 완성함으로써 구조적 안전성과 시공 중 안전을 확보하여 시공의 편의성과 비용을 절감하는 경제적이고 효율성이 우수하다.

title_en: Automatic fault site thematic map generation method based on target guidance
abstract_en: The invention provides a target-oriented-based automatic fault site thematic map generation method, which belongs to the technical field of dispatching automation and power distribution automation systems. By means of the implementation of processes such as topology model extraction, equipment modeling, automatic layout, visual display and the like, after a fault occurs, a relevant plant station thematic map and a distribution network single line map are automatically generated according to a station-line-to-substation-to-user relation, seamless transition from a power grid model to the map is completed, the purposes of assisting a power grid dispatcher in locating the fault and mastering affected areas and users are achieved, and rapid power restoration can be effectively and pertinently carried out.

title_en: Fire night scene restoration method based on Mask R-CNN neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for restoring a fire night scene in a Mask R-CNN model, which comprises the steps of carrying out example segmentation on flame by training a Mask-RCNN model, segmenting a region at the initial stage of the flame at a fire position at night, fusing the segmented region to a monitoring video at daytime, positioning the specific fire position, and superposing the segmented flame region to the monitoring video image at daytime by using an image mixing superposition algorithm in the subsequent operation of the example segmentation, thereby realizing the restoration of the fire scene and assisting in positioning the fire position and laying a solid foundation for the identification of a fire cause.

title_en: Mobile energy storage vehicle emergency dispatching and evaluating method for power restoration after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile energy storage vehicle emergency dispatching and evaluating method for power restoration after disaster. The invention adopts the technical scheme that: constructing a road network model based on graph theory, and solving an emergency shortest path of the post-disaster mobile energy storage vehicle by adopting a path searching algorithm; establishing a mobile energy storage vehicle multipoint optimization scheduling model considering fuzzy opportunity constraint, and determining a mobile energy storage vehicle emergency scheduling strategy; based on an emergency scheduling strategy of the mobile energy storage vehicles, establishing a parallel coordination optimization model of a plurality of mobile energy storage vehicles, calling a gurobi solver, and determining output power distribution conditions of the plurality of mobile energy storage vehicles at disaster nodes; and establishing a comprehensive load recovery capacity assessment model. Aiming at the extreme disaster scene of the power distribution network, the invention provides a reasonable emergency dispatching strategy and energy coordination optimization method for the mobile energy storage vehicle, which can effectively improve the load power supply recovery capability of the power distribution network in an emergency state and optimize the elastic power supply of the power distribution network.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power supply fault release updating method, device, equipment and medium for power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for issuing and updating power supply faults of a power grid. The method is characterized by comprising the following steps: acquiring a power supply fault event of a target power grid, and acquiring power supply fault information corresponding to the power supply fault event through at least one power supply service system; generating at least one power supply fault form corresponding to the power supply fault event based on the power supply fault information, and publishing the power supply fault form to at least one power supply worker through a preset message middleware; generating a power restoration notification message corresponding to a power failure event according to a preset power restoration notification service on the basis of detecting that a target power grid is in a power restoration state; and sending the duplicate notification message to a power supply worker through a message middleware. The micro-service can carry out information sharing and data generation on the power supply faults, and automatically issue the power supply faults and automatically update the fault states, so that the reaction speed of the power grid system to the power supply faults is improved, and the work efficiency of re-electricity is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;SHANTOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Regulation and control operation command training method, system, medium and processor based on real scheduling service scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regulation and control operation command training method, a system, a medium and a processor based on a real dispatching service scene, which relate to the technical field of power dispatching training, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical dispatching service data corresponding to different dispatching service types; processing and analyzing the historical dispatching service data, screening out typical service scene cases of different dispatching service types, generating simulation training contents of typical service scenes according to the typical service scene cases, acquiring simulation training results of a dispatcher in the simulation training contents, and deriving a digital representation of the training results of the dispatcher by analyzing the simulation training results of the dispatcher. According to the invention, the classical service scene cases are screened out from the historical scheduling service data for reverse restoration, so that a dispatcher can train under the condition of truly scheduling service scenes, and the training effect and training quality are effectively improved.

title_en: Forest and grass fire hazard locus restoration prediction method based on historical bit slice information
abstract_en: A forest fire site restoration prediction method based on historical bit information is characterized by comprising the steps of 1, constructing a forest fire site restoration prediction system, 2, obtaining satellite remote sensing images of a target forest region by an image obtaining module, 3, performing image correction operation on the satellite remote sensing images by an image correction module to obtain standard images, 4, calculating EVI, T and MVHI of the standard images by a multi-mode remote sensing data fusion calculation module, performing normalization processing and data enhancement on the EVI, T and MVHI by a preprocessing module, 6, predicting a first restoration time by a machine learning model in a dynamic time analysis module through a machine learning algorithm, predicting a second restoration time by an ARIMA time sequence model in the dynamic time analysis module according to MVHI, and 7, performing weighted average fusion on the first restoration time and the second restoration time by the dynamic time analysis module to output a final restoration time. The method has the effect of accurately evaluating and predicting the recovery time of the forest grass vegetation after the fire disaster.

title_en: Mud-rock flow slope solid source greening system and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow slope solid source greening system which comprises an ecological blanket, an automatic water collecting device, a solar panel, a water collecting tank and an intelligent control system, wherein the ecological blanket is formed by compounding a flexible substrate layer and a vegetation recovery layer, the ecological blanket is paved and unfolded along a slope, the automatic water collecting device is arranged at the intersection point of the ecological blanket and the intersection point with the interval of 1.5m, the automatic water collecting device comprises a diversion water collecting tank at the upper part, the solar panel, the water collecting tank at the lower part and the intelligent control system, the solar panel is erected above the water collecting tank, the diversion water collecting tank is suspended between the solar panel and the water collecting tank, and the diversion water collecting tank is communicated with the water collecting tank through a pipeline. According to the invention, through the cooperation of the anti-scouring ecological blanket structure and intelligent water collection-irrigation, the problem that vegetation is easy to scour and irrigation depends on manpower in the traditional technology is solved, and the slope solid source and ecological restoration efficiency are remarkably improved.

title_en: Urban medical system double-stage anti-seismic toughness assessment method
abstract_en: A method for evaluating the anti-seismic toughness of an urban medical system in two stages relates to the technical field of civil engineering. The invention aims to solve the problem that the existing medical system evaluation method neglects the dynamic interaction between the regional medical network and the traffic system. The method comprises the steps of establishing a network topology model of a medical system, analyzing medical system states under different earthquake scenes by using the network topology model of the medical system, respectively carrying out functional analysis on the medical system in an emergency period after earthquake and a recovery period by using the medical system states, carrying out earthquake resistance evaluation based on functional loss by using functional indexes in the emergency period after earthquake and the recovery period after earthquake, formulating a restoration strategy according to the medical system states, constructing a functional recovery curve of the medical system, carrying out earthquake resistance evaluation based on the curve, and comprehensively realizing double-stage earthquake resistance evaluation of the urban medical system by using an earthquake resistance evaluation result based on the functional loss and an earthquake resistance evaluation result based on restoration time.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting fire-extinguishing system for building
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire extinguishment, in particular to an intelligent fire extinguishment system for a building. The intelligent decision and fire extinguishing termination judging system comprises a multi-source information acquisition module, a characteristic fusion and situation generation module, an intelligent decision and fire extinguishing termination judging module and an execution and feedback control module. The system firstly collects surface temperature sequence, characteristic gas concentration and electric signal parameters respectively, a multi-source monitoring data set is generated, characteristic parameters are extracted based on the data set, a battery stability situation index is generated, multi-stage decision is carried out according to the index, water spray cooling is maintained when the index is lower than a safety threshold, a stable observation period is started and converted into a heuristic spray mode when the index exceeds the threshold, and a fire extinguishing termination instruction or a water spray restoration instruction is generated through trend stability analysis in the observation period. The invention solves the technical problem of serious water stain loss caused by continuous water spraying when the traditional fire protection system is used for dealing with lithium battery fire, and realizes accurate fire extinguishing control on the premise of ensuring no re-combustion.

title_en: Task restoration support system, restoration situation management device, and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To efficiently restore a task which has been interrupted or deteriorated in an execution level regardless of the type or scale of a disaster or the content of a damage which occurs due to the disaster or the like.SOLUTION: Terminal equipment for site includes: status information input means for inputting status information specifying the operation state of a resource indispensable for executing a task; and measure information presenting means for presenting the restoration measures of each resource on the basis of status information input by the status information input means and status information received from a management server. The management server manages the status information of the resource received from the terminal equipment for site, and specifies and manages the operation state of a task to which the resource is belonging on the basis of the status information of each resource. Also, the management server calculates the restoration time of the task, and obtains the degree of progress of the execution situation of the restoration measures with respect to a restoration scheduled time. Furthermore, the management server predicts a time when the operation of the task to which the resource is belonging is resumed.

title_en: Method for operating a gas turbine power plant and gas turbine power plants, in particular a method for supporting a black grid restoration by using a gas turbine with sequential combustors
Power outage protection and restoration using low power states in data storage devices/systems
abstract_en: Systems and methods for early warning of power loss in solid state storage drives are disclosed. An early power loss warning may be used to activate the drive into a low power state before using the energy in the backup power source (e.g., backup capacitor). This low power state may allow for a reduction in power used by the drive, which may provide cost savings and reduce the risk of: the drive will be rendered as reconfigurable by a power outage event.

title_en: Intelligent wind power data restoration method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses an intelligent wind power data restoration method and device. According to the method, missing wind power data can be estimated from three dimensions of characteristic parameters, time sequences and spatial distribution, and a model with the highest correlation in a certain dimension is selected from a model pool to finally repair the wind power data. The device is realized based on the method. According to the embodiment of the specification, the wind power missing data can be completely and accurately repaired from multiple dimensions based on objective complex conditions of the wind power missing data.

title_en: Ultrasonic metering instrument data management method, device and equipment based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses ultrasonic metering device data management method, device and equipment based on the Internet of things, relate to the technical field of data management, through increasing outage and keep the module, under the circumstances that power module cuts off the power supply, can immediately switch to outage and keep the module according to outage signal fast and supply power, ultrasonic metering device object platform independent work, do not interact with other platforms in the Internet of things system, the operation data during outage is gathered in ultrasonic metering device object platform inside, the quantity of ultrasonic metering devices that is inserted at present is confirmed immediately in response to the power restoration signal, the ultrasonic metering devices that make it switch to the power module when supplying power are fewer under the circumstances that its is less than threshold value quantity, each platform is interconnected again, upload outage operation data to gas management platform by ultrasonic metering device object platform, even if there is outage condition, the Internet of things system also can all acquire complete information in order to realize gas data's management.

title_en: Method and apparatus for communicating power distribution event and location
abstract_en: A system, device, and method of providing information for a power distribution system is provided. In one embodiment, a method of using a device that receives power from the low voltage power of the power distribution system and experiences a power loss during a local power outage may perform the processes of monitoring a voltage of the low voltage power line, detecting a voltage reduction below a threshold voltage for a predetermined time period, storing information of the voltage reduction in a non-volatile memory prior to the power outage, and transmitting a notification to a remote computer system prior to the outage. The monitoring may comprise making a plurality of measurements of the voltage during a time interval and averaging the plurality of voltage measurements. In addition, the method may include transmitting an alert message upon power up after the outage to indicate a power restoration local to the device.
assignees: YANEY DAVID S;KEHN ROBERT D;CURRENT TECH LLC

title_en: Seismic strengthening device of shape memory alloy pipe network
abstract_en: The utility model provides a seismic strengthening device of a shape memory alloy pipe network, which can reduce tensile stress and bending stress of a pipeline under an earthquake, dissipate input energy during the earthquake, reduce earthquake response of the pipe network, and protect the pipe network from being damaged under earthquake action. The seismic strengthening device comprises a pipeline, flanges of fixed connecting parts, a pipeline flange, a pipeline connecting bolt, a shape memory alloy rod and a connecting bolt for the shape memory alloy rod, wherein the pipeline is connected with the pipeline flange, the pipeline flange is connected with the pipeline connecting bolt, the flanges of the fixed connecting parts are positioned on two sides of the pipeline flange, the flanges of the fixed connecting parts are connected with the shape memory alloy rod, and the shape memory alloy rod is connected with the connecting bolt for the shape memory alloy rod. The seismic strengthening device can dissipate the input energy during the earthquake, reduce the earthquake response of the pipeline and protect the pipeline from being damaged under the earthquake action. After the earthquake ends up, as shape memory alloy has the self-restoration capability, the deformation of the pipeline can be restored automatically without any maintenance and replacement.

title_en: Jellyfish acetabulum culture device and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a jellyfish acetabulum culture device and a use method thereof. The jellyfish acetabulum culture device structurally comprises a culture bottle and an electric bottle rolling machine. The culture bottle comprises a cylindrical bottle body with openings in two ends, and side covers capable of being detachably connected with the two ends of the bottle body. A hole is formed in the middle of each side cover. Hemispherical pits are evenly formed in the bottle body. In the specific experiment process, acetabulum can float along with the low-speed effective water flow in the culture bottle, and the cylindrical bottle body is free of dead corners and inflation pipes, so individual damage is effectively avoided; meanwhile, a water body does not produce bubbles, so it can be effectively avoided that when bubbles enter a gastral cavity, acetabulum floats up, and the death rate is decreased. The survival rate of jellyfish acetabulum is practically increased, and the accuracy of indoor research experiments is ensured. The deep research on disaster jellyfish and economic jellyfish is facilitated, and the jellyfish acetabulum culture device is widely applied in related research fields such as fishery resource utilization and ecological restoration.
assignees: LIAONING OCEAN AND FISHERIES SCIENCE RES INST

title_en: Ecological self-repairing system and construction method for artificial tidal flat
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial tidal flat ecological self-repairing system, which belongs to the technical field of coastal wetland ecological repairing and comprises a highland, a transverse artificial tidal flat, a longitudinal artificial tidal flat, a layered coastal wetland system and an open sea; the transverse artificial tidal channels and the longitudinal artificial tidal channels are arranged between the beaches in a staggered mode to form a net structure, so that tidal water from open sea can freely flow in the middle; the layered coastal wetland system is a transition zone between a beach and a transverse artificial tidal channel and between the beach and a longitudinal artificial tidal channel; the transverse artificial tidal channel and the longitudinal artificial tidal channel are used for introducing tidal water, so that the ecological and biological diversity of the system is restored; when the wave and tide action is strong, a protection project is built in open sea. The invention also discloses a construction method thereof, which effectively regulates the action of waves and tides so as to reduce natural disasters; the coastal wetland can effectively degrade pollution and restore the original ecological system and natural balance mechanism; through ecological restoration, the diversity of species is increased.

title_en: Prevention and treatment method for algal bloom disasters of eutrophic water body
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water body ecological restoration, and particularly relates to a method for preventing and treating algal bloom disasters of an eutrophic water body, which comprises the following steps: (1) seed selection: determining harmless or low harmful algal species having a competitive relationship with the main algal bloom species; (2) propagation: culturing the harmless or low-harm algae; (3) inhibition: by paving the semi-open type photobioreactor clusters in a specific interval of a target water body, harmless or low-harm algal species can more easily obtain survival factors in the target water body, and the competitive advantage and the inhibiting effect on harmful algal blooms in the target water body are formed; (4) and (3) recovering: through continuous recovery of algae liquid in the semi-open type photobioreactor cluster, high-efficiency removal of nitrogen, phosphorus and other rich nutrient elements in target water is achieved. According to the invention, the artificial culture algae is used for replacing ecological niches of harmful algal blooms, so that the algal blooms are inhibited, and the water quality is improved; the method has the advantages of reducing high investment, high energy consumption and ecological risks in the algal bloom treatment process.

title_en: Full-service ubiquitous power Internet of things danger coefficient induction and fault repair system
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-service ubiquitous power Internet of things danger coefficient induction and fault restoration system which comprises a data acquisition module, a data storage module, a data receiving module, an edge calculation module, a data analysis module, a maintenance module, an intelligent meter box module, a control center and the like. The method has the advantages that the effects of comprehensive access, edge intelligence, multidimensional perception and safety protection can be achieved, various faults which are about to occur in the power system can be effectively and accurately predicted, dangerous situations of the power system can be timely resisted, the fault rate of the power system is effectively reduced, and the faults can be timely and effectively repaired to enable the power system to recover to a normal state.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER BRANCH COMPANY OF SHENGLI PETROLEUM ADMINISTRATION CO LTD OF CHINA PETROCHEMICAL GROU;UNIV QINGHUA

title_en: Short-term load prediction and restoration method based on historical load data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term load forecasting and repairing method based on historical load data, which comprises the following steps: carrying out data preprocessing on the historical load data set to obtain a preprocessed historical load data set; performing feature extraction processing on the preprocessed historical load data set through a depth self-encoder to obtain a reconstructed data set; carrying out load prediction on the reconstructed data set through a Stacking integration model to obtain a predicted value; and repairing the historical load data set according to the prediction value to obtain a repaired historical load data set. By using the method and the device, the detection precision of the abnormal load data can be improved by accurately extracting the potential characteristics of the historical load data. The short-term load forecasting and repairing method based on historical load data can be widely applied to the technical field of power load data mining.

title_en: Method and device for determining distributed power supply restoration mode of power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for determining a distributed power supply restoration mode of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of sub-areas of a pre-divided active power distribution system; and according to the switching action paths and the target power supply restoration model, carrying out power supply restoration mode solving processing on the sub-areas to obtain a target restoration mode. The Monte Carlo tree search of the application effectively solves the problem of the sequence of switching actions in the power supply recovery process by continuously exploring and evaluating different topological states, and avoids the computational bottleneck faced by the traditional method when dealing with large-scale non-convex problems. And solving the power supply recovery mode by using the target power supply recovery model, wherein the obtained target recovery mode has good optimization performance.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;UNIV TIANJIN;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Novel ecological restoration structure for high-steep side slope and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel high-steep slope ecological restoration structure and a construction method thereof, wherein the novel high-steep slope ecological restoration structure comprises a slope stabilizing base unit, a soil nail anchoring assembly and a dynamic permeable guard plate, the surface of the slope stabilizing base unit is covered with an ecological base material layer, the slope stabilizing base unit comprises a plurality of anti-slip stabilizing slope modules distributed along a slope surface array, each anti-slip stabilizing slope module comprises a rigid supporting body, a mortise part is formed on the outer surface of one side of each rigid supporting body, a continuous anti-slip action surface is formed on the inner surface of the other opposite side of each rigid supporting body, the adjacent rigid supporting body is connected with the mortise part through the tenon part in an embedded mode, the soil nail anchoring assembly is connected with the rigid supporting body through a telescopic permeable connecting piece, and the telescopic permeable connecting piece comprises an elastic energy storage supporting assembly and a water absorption expansion body. According to the invention, by constructing the slope stabilizing matrix unit, the ecological restoration effect of the slope is greatly improved, and the occurrence risk of geological disasters such as landslide is reduced.

title_en: Power distribution network dynamic scheduling method considering restoring force lifting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic scheduling method of a power distribution network considering restoration force improvement, which relates to the field of electric power sources and comprises the steps of firstly considering the influence of extreme events on a traffic network, establishing a mobile energy storage space-time dynamic scheduling model under a fault state, secondly considering the dynamic scheduling potential of a data center in the communication network under the extreme events, establishing a data center data load space-time flexibility transfer model, further establishing a dynamic optimization model of the power distribution network based on the model by taking the minimum load shedding cost of the power distribution network, the mobile energy storage scheduling cost, the running cost of the data center and the distributed photovoltaic light rejection cost as objective functions, improving the restoration force of the power distribution network after disaster through the dynamic scheduling of the mobile energy storage and the data load, and finally verifying the rationality and the economical efficiency of the dynamic optimization model of the power distribution network by an example system. The invention can improve the elastic response capability and the quick recovery capability of the power distribution network to extreme events.

title_en: Disaster relief robot control system and method
title_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster rescue robot control system and a method thereof. The disaster rescue robot control system comprises: a slave arm of multiple degrees of freedom which is installed on a disaster rescue robot, and performs restoration and rescue operations in a disaster environment; a master arm to receive an operation command of a worker; a control unit linked to an operation of the master arm to control an operation of the slave arm; and an operation limiting unit to limit an operation of the master arm based on an operating area of the slave arm to allow an instruction of the master arm to be generated in the operating area of the slave arm. The slave is operated based on an operation applied to the master arm to perform restoration and rescue operations in a disaster environment. Even if the operating area of the slave arm and an instruction area of the master arm do not match each other, an instruction of the master arm can be limited to be prevented from being generated outside the operating area of the slave arm.
abstract_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 재난 구조 로봇에 설치되고, 재난 환경에서 복구 및 구조 동작을 수행하는 다자유도의 슬레이브암, 작업자의 조작명령을 입력받는 마스터암, 상기 마스터암의 동작에 연동해서 상기 슬레이브암의 동작을 제어하는 제어부 및 상기 마스터암의 지령이 상기 슬레이브암의 동작영역 내부에서 발생하도록, 상기 슬레이브암의 동작영역을 기준으로 상기 마스터암의 동작을 제한하는 동작 제한부를 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 마스터암에 가해지는 조작에 기초해서 슬레이브암을 동작시켜 재난 환경에서 복구 및 구조 동작을 수행하고, 슬레이브암의 동작영역과 마스터암의 지령영역이 서로 불일치하더라도 마스터암의 지령이 슬레이브암의 동작영역 외부에 생성되지 않도록 제한할 수 있다.

title_en: Disaster Information Management Apparatus, Disaster Information System, Disaster Information Management Method, Disaster Information Management Program, Portable Terminal, Control Method of Portable Terminal, and Control Program of Controlling Operation of Portable Terminal
abstract_en: To attempt to extend a providing service by allowing collection of various kinds of information and early restoration of a defective function in a disaster response infrastructure network, in a disaster information system, a disaster information management apparatus for collecting disaster information via a network includes a terminal information acquirer that acquires terminal information including the current position and identification information of a portable terminal, a need information generator that generates, from received disaster information, need information including information about a need which can be satisfied by the operation of an apparatus, and a request information generator that generates, based on the terminal information and the need information, request information for requesting the portable terminal existing within a range of a predetermined distance from the occurrence location of the need to operate the apparatus necessary for satisfying the need, and transmits the request information.

title_en: Improved ship track prediction method and device based on cyclic neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved ship track prediction method and device based on a cyclic neural network. Offshore vessels are dense, the traffic environment is complex, and the automatic ship identification system (AIS) data has the following characteristics: (1) there are a large number of anchor tracks in the sea; (2) an abnormal acute angle bend exists in a part of the non-anchored track; (3) the behavior of the ship in different voyages is greatly different. These features can reduce the accuracy of trajectory prediction, and the invention proposes an improved ship trajectory prediction model based on a recurrent neural network: (1) providing an anchor track elimination algorithm to eliminate anchor tracks; (2) Providing a probability-based trajectory restoration algorithm to restore the acute angle bend; (3) Designing a two-stage ship track flow clustering algorithm to distinguish ship behaviors; and (4) constructing a deep bidirectional gate cycle unit (GRU) model. The improved ship track prediction model provided by the invention has higher prediction precision and has a certain reference value in the ship track prediction of an offshore area.

title_en: Optimized regulation and control method for land utilization of multiple-outlet watershed
abstract_en: The application provides an optimized regulation and control method for land utilization of multiple-outlet watershed, which comprises the steps of constructing a space-based watershed attribute regression model, quantitatively analyzing the influence of each land utilization type in a study area on water ecological load, obtaining corresponding regulation and control potential according to the step one, optimizing the space-based watershed attribute regression model, evaluating land utilization regulation and control potential and ecological restoration regulation and control potential of the corresponding watershed by using the optimized space-based watershed attribute regression model, setting land utilization regulation and control scenes and ecological restoration regulation scenes, simulating the environmental effect related to the land utilization regulation scenes and the ecological restoration regulation scenes by using the optimized space-based watershed attribute regression model, and making an optimized restoration measure scheme.

title_en: Shock Absorber for Underground Distribution Cable
title_ko: 건축용 지중배전 케이블 완충장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underground power distribution cable buffer device for construction which can immediately restore a binding band to a state in which the binding band is tight by an elastic restoration force of a tensile spring when the binding band installed in a power cable is loosened in case of an earthquake. The underground power distribution cable buffer device comprises: a band hook groove (44) formed by cutting a convex surface, formed on a lower surface of a band tensile plate (42), in an eleventh shape along a longitudinal direction and deforming a cut portion to a more gentle curved shape than the band tensile plate (42) and configured to prevent separation of the binding band; and chamfered portions (62, 72) individually formed on facing surfaces of a pin head (61) and a flange (71).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지진시 전력케이블에 설치된 결속밴드가 이완되는 경우 인장스프링의 탄성복원력에 의해 결속밴드가 팽팽한 상태로 즉시 복원될 수 있도록 한 건축용 지중배전 케이블 완충장치에 관한 것으로, 밴드인장판(42)의 저면에 형성된 볼록한 면을 길이방향을 따라 십일자 모양으로 절개한 다음 절개부를 밴드인장판(42)보다 완만한 곡면으로 변형시켜서 형성되고, 결속밴드(20)의 이탈을 방지하는 밴드걸림홈(44); 핀헤드(61)와 플랜지(71)의 마주보는 면에 각각 형성되는 면취부(62)(72)를 포함한다.

title_en: Emergent evacuation and escape central control unit system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergent evacuation and escape central control unit system. A central control unit serves as a network manager and sends network management messages. All emergency lighting units response sequentially and report respective work states. The central control unit is also compatible with a control room emergency lighting charger for charging a storage battery in a phased manner with full-course restoration, thereby preventing the storage battery from being vulcanized and aged due to being laid up for a long term and prolonging the service life of the storage battery. The charger is provided with a CAN communication interface and maintains the communication with other emergent evacuation and escape chargers. Fault content of the whole system is collected through a CAN bus and the specific positions and fault content are displayed, thereby warning people to remove faults in time, guaranteeing that the system can work normally during disasters, and reducing unnecessary personnel casualties.

title_en: A kind of the black starting-up path automatic optimizing method and system of wind-light storage isolated network
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of black starting-up path automatic optimizing method of wind-light storage isolated network and systems, this method comprises: the average active power output data according to generation of electricity by new energy each in Isolated Network System station determine that head opens generation of electricity by new energy station；Start the head and opens generation of electricity by new energy station；The self-starting path of each generation of electricity by new energy station is determined using ant group algorithm according to the starting path optimization model of the more generation of electricity by new energy stations pre-established；During isolated network black starting-up, based on the low capacity Power Support self-starting wind farm group and photovoltaic power station group in wind power plant and photovoltaic plant, technical solution of the present invention is started multiple wind farm groups and photovoltaic power station group by restoration path optimizing in partial electric grid and provides power support for entire black starting-up process, black starting-up efficiency can effectively be accelerated, and then reduce failure loss.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Power grid power failure monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for monitoring power failure of a power grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting whether a newly-added power failure event exists, and if so, acquiring power failure data corresponding to the newly-added power failure event; judging whether the newly-added power failure event is a power determining event or not according to a preset power failure correction model and power failure data, if not, analyzing the power failure data according to a preset power failure analysis model to obtain a power determining matching degree corresponding to the newly-added power failure event, wherein the power determining matching degree is used for determining a power restoration scheme for processing the newly-added power failure event; and determining a power restoration parameter corresponding to the newly increased power failure event according to the determined power restoration matching degree and the determined power restoration monitoring model, and generating a corresponding target power restoration scheme according to the power restoration parameter, so that power restoration personnel can process the newly increased power failure event according to the target power restoration scheme. Therefore, the method and the device can automatically verify the accuracy of the newly increased power failure events to screen out repeated and wrong power failure events, and improve the generation efficiency of the subsequent power restoration scheme and the reliability of the generated power restoration scheme.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for calculating workload of dispatcher
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for calculating workload of a dispatcher. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of maintenance lists corresponding to the current value dispatcher and the execution condition of each maintenance list; acquiring the power failure workload, the power restoration workload and the equipment starting workload corresponding to the current value dispatcher according to the execution condition of each maintenance order; and acquiring the work load amount corresponding to the current value dispatcher according to the power failure work load amount, the power restoration work load amount and the equipment starting work load amount corresponding to the current value dispatcher. According to the technical scheme of the embodiment, the power failure workload, the power restoration workload and the equipment starting workload are calculated according to the maintenance order execution condition of the current value dispatcher, and then the total workload is calculated, so that the real-time calculation of the workload of the local dispatching dispatcher can be realized, the accurate evaluation of the workload state can be realized, and the rationality of dispatching work arrangement can be improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of panoramic display electronic sand table in power failure and power restoration state
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction method of an electronic sand table for panoramic display in a power failure and restoration state, which comprises the following steps: step S1: data preparation: developing a cell boundary drawing tool; step S2: judging power failure: judging whether the power outage and restoration rule of the cell belongs to power outage, restoration and rush repair or normal; step S3: data presentation: through stopping and re-electrifying data, converting the numbers into visual pages; step S4: and (3) adaptive optimization: self-adapting to various resolution displays; the application of Redis and PG database technology enables data to change dynamically; the invention has the advantages of reasonable structure, visual graphical display and improvement of the modern emergency command capability.
assignees: State Grid Henan Electric Power Company Marketing Service Center

title_en: Photovoltaic desertification control and characteristic sand industry planning method and system for efficiently utilizing precipitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic desertification control and characteristic sand industry planning method and system for efficiently utilizing precipitation, and relates to the technical field of photovoltaic desertification control, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting data of a target area, designing a precipitation collection guide system of a photovoltaic board foundation based on the collected data, and maximizing collection and utilization of water resources; the method comprises the steps of collecting water resources by a precipitation collecting and guiding system, setting irrigation quota according to water demand of sand-fixing plants and traditional Chinese medicinal materials, selecting and adjusting planting configuration modes of the sand-fixing plants and the traditional Chinese medicinal materials by using the set irrigation quota and field sand-blast observation data, quantitatively analyzing economic output of different vegetation configuration modes and protection effect of vegetation, implementing planning schemes of desert photovoltaic electric field sand control and characteristic sand industry according to analysis results, and monitoring and evaluating implementation results. The invention improves the survival rate and biomass of vegetation in arid areas, effectively improves the sand fixing capability and ecological restoration effect of the desert photovoltaic electric field, and increases the economic benefit of sand industry.
assignees: HUANENG JIUQUAN WIND POWER CO LTD

title_en: Scenic region whole process planning management method and system based on GIS platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landscape area whole process planning management method and system based on a GIS platform, the method comprises the steps of raw data acquisition, data preliminary processing, ecological risk area discrimination, planning management optimization and scenic region planning management.
