title_en: Intelligence magnetic flux stay rope shock absorption support
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligence magnetic flux stay rope shock absorption support contains stay rope shock absorption support and sensing system. Stay rope shock absorption support includes lower base, upward bedplate, cable, wire rope press from both sides, every cable passes the pore in bedplate and the lower base, then closes through the wire rope clip and close grommet of formation. Sensing system includes the magnetic flow level sensor of measuring rope power, the foil gage and the signal transmission line of pressure measurement power. The utility model discloses a magnetic flow level sensor's of installation measuring rope power mode on the cable of support can realize cutting the force measurement to calamity effect undersettings such as earthquakes, through the foil gage of the vertical pressure of the survey support of the lower pedestal mounting at the support, can realize support vertical load's measurement. The utility model discloses but the risk of not only early warning support emergence of the bridge overload circumstances under the normal operation situation can also be come temporarily in calamity effect (like earthquake disaster ), thereby can confirm the earthquake that the structure receives through cable suo li acquisition support shear force in the monitoring support and react, conveniently shakes quick aassessment of axle casing state and restoration.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI;LIUZHOU OVM STRUCTURE INSPECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Traditional rammed earth building repair structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a traditional rammed earth building restoration structure, which can effectively improve the mechanical property of rammed earth building wall surface through three soil layers; the integrity and the strength of the wall body can be enhanced through the arrangement of the wire netting; the repaired building has waterproof property through the waterproof layer; the technical effects of enhancing the earthquake resistance of the building and keeping the integral structure of the house stable can be achieved by arranging the counterfort columns; can strengthen the wholeness in house through the cuff, can practice thrift the cost and reach the anti shear force effect, the cuff also can play the reinforcing action to the vertical crack that link up of wall body simultaneously.

title_en: Multidirectional energy-consuming bridge damping support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multidirectional power consumption bridge damping support belongs to bridge construction technical field. The multidirectional energy-consuming bridge damping support comprises an upper connecting plate and a lower connecting plate, wherein the upper connecting plate is connected with the lower connecting plate through a connecting rod, a connector is arranged at the upper end of the connecting rod, a cantilever plate is arranged at the upper end of the connector, and a slide rail inner core is arranged at the upper end of the cantilever plate; the sliding rail is characterized in that a sliding plate is arranged above the sliding rail inner core, a sliding rail is fixed on the lower surface of the sliding plate, and the sliding rail inner core is connected with the sliding rail. The utility model can complete the restoration of the whole support function by replacing the connecting rod, improve the maintenance convenience of the support, save the maintenance cost of the support and ensure the safety and stability of the whole bridge; and vertical vibration and horizontal vibration can be resisted simultaneously under the action of earthquakes with different strengths, so that the energy consumption capacity is sufficient, and the earthquake energy can be effectively consumed.

title_en: Geological hidden danger point monitoring method and system considering heavy rainfall disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power disaster prevention and reduction, in particular to a geological hidden danger point monitoring method and system considering heavy rainfall disasters. The method and the system creatively realize the function of warning the influence level of the geological disaster, overcome the difficult problems that scientific calculation and visual display are difficult, and the influence of the geological disaster caused by heavy rainfall on the power transmission and distribution facilities is difficult, accurately reflect the monitoring data such as the displacement, the inclination angle and the like of the power transmission and distribution facilities, and support a production monitoring command center to guide the development of emergency work such as load transfer, facility reinforcement, emergency repair and restoration and the like.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF GUANGXI POWER GRID LIMITED RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Ecological restoration technology for river system in mountain gorge valley area
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological restoration technology aiming at a river system in a mountain gorge valley area, which comprises river bed management measures, bank slope protection measures and river flood beach restoration measures, wherein the river bed management measures are used for longitudinally managing a river bed by constructing a ladder system; the bank slope protection measures adopt a fiber roll foreign soil planting method to establish a arbor zone parallel to a river bank line; the river flood restoration measures imitate natural forms to trim the river flood into sand waves, the gabion is utilized to buffer flood impact, and the river flood ecological restoration species are designed according to ecological investigation results. The technology can weaken water flow erosion power to stabilize a river course, control loss of fine materials on a flood plain, promote soil quality improvement of the flood plain, accelerate ecological system restoration of the flood plain, improve local microclimate environment and comprehensively improve ecological service functions of a river system. The invention also specifically provides a calculation method of the ladder system and the sand wave design parameters, and the stability and the persistence of ecological restoration of the river system are ensured.

title_en: Offshore wind power black start path recovery processing method and equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a method and equipment for recovering a black start path of offshore wind power. The method comprises the steps of determining black start capability scores of wind turbines by adopting a gray multi-attribute decision method according to working attributes of the wind turbines, constructing a path recovery objective function of the offshore wind turbines according to the black start capability scores of the wind turbines, determining shortest recovery paths under different wind turbines recovery sequences by adopting a Floride algorithm, and calculating to obtain a black start path of a target offshore wind turbine by adopting a genetic algorithm according to the shortest recovery paths under different wind turbines recovery sequences and the path recovery objective function, wherein the black start path of the target offshore wind turbine is the black start path with the shortest electrical distance and the largest total power generation amount. The method shortens the black start recovery time of the offshore wind power and improves the toughness of the power grid.
assignees: SANXIA NEW ENERGY NANTONG CO LTD;THREE GORGES NEW ENERGY RUDONG CO LTD

title_en: Ecological integrity-based water ecological health evaluation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological health evaluation method based on ecological integrity and application thereof, wherein an evaluation index system is divided into a target layer, a criterion layer, an element layer and an index layer, different types of indexes are subjected to differential standard determination method based on ecological integrity, a core index is subjected to quantitative and qualitative analysis by adopting a method combining an entropy weight method and a analytic hierarchy process, and finally the health condition of an water ecological system is displayed in a pattern marking and color partition mode which is easy to understand. In conclusion, the method can comprehensively, scientifically and accurately evaluate the health state of the water ecological system, is beneficial to promoting the water ecological assessment, and provides scientific basis for water ecological management and restoration.

title_en: Electric bus cooperative scheduling method for improving toughness of power distribution-traffic system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution-traffic system toughness improvement-oriented electric bus cooperative scheduling method, which relates to the field of power distribution networks, considers the electric power-traffic dual attribute of electric buses, and is based on cooperation between the operation requirements of the power distribution networks and traffic networks after disaster and cooperation between power supply and evacuation multitasks of the electric buses, the cooperative multitasking scheduling model of the electric buses for power restoration and trapped people evacuation after the disaster of the power distribution-traffic system is constructed, the application value of the electric buses in the aspect of comprehensive toughness improvement of the coupling system is fully excavated, and the calculation method of partitioning and routing is adopted, so that the high-efficiency and accurate solving of the proposed model is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Power grid node recovery importance assessment method, system, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of large power grid recovery, and discloses a power grid node recovery importance evaluation method, a system, a device and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a power failure area of a power grid based on acquired power grid monitoring state data, dividing the power failure area by a dynamic partitioning method and obtaining a plurality of parallel recovery partitions; and for the nodes to be recovered in the recovery partitions, carrying out importance evaluation on the recovery nodes according to the multidimensional index of the nodes to be recovered. According to the invention, the importance of the power generation nodes and the non-power generation nodes are unified to the expected recovery income, so that unified sequencing of the power generation nodes and the non-power generation nodes is realized, the problem that the traditional method relies on manually appointed unit recovery priority is avoided, and a good foundation is laid for subsequent recovery decision optimization.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Pumped storage power station side slope ecological restoration method and system based on near-natural concept
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pumped storage power station side slope ecological restoration method and system based on a near natural concept, and relates to the field of ecological restoration, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the landform characteristics of a current pumped storage power station side slope and analyzing to obtain a characteristic factor sequence, obtaining the geographic position of the pumped storage power station side slope and generating a virtual model proportionally; screening plant materials in a plant material library according to the current demand condition and the characteristic factor sequence to obtain target plant materials, marking the target plant materials in a virtual model, generating a sowing strategy, simulating plant material growth vigor in the virtual model, recording virtual plant material growth vigor conditions under different periods, collecting the current plant material growth vigor conditions of a pumped storage power station side slope, comparing and analyzing the current plant material growth vigor conditions with the virtual plant material growth vigor conditions under the same period to obtain the ecological restoration evaluation of the pumped storage power station side slope, and adjusting the sowing strategy according to the ecological restoration evaluation of the pumped storage power station side slope and performing current remediation.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Power failure cause tracing and restoration decision method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a power failure cause tracing and recovering decision method and a system, belonging to the technical field of intelligent operation and fault processing of a power system; the method comprises the steps of constructing a power grid GIS topological graph, generating an extreme weather fault sample through a TC-GAN topological constraint based on the power grid GIS topological graph and power distribution network operation data, analyzing a causal chain of a voltage event and a work order text of an intelligent ammeter by adopting an artificial intelligent large model based on the TC-GAN generated extreme weather fault sample, outputting a root cause probability distribution matrix, dynamically deducting a fault propagation path through a TV-GNN time-varying graph neural network based on the power grid GIS topological graph and the root cause probability distribution matrix, generating a node risk coefficient thermodynamic diagram, generating a layered recovery strategy through reinforcement learning based on the node risk coefficient thermodynamic diagram, checking the safety of the layered recovery strategy through an embedded N-1 rule base, and issuing if the check is passed.

title_en: Construction method for disaster recovery of river-approaching Gao Douge binded retaining wall foundation undercut
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method for disaster recovery of a river-passing Gao Douge binded retaining wall foundation undercut, and belongs to the technical field of water conservancy and hydropower bank slope water-passing maintenance engineering construction technology. The construction method for disaster recovery of the river Gao Douge binded retaining wall foundation undercut is convenient to construct and operate, and can remarkably improve stability and safety of disaster recovery parts. The construction method comprises the steps of firstly adopting tetrahedral strings to enclose a shoal construction area comprising undercut disaster areas in a high-speed water flow river channel in a dead water period, then erecting concrete casting templates with narrow outside and wide inside in the shoal construction area, then filling block stones in the shoal construction area on two sides of the concrete casting templates, casting cavity concrete of an emptying disaster area based on filling block stones and casting concrete of the block stone filling area, and finally obtaining a temporary Gao Douge bine cage retaining wall restoration foundation comprising tetrahedral string enclosing structures, concrete casting templates, cavity concrete of the emptying disaster area and concrete of the block stone filling area through maintenance.

title_en: Embedded piping structure, pile structural body, and application method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an embedded piping structure including a pile structural body suitably used for restoration of water supply pipes, fire extinguishing facilities, and the like in an earthquake, the pile structural body, and a method for applying the pile structural body into ground.  <P>SOLUTION: The pile structural body 220 included in the embedded piping structure 200 includes an intake 222 arranged near embedded piping (206, 208, 210) and taking fluid therein, an internal channel leading fluid flowing in from the intake 222, a discharge opening 302b provided at a head part 300 of the pile structural body and discharging fluid flowing in the internal channel to an outside of the pile structural body, an earthquake sensing structure 350 detecting vibration of set intensity or higher, and a light emitting means 350 emitting light in response to detection of vibration by the earthquake sensing mechanism. The embedded piping structure 200 also includes an external channel forming means 224 surrounding embedded piping and forming an external channel G leading fluid leaking from the embedded piping to the intake of the pile structural body.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Game machine
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To cause no trouble even when a plurality of variable display games are simultaneously executed in a game machine.SOLUTION: The game machine can make both of a first variable display game by first control means and a second variable display game by second control means to a currently-executing state; when one variable display game out of the first variable display game and second variable display game turns out a winning result mode, interrupts the other variable display game; when a prescribed game state that is produced when the one variable display game turns out a winning result mode, is terminated, restarts the other variable display game; and when power outage occurs during the interruption of the other variable display game and then the power is restored, transmits to performance control means, an interruption command representing that the other variable display game is currently interrupted, before execution control of any variable display game is started on and after the power restoration.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 109

title_en: System and method for restoring service in power system
abstract_en: A system and method for restoring service within an electrical power system is disclosed. The method may include identifying a restoration path for a blackout area within a power system, selecting a mobile energy resource connection site electrically connected to at least one of the restoration path and the blackout area, sending power injection requests to a plurality of mobile energy resources, at least some of which may be neighboring connection sites, receiving power injection grants from participants in the plurality of mobile energy resources, and implementing the restoration path. The system may include a processor and a computer-readable storage medium having a plurality of machine-readable instructions embedded thereon and configured to perform the method by the processor.

title_en: Based on the distribution network failure restoration methods that DBCC optimized algorithms and entropy weight are theoretical
abstract_en: A kind of distribution network failure restoration methods theoretical based on DBCC optimized algorithms and entropy weight, methods described considers constraints and the fault recovery the objectives structure distribution network failure Restoration model that system should meet, fault recovery optimal case is obtained using DBCC algorithms.During DBCC Optimized Iteratives, using the theoretical entropy weight for obtaining the objectives in fault recovery model of entropy weight, the weight using the entropy weight as each target in each iteration of DBCC, the optimal speeds of DBCC algorithms is improved.Fault recovery model commonality is strong in the present invention, can be directly embedded into current electric company's fault recovery software, easy to utilize, has the advantages that calculating speed is fast, and convergence is strong in combination with the theoretical DBCC algorithms of entropy weight.

title_en: Virtual card power restoration instruction transmission method and device based on digital token
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual card power restoration instruction transmission method and a virtual card power restoration instruction transmission device based on a digital token, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the power restoration instruction generating module generates a remote power restoration instruction; the digital token encryption module encrypts the remote power restoration instruction and the encryption transmission key and generates a ciphertext digital token; the digital token sending module converts the ciphertext digital token into a two-dimensional code digital token and sends the two-dimensional code digital token to a power user; the power utilization user displays the two-dimensional code digital token on a complex call terminal; the complex power terminal restores the two-dimension code digital token into the ciphertext digital token and sends the ciphertext digital token to a security chip in the terminal; the safety chip restores the ciphertext digital token into the remote power restoration instruction; and the power recovery terminal sends the remote power recovery instruction to the intelligent charge control electric energy meter, and the intelligent charge control electric energy meter completes authentication and power recovery operation. In the implementation of the invention, convenient and quick power restoration service is provided.

title_en: Ecological space optimization and function improvement method for river wetland
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological space optimization and function improvement method for a river wetland, and belongs to the technical field of river treatment. Determining and analyzing the space structure of the current river to obtain the area proportion occupied by different river structures; determining the flow capacity of the river and analyzing the current flood discharge capacity of the river; on the basis of the section of the river channel, taking an earthwork balance principle, flood carrying capacity and beach water flooding duration and depth as calculation bases, analyzing by using a dichotomy, respectively determining the excavation position of the river channel, the excavation depth, a vertical dredging space and a dredging volume, and optimizing a river beach wetland; and analyzing the space structure area, the proportion condition and the ecological space change of the river channel before and after optimization respectively, and evaluating the ecological space optimization scheme of the river channel. The invention optimizes and treats the cross section of the river based on the comprehensive consideration of the structure and the function of the river system, realizes the improvement of the ecological function and the environmental optimization of the river, and provides references for the restoration protection and the function improvement of the river wetland in China and the flood control and disaster reduction of the area.

title_en: Disaster recovery collaborated with storage system and backup appliance in hybrid cloud environment
abstract_en: Example implementations described herein are directed to backup and restore of a public cloud and data center for disaster recovery. In a backup process of the disaster recovery, the VM root device information (a public cloud) and storage system volume information (a data center) in a main site are transferred to the disaster recovery tool. In a restoration process, the DR Tool specifies the storage system volume for backup to attach the VM in a backup site with the above information.

title_en: The composition that there is a kind of pair of crop the transfer of degeneration-resistant potential and root cap to promote pressure function
abstract_en: The present invention provides the composition that a kind of pair of crop promotees pressure function with the transfer of degeneration-resistant potential and root cap, it delays component, the plant growth containing α-naphthylacetic acid that component and the degeneration-resistant growth promotion component of crop is promoted to compound by the plant growth containing choline chloride；Choline chloride and α-naphthylacetic acid mass ratio are 0.1~20:0.01~3；The degeneration-resistant growth promotion component of crop is made of trace-element fertilizer, salicylic acid, glycine betaine and humic acid, and secondary and micro-element fertilizers form and at least account for the 9wt% of the degeneration-resistant growth promotion component of crop by zinc fertilizer, boron fertilizer, molydbenum fertilizer and manganese fertilizer compounding.Composition of the invention, which can integrate, promotes crop to abiotic stresses, such as arid, high temperature, Low temperature disaster degeneration-resistant potential, its effect, which is not only shown, makes crop adapt to physiology water shortage environment, reduces stress damage, is also manifested by the rapid restoration ecosystem of adverse environmental factor disappearance ensuing crop.
assignees: INST OF ENVIRONMENT AND SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT IN AGRICULTURE CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIEN

title_en: Direct-current power distribution network reliability assessment method considering source-load uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a direct-current power distribution network reliability assessment method considering source-load uncertainty, which relates to the field of direct-current power distribution systems, and aims at two operation modes of direct-current power distribution network grid connection and island, and calculates the system side power grid fault rate and the restoration rate of each load point of a direct-current power distribution network in the grid connection operation mode based on a network equivalence method; and calculating a sufficiency conversion rate parameter considering uncertainty of a power supply and a load during the operation of the island, a mechanical fault parameter of the distributed power supply and a starting switching parameter of the island system. Finally, two operation modes are combined, and a Markov model is adopted to calculate the reliability index of the direct-current power distribution network. The method can account for the uncertainty of the power supply and the load, and the influence of the topological structure of the grid frame and equipment factors on the reliability of the direct current distribution network; the dynamic matching relation between the distributed power supply and the load demand in the island operation is fully considered, the influence of source-load uncertainty on the reliability evaluation of the direct current distribution network can be more accurately reflected, and the method has good accuracy.
assignees: UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Power outage and restoration detection for multi-meter nodes in a mesh network
abstract_en: A system is provided for detecting a power condition change, such as a power outage or power restoration, at a multi-meter node associated with a power distribution network. For example, a multi-meter node associated with an electricity distribution network may be configured to detect a power state change event occurring at the node, such as a power outage event or a power restoration event. Based on the type of event, the communication module of the multi-meter node identifies meters contained in the multi-meter node that are affected by the event, such as meters that become unpowered due to a power outage event or meters that become powered due to a power restoration event. The communication module generates a consolidated power state change message for the affected meter and transmits the message to the head-end system over the mesh network.

title_en: Water bloom early warning method, device, equipment and medium based on water quality monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration of rivers and lakes, and discloses a water bloom early warning method, device, equipment and medium based on water quality monitoring.

title_en: River ecological water storage restoration system and restoration method
abstract_en: The invention provides a river ecological water storage restoration system and a restoration method, wherein the river ecological water storage restoration system comprises a water storage ditch, a filtering weir and a wetland bubble, the water storage ditch is arranged at the bottom of a river channel, the bottom of the water storage ditch is provided with first vegetation and a first pebble layer, the filtering weir is arranged perpendicular to the trend of the river channel, the wetland bubble is arranged at the bottom of the river channel and communicated with the water storage ditch, the wetland bubble is internally provided with second vegetation, and the wetland bubble is used for water storage. According to the river ecological water storage restoration system provided by the invention, the water level can be stored in the dead water period by combining the water storage ditch with the wetland bubble, the river cut-off is avoided on the premise of not influencing the river flood-passing function, the diversity of the ecological system is kept by arranging the first vegetation and the second vegetation, the water storage ditch can form various complex water conservancy conditions such as rapid flow, slow flow and the like, the wetland bubble has an impurity precipitation function, the filter weir can form a filter effect, and the river ecological restoration system has a good purification effect on aquatic plants and microorganisms, so that the river water quality is improved, and meanwhile, the ecological diversity of the river is enriched.

title_en: Excavation downhill slag slide pile body slope zoning grading durable control method
abstract_en: The application discloses a regional and hierarchical durable control method for a side slope of an excavation downhill slag pile, which belongs to the technical field of geological disaster management and ecological restoration, the method comprises the steps of firstly carrying out detailed investigation on the excavated side slope of a collapse pile to obtain basic data, then carrying out overall and local stability evaluation according to the basic data and the actual condition of the side slope, and obtaining the overall and local stable states of the excavated slope, classifying the excavated slope according to the deformation damage characteristics and the stable states in a partitioning way, integrating the partitioning and classifying results, and finally, formulating corresponding geological disaster management and ecological restoration schemes based on the partitioning and classifying comprehensive results. Aiming at the characteristics Shi Ce of different areas and grades of slopes, the method organically combines geological disaster management and ecological restoration, can improve the stability of the slopes, reduce the risk of collapse and landslide, ensure engineering safety, promote ecological protection and recovery, reduce the negative influence of disasters on surrounding ecology, realize win-win of engineering construction and ecological protection, and lay a foundation for sustainable development.

title_en: Gas shutoff restoration determination system
abstract_en: To provide a gas meter and a gas shutoff restoration determination system capable of streamlining recovery operations while ensuring the safety of the entire gas infrastructure, including gas meters.SOLUTION: The gas meter includes: a flow rate measurement unit that is provided in a flow path through which gas flows to be supplied to gas appliances installed in a home of a customer to measure a flow rate of gas passing through the flow path; a self-diagnosis unit that performs self-diagnosis; a vibration detection unit that detects vibrations; a calculation unit that calculates an earthquake index value representing the magnitude of the earthquake based on the detected vibrations by the vibration detection unit; a shut-off unit that is configured so as to, when the earthquake index value is equal to or greater than a specified value, switch the flow path from an open state allowing gas to flow, to a closed state blocking gas flow through the flow path; and a recovery method determination unit that is configured so as to, when the shut-off unit gets into the closed state, determine a recovery method of the shut-off unit from a closed state to an open state based on the diagnosis result by the self-diagnosis unit and the earthquake index value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: Multi-threaded server control automation for disaster recovery
abstract_en: Systems and methods for multi-threaded server control automation for disaster recovery are described. A method may include initiating a disaster recovery sequence on two or more processors, wherein the disaster recovery sequence comprises a plurality of subsequences. The method may also include implementing the disaster recovery sequence on the two or more processors in parallel, wherein one or more subsequences of the disaster recovery sequence are implemented on the two or more processors in parallel. Upon completion of the disaster recovery sequence, at least one server partition is repurposed from a first configuration, such as a test configuration, to a second configuration, such as a production configuration.

title_en: System and method for monitoring quantitative and qualitative environmental analytics and managing associated transactions
abstract_en: A system and method for using financial instruments to provide investment incentive to fund disaster mitigation projects and/or ecosystem restoration projects triggered by real world events detected at set points by sensors and analyzed by computing devices. The detection of events results in the computational analysis and determination of a characteristics of a resilience bond or ecosystem-service bond to be issued or returned to investors. Examples involve sensors used to detect events, including flood damage mitigation, earthquake damage mitigation, or air quality improvement. In one preferred embodiment of the disclosure an investor may make an initial payment into a financial instrument being a resilience bond used to fund a mitigation project, said financial instrument pays phases to the mitigation project developer at the completion of phases of the project that occur prior to the occurrence of a disaster.

title_en: Method for plugging water in pit slope footrill
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for plugging water on an open pit side slope, which belongs to the technical field of mine facilities, comprehensively adopts multi-level measures such as retaining walls, waterproof cloth, dike protection, plant ecological systems and the like to ensure that an excellent waterproof effect is realized under extreme hydrologic conditions, effectively reduces the risks of water invasion and soil erosion, passes engineering means such as bearing columns, pile foundations, anchoring treatment and the like, enhances the stability of a footbed structure, reduces the potential risks of geological landslide and soil settlement, ensures the sustainability and safety of the pit side slope, ensures that amphibious plants adopted in the method not only play a role in waterproof aspects, but also provide important habitats for ecological systems, improves vegetation coverage and wild animal and plant habitat, is beneficial to ecological restoration and protection, has lower construction cost of the whole scheme, does not need subsequent maintenance operation, and has high construction flexibility.

title_en: Self-resetting steel frame beam-column joint with hidden staged energy dissipation damper
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a hidden stage power consumption attenuator from restoring to throne steel frame beam column node, including steel frame post, steel frame roof beam, bracket, stage power consumption attenuator, prestressing tendons and adapting unit. Bracket one end welds in steel frame post side, and the other end passes through upper junction plate, lower connecting plate, high strength bolted connection with the steel frame roof beam. The staged energy dissipation damper is formed by welding an upper connecting plate, a lower connecting plate and a plurality of X-shaped soft steel sheets with clear sizes. The damper is connected between the bracket and the steel frame beam through high-strength bolts, and the X-shaped steel sheets are subjected to stage yielding and energy consumption under different load effects. The prestressed tendons are arranged along the length direction of the beam to meet the functional requirements under the normal use condition, and meanwhile, the restoring force is provided, so that the node has the self-resetting capability after the earthquake. The utility model discloses the simple structure, and mostly bolted connection can realize the assembly.
